sanskrit_iast:
bhedo jalānāṃ loke'sminpratibhāve'vicārataḥ |
evamāhustathā cānye sarve vedārthatattvagāḥ ||
meaning:
भेदो जलानां लोकेऽस्मिन्प्रतिभावेऽविचारतः |
एवमाहुस्तथा चान्ये सर्वे वेदार्थतत्त्वगाः ||
text_mt: The difference between waters in this world [is perceived] without reflection in [each] appearance; / so say all the others who have arrived at the truth of the Vedic meaning.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdi saṃsāriṇaḥ sākṣātsakalaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
iti vijñānayuktasya kiṃ tasya pratimādibhiḥ ||
meaning:
हृदि संसारिणः साक्षात्सकलः परमेश्वरः |
इति विज्ञानयुक्तस्य किं तस्य प्रतिमादिभिः ||
text_mt: In the heart of the transmigrating soul, Parameśvara is directly present with parts. / For one endowed with such discernment, what need is there for images and the like?

sanskrit_iast:
iti vijñānahīnasya pratimākalpanā śubhā |
padamuccaiḥ samāroḍhuṃ puṃso hyālambanaṃ smṛtam ||
meaning:
इति विज्ञानहीनस्य प्रतिमाकल्पना शुभा |
पदमुच्चैः समारोढुं पुंसो ह्यालम्बनं स्मृतम् ||
text_mt: For one lacking such discernment, the making of an image is auspicious; / it is taught as a support for a person to ascend to the high station.

sanskrit_iast:
ālambanaṃ vinā tasya padamuccaiḥ suduṣkaram |
nirguṇaprāptaye nṝṇāṃ pratimālambanaṃ smṛtam ||
meaning:
आलम्बनं विना तस्य पदमुच्चैः सुदुष्करम् |
निर्गुणप्राप्तये नॄणां प्रतिमालम्बनं स्मृतम् ||
text_mt: Without a support, the high station is very difficult for him to reach; / an image is taught as a support for men to attain the attribute-less.

sanskrit_iast:
saguṇānnirguṇaprāptirbhavatīti suniścitam |
evaṃ ca sarvadevānāṃ pratimā pratyayāvahā ||
meaning:
सगुणान्निर्गुणप्राप्तिर्भवतीति सुनिश्चितम् |
एवं च सर्वदेवानां प्रतिमा प्रत्ययावहा ||
text_mt: The attainment of the attribute-less comes from the endowed with attributes: this is quite certain. / And thus, the image of all deities brings conviction.

sanskrit_iast:
devaścāyaṃ mahīyānvai tasyārthe pūjanaṃ tvidam |
gandhacandanapuṣpādi kimarthaṃ pratimāṃ vinā ||
meaning:
देवश्चायं महीयान्वै तस्यार्थे पूजनं त्विदम् |
गन्धचन्दनपुष्पादि किमर्थं प्रतिमां विना ||
text_mt: This god is truly exalted; this worship is for his sake. / For what purpose would fragrances, sandalwood, flowers, and the like be, without an image?

sanskrit_iast:
tāvacca pratimā pūjyā yāvadvijñānasambhavaḥ |
jñānābhāve na pūjyeta patanaṃ tasya niścitam ||
meaning:
तावच्च प्रतिमा पूज्या यावद्विज्ञानसम्भवः |
ज्ञानाभावे न पूज्येत पतनं तस्य निश्चितम् ||
text_mt: An image is to be worshiped as long as discernment has not arisen; / in the absence of knowledge, if it is not worshiped, one's fall is certain.

sanskrit_iast:
etasmātkāraṇādviprāḥ śrūyatāṃ paramārthataḥ |
svajātyuktaṃ tu yatkarma kartavyaṃ tatprayatnataḥ ||
meaning:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्विप्राः श्रूयतां परमार्थतः |
स्वजात्युक्तं तु यत्कर्म कर्तव्यं तत्प्रयत्नतः ||
text_mt: For this reason, O brahmins, listen to the ultimate truth: / the duty prescribed for one's own caste must be performed with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra yatra yathā bhaktiḥ kartavyaṃ pūjanādikam |
vinā pūjanadānādi pātakaṃ na ca dūrataḥ ||
meaning:
यत्र यत्र यथा भक्तिः कर्तव्यं पूजनादिकम् |
विना पूजनदानादि पातकं न च दूरतः ||
text_mt: Wherever and however one has devotion, worship and the like must be done. / Without worship, giving, and the like, sin is not removed far away.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvacca pātakaṃ dehe tāvatsiddhirna jāyate |
gate ca pātake tasya sarvaṃ ca saphalaṃ bhavet ||
meaning:
यावच्च पातकं देहे तावत्सिद्धिर्न जायते |
गते च पातके तस्य सर्वं च सफलं भवेत् ||
text_mt: As long as sin remains in the body, so long does attainment not arise; / and when sin has departed, everything of his becomes fruitful.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ca maline vastre raṅgaḥ śubhataro na hi |
kṣālane hi kṛte śuddhe sarvo raṅgaḥ prasajjate ||
meaning:
तथा च मलिने वस्त्रे रङ्गः शुभतरो न हि |
क्षालने हि कृते शुद्धे सर्वो रङ्गः प्रसज्जते ||
text_mt: Likewise, dye does not take well on a dirty cloth; / indeed, when washing is done and it is clean, all dye adheres well.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ca nirmale dehe devānāṃ samyagarcayā |
jñānaraṅgaḥ prajāyeta tadā vijñānasambhavaḥ ||
meaning:
तथा च निर्मले देहे देवानां सम्यगर्चया |
ज्ञानरङ्गः प्रजायेत तदा विज्ञानसम्भवः ||
text_mt: Likewise, in a spotless body through the proper worship of the deities, / the dye of knowledge will arise; then the emergence of discernment occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
vijñānasya ca sanmūlaṃ bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī |
jñānasyāpi ca sanmūlaṃ bhaktirevā'bhidhīyate ||
meaning:
विज्ञानस्य च सन्मूलं भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी |
ज्ञानस्यापि च सन्मूलं भक्तिरेवाऽभिधीयते ||
text_mt: The true root of discernment is unswerving devotion; / devotion alone is said to be the true root of knowledge as well.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktermūlaṃ tu satkarma sveṣṭadevādipūjanam |
tanmūlaṃ sadguruḥ proktastanmūlaṃ saṅgatiḥ satām ||
saṅgatyā gururāpyeta gurormantrādipūjanam |
pūjanājjāyate bhaktirbhaktyā jñānaṃ prajāyate ||
meaning:
भक्तेर्मूलं तु सत्कर्म स्वेष्टदेवादिपूजनम् |
तन्मूलं सद्गुरुः प्रोक्तस्तन्मूलं सङ्गतिः सताम् ||
सङ्गत्या गुरुराप्येत गुरोर्मन्त्रादिपूजनम् |
पूजनाज्जायते भक्तिर्भक्त्या ज्ञानं प्रजायते ||
text_mt:
The root of devotion is right action, the worship of one’s chosen deity and the like; / its root is said to be the true guru; its root is association with the good.

Through association, the guru is obtained; from the guru comes worship with mantras and the like; / from worship arises devotion, and from devotion knowledge is born.

sanskrit_iast:
vijñānaṃ jāyate jñānātparabrahmaprakāśakam |
vijñānaṃ ca yadā jātaṃ tadā bhedo nivartate ||
meaning:
विज्ञानं जायते ज्ञानात्परब्रह्मप्रकाशकम् |
विज्ञानं च यदा जातं तदा भेदो निवर्तते ||
text_mt: From knowledge discernment is born, illuminating the supreme Brahman; / and when discernment has arisen, differentiation ceases.

sanskrit_iast:
bhede nivṛtte sakale dvandvaduḥkhavihīnatā |
dvandvaduḥkhavihīnastu śivarūpo bhavatyasau ||
meaning:
भेदे निवृत्ते सकले द्वन्द्वदुःखविहीनता |
द्वन्द्वदुःखविहीनस्तु शिवरूपो भवत्यसौ ||
text_mt: When all differentiation has ceased, there is freedom from the suffering of the dualities; / and free from the suffering of the dualities, he becomes of the form of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
dvandvāprāptau na jāyetāṃ sukhaduḥkhe vijānataḥ |
vihitāvihite tasya na syātāṃ ca surarṣayaḥ ||
meaning:
द्वन्द्वाप्राप्तौ न जायेतां सुखदुःखे विजानतः |
विहिताविहिते तस्य न स्यातां च सुरर्षयः ||
text_mt: When the dualities are not encountered, pleasure and pain do not arise for the one who knows; / for him there are no prescribed or prohibited acts, O divine sages.

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛśo viralo loke gṛhāśramavivarjitaḥ |
yadi loke bhavatyasmindarśanātpāpahārakaḥ ||
meaning:
ईदृशो विरलो लोके गृहाश्रमविवर्जितः |
यदि लोके भवत्यस्मिन्दर्शनात्पापहारकः ||
text_mt: Such a person, free from the householder stage of life, is rare in the world; / if he is present in this world, he removes sins merely by sight.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthāni ślāghayantīha tādṛśaṃ jñānavittamam |
devāśca munayaḥ sarve parabrahmātmakaṃ śivam ||
meaning:
तीर्थानि श्लाघयन्तीह तादृशं ज्ञानवित्तमम् |
देवाश्च मुनयः सर्वे परब्रह्मात्मकं शिवम् ||
text_mt: Tīrthas praise such a person most distinguished in knowledge here, / and all the gods and sages [praise him as] Śiva, consisting of the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
tādṛśāni na tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ |
te punantyurukālena vijñānī darśanādapi ||
meaning:
तादृशानि न तीर्थानि न देवा मृच्छिलामयाः |
ते पुनन्त्युरुकालेन विज्ञानी दर्शनादपि ||
text_mt: Tīrthas are not such, nor are deities made of clay or stone; / they purify over a long time, but the discerning person purifies even by sight.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadgṛhāśrame tiṣṭhettāvadākārapūjanam |
kuryācchreṣṭhasya suprītyā sureṣu khalu pañcasu ||
meaning:
यावद्गृहाश्रमे तिष्ठेत्तावदाकारपूजनम् |
कुर्याच्छ्रेष्ठस्य सुप्रीत्या सुरेषु खलु पञ्चसु ||
text_mt: As long as one remains in the householder stage of life, so long should one perform worship with form, / with great affection, of the preeminent one among the five gods.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā ca śivaḥ pūjyo mūlamekaṃ viśiṣyate |
mūle sikte tathā śākhāḥ tṛptāḥ satyakhilāḥ surāḥ ||
meaning:
अथवा च शिवः पूज्यो मूलमेकं विशिष्यते |
मूले सिक्ते तथा शाखाः तृप्ताः सत्यखिलाः सुराः ||
text_mt: Or Śiva should be worshiped: the single root is distinguished. / When the root is watered, all the branches, the gods, are satisfied.

sanskrit_iast:
śākhāsu ca sutṛptāsu mūlaṃ tṛptaṃ na karhicit |
evaṃ sarveṣu tṛpteṣu sureṣu munisattamāḥ ||
meaning:
शाखासु च सुतृप्तासु मूलं तृप्तं न कर्हिचित् |
एवं सर्वेषु तृप्तेषु सुरेषु मुनिसत्तमाः ||
text_mt: When the branches are well satisfied, the root is never satisfied; / thus, when all the gods are satisfied, O best of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvathā śivatṛptirno vijñeyā sūkṣmabuddhibhiḥ |
śive ca pūjite devāḥ pūjitāḥ sarva eva hi ||
meaning:
सर्वथा शिवतृप्तिर्नो विज्ञेया सूक्ष्मबुद्धिभिः |
शिवे च पूजिते देवाः पूजिताः सर्व एव हि ||
text_mt: the satisfaction of Śiva is by no means [achieved], as should be understood by those of subtle intellect. / But when Śiva is worshiped, all the gods are worshiped indeed.'

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācca pūjayeddevaṃ śaṅkaraṃ lokaśaṅkaram |
sarvakāmaphalāvāptyai sarvabhūtahite rataḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ prathamaḥ sṛṣṭikhaṇḍaḥ
meaning:
तस्माच्च पूजयेद्देवं शङ्करं लोकशङ्करम् |
सर्वकामफलावाप्त्यै सर्वभूतहिते रतः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां प्रथमः सृष्टिखण्डः
text_mt:
Therefore, devoted to the welfare of all beings, / one should worship god Śaṅkara, who brings welfare to the world, for the attainment of the fruit of all desires.

Thus ends the twelfth chapter, named “The Exposition on Discernment of Essence and Non-Essence” in the description of the rules of worship, in the Sṛṣṭi section of the second part, the Rudrasaṃhitā, of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pūjāvidhimanuttamam |
śrūyatāmṛṣayo devāḥsarvakāmasukhāvaham ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि पूजाविधिमनुत्तमम् |
श्रूयतामृषयो देवाःसर्वकामसुखावहम् ||
title: trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivapūjanavarṇanam
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Beyond this, I shall declare the unsurpassed rite of worship; / let it be heard, O sages and gods, bringing every desire and happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhme muhūrte cotthāya saṃsmaretsāmbakaṃ śivam |
kuryāttatprārthanāṃ bhaktyā sāñjalirnatamastakaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते चोत्थाय संस्मरेत्साम्बकं शिवम् |
कुर्यात्तत्प्रार्थनां भक्त्या साञ्जलिर्नतमस्तकः ||
text_mt: Rising at the brahma-hour, one should remember Śiva accompanied by Ambikā; / with hands folded and head bowed, one should offer a prayer to him with devotion:

sanskrit_iast:
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha deveśa uttiṣṭha hṛdayeśaya |
uttiṣṭha tvamumāsvāminbrahmāṇḍe maṅgalaṃ kuru ||
meaning:
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ देवेश उत्तिष्ठ हृदयेशय |
उत्तिष्ठ त्वमुमास्वामिन्ब्रह्माण्डे मङ्गलं कुरु ||
text_mt: “Arise, arise, O Lord of gods! Arise, O sleeper in the heart! / Arise, O husband of Umā, and bring auspiciousness to the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
jānāmi dharmaṃ na ca me pravṛtti-rjānāmyadharmaṃ na ca me nivṛttiḥ |
tvayā mahādeva hṛdi sthitena yathā niyukto'smi tathā karomi ||
meaning:
जानामि धर्मं न च मे प्रवृत्ति-र्जानाम्यधर्मं न च मे निवृत्तिः |
त्वया महादेव हृदि स्थितेन यथा नियुक्तोऽस्मि तथा करोमि ||
text_mt: I know what is righteous, yet I have no inclination toward it; / I know what is unrighteous, yet I have no turning away from it. / O Mahādeva, stationed within my heart, / as I am impelled by you, so do I act.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā vacanaṃ bhaktyā smṛtvā ca gurupādake |
bahirgaccheddakṣiṇāśāṃ tyāgārthaṃ malamūtrayoḥ ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा वचनं भक्त्या स्मृत्वा च गुरुपादके |
बहिर्गच्छेद्दक्षिणाशां त्यागार्थं मलमूत्रयोः ||
text_mt: Having spoken this prayer with devotion and remembered the feet of one’s guru, / one should go outside toward the southern direction to discharge feces and urine.

sanskrit_iast:
dehaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sa mṛjjalaviśodhanaiḥ |
hastau pādau ca prakṣālya dantadhāvanamācaret ||
meaning:
देहशुद्धिं ततः कृत्वा स मृज्जलविशोधनैः |
हस्तौ पादौ च प्रक्षाल्य दन्तधावनमाचरेत् ||
text_mt: Having then performed the purification of the body through purifications with earth and water, / and having washed both hands and feet, one should clean one’s teeth.

sanskrit_iast:
divānāthe tvanudite kṛtvā vai dantadhāvanam |
mukhaṃ ṣoḍaśavāraṃ tu prakṣālyāñjalibhistathā ||
meaning:
दिवानाथे त्वनुदिते कृत्वा वै दन्तधावनम् |
मुखं षोडशवारं तु प्रक्षाल्याञ्जलिभिस्तथा ||
text_mt: Having cleaned one’s teeth before the sun has risen, / one should rinse the mouth sixteen times with handfuls of water.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhyādyāmāśca tithayo navamyarkadine tathā |
varjyāḥ surarṣayo yatnādbhaktena radadhāvane ||
meaning:
षष्ठ्याद्यामाश्च तिथयो नवम्यर्कदिने तथा |
वर्ज्याः सुरर्षयो यत्नाद्भक्तेन रदधावने ||
text_mt: The lunar days beginning with the sixth, the ninth, and Sundays / are to be diligently avoided for tooth-cleaning by the devotee, O divine sages.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāvakāśaṃ susnāyānnadyādiṣvathavā gṛhe |
deśakālāviruddhaṃ ca snānaṃ kāryaṃ nareṇa ca ||
meaning:
यथावकाशं सुस्नायान्नद्यादिष्वथवा गृहे |
देशकालाविरुद्धं च स्नानं कार्यं नरेण च ||
text_mt: One should bathe well according to opportunity, either in rivers and the like or at home; / a man should perform the bath without contravening place and time.

sanskrit_iast:
raverdine tathā śrāddhe saṅkrāntau grahaṇe tathā |
mahādāne tathā tīrthe hyupavāsadine tathā ||
meaning:
रवेर्दिने तथा श्राद्धे सङ्क्रान्तौ ग्रहणे तथा |
महादाने तथा तीर्थे ह्युपवासदिने तथा ||
text_mt: On a Sunday, at a funeral feast, at a solstice or transit, at an eclipse, / at a great gift, at a sacred place, and on a day of fasting,

sanskrit_iast:
aśauce'pyathavā prāpte na snāyāduṣṇavāriṇā |
yathā sābhimukhaṃ snāyāttīrthādau bhaktimānnaraḥ ||
meaning:
अशौचेऽप्यथवा प्राप्ते न स्नायादुष्णवारिणा |
यथा साभिमुखं स्नायात्तीर्थादौ भक्तिमान्नरः ||
text_mt: or even when ritual impurity has occurred, one should not bathe with hot water; / a devoted man should bathe facing [the sun or water-source] as prescribed at sacred places and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tailābhyaṅgaṃ ca kurvīta vārāndṛṣṭvā krameṇa ca |
nityamabhyaṅgake caiva vāsitaṃ vā na dūṣitam ||
meaning:
तैलाभ्यङ्गं च कुर्वीत वारान्दृष्ट्वा क्रमेण च |
नित्यमभ्यङ्गके चैव वासितं वा न दूषितम् ||
text_mt: One should take an oil bath observing the days of the week in proper order; / in a daily oil application, perfumed [oil] is not defective.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhe ca grahaṇe caivopavāse pratipaddine |
athavā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ na duṣyed grahaṇaṃ vinā ||
meaning:
श्राद्धे च ग्रहणे चैवोपवासे प्रतिपद्दिने |
अथवा सार्षपं तैलं न दुष्येद् ग्रहणं विना ||
text_mt: At a funeral feast, an eclipse, a fast, and on the first lunar day; / or mustard oil is not defective, except during an eclipse.

sanskrit_iast:
deśaṃ kālaṃ vicāryyaivaṃ snānaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi |
uttarābhimukhaścaiva prāṅmukho'pyathavā punaḥ ||
meaning:
देशं कालं विचार्य्यैवं स्नानं कुर्याद्यथाविधि |
उत्तराभिमुखश्चैव प्राङ्मुखोऽप्यथवा पुनः ||
text_mt: Having thus considered place and time, one should bathe according to the rule, / facing north or facing east.

sanskrit_iast:
ucchiṣṭenaiva vastreṇa na snāyātsa kadācana |
śuddhavastreṇa sa snāyāttaddevasmṛtipūrvakam ||
meaning:
उच्छिष्टेनैव वस्त्रेण न स्नायात्स कदाचन |
शुद्धवस्त्रेण स स्नायात्तद्देवस्मृतिपूर्वकम् ||
text_mt: He should never bathe in defiled clothing; / he should bathe in clean clothing, preceded by the remembrance of that deity.

sanskrit_iast:
paradhāryyaṃ ca nocchiṣṭaṃ rātrau ca vidhṛtaṃ ca yat |
tena snānaṃ tathā kāryaṃ kṣālitaṃ ca parityajet ||
meaning:
परधार्य्यं च नोच्छिष्टं रात्रौ च विधृतं च यत् |
तेन स्नानं तथा कार्यं क्षालितं च परित्यजेत् ||
text_mt: A cloth worn by another and not defiled, or one worn at night— / one should bathe with that, and discard it once washed.

sanskrit_iast:
tarpaṇaṃ ca tataḥ kāryaṃ devarṣipitṛtṛptidam |
dhautavastraṃ tato dhāryaṃ punarācamanaṃ caret ||
meaning:
तर्पणं च ततः कार्यं देवर्षिपितृतृप्तिदम् |
धौतवस्त्रं ततो धार्यं पुनराचमनं चरेत् ||
text_mt: Then water-libations should be made, granting satisfaction to gods, sages, and ancestors; / then washed clothing is to be worn, and one should perform sipping of water again.

sanskrit_iast:
śucau deśe tato gatvā gomayādyapamārjite |
āsanaṃ ca śubhaṃ tatra racanīyaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
meaning:
शुचौ देशे ततो गत्वा गोमयाद्यपमार्जिते |
आसनं च शुभं तत्र रचनीयं द्विजोत्तमाः ||
text_mt: Having gone then to a clean place smeared with cow-dung and the like, / an auspicious seat is to be arranged there, O best of twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhakāṣṭhasamutpannaṃ pūrṇaṃ staritameva vā |
citrāsanaṃ tathā kuryātsarvakāmaphalapradam ||
meaning:
शुद्धकाष्ठसमुत्पन्नं पूर्णं स्तरितमेव वा |
चित्रासनं तथा कुर्यात्सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ||
text_mt: Made of clean wood, complete or spread over, / one should prepare a variegated seat that grants the fruit of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāyogyaṃ punargrāhyaṃ mṛgacarmādikaṃ ca yat |
tatropaviśya kurvīta tripuṇḍraṃ bhasmanā sudhīḥ ||
meaning:
यथायोग्यं पुनर्ग्राह्यं मृगचर्मादिकं च यत् |
तत्रोपविश्य कुर्वीत त्रिपुण्ड्रं भस्मना सुधीः ||
text_mt: A deer skin or the like should also be taken as appropriate; / seated there, the wise one should make the tripuṇḍra mark with ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
japastapastathā dānaṃ tripuṇḍrātsaphalaṃ bhavet |
abhāve bhasmanastatra jalasyādi prakīrtitam ||
meaning:
जपस्तपस्तथा दानं त्रिपुण्ड्रात्सफलं भवेत् |
अभावे भस्मनस्तत्र जलस्यादि प्रकीर्तितम् ||
text_mt: Recitation, austerity, and giving become fruitful because of the tripuṇḍra; / in the absence of ashes, water and the like are prescribed there.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā tripuṇḍraṃ ca rudrākṣāndhārayennaraḥ |
sampādya ca svakaṃ karma punarārādhayecchivam ||
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा त्रिपुण्ड्रं च रुद्राक्षान्धारयेन्नरः |
सम्पाद्य च स्वकं कर्म पुनराराधयेच्छिवम् ||
text_mt: Having made the tripuṇḍra in this way, a man should wear rudrākṣa beads; / and having accomplished his own duties, he should again worship Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
punarācamanaṃ kṛtvā trivāraṃ mantrapūrvakam |
ekaṃ vātha prakuryācca gaṅgābinduriti bruvan ||
meaning:
पुनराचमनं कृत्वा त्रिवारं मन्त्रपूर्वकम् |
एकं वाथ प्रकुर्याच्च गङ्गाबिन्दुरिति ब्रुवन् ||
text_mt: Having again sipped water three times preceded by the mantra, / or one should do it once, saying “a drop of Gaṅgā.”

sanskrit_iast:
annodakaṃ tathā tatra śivapūjārthamāharet |
anyadvastu ca yatkiñcidyathāśakti samīpagam ||
meaning:
अन्नोदकं तथा तत्र शिवपूजार्थमाहरेत् |
अन्यद्वस्तु च यत्किञ्चिद्यथाशक्ति समीपगम् ||
text_mt: He should also bring food and water there for the worship of Śiva, / and whatever other item is near at hand, according to his capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā stheyaṃ ca tatraiva dhairyamāsthāya vai punaḥ |
arghapātraṃ tathā caikaṃ jalagandhākṣatairyutam ||
meaning:
कृत्वा स्थेयं च तत्रैव धैर्यमास्थाय वै पुनः |
अर्घपात्रं तथा चैकं जलगन्धाक्षतैर्युतम् ||
text_mt: Having placed [them], he should remain right there, having regained firmness; / likewise, a single offering-vessel containing water, sandal paste, and unbroken grains

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṃse tathā sthāpyamupacārasya klṛptaye |
gurośca smaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tadanujñāmavāpya ca ||
meaning:
दक्षिणांसे तथा स्थाप्यमुपचारस्य क्लृप्तये |
गुरोश्च स्मरणं कृत्वा तदनुज्ञामवाप्य च ||
text_mt: should be placed on the right side for the arrangement of the services; / and having remembered the guru and obtained his permission,

sanskrit_iast:
saṅkalpaṃ vidhivatkṛtvā kāmanāṃ ca niyujya vai |
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā śivaṃ saparivārakam ||
meaning:
सङ्कल्पं विधिवत्कृत्वा कामनां च नियुज्य वै |
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या शिवं सपरिवारकम् ||
text_mt: having duly made the solemn vow and fixed his wish, / he should worship Śiva together with his retinue with supreme devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
mudrāmekāṃ pradarśyaiva pūjayedvighnahārakam |
sindurādipadārthaiśca siddhibuddhisamanvitam ||
meaning:
मुद्रामेकां प्रदर्श्यैव पूजयेद्विघ्नहारकम् |
सिन्दुरादिपदार्थैश्च सिद्धिबुद्धिसमन्वितम् ||
text_mt: Displaying a single hand-gesture, he should worship the remover of obstacles, / accompanied by Siddhi and Buddhi, with red lead and other substances.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣalābhayutaṃ tatra pūjayitvā nametpunaḥ |
caturthyantairnāmapadairnamo'ntaiḥ praṇavādibhiḥ ||
meaning:
लक्षलाभयुतं तत्र पूजयित्वा नमेत्पुनः |
चतुर्थ्यन्तैर्नामपदैर्नमोऽन्तैः प्रणवादिभिः ||
text_mt: Having worshipped him there, accompanied by Lakṣa and Lābha, he should bow again / with names ending in the dative case, ending with “namaḥ,” and preceded by the Praṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamāpyainaṃ tadā devaṃ bhrātrā caiva samanvitam |
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā namaskuryātpunaḥ punaḥ ||
meaning:
क्षमाप्यैनं तदा देवं भ्रात्रा चैव समन्वितम् |
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या नमस्कुर्यात्पुनः पुनः ||
text_mt: Then, having asked forgiveness from that god, who is also accompanied by his brother, / he should worship with supreme devotion and bow down again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārapālaṃ sadā dvāri tiṣṭhantaṃ ca mahodaram |
pūjayitvā tataḥ paścātpūjayedgirijāṃ satīm ||
meaning:
द्वारपालं सदा द्वारि तिष्ठन्तं च महोदरम् |
पूजयित्वा ततः पश्चात्पूजयेद्गिरिजां सतीम् ||
text_mt: Having worshipped Mahodara, the door-keeper who stands ever at the door, / after that he should worship the chaste daughter of the mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
candanaiḥ kuṅkumaiścaiva dhūpairdīpairanekaśaḥ |
naivedyairvividhaiścaiva pūjayitvā tataḥ śivam ||
meaning:
चन्दनैः कुङ्कुमैश्चैव धूपैर्दीपैरनेकशः |
नैवेद्यैर्विविधैश्चैव पूजयित्वा ततः शिवम् ||
text_mt: With sandal pastes, with kumkum, with various incenses and lamps, / and with diverse food offerings, having worshipped [her], then Śiva—

sanskrit_iast:
namaskṛtya punastatra gacchecca śivasannidhau |
yadi gehe pārthivīṃ vā haimīṃ vā rājatīṃ tathā ||
meaning:
नमस्कृत्य पुनस्तत्र गच्छेच्च शिवसन्निधौ |
यदि गेहे पार्थिवीं वा हैमीं वा राजतीं तथा ||
text_mt: having bowed down there again, he should go into the presence of Śiva; / if in the house, he should arrange an earthen, or golden, or silver,

sanskrit_iast:
dhātujanyāṃ tathaivānyāṃ pāradāṃ vā prakalpayet |
namaskṛtya punastāṃ ca pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥ ||
meaning:
धातुजन्यां तथैवान्यां पारदां वा प्रकल्पयेत् |
नमस्कृत्य पुनस्तां च पूजयेद्भक्तितत्परः ||
text_mt: or other [image] made of metal, or one made of quicksilver; / having bowed to it, devoted to devotion, he should worship it.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ tu pūjitāyāṃ vai sarve syuḥ pūjitāstathā |
sthāpayecca mṛdā liṅgaṃ vidhāya vidhipūrvakam ||
meaning:
तस्यां तु पूजितायां वै सर्वे स्युः पूजितास्तथा |
स्थापयेच्च मृदा लिङ्गं विधाय विधिपूर्वकम् ||
text_mt: Indeed, when that is worshipped, all become worshipped; / having made a liṅga of clay according to rule, he should establish it.

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyaṃ sarvathā tatra niyamāḥ svagṛhe sthitaiḥ |
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kurvīta bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāya ca ||
meaning:
कर्तव्यं सर्वथा तत्र नियमाः स्वगृहे स्थितैः |
प्राणप्रतिष्ठां कुर्वीत भूतशुद्धिं विधाय च ||
text_mt: By those residing in their own homes, the observances must be performed in every way; / having performed the purification of elements, he should perform the installation of the breath of life.

sanskrit_iast:
dikpālānpūjayettatra sthāpayitvā śivālaye |
gṛhe śivaḥ sadā pūjyo mūlamantrābhiyogataḥ ||
meaning:
दिक्पालान्पूजयेत्तत्र स्थापयित्वा शिवालये |
गृहे शिवः सदा पूज्यो मूलमन्त्राभियोगतः ||
text_mt: Having installed the guardians of the directions in the temple of Śiva, he should worship them there; / in the house, Śiva is ever to be worshipped by applying the root mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tu dvārapālānāṃ niyamo nāsti sarvathā |
gṛhe liṅgaṃ ca yatpūjyaṃ tasminsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
meaning:
तत्र तु द्वारपालानां नियमो नास्ति सर्वथा |
गृहे लिङ्गं च यत्पूज्यं तस्मिन्सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ||
text_mt: There, however, there is by no means an obligatory rule regarding door-keepers; / for in that liṅga which is worshipped at home, everything is established.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjākāle ca sāṅgaṃ vai parivāreṇa saṃyutam |
āvāhya pūjayeddevaṃ niyamo'tra na vidyate ||
meaning:
पूजाकाले च साङ्गं वै परिवारेण संयुतम् |
आवाह्य पूजयेद्देवं नियमोऽत्र न विद्यते ||
text_mt: At the time of worship, having invoked the god with his limbs and accompanied by his retinue, / he should worship him; there is no restriction here.

sanskrit_iast:
śivasya sannidhiṃ kṛtvā svāsanaṃ parikalpayet |
udaṅmukhastadā sthitvā punarācamanaṃ caret ||
meaning:
शिवस्य सन्निधिं कृत्वा स्वासनं परिकल्पयेत् |
उदङ्मुखस्तदा स्थित्वा पुनराचमनं चरेत् ||
text_mt: Having approached Śiva, he should arrange his own seat; / then, standing facing north, he should perform sipping of water again.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣālya hastau paścādvai prāṇāyāmaṃ prakalpayet |
mūlamantreṇa tatraiva daśāvartaṃ nayennaraḥ ||
meaning:
प्रक्षाल्य हस्तौ पश्चाद्वै प्राणायामं प्रकल्पयेत् |
मूलमन्त्रेण तत्रैव दशावर्तं नयेन्नरः ||
text_mt: Then, having washed his hands, he should perform breath control; / there a man should conduct ten repetitions using the root mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamudrāḥ prakartavyāḥ pūjāvaśyaṃ kare sthitā |
etā mudrāḥ pradarśyaiva caretpūjāvidhiṃ naraḥ ||
meaning:
पञ्चमुद्राः प्रकर्तव्याः पूजावश्यं करे स्थिता |
एता मुद्राः प्रदर्श्यैव चरेत्पूजाविधिं नरः ||
text_mt: Five hand-gestures are to be formed, remaining necessarily in the hand for the worship; / only after displaying these hand-gestures should a man perform the procedure of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpaṃ kṛtvā tadā tatra namaskāraṃ guroratha |
badhvā padmāsanaṃ tatra bhadrāsanamathāpi vā ||
meaning:
दीपं कृत्वा तदा तत्र नमस्कारं गुरोरथ |
बध्वा पद्मासनं तत्र भद्रासनमथापि वा ||
text_mt: Lighting a lamp then and there, and bowing to the guru, / having assumed the lotus posture (padmāsana) or the auspicious posture (bhadrāsana),

sanskrit_iast:
uttānāsanakaṃ kṛtvā paryaṅkāsanakaṃ tathā |
yathāsukhaṃ tathā sthitvā prayogaṃ punareva ca ||
meaning:
उत्तानासनकं कृत्वा पर्यङ्कासनकं तथा |
यथासुखं तथा स्थित्वा प्रयोगं पुनरेव च ||
text_mt: or having adopted the posture of lying stretched out (uttānāsana) or the seated cross-legged posture (paryaṅkāsana), / sitting thus according to one's comfort, [he should proceed with] the ritual practice once again.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā pūjāṃ purā jātāṃ vaṭṭakenaiva tārayet |
yadi vā svayameveha gṛhe na niyamo'sti ca ||
meaning:
कृत्वा पूजां पुरा जातां वट्टकेनैव तारयेत् |
यदि वा स्वयमेवेह गृहे न नियमोऽस्ति च ||
text_mt: Having performed the earlier worship, he should carry it out with the small cup; / or indeed by himself here, there is no restriction in a house.

sanskrit_iast:
paścāccaivārghapātreṇa kṣālayelliṅgamuttamam |
ananyamānaso bhūtvā pūjādravyaṃ nidhāya ca ||
meaning:
पश्चाच्चैवार्घपात्रेण क्षालयेल्लिङ्गमुत्तमम् |
अनन्यमानसो भूत्वा पूजाद्रव्यं निधाय च ||
text_mt: And then he should wash the excellent liṅga with the arghya vessel, / and, becoming single-minded, place down the articles of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
paścāccāvāhayeddevaṃ mantreṇānena vai naraḥ |
kailāsaśikharasthaṃ ca pārvatīpatimuttamam ||
meaning:
पश्चाच्चावाहयेद्देवं मन्त्रेणानेन वै नरः |
कैलासशिखरस्थं च पार्वतीपतिमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Then a man should invoke the god with this mantra: / [the god] seated on the summit of Kailāsa, the excellent lord of Pārvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
yathoktarūpiṇaṃ śambhuṃ nirguṇaṃ guṇarūpiṇam |
pañcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ trinetraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam ||
meaning:
यथोक्तरूपिणं शम्भुं निर्गुणं गुणरूपिणम् |
पञ्चवक्त्रं दशभुजं त्रिनेत्रं वृषभध्वजम् ||
text_mt: Śambhu having the described form, devoid of qualities yet embodied in qualities, / having five faces, ten arms, three eyes, and Vṛṣabhadhvaja;

sanskrit_iast:
karpūragauraṃ divyāṅgaṃ candramauliṃ kapardinam |
vyāghracarmottarīyaṃ ca gajacarmāmbaraṃ śubham ||
meaning:
कर्पूरगौरं दिव्याङ्गं चन्द्रमौलिं कपर्दिनम् |
व्याघ्रचर्मोत्तरीयं च गजचर्माम्बरं शुभम् ||
text_mt: white as camphor, of divine body, with the moon in his crown, having matted hair, / wearing an upper garment of tiger skin and an auspicious garment of elephant skin;

sanskrit_iast:
vāsukyādiparītāṅgaṃ pinākādyāyudhānvitam |
siddhayo'ṣṭau ca yasyāgre nṛtyantīha nirantaram ||
meaning:
वासुक्यादिपरीताङ्गं पिनाकाद्यायुधान्वितम् |
सिद्धयोऽष्टौ च यस्याग्रे नृत्यन्तीह निरन्तरम् ||
text_mt: his body encircled by Vāsuki and others, equipped with the Pināka and other weapons, / before whom the eight supernatural powers (siddhis) dance incessantly here;

sanskrit_iast:
jayajayeti śabdaiśca sevitaṃ bhaktapuñjakaiḥ |
tejasā duḥsahenaiva durlakṣyaṃ devasevitam ||
meaning:
जयजयेति शब्दैश्च सेवितं भक्तपुञ्जकैः |
तेजसा दुःसहेनैव दुर्लक्ष्यं देवसेवितम् ||
text_mt: worshipped with shouts of 'Victory! Victory!' by hosts of devotees; / difficult to behold because of his insupportable splendor, served by the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇyaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ prasannamukhapaṅkajam |
vedaiḥ śāstrairyathāgītaṃ viṣṇubrahmanutaṃ sadā ||
meaning:
शरण्यं सर्वसत्त्वानां प्रसन्नमुखपङ्कजम् |
वेदैः शास्त्रैर्यथागीतं विष्णुब्रह्मनुतं सदा ||
text_mt: the refuge of all beings, with a pleased lotus-face, / as sung by the Vedas and the treatises (śāstras), ever praised by Viṣṇu and Brahmā;

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktavatsalamānandaṃ śivamāvāhayāmyaham |
evaṃ dhyātvā śivaṃ sāmbamāsanaṃ parikalpayet ||
meaning:
भक्तवत्सलमानन्दं शिवमावाहयाम्यहम् |
एवं ध्यात्वा शिवं साम्बमासनं परिकल्पयेत् ||
text_mt: affectionate toward devotees, bliss itself: 'I invoke Śiva.' / Having thus meditated on Śiva accompanied by Ambā, he should offer a seat.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthyantapadenaiva sarvaṃ kuryādyathākramam |
tataḥ pādyaṃ pradadyādvai tato'rghyaṃ śaṅkarāya ca ||
meaning:
चतुर्थ्यन्तपदेनैव सर्वं कुर्याद्यथाक्रमम् |
ततः पाद्यं प्रदद्याद्वै ततोऽर्घ्यं शङ्कराय च ||
text_mt: He should perform everything in due order with words ending in the dative case. / Then he should offer water for washing the feet (pādya), and then water of respect (arghya) to Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścācamanaṃ kṛtvā śambhave paramātmane |
paścācca pañcabhirdravyaiḥ snāpayecchaṅkaraṃ mudā ||
meaning:
ततश्चाचमनं कृत्वा शम्भवे परमात्मने |
पश्चाच्च पञ्चभिर्द्रव्यैः स्नापयेच्छङ्करं मुदा ||
text_mt: Then, having offered water for sipping (ācamana) to Śambhu, the supreme Self, / he should afterward bathe Śaṅkara joyfully with the five articles.

sanskrit_iast:
vedamantrairyathāyogyaṃ nāmabhirvā samantrakaiḥ |
caturthyantapadairbhaktyā dravyāṇyevārpayettadā ||
meaning:
वेदमन्त्रैर्यथायोग्यं नामभिर्वा समन्त्रकैः |
चतुर्थ्यन्तपदैर्भक्त्या द्रव्याण्येवार्पयेत्तदा ||
text_mt: With Vedic mantras as appropriate, or with names accompanied by mantras, / he should then present the offerings with devotion using words ending in the dative case.

sanskrit_iast:
tathābhilaṣitaṃ dravyamarpayecchaṅkaropari |
tataśca vāruṇaṃ snānaṃ karaṇīyaṃ śivāya vai ||
meaning:
तथाभिलषितं द्रव्यमर्पयेच्छङ्करोपरि |
ततश्च वारुणं स्नानं करणीयं शिवाय वै ||
text_mt: He should present the desired substances upon Śaṅkara. / Then a water bath should indeed be performed for Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhaṃ candanaṃ dadyādanyalepāni yatnataḥ |
sasugandhajalenaiva jaladhārāṃ prakalpayet ||
meaning:
सुगन्धं चन्दनं दद्यादन्यलेपानि यत्नतः |
ससुगन्धजलेनैव जलधारां प्रकल्पयेत् ||
text_mt: He should offer fragrant sandalwood paste and other ointments with care; / he should arrange a continuous stream of water using perfumed water.

sanskrit_iast:
vedamantraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgairvā nāmabhī rudrasaṅkhyayā |
yathāvakāśaṃ tāṃ datvā vastreṇa mārjayettataḥ ||
meaning:
वेदमन्त्रैः षडङ्गैर्वा नामभी रुद्रसङ्ख्यया |
यथावकाशं तां दत्वा वस्त्रेण मार्जयेत्ततः ||
text_mt: With Vedic mantras, with the six limbs of the Veda, or with names according to the number of the Rudras, / having offered it as time permits, he should then wipe [the liṅga] with a cloth.

sanskrit_iast:
paścādācamanaṃ dadyāttato vastraṃ samarpayeta |
tilāścaiva yavā vāpi godhūmā mudgamāṣakāḥ ||
meaning:
पश्चादाचमनं दद्यात्ततो वस्त्रं समर्पयेत |
तिलाश्चैव यवा वापि गोधूमा मुद्गमाषकाः ||
text_mt: Then he should offer water for sipping, and thereafter offer a garment; / sesame seeds, barley, wheat, mung beans, and black gram

sanskrit_iast:
arpaṇīyāḥ śivāyaivaṃ mantrairnānāvidhairapi |
tataḥ puṣpāṇi deyāni pañcāsyāya mahātmane ||
meaning:
अर्पणीयाः शिवायैवं मन्त्रैर्नानाविधैरपि |
ततः पुष्पाणि देयानि पञ्चास्याय महात्मने ||
text_mt: should thus be offered to Śiva with various mantras. / Then flowers should be offered to the five-faced, great-souled god,

sanskrit_iast:
prativaktraṃ yathādhyānaṃ yathāyogyābhilāṣataḥ |
kamalaiḥ śatapatraiśca śaṅkhapuṣpaiḥ paraistathā ||
meaning:
प्रतिवक्त्रं यथाध्यानं यथायोग्याभिलाषतः |
कमलैः शतपत्रैश्च शङ्खपुष्पैः परैस्तथा ||
text_mt: for each face according to the meditation and in accordance with one's wish: / with lotuses, centifolias, conch-flowers, and other [blossoms];

sanskrit_iast:
kuśapuṣpaiśca dhattūrairmandārairdroṇasambhavaiḥ |
tathā ca tulasīpatrairbilvapatrairviśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
कुशपुष्पैश्च धत्तूरैर्मन्दारैर्द्रोणसम्भवैः |
तथा च तुलसीपत्रैर्बिल्वपत्रैर्विशेषतः ||
text_mt: and with kuśa flowers, dhattūras, mandāras, droṇa blossoms, / and also with tulasī leaves, and especially with bilva leaves,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā śaṅkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam |
sarvābhāve bilvapatramarpaṇīyaṃ śivāya vai ||
meaning:
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या शङ्करं भक्तवत्सलम् |
सर्वाभावे बिल्वपत्रमर्पणीयं शिवाय वै ||
text_mt: he should worship Śaṅkara, affectionate toward devotees, with supreme devotion. / In the absence of all else, a bilva leaf must indeed be offered to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
bilvapatrārpaṇenaiva sarvapūjā prasidhyati |
tataḥ sugandhacūrṇaṃ vai vāsitaṃ tailamuttamam ||
meaning:
बिल्वपत्रार्पणेनैव सर्वपूजा प्रसिध्यति |
ततः सुगन्धचूर्णं वै वासितं तैलमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: By the offering of a bilva leaf alone, the entire worship is accomplished. / Then fragrant powder and excellent perfumed oil

sanskrit_iast:
arpaṇīyaṃ ca vividhaṃ śivāya parayā mudā |
tato dhūpaḥ prakartavyo guggulāgurubhirmudā ||
meaning:
अर्पणीयं च विविधं शिवाय परया मुदा |
ततो धूपः प्रकर्तव्यो गुग्गुलागुरुभिर्मुदा ||
text_mt: of various kinds should be offered to Śiva with supreme joy. / Then incense of guggulu and aguru should joyfully be offered.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpo deyastatastasmai śaṅkarāya ghṛtāplutaḥ |
arghaṃ dadyātpunastasmai mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ ||
meaning:
दीपो देयस्ततस्तस्मै शङ्कराय घृताप्लुतः |
अर्घं दद्यात्पुनस्तस्मै मन्त्रेणानेन भक्तितः ||
text_mt: Then a lamp flooded with ghee should be given to him, Śaṅkara; / he should again offer water of respect (arghya) to him with devotion using this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
kārayedbhāvato bhaktyā vastreṇa mukhamārjanam |
rūpaṃ dehi yaśo dehi bhogaṃ dehi ca śaṅkara ||
meaning:
कारयेद्भावतो भक्त्या वस्त्रेण मुखमार्जनम् |
रूपं देहि यशो देहि भोगं देहि च शङ्कर ||
text_mt: He should sincerely and devotionally have the face wiped with a cloth: / 'Grant beauty, grant fame, and grant enjoyment, O Śaṅkara;

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktimuktiphalaṃ dehi gṛhītvārghaṃ namo'stu te |
tato deyaṃ śivāyaiva naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ śubham ||
meaning:
भुक्तिमुक्तिफलं देहि गृहीत्वार्घं नमोऽस्तु ते |
ततो देयं शिवायैव नैवेद्यं विविधं शुभम् ||
text_mt: Grant the fruit of enjoyment and liberation! Having accepted this arghya, homage to you!' / Then various auspicious food-offerings (naivedya) should indeed be given to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tata ācamanaṃ prītyā kārayedvāvilambataḥ |
tataḥ śivāya tāmbūlaṃ sāṅgopāṅgaṃ vidhāya ca ||
meaning:
तत आचमनं प्रीत्या कारयेद्वाविलम्बतः |
ततः शिवाय ताम्बूलं साङ्गोपाङ्गं विधाय च ||
text_mt: Then he should gladly make him sip water without delay; / then, having prepared betel (tāmbūla) for Śiva with all its parts and accessories,

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādārārtikaṃ pañcavartikāmanusaṅkhyayā |
pādayośca caturvāraṃ dviḥkṛtvo nābhimaṇḍale ||
meaning:
कुर्यादारार्तिकं पञ्चवर्तिकामनुसङ्ख्यया |
पादयोश्च चतुर्वारं द्विःकृत्वो नाभिमण्डले ||
text_mt: he should perform the waving of lamps (ārārtika) with five wicks in proper count: / four times at the feet, twice at the navel-circle,

sanskrit_iast:
ekakṛtvo mukhe saptakṛtvaḥ sarvāṅga eva hi |
tato dhyānaṃ yathoktaṃ vai kṛtvā mantramudīrayet ||
meaning:
एककृत्वो मुखे सप्तकृत्वः सर्वाङ्ग एव हि |
ततो ध्यानं यथोक्तं वै कृत्वा मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् ||
text_mt: once at the face, and seven times over the entire body. / Then, having performed meditation as prescribed, he should utter the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāsaṅkhyaṃ yathājñānaṃ kuryānmantravidhiṃ naraḥ |
gurūpadiṣṭamārgeṇa kṛtvā mantrajapaṃ sudhīḥ ||
meaning:
यथासङ्ख्यं यथाज्ञानं कुर्यान्मन्त्रविधिं नरः |
गुरूपदिष्टमार्गेण कृत्वा मन्त्रजपं सुधीः ||
text_mt:
A man should carry out the ritual of the mantra according to count and knowledge; / having performed the mantra-repetition according to the method taught by his guru, the wise man,

having followed the method taught by his guru, should utter the mantra; / a man should carry out the ritual of the mantra according to count and knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
gurūpadiṣṭamārgeṇa kṛtvā mantramudīrayet |
yathāsaṅkhyaṃ yathājñānaṃ kuryānmantravidhiṃ naraḥ ||
meaning:
गुरूपदिष्टमार्गेण कृत्वा मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् |
यथासङ्ख्यं यथाज्ञानं कुर्यान्मन्त्रविधिं नरः ||

sanskrit_iast:
stotrairnānāvidhaiḥ prītyā stuvīta vṛṣabhadhvajam |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kuryācchivasya ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||
meaning:
स्तोत्रैर्नानाविधैः प्रीत्या स्तुवीत वृषभध्वजम् |
ततः प्रदक्षिणां कुर्याच्छिवस्य च शनैः शनैः ||
text_mt: He should gladly praise Vṛṣabhadhvaja with various hymns of praise; / then he should slowly circumambulate Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskārāṃstataḥ kuryātsāṣṭāṅgaṃ vidhivatpumān |
tataḥ puṣpāñjalirdeyo mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ ||
meaning:
नमस्कारांस्ततः कुर्यात्साष्टाङ्गं विधिवत्पुमान् |
ततः पुष्पाञ्जलिर्देयो मन्त्रेणानेन भक्तितः ||
text_mt: Then a man should perform full prostrations with eight limbs according to rule; / then a handful of flowers should be offered with devotion using this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkarāya pareśāya śivasantoṣahetave |
ajñānādyadi vā jñānādyadyatpūjādikaṃ mayā ||
meaning:
शङ्कराय परेशाय शिवसन्तोषहेतवे |
अज्ञानाद्यदि वा ज्ञानाद्यद्यत्पूजादिकं मया ||
text_mt: For Śaṅkara, the supreme lord, for the sake of Śiva's satisfaction: / 'Whatever worship and the like has been performed by me, through ignorance or through knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ tadastu saphalaṃ kṛpayā tava śaṅkara |
tāvakastvadgataprāṇastvaccitto'haṃ sadā mṛḍa ||
meaning:
कृतं तदस्तु सफलं कृपया तव शङ्कर |
तावकस्त्वद्गतप्राणस्त्वच्चित्तोऽहं सदा मृड ||
text_mt: may that become fruitful through your grace, O Śaṅkara! / I am yours, my life-breath is devoted to you, my mind is fixed on you, O Mṛḍa!

sanskrit_iast:
iti vijñāya gaurīśa bhūtanātha prasīda me |
bhūmau skhalitapādānāṃ bhūmirevāvalambanam ||
meaning:
इति विज्ञाय गौरीश भूतनाथ प्रसीद मे |
भूमौ स्खलितपादानां भूमिरेवावलम्बनम् ||
text_mt: Knowing this, O lord of Gaurī, O lord of beings, be gracious to me! / For those whose feet slip on the ground, the ground itself is the support;

sanskrit_iast:
tvayi jātāparādhānāṃ tvameva śaraṇaṃ prabho |
ityādi bahuvijñaptiṃ kṛtvā samyagvidhānataḥ ||
meaning:
त्वयि जातापराधानां त्वमेव शरणं प्रभो |
इत्यादि बहुविज्ञप्तिं कृत्वा सम्यग्विधानतः ||
text_mt: for those who have committed offenses against you, you alone are the refuge, O Lord!' / Having made many such entreaties properly according to the prescribed rule,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpāñjaliṃ samarpyaiva punaḥ kuryānnatiṃ muhuḥ |
svasthānaṃ gaccha deveśa parivārayutaḥ prabho ||
meaning:
पुष्पाञ्जलिं समर्प्यैव पुनः कुर्यान्नतिं मुहुः |
स्वस्थानं गच्छ देवेश परिवारयुतः प्रभो ||
text_mt: having offered the handful of flowers, he should again bow repeatedly: / 'Go to your own abode, O lord of gods, accompanied by your retinue, O Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
pūjākāle punarnātha tvayāgantavyamādarāt |
iti samprārthya bahuśaḥ śaṅkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam ||
meaning:
पूजाकाले पुनर्नाथ त्वयागन्तव्यमादरात् |
इति सम्प्रार्थ्य बहुशः शङ्करं भक्तवत्सलम् ||
text_mt: At the time of worship, O Master, you must come again with care!' / Having prayed thus repeatedly to Śaṅkara, affectionate toward devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
visarjayetsvahṛdaye tadapo mūrdhni vinyaset |
iti proktamaśeṣeṇa munayaḥ śivapūjanam |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ caiva kimanyacchrotumarhatha ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ prathamaḥ sṛṣṭikhaṇḍaḥ
meaning:
विसर्जयेत्स्वहृदये तदपो मूर्ध्नि विन्यसेत् |
इति प्रोक्तमशेषेण मुनयः शिवपूजनम् |
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं चैव किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमर्हथ ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां प्रथमः सृष्टिखण्डः
text_mt:
he should dismiss him into his own heart, and place those waters on his head. / Thus, O sages, the worship of Śiva, which grants enjoyment and liberation, has been described completely. What else do you wish to hear?

Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Worship of Śiva', in the Sṛṣṭyupākhyāna in the first division of the Rudrasaṃhitā, in the venerable Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
vyāsaśiṣya mahābhāga kathaya tvaṃ pramāṇataḥ |
kaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjitaḥ śambhuḥ kiṃ kiṃ yacchati vai phalam ||
sūta uvāca |
śaunakādyāśca ṛṣayaḥ śṛṇutādarato'khilam ||
kathayāmyadya suprītyā puṣpārpaṇavinirṇayam | 2 ||
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः |
व्यासशिष्य महाभाग कथय त्वं प्रमाणतः |
कैः पुष्पैः पूजितः शम्भुः किं किं यच्छति वै फलम् ||
सूत उवाच |
शौनकाद्याश्च ऋषयः शृणुतादरतोऽखिलम् ||
कथयाम्यद्य सुप्रीत्या पुष्पार्पणविनिर्णयम् | 2 ||
title: caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivapūjāvidhānavarṇanam
text_mt:
The sages said: / O disciple of Vyāsa, highly fortunate one, tell us with authority: / worshipped with what flowers does Śambhu grant what particular fruit?

Sūta said: / O Śaunaka and other sages, listen with respect to everything.

Today I declare with great joy the determination of offering flowers. [2]

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa eva vidhiḥ pṛṣṭo nāradena maharṣiṇā |
provāca paramaprītyā puṣpārpaṇavinirṇayam ||
meaning:
एष एव विधिः पृष्टो नारदेन महर्षिणा |
प्रोवाच परमप्रीत्या पुष्पार्पणविनिर्णयम् ||
text_mt: This very rule was inquired about by the great sage Nārada; / [Brahmā] declared with supreme joy the determination of offering flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
kamalairbilvapatraiśca śatapatraistathā punaḥ |
śaṅkhapuṣpaistathā devaṃ lakṣmīkāmo'rcayecchivam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
कमलैर्बिल्वपत्रैश्च शतपत्रैस्तथा पुनः |
शङ्खपुष्पैस्तथा देवं लक्ष्मीकामोऽर्चयेच्छिवम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / One who desires fortune should worship the god Śiva with lotuses, bilva leaves, / likewise with water-lilies, and with śaṅkhapuṣpī flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
etaiśca lakṣasaṅkhyākaiḥ pūjitaścedbhavecchivaḥ |
pāpahānistathā vipra lakṣmīḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
एतैश्च लक्षसङ्ख्याकैः पूजितश्चेद्भवेच्छिवः |
पापहानिस्तथा विप्र लक्ष्मीः स्यान्नात्र संशयः ||
text_mt: If Śiva is worshipped with a hundred thousand of these, / sins are destroyed, O brahmin, and fortune surely arises; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśatiḥ kamalānāṃ tu prasthamekamudāhṛtam |
bilvo dalasahasreṇa prasthārdhaṃ paribhāṣitam ||
meaning:
विंशतिः कमलानां तु प्रस्थमेकमुदाहृतम् |
बिल्वो दलसहस्रेण प्रस्थार्धं परिभाषितम् ||
text_mt: Twenty lotuses are said to make one prastha; / a thousand bilva leaves are declared to be half a prastha.

sanskrit_iast:
śatapatrasahasreṇa prasthārdhaṃ paribhāṣitam |
palaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ prasthaḥ palaṃ ṭaṅkadaśasmṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
शतपत्रसहस्रेण प्रस्थार्धं परिभाषितम् |
पलैः षोडशभिः प्रस्थः पलं टङ्कदशस्मृतः ||
text_mt: A thousand water-lilies are declared to be half a prastha; / sixteen palas make a prastha, and a pala is recorded as ten ṭaṅkas.

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva tu mānena tulāmāropayedyadā |
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti niṣkāmaścecchivo bhavet ||
meaning:
अनेनैव तु मानेन तुलामारोपयेद्यदा |
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति निष्कामश्चेच्छिवो भवेत् ||
text_mt: When one places [these offerings] upon the balance by this very measure, / he attains all desires, and if he is free of desire, he becomes Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyasya kāmuko yo vai pārthivānāṃ ca pūjayā |
toṣayecchaṅkaraṃ devaṃ daśakoṭyā munīśvarāḥ ||
meaning:
राज्यस्य कामुको यो वै पार्थिवानां च पूजया |
तोषयेच्छङ्करं देवं दशकोट्या मुनीश्वराः ||
text_mt: One who desires kingship, O chiefs of sages, / should please the god Śaṅkara with ten crores by worshipping clay [liṅgas]—

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgaṃ śivaṃ tathā puṣpamakhaṇḍaṃ taṇḍulaṃ tathā |
carcitaṃ candanenaiva jaladhārāṃ tathā punaḥ ||
meaning:
लिङ्गं शिवं तथा पुष्पमखण्डं तण्डुलं तथा |
चर्चितं चन्दनेनैव जलधारां तथा पुनः ||
text_mt: the Śiva-liṅga, and unbroken flowers, unbroken rice grains / smeared with sandal-paste, and a stream of water,

sanskrit_iast:
pratirūpaṃ tathā mantraṃ bilvīdalamanuttamam |
athavā śatapatraṃ ca kamalaṃ vā tathā punaḥ ||
meaning:
प्रतिरूपं तथा मन्त्रं बिल्वीदलमनुत्तमम् |
अथवा शतपत्रं च कमलं वा तथा पुनः ||
text_mt: with each corresponding mantra, excellent bilva leaves, / or water-lilies, or lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhapuṣpaistathā proktaṃ viśeṣeṇa purātanaiḥ |
sarvakāmaphalaṃ divyaṃ paratrehāpi sarvathā ||
meaning:
शङ्खपुष्पैस्तथा प्रोक्तं विशेषेण पुरातनैः |
सर्वकामफलं दिव्यं परत्रेहापि सर्वथा ||
text_mt: or with śaṅkhapuṣpī flowers, as declared by the ancients in detail, / [granting] the divine fruit of all desires, in the next world and in this world in every way.

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyamarghaṃ cārārtikaṃ tathā |
pradakṣiṇāṃ namaskāraṃ kṣamāpanavisarjane ||
meaning:
धूपं दीपं च नैवेद्यमर्घं चारार्तिकं तथा |
प्रदक्षिणां नमस्कारं क्षमापनविसर्जने ||
text_mt: Having offered incense, a lamp, food offering, argha water, and waving of lights, / circumambulation, salutation, seeking forgiveness, and dismissal,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā sāṅgaṃ tathā bhojyaṃ kṛtaṃ yena bhavediha |
tasya vai sarvathā rājyaṃ śaṅkaraḥ pradadāti ca ||
meaning:
कृत्वा साङ्गं तथा भोज्यं कृतं येन भवेदिह |
तस्य वै सर्वथा राज्यं शङ्करः प्रददाति च ||
text_mt: and having performed [the rite] with all its limbs, and fed [brahmins], / Śaṅkara grants kingship entirely to such a person here.

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānyakāmuko yo vai tadardhenārcayetpumān |
kārāgṛhagato yo vai lakṣenaivārcayeddharam ||
meaning:
प्रधान्यकामुको यो वै तदर्धेनार्चयेत्पुमान् |
कारागृहगतो यो वै लक्षेनैवार्चयेद्धरम् ||
text_mt: A man who desires pre-eminence should worship with half of that; / one who has fallen into prison should worship Hara with a hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
rogagrasto yadā syādvai tadardhenārcayecchivam |
kanyākāmo bhavedyo vai tadardhena śivaṃ punaḥ ||
meaning:
रोगग्रस्तो यदा स्याद्वै तदर्धेनार्चयेच्छिवम् |
कन्याकामो भवेद्यो वै तदर्धेन शिवं पुनः ||
text_mt: When afflicted by disease, he should worship Śiva with half of that; / one who desires a daughter should worship Śiva with half of that again.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyākāmastathā yaḥ syāttadardhenārcayecchivam |
vāṇīkāmo bhavedyo vai ghṛtenaivārcayecchivam ||
meaning:
विद्याकामस्तथा यः स्यात्तदर्धेनार्चयेच्छिवम् |
वाणीकामो भवेद्यो वै घृतेनैवार्चयेच्छिवम् ||
text_mt: One who desires learning should worship Śiva with half of that; / one who desires eloquence should worship Śiva with ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
uccāṭanārthaṃ śatrūṇāṃ tanmitenaiva pūjanam |
māraṇe vai tu lakṣeṇa mohane tu tadardhataḥ ||
meaning:
उच्चाटनार्थं शत्रूणां तन्मितेनैव पूजनम् |
मारणे वै तु लक्षेण मोहने तु तदर्धतः ||
text_mt: For the expulsion of enemies, the worship is performed with that same number; / for killing them, with a hundred thousand, and for confounding them, with half of that.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmantānāṃ jaye caiva koṭipūjā praśasyate |
rājñāmayutasaṅkhyaṃ ca vaśīkaraṇakarmaṇi ||
meaning:
सामन्तानां जये चैव कोटिपूजा प्रशस्यते |
राज्ञामयुतसङ्ख्यं च वशीकरणकर्मणि ||
text_mt: For victory over vassal kings, a worship of ten million is commended; / and the count of ten thousand for kings in rites of subjugation.

sanskrit_iast:
yaśase ca tathā saṅkhyā vāhanādyaiḥ sahasrikā |
muktikāmo'rcayecchambhuṃ pañcakoṭyā subhaktitaḥ ||
meaning:
यशसे च तथा सङ्ख्या वाहनाद्यैः सहस्रिका |
मुक्तिकामोऽर्चयेच्छम्भुं पञ्चकोट्या सुभक्तितः ||
text_mt: For fame, the count is the same, and one thousand with vehicles and the like; / one who desires liberation should worship Śambhu with fifty million with deep devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānārthī pūjayetkoṭyā śaṅkaraṃ loka śaṅkaram |
śivadarśanakāmo vai tadardhena prapūjayet ||
meaning:
ज्ञानार्थी पूजयेत्कोट्या शङ्करं लोक शङ्करम् |
शिवदर्शनकामो वै तदर्धेन प्रपूजयेत् ||
text_mt: One who seeks knowledge should worship Śaṅkara, who brings peace to the world, with ten million; / one who desires the vision of Śiva should worship with half of that.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā mṛtyuñjayo jāpyaḥ kāmanāphalarūpataḥ |
pañcalakṣā japā yarhi pratyakṣaṃ tu bhavecchivaḥ ||
meaning:
तथा मृत्युञ्जयो जाप्यः कामनाफलरूपतः |
पञ्चलक्षा जपा यर्हि प्रत्यक्षं तु भवेच्छिवः ||
text_mt: Likewise, the Mṛtyuñjaya mantra should be recited according to the nature of the desired fruit; / when five hundred thousand recitations are performed, Śiva becomes visible.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣeṇa bhajate kaścid dvitīye jātisambhavaḥ |
tṛtīye kāmanālābhaścaturthe taṃ prapaśyati ||
meaning:
लक्षेण भजते कश्चिद् द्वितीये जातिसम्भवः |
तृतीये कामनालाभश्चतुर्थे तं प्रपश्यति ||
text_mt: With one hundred thousand, one worships him; at the second, remembrance of past births arises; / at the third, the attainment of desires; at the fourth, one sees him;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamaṃ ca yadā lakṣaṃ phalaṃ yacchatyasaṃśayam |
anenaiva tu mantreṇa daśalakṣe phalaṃ bhavet ||
meaning:
पञ्चमं च यदा लक्षं फलं यच्छत्यसंशयम् |
अनेनैव तु मन्त्रेण दशलक्षे फलं भवेत् ||
text_mt: and when the fifth hundred thousand is completed, he undoubtedly bestows the fruit; / with this very mantra, the fruit is attained at one million.

sanskrit_iast:
muktikāmo bhavedyo vai darbhaiśca pūjanaṃ caret |
lakṣasaṅkhyā tu sarvatra jñātavyā ṛṣisattama ||
meaning:
मुक्तिकामो भवेद्यो वै दर्भैश्च पूजनं चरेत् |
लक्षसङ्ख्या तु सर्वत्र ज्ञातव्या ऋषिसत्तम ||
text_mt: One who desires liberation should perform worship with darbha grass; / the count of one hundred thousand should be known in every case, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuḥkāmo bhavedyo vai dūrvābhiḥ pūjanaṃ caret |
putrakāmo bhavedyo vai dhattūrakusumaiścaret ||
meaning:
आयुःकामो भवेद्यो वै दूर्वाभिः पूजनं चरेत् |
पुत्रकामो भवेद्यो वै धत्तूरकुसुमैश्चरेत् ||
text_mt: One who desires long life should perform worship with dūrvā grass; / one who desires a son should perform it with dhattūra flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
raktadaṇḍaśca dhattūraḥ pūjane śubhadaḥ smṛtaḥ |
agastyakusumaiścaiva pūjakasya mahadyaśaḥ ||
meaning:
रक्तदण्डश्च धत्तूरः पूजने शुभदः स्मृतः |
अगस्त्यकुसुमैश्चैव पूजकस्य महद्यशः ||
text_mt: Red-stemmed dhattūra is recorded as auspicious in worship; / and by agastya flowers, great fame comes to the worshipper.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktimuktiphalaṃ tasya tulasyā pūjayedyadi |
arkapuṣpaiḥ pratāpaśca kubjakahlārakaistathā ||
meaning:
भुक्तिमुक्तिफलं तस्य तुलस्या पूजयेद्यदि |
अर्कपुष्पैः प्रतापश्च कुब्जकह्लारकैस्तथा ||
text_mt: The fruit of enjoyment and liberation is his if he worships with tulasī; / majesty is gained with arka flowers, as well as with kubja and kahlāra flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
japākusumapūjā tu śatrūṇāṃ mṛtyudā smṛtā |
rogoccāṭanakānīha karavīrāṇi vai kramāt ||
meaning:
जपाकुसुमपूजा तु शत्रूणां मृत्युदा स्मृता |
रोगोच्चाटनकानीह करवीराणि वै क्रमात् ||
text_mt: Worship with hibiscus flowers is recorded as bringing death to enemies; / oleanders here expel diseases in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
bandhukairbhūṣaṇāvāptirjātyā vāhānna saṃśayaḥ |
atasīpuṣpakairdevaṃ viṣṇuvallabhatāmiyāt ||
meaning:
बन्धुकैर्भूषणावाप्तिर्जात्या वाहान्न संशयः |
अतसीपुष्पकैर्देवं विष्णुवल्लभतामियात् ||
text_mt: With bandhūka flowers, ornaments are obtained; with jātī flowers, vehicles, without doubt; / with flax flowers, one attains the state of being dear to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
śamīpatraistathā muktiḥ prāpyate puruṣeṇa ca |
mallikākusumairdattaiḥ striyaṃ śubhatarāṃ śivaḥ ||
meaning:
शमीपत्रैस्तथा मुक्तिः प्राप्यते पुरुषेण च |
मल्लिकाकुसुमैर्दत्तैः स्त्रियं शुभतरां शिवः ||
text_mt: With śamī leaves, liberation is attained by a man; / by offering mallikā flowers, Śiva gives an exceptionally auspicious wife.

sanskrit_iast:
yūthikākusumaiḥ śastairgṛhaṃ naiva vimucyate |
karṇikāraistathā vastrasampattirjāyate nṛṇām ||
meaning:
यूथिकाकुसुमैः शस्तैर्गृहं नैव विमुच्यते |
कर्णिकारैस्तथा वस्त्रसम्पत्तिर्जायते नृणाम् ||
text_mt: With praised yūthikā flowers, one never departs from his house; / with karṇikāras, wealth of garments is produced for men.

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇḍīkusumairloke mano nirmalatāṃ vrajet |
vilvapatraistathā lakṣaiḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||
meaning:
निर्गुण्डीकुसुमैर्लोके मनो निर्मलतां व्रजेत् |
विल्वपत्रैस्तथा लक्षैः सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: With nirguṇḍī flowers, the mind becomes pure in this world; / with a hundred thousand bilva leaves, one attains all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgārahārapuṣpaistu vardhate sukhasampadā |
ṛtujātāni puṣpāṇi muktidāni na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
शृङ्गारहारपुष्पैस्तु वर्धते सुखसम्पदा |
ऋतुजातानि पुष्पाणि मुक्तिदानि न संशयः ||
text_mt: With śṛṅgārahāra flowers, one increases with wealth of happiness; / seasonal flowers bring liberation, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
rājikākusumānīha śatrūṇāṃ mṛtyudāni ca |
eṣāṃ lakṣaṃ śive dadyāddadyācca vipulaṃ phalam ||
meaning:
राजिकाकुसुमानीह शत्रूणां मृत्युदानि च |
एषां लक्षं शिवे दद्याद्दद्याच्च विपुलं फलम् ||
text_mt: Mustard flowers here bring death to enemies; / one should offer a hundred thousand of these to Śiva, and he will grant abundant fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyate kusumaṃ tanna yannaiva śivavallabham |
campakaṃ ketakaṃ hitvā tvanyatsarvaṃ samarpayet ||
meaning:
विद्यते कुसुमं तन्न यन्नैव शिववल्लभम् |
चम्पकं केतकं हित्वा त्वन्यत्सर्वं समर्पयेत् ||
text_mt: There is no flower that is not dear to Śiva, / but leaving aside campaka and ketaka, one should offer everything else.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ ca dhānyānāṃ pūjane śaṅkarasya ca |
pramāṇaṃ ca phalaṃ sarvaṃ prītyā śṛṇu ca sattama ||
meaning:
अतः परं च धान्यानां पूजने शङ्करस्य च |
प्रमाणं च फलं सर्वं प्रीत्या शृणु च सत्तम ||
text_mt: Listen with joy henceforth, O best of men, to the measure and all the fruits / of grains in the worship of Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
tandulāropaṇe nṛṇāṃ lakṣmī vṛddhiḥ prajāyate |
akhaṇḍitavidhau vipra samyagbhaktyā śivopari ||
meaning:
तन्दुलारोपणे नृणां लक्ष्मी वृद्धिः प्रजायते |
अखण्डितविधौ विप्र सम्यग्भक्त्या शिवोपरि ||
text_mt: By offering rice grains, an increase of fortune arises for men; / in the prescribed rite with unbroken grains, O brahmin, [offered] with full devotion over Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkenaiva tu prasthānāṃ tadardhena tathā punaḥ |
paladvayaṃ tathā lakṣamānena samudāhṛtam ||
meaning:
षट्केनैव तु प्रस्थानां तदर्धेन तथा पुनः |
पलद्वयं तथा लक्षमानेन समुदाहृतम् ||
text_mt: six prasthas, and half of that [a prastha], / and two palas, is declared as the measure for a hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāṃ rudrapradhānena kṛtvā vastraṃ susundaram |
śivopari nyasettatra tandulārpaṇamuttamam ||
meaning:
पूजां रुद्रप्रधानेन कृत्वा वस्त्रं सुसुन्दरम् |
शिवोपरि न्यसेत्तत्र तन्दुलार्पणमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Having performed the worship with the Rudra hymn as principal, one should place a beautiful cloth / over Śiva, and upon that, the excellent offering of rice grains,

sanskrit_iast:
upari śrīphalaṃ tvekaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhistathā |
ropayitvā ca dhūpādi kṛtvā pūjāphalaṃ bhavet ||
meaning:
उपरि श्रीफलं त्वेकं गन्धपुष्पादिभिस्तथा |
रोपयित्वा च धूपादि कृत्वा पूजाफलं भवेत् ||
text_mt: and placing one coconut on top, with scent, flowers, and the rest, / and offering incense and the like, the fruit of the worship is attained.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatyadvayaṃ raupyamāṣasaṅkhyā ca dakṣiṇā |
deyā tadupadeṣṭre hi śaktyā vā dakṣiṇā matā ||
meaning:
प्रजापत्यद्वयं रौप्यमाषसङ्ख्या च दक्षिणा |
देया तदुपदेष्ट्रे हि शक्त्या वा दक्षिणा मता ||
text_mt: A fee of two prājāpatyas, measured in silver māṣas, / must be given to the teacher of the rite, or a fee according to one's means is considered proper.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityasaṅkhyayā tatra brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ |
lakṣapūjā tathā jātā sāṅgañca mantrapūrvakam ||
meaning:
आदित्यसङ्ख्यया तत्र ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्ततः |
लक्षपूजा तथा जाता साङ्गञ्च मन्त्रपूर्वकम् ||
text_mt: One should then feed twelve brahmins there; / thus the worship of a hundred thousand is accomplished, complete in all limbs and preceded by mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tatra mantre vidhirudāhṛtaḥ |
tilānāṃ ca palaṃ lakṣaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
meaning:
शतमष्टोत्तरं तत्र मन्त्रे विधिरुदाहृतः |
तिलानां च पलं लक्षं महापातकनाशनम् ||
text_mt: One hundred and eight is stated as the rule for the mantra there; / and a hundred thousand palas of sesame seeds destroys heinous sins.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśapalaireva lakṣamānamudāhṛtam |
pūrvavatpūjanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ hitakāmyayā ||
meaning:
एकादशपलैरेव लक्षमानमुदाहृतम् |
पूर्ववत्पूजनं तत्र कर्तव्यं हितकाम्यया ||
text_mt: Eleven palas is declared as the measure for a hundred thousand; / worship should be performed there as before, with a desire for well-being.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojyā vai brāhmaṇāstasmādatra kāryā nareṇa hi |
mahāpātakajaṃ duḥkhaṃ tatkṣaṇānnaśyati dhruvam ||
meaning:
भोज्या वै ब्राह्मणास्तस्मादत्र कार्या नरेण हि |
महापातकजं दुःखं तत्क्षणान्नश्यति ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: Therefore brahmins should indeed be fed here by a man; / the sorrow arising from heinous sins is immediately destroyed for certain.

sanskrit_iast:
yavapūjā tathā proktā lakṣeṇa paramā śive |
prasthānāmaṣṭakaṃ caiva tathā prasthārdhakaṃ punaḥ ||
meaning:
यवपूजा तथा प्रोक्ता लक्षेण परमा शिवे |
प्रस्थानामष्टकं चैव तथा प्रस्थार्धकं पुनः ||
text_mt: Worship with barley to the count of a hundred thousand is declared supreme for Śiva: / eight prasthas, half a prastha,

sanskrit_iast:
paladvayayutaṃ tatra mānametatpurātanam |
yavapūjā ca munibhiḥ svargasaukhyavivardhinī ||
meaning:
पलद्वययुतं तत्र मानमेतत्पुरातनम् |
यवपूजा च मुनिभिः स्वर्गसौख्यविवर्धिनी ||
text_mt: joined with two palas—that is the ancient measure; / and worship with barley is declared by the sages to increase heavenly happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kartavyaṃ ca phalepsubhiḥ |
godhūmānnaistathā pūjā praśastā śaṅkarasya vai ||
meaning:
प्राजापत्यं ब्राह्मणानां कर्तव्यं च फलेप्सुभिः |
गोधूमान्नैस्तथा पूजा प्रशस्ता शङ्करस्य वै ||
text_mt: A prājāpatya observance should be performed by those seeking the fruit of feeding brahmins; / worship of Śaṅkara with wheat grains is commended:

sanskrit_iast:
santatirvardhate tasya yadi lakṣāvadhiḥ kṛtā |
droṇārdhena bhavellakṣaṃ vidhānaṃ vidhipūrvakam ||
meaning:
सन्ततिर्वर्धते तस्य यदि लक्षावधिः कृता |
द्रोणार्धेन भवेल्लक्षं विधानं विधिपूर्वकम् ||
text_mt: one's offspring increases if it is performed up to the limit of a hundred thousand; / a hundred thousand is half a droṇa according to the prescribed rite.

sanskrit_iast:
mudgānāṃ pūjane devaḥ śivo yacchati vai sukham |
prasthānāṃ saptakenaiva prasthārdhenāthavā punaḥ ||
meaning:
मुद्गानां पूजने देवः शिवो यच्छति वै सुखम् |
प्रस्थानां सप्तकेनैव प्रस्थार्धेनाथवा पुनः ||
text_mt: In the worship with mudga beans, the god Śiva certainly bestows happiness. / With seven prasthas, or half a prastha again,

sanskrit_iast:
paladvayayutenaiva lakṣamuktaṃ purātanaiḥ |
brāhmaṇāśca tathā bhojyā rudrasaṅkhyāpramāṇataḥ ||
meaning:
पलद्वययुतेनैव लक्षमुक्तं पुरातनैः |
ब्राह्मणाश्च तथा भोज्या रुद्रसङ्ख्याप्रमाणतः ||
text_mt: together with two palas, one hundred thousand [grains] are stated by the ancients. / And brāhmaṇas should be fed according to the number of the Rudras.

sanskrit_iast:
priyaṅgupūjanādeva dharmādhyakṣe parātmani |
dharmārthakāmā vardhante pūjā sarvasukhāvahā ||
meaning:
प्रियङ्गुपूजनादेव धर्माध्यक्षे परात्मनि |
धर्मार्थकामा वर्धन्ते पूजा सर्वसुखावहा ||
text_mt: Through the worship of the Supreme Self, the superintendent of dharma, with priyaṅgu [grains], / virtue, wealth, and desire increase; such worship brings all happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
prasthaikena ca tasyoktaṃ lakṣamekaṃ purātanaiḥ |
brahmabhojaṃ tathā proktamarkasaṅkhyāpramāṇataḥ ||
meaning:
प्रस्थैकेन च तस्योक्तं लक्षमेकं पुरातनैः |
ब्रह्मभोजं तथा प्रोक्तमर्कसङ्ख्याप्रमाणतः ||
text_mt: With one prastha of it, one hundred thousand [grains] are declared by the ancients. / Feeding of brāhmaṇas is likewise prescribed according to the number of the suns.

sanskrit_iast:
rājikāpūjanaṃ śambhoḥ śatrormṛtyukaraṃ smṛtam |
sarṣapānāṃ tathā lakṣaṃ palairviṃśatisaṅkhyayā ||
meaning:
राजिकापूजनं शम्भोः शत्रोर्मृत्युकरं स्मृतम् |
सर्षपानां तथा लक्षं पलैर्विंशतिसङ्ख्यया ||
text_mt: Worship of Śambhu with mustard seeds is remembered to cause the death of an enemy. / So too, one hundred thousand mustard seeds [amount] to the measure of twenty palas.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ ca pūjanādeva śatrormṛtyurudāhṛtaḥ |
āḍhakīnāṃ dalaiścaiva śobhayitvārcayecchivam ||
meaning:
तेषां च पूजनादेव शत्रोर्मृत्युरुदाहृतः |
आढकीनां दलैश्चैव शोभयित्वार्चयेच्छिवम् ||
text_mt: Through the worship with them indeed, the death of the enemy is proclaimed. / Having adorned Śiva with leaves of āḍhakī, one should worship him.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛtā gauśca pradātavyā balīvardastathaiva ca |
marīcisambhavā pūjā śatrornāśakarī smṛtā ||
meaning:
वृता गौश्च प्रदातव्या बलीवर्दस्तथैव च |
मरीचिसम्भवा पूजा शत्रोर्नाशकरी स्मृता ||
text_mt: A cow must be given, and likewise an ox. / Worship performed with black pepper is remembered to cause the destruction of the enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
āḍhakīnāṃ dalaiścaiva rañjayitvārcayecchivam |
nānāsukhakarī hyeṣā pūjā sarvaphalapradā ||
meaning:
आढकीनां दलैश्चैव रञ्जयित्वार्चयेच्छिवम् |
नानासुखकरी ह्येषा पूजा सर्वफलप्रदा ||
text_mt: Having delighted Śiva with leaves of āḍhakī, one should worship him; / for this worship brings diverse happiness and bestows all fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyamānamiti proktaṃ mayā te munisattama |
lakṣamānaṃ tu puṣpāṇāṃ śṛṇu prītyā munīśvara ||
meaning:
धान्यमानमिति प्रोक्तं मया ते मुनिसत्तम |
लक्षमानं तु पुष्पाणां शृणु प्रीत्या मुनीश्वर ||
text_mt: Thus the measure of grains has been declared by me to you, best of sages. / But hear with delight, O lord of sages, the measure of one hundred thousand flowers:

sanskrit_iast:
prasthānāṃ ca tathā caikaṃ śaṅkhapuṣpasamudbhavam |
proktaṃ vyāsena lakṣaṃ hi sūkṣmamānapradarśinā ||
meaning:
प्रस्थानां च तथा चैकं शङ्खपुष्पसमुद्भवम् |
प्रोक्तं व्यासेन लक्षं हि सूक्ष्ममानप्रदर्शिना ||
text_mt: One prastha of śaṅkhapuṣpa flowers / is declared to be one hundred thousand by Vyāsa, who shows the subtle measure.

sanskrit_iast:
prasthairekādaśairjātilakṣamānaṃ prakīrtitam |
yūthikāyāstathā mānaṃ rājikāyāstadardhakam ||
meaning:
प्रस्थैरेकादशैर्जातिलक्षमानं प्रकीर्तितम् |
यूथिकायास्तथा मानं राजिकायास्तदर्धकम् ||
text_mt: The measure of one hundred thousand jāti flowers is proclaimed as eleven prasthas; / the same is the measure for yūthikā, and half of that for rājikā.

sanskrit_iast:
prasthairviṃśatikaiścaiva mallikāmānamuttamam |
tilapuṣpaistathā mānaṃ prasthānnyūnaṃ tathaiva ca ||
meaning:
प्रस्थैर्विंशतिकैश्चैव मल्लिकामानमुत्तमम् |
तिलपुष्पैस्तथा मानं प्रस्थान्न्यूनं तथैव च ||
text_mt: With twenty prasthas is the supreme measure of mallikā flowers; / the measure of sesamum blossoms is less than a prastha.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca triguṇaṃ mānaṃ karavīrabhave smṛtam |
nirguṇḍīkusume mānaṃ tathaiva kathitaṃ budhaiḥ ||
meaning:
ततश्च त्रिगुणं मानं करवीरभवे स्मृतम् |
निर्गुण्डीकुसुमे मानं तथैव कथितं बुधैः ||
text_mt: Three times that is remembered as the measure for karavīra flowers; / the measure for nirguṇḍī blossoms is declared by the wise to be just the same.

sanskrit_iast:
karṇikāre tathā mānaṃ śirīṣakusume punaḥ |
bandhujīve tathā mānaṃ prasthānaṃ daśakena ca ||
meaning:
कर्णिकारे तथा मानं शिरीषकुसुमे पुनः |
बन्धुजीवे तथा मानं प्रस्थानं दशकेन च ||
text_mt: The measure is the same for karṇikāra, and likewise for śirīṣa flowers; / for bandhujīva blossoms, the measure is by ten prasthas.

sanskrit_iast:
ityādyairvividhairmānaṃ dṛṣṭvā kuryācchivārcanam |
sarvakāmasamṛddhyarthaṃ muktyarthaṃ kāmanojjhitaḥ ||
meaning:
इत्याद्यैर्विविधैर्मानं दृष्ट्वा कुर्याच्छिवार्चनम् |
सर्वकामसमृद्ध्यर्थं मुक्त्यर्थं कामनोज्झितः ||
text_mt: Observing the measure by these and other various [flowers], one should worship Śiva / to attain the fulfillment of all desires, or, free from desire, for liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dhārāpūjāphalaṃ mahat |
yasya śravaṇamātreṇa kalyāṇaṃ jāyate nṛṇām ||
meaning:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि धारापूजाफलं महत् |
यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण कल्याणं जायते नृणाम् ||
text_mt: Hereafter I will declare the great fruit of worship with continuous streams [dhārā], / through the mere hearing of which welfare arises for men.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhānapūrvakaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā bhaktyā śivasya vai |
paścācca jaladhārā hi kartavyā bhaktitatparaiḥ ||
meaning:
विधानपूर्वकं पूजां कृत्वा भक्त्या शिवस्य वै |
पश्चाच्च जलधारा हि कर्तव्या भक्तितत्परैः ||
text_mt: Having performed the worship of Śiva according to the rules with devotion, / a continuous stream of water should subsequently be offered by those devoted to [such] devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
jvarapralāpaśāntyarthaṃ jaladhārā śubhāvahā |
śatarudriyamantreṇa rudrasyaikādaśena tu ||
meaning:
ज्वरप्रलापशान्त्यर्थं जलधारा शुभावहा |
शतरुद्रियमन्त्रेण रुद्रस्यैकादशेन तु ||
text_mt: For calming the delirium of fever, a stream of water is auspicious, / [offered] with the Śatarudriya mantra, or with the eleven [mantras] of Rudra,

sanskrit_iast:
rudrajāpyena vā tatra sūktena pauruṣeṇa vā |
ṣaḍaṅgenātha vā tatra mahāmṛtyuñjayena ca ||
meaning:
रुद्रजाप्येन वा तत्र सूक्तेन पौरुषेण वा |
षडङ्गेनाथ वा तत्र महामृत्युञ्जयेन च ||
text_mt: or with the Rudrajāpya, or there with the Pauruṣa hymn, / or with the six-limbed [mantra], or there with the Mahāmṛtyuñjaya [mantra],

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryā vā namo'ntaiśca nāmabhiḥ praṇavādibhiḥ |
mantrairvāthāgamoktaiśca jaladhārādikaṃ tathā ||
meaning:
गायत्र्या वा नमोऽन्तैश्च नामभिः प्रणवादिभिः |
मन्त्रैर्वाथागमोक्तैश्च जलधारादिकं तथा ||
text_mt: or with the Gāyatrī, or with names ending in 'namaḥ' beginning with the Praṇava, / or with mantras proclaimed in the Āgamas—thus [one should offer] the stream of water and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhasantānavṛddhyarthaṃ dhārāpūjanamuttamam |
nānādravyaiḥ śubhairdivyaiḥ prītyā sadbhasmadhāriṇā ||
meaning:
सुखसन्तानवृद्ध्यर्थं धारापूजनमुत्तमम् |
नानाद्रव्यैः शुभैर्दिव्यैः प्रीत्या सद्भस्मधारिणा ||
text_mt: Worship with a stream is supreme for the increase of happiness and offspring; / [it should be performed] with various auspicious, celestial substances, with love, by one wearing sacred ash.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtadhārā śive kāryā yāvanmantrasahasrakam |
tadā vaṃśasya vistāro jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
घृतधारा शिवे कार्या यावन्मन्त्रसहस्रकम् |
तदा वंशस्य विस्तारो जायते नात्र संशयः ||
text_mt: A stream of ghee should be offered upon Śiva during a thousand mantras; / then the expansion of one's lineage takes place; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
evamayutamantreṇa kāryaṃ vai śivapūjanam |
prameharogaśāntyarthaṃ prāpnuyācca manepsitam |
ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ yadādātastadā ghṛtasupūjanam |
brahmabhojyaṃ tathā proktaṃ prājāpatyaṃ munīśvaraiḥ ||
meaning:
एवमयुतमन्त्रेण कार्यं वै शिवपूजनम् |
प्रमेहरोगशान्त्यर्थं प्राप्नुयाच्च मनेप्सितम् |
षण्ढत्वं यदादातस्तदा घृतसुपूजनम् |
ब्रह्मभोज्यं तथा प्रोक्तं प्राजापत्यं मुनीश्वरैः ||
text_mt: Thus the worship of Śiva must be performed with ten thousand mantras / for the calming of urinary disease [prameha], and one will obtain one's heart's desire. / When impotence has arrived, then excellent worship with ghee [should be performed]; / and feeding of brāhmaṇas as a prājāpatya is declared by lords of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
kevalaṃ dugdhadhārā ca tadā kāryā viśeṣataḥ |
śarkarāmiśritā tatra yadā buddhijaḍo bhavet ||
meaning:
केवलं दुग्धधारा च तदा कार्या विशेषतः |
शर्करामिश्रिता तत्र यदा बुद्धिजडो भवेत् ||
text_mt: Then a stream of pure milk especially should be offered, / mixed with sugar there, when one is dull of intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā sañjāyate jīvasadṛśī buddhiruttamā |
yāvanmantrāyutaṃ na syāttāvaddhārāprapūjanam ||
meaning:
तस्या सञ्जायते जीवसदृशी बुद्धिरुत्तमा |
यावन्मन्त्रायुतं न स्यात्तावद्धाराप्रपूजनम् ||
text_mt: Through that, an excellent intellect equal to Bṛhaspati's is born; / worship with the stream should continue until there are ten thousand mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā coccāṭanaṃ dehe jāyate kāraṇaṃ vinā |
yatra kutrāpi vā prema duḥkhaṃ ca parivardhitam ||
meaning:
यदा चोच्चाटनं देहे जायते कारणं विना |
यत्र कुत्रापि वा प्रेम दुःखं च परिवर्धितम् ||
text_mt: And when agitation [uccāṭana] arises in the body without a cause, / or anywhere love and sorrow are excessively heightened,

sanskrit_iast:
svagṛhe kalaho nityaṃ yadā caiva prajāyate |
taddhārāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ vai sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ vilīyate ||
meaning:
स्वगृहे कलहो नित्यं यदा चैव प्रजायते |
तद्धारायां कृतायां वै सर्वं दुःखं विलीयते ||
text_mt: and when strife arises constantly in one's own house, / when that stream is offered, all sorrow indeed dissolves.

sanskrit_iast:
śatrūṇāṃ tāpanārthaṃ vai tailadhārā śivopari |
kartavyā suprayatnena kāryasiddhirdhruvaṃ bhavet ||
meaning:
शत्रूणां तापनार्थं वै तैलधारा शिवोपरि |
कर्तव्या सुप्रयत्नेन कार्यसिद्धिर्ध्रुवं भवेत् ||
text_mt: For the torment of enemies, a stream of oil upon Śiva / should be offered with great effort; success in the objective will certainly occur.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsitenaiva tailena bhogavṛddhiḥ prajāyate |
sārṣapeṇaiva tailena śatrunāśo bhaved dhruvam ||
meaning:
वासितेनैव तैलेन भोगवृद्धिः प्रजायते |
सार्षपेणैव तैलेन शत्रुनाशो भवेद् ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: With scented oil, an increase of enjoyment arises; / with mustard oil, the destruction of enemies will certainly occur.

sanskrit_iast:
madhunā yakṣarājo vai gacchecca śivapūjanāt |
dhārā cekṣurasasyāpi sarvānandakarī śive ||
meaning:
मधुना यक्षराजो वै गच्छेच्च शिवपूजनात् |
धारा चेक्षुरसस्यापि सर्वानन्दकरी शिवे ||
text_mt: Through worship of Śiva with honey, even the King of Yakṣas [consumption] will depart; / and a stream of sugarcane juice brings all bliss when offered to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
dhārā gaṅgājalasyaiva bhuktimuktiphalapradā |
etāḥ sarvāśca yāḥ proktā mṛtyañjayasamudbhavāḥ ||
meaning:
धारा गङ्गाजलस्यैव भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदा |
एताः सर्वाश्च याः प्रोक्ता मृत्यञ्जयसमुद्भवाः ||
text_mt: A stream of Gaṅgā water alone bestows the fruit of enjoyment and liberation. / All these [streams] that have been declared arise from the Mṛtyuñjaya [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāyutapramāṇaṃ hi kartavyaṃ tadvidhānataḥ |
kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojyaṃ vai rudrasaṅkhyayā ||
meaning:
तत्रायुतप्रमाणं हि कर्तव्यं तद्विधानतः |
कर्तव्यं ब्राह्मणानां च भोज्यं वै रुद्रसङ्ख्यया ||
text_mt: In that case, the measure of ten thousand [recitations] should be performed according to the rule; / and feeding of brāhmaṇas must be done according to the number of the Rudras.

sanskrit_iast:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ munīśvara |
etadvai saphalaṃ loke sarvakāmahitāvaham ||
meaning:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽहं मुनीश्वर |
एतद्वै सफलं लोके सर्वकामहितावहम् ||
text_mt: All this has been related to you which I was asked, O lord of sages. / This is fruitful in the world, bringing benefit to all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
skandomāsahitaṃ śambhuṃ sampūjya vidhinā saha |
yatphalaṃ labhate bhaktyā tadvadāmi yathāśrutam ||
meaning:
स्कन्दोमासहितं शम्भुं सम्पूज्य विधिना सह |
यत्फलं लभते भक्त्या तद्वदामि यथाश्रुतम् ||
text_mt: Having worshipped Śambhu together with Skanda and Umā according to the rule, / what fruit one attains through devotion, that I tell as I have heard it.

sanskrit_iast:
atra bhuktvākhilaṃ saukhyaṃ putrapautrādibhiḥ śubham |
tato yāti maheśasya lokaṃ sarvasukhāvaham ||
meaning:
अत्र भुक्त्वाखिलं सौख्यं पुत्रपौत्रादिभिः शुभम् |
ततो याति महेशस्य लोकं सर्वसुखावहम् ||
text_mt: Having enjoyed all auspicious happiness here with sons, grandsons, and others, / he then goes to the world of Maheśa, which brings all happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryakoṭipratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sarvakāmagaiḥ |
rudrakanyāsamākīrṇairgeyavādyasamanvitaiḥ ||
meaning:
सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैः सर्वकामगैः |
रुद्रकन्यासमाकीर्णैर्गेयवाद्यसमन्वितैः ||
text_mt: In aerial chariots resembling ten million suns, going wherever desired, / crowded with Rudra maidens, accompanied by song and musical instruments,

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍate śivabhūtaśca yāvadābhūtasamplavam |
tato mokṣamavāpnoti vijñānaṃ prāpya cāvyayam ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ prathamaḥ sṛṣṭikhaṇḍeḥ
meaning:
क्रीडते शिवभूतश्च यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् |
ततो मोक्षमवाप्नोति विज्ञानं प्राप्य चाव्ययम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां प्रथमः सृष्टिखण्डेः
text_mt:
having become an attendant of Śiva, he sports until the dissolution of all beings; / then he attains liberation, having reached imperishable discernment.

Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Rules of Śiva Worship', in the first section, the Account of Creation, in the second Rudrasaṃhitā of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca |
vidhe vidhe mahābhāga dhanyastvaṃ surasattama |
śrāvitādyādbhutā śaivakathā paramapāvanī ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच |
विधे विधे महाभाग धन्यस्त्वं सुरसत्तम |
श्राविताद्याद्भुता शैवकथा परमपावनी ||
title: pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | rudrāvatārāvirbhāvavarṇanam
text_mt: Nārada said: / O Brahmā, O Brahmā, fortunate one, best of the gods, blessed are you! / Today the wonderful story of Śiva, supremely purifying, has been recounted [by you].

sanskrit_iast:
tatrādbhutā mahādivyā liṅgotpattiḥ śrutā śubhā |
śrutvā yasyāḥ prabhāvaṃ ca duḥkhanāśo bhavediha ||
meaning:
तत्राद्भुता महादिव्या लिङ्गोत्पत्तिः श्रुता शुभा |
श्रुत्वा यस्याः प्रभावं च दुःखनाशो भवेदिह ||
text_mt: Therein the wonderful, supremely celestial, auspicious origin of the Liṅga was heard, / having heard whose power destruction of sorrow occurs in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
anantaraṃ ca yajjātaṃ māhātmyaṃ caritaṃ tathā |
sṛṣṭeścaiva prakāraṃ ca kathaya tvaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
अनन्तरं च यज्जातं माहात्म्यं चरितं तथा |
सृष्टेश्चैव प्रकारं च कथय त्वं विशेषतः ||
text_mt: And what eulogy and deed occurred thereafter, / and the manner of creation—relate that in detail.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
samyak pṛṣṭaṃ ca bhavatā yajjātaṃ tadanantaram |
kathayiṣyāmi saṅkṣepādyathā pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ mayā ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
सम्यक् पृष्टं च भवता यज्जातं तदनन्तरम् |
कथयिष्यामि सङ्क्षेपाद्यथा पूर्वं श्रुतं मया ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / You have questioned well about what occurred thereafter. / I shall narrate it in brief as it was formerly heard by me.

sanskrit_iast:
antarhite tadā deve śivarūpe sanātane |
ahaṃ viṣṇuśca viprendra adhikaṃ sukhamāptavān ||
meaning:
अन्तर्हिते तदा देवे शिवरूपे सनातने |
अहं विष्णुश्च विप्रेन्द्र अधिकं सुखमाप्तवान् ||
text_mt: When that eternal god of the form of Śiva had disappeared, / I and Viṣṇu, O best of brāhmaṇas, attained supreme happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā ca viṣṇunā rūpaṃ haṃsavārāhayostadā |
saṃvṛtaṃ tu tatastābhyāṃ lokasargāvanecchayā ||
meaning:
मया च विष्णुना रूपं हंसवाराहयोस्तदा |
संवृतं तु ततस्ताभ्यां लोकसर्गावनेच्छया ||
text_mt: And then the forms of the swan and the boar were withdrawn / by me and by Viṣṇu, out of a desire to create and protect the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca |
vidhe brahman mahāprājña saṃśayo hṛdi me mahān |
kṛpāṃ kṛtvātulāṃ śīghraṃ taṃ nāśayitumarhasi ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच |
विधे ब्रह्मन् महाप्राज्ञ संशयो हृदि मे महान् |
कृपां कृत्वातुलां शीघ्रं तं नाशयितुमर्हसि ||
text_mt:
Nārada said:
O Brahmā, creator, endowed with great wisdom, there is a great doubt in my heart. / Having shown incomparable mercy, you ought quickly to dispel it.

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsavārāhayo rūpaṃ yuvābhyāṃ ca dhṛtaṃ katham |
anyadrūpaṃ vihāyaiva kimatra vada kāraṇam ||
meaning:
हंसवाराहयो रूपं युवाभ्यां च धृतं कथम् |
अन्यद्रूपं विहायैव किमत्र वद कारणम् ||
text_mt: Why was the form of a swan and a boar assumed by both of you? / Leaving aside any other form, tell me the reason for this.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā nāradasya mahātmanaḥ |
smṛtvā śivapadāmbhojaṃ brahmā sādaramabravīt ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
इत्येतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा नारदस्य महात्मनः |
स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजं ब्रह्मा सादरमब्रवीत् ||
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Having heard these words of the great-souled Nārada, / remembering the lotus feet of Śiva, Brahmā spoke with respect.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
haṃsasya cordhvagamane gatirbhavati niścalā |
tattvātattvaviveko'sti jaladugdhavibhāgavat ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
हंसस्य चोर्ध्वगमने गतिर्भवति निश्चला |
तत्त्वातत्त्वविवेकोऽस्ति जलदुग्धविभागवत् ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
The swan's movement in soaring upward is unswerving, / and it possesses the discrimination between the real and unreal, like the separation of water and milk.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānajñānayostattvaṃ vivecayati haṃsakaḥ |
haṃsarūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ tena brahmaṇā sṛṣṭikāriṇā ||
meaning:
अज्ञानज्ञानयोस्तत्त्वं विवेचयति हंसकः |
हंसरूपं धृतं तेन ब्रह्मणा सृष्टिकारिणा ||
text_mt: The swan discerns the true nature of ignorance and knowledge; / for that reason, the form of a swan was assumed by Brahmā, the agent of creation.

sanskrit_iast:
viveko naiva labdhaśca yato haṃso vyalīyata |
śivasvarūpatattvasya jyotirūpasya nārada ||
meaning:
विवेको नैव लब्धश्च यतो हंसो व्यलीयत |
शिवस्वरूपतत्त्वस्य ज्योतिरूपस्य नारद ||
text_mt: Yet discrimination was not obtained at all, since the swan vanished / into the true nature of Śiva, whose form is light, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭipravṛttikāmasya kathaṃ jñānaṃ prajāyate |
yato labdho viveko'pi na mayā haṃsarūpiṇā ||
meaning:
सृष्टिप्रवृत्तिकामस्य कथं ज्ञानं प्रजायते |
यतो लब्धो विवेकोऽपि न मया हंसरूपिणा ||
text_mt: How can knowledge arise in one desirous of engaging in creation? / For even discrimination was not obtained by me in the form of a swan.

sanskrit_iast:
gamane'dho varāhasya gatirbhavati niścalā |
dhṛtaṃ vārāharūpaṃ hi viṣṇunā vanacāriṇā ||
meaning:
गमनेऽधो वराहस्य गतिर्भवति निश्चला |
धृतं वाराहरूपं हि विष्णुना वनचारिणा ||
text_mt: In moving downward, the boar's path is unswerving; / indeed, the form of a boar was assumed by Viṣṇu, who roams the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā bhavakalpārthaṃ tadrūpaṃ hi prakalpitam |
viṣṇunā ca varāhasya bhuvanāvanakāriṇā ||
meaning:
अथवा भवकल्पार्थं तद्रूपं हि प्रकल्पितम् |
विष्णुना च वराहस्य भुवनावनकारिणा ||
text_mt: Or rather, that form was assumed by Viṣṇu, the protector of the worlds, / for the sake of the kalpa of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
yaddinaṃ hi samārabhya tadrūpaṃ dhṛtavānhariḥ |
taddinaṃ pratikalpo'sau kalpo vārāhasaṃjñakaḥ ||
meaning:
यद्दिनं हि समारभ्य तद्रूपं धृतवान्हरिः |
तद्दिनं प्रतिकल्पोऽसौ कल्पो वाराहसंज्ञकः ||
text_mt: From the day Hari assumed that form, / that day in every kalpa is called the Vārāhakalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
tadicchā vā yadā jātā tasya rūpasya dhāraṇe |
taddinaṃ pratikalpo'sau kalpo vārāhasaṃjñakaḥ ||
meaning:
तदिच्छा वा यदा जाता तस्य रूपस्य धारणे |
तद्दिनं प्रतिकल्पोऽसौ कल्पो वाराहसंज्ञकः ||
text_mt: Or when the desire arose in him to assume that form, / from that day in every kalpa it is called the Vārāhakalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
iti praśnottaraṃ dattaṃ prastutaṃ śṛṇu nārada |
smṛtvā śivapadāmbhojaṃ vakṣye sṛṣṭividhiṃ mune ||
meaning:
इति प्रश्नोत्तरं दत्तं प्रस्तुतं शृणु नारद |
स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजं वक्ष्ये सृष्टिविधिं मुने ||
text_mt: Thus the answer to your question has been given. Now hear the present matter, O Nārada: / remembering the lotus feet of Śiva, I shall explain the ordinance of creation, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
antarhite mahādeve tvahaṃ lokapitāmahaḥ |
tadīyaṃ vacanaṃ kartumadhyāyandhyānatatparaḥ ||
meaning:
अन्तर्हिते महादेवे त्वहं लोकपितामहः |
तदीयं वचनं कर्तुमध्यायन्ध्यानतत्परः ||
text_mt: When Mahādeva had disappeared, I, the grandfather of the worlds, / intent upon meditation, reflected in order to carry out his command.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskṛtya tadā śambhuṃ jñānaṃ prāpya harestadā |
ānandaṃ paramaṃ gatvā sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ mano dadhe ||
meaning:
नमस्कृत्य तदा शम्भुं ज्ञानं प्राप्य हरेस्तदा |
आनन्दं परमं गत्वा सृष्टिं कर्तुं मनो दधे ||
text_mt: Having bowed to Śambhu then, and received knowledge from Hari at that time, / experiencing supreme bliss, I set my mind to making creation.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuścāpi tadā tatra praṇipatya sadāśivam |
