कृपां कृत्वा नमस्तेऽस्तु दर्शितं स्ववपुर्मम ||
text_mt:
Dakṣa said:
O Mother of the universe, O Mahāmāyā, O Sovereign of the universe, O Maheśvarī,
obeisance to you who have mercifully revealed your own form to me!

sanskrit_iast:
prasīda bhagavatyādye prasīda śivarūpiṇi |
prasīda bhaktavarade jaganmāye namo'stu te ||
meaning:
प्रसीद भगवत्याद्ये प्रसीद शिवरूपिणि |
प्रसीद भक्तवरदे जगन्माये नमोऽस्तु ते ||
text_mt:
Be pleased, O primordial Goddess! Be pleased, O you whose nature is Śiva!
Be pleased, O grantor of boons to devotees! O cosmic illusion, obeisance to you!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
iti stutā maheśānī dakṣeṇa prayatātmanā |
uvāca dakṣaṃ jñātvāpi svayaṃ tasyepsitaṃ mune ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इति स्तुता महेशानी दक्षेण प्रयतात्मना |
उवाच दक्षं ज्ञात्वापि स्वयं तस्येप्सितं मुने ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Thus praised by Dakṣa of disciplined mind,
Maheśānī, though knowing his desire herself, spoke to Dakṣa, O sage:

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca |
tuṣṭāhaṃ dakṣa bhavataḥ sadbhaktyā hyanayā bhṛśam |
varaṃ vṛṣṇīṣva svābhīṣṭaṃ nādeyaṃ vidyate tava ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच |
तुष्टाहं दक्ष भवतः सद्भक्त्या ह्यनया भृशम् |
वरं वृष्णीष्व स्वाभीष्टं नादेयं विद्यते तव ||
text_mt:
The Goddess said:
“I am exceedingly pleased, O Dakṣa, with this true devotion of yours.
Choose a boon according to your wish; there is nothing that cannot be given to you.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
jagadambāvacaḥ śrutvā tato dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
suprahṛṣṭataraḥ prāha nāmaṃ nāmaṃ ca tāṃ śivām ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
जगदम्बावचः श्रुत्वा ततो दक्षः प्रजापतिः |
सुप्रहृष्टतरः प्राह नामं नामं च तां शिवाम् ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing the words of the Mother of the universe, Dakṣa Prajāpati
then, overjoyed, spoke, bowing again and again to that Śivā:

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣa uvāca |
jagadamba mahāmāye yadi tvaṃ varadā mama |
madvacaḥ śṛ ṇu suprītyā mama kāmaṃ prapūraya ||
meaning:
दक्ष उवाच |
जगदम्ब महामाये यदि त्वं वरदा मम |
मद्वचः शृ णु सुप्रीत्या मम कामं प्रपूरय ||
text_mt:
Dakṣa said:
“O Mother of the universe, O Mahāmāyā, if you grant me a boon,
hear my request with great favor and fulfill my desire.

sanskrit_iast:
mama svāmī śivo yo hi sa jāto brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ |
rudranāmā pūrṇarūpāvatāraḥ paramātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
मम स्वामी शिवो यो हि स जातो ब्रह्मणः सुतः |
रुद्रनामा पूर्णरूपावतारः परमात्मनः ||
text_mt:
He who is my master, Śiva, has been born as Brahmā's son
named Rudra, the full incarnation of the Supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
tavāvatāro no jātaḥ kā tatpatnī bhavedataḥ |
taṃ mohaya maheśānamavatīrya kṣitau śive ||
meaning:
तवावतारो नो जातः का तत्पत्नी भवेदतः |
तं मोहय महेशानमवतीर्य क्षितौ शिवे ||
text_mt:
No incarnation of yours has taken place, so who could become his wife?
Therefore, having descended onto the earth, O Śivā, bewilder that Maheśāna.”

sanskrit_iast:
tvadṛte tasya mohāya na śaktānyā kadācana |
tasmānmama sutā bhūtvā harajāyā bhavādhunā ||
meaning:
त्वदृते तस्य मोहाय न शक्तान्या कदाचन |
तस्मान्मम सुता भूत्वा हरजाया भवाधुना ||
text_mt:
Except for you, no other is ever capable of enchanting him.
Therefore, having become my daughter, become now the wife of Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ kṛtvā sulīlāṃ ca bhava tvaṃ haramohinī |
mamaivaiṣa varo devi satyamuktaṃ tavāgrataḥ ||
meaning:
इत्थं कृत्वा सुलीलां च भव त्वं हरमोहिनी |
ममैवैष वरो देवि सत्यमुक्तं तवाग्रतः ||
text_mt:
Acting thus in delightful play, become the enchantress of Hara.
This indeed is my boon, O goddess; truth has been spoken before you.

sanskrit_iast:
svārthaṃ na kevalaṃ me'sti sarveṣāṃ jagatāmapi |
brahmaviṣṇuśivānāṃ ca brahmaṇā prerito hyaham ||
meaning:
स्वार्थं न केवलं मेऽस्ति सर्वेषां जगतामपि |
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवानां च ब्रह्मणा प्रेरितो ह्यहम् ||
text_mt:
It is not merely my own purpose, but also that of all the worlds,
and of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva; indeed, I have been urged by Brahmā."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityākarṇya prajeśasya vacanaṃ jagadambikā |
pratyuvāca vihasyeti smṛtvā taṃ manasā śivam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य प्रजेशस्य वचनं जगदम्बिका |
प्रत्युवाच विहस्येति स्मृत्वा तं मनसा शिवम् ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having heard this speech of the lord of subjects, the mother of the universe,
remembering that Śiva in her mind, smiled and replied thus:

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca |
tāta prajāpate dakṣa śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ |
satyaṃ bravīmi tvadbhaktyā suprasannākhilapradā ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच |
तात प्रजापते दक्ष शृणु मे परमं वचः |
सत्यं ब्रवीमि त्वद्भक्त्या सुप्रसन्नाखिलप्रदा ||
text_mt:
The goddess said:
"Dear father, Prajāpati Dakṣa, hear my supreme word.
I speak the truth: well pleased by your devotion, I am the granter of all.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ tava sutā dakṣa tvajjāyāyāṃ maheśvarī |
bhaviṣyāmi na sandehastvadbhaktivaśavartinī ||
meaning:
अहं तव सुता दक्ष त्वज्जायायां महेश्वरी |
भविष्यामि न सन्देहस्त्वद्भक्तिवशवर्तिनी ||
text_mt:
I, the great goddess, shall become your daughter, O Dakṣa, in your wife;
there is no doubt, held subject by your devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā yatnaṃ kariṣyāmi tapaḥ kṛtvā suduḥsaham |
harajāyā bhaviṣyāmi tadvaraṃ prāpya cānagha ||
meaning:
तथा यत्नं करिष्यामि तपः कृत्वा सुदुःसहम् |
हरजाया भविष्यामि तद्वरं प्राप्य चानघ ||
text_mt:
I shall make such an effort, performing most unbearable austerity;
and obtaining his boon, O sinless one, I shall become the wife of Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
nānyathā kāryasiddhirhi nirvikārī ca sa prabhuḥ |
vidherviṣṇośca saṃsevyaḥ pūrṇa eva sadāśivaḥ ||
meaning:
नान्यथा कार्यसिद्धिर्हि निर्विकारी च स प्रभुः |
विधेर्विष्णोश्च संसेव्यः पूर्ण एव सदाशिवः ||
text_mt:
Otherwise, indeed, the task cannot be accomplished, for that lord is changeless;
he is to be served by Brahmā and Viṣṇu, the complete Sadāśiva himself.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ tasya sadā dāsī priyā janmani janmani |
mama svāmī sa vai śambhurnānārūpadharo'pi ha ||
meaning:
अहं तस्य सदा दासी प्रिया जन्मनि जन्मनि |
मम स्वामी स वै शम्भुर्नानारूपधरोऽपि ह ||
text_mt:
I am ever his handmaiden, his beloved in birth after birth;
that Śambhu indeed is my husband, though assuming manifold forms.

sanskrit_iast:
varaprabhāvād bhrukuṭeravatīrṇo vidheḥ sa ca |
ahaṃ tadvarato'pīhāvatariṣye tadājñayā ||
meaning:
वरप्रभावाद् भ्रुकुटेरवतीर्णो विधेः स च |
अहं तद्वरतोऽपीहावतरिष्ये तदाज्ञया ||
text_mt:
By the power of a boon, he descended from the eyebrow of Brahmā;
and I too, by his boon, shall descend here by his command.

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha svabhavanaṃ tāta mayā jñātā tu dūtikā |
harajāyā bhaviṣyāmi bhūtvā te tanayācirāt ||
meaning:
गच्छ स्वभवनं तात मया ज्ञाता तु दूतिका |
हरजाया भविष्यामि भूत्वा ते तनयाचिरात् ||
text_mt:
Go to your own abode, father; the female messenger has been acknowledged by me.
Becoming your daughter, before long I shall become the wife of Hara."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sadvaco dakṣaṃ śivājñāṃ prāpya cetasi |
punaḥ provāca sā devī smṛtvā śivapadāmbujam ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा सद्वचो दक्षं शिवाज्ञां प्राप्य चेतसि |
पुनः प्रोवाच सा देवी स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्बुजम् ||
text_mt:
Having spoken this true word to Dakṣa, receiving Śiva's command in her mind,
that goddess spoke again, remembering Śiva's lotus feet:

sanskrit_iast:
parantu praṇa ādheyo manasā te prajāpate |
śrāvayiṣyāmi te taṃ vai satyaṃ jānīhi no mṛṣā ||
meaning:
परन्तु प्रण आधेयो मनसा ते प्रजापते |
श्रावयिष्यामि ते तं वै सत्यं जानीहि नो मृषा ||
text_mt:
"However, a solemn condition must be placed in your mind, O Prajāpati.
I shall recite it to you; know it to be true, not false.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā bhavān mayi punarbhavenmandādarastadā |
dehaṃ tyakṣye nijaṃ satyaṃ svātmanyasmyatha vetaram ||
meaning:
यदा भवान् मयि पुनर्भवेन्मन्दादरस्तदा |
देहं त्यक्ष्ये निजं सत्यं स्वात्मन्यस्म्यथ वेतरम् ||
text_mt:
Whenever you again become deficient in respect toward me,
then I shall truly cast off my body, either in my own self or another.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa dattastava varaḥ pratisargaṃ prajāpate |
ahaṃ tava sutā bhūtvā bhaviṣyāmi harapriyā ||
brahmovāca |
evamuktvā maheśānī dakṣaṃ mukhyaprajāpatim ||
antardadhe drutaṃ tatra samyag dakṣasya paśyataḥ | 36 ||
meaning:
एष दत्तस्तव वरः प्रतिसर्गं प्रजापते |
अहं तव सुता भूत्वा भविष्यामि हरप्रिया ||
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एवमुक्त्वा महेशानी दक्षं मुख्यप्रजापतिम् ||
अन्तर्दधे द्रुतं तत्र सम्यग् दक्षस्य पश्यतः | 36 ||
text_mt:
This boon has been given to you in every creation, O Prajāpati:
becoming your daughter, I shall be Hara's beloved."

Brahmā said:
Having spoken thus to Dakṣa, the foremost Prajāpati,

Maheśānī instantly disappeared right there, while Dakṣa looked on. (36)

sanskrit_iast:
antarhitāyāṃ durgāyāṃ sa dakṣo'pi nijāśramam |
jagāma ca mudaṃ lebhe bhaviṣyati suteti sā ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ satīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
अन्तर्हितायां दुर्गायां स दक्षोऽपि निजाश्रमम् |
जगाम च मुदं लेभे भविष्यति सुतेति सा ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां द्वितीयः सतीखण्डे
text_mt:
When Durgā had disappeared, Dakṣa too went to his own hermitage
and attained joy, thinking, 'She will become my daughter.'

Thus ends the twelfth chapter, named 'Description of the Attainment of Dakṣa’s Boon,' in the second Satī section of the second Rudrasaṃhitā in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca |
brahman vidhe mahāprājña vada no vadatāṃ vara |
dakṣe gṛhaṃ gate prītyā kimabhūttadanantaram ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच |
ब्रह्मन् विधे महाप्राज्ञ वद नो वदतां वर |
दक्षे गृहं गते प्रीत्या किमभूत्तदनन्तरम् ||
title: trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | dakṣasṛṣṭau nāradaśāpaḥ
text_mt:
Nārada said:
"O Brahmā, O creator, of great wisdom, tell us, O best of speakers,
when Dakṣa had gone home with affection, what happened after that?"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
dakṣaḥ prajāpatirgatvā svāśramaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ |
sargaṃ cakāra bahudhā mānasaṃ mama cājñayā ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
दक्षः प्रजापतिर्गत्वा स्वाश्रमं हृष्टमानसः |
सर्गं चकार बहुधा मानसं मम चाज्ञया ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Prajāpati Dakṣa, having gone to his hermitage with a delighted mind,
fashioned the mental creation in many ways by my command.

sanskrit_iast:
tamabṛṃhitamālokya prajāsargaṃ prajāpatiḥ |
dakṣo nivedayāmāsa brahmaṇe janakāya me ||
meaning:
तमबृंहितमालोक्य प्रजासर्गं प्रजापतिः |
दक्षो निवेदयामास ब्रह्मणे जनकाय मे ||
text_mt:
Seeing that creation of progeny unmultiplied, Prajāpati
Dakṣa reported [it] to Brahmā, my progenitor.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣa uvāca |
brahmaṃstāta prajānātha vardhante na prajāḥ prabho mayā viracitāḥ sarvāstāvatyo hi sthitāḥ khalu ||
meaning:
दक्ष उवाच |
ब्रह्मंस्तात प्रजानाथ वर्धन्ते न प्रजाः प्रभो मया विरचिताः सर्वास्तावत्यो हि स्थिताः खलु ||
text_mt:
Dakṣa said:
"O Brahmā, father, lord of creatures, the subjects do not multiply, O lord.
All those created by me indeed remain just as many.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ karomi prajānātha vardheyuḥ kathamātmanā |
tadupāyaṃ samācakṣva prajāḥ kuryāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
किं करोमि प्रजानाथ वर्धेयुः कथमात्मना |
तदुपायं समाचक्ष्व प्रजाः कुर्यां न संशयः ||
text_mt:
What shall I do, O lord of creatures? How may they multiply by themselves?
Declare that means, so that I may create subjects beyond doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
dakṣa prajāpate tāta śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ |
tatkuruṣva suraśreṣṭha śivaste śaṃ kariṣyati ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
दक्ष प्रजापते तात शृणु मे परमं वचः |
तत्कुरुष्व सुरश्रेष्ठ शिवस्ते शं करिष्यति ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
"O Dakṣa, Prajāpati, dear son, hear my supreme word.
Do that, O best of gods; Śiva will bring you welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
yā ca pañcajanasyāṅgasutā ramyā prajāpateḥ |
asiknī nāma patnītve prajeśa pratigṛhyatām ||
meaning:
या च पञ्चजनस्याङ्गसुता रम्या प्रजापतेः |
असिक्नी नाम पत्नीत्वे प्रजेश प्रतिगृह्यताम् ||
text_mt:
Let that lovely daughter of Prajāpati Pañcajana, O dear one,
named Asiknī, be accepted in marriage, O lord of subjects.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmavyavāyadharmastvaṃ prajāsargamimaṃ punaḥ |
tadvidhāyāṃ ca kāminyāṃ bhūriśo bhāvayiṣyasi ||
meaning:
वामव्यवायधर्मस्त्वं प्रजासर्गमिमं पुनः |
तद्विधायां च कामिन्यां भूरिशो भावयिष्यसि ||
text_mt:
Observing the duty of sexual union, you, in turn,
shall generate this creation of subjects abundantly in that desirous woman."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca tataḥsamutpādayituṃ prajā maithunadharmataḥ |
upayeme vīraṇasya nideśānme sutāṃ tataḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ततःसमुत्पादयितुं प्रजा मैथुनधर्मतः |
उपयेमे वीरणस्य निदेशान्मे सुतां ततः ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said: Then, in order to produce progeny by the duty of copulation,
he married the daughter of Vīraṇa by my instruction.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tasyāṃ svapatnyāṃ ca vīriṇyāṃ sa prajāpatiḥ |
haryaśvasaṃjñānayutaṃ dakṣaḥ putrānajījanat ||
meaning:
अथ तस्यां स्वपत्न्यां च वीरिण्यां स प्रजापतिः |
हर्यश्वसंज्ञानयुतं दक्षः पुत्रानजीजनत् ||
text_mt:
Then in her, his own wife Vīriṇī, that Prajāpati
Dakṣa begot ten thousand sons named the Haryaśvas.

sanskrit_iast:
apṛthagdharmaśīlāste sarva āsan sutā mune |
pitṛbhaktiratā nityaṃ vedamārgaparāyaṇāḥ ||
meaning:
अपृथग्धर्मशीलास्ते सर्व आसन् सुता मुने |
पितृभक्तिरता नित्यं वेदमार्गपरायणाः ||
text_mt:
All those sons were of undivided virtuous conduct, O sage,
always devoted to fatherly love and dedicated to the Vedic path.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛproktāḥ prajāsargakaraṇārthaṃ yayurdiśam |
pratīcīṃ tapase tāta sarve dākṣāyaṇāḥ sutāḥ ||
meaning:
पितृप्रोक्ताः प्रजासर्गकरणार्थं ययुर्दिशम् |
प्रतीचीं तपसे तात सर्वे दाक्षायणाः सुताः ||
text_mt:
Instructed by their father to generate progeny, all the sons of Dakṣa,
O dear one, went to the western quarter for austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra nārāyaṇasarastīrthaṃ paramapāvanam |
saṅgamo yatra sañjāto divyasindhusamudrayoḥ ||
meaning:
तत्र नारायणसरस्तीर्थं परमपावनम् |
सङ्गमो यत्र सञ्जातो दिव्यसिन्धुसमुद्रयोः ||
text_mt:
There is the supremely purifying holy place Nārāyaṇasaras,
where the confluence of the divine Sindhu and the ocean occurred.

sanskrit_iast:
tadupasparśanādeva protpannamatayo'bhavan |
dharme pāramahaṃse ca vinirdhūtamalāśayāḥ ||
meaning:
तदुपस्पर्शनादेव प्रोत्पन्नमतयोऽभवन् |
धर्मे पारमहंसे च विनिर्धूतमलाशयाः ||
text_mt:
From the mere touching of its waters, their intellects were awakened
unto the duty of supreme ascetics, their minds cleansed of impurities.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāvivṛddhaye te vai tepire tatra sattamāḥ |
dākṣāyaṇā dṛḍhātmānaḥ pitrādeśesuyantritā ||
meaning:
प्रजाविवृद्धये ते वै तेपिरे तत्र सत्तमाः |
दाक्षायणा दृढात्मानः पित्रादेशेसुयन्त्रिता ||
text_mt:
For the increase of progeny, those best of beings indeed performed austerity there,
the sons of Dakṣa, firm-minded, well-restrained by their father's command.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ ca tān nārada jñātvā tapataḥ sṛṣṭihetave |
agamastatra bhūrīṇi hārdamājñāya māpateḥ ||
meaning:
त्वं च तान् नारद ज्ञात्वा तपतः सृष्टिहेतवे |
अगमस्तत्र भूरीणि हार्दमाज्ञाय मापतेः ||
text_mt:
And you, O Nārada, knowing that they were performing austerity for the sake of creation,
went there, knowing the manifold intention of the lord of Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛṣṭvā taṃ bhuvaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ kathaṃ kartuṃ samudyatāḥ |
haryaśvā dakṣatanayā ityavocaṃstamādarat ||
meaning:
अदृष्ट्वा तं भुवः सृष्टिं कथं कर्तुं समुद्यताः |
हर्यश्वा दक्षतनया इत्यवोचंस्तमादरत् ||
text_mt:
"Without seeing that, how are you prepared to undertake the creation of the earth,
O Haryaśvas, sons of Dakṣa?" Thus you spoke to them with respect.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca taṃ niśamyātha haryaśvāste tvaduktamatandritāḥ |
autpattikadhiyaḥ sarve svayaṃ vimamṛśurbhṛśam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच तं निशम्याथ हर्यश्वास्ते त्वदुक्तमतन्द्रिताः |
औत्पत्तिकधियः सर्वे स्वयं विममृशुर्भृशम् ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said: Then, having heard that statement spoken by you, those unwearied Haryaśvas,
all possessing intuitive wisdom, reflected deeply by themselves:

sanskrit_iast:
suśāstrajanakādeśaṃ yo na veda nivartakam |
sa kathaṃ guṇaviśrambhī kartuṃ sargamupakramet ||
meaning:
सुशास्त्रजनकादेशं यो न वेद निवर्तकम् |
स कथं गुणविश्रम्भी कर्तुं सर्गमुपक्रमेत् ||
text_mt:
"He who does not know the instruction of the progenitor of good scriptures, which leads to cessation,
how can he, trusting in the qualities, undertake to create?

sanskrit_iast:
iti niścitya te putrāḥ sudhiyaścaikacetasaḥ |
praṇamya taṃ parikramyāyurmārgamanivartakam ||
meaning:
इति निश्चित्य ते पुत्राः सुधियश्चैकचेतसः |
प्रणम्य तं परिक्रम्यायुर्मार्गमनिवर्तकम् ||
text_mt:
Having decided thus, those intelligent sons, single-minded,
bowing to him and circumambulating him, took the path of no return.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada tvaṃ manaḥ śambhorlokānanyacaro mune |
nirvikāro maheśānamanovṛttikarastadā ||
meaning:
नारद त्वं मनः शम्भोर्लोकानन्यचरो मुने |
निर्विकारो महेशानमनोवृत्तिकरस्तदा ||
text_mt:
O Nārada, you are the mind of Śambhu, wanderer of other worlds, O sage,
changeless, carrying out the intention of Maheśāna at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
kāle gate bahutare mama putraḥ prajāpatiḥ |
nāśaṃ niśamya putrāṇāṃ nāradādanvatapyata ||
meaning:
काले गते बहुतरे मम पुत्रः प्रजापतिः |
नाशं निशम्य पुत्राणां नारदादन्वतप्यत ||
text_mt:
When much time had passed, my son, the Prajāpati,
hearing from Nārada of the loss of his sons, grieved.

sanskrit_iast:
muhurmuhuruvāceti suprajatvaṃ śucāṃ padam |
śuśoca bahuśo dakṣaḥ śivamāyāvimohitaḥ ||
meaning:
मुहुर्मुहुरुवाचेति सुप्रजत्वं शुचां पदम् |
शुशोच बहुशो दक्षः शिवमायाविमोहितः ||
text_mt:
Again and again he said, 'Having good offspring is the seat of griefs!'
Deluded by the illusion of Śiva, Dakṣa lamented exceedingly.

sanskrit_iast:
ahamāgatya suprītyā sāntvayaṃ dakṣamātmajam |
śāntibhāvaṃ pradarśyaiva daivaṃ prabalamityuta ||
meaning:
अहमागत्य सुप्रीत्या सान्त्वयं दक्षमात्मजम् |
शान्तिभावं प्रदर्श्यैव दैवं प्रबलमित्युत ||
text_mt:
Coming with great affection, I consoled Dakṣa, my son,
displaying a state of calm and saying that destiny is powerful.

sanskrit_iast:
atha dakṣaḥ pañcajanyāṃ mayā sa parisāntvitaḥ |
sabalāśvābhidhān putrān sahasraṃ cāpyajījanat ||
meaning:
अथ दक्षः पञ्चजन्यां मया स परिसान्त्वितः |
सबलाश्वाभिधान् पुत्रान् सहस्रं चाप्यजीजनत् ||
text_mt:
Then Dakṣa, consoled by me, in the daughter of Pañcajana
begot a thousand sons named the Sabalāśvas.

sanskrit_iast:
te'pi jagmustatra sutāḥ pitrādiṣṭā dṛḍhavratāḥ |
prajāsarge yatra siddhāḥ svapūrvabhrātaro yayuḥ ||
meaning:
तेऽपि जग्मुस्तत्र सुताः पित्रादिष्टा दृढव्रताः |
प्रजासर्गे यत्र सिद्धाः स्वपूर्वभ्रातरो ययुः ||
text_mt:
They too, instructed by their father, firm in vows, went there
for the creation of progeny, where their former brothers, who had achieved perfection, had gone.

sanskrit_iast:
tadupasparśanādeva naṣṭāghā vimalāśayāḥ |
tepurmahattapastatra japanto brahma suvratāḥ ||
meaning:
तदुपस्पर्शनादेव नष्टाघा विमलाशयाः |
तेपुर्महत्तपस्तत्र जपन्तो ब्रह्म सुव्रताः ||
text_mt:
From the mere touching of its waters, with sins destroyed and minds purified,
those of good vows performed great austerity there, chanting the sacred syllable."

sanskrit_iast:
prajāsargodyatāṃstān vai jñātvā gatveti nārada |
pūrvavaccāgado vākyaṃ saṃsmarannaiśvarīṃ gatim ||
meaning:
प्रजासर्गोद्यतांस्तान् वै ज्ञात्वा गत्वेति नारद |
पूर्ववच्चागदो वाक्यं संस्मरन्नैश्वरीं गतिम् ||
text_mt: Knowing that they were intent upon the creation of offspring, Nārada, you went there / and spoke words as before, remembering the movement of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātṛpanthānamādiśya tvaṃ mune'moghadarśana |
ayāścordhvagatiṃ te'pi bhrātṛmārgaṃ yayuḥ sutāḥ ||
meaning:
भ्रातृपन्थानमादिश्य त्वं मुनेऽमोघदर्शन |
अयाश्चोर्ध्वगतिं तेऽपि भ्रातृमार्गं ययुः सुताः ||
text_mt: Having pointed out the path of their brothers, O sage of unfailing vision, / you went along an upward course, and those sons also followed the path of their brothers.

sanskrit_iast:
utpātān bahuśo'paśyattadaiva sa prajāpatiḥ |
vismito'bhūtsa me putro dakṣo manasi duḥkhitaḥ ||
meaning:
उत्पातान् बहुशोऽपश्यत्तदैव स प्रजापतिः |
विस्मितोऽभूत्स मे पुत्रो दक्षो मनसि दुःखितः ||
text_mt: At that very time, the Prajāpati saw many portents; / he, my son Dakṣa, was astonished and grieved in his mind.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavat tvatkṛtaṃ dakṣaḥ śuśrāva cakito bhṛśam |
putranāśaṃ śuśocāti putraśokavimūrcchitaḥ ||
meaning:
पूर्ववत् त्वत्कृतं दक्षः शुश्राव चकितो भृशम् |
पुत्रनाशं शुशोचाति पुत्रशोकविमूर्च्छितः ||
text_mt: Dakṣa heard that the deed had been done by you just as before, and was utterly shocked; / he grieved greatly over the loss of his sons, fainting away with grief for his sons.

sanskrit_iast:
cukrodha tubhyaṃ dakṣo'sau duṣṭo'yamiti cābravīt |
āgatastatra daivāt tvamanugrahakarastadā ||
meaning:
चुक्रोध तुभ्यं दक्षोऽसौ दुष्टोऽयमिति चाब्रवीत् |
आगतस्तत्र दैवात् त्वमनुग्रहकरस्तदा ||
text_mt: That Dakṣa grew furious with you and said, 'This one is wicked!' / By chance you arrived there at that time, bringing grace.

sanskrit_iast:
śokāviṣṭaḥ sa dakṣo hi roṣavisphuritādharaḥ |
upalabhya tamāhatya dhigdhik procya vigarhayan ||
meaning:
शोकाविष्टः स दक्षो हि रोषविस्फुरिताधरः |
उपलभ्य तमाहत्य धिग्धिक् प्रोच्य विगर्हयन् ||
text_mt: Dakṣa, overwhelmed with grief, his lower lip trembling with fury, / approached you, struck out, and censured [you], crying: 'Fie, fie!'

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣa uvāca |
kiṃ kṛtaṃ te'dhamaśreṣṭha sādhūnāṃ sādhuliṅgataḥ |
bhikṣomārgo'rbhakānāṃ vai darśito'sādhukāri naḥ ||
meaning:
दक्ष उवाच |
किं कृतं तेऽधमश्रेष्ठ साधूनां साधुलिङ्गतः |
भिक्षोमार्गोऽर्भकानां वै दर्शितोऽसाधुकारि नः ||
text_mt: Dakṣa said: / 'What have you done, O chief of the vile, in the garb of the virtuous? / You have shown the path of a mendicant to children, doing us wrong!

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṇaistribhiramuktānāṃ lokayorubhayoḥ kṛtaḥ |
vighātaḥ śreyaso'mīṣāṃ nirdayena śaṭhena te ||
meaning:
ऋणैस्त्रिभिरमुक्तानां लोकयोरुभयोः कृतः |
विघातः श्रेयसोऽमीषां निर्दयेन शठेन ते ||
text_mt: By you, cruel and rogue, an obstacle to the welfare of these boys / in both worlds has been made, when they were not yet freed from the three debts.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya yo gṛhātpravrajetpumān |
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tyaktvā mokṣamicchan vrajatyadhaḥ ||
meaning:
ऋणानि त्रीण्यपाकृत्य यो गृहात्प्रव्रजेत्पुमान् |
मातरं पितरं त्यक्त्वा मोक्षमिच्छन् व्रजत्यधः ||
text_mt: Whatever man renounces home without discharging the three debts, / abandoning mother and father in the desire for liberation, he goes downwards.

sanskrit_iast:
nirdayastvaṃ sunirlajjaḥ śiśudhībhidyaśo'pahā |
hareḥ pārṣadamadhye hi vṛthā carasi mūḍhadhīḥ ||
meaning:
निर्दयस्त्वं सुनिर्लज्जः शिशुधीभिद्यशोऽपहा |
हरेः पार्षदमध्ये हि वृथा चरसि मूढधीः ||
text_mt: You are merciless, utterly shameless, a subverter of children's minds, a destroyer of fame! / You wander among the attendants of Hari in vain, foolish-minded one!

sanskrit_iast:
muhurmuhurabhadraṃ tvamacaro me'dhamādhama |
vibhaved bhramataste'taḥ padaṃ lokeṣu na sthiram ||
meaning:
मुहुर्मुहुरभद्रं त्वमचरो मेऽधमाधम |
विभवेद् भ्रमतस्तेऽतः पदं लोकेषु न स्थिरम् ||
text_mt: Again and again you have done evil to me, lowest of the vile! / Therefore, as you wander, there shall be no fixed place for you in the worlds!'

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāpeti śucā dakṣastvāṃ tadā sādhusammatam |
bubodha neśvarecchāṃ sa śivamāyāvimohitaḥ ||
meaning:
शशापेति शुचा दक्षस्त्वां तदा साधुसम्मतम् |
बुबोध नेश्वरेच्छां स शिवमायाविमोहितः ||
text_mt: Thus Dakṣa cursed you in grief, who are honoured by the virtuous; / deluded by the māyā of Śiva, he did not understand the will of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
śāpaṃ pratyagrahīcca tvaṃ sa mune nirvikāradhīḥ |
eṣa eva brahmasādho sahate so'pi ca svayam ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ satīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
शापं प्रत्यग्रहीच्च त्वं स मुने निर्विकारधीः |
एष एव ब्रह्मसाधो सहते सोऽपि च स्वयम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां द्वितीयः सतीखण्डे
text_mt:
And you, O sage, accepted the curse with an untroubled mind; / such indeed is a virtuous follower of Brahmā—he even endures it himself.

Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, named 'The Curse upon Nārada', in the Dakṣasṛṣṭi of the second section, the Satīkhaṇḍa, in the Rudrasaṃhitā, the second [part] of the auspicious Śivamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
etasminnantare devamune lokapitāmahaḥ |
tatrāgamamahaṃ prītyā jñātvā taccaritaṃ drutam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवमुने लोकपितामहः |
तत्रागममहं प्रीत्या ज्ञात्वा तच्चरितं द्रुतम् ||
title: caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ | satījanma tasyā bālalīlā ca
text_mt: Brahmā said: / In the meantime, O celestial sage, I, the grandfather of the worlds, / having quickly learned of that event, went there with affection.

sanskrit_iast:
asāntvayamahaṃ dakṣaṃ pūrvavatsuvicakṣaṇaḥ |
akārṣaṃ tena susnehaṃ tava suprītimāvahan ||
meaning:
असान्त्वयमहं दक्षं पूर्ववत्सुविचक्षणः |
अकार्षं तेन सुस्नेहं तव सुप्रीतिमावहन् ||
text_mt: Being very discerning, I consoled Dakṣa as before; / I established good affection with him, bringing great joy to you.

sanskrit_iast:
svātmajaṃ munivaryaṃ tvāṃ suprītyā devavallabham |
samāśvāsya samādāya pratyapadye svadhāma ha ||
meaning:
स्वात्मजं मुनिवर्यं त्वां सुप्रीत्या देववल्लभम् |
समाश्वास्य समादाय प्रत्यपद्ये स्वधाम ह ||
text_mt: Having consoled and taken you with great affection, my own son, the best of sages, dear to the gods, / I returned to my own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prajāpatirdakṣo'nunīto me nijastriyām |
janayāmāsa duhitṝḥ subhagāḥ ṣaṣṭisammitāḥ ||
meaning:
ततः प्रजापतिर्दक्षोऽनुनीतो मे निजस्त्रियाम् |
जनयामास दुहितॄः सुभगाः षष्टिसम्मिताः ||
text_mt: Then the Prajāpati Dakṣa, conciliated by me, / begot sixty fortunate daughters upon his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ vivāhaṃ kṛtavān dharmādibhiratandritaḥ |
tadeva śṛṇu suprītyā pravadāmi munīśvara ||
meaning:
तासां विवाहं कृतवान् धर्मादिभिरतन्द्रितः |
तदेव शृणु सुप्रीत्या प्रवदामि मुनीश्वर ||
text_mt: Untiringly, he gave them in marriage to Dharma and the others; / listen with great joy, O lord of sages, as I tell of that.

sanskrit_iast:
dadau daśa sutā dakṣo dharmāya vidhivanmune |
trayodaśa kaśyapāya munaye trinavendave ||
meaning:
ददौ दश सुता दक्षो धर्माय विधिवन्मुने |
त्रयोदश कश्यपाय मुनये त्रिनवेन्दवे ||
text_mt: O sage, Dakṣa gave ten daughters to Dharma according to rule, / thirteen to the sage Kaśyapa, and twenty-seven to the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtāṅgiraḥ kṛśāśśvābhyāṃ dve dve putryau pradattavān |
tārkṣyāya cāparāḥ kanyāḥ prasūtiprasavairyataḥ ||
trilokāḥ pūritāstanno varṇyate vyāsato bhayāt | 8 ||
meaning:
भूताङ्गिरः कृशाश्श्वाभ्यां द्वे द्वे पुत्र्यौ प्रदत्तवान् |
तार्क्ष्याय चापराः कन्याः प्रसूतिप्रसवैर्यतः ||
त्रिलोकाः पूरितास्तन्नो वर्ण्यते व्यासतो भयात् | 8 ||
text_mt:
He gave two daughters each to Bhūta, Aṅgiras, and Kṛśāśva, / and the other daughters to Tārkṣya, through whose bearing of offspring

the three worlds were filled; that is not described [here] for fear of prolixity.

sanskrit_iast:
kecidvadanti tāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ madhyamāṃ cāpare śivām |
sarvānantarajāṃ kecitkalpabhedāt trayaṃ ca sat ||
meaning:
केचिद्वदन्ति तां ज्येष्ठां मध्यमां चापरे शिवाम् |
सर्वानन्तरजां केचित्कल्पभेदात् त्रयं च सत् ||
text_mt: Some say that Śivā was the eldest, others that she was the middle one, / and some that she was born after all of them; through the difference of kalpas, all three are true.

sanskrit_iast:
anantaraṃ sutotpatteḥ sapatnīkaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
dakṣo dadhau suprītyā tāṃ manasā jagadambikām ||
meaning:
अनन्तरं सुतोत्पत्तेः सपत्नीकः प्रजापतिः |
दक्षो दधौ सुप्रीत्या तां मनसा जगदम्बिकाम् ||
text_mt: After the birth of the daughters, the Prajāpati Dakṣa, / together with his wife, meditated with great love upon that mother of the universe in his mind.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ premṇā ca tuṣṭāva girā gadgadayā hi saḥ |
bhūyo bhūyo namaskṛtya sāñjalirvinayānvitaḥ ||
meaning:
अतः प्रेम्णा च तुष्टाव गिरा गद्गदया हि सः |
भूयो भूयो नमस्कृत्य साञ्जलिर्विनयान्वितः ||
text_mt: Then, out of love, he praised her with a voice faltering [with emotion], / bowing down repeatedly, with folded hands, endowed with humility.

sanskrit_iast:
santuṣṭā sā tadā devī vicāraṃ manasīti ca |
cakre'vatāraṃ vīriṇyāṃ kuryāṃ paṇavipūrtaye ||
meaning:
सन्तुष्टा सा तदा देवी विचारं मनसीति च |
चक्रेऽवतारं वीरिण्यां कुर्यां पणविपूर्तये ||
text_mt: The goddess was pleased then and formed this thought in her mind: / 'I shall make an incarnation in Vīriṇī in order to fulfill my promise.'

sanskrit_iast:
atha sovāsa manasi dakṣasya jagadambikā |
vilalāsa tadātīva sa dakṣo munisattama ||
meaning:
अथ सोवास मनसि दक्षस्य जगदम्बिका |
विललास तदातीव स दक्षो मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: Then the mother of the universe dwelt in the mind of Dakṣa; / at that time Dakṣa shone exceedingly bright, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
sumuhūrtena dakṣo'pi svapatnyāṃ nidadhe mudā |
dakṣapatnyāstadā citte śivovāsa dayānvitā ||
āvirbabhūva cihnāni dohadasyākhilāni vai | 15 ||
meaning:
सुमुहूर्तेन दक्षोऽपि स्वपत्न्यां निदधे मुदा |
दक्षपत्न्यास्तदा चित्ते शिवोवास दयान्विता ||
आविर्बभूव चिह्नानि दोहदस्याखिलानि वै | 15 ||
text_mt:
At an auspicious hour, Dakṣa joyfully deposited [her] into his wife; / then, compassionate, Śivā dwelt in the heart of Dakṣa's wife.

All the signs of pregnancy appeared.

sanskrit_iast:
vireje vīriṇī tāta hṛṣṭacittādhikaṃ ca sā |
śivāvāsaprabhāvāttu mahāmaṅgalarūpiṇī ||
meaning:
विरेजे वीरिणी तात हृष्टचित्ताधिकं च सा |
शिवावासप्रभावात्तु महामङ्गलरूपिणी ||
text_mt: O dear one, Vīriṇī shone forth, exceedingly gladdened in heart, / taking on a form of great auspiciousness through the power of Śivā's presence.

sanskrit_iast:
kulasya sampradāyaiśca śruteścittasamunnateḥ |
vyadhatta sukriyā dakṣaḥ prītyā puṃsavanādikāḥ ||
meaning:
कुलस्य सम्प्रदायैश्च श्रुतेश्चित्तसमुन्नतेः |
व्यधत्त सुक्रिया दक्षः प्रीत्या पुंसवनादिकाः ||
text_mt: In accordance with the traditions of his family and the Vedic scriptures, and from the elevation of his mind, / Dakṣa gladly performed the auspicious rites such as the puṃsavana.

sanskrit_iast:
utsavo'tīva sañjātastadā teṣu ca karmasu |
vittaṃ dadau dvijātibhyo yathākāmaṃ prajāpatiḥ ||
meaning:
उत्सवोऽतीव सञ्जातस्तदा तेषु च कर्मसु |
वित्तं ददौ द्विजातिभ्यो यथाकामं प्रजापतिः ||
text_mt: A great festival took place during those rites, / and the Prajāpati gave wealth to the twice-born as much as they desired.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tasminnavasare sarve haryādayaḥ surāḥ |
jñātvā garbhagatāṃ devīṃ vīriṇyāṃ te mudaṃ yayuḥ ||
meaning:
अथ तस्मिन्नवसरे सर्वे हर्यादयः सुराः |
ज्ञात्वा गर्भगतां देवीं वीरिण्यां ते मुदं ययुः ||
text_mt: Then at that time, all the gods headed by Hari, / knowing that the goddess was in the womb of Vīriṇī, were filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāgatya ca sarve te tuṣṭuvurjagadambikām |
lokopakārakariṇīṃ praṇamya ca muhurmuhuḥ ||
meaning:
तत्रागत्य च सर्वे ते तुष्टुवुर्जगदम्बिकाम् |
लोकोपकारकरिणीं प्रणम्य च मुहुर्मुहुः ||
text_mt: They all came there and praised the mother of the universe, / the benefactor of the worlds, bowing down again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tataste bahudhā praśaṃsāṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ |
dakṣaprajāpateścaiva vīriṇyāḥ svagṛhaṃ yayuḥ ||
meaning:
कृत्वा ततस्ते बहुधा प्रशंसां हृष्टमानसाः |
दक्षप्रजापतेश्चैव वीरिण्याः स्वगृहं ययुः ||
text_mt: Having spoken many praises, with delighted minds, / for the Prajāpati Dakṣa and for Vīriṇī, they returned to their own abodes.

sanskrit_iast:
gateṣu navamāseṣu kārayitvā ca laukikīm |
gatiṃ śivā ca pūrṇe sā daśame māsi nārada ||
meaning:
गतेषु नवमासेषु कारयित्वा च लौकिकीम् |
गतिं शिवा च पूर्णे सा दशमे मासि नारद ||
text_mt: When nine months had passed and she had made the worldly course run, / in the full tenth month, O Nārada, Śivā

sanskrit_iast:
āvirbabhūva purato mātuḥ sadyastadā mune |
muhūrte sukhade candragrahatārānukūlake ||
meaning:
आविर्बभूव पुरतो मातुः सद्यस्तदा मुने |
मुहूर्ते सुखदे चन्द्रग्रहतारानुकूलके ||
text_mt: manifested at once before her mother, O sage, / at an auspicious hour, when the moon, planets, and constellations were favourable.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ tu jātamātrāyāṃ suprīto'sau prajāpatiḥ |
śaivadevīti tāṃ mene dṛṣṭvā tāṃ tejasolbaṇām ||
meaning:
तस्यां तु जातमात्रायां सुप्रीतोऽसौ प्रजापतिः |
शैवदेवीति तां मेने दृष्ट्वा तां तेजसोल्बणाम् ||
text_mt: As soon as she was born, the Prajāpati was overjoyed; / seeing her blazing with brilliance, he recognized her as the Śaiva goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
tadābhūtpuṣpasadvṛṣṭirmeghāśca vavṛṣurjalam |
diśaḥ śāntā drutaṃ tasyāṃ jātāyāṃ ca munīśvara ||
meaning:
तदाभूत्पुष्पसद्वृष्टिर्मेघाश्च ववृषुर्जलम् |
दिशः शान्ता द्रुतं तस्यां जातायां च मुनीश्वर ||
text_mt: Then there was a shower of fine flowers, and the clouds rained down water; / the directions became calm at once when she was born, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
avādayanta tridaśāḥ śubhavādyāni khe gatāḥ |
jajjvaluścāgnayaḥ śāntāḥ sarvamāsītsumaṅgalam ||
meaning:
अवादयन्त त्रिदशाः शुभवाद्यानि खे गताः |
जज्ज्वलुश्चाग्नयः शान्ताः सर्वमासीत्सुमङ्गलम् ||
text_mt: Going into the sky, the gods sounded auspicious musical instruments; / the fires burned serenely, and all became most auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
vīriṇīsambhavāṃ dṛṣṭvā dakṣastāṃ jagadambikām |
namaskṛtya karau baddhvā bahu tuṣṭāva bhaktitaḥ ||
meaning:
वीरिणीसम्भवां दृष्ट्वा दक्षस्तां जगदम्बिकाम् |
नमस्कृत्य करौ बद्ध्वा बहु तुष्टाव भक्तितः ||
text_mt: Seeing that mother of the universe born of Vīriṇī, / Dakṣa bowed, joined his hands, and praised her greatly with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣa uvāca |
maheśāni namastubhyaṃ jagadambe sanātani |
kṛpāṃ kuru mahādevi satye satyasvarūpiṇi ||
meaning:
दक्ष उवाच |
महेशानि नमस्तुभ्यं जगदम्बे सनातनि |
कृपां कुरु महादेवि सत्ये सत्यस्वरूपिणि ||
text_mt: Dakṣa said: / 'Homage to you, Maheśānī, mother of the universe, eternal one! / Grant mercy, great goddess, Satī, whose nature is truth!

sanskrit_iast:
śivā śāntā mahāmāyā yoganidrā jaganmayī |
yā procyate vedavidbhirnamāmi tvāṃ hitāvahām ||
meaning:
शिवा शान्ता महामाया योगनिद्रा जगन्मयी |
या प्रोच्यते वेदविद्भिर्नमामि त्वां हितावहाम् ||
text_mt: She who is called Śivā, the tranquil, Mahāmāyā, Yoganidrā, identical with the universe / by those who know the Vedas—I bow to you who bring welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
yayā dhātā jagatsṛṣṭau niyuktastāṃ purākarot |
tāṃ tvāṃ namāmi paramāṃ jagaddhātrīṃ maheśvarīm ||
meaning:
यया धाता जगत्सृष्टौ नियुक्तस्तां पुराकरोत् |
तां त्वां नमामि परमां जगद्धात्रीं महेश्वरीम् ||
text_mt: Appointed by whom the Creator performed the creation of the universe of old, / to you, the supreme protectress of the universe, Maheśvarī, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
yayā viṣṇurjagatsthityai niyuktastāṃ sadākarot |
tāṃ tvāṃ namāmi paramāṃ jagaddhātrīṃ maheśvarīm ||
meaning:
यया विष्णुर्जगत्स्थित्यै नियुक्तस्तां सदाकरोत् |
तां त्वां नमामि परमां जगद्धात्रीं महेश्वरीम् ||
text_mt: Appointed by whom Viṣṇu always carries out the maintenance of the universe, / to you, the supreme protectress of the universe, Maheśvarī, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
yayā rudro jagannāśe niyuktastāṃ sadākarot |
tāṃ tvāṃ namāmi paramāṃ jagaddhātrīṃ maheśvarīm ||
meaning:
यया रुद्रो जगन्नाशे नियुक्तस्तां सदाकरोत् |
तां त्वां नमामि परमां जगद्धात्रीं महेश्वरीम् ||
text_mt: Appointed by whom Rudra always carries out the destruction of the universe, / to you, the supreme protectress of the universe, Maheśvarī, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
rajaḥsattvatamorūpāṃ sarvakāryakarīṃ sadā |
tridevajananīṃ devīṃ tvāṃ namāmi ca tāṃ śivām ||
meaning:
रजःसत्त्वतमोरूपां सर्वकार्यकरीं सदा |
त्रिदेवजननीं देवीं त्वां नमामि च तां शिवाम् ||
text_mt: To the goddess who consists of rajas, sattva, and tamas, the perpetual doer of all actions, / the mother of the three gods, to that Śivā I bow.'

sanskrit_iast:
yastvāṃ vicintayed devi vidyāvidyātmikāṃ parām |
tasya bhuktiśca muktiśca sadā karatale sthitā ||
meaning:
यस्त्वां विचिन्तयेद् देवि विद्याविद्यात्मिकां पराम् |
तस्य भुक्तिश्च मुक्तिश्च सदा करतले स्थिता ||
text_mt: Whoever meditates upon you, O Goddess, whose nature is the supreme knowledge and ignorance, / enjoyment and liberation are ever in the palm of his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvāṃ pratyakṣato devi śivāṃ paśyati pāvanīm |
tasyāvaśyaṃ bhavenmuktirvidyāvidyāprakāśikā ||
meaning:
यस्त्वां प्रत्यक्षतो देवि शिवां पश्यति पावनीम् |
तस्यावश्यं भवेन्मुक्तिर्विद्याविद्याप्रकाशिका ||
text_mt: Whoever directly perceives you, O auspicious, purifying Goddess, / his liberation is certain, as you illumine knowledge and ignorance.

sanskrit_iast:
ye stuvanti jaganmātarbhavānīmambiketi ca |
jaganmayīti durgeti sarvaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
ये स्तुवन्ति जगन्मातर्भवानीमम्बिकेति च |
जगन्मयीति दुर्गेति सर्वं तेषां भविष्यति ||
text_mt: Those who praise you, O Mother of the universe, as Bhavānī and Ambikā, / as pervading the universe and as Durgā—everything shall be theirs.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
iti stutā jaganmātā śivā dakṣeṇa dhīmatā |
tathovāca tadā dakṣaṃ yathā mātā śṛṇoti na ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इति स्तुता जगन्माता शिवा दक्षेण धीमता |
तथोवाच तदा दक्षं यथा माता शृणोति न ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Thus praised by wise Dakṣa, the auspicious Mother of the universe / then spoke to Dakṣa in such a way that his mother did not hear.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ sammohya tathyaṃ ca tathā dakṣaḥ śṛṇotu tat |
nānyastathā śivā prāha nānotiḥ parameśvarī ||
meaning:
सर्वं सम्मोह्य तथ्यं च तथा दक्षः शृणोतु तत् |
नान्यस्तथा शिवा प्राह नानोतिः परमेश्वरी ||
text_mt: Having bewitched everyone, so that Dakṣa might hear that truth / and no one else, the auspicious Parameśvarī spoke.

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca |
ahamārādhitā pūrvaṃ sutārthaṃ te prajāpate |
īpsitaṃ tava siddhaṃ tu tapo dhāraya samprati ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच |
अहमाराधिता पूर्वं सुतार्थं ते प्रजापते |
ईप्सितं तव सिद्धं तु तपो धारय सम्प्रति ||
text_mt: The Goddess said: / I was propitiated formerly by you for the sake of a daughter, O Prajāpati. / That which was desired by you is accomplished; maintain your austerity now.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
evamuktvā tadā devī dakṣaṃ ca nijamāyayā |
āsthāya śaiśavaṃ bhāvaṃ jananyante ruroda sā ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एवमुक्त्वा तदा देवी दक्षं च निजमायया |
आस्थाय शैशवं भावं जनन्यन्ते रुरोद सा ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus to Dakṣa, the Goddess then, through her own māyā / assuming the state of infancy, cried near her mother.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tad rodanaṃ śrutvā striyo vākyaṃ sasambhramāḥ |
āgatāstatra suprītyā dāsyo'pi ca sasambhramāḥ ||
meaning:
अथ तद् रोदनं श्रुत्वा स्त्रियो वाक्यं ससम्भ्रमाः |
आगतास्तत्र सुप्रीत्या दास्योऽपि च ससम्भ्रमाः ||
text_mt: Then, hearing that crying, the women came in flurry, speaking; / the maidservants also arrived there with great joy, in great agitation.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvāsiknīsutārūpaṃ nananduḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ |
sarve paurajanāścāpi cakrurjayaravaṃ tadā ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वासिक्नीसुतारूपं ननन्दुः सर्वयोषितः |
सर्वे पौरजनाश्चापि चक्रुर्जयरवं तदा ||
text_mt: Seeing the form of Asiknī's daughter, all the women rejoiced; / all the citizens also then raised cries of victory.

sanskrit_iast:
utsavaśca mahānāsīd gānavādyapuraḥsaram |
dakṣo'siknī mudaṃ lebhe śubhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sutānanam ||
meaning:
उत्सवश्च महानासीद् गानवाद्यपुरःसरम् |
दक्षोऽसिक्नी मुदं लेभे शुभं दृष्ट्वा सुताननम् ||
text_mt: A great festival took place, accompanied by song and musical instruments. / Dakṣa and Asiknī attained joy on seeing their daughter's auspicious face.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣaḥ śrutikulācāraṃ cakre ca vidhivattadā |
dānaṃ dadau dvijātibhyo'nyebhyaśca draviṇaṃ tathā ||
meaning:
दक्षः श्रुतिकुलाचारं चक्रे च विधिवत्तदा |
दानं ददौ द्विजातिभ्योऽन्येभ्यश्च द्रविणं तथा ||
text_mt: Dakṣa then duly performed the rites according to the Vedas and family tradition; / he gave gifts to the twice-born and wealth likewise to others.

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva sarvato gānaṃ nartanaṃ ca yathocitam |
nedurvādyāni bahuśaḥ sumaṅgalapuraḥsaram ||
meaning:
बभूव सर्वतो गानं नर्तनं च यथोचितम् |
नेदुर्वाद्यानि बहुशः सुमङ्गलपुरःसरम् ||
text_mt: Everywhere there was singing and dancing as appropriate; / musical instruments sounded in abundance, accompanied by great auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
atha haryādayo devāḥ sarve sānucarāstadā |
munivṛndaiḥ samāgatyotsavaṃ cakruryathāvidhi ||
meaning:
अथ हर्यादयो देवाः सर्वे सानुचरास्तदा |
मुनिवृन्दैः समागत्योत्सवं चक्रुर्यथाविधि ||
text_mt: Then the gods, Hari and others, all together with their followers, / having arrived with hosts of sages, held a festival according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā dakṣasutāmambāṃ jagataḥ parameśvarīm |
nemuḥ savinayāḥ sarve tuṣṭuvuśca śubhaiḥ stavaiḥ ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा दक्षसुतामम्बां जगतः परमेश्वरीम् |
नेमुः सविनयाः सर्वे तुष्टुवुश्च शुभैः स्तवैः ||
text_mt: Seeing Dakṣa's daughter, the mother, the Parameśvarī of the universe, / all bowed with humility and praised her with auspicious hymns.

sanskrit_iast:
ūcuḥ sarve pramuditā giraṃ jayajayātmikām |
praśaśaṃsurmudā dakṣaṃ vīriṇīṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
ऊचुः सर्वे प्रमुदिता गिरं जयजयात्मिकाम् |
प्रशशंसुर्मुदा दक्षं वीरिणीं च विशेषतः ||
text_mt: Rejoicing, they all uttered words consisting of "Victory, victory!" / They praised Dakṣa with joy, and especially Vīriṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
tadometi nāma cakre tasyā dakṣastadājñayā |
praśastāyāḥ sarvaguṇaiḥ sattvādapi mudānvitaḥ ||
meaning:
तदोमेति नाम चक्रे तस्या दक्षस्तदाज्ञया |
प्रशस्तायाः सर्वगुणैः सत्त्वादपि मुदान्वितः ||
text_mt: Then Dakṣa, by her command, gave her the name Umā, / filled with joy because she was praised with all qualities and through her goodness.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmānyanyāni tasyāstu paścājjātāni lokataḥ |
mahāmaṅgaladānyeva duḥkhaghnāni viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
नामान्यन्यानि तस्यास्तु पश्चाज्जातानि लोकतः |
महामङ्गलदान्येव दुःखघ्नानि विशेषतः ||
text_mt: Her other names, however, arose later among the people; / they are truly bestowers of great auspiciousness and especially destroyers of sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣastadā hariṃ natvā māṃ sarvānamarānapi |
munīnapi karau baddhvā stutvā cānarca bhaktitaḥ ||
meaning:
दक्षस्तदा हरिं नत्वा मां सर्वानमरानपि |
मुनीनपि करौ बद्ध्वा स्तुत्वा चानर्च भक्तितः ||
text_mt: Dakṣa, then bowing to Hari, to me, to all the immortals, / and to the sages with folded hands, praised and worshipped them with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
atha viṣṇvādayaḥ sarve supraśasyājanandanam |
prītyā yayuḥ svadhāmāni saṃsmaran saśivaṃ śivam ||
meaning:
अथ विष्ण्वादयः सर्वे सुप्रशस्याजनन्दनम् |
प्रीत्या ययुः स्वधामानि संस्मरन् सशिवं शिवम् ||
text_mt: Then all, Viṣṇu and the others, highly praising the son of the Unborn, / departed with delight to their own abodes, remembering Śiva together with his auspicious consort.

sanskrit_iast:
atastāṃ ca sutāṃ mātā susaṃskṛtya yathocitam |
śiśupānena vidhinā tasyai stanyādikaṃ dadau ||
meaning:
अतस्तां च सुतां माता सुसंस्कृत्य यथोचितम् |
शिशुपानेन विधिना तस्यै स्तन्यादिकं ददौ ||
text_mt: Thereupon the mother, having properly purified that daughter, / gave her breast-milk and other nourishment according to the procedure for nursing an infant.

sanskrit_iast:
pālitā sātha vīriṇyā dakṣeṇa ca mahātmanā |
vavṛdhe śuklapakṣasya yathā śaśikalānvaham ||
meaning:
पालिता साथ वीरिण्या दक्षेण च महात्मना |
ववृधे शुक्लपक्षस्य यथा शशिकलान्वहम् ||
text_mt: Nourished then by Vīriṇī and the great-souled Dakṣa, / she grew day by day like the digit of the moon in the bright fortnight.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ tu sadguṇāḥ sarve viviśurdvijasattama |
śaiśave'pi yathā candre kalāḥ sarvā manoharāḥ ||
meaning:
तस्यां तु सद्गुणाः सर्वे विविशुर्द्विजसत्तम |
शैशवेऽपि यथा चन्द्रे कलाः सर्वा मनोहराः ||
text_mt: All good qualities entered into her, O best of the twice-born, / even in childhood, just as all charming digits enter into the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
ācarannijabhāvena sakhīmadhyagatā yadā |
tadā lilekha bhargasya pratimāmanvahaṃ muhuḥ ||
meaning:
आचरन्निजभावेन सखीमध्यगता यदा |
तदा लिलेख भर्गस्य प्रतिमामन्वहं मुहुः ||
text_mt: Acting according to her own true nature when amidst her playmates, / she then repeatedly drew an image of Bharga day after day.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā jagau sugītāni śivā bālyocitāni sā |
tadā sthāṇuṃ haraṃ rudraṃ sasmāra smaraśāsanam ||
meaning:
यदा जगौ सुगीतानि शिवा बाल्योचितानि सा |
तदा स्थाणुं हरं रुद्रं सस्मार स्मरशासनम् ||
text_mt: When she, auspicious, sang beautiful songs suitable for childhood, / she then remembered Sthāṇu, Hara, Rudra, the punisher of Smara.

sanskrit_iast:
vavṛdhe'tīva dampatyoḥ pratyahaṃ karuṇātulā |
tasyā bālye'pi bhaktāyāstayornityaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||
meaning:
ववृधेऽतीव दम्पत्योः प्रत्यहं करुणातुला |
तस्या बाल्येऽपि भक्तायास्तयोर्नित्यं मुहुर्मुहुः ||
text_mt: Every day, the peerless affection of the couple grew exceedingly / toward her who, even in childhood, was devoted to the two of them constantly and repeatedly.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabālaguṇākrāntāṃ sadā svālayakāriṇīm |
toṣayāmāsa pitarau nityaṃ nityaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ satīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
सर्वबालगुणाक्रान्तां सदा स्वालयकारिणीम् |
तोषयामास पितरौ नित्यं नित्यं मुहुर्मुहुः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां द्वितीयः सतीखण्डे
text_mt:
Endowed with all the traits of a child, constantly making the home her own, / she delighted her parents continually, day after day, again and again.

Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, named "Description of the Birth and Childhood Play of Satī," in the Satī section of the second Rudrasaṃhitā, in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
athaikadā pituḥ pārśve tiṣṭhantīṃ tāṃ satīmaham |
tvayā saha mune'drākṣaṃ sārabhūtāṃ trilokake ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
अथैकदा पितुः पार्श्वे तिष्ठन्तीं तां सतीमहम् |
त्वया सह मुनेऽद्राक्षं सारभूतां त्रिलोकके ||
title: pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | nandāvratavidhānaṃ śivastutikathanañca
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then once, O sage, I saw together with you that Satī / who is the essence of the three worlds, standing by her father's side.

sanskrit_iast:
pitrā namaskṛtaṃ vīkṣya satkṛtaṃ tvāṃ ca māṃ satī |
praṇanāma mudā bhaktyā lokalīlānusāriṇī ||
meaning:
पित्रा नमस्कृतं वीक्ष्य सत्कृतं त्वां च मां सती |
प्रणनाम मुदा भक्त्या लोकलीलानुसारिणी ||
text_mt: Seeing you and me bowed down to and honored by her father, Satī, / conforming to the ways of the world, bowed down with devotion and joy.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇāmānte satīṃ vīkṣya dakṣadattaśubhāsane |
sthito'haṃ nārada tvaṃ ca vinatāmahamāgadam ||
meaning:
प्रणामान्ते सतीं वीक्ष्य दक्षदत्तशुभासने |
स्थितोऽहं नारद त्वं च विनतामहमागदम् ||
text_mt: Seeing Satī after her bow, seated on the auspicious seat given by Dakṣa, / I, O Nārada, and you being there, I spoke to her as she bowed:

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmeva yaḥ kāmayate yaṃ tu kāmayase sati |
tamāpnuhi patiṃ devaṃ sarvajñaṃ jagadīśvaram ||
meaning:
त्वामेव यः कामयते यं तु कामयसे सति |
तमाप्नुहि पतिं देवं सर्वज्ञं जगदीश्वरम् ||
text_mt: "He who desires you alone, and whom you desire, O Satī—/ obtain that god, the omniscient Lord of the universe, as your husband.

sanskrit_iast:
yo nānyāṃ jagṛhe nāpi gṛhṇāti na grahīṣyati |
jāyāṃ sa te patirbhūyādananyasadṛśaḥ śubhe ||
meaning:
यो नान्यां जगृहे नापि गृह्णाति न ग्रहीष्यति |
जायां स ते पतिर्भूयादनन्यसदृशः शुभे ||
text_mt: He who has not taken another wife, nor does he take one, nor will he take one—/ may he, peerless and unequaled, be your husband, O auspicious one."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā suciraṃ tāṃ vai sthitvā dakṣālaye punaḥ |
visṛṣṭau tena saṃyātau svasthānaṃ tau ca nārada ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा सुचिरं तां वै स्थित्वा दक्षालये पुनः |
विसृष्टौ तेन संयातौ स्वस्थानं तौ च नारद ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, having stayed for a long time in Dakṣa's abode, / dismissed by him, the two of us returned to our own abode, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣo'bhavacca suprītastadākarṇya gatajvaraḥ |
ādade tanayāṃ svāṃ tāṃ matvā hi parameśvarīm ||
meaning:
दक्षोऽभवच्च सुप्रीतस्तदाकर्ण्य गतज्वरः |
आददे तनयां स्वां तां मत्वा हि परमेश्वरीम् ||
text_mt: Hearing that, Dakṣa became highly pleased and free from anxiety; / he embraced his daughter, knowing her to indeed be Parameśvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ vihārai ruciraiḥ kaumārairbhaktavatsalā |
jahāvavasthāṃ kaumārīṃ svecchādhṛtanarākṛtiḥ ||
meaning:
इत्थं विहारै रुचिरैः कौमारैर्भक्तवत्सला |
जहाववस्थां कौमारीं स्वेच्छाधृतनराकृतिः ||
text_mt: Thus, through delightful childhood diversions, she who is affectionate toward devotees, / having assumed a human form by her own will, passed beyond the stage of childhood.

sanskrit_iast:
bālyaṃ vyatītya sā prāpa kiñcidyauvanatāṃ satī |
atīva tapasāṅgena sarvāṅgeṣu manoharā ||
meaning:
बाल्यं व्यतीत्य सा प्राप किञ्चिद्यौवनतां सती |
अतीव तपसाङ्गेन सर्वाङ्गेषु मनोहरा ||
text_mt: Having passed childhood, that Satī attained some youthfulness; / through her body, an instrument of austerity, she was captivating in all her limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣastāṃ vīkṣya lokeśaḥ prodbhinnāntarvayaḥsthitām |
cintayāmāsa bhargāya kathaṃ dāsya imāṃ sutām ||
meaning:
दक्षस्तां वीक्ष्य लोकेशः प्रोद्भिन्नान्तर्वयःस्थिताम् |
चिन्तयामास भर्गाय कथं दास्य इमां सुताम् ||
text_mt: Dakṣa, the lord of the world, seeing her established in the emerging age [of youth], / pondered: "How shall I give this daughter to Bharga?"

sanskrit_iast:
atha sāpi svayaṃ bhargaṃ prāptumaicchattadānvaham |
piturmanogatiṃ jñātvā māturnikaṭamāgatā ||
meaning:
अथ सापि स्वयं भर्गं प्राप्तुमैच्छत्तदान्वहम् |
पितुर्मनोगतिं ज्ञात्वा मातुर्निकटमागता ||
text_mt: Then she herself also wished daily to obtain Bharga; / knowing the inclination of her father's mind, she approached her mother.

sanskrit_iast:
papracchājñāṃ tapohetoḥ śaṅkarasya viśāladhīḥ |
mātuḥ śivātha vīriṇyāḥ sā satī parameśvarī ||
meaning:
पप्रच्छाज्ञां तपोहेतोः शङ्करस्य विशालधीः |
मातुः शिवाथ वीरिण्याः सा सती परमेश्वरी ||
text_mt: That Satī, Parameśvarī, possessing great wisdom, the auspicious one, / then asked her mother Vīriṇī for permission to perform austerity for Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ satī maheśānaṃ patiṃ prāptuṃ dṛḍhavratā |
sā tamārādhayāmāsa gṛhe māturanujñayā ||
meaning:
ततः सती महेशानं पतिं प्राप्तुं दृढव्रता |
सा तमाराधयामास गृहे मातुरनुज्ञया ||
text_mt: Then Satī, firm in her vow to obtain Maheśāna as her husband, / worshipped him in the house with the permission of her mother.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvine māsi nandāyāṃ tithāvānarca bhaktitaḥ |
guḍaudanaiḥ salavaṇairharaṃ natvā nināya tam ||
meaning:
आश्विने मासि नन्दायां तिथावानर्च भक्तितः |
गुडौदनैः सलवणैर्हरं नत्वा निनाय तम् ||
text_mt: In the month of Āśvina, on the Nandā tithi, she worshipped with devotion, / bowing to Hara with jaggery-rice mixed with salt, and passed that [day].

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikasya caturdaśyāmapūpaiḥ pāyasairapi |
samākīrṇaiḥ samārādhya sasmāra parameśvaram ||
meaning:
कार्तिकस्य चतुर्दश्यामपूपैः पायसैरपि |
समाकीर्णैः समाराध्य सस्मार परमेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: On the fourteenth day of Kārtika, having worshipped with sweet cakes / and bowls of milk-rice mixed together, she remembered Parameśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣe'sitāṣṭamyāṃ satilaiḥ sayavaudanaiḥ |
pūjayitvā haraṃ kīlairnināya divasān satī ||
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षेऽसिताष्टम्यां सतिलैः सयवौदनैः |
पूजयित्वा हरं कीलैर्निनाय दिवसान् सती ||
text_mt: On the dark eighth day in Mārgaśīrṣa, having worshipped Hara / with boiled rice mixed with barley and sesame seeds, Satī passed the days with [offerings of] fresh sprouts.

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣe tu śuklasaptamyāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi |
apūjayacchivaṃ prātaḥ kṛśarānnena sā satī ||
meaning:
पौषे तु शुक्लसप्तम्यां कृत्वा जागरणं निशि |
अपूजयच्छिवं प्रातः कृशरान्नेन सा सती ||
text_mt: In Pauṣa, on the bright seventh day, having observed a vigil at night, / in the morning that Satī worshipped Śiva with khicdi.

sanskrit_iast:
māghe tu paurṇamāsyāṃ sā kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi |
ārdravastrā nadītīre'karocchaṅkarapūjanam ||
meaning:
माघे तु पौर्णमास्यां सा कृत्वा जागरणं निशि |
आर्द्रवस्त्रा नदीतीरेऽकरोच्छङ्करपूजनम् ||
text_mt: In Māgha, on the full moon day, having observed a vigil at night, / she, with wet clothes, performed the worship of Śaṅkara on the bank of the river.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasyāsitabhūtāyāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi |
viśeṣataḥ samānarca śailūṣaiḥ sarvayāmasu ||
meaning:
तपस्यासितभूतायां कृत्वा जागरणं निशि |
विशेषतः समानर्च शैलूषैः सर्वयामसु ||
text_mt: In Phālguna, on the dark fourteenth day, having observed a vigil at night, / she especially worshipped him with bilva leaves in all watches of the night.

sanskrit_iast:
caitre śuklacaturdaśyāṃ palāśairdamanaiḥ śivam |
apūjayaddivārātrau saṃsmaran sā nināya tam ||
meaning:
चैत्रे शुक्लचतुर्दश्यां पलाशैर्दमनैः शिवम् |
अपूजयद्दिवारात्रौ संस्मरन् सा निनाय तम् ||
text_mt: On the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, she worshipped Śiva with palāśa and damana flowers; / remembering him day and night, she spent that [time].

sanskrit_iast:
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ tilāhārayavaudanaiḥ |
pūjayitvā satī rudraṃ gavyairmāsaṃ nināya tam ||
meaning:
माघशुक्लतृतीयायां तिलाहारयवौदनैः |
पूजयित्वा सती रुद्रं गव्यैर्मासं निनाय तम् ||
text_mt: On the third day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, having worshipped Rudra with foods made of sesame, barley-rice, / and cow-products, she spent that month.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimāyāṃ vai rātrau sampūjya śaṅkaram |
vasanairbṛhatīpuṣpairnirāhārā nināya tam ||
meaning:
ज्येष्ठस्य पूर्णिमायां वै रात्रौ सम्पूज्य शङ्करम् |
वसनैर्बृहतीपुष्पैर्निराहारा निनाय तम् ||
text_mt: On the full moon night of Jyeṣṭha, having worshipped Śaṅkara / with garments and bṛhatī flowers, she spent it without food.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhasya caturdaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ kṛṣṇavāsasā |
bṛhatīkusumaiḥ pūjā rudrasyākāri vai tathā ||
meaning:
आषाढस्य चतुर्दश्यां शुक्लायां कृष्णवाससा |
बृहतीकुसुमैः पूजा रुद्रस्याकारि वै तथा ||
text_mt: On the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Āṣāḍha, with black garments / and bṛhatī flowers, worship was likewise performed to Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇasya sitāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ ca sā śivam |
yajñopavītairvāsobhiḥ pavitrairapyapūjayat ||
meaning:
श्रावणस्य सिताष्टम्यां चतुर्दश्यां च सा शिवम् |
यज्ञोपवीतैर्वासोभिः पवित्रैरप्यपूजयत् ||
text_mt: On the eighth and fourteenth days of the bright fortnight of Śrāvaṇa, she worshipped Śiva / with sacred threads and pure garments.

sanskrit_iast:
bhādre kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ puṣpairnānāvidhaiḥ phalaiḥ |
sampūjya ca caturdaśyāṃ cakāra jalabhojanam ||
meaning:
भाद्रे कृष्णत्रयोदश्यां पुष्पैर्नानाविधैः फलैः |
सम्पूज्य च चतुर्दश्यां चकार जलभोजनम् ||
text_mt: On the thirteenth day of the dark fortnight of Bhādra, having worshipped with various flowers and fruits, / she fasted on water on the fourteenth day.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvidhaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sasyaistatkālasambhavaiḥ |
cakre suniyatāhārā japanmāse śivārcanam ||
meaning:
नानाविधैः फलैः पुष्पैः सस्यैस्तत्कालसम्भवैः |
चक्रे सुनियताहारा जपन्मासे शिवार्चनम् ||
text_mt: With various kinds of fruits, flowers, and grains grown in that season, / she, strictly moderating her diet, performed the worship of Śiva throughout the month of recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamāse sarvadine śivārcanaratā satī |
dṛḍhavratābhavaddevī svecchādhṛtanarākṛtiḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वमासे सर्वदिने शिवार्चनरता सती |
दृढव्रताभवद्देवी स्वेच्छाधृतनराकृतिः ||
text_mt: Devoted to the worship of Śiva every day of every month, / the goddess Satī, who had assumed human form by her own will, remained firm in her observance.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ nandāvrataṃ kṛtsnaṃ samāpya susamāhitā |
dadhyau śivaṃ satī premṇā niścalābhūdananyadhīḥ ||
meaning:
इत्थं नन्दाव्रतं कृत्स्नं समाप्य सुसमाहिता |
दध्यौ शिवं सती प्रेम्णा निश्चलाभूदनन्यधीः ||
text_mt: Having thus completed the entire Nandā observance with deep concentration, / Satī meditated on Śiva with love, motionless and with undivided mind.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare devā munayaścākhilā mune |
viṣṇuṃ māṃ ca puraskṛtya yayurdraṣṭuṃ satītapaḥ ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवा मुनयश्चाखिला मुने |
विष्णुं मां च पुरस्कृत्य ययुर्द्रष्टुं सतीतपः ||
text_mt: In the meantime, O sage, all the gods and sages, / placing Viṣṇu and me at their head, went to see Satī's tapas.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭāgatya satī devairmūrtā siddhirivāparā |
śivadhyānamahāmagnā siddhāvasthāṃ gatā tadā ||
meaning:
दृष्टागत्य सती देवैर्मूर्ता सिद्धिरिवापरा |
शिवध्यानमहामग्ना सिद्धावस्थां गता तदा ||
text_mt: Having arrived, they saw Satī looking like another embodied siddhi, / deeply absorbed in meditation on Śiva, having attained the state of perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
cakruḥ sarve surāḥ satyai mudā sāñjalayo natim |
munayaśca nataskandhā viṣṇvādyāḥ prītamānasāḥ ||
meaning:
चक्रुः सर्वे सुराः सत्यै मुदा साञ्जलयो नतिम् |
मुनयश्च नतस्कन्धा विष्ण्वाद्याः प्रीतमानसाः ||
text_mt: All the gods, with joined palms, joyfully bowed down to Satī, / and the sages, along with Viṣṇu and the others, had their necks bowed and their minds delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sarve suprasannāḥ viṣṇvādyāśca surarṣayaḥ |
praśaśaṃsustapastasyāḥ satyāstasmātsavismayāḥ ||
meaning:
अथ सर्वे सुप्रसन्नाः विष्ण्वाद्याश्च सुरर्षयः |
प्रशशंसुस्तपस्तस्याः सत्यास्तस्मात्सविस्मयाः ||
text_mt: Then, well-pleased, Viṣṇu, the gods, and the divine sages / praised the tapas of that Satī in amazement.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ praṇamya tāṃ devīṃ punaste munayaḥ surāḥ |
jagmurgirivaraṃ sadyaḥ kailāsaṃ śivavallabham ||
meaning:
ततः प्रणम्य तां देवीं पुनस्ते मुनयः सुराः |
जग्मुर्गिरिवरं सद्यः कैलासं शिववल्लभम् ||
text_mt: Then, having bowed to that goddess, those sages and gods / immediately went to Kailāsa, the excellent mountain dear to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrīsahitaścāhaṃ saha lakṣmyā mudānvitaḥ |
vāsudevo'pi bhagavāñjagāmātha harāntikam ||
meaning:
सावित्रीसहितश्चाहं सह लक्ष्म्या मुदान्वितः |
वासुदेवोऽपि भगवाञ्जगामाथ हरान्तिकम् ||
text_mt: And I, accompanied by Sāvitrī, and the blessed Vāsudeva / accompanied by Lakṣmī, went with joy into the presence of Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā tatra prabhuṃ dṛṣṭvā supraṇamya sasambhramāḥ |
tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotraiḥ karau baddhvā vinamrakāḥ ||
meaning:
गत्वा तत्र प्रभुं दृष्ट्वा सुप्रणम्य ससम्भ्रमाः |
तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तोत्रैः करौ बद्ध्वा विनम्रकाः ||
text_mt: Having gone there and seen the Lord, having bowed reverently with agitation, / they praised him with various hymns, joining their hands in humility.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ |
namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ yata etaccarācaram |
puruṣāya maheśāya pareśāya mahātmane ||
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः |
नमो भगवते तुभ्यं यत एतच्चराचरम् |
पुरुषाय महेशाय परेशाय महात्मने ||
text_mt: The gods said: / Homage to you, the Blessed Lord, from whom [comes] this moving and unmoving [universe], / to the Puruṣa, the Great Lord, the Supreme Master, the Great Atman,

sanskrit_iast:
ādibījāya sarveṣāṃ cidrūpāya parāya ca |
brahmaṇe nirvikārāya prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca ||
meaning:
आदिबीजाय सर्वेषां चिद्रूपाय पराय च |
ब्रह्मणे निर्विकाराय प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्य च ||
text_mt: to the primal seed of all, whose nature is consciousness, supreme, / to Brahman, free from modification, beyond both Prakṛti and Puruṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ pratipacyedaṃ yenedaṃ vicakāsti hi |
yasmādidaṃ yataścedaṃ yasyedaṃ tvaṃ ca yatrataḥ ||
meaning:
य इदं प्रतिपच्येदं येनेदं विचकास्ति हि |
यस्मादिदं यतश्चेदं यस्येदं त्वं च यत्रतः ||
text_mt: who perceives this, through whom this shines, / from whom this [comes], of whom this [is], whose this [is], and in whom you abide;

sanskrit_iast:
yo'smātparasmācca paro nirvikārī mahāprabhuḥ |
īkṣate yaḥ svātmanīdaṃ taṃ natāḥ sma svayambhuvam ||
meaning:
योऽस्मात्परस्माच्च परो निर्विकारी महाप्रभुः |
ईक्षते यः स्वात्मनीदं तं नताः स्म स्वयम्भुवम् ||
text_mt: to him who is higher than this high, changeless, the great sovereign, / who beholds this within himself—to that self-born one we bow down.

sanskrit_iast:
aviddhadṛk paraḥ sākṣī sarvātmānekarūpadhṛk |
ātmabhūtaḥ parabrahma tapantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||
meaning:
अविद्धदृक् परः साक्षी सर्वात्मानेकरूपधृक् |
आत्मभूतः परब्रह्म तपन्तं शरणं गताः ||
text_mt: To the unclouded-sighted, supreme witness, inner self of all, bearing many forms, / the Parabrahman become the Atman, burning [with tapas], we have gone for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
na yasya devā ṛṣayaḥ siddhāśca na viduḥ padam |
kaḥ punarjanturaparo jñātumarhati veditum ||
meaning:
न यस्य देवा ऋषयः सिद्धाश्च न विदुः पदम् |
कः पुनर्जन्तुरपरो ज्ञातुमर्हति वेदितुम् ||
text_mt: Whose state neither gods, sages, nor siddhas know— / what other creature could be able to know it?

sanskrit_iast:
didṛkṣavo yasya padaṃ muktasaṅgāḥ susādhavaḥ |
caritaṃ sugatirnastvaṃ salokavratamavraṇam ||
meaning:
दिदृक्षवो यस्य पदं मुक्तसङ्गाः सुसाधवः |
चरितं सुगतिर्नस्त्वं सलोकव्रतमव्रणम् ||
text_mt: Whose state the truly virtuous, freed from attachment, desire to see— / you whose conduct is a good path for us, whose vow is for the worlds, unblemished.

sanskrit_iast:
tvajjanmādivikārā no vidyante ke'pi duḥkhadāḥ |
tathāpi māyayā tvaṃ hi gṛhṇāsi kṛpayā ca tān ||
meaning:
त्वज्जन्मादिविकारा नो विद्यन्ते केऽपि दुःखदाः |
तथापि मायया त्वं हि गृह्णासि कृपया च तान् ||
text_mt: In you, no modifications such as birth, which cause suffering, exist; / nevertheless, through māyā and through compassion, you assume them.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai namaḥ pareśāya tubhyamāścaryakarmaṇe |
namo girāṃ vidūrāya brahmaṇe paramātmane ||
meaning:
तस्मै नमः परेशाय तुभ्यमाश्चर्यकर्मणे |
नमो गिरां विदूराय ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने ||
text_mt: Homage to him, to that Supreme Master, to you of wondrous deeds; / homage to Brahman, the Supreme Self, far beyond speech;

sanskrit_iast:
arūpāyorurūpāya parāyānantaśaktaye |
trilokapataye sarvasākṣiṇe sarvagāya ca ||
meaning:
अरूपायोरुरूपाय परायानन्तशक्तये |
त्रिलोकपतये सर्वसाक्षिणे सर्वगाय च ||
text_mt: to him without form, of vast form, supreme, of infinite power, / lord of the three worlds, witness of all, and omnipresent;

sanskrit_iast:
nama ātmapradīpāya nirvāṇasukhasampade |
jñānātmane namaste'stu vyāpakāyeśvarāya ca ||
meaning:
नम आत्मप्रदीपाय निर्वाणसुखसम्पदे |
ज्ञानात्मने नमस्तेऽस्तु व्यापकायेश्वराय च ||
text_mt: homage to the lamp of the Self, the wealth of the bliss of liberation, / whose nature is knowledge; homage to you, the all-pervasive Īśvara;

sanskrit_iast:
naiṣkarmyeṇa sulabhyāya kaivalyapataye namaḥ |
puruṣāya pareśāya namaste sarvadāya ca ||
meaning:
नैष्कर्म्येण सुलभ्याय कैवल्यपतये नमः |
पुरुषाय परेशाय नमस्ते सर्वदाय च ||
text_mt: homage to the master of absolute solitude, easily attainable through actionlessness; / to the Puruṣa, the Supreme Master, homage to you who grant everything;

sanskrit_iast: kṣetrajñāyātmarūpāya sarvapratyayahetave ||
meaning: क्षेत्रज्ञायात्मरूपाय सर्वप्रत्ययहेतवे ||
text_mt: to the knower of the field, whose nature is the Self, the cause of all apprehension,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvādhyakṣāya mahate mūlaprakṛtaye namaḥ |
puruṣāya pareśāya namaste sarvadāya ca ||
meaning:
सर्वाध्यक्षाय महते मूलप्रकृतये नमः |
पुरुषाय परेशाय नमस्ते सर्वदाय च ||
text_mt: to the overseer of all, the great, the root nature; homage / to the Puruṣa, the Supreme Master; homage to you who grant everything;

sanskrit_iast:
trinetrāyeṣuvaktrāya sadābhāsāya te namaḥ |
sarvendriyaguṇadraṣṭre niṣkāraṇa namo'stu te ||
meaning:
त्रिनेत्रायेषुवक्त्राय सदाभासाय ते नमः |
सर्वेन्द्रियगुणद्रष्ट्रे निष्कारण नमोऽस्तु ते ||
text_mt: to the three-eyed one, whose face is an arrow, who shines eternally; homage to you, / observer of the qualities of all senses; to you without cause, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
trilokakāraṇāyāthāpavargāya namo namaḥ |
apavargapradāyāśu śaraṇāgatatāriṇe ||
meaning:
त्रिलोककारणायाथापवर्गाय नमो नमः |
अपवर्गप्रदायाशु शरणागततारिणे ||
text_mt: To the cause of the three worlds, and to liberation, homage, homage! / To the giver of liberation swiftly, the deliverer of those who seek refuge;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāmnāyāgamānāṃ codadhaye parameṣṭhine |
parāyaṇāya bhaktānāṃ guṇānāṃ ca namo'stu te ||
meaning:
सर्वाम्नायागमानां चोदधये परमेष्ठिने |
परायणाय भक्तानां गुणानां च नमोऽस्तु ते ||
text_mt: to the ocean of all sacred traditions and āgamas, the highest lord, / the supreme refuge of devotees and of virtues, homage to you;

sanskrit_iast:
namo guṇāraṇicchannacidūṣmāya maheśvara |
mūḍhaduṣprāptarūpāya jñānihṛdvāsine sadā ||
meaning:
नमो गुणारणिच्छन्नचिदूष्माय महेश्वर |
मूढदुष्प्राप्तरूपाय ज्ञानिहृद्वासिने सदा ||
text_mt: homage to the heat of consciousness concealed within the fire-sticks of the guṇas, O Great Lord, / whose form is difficult for the foolish to attain, who dwells forever in the hearts of the wise;

sanskrit_iast:
paśupāśavimokṣāya bhaktasanmuktidāya ca |
svaprakāśāya nityāyāvyayāyājasrasaṃvide ||
pratyagdraṣṭe'vikārāya paramaiśvaryadhāriṇe |
yaṃ bhajanti caturvargaṃ kāmayantīṣṭasadgatim ||
meaning:
पशुपाशविमोक्षाय भक्तसन्मुक्तिदाय च |
स्वप्रकाशाय नित्यायाव्ययायाजस्रसंविदे ||
प्रत्यग्द्रष्टेऽविकाराय परमैश्वर्यधारिणे |
यं भजन्ति चतुर्वर्गं कामयन्तीष्टसद्गतिम् ||
text_mt:
to the releaser of the fetters of bound souls, the giver of true liberation to devotees, / self-luminous, eternal, imperishable, of constant consciousness;

to the inner seer, devoid of change, holding supreme sovereignty, / whom those who desire the four ends of life worship, seeking the cherished good path;

sanskrit_iast: so'bhūdakaruṇastvaṃ naḥ prasanno bhava te namaḥ ||
meaning: सोऽभूदकरुणस्त्वं नः प्रसन्नो भव ते नमः ||
text_mt: that you have been merciless toward us—be gracious; homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
ekāntinaḥ kañcanārthaṃ bhaktā vāñchanti yasya na |
kevalaṃ caritaṃ te te gāyanti paramaṅgalam ||
meaning:
एकान्तिनः कञ्चनार्थं भक्ता वाञ्छन्ति यस्य न |
केवलं चरितं ते ते गायन्ति परमङ्गलम् ||
text_mt: Whose single-minded devotees desire no object whatsoever, / but sing only of your supremely auspicious conduct;

sanskrit_iast:
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma tamavyaktākṛtiṃ vibhum |
adhyātmayogagamyaṃ tvāṃ paripūrṇaṃ stumo vayam ||
meaning:
अक्षरं परमं ब्रह्म तमव्यक्ताकृतिं विभुम् |
अध्यात्मयोगगम्यं त्वां परिपूर्णं स्तुमो वयम् ||
text_mt: the imperishable, supreme Brahman, of unmanifest form, the all-pervading lord, / attainable through spiritual yoga, the complete—you we praise;

sanskrit_iast:
atīndriyamanādhāraṃ sarvādhāramahetukam |
anantamādyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tvāṃ praṇamāmo'khileśvaram ||
meaning:
अतीन्द्रियमनाधारं सर्वाधारमहेतुकम् |
अनन्तमाद्यं सूक्ष्मं त्वां प्रणमामोऽखिलेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: beyond the senses, without support, the support of all, causeless, / infinite, primal, subtle—to you, the lord of all, we bow down.

sanskrit_iast:
haryādayo'khilā devāstathā lokāścarācarāḥ |
nāmarūpavibhedena phalgvyā ca kalayā kṛtāḥ ||
meaning:
हर्यादयोऽखिला देवास्तथा लोकाश्चराचराः |
नामरूपविभेदेन फल्ग्व्या च कलया कृताः ||
text_mt: All the gods beginning with Hari, as well as the moving and unmoving worlds, / have been made with distinctions of name and form, by an insignificant portion [of you].

sanskrit_iast:
yathārciṣo'gneḥ savituryānti niryānti vāsakṛt |
gabhastayastathāyaṃ vai pravāho gauṇa ucyate ||
meaning:
यथार्चिषोऽग्नेः सवितुर्यान्ति निर्यान्ति वासकृत् |
गभस्तयस्तथायं वै प्रवाहो गौण उच्यते ||
text_mt: Just as the sparks of fire and the rays of the sun repeatedly go forth and return, / so indeed this secondary flow [of creation] is described.

sanskrit_iast:
na tvaṃ devo'suro martyo na tiryaṅ na dvijaḥ prabho |
na strī na ṣaṇḍho na pumānsadasanna ca kiñcana ||
meaning:
न त्वं देवोऽसुरो मर्त्यो न तिर्यङ् न द्विजः प्रभो |
न स्त्री न षण्ढो न पुमान्सदसन्न च किञ्चन ||
text_mt: You are neither god, demon, nor mortal, neither animal nor twice-born, O Lord; / neither woman, eunuch, nor man; neither being nor non-being, nor anything [else].

sanskrit_iast:
niṣedhaśeṣaḥ sarvaṃ tvaṃ viśvakṛdviśvapālakaḥ |
viśvalayakṛdviśvātmā praṇatāḥ smaḥ tamīśvaram ||
meaning:
निषेधशेषः सर्वं त्वं विश्वकृद्विश्वपालकः |
विश्वलयकृद्विश्वात्मा प्रणताः स्मः तमीश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Remaining after all negations, you are everything: the creator of the universe, the protector of the universe, / the destroyer of the universe, the soul of the universe; to that Īśvara we bow down.

sanskrit_iast:
yogarandhitakarmāṇo yaṃ prapaśyanti yoginaḥ |
yogasambhāvite citte yogeśaṃ tvāṃ natā vayam ||
meaning:
योगरन्धितकर्माणो यं प्रपश्यन्ति योगिनः |
योगसम्भाविते चित्ते योगेशं त्वां नता वयम् ||
text_mt: Whom yogins whose actions have been consumed by yoga behold / in their minds cultured by yoga—to you, the Lord of Yoga, we bow down.

sanskrit_iast:
namo'stu te'sahyavega śaktitraya trayīmaya |
namaḥ prasannapālāya namaste bhūriśaktaye ||
meaning:
नमोऽस्तु तेऽसह्यवेग शक्तित्रय त्रयीमय |
नमः प्रसन्नपालाय नमस्ते भूरिशक्तये ||
text_mt: Homage to you of irresistible speed, possessing the three powers, consisting of the three Vedas; / homage to the protector of the serene; homage to you of abundant power;

sanskrit_iast:
kadindriyāṇāṃ durgeśānavāpya paravartmane |
bhaktoddhāraratāyātha namaste gūḍhavarcase ||
meaning:
कदिन्द्रियाणां दुर्गेशानवाप्य परवर्त्मने |
भक्तोद्धाररतायाथ नमस्ते गूढवर्चसे ||
text_mt: hard to reach for corrupted senses, Lord, unattained, the supreme path, / engaged in uplifting devotees; homage to you of hidden splendor!

sanskrit_iast:
yacchaktyāhandhiyātmānaṃ hanta veda na mūḍhadhīḥ |
taṃ duratyayamāhātmyaṃ tvāṃ natāḥ smo mahāprabhum ||
meaning:
यच्छक्त्याहन्धियात्मानं हन्त वेद न मूढधीः |
तं दुरत्ययमाहात्म्यं त्वां नताः स्मो महाप्रभुम् ||
text_mt: By whose power, alas, the foolish mind does not know the Self through ego-consciousness— / to that great Lord of insuperable greatness we bow down.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
iti stutvā mahādevaṃ sarve viṣṇvādikāḥ surāḥ |
tūṣṇīmāsanprabhoragre sadbhaktinatakandharāḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ satīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इति स्तुत्वा महादेवं सर्वे विष्ण्वादिकाः सुराः |
तूष्णीमासन्प्रभोरग्रे सद्भक्तिनतकन्धराः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां द्वितीयः सतीखण्डे
text_mt:
Brahmā said: / Having thus praised Mahādeva, all the gods beginning with Viṣṇu / remained silent before the Lord, their necks bowed in true devotion.

Thus ends the fifteenth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Rules for the Nandā Observance and the Praise of Śiva," in the Satī Section, the second [section] in the second Rudrasaṃhitā of the glorious Śivamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
iti stutiṃ ca haryādikṛtāmākarṇya śaṅkaraḥ |
babhūvātiprasanno hi vijahāsa ca sūtikṛt ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इति स्तुतिं च हर्यादिकृतामाकर्ण्य शङ्करः |
बभूवातिप्रसन्नो हि विजहास च सूतिकृत् ||
title: ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ | brahmaviṣṇukṛtā śivaprārthanā
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing this hymn of praise offered by Hari and the others, Śaṅkara / became exceedingly pleased, and the creator of all things smiled.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇū tu dṛṣṭvā tau sastrīkau saṅgatau haraḥ |
yathocitaṃ samābhāṣya papracchāgamanaṃ tayoḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णू तु दृष्ट्वा तौ सस्त्रीकौ सङ्गतौ हरः |
यथोचितं समाभाष्य पप्रच्छागमनं तयोः ||
text_mt: Seeing Brahmā and Viṣṇu joined together with their wives, Hara / greeted them fittingly and asked the reason for their arrival.

sanskrit_iast:
rudra uvāca |
he hare he vidhe devā munayaścādya nirbhayāḥ |
nijāgamanahetuṃ hi kathayadhvaṃ sutattvataḥ ||
meaning:
रुद्र उवाच |
हे हरे हे विधे देवा मुनयश्चाद्य निर्भयाः |
निजागमनहेतुं हि कथयध्वं सुतत्त्वतः ||
text_mt: Rudra said: / "O Hari, O Vidhi, gods, and sages, free from fear today, / state truly the reason for your arrival.

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthamāgatā yūyaṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ ceha vidyate |
tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhavatstutyā prasannadhīḥ ||
meaning:
किमर्थमागता यूयं किं कार्यं चेह विद्यते |
तत्सर्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामि भवत्स्तुत्या प्रसन्नधीः ||
text_mt: For what purpose have you come, and what task is to be done here? / Pleased in mind by your praise, I wish to hear all of that."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
iti pṛṣṭe hareṇāhaṃ sarvalokapitāmahaḥ |
mune'vocaṃ mahādevaṃ viṣṇunā paricoditaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इति पृष्टे हरेणाहं सर्वलोकपितामहः |
मुनेऽवोचं महादेवं विष्णुना परिचोदितः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / "When questioned thus by Hara, O sage, I, the grandfather of all worlds, / urged on by Viṣṇu, spoke to Mahādeva:

sanskrit_iast:
devadeva mahādeva karuṇāsāgara prabho |
yadarthamāgatāvāvāṃ tacchṛṇu tvaṃ surarṣibhiḥ ||
meaning:
देवदेव महादेव करुणासागर प्रभो |
यदर्थमागतावावां तच्छृणु त्वं सुरर्षिभिः ||
text_mt: 'O God of gods, Mahādeva, ocean of compassion, O Lord, / hear along with the celestial sages the purpose for which we two have come.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣatastavaivārthamāgatā vṛṣabhadhvaja |
sahārthinaḥ sadā yogyamanyathā na jagadbhavet ||
meaning:
विशेषतस्तवैवार्थमागता वृषभध्वज |
सहार्थिनः सदा योग्यमन्यथा न जगद्भवेत् ||
text_mt: It is especially for your sake, O Vṛṣabhadhvaja, that we have come as petitioners. / This is always proper, for otherwise the world could not exist.

sanskrit_iast:
kecidbhaviṣyantyasurā mama vadhyā maheśvara |
harervadhyāstathā kecidbhavantaścāpi kecana ||
meaning:
केचिद्भविष्यन्त्यसुरा मम वध्या महेश्वर |
हरेर्वध्यास्तथा केचिद्भवन्तश्चापि केचन ||
text_mt: Certain asuras will arise who are to be slain by me, O Maheśvara; / certain ones are to be slain by Hari, and some by you.

sanskrit_iast:
kecittvadvīryajātasya tanayasya mahāprabho |
māyāvadhyāḥ prabho kecidbhaviṣyantyasurāḥ sadā ||
meaning:
केचित्त्वद्वीर्यजातस्य तनयस्य महाप्रभो |
मायावध्याः प्रभो केचिद्भविष्यन्त्यसुराः सदा ||
text_mt: Some are to be slain by a son born of your semen, O Great Lord; / and some asuras will always be slain by Māyā, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tavaiva kṛpayā śambhoḥ surāṇāṃ sukhamuttamam |
nāśayitvāsurān ghorāñjagatsvāsthyaṃ sadābhayam ||
meaning:
तवैव कृपया शम्भोः सुराणां सुखमुत्तमम् |
नाशयित्वासुरान् घोराञ्जगत्स्वास्थ्यं सदाभयम् ||
text_mt: Only by your grace, O Śambhu, can the gods attain the highest happiness, / and the wellbeing and perpetual fearlessness of the world [be secured] by destroying the dreadful asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
yogayukte tvayi sadā rāgadveṣavivarjite |
dayāmātraikanirate na vadhyā hyathavā tava ||
meaning:
योगयुक्ते त्वयि सदा रागद्वेषविवर्जिते |
दयामात्रैकनिरते न वध्या ह्यथवा तव ||
text_mt: When you are constantly absorbed in yoga, free from attachment and aversion, / intent only upon compassion alone, they are indeed not to be slain by you.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhiteṣu teṣvīśa kathaṃ sṛṣṭistathā sthitiḥ |
ataśca bhavitā yuktaṃ nityaṃ nityaṃ vṛṣadhvaja ||
meaning:
आराधितेषु तेष्वीश कथं सृष्टिस्तथा स्थितिः |
अतश्च भविता युक्तं नित्यं नित्यं वृषध्वज ||
text_mt: When they are propitiated, O Īśa, how can there be creation and maintenance? / Therefore, O Vṛṣadhvaja, it is always proper that this take place.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭisthityantakarmāṇi na kāryāṇi yadā tadā |
śarīrabhedamasmākaṃ māyāyāśca na yujyate ||
meaning:
सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तकर्माणि न कार्याणि यदा तदा |
शरीरभेदमस्माकं मायायाश्च न युज्यते ||
text_mt: When the acts of creation, maintenance, and dissolution are not to be performed, / then the distinction between our bodies and [that of] Māyā would not be fitting.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasvarūpā hi vayaṃ bhinnāḥ kāryasya bhedataḥ |
kāryabhedo na siddhaścedrūpabhedo'prayojanaḥ ||
meaning:
एकस्वरूपा हि वयं भिन्नाः कार्यस्य भेदतः |
कार्यभेदो न सिद्धश्चेद्रूपभेदोऽप्रयोजनः ||
text_mt: For we are of one nature, divided only by division of function; / if division of function is not established, the division of forms serves no purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
eka eva tridhā bhinnaḥ paramātmā maheśvaraḥ |
māyāyāḥ kāraṇādeva svatantro līlayā prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
एक एव त्रिधा भिन्नः परमात्मा महेश्वरः |
मायायाः कारणादेव स्वतन्त्रो लीलया प्रभुः ||
text_mt: The supreme self, Maheśvara, the independent Lord, / divided himself threefold by his sport purely on account of Māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmāṅgajo haristasya dakṣiṇāṅgabhavo hyaham |
śivasya hṛdayājjātastvaṃ hi pūrṇatanuḥ śivaḥ ||
meaning:
वामाङ्गजो हरिस्तस्य दक्षिणाङ्गभवो ह्यहम् |
शिवस्य हृदयाज्जातस्त्वं हि पूर्णतनुः शिवः ||
text_mt: Hari was born from his left side, and I was born from his right side; / you, born from the heart of Śiva, are indeed Śiva with a complete body.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ vayaṃ tridhā bhūtāḥ prabho bhinnasvarūpiṇaḥ |
śivāśivasutāstattvaṃ hṛdā viddhi sanātana ||
meaning:
इत्थं वयं त्रिधा भूताः प्रभो भिन्नस्वरूपिणः |
शिवाशिवसुतास्तत्त्वं हृदा विद्धि सनातन ||
text_mt: Thus we have become threefold, O Lord, having distinct forms; / know in your heart, O eternal one, the truth: we are the sons of Śivā and Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ viṣṇuśca sastrīkau sañjātau kāryahetutaḥ |
lokakāryakarau prītyā tava śāsanataḥ prabho ||
meaning:
अहं विष्णुश्च सस्त्रीकौ सञ्जातौ कार्यहेतुतः |
लोककार्यकरौ प्रीत्या तव शासनतः प्रभो ||
text_mt: Viṣṇu and I have taken wives for the sake of our duties, / gladly carrying out the affairs of the world under your command, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādviśvahitārthāya surāṇāṃ sukhahetave |
parigṛhṇīṣva bhāryārthe rāmāmekāṃ suśobhanām ||
meaning:
तस्माद्विश्वहितार्थाय सुराणां सुखहेतवे |
परिगृह्णीष्व भार्यार्थे रामामेकां सुशोभनाम् ||
text_mt: Therefore, for the welfare of the universe and to bring happiness to the gods, / accept a single, beautiful woman for the sake of [having] a wife.

sanskrit_iast:
anyacchṛṇu maheśāna pūrvavṛttaṃ smṛtaṃ mayā |
yanno puraḥ purā proktaṃ tvayaiva śivarūpiṇā ||
meaning:
अन्यच्छृणु महेशान पूर्ववृत्तं स्मृतं मया |
यन्नो पुरः पुरा प्रोक्तं त्वयैव शिवरूपिणा ||
text_mt: Hear another thing, O Maheśāna, a past occurrence remembered by me, / which was spoken long ago before us by you yourself in the form of Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
madrūpaṃ paramaṃ brahmannīdṛśaṃ bhavadaṅgataḥ |
prakaṭībhavitā loke nāmnā rudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
meaning:
मद्रूपं परमं ब्रह्मन्नीदृशं भवदङ्गतः |
प्रकटीभविता लोके नाम्ना रुद्रः प्रकीर्तितः ||
text_mt: "My supreme form, O Brahmā, such as it is, / will manifest in the world from your body, renowned by the name Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭikartābhavad brahmā hariḥ pālanakārakaḥ |
layakārī bhaviṣyāmi rudrarūpo guṇākṛtiḥ ||
meaning:
सृष्टिकर्ताभवद् ब्रह्मा हरिः पालनकारकः |
लयकारी भविष्यामि रुद्ररूपो गुणाकृतिः ||
text_mt: Brahmā is the creator, Hari is the protector, / and I, possessing the nature of the Guṇas in the form of Rudra, shall be the agent of dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
striyaṃ vivāhya lokasya kariṣye kāryamuttamam |
iti saṃsmṛtya svaproktaṃ pūrṇaṃ kuru nijaṃ paṇam ||
meaning:
स्त्रियं विवाह्य लोकस्य करिष्ये कार्यमुत्तमम् |
इति संस्मृत्य स्वप्रोक्तं पूर्णं कुरु निजं पणम् ||
text_mt: Marrying a woman, I shall perform the highest work for the world." / Remembering what you yourself said, fulfill your own pledge.

sanskrit_iast:
nideśastava ca svāminnahaṃ sṛṣṭikaro hariḥ |
pālako layahetustvamāvirbhūtaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ ||
meaning:
निदेशस्तव च स्वामिन्नहं सृष्टिकरो हरिः |
पालको लयहेतुस्त्वमाविर्भूतः स्वयं शिवः ||
text_mt: By your command, O Master, I am the creator, Hari is / the protector, and you, having manifested as Śiva yourself, are the cause of dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ vinā na samarthau hi āvāṃ ca svasvakarmaṇi |
lokakāryaratāṃ tasmādekāṃ gṛhṇīṣva kāminīm ||
meaning:
त्वां विना न समर्थौ हि आवां च स्वस्वकर्मणि |
लोककार्यरतां तस्मादेकां गृह्णीष्व कामिनीम् ||
text_mt: Without you, we two are indeed unable to perform our respective duties; / therefore accept a loving woman dedicated to the welfare of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā padmālayā viṣṇoḥ sāvitrī ca yathā mama |
tathā sahacarīṃ śambho kāntāṃ gṛhṇīṣva samprati ||
meaning:
यथा पद्मालया विष्णोः सावित्री च यथा मम |
तथा सहचरीं शम्भो कान्तां गृह्णीष्व सम्प्रति ||
text_mt: Just as Viṣṇu has Padmālayā and I have Sāvitrī, / so now accept a beloved companion, O Śambhu.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
iti śrutvā vaco me hi brahmaṇaḥ purato hareḥ |
sa māṃ jagāda lokeśaḥ smerānanamukho haraḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इति श्रुत्वा वचो मे हि ब्रह्मणः पुरतो हरेः |
स मां जगाद लोकेशः स्मेराननमुखो हरः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / "Having heard these words of mine, Brahmā, spoken in the presence of Hari, / Hara, the Lord of the world, with a smiling face, spoke to me:

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca |
he brahman he hare me hi yuvāṃ priyatarau sadā |
dṛṣṭvā vāṃ ca mamānando bhavatyatitarāṃ khalu ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच |
हे ब्रह्मन् हे हरे मे हि युवां प्रियतरौ सदा |
दृष्ट्वा वां च ममानन्दो भवत्यतितरां खलु ||
text_mt: The Lord said: / 'O Brahmā, O Hari, you two are always very dear to me; / indeed, seeing you both brings me extraordinary joy.

sanskrit_iast:
yuvāṃ suraviśiṣṭau hi tribhuvasvāminau kila |
kathanaṃ vāṃ gariṣṭheti bhavakāryaratātmanoḥ ||
meaning:
युवां सुरविशिष्टौ हि त्रिभुवस्वामिनौ किल |
कथनं वां गरिष्ठेति भवकार्यरतात्मनोः ||
text_mt: You two are the foremost among the gods, the lords of the three worlds; / the word of you two, whose minds are engaged in the affairs of worldly existence, carries great weight.

sanskrit_iast:
ucitaṃ na suraśreṣṭhau vivāhakaraṇaṃ mama |
taporataviraktasya sadā viditayoginaḥ ||
meaning:
उचितं न सुरश्रेष्ठौ विवाहकरणं मम |
तपोरतविरक्तस्य सदा विदितयोगिनः ||
