जहर्षातीव मनसि प्रणनाम शिवं मुदा ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having heard the greatness of devotion in this manner, Satī, Dakṣa’s daughter, / rejoiced exceedingly in her heart and bowed down to Śiva with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ papraccha sadbhaktyā tatkāṇḍaviṣayaṃ mune |
śāstraṃ sukhakaraṃ loke jīvoddhāraparāyaṇam ||
meaning:
पुनः पप्रच्छ सद्भक्त्या तत्काण्डविषयं मुने |
शास्त्रं सुखकरं लोके जीवोद्धारपरायणम् ||
text_mt: Again, with true devotion, she inquired about the section on that subject, O sage, / the scripture that brings happiness to the world and is dedicated to the salvation of living beings,

sanskrit_iast:
sayantramantraśāstraṃ ca tanmāhātmyaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
anyāni dharmavastūni jīvoddhārakarāṇi hi ||
meaning:
सयन्त्रमन्त्रशास्त्रं च तन्माहात्म्यं विशेषतः |
अन्यानि धर्मवस्तूनि जीवोद्धारकराणि हि ||
text_mt: and the scripture of yantras and mantras, especially its eulogy, / and other righteous matters that bring about the salvation of living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkaro'pi tadākarṇya satīpraśnaṃ prahṛṣṭadhīḥ |
varṇayāmāsa suprītyā jīvoddhārāya kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
meaning:
शङ्करोऽपि तदाकर्ण्य सतीप्रश्नं प्रहृष्टधीः |
वर्णयामास सुप्रीत्या जीवोद्धाराय कृत्स्नशः ||
text_mt: Hearing Satī's question, Śaṅkara too, with a delighted mind, / recounted everything in full with great affection for the salvation of living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tantraśāstraṃ sayantraṃ hi sapañcāṅgaṃ maheśvaraḥ |
babhāṣe mahimānaṃ ca tattaddevavarasya vai ||
meaning:
तन्त्रशास्त्रं सयन्त्रं हि सपञ्चाङ्गं महेश्वरः |
बभाषे महिमानं च तत्तद्देववरस्य वै ||
text_mt: The Great Lord spoke of the Tantra scripture together with yantras and the five limbs, / and the greatness of each respective supreme deity,

sanskrit_iast:
setihāsakathāṃ teṣāṃ bhaktamāhātmyameva ca |
savarṇāśramadharmāṃśca nṛpadharmān munīśvara ||
meaning:
सेतिहासकथां तेषां भक्तमाहात्म्यमेव च |
सवर्णाश्रमधर्मांश्च नृपधर्मान् मुनीश्वर ||
text_mt: the historical tales of them, the eulogy of devotees, / the duties of the social classes and stages of life, and the duties of kings, O best of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
sutastrīdharmamāhātmyaṃ varṇāśramamanaśvaram |
vaidyaśāstraṃ tathā jyotiḥśāstraṃ jīvasukhāvaham ||
meaning:
सुतस्त्रीधर्ममाहात्म्यं वर्णाश्रममनश्वरम् |
वैद्यशास्त्रं तथा ज्योतिःशास्त्रं जीवसुखावहम् ||
text_mt: the eulogy of the duties of sons and women, the imperishable [order of] classes and stages of life, / medical science, and the science of astrology that brings happiness to living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmudrikaṃ paraṃ śāstramanyacchāstrāṇi bhūriśaḥ |
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā maheśāno varṇayāmāsa tattvataḥ ||
meaning:
सामुद्रिकं परं शास्त्रमन्यच्छास्त्राणि भूरिशः |
कृपां कृत्वा महेशानो वर्णयामास तत्त्वतः ||
text_mt: The Great Lord, out of compassion, accurately explained / the supreme science of palmistry and numerous other scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ trilokasukhadau sarvajñau ca satīśivau |
lokopakārakaraṇadhṛtasadguṇavigrahau ||
meaning:
इत्थं त्रिलोकसुखदौ सर्वज्ञौ च सतीशिवौ |
लोकोपकारकरणधृतसद्गुणविग्रहौ ||
text_mt: In this way, Satī and Śiva, who bestow happiness on the three worlds and are omniscient, / assuming forms composed of noble virtues to benefit the world,

sanskrit_iast:
cikrīḍāte bahuvidhaṃ kailāse himavad girau |
anyasthaleṣu ca tadā parabrahmasvarūpiṇau ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ satīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
चिक्रीडाते बहुविधं कैलासे हिमवद् गिरौ |
अन्यस्थलेषु च तदा परब्रह्मस्वरूपिणौ ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां द्वितीयः सतीखण्डे
text_mt:
sported in various ways on Kailāsa, on the Himavat mountain, / and in other places at that time, being the very nature of supreme Brahman.

Thus ends the twenty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Power of Devotion,' in the Satī Section, the second [part] of the Rudrasaṃhitā, in the glorious Śivamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca |
brahman vidhe prajānātha mahāprājña kṛpākara |
śrāvitaṃ śaṅkarayaśaḥ satīśaṅkarayoḥ śubham ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच |
ब्रह्मन् विधे प्रजानाथ महाप्राज्ञ कृपाकर |
श्रावितं शङ्करयशः सतीशङ्करयोः शुभम् ||
title: caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | rāmaparīkṣāvarṇanam
text_mt: Nārada said: / O Brahmā, O creator, O lord of creatures, O greatly wise one, O bestower of mercy, / the auspicious fame of Śaṅkara, of Satī and Śaṅkara, has been recited.

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ brūhi satprītyā paraṃ tadyaśa uttamam |
kimakārṣṭāṃ hi tatsthau vai caritaṃ dampatī śivau ||
meaning:
इदानीं ब्रूहि सत्प्रीत्या परं तद्यश उत्तमम् |
किमकार्ष्टां हि तत्स्थौ वै चरितं दम्पती शिवौ ||
text_mt: Now, with true affection, tell of their supreme, excellent renown; / what deed did the couple, the two auspicious ones residing there, perform?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
satīśivacaritraṃ ca śṛṇu me premato mune |
laukikīṃ gatimāśritya cikrīḍāte sadānvaham ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
सतीशिवचरित्रं च शृणु मे प्रेमतो मुने |
लौकिकीं गतिमाश्रित्य चिक्रीडाते सदान्वहम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Listen with love from me to the conduct of Satī and Śiva, O sage; / adopting worldly conduct, they sported day after day.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ satī mahādevī viyogamalabhanmune |
svapataḥ śaṅkarasyeti vadantyeke subuddhayaḥ ||
meaning:
ततः सती महादेवी वियोगमलभन्मुने |
स्वपतः शङ्करस्येति वदन्त्येके सुबुद्धयः ||
text_mt: Then Satī, the great goddess, experienced separation, O sage, / while Śaṅkara was sleeping: so say some who possess good intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
vāgarthāviva sampṛktau śaktīśau sarvadā citau |
kathaṃ ghaṭeta ca tayorviyogastattvato mune ||
meaning:
वागर्थाविव सम्पृक्तौ शक्तीशौ सर्वदा चितौ |
कथं घटेत च तयोर्वियोगस्तत्त्वतो मुने ||
text_mt: United like word and meaning, Śakti and the Lord, always of the nature of consciousness— / how could separation truly occur between the two, O sage?

sanskrit_iast:
līlārucitvādathavā saṅghaṭetākhilaṃ ca tat |
kurute yadyadīśau ca satīśau bhavarītigau ||
meaning:
लीलारुचित्वादथवा सङ्घटेताखिलं च तत् |
कुरुते यद्यदीशौ च सतीशौ भवरीतिगौ ||
text_mt: Or else all that might happen because of their taste for divine play; / whatever the two rulers, Satī and the Lord, do, follows worldly conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tyaktā dakṣajā dṛṣṭvā patinā janakādhvare |
śambhoranādarāttatra dehaṃ tatyāja saṅgatā ||
meaning:
सा त्यक्ता दक्षजा दृष्ट्वा पतिना जनकाध्वरे |
शम्भोरनादरात्तत्र देहं तत्याज सङ्गता ||
text_mt: Seeing that she was abandoned by her husband, Dakṣa’s daughter, having gone there, / cast off her body at her father’s sacrifice because of the disrespect shown to Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
punarhimālaye saivāvirbhūtā nāmataḥ satī |
pārvatīti śivaṃ prāpa taptvā bhūri vivāhataḥ ||
meaning:
पुनर्हिमालये सैवाविर्भूता नामतः सती |
पार्वतीति शिवं प्राप तप्त्वा भूरि विवाहतः ||
text_mt: Again, she herself manifested in the Himālaya by the name of Satī; / as Pārvatī, having practiced intense austerity, she obtained Śiva through marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
ityākarṇya vacastasya brahmaṇaḥ sa tu nāradaḥ |
papraccha ca vidhātāraṃ śivāśivamahadyaśaḥ ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य ब्रह्मणः स तु नारदः |
पप्रच्छ च विधातारं शिवाशिवमहद्यशः ||
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard these words of Brahmā, Nārada / questioned the creator about the great glory of Śivā and Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca |
viṣṇuśiṣya mahābhāga vidhe me vada vistarāt |
śivāśivacaritraṃ tadbhavācāraparānugam ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच |
विष्णुशिष्य महाभाग विधे मे वद विस्तरात् |
शिवाशिवचरित्रं तद्भवाचारपरानुगम् ||
text_mt: Nārada said: / O disciple of Viṣṇu, O fortunate one, O creator, tell me in detail / the conduct of Śivā and Śiva that conforms to worldly conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthaṃ śaṅkaro jāyāṃ tatyāja prāṇataḥ priyām |
tasmādācakṣva me tāta vicitramiti manmahe ||
meaning:
किमर्थं शङ्करो जायां तत्याज प्राणतः प्रियाम् |
तस्मादाचक्ष्व मे तात विचित्रमिति मन्महे ||
text_mt: For what reason did Śaṅkara abandon his wife, who was dearer to him than life? / Therefore tell me, father; we consider this an extraordinary thing.

sanskrit_iast:
kuto'dhvare'jaḥ putrasyānādaro'bhūcchivasya te |
kathaṃ tatyāja sā dehaṃ gatvā tatra pituḥ kratau ||
meaning:
कुतोऽध्वरेऽजः पुत्रस्यानादरोऽभूच्छिवस्य ते |
कथं तत्याज सा देहं गत्वा तत्र पितुः क्रतौ ||
text_mt: Why was your son Śiva disrespected at the sacrifice by the Unborn [Daksha]? / How did she, having gone there to her father's sacrifice, cast off her body?

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kimabhavattatra kimakārṣīnmaheśvaraḥ |
tatsarvaṃ me samācakṣva śraddhāyuk tacchrutāvaham ||
meaning:
ततः किमभवत्तत्र किमकार्षीन्महेश्वरः |
तत्सर्वं मे समाचक्ष्व श्रद्धायुक् तच्छ्रुतावहम् ||
text_mt: What happened there after that? What did Maheśvara do? / Tell me all that; I am filled with faith to hear it.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
śṛṇu tāta paraprītyā munibhiḥ saha nārada |
sutavarya mahāprājña caritaṃ śaśimaulinaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
शृणु तात परप्रीत्या मुनिभिः सह नारद |
सुतवर्य महाप्राज्ञ चरितं शशिमौलिनः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Listen with great love together with the sages, Nārada, / O best of sons, O greatly wise one, to the deeds of the moon-crested lord.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskṛtya maheśānaṃ haryādisurasevitam |
parabrahma pravakṣyāmi taccaritraṃ mahādbhutam ||
meaning:
नमस्कृत्य महेशानं हर्यादिसुरसेवितम् |
परब्रह्म प्रवक्ष्यामि तच्चरित्रं महाद्भुतम् ||
text_mt: Having bowed to Maheśāna, who is served by Hari and the other gods, / the Supreme Brahman, I shall narrate his exceedingly wonderful deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveyaṃ śivalīlā hi bahulīlākaraḥ prabhuḥ |
svatantro nirvikārī ca satī sāpi hi tadvidhā ||
meaning:
सर्वेयं शिवलीला हि बहुलीलाकरः प्रभुः |
स्वतन्त्रो निर्विकारी च सती सापि हि तद्विधा ||
text_mt: Indeed, all this is Śiva's divine play; the lord performs manifold play, / independent and changeless; and Satī too is of the same nature.

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā kaḥ samartho hi tatkarmakaraṇe mune |
paramātmā parabrahma sa eva parameśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
अन्यथा कः समर्थो हि तत्कर्मकरणे मुने |
परमात्मा परब्रह्म स एव परमेश्वरः ||
text_mt: Otherwise, who indeed is capable of performing such acts, O sage? / He alone is the Supreme Self, the Supreme Brahman, the Parameśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ sadā bhajate śrīśo'haṃ cāpi sakalāḥ surāḥ |
munayaśca mahātmānaḥ siddhāśca sanakādayaḥ ||
meaning:
यं सदा भजते श्रीशोऽहं चापि सकलाः सुराः |
मुनयश्च महात्मानः सिद्धाश्च सनकादयः ||
text_mt: Whom the Lord of Śrī, and I, and all the gods constantly worship, / as well as the high-souled sages, and the perfected ones headed by Sanaka;

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣaḥ sadā yaśo yasya mudā gāyati nityaśaḥ |
pāraṃ na labhate tāta sa prabhuḥ śaṅkaraḥ śivaḥ ||
meaning:
शेषः सदा यशो यस्य मुदा गायति नित्यशः |
पारं न लभते तात स प्रभुः शङ्करः शिवः ||
text_mt: Whose glory Śeṣa always sings daily with joy, / yet does not reach its end, father; he is the Lord Śaṅkara, Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva līlayā sarvo'yamiti tattvavibhramaḥ |
tatra doṣo na kasyāpi sarvavyāpī sa prerakaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्यैव लीलया सर्वोऽयमिति तत्त्वविभ्रमः |
तत्र दोषो न कस्यापि सर्वव्यापी स प्रेरकः ||
text_mt: It is solely through his divine play that all this confusion regarding true reality occurs; / no fault lies with anyone there; he is the all-pervading instigator.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasminsamaye rudraḥ satyā tribhavane bhavaḥ |
vṛṣamāruhya paryāṭadrasāṃ līlāviśāradaḥ ||
meaning:
एकस्मिन्समये रुद्रः सत्या त्रिभवने भवः |
वृषमारुह्य पर्याटद्रसां लीलाविशारदः ||
text_mt: At one time, Rudra, the Bhava of the three worlds, skilled in divine play, / mounted his bull and roamed the earth together with Satī.

sanskrit_iast:
āgatya daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ paryaṭan sāgarāmbarām |
darśayan tatragāṃ śobhāṃ satyai satyapaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
आगत्य दण्डकारण्यं पर्यटन् सागराम्बराम् |
दर्शयन् तत्रगां शोभां सत्यै सत्यपणः प्रभुः ||
text_mt: Having come to the Daṇḍaka forest while wandering over the ocean-clad earth, / the lord whose promise is truth showed Satī the splendor found there.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra rāmaṃ dadarśāsau lakṣmaṇenānvitaṃ haraḥ |
anviṣyantaṃ priyāṃ sītāṃ rāvaṇena hṛtāṃ chalāt ||
meaning:
तत्र रामं ददर्शासौ लक्ष्मणेनान्वितं हरः |
अन्विष्यन्तं प्रियां सीतां रावणेन हृतां छलात् ||
text_mt: There Hara saw Rāma accompanied by Lakṣmaṇa, / searching for his beloved Sītā, who had been abducted deceitfully by Rāvaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
hā sīteti proccarantaṃ virahāviṣṭamānasam |
yatastataśca paśyantaṃ rudantaṃ hi muhurmuhuḥ ||
meaning:
हा सीतेति प्रोच्चरन्तं विरहाविष्टमानसम् |
यतस्ततश्च पश्यन्तं रुदन्तं हि मुहुर्मुहुः ||
text_mt: Crying out aloud, "Ah, Sītā!", his mind possessed by the pain of separation, / looking this way and that, and weeping again and again,

sanskrit_iast:
samicchantaṃ ca tatprāptiṃ pṛcchantaṃ tadgatiṃ hṛdā |
kujādibhyo naṣṭadhiyamatrapaṃ śokavihvalam ||
meaning:
समिच्छन्तं च तत्प्राप्तिं पृच्छन्तं तद्गतिं हृदा |
कुजादिभ्यो नष्टधियमत्रपं शोकविह्वलम् ||
text_mt: Longing to recover her, inquiring in his heart of her whereabouts / from trees and the like, his mind distraught, unashamed, overwhelmed by grief,

sanskrit_iast:
sūryavaṃśodbhavaṃ vīraṃ bhūpaṃ daśarathātmajam |
bharatāgrajamānandarahitaṃ vigataprabham ||
meaning:
सूर्यवंशोद्भवं वीरं भूपं दशरथात्मजम् |
भरताग्रजमानन्दरहितं विगतप्रभम् ||
text_mt: The heroic king born in the solar lineage, Daśaratha's son, / the elder brother of Bharata, devoid of joy and robbed of his luster.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇakāmo varādhīnaṃ prāṇamatsma mudā haraḥ |
rāmaṃ bhramantaṃ vipine salakṣmaṇamudāradhīḥ ||
meaning:
पूर्णकामो वराधीनं प्राणमत्स्म मुदा हरः |
रामं भ्रमन्तं विपिने सलक्ष्मणमुदारधीः ||
text_mt: Hara, whose desires are fulfilled, with noble mind, joyfully bowed / to Rāma, who was subject to a boon, as he roamed the forest with Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
jayetyuktvānyato'gacchannadāttasmai svadarśanam |
rāmāya vipine tasmin śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
जयेत्युक्त्वान्यतोऽगच्छन्नदात्तस्मै स्वदर्शनम् |
रामाय विपिने तस्मिन् शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः ||
text_mt: Saying "Victory!", Śaṅkara, who is affectionate toward devotees, went elsewhere / without revealing himself to Rāma in that forest.

sanskrit_iast:
itīdṛśīṃ satī dṛṣṭvā śivalīlāṃ vimohanīm |
suvismitā śivaṃ prāha śivamāyāvimohitā ||
meaning:
इतीदृशीं सती दृष्ट्वा शिवलीलां विमोहनीम् |
सुविस्मिता शिवं प्राह शिवमायाविमोहिता ||
text_mt: Seeing such a deluding divine play of Śiva, Satī, / greatly astonished and bewildered by Śiva's māyā, spoke to Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
satyuvāca |
devadeva parabrahma sarveśa parameśvara |
sevante tvāṃ sadā sarve haribrahmādayaḥ surāḥ ||
meaning:
सत्युवाच |
देवदेव परब्रह्म सर्वेश परमेश्वर |
सेवन्ते त्वां सदा सर्वे हरिब्रह्मादयः सुराः ||
text_mt: Satī said: / O God of gods, Supreme Brahman, Lord of all, Parameśvara, / all the gods headed by Hari and Brahmā constantly serve you.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ praṇamyo hi sarveṣāṃ sevyo dhyeyaśca sarvadā |
vedāntavedyo yatnena nirvikārī paraprabhuḥ ||
meaning:
त्वं प्रणम्यो हि सर्वेषां सेव्यो ध्येयश्च सर्वदा |
वेदान्तवेद्यो यत्नेन निर्विकारी परप्रभुः ||
text_mt: Indeed, you are to be bowed to, served, and meditated upon by all at all times; / known through the Vedānta with effort, changeless, the supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
kāvimau puruṣau nātha virahavyākulākṛtī |
vicarantau vane kliṣṭau dīnau vīrau dhanurdharau ||
meaning:
काविमौ पुरुषौ नाथ विरहव्याकुलाकृती |
विचरन्तौ वने क्लिष्टौ दीनौ वीरौ धनुर्धरौ ||
text_mt: Who are these two men, O lord, appearing distraught by separation, / wandering in the forest, afflicted, wretched, [yet] heroic bowmen?

sanskrit_iast:
tayorjyeṣṭhaṃ kañjaśyāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai kena hetunā |
muditaḥ suprasannātmābhavo bhakta ivādhunā ||
meaning:
तयोर्ज्येष्ठं कञ्जश्यामं दृष्ट्वा वै केन हेतुना |
मुदितः सुप्रसन्नात्माभवो भक्त इवाधुना ||
text_mt: Having seen the elder of the two, dark as a lotus, for what reason / have you now become delighted, with a thoroughly joyful mind, like a devotee?

sanskrit_iast:
iti me saṃśayaṃ svāmin śaṅkara chettumarhasi |
sevyasya sevake naiva ghaṭate praṇatiḥ prabho ||
meaning:
इति मे संशयं स्वामिन् शङ्कर छेत्तुमर्हसि |
सेव्यस्य सेवके नैव घटते प्रणतिः प्रभो ||
text_mt: O Lord Śaṅkara, you ought to dispel this doubt of mine; / O lord, an obeisance by the one who is worshipped to a servant is never fitting.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ādiśaktiḥ satī devī śivā sā parameśvarī |
śivamāyāvaśī bhūtvā papracchetthaṃ śivaṃ prabhum ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
आदिशक्तिः सती देवी शिवा सा परमेश्वरी |
शिवमायावशी भूत्वा पप्रच्छेत्थं शिवं प्रभुम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / The goddess Satī, the Primordial Energy, Śivā, the Supreme Mistress, / having fallen under the power of Śiva's māyā, thus questioned Lord Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tadākarṇya vacaḥ satyāḥ śaṅkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ |
tadā vihasya sa prāha satīṃ līlāviśāradaḥ ||
meaning:
तदाकर्ण्य वचः सत्याः शङ्करः परमेश्वरः |
तदा विहस्य स प्राह सतीं लीलाविशारदः ||
text_mt: Hearing those words of Satī, Śaṅkara, the Parameśvara, / skilled in divine play, then smiled and spoke to Satī:

sanskrit_iast:
parameśvara uvāca |
śṛṇu devi sati prītyā yathārthaṃ vacmi nacchalam |
varadānaprabhāvāttu praṇāmaṃ caivamādarāt ||
meaning:
परमेश्वर उवाच |
शृणु देवि सति प्रीत्या यथार्थं वच्मि नच्छलम् |
वरदानप्रभावात्तु प्रणामं चैवमादरात् ||
text_mt: Parameśvara said: / Listen with love, O goddess Satī, I speak the truth without deception; / but it is by the power of granting a boon that such an obeisance was made with respect.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmalakṣmaṇanāmānau bhrātarau vīrasammatau |
sūryavaṃśodbhavau devi prājñau daśarathātmajau ||
meaning:
रामलक्ष्मणनामानौ भ्रातरौ वीरसम्मतौ |
सूर्यवंशोद्भवौ देवि प्राज्ञौ दशरथात्मजौ ||
text_mt: The two brothers named Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa are esteemed heroes; / born of the solar race, O goddess, they are the wise sons of Daśaratha.

sanskrit_iast:
gauravarṇau laghurbandhuḥ śeṣeśo lakṣmaṇābhidhaḥ |
jyeṣṭho rāmābhidho viṣṇuḥ pūrṇāṃśo nirupadravaḥ ||
meaning:
गौरवर्णौ लघुर्बन्धुः शेषेशो लक्ष्मणाभिधः |
ज्येष्ठो रामाभिधो विष्णुः पूर्णांशो निरुपद्रवः ||
text_mt: The younger brother named Lakṣmaṇa is fair in complexion, the Lord Śeṣa; / the elder, named Rāma, is Viṣṇu, a complete portion, free from afflictions.

sanskrit_iast:
avatīrṇaḥ kṣitau sādhurakṣaṇāya bhavāya naḥ |
ityuktvā virarāmāsau śambhuḥ sūtikaraḥ prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
अवतीर्णः क्षितौ साधुरक्षणाय भवाय नः |
इत्युक्त्वा विररामासौ शम्भुः सूतिकरः प्रभुः ||
text_mt: He has descended to the earth for the protection of the virtuous and for our welfare. / Having spoken thus, the lord Sambhu, the author of creation, paused.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvāpītthaṃ vacaḥ śambhorna viśaśvāsa tanmanaḥ |
śivamāyā balavatī saiva trailokyamohinī ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वापीत्थं वचः शम्भोर्न विशश्वास तन्मनः |
शिवमाया बलवती सैव त्रैलोक्यमोहिनी ||
text_mt: Even having heard such words of Śambhu, her mind did not believe; / Śiva's māyā is powerful, and it deludes the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
aviśvastaṃ mano jñātvā tasyāḥ śambhuḥ sanātanaḥ |
avocadvacanaṃ ceti prabhurlīlāviśāradaḥ ||
meaning:
अविश्वस्तं मनो ज्ञात्वा तस्याः शम्भुः सनातनः |
अवोचद्वचनं चेति प्रभुर्लीलाविशारदः ||
text_mt: Knowing her mind to be unconvinced, the eternal Śambhu, / the lord skilled in divine play, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca |
śṛṇu madvacanaṃ devi na viśvasiti cenmanaḥ |
tava rāmaparikṣāṃ hi kuru tatra svayā dhiyā ||
meaning:
शिव उवाच |
शृणु मद्वचनं देवि न विश्वसिति चेन्मनः |
तव रामपरिक्षां हि कुरु तत्र स्वया धिया ||
text_mt: Śiva said: / Listen to my words, O goddess: if your mind does not believe, / then test Rāma yourself with your own intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
vinaśyati yathā mohastatkuru tvaṃ sati priye |
gatvā tatra sthitastāvad vaṭe bhava parīkṣikā ||
meaning:
विनश्यति यथा मोहस्तत्कुरु त्वं सति प्रिये |
गत्वा तत्र स्थितस्तावद् वटे भव परीक्षिका ||
text_mt: Act so that your delusion may be destroyed, O dear Satī; / having gone there while I remain at the banyan tree, test him.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
śivājñayā satī tatra gatvācintayadīśvarī |
kuryāṃ parīkṣāṃ ca kathaṃ rāmasya vanacāriṇaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
शिवाज्ञया सती तत्र गत्वाचिन्तयदीश्वरी |
कुर्यां परीक्षां च कथं रामस्य वनचारिणः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / By Śiva's command, the goddess Satī went there and thought: / "How shall I test Rāma who wanders the forest?

sanskrit_iast:
sītārūpamahaṃ dhṛtvā gaccheyaṃ rāmasannidhau |
yadi rāmo hariḥ sarvaṃ vijñāsyati na cānyathā ||
meaning:
सीतारूपमहं धृत्वा गच्छेयं रामसन्निधौ |
यदि रामो हरिः सर्वं विज्ञास्यति न चान्यथा ||
text_mt: Assuming the form of Sītā, I shall go near Rāma; / if Rāma is Hari, he will know everything, and not otherwise."

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ vicārya sītā sā bhūtvā rāmasamīpataḥ |
agamattatparīkṣārthaṃ satī mohaparāyaṇā ||
meaning:
इत्थं विचार्य सीता सा भूत्वा रामसमीपतः |
अगमत्तत्परीक्षार्थं सती मोहपरायणा ||
text_mt: Having thus considered and assumed the form of Sītā, Satī, / intent on her delusion, went near Rāma in order to test him.

sanskrit_iast:
sītārūpāṃ satīṃ dṛṣṭvā japannāma śiveti ca |
vihasya tatpravijñāya natvāvocad raghūdvahaḥ ||
meaning:
सीतारूपां सतीं दृष्ट्वा जपन्नाम शिवेति च |
विहस्य तत्प्रविज्ञाय नत्वावोचद् रघूद्वहः ||
text_mt: Seeing Satī in the form of Sītā, repeating the name "Śiva", / the descendant of Raghu smiled, understood, bowed, and said:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrāma uvāca |
prematastvaṃ sati brūhi kva śambhuste namo gataḥ |
ekākī vipine kasmādāgatā patinā vinā ||
meaning:
श्रीराम उवाच |
प्रेमतस्त्वं सति ब्रूहि क्व शम्भुस्ते नमो गतः |
एकाकी विपिने कस्मादागता पतिना विना ||
text_mt: Śrī Rāma said: / Tell me with affection, O Satī, where has your Śambhu gone? Salutations to you. / Why have you come alone to the forest without your husband?

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā svarūpaṃ kasmātte dhṛtaṃ rūpamidaṃ sati |
brūhi tatkāraṇaṃ devi kṛpāṃ kṛtvā mamopari ||
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा स्वरूपं कस्मात्ते धृतं रूपमिदं सति |
ब्रूहि तत्कारणं देवि कृपां कृत्वा ममोपरि ||
text_mt: Having cast off your own form, why have you assumed this form, O Satī? / Tell me the reason for that, O goddess, having taken pity on me.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
iti rāmavacaḥ śrutvā cakitāsītsatī tadā |
smṛtvā śivoktaṃ matvā cāvitathaṃ lajjitā bhṛśam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इति रामवचः श्रुत्वा चकितासीत्सती तदा |
स्मृत्वा शिवोक्तं मत्वा चावितथं लज्जिता भृशम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing these words of Rāma, Satī was then astonished; / remembering what Śiva had said and knowing it to be true, she was greatly ashamed.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaṃ vijñāya viṣṇuṃ taṃ svarūpaṃ saṃvidhāya ca |
smṛtvā śivapadaṃ citte satyuvāca prasannadhīḥ ||
meaning:
रामं विज्ञाय विष्णुं तं स्वरूपं संविधाय च |
स्मृत्वा शिवपदं चित्ते सत्युवाच प्रसन्नधीः ||
text_mt: Recognizing that Rāma was Viṣṇu, reassuming her own form, / and remembering the feet of Śiva in her heart, Satī spoke with a serene mind:

sanskrit_iast:
śivo mayā gaṇaiścaiva paryaṭan vasudhāṃ prabhuḥ |
ihāgacchacca vipine svatantraḥ parameśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
शिवो मया गणैश्चैव पर्यटन् वसुधां प्रभुः |
इहागच्छच्च विपिने स्वतन्त्रः परमेश्वरः ||
text_mt: "Lord Śiva, the independent Parameśvara, roaming the earth / along with me and his attendants, came here to the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyadatra sa tvāṃ hi sītānveṣaṇatatparam |
salakṣmaṇaṃ virahiṇaṃ sītayā kliṣṭamānasam ||
meaning:
अपश्यदत्र स त्वां हि सीतान्वेषणतत्परम् |
सलक्ष्मणं विरहिणं सीतया क्लिष्टमानसम् ||
text_mt: He saw you here, intent on searching for Sītā, / accompanied by Lakṣmaṇa, pining in separation, your mind afflicted by [the loss of] Sītā.

sanskrit_iast:
natvā tvāṃ sa gato mūle vaṭasya sthita eva hi |
praśaṃsan mahimānaṃ te vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ mudā ||
meaning:
नत्वा त्वां स गतो मूले वटस्य स्थित एव हि |
प्रशंसन् महिमानं ते वैष्णवं परमं मुदा ||
text_mt: Having bowed to you, he went and stayed at the foot of the banyan tree, / joyfully praising your supreme greatness as Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujaṃ hariṃ tvāṃ no dṛṣṭvaiva mudito'bhavat |
yathedaṃ rūpamamalaṃ paśyannānandamāptavān ||
meaning:
चतुर्भुजं हरिं त्वां नो दृष्ट्वैव मुदितोऽभवत् |
यथेदं रूपममलं पश्यन्नानन्दमाप्तवान् ||
text_mt: He was not delighted by seeing you as the four-armed Hari / in the way he found joy upon beholding this spotless form of yours."

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ śambhorbhramamānīya cetasi |
tadājñayā parīkṣāṃ te kṛtavatyasmi rāghava ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं शम्भोर्भ्रममानीय चेतसि |
तदाज्ञया परीक्षां ते कृतवत्यस्मि राघव ||
text_mt: Hearing those words of Śambhu, and having fallen into doubt in my mind, / I tested you, O descendant of Raghu, by his command.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātaṃ me rāma viṣṇustvaṃ dṛṣṭā te prabhutākhilā |
niḥsaṃśayā tadāpi tacchṛṇu tvaṃ ca mahāmate ||
meaning:
ज्ञातं मे राम विष्णुस्त्वं दृष्टा ते प्रभुताखिला |
निःसंशया तदापि तच्छृणु त्वं च महामते ||
text_mt: I know, O Rāma, that you are Viṣṇu; all your lordship has been seen [by me]. / Yet, [even so], listen to this, O highly intelligent one, so that I may be free from doubt:

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ praṇamyastvaṃ tasya satyaṃ brūhi mamāgrataḥ |
kuru niḥsaṃśayāṃ tvaṃ māṃ śamalaṃ prāpnuhi drutam ||
meaning:
कथं प्रणम्यस्त्वं तस्य सत्यं ब्रूहि ममाग्रतः |
कुरु निःसंशयां त्वं मां शमलं प्राप्नुहि द्रुतम् ||
text_mt: How is it that you are to be bowed to by him? Speak the truth before me! / Make me free from doubt, and quickly relieve [my] agitation.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityākarṇya vacastasyā rāmaścotphullalocanaḥ |
asmaratsvaṃ prabhuṃ śambhuṃ premābhūd hṛdi cādhikam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्या रामश्चोत्फुल्ललोचनः |
अस्मरत्स्वं प्रभुं शम्भुं प्रेमाभूद् हृदि चाधिकम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing her words, Rāma, his eyes blooming [wide], / remembered his lord Śambhu, and devotion increased even more in his heart.

sanskrit_iast:
satyā vinājñayā śambhusamīpaṃ nāgamanmune |
saṃvarṇya mahimānaṃ ca prāvocadrāghavaḥ satīm ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ satīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
सत्या विनाज्ञया शम्भुसमीपं नागमन्मुने |
संवर्ण्य महिमानं च प्रावोचद्राघवः सतीम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां द्वितीयः सतीखण्डे
text_mt:
He did not go near Śambhu without Satī's permission, O sage; / and, recounting his majesty, the descendant of Raghu spoke to Satī:

Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter, entitled "The Account of the Testing of Rāma," in the second section, the Satīkhaṇḍa, of the second Rudrasaṃhitā in the glorious Śivamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrāma uvāca |
ekadā hi purā devi śambhuḥ paramasūtikṛt |
viśvakarmāṇamāhūya svaloke parataḥ pare ||
meaning:
श्रीराम उवाच |
एकदा हि पुरा देवि शम्भुः परमसूतिकृत् |
विश्वकर्माणमाहूय स्वलोके परतः परे ||
title: pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivasatīviyogaḥ
text_mt: The glorious Rāma said: / Once long ago, O goddess, Śambhu, the supreme creator, / summoned Viśvakarman in his own realm beyond the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
tena svadhenuśālāyāṃ kārayāmāsa vistṛtam |
ramyaṃ ca bhavanaṃ samyak tatra siṃhāsanaṃ varam ||
meaning:
तेन स्वधेनुशालायां कारयामास विस्तृतम् |
रम्यं च भवनं सम्यक् तत्र सिंहासनं वरम् ||
text_mt: By him he had a vast and beautiful mansion properly built / in his own cowshed, and an excellent lion-throne therein.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra cchatraṃ mahādivyaṃ sarvadādbhutamuttamam |
kārayāmāsa vighnārthaṃ śaṅkaro viśvakarmaṇā ||
meaning:
तत्र च्छत्रं महादिव्यं सर्वदाद्भुतमुत्तमम् |
कारयामास विघ्नार्थं शङ्करो विश्वकर्मणा ||
text_mt: Śaṅkara had Viśvakarman make there a most celestial umbrella, / ever wonderful and supreme, for the sake of warding off obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
śakrādīnāṃ juhāvāśu samastān devatāgaṇān |
siddhagandharvanāgādīnupadevāṃśca kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
meaning:
शक्रादीनां जुहावाशु समस्तान् देवतागणान् |
सिद्धगन्धर्वनागादीनुपदेवांश्च कृत्स्नशः ||
text_mt: He quickly summoned all the hosts of gods headed by Śakra, / and the Siddhas, Gandharvas, Nāgas, and all the minor gods without exception;

sanskrit_iast:
devān sarvānāgamāṃśca vidhiputrān munīnapi |
devīḥ sarvā apsarobhirnānāvastusamanvitāḥ ||
meaning:
देवान् सर्वानागमांश्च विधिपुत्रान् मुनीनपि |
देवीः सर्वा अप्सरोभिर्नानावस्तुसमन्विताः ||
text_mt: all the gods, the Āgamas, the sons of Brahmā, and the sages, / and all the goddesses accompanied by Apsarases, endowed with various objects.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ ca tatharṣīṇāṃ siddhānāṃ phaṇināmapi |
ānayan maṅgalakarāḥ kanyāḥ ṣoḍaśa ṣoḍaśa ||
meaning:
देवानां च तथर्षीणां सिद्धानां फणिनामपि |
आनयन् मङ्गलकराः कन्याः षोडश षोडश ||
text_mt: They brought sixteen auspicious maidens each / belonging to the gods, the sages, the Siddhas, and the serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
vīṇāmṛdaṅgapramukhavādyānnānāvidhān mune |
utsavaṃ kārayāmāsa vādayitvā sugāyanaiḥ ||
rājābhiṣekayogyāni dravyāṇi sakalauṣadhaiḥ pratyakṣatīrthapāthobhiḥ pañcakumbhāṃśca pūritān | 8 ||
meaning:
वीणामृदङ्गप्रमुखवाद्यान्नानाविधान् मुने |
उत्सवं कारयामास वादयित्वा सुगायनैः ||
राजाभिषेकयोग्यानि द्रव्याणि सकलौषधैः प्रत्यक्षतीर्थपाथोभिः पञ्चकुम्भांश्च पूरितान् | 8 ||
text_mt:
Various musical instruments, headed by the lute and the mṛdaṅga drum, O sage, / he caused to be played by fine singers, making a festival.

Materials fit for a royal consecration, with all medicinal herbs, / and five pitchers filled with waters from visible holy places—

sanskrit_iast:
tathānyāḥ saṃvidhā divyā ānayatsvagaṇaistadā |
brahmaghoṣaṃ mahārāvaṃ kārayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ ||
meaning:
तथान्याः संविधा दिव्या आनयत्स्वगणैस्तदा |
ब्रह्मघोषं महारावं कारयामास शङ्करः ||
text_mt: and other divine provisions he then had brought by his attendants; / and Śaṅkara had the great roar of chanting the Veda resound.

sanskrit_iast:
atho hariṃ samāhūya vaikuṇṭhātprītamānasaḥ |
tadbhaktyā pūrṇayā devi modati sma maheśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
अथो हरिं समाहूय वैकुण्ठात्प्रीतमानसः |
तद्भक्त्या पूर्णया देवि मोदति स्म महेश्वरः ||
text_mt: Then, having summoned Hari from Vaikuṇṭha with a delighted mind, / Maheśvara rejoiced, O goddess, in full devotion to him.

sanskrit_iast:
sumuhūrte mahādevastatra siṃhāsane vare |
upaveśya hariṃ prītyā bhūṣayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ||
meaning:
सुमुहूर्ते महादेवस्तत्र सिंहासने वरे |
उपवेश्य हरिं प्रीत्या भूषयामास सर्वशः ||
text_mt: At an auspicious hour Mahādeva, having affectionately seated Hari / on that excellent throne, adorned him completely.

sanskrit_iast:
ābaddharamyamukuṭaṃ kṛtakautukamaṅgalam |
abhyaṣiñcanmaheśastu svayaṃ brahmāṇḍamaṇḍape ||
meaning:
आबद्धरम्यमुकुटं कृतकौतुकमङ्गलम् |
अभ्यषिञ्चन्महेशस्तु स्वयं ब्रह्माण्डमण्डपे ||
text_mt: With an attractive diadem bound on, and auspicious rites of curious wonder performed, / Maheśa himself consecrated [him] in the pavilion of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
dattavānnikhilaiśvaryaṃ yannaijaṃ nānyagāmi yat |
tatastuṣṭāva taṃ śambhuḥ svatantro bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
दत्तवान्निखिलैश्वर्यं यन्नैजं नान्यगामि यत् |
ततस्तुष्टाव तं शम्भुः स्वतन्त्रो भक्तवत्सलः ||
text_mt: He bestowed all sovereign power—his very own, which went to none other; / and then Śambhu, independent and affectionate toward devotees, praised him.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ lokakartāramavocadvacanaṃ tvidam |
vyāpayansvaṃ varādhīnaṃ svatantraṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं लोककर्तारमवोचद्वचनं त्विदम् |
व्यापयन्स्वं वराधीनं स्वतन्त्रं भक्तवत्सलः ||
text_mt: He spoke these words to Brahmā, the creator of the world, / displaying his own [sovereignty], obedient to the boon, independent, affectionate toward devotees:

sanskrit_iast:
maheśa uvāca |
ataḥ prabhṛti lokeśa mannideśādayaṃ hariḥ |
mama vandyaḥ svayaṃ viṣṇurjātaḥ sarvaḥ śṛṇoti hi ||
meaning:
महेश उवाच |
अतः प्रभृति लोकेश मन्निदेशादयं हरिः |
मम वन्द्यः स्वयं विष्णुर्जातः सर्वः शृणोति हि ||
text_mt: Maheśa said: / "Henceforth, O lord of the world, by my decree this Hari, / Viṣṇu himself, is worthy of my worship; let everyone hear!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvairdevādibhistāta praṇama tvamamuṃ harim |
varṇayantu hariṃ vedā mamaite māmivājñayā ||
meaning:
सर्वैर्देवादिभिस्तात प्रणम त्वममुं हरिम् |
वर्णयन्तु हरिं वेदा ममैते मामिवाज्ञया ||
text_mt: Together with all the gods and others, dear one, bow down to this Hari! / Let these Vedas of mine praise Hari at my command, just as [they praise] me."

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrāma uvāca |
ityuktvātha svayaṃ rudro'namadvai garuḍadhvajam |
viṣṇubhaktiprasannātmā varado bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
श्रीराम उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वाथ स्वयं रुद्रोऽनमद्वै गरुडध्वजम् |
विष्णुभक्तिप्रसन्नात्मा वरदो भक्तवत्सलः ||
text_mt: The glorious Rāma said: / Having spoken thus, Rudra himself, the giver of boons, affectionate toward devotees, / his soul pleased with devotion to Viṣṇu, bowed down to the one who has Garuḍa on his banner.

sanskrit_iast:
tato brahmādibhirdevaiḥ sarvarūpasuraistathā |
munisiddhādibhiścaiva vandito'bhūddharistadā ||
meaning:
ततो ब्रह्मादिभिर्देवैः सर्वरूपसुरैस्तथा |
मुनिसिद्धादिभिश्चैव वन्दितोऽभूद्धरिस्तदा ||
text_mt: Then Hari was praised by the gods headed by Brahmā, / by all manner of celestials, and by sages, Siddhas, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tato maheśo haraye'śaṃsaddiviṣadāṃ puraḥ |
mahāvarān suprasanno dattavān bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
ततो महेशो हरयेऽशंसद्दिविषदां पुरः |
महावरान् सुप्रसन्नो दत्तवान् भक्तवत्सलः ||
text_mt: Then Maheśa praised Hari in the presence of the dwellers of heaven; / highly pleased, affectionate toward devotees, he gave him great boons.

sanskrit_iast:
maheśa uvāca |
tvaṃ kartā sarvalokānāṃ bhartā hartā madājñayā |
dātā dharmārthakāmānāṃ śāstā durṇayakāriṇām ||
meaning:
महेश उवाच |
त्वं कर्ता सर्वलोकानां भर्ता हर्ता मदाज्ञया |
दाता धर्मार्थकामानां शास्ता दुर्णयकारिणाम् ||
text_mt: Maheśa said: / "You are the creator, maintainer, and destroyer of all worlds by my command, / the giver of virtue, wealth, and desire, the chastiser of those who act unlawfully.

sanskrit_iast:
jagadīśo jagatpūjyo mahābalaparākramaḥ |
ajeyastvaṃ raṇe kvāpi mamāpi hi bhaviṣyasi ||
meaning:
जगदीशो जगत्पूज्यो महाबलपराक्रमः |
अजेयस्त्वं रणे क्वापि ममापि हि भविष्यसि ||
text_mt: Lord of the universe, worthy of worship by the universe, possessed of great strength and prowess, / you will be invincible anywhere in battle, even to me.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktitrayaṃ gṛhāṇa tvamicchādi prāpitaṃ mayā |
nānālīlāprabhāvatvaṃ svatantratvaṃ bhavatraye ||
meaning:
शक्तित्रयं गृहाण त्वमिच्छादि प्रापितं मया |
नानालीलाप्रभावत्वं स्वतन्त्रत्वं भवत्रये ||
text_mt: Receive the three powers, will and the others, granted by me, / the majesty of various sports, and independence in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaddveṣṭāro hare nūnaṃ mayā śāsyāḥ prayatnataḥ |
tvadbhaktānāṃ mayā viṣṇo deyaṃ nirvāṇamuttamam ||
meaning:
त्वद्द्वेष्टारो हरे नूनं मया शास्याः प्रयत्नतः |
त्वद्भक्तानां मया विष्णो देयं निर्वाणमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Those who hate you, O Hari, must surely be chastised by me with diligence; / to your devotees, O Viṣṇu, supreme liberation must be given by me.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāṃ cāpi gṛhāṇemāṃ duḥpraṇodyāṃ surādibhiḥ |
yayā sammohitaṃ viśvamacidrūpaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
मायां चापि गृहाणेमां दुःप्रणोद्यां सुरादिभिः |
यया सम्मोहितं विश्वमचिद्रूपं भविष्यति ||
text_mt: And receive this Maya, hard to be repelled by gods and others, / by which the universe, deluded, will become insentient.

sanskrit_iast:
mama bāhurmadīyastvaṃ dakṣiṇo'sau vidhirhare |
asyāpi hi vidheḥ pātā janitāpi bhaviṣyasi ||
meaning:
मम बाहुर्मदीयस्त्वं दक्षिणोऽसौ विधिर्हरे |
अस्यापि हि विधेः पाता जनितापि भविष्यसि ||
text_mt: You are my arm; this right arm of mine is Brahmā, O Hari; / you will be the protector and also the progenitor of this very Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayaṃ mama yo rudraḥ sa evāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
pūjyastava sadā so'pi brahmādīnāmapi dhruvam ||
meaning:
हृदयं मम यो रुद्रः स एवाहं न संशयः |
पूज्यस्तव सदा सोऽपि ब्रह्मादीनामपि ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: That Rudra who is my heart is indeed myself, there is no doubt; / he too is ever to be worshipped by you, and surely by Brahmā and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
atra sthitvā jagatsarvaṃ pālaya tvaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
nānāvatārabhedaiśca sadā nānotikartṛbhiḥ ||
meaning:
अत्र स्थित्वा जगत्सर्वं पालय त्वं विशेषतः |
नानावतारभेदैश्च सदा नानोतिकर्तृभिः ||
text_mt: Remaining here, protect the whole universe especially, / by means of various incarnations that continually perform various acts.

sanskrit_iast:
mama loke tavedaṃ vai sthānaṃ ca paramarddhimat |
goloka iti vikhyātaṃ bhaviṣyati mahojjvalam ||
meaning:
मम लोके तवेदं वै स्थानं च परमर्द्धिमत् |
गोलोक इति विख्यातं भविष्यति महोज्ज्वलम् ||
text_mt: This realm of yours in my world, supremely prosperous, / will be renowned as Goloka, exceedingly radiant.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyanti hare ye te'vatārā bhuvi rakṣakāḥ |
madbhaktāstān dhruvaṃ drakṣye prītānatha nijād varāt ||
meaning:
भविष्यन्ति हरे ये तेऽवतारा भुवि रक्षकाः |
मद्भक्तास्तान् ध्रुवं द्रक्ष्ये प्रीतानथ निजाद् वरात् ||
text_mt: Whatever incarnations of yours protect the earth, O Hari, / those devotees of mine I shall surely look upon, pleased by my own boon."

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrāma uvāca |
akhaṇḍaiśvaryamāsādya hareritthaṃ haraḥ svayam |
kailāse svagaṇaistasmin svairaṃ krīḍatyumāpatiḥ ||
meaning:
श्रीराम उवाच |
अखण्डैश्वर्यमासाद्य हरेरित्थं हरः स्वयम् |
कैलासे स्वगणैस्तस्मिन् स्वैरं क्रीडत्युमापतिः ||
text_mt: The glorious Rāma said: / Having thus conferred undivided sovereignty upon Hari, Hara himself, / the lord of Umā, sports freely on that Kailāsa with his attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāprabhṛti lakṣmīśo gopaveṣo'bhavattathā |
ayāsīttatra suprītyā gopagopīgavāṃ patiḥ ||
meaning:
तदाप्रभृति लक्ष्मीशो गोपवेषोऽभवत्तथा |
अयासीत्तत्र सुप्रीत्या गोपगोपीगवां पतिः ||
text_mt: From that time forth the lord of Lakṣmī took the guise of a cowherd, / and with great delight went there as the lord of the cowherds, cowherdesses, and cows.

sanskrit_iast:
so'pi viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā jugopa nikhilaṃ jagat |
nānāvatārasandhartāvanakartā śivājñayā ||
meaning:
सोऽपि विष्णुः प्रसन्नात्मा जुगोप निखिलं जगत् |
नानावतारसन्धर्तावनकर्ता शिवाज्ञया ||
text_mt: Viṣṇu too, joyful in soul, protected the entire universe, / assuming various incarnations and acting as protector by the command of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ sa caturddhātrāvātaracchaṅkarājñayā |
rāmo'haṃ tatra bharato lakṣmaṇaḥ śatruheti ca ||
meaning:
इदानीं स चतुर्द्धात्रावातरच्छङ्कराज्ञया |
रामोऽहं तत्र भरतो लक्ष्मणः शत्रुहेति च ||
text_mt: Now he has descended here in four forms by the command of Śaṅkara: / I am Rāma, and among them are Bharata, Lakṣmaṇa, and the slayer of foes [Śatrughna].

sanskrit_iast:
atha pitrājñayā devi sasītālakṣmaṇaḥ sati |
āgato'haṃ vane cādya duḥkhito daivato'bhavam ||
meaning:
अथ पित्राज्ञया देवि ससीतालक्ष्मणः सति |
आगतोऽहं वने चाद्य दुःखितो दैवतोऽभवम् ||
text_mt: Then, by the command of my father, O goddess, O chaste Satī, with Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa / I came to the forest, and today I have become distressed by destiny.

sanskrit_iast:
niśācareṇa me jāyā hṛtā sīteti kenacit |
anveṣyāmi priyāṃ cātra virahī bandhunā vane ||
meaning:
निशाचरेण मे जाया हृता सीतेति केनचित् |
अन्वेष्यामि प्रियां चात्र विरही बन्धुना वने ||
text_mt: My wife Sītā has been abducted by some demon; / separated from her, I search for my beloved here in the forest with my brother.

sanskrit_iast:
darśanaṃ te yadi prāptaṃ sarvathā kuśalaṃ mama |
bhaviṣyati na sandeho mātaste kṛpayā sati ||
meaning:
दर्शनं ते यदि प्राप्तं सर्वथा कुशलं मम |
भविष्यति न सन्देहो मातस्ते कृपया सति ||
text_mt: Since sight of you has been attained, my welfare in every way / will come to pass, there is no doubt, O Mother, by your grace, O Satī.

sanskrit_iast:
sītāprāptivaraṃ devi bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
taṃ hatvā duḥkhadaṃ pāpaṃ rākṣasaṃ tvadanugrahāt ||
meaning:
सीताप्राप्तिवरं देवि भविष्यति न संशयः |
तं हत्वा दुःखदं पापं राक्षसं त्वदनुग्रहात् ||
text_mt: The boon of recovering Sītā will come to pass, O goddess, there is no doubt, / having slain that wicked demon who caused distress, by your favor.

sanskrit_iast:
mahadbhāgyaṃ mamādyaiva yadyakārṣṭāṃ kṛpāṃ yuvām |
yasmin sakaruṇau syātāṃ sa dhanyaḥ puruṣo varaḥ ||
meaning:
महद्भाग्यं ममाद्यैव यद्यकार्ष्टां कृपां युवाम् |
यस्मिन् सकरुणौ स्यातां स धन्यः पुरुषो वरः ||
text_mt: Great is my good fortune this very day, since you two have shown mercy; / he upon whom you two are compassionate is blessed, the best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
itthamābhāṣya bahudhā supraṇamya satīṃ śivām |
tadājñayā vane tasmin vicacāra raghūdvahaḥ ||
meaning:
इत्थमाभाष्य बहुधा सुप्रणम्य सतीं शिवाम् |
तदाज्ञया वने तस्मिन् विचचार रघूद्वहः ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus in many ways and bowed low to the auspicious Satī, / the scion of Raghu roamed in that forest with her permission.

sanskrit_iast:
athākarṇya satī vākyaṃ rāmasya prayatātmanaḥ |
hṛṣṭābhūtsā praśaṃsantaṃ śivabhaktirataṃ hṛdi ||
meaning:
अथाकर्ण्य सती वाक्यं रामस्य प्रयतात्मनः |
हृष्टाभूत्सा प्रशंसन्तं शिवभक्तिरतं हृदि ||
text_mt: Then, hearing the words of Rāma whose self was restrained, / she was delighted at heart by him who praised [Śiva] and was devoted to Śiva's devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtvā svakarma manasākārṣīcchokaṃ suvistaram |
pratyāgacchadudāsīnā vivarṇā śivasannidhau ||
meaning:
स्मृत्वा स्वकर्म मनसाकार्षीच्छोकं सुविस्तरम् |
प्रत्यागच्छदुदासीना विवर्णा शिवसन्निधौ ||
text_mt: Remembering in her mind her own deed, she felt great sorrow; / she returned to Śiva's presence, indifferent and pale.

sanskrit_iast:
pathi sācintayad devī sañcalantī punaḥ punaḥ |
nāṅgīkṛtaṃ śivoktaṃ me rāmaṃ prati kudhīḥ kṛtā ||
meaning:
पथि साचिन्तयद् देवी सञ्चलन्ती पुनः पुनः |
नाङ्गीकृतं शिवोक्तं मे रामं प्रति कुधीः कृता ||
text_mt: On the way, walking repeatedly, the goddess thought: / "Śiva's word was not accepted by me; an evil mind was shown toward Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
kimuttaramahaṃ dāsye gatvā śaṅkarasannidhau |
iti sañcintya bahudhā paścāttāpo'bhavattadā ||
meaning:
किमुत्तरमहं दास्ये गत्वा शङ्करसन्निधौ |
इति सञ्चिन्त्य बहुधा पश्चात्तापोऽभवत्तदा ||
text_mt: What answer shall I give when I arrive before Śaṅkara?" / Thinking thus in many ways, repentance then came upon her.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā śambhusamīpaṃ ca praṇanāma śivaṃ hṛdā |
viṣaṇṇavadanā śokavyākulā vigataprabhā ||
meaning:
गत्वा शम्भुसमीपं च प्रणनाम शिवं हृदा |
विषण्णवदना शोकव्याकुला विगतप्रभा ||
text_mt: Approaching Śambhu, she bowed to Śiva with her heart, / with dejected face, bewildered by grief, and bereft of luster.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tāṃ duḥkhitāṃ dṛṣṭvā papraccha kuśalaṃ haraḥ |
provāca vacanaṃ prītyā tatparīkṣā kṛtā katham ||
meaning:
अथ तां दुःखितां दृष्ट्वा पप्रच्छ कुशलं हरः |
प्रोवाच वचनं प्रीत्या तत्परीक्षा कृता कथम् ||
text_mt: Then, seeing her distressed, Hara asked after her welfare / and lovingly spoke these words: "How was that test performed?"

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā śivavaco nāhaṃ kimapi praṇatānanā |
satī śokaviṣaṇṇā sā tasthau tatra samīpataḥ ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वा शिववचो नाहं किमपि प्रणतानना |
सती शोकविषण्णा सा तस्थौ तत्र समीपतः ||
text_mt: Hearing Śiva's words, Satī, bowed-faced and dejected with sorrow, / said nothing; she stood there near him.

sanskrit_iast:
atha dhyātvā maheśastu bubodha caritaṃ hṛdā |
dakṣajāyā mahāyogī nānālīlāviśāradaḥ ||
meaning:
अथ ध्यात्वा महेशस्तु बुबोध चरितं हृदा |
दक्षजाया महायोगी नानालीलाविशारदः ||
text_mt: Then Maheśa, the great yogin skilled in diverse divine sports, / meditating in his heart, understood the conduct of Dakṣa's daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
sasmāra svapaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ yatkṛtaṃ harikopataḥ |
tatprārthito'tha rudro'sau maryādāpratipālakaḥ ||
meaning:
सस्मार स्वपणं पूर्वं यत्कृतं हरिकोपतः |
तत्प्रार्थितोऽथ रुद्रोऽसौ मर्यादाप्रतिपालकः ||
text_mt: He remembered his former vow, which had been made out of anger from Hari; / then that Rudra, who protects proper conduct, was prayed to.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣādo'bhūtprabhostatra manasyevamuvāca ha |
dharmavaktā dharmakartā dharmāvanakaraḥ sadā ||
meaning:
विषादोऽभूत्प्रभोस्तत्र मनस्येवमुवाच ह |
धर्मवक्ता धर्मकर्ता धर्मावनकरः सदा ||
text_mt: Despondency arose in the Lord's mind, and he spoke thus: / he who speaks dharma, performs dharma, and ever protects dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca |
kuryāṃ ceddakṣajāyāṃ hi snehaṃ pūrvaṃ yathā mahān |
naśyenmama paṇaḥ śuddho lokalīlānusāriṇaḥ ||
meaning:
शिव उवाच |
कुर्यां चेद्दक्षजायां हि स्नेहं पूर्वं यथा महान् |
नश्येन्मम पणः शुद्धो लोकलीलानुसारिणः ||
text_mt: Śiva said: / "If I show great affection for Dakṣa's daughter as before, / my pure vow, as one conforming to worldly sport, would perish."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
itthaṃ vicārya bahudhā hṛdā tāmatyajatsatīm |
paṇaṃ na nāśayāmāsa vedadharmaprapālakaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्थं विचार्य बहुधा हृदा तामत्यजत्सतीम् |
पणं न नाशयामास वेदधर्मप्रपालकः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Reflecting thus in many ways in his heart, he abandoned that Satī; / the protector of Vedic dharma did not break his vow.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vihāya manasā satīṃ tāṃ parameśvaraḥ |
jagāma svagiriṃ bhedaṃ jagāvaddhā sa hi prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
ततो विहाय मनसा सतीं तां परमेश्वरः |
जगाम स्वगिरिं भेदं जगावद्धा स हि प्रभुः ||
text_mt: Then, abandoning that Satī in his mind, Parameśvara / went to his mountain; for the Lord was truly established in non-duality.

sanskrit_iast:
calantaṃ pathi taṃ vyomavāṇyuvāca maheśvaram |
sarvān saṃśrāvayaṃstatra dakṣajāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
चलन्तं पथि तं व्योमवाण्युवाच महेश्वरम् |
सर्वान् संश्रावयंस्तत्र दक्षजां च विशेषतः ||
text_mt: As he was walking on the path, a heavenly voice spoke to Maheśvara, / letting everyone hear there, and especially Dakṣa's daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
vyomavāṇyuvāca |
dhanyastvaṃ parameśāna tvatsamo'dya tathā paṇaḥ |
na ko'pyanyastriloke'smin mahāyogī mahāprabhuḥ ||
meaning:
व्योमवाण्युवाच |
धन्यस्त्वं परमेशान त्वत्समोऽद्य तथा पणः |
न कोऽप्यन्यस्त्रिलोकेऽस्मिन् महायोगी महाप्रभुः ||
text_mt: The heavenly voice said: / "Blessed are you, Parameśāna! There is no other vow today like yours; / no one else is such a great yogin and great lord in this three-fold world."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
śrutvā vyomavaco devī śivaṃ papraccha viprabhā |
kaṃ paṇaṃ kṛtavānnātha brūhi me parameśvara ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
श्रुत्वा व्योमवचो देवी शिवं पप्रच्छ विप्रभा |
कं पणं कृतवान्नाथ ब्रूहि मे परमेश्वर ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing the heavenly voice, the goddess, deprived of luster, asked Śiva: / "What vow did you make, O Lord? Tell me, Parameśvara!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti pṛṣṭo'pi giriśaḥ satyā hitakaraḥ prabhuḥ |
nodvāhaṃ svaṃ paṇaṃ tasyai yat haryagre'karotpurā ||
meaning:
इति पृष्टोऽपि गिरिशः सत्या हितकरः प्रभुः |
नोद्वाहं स्वं पणं तस्यै यत् हर्यग्रेऽकरोत्पुरा ||
text_mt: Though asked thus by Satī, Giriśa, the beneficent Lord, / did not reveal to her his vow, which he had formerly made before Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā satī śivaṃ dhyātvā svapatiṃ prāṇavallabham |
sarvaṃ bubodha hetuṃ taṃ priyatyāgamayaṃ mune ||
meaning:
तदा सती शिवं ध्यात्वा स्वपतिं प्राणवल्लभम् |
सर्वं बुबोध हेतुं तं प्रियत्यागमयं मुने ||
text_mt: Then Satī, meditating on Śiva, her husband and beloved of her life, / understood the entire reason, O sage, which consisted of the abandonment of his beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'tīva śuśocāśu budhvā sā tyāgamātmanaḥ |
śambhunā dakṣajā tasmānniḥśvasantī muhurmuhuḥ ||
meaning:
ततोऽतीव शुशोचाशु बुध्वा सा त्यागमात्मनः |
शम्भुना दक्षजा तस्मान्निःश्वसन्ती मुहुर्मुहुः ||
text_mt: Then, realizing her abandonment by Śambhu, Dakṣa's daughter / grieved exceedingly, sighing repeatedly from that cause.

sanskrit_iast:
śivastasyāḥ samājñāya guptaṃ cakre manobhavam |
satyai paṇaṃ svakīyaṃ hi kathā bahvīrvadan prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
शिवस्तस्याः समाज्ञाय गुप्तं चक्रे मनोभवम् |
सत्यै पणं स्वकीयं हि कथा बह्वीर्वदन् प्रभुः ||
text_mt: Knowing her [state], Śiva concealed his mind's feeling / and his vow from Satī, the Lord speaking many tales.

sanskrit_iast:
satyā prāpa sa kailāsaṃ kathayan vividhāḥ kathāḥ |
vare sthitvā nijaṃ rūpaṃ dadhau yogī samādhibhṛt ||
meaning:
सत्या प्राप स कैलासं कथयन् विविधाः कथाः |
वरे स्थित्वा निजं रूपं दधौ योगी समाधिभृत् ||
text_mt: Telling various stories, he reached Kailāsa with Satī; / staying in an excellent place, the yogin absorbed in meditation held fast to his own nature.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tasthau satī dhāmni mahāvyākulamānasā |
na bubodha caritraṃ tatkaścicca śivayormune ||
meaning:
तत्र तस्थौ सती धाम्नि महाव्याकुलमानसा |
न बुबोध चरित्रं तत्कश्चिच्च शिवयोर्मुने ||
text_mt: Satī stayed there in the abode, her mind exceedingly agitated; / and no one, O sage, understood that conduct of the two Śivas.

sanskrit_iast:
mahānkālo vyatīyāya tayoritthaṃ mahāmune |
svopāttadehayoḥ prabhvorlokalīlānusāriṇoḥ ||
meaning:
महान्कालो व्यतीयाय तयोरित्थं महामुने |
स्वोपात्तदेहयोः प्रभ्वोर्लोकलीलानुसारिणोः ||
text_mt: A great period of time passed in this way for both of them, O great sage, / the two lords who had assumed bodies of their own accord, following worldly sport.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaṃ tatyāja giriśastataḥ sa paramotikṛt |
tajjñātvā jagadambā hi satī tatrājagāma sā ||
meaning:
ध्यानं तत्याज गिरिशस्ततः स परमोतिकृत् |
तज्ज्ञात्वा जगदम्बा हि सती तत्राजगाम सा ||
text_mt: Then Giriśa, the worker of supreme welfare, left his meditation; / knowing that, Satī, the Mother of the Universe, went there.

sanskrit_iast:
nanāmātha śivaṃ devī hṛdayena vidūyatā |
āsanaṃ dattavān śambhuḥ svasammukha udāradhīḥ ||
meaning:
ननामाथ शिवं देवी हृदयेन विदूयता |
आसनं दत्तवान् शम्भुः स्वसम्मुख उदारधीः ||
text_mt: Then the goddess bowed to Śiva with a heart in torment; / the noble-minded Śambhu gave her a seat facing himself.

sanskrit_iast:
kathayāmāsa suprītyā kathā vahvīrmanoramāḥ |
niḥśokāṃ kṛtavān sadyo līlāṃ kṛtvā ca tādṛśīm ||
meaning:
कथयामास सुप्रीत्या कथा वह्वीर्मनोरमाः |
निःशोकां कृतवान् सद्यो लीलां कृत्वा च तादृशीम् ||
text_mt: He told many charming tales with great love; / having enacted such a divine sport, he instantly freed her from sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavatsā sukhaṃ lebhe tatyāja svapaṇaṃ na saḥ |
netyāścaryaṃ śive tāta mantavyaṃ parameśvare ||
meaning:
पूर्ववत्सा सुखं लेभे तत्याज स्वपणं न सः |
नेत्याश्चर्यं शिवे तात मन्तव्यं परमेश्वरे ||
text_mt: She obtained happiness as before, but he did not abandon his vow; / this should not be considered an astonishing thing regarding Śiva, the Parameśvara, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ śivāśivakathāṃ vadanti munayo mune |
kila kecidavidvāṃso viyogaśca kathaṃ tayoḥ ||
meaning:
इत्थं शिवाशिवकथां वदन्ति मुनयो मुने |
किल केचिदविद्वांसो वियोगश्च कथं तयोः ||
text_mt: In this way, O sage, sages recount the story of Śiva and Satī; / indeed, some ignorant people [ask], "How could there be separation between the two?"

sanskrit_iast:
śivāśivacaritraṃ ko jānāti paramārthataḥ |
svecchayā krīḍatastau hi caritaṃ kurutaḥ sadā ||
meaning:
शिवाशिवचरित्रं को जानाति परमार्थतः |
स्वेच्छया क्रीडतस्तौ हि चरितं कुरुतः सदा ||
text_mt: Who knows the conduct of Śivā and Śiva in absolute truth? / Playing according to their own will, they constantly perform their deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
vāgarthāviva sampṛktau sadā khalu satīśivau |
tayorviyogo'sambhāvyaḥ sambhavedicchayā tayoḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ satīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
वागर्थाविव सम्पृक्तौ सदा खलु सतीशिवौ |
तयोर्वियोगोऽसम्भाव्यः सम्भवेदिच्छया तयोः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां द्वितीयः सतीखण्डे
text_mt:
Satī and Śiva are indeed always united, like speech and its meaning; / separation between them is impossible, [though] it can occur by their own will.

Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter, named "The Separation of Satī", in the second part, the Satīkhaṇḍa, of the Rudrasaṃhitā, in the venerable Śivamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
purābhavacca sarveṣāmadhvaro vidhinā mahān |
prayāge samavetānāṃ munīnāṃ ca mahātmanām ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
पुराभवच्च सर्वेषामध्वरो विधिना महान् |
प्रयागे समवेतानां मुनीनां च महात्मनाम् ||
title: ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivasatīviyogaḥ
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Formerly, there was a great sacrifice [performed] according to the ritual by all / the high-souled sages assembled at Prayāga.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra siddhāḥ samāyātāḥ sanakādyāḥ surarṣayaḥ |
saprajāpatayo devā jñānino brahmadarśinaḥ ||
meaning:
तत्र सिद्धाः समायाताः सनकाद्याः सुरर्षयः |
सप्रजापतयो देवा ज्ञानिनो ब्रह्मदर्शिनः ||
text_mt: There arrived the perfected ones, Sanaka and the others, the divine seers, / the gods accompanied by the Prajāpatis, the wise who behold Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ samāgatastatra parivārasamanvitaḥ |
nigamairāgamairyukto mūrtimadbhirmahāprabhaiḥ ||
meaning:
अहं समागतस्तत्र परिवारसमन्वितः |
निगमैरागमैर्युक्तो मूर्तिमद्भिर्महाप्रभैः ||
text_mt: I arrived there accompanied by my retinue, / joined by the Vedas and Āgamas personified, of great splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
samājo'bhūdvicitro hi teṣāmutsavasaṃyutaḥ |
jñānavādo'bhavattatra nānāśāstrasamudbhavaḥ ||
meaning:
समाजोऽभूद्विचित्रो हि तेषामुत्सवसंयुतः |
ज्ञानवादोऽभवत्तत्र नानाशास्त्रसमुद्भवः ||
text_mt: A wondrous assembly took place among them, filled with festive joy; / philosophical debate arising from diverse scriptures occurred there.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnavasare rudraḥ sabhavānīgaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
trilokahitakṛtsvāmī tatrāgātsūtikṛnmune ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्नवसरे रुद्रः सभवानीगणः प्रभुः |
त्रिलोकहितकृत्स्वामी तत्रागात्सूतिकृन्मुने ||
text_mt: At that juncture, Lord Rudra, accompanied by Bhavānī and his attendants, / the Master who works the welfare of the three worlds and the source of creation, came there, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā śivaṃ surāḥ sarve siddhāśca munayastathā |
anamaṃstaṃ prabhuṃ bhaktyā tuṣṭuvuśca tathā hyaham ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा शिवं सुराः सर्वे सिद्धाश्च मुनयस्तथा |
अनमंस्तं प्रभुं भक्त्या तुष्टुवुश्च तथा ह्यहम् ||
text_mt: Seeing Śiva, all the gods, perfected ones, and sages / bowed to that Lord with devotion and praised him, as did I.

sanskrit_iast:
tasthuḥ śivājñayā sarve yathāsthānaṃ mudānvitāḥ |
prabhudarśanasantuṣṭāḥ varṇayanto nijaṃ vidhim ||
meaning:
तस्थुः शिवाज्ञया सर्वे यथास्थानं मुदान्विताः |
प्रभुदर्शनसन्तुष्टाः वर्णयन्तो निजं विधिम् ||
text_mt: By Śiva's command, all stood in their respective places, filled with joy, / satisfied with the vision of the Lord, describing their own rules.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnavasare dakṣaḥ prajāpatipatiḥ prabhuḥ |
āgamattatra suprītaḥ suvarcasvī yadṛcchayā ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्नवसरे दक्षः प्रजापतिपतिः प्रभुः |
आगमत्तत्र सुप्रीतः सुवर्चस्वी यदृच्छया ||
text_mt: At that juncture, Lord Dakṣa, the lord of the Prajāpatis, / highly radiant, arrived there by chance, exceedingly delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ praṇamya sa dakṣo hi nyuṣṭastatra madājñayā |
brahmāṇḍādhipatirmānyo mānī tattvabahirmukhaḥ ||
meaning:
मां प्रणम्य स दक्षो हि न्युष्टस्तत्र मदाज्ञया |
ब्रह्माण्डाधिपतिर्मान्यो मानी तत्त्वबहिर्मुखः ||
text_mt: Bowing to me, Dakṣa sat down there by my command— / he, the ruler of the universe, worthy of honor, proud, and turned away from the truth.

sanskrit_iast:
stutibhiḥ praṇipātaiśca dakṣaḥ sarvaiḥ surarṣibhiḥ |
pūjito varatejasvī karau vadhvā vinamrakaiḥ ||
meaning:
स्तुतिभिः प्रणिपातैश्च दक्षः सर्वैः सुरर्षिभिः |
पूजितो वरतेजस्वी करौ वध्वा विनम्रकैः ||
text_mt: With praises and prostrations by all the divine seers, / Dakṣa, of supreme splendor, was honored as they humbly folded their hands.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvihārakṛnnāthaḥ svatantraḥ paramotikṛt |
nānāmattaṃ tadā dakṣaṃ svāsanastho maheśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
नानाविहारकृन्नाथः स्वतन्त्रः परमोतिकृत् |
नानामत्तं तदा दक्षं स्वासनस्थो महेश्वरः ||
text_mt: The independent Master who engages in diverse pastimes and accomplishes supreme welfare, / Maheśvara, seated on his own seat, did not bow then to Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvānataṃ haraṃ tatra sa me putro'prasannadhīḥ |
akupyatsahasā rudre tadā dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वानतं हरं तत्र स मे पुत्रोऽप्रसन्नधीः |
अकुप्यत्सहसा रुद्रे तदा दक्षः प्रजापतिः ||
text_mt: Seeing that Hara was not bowed there, my son of displeased mind, / Dakṣa, the Prajāpati, suddenly grew furious with Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
krūradṛṣṭyā mahāgarvo dṛṣṭvā rudraṃ mahāprabhum |
sarvānsaṃśrāvayannuccairavocajjñānavarjitaḥ ||
meaning:
क्रूरदृष्ट्या महागर्वो दृष्ट्वा रुद्रं महाप्रभुम् |
सर्वान्संश्रावयन्नुच्चैरवोचज्ज्ञानवर्जितः ||
text_mt: Looking upon Lord Rudra with a cruel glance, full of great pride / and devoid of wisdom, he spoke aloud so that everyone could hear.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣavāca |
ete hi sarve ca surāsurā bhṛśaṃ namanti māṃ vipravarāstatharṣayaḥ |
kathaṃ hyasau durjanavanmahāmanā tvabhūttu yaḥ pretapiśācasaṃvṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
दक्षवाच |
एते हि सर्वे च सुरासुरा भृशं नमन्ति मां विप्रवरास्तथर्षयः |
कथं ह्यसौ दुर्जनवन्महामना त्वभूत्तु यः प्रेतपिशाचसंवृतः ||
text_mt: Dakṣa said: / "All these gods and asuras, the foremost of brahmins and the seers, bow deeply before me. / Why did this haughty one, surrounded by ghosts and piśācas, act like a wicked person?"

sanskrit_iast:
śmaśānavāsī nirapatrapo hyayaṃ kathaṃ praṇāmaṃ na karoti me'dhunā |
luptakriyo bhūtapiśācasevito matto'vidho nītividūṣakaḥ sadā ||
meaning:
श्मशानवासी निरपत्रपो ह्ययं कथं प्रणामं न करोति मेऽधुना |
लुप्तक्रियो भूतपिशाचसेवितो मत्तोऽविधो नीतिविदूषकः सदा ||
text_mt: This dweller in cremation grounds, shameless indeed—why does he not bow to me now? / Devoid of rites, served by ghosts and goblins, intoxicated, lawless, ever defiling propriety!

sanskrit_iast:
pākhaṇḍino durjanapāpaśīlā dṛṣṭvā dvijaṃ proddhatanindakāñca |
vadhvāṃ sadāsaktaratipravīṇa-stasmādamuṃ śaptumahaṃ pravṛttaḥ ||
meaning:
पाखण्डिनो दुर्जनपापशीला दृष्ट्वा द्विजं प्रोद्धतनिन्दकाञ्च |
वध्वां सदासक्तरतिप्रवीण-स्तस्मादमुं शप्तुमहं प्रवृत्तः ||
text_mt: Heretics of wicked conduct and sinful nature, seeing a twice-born, are arrogant revilers; / ever engrossed in his wife, an expert in love-making—therefore I proceed to curse him!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityevamuktvā sa mahākhalastadā ruṣānvito rudramidaṃ hyavocat |
śṛṇvantvamī vipravarāstathā surā vadhyaṃ hi me cārhatha kartumetam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्येवमुक्त्वा स महाखलस्तदा रुषान्वितो रुद्रमिदं ह्यवोचत् |
शृण्वन्त्वमी विप्रवरास्तथा सुरा वध्यं हि मे चार्हथ कर्तुमेतम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus, filled with wrath, that great villain then said this to Rudra: / “Let these excellent twice-borns and the gods hear: you ought to make this one subject to execution by me!”

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣa uvāca |
rudro hyayaṃ yajñabahiṣkṛto me varṇeṣvatīto'tha vivarṇarūpaḥ |
devairna bhāgaṃ labhatāṃ sahaiva śmaśānavāsī kulajanmahīnaḥ ||
meaning:
दक्ष उवाच |
रुद्रो ह्ययं यज्ञबहिष्कृतो मे वर्णेष्वतीतोऽथ विवर्णरूपः |
देवैर्न भागं लभतां सहैव श्मशानवासी कुलजन्महीनः ||
text_mt: Dakṣa said: / “This Rudra is excluded by me from the sacrifice; having passed beyond the social classes, his form lacks class. / Let him not receive a share along with the gods—a dweller in cremation grounds, devoid of family and birth!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
iti dakṣoktamākarṇya bhṛgvādyā bahavo janāḥ |
agarhayan duṣṭasattvaṃ rudraṃ mattvāmaraiḥ samam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इति दक्षोक्तमाकर्ण्य भृग्वाद्या बहवो जनाः |
अगर्हयन् दुष्टसत्त्वं रुद्रं मत्त्वामरैः समम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing what Dakṣa had said, many people, beginning with Bhṛgu, / reviled Rudra, whose nature is uncorrupted, considering him equal to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
nandī niśamya tadvākyaṃ lolākṣo'tiruṣānvitaḥ |
abravīt tvaritaṃ dakṣaṃ śāpaṃ dātumanā gaṇaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दी निशम्य तद्वाक्यं लोलाक्षोऽतिरुषान्वितः |
अब्रवीत् त्वरितं दक्षं शापं दातुमना गणः ||
text_mt: Hearing that speech, Nandin, his eyes rolling, filled with extreme wrath, / quickly addressed Dakṣa, the attendant intending to utter a curse.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
re re śaṭha mahāmūḍha dakṣa duṣṭamate tvayā |
yajñabāhyo hi me svāmī maheśo hi kṛtaḥ katham ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
रे रे शठ महामूढ दक्ष दुष्टमते त्वया |
यज्ञबाह्यो हि मे स्वामी महेशो हि कृतः कथम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / “O rogue, O great fool, Dakṣa of wicked mind, / how has my lord, Maheśa, been excluded from the sacrifice by you?

sanskrit_iast:
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa bhavanti saphalā makhāḥ |
tīrthāni ca pavitrāṇi so'yaṃ śapto haraḥ katham ||
meaning:
यस्य स्मरणमात्रेण भवन्ति सफला मखाः |
तीर्थानि च पवित्राणि सोऽयं शप्तो हरः कथम् ||
text_mt: By the mere remembrance of whom sacrifices become fruitful / and sacred places pure—how is that Hara cursed?

sanskrit_iast:
vṛthā te brahmacāpalyācchapto'yaṃ dakṣa durmate |
vṛthopahasitaścaivāduṣṭo rudro mahāprabhuḥ ||
meaning:
वृथा ते ब्रह्मचापल्याच्छप्तोऽयं दक्ष दुर्मते |
वृथोपहसितश्चैवादुष्टो रुद्रो महाप्रभुः ||
text_mt: In vain, out of brahminical caprice, has he been cursed by you, O Dakṣa of evil mind! / And in vain has the unblemished Rudra, the great lord, been mocked!

sanskrit_iast:
yenedaṃ pālyate viśvaṃ sṛṣṭamante vināśitam |
śapto'yaṃ sa kathaṃ rudro maheśo brāhmaṇādhama ||
meaning:
येनेदं पाल्यते विश्वं सृष्टमन्ते विनाशितम् |
शप्तोऽयं स कथं रुद्रो महेशो ब्राह्मणाधम ||
text_mt: By whom this universe is protected, created, and at the end destroyed— / how has that Rudra, Maheśa, been cursed, O vilest of brahmins?

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ nirbhatsitastena nandinā hi prajāpatiḥ |
nandinaṃ ca śaśāpātha dakṣo roṣasamanvitaḥ ||
meaning:
एवं निर्भत्सितस्तेन नन्दिना हि प्रजापतिः |
नन्दिनं च शशापाथ दक्षो रोषसमन्वितः ||
text_mt: Thus rebuked by that Nandin, the lord of creatures, / Dakṣa, filled with anger, then cursed Nandin:

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣa uvāca |
yūyaṃ sarve rudragaṇā vedabāhyā bhavantu vai |
vedamārgaparityaktāstathā tyaktā maharṣibhiḥ ||
meaning:
दक्ष उवाच |
यूयं सर्वे रुद्रगणा वेदबाह्या भवन्तु वै |
वेदमार्गपरित्यक्तास्तथा त्यक्ता महर्षिभिः ||
text_mt: Dakṣa said: / “May all of you attendants of Rudra become outside the Veda, / abandoned by the Vedic path and abandoned by the great sages!

sanskrit_iast:
pākhaṇḍavādaniratāḥ śiṣṭācārabahiṣkṛtāḥ |
madirāpānaniratā jaṭābhasmāsthidhāriṇaḥ ||
meaning:
पाखण्डवादनिरताः शिष्टाचारबहिष्कृताः |
मदिरापाननिरता जटाभस्मास्थिधारिणः ||
text_mt: Engaged in heretical doctrines, excluded from proper conduct, / devoted to drinking wine, bearing matted hair, ashes, and bones!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
iti śaptāstathā tena dakṣeṇa śivakiṅkarāḥ |
tacchrutvātiruṣāviṣṭo'bhavannandī śivapriyaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इति शप्तास्तथा तेन दक्षेण शिवकिङ्कराः |
तच्छ्रुत्वातिरुषाविष्टोऽभवन्नन्दी शिवप्रियः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / When Śiva’s servants were thus cursed by that Dakṣa, / hearing that, Nandin, beloved of Śiva, became overcome with extreme anger.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyuvāca drutaṃ dakṣaṃ garvitaṃ taṃ mahākhalam |
śilādatanayo nandī tejasvī śivavallabhaḥ ||
meaning:
प्रत्युवाच द्रुतं दक्षं गर्वितं तं महाखलम् |
शिलादतनयो नन्दी तेजस्वी शिववल्लभः ||
text_mt: Nandin, the son of Śilāda, full of splendor, beloved of Śiva, / swiftly replied to that arrogant, great villain Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
re dakṣa śaṭha durbuddhe vṛthaiva śivakiṅkarāḥ |
śaptāste brahmacāpalyācchivatattvamajānatā ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
रे दक्ष शठ दुर्बुद्धे वृथैव शिवकिङ्कराः |
शप्तास्ते ब्रह्मचापल्याच्छिवतत्त्वमजानता ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / “O Dakṣa, O rogue of wicked intellect! In vain have Śiva’s servants / been cursed by you out of brahminical caprice, not knowing the reality of Śiva!

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgvādyairduṣṭacittaiśca mūḍhaiḥ sa upahāsitaḥ |
mahāprabhurmaheśāno brāhmaṇatvādahammate ||
meaning:
भृग्वाद्यैर्दुष्टचित्तैश्च मूढैः स उपहासितः |
महाप्रभुर्महेशानो ब्राह्मणत्वादहम्मते ||
text_mt: By Bhṛgu and others of wicked hearts, fools full of pride due to their brahminhood, / he has been mocked, the great lord, Maheśāna!

sanskrit_iast:
ye rudravimukhāścātra brāhmaṇāstvādṛśāḥ khalāḥ |
rudratejaḥprabhāvatvātteṣāṃ śāpaṃ dadāmyaham ||
meaning:
ये रुद्रविमुखाश्चात्र ब्राह्मणास्त्वादृशाः खलाः |
रुद्रतेजःप्रभावत्वात्तेषां शापं ददाम्यहम् ||
text_mt: Whatever brahmins here are averse to Rudra, wicked like you, / by the power of Rudra's splendor I pronounce a curse upon them:

sanskrit_iast:
vedavādaratā yūyaṃ vedatattvabahirmukhāḥ |
bhavantu satataṃ viprā nānyadastīti vādinaḥ ||
meaning:
वेदवादरता यूयं वेदतत्त्वबहिर्मुखाः |
भवन्तु सततं विप्रा नान्यदस्तीति वादिनः ||
text_mt: Devoted to Vedic debate, turned away from the true meaning of the Veda, / let the twice-borns continually proclaim that there is nothing else!

sanskrit_iast:
kāmātmānaḥ svargaparāḥ krodhalobhamadānvitāḥ |
bhavantu satataṃ viprā bhikṣukā nirapatrapāḥ ||
meaning:
कामात्मानः स्वर्गपराः क्रोधलोभमदान्विताः |
भवन्तु सततं विप्रा भिक्षुका निरपत्रपाः ||
text_mt: Full of desire, intent on heaven, filled with anger, greed, and arrogance, / let the twice-borns always be shameless beggars!

sanskrit_iast:
vedamārgaṃ puraskṛtya brāhmaṇāḥ śūdrayājinaḥ |
daridrā vai bhaviṣyanti pratigraharatāḥ sadā ||
meaning:
वेदमार्गं पुरस्कृत्य ब्राह्मणाः शूद्रयाजिनः |
दरिद्रा वै भविष्यन्ति प्रतिग्रहरताः सदा ||
text_mt: Setting forth the Vedic path, brahmins sacrificing for Śūdras / shall indeed become impoverished, ever delighting in accepting gifts!

sanskrit_iast:
asatpratigrahāścaiva sarve nirayagāminaḥ |
bhaviṣyanti sadā dakṣa kecidvai brahmarākṣasāḥ ||
meaning:
असत्प्रतिग्रहाश्चैव सर्वे निरयगामिनः |
भविष्यन्ति सदा दक्ष केचिद्वै ब्रह्मराक्षसाः ||
text_mt: Accepting unworthy gifts, they shall all go to hell; / they will always be [born as] brahmarākṣasas, O Dakṣa!

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śivaṃ surasāmānyamuddiśya parameśvaram |
druhyatyajo duṣṭamatiḥ tattvatāṃ vimukho bhavet ||
meaning:
यः शिवं सुरसामान्यमुद्दिश्य परमेश्वरम् |
द्रुह्यत्यजो दुष्टमतिः तत्त्वतां विमुखो भवेत् ||
text_mt: The unborn, wicked-minded fool who bears malice toward Śiva, the Parameśvara, / treating him like an ordinary god, shall become turned away from the truth!

sanskrit_iast:
kūṭadharmeṣu geheṣu sadā grāmyasukhecchayā |
karmatantraṃ vitanutāṃ vedavādaṃ ca śāśvatam ||
meaning:
कूटधर्मेषु गेहेषु सदा ग्राम्यसुखेच्छया |
कर्मतन्त्रं वितनुतां वेदवादं च शाश्वतम् ||
text_mt: In deceitful ways, in households, desiring vulgar pleasure, / let him extend ritualism and perpetual Vedic debate!

sanskrit_iast:
vinaṣṭānandakamukho vismṛtātmagatiḥ paśuḥ |
bhraṣṭakarmānayarato dakṣo bastamukho'cirāt ||
meaning:
विनष्टानन्दकमुखो विस्मृतात्मगतिः पशुः |
भ्रष्टकर्मानयरतो दक्षो बस्तमुखोऽचिरात् ||
text_mt: With the joy of his face destroyed, forgetting his spiritual destiny, a bound soul, / fallen from duty and given to injustice, Dakṣa shall soon have the face of a goat!”

sanskrit_iast:
śaptāste kopinā tatra nandinā brāhmaṇā yadā |
hāhākāro mahānāsīcchapto dakṣeṇa ceśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
शप्तास्ते कोपिना तत्र नन्दिना ब्राह्मणा यदा |
हाहाकारो महानासीच्छप्तो दक्षेण चेश्वरः ||
text_mt: When those brahmins were cursed there by the angry Nandin, / a great cry of dismay arose, and the Lord had been cursed by Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
tadākarṇyāhamatyantamanindaṃ taṃ muhurmuhuḥ |
bhṛgvādīnapi viprāṃśca vedasṛṭ śivatattvavit ||
meaning:
तदाकर्ण्याहमत्यन्तमनिन्दं तं मुहुर्मुहुः |
भृग्वादीनपि विप्रांश्च वेदसृट् शिवतत्त्ववित् ||
text_mt: Hearing that, I, the creator of the Vedas, knowing the truth of Śiva, / exceedingly blamed him again and again, as well as the twice-borns beginning with Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvaro'pi vacaḥ śrutvā nandinaḥ prahasanniva |
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ bodhayaṃstaṃ sadāśivaḥ ||
meaning:
ईश्वरोऽपि वचः श्रुत्वा नन्दिनः प्रहसन्निव |
उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं बोधयंस्तं सदाशिवः ||
text_mt: Hearing Nandin’s words, the Lord Sadāśiva, / as if smiling, spoke sweet words, enlightening him.

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśiva uvāca |
śṛṇu nandin mahāprājña na kartuṃ krodhamarhasi |
vṛthā śaptaṃ brahmakulaṃ matvā śaptaṃ ca māṃ bhramāt ||
meaning:
सदाशिव उवाच |
शृणु नन्दिन् महाप्राज्ञ न कर्तुं क्रोधमर्हसि |
वृथा शप्तं ब्रह्मकुलं मत्वा शप्तं च मां भ्रमात् ||
text_mt: Sadāśiva said: / “Listen, O Nandin of great wisdom, you ought not to give way to anger; / in vain was the family of brahmins cursed, thinking through delusion that I was cursed.

sanskrit_iast:
vedo mantrākṣaramayaḥ sākṣātsūktamayo bhṛśam |
sūkte pratiṣṭhito hyātmā sarveṣāmapi dehinām ||
meaning:
वेदो मन्त्राक्षरमयः साक्षात्सूक्तमयो भृशम् |
सूक्ते प्रतिष्ठितो ह्यात्मा सर्वेषामपि देहिनाम् ||
text_mt: The Veda consists of sacred syllables; it consists directly of hymns; / in the hymn is established the Self of all embodied beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādātmavido nityaṃ tvaṃ mā śapa ruṣānvitaḥ |
śapyā na vedāḥ kenāpi durddhiyā'pi kadācana ||
meaning:
तस्मादात्मविदो नित्यं त्वं मा शप रुषान्वितः |
शप्या न वेदाः केनापि दुर्द्धियाऽपि कदाचन ||
text_mt: Therefore, do not, filled with wrath, ever curse the knowers of the Self. / The Vedas should never be cursed by anyone, even with a wicked intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ śapto na cedānīṃ tattvato boddhumarhasi |
śānto bhava mahādhīman sanakādivibodhakaḥ ||
meaning:
अहं शप्तो न चेदानीं तत्त्वतो बोद्धुमर्हसि |
शान्तो भव महाधीमन् सनकादिविबोधकः ||
text_mt: I am not cursed; you ought to understand this in truth now. / Be calm, O highly intelligent one, who enlightens Sanaka and the rest!

sanskrit_iast:
yajño'haṃ yajñakarmāhaṃ yajñāṅgāni ca sarvaśaḥ |
yajñātmā yajñanirato yajñabāhyo'hameva vai ||
meaning:
यज्ञोऽहं यज्ञकर्माहं यज्ञाङ्गानि च सर्वशः |
यज्ञात्मा यज्ञनिरतो यज्ञबाह्योऽहमेव वै ||
text_mt: I am the sacrifice, I am the sacrificial rite, and I am all the limbs of the sacrifice; / I am the soul of the sacrifice, intent on the sacrifice, and I alone am outside the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
ko'yaṃ kastvamime ke hi sarvo'hamapi tattvataḥ |
iti buddhyā hi vimṛśa vṛthā śaptāstvayā dvijāḥ ||
meaning:
कोऽयं कस्त्वमिमे के हि सर्वोऽहमपि तत्त्वतः |
इति बुद्ध्या हि विमृश वृथा शप्तास्त्वया द्विजाः ||
text_mt: Who is this one? Who are you? Who are these? In truth, I am indeed everything. / Reflect thus with your intellect; in vain were the twice-borns cursed by you.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvajñānena nirhṛtya prapañcaracanāṃ bhava |
budhaḥsvastho mahābuddhe nandin krodhādivarjitaḥ ||
meaning:
तत्त्वज्ञानेन निर्हृत्य प्रपञ्चरचनां भव |
बुधःस्वस्थो महाबुद्धे नन्दिन् क्रोधादिवर्जितः ||
text_mt: Having dissolved the manifestation of the cosmos by knowledge of reality, / be wise, composed, and free from anger and the like, O Nandin of great intellect!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
evaṃ prabodhitastena śambhunā nandikeśvaraḥ |
vivekaparamo bhūtvā śānto'bhūtkrodhavarjitaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एवं प्रबोधितस्तेन शम्भुना नन्दिकेश्वरः |
विवेकपरमो भूत्वा शान्तोऽभूत्क्रोधवर्जितः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Thus enlightened by Śambhu, Nandikeśvara, / having attained supreme discernment, became calm and free from anger.

sanskrit_iast:
śivo'pi taṃ prabodhyāśu svagaṇaṃ prāṇavallabham |
sagaṇaḥ sa yayau tasmātsvasthānaṃ pramudānvitaḥ ||
meaning:
शिवोऽपि तं प्रबोध्याशु स्वगणं प्राणवल्लभम् |
सगणः स ययौ तस्मात्स्वस्थानं प्रमुदान्वितः ||
text_mt: Śiva too, having quickly enlightened him, his own attendant dear as life, / departed with his retinue from there to his own abode, filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣo'pi sa ruṣāviṣṭastairdvijaiḥ parivāritaḥ |
svasthānaṃ ca yayau citte śivadrohaparāyaṇaḥ ||
meaning:
दक्षोऽपि स रुषाविष्टस्तैर्द्विजैः परिवारितः |
स्वस्थानं च ययौ चित्ते शिवद्रोहपरायणः ||
text_mt: Dakṣa also, overcome with wrath, surrounded by those twice-borns, / went to his own abode, his mind bent on malice against Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
rudraṃ tadānīṃ pariśapyamānaṃ saṃsmṛtya dakṣaḥ parayā ruṣānvitaḥ |
śraddhāṃ vihāyaiva sa mūḍhabuddhi-rnindāparo'bhūcchivapūjakānām ||
meaning:
रुद्रं तदानीं परिशप्यमानं संस्मृत्य दक्षः परया रुषान्वितः |
श्रद्धां विहायैव स मूढबुद्धि-र्निन्दापरोऽभूच्छिवपूजकानाम् ||
text_mt: Remembering Rudra being cursed at that time, filled with supreme wrath, / having cast aside faith, that foolish-minded one became intent on reviling the worshipers of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto dakṣadurbuddhiḥ śambhunā paramātmanā |
parāṃ durdhiṣaṇāṃ tasya śṛṇu tāta vadāmyaham ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyā rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ satīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
इत्युक्तो दक्षदुर्बुद्धिः शम्भुना परमात्मना |
परां दुर्धिषणां तस्य शृणु तात वदाम्यहम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीया रुद्रसंहितायां द्वितीयः सतीखण्डे
text_mt:
Thus addressed was Dakṣa of evil intellect by Śambhu, the supreme Self. / Hear, dear one, of his terrible foolishness; I shall tell it.

Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter, named “The Enmity of Dakṣa with Śiva,” in the narrative of Satī in the second Satī section of the second Rudrasaṃhitā of the glorious Śivamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ekadā tu mune tena yajñaḥ prārambhito mahān |
tatrāhūtāstadā sarve dīkṣitena surarṣayaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एकदा तु मुने तेन यज्ञः प्रारम्भितो महान् |
तत्राहूतास्तदा सर्वे दीक्षितेन सुरर्षयः ||
title: saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | dakṣayajñārambhaḥ
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Once, O sage, a great sacrifice was initiated by him; / all the divine sages were then summoned there by him when he had taken the consecration.

sanskrit_iast:
maharṣayo'khilāstatra nirjarāśca samāgatāḥ |
yadyajñakaraṇārthaṃ hi śivamāyāvimohitāḥ ||
meaning:
महर्षयोऽखिलास्तत्र निर्जराश्च समागताः |
यद्यज्ञकरणार्थं हि शिवमायाविमोहिताः ||
text_mt: All the great sages and the gods assembled there / for the purpose of performing the sacrifice, utterly deluded by the illusion of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
agastyaḥ kaśyapo'triśca vāmadevastathā bhṛguḥ |
dadhīcirbhagavān vyāso bhāradvājo'tha gautamaḥ ||
meaning:
अगस्त्यः कश्यपोऽत्रिश्च वामदेवस्तथा भृगुः |
दधीचिर्भगवान् व्यासो भारद्वाजोऽथ गौतमः ||
text_mt: Agastya, Kaśyapa, Atri, Vāmadeva, and Bhṛgu, / the venerable Dadhīci, Vyāsa, Bhāradvāja, and Gautama;

sanskrit_iast:
pailaḥ parāśaro gargo bhārgavaḥ kakubhaḥ sitaḥ |
sumantutrikakaṅkāśca vaiśampāyana eva ca ||
meaning:
पैलः पराशरो गर्गो भार्गवः ककुभः सितः |
सुमन्तुत्रिककङ्काश्च वैशम्पायन एव च ||
text_mt: Paila, Parāśara, Garga, Bhārgava, Kakubha, Sita, / Sumantu, Trikakaṅka, and Vaiśampāyana;

sanskrit_iast:
ete cānye ca bahavo munayo harṣitā yayuḥ |
mama putrasya dakṣasya sadārāḥ sasutā makham ||
meaning:
एते चान्ये च बहवो मुनयो हर्षिता ययुः |
मम पुत्रस्य दक्षस्य सदाराः ससुता मखम् ||
text_mt: these and many other sages, along with their wives and sons, / went rejoicing to the sacrifice of my son Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā sarve suragaṇā lokapālā mahodayāḥ |
tathopanirjarāḥ sarve svopakārabalānvitāḥ ||
meaning:
तथा सर्वे सुरगणा लोकपाला महोदयाः |
तथोपनिर्जराः सर्वे स्वोपकारबलान्विताः ||
text_mt: Likewise, all the hosts of gods, the glorious world protectors, / and all the lesser gods arrived, endowed with the power to offer their services.

sanskrit_iast:
satyalokātsamānīto nuto'haṃ viśvakārakaḥ |
sasutaḥ saparīvāro mūrtavedādisaṃyutaḥ ||
meaning:
सत्यलोकात्समानीतो नुतोऽहं विश्वकारकः |
ससुतः सपरीवारो मूर्तवेदादिसंयुतः ||
text_mt: Brought from the world of truth and praised, I, the creator of the universe, / arrived with my sons and retinue, accompanied by the Vedas and others in embodied form.

sanskrit_iast:
vaikuṇṭhācca tathā viṣṇuḥ samprārthya vividhādarāt |
sapārṣadaparīvāraḥ samānīto makhaṃ prati ||
meaning:
वैकुण्ठाच्च तथा विष्णुः सम्प्रार्थ्य विविधादरात् |
सपार्षदपरीवारः समानीतो मखं प्रति ||
text_mt: And Viṣṇu, entreatingly prayed to with diverse courtesies, / was brought from Vaikuṇṭha to the sacrifice, together with his attendants and retinue.

sanskrit_iast:
evamanye samāyātā dakṣayajñaṃ vimohitāḥ |
satkṛtāstena dakṣeṇa sarve te hi durātmanā ||
meaning:
एवमन्ये समायाता दक्षयज्ञं विमोहिताः |
सत्कृतास्तेन दक्षेण सर्वे ते हि दुरात्मना ||
text_mt: Thus others came to Dakṣa's sacrifice, deluded; / and all of them were received with hospitality by that evil-minded Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanāni mahārhāṇi suprabhāṇi mahānti ca |
tvaṣṭrā kṛtāni divyāni tebhyo dattāni tena vai ||
meaning:
भवनानि महार्हाणि सुप्रभाणि महान्ति च |
त्वष्ट्रा कृतानि दिव्यानि तेभ्यो दत्तानि तेन वै ||
text_mt: Precious, radiant, vast, and celestial mansions, / fashioned by Tvaṣṭṛ, were given to them by him.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu sarveṣu dhiṣṇyeṣu yathāyogyaṃ ca saṃsthitāḥ |
sanmānitā arājaṃste sakalā viṣṇunā mayā ||
meaning:
तेषु सर्वेषु धिष्ण्येषु यथायोग्यं च संस्थिताः |
सन्मानिता अराजंस्ते सकला विष्णुना मया ||
text_mt: Having taken their places as was fitting in all those dwellings, / honored, they all shone together with Viṣṇu and me.

sanskrit_iast:
vartamāne mahāyajñe tīrthe kanakhale tadā |
ṛtvijaśca kṛtāstena bhṛgvādyāśca tapodhanāḥ ||
meaning:
वर्तमाने महायज्ञे तीर्थे कनखले तदा |
ऋत्विजश्च कृतास्तेन भृग्वाद्याश्च तपोधनाः ||
text_mt: As that great sacrifice was proceeding at the holy ford of Kanakhala, / Bhṛgu and other ascetics were appointed by him as officiating priests.

sanskrit_iast:
adhiṣṭhātā svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ saha sarvamarudgaṇaiḥ |
ahaṃ tatrābhavaṃ brahmā trayīvidhinidarśakaḥ ||
meaning:
अधिष्ठाता स्वयं विष्णुः सह सर्वमरुद्गणैः |
अहं तत्राभवं ब्रह्मा त्रयीविधिनिदर्शकः ||
text_mt: Viṣṇu himself, together with all the hosts of Maruts, was the presiding deity; / and I, Brahmā, was there indicating the rites of the three Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva sarve dikpālā dvārapālāśca rakṣakāḥ |
sāyudhāḥ saparīvārāḥ kutūhalakarāḥ sadā ||
meaning:
तथैव सर्वे दिक्पाला द्वारपालाश्च रक्षकाः |
सायुधाः सपरीवाराः कुतूहलकराः सदा ||
text_mt: Likewise, all the guardians of the directions became gatekeepers and protectors, / bearing weapons with their retinues, constantly showing their eagerness.

sanskrit_iast:
upatasthe svayaṃ yajñaḥ surūpastasya cādhvare |
sarve mahāmuniśreṣṭhāḥ svayaṃ vedadharābhavan ||
meaning:
उपतस्थे स्वयं यज्ञः सुरूपस्तस्य चाध्वरे |
सर्वे महामुनिश्रेष्ठाः स्वयं वेदधराभवन् ||
text_mt: The Sacrifice itself, handsome in form, was present at his ritual; / all the foremost great sages themselves became the upholders of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
tanūnapādapi nijaṃ cakre rūpaṃ sahasraśaḥ |
haviṣāṃ grahaṇāyāśu tasmin yajñe mahotsave ||
meaning:
तनूनपादपि निजं चक्रे रूपं सहस्रशः |
हविषां ग्रहणायाशु तस्मिन् यज्ञे महोत्सवे ||
text_mt: Even Agni assumed thousands of forms of his own / to quickly receive the oblations in that great sacrificial festival.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi juhvati saha ṛtvijaḥ |
udgātāraścatuḥṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi surarṣayaḥ ||
meaning:
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि जुह्वति सह ऋत्विजः |
उद्गातारश्चतुःषष्टिसहस्राणि सुरर्षयः ||
text_mt: Eighty-eight thousand priests performed the offerings together; / sixty-four thousand celestial sages served as chanting priests;

sanskrit_iast:
adhvaryavo'tha hotārastāvanto nāradādayaḥ |
saptarṣayaḥ samā gāthāḥ kurvanti sma pṛthakpṛthak ||
meaning:
अध्वर्यवोऽथ होतारस्तावन्तो नारदादयः |
सप्तर्षयः समा गाथाः कुर्वन्ति स्म पृथक्पृथक् ||
text_mt: just as many, including Nārada and others, were the Adhvaryu and Hotṛ priests; / the Seven Sages chanted identical verses, each in his turn.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvavidyādharasiddhasaṅghā-nādityasaṅghān sagaṇān sayajñān |
saṅkhyāvatānnāgacarān samastān vavre sa dakṣo hi mahādhvare sve ||
meaning:
गन्धर्वविद्याधरसिद्धसङ्घा-नादित्यसङ्घान् सगणान् सयज्ञान् |
सङ्ख्यावतान्नागचरान् समस्तान् वव्रे स दक्षो हि महाध्वरे स्वे ||
text_mt: The hosts of Gandharvas, Vidyādharas, and Siddhas, the hosts of Ādityas with their attendants and sacrifices, / and all the wise dwellers among the serpent folk were chosen by Dakṣa for his great ritual.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijarṣirājarṣisurarṣisaṅghā nṛpāḥ samitrāḥ sacivāḥ sasainyāḥ |
vasupramukhyā gaṇadevatāśca sarve vṛtāstena makhopavettrā ||
meaning:
द्विजर्षिराजर्षिसुरर्षिसङ्घा नृपाः समित्राः सचिवाः ससैन्याः |
वसुप्रमुख्या गणदेवताश्च सर्वे वृतास्तेन मखोपवेत्त्रा ||
text_mt: Hosts of priestly sages, royal sages, and celestial sages, kings with their friends, ministers, and armies, / and the host deities headed by the Vasus were all chosen by him, the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāyuktastadā dakṣaḥ kṛtakautukamaṅgalaḥ |
bhāryayā sahito reje kṛtasvastyayano bhṛśam ||
meaning:
दीक्षायुक्तस्तदा दक्षः कृतकौतुकमङ्गलः |
भार्यया सहितो रेजे कृतस्वस्त्ययनो भृशम् ||
text_mt: Endowed with the consecration, having performed the auspicious rites of curiosity, / and having performed the benedictions, Dakṣa shone brightly together with his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin yajñe vṛtaḥ śambhurna dakṣeṇa durātmanā |
kapālīti viniścitya tasya yajñārhatā na hi ||
meaning:
तस्मिन् यज्ञे वृतः शम्भुर्न दक्षेण दुरात्मना |
कपालीति विनिश्चित्य तस्य यज्ञार्हता न हि ||
text_mt: Śambhu was not invited to that sacrifice by the evil-minded Dakṣa; / having resolved, 'He is a skull-bearer,' [he deemed] he had no fitness for the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālibhāryeti satī dayitā svasutāpi ca |
nāhūtā yajñaviṣaye dakṣeṇāguṇadarśinā ||
meaning:
कपालिभार्येति सती दयिता स्वसुतापि च |
नाहूता यज्ञविषये दक्षेणागुणदर्शिना ||
text_mt: Because she was the wife of the skull-bearer, even his beloved daughter Satī / was not invited to the sacrifice by Dakṣa, who saw no virtue in them.
