text_mt: Lord Vīrabhadra, the unyielding Śiva, paralyzed / his extremely terrifying discus, which shone like the sun of dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
mune śambhoḥ prabhāvāttu māyeśasya mahāprabhoḥ |
na cacāla hareścakraṃ karasthaṃ stambhitaṃ dhruvam ||
meaning:
मुने शम्भोः प्रभावात्तु मायेशस्य महाप्रभोः |
न चचाल हरेश्चक्रं करस्थं स्तम्भितं ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: O sage, by the power of Śambhu, the great Lord and master of illusion, / Hari’s discus remained motionless, firmly paralyzed in his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
atha viṣṇurgaṇeśena vīrabhadreṇa bhāṣatā |
atiṣṭhat stambhitastena śṛṅgavāniva niścalaḥ ||
meaning:
अथ विष्णुर्गणेशेन वीरभद्रेण भाषता |
अतिष्ठत् स्तम्भितस्तेन शृङ्गवानिव निश्चलः ||
text_mt: Then Viṣṇu, paralyzed by the roaring Vīrabhadra, the lord of attendants, / stood motionless like a mountain horn.

sanskrit_iast:
tato viṣṇuḥ stambhito hi vīrabhadreṇa nārada |
yajvopamantraṇamanuṃ niḥstambhanakaraṃ japan ||
meaning:
ततो विष्णुः स्तम्भितो हि वीरभद्रेण नारद |
यज्वोपमन्त्रणमनुं निःस्तम्भनकरं जपन् ||
text_mt: Then, being paralyzed by Vīrabhadra, O Nārada, Viṣṇu / recited the sacrificial invocation mantra that neutralizes paralysis.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ stambhananirmuktaḥ śārṅgadhanvā rameśvaraḥ |
śārṅgaṃ jagrāha sa kruddhaḥ svadhanuḥ saśaraṃ mune ||
meaning:
ततः स्तम्भननिर्मुक्तः शार्ङ्गधन्वा रमेश्वरः |
शार्ङ्गं जग्राह स क्रुद्धः स्वधनुः सशरं मुने ||
text_mt: Then, freed from paralysis, the Lord of Ramā, wielder of the bow Śārṅga, / angrily grasped his own bow Śārṅga along with an arrow, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tribhiśca dharṣitaṃ bāṇaistena śārṅgadhanurhareḥ |
vīrabhadreṇa tattāta tridhābhūttatkṣaṇānmune ||
meaning:
त्रिभिश्च धर्षितं बाणैस्तेन शार्ङ्गधनुर्हरेः |
वीरभद्रेण तत्तात त्रिधाभूत्तत्क्षणान्मुने ||
text_mt: Assailed by three arrows shot by Vīrabhadra, / that bow Śārṅga of Hari was instantly broken into three parts, O dear one, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
atha viṣṇurmahāvāṇyā bodhitastaṃ mahāgaṇam |
asahyavarcasaṃ jñātvā hyantardhātuṃ mano dadhe ||
meaning:
अथ विष्णुर्महावाण्या बोधितस्तं महागणम् |
असह्यवर्चसं ज्ञात्वा ह्यन्तर्धातुं मनो दधे ||
text_mt: Then Viṣṇu, awakened by a great voice and realizing that great attendant / possessed unbearable lustre, set his mind on disappearing.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā ca tatsarvamidaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ satīkṛtaṃ duṣprasahaṃ pareṣām |
gatāḥ svalokaṃ svagaṇānvitāstu smṛtvā śivaṃ sarvapatiṃ svatantram ||
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा च तत्सर्वमिदं भविष्यं सतीकृतं दुष्प्रसहं परेषाम् |
गताः स्वलोकं स्वगणान्वितास्तु स्मृत्वा शिवं सर्वपतिं स्वतन्त्रम् ||
text_mt: Knowing all this future event brought about by Satī to be intolerable for others, / they went to their own world along with their attendants, remembering Śiva, the independent master of all.

sanskrit_iast:
satyalokagataścāhaṃ putraśokena pīḍitaḥ |
acintayaṃ suduḥkhārto mayā kiṃ kāryamadya vai ||
meaning:
सत्यलोकगतश्चाहं पुत्रशोकेन पीडितः |
अचिन्तयं सुदुःखार्तो मया किं कार्यमद्य वै ||
text_mt: And I, having gone to Satyaloka, tormented by sorrow for my son, / grieved with great distress, thinking: 'What must I do now?'

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇau mayi gate caiva devāśca munibhiḥ saha |
vinirjitā gaṇaiḥ sarve ye te yajñopajīvinaḥ ||
meaning:
विष्णौ मयि गते चैव देवाश्च मुनिभिः सह |
विनिर्जिता गणैः सर्वे ये ते यज्ञोपजीविनः ||
text_mt: When Viṣṇu and I had departed, the gods along with the sages, / all those who subsisted on sacrifices, were conquered by the attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
tamupadravamālakṣya vidhvastaṃ ca mahāmakham |
mṛgasvarūpo yajño hi mahābhīto'pi dudruve ||
meaning:
तमुपद्रवमालक्ष्य विध्वस्तं च महामखम् |
मृगस्वरूपो यज्ञो हि महाभीतोऽपि दुद्रुवे ||
text_mt: Seeing that turmoil and the great sacrifice destroyed, / the Sacrifice, assuming the form of a deer, fled in great terror.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tadā mṛgarūpeṇa dhāvantaṃ gaganaṃ prati |
vīrabhadraḥ samādāya viśiraskamathākarot ||
meaning:
तं तदा मृगरूपेण धावन्तं गगनं प्रति |
वीरभद्रः समादाय विशिरस्कमथाकरोत् ||
text_mt: Then, seizing him as he fled toward the sky in the form of a deer, / Vīrabhadra made him headless.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prajāpatiṃ dharmaṃ kaśyapaṃ ca pragṛhya saḥ |
ariṣṭaneminaṃ vīro bahuputraṃ munīśvaram ||
meaning:
ततः प्रजापतिं धर्मं कश्यपं च प्रगृह्य सः |
अरिष्टनेमिनं वीरो बहुपुत्रं मुनीश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Then, seizing the Prajāpati Dharma, Kaśyapa, / Ariṣṭanemi, and the lord of sages Bahuputra;

sanskrit_iast:
munimaṅgirasaṃ caiva kṛśāśvaṃ ca mahāgaṇaḥ |
jaghāna mūrdhni pādena dattaṃ ca munipuṅgavam ||
meaning:
मुनिमङ्गिरसं चैव कृशाश्वं च महागणः |
जघान मूर्ध्नि पादेन दत्तं च मुनिपुङ्गवम् ||
text_mt: and the sage Aṅgiras, Kṛśāśva, and the foremost sage Datta, / that great attendant struck them on the head with his foot.

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatyāśca nāsāgraṃ devamātustathaiva ca |
ciccheda karajāgreṇa vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān ||
meaning:
सरस्वत्याश्च नासाग्रं देवमातुस्तथैव च |
चिच्छेद करजाग्रेण वीरभद्रः प्रतापवान् ||
text_mt: The powerful Vīrabhadra cut off with the tip of his fingernail / the tip of the nose of Sarasvatī, and likewise that of the mother of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'nyānapi devādīn vidārya pṛthivītale |
pātayāmāsa so'yaṃ vai krodhākrāntātilocanaḥ ||
meaning:
ततोऽन्यानपि देवादीन् विदार्य पृथिवीतले |
पातयामास सोऽयं वै क्रोधाक्रान्तातिलोचनः ||
text_mt: Then, tearing apart other gods and beings on the surface of the earth, / he, whose eyes were filled with fury, hurled them down.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhadro vidāryāpi devānmukhyānmunīnapi |
nābhūcchānto drutakrodhaḥ phaṇirāḍiva maṇḍitaḥ ||
meaning:
वीरभद्रो विदार्यापि देवान्मुख्यान्मुनीनपि |
नाभूच्छान्तो द्रुतक्रोधः फणिराडिव मण्डितः ||
text_mt: Even after tearing apart the principal gods and sages, Vīrabhadra, / blazing with anger like an ornamented king of serpents, did not become pacified.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhadroddhṛtārātiḥ kesarīva vanadvipān |
diśo vilokayāmāsa kaḥ kutrāstītyanukṣaṇam ||
meaning:
वीरभद्रोद्धृतारातिः केसरीव वनद्विपान् |
दिशो विलोकयामास कः कुत्रास्तीत्यनुक्षणम् ||
text_mt: Vīrabhadra, having uprooted his enemies like a lion [uproots] wild elephants, / looked in all directions at every moment, [wondering] who was where.

sanskrit_iast:
vyapothayad bhṛguṃ yāvanmaṇibhadraḥ pratāpavān |
padākramyorasi tadākārṣīttacchmaśruluñcanam ||
meaning:
व्यपोथयद् भृगुं यावन्मणिभद्रः प्रतापवान् |
पदाक्रम्योरसि तदाकार्षीत्तच्छ्मश्रुलुञ्चनम् ||
text_mt: While the mighty Maṇibhadra was crushing Bhṛgu, / he trampled him upon the chest with his foot and plucked out his beard.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍaścotpāṭayāmāsa pūṣṇo dantān pravegataḥ |
śapyamāne hare pūrvaṃ yo'hasaddarśayandataḥ ||
meaning:
चण्डश्चोत्पाटयामास पूष्णो दन्तान् प्रवेगतः |
शप्यमाने हरे पूर्वं योऽहसद्दर्शयन्दतः ||
text_mt: And Caṇḍa forcefully wrenched out the teeth of Pūṣan, / who had formerly laughed showing his teeth while Hara was being cursed.

sanskrit_iast:
nandī bhagasya netre hi pātitasya ruṣā bhuvi |
ujjahāra dakṣamakṣṇā yaḥ śapantamasūsucat ||
meaning:
नन्दी भगस्य नेत्रे हि पातितस्य रुषा भुवि |
उज्जहार दक्षमक्ष्णा यः शपन्तमसूसुचत् ||
text_mt: Nandin gouged out the eyes of Bhaga, who had been thrown to the ground in wrath, / and who had gestured with his eye while Dakṣa was cursing.

sanskrit_iast:
viḍambitā svadhā tatra sā svāhā dakṣiṇā tathā |
mantrāstantrāstathā cānye tatrasthā gaṇanāyakaiḥ ||
meaning:
विडम्बिता स्वधा तत्र सा स्वाहा दक्षिणा तथा |
मन्त्रास्तन्त्रास्तथा चान्ये तत्रस्था गणनायकैः ||
text_mt: There Svadhā, Svāhā, Dakṣiṇā, / as well as the mantras, rituals, and others present were mocked by the leaders of the attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
vavṛṣuste purīṣāṇi vitānāgnau ruṣā gaṇāḥ |
anirvācyaṃ tadā cakrurgaṇā vīrāstamadhvaram ||
meaning:
ववृषुस्ते पुरीषाणि वितानाग्नौ रुषा गणाः |
अनिर्वाच्यं तदा चक्रुर्गणा वीरास्तमध्वरम् ||
text_mt: Furious, the attendants showered excrement into the sacrificial fire; / the heroic attendants made that sacrifice utterly indescribable.

sanskrit_iast:
antarvedyantaragataṃ nilīnaṃ tadbhayād balāt |
ānināya samājñāya vīrabhadraḥ svabhūḥsutam ||
meaning:
अन्तर्वेद्यन्तरगतं निलीनं तद्भयाद् बलात् |
आनिनाय समाज्ञाय वीरभद्रः स्वभूःसुतम् ||
text_mt: Finding that the son of the Self-born had gone inside the sacrificial enclosure and hidden out of fear of him, / Vīrabhadra forcibly dragged him forth.

sanskrit_iast:
kapole'sya gṛhītvā tu khaḍgenopahṛtaṃ śiraḥ |
abhedyamabhavattasya tacca yogaprabhāvataḥ ||
meaning:
कपोलेऽस्य गृहीत्वा तु खड्गेनोपहृतं शिरः |
अभेद्यमभवत्तस्य तच्च योगप्रभावतः ||
text_mt: Seizing him by the cheek, he struck at his head with a sword; / but by virtue of his yoga, it proved impossible to cut.

sanskrit_iast:
abhedyaṃ tacchiro matvā śastrāstraiśca tu sarvaśaḥ |
kareṇa troṭayāmāsa padbhyāmākramya corasi ||
meaning:
अभेद्यं तच्छिरो मत्वा शस्त्रास्त्रैश्च तु सर्वशः |
करेण त्रोटयामास पद्भ्यामाक्रम्य चोरसि ||
text_mt: Knowing that head to be impenetrable by all weapons and missiles, / he severed it with his hand while trampling his chest with both feet.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchirastasya duṣṭasya dakṣasya haravairiṇaḥ |
agnikuṇḍe pracikṣepa vīrabhadro gaṇāgraṇīḥ ||
meaning:
तच्छिरस्तस्य दुष्टस्य दक्षस्य हरवैरिणः |
अग्निकुण्डे प्रचिक्षेप वीरभद्रो गणाग्रणीः ||
text_mt: The leader of the attendants, Vīrabhadra, cast into the fire pit / that head of the wicked Dakṣa, the enemy of Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
reje tadā vīrabhadrastriśūlaṃ bhrāmayankare |
kruddhā raṇākṣasaṃvartāḥ prajvālya parvatopamāḥ ||
meaning:
रेजे तदा वीरभद्रस्त्रिशूलं भ्रामयन्करे |
क्रुद्धा रणाक्षसंवर्ताः प्रज्वाल्य पर्वतोपमाः ||
text_mt: Then Vīrabhadra shone as he brandished the trident in his hand; / the wrathful [attendants], resembling mountains, burned like fires of dissolution on the battlefield.

sanskrit_iast:
anāyāsena hatvaitān vīrabhadrastato'gninā |
jvālayāmāsa sakrodho dīptāgniḥ śalabhāniva ||
meaning:
अनायासेन हत्वैतान् वीरभद्रस्ततोऽग्निना |
ज्वालयामास सक्रोधो दीप्ताग्निः शलभानिव ||
text_mt: Having slain them effortlessly, the enraged Vīrabhadra / burned them with fire, as a blazing fire burns moths.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhadrastato dagdhān dṛṣṭvā dakṣapurogamān |
aṭṭāṭṭahāsamakarot pūrayaṃśca jagattrayam ||
meaning:
वीरभद्रस्ततो दग्धान् दृष्ट्वा दक्षपुरोगमान् |
अट्टाट्टहासमकरोत् पूरयंश्च जगत्त्रयम् ||
text_mt: Then, seeing Dakṣa and the others burnt, / Vīrabhadra let out a loud roar of laughter, filling the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
vīraśriyā vṛtastatra tato nandanasambhavā |
puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūddivyā vīrabhadre gaṇānvite ||
meaning:
वीरश्रिया वृतस्तत्र ततो नन्दनसम्भवा |
पुष्पवृष्टिरभूद्दिव्या वीरभद्रे गणान्विते ||
text_mt: Attended there by heroic glory, / a divine shower of flowers from the Nandana garden fell upon Vīrabhadra accompanied by the attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
vavurgandhavahāḥ śītāḥ sugandhāḥ sukhadāḥ śanaiḥ |
devadundubhayo neduḥ samameva tataḥ param ||
meaning:
ववुर्गन्धवहाः शीताः सुगन्धाः सुखदाः शनैः |
देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः सममेव ततः परम् ||
text_mt: Cool, fragrant, and pleasant breezes blew softly; / celestial drums sounded immediately thereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
kailāsaṃ sa yayau vīraḥ kṛtakāryastataḥ param |
vināśitadṛḍhadhvānto bhānumāniva satvaram ||
meaning:
कैलासं स ययौ वीरः कृतकार्यस्ततः परम् |
विनाशितदृढध्वान्तो भानुमानिव सत्वरम् ||
text_mt: Then, having accomplished his task, the hero swiftly went to Kailāsa, / like the sun when it has destroyed deep darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtakāryaṃ vīrabhadraṃ dṛṣṭvā santuṣṭamānasaḥ |
śambhurvīragaṇādhyakṣaṃ cakāra parameśvaraḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ satīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
कृतकार्यं वीरभद्रं दृष्ट्वा सन्तुष्टमानसः |
शम्भुर्वीरगणाध्यक्षं चकार परमेश्वरः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां द्वितीयः सतीखण्डे
text_mt:
Seeing that Vīrabhadra had accomplished his task, / Śambhu, the supreme lord, his mind delighted, made him commander of the host of heroes.

Homage to glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

In the second section, the Satīkhaṇḍa, of the second Rudrasaṃhitā:

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
ityākarṇya vacastasya vidheramitadhīmataḥ |
papraccha nāradaḥ prītyā vismitastaṃ dvijottamaḥ ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य विधेरमितधीमतः |
पप्रच्छ नारदः प्रीत्या विस्मितस्तं द्विजोत्तमः ||
title: aṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | kṣuvadadhīcavivādaḥ
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hearing those words of the Creator of boundless intellect, / Nārada, the best of the twice-born, filled with wonder, asked him with affection:

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca |
śivaṃ vihāya dakṣasya surairyajñaṃ harirgataḥ |
hetunā kena tad brūhi yatrāvajñābhavattataḥ ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच |
शिवं विहाय दक्षस्य सुरैर्यज्ञं हरिर्गतः |
हेतुना केन तद् ब्रूहि यत्रावज्ञाभवत्ततः ||
text_mt: Nārada said: / Hari went to Dakṣa's sacrifice along with the gods, forsaking Śiva; / tell [me] for what reason disrespect toward him arose thereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
jānāti kiṃ sa śambhuṃ no hariḥ pralayavikramam |
raṇaṃ kathaṃ ca kṛtavān tadgaṇairabudho yathā ||
meaning:
जानाति किं स शम्भुं नो हरिः प्रलयविक्रमम् |
रणं कथं च कृतवान् तद्गणैरबुधो यथा ||
text_mt: Did Hari not know that Śambhu possesses valour [capable of] cosmic dissolution? / And how did he fight with his attendants, like a fool?

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa me saṃśayo bhūyāṃstaṃ chindhi karuṇānidhe |
caritaṃ brūhi śambhostu cittotsāhakaraṃ prabho ||
meaning:
एष मे संशयो भूयांस्तं छिन्धि करुणानिधे |
चरितं ब्रूहि शम्भोस्तु चित्तोत्साहकरं प्रभो ||
text_mt: This is a great doubt of mine; sever it, O treasure of compassion! / O lord, tell the deeds of Śambhu, which bring enthusiasm to the heart.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
dvijavarya śṛṇu prītyā caritaṃ śaśimaulinaḥ |
yatpṛcchate kurvataśca sarvasaṃśayahārakam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
द्विजवर्य शृणु प्रीत्या चरितं शशिमौलिनः |
यत्पृच्छते कुर्वतश्च सर्वसंशयहारकम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / O best of the twice-born, listen with delight to the deeds of the moon-crested [deity], / which removes all doubt for the one who asks and the one who recites.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīcasya muneḥ śāpād bhraṣṭajñāno hariḥ purā |
sāmaro dakṣayajñaṃ vai gataḥ kṣuvasahāyakṛt ||
meaning:
दधीचस्य मुनेः शापाद् भ्रष्टज्ञानो हरिः पुरा |
सामरो दक्षयज्ञं वै गतः क्षुवसहायकृत् ||
text_mt: Formerly, Hari, having lost his knowledge through the curse of sage Dadhīca, / went with the immortals to Dakṣa's sacrifice, aiding Kṣuva.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca |
kimarthaṃ śaptavānviṣṇuṃ dadhīco munisattamaḥ |
ko'pakāraḥ kṛtastasya hariṇā tatsahāyinā ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच |
किमर्थं शप्तवान्विष्णुं दधीचो मुनिसत्तमः |
कोऽपकारः कृतस्तस्य हरिणा तत्सहायिना ||
text_mt: Nārada said: / For what reason did Dadhīca, the best of sages, curse Viṣṇu? / What harm was done to him by Hari, who aided him?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
samutpanno mahātejā rājā kṣuva iti smṛtaḥ |
abhūnmitraṃ dadhīcasya munīndrasya mahāprabhoḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
समुत्पन्नो महातेजा राजा क्षुव इति स्मृतः |
अभून्मित्रं दधीचस्य मुनीन्द्रस्य महाप्रभोः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / A king known as Kṣuva, of great splendour, was born; / he was a friend of Dadhīca, the great, powerful lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
cirāttapaḥprasaṅgādvai vādaḥ kṣuvadadhīcayoḥ |
mahānarthakaraḥ khyātastrilokeṣvabhavatpurā ||
meaning:
चिरात्तपःप्रसङ्गाद्वै वादः क्षुवदधीचयोः |
महानर्थकरः ख्यातस्त्रिलोकेष्वभवत्पुरा ||
text_mt: In the course of time, in the context of austerity, a dispute arose between Kṣuva and Dadhīca / in ancient times, famous in the three worlds, which caused great misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra trivarṇataḥ śreṣṭho vipra eva na saṃśayaḥ |
iti prāha dadhīco hi śivabhaktastu vedavit ||
meaning:
तत्र त्रिवर्णतः श्रेष्ठो विप्र एव न संशयः |
इति प्राह दधीचो हि शिवभक्तस्तु वेदवित् ||
text_mt: Dadhīca, a devotee of Śiva and knower of the Veda, declared: / 'Among the three social classes, the brahmin alone is superior; there is no doubt.'

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya dadhīcasya mahāmune |
kṣuvaḥ prāheti nṛpatiḥ śrīmadena vimohitaḥ ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य दधीचस्य महामुने |
क्षुवः प्राहेति नृपतिः श्रीमदेन विमोहितः ||
text_mt: Hearing those words of the great sage Dadhīca, / King Kṣuva, deluded by pride in his royal power, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣuva uvāca |
aṣṭānāṃ lokapālānāṃ vapurdhārayate nṛpaḥ |
tasmānnṛpo variṣṭho hi varṇāśramapatiḥ prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
क्षुव उवाच |
अष्टानां लोकपालानां वपुर्धारयते नृपः |
तस्मान्नृपो वरिष्ठो हि वर्णाश्रमपतिः प्रभुः ||
text_mt: Kṣuva said: / 'A king bears the bodies of the eight guardians of the world; / therefore, the king is the most eminent, the master of the social classes and stages of life, the sovereign.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevamayo rājā śrutiḥ prāheti tatparā |
mahatī devatā yā sā so'hameva tato mune ||
meaning:
सर्वदेवमयो राजा श्रुतिः प्राहेति तत्परा |
महती देवता या सा सोऽहमेव ततो मुने ||
text_mt: The Vedic scripture, intent upon this, declares that a king embodies all deities; / therefore, O sage, I myself am that great deity.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādviprādvaro rājā cyāvaneya vicāryatām |
nāvamantavya evātaḥ pūjyo'haṃ sarvathā tvayā ||
meaning:
तस्माद्विप्राद्वरो राजा च्यावनेय विचार्यताम् |
नावमन्तव्य एवातः पूज्योऽहं सर्वथा त्वया ||
text_mt: Therefore, O son of Cyavana, consider [this]: the king is superior to the brahmin. / Hence I must never be despised; I am to be worshipped by you in every way.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
śrutvā tathā mataṃ tasya kṣuvasya munisattamaḥ |
śrutismṛtiviruddhaṃ taṃ cukopātīva bhārgavaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
श्रुत्वा तथा मतं तस्य क्षुवस्य मुनिसत्तमः |
श्रुतिस्मृतिविरुद्धं तं चुकोपातीव भार्गवः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing that opinion of Kṣuva, which contradicted the revealed and remembered texts, / the descendant of Bhṛgu, the best of sages, was exceedingly enraged.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kruddho mahātejā gauravāccātmano mune |
atāḍayatkṣuvaṃ mūrdhni dadhīco vāmamuṣṭitaḥ ||
meaning:
अथ क्रुद्धो महातेजा गौरवाच्चात्मनो मुने |
अताडयत्क्षुवं मूर्ध्नि दधीचो वाममुष्टितः ||
text_mt: Then, infuriated out of his own dignity, O sage, / Dadhīca of great splendour struck Kṣuva on the head with his left fist.

sanskrit_iast:
vajreṇa taṃ ca ciccheda dadhīcaṃ tāḍitaḥ kṣuvaḥ |
jagarjātīva saṅkruddho brahmāṇḍādhipatiḥ kudhīḥ ||
meaning:
वज्रेण तं च चिच्छेद दधीचं ताडितः क्षुवः |
जगर्जातीव सङ्क्रुद्धो ब्रह्माण्डाधिपतिः कुधीः ||
text_mt: Struck, Kṣuva cut Dadhīca with a thunderbolt; / that wicked ruler of the universe roared with intense rage.

sanskrit_iast:
papāta bhūmau nihato tena vajreṇa bhārgavaḥ |
śukraṃ sasmāra kṣuvakṛdbhārgavasya kulandharaḥ ||
meaning:
पपात भूमौ निहतो तेन वज्रेण भार्गवः |
शुक्रं सस्मार क्षुवकृद्भार्गवस्य कुलन्धरः ||
text_mt: Struck by that thunderbolt, the descendant of Bhṛgu fell to the ground; / having caused Kṣuva [this sorrow], the maintainer of Bhṛgu's lineage remembered Śukra.

sanskrit_iast:
śukro'tha sandhayāmāsa tāḍitaṃ ca kṣuvena tu |
yogī dadhīcasya tadā dehamāgatya sa drutam ||
meaning:
शुक्रोऽथ सन्धयामास ताडितं च क्षुवेन तु |
योगी दधीचस्य तदा देहमागत्य स द्रुतम् ||
text_mt: Then the yogin Śukra, arriving quickly at the body of Dadhīca / who had been struck down by Kṣuva, rejoined it.

sanskrit_iast:
sandhāya pūrvavaddehaṃ dadhīcasyāha bhārgavaḥ |
śivabhaktāgraṇīrmṛtyañjayavidyāpravartakaḥ ||
meaning:
सन्धाय पूर्ववद्देहं दधीचस्याह भार्गवः |
शिवभक्ताग्रणीर्मृत्यञ्जयविद्याप्रवर्तकः ||
text_mt: Having healed Dadhīca's body as before, the descendant of Bhṛgu, / foremost among devotees of Śiva and author of the lore that conquers death, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
śukra uvāca |
dadhīca tāta sampūjya śivaṃ sarveśvaraṃ prabhum |
mahāmṛtyuñjayaṃ mantraṃ śrautamagryaṃ vadāmi te ||
meaning:
शुक्र उवाच |
दधीच तात सम्पूज्य शिवं सर्वेश्वरं प्रभुम् |
महामृत्युञ्जयं मन्त्रं श्रौतमग्र्यं वदामि ते ||
text_mt: Śukra said: / 'O dear Dadhīca, having worshipped Śiva, the sovereign lord of all, / I shall tell you the supreme Vedic Mahāmṛtyuñjaya mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
tryambakaṃ yajāmahe trailokyaṃ pitaraṃ prabhum |
trimaṇḍalasya pitaraṃ triguṇasya maheśvaram ||
meaning:
त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे त्रैलोक्यं पितरं प्रभुम् |
त्रिमण्डलस्य पितरं त्रिगुणस्य महेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: "We worship Tryambaka, the sovereign father of the three worlds, / the father of the three realms, the great lord of the three guṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
tritattvasya trivahneśca tridhābhūtasya sarvataḥ |
tridivasya tribāhośca tridhābhūtasya sarvataḥ ||
meaning:
त्रितत्त्वस्य त्रिवह्नेश्च त्रिधाभूतस्य सर्वतः |
त्रिदिवस्य त्रिबाहोश्च त्रिधाभूतस्य सर्वतः ||
text_mt: the lord of the three realities and the three fires, omnipresent in three ways, / of the three heavens, of the three arms, omnipresent in three ways;

sanskrit_iast:
tridevasya mahādevaḥ sugandhiṃ puṣṭivarddhanam |
sarvabhūteṣu sarvatra triguṇeṣu kṛtau yathā ||
meaning:
त्रिदेवस्य महादेवः सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्द्धनम् |
सर्वभूतेषु सर्वत्र त्रिगुणेषु कृतौ यथा ||
text_mt: Mahādeva of the three deities, the fragrant one who increases nourishment; / as in all beings everywhere, in the three guṇas in creation,

sanskrit_iast:
indriyeṣu tathānyeṣu deveṣu ca gaṇeṣu ca |
puṣpe sugandhivatsūraḥ sugandhiramareśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
इन्द्रियेषु तथान्येषु देवेषु च गणेषु च |
पुष्पे सुगन्धिवत्सूरः सुगन्धिरमरेश्वरः ||
text_mt: so in the senses, in the other gods, and in the attendants, / like fragrance in a flower, the hero, the lord of immortals, is fragrant.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣṭiśca prakṛteryasmātpuruṣād vai dvijottama |
mahadādiviśeṣāntavikalpaścāpi suvrata ||
meaning:
पुष्टिश्च प्रकृतेर्यस्मात्पुरुषाद् वै द्विजोत्तम |
महदादिविशेषान्तविकल्पश्चापि सुव्रत ||
text_mt: And since nourishment [arises] from prakṛti and puruṣa, O best of the twice-born, / and also the varieties from the cosmic intellect down to particular elements, O you of noble vows,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇoḥ pitāmahasyāpi munīnāṃ ca mahāmune |
indriyāṇāṃ ca devānāṃ tasmād vai puṣṭivardhanaḥ ||
meaning:
विष्णोः पितामहस्यापि मुनीनां च महामुने |
इन्द्रियाणां च देवानां तस्माद् वै पुष्टिवर्धनः ||
text_mt: and of Viṣṇu, of the Grandfather, and of the sages, O great sage, / and of the senses and the gods; therefore, indeed, he increases nourishment.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ devamamṛtaṃ rudraṃ karmaṇā tapasāpi vā |
svādhyāyena ca yogena dhyānena ca prajāyate ||
meaning:
तं देवममृतं रुद्रं कर्मणा तपसापि वा |
स्वाध्यायेन च योगेन ध्यानेन च प्रजायते ||
text_mt: That immortal god Rudra is attained by action or by austerity, / by private Vedic study, by yoga, and by meditation;

sanskrit_iast:
satyenānyena sūkṣmāgrānmṛtyupāśādbhavaḥ svayam |
bandhamokṣakaro yasmādurvārukamiva prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
सत्येनान्येन सूक्ष्माग्रान्मृत्युपाशाद्भवः स्वयम् |
बन्धमोक्षकरो यस्मादुर्वारुकमिव प्रभुः ||
text_mt: by truth, and through no other means, Bhava himself frees one from the bonds / of the subtle edge of death's fetters, as a sovereign frees a cucumber [from its stalk]."

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtasañjīvanīmantro mama sarvottamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
evaṃ japaparaḥ prītyā niyamena śivaṃ smaran ||
meaning:
मृतसञ्जीवनीमन्त्रो मम सर्वोत्तमः स्मृतः |
एवं जपपरः प्रीत्या नियमेन शिवं स्मरन् ||
text_mt: This Mṛtasañjīvanī mantra is considered my greatest; / one who is thus devoted to reciting it, remembering Śiva with love according to the rules,

sanskrit_iast:
japtvā hutvābhimantryaivaṃ jalaṃ piba divāniśam |
śivasya sannidhau dhyātvā nāsti mṛtyubhayaṃ kvacit ||
meaning:
जप्त्वा हुत्वाभिमन्त्र्यैवं जलं पिब दिवानिशम् |
शिवस्य सन्निधौ ध्यात्वा नास्ति मृत्युभयं क्वचित् ||
text_mt: after reciting, offering oblations, and consecrating water in this way, should drink it day and night; / meditating in the presence of Śiva, there is no fear of death anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā nyāsādikaṃ sarvaṃ sampūjya vidhivacchivam |
saṃvidhāyedaṃ nirvyagraḥ śaṅkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam ||
meaning:
कृत्वा न्यासादिकं सर्वं सम्पूज्य विधिवच्छिवम् |
संविधायेदं निर्व्यग्रः शङ्करं भक्तवत्सलम् ||
text_mt: Having performed all the ritual placements and the rest, having worshipped Śiva according to the rules, / and having arranged this without distraction, [one should worship] Śaṅkara, affectionate toward devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānamasya pravakṣyāmi yathā dhyātvā japenmanum |
siddhamantro bhaveddhīmān yāvacchambhuprabhāvataḥ ||
meaning:
ध्यानमस्य प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा ध्यात्वा जपेन्मनुम् |
सिद्धमन्त्रो भवेद्धीमान् यावच्छम्भुप्रभावतः ||
text_mt: I shall declare his meditation, meditating on which a wise man should recite the mantra / until, by the power of Śambhu, he becomes accomplished in the mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
hastāmbhojayugasthakumbhayugalāduddhṛtya toyaṃ śiraḥ siñcantaṃ karayoryugena dadhataṃ svāṅke sakumbhau karau |
akṣasraṅmṛgahastamambujagataṃ mūrdhasthacandrasravat-pīyūṣārdratanuṃ bhaje sagirijaṃ tryakṣaṃ ca mṛtyuñjayam ||
meaning:
हस्ताम्भोजयुगस्थकुम्भयुगलादुद्धृत्य तोयं शिरः सिञ्चन्तं करयोर्युगेन दधतं स्वाङ्के सकुम्भौ करौ |
अक्षस्रङ्मृगहस्तमम्बुजगतं मूर्धस्थचन्द्रस्रवत्-पीयूषार्द्रतनुं भजे सगिरिजं त्र्यक्षं च मृत्युञ्जयम् ||
text_mt: "I worship the three-eyed conqueror of death, together with the daughter of the mountain, / who with a pair of hands sprinkles his head with water drawn from a pair of jars held in his lotus hands, whose hands rest on his lap holding the jars, / who holds a rosary and a deer, seated on a lotus, his body moistened with nectar flowing from the moon on his crest."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
upadiśyeti śukraḥ taṃ dadhīciṃ munisattamam |
svasthānamagamattāta saṃsmaran śaṅkaraṃ prabhum ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
उपदिश्येति शुक्रः तं दधीचिं मुनिसत्तमम् |
स्वस्थानमगमत्तात संस्मरन् शङ्करं प्रभुम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having thus instructed that Dadhīca, the best of sages, / Śukra went to his own abode, my dear, constantly remembering the lord Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dadhīco hi mahāmuniḥ |
vanaṃ jagāma tapase mahāprītyā śivaṃ smaran ||
meaning:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दधीचो हि महामुनिः |
वनं जगाम तपसे महाप्रीत्या शिवं स्मरन् ||
text_mt: Hearing those words of his, the great sage Dadhīca / went to the forest for austerity, remembering Śiva with great love.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā vidhānena mahāmṛtyuñjayābhidham |
taṃ manuṃ prajapan prītyā tapastepe śivaṃ smaran ||
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा विधानेन महामृत्युञ्जयाभिधम् |
तं मनुं प्रजपन् प्रीत्या तपस्तेपे शिवं स्मरन् ||
text_mt: Going there in accordance with rule, properly chanting that mantra / called the Mahāmṛtyuñjaya, he performed austerity, remembering Śiva with love.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmanuṃ suciraṃ japtvā tapasārādhya śaṅkaram |
śivaṃ santoṣayāmāsa mahāmṛtyuñjayaṃ hi saḥ ||
meaning:
तन्मनुं सुचिरं जप्त्वा तपसाराध्य शङ्करम् |
शिवं सन्तोषयामास महामृत्युञ्जयं हि सः ||
text_mt: Having chanted that mantra for a very long time, propitiating Śaṅkara through austerity, / he indeed pleased Śiva, the Great Conqueror of Death (Mahāmṛtyuñjaya).

sanskrit_iast:
atha śambhuḥ prasannātmā tajjapādbhaktavatsalaḥ |
āvirbabhūva puratastasya prītyā mahāmune ||
meaning:
अथ शम्भुः प्रसन्नात्मा तज्जपाद्भक्तवत्सलः |
आविर्बभूव पुरतस्तस्य प्रीत्या महामुने ||
text_mt: Then Śambhu, gracious in spirit, affectionate toward devotees, / appeared before him with affection because of his recitation, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā svaprabhuṃ śambhuṃ sa mumoda munīśvaraḥ |
praṇamya vidhivadbhaktyā tuṣṭāva sukṛtāñjaliḥ ||
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा स्वप्रभुं शम्भुं स मुमोद मुनीश्वरः |
प्रणम्य विधिवद्भक्त्या तुष्टाव सुकृताञ्जलिः ||
text_mt: Seeing his own lord Śambhu, that foremost of sages rejoiced; / bowing down with devotion according to rule, his hands folded, he praised him.

sanskrit_iast:
atha prītyā śivastāta prasannaścyāvaniṃ mune |
varaṃ brūhīti sa prāha suprasannena cetasā ||
meaning:
अथ प्रीत्या शिवस्तात प्रसन्नश्च्यावनिं मुने |
वरं ब्रूहीति स प्राह सुप्रसन्नेन चेतसा ||
text_mt: Then with love, my dear, Śiva, pleased, said to Cyavana's son, / O sage, with an exceedingly gracious mind: 'Choose a boon!'

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā śambhuvacanaṃ dadhīco bhaktasattamaḥ |
sāñjalirnatakaḥ prāha śaṅkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा शम्भुवचनं दधीचो भक्तसत्तमः |
साञ्जलिर्नतकः प्राह शङ्करं भक्तवत्सलम् ||
text_mt: Hearing that speech of Śambhu, Dadhīca, best of devotees, / bowing his head with folded hands, spoke to Śaṅkara, who is affectionate toward devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīca uvāca |
devadeva mahādeva mahyaṃ dehi varatrayam |
vajrāsthitvamavadhyatvamadīnatvaṃ hi sarvataḥ ||
meaning:
दधीच उवाच |
देवदेव महादेव मह्यं देहि वरत्रयम् |
वज्रास्थित्वमवध्यत्वमदीनत्वं हि सर्वतः ||
text_mt: Dadhīca said: / 'O God of gods, O Mahādeva, grant me three boons: / having bones like adamantine vajra, invulnerability to death, and freedom from depression everywhere.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
taduktavacanaṃ śrutvā prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
varatrayaṃ dadau tasmai dadhīcāya tathāstviti ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
तदुक्तवचनं श्रुत्वा प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः |
वरत्रयं ददौ तस्मै दधीचाय तथास्त्विति ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing the words he spoke, the pleased Parameśvara / granted those three boons to Dadhīca, saying, 'So be it.'

sanskrit_iast:
varatrayaṃ śivātprāpya sānandaśca mahāmuniḥ |
kṣuvasthānaṃ jagāmāśu vedamārge pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
meaning:
वरत्रयं शिवात्प्राप्य सानन्दश्च महामुनिः |
क्षुवस्थानं जगामाशु वेदमार्गे प्रतिष्ठितः ||
text_mt: Having obtained the three boons from Śiva, the great sage, filled with joy / and established in the Vedic path, quickly went to Kṣuva's abode.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpyāvadhyatvamugrātsa vajrāsthitvamadīnatām |
atāḍayacca rājendraṃ pādamūlena mūrdhani ||
meaning:
प्राप्यावध्यत्वमुग्रात्स वज्रास्थित्वमदीनताम् |
अताडयच्च राजेन्द्रं पादमूलेन मूर्धनि ||
text_mt: Having obtained invulnerability to death from the fierce god, bones like vajra, and freedom from dejection, / he struck the lord of kings on the head with the sole of his foot.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣuvo dadhīcaṃ vajreṇa jaghānorasyatho nṛpaḥ |
krodhaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa viṣṇugauravagarvitaḥ ||
meaning:
क्षुवो दधीचं वज्रेण जघानोरस्यथो नृपः |
क्रोधं कृत्वा विशेषेण विष्णुगौरवगर्वितः ||
text_mt: Then King Kṣuva struck Dadhīca on the chest with a vajra, / having become exceedingly angry and arrogant with pride in Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhūnnāśāya tadvajraṃ dadhīcasya mahātmanaḥ |
prabhāvātparameśasya dhātṛputro visismiye ||
meaning:
नाभून्नाशाय तद्वज्रं दधीचस्य महात्मनः |
प्रभावात्परमेशस्य धातृपुत्रो विसिस्मिये ||
text_mt: That vajra did not lead to the destruction of the noble Dadhīca; / through the power of Parameśa, the son of the Creator was astonished.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvāpyavadhyatvamadīnatāṃ ca vajrasya cātyantaparaprabhāvam |
kṣuvo dadhīcasya munīśvarasya visismiye cetasi dhātṛputraḥ ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वाप्यवध्यत्वमदीनतां च वज्रस्य चात्यन्तपरप्रभावम् |
क्षुवो दधीचस्य मुनीश्वरस्य विसिस्मिये चेतसि धातृपुत्रः ||
text_mt: Having seen his invulnerability to death, his freedom from dejection, and the vajra's utter failure of supreme power, / Kṣuva, the son of the Creator, was astonished in his mind at Dadhīca, the foremost of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhayāmāsa hariṃ mukunda-mindrānujaṃ kānanamāśu gatvā |
prapannapālaśca parājito hi dadhīcamṛtyuñjayasevakena ||
meaning:
आराधयामास हरिं मुकुन्द-मिन्द्रानुजं काननमाशु गत्वा |
प्रपन्नपालश्च पराजितो हि दधीचमृत्युञ्जयसेवकेन ||
text_mt: Going swiftly to the forest, he propitiated Hari, Mukunda, / Indra's younger brother, the protector of the surrendered, having indeed been defeated by the servant of Mṛtyuñjaya, Dadhīca.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayā tasya santuṣṭo bhagavān madhusūdanaḥ |
pradadau darśanaṃ tasmai divyaṃ vai garuḍadhvajaḥ ||
meaning:
पूजया तस्य सन्तुष्टो भगवान् मधुसूदनः |
प्रददौ दर्शनं तस्मै दिव्यं वै गरुडध्वजः ||
text_mt: Satisfied with his worship, the blessed slayer of Madhu, / having Garuḍa on his banner, granted him a divine vision of himself.

sanskrit_iast:
divyena darśanenaiva dṛṣṭvā devaṃ janārdanam |
tuṣṭāva vāgbhiriṣṭābhiḥ praṇamya garuḍadhvajam ||
meaning:
दिव्येन दर्शनेनैव दृष्ट्वा देवं जनार्दनम् |
तुष्टाव वाग्भिरिष्टाभिः प्रणम्य गरुडध्वजम् ||
text_mt: Having seen the divine Janārdana through that divine vision, / he bowed to him whose banner bears Garuḍa and praised him with chosen words.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjya caivaṃ tridaśeśvarādyaiḥ stutvā stutaṃ devamajeyamīśam |
vijñāpayāmāsa nirīkṣya bhaktyā janārdanāya praṇipatya mūrdhnā ||
meaning:
सम्पूज्य चैवं त्रिदशेश्वराद्यैः स्तुत्वा स्तुतं देवमजेयमीशम् |
विज्ञापयामास निरीक्ष्य भक्त्या जनार्दनाय प्रणिपत्य मूर्ध्ना ||
text_mt: Having thus worshipped and praised the invincible lord, who is praised by Indra and the other gods, / he looked upon him with devotion, prostrated with his head to Janārdana, and addressed him:

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca |
bhagavan brāhmaṇaḥ kaściddadhīca iti viśrutaḥ |
dharmavettā vinītātmā sakhā mama purābhavat ||
meaning:
राजोवाच |
भगवन् ब्राह्मणः कश्चिद्दधीच इति विश्रुतः |
धर्मवेत्ता विनीतात्मा सखा मम पुराभवत् ||
text_mt: The king said: / 'O Lord, a certain brāhmaṇa known as Dadhīca, / a knower of dharma and disciplined in mind, was formerly my friend.

sanskrit_iast:
avadhyaḥ sarvadā sarvaiḥ śaṅkarasya prabhāvataḥ |
tamārādhya mahādevaṃ mṛtyuñjayamanāmayam ||
meaning:
अवध्यः सर्वदा सर्वैः शङ्करस्य प्रभावतः |
तमाराध्य महादेवं मृत्युञ्जयमनामयम् ||
text_mt: He is always invulnerable to death by anyone through the power of Śaṅkara, / having propitiated that Mahādeva, the conqueror of death, the flawless one.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvajñaṃ vāmapādena mama mūrdhni sadasyapi |
tāḍayāmāsa vegena sa dadhīco mahātapāḥ ||
meaning:
सावज्ञं वामपादेन मम मूर्ध्नि सदस्यपि |
ताडयामास वेगेन स दधीचो महातपाः ||
text_mt: Contemptuously with his left foot, even in the assembly, / that Dadhīca of great austerities struck my head with force.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca māṃ ca garveṇa na bibhemīti sarvataḥ |
mṛtyuñjayāptasuvaro garvito hyatulaṃ hare ||
meaning:
उवाच मां च गर्वेण न बिभेमीति सर्वतः |
मृत्युञ्जयाप्तसुवरो गर्वितो ह्यतुलं हरे ||
text_mt: And with pride he said to me: “I have no fear from any quarter!” / Having obtained excellent boons from Mṛtyuñjaya, he is matchlessly haughty, O Hari.'

sanskrit_iast:
atha jñātvā dadhīcasya hyavadhyatvaṃ mahātmanaḥ |
sasmārāsya maheśasya prabhāvamatulaṃ hariḥ ||
meaning:
अथ ज्ञात्वा दधीचस्य ह्यवध्यत्वं महात्मनः |
सस्मारास्य महेशस्य प्रभावमतुलं हरिः ||
text_mt: Then, having learned of the noble Dadhīca's invulnerability to death, / Hari remembered the peerless power of this Maheśa.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ smṛtvā hariḥ prāha kṣuvaṃ vidhisutaṃ drutam |
viprāṇāṃ nāsti rājendra bhayamaṇvapi kutracit ||
meaning:
एवं स्मृत्वा हरिः प्राह क्षुवं विधिसुतं द्रुतम् |
विप्राणां नास्ति राजेन्द्र भयमण्वपि कुत्रचित् ||
text_mt: Remembering this, Hari quickly said to Kṣuva, the son of the Creator: / 'O lord of kings, brāhmaṇas have not the slightest fear anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣād rudrabhaktānāṃ bhayaṃ nāsti ca bhūpate |
duḥkhaṃ karoti viprasya śāpārthaṃ sa surasya me ||
meaning:
विशेषाद् रुद्रभक्तानां भयं नास्ति च भूपते |
दुःखं करोति विप्रस्य शापार्थं स सुरस्य मे ||
text_mt: Especially devotees of Rudra have no fear, O ruler of the earth. / If one brings grief to a brāhmaṇa, he utters a curse even against me, a god.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavitā tasya śāpena dakṣayajñe sureśvarāt |
vināśo mama rājendra punarutthānameva ca ||
meaning:
भविता तस्य शापेन दक्षयज्ञे सुरेश्वरात् |
विनाशो मम राजेन्द्र पुनरुत्थानमेव च ||
text_mt: By his curse, at the sacrifice of Dakṣa, there will be my destruction / by the lord of the gods, O lord of kings, and then my rising up again.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsametya rājendra sarvayajño na bhūyate |
karomi yatnaṃ rājendra dadhīcavijayāya te ||
meaning:
तस्मात्समेत्य राजेन्द्र सर्वयज्ञो न भूयते |
करोमि यत्नं राजेन्द्र दधीचविजयाय ते ||
text_mt: Therefore, even if all sacrifices were united, O lord of kings, it would not happen; / [yet] I will make an effort, O lord of kings, for your victory over Dadhīca.'

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā vākyaṃ kṣuvaḥ prāha tathāstviti harernṛpaḥ |
tasthau tatraiva tatprītyā tatkāmotsukamānasaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ satīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
श्रुत्वा वाक्यं क्षुवः प्राह तथास्त्विति हरेर्नृपः |
तस्थौ तत्रैव तत्प्रीत्या तत्कामोत्सुकमानसः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां द्वितीयः सतीखण्डे
text_mt:
Hearing Hari's speech, King Kṣuva said, 'So be it,' / and stayed right there out of love for him, his mind eager for that desired end.

Thus ends the thirty-eighth chapter, called 'The Description of the Dispute Between Kṣuva and Dadhīca,' in the Satī section, the second [part] of the Rudrasaṃhitā, in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
kṣuvasya hitakṛtyena dadhīcasyāśramaṃ yayau |
viprarūpamathāsthāya bhagavān bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
क्षुवस्य हितकृत्येन दधीचस्याश्रमं ययौ |
विप्ररूपमथास्थाय भगवान् भक्तवत्सलः ||
title: ekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | viṣṇudadhīcayuddhavarṇanam
text_mt: Brahmā said: / For the sake of Kṣuva's welfare, the Blessed One, affectionate toward devotees, / assumed the form of a brāhmaṇa and went to Dadhīca's hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīcaṃ prāha viprarṣimabhivandya jagadguruḥ |
kṣuvakāryārthamudyuktaḥ śaivendraṃ chalamāśritaḥ ||
meaning:
दधीचं प्राह विप्रर्षिमभिवन्द्य जगद्गुरुः |
क्षुवकार्यार्थमुद्युक्तः शैवेन्द्रं छलमाश्रितः ||
text_mt: The teacher of the universe, dedicated to Kṣuva's purpose, / bowed to Dadhīca, the brāhmaṇa-sage, and addressed the foremost of Śaivas, resorting to deceit.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca |
bho bho dadhīca viprarṣe bhavārcanaratāvyaya |
varamekaṃ vṛṇe tvattastadbhavān dātumarhati ||
brahmovāca |
yācito devadevena dadhīcaḥ śaivasattamaḥ ||
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच |
भो भो दधीच विप्रर्षे भवार्चनरताव्यय |
वरमेकं वृणे त्वत्तस्तद्भवान् दातुमर्हति ||
ब्रह्मोवाच |
याचितो देवदेवेन दधीचः शैवसत्तमः ||
text_mt:
Viṣṇu said: / 'O Dadhīca, O brāhmaṇa-sage, imperishable one devoted to worshipping Bhava, / I ask one boon from you; you ought to grant it.'

Brahmā said: / When Dadhīca, the best of Śaivas, was thus petitioned / by the God of gods who sought to accomplish Kṣuva's purpose,

sanskrit_iast: kṣuvakāryārthinā śīghraṃ jagāda vacanaṃ harim ||
meaning: क्षुवकार्यार्थिना शीघ्रं जगाद वचनं हरिम् ||
text_mt: he quickly spoke these words to Hari:

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīca uvāca |
jñātaṃ tavepsitaṃ vipra kṣuvakāryārthamāgataḥ |
bhagavān viprarūpeṇa māyī tvamasi vai hariḥ ||
meaning:
दधीच उवाच |
ज्ञातं तवेप्सितं विप्र क्षुवकार्यार्थमागतः |
भगवान् विप्ररूपेण मायी त्वमसि वै हरिः ||
text_mt: Dadhīca said: / 'What you desire is known, O brāhmaṇa. You have come for Kṣuva's sake. / In the form of a brāhmaṇa, you are indeed the Blessed One, the illusory Hari!

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ deveśa vartamānaṃ janārdana |
jñānaṃ prasādād rudrasya sadā traikālikaṃ mama ||
meaning:
भूतं भविष्यं देवेश वर्तमानं जनार्दन |
ज्ञानं प्रसादाद् रुद्रस्य सदा त्रैकालिकं मम ||
text_mt: O God of gods, O Janārdana, through the grace of Rudra / my knowledge of the past, the future, and the present is ever threefold in time.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ jāne'haṃ hariṃ viṣṇuṃ dvijatvaṃ tyaja suvrata |
ārādhito'si bhūpena kṣuveṇa khalabuddhinā ||
meaning:
त्वां जानेऽहं हरिं विष्णुं द्विजत्वं त्यज सुव्रत |
आराधितोऽसि भूपेन क्षुवेण खलबुद्धिना ||
text_mt: I know you are Hari, Viṣṇu! Cast aside your disguise as a brāhmaṇa, O you of good vows! / You have been propitiated by King Kṣuva of wicked mind.

sanskrit_iast:
jāne tavaiva bhagavan bhaktavatsalatāṃ hare |
chalaṃ tyaja svarūpaṃ hi svīkuru smara śaṅkaram ||
meaning:
जाने तवैव भगवन् भक्तवत्सलतां हरे |
छलं त्यज स्वरूपं हि स्वीकुरु स्मर शङ्करम् ||
text_mt: I know your affection toward devotees, O Lord, O Hari. / Cast off deceit, assume your own form, and remember Śaṅkara!

sanskrit_iast:
asti cetkasyacidbhītirbhavārcanaratasya me |
vaktumarhasi yatnena satyadhāraṇapūrvakam ||
meaning:
अस्ति चेत्कस्यचिद्भीतिर्भवार्चनरतस्य मे |
वक्तुमर्हसि यत्नेन सत्यधारणपूर्वकम् ||
text_mt: If I, devoted to the worship of Bhava, have fear of anyone, / you ought to say so carefully, holding to truth.

sanskrit_iast:
vadāmi na mṛṣā kvāpi śivasmaraṇasaktadhīḥ |
na bibhemi jagatyasmindevadaityādikādapi ||
meaning:
वदामि न मृषा क्वापि शिवस्मरणसक्तधीः |
न बिभेमि जगत्यस्मिन्देवदैत्यादिकादपि ||
text_mt: With my mind attached to remembering Śiva, I never speak falsely: / I do not fear anything in this world, even gods and demons!'

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca |
bhayaṃ dadhīca sarvatra naṣṭaṃ ca tava suvrata |
bhavārcanarato yasmādbhavānsarvajña eva ca ||
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच |
भयं दधीच सर्वत्र नष्टं च तव सुव्रत |
भवार्चनरतो यस्माद्भवान्सर्वज्ञ एव च ||
text_mt: Viṣṇu said: / 'Fear has indeed vanished everywhere for you, Dadhīca, O you of good vows, / because you are devoted to the worship of Bhava and are all-knowing.

sanskrit_iast:
bibhemīti sakṛdvaktumarhasi tvaṃ namastava |
niyogānmama rājendra kṣuvāt pratisahādaham ||
meaning:
बिभेमीति सकृद्वक्तुमर्हसि त्वं नमस्तव |
नियोगान्मम राजेन्द्र क्षुवात् प्रतिसहादहम् ||
text_mt: You ought to say “I am afraid” just once—salutations to you!— / at my command, O foremost of kings, so that I can face Kṣuva.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
evaṃ śrutvāpi tadvākyaṃ viṣṇoḥ sa tu mahāmuniḥ |
vihasya nirbhayaḥ prāha dadhīcaḥ śaivasattamaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एवं श्रुत्वापि तद्वाक्यं विष्णोः स तु महामुनिः |
विहस्य निर्भयः प्राह दधीचः शैवसत्तमः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing that speech of Viṣṇu, that great sage, / Dadhīca, best of Śaivas, laughed and fearlessly replied:

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīca uvāca |
na bibhemi sadā kvāpi kutaścidapi kiñcana |
prabhāvāddevadevasya śambhoḥ sākṣātpinākinaḥ ||
meaning:
दधीच उवाच |
न बिभेमि सदा क्वापि कुतश्चिदपि किञ्चन |
प्रभावाद्देवदेवस्य शम्भोः साक्षात्पिनाकिनः ||
text_mt: Dadhīca said: / 'I am never afraid, anywhere, of anything whatsoever, / through the power of the God of gods, Śambhu himself, who bears the Pināka.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
tatastasya muneḥ śrutvā vacanaṃ kupito hariḥ |
cakramudyamya santasthau didhakṣurmunisattamam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
ततस्तस्य मुनेः श्रुत्वा वचनं कुपितो हरिः |
चक्रमुद्यम्य सन्तस्थौ दिधक्षुर्मुनिसत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing the speech of that sage, Hari became enraged; / raising his discus, he stood ready, desiring to burn the foremost of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
abhavatkuṇṭhitaṃ tatra vipre cakraṃ sudāruṇam |
prabhāvācca tadīśasya nṛpateḥ sannidhāvapi ||
meaning:
अभवत्कुण्ठितं तत्र विप्रे चक्रं सुदारुणम् |
प्रभावाच्च तदीशस्य नृपतेः सन्निधावपि ||
text_mt: The terrifying discus became blunted against the Brahmin there, / and through the power of his Lord, even in the presence of the king.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ kuṇṭhitāsyaṃ taccakraṃ viṣṇuṃ jagāda ha |
dadhīcaḥ sasmitaṃ sākṣātsadasadvyaktikāraṇam ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तं कुण्ठितास्यं तच्चक्रं विष्णुं जगाद ह |
दधीचः सस्मितं साक्षात्सदसद्व्यक्तिकारणम् ||
text_mt: Seeing that discus with its edge blunted, Dadhīca, / the cause of revealing the real and the unreal, smiled and addressed Viṣṇu in person:

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīca uvāca |
bhagavan bhavatā labdhaṃ purātīva sudāruṇam |
sudarśanamiti khyātaṃ cakraṃ viṣṇoḥ prayatnataḥ |
bhavasya tacchubhaṃ cakraṃ na jighāṃsati māmiha ||
meaning:
दधीच उवाच |
भगवन् भवता लब्धं पुरातीव सुदारुणम् |
सुदर्शनमिति ख्यातं चक्रं विष्णोः प्रयत्नतः |
भवस्य तच्छुभं चक्रं न जिघांसति मामिह ||
text_mt: Dadhīca said: / 'O lord, that very terrible discus renowned as Sudarśana / was formerly obtained by you, Viṣṇu, with great effort. / That auspicious discus belonging to Bhava does not wish to slay me here.'

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānatha kruddho'smai sarvāstrāṇi kramāddhariḥ |
brahmāstrādyaiḥ śaraiścāstraiḥ prayatnaṃ kartumarhasi ||
meaning:
भगवानथ क्रुद्धोऽस्मै सर्वास्त्राणि क्रमाद्धरिः |
ब्रह्मास्त्राद्यैः शरैश्चास्त्रैः प्रयत्नं कर्तुमर्हसि ||
text_mt: [Viṣṇu thought:] 'Now the lord Hari is enraged at him with all his weapons in succession; / you ought to make an effort with arrows and weapons beginning with the Brahmāstra.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
sa tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā nirvīryamānuṣam |
sasarjātha krudhā tasmai sarvāstrāṇi kramāddhariḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
स तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा निर्वीर्यमानुषम् |
ससर्जाथ क्रुधा तस्मै सर्वास्त्राणि क्रमाद्धरिः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing his words and seeing him as a powerless mortal, / Hari then in anger discharged all his weapons against him in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrurdevāstatastasya viṣṇoḥsāhāyyamādarāt |
dvijenaikena saṃyoddhuṃ prasṛtasya vibuddhayaḥ ||
meaning:
चक्रुर्देवास्ततस्तस्य विष्णोःसाहाय्यमादरात् |
द्विजेनैकेन संयोद्धुं प्रसृतस्य विबुद्धयः ||
text_mt: Then the gods, having no sense, eagerly gave assistance / to that Viṣṇu who advanced to fight with a single twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
cikṣipuḥ svāni svānyāśu śastrāṇyastrāṇi sarvataḥ |
dadhīcopari vegena śakrādyā haripākṣikāḥ ||
meaning:
चिक्षिपुः स्वानि स्वान्याशु शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि सर्वतः |
दधीचोपरि वेगेन शक्राद्या हरिपाक्षिकाः ||
text_mt: The gods headed by Śakra, siding with Hari, swiftly hurled their own / arms and missiles from all sides upon Dadhīca with great speed.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśamuṣṭimathādāya dadhīcaḥ saṃsmaran śivam |
sasarja sarvadevebhyo vajrāsthiḥ sarvato vaśī ||
meaning:
कुशमुष्टिमथादाय दधीचः संस्मरन् शिवम् |
ससर्ज सर्वदेवेभ्यो वज्रास्थिः सर्वतो वशी ||
text_mt: Then, taking a handful of kuśa grass and remembering Śiva, / Dadhīca, whose bones were adamantine and who was self-controlled, hurled it all around at all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkarasya prabhāvāttu kuśamuṣṭirmunerhi sā |
divyaṃ triśūlamabhavat kālāgnisadṛśaṃ mune ||
meaning:
शङ्करस्य प्रभावात्तु कुशमुष्टिर्मुनेर्हि सा |
दिव्यं त्रिशूलमभवत् कालाग्निसदृशं मुने ||
text_mt: Through the power of Śaṅkara, O sage, that handful of kuśa grass belonging to the sage / became a divine trident, resembling the fire of cosmic dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhuṃ devān matiṃ cakre sāyudhān saśikhaṃ ca tat |
prajvalatsarvataḥ śaivaṃ yugāntāgnyadhikaprabham ||
meaning:
दग्धुं देवान् मतिं चक्रे सायुधान् सशिखं च तत् |
प्रज्वलत्सर्वतः शैवं युगान्ताग्न्यधिकप्रभम् ||
text_mt: Flaming on all sides with splendor greater than the fire at the end of the age, / that trident of Śiva, along with its points, resolved to burn the gods together with their weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇendramukhyaistu devaiḥ kṣiptāni yāni ca |
āyudhāni samastāni praṇemustriśikhaṃ ca tat ||
meaning:
नारायणेन्द्रमुख्यैस्तु देवैः क्षिप्तानि यानि च |
आयुधानि समस्तानि प्रणेमुस्त्रिशिखं च तत् ||
text_mt: All the weapons that were hurled by the gods, / headed by Nārāyaṇa and Indra, bowed down before that three-pronged [trident].

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca dudruvuḥ sarve dhvastavīryā divaukasaḥ |
tasthau tatra harirbhītaḥ kevalaṃ māyināṃ varaḥ ||
meaning:
देवाश्च दुद्रुवुः सर्वे ध्वस्तवीर्या दिवौकसः |
तस्थौ तत्र हरिर्भीतः केवलं मायिनां वरः ||
text_mt: And all the gods, the dwellers of heaven, fled, their valor shattered. / Only Hari, the best of illusionists, stood there terrified.

sanskrit_iast:
sasarja bhagavān viṣṇuḥ svadehātpuruṣottamaḥ |
ātmanaḥ sadṛśān divyān lakṣalakṣāyutān gaṇān ||
meaning:
ससर्ज भगवान् विष्णुः स्वदेहात्पुरुषोत्तमः |
आत्मनः सदृशान् दिव्यान् लक्षलक्षायुतान् गणान् ||
text_mt: Lord Viṣṇu, the Supreme Person, produced from his own body / divine hosts resembling himself by hundreds of thousands and tens of thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
te cāpi yuyudhustatra vīrā viṣṇugaṇāstataḥ |
muninaikena devarṣe dadhīcena śivātmanā ||
meaning:
ते चापि युयुधुस्तत्र वीरा विष्णुगणास्ततः |
मुनिनैकेन देवर्षे दधीचेन शिवात्मना ||
text_mt: And then those heroic attendants of Viṣṇu fought there, / O divine sage, against a single sage, Dadhīca, whose essence was Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tato viṣṇugaṇāṃstānvai niyudhya bahuśo raṇe |
dadāha sahasā sarvān dadhīcaḥ śaivasattamaḥ ||
meaning:
ततो विष्णुगणांस्तान्वै नियुध्य बहुशो रणे |
ददाह सहसा सर्वान् दधीचः शैवसत्तमः ||
text_mt: Having fought repeatedly in battle, Dadhīca, the best of Śaivas, / then instantly burned all those attendants of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastadvismayārthāya dadhīcasya munerhariḥ |
viśvamūrtirabhūcchīghraṃ mahāmāyāviśāradaḥ ||
meaning:
ततस्तद्विस्मयार्थाय दधीचस्य मुनेर्हरिः |
विश्वमूर्तिरभूच्छीघ्रं महामायाविशारदः ||
text_mt: Then, to astonish that sage Dadhīca, Hari, / who is skilled in great illusion, quickly assumed his universal form.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya dehe hareḥ sākṣādapaśyad dvijasattamaḥ |
dadhīco devatādīnāṃ jīvānāṃ ca sahasrakam ||
meaning:
तस्य देहे हरेः साक्षादपश्यद् द्विजसत्तमः |
दधीचो देवतादीनां जीवानां च सहस्रकम् ||
text_mt: In that body of Hari, Dadhīca, the best of the twice-born, / directly saw thousands of living beings beginning with the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtānāṃ koṭayaścaiva gaṇānāṃ koṭayastathā |
aṇḍānāṃ koṭayaścaiva viśvamūrtestanau tadā ||
meaning:
भूतानां कोटयश्चैव गणानां कोटयस्तथा |
अण्डानां कोटयश्चैव विश्वमूर्तेस्तनौ तदा ||
text_mt: and crores of beings, crores of attendants, / and crores of cosmic eggs in the body of the Universal Form at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvaitadakhilaṃ tatra cyāvaniḥ satataṃ tadā |
viṣṇumāha jagannāthaṃ jagatstavamajaṃ vibhum ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वैतदखिलं तत्र च्यावनिः सततं तदा |
विष्णुमाह जगन्नाथं जगत्स्तवमजं विभुम् ||
text_mt: Seeing all this there, the son of Cyavana then constantly / addressed Viṣṇu, the lord of the universe, who is praised by the world, unborn, and all-pervading.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīca uvāca |
māyāṃ tyaja mahābāho pratibhāso vicārataḥ |
vijñātāni sahasrāṇi durvijñeyāni mādhava ||
meaning:
दधीच उवाच |
मायां त्यज महाबाहो प्रतिभासो विचारतः |
विज्ञातानि सहस्राणि दुर्विज्ञेयानि माधव ||
text_mt: Dadhīca said: / 'Cast off your illusion, O mighty-armed one! It is an appearance upon inquiry; / thousands [of things] that are difficult to comprehend have been known [by me], O Mādhava!

sanskrit_iast:
mayi paśya jagatsarvaṃ tvayā yuktamatandritaḥ |
brahmāṇaṃ ca tathā rudraṃ divyāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ dadāmi te ||
meaning:
मयि पश्य जगत्सर्वं त्वया युक्तमतन्द्रितः |
ब्रह्माणं च तथा रुद्रं दिव्यां दृष्टिं ददामि ते ||
text_mt: Look upon the entire universe within me, united with you, without sloth, / as well as Brahmā and Rudra; I grant you divine vision!'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityuktvā darśayāmāsa svatanau nikhilaṃ muniḥ |
brahmāṇḍaṃ cyāvaniḥ śambhutejasā pūrṇadehakaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा दर्शयामास स्वतनौ निखिलं मुनिः |
ब्रह्माण्डं च्यावनिः शम्भुतेजसा पूर्णदेहकः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus, the sage, the son of Cyavana, whose body was filled with the fiery energy of Śambhu, / showed the entire universe within his own body.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāha viṣṇuṃ deveśaṃ dadhīcaḥ śaivasattamaḥ |
saṃsmaran śaṅkaraṃ citte vihasan vibhayaḥ sudhīḥ ||
meaning:
तदाह विष्णुं देवेशं दधीचः शैवसत्तमः |
संस्मरन् शङ्करं चित्ते विहसन् विभयः सुधीः ||
text_mt: Then Dadhīca, the best of Śaivas, remembering Śaṅkara in his heart, / smiling, fearless, and wise, spoke to Viṣṇu, the lord of the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīca uvāca |
māyayā tvanayā kiṃ vā mantraśaktyātha vā hare |
satkāmanāmimāṃ kṛtvā yoddhumarhasi yatnataḥ ||
meaning:
दधीच उवाच |
मायया त्वनया किं वा मन्त्रशक्त्याथ वा हरे |
सत्कामनामिमां कृत्वा योद्धुमर्हसि यत्नतः ||
text_mt: Dadhīca said: / 'What is to be gained by this illusion, or by the power of mantras, O Hari? / Having made this noble desire, you ought to fight with effort.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
etacchutvā munestasya vacanaṃ nirbhayastadā |
śambhutejomayaṃ viṣṇuḥ cukopātīva taṃ munim ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एतच्छुत्वा मुनेस्तस्य वचनं निर्भयस्तदा |
शम्भुतेजोमयं विष्णुः चुकोपातीव तं मुनिम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing these fearless words of that sage at that time, / Viṣṇu became exceedingly angry with that sage who was filled with Śambhu's fiery energy.

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca dudruvurbhūyo devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ca tam |
yoddhukāmāśca muninā dadhīcena pratāpinā ||
meaning:
देवाश्च दुद्रुवुर्भूयो देवं नारायणं च तम् |
योद्धुकामाश्च मुनिना दधीचेन प्रतापिना ||
text_mt: And the gods fled once again, and that god Nārāyaṇa, / wishing to fight with the glorious sage Dadhīca, [stood ready].

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tatrāgamanmatsaṅgamaḥ kṣuvaḥ |
avārayantaṃ niśceṣṭaṃ padmayoniṃ hariṃ surān ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्रागमन्मत्सङ्गमः क्षुवः |
अवारयन्तं निश्चेष्टं पद्मयोनिं हरिं सुरान् ||
text_mt: In the meantime, Kṣuva, who was united with me, came there; / he restrained the motionless lotus-born [Brahmā], Hari, and the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
niśamya vacanaṃ me hi brāhmaṇo na vinirjitaḥ |
jagāma nikaṭaṃ tasya praṇanāma muniṃ hariḥ ||
meaning:
निशम्य वचनं मे हि ब्राह्मणो न विनिर्जितः |
जगाम निकटं तस्य प्रणनाम मुनिं हरिः ||
text_mt: Hearing my word that the Brahmin could not be conquered, / Hari approached him and bowed down to the sage.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣuvo dīnataro bhūtvā gatvā tatra munīśvaram |
dadhīcamabhivādyaiva prārthayāmāsa viklavaḥ ||
meaning:
क्षुवो दीनतरो भूत्वा गत्वा तत्र मुनीश्वरम् |
दधीचमभिवाद्यैव प्रार्थयामास विक्लवः ||
text_mt: Kṣuva, becoming most humble, went there to the lord of sages, / Dadhīca, and having saluted him, agitatedly prayed:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣuva uvāca |
prasīda muniśārdūla śivabhaktaśiromaṇe |
prasīda parameśāna durlakṣyo durjanaiḥ sadā ||
meaning:
क्षुव उवाच |
प्रसीद मुनिशार्दूल शिवभक्तशिरोमणे |
प्रसीद परमेशान दुर्लक्ष्यो दुर्जनैः सदा ||
text_mt: Kṣuva said: / 'Be gracious, O tiger among sages, O crest-jewel of Śiva's devotees! / Be gracious, O supreme lord, always difficult to be perceived by evil people!'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityākarṇya vacastasya rājñaḥ suragaṇasya hi |
anujagrāha taṃ vipro dadhīcastapasāṃ nidhiḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य राज्ञः सुरगणस्य हि |
अनुजग्राह तं विप्रो दधीचस्तपसां निधिः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing these words of that king and of the host of gods, / the Brahmin Dadhīca, a treasury of austerities, showed favor to him.

sanskrit_iast:
atha dṛṣṭvā rameśādīn krodhavihvalito muniḥ |
hṛdi smṛtvā śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaśāpa ca surānapi ||
meaning:
अथ दृष्ट्वा रमेशादीन् क्रोधविह्वलितो मुनिः |
हृदि स्मृत्वा शिवं विष्णुं शशाप च सुरानपि ||
text_mt: Then, seeing the Lord of Ramā and the others, the sage, overcome with anger, / remembered Śiva in his heart and cursed Viṣṇu and the gods as well.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīca uvāca |
rudrakopāgninā devāḥ sadevendrā munīśvarāḥ |
dhvastā bhavantu devena viṣṇunā ca samaṃ gaṇaiḥ ||
meaning:
दधीच उवाच |
रुद्रकोपाग्निना देवाः सदेवेन्द्रा मुनीश्वराः |
ध्वस्ता भवन्तु देवेन विष्णुना च समं गणैः ||
text_mt: Dadhīca said: / 'May the gods, along with the lord of gods and the lords of sages, / be destroyed by the fire of Rudra's wrath, together with the god Viṣṇu and his attendants!'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
evaṃ śaptvā surān prekṣya kṣuvamāha tato muniḥ |
devaiśca pūjyo rājendra nṛpaiścaiva dvijottamaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एवं शप्त्वा सुरान् प्रेक्ष्य क्षुवमाह ततो मुनिः |
देवैश्च पूज्यो राजेन्द्र नृपैश्चैव द्विजोत्तमः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having cursed the gods in this manner and looked at Kṣuva, the sage then said: / 'The best of the twice-born is worthy of worship by gods and by kings, O king of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇā eva rājendra balinaḥ prabhaviṣṇavaḥ |
ityuktvā sa sphuṭaṃ vipraḥ praviveśa nijāśramam ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मणा एव राजेन्द्र बलिनः प्रभविष्णवः |
इत्युक्त्वा स स्फुटं विप्रः प्रविवेश निजाश्रमम् ||
text_mt: Only Brahmins are mighty and powerful, O king of kings!' / Having spoken clearly thus, the Brahmin entered his own hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīcamabhivandyaiva kṣuvo nijagṛhaṃ gataḥ |
viṣṇurjagāma svaṃ lokaṃ suraiḥ saha yathāgatam ||
meaning:
दधीचमभिवन्द्यैव क्षुवो निजगृहं गतः |
विष्णुर्जगाम स्वं लोकं सुरैः सह यथागतम् ||
text_mt: Having saluted Dadhīca, Kṣuva went to his own home; / Viṣṇu went to his own realm along with the gods, just as he had come.

sanskrit_iast:
tadevaṃ tīrthamabhavat sthāneśvara iti smṛtam |
sthāneśvaramanuprāpya śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt ||
meaning:
तदेवं तीर्थमभवत् स्थानेश्वर इति स्मृतम् |
स्थानेश्वरमनुप्राप्य शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: In this way, that place became a sacred ford known as Sthāneśvara; / reaching Sthāneśvara, one attains communion with Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
kathitastava saṅkṣepādvādaḥ kṣuvadadhīcayoḥ |
nṛpāptaśāpayostāta brahmaviṣṇvoḥ śivaṃ vinā ||
meaning:
कथितस्तव सङ्क्षेपाद्वादः क्षुवदधीचयोः |
नृपाप्तशापयोस्तात ब्रह्मविष्ण्वोः शिवं विना ||
text_mt: The dispute between Kṣuva and Dadhīca has been told to you in brief, / O dear one, [and the dispute] between Brahmā and Viṣṇu who incurred the king's curse, devoid of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ kīrtayennityaṃ vādaṃ kṣuvadadhīcayoḥ |
jitvāpamṛtyuṃ dehānte brahmalokaṃ prayāti saḥ ||
meaning:
य इदं कीर्तयेन्नित्यं वादं क्षुवदधीचयोः |
जित्वापमृत्युं देहान्ते ब्रह्मलोकं प्रयाति सः ||
text_mt: Whoever constantly recites this dispute between Kṣuva and Dadhīca, / having conquered untimely death, goes to the world of Brahmā at the end of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
raṇe yaḥ kīrtayitvedaṃ praviśettasya sarvadā |
mṛtyubhītirbhavennaiva vijayī ca bhaviṣyati ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ satīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
रणे यः कीर्तयित्वेदं प्रविशेत्तस्य सर्वदा |
मृत्युभीतिर्भवेन्नैव विजयी च भविष्यति ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां द्वितीयः सतीखण्डे
text_mt:
For one who enters a battle having recited this, / there shall never be fear of death, and he will become victorious.

Thus ends the thirty-ninth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Battle between Viṣṇu and Dadhīca,' in the Satīkhaṇḍa, the second [part] of the Rudrasaṃhitā, in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
vidhe vidhe mahāprājña śaivatattvapradarśaka |
śrāvitā ramaṇīprāyā śivalīlā mahādbhutā ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच
विधे विधे महाप्राज्ञ शैवतत्त्वप्रदर्शक |
श्राविता रमणीप्राया शिवलीला महाद्भुता ||
title: catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | brahmādīnāṃ kailāsayātrā śivadarśanaṃ ca
text_mt: Nārada said: / 'O creator, O creator of great wisdom, revealer of the truth of Śiva, / the most delightful and most wonderful sporting of Śiva has been related [by you].

sanskrit_iast:
vīreṇa vīrabhadreṇa dakṣayajñaṃ vināśya vai |
kailāsādrau gate tāta kimabhūttadvadādhunā ||
meaning:
वीरेण वीरभद्रेण दक्षयज्ञं विनाश्य वै |
कैलासाद्रौ गते तात किमभूत्तद्वदाधुना ||
text_mt: After the heroic Vīrabhadra destroyed Dakṣa's sacrifice / and went to Mount Kailāsa, tell [me] now, dear father, what happened then?'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
atha devagaṇāḥ sarve munayaśca parājitāḥ |
rudrānīkairvibhinnāṅgā mama lokaṃ yayustadā ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
अथ देवगणाः सर्वे मुनयश्च पराजिताः |
रुद्रानीकैर्विभिन्नाङ्गा मम लोकं ययुस्तदा ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Then all the hosts of gods and sages, defeated,
their limbs shattered by Rudra's forces, went to my realm.

sanskrit_iast:
svayambhuve namaskṛtya mahyaṃ saṃstūya bhūriśaḥ |
tatsvakleśaṃ viṣeśeṇa kārtsnyenaiva nyavedayan ||
meaning:
स्वयम्भुवे नमस्कृत्य मह्यं संस्तूय भूरिशः |
तत्स्वक्लेशं विषेशेण कार्त्स्न्येनैव न्यवेदयन् ||
text_mt:
Bowing to me, the Self-born, and praising me profusely,
they reported their suffering in detail and completely.

sanskrit_iast:
tadākarṇya tato'haṃ vai putraśokena pīḍitaḥ |
acintayamativyagro dūyamānena cetasā ||
meaning:
तदाकर्ण्य ततोऽहं वै पुत्रशोकेन पीडितः |
अचिन्तयमतिव्यग्रो दूयमानेन चेतसा ||
text_mt:
Hearing that, tormented by grief for my son,
I contemplated with a burning mind, extremely agitated:

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kāryaṃ kāryamadyāśu mayā devasukhāvaham |
yena jīvatu dakṣo'sau makhaḥ pūrṇo bhavetsuraḥ ||
meaning:
किं कार्यं कार्यमद्याशु मया देवसुखावहम् |
येन जीवतु दक्षोऽसौ मखः पूर्णो भवेत्सुरः ||
text_mt:
"What deed must be done by me now to bring joy to the gods,
so that Dakṣa may live and the god's sacrifice may be completed?"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vicārya bahudhā nālabhaṃ śamahaṃ mune |
viṣṇuṃ tadā smaran bhaktyā jñānamāpa tadocitam ||
meaning:
एवं विचार्य बहुधा नालभं शमहं मुने |
विष्णुं तदा स्मरन् भक्त्या ज्ञानमाप तदोचितम् ||
text_mt:
Reflecting thus in many ways, I found no peace, O sage.
Then, remembering Viṣṇu with devotion, I attained fitting insight.

sanskrit_iast:
atha devaiśca munibhirviṣṇorlokamahaṃ gataḥ |
natvā nutvā ca vividhaiḥ stavairduḥkhaṃ nyavadeyam ||
meaning:
अथ देवैश्च मुनिभिर्विष्णोर्लोकमहं गतः |
नत्वा नुत्वा च विविधैः स्तवैर्दुःखं न्यवदेयम् ||
text_mt:
Then, with the gods and sages, I went to Viṣṇu's world;
bowing and praising him with various hymns, I reported the distress:

sanskrit_iast:
yathādhvaraḥ prapūrṇaḥ syāddeva yajñakaraśca saḥ |
sukhinaḥ syuḥ surāḥ sarve munayaśca tathā kuru ||
meaning:
यथाध्वरः प्रपूर्णः स्याद्देव यज्ञकरश्च सः |
सुखिनः स्युः सुराः सर्वे मुनयश्च तथा कुरु ||
text_mt:
"Act so that the sacrifice may be completed, O God, and the performer of the sacrifice [restored],
and all the gods and sages made happy.

sanskrit_iast:
devadeva ramānātha viṣṇo devasukhāvaha |
vayaṃ tvaccharaṇaṃ prāptāḥ sadevamunayo dhruvam ||
meaning:
देवदेव रमानाथ विष्णो देवसुखावह |
वयं त्वच्छरणं प्राप्ताः सदेवमुनयो ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt:
O God of gods, lord of Ramā, O Viṣṇu, bringer of joy to the gods,
we have surely taken refuge in you, along with the gods and sages."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityākarṇya vaco me hi brahmaṇaḥ sa rameśvaraḥ |
pratyuvāca śivaṃ smṛtvā śivātmā dīnamānasaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचो मे हि ब्रह्मणः स रमेश्वरः |
प्रत्युवाच शिवं स्मृत्वा शिवात्मा दीनमानसः ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing these words of mine, of Brahmā, that lord of Ramā,
whose self is Śiva, remembered Śiva and replied with a humble mind.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca |
tejīyasi na sā bhūtā kṛtāgasi bubhūṣatām |
tatra kṣemāya bahudhā bubhūṣā hi kṛtāgasām ||
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच |
तेजीयसि न सा भूता कृतागसि बुभूषताम् |
तत्र क्षेमाय बहुधा बुभूषा हि कृतागसाम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtapāpāḥ surāḥ sarve śive hi parameśvare |
parādaduryajñabhāgaṃ tasya śambhorvidhe yataḥ ||
meaning:
कृतपापाः सुराः सर्वे शिवे हि परमेश्वरे |
पराददुर्यज्ञभागं तस्य शम्भोर्विधे यतः ||
text_mt:
All the gods have committed sin against Śiva, Parameśvara,
since, O Brahmā, they excluded that Śambhu from his sacrificial share.

sanskrit_iast:
prasādayadhvaṃ sarve hi yūyaṃ śuddhena cetasā |
athāparaprasādaṃ taṃ gṛhītāṅghriyugaṃ śivam ||
meaning:
प्रसादयध्वं सर्वे हि यूयं शुद्धेन चेतसा |
अथापरप्रसादं तं गृहीताङ्घ्रियुगं शिवम् ||
text_mt:
Propitiate him, all of you indeed, with a pure mind,
grasping the pair of feet of Śiva, whose grace is unsurpassed.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmin prakupite deve vinaśyatyakhilaṃ jagat |
salokapālayajñasya śāsanājjīvitaṃ drutam ||
meaning:
यस्मिन् प्रकुपिते देवे विनश्यत्यखिलं जगत् |
सलोकपालयज्ञस्य शासनाज्जीवितं द्रुतम् ||
text_mt:
When that god is enraged, the entire world perishes;
by his decree, the life of the sacrifice and its guardians is swift[ly restored].

sanskrit_iast:
tamāśu priyayā devaṃ vihīnaṃ ca duruktibhiḥ |
kṣamāpayadhvaṃ hṛdviddhaṃ dakṣeṇa sudurātmanā ||
meaning:
तमाशु प्रियया देवं विहीनं च दुरुक्तिभिः |
क्षमापयध्वं हृद्विद्धं दक्षेण सुदुरात्मना ||
text_mt:
Quickly beg forgiveness of that god, who has been deprived of his beloved
and pierced to the heart by the harsh words of the wicked Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
ayameva mahopāyastacchāntyai kevalaṃ vidhe |
śambhoḥ santuṣṭaye manye satyamevoditaṃ mayā ||
meaning:
अयमेव महोपायस्तच्छान्त्यै केवलं विधे |
शम्भोः सन्तुष्टये मन्ये सत्यमेवोदितं मया ||
text_mt:
This is the only great expedient to appease him, O Brahmā;
I deem that what I have spoken for Śambhu's satisfaction is the absolute truth.

sanskrit_iast:
nāhaṃ na tvaṃ surāścānye munayo'pi tanūbhṛtaḥ |
yasya tattvaṃ pramāṇaṃ ca na vidurbalavīryayoḥ ||
meaning:
नाहं न त्वं सुराश्चान्ये मुनयोऽपि तनूभृतः |
यस्य तत्त्वं प्रमाणं च न विदुर्बलवीर्ययोः ||
text_mt:
Neither I, nor you, nor the other gods, nor the sages, embodied beings,
know the truth and measure of his strength and power.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmatantrasya tasyāpi parasya paramātmanaḥ |
ka upāyaṃ vidhitsedvai paraṃ mūḍhaṃ virodhinam ||
meaning:
आत्मतन्त्रस्य तस्यापि परस्य परमात्मनः |
क उपायं विधित्सेद्वै परं मूढं विरोधिनम् ||
text_mt:
Against him, self-dependent, the supreme, highest Self,
what person would dare devise an expedient, other than a foolish antagonist?

sanskrit_iast:
caliṣye'hamapi brahman sarvaiḥ sārdhaṃ śivālayam |
kṣamāpayāmi giriśaṃ kṛtāgaśca śive dhruvam ||
meaning:
चलिष्येऽहमपि ब्रह्मन् सर्वैः सार्धं शिवालयम् |
क्षमापयामि गिरिशं कृतागश्च शिवे ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt:
I too, O Brahmā, will set out for Śiva's abode along with all of you.
I shall surely ask Giriśa's forgiveness, having committed an offense against Śiva."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
itthamādiśya viṣṇurmāṃ brahmāṇaṃ sāmarādikam |
sārdhaṃ devairmatiṃ cakre tadgirau gamanāya saḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्थमादिश्य विष्णुर्मां ब्रह्माणं सामरादिकम् |
सार्धं देवैर्मतिं चक्रे तद्गिरौ गमनाय सः ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having thus instructed me, Brahmā, and the gods,
he resolved with the gods to go to that mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
yayau svadhiṣṇyanilayaṃ śivasyādrivaraṃ śubham |
kailāsaṃ sāmaramuniprajeśādimayo hariḥ ||
meaning:
ययौ स्वधिष्ण्यनिलयं शिवस्याद्रिवरं शुभम् |
कैलासं सामरमुनिप्रजेशादिमयो हरिः ||
text_mt:
Hari, accompanied by the gods, sages, lords of creatures, and others, went
to the best of mountains, Kailāsa, the auspicious abode that is Śiva's seat,

sanskrit_iast:
atipriyaṃ prabhornityaṃ sujuṣṭaṃ kinnarādibhiḥ |
naretarairapsarobhiryogasiddhairmahonnatam ||
meaning:
अतिप्रियं प्रभोर्नित्यं सुजुष्टं किन्नरादिभिः |
नरेतरैरप्सरोभिर्योगसिद्धैर्महोन्नतम् ||
text_mt:
Ever extremely dear to the Lord, well-frequented by Kinnaras and others,
by non-humans, Apsarases, and those perfected by yoga, supremely high,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāmaṇimayaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ śobhamānaṃ samantataḥ |
nānādhātuvicitraṃ vai nānādrumalatākulam ||
meaning:
नानामणिमयैः शृङ्गैः शोभमानं समन्ततः |
नानाधातुविचित्रं वै नानाद्रुमलताकुलम् ||
text_mt:
Resplendent on all sides with peaks composed of various gems,
variegated with diverse minerals, teeming with diverse trees and creepers,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ nānāpakṣisamanvitam |
nānājalaprasravaṇairamaraiḥ siddhayoṣitām ||
meaning:
नानामृगगणाकीर्णं नानापक्षिसमन्वितम् |
नानाजलप्रस्रवणैरमरैः सिद्धयोषिताम् ||
text_mt:
Teeming with herds of diverse beasts, accompanied by diverse birds,
with various water cascades, with immortal [lovers] of Siddha women

sanskrit_iast:
ramaṇairviharantīnāṃ nānākandarasānubhiḥ |
drumajātibhiranyābhī rājitaṃ rājataprabham ||
meaning:
रमणैर्विहरन्तीनां नानाकन्दरसानुभिः |
द्रुमजातिभिरन्याभी राजितं राजतप्रभम् ||
text_mt:
Who sport and wander across its diverse caves and ridges;
adorned with species of trees and others, shining with the luster of silver,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghrādibhirmahāsattvairnirghuṣṭaṃ krūratojjhitam |
sarvaśobhānvitaṃ divyaṃ mahāvismayakārakam ||
meaning:
व्याघ्रादिभिर्महासत्त्वैर्निर्घुष्टं क्रूरतोज्झितम् |
सर्वशोभान्वितं दिव्यं महाविस्मयकारकम् ||
text_mt:
Roared over by great beasts such as tigers, yet devoid of cruelty,
endowed with all splendor, divine, evoking great wonder,

sanskrit_iast:
paryastaṃ gaṅgayā satyā sthānapuṇyatarodayā |
sarvapāvanasaṅkartryā viṣṇupadyā sunirmalam ||
meaning:
पर्यस्तं गङ्गया सत्या स्थानपुण्यतरोदया |
सर्वपावनसङ्कर्त्र्या विष्णुपद्या सुनिर्मलम् ||
text_mt:
Encircled by the true Gaṅgā, whose rise brings the most holy of places,
who purifies all, the Viṣṇupadī, exceedingly pure.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhaṃ giriṃ dṛṣṭvā kailāsākhyaṃ śivapriyam |
yayuste vismayaṃ devā viṣṇvādyāḥ samunīśvarāḥ ||
meaning:
एवंविधं गिरिं दृष्ट्वा कैलासाख्यं शिवप्रियम् |
ययुस्ते विस्मयं देवा विष्ण्वाद्याः समुनीश्वराः ||
text_mt:
Seeing such a mountain named Kailāsa, dear to Śiva,
the gods, led by Viṣṇu and accompanied by the foremost sages, were filled with wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsamīpe'lakāṃ ramyāṃ dadṛśurnāma te purīm |
kuberasya mahādivyāṃ rudramitrasya nirjarāḥ ||
meaning:
तत्समीपेऽलकां रम्यां ददृशुर्नाम ते पुरीम् |
कुबेरस्य महादिव्यां रुद्रमित्रस्य निर्जराः ||
text_mt:
Near it, the immortals saw a delightful city named Alakā,
the greatly divine [city] of Kubera, the friend of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
vanaṃ saugandhikaṃ cāpi dadṛśustatsamīpataḥ |
sarvadrumānvitaṃ divyaṃ yatra tannādamadbhutam ||
meaning:
वनं सौगन्धिकं चापि ददृशुस्तत्समीपतः |
सर्वद्रुमान्वितं दिव्यं यत्र तन्नादमद्भुतम् ||
text_mt:
They also saw nearby the Saugandhika forest,
divine and filled with all trees, where there was that wondrous sound.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbāhyatastasya divye saritāvatipāvane |
nandā cālakanandā ca darśanātpāpahārike ||
meaning:
तद्बाह्यतस्तस्य दिव्ये सरितावतिपावने |
नन्दा चालकनन्दा च दर्शनात्पापहारिके ||
text_mt:
Outside it were two divine, supremely purifying rivers,
Nandā and Alakanandā, which remove sins merely by being seen.

sanskrit_iast:
papuḥ surastriyo nityamavagūhya svalokataḥ |
vigāhya pumbhistāstatra krīḍanti ratikarśitāḥ ||
meaning:
पपुः सुरस्त्रियो नित्यमवगूह्य स्वलोकतः |
विगाह्य पुम्भिस्तास्तत्र क्रीडन्ति रतिकर्शिताः ||
text_mt:
Plunging into them after coming from their own realm, celestial women drank continually;
immersing themselves there, exhausted by amorous play, they sported with their men.

sanskrit_iast:
hitvā yakṣeśvarapurīṃ vanaṃ saugandhikaṃ ca yat |
gacchantaste surā ārāddadṛśuḥ śāṅkaraṃ vaṭam ||
meaning:
हित्वा यक्षेश्वरपुरीं वनं सौगन्धिकं च यत् |
गच्छन्तस्ते सुरा आराद्ददृशुः शाङ्करं वटम् ||
text_mt:
Passing the city of the lord of Yakṣas and the Saugandhika forest,
the gods proceeded and saw from afar the banyan tree of Śaṅkara,

sanskrit_iast:
paryakkṛtācalacchāyaṃ pādonaviṭapāyatam |
śatayojanakotsedhaṃ nirnīḍaṃ tāpavarjitam ||
meaning:
पर्यक्कृताचलच्छायं पादोनविटपायतम् |
शतयोजनकोत्सेधं निर्नीडं तापवर्जितम् ||
text_mt:
Casting an unmoving shadow all around, its branches extending a quarter less [than its height],
a hundred yojanas in height, free of bird-nests and devoid of heat,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpuṇyavatāṃ dṛśyaṃ suramyaṃ cātipāvanam |
śambhuyogasthalaṃ divyaṃ yogisevyaṃ mahottamam ||
meaning:
महापुण्यवतां दृश्यं सुरम्यं चातिपावनम् |
शम्भुयोगस्थलं दिव्यं योगिसेव्यं महोत्तमम् ||
text_mt:
Visible only to the highly meritorious, very delightful and exceedingly holy,
the divine place of Śambhu's yoga, served by yogins, supremely excellent.

sanskrit_iast:
mumukṣuśaraṇe tasmin mahāyogamaye vaṭe |
āsīnaṃ dadṛśuḥ sarve śivaṃ viṣṇvādayaḥ surāḥ ||
meaning:
मुमुक्षुशरणे तस्मिन् महायोगमये वटे |
आसीनं ददृशुः सर्वे शिवं विष्ण्वादयः सुराः ||
text_mt:
Under that banyan tree full of great yoga, a refuge for seekers of liberation,
all the gods, led by Viṣṇu, saw Śiva seated,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhiputrairmahāsiddhaiḥ śivabhaktirataiḥ sadā |
upāsyamānaṃ samudā śāntaiḥ saṃśāntavigrahaiḥ ||
meaning:
विधिपुत्रैर्महासिद्धैः शिवभक्तिरतैः सदा |
उपास्यमानं समुदा शान्तैः संशान्तविग्रहैः ||
text_mt:
Being worshipped joyfully by the sons of Brahmā, great perfected beings
ever devoted to Śiva's devotion, tranquil, their bodies completely pacified,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā sakhyā kubereṇa bhartrā guhyakarakṣasām |
sevyamānaṃ viśeṣeṇa svagaṇairjñātibhiḥ sadā ||
meaning:
तथा सख्या कुबेरेण भर्त्रा गुह्यकरक्षसाम् |
सेव्यमानं विशेषेण स्वगणैर्ज्ञातिभिः सदा ||
text_mt:
And particularly attended by his friend Kubera, the master of Guhyakas and Rākṣasas,
and ever by his own attendants and kinsmen,

sanskrit_iast:
tāpasābhīṣṭasadrūpaṃ bibhrataṃ parameśvaram |
vātsalyādviśvasuhṛdaṃ bhasmādisuvirājitam ||
meaning:
तापसाभीष्टसद्रूपं बिभ्रतं परमेश्वरम् |
वात्सल्याद्विश्वसुहृदं भस्मादिसुविराजितम् ||
text_mt:
Bearing the noble form desired by ascetics, Parameśvara,
the friend of the universe out of affection, splendidly adorned with ashes and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
mune tubhyaṃ pravocantaṃ pṛcchate jñānamuttamam |
kuśāsane sūpaviṣṭaṃ sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ satām ||
meaning:
मुने तुभ्यं प्रवोचन्तं पृच्छते ज्ञानमुत्तमम् |
कुशासने सूपविष्टं सर्वेषां शृण्वतां सताम् ||
text_mt:
Expounding supreme knowledge to you, O sage, as you inquired,
well-seated upon a kuśa grass mat while all the virtuous listened,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvorau dakṣiṇe savyaṃ caraṇaṃ caiva jānuni |
bāhuprakoṣṭhākṣamālaṃ sthitaṃ sattarkamudrayā ||
meaning:
कृत्वोरौ दक्षिणे सव्यं चरणं चैव जानुनि |
बाहुप्रकोष्ठाक्षमालं स्थितं सत्तर्कमुद्रया ||
text_mt:
Having placed his left foot on his right thigh and knee,
with a rosary around his forearm, seated in the gesture of sound reasoning.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhaṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā viṣṇvādayaḥ surāḥ |
praṇemustvaritaṃ sarve karau badhvā vinamrakāḥ ||
meaning:
एवंविधं शिवं दृष्ट्वा तदा विष्ण्वादयः सुराः |
प्रणेमुस्त्वरितं सर्वे करौ बध्वा विनम्रकाः ||
text_mt:
Seeing Śiva thus, all the gods led by Viṣṇu
swiftly bowed down, joining their hands in humility.

sanskrit_iast:
upalabhyāgataṃ rudro mayā viṣṇuṃ satāṃ gatiḥ |
utthāya cakre śirasābhivandanamapi prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
उपलभ्यागतं रुद्रो मया विष्णुं सतां गतिः |
उत्थाय चक्रे शिरसाभिवन्दनमपि प्रभुः ||
text_mt:
Perceiving that Viṣṇu, the refuge of the virtuous, had arrived with me,
the Lord Rudra stood up and bowed with his head.

sanskrit_iast:
vanditāṅghristadā sarvairdivyairviṣṇvādibhiḥ śivaḥ |
nanāmātha yathā viṣṇuḥ kaśyapaṃ lokasadgatiḥ ||
meaning:
वन्दिताङ्घ्रिस्तदा सर्वैर्दिव्यैर्विष्ण्वादिभिः शिवः |
ननामाथ यथा विष्णुः कश्यपं लोकसद्गतिः ||
text_mt:
Then Śiva, whose feet were saluted by all the divine ones led by Viṣṇu,
bowed down, as Viṣṇu, the true refuge of the worlds, [bowed] to Kaśyapa.

sanskrit_iast:
surasiddhagaṇādhīśamaharṣisunamaskṛtam |
samuvāca surairviṣṇuṃ kṛtasannatimādarāt ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ satīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
सुरसिद्धगणाधीशमहर्षिसुनमस्कृतम् |
समुवाच सुरैर्विष्णुं कृतसन्नतिमादरात् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां द्वितीयः सतीखण्डे
text_mt:
He respectfully addressed Viṣṇu, who was reverently saluted by the gods,
and who had been well greeted by the hosts of gods, Siddhas, and great sages.

Thus ends the fortieth chapter, named 'The Description of the Vision of Śiva', in the second part, the Satīkhaṇḍa, of the second Rudrasaṃhitā of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇvādaya ūcuḥ |
devadeva mahādeva laukikācārakṛtprabho |
brahma tvāmīśvaraṃ śambhuṃ jānīmaḥ kṛpayā tava ||
meaning:
विष्ण्वादय ऊचुः |
देवदेव महादेव लौकिकाचारकृत्प्रभो |
ब्रह्म त्वामीश्वरं शम्भुं जानीमः कृपया तव ||
title: ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | devaiḥ kṛtā śivastutiḥ
text_mt:
Viṣṇu and the others said:
"O God of gods, Mahādeva, O Lord who acts in worldly custom,
we know you as Brahman, Īśvara, Śambhu, by your grace.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ mohayasi nastāta māyayā parayā tava |
durjñeyayā sadā puṃsāṃ mohinyā parameśvara ||
meaning:
किं मोहयसि नस्तात मायया परया तव |
दुर्ज्ञेयया सदा पुंसां मोहिन्या परमेश्वर ||
text_mt: O father, why do you delude us with your supreme illusion, / which is always difficult for men to comprehend and deluding, O Parameśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛteḥ puruṣasyāpi jagato yonibījayoḥ |
parabrahma parastvaṃ ca manovācāmagocaraḥ ||
meaning:
प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्यापि जगतो योनिबीजयोः |
परब्रह्म परस्त्वं च मनोवाचामगोचरः ||
text_mt: You are beyond both primordial nature and the cosmic person, the womb and the seed of the universe; / you are the supreme Brahman, transcendent, beyond the range of mind and speech.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva viśvaṃ sṛjasi pāsyatsi nijatantrataḥ |
svarūpāṃ śivaśaktiṃ hi krīḍannūrṇapaṭo yathā ||
meaning:
त्वमेव विश्वं सृजसि पास्यत्सि निजतन्त्रतः |
स्वरूपां शिवशक्तिं हि क्रीडन्नूर्णपटो यथा ||
text_mt: You alone create, protect, and consume the universe through your own power, / playing indeed with your own form, the power of Śiva, like a woven web of thread.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva kratumīśāna sasarjitha dayāparaḥ |
dakṣeṇa sūtreṇa vibho sadā trayyabhipattaye ||
meaning:
त्वमेव क्रतुमीशान ससर्जिथ दयापरः |
दक्षेण सूत्रेण विभो सदा त्रय्यभिपत्तये ||
text_mt: Filled with compassion, O Īśāna, you alone instituted sacrifice / by means of the capable guideline, O omnipresent one, for the perpetual preservation of the three Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayaiva loke'vasitāḥ setavo yān dhṛtavratāḥ |
śuddhān śraddadhate viprā vedamārgavicakṣaṇāḥ ||
meaning:
त्वयैव लोकेऽवसिताः सेतवो यान् धृतव्रताः |
शुद्धान् श्रद्दधते विप्रा वेदमार्गविचक्षणाः ||
text_mt: By you alone were the moral boundaries established in the world, which / pure Brahmins, skilled in the Vedic path and observing vows, have faith in.

sanskrit_iast:
kartustvaṃ maṅgalānāṃ hi svaparaṃ tu sukhe vibho |
amaṅgalānāṃ ca hitaṃ miśraṃ vātha viparyayam ||
meaning:
कर्तुस्त्वं मङ्गलानां हि स्वपरं तु सुखे विभो |
अमङ्गलानां च हितं मिश्रं वाथ विपर्ययम् ||
text_mt: You indeed provide the performer with auspicious things or their opposite, O omnipresent one, / happiness to oneself and others, and beneficial results or mixed or the reverse for inauspicious deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakarmaphalānāṃ hi sadā dātā tvameva hi |
sarve hi proktāḥ paśavastatpatistvaṃ śrutiśrutaḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वकर्मफलानां हि सदा दाता त्वमेव हि |
सर्वे हि प्रोक्ताः पशवस्तत्पतिस्त्वं श्रुतिश्रुतः ||
text_mt: For you alone are always the giver of the fruits of all actions; / indeed all are called bound souls, and you are their lord, heard of in the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthagdhiyaḥ karmadṛśo'runtudāśca durāśayāḥ |
vitudanti parān mūḍhā duruktairmatsarānvitāḥ ||
meaning:
पृथग्धियः कर्मदृशोऽरुन्तुदाश्च दुराशयाः |
वितुदन्ति परान् मूढा दुरुक्तैर्मत्सरान्विताः ||
text_mt: Men of divisive intellect, seeing only rituals, wounding the hearts of others and evil-minded, / foolish and filled with jealousy, torment others with harsh words.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ daivavadhānāṃ bho bhūyāttvacca vadho vibho |
bhagavanparameśāna kṛpāṃ kuru paraprabho ||
meaning:
तेषां दैववधानां भो भूयात्त्वच्च वधो विभो |
भगवन्परमेशान कृपां कुरु परप्रभो ||
text_mt: May their destruction, wrought by destiny, be taken as wrought by you, O lord; / O blessed Parameśāna, supreme sovereign, show compassion!

sanskrit_iast:
namo rudrāya śāntāya brahmaṇe paramātmane |
kapardine maheśāya jyotsnāya mahate namaḥ ||
meaning:
नमो रुद्राय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने |
कपर्दिने महेशाय ज्योत्स्नाय महते नमः ||
text_mt: Homage to Rudra, the peaceful one, to Brahman, the supreme self, / to the matted-haired Maheśa, to the radiant, the great; homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hi viśvasṛjāṃ sraṣṭā dhātā tvaṃ prapitāmahaḥ |
triguṇātmā nirguṇaśca prakṛteḥ puruṣātparaḥ ||
meaning:
त्वं हि विश्वसृजां स्रष्टा धाता त्वं प्रपितामहः |
त्रिगुणात्मा निर्गुणश्च प्रकृतेः पुरुषात्परः ||
text_mt: For you are the creator of the creators of the universe; you are the sustainer, the great-grandfather; / possessing the three qualities and devoid of qualities, higher than primordial nature and the cosmic person.

sanskrit_iast:
namaste nīlakaṇṭhāya vedhase paramātmane |
viśvāya viśvabījāya jagadānandahetave ||
meaning:
नमस्ते नीलकण्ठाय वेधसे परमात्मने |
विश्वाय विश्वबीजाय जगदानन्दहेतवे ||
text_mt: Homage to you, the blue-throated one, the creator, the supreme self, / the universal, the seed of the universe, the cause of bliss to the world!

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkārastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāraḥ sarvārambhapravartakaḥ |
hantakāraḥ svadhākāro havyakavyānnabhuk sadā ||
meaning:
ओङ्कारस्त्वं वषट्कारः सर्वारम्भप्रवर्तकः |
हन्तकारः स्वधाकारो हव्यकव्यान्नभुक् सदा ||
text_mt: You are the syllable Om, you are the exclamation Vaṣaṭ, the instigator of all undertakings; / you are the exclamation Hanta, you are the exclamation Svadhā, the perpetual eater of sacrificial and ancestral food!

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaḥ kathaṃ yajñabhaṅgastvayā dharmaparāyaṇa |
brahmaṇyastvaṃ mahādeva kathaṃ yajñahano vibho ||
meaning:
कृतः कथं यज्ञभङ्गस्त्वया धर्मपरायण |
ब्रह्मण्यस्त्वं महादेव कथं यज्ञहनो विभो ||
text_mt: How was the destruction of the sacrifice performed by you, who are devoted to dharma? / You are well-disposed to Brahmins, O Mahādeva; how could you be a destroyer of sacrifices, O omnipresent lord?

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ caiva dharmasya pratipālakaḥ |
śaraṇyo'si sadānantyaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ prabho ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मणानां गवां चैव धर्मस्य प्रतिपालकः |
शरण्योऽसि सदानन्त्यः सर्वेषां प्राणिनां प्रभो ||
text_mt: You are the protector of Brahmins, of cows, and of dharma; / you are ever the refuge and infinite for all living beings, O lord!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste bhagavan rudra bhāskarāmitatejase |
namo bhavāya devāya rasāyāmbumayāya te ||
meaning:
नमस्ते भगवन् रुद्र भास्करामिततेजसे |
नमो भवाय देवाय रसायाम्बुमयाय ते ||
text_mt: Homage to you, O blessed Rudra, possessing the immeasurable splendor of the sun! / Homage to Bhava, the divine, the essence consisting of water!

sanskrit_iast:
śarvāya kṣitirūpāya sadā surabhiṇe namaḥ |
