evamuktvā tadā kālīṃ nārada tvaṃ śivapriyaḥ |
yādṛcchiko'gamastvaṃ tu svargaṃ devahite rataḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एवमुक्त्वा तदा कालीं नारद त्वं शिवप्रियः |
यादृच्छिकोऽगमस्त्वं तु स्वर्गं देवहिते रतः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus to Kālī, O Nārada, you, dear to Śiva / and intent on the good of the gods, went to heaven as you pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatī ca tadā śrutvā vacanaṃ tava nārada |
suprasannā tadā prāpa pañcākṣaramanūttamam ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaḥ pārvatīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
पार्वती च तदा श्रुत्वा वचनं तव नारद |
सुप्रसन्ना तदा प्राप पञ्चाक्षरमनूत्तमम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां तृतीयः पार्वतीखण्डे
text_mt:
And Pārvatī, having heard your words then, O Nārada, / exceedingly pleased, received the unsurpassed five-syllable mantra.

Thus ends the twenty-first chapter, named ‘Instruction by Nārada’, in the Pārvatī section, the third in the second [book], the Rudrasaṃhitā, of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
tvayi devamune yāte pārvatī hṛṣṭamānasā |
tapaḥsādhyaṃ haraṃ mene tapo'rthaṃ mana ādadhe ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
त्वयि देवमुने याते पार्वती हृष्टमानसा |
तपःसाध्यं हरं मेने तपोऽर्थं मन आदधे ||
title: dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | pārvatītapovarṇanam
text_mt: Brahmā said: / When you, O celestial sage, had departed, Pārvatī, glad at heart, / considered Hara attainable through austerity, and set her mind upon austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sakhyau samādāya jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ tathā |
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva sakhībhyāṃ paryapṛcchata ||
meaning:
ततः सख्यौ समादाय जयां च विजयां तथा |
मातरं पितरं चैव सखीभ्यां पर्यपृच्छत ||
text_mt: Then, taking along her two female friends, Jayā and Vijayā, / she made inquiry through those two friends to her mother and father.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ pitaraṃ gatvā himavantaṃ nageśvaram |
paryapṛcchatsupraṇamya vinayena samanvitā ||
sakhyāvūcatuḥ -
himavan śrūyatāṃ putrīvacanaṃ kathyate'dhunā ||
sā svayaṃ caiva dehasya rūpasyāpi tathā punaḥ | 4 ||
meaning:
प्रथमं पितरं गत्वा हिमवन्तं नगेश्वरम् |
पर्यपृच्छत्सुप्रणम्य विनयेन समन्विता ||
सख्यावूचतुः -
हिमवन् श्रूयतां पुत्रीवचनं कथ्यतेऽधुना ||
सा स्वयं चैव देहस्य रूपस्यापि तथा पुनः | 4 ||
text_mt:
Having first gone to her father, Himavat, the lord of mountains, / she bowed down well and inquired, filled with modesty.

The two friends said: / “O Himavat, let the words of your daughter be heard, which are now being spoken:

She herself [wishes to achieve] the fruition of her body and beauty, and furthermore,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavato hi kulasyāsya sāphalyaṃ kartumicchati |
tapasā sādhanīyo'sau nānyathā dṛśyatāṃ vrajet ||
meaning:
भवतो हि कुलस्यास्य साफल्यं कर्तुमिच्छति |
तपसा साधनीयोऽसौ नान्यथा दृश्यतां व्रजेत् ||
text_mt: she desires to bring fruition to this family of yours; / he is to be attained by austerity; not otherwise can he come into view.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācca parvataśreṣṭha deyājñā bhavatādhunā |
tapaḥ karotu girijā vanaṃ gatveti sādaram ||
meaning:
तस्माच्च पर्वतश्रेष्ठ देयाज्ञा भवताधुना |
तपः करोतु गिरिजा वनं गत्वेति सादरम् ||
text_mt: Therefore, O best of mountains, permission must now be given by you: / ‘Let Girijā go to the forest and perform austerity with reverence.’”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityevaṃ ca tadā pṛṣṭaḥ sakhībhyāṃ munisattama |
pārvatyā suvicāryātha girirājo'bravīdidam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्येवं च तदा पृष्टः सखीभ्यां मुनिसत्तम |
पार्वत्या सुविचार्याथ गिरिराजोऽब्रवीदिदम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Being thus questioned by the two friends on behalf of Pārvatī, O best of sages, / the king of mountains, having reflected well, said this:

sanskrit_iast:
himālaya uvāca |
mahyaṃ ca rocate'tyarthaṃ menāyai rucyatāṃ punaḥ |
yathedaṃ bhavitavyaṃ ca kimataḥ paramuttamam ||
meaning:
हिमालय उवाच |
मह्यं च रोचतेऽत्यर्थं मेनायै रुच्यतां पुनः |
यथेदं भवितव्यं च किमतः परमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Himālaya said: / “It is exceedingly pleasing to me; but let it be agreeable to Menā. / As this is destined to be, what could be better than this?

sanskrit_iast:
sāphalyaṃ tu madīyasya kulasya ca na saṃśayaḥ |
mātre tu rucyate cedvai tataḥ śubhataraṃ nu kim ||
meaning:
साफल्यं तु मदीयस्य कुलस्य च न संशयः |
मात्रे तु रुच्यते चेद्वै ततः शुभतरं नु किम् ||
text_mt: Fruitfulness will come to my family, without a doubt; / but if it is agreeable to her mother, what could indeed be more auspicious than that?”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityevaṃ vacanaṃ pitrā proktaṃ śrutvā tu te tadā |
jagmaturmātaraṃ sakhyau tadājñapte tayā saha ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्येवं वचनं पित्रा प्रोक्तं श्रुत्वा तु ते तदा |
जग्मतुर्मातरं सख्यौ तदाज्ञप्ते तया सह ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having heard these words spoken by the father, those two female companions, instructed by her, then went together with her to the mother.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā tu mātaraṃ tasyāḥ pārvatyāste ca nārada |
supraṇamya karau badhvocaturvacanamādarāt ||
sakhyāvūcatuḥ
mātastvaṃ vacanaṃ putryāḥ śṛṇu devi namo'stu te ||
suprasannatayā tadvai śrutvā kartumihārhasi | 12 ||
meaning:
गत्वा तु मातरं तस्याः पार्वत्यास्ते च नारद |
सुप्रणम्य करौ बध्वोचतुर्वचनमादरात् ||
सख्यावूचतुः
मातस्त्वं वचनं पुत्र्याः शृणु देवि नमोऽस्तु ते ||
सुप्रसन्नतया तद्वै श्रुत्वा कर्तुमिहार्हसि | 12 ||
text_mt:
Having approached her mother, the mother of Pārvatī, O Nārada, / they bowed down, folded their hands, and spoke with reverence:

The two companions said: / "O mother, listen to the daughter's words, O goddess, reverence be to you!

Having heard them with great graciousness, you ought indeed to grant it here. [12]

sanskrit_iast:
taptukāmā tu te putrī śivārthaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ |
prāptānujñā pituścaiva tubhyaṃ ca paripṛcchati ||
meaning:
तप्तुकामा तु ते पुत्री शिवार्थं परमं तपः |
प्राप्तानुज्ञा पितुश्चैव तुभ्यं च परिपृच्छति ||
text_mt: Your daughter wishes to perform supreme austerity for the sake of Śiva; / having obtained permission from her father, she is now asking you.

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ svarūpasāphalyaṃ kartukāmā pativrate |
tvadājñā yadi jāyeta tapyate ca tathā tapaḥ ||
meaning:
इयं स्वरूपसाफल्यं कर्तुकामा पतिव्रते |
त्वदाज्ञा यदि जायेत तप्यते च तथा तपः ||
text_mt: She wishes to make her beauty fruitful, O faithful wife; / if your permission is granted, then she will perform austerity."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityuktvā ca tataḥsakhyau tūṣṇīmāstāṃ munīśvara |
nāṅgīcakāra menā sā tadvākyaṃ khinnamānasā ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा च ततःसख्यौ तूष्णीमास्तां मुनीश्वर |
नाङ्गीचकार मेना सा तद्वाक्यं खिन्नमानसा ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus, O lord of sages, the two companions fell silent; / Menā, dejected in mind, did not accept their words.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā pārvatī prāha svayamevātha mātaram |
karau baddhvā vinītātmā smṛtvā śivapadāmbujam ||
meaning:
ततः सा पार्वती प्राह स्वयमेवाथ मातरम् |
करौ बद्ध्वा विनीतात्मा स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्बुजम् ||
text_mt: Then Pārvatī herself spoke to her mother, / folding her hands, humble in spirit, remembering the lotus feet of Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca |
mātastaptuṃ gamiṣyāmi prātaḥ prāptuṃ maheśvaram |
anujānīhi māṃ gantuṃ tapase'dya tapovanam ||
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच |
मातस्तप्तुं गमिष्यामि प्रातः प्राप्तुं महेश्वरम् |
अनुजानीहि मां गन्तुं तपसेऽद्य तपोवनम् ||
text_mt: Pārvatī said: / "O mother, I shall go at dawn to perform austerity to attain Maheśvara; / permit me today to go to the penance grove for austerity."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityākarṇya vacaḥ putryā menā duḥkhamupāgatā |
sopāhūya tadā putrīmuvāca vikalā satī ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचः पुत्र्या मेना दुःखमुपागता |
सोपाहूय तदा पुत्रीमुवाच विकला सती ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing these words of her daughter, Menā became grief-stricken; / having summoned her daughter, she, distraught, said:

sanskrit_iast:
menovāca |
duḥkhitāsi śive putrī tapastaptuṃ purā yadi |
tapaścara gṛhe'dya tvaṃ na bahirgaccha pārvati ||
meaning:
मेनोवाच |
दुःखितासि शिवे पुत्री तपस्तप्तुं पुरा यदि |
तपश्चर गृहेऽद्य त्वं न बहिर्गच्छ पार्वति ||
text_mt: Menā said: / "O daughter Śivā, if you were grieved before by performing austerity, / practice austerity here at home today; do not go outside, O Pārvatī!

sanskrit_iast:
kutra yāsi tapaḥ kartuṃ devāḥ santi gṛhe mama |
tīrthāni ca samastāni kṣetrāṇi vividhāni ca ||
meaning:
कुत्र यासि तपः कर्तुं देवाः सन्ति गृहे मम |
तीर्थानि च समस्तानि क्षेत्राणि विविधानि च ||
text_mt: Where will you go to practice austerity? There are gods in my house, / and all the sacred fords and various sacred places.

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyo na haṭhaḥ putri gantavyaṃ na bahiḥ kvacit |
sādhitaṃ kiṃ tvayā pūrvaṃ punaḥ kiṃ sādhayiṣyasi ||
meaning:
कर्तव्यो न हठः पुत्रि गन्तव्यं न बहिः क्वचित् |
साधितं किं त्वया पूर्वं पुनः किं साधयिष्यसि ||
text_mt: Obstinacy should not be shown, O daughter! You must not go anywhere outside! / What was accomplished by you before, that you will accomplish again?

sanskrit_iast:
śarīraṃ komalaṃ vatse tapastu kaṭhinaṃ mahat |
etasmāttu tvayā kāryaṃ tapo'tra na bahirvraja ||
meaning:
शरीरं कोमलं वत्से तपस्तु कठिनं महत् |
एतस्मात्तु त्वया कार्यं तपोऽत्र न बहिर्व्रज ||
text_mt: Your body is tender, O child, but austerity is very severe; / therefore, you must perform austerity here; do not go outside!

sanskrit_iast:
strīṇāṃ tapovanagatirna śrutā kāmanārthinī |
tasmāttvaṃ putri mā kārṣīḥ tapo'rthaṃ gamanaṃ prati ||
meaning:
स्त्रीणां तपोवनगतिर्न श्रुता कामनार्थिनी |
तस्मात्त्वं पुत्रि मा कार्षीः तपोऽर्थं गमनं प्रति ||
text_mt: A woman's departure for the penance grove to seek a desire has never been heard of; / therefore, O daughter, do not depart for the sake of austerity!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityevaṃ bahudhā putrī tanmātrā vinivāritā |
saṃvade na sukhaṃ kiñcidvinārādhya maheśvaram ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्येवं बहुधा पुत्री तन्मात्रा विनिवारिता |
संवदे न सुखं किञ्चिद्विनाराध्य महेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Thus forbidden in many ways by her mother, the daughter / [spoke]: "I have no pleasure at all without worshipping Maheśvara."

sanskrit_iast:
taponiṣiddhā tapase vanaṃ gantuṃ ca menayā |
hetunā tena someti nāma prāpa śivā tadā ||
meaning:
तपोनिषिद्धा तपसे वनं गन्तुं च मेनया |
हेतुना तेन सोमेति नाम प्राप शिवा तदा ||
text_mt: Because she was forbidden from austerity—from going to the forest for austerity—by Menā, / for that reason Śivā then acquired the name Umā [‘U mā’ = ‘Oh, do not’].

sanskrit_iast:
atha tāṃ duḥkhitāṃ jñātvā menā śailapriyā śivām |
nideśaṃ sā dadau tasyāḥ pārvatyāstapase mune ||
meaning:
अथ तां दुःखितां ज्ञात्वा मेना शैलप्रिया शिवाम् |
निदेशं सा ददौ तस्याः पार्वत्यास्तपसे मुने ||
text_mt: Then, seeing her in distress, Menā, beloved of the Mountain, O sage, / gave her permission to Pārvatī for austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
māturājñāṃ ca samprāpya suvratā munisattama |
tataḥ svānte sukhaṃ lebhe pārvatī smṛtaśaṅkarā ||
meaning:
मातुराज्ञां च सम्प्राप्य सुव्रता मुनिसत्तम |
ततः स्वान्ते सुखं लेभे पार्वती स्मृतशङ्करा ||
text_mt: Having obtained her mother's permission, O best of sages, the observant one, / Pārvatī, remembering Śaṅkara, then attained joy in her heart.

sanskrit_iast:
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ sātha praṇipatya mudā śivā |
sakhībhyāṃ ca śivaṃ smṛtvā tapastaptuṃ samudgatā ||
meaning:
मातरं पितरं साथ प्रणिपत्य मुदा शिवा |
सखीभ्यां च शिवं स्मृत्वा तपस्तप्तुं समुद्गता ||
text_mt: Having joyfully bowed to her mother and father, Śivā, / remembering Śiva with her two companions, set out to perform austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
hitvā matānyanekāni vastrāṇi vividhāni ca |
valkalāni dhṛtānyāśu mauñjīṃ baddhvā tu śobhanām ||
meaning:
हित्वा मतान्यनेकानि वस्त्राणि विविधानि च |
वल्कलानि धृतान्याशु मौञ्जीं बद्ध्वा तु शोभनाम् ||
text_mt: Abandoning manifold garments and various clothes, / she quickly wore bark garments and tied an auspicious belt of muñja grass.

sanskrit_iast:
hitvā hāraṃ tathā carma mṛgasya paramaṃ dhṛtam |
jagāma tapase tatra gaṅgāvataraṇaṃ prati ||
meaning:
हित्वा हारं तथा चर्म मृगस्य परमं धृतम् |
जगाम तपसे तत्र गङ्गावतरणं प्रति ||
text_mt: Casting off her necklace, she likewise wore an excellent deer skin, / and went to Gaṅgāvataraṇa for the sake of austerity,

sanskrit_iast:
śambhunā kurvatā dhyānaṃ yatra dagdho manobhavaḥ |
gaṅgāvataraṇo nāma prastho himavataḥsa ca ||
meaning:
शम्भुना कुर्वता ध्यानं यत्र दग्धो मनोभवः |
गङ्गावतरणो नाम प्रस्थो हिमवतःस च ||
text_mt: where Kāmadeva had been burnt by Śambhu while performing meditation; / that was the plateau of the Himālaya named Gaṅgāvataraṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
haraśūnyo'tha dadṛśe sa prastho himabhūbhṛtaḥ |
kālyā tatretya bhostāta pārvatyā jagadambayā ||
meaning:
हरशून्योऽथ ददृशे स प्रस्थो हिमभूभृतः |
काल्या तत्रेत्य भोस्तात पार्वत्या जगदम्बया ||
text_mt: Arriving there, O dear friend, that plateau of the snow-mountain was seen to be devoid of Hara / by Kālī, Pārvatī, the mother of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra sthitvā purā śambhuḥ taptavāndustaraṃ tapaḥ |
tatra kṣaṇaṃ tu sā sthitvā babhūva virahārditā ||
meaning:
यत्र स्थित्वा पुरा शम्भुः तप्तवान्दुस्तरं तपः |
तत्र क्षणं तु सा स्थित्वा बभूव विरहार्दिता ||
text_mt: Where formerly Śambhu had stayed and performed severe austerity, / standing there for a moment, she was afflicted by separation.

sanskrit_iast:
hā hareti śivā tatra rudantī sā gireḥ sutā |
vilalāpātiduḥkhārtā cintāśokasamanvitā ||
meaning:
हा हरेति शिवा तत्र रुदन्ती सा गिरेः सुता |
विललापातिदुःखार्ता चिन्ताशोकसमन्विता ||
text_mt: Crying out 'Alas, Hara!', Śivā, the daughter of the mountain, weeping there, / wailed, tormented with extreme grief, filled with anxious longing and sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścireṇa sā mohaṃ dhairyātsaṃstabhya pārvatī |
niyamāyābhavattatra dīkṣitā himavatsutā ||
meaning:
ततश्चिरेण सा मोहं धैर्यात्संस्तभ्य पार्वती |
नियमायाभवत्तत्र दीक्षिता हिमवत्सुता ||
text_mt: Then, having restrained her delusion with fortitude after a long time, Pārvatī, / the daughter of the Himālaya, was initiated there for spiritual observance.

sanskrit_iast:
tapaścakāra sā tatra śṛṅgitīrthe mahottame |
gaurīśikhara nāmāsīttattapaḥkaraṇāddhi tat ||
meaning:
तपश्चकार सा तत्र शृङ्गितीर्थे महोत्तमे |
गौरीशिखर नामासीत्तत्तपःकरणाद्धि तत् ||
text_mt: She performed austerity there at the great, supreme Śṛṅgitīrtha; / because of her performance of austerity, it came to be named Gaurīśikhara.

sanskrit_iast:
sundarāśca drumāstatra pavitrāśśivayā mune |
āropitāḥ parīkṣārthaṃ tapasaḥ phalabhāginaḥ ||
meaning:
सुन्दराश्च द्रुमास्तत्र पवित्राश्शिवया मुने |
आरोपिताः परीक्षार्थं तपसः फलभागिनः ||
text_mt: And beautiful, sacred trees were planted there by Śivā, O sage, / to test the fruits of her austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūbhiśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vedīṃ nirmāya sundarī |
tathā tapaḥsamārabdhaṃ munīnāmapi duṣkaram ||
meaning:
भूभिशुद्धिं ततः कृत्वा वेदीं निर्माय सुन्दरी |
तथा तपःसमारब्धं मुनीनामपि दुष्करम् ||
text_mt: Then, having purified the ground and erected an altar, the beautiful maiden / began an austerity difficult even for sages to perform.

sanskrit_iast:
vigṛhya manasā sarvāṇīndriyāṇi sahāśu sā |
samupasthānike tatra cakāra paramaṃ tapaḥ ||
meaning:
विगृह्य मनसा सर्वाणीन्द्रियाणि सहाशु सा |
समुपस्थानिके तत्र चकार परमं तपः ||
text_mt: Restraining all her senses at once with her mind, / she performed supreme austerity there on the place of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
grīṣme ca parito vahniṃ prajvalantaṃ divāniśam |
kṛtvā tasthau ca tanmadhye satataṃ japatī manum ||
meaning:
ग्रीष्मे च परितो वह्निं प्रज्वलन्तं दिवानिशम् |
कृत्वा तस्थौ च तन्मध्ये सततं जपती मनुम् ||
text_mt: In summer, having made a fire blazing day and night all around, / she stood in the midst of it, constantly reciting the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
satataṃ caiva varṣāsu sthaṇḍile susthirāsanā |
śilāpṛṣṭhe ca saṃsiktā babhūva jaladhārayā ||
meaning:
सततं चैव वर्षासु स्थण्डिले सुस्थिरासना |
शिलापृष्ठे च संसिक्ता बभूव जलधारया ||
text_mt: And constantly in the rainy season, firmly seated on bare ground / upon a flat rock, she was drenched by streams of water.

sanskrit_iast:
śīte jalāntare śaśvattasthau sā bhaktitatparā |
anāhārātapattatra nīhāreṣu niśāsu ca ||
meaning:
शीते जलान्तरे शश्वत्तस्थौ सा भक्तितत्परा |
अनाहारातपत्तत्र नीहारेषु निशासु च ||
text_mt: In the cold, she stood continually inside the water, devoted to devotion; / fasting, she performed penance there amidst frosts and during nights.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tapaḥ prakurvāṇā pañcākṣarajape ratā |
dadhyau śivaṃ śivā tatra sarvakāmaphalapradam ||
meaning:
एवं तपः प्रकुर्वाणा पञ्चाक्षरजपे रता |
दध्यौ शिवं शिवा तत्र सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ||
text_mt: Thus performing austerity, intent on reciting the five-syllable mantra, / Śivā meditated there on Śiva, the bestower of the fruits of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
svāropitān śubhānvṛkṣānsakhībhissiñcatī mudā |
pratyahaṃ sāvakāśe sā tatrātithyamakalpayat ||
meaning:
स्वारोपितान् शुभान्वृक्षान्सखीभिस्सिञ्चती मुदा |
प्रत्यहं सावकाशे सा तत्रातिथ्यमकल्पयत् ||
text_mt: Joyfully watering the auspicious trees planted by herself with her female companions, / every day, when she had leisure, she offered hospitality there.

sanskrit_iast:
vātaścaiva tathā śītavṛṣṭiśca vividhā tathā |
dussaho'pi tathā gharmastayā sehe sucittayā ||
meaning:
वातश्चैव तथा शीतवृष्टिश्च विविधा तथा |
दुस्सहोऽपि तथा घर्मस्तया सेहे सुचित्तया ||
text_mt: And the wind, the cold, the various rains, / and even the unbearable heat—she endured them all with a resolute mind.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhaṃ ca vividhaṃ tatra gaṇitaṃ na tayāgatam |
kevalaṃ mana ādhāya śive sāsītsthitā mune ||
meaning:
दुःखं च विविधं तत्र गणितं न तयागतम् |
केवलं मन आधाय शिवे सासीत्स्थिता मुने ||
text_mt: And the various sufferings that came there were not counted by her; / fixing her mind solely on Śiva, she remained steadfast, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ phalabhogena dvitīyaṃ parṇabhojanaiḥ |
tapaḥ prakurvatī devī kramānninye'mitāḥ samāḥ ||
meaning:
प्रथमं फलभोगेन द्वितीयं पर्णभोजनैः |
तपः प्रकुर्वती देवी क्रमान्निन्येऽमिताः समाः ||
text_mt: Performing austerity first by eating fruits, and secondly by eating fallen leaves, / the goddess gradually passed countless years.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ parṇānyapi śivā nirasya himavatsutā |
nirāhārābhavaddevī tapaścaraṇasaṃratā ||
meaning:
ततः पर्णान्यपि शिवा निरस्य हिमवत्सुता |
निराहाराभवद्देवी तपश्चरणसंरता ||
text_mt: Then, casting aside even leaves, Śivā, the daughter of the Himālaya, / the goddess became completely fasting, devoted to the practice of austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
āhāre tyaktaparṇābhūdyasmāddhimavataḥ sutā |
tena devairaparṇeti kathitā nāmataḥ śivā ||
meaning:
आहारे त्यक्तपर्णाभूद्यस्माद्धिमवतः सुता |
तेन देवैरपर्णेति कथिता नामतः शिवा ||
text_mt: Because the daughter of the Himālaya abandoned even leaves for food, / therefore Śivā was named Aparṇā by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
ekapādasthitā sāsīcchivaṃ saṃsmṛtya pārvatī |
pañcākṣaraṃ japantī ca manuṃ tepe tapo mahat ||
meaning:
एकपादस्थिता सासीच्छिवं संस्मृत्य पार्वती |
पञ्चाक्षरं जपन्ती च मनुं तेपे तपो महत् ||
text_mt: Standing on one foot, remembering Śiva / and reciting the five-syllable mantra, Pārvatī practiced great austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
cīravalkalasaṃvītā jaṭāsaṅghātadhāriṇī |
śivacintanasaṃsaktā jigāya tapasā munīn ||
meaning:
चीरवल्कलसंवीता जटासङ्घातधारिणी |
शिवचिन्तनसंसक्ता जिगाय तपसा मुनीन् ||
text_mt: Clad in rags and bark, wearing a mass of matted hair, / devoted to meditating on Śiva, she surpassed the sages by her austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tasyāstapasyantyā cintayantyā maheśvaram |
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi jagmuḥ kālyāstapovane ||
meaning:
एवं तस्यास्तपस्यन्त्या चिन्तयन्त्या महेश्वरम् |
त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि जग्मुः काल्यास्तपोवने ||
text_mt: As she thus practiced austerity, meditating on Maheśvara, / three thousand years passed for Kālī in the penance grove.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi yatra tepe tapo haraḥ |
tatra kṣaṇamathoṣitvā cintayāmāsa sā śivā ||
meaning:
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि यत्र तेपे तपो हरः |
तत्र क्षणमथोषित्वा चिन्तयामास सा शिवा ||
text_mt: Where Hara had performed austerity for sixty thousand years, / dwelling there for a moment, that Śivā thought:

sanskrit_iast:
niyamasthāṃ mahādeva kiṃ māṃ jānāsi nādhunā |
yenāhaṃ suciraṃ tena nānuyātā taporatā ||
meaning:
नियमस्थां महादेव किं मां जानासि नाधुना |
येनाहं सुचिरं तेन नानुयाता तपोरता ||
text_mt: "O Mahādeva, do you not know me now, who am steadfast in observance, / on account of which I, devoted to austerity, have not been followed by you for so long?

sanskrit_iast:
loke vede ca giriśo munibhirgīyate sadā |
śaṅkaraḥ sa hi sarvajñaḥ sarvātmā sarvadarśanaḥ ||
meaning:
लोके वेदे च गिरिशो मुनिभिर्गीयते सदा |
शङ्करः स हि सर्वज्ञः सर्वात्मा सर्वदर्शनः ||
text_mt: In the world and in the Veda, Giriśa is constantly praised by sages; / for he is Śaṅkara, all-knowing, the self of all, perceiving all,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtiprado devaḥ sarvabhāvānubhāvanaḥ |
bhaktābhīṣṭaprado nityaṃ sarvakleśanivāraṇaḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वभूतिप्रदो देवः सर्वभावानुभावनः |
भक्ताभीष्टप्रदो नित्यं सर्वक्लेशनिवारणः ||
text_mt: the god who bestows all prosperity, who manifests all states of being, / who constantly fulfills the wishes of devotees, and who removes all afflictions."

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmānparityajya yadi cāhaṃ vṛṣadhvaje |
anuraktā tadā so'tra samprasīdatu śaṅkaraḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वकामान्परित्यज्य यदि चाहं वृषध्वजे |
अनुरक्ता तदा सोऽत्र सम्प्रसीदतु शङ्करः ||
text_mt: "If, having abandoned all desires, I am devoted to Vṛṣadhvaja, / then may Śaṅkara be well pleased here."

sanskrit_iast:
yadi nāradatantroktamantro japtaḥ śarākṣaraḥ |
subhaktyā vidhinā nityaṃ samprasīdatu śaṅkaraḥ ||
meaning:
यदि नारदतन्त्रोक्तमन्त्रो जप्तः शराक्षरः |
सुभक्त्या विधिना नित्यं सम्प्रसीदतु शङ्करः ||
text_mt: "If the five-syllable mantra spoken in Nārada's Tantra has been repeated / with true devotion and according to rule every day, may Śaṅkara be well pleased."

sanskrit_iast:
yadi bhaktyā śivasyāhaṃ nirvikārā yathoditam |
sarveśvarasya cātyantaṃ samprasīdatu śaṅkaraḥ ||
meaning:
यदि भक्त्या शिवस्याहं निर्विकारा यथोदितम् |
सर्वेश्वरस्य चात्यन्तं सम्प्रसीदतु शङ्करः ||
text_mt: "If with devotion I am utterly free from passion toward Śiva, the Lord of all, / as prescribed, may Śaṅkara be well pleased."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ cintayatī nityaṃ tepe sā suciraṃ tapaḥ |
adhomukhī nirvikārā jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇī ||
meaning:
एवं चिन्तयती नित्यं तेपे सा सुचिरं तपः |
अधोमुखी निर्विकारा जटावल्कलधारिणी ||
text_mt: Reflecting thus continuously, she performed austerity for a very long time, / head downward, free from passion, wearing matted locks and bark garments.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā tayā tapastaptaṃ munīnāmapi duṣkaram |
smṛtvā ca puruṣāstatra paramaṃ vismayaṃ gatāḥ ||
meaning:
तथा तया तपस्तप्तं मुनीनामपि दुष्करम् |
स्मृत्वा च पुरुषास्तत्र परमं विस्मयं गताः ||
text_mt: Such austerity she performed as was hard even for sages to do; / remembering it, the men there were filled with utmost amazement.

sanskrit_iast:
tattapodarśanārthaṃ hi samājagmuśca te'khilāḥ |
dhanyānnijānmanyamānā jagaduśceti sammatāḥ ||
meaning:
तत्तपोदर्शनार्थं हि समाजग्मुश्च तेऽखिलाः |
धन्यान्निजान्मन्यमाना जगदुश्चेति सम्मताः ||
text_mt: Indeed, they all came to witness that austerity; / considering themselves blessed, those esteemed ones spoke thus:

sanskrit_iast:
mahatāṃ dharmavṛddheṣu gamanaṃ śreya ucyate |
pramāṇaṃ tapaso nāsti mānyo dharmaḥsadā budhaiḥ ||
meaning:
महतां धर्मवृद्धेषु गमनं श्रेय उच्यते |
प्रमाणं तपसो नास्ति मान्यो धर्मःसदा बुधैः ||
text_mt: "To go among those who are advanced in righteousness is said to be the highest good for the great. / There is no limit to austerity; righteousness is always to be honored by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā dṛṣṭvā tapo'syāstu kimanyaiḥ kriyate tapaḥ |
asmāttapo'dhikaṃ loke na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा तपोऽस्यास्तु किमन्यैः क्रियते तपः |
अस्मात्तपोऽधिकं लोके न भूतं न भविष्यति ||
text_mt: Having heard of and seen her austerity, what austerity could be performed by others? / Austerity greater than this never was, nor ever will be in the world!"

sanskrit_iast:
jalpanta iti te sarve supraśasya śivātapaḥ |
jagmuḥ svaṃ dhāma muditāḥ kaṭhināṅgāśca ye hyapi ||
meaning:
जल्पन्त इति ते सर्वे सुप्रशस्य शिवातपः |
जग्मुः स्वं धाम मुदिताः कठिनाङ्गाश्च ये ह्यपि ||
text_mt: Speaking thus, they all praised Śivā's austerity exceedingly; / and even those who were hardy-bodied returned to their own abodes, gladdened.

sanskrit_iast:
anyacchṛṇu maharṣe tvaṃ prabhāvaṃ tapaso'dhunā |
pārvatyā jagadambāyāḥ parāścaryakaraṃ mahat ||
meaning:
अन्यच्छृणु महर्षे त्वं प्रभावं तपसोऽधुना |
पार्वत्या जगदम्बायाः पराश्चर्यकरं महत् ||
text_mt: Now hear another effect of austerity, O great sage, / the great, exceedingly wondrous effect of Pārvatī, the mother of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāśramagatā ye ca svabhāvena virodhinaḥ |
te'pyāsam̐statprabhāveṇa virodharahitāstadā ||
meaning:
तदाश्रमगता ये च स्वभावेन विरोधिनः |
तेऽप्यासम्̐स्तत्प्रभावेण विरोधरहितास्तदा ||
text_mt: Those who had come to that hermitage and were natural enemies / became free from enmity at that time by her power.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhā gāvaśca satataṃ rāgādidoṣasaṃyutāḥ |
tanmahimnā ca te tatra nābādhanta parasparam ||
meaning:
सिंहा गावश्च सततं रागादिदोषसंयुताः |
तन्महिम्ना च ते तत्र नाबाधन्त परस्परम् ||
text_mt: Lions and cows, constantly possessed of passion and other faults, / did not torment one another there by her greatness.

sanskrit_iast:
athānye ca muniśreṣṭha mārjārā mūṣakādayaḥ |
nisargādvairiṇo yatra vikriyante sma na kvacit ||
meaning:
अथान्ये च मुनिश्रेष्ठ मार्जारा मूषकादयः |
निसर्गाद्वैरिणो यत्र विक्रियन्ते स्म न क्वचित् ||
text_mt: Moreover, O best of sages, cats, mice, and the like, / enemies by nature, were not agitated anywhere there.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣāśca saphalāstatra tṛṇāni vividhāni ca |
puṣpāṇi ca vicitrāṇi tatrāsanmunisattama ||
meaning:
वृक्षाश्च सफलास्तत्र तृणानि विविधानि च |
पुष्पाणि च विचित्राणि तत्रासन्मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: Trees bore fruit there, various grasses grew, / and wondrous flowers were there, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvanaṃ ca tadā sarvaṃ kailāsenopamānvitam |
jātaṃ ca tapasastasyāḥ siddhirūpamabhūttadā ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaḥ pārvatīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
तद्वनं च तदा सर्वं कैलासेनोपमान्वितम् |
जातं च तपसस्तस्याः सिद्धिरूपमभूत्तदा ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां तृतीयः पार्वतीखण्डे
text_mt:
And that whole forest then came to resemble Kailāsa; / it became the very embodiment of the fulfillment of her austerity.

Thus ends the twenty-second chapter, titled "Description of Pārvatī's Austerity," in the third section, the Pārvatīkhaṇḍa, of the second book, the Rudrasaṃhitā, of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
evaṃ tapatyāṃ pārvatyāṃ śivaprāptau munīśvara |
cirakālo vyatīyāya prādurbhūto haro na hi ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एवं तपत्यां पार्वत्यां शिवप्राप्तौ मुनीश्वर |
चिरकालो व्यतीयाय प्रादुर्भूतो हरो न हि ||
title: trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivena pārvatīsāntvanam
text_mt: Brahmā said: / While Pārvatī was thus practicing austerity to attain Śiva, O lord of sages, / a long time passed, but Hara did not appear.

sanskrit_iast:
himālayastadāgatya pārvatīṃ kṛtaniścayām |
sabhāryaḥ sasutāmātya uvāca parameśvarīm ||
meaning:
हिमालयस्तदागत्य पार्वतीं कृतनिश्चयाम् |
सभार्यः ससुतामात्य उवाच परमेश्वरीम् ||
text_mt: Himālaya then approached Pārvatī, who had made up her mind, / together with his wife, sons, and ministers, and spoke to the Supreme Lady.

sanskrit_iast:
himālaya uvāca |
mā khidyatāṃ mahābhāge tapasānena pārvatī |
rudro na dṛśyate bāle virakto nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
हिमालय उवाच |
मा खिद्यतां महाभागे तपसानेन पार्वती |
रुद्रो न दृश्यते बाले विरक्तो नात्र संशयः ||
text_mt: Himālaya said: / "Do not be distressed by this austerity, O fortunate Pārvatī! / Rudra is not to be seen, O girl; he is detached, there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ tanvī sukumārāṅgī tapasā ca vimohitā |
bhaviṣyasi na sandehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmi te ||
meaning:
त्वं तन्वी सुकुमाराङ्गी तपसा च विमोहिता |
भविष्यसि न सन्देहः सत्यं सत्यं वदामि ते ||
text_mt: You are slender, with delicate limbs, and bewildered by austerity / you will become—without doubt; I speak the truth, the absolute truth to you.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāduttiṣṭha caihi tvaṃ svagṛhaṃ varavarṇini |
kiṃ tena tava rudreṇa yena dagdhaḥ purā smaraḥ ||
meaning:
तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ चैहि त्वं स्वगृहं वरवर्णिनि |
किं तेन तव रुद्रेण येन दग्धः पुरा स्मरः ||
text_mt: Therefore arise and come to your own home, O fair-complexioned lady! / What is the use of that Rudra to you, by whom Love was formerly burned?

sanskrit_iast:
ato hi nirvikāratvāttvāmādātuṃ varāṃ haraḥ |
nāgamiṣyati deveśi taṃ kathaṃ prārthayiṣyasi ||
meaning:
अतो हि निर्विकारत्वात्त्वामादातुं वरां हरः |
नागमिष्यति देवेशि तं कथं प्रार्थयिष्यसि ||
text_mt: Because of his desireless nature, Hara will not come / to take you, the best [of maidens], O queen of the gods; how will you entreat him?

sanskrit_iast:
gaganastho yathā candro grahītuṃ na hi śakyate |
tathaiva durgamaṃ śambhuṃ jānīhi tvamihānaghe ||
meaning:
गगनस्थो यथा चन्द्रो ग्रहीतुं न हि शक्यते |
तथैव दुर्गमं शम्भुं जानीहि त्वमिहानघे ||
text_mt: Just as the moon in the sky cannot be grasped, / even so know Śambhu to be unapproachable here, O sinless one!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
tathaiva menayā coktā tathā sahyādriṇā satī |
meruṇā mandareṇaiva mainākena tathaiva sā ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
तथैव मेनया चोक्ता तथा सह्याद्रिणा सती |
मेरुणा मन्दरेणैव मैनाकेन तथैव सा ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Likewise Satī was addressed by Menā, by the Sahya mountain, / by Meru, by Mandara, and likewise by Maināka;

sanskrit_iast:
evamanyaiḥ kṣitidhraiśca krauñcādibhiranāturā |
tathaiva girijā proktā nānāvādavidhāyibhiḥ ||
meaning:
एवमन्यैः क्षितिध्रैश्च क्रौञ्चादिभिरनातुरा |
तथैव गिरिजा प्रोक्ता नानावादविधायिभिः ||
text_mt: likewise, the unperturbed Girijā was addressed by other mountains, / such as Krauñca, who presented various arguments.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ proktā yadā tanvī sā sarvaiḥ tapasi sthitā |
uvāca prahasantyeva himavantaṃ śucismitā ||
meaning:
एवं प्रोक्ता यदा तन्वी सा सर्वैः तपसि स्थिता |
उवाच प्रहसन्त्येव हिमवन्तं शुचिस्मिता ||
text_mt: When addressed thus by all, the slender lady, steadfast in her austerity, / laughed gently with a bright smile and spoke to Himavant:

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca |
purā proktaṃ mayā tāta mātaḥ kiṃ vismṛtaṃ tvayā |
adhunāpi pratijñāṃ ca śṛṇudhvaṃ mama bāndhavāḥ ||
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच |
पुरा प्रोक्तं मया तात मातः किं विस्मृतं त्वया |
अधुनापि प्रतिज्ञां च शृणुध्वं मम बान्धवाः ||
text_mt: Pārvatī said: / "O father, what I said previously—O mother, have you forgotten it? / Even now, hear my vow, O my kinsmen!

sanskrit_iast:
virakto'sau mahādevo yena dagdho ruṣā smaraḥ |
taṃ toṣayāmi tapasā śaṅkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam ||
meaning:
विरक्तोऽसौ महादेवो येन दग्धो रुषा स्मरः |
तं तोषयामि तपसा शङ्करं भक्तवत्सलम् ||
text_mt: That Mahādeva, who is detached, by whom Love was burned in anger— / him, Śaṅkara, affectionate toward devotees, I shall propitiate through austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve bhavanto gacchantu svaṃ svaṃ dhāma praharṣitāḥ |
bhaviṣyatyeva tuṣṭo'sau nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
meaning:
सर्वे भवन्तो गच्छन्तु स्वं स्वं धाम प्रहर्षिताः |
भविष्यत्येव तुष्टोऽसौ नात्र कार्या विचारणा ||
text_mt: May all of you depart to your respective abodes rejoicing; / he will surely be pleased; no hesitation should be felt in this regard.

sanskrit_iast:
dagdho hi madano yena yena dagdhaṃ girervanam |
tamānayiṣye cātraiva tapasā kevalena hi ||
meaning:
दग्धो हि मदनो येन येन दग्धं गिरेर्वनम् |
तमानयिष्ये चात्रैव तपसा केवलेन हि ||
text_mt: By whom Madana was burned, by whom the mountain forest was burned— / him indeed I shall bring right here by austerity alone.

sanskrit_iast:
tapobalena mahatā susevyo hi sadāśivaḥ |
jānīdhvaṃ hi mahābhāgāḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmi vaḥ ||
meaning:
तपोबलेन महता सुसेव्यो हि सदाशिवः |
जानीध्वं हि महाभागाः सत्यं सत्यं वदामि वः ||
text_mt: By the great power of austerity Sadāśiva is truly easily served; / know this, O fortunate ones; I tell you the truth, the absolute truth!"

sanskrit_iast:
ābhāṣya caivaṃ girijā ca menakāṃ mainākabandhuṃ pitaraṃ himālayam |
tūṣṇīṃ babhūvāśu subhāṣiṇī śivā samandaraṃ parvatarājabālikā ||
meaning:
आभाष्य चैवं गिरिजा च मेनकां मैनाकबन्धुं पितरं हिमालयम् |
तूष्णीं बभूवाशु सुभाषिणी शिवा समन्दरं पर्वतराजबालिका ||
text_mt: Having thus spoken to Menakā, to her brother Maināka, to Mandara, / and to her father Himālaya, Girijā Śivā, the sweet-speaking daughter of the king of mountains, immediately fell silent.

sanskrit_iast:
jagmustathoktāḥ śivayā hi parvatā yathāgatenāpi vicakṣaṇāste |
praśaṃsamānā girijāṃ muhurmuhuḥ suvismitā hemanageśvarādyāḥ ||
meaning:
जग्मुस्तथोक्ताः शिवया हि पर्वता यथागतेनापि विचक्षणास्ते |
प्रशंसमाना गिरिजां मुहुर्मुहुः सुविस्मिता हेमनगेश्वराद्याः ||
text_mt: Addressed thus by Śivā, those wise mountains departed / just as they had come, praising Girijā again and again, filled with great wonder, headed by the lord of the golden mountains [Meru].

sanskrit_iast:
gateṣu teṣu sūrveṣu sakhībhiḥ parivāritā |
tapastepe tadadhikaṃ paramārthasuniścayā ||
meaning:
गतेषु तेषु सूर्वेषु सखीभिः परिवारिता |
तपस्तेपे तदधिकं परमार्थसुनिश्चया ||
text_mt: When all of them had gone, she, surrounded by her female companions, / performed even greater austerity, firmly resolved upon the highest reality.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā mahatā tena taptamāsīccarācaram |
trailokyaṃ hi muniśreṣṭha sadevāsuramānuṣam ||
meaning:
तपसा महता तेन तप्तमासीच्चराचरम् |
त्रैलोक्यं हि मुनिश्रेष्ठ सदेवासुरमानुषम् ||
text_mt: By that immense austerity, the moving and unmoving creation was heated, / indeed, the three worlds with their gods, asuras, and humans, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā surāsurāḥ sarve yakṣakinnaracāraṇāḥ |
siddhāḥsādhyāśca munayo vidyādharamahoragāḥ ||
meaning:
तदा सुरासुराः सर्वे यक्षकिन्नरचारणाः |
सिद्धाःसाध्याश्च मुनयो विद्याधरमहोरगाः ||
text_mt: Then all the gods and asuras, yakṣas, kinnaras, and cāraṇas, / siddhas, sādhyas, sages, vidyādharas, and great serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
saprajāpatayaścaiva guhyakāśca tathāpare |
kaṣṭāt kaṣṭataraṃ prāptāḥ kāraṇaṃ na viduḥ sma tat ||
meaning:
सप्रजापतयश्चैव गुह्यकाश्च तथापरे |
कष्टात् कष्टतरं प्राप्ताः कारणं न विदुः स्म तत् ||
text_mt: along with the prajāpatis, and likewise other guhyakas, / reached the most terrible distress, and they did not know the cause of it.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve militvā śakrādyā gurumāmantrya vihvalāḥ |
sumerau taptasarvāṅgā vidhiṃ māṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वे मिलित्वा शक्राद्या गुरुमामन्त्र्य विह्वलाः |
सुमेरौ तप्तसर्वाङ्गा विधिं मां शरणं ययुः ||
text_mt: All gathered together, Śakra and the others, distraught, consulted their preceptor [Bṛhaspati], / and with their bodies scorched, they went for refuge to Sumeru, to me, the Creator [Brahmā].

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā praṇamyāśu vihvalā naṣṭasutviṣaḥ |
ūcuḥsarve ca saṃstūya hyaikapadyena māṃ hi te ||
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा प्रणम्याशु विह्वला नष्टसुत्विषः |
ऊचुःसर्वे च संस्तूय ह्यैकपद्येन मां हि ते ||
text_mt: Having gone there and quickly bowed down, distraught, their luster lost, / having praised me together in a single voice, they said:

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ |
tvayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram |
santaptamati kasmādvai na jñātaṃ kāraṇaṃ vibho ||
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः |
त्वया सृष्टमिदं सर्वं जगदेतच्चराचरम् |
सन्तप्तमति कस्माद्वै न ज्ञातं कारणं विभो ||
text_mt: The gods said: / "All this universe, moving and unmoving, was created by you; / why is it exceedingly torrid? The cause is not known, O all-pervading Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
tad brūhi kāraṇaṃ brahman jñātumarhasi naḥ prabho |
dagdhībhūtatanūndevān tvatto nānyo'sti rakṣakaḥ ||
meaning:
तद् ब्रूहि कारणं ब्रह्मन् ज्ञातुमर्हसि नः प्रभो |
दग्धीभूततनून्देवान् त्वत्तो नान्योऽस्ति रक्षकः ||
text_mt: Therefore tell us the cause, O Brahmā; you ought to know it, O lord; / for the gods whose bodies are burned, there is no other protector than you."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityākarṇya vacasteṣāmahaṃ smṛtvā śivaṃ hṛdā |
vicārya manasā sarvaṃ girijāyāstapaḥ phalam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तेषामहं स्मृत्वा शिवं हृदा |
विचार्य मनसा सर्वं गिरिजायास्तपः फलम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing these words of theirs, I remembered Śiva in my heart, / and considered in my mind the whole fruit of Girijā's austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhaṃ viśvamiti jñātvā taiḥ sarvairiha sādarāt |
haraye tatkathayituṃ kṣīrābdhimagamaṃ drutam ||
meaning:
दग्धं विश्वमिति ज्ञात्वा तैः सर्वैरिह सादरात् |
हरये तत्कथयितुं क्षीराब्धिमगमं द्रुतम् ||
text_mt: Knowing that the universe was being burned by all this, / I quickly went with reverence to the Ocean of Milk to report it to Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā hariṃ dṛṣṭvā vilasantaṃ sukhāsane |
supraṇamya susaṃstūya prāvocaṃ sāñjaliḥ suraiḥ ||
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा हरिं दृष्ट्वा विलसन्तं सुखासने |
सुप्रणम्य सुसंस्तूय प्रावोचं साञ्जलिः सुरैः ||
text_mt: Having gone there and seen Hari reclining on a comfortable seat, / having bowed down well and praised him, with folded hands alongside the gods, I said:

sanskrit_iast:
trāhi trāhi mahāviṣṇo taptānnaḥ śaraṇāgatān |
tapasogreṇa pārvatyāstapantyāḥ parameṇa hi ||
meaning:
त्राहि त्राहि महाविष्णो तप्तान्नः शरणागतान् |
तपसोग्रेण पार्वत्यास्तपन्त्याः परमेण हि ||
text_mt: "Protect us, protect us, O Mahāviṣṇu! We who have come for refuge are burned / by the fierce, supreme austerity of Pārvatī practicing penance!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityākarṇya vacasteṣāmasmadādidivaukasām |
śeṣāsane samāviṣṭo'smānuvāca rameśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तेषामस्मदादिदिवौकसाम् |
शेषासने समाविष्टोऽस्मानुवाच रमेश्वरः ||
text_mt: Hearing those words of the gods headed by us, / seated on the serpent Śeṣa, the lord of Ramā spoke to us:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca |
jñātaṃ sarvaṃ nidānaṃ me pārvatītapaso'dya vai |
yuṣmābhiḥ sahitastvadya vrajāmi parameśvaram ||
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच |
ज्ञातं सर्वं निदानं मे पार्वतीतपसोऽद्य वै |
युष्माभिः सहितस्त्वद्य व्रजामि परमेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Viṣṇu said: / "I have learned today the entire cause of Pārvatī's austerity. / Accompanied by you, I shall go today to Parameśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevaṃ prārthayāmo girijāprāpaṇāya tam |
pāṇigrahārthamadhunā lokānāṃ svastaye'marāḥ ||
meaning:
महादेवं प्रार्थयामो गिरिजाप्रापणाय तम् |
पाणिग्रहार्थमधुना लोकानां स्वस्तयेऽमराः ||
text_mt: We shall entreat Mahādeva to accept the mountain-born goddess [Girijā], / for taking her hand [in marriage] now, O immortals, for the welfare of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ dātuṃ śivāyai hi devadevaḥ pinākadhṛk |
yathā ceṣyati tatraiva kariṣyāmo'dhunā hi tat ||
meaning:
वरं दातुं शिवायै हि देवदेवः पिनाकधृक् |
यथा चेष्यति तत्रैव करिष्यामोऽधुना हि तत् ||
text_mt: In whatever way the god of gods, the bow-bearer [Pinākadhṛk], will wish to grant a boon / to Śivā, we shall indeed do that right now.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād vayaṃ gamiṣyāmo yatra rudro mahāprabhuḥ |
tapasogreṇa saṃyukto'dyāste paramamaṅgalaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्माद् वयं गमिष्यामो यत्र रुद्रो महाप्रभुः |
तपसोग्रेण संयुक्तोऽद्यास्ते परममङ्गलः ||
text_mt: Therefore we shall go where Rudra, the great lord, / engaged in fierce austerity, stays today, the supremely auspicious one."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
viṣṇostadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarva ūcuḥ surādayaḥ |
mahābhītā haṭhāt kuddhāddagdhukāmāt layaṅkarāt ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
विष्णोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्व ऊचुः सुरादयः |
महाभीता हठात् कुद्धाद्दग्धुकामात् लयङ्करात् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing those words of Viṣṇu, all the gods and others said, / greatly terrified of [Śiva] who might suddenly become angry, desiring to burn, bringing dissolution:

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ |
mahābhayaṅkaraṃ kruddhaṃ kālānalasamaprabham |
na yāsyāmo vayaṃ sarve virūpākṣaṃ mahāprabhum ||
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः |
महाभयङ्करं क्रुद्धं कालानलसमप्रभम् |
न यास्यामो वयं सर्वे विरूपाक्षं महाप्रभुम् ||
text_mt: The gods said: / "To the very terrifying, angered Virūpākṣa, the great lord, / possessing splendor equal to the fire of time's end, we all will not go.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā dagdhaḥ purā tena madano duratikramaḥ |
tathaiva krodhayukto naḥ sa dhakṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
यथा दग्धः पुरा तेन मदनो दुरतिक्रमः |
तथैव क्रोधयुक्तो नः स धक्ष्यति न संशयः ||
text_mt: Just as Madana, insurmountable [to others], was previously burned by him, / even so, full of wrath, he will burn us; there is no doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca tadākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ śakrādīnāṃ rameśvaraḥ |
sāntvayaṃstānsurānsarvānprovāca sa harirmune ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच तदाकर्ण्य वचस्तेषां शक्रादीनां रमेश्वरः |
सान्त्वयंस्तान्सुरान्सर्वान्प्रोवाच स हरिर्मुने ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing that speech of Śakra and the others, O sage, the lord of Ramā, / Hari, consoling all those gods, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
hariruvāca |
he surā madvacaḥ prītyā śṛṇutādarato'khilāḥ |
na vo dhakṣyati sa svāmī devānāṃ bhayanāśanaḥ ||
meaning:
हरिरुवाच |
हे सुरा मद्वचः प्रीत्या शृणुतादरतोऽखिलाः |
न वो धक्ष्यति स स्वामी देवानां भयनाशनः ||
text_mt: Hari said: / "O gods, listen affectionately to my words with respect, all of you! / That master, the destroyer of the fear of the gods, will not burn you.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādbhavadbhirgantavyaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ |
śambhuṃ śubhakaraṃ matvā śaraṇaṃ tasya suprabhoḥ ||
meaning:
तस्माद्भवद्भिर्गन्तव्यं मया सार्धं विचक्षणैः |
शम्भुं शुभकरं मत्वा शरणं तस्य सुप्रभोः ||
text_mt: Therefore, wise as you are, you must go with me, / regarding Śambhu as the bringer of good fortune, to the refuge of that illustrious lord.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ hyadhīśaṃ vareṇyarūpaṃ hi paraṃ purāṇam |
tapo juṣāṇaṃ paramātmarūpaṃ parātparaṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmaḥ ||
meaning:
शिवं पुराणं पुरुषं ह्यधीशं वरेण्यरूपं हि परं पुराणम् |
तपो जुषाणं परमात्मरूपं परात्परं तं शरणं व्रजामः ||
text_mt: Let us take refuge in Śiva, the ancient Puruṣa, the sovereign lord, / whose form is most worthy of choice, the supreme ancient one, / enjoying austerity, the form of the supreme self, higher than the high."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
evamuktāstadā devā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā |
jagmuḥ sarve tena saha draṣṭukāmāḥ pinākinam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एवमुक्तास्तदा देवा विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना |
जग्मुः सर्वे तेन सह द्रष्टुकामाः पिनाकिनम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Thus addressed at that time by the mighty Viṣṇu, / all the gods, wishing to see the bow-wielder [Pinākin], went along with him.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ śailaputryāstattapo draṣṭuṃ tadāśramam |
jagmurmārgavaśātsarve viṣṇvādyāḥ sakutūhalāḥ ||
meaning:
प्रथमं शैलपुत्र्यास्तत्तपो द्रष्टुं तदाश्रमम् |
जग्मुर्मार्गवशात्सर्वे विष्ण्वाद्याः सकुतूहलाः ||
text_mt: First, to see that austerity of the mountain's daughter, / Viṣṇu and the others, full of curiosity, all went to her hermitage on their way.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyāḥ sutapo dṛṣṭvā tejasā vyāpṛtāstadā |
praṇemustāṃ jagaddhātrīṃ tejorūpāṃ tapaḥsthitām ||
meaning:
पार्वत्याः सुतपो दृष्ट्वा तेजसा व्यापृतास्तदा |
प्रणेमुस्तां जगद्धात्रीं तेजोरूपां तपःस्थिताम् ||
text_mt: Having seen the great austerity of Pārvatī, enveloped then with brilliance, / they bowed to her, the supporter of the world, whose form is radiant, steadfast in austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
praśaṃsantastapastasyāḥ sākṣātsiddhitanoḥ surāḥ |
jagmustatra tadā te ca yatrāste vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ||
meaning:
प्रशंसन्तस्तपस्तस्याः साक्षात्सिद्धितनोः सुराः |
जग्मुस्तत्र तदा ते च यत्रास्ते वृषभध्वजः ||
text_mt: Praising the austerity of her whose body was visible perfection, the gods / then went there, where stays Vṛṣabhadhvaja.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā ca te devāstvāṃ mune praiṣayaṃstadā |
paśyanto dūratastasthuḥ kāmabhasmakṛto harāt ||
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा च ते देवास्त्वां मुने प्रैषयंस्तदा |
पश्यन्तो दूरतस्तस्थुः कामभस्मकृतो हरात् ||
text_mt: And having gone there, O sage, those gods then sent you forth, / and stood watching from afar out of fear of Hara, who had reduced Kāma to ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada tvaṃ śivasthānaṃ tadā gatvābhayaḥ sadā |
śivabhakto viśeṣeṇa prasannaṃ dṛṣṭavān prabhum ||
meaning:
नारद त्वं शिवस्थानं तदा गत्वाभयः सदा |
शिवभक्तो विशेषेण प्रसन्नं दृष्टवान् प्रभुम् ||
text_mt: O Nārada, having gone then to the abode of Śiva, always fearless, / being especially devoted to Śiva, you saw the gracious lord.

sanskrit_iast:
punarāgatya yatnena devānāhūya tāṃstataḥ |
nināya śaṅkarasthānaṃ tadā viṣṇvādikānmune ||
meaning:
पुनरागत्य यत्नेन देवानाहूय तांस्ततः |
निनाय शङ्करस्थानं तदा विष्ण्वादिकान्मुने ||
text_mt: Having returned, having summoned those gods with effort from there, / O sage, you then led Viṣṇu and the others to the abode of Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
atha viṣṇvādayaḥ sarve tatra gatvā śivaṃ prabhum |
dadṛśuḥ sukhamāsīnaṃ prasannaṃ bhaktavatsalam ||
meaning:
अथ विष्ण्वादयः सर्वे तत्र गत्वा शिवं प्रभुम् |
ददृशुः सुखमासीनं प्रसन्नं भक्तवत्सलम् ||
text_mt: Then Viṣṇu and all the others, having gone there, saw lord Śiva / seated comfortably, gracious, affectionate toward devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
yogapaṭṭasthitaṃ śambhuṃ gaṇaiśca parivāritam |
taporūpaṃ dadhānaṃ ca parameśvararūpiṇam ||
meaning:
योगपट्टस्थितं शम्भुं गणैश्च परिवारितम् |
तपोरूपं दधानं च परमेश्वररूपिणम् ||
text_mt: Śambhu bound in a yogic posture, surrounded by his attendants, / embodying austerity, taking the form of Parameśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
tato viṣṇurmayānye ca surasiddhamunīśvarāḥ |
praṇamya tuṣṭuvuḥ sūktairvedopaniṣadanvitaiḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaḥ pārvatīkhaṇḍe
devā ūcuḥ |
namo rudrāya devāya madanāntakarāya ca ||
meaning:
ततो विष्णुर्मयान्ये च सुरसिद्धमुनीश्वराः |
प्रणम्य तुष्टुवुः सूक्तैर्वेदोपनिषदन्वितैः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां तृतीयः पार्वतीखण्डे
देवा ऊचुः |
नमो रुद्राय देवाय मदनान्तकराय च ||
text_mt:
Then Viṣṇu, along with me and other gods, perfected beings, and great sages, / bowed and praised [him] with hymns accompanied by the Vedas and Upaniṣads.

Thus ends the twenty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Consolation of Pārvatī and the Vision of the God Śiva,' in the Pārvatī section, the third in the Rudrasaṃhitā, in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

The gods said: / "Homage to Rudra, the god, and to the destroyer of Madana!

sanskrit_iast: stutyāya bhūribhāsāya trinetrāya namo namaḥ ||
meaning: स्तुत्याय भूरिभासाय त्रिनेत्राय नमो नमः ||
title: caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivakṛtā pārvatīvivāhasvīkṛtiḥ
text_mt: To the one worthy of praise, of abundant splendor, to the three-eyed one, homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
śipiviṣṭāya bhīmāya bhīmākṣāya namonamaḥ |
mahādevāya prabhave triviṣṭapataye namaḥ ||
meaning:
शिपिविष्टाय भीमाय भीमाक्षाय नमोनमः |
महादेवाय प्रभवे त्रिविष्टपतये नमः ||
text_mt: To Śipiviṣṭa, the terrible, the terrible-eyed one, homage, homage! / To Mahādeva, the mighty lord, homage to the lord of heaven!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ nāthaḥ sarvalokānāṃ pitā mātā tvamīśvaraḥ |
śambhurīśaḥ śaṅkaro'si dayālustvaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
त्वं नाथः सर्वलोकानां पिता माता त्वमीश्वरः |
शम्भुरीशः शङ्करोऽसि दयालुस्त्वं विशेषतः ||
text_mt: You are the protector of all worlds, the father, the mother, you are the Lord; / you are Śambhu, Īśa, Śaṅkara, you are especially compassionate.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ dhātā sarvajagatāṃ trātumarhasi naḥ prabho |
tvāṃ vinā kaḥ samartho'sti duḥkhanāśe maheśvara ||
meaning:
त्वं धाता सर्वजगतां त्रातुमर्हसि नः प्रभो |
त्वां विना कः समर्थोऽस्ति दुःखनाशे महेश्वर ||
text_mt: You are the sustainer of all worlds; you ought to save us, O lord! / Without you, who is capable of destroying sorrow, O Maheśvara?"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ surāṇāṃ nandikeśvaraḥ |
kṛpayā parayā yukto vijñaptuṃ śambhumārabhat ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तेषां सुराणां नन्दिकेश्वरः |
कृपया परया युक्तो विज्ञप्तुं शम्भुमारभत् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing those words of the gods, Nandikeśvara, / filled with supreme compassion, began to make a petition to Śambhu:

sanskrit_iast:
nandikeśvara uvāca |
viṣṇvādayaḥ suragaṇā munisiddhasaṅghā-stvāṃ draṣṭumeva suravarya viśeṣayanti |
kāryārthino'suravaraiḥ paribhartsyamānāḥ samyak parābhavapadaṃ paramaṃ prapannāḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दिकेश्वर उवाच |
विष्ण्वादयः सुरगणा मुनिसिद्धसङ्घा-स्त्वां द्रष्टुमेव सुरवर्य विशेषयन्ति |
कार्यार्थिनोऽसुरवरैः परिभर्त्स्यमानाः सम्यक् पराभवपदं परमं प्रपन्नाः ||
text_mt: Nandikeśvara said: / "The hosts of gods, Viṣṇu and others, and the multitudes of sages and perfected beings, / single you out, O best of gods, merely to see you; / seeking assistance, harassed by the foremost demons, / they have fallen into an utter state of supreme defeat.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvayā hi sarveśa trātavyā munayaḥ surāḥ |
dīnabandhurviśeṣeṇa tvamukto bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वया हि सर्वेश त्रातव्या मुनयः सुराः |
दीनबन्धुर्विशेषेण त्वमुक्तो भक्तवत्सलः ||
text_mt: Therefore, O lord of all, the sages and gods must indeed be saved by you; / you are called especially the friend of the wretched, affectionate toward devotees."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
evaṃ dayāvatā śambhurvijñapto nandinā bhṛśam |
śanaiḥ śanairuparamaddhyānādunmīlya cākṣiṇī ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एवं दयावता शम्भुर्विज्ञप्तो नन्दिना भृशम् |
शनैः शनैरुपरमद्ध्यानादुन्मील्य चाक्षिणी ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Thus entreatingly addressed by the compassionate Nandin, / Śambhu slowly ceased from meditation and opened his two eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
īśo'thoparataḥ śambhustadā paramakovidaḥ |
samādheḥ paramātmāsau surānsarvānuvāca ha ||
meaning:
ईशोऽथोपरतः शम्भुस्तदा परमकोविदः |
समाधेः परमात्मासौ सुरान्सर्वानुवाच ह ||
text_mt: Then lord Śambhu, supremely wise, / having ceased from contemplation, that supreme self spoke to all the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
śambhuruvāca |
kasmādyūyaṃ samāyātā matsamīpaṃ sureśvarāḥ |
haribrahmādayaḥ sarve brūta kāraṇamāśu tat ||
meaning:
शम्भुरुवाच |
कस्माद्यूयं समायाता मत्समीपं सुरेश्वराः |
हरिब्रह्मादयः सर्वे ब्रूत कारणमाशु तत् ||
text_mt: Śambhu said: / "Why have you, O lords of the gods, come near to me, / Hari, Brahmā, and all the rest? Tell that reason at once!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
iti śrutvā vacaḥ śambhoḥ sarve devā mudānvitāḥ |
viṣṇorvilokayāmāsurmukhaṃ vijñaptihetave ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इति श्रुत्वा वचः शम्भोः सर्वे देवा मुदान्विताः |
विष्णोर्विलोकयामासुर्मुखं विज्ञप्तिहेतवे ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having heard these words of Śambhu, all the gods, filled with joy, / looked at Viṣṇu's face so that he might submit their petition.

sanskrit_iast:
atha viṣṇurmahābhakto devānāṃ hitakārakaḥ |
madīritamuvācedaṃ surakāryaṃ mahattamam ||
meaning:
अथ विष्णुर्महाभक्तो देवानां हितकारकः |
मदीरितमुवाचेदं सुरकार्यं महत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Then Viṣṇu, the great devotee who brings welfare to the gods, / spoke this most important business of the gods, prompted by me:

sanskrit_iast:
tārakeṇa kṛtaṃ śambho devānāṃ paramādbhutam |
kaṣṭātkaṣṭataraṃ devā vijñaptuṃ sarva āgatāḥ ||
meaning:
तारकेण कृतं शम्भो देवानां परमाद्भुतम् |
कष्टात्कष्टतरं देवा विज्ञप्तुं सर्व आगताः ||
text_mt: "By Tāraka, O Śambhu, has been wrought a great disaster for the gods, / painful beyond pain; all the gods have come to make their plea.

sanskrit_iast:
he śambho tava putreṇaurasena hi bhaviṣyati |
nihatastārako daityo nānyathā mama bhāṣitam ||
meaning:
हे शम्भो तव पुत्रेणौरसेन हि भविष्यति |
निहतस्तारको दैत्यो नान्यथा मम भाषितम् ||
text_mt: O Śambhu, by your legitimate son indeed / the demon Tāraka will be slain; my speech is not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
vicāryetthaṃ mahādeva kṛpāṃ kuru namo'stu te |
devānsamuddhara svāmin kaṣṭāttārakanirmitāt ||
meaning:
विचार्येत्थं महादेव कृपां कुरु नमोऽस्तु ते |
देवान्समुद्धर स्वामिन् कष्टात्तारकनिर्मितात् ||
text_mt: Considering this, O Mahādeva, show compassion; homage be to you! / Deliver the gods, O master, from the misery caused by Tāraka.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvayā girijā deva śambho grahītavyā pāṇinā dakṣiṇena |
pāṇigraheṇaiva mahānubhāvāṃ dattāṃ girīndreṇa ca tāṃ kuruṣva ||
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वया गिरिजा देव शम्भो ग्रहीतव्या पाणिना दक्षिणेन |
पाणिग्रहेणैव महानुभावां दत्तां गिरीन्द्रेण च तां कुरुष्व ||
text_mt: Therefore, O god Śambhu, the mountain's daughter must be taken by your right hand; / make that noble lady yours by taking her hand in marriage, as she is given by the king of mountains."

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇostadvacanaṃ śrutvā prasanno hyabravīcchivaḥ |
darśayan sadgatiṃ teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ yogatatparaḥ ||
meaning:
विष्णोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रसन्नो ह्यब्रवीच्छिवः |
दर्शयन् सद्गतिं तेषां सर्वेषां योगतत्परः ||
text_mt: Hearing that speech of Viṣṇu, Śiva became pleased and spoke, / showing them all the good path, intent on yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca |
yadā me svīkṛtā devī girijā sarvasundarī |
tadā sarve surendrāśca munayo ṛṣayastadā ||
meaning:
शिव उवाच |
यदा मे स्वीकृता देवी गिरिजा सर्वसुन्दरी |
तदा सर्वे सुरेन्द्राश्च मुनयो ऋषयस्तदा ||
text_mt: Śiva said: / "When the goddess, the mountain-born, who is beautiful in every way, is accepted by me, / then all the kings of the gods, and the ascetics and sages at that time,

sanskrit_iast:
sakāmāśca bhaviṣyanti na kṣamāśca pare pathi |
jīvayiṣyati durgā sā pāṇigrahaṇataḥ smaram ||
meaning:
सकामाश्च भविष्यन्ति न क्षमाश्च परे पथि |
जीवयिष्यति दुर्गा सा पाणिग्रहणतः स्मरम् ||
text_mt: will also become full of desire and unable to tread the supreme path; / that Durgā will revive Smara by virtue of the marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
madano hi mayā dagdhaḥ sarveṣāṃ kāryasiddhaye |
brahmaṇo vacanādviṣṇo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
meaning:
मदनो हि मया दग्धः सर्वेषां कार्यसिद्धये |
ब्रह्मणो वचनाद्विष्णो नात्र कार्या विचारणा ||
text_mt: For Madana was burned by me for the accomplishment of the purpose of all, / at the word of Brahmā, O Viṣṇu; no doubt should be entertained on this matter."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vimṛśya manasā kāryākāryavyavasthitau |
sudhīḥ sarvaiśca devendra haṭhaṃ no kartumarhasi ||
meaning:
एवं विमृश्य मनसा कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ |
सुधीः सर्वैश्च देवेन्द्र हठं नो कर्तुमर्हसि ||
text_mt: Deliberating thus in mind on the determination of what should and should not be done, / O wise Indra, lord of the gods, along with everyone, you should not be obstinate.

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhe kāme mayā viṣṇo surakāryaṃ mahat kṛtam |
sarve tiṣṭhantu niṣkāmā mayā saha suniścitam ||
meaning:
दग्धे कामे मया विष्णो सुरकार्यं महत् कृतम् |
सर्वे तिष्ठन्तु निष्कामा मया सह सुनिश्चितम् ||
text_mt: O Viṣṇu, by my burning of Kāma a great service to the gods has been accomplished. / Let everyone remain free from desire along with me, definitely.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāhaṃ ca surāḥ sarve tathā yūyamayatnataḥ |
tapaḥ paramasaṃyuktāḥ kariṣyadhvaṃ suduṣkaram ||
meaning:
यथाहं च सुराः सर्वे तथा यूयमयत्नतः |
तपः परमसंयुक्ताः करिष्यध्वं सुदुष्करम् ||
text_mt: Just as I am, O all gods, so will you effortlessly, / being endowed with supreme tapas, perform very difficult [austerity].

sanskrit_iast:
yūyaṃ samādhinā tena madanena vinā surāḥ |
paramānandasaṃyuktā nirvikārā bhavantu vai ||
meaning:
यूयं समाधिना तेन मदनेन विना सुराः |
परमानन्दसंयुक्ता निर्विकारा भवन्तु वै ||
text_mt: Through that absorption, O gods, free from Madana, / may you truly become endowed with supreme bliss and changeless!

sanskrit_iast:
purāvṛttaṃ smarakṛtaṃ vismṛtaṃ yad vidhe hare |
mahendra munayo devā yattatsarvaṃ vimṛśyatām ||
meaning:
पुरावृत्तं स्मरकृतं विस्मृतं यद् विधे हरे |
महेन्द्र मुनयो देवा यत्तत्सर्वं विमृश्यताम् ||
text_mt: Has that past deed done by Smara been forgotten, O Vidhi, O Hari, / O Mahendra, sages, and gods? Let all of that be recalled!

sanskrit_iast:
mahādhanurdhareṇaiva madanena haṭhātsurāḥ |
sarveṣāṃ dhyānavidhvaṃsaḥ kṛtastena purāmarāḥ ||
meaning:
महाधनुर्धरेणैव मदनेन हठात्सुराः |
सर्वेषां ध्यानविध्वंसः कृतस्तेन पुरामराः ||
text_mt: By Madana himself, bearer of the great bow, by sheer force, O gods, / the meditation of everyone was destroyed in the past, O immortals.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmo hi narakāyaiva tasmāt krodho'bhijāyate |
krodhādbhavati sammoho mohācca bhraṃśate tapaḥ ||
meaning:
कामो हि नरकायैव तस्मात् क्रोधोऽभिजायते |
क्रोधाद्भवति सम्मोहो मोहाच्च भ्रंशते तपः ||
text_mt: For desire leads only to hell; from it anger is born; / from anger arises delusion, and from delusion tapas falls away.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmakrodhau parityājyau bhavadbhiḥ surasattamaiḥ |
sarvaireva ca mantavyaṃ madvākyaṃ nānyathā kvacit ||
meaning:
कामक्रोधौ परित्याज्यौ भवद्भिः सुरसत्तमैः |
सर्वैरेव च मन्तव्यं मद्वाक्यं नान्यथा क्वचित् ||
text_mt: Desire and anger are to be abandoned by you, the best of the gods; / and my word is to be respected by everyone, never otherwise at any time.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
evaṃ viśrāvya bhagavān mahādevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ |
surān pravācayāmāsa vidhiviṣṇū tathā munīn ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एवं विश्राव्य भगवान् महादेवो वृषध्वजः |
सुरान् प्रवाचयामास विधिविष्णू तथा मुनीन् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having thus proclaimed, the blessed Mahādeva Vṛṣadhvaja / addressed the gods, along with Vidhi, Viṣṇu, and the sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tūṣṇīmbhūto'bhavacchambhurdhyānamāśritya vai punaḥ |
āste purā yathā sthāṇurgaṇaiśca parivāritaḥ ||
meaning:
तूष्णीम्भूतोऽभवच्छम्भुर्ध्यानमाश्रित्य वै पुनः |
आस्ते पुरा यथा स्थाणुर्गणैश्च परिवारितः ||
text_mt: Śambhu became silent, once again resorting to meditation; / he sat surrounded by his attendants, just like a motionless pillar as before.

sanskrit_iast:
svātmānamātmanā śambhurātmanyeva vyacintayat |
nirañjanaṃ nirābhāsaṃ nirvikāraṃ nirāmayam ||
meaning:
स्वात्मानमात्मना शम्भुरात्मन्येव व्यचिन्तयत् |
निरञ्जनं निराभासं निर्विकारं निरामयम् ||
text_mt: Within his very self Śambhu contemplated his own self through the self: / stainless, free from appearances, changeless, and free from disease,

sanskrit_iast:
parātparataraṃ nityaṃ nirmamaṃ niravagraham |
śabdātītaṃ nirguṇaṃ ca jñānagamyaṃ parātparam ||
meaning:
परात्परतरं नित्यं निर्ममं निरवग्रहम् |
शब्दातीतं निर्गुणं च ज्ञानगम्यं परात्परम् ||
text_mt: higher than the highest, eternal, devoid of mine-ness, unrestrained, / beyond sound, devoid of qualities, knowable through wisdom, the supreme of the supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ svarūpaṃ paramaṃ cintayan dhyānamāsthitaḥ |
paramānandasammagno babhūva bahusūtikṛt ||
meaning:
एवं स्वरूपं परमं चिन्तयन् ध्यानमास्थितः |
परमानन्दसम्मग्नो बभूव बहुसूतिकृत् ||
text_mt: Thus contemplating his supreme nature, established in meditation, / he, the source of many creations, became submerged in supreme bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānasthitaṃ ca sarveśaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve divaukasaḥ |
hariśakrādayaḥ sarve nandinaṃ procurānatāḥ ||
meaning:
ध्यानस्थितं च सर्वेशं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे दिवौकसः |
हरिशक्रादयः सर्वे नन्दिनं प्रोचुरानताः ||
text_mt: And seeing the Lord of All seated in meditation, all the sky-dwellers, / all of them, Hari, Śakra, and the rest, bowing down, spoke to Nandin.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ |
kiṃ vayaṃ karavāmādya virakto dhyānamāsthitaḥ |
śambhustvaṃ śaṅkarasakhaḥ sarvajñaḥ śucisevakaḥ ||
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः |
किं वयं करवामाद्य विरक्तो ध्यानमास्थितः |
शम्भुस्त्वं शङ्करसखः सर्वज्ञः शुचिसेवकः ||
text_mt: The gods said: / What shall we do now? Śambhu is detached and seated in meditation. / You are the friend of Śaṅkara, all-knowing, and his pure servant.

sanskrit_iast:
kenopāyena giriśaḥ prasannaḥ syādgaṇādhipa |
tadupāyaṃ samācakṣva vayaṃ tvaccharaṇaṃ gatāḥ ||
meaning:
केनोपायेन गिरिशः प्रसन्नः स्याद्गणाधिप |
तदुपायं समाचक्ष्व वयं त्वच्छरणं गताः ||
text_mt: By what means might Giriśa become pleased, O lord of the attendants? / Tell us that means; we have taken refuge in you.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
iti vijñāpito devairmune haryādibhistadā |
pratyuvāca surāṃstānsa nandī śambhupriyo gaṇaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इति विज्ञापितो देवैर्मुने हर्यादिभिस्तदा |
प्रत्युवाच सुरांस्तान्स नन्दी शम्भुप्रियो गणः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Thus addressed by the gods led by Hari at that time, O sage, / that Nandin, the attendant beloved of Śambhu, replied to those gods.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
he hare he vidhe śakra nirjarā munayastathā |
śṛṇudhvaṃ vacanaṃ me hi śivasantoṣakārakam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
हे हरे हे विधे शक्र निर्जरा मुनयस्तथा |
शृणुध्वं वचनं मे हि शिवसन्तोषकारकम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / O Hari, O Vidhi, O Śakra, O immortals and sages, / listen indeed to my words that produce satisfaction in Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi vo haṭha evādya śivadāraparigrahe |
atidīnatayā sarve sunutiṃ kurutādarāt ||
meaning:
यदि वो हठ एवाद्य शिवदारपरिग्रहे |
अतिदीनतया सर्वे सुनुतिं कुरुतादरात् ||
text_mt: If you are indeed obstinate today regarding Śiva’s taking a wife, / then with extreme humility let all of you offer a sincere hymn of praise with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktervaśyo mahādevo na sādhāraṇataḥ surāḥ |
akāryamapi sadbhaktyā karoti parameśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
भक्तेर्वश्यो महादेवो न साधारणतः सुराः |
अकार्यमपि सद्भक्त्या करोति परमेश्वरः ||
text_mt: Mahādeva is subject to devotion, not to ordinary means, O gods. / Parameśvara performs even what should not be done through true devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kuruta sarve hi vidhiviṣṇumukhāḥ surāḥ |
yathāgatena mārgeṇānyathā gacchata mā ciram ||
meaning:
एवं कुरुत सर्वे हि विधिविष्णुमुखाः सुराः |
यथागतेन मार्गेणान्यथा गच्छत मा चिरम् ||
text_mt: Act thus, indeed, all gods headed by Vidhi and Viṣṇu! / Otherwise, go without delay along the path by which you came!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityākarṇya vacastasya mune viṣṇvādayaḥ surāḥ |
tatheti mattvā suprītyā śaṅkaraṃ tuṣṭuvurhi te ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य मुने विष्ण्वादयः सुराः |
तथेति मत्त्वा सुप्रीत्या शङ्करं तुष्टुवुर्हि ते ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having heard his words, O sage, the gods led by Viṣṇu, / thinking 'so be it', praised Śaṅkara with great joy.

sanskrit_iast:
devadeva mahādeva karuṇāsāgara prabho |
samuddhara mahākleśāt trāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān ||
meaning:
देवदेव महादेव करुणासागर प्रभो |
समुद्धर महाक्लेशात् त्राहि नः शरणागतान् ||
text_mt: O God of gods, O Mahādeva, O ocean of compassion, O Lord! / Rescue us from great distress; protect us who have sought refuge!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityevaṃ bahudīnoktyā tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṅkaraṃ surāḥ |
ruruduḥ susvaraṃ sarve premavyākulamānasāḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्येवं बहुदीनोक्त्या तुष्टुवुः शङ्करं सुराः |
रुरुदुः सुस्वरं सर्वे प्रेमव्याकुलमानसाः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Thus with many humble words the gods praised Śaṅkara; / their minds agitated by love, all wept aloud.

sanskrit_iast:
harirmayā sudīnoktyā suvijñaptaṃ cakāra ha |
saṃsmaranmanasā śambhuṃ bhaktyā paramayānvitaḥ ||
meaning:
हरिर्मया सुदीनोक्त्या सुविज्ञप्तं चकार ह |
संस्मरन्मनसा शम्भुं भक्त्या परमयान्वितः ||
text_mt: Hari, together with me, made an earnest appeal with very humble speech, / remembering Śambhu in his mind, endowed with supreme devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
surairevaṃ stutaḥ śambhurhariṇā ca mayā bhṛśam |
bhaktavātsalyato dhyānādvirato'bhūnmaheśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
सुरैरेवं स्तुतः शम्भुर्हरिणा च मया भृशम् |
भक्तवात्सल्यतो ध्यानाद्विरतोऽभून्महेश्वरः ||
text_mt: When Śambhu was thus praised intensely by the gods, by Hari, and by me, / Maheśvara ceased from meditation out of affection for his devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca suprasannātmā haryādīnharṣayanharaḥ |
vilokya karuṇādṛṣṭyā śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
उवाच सुप्रसन्नात्मा हर्यादीन्हर्षयन्हरः |
विलोक्य करुणादृष्ट्या शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः ||
text_mt: Looking with a gaze of compassion, Śaṅkara, affectionate toward devotees, / with a very gracious mind, Hara spoke, gladdening Hari and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca |
he hare he vidhe devāḥ śakrādyā yugapatsame |
kimarthamāgatā yūyaṃ satyaṃ brūta mamāgrataḥ ||
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच |
हे हरे हे विधे देवाः शक्राद्या युगपत्समे |
किमर्थमागता यूयं सत्यं ब्रूत ममाग्रतः ||
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / O Hari, O Vidhi, O gods headed by Śakra, all together equally, / for what purpose have you come? Speak the truth before me.

sanskrit_iast:
hariruvāca |
sarvajñastvaṃ maheśāna tvantaryāmyakhileśvaraḥ |
kiṃ na jānāsi cittasthaṃ tathā vacmyapi śāsanāt ||
meaning:
हरिरुवाच |
सर्वज्ञस्त्वं महेशान त्वन्तर्याम्यखिलेश्वरः |
किं न जानासि चित्तस्थं तथा वच्म्यपि शासनात् ||
text_mt: Hari said: / You are omniscient, O Maheśāna, the inner ruler, the Lord of all. / Do you not know what is in our hearts? Even so, I speak at your command.

sanskrit_iast:
tārakāsurato duḥkhaṃ sambhūtaṃ vividhaṃ mṛḍa |
sarveṣāṃ nastadarthaṃ hi prasanno'kāri vai suraiḥ ||
meaning:
तारकासुरतो दुःखं सम्भूतं विविधं मृड |
सर्वेषां नस्तदर्थं हि प्रसन्नोऽकारि वै सुरैः ||
text_mt: Manifold suffering has arisen from the demon Tāraka, O Mṛḍa; / for the sake of all of us, you have indeed been propitiated by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
śivā sā janitā śailāttvadarthaṃ hi himālayāt |
tasyāṃ tvadudbhavātputrāttasya mṛtyurna cānyathā ||
meaning:
शिवा सा जनिता शैलात्त्वदर्थं हि हिमालयात् |
तस्यां त्वदुद्भवात्पुत्रात्तस्य मृत्युर्न चान्यथा ||
text_mt: That Śivā was born from the mountain Himālaya for your sake; / his death cannot occur otherwise than from a son born of you upon her.

sanskrit_iast:
iti datto brahmaṇā hi tasmai daityāya yadvaraḥ |
tadanyasmādamṛtyuḥ sa bādhate nikhilaṃ jagat ||
meaning:
इति दत्तो ब्रह्मणा हि तस्मै दैत्याय यद्वरः |
तदन्यस्मादमृत्युः स बाधते निखिलं जगत् ||
text_mt: For such a boon was given to that demon by Brahmā, / that he cannot be killed by any other; he afflicts the entire world.

sanskrit_iast:
nāradasya nideśātsā karoti kaṭhinaṃ tapaḥ |
tattejasākhilaṃ vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram ||
meaning:
नारदस्य निदेशात्सा करोति कठिनं तपः |
तत्तेजसाखिलं व्याप्तं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ||
text_mt: At Nārada’s instruction she is performing severe tapas; / by her splendor the entire threefold world, moving and unmoving, is pervaded.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ dātuṃ śivāyai hi gaccha tvaṃ parameśvara |
devaduḥkhaṃ jahi svāminnasmākaṃ sukhamāvaha ||
meaning:
वरं दातुं शिवायै हि गच्छ त्वं परमेश्वर |
देवदुःखं जहि स्वामिन्नस्माकं सुखमावह ||
text_mt: Go, O Parameśvara, to grant a boon to Śivā; / destroy the distress of the gods, O Lord, and bring us happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ me mahotsāho hṛdaye cāsti śaṅkara |
vivāhaṃ tava sandraṣṭuṃ tattvaṃ kuru yathocitam ||
meaning:
देवानां मे महोत्साहो हृदये चास्ति शङ्कर |
विवाहं तव सन्द्रष्टुं तत्त्वं कुरु यथोचितम् ||
text_mt: And in the heart of the gods and in mine there is great eagerness, O Śaṅkara, / to witness your wedding; so do what is appropriate.

sanskrit_iast:
ratyai yadbhavatā datto varastasya parātpara |
prāpto'vasara evāśu saphalaṃ svapaṇaṃ kuru ||
meaning:
रत्यै यद्भवता दत्तो वरस्तस्य परात्पर |
प्राप्तोऽवसर एवाशु सफलं स्वपणं कुरु ||
text_mt: The boon that was given by you to Rati, O you higher than the highest— / its occasion has just arrived; quickly make your promise bear fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityuktvā taṃ praṇamyaiva viṣṇurdevā maharṣayaḥ |
saṃstūya vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ santasthustatpuro'khilāḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा तं प्रणम्यैव विष्णुर्देवा महर्षयः |
संस्तूय विविधैः स्तोत्रैः सन्तस्थुस्तत्पुरोऽखिलाः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus and bowed to him, Viṣṇu, the gods, and the great sages, / having praised him with manifold hymns, all stood before him.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktādhīnaḥ śaṅkaro'pi śrutvā devavacastadā |
vihasya pratyuvācāśu vedamaryādarakṣakaḥ ||
meaning:
भक्ताधीनः शङ्करोऽपि श्रुत्वा देववचस्तदा |
विहस्य प्रत्युवाचाशु वेदमर्यादरक्षकः ||
text_mt: And Śaṅkara, who is obedient to his devotees, having heard the words of the gods then, / smiled and quickly replied, he who protects the ordinances of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca |
he hare he vidhe devāḥ śṛṇutādarato'khilāḥ |
yathocitamahaṃ vacmi saviśeṣaṃ vivekataḥ ||
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच |
हे हरे हे विधे देवाः शृणुतादरतोऽखिलाः |
यथोचितमहं वच्मि सविशेषं विवेकतः ||
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / O Hari, O Vidhi, O gods, all of you listen with respect; / I speak what is appropriate, in particular detail through discernment.

sanskrit_iast:
nocitaṃ hi vidhānaṃ vai vivāhakaraṇaṃ nṛṇām |
mahānigaḍasaṃjño hi vivāho dṛḍhabandhanaḥ ||
meaning:
नोचितं हि विधानं वै विवाहकरणं नृणाम् |
महानिगडसंज्ञो हि विवाहो दृढबन्धनः ||
text_mt: Indeed, entering into marriage is not a proper arrangement for men; / for marriage is known as a great iron chain, a tight bond.

sanskrit_iast:
kusaṅgā bahavo loke strīsaṅgastatra cādhikaḥ |
uddharetsakalairbandhairna strīsaṅgātpramucyate ||
meaning:
कुसङ्गा बहवो लोके स्त्रीसङ्गस्तत्र चाधिकः |
उद्धरेत्सकलैर्बन्धैर्न स्त्रीसङ्गात्प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: There are many bad associations in the world, and association with women is the worst among them; / one may be rescued from all bonds, but one is not freed from association with women.

sanskrit_iast:
lohadārumayaiḥ pāśairdṛḍhaṃ baddho'pi mucyate |
stryādipāśasusambaddho mucyate na kadācana ||
meaning:
लोहदारुमयैः पाशैर्दृढं बद्धोऽपि मुच्यते |
स्त्र्यादिपाशसुसम्बद्धो मुच्यते न कदाचन ||
text_mt: Even one tightly bound by fetters of iron or wood is released, / but one firmly bound by the fetters of women and the like is never released.

sanskrit_iast:
vardhante viṣayāḥ śaśvanmahābandhanakāriṇaḥ |
viṣayākrāntamanasaḥ svapne mokṣo'pi durlabhaḥ ||
meaning:
वर्धन्ते विषयाः शश्वन्महाबन्धनकारिणः |
विषयाक्रान्तमनसः स्वप्ने मोक्षोऽपि दुर्लभः ||
text_mt: Sense objects, which cause great bondage, constantly multiply; / for one whose mind is overcome by sense objects, liberation is difficult to attain even in a dream.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhamicchati cetprājño vidhivadviṣayāṃstyajet |
viṣavadviṣayānāhurviṣayairyairnihanyate ||
meaning:
सुखमिच्छति चेत्प्राज्ञो विधिवद्विषयांस्त्यजेत् |
विषवद्विषयानाहुर्विषयैर्यैर्निहन्यते ||
text_mt: If a wise man desires happiness, he should duly abandon sense objects; / they call sense objects like poison, by which sense objects one is destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
jano viṣayiṇā sākaṃ vārtātaḥ patati kṣaṇāt |
viṣayaṃ prāhurācāryāḥ sitāliptendravāruṇīm ||
meaning:
जनो विषयिणा साकं वार्तातः पतति क्षणात् |
विषयं प्राहुराचार्याः सितालिप्तेन्द्रवारुणीम् ||
text_mt: A person falls in an instant merely from conversation with a sensual person; / teachers describe a sense object as a bitter gourd smeared with sugar.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyapyevaṃ hi jānāmi sarvaṃ jñānaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
tathāpyahaṃ kariṣyāmi prārthanāṃ saphalāṃ ca vaḥ ||
meaning:
यद्यप्येवं हि जानामि सर्वं ज्ञानं विशेषतः |
तथाप्यहं करिष्यामि प्रार्थनां सफलां च वः ||
text_mt: Even though I know all this wisdom especially well, / nevertheless I will grant your request and make it fruitful.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktādhīno'hamevāsmi tadvaśātsarvakāryakṛt |
ayathocitakartā hi prasiddho bhuvanatraye ||
meaning:
भक्ताधीनोऽहमेवास्मि तद्वशात्सर्वकार्यकृत् |
अयथोचितकर्ता हि प्रसिद्धो भुवनत्रये ||
text_mt: Indeed, I am subordinate to my devotees; under their influence I do everything. / I am well known in the three worlds as one who acts against what is conventional.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmarūpādhipasyaiva paṇaśca saphalaḥ kṛtaḥ |
sudakṣiṇasya bhūpasya bhavabandhagatasya hi ||
meaning:
कामरूपाधिपस्यैव पणश्च सफलः कृतः |
सुदक्षिणस्य भूपस्य भवबन्धगतस्य हि ||
text_mt: The pledge of the ruler of Kāmarūpa was fulfilled [by me], / of King Sudakṣiṇa, who had fallen into the fetters of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
gautamakleśakartāhaṃ tryambakātmā sukhāvahaḥ |
tatkaṣṭapradaduṣṭānāṃ śāpadāyī viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
गौतमक्लेशकर्ताहं त्र्यम्बकात्मा सुखावहः |
तत्कष्टप्रददुष्टानां शापदायी विशेषतः ||
text_mt: I relieved the distress of Gautama, bringing happiness as Tryambaka, / and especially gave a curse to the wicked who caused him torment.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣaṃ pītaṃ surārthaṃ hi bhaktavatsalabhāvadhṛk |
devakaṣṭaṃ hṛtaṃ yatnātsarvadaiva mayā surāḥ ||
meaning:
विषं पीतं सुरार्थं हि भक्तवत्सलभावधृक् |
देवकष्टं हृतं यत्नात्सर्वदैव मया सुराः ||
text_mt: Bearing the disposition of one affectionate toward devotees, I drank the poison for the sake of the gods; / the distress of the gods has always been removed by me with effort, O gods.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktārthamasahaṃ kaṣṭaṃ bahuśo bahuyatnataḥ |
viśvānaramunerduḥkhaṃ hṛtaṃ gṛhapatirbhavan ||
meaning:
भक्तार्थमसहं कष्टं बहुशो बहुयत्नतः |
विश्वानरमुनेर्दुःखं हृतं गृहपतिर्भवन् ||
text_mt: For the sake of devotees, I endured distress many times with great effort; / becoming Gṛhapati, I removed the sorrow of the sage Viśvānara.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ bahūktena ca hare vidhe satyaṃ bravīmyaham |
matpaṇo'stīti yūyaṃ vai sarve jānītha tattvataḥ ||
meaning:
किं बहूक्तेन च हरे विधे सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम् |
मत्पणोऽस्तीति यूयं वै सर्वे जानीथ तत्त्वतः ||
text_mt: What need is there of saying much, O Hari, O Vidhi? I speak the truth. / You all truly know that this is my pledge.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā yadā vipattirhi bhaktānāṃ bhavati kvacit |
tadā tadā harāmyāśu tatkṣaṇātsarvaśaḥsadā ||
meaning:
यदा यदा विपत्तिर्हि भक्तानां भवति क्वचित् |
तदा तदा हराम्याशु तत्क्षणात्सर्वशःसदा ||
text_mt: Whenever distress befalls devotees anywhere, / then I always remove it immediately, at that very moment, completely.

sanskrit_iast:
jāne'haṃ tārakādduḥkhaṃ sarveṣāṃ vaḥ samutthitam |
asurāttaddhariṣyāmi satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham ||
meaning:
जानेऽहं तारकाद्दुःखं सर्वेषां वः समुत्थितम् |
असुरात्तद्धरिष्यामि सत्यं सत्यं वदाम्यहम् ||
text_mt: I know the sorrow arisen for all of you from Tāraka; / I will take it away from that Asura—I speak the truth, the truth.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti yadyapi me kācidvivāhakaraṇe ruciḥ |
vivāhayiṣye girijāṃ putrotpādanahetave ||
meaning:
नास्ति यद्यपि मे काचिद्विवाहकरणे रुचिः |
विवाहयिष्ये गिरिजां पुत्रोत्पादनहेतवे ||
text_mt: Although I have no desire at all to enter into marriage, / I shall marry Girijā for the sake of producing a son.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchata svagṛhāṇyeva nirbhayāḥ sakalāḥ surāḥ |
kāryaṃ vaḥ sādhayiṣyāmi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
meaning:
गच्छत स्वगृहाण्येव निर्भयाः सकलाः सुराः |
कार्यं वः साधयिष्यामि नात्र कार्या विचारणा ||
text_mt: Go to your own homes, all you gods, free from fear; / I shall accomplish your purpose; no doubt should be entertained here.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityuktvā maunamāsthāya samādhistho'bhavaddharaḥ |
sarve viṣṇvādayo devāḥ svadhāmāni yayurmune ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaḥ pārvatīkhaṇḍe
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा मौनमास्थाय समाधिस्थोऽभवद्धरः |
सर्वे विष्ण्वादयो देवाः स्वधामानि ययुर्मुने ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां तृतीयः पार्वतीखण्डे
text_mt:
Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus and observing silence, Hara entered into deep meditation; / all the gods, headed by Viṣṇu, went to their own abodes, O sage.

Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter, named Acceptance of the Marriage to Pārvatī, in the Pārvatīkhaṇḍa, the third [section] of the second Rudrasaṃhitā in the auspicious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca |
gateṣu teṣu deveṣu vidhiviṣṇvādikeṣu ca |
sarveṣu muniṣu prītyā kiṃ babhūva tataḥ param ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच |
गतेषु तेषु देवेषु विधिविष्ण्वादिकेषु च |
सर्वेषु मुनिषु प्रीत्या किं बभूव ततः परम् ||
title: pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | saptarṣikṛtā pārvatīparīkṣā
text_mt: Nārada said: / When those gods, Vidhi, Viṣṇu, and the others, and all the sages had gone, / out of affection, what happened after that?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kṛtaṃ śambhunā tāta varaṃ dātuṃ samāgataḥ |
kiyatkālena ca kathaṃ tadvada prītimāvaha ||
meaning:
किं कृतं शम्भुना तात वरं दातुं समागतः |
कियत्कालेन च कथं तद्वद प्रीतिमावह ||
text_mt: What was done by Śambhu, dear father? Did he arrive to grant a boon? / After how much time, and how? Tell that, bringing delight.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
gateṣu teṣu deveṣu brahmādiṣu nijāśramam |
tattapaḥ suparīkṣārthaṃ samādhistho'bhavadbhavaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
गतेषु तेषु देवेषु ब्रह्मादिषु निजाश्रमम् |
तत्तपः सुपरीक्षार्थं समाधिस्थोऽभवद्भवः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / When those gods, Brahmā and the others, had gone to their own hermitage, / Bhava entered into deep meditation in order to thoroughly test her austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
svātmānamātmanā kṛtvā svātmanyeva vyacintayat |
parātparataraṃ svasthaṃ nirmāyaṃ niravagraham ||
meaning:
स्वात्मानमात्मना कृत्वा स्वात्मन्येव व्यचिन्तयत् |
परात्परतरं स्वस्थं निर्मायं निरवग्रहम् ||
text_mt: Establishing himself by himself, he contemplated solely within his own self / that which is beyond the highest, self-abiding, free from illusion, and unimpeded.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvastubhūto bhagavānīśvaro vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
avijñātagatiḥsūtiḥsa haraḥ parameśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
तद्वस्तुभूतो भगवानीश्वरो वृषभध्वजः |
अविज्ञातगतिःसूतिःस हरः परमेश्वरः ||
text_mt: The Lord, Īśvara, Vṛṣabhadhvaja, who is identical with that reality, / whose course and origin are unknown—he is Hara, Parameśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
girijā hi tadā tāta tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ |
tapasā tena rudro'pi paraṃ vismayamāgataḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
गिरिजा हि तदा तात तताप परमं तपः |
तपसा तेन रुद्रोऽपि परं विस्मयमागतः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then, dear child, Girijā performed supreme austerity; / by that austerity even Rudra reached supreme astonishment.

sanskrit_iast:
samādheścalitasso'bhūdbhaktādhīno'pi nānyathā |
vasiṣṭhādīnmunīnsapta sasmāra sūtikṛddharaḥ ||
meaning:
समाधेश्चलितस्सोऽभूद्भक्ताधीनोऽपि नान्यथा |
वसिष्ठादीन्मुनीन्सप्त सस्मार सूतिकृद्धरः ||
text_mt: He moved from deep meditation, subordinate to devotees, and not otherwise; / Hara, the author of origin, remembered the seven sages headed by Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
saptāpi munayaḥ śīghramāyayuḥ smṛtimātrataḥ |
prasannavadanāḥ sarve varṇayanto vidhiṃ bahu ||
meaning:
सप्तापि मुनयः शीघ्रमाययुः स्मृतिमात्रतः |
प्रसन्नवदनाः सर्वे वर्णयन्तो विधिं बहु ||
text_mt: All seven sages came quickly merely upon being remembered, / all with cheerful faces, praising the creator in many ways.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya taṃ maheśānaṃ tuṣṭuvurharṣanirbharāḥ |
vāṇyā gadgadayā baddhakarā vinatakandharāḥ ||
meaning:
प्रणम्य तं महेशानं तुष्टुवुर्हर्षनिर्भराः |
वाण्या गद्गदया बद्धकरा विनतकन्धराः ||
text_mt: Having bowed to that Maheśāna, filled with joy, / with choked voices, folded hands, and bowed necks, they praised him.

sanskrit_iast:
saptarṣaya ūcuḥ |
devadeva mahādeva karuṇāsāgara prabho |
jātā vayaṃ sudhanyā hi tvayā yadadhunā smṛtāḥ ||
meaning:
सप्तर्षय ऊचुः |
देवदेव महादेव करुणासागर प्रभो |
जाता वयं सुधन्या हि त्वया यदधुना स्मृताः ||
text_mt: The seven sages said: / O god of gods, O Mahādeva, O ocean of compassion, O Lord! / We have indeed become most blessed, since we have now been remembered by you.

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthaṃ saṃsmṛtā nātha śāsanaṃ dehi taddhi naḥ |
svadāsasadṛśīṃ svāminkṛpāṃ kuru namo'stu te ||
meaning:
किमर्थं संस्मृता नाथ शासनं देहि तद्धि नः |
स्वदाससदृशीं स्वामिन्कृपां कुरु नमोऽस्तु ते ||
text_mt: For what purpose have we been remembered, O Lord? Give us that command; / O Master, bestow your grace upon us as upon your own servants. Obeisance to you!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityākarṇya munīnāṃ tu vijñaptiṃ karuṇānidhiḥ |
provāca vihasanprītyā protphullanayanāmbujaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य मुनीनां तु विज्ञप्तिं करुणानिधिः |
प्रोवाच विहसन्प्रीत्या प्रोत्फुल्लनयनाम्बुजः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing the petition of the sages, the treasure of compassion, / smiling with affection, his lotus eyes fully blooming, spoke.

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvara uvāca |
he saptamunayastātāḥ śṛṇutāraṃ vaco mama |
asmaddhitakarā yūyaṃ sarvajñānavicakṣaṇāḥ ||
meaning:
महेश्वर उवाच |
हे सप्तमुनयस्ताताः शृणुतारं वचो मम |
अस्मद्धितकरा यूयं सर्वज्ञानविचक्षणाः ||
text_mt: Maheśvara said: / O seven sages, dear ones! Listen quickly to my words. / You are skilled in all knowledge, doers of what is beneficial to me.

sanskrit_iast:
tapaścarati deveśī pārvatī girijādhunā |
gaurīśikharasaṃjñe hi parvate dṛḍhamānasā ||
meaning:
तपश्चरति देवेशी पार्वती गिरिजाधुना |
गौरीशिखरसंज्ञे हि पर्वते दृढमानसा ||
text_mt: Now the ruler of the gods, Pārvatī, Girijā, is performing austerity / with a resolute mind on the mountain named Gaurīśikhara.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ patiṃ prāptukāmā hi sā sakhīsevitā dvijāḥ |
sarvānkāmānvihāyānyānparaṃ niścayamāgatā ||
meaning:
मां पतिं प्राप्तुकामा हि सा सखीसेविता द्विजाः |
सर्वान्कामान्विहायान्यान्परं निश्चयमागता ||
text_mt: Desiring to obtain me as her husband, attended by her female friends, O twice-born ones, / having abandoned all other desires, she has reached a supreme resolve.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gacchata yūyaṃ macchāsanānmunisattamāḥ |
parīkṣāṃ dṛḍhatāyāstatkuruta premacetasaḥ ||
meaning:
तत्र गच्छत यूयं मच्छासनान्मुनिसत्तमाः |
परीक्षां दृढतायास्तत्कुरुत प्रेमचेतसः ||
