sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśa uvāca
yūyaṃ ke kuta āyātā bhavantaḥ sundarā ime |
yāta dūraṃ kimarthaṃ vai sthitā atra virodhinaḥ ||
meaning:
गणेश उवाच
यूयं के कुत आयाता भवन्तः सुन्दरा इमे |
यात दूरं किमर्थं वै स्थिता अत्र विरोधिनः ||
text_mt:
Gaṇeśa said:
“Who are you, whence have you fair ones come? / Go far away! For what purpose do you stand here as adversaries?”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca evaṃ śrutvā vacastasya hāsyaṃ kṛtvā parasparam |
ūcuḥsarve śivagaṇā mahāvīrā gatasmayāḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच एवं श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य हास्यं कृत्वा परस्परम् |
ऊचुःसर्वे शिवगणा महावीरा गतस्मयाः ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having heard his words, laughing among themselves, / all the attendants of Śiva, great heroes free from pride, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamiti procya sarve te śivapārṣadāḥ |
dvārapālaṃ gaṇeśaṃ taṃ pratyūcuḥ kruddhamānasāḥ ||
meaning:
परस्परमिति प्रोच्य सर्वे ते शिवपार्षदाः |
द्वारपालं गणेशं तं प्रत्यूचुः क्रुद्धमानसाः ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus to one another, all those attendants of Śiva, / their minds enraged, replied to Gaṇeśa the doorkeeper:

sanskrit_iast:
śivagaṇā ūcuḥ
śrūyatāṃ dvārapālā hi vayaṃ śivagaṇā varāḥ |
tvāṃ nivārayituṃ prāptāḥ śaṅkarasyājñayā vibhoḥ ||
meaning:
शिवगणा ऊचुः
श्रूयतां द्वारपाला हि वयं शिवगणा वराः |
त्वां निवारयितुं प्राप्ताः शङ्करस्याज्ञया विभोः ||
text_mt: The attendants of Śiva said: / "Listen! We are indeed the doorkeepers, the foremost attendants of Śiva. / We have come by the order of the all-pervading Śaṅkara to turn you away.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmapīha gaṇaṃ matvā na hanyāmo'nyathā hataḥ |
tiṣṭha dūre svataḥ tvaṃ ca kimarthaṃ mṛtyumīhase ||
meaning:
त्वामपीह गणं मत्वा न हन्यामोऽन्यथा हतः |
तिष्ठ दूरे स्वतः त्वं च किमर्थं मृत्युमीहसे ||
text_mt: Considering you too as an attendant here, we will not slay [you]; otherwise [you would be] slain. / Stand aside on your own! Why do you seek death?"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ityukto'pi gaṇeśaśca girijātanayo'bhayaḥ |
nirbhartsya śaṅkaragaṇānna dvāraṃ muktavāṃstadā ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इत्युक्तोऽपि गणेशश्च गिरिजातनयोऽभयः |
निर्भर्त्स्य शङ्करगणान्न द्वारं मुक्तवांस्तदा ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Even though spoken to thus, Gaṇeśa, the son of the Mountain's Daughter, fearless, / rebuking the attendants of Śaṅkara, did not leave the doorway then.

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve'pi gaṇāḥ śaivāḥ tatratyā vacanaṃ tadā |
śrutvā tatra śivaṃ gatvā tadvṛttāntamathābruvan ||
meaning:
ते सर्वेऽपि गणाः शैवाः तत्रत्या वचनं तदा |
श्रुत्वा तत्र शिवं गत्वा तद्वृत्तान्तमथाब्रुवन् ||
text_mt: All those attendants of Śiva present there, having heard his speech, / went there to Śiva and reported that incident.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca tadvacaḥ śrutvādbhutalīlo maheśvaraḥ |
vinirbhartsya gaṇānūce nijām̐llokagatirmune ||
meaning:
ततश्च तद्वचः श्रुत्वाद्भुतलीलो महेश्वरः |
विनिर्भर्त्स्य गणानूचे निजाम्̐ल्लोकगतिर्मुने ||
text_mt: Then, having heard their report, Maheśvara of wondrous sport, / rebuking his own attendants, spoke, O sage, he who is the destination of the worlds:

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvara uvāca
kaścāyaṃ vartate kiṃ ca bravītyarivaducchritaḥ |
kiṃ kariṣyatyasadbuddhiḥ svamṛtyuṃ vāñchati dhruvam ||
meaning:
महेश्वर उवाच
कश्चायं वर्तते किं च ब्रवीत्यरिवदुच्छ्रितः |
किं करिष्यत्यसद्बुद्धिः स्वमृत्युं वाञ्छति ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: Maheśvara said: / "Who is this [person], and why does he talk boastfully like an enemy? / What can that evil-minded one do? He surely desires his own death!

sanskrit_iast:
dūrataḥ kriyatāṃ hyeṣa dvārapālo navīnakaḥ |
klībā iva sthitāstasya vṛttaṃ vadatha me katham ||
meaning:
दूरतः क्रियतां ह्येष द्वारपालो नवीनकः |
क्लीबा इव स्थितास्तस्य वृत्तं वदथ मे कथम् ||
text_mt: Let this new doorkeeper be driven far away! / Remaining like eunuchs, how is it that you report his affair to me?"

sanskrit_iast:
svāminoktā gaṇāste cādbhutalīlena śambhunā |
punarāgatya tatraiva tamūcurdvārapālakam ||
meaning:
स्वामिनोक्ता गणास्ते चाद्भुतलीलेन शम्भुना |
पुनरागत्य तत्रैव तमूचुर्द्वारपालकम् ||
text_mt: Addressed by their master, Śambhu of wondrous sport, / those attendants returned to that very place and spoke to that doorkeeper:

sanskrit_iast:
śivagaṇā ūcuḥ |
re re dvārapa kastvaṃ hi sthitaśca sthāpitaḥ kutaḥ |
naivāsmāngaṇayasyevaṃ kathaṃ jīvitumicchasi ||
meaning:
शिवगणा ऊचुः |
रे रे द्वारप कस्त्वं हि स्थितश्च स्थापितः कुतः |
नैवास्मान्गणयस्येवं कथं जीवितुमिच्छसि ||
text_mt: The attendants of Śiva said: / "Hey, hey, doorkeeper, who are you indeed, and wherefore are you stationed and posted? / You do not count us at all; how do you wish to live?

sanskrit_iast:
dvārapālā vayaṃ sarve sthitāḥ kiṃ paribhāṣase |
siṃhāsanagṛhītaśca śṛgālaḥ śivamīhate ||
meaning:
द्वारपाला वयं सर्वे स्थिताः किं परिभाषसे |
सिंहासनगृहीतश्च शृगालः शिवमीहते ||
text_mt: We all stand as doorkeepers; why do you boast? / A jackal perched upon a lion's seat seeks after the lion!

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadgarjasi mūrkha tvaṃ yāvadgaṇaparākramaḥ |
nānubhūtastvayātraiva hyanubhūtaḥ patiṣyasi ||
meaning:
तावद्गर्जसि मूर्ख त्वं यावद्गणपराक्रमः |
नानुभूतस्त्वयात्रैव ह्यनुभूतः पतिष्यसि ||
text_mt: You roar, you fool, only so long as the prowess of the attendants / has not been experienced by you right here; once experienced, you shall fall!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktastaissusaṅkruddho hastābhyāṃ yaṣṭikāṃ tadā |
gṛhītvā tāḍayāmāsa gaṇāṃstānparibhāṣiṇaḥ ||
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्तैस्सुसङ्क्रुद्धो हस्ताभ्यां यष्टिकां तदा |
गृहीत्वा ताडयामास गणांस्तान्परिभाषिणः ||
text_mt: Spoken to thus by them, he became exceedingly enraged; then, seizing a staff with both hands, / he struck those taunting attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
uvācātha śivāputraḥ paribhartsya gaṇeśvarān |
śaṅkarasya mahāvīrānnirbhayastāngaṇeśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
उवाचाथ शिवापुत्रः परिभर्त्स्य गणेश्वरान् |
शङ्करस्य महावीरान्निर्भयस्तान्गणेश्वरः ||
text_mt: Then the son of Śivā, fearlessly rebuking those lords of the attendants, / the great heroes of Śaṅkara, he, the lord of the attendants, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
śivāputra uvāca
yāta yāta ito dūre no cedvo darśayāmi ha |
svaparākramamatyugraṃ yāsyathātyupahāsyatām ||
meaning:
शिवापुत्र उवाच
यात यात इतो दूरे नो चेद्वो दर्शयामि ह |
स्वपराक्रममत्युग्रं यास्यथात्युपहास्यताम् ||
text_mt: The son of Śivā said: / "Go, go far from here! Otherwise, indeed, I shall show you / my fierce prowess; you will become objects of utter ridicule!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityākarṇya vacastasya girijātanayasya hi |
parasparamathocuste śaṅkarasya gaṇāstadā ||
meaning:
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य गिरिजातनयस्य हि |
परस्परमथोचुस्ते शङ्करस्य गणास्तदा ||
text_mt: Having heard that speech of the son of the Mountain's Daughter, / those attendants of Śaṅkara then spoke among themselves:

sanskrit_iast:
śivagaṇā ūcuḥ |
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ kriyate sa na kiṃ punaḥ |
maryādā rakṣyate'smābhiranyathā kiṃ bravīti ca ||
meaning:
शिवगणा ऊचुः |
किं कर्तव्यं क्व गन्तव्यं क्रियते स न किं पुनः |
मर्यादा रक्ष्यतेऽस्माभिरन्यथा किं ब्रवीति च ||
text_mt: The attendants of Śiva said: / "What is to be done? Where should we go? Why is he not dealt with again? / Proper bounds are preserved by us; otherwise, why does he speak [so]?"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca tataḥ śambhugaṇāḥsarve śivaṃ dūre vyavasthitam |
krośamātraṃ tu kailāsādgatvā te ca tathā'bruvan ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ततः शम्भुगणाःसर्वे शिवं दूरे व्यवस्थितम् |
क्रोशमात्रं तु कैलासाद्गत्वा ते च तथाऽब्रुवन् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then all the attendants of Śambhu, going to Śiva who stood far off, / a mere krośa from Kailāsa, spoke to him in the same way.

sanskrit_iast:
śivo vihasya tānsarvāṃstriśūlakara ugradhīḥ |
uvāca parameśo hi svagaṇān vīrasammatān ||
meaning:
शिवो विहस्य तान्सर्वांस्त्रिशूलकर उग्रधीः |
उवाच परमेशो हि स्वगणान् वीरसम्मतान् ||
text_mt: Śiva, trident in hand, fierce-minded, laughing at all of them, / Parameśa spoke to his attendants who were esteemed as heroes:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
re re gaṇāḥ klībamatā na vīrā vīramāninaḥ |
madagre nodituṃ yogyā bhartsitaḥ kiṃ punarvadet ||
meaning:
शिव उवाच
रे रे गणाः क्लीबमता न वीरा वीरमानिनः |
मदग्रे नोदितुं योग्या भर्त्सितः किं पुनर्वदेत् ||
text_mt: Śiva said: / "Hey, hey, attendants, deemed eunuchs, not heroes, though boasting of heroism! / You are not fit to speak before me. Rebuked, what more can one say?

sanskrit_iast:
gamyatāṃ tāḍyatāṃ caiṣa yaḥ kaścitprabhavediha |
bahunoktena kiṃ cātra dūrīkartavya eva saḥ ||
meaning:
गम्यतां ताड्यतां चैष यः कश्चित्प्रभवेदिह |
बहुनोक्तेन किं चात्र दूरीकर्तव्य एव सः ||
text_mt: Let him be approached and struck down, whoever he may be that holds power here! / What need of much speaking in this matter? He must simply be driven far away."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca iti sarve maheśena jagmustatra munīśvara |
bhartsitāstena devena procuśca gaṇasattamāḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इति सर्वे महेशेन जग्मुस्तत्र मुनीश्वर |
भर्त्सितास्तेन देवेन प्रोचुश्च गणसत्तमाः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Thus addressed by Maheśa, O best of sages, all went there; / rebuked by that god, the excellent attendants spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
śivagaṇā ūcuḥ |
rere tvaṃ śṛṇu vai bāla balātkiṃ paribhāṣase |
itastvaṃ dūrato yāhi no cenmṛtyurbhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
शिवगणा ऊचुः |
रेरे त्वं शृणु वै बाल बलात्किं परिभाषसे |
इतस्त्वं दूरतो याहि नो चेन्मृत्युर्भविष्यति ||
text_mt: The attendants of Śiva said: / "Hey, hey boy, listen! Why do you talk boldly with force? / Go far away from here; otherwise death will be your lot!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ śivājñākāriṇāṃ dhruvam |
śivāsutastadābhūtsa kiṃ karomīti duḥkhitaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां शिवाज्ञाकारिणां ध्रुवम् |
शिवासुतस्तदाभूत्स किं करोमीति दुःखितः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having heard that speech of those who strictly followed the orders of Śiva, / the son of Śivā then became distressed, thinking, 'What shall I do?'

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare devī teṣāṃ tasya ca vai punaḥ |
śrutvā tu kalahaṃ dvāri sakhīṃ paśyeti sābravīt ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवी तेषां तस्य च वै पुनः |
श्रुत्वा तु कलहं द्वारि सखीं पश्येति साब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: Meanwhile, the goddess, hearing once again / that quarrel at the door between them and him, said to her companion, 'See!'

sanskrit_iast:
samāgatya sakhī tatra vṛttāntaṃ samabudhyata |
kṣaṇamātraṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā gatā hṛṣṭā śivāntikam ||
meaning:
समागत्य सखी तत्र वृत्तान्तं समबुध्यत |
क्षणमात्रं तदा दृष्ट्वा गता हृष्टा शिवान्तिकम् ||
text_mt: Having arrived there, the companion understood the news; / having watched for a mere moment, she returned delighted to Śivā's presence.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā tu tatsarvaṃ vṛttaṃ tadyadabhūnmune |
aśeṣeṇa tayā sakhyā kathitaṃ girijāgrataḥ ||
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा तु तत्सर्वं वृत्तं तद्यदभून्मुने |
अशेषेण तया सख्या कथितं गिरिजाग्रतः ||
text_mt: Having gone there, that whole matter that had occurred, O sage, / was related in full by that companion before the Mountain's Daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
sakhyuvāca
asmadīyo gaṇo yo hi sthito dvāri maheśvari |
nirbhartsayanti taṃ vīrāḥ śaṅkarasya gaṇā dhruvam ||
meaning:
सख्युवाच
अस्मदीयो गणो यो हि स्थितो द्वारि महेश्वरि |
निर्भर्त्सयन्ति तं वीराः शङ्करस्य गणा ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: The companion said: / "Our attendant who stands at the door, O Maheśvarī, / is indeed being rebuked by the heroic attendants of Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaścaiva gaṇāḥ sarve vinā te'vasaraṃ katham |
praviśanti haṭhādgehe naitacchubhataraṃ tava ||
meaning:
शिवश्चैव गणाः सर्वे विना तेऽवसरं कथम् |
प्रविशन्ति हठाद्गेहे नैतच्छुभतरं तव ||
text_mt: How can Śiva and all the attendants, without an opportunity [offered] by you, / enter the house by force? This is by no means good for you.

sanskrit_iast:
samyak kṛtaṃ hyanenaiva na hi ko'pi praveśitaḥ |
duḥkhaṃ caivānubhūyātra tiraskārādikaṃ tathā ||
meaning:
सम्यक् कृतं ह्यनेनैव न हि कोऽपि प्रवेशितः |
दुःखं चैवानुभूयात्र तिरस्कारादिकं तथा ||
text_mt: It was rightly done by him indeed, as no one was allowed to enter, / even while suffering distress and insult here.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ parantu vāgvādaḥ kriyate ca parasparam |
vāgvāde ca kṛte naiva tarhyāyāntu sukhena vai ||
meaning:
अतः परन्तु वाग्वादः क्रियते च परस्परम् |
वाग्वादे च कृते नैव तर्ह्यायान्तु सुखेन वै ||
text_mt: Beyond this, a dispute in words is going on between them; / and if no verbal dispute is made, then let them come in peacefully.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaścaivātra vāgvādastaṃ jitvā vijayena ca |
praviśantu tathā sarve nānyathā karhicitpriye ||
meaning:
कृतश्चैवात्र वाग्वादस्तं जित्वा विजयेन च |
प्रविशन्तु तथा सर्वे नान्यथा कर्हिचित्प्रिये ||
text_mt: A verbal dispute has indeed been made here; having conquered him through victory, / then let them all enter, not otherwise at any time, my dear.

sanskrit_iast:
asminnevāsmadīye vai sarve sambhartsitā vayam |
tasmāddevi tvayā bhadre na tyājyo māna uttamaḥ ||
meaning:
अस्मिन्नेवास्मदीये वै सर्वे सम्भर्त्सिता वयम् |
तस्माद्देवि त्वया भद्रे न त्याज्यो मान उत्तमः ||
text_mt: Because of this very [attendant] of ours, all of us have been insulted; / therefore, O auspicious goddess, you must not abandon your high honor.

sanskrit_iast:
śivo markaṭavatte'dya vartate sarvadā sati |
kiṃ kariṣyatyahaṅkāramānukūlyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
brahmovāca aho kṣaṇaṃ sthitā tatra śivecchā vaśataḥsatī | 40 ||
manasyuvāca sā bhūtvā māninī pārvatī tadā | 41 ||
meaning:
शिवो मर्कटवत्तेऽद्य वर्तते सर्वदा सति |
किं करिष्यत्यहङ्कारमानुकूल्यं भविष्यति ||
ब्रह्मोवाच अहो क्षणं स्थिता तत्र शिवेच्छा वशतःसती | 40 ||
मनस्युवाच सा भूत्वा मानिनी पार्वती तदा | 41 ||
text_mt:
Śiva behaves like a monkey toward you today, as always, O virtuous lady! / What will he do with pride? There will be conciliation."

Brahmā said: / Ah, the virtuous lady remained there for a moment, under the influence of Śiva's will.

Becoming proud in her mind, Pārvatī then spoke [to herself]:

sanskrit_iast:
śivovāca aho kṣaṇaṃ sthito naiva haṭhātkāraḥ kathaṃ kṛtaḥ |
kathaṃ caivātra karttavyaṃ vinayenātha vā punaḥ ||
meaning:
शिवोवाच अहो क्षणं स्थितो नैव हठात्कारः कथं कृतः |
कथं चैवात्र कर्त्तव्यं विनयेनाथ वा पुनः ||
text_mt: Śivā said: / "Ah, he did not wait a moment! Why was force used? / And how should it be acted here—with humility or otherwise?

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyati bhavatyeva kṛtaṃ naivānyathā punaḥ |
ityuktvā tu sakhī tatra preṣitā priyayā tadā ||
meaning:
भविष्यति भवत्येव कृतं नैवान्यथा पुनः |
इत्युक्त्वा तु सखी तत्र प्रेषिता प्रियया तदा ||
text_mt: What will be, will indeed be; what is done cannot be undone." / Having spoken thus, the companion was then sent by the beloved [goddess].

sanskrit_iast:
samāgatyā'bravītsā ca priyayā kathitaṃ hi yat |
samācaṣṭa gaṇeśaṃ taṃ girijātanayaṃ tadā ||
meaning:
समागत्याऽब्रवीत्सा च प्रियया कथितं हि यत् |
समाचष्ट गणेशं तं गिरिजातनयं तदा ||
text_mt: Having arrived, she told what was spoken by the beloved [goddess]; / she reported then to that Gaṇeśa, the son of the Mountain's Daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
sakhyuvāca
samyakkṛtaṃ tvayā bhadra balātte praviśantu na |
bhavadagre gaṇā hyete kiṃ jayantu bhavādṛśam ||
meaning:
सख्युवाच
सम्यक्कृतं त्वया भद्र बलात्ते प्रविशन्तु न |
भवदग्रे गणा ह्येते किं जयन्तु भवादृशम् ||
text_mt: The companion said: / "It was done well by you, my good lad; let them not enter by force! / How can these attendants before you conquer one like you?

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ cedvākṛtaṃ caiva karttavyaṃ kriyatāṃ tvayā |
jito yastu punarvāpi na vairamatha vā dhruvam ||
meaning:
कृतं चेद्वाकृतं चैव कर्त्तव्यं क्रियतां त्वया |
जितो यस्तु पुनर्वापि न वैरमथ वा ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: Whether done or not done, let that which must be done be done by you; / for he who is conquered again will certainly bear no enmity."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca iti śrutvā vacastasyā mātuścaiva gaṇeśvaraḥ |
ānandaṃ paramaṃ prāpa balaṃ bhūri mahonnatim ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्या मातुश्चैव गणेश्वरः |
आनन्दं परमं प्राप बलं भूरि महोन्नतिम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having heard this speech of hers and of his mother, the lord of the attendants / attained supreme joy, immense strength, and great elevation.

sanskrit_iast:
baddhakakṣastathoṣṇīṣaṃ baddhvā jaṅghoru saṃspṛśan |
uvāca tān gaṇān sarvān nirbhayaṃ vacanaṃ mudā ||
meaning:
बद्धकक्षस्तथोष्णीषं बद्ध्वा जङ्घोरु संस्पृशन् |
उवाच तान् गणान् सर्वान् निर्भयं वचनं मुदा ||
text_mt: Having girded his loins and tied his turban, touching his shanks and thighs, / he joyfully spoke fearless words to all those attendants:

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśa uvāca
ahaṃ ca girijāsūnuryūyaṃ śivagaṇāstathā |
ubhaye samatāṃ prāptāḥ kartavyaṃ kriyatāṃ punaḥ ||
meaning:
गणेश उवाच
अहं च गिरिजासूनुर्यूयं शिवगणास्तथा |
उभये समतां प्राप्ताः कर्तव्यं क्रियतां पुनः ||
text_mt: Gaṇeśa said: / "I am the son of the Mountain's Daughter, and you are the attendants of Śiva; / both have attained equality. Let what is to be done be done!

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanto dvārapālāśca dvārapo'haṃ kathaṃ na hi |
bhavantaśca sthitāstatrā'haṃ sthito'treti niścitam ||
meaning:
भवन्तो द्वारपालाश्च द्वारपोऽहं कथं न हि |
भवन्तश्च स्थितास्तत्राऽहं स्थितोऽत्रेति निश्चितम् ||
text_mt: You are doorkeepers, and why am I not a doorkeeper? / You stood there, and I stand here—this is certain.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavadbhiśca sthitaṃ hyatra yadā bhavati niścitam |
tadā bhavadbhiḥ karttavyaṃ śivājñāparipālanam ||
meaning:
भवद्भिश्च स्थितं ह्यत्र यदा भवति निश्चितम् |
तदा भवद्भिः कर्त्तव्यं शिवाज्ञापरिपालनम् ||
text_mt: And when it is established that your standing is here, / then the execution of Śiva's command must be carried out by you!"

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ tu mayā cātra śivājñāparipālanam |
satyaṃ ca kriyate vīrā nirṇītaṃ me yathocitam ||
meaning:
इदानीं तु मया चात्र शिवाज्ञापरिपालनम् |
सत्यं च क्रियते वीरा निर्णीतं मे यथोचितम् ||
text_mt: Now, however, the carrying out of Śiva’s command is indeed / being performed here by me, O heroes; my [resolve] is decided as is proper.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācchivagaṇāḥsarve vacanaṃ śṛṇutādarāt |
haṭhādvā vinayādvā na gantavyaṃ mandire punaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्माच्छिवगणाःसर्वे वचनं शृणुतादरात् |
हठाद्वा विनयाद्वा न गन्तव्यं मन्दिरे पुनः ||
text_mt: Therefore, O all attendants of Śiva, hear my words with respect: / whether by force or by courtesy, you must not enter the mansion again!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ityuktāste gaṇenaiva sarve te lajjitā gaṇāḥ |
yayuḥ śivāntikaṃ taṃ vai namaskṛtya puraḥ sthitāḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इत्युक्तास्ते गणेनैव सर्वे ते लज्जिता गणाः |
ययुः शिवान्तिकं तं वै नमस्कृत्य पुरः स्थिताः ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Addressed in this way by that attendant alone, all those attendants were ashamed; / they went to Śiva’s presence, bowed before him, and stood before him.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitvā nyavedayansarve vṛttāntaṃ ca tadadbhutam |
karau baddhvā nataskandhāḥ śivaṃ stutvā puraḥ sthitāḥ ||
meaning:
स्थित्वा न्यवेदयन्सर्वे वृत्तान्तं च तदद्भुतम् |
करौ बद्ध्वा नतस्कन्धाः शिवं स्तुत्वा पुरः स्थिताः ||
text_mt: Standing there, they reported that wondrous event; / with folded hands, their heads bowed, they praised Śiva and stood before him.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ tu tadā śrutvā vṛttaṃ tatsvagaṇoditam |
laukikīṃ vṛttimāśritya śaṅkaro vākyamabravīt ||
meaning:
तत्सर्वं तु तदा श्रुत्वा वृत्तं तत्स्वगणोदितम् |
लौकिकीं वृत्तिमाश्रित्य शङ्करो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: Hearing all that news spoken then by his attendants, / resorting to worldly conduct, Śaṅkara spoke [these] words:

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca
śrūyatāṃ ca gaṇāḥsarve yuddhaṃ yogyaṃ bhavenna hi |
yūyaṃ cātrāsmadīyā vai sa ca gaurīgaṇastathā ||
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच
श्रूयतां च गणाःसर्वे युद्धं योग्यं भवेन्न हि |
यूयं चात्रास्मदीया वै स च गौरीगणस्तथा ||
text_mt:
Śaṅkara said:
Listen, all attendants, a battle would not be proper: / you here are ours, and he is Gaurī's attendant.

sanskrit_iast:
vinayaḥ kriyate cedvai vaśyaḥ śambhuḥ striyā sadā |
iti khyātirbhavelloke garhitā me gaṇā dhruvam ||
meaning:
विनयः क्रियते चेद्वै वश्यः शम्भुः स्त्रिया सदा |
इति ख्यातिर्भवेल्लोके गर्हिता मे गणा ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: If courtesy is shown, surely the report would arise in the world: / “Śambhu is constantly subject to his wife!”—a disgrace indeed to me, O attendants!

sanskrit_iast:
kṛte caivātra kartavyamiti nītirgarīyasī |
ekākī sa gaṇo bālaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati vikramam ||
meaning:
कृते चैवात्र कर्तव्यमिति नीतिर्गरीयसी |
एकाकी स गणो बालः किं करिष्यति विक्रमम् ||
text_mt: “An action must be met with action”—this is the weightier rule of conduct. / He is a lone boy, an attendant; what valor will he display?

sanskrit_iast:
bhavantaśca gaṇā loke yuddhe cāti viśāradāḥ |
madīyāśca kathaṃ yuddhaṃ hitvā yāsyatha lāghavam ||
meaning:
भवन्तश्च गणा लोके युद्धे चाति विशारदाः |
मदीयाश्च कथं युद्धं हित्वा यास्यथ लाघवम् ||
text_mt: You attendants are celebrated in the world and exceedingly skilled in battle; / being mine, how can you abandon the fight and incur disgrace?

sanskrit_iast:
striyā''grahaḥ kathaṃ kāryo patyuragre viśeṣataḥ |
kṛtvā sā girijā tasya nūnaṃ phalamavāpsyati ||
meaning:
स्त्रिया'ऽग्रहः कथं कार्यो पत्युरग्रे विशेषतः |
कृत्वा सा गिरिजा तस्य नूनं फलमवाप्स्यति ||
text_mt: How can an insistence be made by a woman, especially before her husband? / Having done so, Girijā will certainly reap its fruit!

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarve ca madvīrāḥ śṛṇutādarato vacaḥ |
karttavyaṃ sarvathā yuddhaṃ bhāvi yattadbhavatviti ||
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वे च मद्वीराः शृणुतादरतो वचः |
कर्त्तव्यं सर्वथा युद्धं भावि यत्तद्भवत्विति ||
text_mt: Therefore, all my heroes, hear my words with respect: / battle must by all means be fought; whatever is to happen, let it happen!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ityuktvā śaṅkaro brahman nānālīlāviśāradaḥ |
virarāma muniśreṣṭha darśayam̐llaukikīṃ gatim ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthaḥ kumārakhaṇḍe
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इत्युक्त्वा शङ्करो ब्रह्मन् नानालीलाविशारदः |
विरराम मुनिश्रेष्ठ दर्शयम्̐ल्लौकिकीं गतिम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां चतुर्थः कुमारखण्डे
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having spoken thus, O sage, Śaṅkara, skilled in various divine sports, / ceased, O best of sages, displaying worldly conduct.

Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, entitled “Description of the Dispute of the Attendants,” in the Kumārakhaṇḍa of the second book, the Rudrasaṃhitā, in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ityuktā vibhunā tena niścayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ |
sannaddhāstu tadā tatra jagmuśca śivamandiram ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इत्युक्ता विभुना तेन निश्चयं परमं गताः |
सन्नद्धास्तु तदा तत्र जग्मुश्च शिवमन्दिरम् ||
title: pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivagaṇaiḥ saha gaṇeśayuddhavarṇanam
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Spoken to thus by that lord, reaching the highest resolve, / prepared for battle, they then went to Śiva's mansion.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśo'pi tathā dṛṣṭvā hyāyātāngaṇasattamān |
yuddhā''ṭopaṃ vidhāyaiva sthitāṃścaivābravīdidam ||
meaning:
गणेशोऽपि तथा दृष्ट्वा ह्यायातान्गणसत्तमान् |
युद्धा'ऽटोपं विधायैव स्थितांश्चैवाब्रवीदिदम् ||
text_mt: Gaṇeśa too, seeing the best of attendants arrived, / having assumed a stance for battle as they stood there, said this:

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśa uvāca
āyāntu gaṇapāḥ sarve śivājñāparipālakāḥ |
ahamekaśca bālaśca śivājñāparipālakaḥ ||
meaning:
गणेश उवाच
आयान्तु गणपाः सर्वे शिवाज्ञापरिपालकाः |
अहमेकश्च बालश्च शिवाज्ञापरिपालकः ||
text_mt:
Gaṇeśa said:
Let all the lords of attendants come, who carry out Śiva's command! / I am alone and a boy, carrying out Śivā’s command.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi paśyatāṃ devī pārvatī sūnujaṃ balam |
śivaśca svagaṇānāṃ tu balaṃ paśyatu vai punaḥ ||
meaning:
तथापि पश्यतां देवी पार्वती सूनुजं बलम् |
शिवश्च स्वगणानां तु बलं पश्यतु वै पुनः ||
text_mt: Even so, let the goddess Pārvatī see the strength born of her son, / and let Śiva again see the strength of his own attendants!

sanskrit_iast:
balavadbālayuddhaṃ ca bhavānīśivapakṣayoḥ |
bhavadbhiśca kṛtaṃ yuddhaṃ pūrvaṃ yuddhaviśāradaiḥ ||
meaning:
बलवद्बालयुद्धं च भवानीशिवपक्षयोः |
भवद्भिश्च कृतं युद्धं पूर्वं युद्धविशारदैः ||
text_mt: A fight between the strong and a boy, between the factions of Bhavānī and Śiva! / Formerly, battle was fought by you who are skilled in warfare;

sanskrit_iast:
mayā pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ naiva bālo'smi kriyate'dhunā |
tathāpi bhavatāṃ lajjā girijāśivayoriha ||
meaning:
मया पूर्वं कृतं नैव बालोऽस्मि क्रियतेऽधुना |
तथापि भवतां लज्जा गिरिजाशिवयोरिह ||
text_mt: no battle was fought by me before, for I am a boy, and one is being fought now. / Nevertheless, shame will fall upon you in the presence of Girijā and Śiva here;

sanskrit_iast:
mamaivaṃ tu bhavennaiva vaiparītyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
mamaiva bhavatāṃ lajjā girijāśivayoriha ||
meaning:
ममैवं तु भवेन्नैव वैपरीत्यं भविष्यति |
ममैव भवतां लज्जा गिरिजाशिवयोरिह ||
text_mt: to me it will not happen so, but the reverse will occur; / shame belongs only to you in the presence of Girijā and Śiva here.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ jñātvā ca karttavyaḥ samaraśca gaṇeśvarāḥ |
bhavadbhiḥ svāminaṃ dṛṣṭvā mayā ca mātaraṃ tadā ||
meaning:
एवं ज्ञात्वा च कर्त्तव्यः समरश्च गणेश्वराः |
भवद्भिः स्वामिनं दृष्ट्वा मया च मातरं तदा ||
text_mt: Knowing this, O lords of the attendants, a battle must be fought / by you looking to your master, and by me then to my mother.

sanskrit_iast:
kriyate kīdṛśaṃ yuddhaṃ bhavitavyaṃ bhavatviti |
tasya vai vāraṇe ko'pi na samarthastrilokake ||
meaning:
क्रियते कीदृशं युद्धं भवितव्यं भवत्विति |
तस्य वै वारणे कोऽपि न समर्थस्त्रिलोकके ||
text_mt: What kind of battle is being fought! Whatever is to happen, let it happen! / No one in the three worlds is capable of warding that off.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ityevaṃ bhartsitāste tu daṇḍabhūṣitabāhavaḥ |
vividhānyāyudhānyevaṃ dhṛtvā te ca samāyayuḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इत्येवं भर्त्सितास्ते तु दण्डभूषितबाहवः |
विविधान्यायुधान्येवं धृत्वा ते च समाययुः ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Rebuked in this manner, their arms adorned with clubs, / holding various weapons, they advanced.

sanskrit_iast:
gharṣayantastathā dantān huṅkṛtya ca punaḥ punaḥ |
paśya paśya bruvantaśca gaṇāste samupāgatāḥ ||
meaning:
घर्षयन्तस्तथा दन्तान् हुङ्कृत्य च पुनः पुनः |
पश्य पश्य ब्रुवन्तश्च गणास्ते समुपागताः ||
text_mt: Grinding their teeth and shouting “Huṃ!” again and again, / saying “Look, look!”, those attendants approached.

sanskrit_iast:
nandī prathamamāgatya dhṛtvā pādaṃ vyakarṣayat |
dhāvanbhṛṅgī dvitīyaṃ ca pādaṃ dhṛtvā gaṇasya ca ||
meaning:
नन्दी प्रथममागत्य धृत्वा पादं व्यकर्षयत् |
धावन्भृङ्गी द्वितीयं च पादं धृत्वा गणस्य च ||
text_mt: Nandin, having arrived first, seized his foot and dragged him; / Bhṛṅgin, running, seized the other foot of the attendant.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatpāde vikarṣantau tāvaddhastena vai gaṇaḥ |
āhatya hastayostābhyāmutkṣiptau pādakau svayam ||
meaning:
यावत्पादे विकर्षन्तौ तावद्धस्तेन वै गणः |
आहत्य हस्तयोस्ताभ्यामुत्क्षिप्तौ पादकौ स्वयम् ||
text_mt: As the two were dragging his feet, the attendant struck / their hands with his own hand and threw his feet free himself.

sanskrit_iast:
atha devīsuto vīrassaṅgṛhya parighaṃ bṛhat |
dvārasthito gaṇapatiḥ sarvānāpothayattadā ||
meaning:
अथ देवीसुतो वीरस्सङ्गृह्य परिघं बृहत् |
द्वारस्थितो गणपतिः सर्वानापोथयत्तदा ||
text_mt: Then the heroic son of the goddess, Gaṇapati, seizing a large iron club / and standing at the gate, struck them all down.

sanskrit_iast:
keṣāñcitpāṇayo bhinnāḥ keṣāñcitpṛṣṭhakāni ca |
keṣāñcicca śirāṃsyeva keṣāñcinmastakāni ca ||
meaning:
केषाञ्चित्पाणयो भिन्नाः केषाञ्चित्पृष्ठकानि च |
केषाञ्चिच्च शिरांस्येव केषाञ्चिन्मस्तकानि च ||
text_mt: The hands of some were broken, and the backs of some, / the heads of some, and the skulls of some.

sanskrit_iast:
keṣāñcijjānunī tatra keṣāñcitskandhakāstathā |
keṣāñcijjānunī tatra keṣāñcitskandhāstathā |
sammukhe cāgatā ye vai te sarve hṛdaye hatāḥ ||
meaning:
केषाञ्चिज्जानुनी तत्र केषाञ्चित्स्कन्धकास्तथा |
केषाञ्चिज्जानुनी तत्र केषाञ्चित्स्कन्धास्तथा |
सम्मुखे चागता ये वै ते सर्वे हृदये हताः ||
text_mt: The knees of some were broken there, and likewise the shoulders of some; / the knees of some were broken there, and likewise the shoulders of some; / whoever came face-to-face were struck in the chest.

sanskrit_iast:
kecicca patitā bhūmau kecicca vidiśo gatāḥ |
keṣāñciccaraṇau chinnau keciccharvāntikaṃ gatāḥ ||
meaning:
केचिच्च पतिता भूमौ केचिच्च विदिशो गताः |
केषाञ्चिच्चरणौ छिन्नौ केचिच्छर्वान्तिकं गताः ||
text_mt: Some fell to the ground, and some fled in intermediate directions; / the legs of some were severed, and some went to the presence of Śarva.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ madhye tu kaścidvai saṅgrāme sammukho na hi |
siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā yānti mṛgāścaiva diśo daśa ||
meaning:
तेषां मध्ये तु कश्चिद्वै सङ्ग्रामे सम्मुखो न हि |
सिंहं दृष्ट्वा यथा यान्ति मृगाश्चैव दिशो दश ||
text_mt: Among them, none stood face-to-face in the combat, / just as deer flee in ten directions upon seeing a lion.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā te ca gaṇāḥ sarve gatāścaiva sahasraśaḥ |
parāvṛtya tathā so'pi sudvāri samupasthitaḥ ||
meaning:
तथा ते च गणाः सर्वे गताश्चैव सहस्रशः |
परावृत्य तथा सोऽपि सुद्वारि समुपस्थितः ||
text_mt: In the same way, all those attendants fled by the thousands, / while he, turning around, stood at the splendid doorway.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpāntakaraṇe kālo dṛśyate ca bhayaṅkaraḥ |
yathā tathaiva dṛṣṭaḥ sa sarveṣāṃ pralayaṅkaraḥ ||
meaning:
कल्पान्तकरणे कालो दृश्यते च भयङ्करः |
यथा तथैव दृष्टः स सर्वेषां प्रलयङ्करः ||
text_mt: Just as Kāla appears terrible at the end of a cosmic age, / so he appeared to all, bringing about universal destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminsamaye caiva sarameśasureśvarāḥ |
preritā nāradeneha devāḥ sarve samāgaman ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्समये चैव सरमेशसुरेश्वराः |
प्रेरिता नारदेनेह देवाः सर्वे समागमन् ||
text_mt: At that very time, the lords of the gods, / impelled here by Nārada, all arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
samabruvaṃstadā sarve śivasya hitakāmyayā |
puraḥ sthitvā śivaṃ natvā hyājñāṃ dehi prabho iti ||
meaning:
समब्रुवंस्तदा सर्वे शिवस्य हितकाम्यया |
पुरः स्थित्वा शिवं नत्वा ह्याज्ञां देहि प्रभो इति ||
text_mt: Desiring what is beneficial to Śiva, they all then spoke; / standing before him, bowing to Śiva: “Give the command, O Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ parabrahma sarveśaḥ sarve ca tava sevakāḥ |
sṛṣṭeḥ kartā sadā bhartā saṃhartā parameśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
त्वं परब्रह्म सर्वेशः सर्वे च तव सेवकाः |
सृष्टेः कर्ता सदा भर्ता संहर्ता परमेश्वरः ||
text_mt: You are the supreme Brahman, the lord of all, and all are your servants, / the creator of creation, the constant maintainer, the destroyer, Parameśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
rajassattvatamorūpo līlayā nirguṇaḥ svataḥ |
kā līlā racitā cādya tāmidānīṃ vada prabho ||
meaning:
रजस्सत्त्वतमोरूपो लीलया निर्गुणः स्वतः |
का लीला रचिता चाद्य तामिदानीं वद प्रभो ||
text_mt: Embodied as rajas, sattva, and tamas through divine sport, you are by nature devoid of qualities. / What divine sport has been arranged today? Tell us that now, O Lord!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ityākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ muniśreṣṭha maheśvaraḥ |
gaṇān bhinnām̐stadā dṛṣṭvā tebhyassarvaṃ nyavedayat ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तेषां मुनिश्रेष्ठ महेश्वरः |
गणान् भिन्नाम्̐स्तदा दृष्ट्वा तेभ्यस्सर्वं न्यवेदयत् ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing their words, O best of sages, Maheśvara, / seeing his attendants broken, reported everything to them.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sarveśvarastatra śaṅkaro munisattama |
vihasya girijānātho brahmāṇaṃ māmuvāca ha ||
meaning:
अथ सर्वेश्वरस्तत्र शङ्करो मुनिसत्तम |
विहस्य गिरिजानाथो ब्रह्माणं मामुवाच ह ||
text_mt: Then Śaṅkara, the lord of all, O best of sages, / smiling, the lord of Girijā spoke to me, Brahmā:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
brahmañchṛṇu mama dvāri bāla ekaḥ samāsthitaḥ |
mahābalo yaṣṭipāṇirgehāveśanivārakaḥ ||
meaning:
शिव उवाच
ब्रह्मञ्छृणु मम द्वारि बाल एकः समास्थितः |
महाबलो यष्टिपाणिर्गेहावेशनिवारकः ||
text_mt:
Śiva said:
O Brahmā, listen: a boy stands at my gate, / very powerful, with a staff in hand, preventing entry into the house.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāprahārakartā'sau matpārṣadavighātakaḥ |
parājayaḥ kṛtastena madgaṇānāṃ balādiha ||
meaning:
महाप्रहारकर्ताऽसौ मत्पार्षदविघातकः |
पराजयः कृतस्तेन मद्गणानां बलादिह ||
text_mt: He strikes heavy blows, slaying my attendants; / by him, a defeat of my attendants has been wrought here by force.

sanskrit_iast:
brahman tvayaiva gantavyaṃ prasādyo'yaṃ mahābalaḥ |
yathā brahmannayaḥ syādvai tathā kāryaṃ tvayā vidhe ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मन् त्वयैव गन्तव्यं प्रसाद्योऽयं महाबलः |
यथा ब्रह्मन्नयः स्याद्वै तथा कार्यं त्वया विधे ||
text_mt: O Brahmā, you alone must go; this mighty one must be pacified; / O Brahmā, act in such a way, O Ordainer, that proper conduct may prevail.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ityākarṇya prabhorvākyamajñātvā'jñānamohitaḥ |
tadīyanikaṭaṃ tāta sarvairṛṣivarairayām ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इत्याकर्ण्य प्रभोर्वाक्यमज्ञात्वाऽज्ञानमोहितः |
तदीयनिकटं तात सर्वैरृषिवरैरयाम् ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing the Lord's words, not understanding, deluded by ignorance, / I went to his presence, dear one, along with all the best sages.

sanskrit_iast:
samāyāntaṃ ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā sa gaṇeśo mahābalī |
krodhaṃ kṛtvā samabhyetya mama śmaśrūṇyavākirat ||
meaning:
समायान्तं च मां दृष्ट्वा स गणेशो महाबली |
क्रोधं कृत्वा समभ्येत्य मम श्मश्रूण्यवाकिरत् ||
text_mt: Seeing me approaching, that mighty Gaṇeśa, / flying into a rage, rushed forward and tore out my beard.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamyatāṃ kṣamyatāṃ deva na yuddhārthaṃ samāgataḥ |
brāhmaṇo'hamanugrāhyaḥ śāntikartānupadravaḥ ||
meaning:
क्षम्यतां क्षम्यतां देव न युद्धार्थं समागतः |
ब्राह्मणोऽहमनुग्राह्यः शान्तिकर्तानुपद्रवः ||
text_mt: “Pardon, pardon, O lord! I have not come to fight. / I am a brahmin deserving favour, a peacemaker, harmless.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ bruvati brahmaṃstāvatparighamādade |
sa gaṇeśo mahāvīro bālo'bālaparākramaḥ ||
meaning:
इत्येवं ब्रुवति ब्रह्मंस्तावत्परिघमाददे |
स गणेशो महावीरो बालोऽबालपराक्रमः ||
text_mt: While I was speaking thus, O brahmin, Gaṇeśa, that great hero, / a boy of no childish valour, seized an iron club.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītaparighaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ gaṇeśaṃ mahābalam |
palāyanaparo yātastvahaṃ drutataraṃ tadā ||
meaning:
गृहीतपरिघं दृष्ट्वा तं गणेशं महाबलम् |
पलायनपरो यातस्त्वहं द्रुततरं तदा ||
text_mt: Seeing that very powerful Gaṇeśa with the iron club in hand, / I took to flight and went away all the more quickly then.

sanskrit_iast:
yāta yāta bruvantaste parighena hatāstadā |
svayaṃ ca patitāḥ kecitkecittena nipātitāḥ ||
meaning:
यात यात ब्रुवन्तस्ते परिघेन हतास्तदा |
स्वयं च पतिताः केचित्केचित्तेन निपातिताः ||
text_mt: Saying “Go, go!”, they were struck down then with the iron club; / some fell on their own, and others were felled by him.

sanskrit_iast:
kecicca śivasāmīpyaṃ gatvā tatkṣaṇamātrataḥ |
śivaṃ vijñāpayāñcakrustadvṛttāntamaśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
केचिच्च शिवसामीप्यं गत्वा तत्क्षणमात्रतः |
शिवं विज्ञापयाञ्चक्रुस्तद्वृत्तान्तमशेषतः ||
text_mt: And some, having gone to Śiva's side that very moment, / informed Śiva of the whole incident without exception.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāvidhāṃśca tān dṛṣṭvā tadvṛttāntaṃ niśamya saḥ |
apāramādadhe kopaṃ haro līlāviśāradaḥ ||
meaning:
तथाविधांश्च तान् दृष्ट्वा तद्वृत्तान्तं निशम्य सः |
अपारमादधे कोपं हरो लीलाविशारदः ||
text_mt: Seeing them in such a state and hearing that news, / Hara, skilled in sport, gave way to boundless wrath.

sanskrit_iast:
indrādikāndevagaṇān ṣaṇmukhapravarān gaṇān |
bhūtapretapiśācāṃśca sarvānādeśayattadā ||
meaning:
इन्द्रादिकान्देवगणान् षण्मुखप्रवरान् गणान् |
भूतप्रेतपिशाचांश्च सर्वानादेशयत्तदा ||
text_mt: He then commanded the hosts of gods led by Indra, the attendant hosts led by Ṣaṇmukha, / and all the bhūtas, pretas, and piśācas.

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve ca yathāyogyaṃ gatāste sarvato diśam |
taṃ gaṇaṃ hantukāmā hi śivājñaptā udāyudhāḥ ||
meaning:
ते सर्वे च यथायोग्यं गतास्ते सर्वतो दिशम् |
तं गणं हन्तुकामा हि शिवाज्ञप्ता उदायुधाः ||
text_mt: They all went in every direction as was fitting, / eager to kill that attendant, taking up their weapons at Śiva's command.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya yasyāyudhaṃ yacca tattatsarvaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
tad gaṇeśopari balātsamāgatya vimocitam ||
meaning:
यस्य यस्यायुधं यच्च तत्तत्सर्वं विशेषतः |
तद् गणेशोपरि बलात्समागत्य विमोचितम् ||
text_mt: Whatever weapon each one had, all of those in particular / were loosed with force upon Gaṇeśa after they advanced.

sanskrit_iast:
hāhākāro mahānāsīt trailokye sacarācare |
trilokasthā janāḥ sarve saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ||
meaning:
हाहाकारो महानासीत् त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे |
त्रिलोकस्था जनाः सर्वे संशयं परमं गताः ||
text_mt: A great cry of woe arose in the three worlds, with all that moves and is still; / all people dwelling in the three worlds fell into the greatest doubt:

sanskrit_iast:
na yātaṃ brahmaṇo'pyāyurbrahmāṇḍaṃ kṣayameti hi |
akāle ca tathā nūnaṃ śivecchāvaśataḥ svayam ||
meaning:
न यातं ब्रह्मणोऽप्यायुर्ब्रह्माण्डं क्षयमेति हि |
अकाले च तथा नूनं शिवेच्छावशतः स्वयम् ||
text_mt: “The lifespan of Brahmā has not yet ended, yet the universe goes to ruin! / Truly this is before its time, driven spontaneously by Śiva's will.”

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve cāgatāstatra ṣaṇmukhādyāśca ye punaḥ |
devā vyarthāyudhā jātā āścaryaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ||
meaning:
ते सर्वे चागतास्तत्र षण्मुखाद्याश्च ये पुनः |
देवा व्यर्थायुधा जाता आश्चर्यं परमं गताः ||
text_mt: All those who had arrived there—Ṣaṇmukha and the rest, and also / the gods—had their weapons rendered futile and were struck with extreme wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare devī jagadambā vibodhanā |
jñātvā taccaritaṃ sarvamapāraṃ krodhamādadhe ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवी जगदम्बा विबोधना |
ज्ञात्वा तच्चरितं सर्वमपारं क्रोधमादधे ||
text_mt: In the meantime the goddess, the Mother of the Universe, waking to it / and knowing all that conduct, fell into boundless wrath.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktidvayaṃ tadā tatra tayā devyā munīśvara |
nirmitaṃ svagaṇasyaiva sarvasāhāyyahetave ||
meaning:
शक्तिद्वयं तदा तत्र तया देव्या मुनीश्वर |
निर्मितं स्वगणस्यैव सर्वसाहाय्यहेतवे ||
text_mt: Two Śaktis were then created there by that goddess, O best of sages, / solely for the sake of giving every assistance to her attendant.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā pracaṇḍarūpaṃ ca dhṛtvātiṣṭhanmahāmune |
śyāmaparvatasaṅkāśaṃ vistīrya mukhagahvaram ||
meaning:
एका प्रचण्डरूपं च धृत्वातिष्ठन्महामुने |
श्यामपर्वतसङ्काशं विस्तीर्य मुखगह्वरम् ||
text_mt: One assumed a fierce form and stood there, O great sage, / resembling a dark mountain, widening the chasm of her mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā vidyutsvarūpā ca bahuhastasamanvitā |
bhayaṅkarā mahādevī duṣṭadaṇḍavidhāyinī ||
meaning:
एका विद्युत्स्वरूपा च बहुहस्तसमन्विता |
भयङ्करा महादेवी दुष्टदण्डविधायिनी ||
text_mt: The other had the nature of lightning, was endowed with many arms, / terrifying, a great goddess who metes out punishment to the wicked.

sanskrit_iast:
āyudhāni ca sarvāṇi mocitāni surairgaṇaiḥ |
gṛhītvā svamukhe tāni tābhyāṃ śīghraṃ ca cikṣipe ||
meaning:
आयुधानि च सर्वाणि मोचितानि सुरैर्गणैः |
गृहीत्वा स्वमुखे तानि ताभ्यां शीघ्रं च चिक्षिपे ||
text_mt: All the weapons that were released by the gods and the attendants, / catching them in their mouths, those two swiftly hurled them back.

sanskrit_iast:
devāyudhaṃ na dṛśyeta parighaḥ paritaḥ punaḥ |
evaṃ tābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ tatra caritaṃ paramādbhutam ||
meaning:
देवायुधं न दृश्येत परिघः परितः पुनः |
एवं ताभ्यां कृतं तत्र चरितं परमाद्भुतम् ||
text_mt: No weapon of the gods could be seen, but the iron club was everywhere around; / thus did those two perform a most wondrous deed there.

sanskrit_iast:
eko bālo'khilaṃ sainyaṃ loḍayāmāsa dustaram |
yathā girivareṇaiva loḍitaḥ sāgaraḥ purā ||
meaning:
एको बालोऽखिलं सैन्यं लोडयामास दुस्तरम् |
यथा गिरिवरेणैव लोडितः सागरः पुरा ||
text_mt: A single boy agitated the entire army, which was hard to overcome, / just as in ancient times the ocean was churned by the best of mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
ekena nihatāḥ sarve śakrādyā nirjarāstathā |
śaṅkarasya gaṇāścaiva vyākulā abhavaṃstadā ||
meaning:
एकेन निहताः सर्वे शक्राद्या निर्जरास्तथा |
शङ्करस्य गणाश्चैव व्याकुला अभवंस्तदा ||
text_mt: All the immortals headed by Śakra were struck down by one; / and the attendants of Śaṅkara then became bewildered.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sarve militvā te niḥśvasya ca muhurmuhuḥ |
parasparaṃ samūcuste tatprahārasamākulāḥ ||
meaning:
अथ सर्वे मिलित्वा ते निःश्वस्य च मुहुर्मुहुः |
परस्परं समूचुस्ते तत्प्रहारसमाकुलाः ||
text_mt: Then they all gathered together and, sighing again and again, / distressed by his blows, spoke to one another:

sanskrit_iast:
devagaṇā ūcuḥ
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ na jñāyante diśo daśa |
parighaṃ bhrāmayatyeṣa savyāpasavyameva ca ||
meaning:
देवगणा ऊचुः
किं कर्तव्यं क्व गन्तव्यं न ज्ञायन्ते दिशो दश |
परिघं भ्रामयत्येष सव्यापसव्यमेव च ||
text_mt: The hosts of gods said: / “What is to be done? Where should we go? The ten directions cannot even be recognized; / he swings the iron club clockwise and counter-clockwise!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca etatkāle'psaraḥ śreṣṭhāḥ puṣpacandanapāṇayaḥ |
ṛṣayaśca tvadādyā hi ye'tiyuddhe'tilālasāḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच एतत्कालेऽप्सरः श्रेष्ठाः पुष्पचन्दनपाणयः |
ऋषयश्च त्वदाद्या हि येऽतियुद्धेऽतिलालसाः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / At that time, the best apsarases with flowers and sandalwood paste in hand, / and the sages led by you, who were exceedingly eager for this intense battle,

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve ca samājagmuryuddhasandarśanāya vai |
pūrito vyoma sanmārgastaistadā munisattama ||
meaning:
ते सर्वे च समाजग्मुर्युद्धसन्दर्शनाय वै |
पूरितो व्योम सन्मार्गस्तैस्तदा मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: all arrived to watch the battle; / the sky's true path was completely filled by them then, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tāste dṛṣṭvā raṇaṃ taṃ vai mahāvismayamāgatāḥ |
īdṛśaṃ paramaṃ yuddhaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ caikadāpi hi ||
meaning:
तास्ते दृष्ट्वा रणं तं वै महाविस्मयमागताः |
ईदृशं परमं युद्धं न दृष्टं चैकदापि हि ||
text_mt: Seeing that battle, they were seized with great astonishment: / “Such a supreme battle has never been seen before!”

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivī kampitā tatra samudrasahitā tadā |
parvatāḥ patitāścaiva cakruḥ saṅgrāmasambhavam ||
meaning:
पृथिवी कम्पिता तत्र समुद्रसहिता तदा |
पर्वताः पतिताश्चैव चक्रुः सङ्ग्रामसम्भवम् ||
text_mt: The earth along with the oceans trembled there then; / and mountains fell, caused by the conflict.

sanskrit_iast:
dyaurgraharkṣagaṇairghūrṇṇā sarve vyākulatāṃ gatāḥ |
devāḥ palāyitāḥsarve gaṇāśca sakalāstadā ||
meaning:
द्यौर्ग्रहर्क्षगणैर्घूर्ण्णा सर्वे व्याकुलतां गताः |
देवाः पलायिताःसर्वे गणाश्च सकलास्तदा ||
text_mt: The sky whirled around with its hosts of planets and stars; all fell into turmoil; / all the gods and attendants then took to flight.

sanskrit_iast:
kevalaṃ ṣaṇmukhastatra nāpalāyata vikramī |
mahāvīrastadā sarvānāvārya purataḥ sthitaḥ ||
meaning:
केवलं षण्मुखस्तत्र नापलायत विक्रमी |
महावीरस्तदा सर्वानावार्य पुरतः स्थितः ||
text_mt: Only the valorous Ṣaṇmukha did not flee there; / that great hero, holding them all back, stood in front.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktidvayena tadyuddhe sarve ca niṣphalīkṛtāḥ |
sarvāstrāṇi nikṛttāni saṅkṣiptānyamarairgaṇaiḥ ||
meaning:
शक्तिद्वयेन तद्युद्धे सर्वे च निष्फलीकृताः |
सर्वास्त्राणि निकृत्तानि सङ्क्षिप्तान्यमरैर्गणैः ||
text_mt: By the two Śaktis, all were rendered powerless in that battle; / all the missiles hurled by the immortals and attendants were cut down.

sanskrit_iast:
ye'vasthitāśca te sarve śivasyāntikamāgatāḥ |
devāḥ palāyitāḥ sarve gaṇāśca sakalāstadā ||
meaning:
येऽवस्थिताश्च ते सर्वे शिवस्यान्तिकमागताः |
देवाः पलायिताः सर्वे गणाश्च सकलास्तदा ||
text_mt: And all those who remained came to Śiva's presence; / for all the gods and all the attendants had fled then.

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve militāścaiva muhurnatvā śivaṃ tadā |
abruvanvacanaṃ kṣipraṃ ko'yaṃ gaṇavaraḥ prabho ||
meaning:
ते सर्वे मिलिताश्चैव मुहुर्नत्वा शिवं तदा |
अब्रुवन्वचनं क्षिप्रं कोऽयं गणवरः प्रभो ||
text_mt: Having all gathered together, bowing again and again to Śiva then, / they quickly spoke these words: “Who is this best of attendants, O Lord?

sanskrit_iast:
purā caiva śrutaṃ yuddhamidānīṃ bahudhā punaḥ |
dṛśyate na śrutaṃ dṛṣṭamīdṛśaṃ tu kadācana ||
meaning:
पुरा चैव श्रुतं युद्धमिदानीं बहुधा पुनः |
दृश्यते न श्रुतं दृष्टमीदृशं तु कदाचन ||
text_mt: Battle has been heard of in ancient times, and now again in many forms / it is seen; but such as this was never heard of nor seen!

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcidvicāryatāṃ deva tvanyathā na jayo bhavet |
tvameva rakṣakaḥ svāminbrahmāṇḍasya na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
किञ्चिद्विचार्यतां देव त्वन्यथा न जयो भवेत् |
त्वमेव रक्षकः स्वामिन्ब्रह्माण्डस्य न संशयः ||
text_mt: Let something be considered, O Lord, otherwise victory will not be ours; / you alone are the protector of the universe, O master, there is no doubt.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ityevaṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā rudraḥ paramakopanaḥ |
kopaṃ kṛtvā ca tatraiva jagāma svagaṇaiḥ saha ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इत्येवं तद्वचः श्रुत्वा रुद्रः परमकोपनः |
कोपं कृत्वा च तत्रैव जगाम स्वगणैः सह ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing those words, Rudra, who was exceedingly wrathful, / became enraged and went right there along with his attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
devasainyaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ viṣṇunā cakriṇā saha |
samutsavaṃ mahatkṛtvā śivasyānujagāma ha ||
meaning:
देवसैन्यं च तत्सर्वं विष्णुना चक्रिणा सह |
समुत्सवं महत्कृत्वा शिवस्यानुजगाम ह ||
text_mt: And that entire army of gods, along with Viṣṇu holding the discus, / making a great celebration, followed Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare bhaktyā namaskṛtya maheśvaram |
abravīnnārada tvaṃ vai devadevaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे भक्त्या नमस्कृत्य महेश्वरम् |
अब्रवीन्नारद त्वं वै देवदेवं कृताञ्जलिः ||
text_mt: In the meantime, bowing with devotion to Maheśvara, / you, O Nārada, spoke to the God of gods with folded hands.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
devadeva mahādeva śṛṇu madvacanaṃ vibho |
tvameva sarvagassvāmī nānālīlāviśāradaḥ ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच
देवदेव महादेव शृणु मद्वचनं विभो |
त्वमेव सर्वगस्स्वामी नानालीलाविशारदः ||
text_mt: Nārada said: / “O God of gods, Mahādeva, all-pervading Lord, hear my words! / You alone are the omnipresent Master, skilled in manifold sports.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā kṛtvā mahālīlāṃ gaṇagarvo'pahāritaḥ |
asmai dattvā balaṃ bhūri devagarvaśca śaṅkara ||
meaning:
त्वया कृत्वा महालीलां गणगर्वोऽपहारितः |
अस्मै दत्त्वा बलं भूरि देवगर्वश्च शङ्कर ||
text_mt: By performing a great sport, you have taken away the pride of the attendants; / by granting great strength to this boy, [you broke] the pride of the gods, O Śaṅkara!

sanskrit_iast:
darśitaṃ bhuvane nātha svameva balamadbhutam |
svatantreṇa tvayā śambho sarvagarvaprahāriṇā ||
meaning:
दर्शितं भुवने नाथ स्वमेव बलमद्भुतम् |
स्वतन्त्रेण त्वया शम्भो सर्वगर्वप्रहारिणा ||
text_mt: Your own wondrous strength has been shown in the world, O Lord, / by you, independent, O Śambhu, destroyer of all pride!

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ na kuruṣveśa tāṃ līlāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ |
svagaṇānamarāṃścāpi susanmānyābhivarddhaya ||
meaning:
इदानीं न कुरुष्वेश तां लीलां भक्तवत्सलः |
स्वगणानमरांश्चापि सुसन्मान्याभिवर्द्धय ||
text_mt: Now do not prolong that sport, O Lord affectionate toward devotees! / Honour well and encourage your own attendants and the immortals as well.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ na khelayedānīṃ jahi brahmapadaprada |
ityuktvā nārada tvaṃ vai hyantarddhānaṃ gatastadā ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthaḥ kumārakhaṇḍe
meaning:
इमं न खेलयेदानीं जहि ब्रह्मपदप्रद |
इत्युक्त्वा नारद त्वं वै ह्यन्तर्द्धानं गतस्तदा ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां चतुर्थः कुमारखण्डे
text_mt:
Do not play with this one now, kill him, O granter of Brahmā’s state!” / Having spoken thus, O Nārada, you vanished from sight then.

Thus ends the fifteenth chapter, named ‘Description of the Battle with Gaṇeśa’, in the Kumārakhaṇḍa of the second [book], the Rudrasaṃhitā, in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca iti śrutvā maheśāno bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ |
tvadvācā yudakāmo'bhūttena bālena nārada ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इति श्रुत्वा महेशानो भक्तानुग्रहकारकः |
त्वद्वाचा युदकामोऽभूत्तेन बालेन नारद ||
title: ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ | gaṇeśaśiraścchedanavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇumāhūya sammantrya balena mahatā yutaḥ |
sāmaraḥ sammukhastasyāpyabhūddevastrilocanaḥ ||
meaning:
विष्णुमाहूय सम्मन्त्र्य बलेन महता युतः |
सामरः सम्मुखस्तस्याप्यभूद्देवस्त्रिलोचनः ||

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca yuyudhustena smṛtvā śivapadāmbujam |
mahābalā mahotsāhāśśivasaddṛṣṭilokitāḥ ||
meaning:
देवाश्च युयुधुस्तेन स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्बुजम् |
महाबला महोत्साहाश्शिवसद्दृष्टिलोकिताः ||

sanskrit_iast:
yuyudhe'tha haristena mahābalaparākramaḥ |
mahādevyāyudho vīraḥ pravaṇaḥ śivarūpakaḥ ||
meaning:
युयुधेऽथ हरिस्तेन महाबलपराक्रमः |
महादेव्यायुधो वीरः प्रवणः शिवरूपकः ||

sanskrit_iast:
yaṣṭyā gaṇādhipaḥ so'tha jaghānāmarapuṅgavān |
hariṃ ca sahasā vīraḥ śaktidattamahābalaḥ ||
meaning:
यष्ट्या गणाधिपः सोऽथ जघानामरपुङ्गवान् |
हरिं च सहसा वीरः शक्तिदत्तमहाबलः ||

sanskrit_iast:
sarve'maragaṇāstatra vikuṇṭhitabalā mune |
abhūvan viṣṇunā tena hatā yaṣṭyā parāṅmukhāḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वेऽमरगणास्तत्र विकुण्ठितबला मुने |
अभूवन् विष्णुना तेन हता यष्ट्या पराङ्मुखाः ||

sanskrit_iast:
śivo'pi saha sainyena yuddhaṃ kṛtvā ciraṃ mune |
vikarālaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||
meaning:
शिवोऽपि सह सैन्येन युद्धं कृत्वा चिरं मुने |
विकरालं च तं दृष्ट्वा विस्मयं परमं गतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
chalenaiva ca hantavyo nānyathā hanyate punaḥ |
iti buddhiṃ samāsthāya sainyamadhye vyavasthitaḥ ||
meaning:
छलेनैव च हन्तव्यो नान्यथा हन्यते पुनः |
इति बुद्धिं समास्थाय सैन्यमध्ये व्यवस्थितः ||

sanskrit_iast:
śive dṛṣṭe tadā deve nirguṇe guṇarūpiṇi |
viṣṇau caivātha saṅgrāme āyāte sarvadevatāḥ ||
meaning:
शिवे दृष्टे तदा देवे निर्गुणे गुणरूपिणि |
विष्णौ चैवाथ सङ्ग्रामे आयाते सर्वदेवताः ||

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇāścaiva maheśasya mahāharṣaṃ tadā yayuḥ |
sarve parasparaṃ prītyā militvā cakrurutsavam ||
meaning:
गणाश्चैव महेशस्य महाहर्षं तदा ययुः |
सर्वे परस्परं प्रीत्या मिलित्वा चक्रुरुत्सवम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
atha śaktisuto vīro vīragatyā svayaṣṭitaḥ |
prathamaṃ pūjayāmāsa viṣṇuṃ sarvasukhāvaham ||
meaning:
अथ शक्तिसुतो वीरो वीरगत्या स्वयष्टितः |
प्रथमं पूजयामास विष्णुं सर्वसुखावहम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ ca mohayiṣyāmi hanyatāṃ ca tvayā vibho |
chalaṃ vinā na vadhyo'yaṃ tāmaso'yaṃ durāsadaḥ ||
meaning:
अहं च मोहयिष्यामि हन्यतां च त्वया विभो |
छलं विना न वध्योऽयं तामसोऽयं दुरासदः ||

sanskrit_iast:
iti kṛtvā matiṃ tatra susammantrya ca śambhunā |
ājñāṃ prāpyā'bhavacchaivīṃ viṣṇurmohaparāyaṇaḥ ||
meaning:
इति कृत्वा मतिं तत्र सुसम्मन्त्र्य च शम्भुना |
आज्ञां प्राप्याऽभवच्छैवीं विष्णुर्मोहपरायणः ||

sanskrit_iast:
śaktidvayaṃ tathā līnaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāvidham |
dattvā śaktibalaṃ tasmai gaṇeśāyābhavanmune ||
meaning:
शक्तिद्वयं तथा लीनं हरिं दृष्ट्वा तथाविधम् |
दत्त्वा शक्तिबलं तस्मै गणेशायाभवन्मुने ||

sanskrit_iast:
śaktidvaye'tha saṃlīne yatra viṣṇuḥ sthitaḥ svayam |
parighaṃ kṣiptavāṃstatra gaṇeśo balavattaraḥ ||
meaning:
शक्तिद्वयेऽथ संलीने यत्र विष्णुः स्थितः स्वयम् |
परिघं क्षिप्तवांस्तत्र गणेशो बलवत्तरः ||

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā yatnaṃ kimapyatra vañcayāmāsa tadgatim |
śivaṃ smṛtvā maheśānaṃ svaprabhuṃ bhaktavatsalam ||
meaning:
कृत्वा यत्नं किमप्यत्र वञ्चयामास तद्गतिम् |
शिवं स्मृत्वा महेशानं स्वप्रभुं भक्तवत्सलम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
ekatastanmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkaro'pyājagāma ha |
svatriśūlaṃ samādāya sukruddho yuddhakāmyayā ||
meaning:
एकतस्तन्मुखं दृष्ट्वा शङ्करोऽप्याजगाम ह |
स्वत्रिशूलं समादाय सुक्रुद्धो युद्धकाम्यया ||

sanskrit_iast:
sa dadarśāgataṃ śambhuṃ śūlahastaṃ maheśvaram |
hantukāmaṃ nijaṃ vīraḥ śivāputro mahābalaḥ ||
meaning:
स ददर्शागतं शम्भुं शूलहस्तं महेश्वरम् |
हन्तुकामं निजं वीरः शिवापुत्रो महाबलः ||

sanskrit_iast:
śaktyā jaghāna taṃ haste smṛtvā mātṛpadāmbujam |
sa gaṇaśo mahāvīraḥ śivaśaktipravarddhitaḥ ||
meaning:
शक्त्या जघान तं हस्ते स्मृत्वा मातृपदाम्बुजम् |
स गणशो महावीरः शिवशक्तिप्रवर्द्धितः ||

sanskrit_iast:
triśūlaṃ patitaṃ hastācchivasya paramātmanaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā sadūtikastaṃ vai pinākaṃ dhanurādade ||
meaning:
त्रिशूलं पतितं हस्ताच्छिवस्य परमात्मनः |
दृष्ट्वा सदूतिकस्तं वै पिनाकं धनुराददे ||

sanskrit_iast:
tamapyapātayadbhūmau parigheṇa gaṇeśvaraḥ |
hatāḥ pañca tathā hastāḥ pañcabhiśśūlamādade ||
meaning:
तमप्यपातयद्भूमौ परिघेण गणेश्वरः |
हताः पञ्च तथा हस्ताः पञ्चभिश्शूलमाददे ||

sanskrit_iast:
aho duḥkhataraṃ nūnaṃ sañjātamadhunā mama |
bhavetpunargaṇānāṃ kiṃ bhavācāro jagāviti ||
meaning:
अहो दुःखतरं नूनं सञ्जातमधुना मम |
भवेत्पुनर्गणानां किं भवाचारो जगाविति ||

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare vīraḥ parigheṇa gaṇeśvaraḥ |
jaghāna sagaṇān devān śaktidattabalānvitaḥ ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरः परिघेण गणेश्वरः |
जघान सगणान् देवान् शक्तिदत्तबलान्वितः ||

sanskrit_iast:
gatā daśadiśo devāḥ sagaṇāḥ parighārditāḥ |
na tasthuḥsamare ke'pi tenādbhutaprahāriṇā ||
meaning:
गता दशदिशो देवाः सगणाः परिघार्दिताः |
न तस्थुःसमरे केऽपि तेनाद्भुतप्रहारिणा ||

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇustaṃ ca gaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanyo'yamiti cābravīt |
mahābalo mahāvīro mahāśūro raṇapriyaḥ ||
meaning:
विष्णुस्तं च गणं दृष्ट्वा धन्योऽयमिति चाब्रवीत् |
महाबलो महावीरो महाशूरो रणप्रियः ||

sanskrit_iast:
bahavo devatāścaiva mayā dṛṣṭāstathā punaḥ |
dānavā bahavo daityā yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ ||
meaning:
बहवो देवताश्चैव मया दृष्टास्तथा पुनः |
दानवा बहवो दैत्या यक्षगन्धर्वराक्षसाः ||

sanskrit_iast:
naitena gaṇanāthena samatāṃ yānti ke'pi ca |
trailokye'pyakhile tejo rūpaśauryaguṇādibhiḥ ||
meaning:
नैतेन गणनाथेन समतां यान्ति केऽपि च |
त्रैलोक्येऽप्यखिले तेजो रूपशौर्यगुणादिभिः ||

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sambruvate'muṣmai parighaṃ bhrāmayan sa ca |
cikṣepa viṣṇave tatra śaktiputro gaṇeśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
एवं सम्ब्रुवतेऽमुष्मै परिघं भ्रामयन् स च |
चिक्षेप विष्णवे तत्र शक्तिपुत्रो गणेश्वरः ||

sanskrit_iast:
cakraṃ gṛhītvā hariṇā smṛtvā śivapadāmbujam |
tena cakreṇa parigho drutaṃ khaṇḍīkṛtastadā ||
meaning:
चक्रं गृहीत्वा हरिणा स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्बुजम् |
तेन चक्रेण परिघो द्रुतं खण्डीकृतस्तदा ||

sanskrit_iast:
khaṇḍaṃ tu parighasyāpi haraye prākṣipadgaṇaḥ |
gṛhītvā garuḍenāpi pakṣiṇā viphalīkṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
खण्डं तु परिघस्यापि हरये प्राक्षिपद्गणः |
गृहीत्वा गरुडेनापि पक्षिणा विफलीकृतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vicaritaṃ kālaṃ mahāvīrāvubhāvapi |
viṣṇuścāpi gaṇaścaiva yuyudhāte parasparam ||
meaning:
एवं विचरितं कालं महावीरावुभावपि |
विष्णुश्चापि गणश्चैव युयुधाते परस्परम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
punarvīravaraḥ śaktisutaḥsmṛtaśivo balī |
gṛhītvā yaṣṭimatulāṃ tayā viṣṇuṃ jaghāna ha ||
meaning:
पुनर्वीरवरः शक्तिसुतःस्मृतशिवो बली |
गृहीत्वा यष्टिमतुलां तया विष्णुं जघान ह ||

sanskrit_iast:
aviṣahya prahāraṃ taṃ sa bhūmau nipapāta ha |
drutamutthāya yuyudhe śivāputreṇa tena vai ||
meaning:
अविषह्य प्रहारं तं स भूमौ निपपात ह |
द्रुतमुत्थाय युयुधे शिवापुत्रेण तेन वै ||

sanskrit_iast:
etadantaramāsādya śūlapāṇistathottare |
āgatya ca triśūlena tacchiro nirakṛntata ||
meaning:
एतदन्तरमासाद्य शूलपाणिस्तथोत्तरे |
आगत्य च त्रिशूलेन तच्छिरो निरकृन्तत ||

sanskrit_iast:
chinne śirasi tasyaiva gaṇanāthasya nārada |
gaṇasainyaṃ devasainyamabhavacca suniścalam ||
meaning:
छिन्ने शिरसि तस्यैव गणनाथस्य नारद |
गणसैन्यं देवसैन्यमभवच्च सुनिश्चलम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
nāradena tvayā''gatya devyai sarvaṃ niveditam |
mānini śrūyatāṃ mānastyājyo naiva tvayādhunā ||
meaning:
नारदेन त्वया'ऽगत्य देव्यै सर्वं निवेदितम् |
मानिनि श्रूयतां मानस्त्याज्यो नैव त्वयाधुना ||

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā'ntarhitastatra nārada tvaṃ kalipriyaḥ |
avikārī sadā śambhurmanogatikaro muniḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthaḥ kumārakhaṇḍe
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वाऽन्तर्हितस्तत्र नारद त्वं कलिप्रियः |
अविकारी सदा शम्भुर्मनोगतिकरो मुनिः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां चतुर्थः कुमारखण्डे
text_mt:
Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara!

In the Kumārakhaṇḍa of the second [book], the Rudrasaṃhitā:

In the Kumārakhaṇḍa, the fourth section of the second book, the Rudrasaṃhitā.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
brahman vada mahāprājña tad vṛttānte'khile śrute |
kimakārṣīnmahādevī śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच
ब्रह्मन् वद महाप्राज्ञ तद् वृत्तान्तेऽखिले श्रुते |
किमकार्षीन्महादेवी श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ||
title: saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | gaṇeśadehe gajamukhayojanavarṇanam
text_mt: Nārada said: / Tell me, O Brahmā, O greatly wise one, upon hearing that entire report, / what did the Great Goddess do? I wish to hear it accurately.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca śrūyatāṃ muniśārdūla kathayāmyadya taddhruvam |
caritaṃ jagadambāyā yajjātaṃ tadanantaram ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच श्रूयतां मुनिशार्दूल कथयाम्यद्य तद्ध्रुवम् |
चरितं जगदम्बाया यज्जातं तदनन्तरम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Listen, O tiger among sages, today I will surely recount / the deeds of the Mother of the Universe that occurred thereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdaṅgānpaṭahāṃścaiva gaṇāścāvādayaṃstathā |
mahotsavaṃ tadā cakrurhate tasmingaṇādhipe ||
meaning:
मृदङ्गान्पटहांश्चैव गणाश्चावादयंस्तथा |
महोत्सवं तदा चक्रुर्हते तस्मिन्गणाधिपे ||
text_mt: The attendants sounded the mṛdaṅga and paṭaha drums, / and they celebrated a great festival when that lord of the attendants was slain.

sanskrit_iast:
śivo'pi tacchiraśchitvā yāvadduḥkhamupādade |
tāvacca girijā devī cukrodhāti munīśvara ||
meaning:
शिवोऽपि तच्छिरश्छित्वा यावद्दुःखमुपाददे |
तावच्च गिरिजा देवी चुक्रोधाति मुनीश्वर ||
text_mt: As soon as Śiva felt grief after cutting off his head, / just so, O lord of sages, the goddess Girijā became exceedingly enraged.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi hāhā duḥkhamupāgatam |
kathaṃ duḥkhaṃ vinaśyetāsyā'tiduḥkhaṃ mamādhunā ||
meaning:
किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि हाहा दुःखमुपागतम् |
कथं दुःखं विनश्येतास्याऽतिदुःखं ममाधुना ||
text_mt: “What shall I do? Where shall I go? Alas, alas, grief has arrived! / How will this grief be destroyed? There is now immense grief for me!

sanskrit_iast:
matsuto nāśitaścādya devaiḥ sarvairgaṇaistathā |
sarvāṃstānnāśayiṣyāmi pralayaṃ vā karomyaham ||
meaning:
मत्सुतो नाशितश्चाद्य देवैः सर्वैर्गणैस्तथा |
सर्वांस्तान्नाशयिष्यामि प्रलयं वा करोम्यहम् ||
text_mt: My son has been destroyed today by all the gods and attendants; / I shall destroy all of them, or I shall cause universal dissolution!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ duḥkhitā sā ca śaktīḥ śatasahasraśaḥ |
nirmame tatkṣaṇaṃ kruddhā sarvalokamaheśvarī ||
meaning:
इत्येवं दुःखिता सा च शक्तीः शतसहस्रशः |
निर्ममे तत्क्षणं क्रुद्धा सर्वलोकमहेश्वरी ||
text_mt: Thus grieving and enraged, the sovereign mistress of all the worlds / created in that instant hundreds of thousands of Śaktis.

sanskrit_iast:
nirmitāstā namaskṛtya jagadambāṃ śivāṃ tadā |
jājvalyamānā hyavadanmātarādiśyatāmiti ||
meaning:
निर्मितास्ता नमस्कृत्य जगदम्बां शिवां तदा |
जाज्वल्यमाना ह्यवदन्मातरादिश्यतामिति ||
text_mt: Created, they bowed down to the Mother of the Universe, Śivā, / and, blazing forth, said: “O Mother, give the command!”

sanskrit_iast:
tacchutvā śambhuśaktiḥ sā prakṛtiḥ krodhatatparā |
pratyuvāca tu tāḥ sarvā mahāmāyā munīśvara ||
meaning:
तच्छुत्वा शम्भुशक्तिः सा प्रकृतिः क्रोधतत्परा |
प्रत्युवाच तु ताः सर्वा महामाया मुनीश्वर ||
text_mt: Hearing that, she, the Śakti of Śambhu, the Primordial Nature, intent on anger, / Mahāmāyā, replied to all of them, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca
he śaktayo'dhunā devyo yuṣmābhirmannideśataḥ |
pralayaścātra karttavyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच
हे शक्तयोऽधुना देव्यो युष्माभिर्मन्निदेशतः |
प्रलयश्चात्र कर्त्तव्यो नात्र कार्या विचारणा ||
text_mt: The Goddess said: / “O Śaktis, now, goddesses, at my command / a dissolution must be wrought here; there should be no hesitation in this!

sanskrit_iast:
devāṃścaiva ṛṣīṃścaiva yakṣarākṣasakāṃstathā |
asmadīyānparāṃścaiva sakhyo bhakṣata vai haṭhāt ||
meaning:
देवांश्चैव ऋषींश्चैव यक्षराक्षसकांस्तथा |
अस्मदीयान्परांश्चैव सख्यो भक्षत वै हठात् ||
text_mt: The gods, the sages, and the Yakṣas and Rākṣasas, / those of our side and the enemies—O companions, devour them by force!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca tadājñaptāśca tāḥ sarvāḥ śaktayaḥ krodhatatparāḥ |
devādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ saṃhāraṃ kartumudyatāḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच तदाज्ञप्ताश्च ताः सर्वाः शक्तयः क्रोधतत्पराः |
देवादीनां च सर्वेषां संहारं कर्तुमुद्यताः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Commanded then, all those Śaktis, intent on anger, / became eager to bring about the destruction of the gods and all the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā ca tṛṇasaṃhāramanalaḥ kurute tathā |
evaṃ tāḥ śaktayaḥ sarvāḥ saṃhāraṃ kartumudyatāḥ ||
meaning:
यथा च तृणसंहारमनलः कुरुते तथा |
एवं ताः शक्तयः सर्वाः संहारं कर्तुमुद्यताः ||
text_mt: And just as fire carries out the destruction of grass, / so all those powers were intent on causing destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇapo vātha viṣṇurvā brahmā vā śaṅkarastathā |
indro vā yakṣarājo vā skando vā sūrya eva vā ||
meaning:
गणपो वाथ विष्णुर्वा ब्रह्मा वा शङ्करस्तथा |
इन्द्रो वा यक्षराजो वा स्कन्दो वा सूर्य एव वा ||
text_mt: Whether it was a lord of the attendants, Viṣṇu, Brahmā, or Śaṅkara, / Indra, the king of the yakṣas, Skanda, or Sūrya,

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ caiva saṃhāraṃ kurvanti sma nirantaram |
yatra yatra tu dṛśyeta tatra tatrāpi śaktayaḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वेषां चैव संहारं कुर्वन्ति स्म निरन्तरम् |
यत्र यत्र तु दृश्येत तत्र तत्रापि शक्तयः ||
text_mt: they continually wrought the destruction of all. / Wherever anyone was seen, there the powers were also.

sanskrit_iast:
karālī kubjakā khañjā lambaśīrṣā hyanekaśaḥ |
haste dhṛtvā tu devāṃśca mukhe caivākṣipaṃstadā ||
meaning:
कराली कुब्जका खञ्जा लम्बशीर्षा ह्यनेकशः |
हस्ते धृत्वा तु देवांश्च मुखे चैवाक्षिपंस्तदा ||
text_mt: Fierce, hunchbacked, lame, and many with long heads, / seizing the gods in their hands, they hurled them into their mouths.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ saṃhāraṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā haro brahmā tathā hariḥ |
indrādayo'khilā devā gaṇāśca ṛṣayastathā ||
meaning:
तं संहारं तदा दृष्ट्वा हरो ब्रह्मा तथा हरिः |
इन्द्रादयोऽखिला देवा गणाश्च ऋषयस्तथा ||
text_mt: Seeing that destruction then, Hara, Brahmā, Hari, / all the gods headed by Indra, the attendants, and the sages,

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kariṣyati sā devī saṃhāraṃ vāpyakālataḥ |
iti saṃśayamāpannā jīvanāśā hatā'bhavat ||
meaning:
किं करिष्यति सा देवी संहारं वाप्यकालतः |
इति संशयमापन्ना जीवनाशा हताऽभवत् ||
text_mt: wondered: “Will that goddess bring about destruction untimely?” / Falling into such doubt, their hope of life was destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve ca militāśceme kiṃ karttavyaṃ vicintyatām |
evaṃ vicārayantaste tūrṇamūcuḥ parasparam ||
meaning:
सर्वे च मिलिताश्चेमे किं कर्त्तव्यं विचिन्त्यताम् |
एवं विचारयन्तस्ते तूर्णमूचुः परस्परम् ||
text_mt: All gathered together, saying: “Let what must be done be considered.” / Deliberating thus, they quickly spoke to one another:

sanskrit_iast:
yadā ca girijā devī prasannā hi bhavediha |
tadā caiva bhavetsvāsthyaṃ nānyathā koṭi yatnataḥ ||
meaning:
यदा च गिरिजा देवी प्रसन्ना हि भवेदिह |
तदा चैव भवेत्स्वास्थ्यं नान्यथा कोटि यत्नतः ||
text_mt: “Only when the goddess Girijā becomes pleased here / will there be well-being, not otherwise, even with millions of efforts.”

sanskrit_iast:
śivo'pi duḥkhamāpanno laukikīṃ gatimāśritaḥ |
mohayansakalāṃstatra nānālīlāviśāradaḥ ||
meaning:
शिवोऽपि दुःखमापन्नो लौकिकीं गतिमाश्रितः |
मोहयन्सकलांस्तत्र नानालीलाविशारदः ||
text_mt: Even Śiva fell into sorrow, adopting worldly behavior, / deluding everyone there, being expert in various divine sports.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ kaṭirbhagnā yadā tadā |
śivā krodhamayī sākṣād gantuṃ na pura utsahet | ||
meaning:
सर्वेषां चैव देवानां कटिर्भग्ना यदा तदा |
शिवा क्रोधमयी साक्षाद् गन्तुं न पुर उत्सहेत् | ||
text_mt: When the back of all the gods was thus broken, / no one dared to step forward before Śivā filled with rage.

sanskrit_iast:
svīyo vā parakīyo vā devo vā dānavo'pi vā |
gaṇo vāpi ca dikpālo yakṣo vā kinnaro muniḥ ||
meaning:
स्वीयो वा परकीयो वा देवो वा दानवोऽपि वा |
गणो वापि च दिक्पालो यक्षो वा किन्नरो मुनिः ||
text_mt: Whether one’s own or a stranger, a god or a dānava, / an attendant, a guardian of the directions, a yakṣa, a kinnara, or a sage,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇurvāpi tathā brahmā śaṅkaraśca tathā prabhuḥ |
na kaścidgirijāgre ca sthātuṃ śakto'bhavanmune ||
meaning:
विष्णुर्वापि तथा ब्रह्मा शङ्करश्च तथा प्रभुः |
न कश्चिद्गिरिजाग्रे च स्थातुं शक्तोऽभवन्मुने ||
text_mt: or Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and the lord Śaṅkara— / none was able to stand before Girijā, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
jājvalyamānaṃ tattejaḥsarvato dāhi te'khilāḥ |
dṛṣṭvā bhītatarā āsan sarve dūrataraṃ sthitāḥ ||
meaning:
जाज्वल्यमानं तत्तेजःसर्वतो दाहि तेऽखिलाः |
दृष्ट्वा भीततरा आसन् सर्वे दूरतरं स्थिताः ||
text_mt: Seeing that blazing splendor burning in all directions, / they were all utterly terrified and stood far away.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminsamaye tatra nārado divyadarśanaḥ |
āgatastvaṃ mune devagaṇānāṃ sukhahetave ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्समये तत्र नारदो दिव्यदर्शनः |
आगतस्त्वं मुने देवगणानां सुखहेतवे ||
text_mt: At that moment, O sage of divine vision, you, Nārada, / arrived there for the sake of the welfare of the hosts of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ māṃ bhavaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaṅkaraṃ ca praṇamya saḥ |
samāgatya militvoce vicārya kāryameva vā ||
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं मां भवं विष्णुं शङ्करं च प्रणम्य सः |
समागत्य मिलित्वोचे विचार्य कार्यमेव वा ||
text_mt: Bowing to Brahmā—me—and to Bhava, Viṣṇu, and Śaṅkara, / and having approached and joined together, you spoke, deliberating on what should be done.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve sammantrayāñcakrustvayā devā mahātmanā |
duḥkhaśāntiḥ kathaṃ syādvai samūcustata eva te ||
meaning:
सर्वे सम्मन्त्रयाञ्चक्रुस्त्वया देवा महात्मना |
दुःखशान्तिः कथं स्याद्वै समूचुस्तत एव ते ||
text_mt: All the gods took counsel with you, the great-souled one; / they spoke together thence: “How may the pacification of sorrow come to pass?”

sanskrit_iast:
yāvacca girijā devī kṛpāṃ naiva kariṣyati |
tāvannaiva sukhaṃ syādvai nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
meaning:
यावच्च गिरिजा देवी कृपां नैव करिष्यति |
तावन्नैव सुखं स्याद्वै नात्र कार्या विचारणा ||
text_mt: “As long as the goddess Girijā does not show compassion, / so long will there be no happiness; on this there need be no deliberation.”

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayo hi tvadādyāśca gatāste vai śivāntikam |
sarve prasādayāmāsuḥ krodhaśāntyai tadā śivām ||
meaning:
ऋषयो हि त्वदाद्याश्च गतास्ते वै शिवान्तिकम् |
सर्वे प्रसादयामासुः क्रोधशान्त्यै तदा शिवाम् ||
text_mt: The sages headed by you indeed went near Śivā; / they all propitiated Śivā then for the pacification of her anger.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ punaḥ praṇemuśca stutvā stotrairanekaśaḥ |
sarve prasādayanprītyā procurdevagaṇājñayā ||
meaning:
पुनः पुनः प्रणेमुश्च स्तुत्वा स्तोत्रैरनेकशः |
सर्वे प्रसादयन्प्रीत्या प्रोचुर्देवगणाज्ञया ||
text_mt: Bowing again and again and praising her with numerous hymns, / they all propitiated her with affection and spoke by the command of the hosts of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
surarṣaya ūcuḥ |
jagadamba namastubhyaṃ śivāyai te namo'stu te |
caṇḍikāyai namastubhyaṃ kalyāṇyai ca namo'stu te ||
meaning:
सुरर्षय ऊचुः |
जगदम्ब नमस्तुभ्यं शिवायै ते नमोऽस्तु ते |
चण्डिकायै नमस्तुभ्यं कल्याण्यै च नमोऽस्तु ते ||
text_mt: The divine sages said: / “O Mother of the universe, obeisance to you! O Śivā, let there be obeisance to you! / Obeisance to you, Caṇḍikā! Let there be obeisance to you, auspicious one!

sanskrit_iast:
ādiśaktistvamevāmba sarvasṛṣṭikarī sadā |
tvameva pālinī śaktistvameva pralayaṅkarī ||
meaning:
आदिशक्तिस्त्वमेवाम्ब सर्वसृष्टिकरी सदा |
त्वमेव पालिनी शक्तिस्त्वमेव प्रलयङ्करी ||
text_mt: You alone are the primordial power, O Mother, who creates all at all times; / you alone are the sustaining power, you alone the cause of dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
prasannā bhava deveśi śāntiṃ kuru namo'stu te |
sarvaṃ hi vikalaṃ devi trijagattava kopataḥ ||
meaning:
प्रसन्ना भव देवेशि शान्तिं कुरु नमोऽस्तु ते |
सर्वं हि विकलं देवि त्रिजगत्तव कोपतः ||
text_mt: Be gracious, O ruler of the gods! Bestow peace! Obeisance to you! / For the entire threefold world is afflicted by your wrath, O goddess!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca evaṃ stutā parā devī ṛṣibhiśca tvadādibhiḥ |
kruddhadṛṣṭyā tadā tāṃśca kiñcinnovāca sā śivā ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच एवं स्तुता परा देवी ऋषिभिश्च त्वदादिभिः |
क्रुद्धदृष्ट्या तदा तांश्च किञ्चिन्नोवाच सा शिवा ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: Praised thus by the sages headed by you, the supreme goddess, / that Śivā, looking upon them with an angry gaze, said nothing at all.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā ca ṛṣayaḥ sarve natvā taccaraṇāmbujam |
punarūcuśśivāṃ bhaktyā kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ śanaiḥ ||
meaning:
तदा च ऋषयः सर्वे नत्वा तच्चरणाम्बुजम् |
पुनरूचुश्शिवां भक्त्या कृताञ्जलिपुटाः शनैः ||
text_mt: Then all the sages, bowing down to her lotus feet, / again spoke slowly with devotion to Śivā, folding their hands in reverence:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamyatāṃ kṣamyatāṃ devi saṃhāro jāyate'dhunā |
tava svāmī sthitaścātra paśya paśya tamambike ||
meaning:
क्षम्यतां क्षम्यतां देवि संहारो जायतेऽधुना |
तव स्वामी स्थितश्चात्र पश्य पश्य तमम्बिके ||
text_mt: “Pardon, pardon, O goddess! Destruction is taking place now! / Here stands your husband; see him, look, O Ambikā!

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ ke ca ime devā viṣṇubrahmādayastathā |
prajāśca bhavadīyāśca kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sthitāḥ ||
meaning:
वयं के च इमे देवा विष्णुब्रह्मादयस्तथा |
प्रजाश्च भवदीयाश्च कृताञ्जलिपुटाः स्थिताः ||
text_mt: Who are we, and who are these gods headed by Viṣṇu and Brahmā? / We are your subjects, standing with hands folded in reverence.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣantavyaścāparādho vai sarveṣāṃ parameśvari |
sarve hi vikalāścādya śāntiṃ teṣāṃ śive kuru ||
meaning:
क्षन्तव्यश्चापराधो वै सर्वेषां परमेश्वरि |
सर्वे हि विकलाश्चाद्य शान्तिं तेषां शिवे कुरु ||
text_mt: The offense of everyone must be forgiven, O supreme ruler! / For everyone is distressed today; bring them peace, O Śivā!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ityuktvā ṛṣayaḥsarve sudīnataramākulāḥ |
santasthire caṇḍikāgre kṛtāñjalipuṭāstadā ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इत्युक्त्वा ऋषयःसर्वे सुदीनतरमाकुलाः |
सन्तस्थिरे चण्डिकाग्रे कृताञ्जलिपुटास्तदा ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: Having spoken thus, all the sages, exceedingly wretched and distressed, / then stood before Caṇḍikā with hands folded in reverence.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ prasannā caṇḍikā'bhavat |
pratyuvāca ṛṣīṃstānvai karuṇāviṣṭamānasā ||
meaning:
एवं श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां प्रसन्ना चण्डिकाऽभवत् |
प्रत्युवाच ऋषींस्तान्वै करुणाविष्टमानसा ||
text_mt: Hearing their words thus, Caṇḍikā became pleased; / her mind filled with compassion, she answered those sages:

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca
matputro yadi jīveta tadā saṃharaṇaṃ na hi |
yathā hi bhavatāṃ madhye pūjyo'yaṃ ca bhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच
मत्पुत्रो यदि जीवेत तदा संहरणं न हि |
यथा हि भवतां मध्ये पूज्योऽयं च भविष्यति ||
text_mt: The goddess said: / “If my son is restored to life, then there will be no destruction; / and if he becomes worthy of worship among you,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvādhyakṣo bhavedadya yūyaṃ kuruta tadyadi |
tadā śāntirbhavelloke nānyathā sukhamāpsyatha ||
meaning:
सर्वाध्यक्षो भवेदद्य यूयं कुरुत तद्यदि |
तदा शान्तिर्भवेल्लोके नान्यथा सुखमाप्स्यथ ||
text_mt: and becomes the presiding lord over all today—if you do that, / then there will be peace in the world; not otherwise will you attain happiness.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ityuktāste tadā sarve ṛṣayo yuṣmadādayaḥ |
tebhyo devebhya āgatya sarvaṃ vṛttaṃ nyavedayan ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच इत्युक्तास्ते तदा सर्वे ऋषयो युष्मदादयः |
तेभ्यो देवेभ्य आगत्य सर्वं वृत्तं न्यवेदयन् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: Addressed thus at that time, all those sages headed by you, / having returned to those gods, reported the entire matter.

sanskrit_iast:
te ca sarve tathā śrutvā śaṅkarāya nyavedayan |
natvā prāñjalayo dīnāḥ śakraprabhṛtayaḥ surāḥ ||
meaning:
ते च सर्वे तथा श्रुत्वा शङ्कराय न्यवेदयन् |
नत्वा प्राञ्जलयो दीनाः शक्रप्रभृतयः सुराः ||
text_mt: Having heard that, all the gods headed by Śakra, / bowing with folded hands and wretched, reported it to Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
provāceti surāñchrutvā śivaścāpi tathā punaḥ |
karttavyaṃ ca tathā sarvalokasvāsthyaṃ bhavediha ||
meaning:
प्रोवाचेति सुराञ्छ्रुत्वा शिवश्चापि तथा पुनः |
कर्त्तव्यं च तथा सर्वलोकस्वास्थ्यं भवेदिह ||
text_mt: Having heard the gods, Śiva also spoke thus in turn: / “It must be done in such a way that there may be well-being for all the worlds here.

sanskrit_iast:
uttarasyāṃ punaryāta prathamaṃ yo milediha |
tacchiraśca samāhṛtya yojanīyaṃ kalevare ||
meaning:
उत्तरस्यां पुनर्यात प्रथमं यो मिलेदिह |
तच्छिरश्च समाहृत्य योजनीयं कलेवरे ||
text_mt: Go toward the north, and whatever is met first here, / having brought its head, it should be joined to the body.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca tatastaistatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ śivājñāpratipālakaiḥ |
kalevaraṃ samānīya prakṣālya vidhivacca tat ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ततस्तैस्तत्कृतं सर्वं शिवाज्ञाप्रतिपालकैः |
कलेवरं समानीय प्रक्षाल्य विधिवच्च तत् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: Then all that was carried out by them who complied with Śiva's command; / having brought the body and washed it in accordance with rule,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā punaste vai gatāścodaṅmukhāstadā |
prathamaṃ militastatra hastī cāpyekadantakaḥ ||
meaning:
पूजयित्वा पुनस्ते वै गताश्चोदङ्मुखास्तदा |
प्रथमं मिलितस्तत्र हस्ती चाप्येकदन्तकः ||
text_mt: and having worshipped it, they then went facing northward. / The first met there was an elephant with a single tusk.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchiraśca tadā nītvā tatra te'yojayan dhruvam |
saṃyojya devatāḥsarvāḥ śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ vidhiṃ tadā ||
meaning:
तच्छिरश्च तदा नीत्वा तत्र तेऽयोजयन् ध्रुवम् |
संयोज्य देवताःसर्वाः शिवं विष्णुं विधिं तदा ||
text_mt: Having taken its head then, they certainly joined it there. / Having joined it, all the deities then, to Śiva, Viṣṇu, and Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya vacanaṃ procurbhavaduktaṃ kṛtaṃ ca naḥ |
anantaraṃ ca tatkāryaṃ bhavatādbhavaśeṣitam ||
meaning:
प्रणम्य वचनं प्रोचुर्भवदुक्तं कृतं च नः |
अनन्तरं च तत्कार्यं भवताद्भवशेषितम् ||
text_mt: bowed and spoke these words: “What was commanded by you has been done by us; / thereafter, whatever remains of that task is to be completed by you, O Bhava.”

sanskrit_iast:
tataste tu virejuśca pārṣadāśca surāḥ sukham |
atha tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śivoktaṃ paryapālayan ||
meaning:
ततस्ते तु विरेजुश्च पार्षदाश्च सुराः सुखम् |
अथ तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शिवोक्तं पर्यपालयन् ||
text_mt: Then those attendants and gods shone happily. / Then, hearing that statement, they fulfilled what was spoken by Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ūcuste ca tadā tatra brahmaviṣṇusurāstathā |
praṇamyeśaṃ śivaṃ devaṃ svaprabhuṃ guṇavarjitam ||
meaning:
ऊचुस्ते च तदा तत्र ब्रह्मविष्णुसुरास्तथा |
प्रणम्येशं शिवं देवं स्वप्रभुं गुणवर्जितम् ||
text_mt: Then Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and the gods spoke there, / having bowed to the lord, the god Śiva, their master, devoid of qualities:

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāttvattejasaḥsarve vayaṃ jātā mahātmanaḥ |
tvattejastatsamāyātu vedamantrābhiyogataḥ ||
meaning:
यस्मात्त्वत्तेजसःसर्वे वयं जाता महात्मनः |
त्वत्तेजस्तत्समायातु वेदमन्त्राभियोगतः ||
text_mt: “Since we all were born from the splendor of you, the great-souled one, / let that splendor of yours enter into it by the application of Vedic mantras.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamabhimantreṇa mantritaṃ jalamuttamam |
smṛtvā śivaṃ sametāste cikṣipustatkalevare ||
meaning:
इत्येवमभिमन्त्रेण मन्त्रितं जलमुत्तमम् |
स्मृत्वा शिवं समेतास्ते चिक्षिपुस्तत्कलेवरे ||
text_mt: Gathering together and remembering Śiva, with such consecration / they sprinkled that excellent water, consecrated with mantras, upon the body.

sanskrit_iast:
tajjalasparśamātreṇa cidyuto jīvito drutam |
tadottasthau supta iva sa bālaśca śivecchayā ||
meaning:
तज्जलस्पर्शमात्रेण चिद्युतो जीवितो द्रुतम् |
तदोत्तस्थौ सुप्त इव स बालश्च शिवेच्छया ||
text_mt: By the mere contact of that water, endowed with consciousness and revived swiftly, / the boy then got up as if from sleep, by the will of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
subhagaḥ sundarataro gajavaktraḥ suraktakaḥ |
prasannavadanaścāti suprabho lalitākṛtiḥ ||
meaning:
सुभगः सुन्दरतरो गजवक्त्रः सुरक्तकः |
प्रसन्नवदनश्चाति सुप्रभो ललिताकृतिः ||
text_mt: Auspicious, exceedingly handsome, elephant-faced, reddish, / with a serene countenance, of great radiance, and of graceful form,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā jīvitaṃ bālaṃ śivāputraṃ munīśvara |
sarve mumudire tatra sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam ||
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा जीवितं बालं शिवापुत्रं मुनीश्वर |
सर्वे मुमुदिरे तत्र सर्वं दुःखं क्षयं गतम् ||
text_mt: seeing that boy, the son of Śivā, restored to life, O best of sages, / everyone rejoiced there, and all sorrow came to an end.

sanskrit_iast:
devyai sandarśayāmāsuḥ sarve harṣasamanvitāḥ |
jīvitaṃ tanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā devī hṛṣṭatarābhavat ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthaḥ kumārakhaṇḍe
meaning:
देव्यै सन्दर्शयामासुः सर्वे हर्षसमन्विताः |
जीवितं तनयं दृष्ट्वा देवी हृष्टतराभवत् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां चतुर्थः कुमारखण्डे
text_mt:
Filled with joy, they all showed him to the goddess. / Seeing her son restored to life, the goddess became exceedingly delighted.

Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Bringing to Life of Gaṇeśa," in the fourth section, the Kumārakhaṇḍa, of the second book, the Rudrasaṃhitā, of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
jīvite girijāputre devyā dṛṣṭe prajeśvara |
tataḥ kimabhavattatra kṛpayā tadvadādhunā ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच
जीविते गिरिजापुत्रे देव्या दृष्टे प्रजेश्वर |
ततः किमभवत्तत्र कृपया तद्वदाधुना ||
title: aṣṭadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | gaṇeśagaṇādhipapadavīprāptiḥ
text_mt: Nārada said: / When the son of the mountain’s daughter had been restored to life and seen by the goddess, O lord of creatures, / what happened there next? Pray tell me that now out of compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca jīvite girijāputre devyā dṛṣṭe munīśvara |
yajjātaṃ tacchṛṇuṣvādya vacmi taṃ mahadutsavam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच जीविते गिरिजापुत्रे देव्या दृष्टे मुनीश्वर |
यज्जातं तच्छृणुष्वाद्य वच्मि तं महदुत्सवम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / When the son of the mountain’s daughter had been restored to life and seen by the goddess, O best of sages, / hear now what happened; I shall describe that great celebration.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvitaḥsa śivāputro nirvyagro vikṛto mune |
abhiṣiktastadā devairgaṇādhyakṣairgajānanaḥ ||
meaning:
जीवितःस शिवापुत्रो निर्व्यग्रो विकृतो मुने |
अभिषिक्तस्तदा देवैर्गणाध्यक्षैर्गजाननः ||
text_mt: Restored to life, free from distress, and with an altered form, O sage, / that elephant-faced son of Śivā was then consecrated by the gods and lords of attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā svatanayaṃ devī śivā harṣasamanvitā |
gṛhītvā bālakaṃ dorbhyāṃ pramudā pariṣasvaje ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा स्वतनयं देवी शिवा हर्षसमन्विता |
गृहीत्वा बालकं दोर्भ्यां प्रमुदा परिषस्वजे ||
text_mt: Seeing her own son, the goddess Śivā was filled with joy; / taking the boy in her arms, she embraced him with great delight.

sanskrit_iast:
vastrāṇi vividhānīha nānālaṅkaraṇāni ca |
dadau prītyā gaṇeśāya svaputrāya mudāmbikā ||
meaning:
वस्त्राणि विविधानीह नानालङ्करणानि च |
ददौ प्रीत्या गणेशाय स्वपुत्राय मुदाम्बिका ||
text_mt: Ambikā joyfully and lovingly gave to Gaṇeśa, her son, / various garments and many kinds of ornaments here.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā tayā devyā siddhibhiścāpyanekaśaḥ |
kareṇa sparśitaḥ so'tha sarvaduḥkhahareṇa vai ||
meaning:
पूजयित्वा तया देव्या सिद्धिभिश्चाप्यनेकशः |
करेण स्पर्शितः सोऽथ सर्वदुःखहरेण वै ||
text_mt: Having worshipped him along with the Siddhis in many ways, / he was then touched by the goddess with her hand that removes all suffering.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā sutaṃ devī mukhamācumbya śāṅkarī |
varāndadau tadā prītyā jātastvaṃ duḥkhito'dhunā ||
meaning:
पूजयित्वा सुतं देवी मुखमाचुम्ब्य शाङ्करी |
वरान्ददौ तदा प्रीत्या जातस्त्वं दुःखितोऽधुना ||
text_mt: Having worshipped her son and kissed his face, Śāṅkarī / then lovingly granted him boons: "You were made to suffer just now;

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyo'si kṛtakṛtyo'si pūrvapūjyo bhavādhunā |
sarveṣāmamarāṇāṃ vai sarvadā duḥkhavarjitaḥ ||
meaning:
धन्योऽसि कृतकृत्योऽसि पूर्वपूज्यो भवाधुना |
सर्वेषाममराणां वै सर्वदा दुःखवर्जितः ||
text_mt: you are blessed, you have accomplished your aim! Become now the first to be worshipped / among all the immortals, and ever free from sorrow!

sanskrit_iast:
ānane tava sindūraṃ dṛśyate sāmprataṃ yadi |
tasmāttvaṃ pūjanīyo'si sindūreṇa sadā naraiḥ ||
meaning:
आनने तव सिन्दूरं दृश्यते साम्प्रतं यदि |
तस्मात्त्वं पूजनीयोऽसि सिन्दूरेण सदा नरैः ||
text_mt: Since vermilion is seen on your face now, / you are therefore ever to be worshipped with vermilion by men.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpairvā candanairvāpi gandhenaiva śubhena ca |
naivedyena suramyeṇa nīrājena vidhānataḥ ||
meaning:
पुष्पैर्वा चन्दनैर्वापि गन्धेनैव शुभेन च |
