nīlalohita jāne tvāṃ mā bhaiṣīścandraśekhara |
bhālasthalānmama purā rudraḥ prādurabhūdbhavān ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
नीललोहित जाने त्वां मा भैषीश्चन्द्रशेखर |
भालस्थलान्मम पुरा रुद्रः प्रादुरभूद्भवान् ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / "Nīlalohita, I know you! Do not be afraid, O Candraśekhara! / Formerly, you appeared as Rudra from my forehead.

sanskrit_iast:
rodanād rudranāmāpi yojito'si mayā purā |
māmeva śaraṇaṃ yāhi putra rakṣāṃ karomi te ||
meaning:
रोदनाद् रुद्रनामापि योजितोऽसि मया पुरा |
मामेव शरणं याहि पुत्र रक्षां करोमि ते ||
text_mt: Because you wept, the name 'Rudra' was given to you by me in the past. / Seek refuge in me alone, my son; I shall protect you!"

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
atheśvaraḥ padmayoneḥ śrutvā garvavatīṃ giram |
cukopātīva ca tadā kurvanniva layammune ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
अथेश्वरः पद्मयोनेः श्रुत्वा गर्ववतीं गिरम् |
चुकोपातीव च तदा कुर्वन्निव लयम्मुने ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Then, hearing the arrogant speech of the lotus-born [Brahmā], Īśvara / became exceedingly enraged at that time, O sage, as if causing cosmic dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kopataḥ samutpādya puruṣaṃ bhairavaṃ kvacit |
prajvalantaṃ sumahasā prītyā ca parameśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
स कोपतः समुत्पाद्य पुरुषं भैरवं क्वचित् |
प्रज्वलन्तं सुमहसा प्रीत्या च परमेश्वरः ||
text_mt: From his wrath, Parameśvara brought forth somewhere a terrible being, Bhairava, / blazing with immense splendour, and out of affection [spoke to him].

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca |
prāk ca paṅkajajanmāsau śāsyaste kālabhairava |
kālavadrājase sākṣātkālarājastato bhavān ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच |
प्राक् च पङ्कजजन्मासौ शास्यस्ते कालभैरव |
कालवद्राजसे साक्षात्कालराजस्ततो भवान् ||
text_mt: Īśvara said: / "First, this lotus-born one is to be chastised by you, O Kālabhairava! / You shine forth like time, death, itself in visible form; therefore you are Kālarāja.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvaṃ bharttuṃ samartho'si bhīṣaṇādbhairavaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tvatto bheṣyati kālo'pi tatastvaṃ kālabhairavaḥ ||
meaning:
विश्वं भर्त्तुं समर्थोऽसि भीषणाद्भैरवः स्मृतः |
त्वत्तो भेष्यति कालोऽपि ततस्त्वं कालभैरवः ||
text_mt: You are capable of sustaining the universe, and because of your terrifying nature you are called Bhairava; / even Time/Death will fear you, and hence you are Kālabhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
āmardayiṣyati bhavānruṣṭo duṣṭātmano yataḥ |
āmardaka iti khyātiṃ tataḥ sarvatra yāsyasi ||
meaning:
आमर्दयिष्यति भवान्रुष्टो दुष्टात्मनो यतः |
आमर्दक इति ख्यातिं ततः सर्वत्र यास्यसि ||
text_mt: Because you will crush the wicked when enraged, / you will therefore attain fame everywhere under the name Āmardaka.

sanskrit_iast:
yataḥ pāpāni bhaktānāṃ bhakṣayiṣyasi tatkṣaṇāt |
pāpabhakṣaṇa ityeva tava nāma bhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
यतः पापानि भक्तानां भक्षयिष्यसि तत्क्षणात् |
पापभक्षण इत्येव तव नाम भविष्यति ||
text_mt: Because you will devour the sins of devotees instantly, / your name will therefore be Pāpabhakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yā me muktipurī kāśī sarvābhyo'pi garīyasī |
ādhipatyaṃ ca tasyāste kālarāja sadaiva hi ||
meaning:
या मे मुक्तिपुरी काशी सर्वाभ्योऽपि गरीयसी |
आधिपत्यं च तस्यास्ते कालराज सदैव हि ||
text_mt: My city of liberation, Kāśī, is greater than all others, / and the lordship over it shall be yours forever, O Kālarāja.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra ye pātakinarāsteṣāṃ śāstā tvameva hi |
śubhāśubhaṃ ca tatkarma citragupto likhiṣyati ||
meaning:
तत्र ये पातकिनरास्तेषां शास्ता त्वमेव हि |
शुभाशुभं च तत्कर्म चित्रगुप्तो लिखिष्यति ||
text_mt: You alone shall be the chastiser of the sinful men there, / and Citragupta will record their good and evil deeds."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
etānvarānpragṛhyātha tatkṣaṇātkālabhairavaḥ |
vāmāṅgulinakhāgreṇa cakarta ca vidheśśiraḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
एतान्वरान्प्रगृह्याथ तत्क्षणात्कालभैरवः |
वामाङ्गुलिनखाग्रेण चकर्त च विधेश्शिरः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Then, having received these boons, Kālabhairava instantly / severed Brahmā's head with the tip of the nail of his left finger.

sanskrit_iast:
yadaṅgamaparādhnoti kāryaṃ tasyaiva śāsanam |
ato yena kṛtā nindā tacchinnaṃ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ ||
meaning:
यदङ्गमपराध्नोति कार्यं तस्यैव शासनम् |
अतो येन कृता निन्दा तच्छिन्नं पञ्चमं शिरः ||
text_mt: The limb that commits an offense is the very one to be punished; / therefore, the fifth head, by which the insult was uttered, was severed.

sanskrit_iast:
atha chinnaṃ vidhiśiro dṛṣṭvā bhītataro hariḥ |
śātarudriyamantraiśca bhaktyā tuṣṭāva śaṅkaram ||
meaning:
अथ छिन्नं विधिशिरो दृष्ट्वा भीततरो हरिः |
शातरुद्रियमन्त्रैश्च भक्त्या तुष्टाव शङ्करम् ||
text_mt: Then, seeing Brahmā's severed head, Hari became extremely terrified, / and with devotion he praised Śaṅkara with the hymns of the Śatarudriya.

sanskrit_iast:
bhīto hiraṇyagarbho'pi jajāpa śatarudriyam |
itthaṃ tau gatagarvau hi sañjātau tatkṣaṇānmune ||
meaning:
भीतो हिरण्यगर्भोऽपि जजाप शतरुद्रियम् |
इत्थं तौ गतगर्वौ हि सञ्जातौ तत्क्षणान्मुने ||
text_mt: Terrified, Hiraṇyagarbha too chanted the Śatarudriya. / Thus, O sage, the two were instantly stripped of their pride.

sanskrit_iast:
parabrahma śivaḥ sākṣātsaccidānandalakṣaṇaḥ |
paramātmā guṇātīta iti jñānamavāpatuḥ ||
meaning:
परब्रह्म शिवः साक्षात्सच्चिदानन्दलक्षणः |
परमात्मा गुणातीत इति ज्ञानमवापतुः ||
text_mt: They attained the knowledge that Śiva is directly the supreme Brahman, / characterized by existence, consciousness, and bliss, the supreme self beyond the qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra sarvajña śṛṇu me paramaṃ śubham |
yāvadgarvo bhavettāvajjñānaguptirviśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ शृणु मे परमं शुभम् |
यावद्गर्वो भवेत्तावज्ज्ञानगुप्तिर्विशेषतः ||
text_mt: O all-knowing Sanatkumāra, hear from me this most auspicious truth: / as long as pride exists, to that extent true knowledge remains hidden.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvābhimānaṃ puruṣo jānāti parameśvaram |
garviṇaṃ hanti viśveśo jāto garvāpahārakaḥ ||
meaning:
त्यक्त्वाभिमानं पुरुषो जानाति परमेश्वरम् |
गर्विणं हन्ति विश्वेशो जातो गर्वापहारकः ||
text_mt: Having cast off egoism, a man knows Parameśvara. / The Lord of the universe destroys the proud; he is born as the remover of pride.

sanskrit_iast:
atha viṣṇuvidhī jñātvā vigarvau parameśvaraḥ |
prasanno'bhūnmahādevo'karottāvabhayau prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
अथ विष्णुविधी ज्ञात्वा विगर्वौ परमेश्वरः |
प्रसन्नोऽभून्महादेवोऽकरोत्तावभयौ प्रभुः ||
text_mt: Then, seeing Viṣṇu and Brahmā free from pride, Parameśvara, / the lord Mahādeva, was pleased and granted them freedom from fear.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvāsya tau mahādevaḥ prītaḥ praṇatavatsalaḥ |
prāha svāṃ mūrtimaparāṃ bhairavantaṃ kaparddinam ||
meaning:
आश्वास्य तौ महादेवः प्रीतः प्रणतवत्सलः |
प्राह स्वां मूर्तिमपरां भैरवन्तं कपर्द्दिनम् ||
text_mt: Having consoled the two, Mahādeva, delighted and affectionate toward the surrendered, / spoke to his other form, that Bhairava with matted hair:

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva uvāca |
tvayā mānyo viṣṇurasau tathā śatadhṛtiḥ svayam |
kapālaṃ vaidhasaṃ vāpi nīlalohita dhāraya ||
meaning:
महादेव उवाच |
त्वया मान्यो विष्णुरसौ तथा शतधृतिः स्वयम् |
कपालं वैधसं वापि नीललोहित धारय ||
text_mt: Mahādeva said: / "You must respect this Viṣṇu, and likewise Brahmā himself. / O Nīlalohita, take up this skull of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyāpanodāya vrataṃ lokāya darśaya |
cara tvaṃ satataṃ bhikṣāṃ kapālavratamāśritaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्यापनोदाय व्रतं लोकाय दर्शय |
चर त्वं सततं भिक्षां कपालव्रतमाश्रितः ||
text_mt: To demonstrate the expiation of brahminicide to the world, show them the rite; / wander continuously for alms, adhering to the observance of the skull."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā paśyatastasya tejorūpaḥ śivo'bravīt |
utpādya caikāṃ kanyāṃ tu brahmahatyābhiviśrutām ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा पश्यतस्तस्य तेजोरूपः शिवोऽब्रवीत् |
उत्पाद्य चैकां कन्यां तु ब्रह्महत्याभिविश्रुताम् ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus while he looked on, Śiva, who is of the form of light, spoke, / having generated a maiden renowned as Brahmahatyā:

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadvārāṇasīṃ divyāṃ purīmeṣāṃ gamiṣyati |
tāvattvaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ kālamanugacchograrūpiṇam ||
meaning:
यावद्वाराणसीं दिव्यां पुरीमेषां गमिष्यति |
तावत्त्वं भीषणं कालमनुगच्छोग्ररूपिणम् ||
text_mt: Until he reaches this divine city of Vārāṇasī, / do you follow this terrible, fierce-formed Kāla.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra te praveśo'sti tyaktvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm |
vārāṇasīṃ yadā gacchettanmukto bhava tatkṣaṇāt ||
meaning:
सर्वत्र ते प्रवेशोऽस्ति त्यक्त्वा वाराणसीं पुरीम् |
वाराणसीं यदा गच्छेत्तन्मुक्तो भव तत्क्षणात् ||
text_mt: You have access everywhere, except the city of Vārāṇasī; / when he enters Vārāṇasī, become freed from that instantly."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
niyojya tāmiti tadā brahmahatyāṃ ca tāṃ prabhuḥ |
mahādbhutaśca sa śivo'pyantardhānamagāttataḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
नियोज्य तामिति तदा ब्रह्महत्यां च तां प्रभुः |
महाद्भुतश्च स शिवोऽप्यन्तर्धानमगात्ततः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said: / Having thus assigned that Brahmahatyā at that time, / that wonderful lord Śiva then vanished from sight.

Thus ends the eighth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Incarnation of Bhairava,' in the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, the third section of the glorious Śivapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
sanatkumāra sarvajña bhairavīmaparāṃ kathām |
śṛṇu prītyā mahādoṣasaṃhartrīṃ bhaktivarddhinīm ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ भैरवीमपरां कथाम् |
शृणु प्रीत्या महादोषसंहर्त्रीं भक्तिवर्द्धिनीम् ||
title: navamo'dhyāyaḥ | bhairavāvatāralīlāvarṇanam
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Omniscient Sanatkumāra, listen with joy to another story of Bhairava, / which destroys great sins and increases devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsānnidhyaṃ bhairavo'pi kālo'bhūtkālakālanaḥ |
sa devadevavākyena bibhratkāpālikaṃ vratam ||
meaning:
तत्सान्निध्यं भैरवोऽपि कालोऽभूत्कालकालनः |
स देवदेववाक्येन बिभ्रत्कापालिकं व्रतम् ||
text_mt: Remaining in his presence, Bhairava also became Kāla, who drives Time; / by the word of the God of gods, he undertook the observance of the skull-bearer.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālapāṇirviśvātmā cacāra bhuvanatrayam |
nātyākṣīccāpi taṃ devaṃ brahmahatyāpi dāruṇā ||
meaning:
कपालपाणिर्विश्वात्मा चचार भुवनत्रयम् |
नात्याक्षीच्चापि तं देवं ब्रह्महत्यापि दारुणा ||
text_mt: With a skull in his hand, the Soul of the universe wandered the three worlds; / nor did that terrible brahminicide leave that god.

sanskrit_iast:
pratitīrthaṃ bhraman nāpi vimukto brahmahatyayā |
ataḥ kāmārimahimā sarvo'pi hyavagamyatām ||
meaning:
प्रतितीर्थं भ्रमन् नापि विमुक्तो ब्रह्महत्यया |
अतः कामारिमहिमा सर्वोऽपि ह्यवगम्यताम् ||
text_mt: Though he wandered from sacred bath to sacred bath, he was not freed from the brahminicide; / therefore let the entire majesty of the Enemy of Kāma be understood!

sanskrit_iast:
pramathaiḥ sevyamāno'pi hyekadā viharanharaḥ |
kāpāliko yayau svairī nārāyaṇaniketanam ||
meaning:
प्रमथैः सेव्यमानोऽपि ह्येकदा विहरन्हरः |
कापालिको ययौ स्वैरी नारायणनिकेतनम् ||
text_mt: Once, while wandering about though attended by the Pramathas, / Hara, roaming at will as a skull-bearer, went to the abode of Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
athāyāntaṃ mahākālaṃ trinetraṃ sarpakuṇḍalam |
mahādevāṃśasambhūtaṃ pūrṇākāraṃ ca bhairavam ||
meaning:
अथायान्तं महाकालं त्रिनेत्रं सर्पकुण्डलम् |
महादेवांशसम्भूतं पूर्णाकारं च भैरवम् ||
text_mt: Then, seeing Mahākāla approaching, three-eyed, with serpent earrings, / born as a portion of Mahādeva, Bhairava in full form,

sanskrit_iast:
papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau taṃ dṛṣṭvā garuḍadhvajaḥ |
devāśca munayaścaiva devanāryyaḥ samantataḥ ||
meaning:
पपात दण्डवद्भूमौ तं दृष्ट्वा गरुडध्वजः |
देवाश्च मुनयश्चैव देवनार्य्यः समन्ततः ||
text_mt: he whose banner bears Garuḍa fell to the ground like a staff upon seeing him, / and so did the gods, the sages, and the celestial women all around.

sanskrit_iast:
atha viṣṇuḥ praṇamyainaṃ prayātaḥ kamalāpatiḥ |
śirasyañjalimādhāya tuṣṭāva vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ ||
meaning:
अथ विष्णुः प्रणम्यैनं प्रयातः कमलापतिः |
शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय तुष्टाव विविधैः स्तवैः ||
text_mt: Then Viṣṇu, the husband of Kamalā, having bowed down, advanced toward him, / and, placing his folded hands upon his head, praised him with diverse hymns.

sanskrit_iast:
sānando'tha hariḥ prāha prasannātmā mahāmune |
kṣīrodamathanodbhūtāṃ padmāṃ padmālayāṃ mudā ||
meaning:
सानन्दोऽथ हरिः प्राह प्रसन्नात्मा महामुने |
क्षीरोदमथनोद्भूतां पद्मां पद्मालयां मुदा ||
text_mt: Then Hari, joyous and serene of soul, O great sage, / spoke gladly to Padmā, whose abode is the lotus, born from the churning of the milk ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca |
priye paśyābjanayane dhanyāsi subhage'naghe |
dhanyo'haṃ devi suśroṇi yatpaśyāvo jagatpatim ||
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच |
प्रिये पश्याब्जनयने धन्यासि सुभगेऽनघे |
धन्योऽहं देवि सुश्रोणि यत्पश्यावो जगत्पतिम् ||
text_mt:
Viṣṇu said:
Look, my beloved lotus-eyed one! You are blessed, fortunate, and sinless; / I too am blessed, O goddess of beautiful hips, since we behold the Lord of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ dhātā vidhātā ca lokānāṃ prabhurīśvaraḥ |
anādiḥ śaraṇaḥ śāntaḥ puraḥ ṣaḍviṃśasammitaḥ ||
meaning:
अयं धाता विधाता च लोकानां प्रभुरीश्वरः |
अनादिः शरणः शान्तः पुरः षड्विंशसम्मितः ||
text_mt: He is the Creator and the Disposer, the Sovereign and the Lord of the worlds, / beginningless, the refuge, peaceful, standing before us, known as the twenty-sixth.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñaḥ sarvayogīśaḥ sarvabhūtaikanāyakaḥ |
sarvabhūtāntarātmā'yaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvadaḥ sadā ||
meaning:
सर्वज्ञः सर्वयोगीशः सर्वभूतैकनायकः |
सर्वभूतान्तरात्माऽयं सर्वेषां सर्वदः सदा ||
text_mt: Omniscient, lord of all yogins, sole leader of all beings, / he is the inner soul of all beings, who always bestows everything upon everyone.

sanskrit_iast:
ye vinidrā viniḥśvāsāḥ śāntāḥ dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ |
dhiyā paśyanti hṛdaye so'yaṃ padme samīkṣatām ||
meaning:
ये विनिद्रा विनिःश्वासाः शान्ताः ध्यानपरायणाः |
धिया पश्यन्ति हृदये सोऽयं पद्मे समीक्षताम् ||
text_mt: He whom the sleepless, the breathless, the peaceful, devoted to meditation / behold in their heart by means of intellect—behold him, O Padmā!

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ vidurvedatattvajñā yogino yatamānasāḥ |
arūpo rūpavānbhūtvā so'yamāyāti sarvagaḥ ||
meaning:
यं विदुर्वेदतत्त्वज्ञा योगिनो यतमानसाः |
अरूपो रूपवान्भूत्वा सोऽयमायाति सर्वगः ||
text_mt: He whom the knowers of the truth of the Veda and yogins of restrained mind know, / formless, having assumed a form, this omnipresent one arrives.

sanskrit_iast:
aho vicitraṃ devasya ceṣṭitaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ |
yasyākhyāṃ bruvato nityaṃ na dehaḥ so'pi dehabhṛt ||
meaning:
अहो विचित्रं देवस्य चेष्टितं परमेष्ठिनः |
यस्याख्यां ब्रुवतो नित्यं न देहः सोऽपि देहभृत् ||
text_mt: Oh, wondrous is the deed of the divine Supreme Lord! / He whose name being uttered constantly frees one from embodiment, even he has taken a body.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā na punarjanma labhyate mānavairbhuvi |
so'yamāyāti bhagavāṃstryambakaḥ śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ ||
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा न पुनर्जन्म लभ्यते मानवैर्भुवि |
सोऽयमायाति भगवांस्त्र्यम्बकः शशिभूषणः ||
text_mt: Having seen him, mortals on earth attain no rebirth; / this blessed Tryambaka arrives, adorned with the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇḍarīkadalāyāme dhanye me'dya vilocane |
yad dṛśyate mahādevo hyābhyāṃ lakṣmi maheśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
पुण्डरीकदलायामे धन्ये मेऽद्य विलोचने |
यद् दृश्यते महादेवो ह्याभ्यां लक्ष्मि महेश्वरः ||
text_mt: Blessed today are my eyes, wide as lotus petals, / since through them Mahādeva, Maheśvara, is seen, O Lakṣmī!

sanskrit_iast:
dhigdhikpadaṃ tu devānāṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā na śaṅkaram |
labhyate yatra nirvāṇaṃ sarvaduḥkhāntakṛttu yat ||
meaning:
धिग्धिक्पदं तु देवानां परं दृष्ट्वा न शङ्करम् |
लभ्यते यत्र निर्वाणं सर्वदुःखान्तकृत्तु यत् ||
text_mt: Shame, shame on the rank of the gods, if after seeing the supreme Śaṅkara / liberation is not attained, which brings an end to all sorrow!

sanskrit_iast:
devatvādaśubhaṃ kiñciddevaloke na vidyate |
dṛṣṭvāpi sarve deveśaṃ yanmuktiṃ na labhāmahe ||
meaning:
देवत्वादशुभं किञ्चिद्देवलोके न विद्यते |
दृष्ट्वापि सर्वे देवेशं यन्मुक्तिं न लभामहे ||
text_mt: There is nothing more inauspicious in the world of the gods than divinity itself, / since even after seeing the Lord of gods, we all do not attain liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ samprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ |
praṇipatya mahādevamidamāha vṛṣadhvajam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशः सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः |
प्रणिपत्य महादेवमिदमाह वृषध्वजम् ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Having spoken thus, Hṛṣīkeśa, his body hairs bristling with joy, / bowed down to Mahādeva, whose banner bears the bull, and said this:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca |
kimidaṃ devadevena sarvajñena tvayā vibho |
kriyate jagatāṃ dhātrā sarvapāpaharāvyaya ||
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच |
किमिदं देवदेवेन सर्वज्ञेन त्वया विभो |
क्रियते जगतां धात्रा सर्वपापहराव्यय ||
text_mt:
Viṣṇu said:
What is this being done by you, the God of gods, the omniscient, O Lord, / the creator of the worlds, O imperishable remover of all sins?

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍeyaṃ tava deveśa trilocana mahāmate |
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ virūpākṣa ceṣṭitaṃ te smarārdana ||
meaning:
क्रीडेयं तव देवेश त्रिलोचन महामते |
किं कारणं विरूपाक्ष चेष्टितं ते स्मरार्दन ||
text_mt: This is a play of yours, O Lord of gods, three-eyed one of great intellect; / what is the reason, O Virūpākṣa, for this deed of yours, O crusher of Smara?

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthaṃ bhagavañchambho bhikṣāṃ carasi śaktipa |
saṃśayo me jagannātha eṣa trailokyarājyada ||
meaning:
किमर्थं भगवञ्छम्भो भिक्षां चरसि शक्तिप |
संशयो मे जगन्नाथ एष त्रैलोक्यराज्यद ||
text_mt: For what reason, O blessed Śambhu, keeper of the Śakti, do you wander for alms? / This doubt arises in me, O Lord of the universe, giver of the kingdom of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
evamuktastataḥ śambhurviṣṇunā bhairavo haraḥ |
pratyuvācādbhutotiḥ sa viṣṇuṃ hi vihasanprabhuḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
एवमुक्तस्ततः शम्भुर्विष्णुना भैरवो हरः |
प्रत्युवाचाद्भुतोतिः स विष्णुं हि विहसन्प्रभुः ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Addressed thus by Viṣṇu, Śambhu, Bhairava, Hara, / that lord of wondrous speech smiled and answered Viṣṇu:

sanskrit_iast:
bhairava uvāca |
brahmaṇastu śiraśchinnamaṅgulyāgranakhena ha |
tadaghaṃ pratihantuṃ hi carāmyetad vrataṃ śubham ||
meaning:
भैरव उवाच |
ब्रह्मणस्तु शिरश्छिन्नमङ्गुल्याग्रनखेन ह |
तदघं प्रतिहन्तुं हि चराम्येतद् व्रतं शुभम् ||
text_mt:
Bhairava said:
The head of Brahmā was severed by the nail at the tip of my finger; / indeed, to strike down that sin I observe this auspicious rite.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
evamukto maheśena bhairaveṇa ramāpatiḥ |
smṛtvā kiñcinnataśirāḥ punarevamajijñapat ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
एवमुक्तो महेशेन भैरवेण रमापतिः |
स्मृत्वा किञ्चिन्नतशिराः पुनरेवमजिज्ञपत् ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Addressed thus by the great lord Bhairava, the husband of Ramā / recalled something, bowed his head, and again addressed him thus:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca |
yathecchasi tathā krīḍa sarvavighnāpanodaka |
māyayā māṃ mahādeva nācchādayitumarhasi ||
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच |
यथेच्छसि तथा क्रीड सर्वविघ्नापनोदक |
मायया मां महादेव नाच्छादयितुमर्हसि ||
text_mt:
Viṣṇu said:
Play as you please, O dispeller of all obstacles! / You ought not to conceal me with your illusion, O Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhīkamalakośāttu koṭiśaḥ kamalāsanāḥ |
kalpe kalpe purā hyānsastvanniyogabalādvibho ||
meaning:
नाभीकमलकोशात्तु कोटिशः कमलासनाः |
कल्पे कल्पे पुरा ह्यान्सस्त्वन्नियोगबलाद्विभो ||
text_mt: For tens of millions of lotus-seated [Brahmās] came forth from the sheath of my navel-lotus / in aeon after aeon in the past, O Lord, through the power of your command.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaja māyāmimāṃ deva dustarāmakṛtātmabhiḥ |
brahmādayo mahādeva māyayā tava mohitāḥ ||
meaning:
त्यज मायामिमां देव दुस्तरामकृतात्मभिः |
ब्रह्मादयो महादेव मायया तव मोहिताः ||
text_mt: Cast off this illusion, O God, hard to cross for the undisciplined; / Brahmā and the others, O Mahādeva, are deluded by your illusion.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāvadanugacchāmi ceṣṭitaṃ te śivāpate |
tavaivānugrahācchambho sarveśvara satāṅgate ||
meaning:
यथावदनुगच्छामि चेष्टितं ते शिवापते |
तवैवानुग्रहाच्छम्भो सर्वेश्वर सताङ्गते ||
text_mt: I understand your deed properly, O Lord of Śivā, / solely by your grace, O Śambhu, Lord of all, refuge of the good.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhārakāle samprāpte sadevānnikhilānmunīn |
lokānvarṇāśramavato hariṣyasi yadā hara ||
meaning:
संहारकाले सम्प्राप्ते सदेवान्निखिलान्मुनीन् |
लोकान्वर्णाश्रमवतो हरिष्यसि यदा हर ||
text_mt: When the time of dissolution arrives, having gods along with all the sages, / the worlds, endowed with social classes and stages of life, you will take away, O Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā kṛte mahādeva pāpaṃ brahmavadhādikam |
pāratantryaṃ na te śambho svairaṃ krīḍatyato bhavān ||
meaning:
तदा कृते महादेव पापं ब्रह्मवधादिकम् |
पारतन्त्र्यं न ते शम्भो स्वैरं क्रीडत्यतो भवान् ||
text_mt: When that is done, O Mahādeva, what is the sin of killing a Brahmin and the like? / There is no subservience for you, O Śambhu, and therefore you play at your own will.

sanskrit_iast:
atīta brahmaṇāṃ hyasthnāṃ srakkaṇṭhe tava bhāsate |
tathāpyanugatā śambho brahmahatyā tavānagha ||
meaning:
अतीत ब्रह्मणां ह्यस्थ्नां स्रक्कण्ठे तव भासते |
तथाप्यनुगता शम्भो ब्रह्महत्या तवानघ ||
text_mt: A garland of the bones of past Brahmās shines upon your neck; / nevertheless, brahminicide pursues you, O sinless Śambhu!

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ yastvāṃ smarati mānavaḥ |
ādhāraṃ jagatāmīśa tasya pāpaṃ vilīyate ||
meaning:
कृत्वापि सुमहत्पापं यस्त्वां स्मरति मानवः |
आधारं जगतामीश तस्य पापं विलीयते ||
text_mt: Even having committed a very great sin, the mortal who remembers you, / the foundation of the worlds, O Lord, has his sin dissolved.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā tamo na tiṣṭheta sannidhāvaṃśumālinaḥ |
tathaiva tava yo bhaktaḥ pāpaṃ tasya vrajetkṣayam ||
meaning:
यथा तमो न तिष्ठेत सन्निधावंशुमालिनः |
तथैव तव यो भक्तः पापं तस्य व्रजेत्क्षयम् ||
text_mt: Just as darkness cannot remain in the presence of the sun, / just so the sin of him who is devoted to you goes to destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścintayati puṇyātmā tava pādāmbujadvayam |
brahmahatyākṛtamapi pāpaṃ tasya vrajetkṣayam ||
meaning:
यश्चिन्तयति पुण्यात्मा तव पादाम्बुजद्वयम् |
ब्रह्महत्याकृतमपि पापं तस्य व्रजेत्क्षयम् ||
text_mt: The virtuous soul who meditates upon your two lotus feet, / even his sin incurred by brahminicide goes to destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
tava nāmānuraktā vāgyasya puṃso jagatpate |
apyadrikūṭatulitaṃ nainastamanubādhate ||
meaning:
तव नामानुरक्ता वाग्यस्य पुंसो जगत्पते |
अप्यद्रिकूटतुलितं नैनस्तमनुबाधते ||
text_mt: That man whose speech is attached to your name, O Lord of the universe, / sin, even if equal to a mountain peak, does not torment him.

sanskrit_iast:
paramātmanparaṃ dhāma svecchābhidhṛtavigraha |
kutūhalaṃ taveśedaṃ kṛpaṇādhīnateśvara ||
meaning:
परमात्मन्परं धाम स्वेच्छाभिधृतविग्रह |
कुतूहलं तवेशेदं कृपणाधीनतेश्वर ||
text_mt: O Supreme Self, supreme abode, you who have assumed a body by your own will! / This curiosity is yours, O Lord, who are sovereign over those in distress.

sanskrit_iast:
adya dhanyo'smi deveśa yanna paśyanti yoginaḥ |
paśyāmi taṃ jaganmūrttiṃ parameśvaramavyayam ||
meaning:
अद्य धन्योऽस्मि देवेश यन्न पश्यन्ति योगिनः |
पश्यामि तं जगन्मूर्त्तिं परमेश्वरमव्ययम् ||
text_mt: Today I am blessed, O Lord of gods; he whom yogins do not behold, / that imperishable Parameśvara, whose form is the universe, I behold.

sanskrit_iast:
adya me paramo lābhastvadya me maṅgalaṃ param |
taṃ dṛṣṭvāmṛtatṛptasya tṛṇaṃ svargāpavargakam ||
meaning:
अद्य मे परमो लाभस्त्वद्य मे मङ्गलं परम् |
तं दृष्ट्वामृततृप्तस्य तृणं स्वर्गापवर्गकम् ||
text_mt: Today is my greatest gain, today is my supreme good fortune; / having seen him, heaven and liberation are like a blade of grass to one satisfied by nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ vadati govinde vimalā padmayā tayā |
manorathavatī nāma bhikṣā pātre samarpitā ||
meaning:
इत्थं वदति गोविन्दे विमला पद्मया तया |
मनोरथवती नाम भिक्षा पात्रे समर्पिता ||
text_mt: While Govinda was speaking thus, a pure [gift of] alms named Manorathavatī / was placed into his bowl by that Padmā.

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣāṭanāya devo'pi niragātparayā mudā |
anyatrāpi mahādevo bhairavaścāttavigrahaḥ ||
meaning:
भिक्षाटनाय देवोऽपि निरगात्परया मुदा |
अन्यत्रापि महादेवो भैरवश्चात्तविग्रहः ||
text_mt: Then the god went out with supreme joy to wander for alms elsewhere as well, / Mahādeva, Bhairava, having assumed that form.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvānuyāyinīṃ tāṃ tu samāhūya janārdanaḥ |
samprārthayad brahmahatyāṃ vimuñca tvaṃ triśūlinam ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वानुयायिनीं तां तु समाहूय जनार्दनः |
सम्प्रार्थयद् ब्रह्महत्यां विमुञ्च त्वं त्रिशूलिनम् ||
text_mt: Seeing her pursuing him, however, Janārdana called her / and entreated Brahminicide: “Release the Wielder of the trident!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyovāca |
anenāpi miṣeṇāhaṃ saṃsevyāmuṃ vṛṣadhvajam |
ātmānaṃ pāvayiṣyāmi tvapunarbhavadarśanam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्योवाच |
अनेनापि मिषेणाहं संसेव्यामुं वृषध्वजम् |
आत्मानं पावयिष्यामि त्वपुनर्भवदर्शनम् ||
text_mt:
Brahminicide said:
Even under this pretext, by serving this one whose banner bears the bull, / I shall purify myself, the sight of whom prevents rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
sā tatyāja na tatpārśvaṃ vyāhṛtāpi murāriṇā |
tamūce'tha hariṃ śambhuḥ smerāsyo bhairavo vacaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
सा तत्याज न तत्पार्श्वं व्याहृतापि मुरारिणा |
तमूचेऽथ हरिं शम्भुः स्मेरास्यो भैरवो वचः ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Though addressed by Murāri, she did not leave his side; / then Śambhu, Bhairava, with a smiling face, spoke words to Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
bhairava uvāca |
tvadvākpīyūṣapānena tṛpto'smi bahumānada |
svabhāvo'yaṃ hi sādhūnāṃ yattvaṃ vadasi māpate ||
meaning:
भैरव उवाच |
त्वद्वाक्पीयूषपानेन तृप्तोऽस्मि बहुमानद |
स्वभावोऽयं हि साधूनां यत्त्वं वदसि मापते ||
text_mt: Bhairava said: / By drinking the nectar of your speech, O giver of great respect, I am satisfied. / For this is the nature of the virtuous, which you speak, O lord of Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva govinda varado'smi tavānagha |
agraṇīrmama bhaktānāṃ tvaṃ hare nirvikāravān ||
meaning:
वरं वृणीष्व गोविन्द वरदोऽस्मि तवानघ |
अग्रणीर्मम भक्तानां त्वं हरे निर्विकारवान् ||
text_mt: Choose a boon, O Govinda; I am the giver of boons to you, O sinless one. / You are the foremost of my devotees, O Hari, free from change.

sanskrit_iast:
no mādyanti tathā bhaikṣyairbhikṣavo'pyatisaṃskṛtaiḥ |
yathā mānasudhāpānairnanu bhikṣāṭanajvarāḥ ||
meaning:
नो माद्यन्ति तथा भैक्ष्यैर्भिक्षवोऽप्यतिसंस्कृतैः |
यथा मानसुधापानैर्ननु भिक्षाटनज्वराः ||
text_mt: Mendicants are not so delighted even by highly refined alms / as those afflicted with the fever of wandering for alms [are delighted] by drinking the nectar of respect.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityākarṇya vacaḥ śambhorbhairavasya parātmanaḥ |
suprasannataro bhūtvā samavocanmaheśvaram ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचः शम्भोर्भैरवस्य परात्मनः |
सुप्रसन्नतरो भूत्वा समवोचन्महेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having heard this speech of Śambhu, of Bhairava the supreme Self, / becoming exceedingly pleased, [Viṣṇu] spoke to Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca |
eṣa eva varaḥ ślāghyo yadahaṃ devatādhipam |
paśyāmi tvāndevadeva manovāṇīpathātigam ||
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच |
एष एव वरः श्लाघ्यो यदहं देवताधिपम् |
पश्यामि त्वान्देवदेव मनोवाणीपथातिगम् ||
text_mt: Viṣṇu said: / This indeed is a praiseworthy boon: that I behold the ruler of deities, / you, the God of gods, who transcend the range of mind and speech.

sanskrit_iast:
adabhreyaṃ sudhādṛṣṭiranayā me mahotsavaḥ |
ayattnanidhilābho'yaṃ vīkṣaṇaṃ hara te satām ||
meaning:
अदभ्रेयं सुधादृष्टिरनया मे महोत्सवः |
अयत्त्ननिधिलाभोऽयं वीक्षणं हर ते सताम् ||
text_mt: This gaze of yours, like nectar, is abundant; by this, I have a great festival. / This seeing of you, O Hara, is for the virtuous the effortless acquisition of a treasure.

sanskrit_iast:
aviyogo'stu me deva tvadaṅghriyugalena vai |
eṣa eva varaḥ śambho nānyaṃ kaścid vṛṇe varam ||
meaning:
अवियोगोऽस्तु मे देव त्वदङ्घ्रियुगलेन वै |
एष एव वरः शम्भो नान्यं कश्चिद् वृणे वरम् ||
text_mt: May there indeed be no separation for me, O God, from your pair of feet. / This alone is the boon, O Śambhu; I choose no other boon whatsoever.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhairava uvāca |
evaṃ bhavatu te tāta yattvayoktaṃ mahāmate |
sarveṣāmapi devānāṃ varadastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ||
meaning:
श्रीभैरव उवाच |
एवं भवतु ते तात यत्त्वयोक्तं महामते |
सर्वेषामपि देवानां वरदस्त्वं भविष्यसि ||
text_mt: The venerable Bhairava said: / Let it be so for you, my dear, as has been spoken by you, O wise one. / You shall also be the giver of boons to all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
anugṛhyeti daityāriṃ kendrādribhuvane caran |
bheje'vimuktanagarīṃ nāmnā vārāṇasīṃ purīm ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
अनुगृह्येति दैत्यारिं केन्द्राद्रिभुवने चरन् |
भेजेऽविमुक्तनगरीं नाम्ना वाराणसीं पुरीम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having thus shown grace to the enemy of the Daityas, wandering through the worlds of the mountain of Indra and the like, / he reached the city Avimukta, the city named Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetre praviṣṭamātre'tha bhairave bhīṣaṇākṛtau |
hāhetyuktvā brahmahatyā pātālaṃ cāviśattadā ||
meaning:
क्षेत्रे प्रविष्टमात्रेऽथ भैरवे भीषणाकृतौ |
हाहेत्युक्त्वा ब्रह्महत्या पातालं चाविशत्तदा ||
text_mt: The moment Bhairava of terrifying form entered the sacred field, / the brahminicide, crying 'Alas, alas!', then entered the underworld.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ sadyo bhairavasya karāmbujāt |
papāta bhuvi tattīrthamabhūtkāpālamocanam ||
meaning:
कपालं ब्राह्मणः सद्यो भैरवस्य कराम्बुजात् |
पपात भुवि तत्तीर्थमभूत्कापालमोचनम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā's skull immediately fell to the ground / from the lotus hand of Bhairava; that holy site became Kāpālamocana.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālaṃ brahmaṇo rudraḥ sarveṣāmeva paśyatām |
hastātpatantamālokya nanarta parayā mudā ||
meaning:
कपालं ब्रह्मणो रुद्रः सर्वेषामेव पश्यताम् |
हस्तात्पतन्तमालोक्य ननर्त परया मुदा ||
text_mt: Seeing Brahmā's skull falling from his hand / before the eyes of everyone, Rudra danced with supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
vidheḥ kapālaṃ nāmuñcatkaramatyantadussaham |
parasya bhramataḥ kvāpi tatkāśyāṃ kṣaṇato'patat ||
meaning:
विधेः कपालं नामुञ्चत्करमत्यन्तदुस्सहम् |
परस्य भ्रमतः क्वापि तत्काश्यां क्षणतोऽपतत् ||
text_mt: The utterly unbearable skull of Brahmā did not leave his hand / anywhere while the Supreme was wandering; in Kāśī, it fell in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
śūlino brahmaṇo hatyā nāpaiti sma ca yā kvacit |
sā kāśyāṃ kṣaṇato naṣṭā tasmātsevyā hi kāśikā ||
meaning:
शूलिनो ब्रह्मणो हत्या नापैति स्म च या क्वचित् |
सा काश्यां क्षणतो नष्टा तस्मात्सेव्या हि काशिका ||
text_mt: And the murder of Brahmā, which did not depart from the trident-bearer anywhere, / perished in an instant in Kāśī; therefore, Kāśī is certainly to be resorted to.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālamocanaṃ kāśyāṃ yaḥ smarettīrthamuttamam |
ihānyatrāpi yatpāpaṃ kṣipraṃ tasya praṇaśyati ||
meaning:
कपालमोचनं काश्यां यः स्मरेत्तीर्थमुत्तमम् |
इहान्यत्रापि यत्पापं क्षिप्रं तस्य प्रणश्यति ||
text_mt: Whoever remembers the excellent holy site Kāpālamocana in Kāśī, / whatever sin is his, here or elsewhere, quickly perishes.

sanskrit_iast:
āgatya tīrthapravare snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ |
tarpayitvā pitṝndevānmucyate brahmahatyayā ||
meaning:
आगत्य तीर्थप्रवरे स्नानं कृत्वा विधानतः |
तर्पयित्वा पितॄन्देवान्मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया ||
text_mt: Having come to the most excellent holy site, having bathed according to the rules, / and having offered libations to the ancestors and gods, one is freed from brahminicide.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālamocanaṃ tīrthaṃ puraskṛtvā tu bhairavaḥ |
tatraiva tasthau bhaktānāṃ bhakṣayannaghasantatim ||
meaning:
कपालमोचनं तीर्थं पुरस्कृत्वा तु भैरवः |
तत्रैव तस्थौ भक्तानां भक्षयन्नघसन्ततिम् ||
text_mt: Having honored the holy site Kāpālamocana, Bhairava / remained right there, consuming the succession of sins of his devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ tu mārgasya māsasya parameśvaraḥ |
āvirbabhūva sallīlo bhairavātmā satāṃ priyaḥ ||
meaning:
कृष्णाष्टम्यां तु मार्गस्य मासस्य परमेश्वरः |
आविर्बभूव सल्लीलो भैरवात्मा सतां प्रियः ||
text_mt: On the eighth day of the dark fortnight of the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, Parameśvara, / playful in nature, embodying Bhairava and dear to the virtuous, manifested.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣāsitāṣṭamyāṃ kālabhairavasannidhau |
upoṣya jāgaraṃ kurvanmahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षासिताष्टम्यां कालभैरवसन्निधौ |
उपोष्य जागरं कुर्वन्महापापैः प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: Having fasted and kept vigil in the presence of Kālabhairava / on the eighth day of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, one is released from great sins.

sanskrit_iast:
anyatrāpi naro bhaktyā tad vrataṃ yaḥ kariṣyati |
sajāgaraṃ mahāpāpairmukto yāsyati sadgatim ||
meaning:
अन्यत्रापि नरो भक्त्या तद् व्रतं यः करिष्यति |
सजागरं महापापैर्मुक्तो यास्यति सद्गतिम् ||
text_mt: Even elsewhere, the person who undertakes that observance with devotion, / keeping vigil, will be freed from great sins and attain the good destination.

sanskrit_iast:
anekajanmaniyutairyatkṛtaṃ jantubhistvagham |
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti kālabhairavadarśanāt ||
meaning:
अनेकजन्मनियुतैर्यत्कृतं जन्तुभिस्त्वघम् |
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति कालभैरवदर्शनात् ||
text_mt: Whatever sin has been committed by living beings through many millions of births, / all that dissolves away from the sight of Kālabhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
kālabhairavabhaktānāṃ pātakāni karoti yaḥ |
sa mūḍho duḥkhito bhūtvā punardurgatimāpnuyāt ||
meaning:
कालभैरवभक्तानां पातकानि करोति यः |
स मूढो दुःखितो भूत्वा पुनर्दुर्गतिमाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: Whoever commits wrongful deeds against the devotees of Kālabhairava, / that fool, having become miserable, will again attain an evil destination.

sanskrit_iast:
viśveśvare'pi ye bhaktā no bhaktāḥ kālabhairave |
te labhante mahāduḥkhaṃ kāśyāṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
विश्वेश्वरेऽपि ये भक्ता नो भक्ताः कालभैरवे |
ते लभन्ते महादुःखं काश्यां चैव विशेषतः ||
text_mt: Those who, though devoted to Viśveśvara, are not devoted to Kālabhairava / obtain great misery, especially in Kāśī.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāṇasyāmuṣitvā yo bhairavaṃ na bhajennaraḥ |
tasya pāpāni varddhante śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī ||
meaning:
वाराणस्यामुषित्वा यो भैरवं न भजेन्नरः |
तस्य पापानि वर्द्धन्ते शुक्लपक्षे यथा शशी ||
text_mt: The man who, having dwelt in Vārāṇasī, does not worship Bhairava, / his sins increase like the moon in the bright fortnight.

sanskrit_iast:
kālarājaṃ na yaḥ kāśyāṃ pratibhūtāṣṭamīkujam |
bhajettasya kṣayaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe yathā śaśī ||
meaning:
कालराजं न यः काश्यां प्रतिभूताष्टमीकुजम् |
भजेत्तस्य क्षयं पुण्यं कृष्णपक्षे यथा शशी ||
text_mt: Whoever does not worship Kālarāja in Kāśī on every fourteenth, eighth, and Tuesday, / his merit diminishes like the moon in the dark fortnight.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ brahmahatyāpanodakam |
bhairavotpattisaṃjñaṃ ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वाख्यानमिदं पुण्यं ब्रह्महत्यापनोदकम् |
भैरवोत्पत्तिसंज्ञं च सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: Having heard this sacred narrative that dispels brahminicide, / named 'The Origin of Bhairava', one is released from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
bandhanāgārasaṃstho'pi prāpto'pi vipadaṃ parām |
prādurbhāvaṃ bhairavasya śrutvā mucyeta saṅkaṭāt ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
बन्धनागारसंस्थोऽपि प्राप्तोऽपि विपदं पराम् |
प्रादुर्भावं भैरवस्य श्रुत्वा मुच्येत सङ्कटात् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Even one stationed in prison, even one who has attained supreme misfortune, / having heard of the manifestation of Bhairava, would be freed from distress.

Thus ends the ninth chapter, named 'The Description of the Sport of Bhairava's Incarnation', in the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, the third [book] in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
vidhvaṃsī dakṣayajñasya vīrabhadrāhvayaḥ prabhoḥ |
avatāraśca vijñeyaḥ śivasya paramātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
विध्वंसी दक्षयज्ञस्य वीरभद्राह्वयः प्रभोः |
अवतारश्च विज्ञेयः शिवस्य परमात्मनः ||
title: daśamo'dhyāyaḥ | nṛsiṃhacaritavarṇanam
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / The destroyer of Dakṣa's sacrifice, named Vīrabhadra, / is to be known as an incarnation of the Lord, Śiva, the supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
satīcaritre kathitaṃ caritaṃ tasya kṛtsnaśaḥ |
śrutaṃ tvayāpi bahudhā nātaḥ proktaṃ suvistarāt ||
meaning:
सतीचरित्रे कथितं चरितं तस्य कृत्स्नशः |
श्रुतं त्वयापि बहुधा नातः प्रोक्तं सुविस्तरात् ||
text_mt: His story was told completely in the story of Satī; / it was also heard by you in many ways, hence it is not told here in great detail.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ muniśreṣṭha bhavatsnehād bravīmi tat |
śārdūlākhyāvatāraṃ ca śaṅkarasya prabhoḥ śṛṇu ||
meaning:
अतः परं मुनिश्रेष्ठ भवत्स्नेहाद् ब्रवीमि तत् |
शार्दूलाख्यावतारं च शङ्करस्य प्रभोः शृणु ||
text_mt: Beyond this, O best of sages, out of affection for you I tell it; / hear also of the incarnation named Śarabha of the lord Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivena devānāṃ hitārthaṃ rūpamadbhutam |
śārabhaṃ ca dhṛtaṃ divyaṃ jvalajjvālāsamaprabham ||
meaning:
सदाशिवेन देवानां हितार्थं रूपमद्भुतम् |
शारभं च धृतं दिव्यं ज्वलज्ज्वालासमप्रभम् ||
text_mt: For the welfare of the gods, Sadāśiva assumed a wondrous, / divine form of Śarabha, equal in luster to blazing flames.

sanskrit_iast:
śivāvatārā amitāḥ sadbhaktahitakārakāḥ |
saṅkhyā na śakyate kartuṃ teṣāṃ ca munisattamāḥ ||
meaning:
शिवावतारा अमिताः सद्भक्तहितकारकाः |
सङ्ख्या न शक्यते कर्तुं तेषां च मुनिसत्तमाः ||
text_mt: The incarnations of Śiva are limitless, bringing benefit to true devotees; / it is not possible, O best of sages, to make an enumeration of them.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśasya ca tārāṇāṃ reṇukānāṃ kṣitestathā |
āsārāṇāṃ ca vṛddhena bahukalpaiḥ kadāpi hi ||
meaning:
आकाशस्य च ताराणां रेणुकानां क्षितेस्तथा |
आसाराणां च वृद्धेन बहुकल्पैः कदापि हि ||
text_mt: Even over many kalpas, of the stars in the sky and of the particles of dust on the earth, / and of torrents of rain, an enumeration might at some time be made by a wise elder

sanskrit_iast:
saṅkhyā viśakyate kartuṃ suprājñairbahujanmabhiḥ |
na vai śivāvatārāṇāṃ satyaṃ jānīhi madvacaḥ ||
meaning:
सङ्ख्या विशक्यते कर्तुं सुप्राज्ञैर्बहुजन्मभिः |
न वै शिवावताराणां सत्यं जानीहि मद्वचः ||
text_mt: through many births by the very wise, / but never of Śiva's incarnations; know my word to be true.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi ca yathābuddhyā kathayāmi yathāśrutam |
caritraṃ śārabhaṃ divyaṃ paramaiśvaryasūcakam ||
meaning:
तथापि च यथाबुद्ध्या कथयामि यथाश्रुतम् |
चरित्रं शारभं दिव्यं परमैश्वर्यसूचकम् ||
text_mt: Nevertheless, according to my intellect and as heard [by me], I will tell / the divine story of Śarabha, indicative of supreme sovereign power.

sanskrit_iast:
jayaśca vijayaścaiva bhavadbhiḥ śāpitau yadā |
tadā ditisutau dvau tāvabhūtāṃ kaśyapānmune ||
meaning:
जयश्च विजयश्चैव भवद्भिः शापितौ यदा |
तदा दितिसुतौ द्वौ तावभूतां कश्यपान्मुने ||
text_mt: When Jaya and Vijaya were cursed by you [sages], / then those two sons of Diti were born from Kaśyapa, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyakaśipuścādyo hiraṇyākṣo'nujo balī |
devarṣipārṣadau jātau tau dvāvapi diteḥ sutau ||
meaning:
हिरण्यकशिपुश्चाद्यो हिरण्याक्षोऽनुजो बली |
देवर्षिपार्षदौ जातौ तौ द्वावपि दितेः सुतौ ||
text_mt: Hiraṇyakaśipu was the elder, and the mighty Hiraṇyākṣa was the younger brother; / both attendants of the divine sage were born as sons of Diti.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthvyuddhāre vidhātrā va prārthito hi purā prabhuḥ |
hiraṇyākṣaṃ jaghānāsau viṣṇurvārāharūpadhṛk ||
meaning:
पृथ्व्युद्धारे विधात्रा व प्रार्थितो हि पुरा प्रभुः |
हिरण्याक्षं जघानासौ विष्णुर्वाराहरूपधृक् ||
text_mt: Formerly, when the earth was lifted up, the Lord was petitioned by the creator; / that Viṣṇu, assuming the form of a boar, slew Hiraṇyākṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ śrutvā bhrātaraṃ vīraṃ nihataṃ prāṇasannibham |
cukopa haraye'tīva hiraṇyakaśipurmune ||
meaning:
तं श्रुत्वा भ्रातरं वीरं निहतं प्राणसन्निभम् |
चुकोप हरयेऽतीव हिरण्यकशिपुर्मुने ||
text_mt: Hearing that his heroic brother, who was dear as his own life, was slain, / Hiraṇyakaśipu became exceedingly angry with Hari, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ taptvā brahmaṇo varamāpa saḥ |
na kaścinmārayenmāṃ vai tvatsṛṣṭāviti tuṣṭataḥ ||
meaning:
वर्षाणामयुतं तप्त्वा ब्रह्मणो वरमाप सः |
न कश्चिन्मारयेन्मां वै त्वत्सृष्टाविति तुष्टतः ||
text_mt: Having performed austerity for ten thousand years, he obtained a boon from Brahmā, / who was pleased: 'Truly, let no one in your creation kill me.'

sanskrit_iast:
śoṇitākhyapuraṃ gatvā devānāhūya sarvataḥ |
trilokīṃ svavaśe kṛtvā cakre rājyamakaṇṭakam ||
meaning:
शोणिताख्यपुरं गत्वा देवानाहूय सर्वतः |
त्रिलोकीं स्ववशे कृत्वा चक्रे राज्यमकण्टकम् ||
text_mt: Having gone to the city named Śoṇita and summoned the gods from all sides, / bringing the three worlds under his control, he ruled an unopposed kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
devarṣikadanaṃ cakre sarvadharmavilopakaḥ |
dvijapīḍākaraḥ pāpī hiraṇyakaśipurmune ||
meaning:
देवर्षिकदनं चक्रे सर्वधर्मविलोपकः |
द्विजपीडाकरः पापी हिरण्यकशिपुर्मुने ||
text_mt: He caused the destruction of gods and sages, eradicated all righteousness, / and tormented the twice-born—that sinful Hiraṇyakaśipu, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
prahlādena svaputreṇa haribhaktena daityarāṭ |
yadā vidveṣamakaroddharirvairī viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
प्रह्लादेन स्वपुत्रेण हरिभक्तेन दैत्यराट् |
यदा विद्वेषमकरोद्धरिर्वैरी विशेषतः ||
text_mt: When the king of the Daityas showed malice toward his own son Prahlāda, / who was devoted to Hari, Hari became especially his enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
sabhāstambhāttadā viṣṇurabhūdāvirdrutaṃ mane |
sandhyāyāṃ krodhamāpanno nṛsiṃhavapuṣā tataḥ ||
meaning:
सभास्तम्भात्तदा विष्णुरभूदाविर्द्रुतं मने |
सन्ध्यायां क्रोधमापन्नो नृसिंहवपुषा ततः ||
text_mt: Then from a pillar of the assembly hall, Viṣṇu quickly manifested, O sage, / at twilight, filled with rage, in the form of the Man-Lion.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvathā muniśārdūla karālaṃ nṛharervapuḥ |
prajajvālātibhayadaṃ trāsayandaityasattamān ||
meaning:
सर्वथा मुनिशार्दूल करालं नृहरेर्वपुः |
प्रजज्वालातिभयदं त्रासयन्दैत्यसत्तमान् ||
text_mt: In every way, O tiger among sages, the dreadful form of Nṛhari / blazed forth, terrifying in the extreme, striking fear into the foremost Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhena tadā daityā nihatāścaiva tatkṣaṇam |
hiraṇyakaśipuścātha yuddhaṃ cakre sudāruṇam ||
meaning:
नृसिंहेन तदा दैत्या निहताश्चैव तत्क्षणम् |
हिरण्यकशिपुश्चाथ युद्धं चक्रे सुदारुणम् ||
text_mt: The Daityas were then slain at that very instant by Nṛsiṃha; / and then Hiraṇyakaśipu fought a most terrible battle.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāyuddhaṃ tayorāsīnmuhūrttaṃ munisattamāḥ |
vikarālaṃ ca bhayadaṃ sarveṣāṃ romaharṣaṇam ||
meaning:
महायुद्धं तयोरासीन्मुहूर्त्तं मुनिसत्तमाः |
विकरालं च भयदं सर्वेषां रोमहर्षणम् ||
text_mt: A great battle took place between the two for a muhūrta, O foremost of sages, / frightful, terrifying, and causing the hair of all to stand on end.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyaṃ cakarṣa deveśo dehalyāṃ daityapuṅgavam |
vyomni deveṣu paśyatsu nṛsiṃhaśca rameśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
सायं चकर्ष देवेशो देहल्यां दैत्यपुङ्गवम् |
व्योम्नि देवेषु पश्यत्सु नृसिंहश्च रमेश्वरः ||
text_mt: At dusk, the lord of the gods, Nṛsiṃha, the lord of Ramā, dragged the foremost Daitya / onto the threshold while the gods looked on in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
athotsaṅge ca taṃ kṛtvā nakhaistadudaraṃ drutam |
vidārya mārayāmāsa paśyatāṃ tridivaukasām ||
meaning:
अथोत्सङ्गे च तं कृत्वा नखैस्तदुदरं द्रुतम् |
विदार्य मारयामास पश्यतां त्रिदिवौकसाम् ||
text_mt: Then, placing him upon his lap and swiftly tearing open his belly / with his claws, he killed him while the denizens of heaven watched.

sanskrit_iast:
hate hiraṇyakaśipau nṛsiṃhenaiva viṣṇunā |
jagatsvāsthyaṃ tadā lebhe na vai devā viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
हते हिरण्यकशिपौ नृसिंहेनैव विष्णुना |
जगत्स्वास्थ्यं तदा लेभे न वै देवा विशेषतः ||
text_mt: When Hiraṇyakaśipu was slain by Nṛsiṃha, who was Viṣṇu himself, / the world then found peace, but the gods especially did not.

sanskrit_iast:
devadundubhayo neduḥ prahlādo vismayaṃ gataḥ |
lakṣmīśca vismayaṃ prāptā rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā'dbhutaṃ hareḥ ||
meaning:
देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः प्रह्लादो विस्मयं गतः |
लक्ष्मीश्च विस्मयं प्राप्ता रूपं दृष्ट्वाऽद्भुतं हरेः ||
text_mt: The celestial drums sounded; Prahlāda was filled with wonder, / and Lakṣmī too was amazed upon seeing Hari's wondrous form.

sanskrit_iast:
hato yadyapi daityendrastathāpi na paraṃ sukham |
yayurdevā nṛsiṃhasya jvālā sā na nivartitā ||
meaning:
हतो यद्यपि दैत्येन्द्रस्तथापि न परं सुखम् |
ययुर्देवा नृसिंहस्य ज्वाला सा न निवर्तिता ||
text_mt: Even though the lord of the Daityas was slain, still the gods / did not attain supreme comfort: that blazing fire of Nṛsiṃha did not abate.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā ca vyākulaṃ jātaṃ sarvaṃ caiva jagatpunaḥ |
devāśca duḥkhamāpannāḥ kiṃ bhaviṣyati vā punaḥ ||
meaning:
तया च व्याकुलं जातं सर्वं चैव जगत्पुनः |
देवाश्च दुःखमापन्नाः किं भविष्यति वा पुनः ||
text_mt: And by it the entire world once again became distressed, / and the gods fell into grief, thinking, “What will happen now?”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ ca vadantaste bhayādū dūramupasthitāḥ |
nṛsiṃhakrodhajajvālāvyākulāḥ padmabhūmukhāḥ ||
meaning:
इत्येवं च वदन्तस्ते भयादू दूरमुपस्थिताः |
नृसिंहक्रोधजज्वालाव्याकुलाः पद्मभूमुखाः ||
text_mt: Saying thus, distressed by the flame born of Nṛsiṃha's wrath, / they, with the Lotus-born [Brahmā] at their head, stood far away out of fear.

sanskrit_iast:
prahrādaṃ preṣayāmāsustacchāntyai nikaṭaṃ hareḥ |
sarvānmilitvā prahlādaḥ prārthito gatavāṃstadā ||
meaning:
प्रह्रादं प्रेषयामासुस्तच्छान्त्यै निकटं हरेः |
सर्वान्मिलित्वा प्रह्लादः प्रार्थितो गतवांस्तदा ||
text_mt: To appease him, they sent Prahlāda near Hari; / having gathered together, all entreated Prahlāda, and he then went.

sanskrit_iast:
urasā''liṅgayāmāsa taṃ nṛsiṃhaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ |
hṛdayaṃ śītalaṃ jātaṃ ruḍjvālā na nivarttitā ||
meaning:
उरसा'ऽलिङ्गयामास तं नृसिंहः कृपानिधिः |
हृदयं शीतलं जातं रुड्ज्वाला न निवर्त्तिता ||
text_mt: Nṛsiṃha, that ocean of mercy, embraced him against his chest; / his heart became cooled, but the flame of his anger did not cease.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi na nivṛtā ruḍjvālā narahareryadā |
duḥkhaṃ prāptāstato devāḥ śaṅkara śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||
meaning:
तथापि न निवृता रुड्ज्वाला नरहरेर्यदा |
दुःखं प्राप्तास्ततो देवाः शङ्कर शरणं ययुः ||
text_mt: When the flame of Narahari's anger still did not cease, / the gods then, filled with distress, sought refuge in Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā surāḥ sarve brahmādyā munayastathā |
śaṅkaraṃ stavayāmāsurlokānāṃ sukhahetave ||
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा सुराः सर्वे ब्रह्माद्या मुनयस्तथा |
शङ्करं स्तवयामासुर्लोकानां सुखहेतवे ||
text_mt: Having gone there, all the gods, Brahmā and the others, as well as the sages, / praised Śaṅkara for the sake of the happiness of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ |
devadeva mahādeva śaraṇāgatavatsala |
pāhi naḥ śaraṇāpannānsarvāndevāñjaganti ca ||
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः |
देवदेव महादेव शरणागतवत्सल |
पाहि नः शरणापन्नान्सर्वान्देवाञ्जगन्ति च ||
text_mt: The gods said: / O God of gods, O Mahādeva, affectionate toward those who seek refuge, / protect us, all the gods and the worlds who have sought refuge [in you]!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste'stu namaste'stu namaste'stu sadāśiva |
pūrvaṃ duḥkhaṃ yadā jātaṃ tadā te rakṣitā vayam ||
meaning:
नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्तेऽस्तु सदाशिव |
पूर्वं दुःखं यदा जातं तदा ते रक्षिता वयम् ||
text_mt: Salutations to you! Salutations to you! Salutations to you, O Sadāśiva! / When distress arose in the past, we were protected by you.

sanskrit_iast:
samudro mathitaścaiva ratnānāṃ ca vibhāgaśaḥ |
kṛte devaistadā śambho gṛhītaṃ garalaṃ tvayā ||
meaning:
समुद्रो मथितश्चैव रत्नानां च विभागशः |
कृते देवैस्तदा शम्भो गृहीतं गरलं त्वया ||
text_mt: The ocean was churned, and when the division of jewels / was made by the gods, then, O Śambhu, poison was taken by you.

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣitāḥ sma tadā nātha nīlakaṇṭha iti śrutaḥ |
viṣaṃ pāsyasi no cettvaṃ bhasmībhūtāstadākhilāḥ ||
meaning:
रक्षिताः स्म तदा नाथ नीलकण्ठ इति श्रुतः |
विषं पास्यसि नो चेत्त्वं भस्मीभूतास्तदाखिलाः ||
text_mt: We were protected then, O Lord renowned as Nīlakaṇṭha; / if you had not drunk the poison, all would then have been reduced to ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
prasiddhaṃ ca yadā yasya duḥkhaṃ ca jāyate prabho |
tadā tvannāmamātreṇa sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ vilīyate ||
meaning:
प्रसिद्धं च यदा यस्य दुःखं च जायते प्रभो |
तदा त्वन्नाममात्रेण सर्वं दुःखं विलीयते ||
text_mt: And it is well known, O Lord, that whenever anyone experiences distress, / then by your name alone all distress melts away.

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ nṛharijvālāpīḍitānnaḥ sadāśiva |
tāṃ tvaṃ śamayituṃ deva śakto'sīti suniścitam ||
meaning:
इदानीं नृहरिज्वालापीडितान्नः सदाशिव |
तां त्वं शमयितुं देव शक्तोऽसीति सुनिश्चितम् ||
text_mt: Now, afflicted by the blazing fire of Nṛhari, O Sadāśiva, / you are indeed able to appease it, O God; this is certain.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti stutastadā devaiḥ śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ |
pratyuvāca prasannātmā'bhayaṃ dattvā paraṃ prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति स्तुतस्तदा देवैः शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः |
प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्माऽभयं दत्त्वा परं प्रभुः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Praised thus by the gods, the lord Śaṅkara, affectionate toward devotees, / his mind pleased, replied after granting supreme safety.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca |
svasthānaṃ gacchata surāḥ sarve brahmādayo'bhayāḥ |
śamayiṣyāmi yadduḥkhaṃ sarvathā hi vrataṃ mama ||
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच |
स्वस्थानं गच्छत सुराः सर्वे ब्रह्मादयोऽभयाः |
शमयिष्यामि यद्दुःखं सर्वथा हि व्रतं मम ||
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Go to your own abode without fear, all you gods headed by Brahmā; / I will appease that distress, for this is indeed my vow in every way.

sanskrit_iast:
gato maccharaṇaṃ yastu tasya duḥkhaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam |
matpriyaḥ śaraṇāpannaḥ prāṇebhyo'pi na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
गतो मच्छरणं यस्तु तस्य दुःखं क्षयं गतम् |
मत्प्रियः शरणापन्नः प्राणेभ्योऽपि न संशयः ||
text_mt: He who has gone to my refuge has his distress destroyed; / one who has sought refuge is dearer to me than my own life, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti śrutvā tadā devā hyānandamparamaṃ gatāḥ |
yathāgataṃ tathā jagmuḥ smarantaḥ śaṅkaraṃ mudā ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति श्रुत्वा तदा देवा ह्यानन्दम्परमं गताः |
यथागतं तथा जग्मुः स्मरन्तः शङ्करं मुदा ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said: / Having heard this, the gods then attained supreme joy; / they departed as they had come, remembering Śaṅkara with delight.

Thus ends the tenth chapter, titled “The Description of Nṛsiṃha’s Deeds in the Tiger Incarnation,” in the third Śatarudrasaṃhitā of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
evamabhyarthito devairmatiṃ cakre kṛpālayaḥ |
mahātejo nṛsiṃhākhyaṃ saṃharttuṃ parameśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
एवमभ्यर्थितो देवैर्मतिं चक्रे कृपालयः |
महातेजो नृसिंहाख्यं संहर्त्तुं परमेश्वरः ||
title: ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śarabhāvatāravarṇanam 1
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Entreated thus by the gods, Parameśvara, the abode of mercy, / resolved to destroy that great splendor named Nṛsiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
tadūrdhvaṃ smṛtavān rudro vīrabhadraṃ mahābalam |
ātmano bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ prāha pralayakārakam ||
meaning:
तदूर्ध्वं स्मृतवान् रुद्रो वीरभद्रं महाबलम् |
आत्मनो भैरवं रूपं प्राह प्रलयकारकम् ||
text_mt: Thereupon Rudra remembered Vīrabhadra of great might; / he addressed his own Bhairava form, the maker of dissolution:

sanskrit_iast:
ājagāma tataḥ sadyo gaṇānāmagraṇīrhasan |
sāṭṭahāsairgaṇavarairutpatadbhiritastataḥ ||
meaning:
आजगाम ततः सद्यो गणानामग्रणीर्हसन् |
साट्टहासैर्गणवरैरुत्पतद्भिरितस्ततः ||
text_mt: Then instantly the leader of the attendants arrived laughing, / accompanied by the foremost attendants leaping about here and there with loud bursts of laughter,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃharūpairatyugraiḥ koṭibhiḥ parivāritaḥ |
mādyadbhirabhito vīrairnṛtyadbhiśca mudānvitaiḥ ||
meaning:
नृसिंहरूपैरत्युग्रैः कोटिभिः परिवारितः |
माद्यद्भिरभितो वीरैर्नृत्यद्भिश्च मुदान्वितैः ||
text_mt: surrounded by crores of exceedingly fierce forms resembling Nṛsiṃha, / by heroes intoxicated on every side and dancing with joy,

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍadbhiśca mahāvīrairbrahmādyaiḥ kandukairiva |
adṛṣṭapūrvairanyaiśca veṣṭito vīravanditaḥ ||
meaning:
क्रीडद्भिश्च महावीरैर्ब्रह्माद्यैः कन्दुकैरिव |
अदृष्टपूर्वैरन्यैश्च वेष्टितो वीरवन्दितः ||
text_mt: and by great heroes playing with [the worlds of] Brahmā and the others like balls; / surrounded by others never seen before, praised by heroes,

sanskrit_iast:
kalpāntajvalanajvālo vilasallocanatrayaḥ |
aśastro hi jaṭājūṭī jvalad bālendumaṇḍitaḥ ||
meaning:
कल्पान्तज्वलनज्वालो विलसल्लोचनत्रयः |
अशस्त्रो हि जटाजूटी ज्वलद् बालेन्दुमण्डितः ||
text_mt: blazing like the fire of the end of the aeon, his three eyes shining, / weaponless, wearing a mass of matted hair, adorned with the glowing crescent moon,

sanskrit_iast:
bālenduvalayākāratīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāṅkuradvayaḥ |
ākhaṇḍaladhanuḥkhaṇḍasannibhabhrūlatānvitaḥ ||
meaning:
बालेन्दुवलयाकारतीक्ष्णदंष्ट्राङ्कुरद्वयः |
आखण्डलधनुःखण्डसन्निभभ्रूलतान्वितः ||
text_mt: with a pair of sharp sprout-like fangs shaped like the crescent moon, / endowed with brow-creepers resembling the fragmented bow of Indra,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpracaṇḍahuṅkārabadhirīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥ |
nīlameghāñjanaśyāmo bhīṣaṇaḥ śmaśrulo'dbhutaḥ ||
meaning:
महाप्रचण्डहुङ्कारबधिरीकृतदिङ्मुखः |
नीलमेघाञ्जनश्यामो भीषणः श्मश्रुलोऽद्भुतः ||
text_mt: deafening the quarters of the sky with a mighty, fierce roar, / dark as a blue cloud and collyrium, terrifying, bearded, wondrous,

sanskrit_iast:
vādyakhaṇḍamakhaṇḍābhyāṃ bhrāmayaṃstriśikhaṃ muhuḥ |
vīrabhadro'pi bhagavānvīraśaktivijṛmbhitaḥ ||
meaning:
वाद्यखण्डमखण्डाभ्यां भ्रामयंस्त्रिशिखं मुहुः |
वीरभद्रोऽपि भगवान्वीरशक्तिविजृम्भितः ||
text_mt: brandishing repeatedly with unbroken arms a musical piece and a trident, / the lord Vīrabhadra, fully displaying his heroic power,

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ vijñāpayāmāsa kimatra smṛtikāraṇam |
ājñāpaya jagatsvāmin prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi ||
meaning:
स्वयं विज्ञापयामास किमत्र स्मृतिकारणम् |
आज्ञापय जगत्स्वामिन् प्रसादः क्रियतां मयि ||
text_mt: humbly asked of his own accord: “What is the reason for remembering me here? / Command, O Master of the universe! Let favor be shown to me.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityākarṇya maheśāno vīrabhadroktamādarāt |
vilokya vacanaṃ prītyā provāca khaladaṇḍadhṛk ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य महेशानो वीरभद्रोक्तमादरात् |
विलोक्य वचनं प्रीत्या प्रोवाच खलदण्डधृक् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing this spoken with respect by Vīrabhadra and looking upon him / with love, the Great Lord, who wields the staff to punish the wicked, spoke words:

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca |
akāle bhayamutpannaṃ devānāmapi bhairavam |
jvalitaḥ sa nṛsiṃhāgniḥ śamayainaṃ durāsadam ||
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच |
अकाले भयमुत्पन्नं देवानामपि भैरवम् |
ज्वलितः स नृसिंहाग्निः शमयैनं दुरासदम् ||
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / An untimely, terrible fear has arisen even for the gods; / that fire of Nṛsiṃha has blazed up; subdue this unassailable one.

sanskrit_iast:
sāntvayan bodhayādau taṃ tena kinnopaśāmyati |
tato matparamaṃ bhāvaṃ bhairavaṃ sampradarśaya ||
meaning:
सान्त्वयन् बोधयादौ तं तेन किन्नोपशाम्यति |
ततो मत्परमं भावं भैरवं सम्प्रदर्शय ||
text_mt: Confer with him first and instruct him gently; why should he not be appeased by that? / If not, show forth my supreme Bhairava nature.

sanskrit_iast:
sūkṣmaṃ saṃhṛtya sūkṣmeṇa sthūlaṃ sthūlena tejasā |
vaśamānaya vanhiṃ tvaṃ vīrabhadra mamājñayā ||
meaning:
सूक्ष्मं संहृत्य सूक्ष्मेण स्थूलं स्थूलेन तेजसा |
वशमानय वन्हिं त्वं वीरभद्र ममाज्ञया ||
text_mt: Subduing the subtle with the subtle, and the gross with gross splendor, / bring that fire under control, O Vīrabhadra, by my command.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityādiṣṭo gaṇādhyakṣo praśāntaṃ vapurāsthitaḥ |
jagāma raṃhasā tatra yatrāste narakesarī ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्यादिष्टो गणाध्यक्षो प्रशान्तं वपुरास्थितः |
जगाम रंहसा तत्र यत्रास्ते नरकेसरी ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Instructed thus, the commander of the attendants, assuming a tranquil form, / went with speed to where the man-lion resided.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sambodhayāmāsa vīrabhadro haro harim |
uvāca vākyamīśānaḥ pitāputramivaurasam ||
meaning:
ततः सम्बोधयामास वीरभद्रो हरो हरिम् |
उवाच वाक्यमीशानः पितापुत्रमिवौरसम् ||
text_mt: Then Vīrabhadra, who was Hara himself, addressed Hari; / the lord spoke words as a father to his own biological son:

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhadra uvāca |
jagatsukhāya bhagavannavatīrṇo'si mādhava |
sthityarthaṃ tvaṃ prayukto'si pareśaḥ parameṣṭhinā ||
meaning:
वीरभद्र उवाच |
जगत्सुखाय भगवन्नवतीर्णोऽसि माधव |
स्थित्यर्थं त्वं प्रयुक्तोऽसि परेशः परमेष्ठिना ||
text_mt: Vīrabhadra said: / O Lord, you have descended for the welfare of the world, O Mādhava; / you, the supreme lord, were employed by Parameṣṭhin for maintenance.

sanskrit_iast:
jantucakraṃ bhagavatā pracchannaṃ matsyarūpiṇā |
pucchenaiva samābadhya bhramannekārṇave purā ||
meaning:
जन्तुचक्रं भगवता प्रच्छन्नं मत्स्यरूपिणा |
पुच्छेनैव समाबध्य भ्रमन्नेकार्णवे पुरा ||
text_mt: Formerly, wandering in the single ocean, the host of living beings was protected / by the Lord who, disguised in the form of a fish, bound it with his very tail.

sanskrit_iast:
bibharṣi kūrmarūpeṇa vārāheṇoddhṛtā mahī |
anena harirūpeṇa hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ ||
meaning:
बिभर्षि कूर्मरूपेण वाराहेणोद्धृता मही |
अनेन हरिरूपेण हिरण्यकशिपुर्हतः ||
text_mt: In the form of a tortoise you support [the earth]; in that of a boar, the earth was raised up; / and by this form of Hari, Hiraṇyakaśipu was slain.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmanena balirbaddhastvayā vikramatā punaḥ |
tvameva sarvabhūtānāṃ prabhavaḥ prabhuravyayaḥ ||
meaning:
वामनेन बलिर्बद्धस्त्वया विक्रमता पुनः |
त्वमेव सर्वभूतानां प्रभवः प्रभुरव्ययः ||
text_mt: As Vāmana striding forth, Bali was bound by you once again; / you alone are the origin and the imperishable master of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā yadā hi lokasya duḥkhaṃ kiñcitprajāyate |
tadā tadāvatīrṇastvaṃ kariṣyasi nirāmayam ||
meaning:
यदा यदा हि लोकस्य दुःखं किञ्चित्प्रजायते |
तदा तदावतीर्णस्त्वं करिष्यसि निरामयम् ||
text_mt: For whenever any sorrow arises for the world, / then, descending [as an incarnation], you shall render it free from affliction.

sanskrit_iast:
nādhikastvatsamo'pyasti hare śivaparāyaṇaḥ |
tvayā vedāśca dharmāśca śubhamārge pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
meaning:
नाधिकस्त्वत्समोऽप्यस्ति हरे शिवपरायणः |
त्वया वेदाश्च धर्माश्च शुभमार्गे प्रतिष्ठिताः ||
text_mt: There is no one superior to you, nor even equal to you, O Hari, devoted to Śiva; / by you the Vedas and the laws are established on the auspicious path.

sanskrit_iast:
yadarthamavatāro'yaṃ nihataḥ sa hi dānavaḥ |
hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva prahlādo'pi surakṣitaḥ ||
meaning:
यदर्थमवतारोऽयं निहतः स हि दानवः |
हिरण्यकशिपुश्चैव प्रह्लादोऽपि सुरक्षितः ||
text_mt: That Dānava, for whose sake this incarnation took place, has indeed been slain, / Hiraṇyakaśipu himself; and Prahlāda has also been well protected.

sanskrit_iast:
atīva ghoraṃ bhagavannarasiṃhavapustava |
upasaṃhara viśvātmaṃstvameva mama sannidhau ||
meaning:
अतीव घोरं भगवन्नरसिंहवपुस्तव |
उपसंहर विश्वात्मंस्त्वमेव मम सन्निधौ ||
text_mt: Exceedingly terrible is this man-lion form of yours, O Lord; / withdraw it right before me, O soul of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityukto vīrabhadreṇa nṛsiṃhaḥ śāntayā girā |
tato'dhikaṃ mahāghoraṃ kopaṃ cakre mahāmadaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्तो वीरभद्रेण नृसिंहः शान्तया गिरा |
ततोऽधिकं महाघोरं कोपं चक्रे महामदः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Thus addressed in peaceful words by Vīrabhadra, / Nṛsiṃha, intensely arrogant, became even more terribly enraged.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca ca mahāghoraṃ kaṭhinaṃ vacanaṃ tadā |
vīrabhadraṃ mahāvīraṃ daṃṣṭrābhirbhīṣayanmune ||
meaning:
उवाच च महाघोरं कठिनं वचनं तदा |
वीरभद्रं महावीरं दंष्ट्राभिर्भीषयन्मुने ||
text_mt: And he then spoke harsh and exceedingly terrible words, / terrifying the great hero Vīrabhadra with his fangs, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃha uvāca |
āgato'si yatastatra gaccha tvaṃ mā hitaṃ vada |
idānīṃ saṃhariṣyāmi jagadetaccarācaram ||
meaning:
नृसिंह उवाच |
आगतोऽसि यतस्तत्र गच्छ त्वं मा हितं वद |
इदानीं संहरिष्यामि जगदेतच्चराचरम् ||
text_mt: Nṛsiṃha said: / Return to whence you have come! Speak no counsel to me! / Right now I shall destroy this world, both moving and unmoving!

sanskrit_iast:
saṃharturna hi saṃhāraḥ svato vā parato'pi vā |
śāsinaṃ mama sarvatra śāstā ko'pi na vidyate ||
meaning:
संहर्तुर्न हि संहारः स्वतो वा परतोऽपि वा |
शासिनं मम सर्वत्र शास्ता कोऽपि न विद्यते ||
text_mt: The destroyer cannot be destroyed, either by himself or by another. / There is no ruler anywhere over me who rules all.

sanskrit_iast:
matprasādena sakalamabhayaṃ hi pravartate |
ahaṃ hi sarvaśaktīnāṃ pravartakanivartakaḥ ||
meaning:
मत्प्रसादेन सकलमभयं हि प्रवर्तते |
अहं हि सर्वशक्तीनां प्रवर्तकनिवर्तकः ||
text_mt: Indeed, by my grace all freedom from fear proceeds; / for I am the promoter and the withdrawer of all powers.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā |
tattadviddhi gaṇādhyakṣa mama tejovijṛmbhitam ||
meaning:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा |
तत्तद्विद्धि गणाध्यक्ष मम तेजोविजृम्भितम् ||
text_mt: Whatever being possesses majesty, glory, or might, / know that, O leader of the attendants, to be a manifestation of my fiery energy.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāḥ paramārthajñaṃ māmeva paramaṃ viduḥ |
madaṃśāḥ śaktisampannā brahmaśakrādayaḥ surāḥ ||
meaning:
देवताः परमार्थज्ञं मामेव परमं विदुः |
मदंशाः शक्तिसम्पन्ना ब्रह्मशक्रादयः सुराः ||
text_mt: The gods know me alone, the knower of ultimate reality, as the Supreme; / the gods, beginning with Brahmā and Śakra, endowed with power, are my portions.

sanskrit_iast:
mannābhikamalājjātaḥ purā brahmā jagatkaraḥ |
sarvādhikaḥ svatantraśca kartā hartākhileśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
मन्नाभिकमलाज्जातः पुरा ब्रह्मा जगत्करः |
सर्वाधिकः स्वतन्त्रश्च कर्ता हर्ताखिलेश्वरः ||
text_mt: Formerly, Brahmā, the creator of the world, was born from my lotus navel; / he is supreme over all, independent, the agent, the destroyer, and the lord of all.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ tu matparaṃ tejaḥ kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi |
ato māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpya gaccha tvaṃ vigatajvaraḥ ||
meaning:
इदं तु मत्परं तेजः किं पुनः श्रोतुमिच्छसि |
अतो मां शरणं प्राप्य गच्छ त्वं विगतज्वरः ||
text_mt: This is my supreme fiery energy; what more do you wish to hear? / Therefore, taking refuge in me, go your way, free from distress.

sanskrit_iast:
avehi paramaṃ bhāvamidambhūtaṃ gaṇeśvara |
māmakaṃ sakalaṃ viśvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam ||
meaning:
अवेहि परमं भावमिदम्भूतं गणेश्वर |
मामकं सकलं विश्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् ||
text_mt: Understand this supreme nature to be such, O lord of the attendants: / the entire universe, with its gods, asuras, and mortals, is mine.

sanskrit_iast:
kālo'smyahaṃ lokavināśahetu-rlokānsamāhartumahaṃ pravṛttaḥ |
mṛtyormṛtyuṃ viddhi māṃ vīrabhadra jīvantyete matprasādena devāḥ ||
meaning:
कालोऽस्म्यहं लोकविनाशहेतु-र्लोकान्समाहर्तुमहं प्रवृत्तः |
मृत्योर्मृत्युं विद्धि मां वीरभद्र जीवन्त्येते मत्प्रसादेन देवाः ||
text_mt: I am Time, the cause of the world's destruction; I have set about to destroy the worlds. / Know me as the death of Death, O Vīrabhadra; these gods live by my grace.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
sāhaṅkāraṃ vacaḥ śrutvā hareramitavikramaḥ |
vihasyovāca sāvajñaṃ tato visphuritādharaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
साहङ्कारं वचः श्रुत्वा हरेरमितविक्रमः |
विहस्योवाच सावज्ञं ततो विस्फुरिताधरः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing Hari's boastful words, [Vīrabhadra] of unmeasured prowess / laughed disdainfully and then, his lower lip quivering, said:

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhadra uvāca |
kinna jānāsi viśveśaṃ saṃhartāraṃ pinākinam |
asadvādo vivādaśca vināśastvayi kevalaḥ ||
meaning:
वीरभद्र उवाच |
किन्न जानासि विश्वेशं संहर्तारं पिनाकिनम् |
असद्वादो विवादश्च विनाशस्त्वयि केवलः ||
text_mt: Vīrabhadra said: / Do you not know the lord of the universe, the destroyer who bears the Pināka? / In you there is only false assertion, dispute, and destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
tavānyonyāvatārāṇi kāni śeṣāṇi sāmpratam |
kṛtāni yena kenaiva kathāśeṣo bhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
तवान्योन्यावताराणि कानि शेषाणि साम्प्रतम् |
कृतानि येन केनैव कथाशेषो भविष्यति ||
text_mt: What other incarnations of yours remain now? / Whatever has been done will end only in mere talk.

sanskrit_iast:
doṣaṃ taṃ vada yena tvamavasthāmīdṛśīṃ gataḥ |
tena saṃhāradakṣeṇa dakṣiṇāśeṣameṣyasi ||
meaning:
दोषं तं वद येन त्वमवस्थामीदृशीं गतः |
तेन संहारदक्षेण दक्षिणाशेषमेष्यसि ||
text_mt: Speak of the fault by which you have come to such a state; / by that very [fault], through him who is skilled in destruction, you will be reduced to nothing in the south.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtistvaṃ pumānrudrastvayi vīryaṃ samāhitam |
tvannābhipaṅkajājjātaḥ pañcavaktraḥ pitāmahaḥ ||
meaning:
प्रकृतिस्त्वं पुमान्रुद्रस्त्वयि वीर्यं समाहितम् |
त्वन्नाभिपङ्कजाज्जातः पञ्चवक्त्रः पितामहः ||
text_mt: You are Prakṛti, and Rudra is the Puruṣa; the seed has been deposited in you. / From the lotus of your navel the five-faced Grandfather was born.

sanskrit_iast:
jagattrayīsarjanārthaṃ śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam |
lalāṭe'cintayatso'yaṃ tapasyugre ca saṃsthitaḥ ||
meaning:
जगत्त्रयीसर्जनार्थं शङ्करं नीललोहितम् |
ललाटेऽचिन्तयत्सोऽयं तपस्युग्रे च संस्थितः ||
text_mt: In order to create the triad of worlds, that [Grandfather], established in fierce austerity, / meditated in his forehead on Śaṅkara, the blue-and-red.

sanskrit_iast:
tallalāṭādabhūcchambhuḥ sṛṣṭyarthe tena bhūṣaṇam |
ato'haṃ devadevasya tasya bhairavarūpiṇaḥ ||
meaning:
तल्ललाटादभूच्छम्भुः सृष्ट्यर्थे तेन भूषणम् |
अतोऽहं देवदेवस्य तस्य भैरवरूपिणः ||
text_mt: From his forehead Śambhu arose for the sake of creation, as an ornament for him; / therefore, by that god of gods, who bears the form of Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
tvatsaṃhāre niyukto'smi vinayena balena ca |
devadevena rudreṇa sakalaprabhuṇā hare ||
meaning:
त्वत्संहारे नियुक्तोऽस्मि विनयेन बलेन च |
देवदेवेन रुद्रेण सकलप्रभुणा हरे ||
text_mt: by the god of gods, Rudra, the lord of all, / I have been appointed, O Hari, to destroy you with humility and with might.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ rakṣo vidāryaiva tacchaktikalayā yutaḥ |
ahaṅkārāvalepena garjasi tvamatandritaḥ ||
meaning:
एकं रक्षो विदार्यैव तच्छक्तिकलया युतः |
अहङ्कारावलेपेन गर्जसि त्वमतन्द्रितः ||
text_mt: Merely tearing open a single demon, possessed of a fraction of his power, / you roar relentlessly, smeared with pride!

sanskrit_iast:
upakāro hi sādhūnāṃ sukhāya kila sammataḥ |
upakāro hyasādhūnāmapakārāya kevalam ||
meaning:
उपकारो हि साधूनां सुखाय किल सम्मतः |
उपकारो ह्यसाधूनामपकाराय केवलम् ||
text_mt: Assistance rendered to the virtuous is indeed acknowledged to be for happiness; / but assistance rendered to the unrighteous leads only to harm.

sanskrit_iast:
yannṛsiṃha maheśānaṃ punarbhūtaṃ tu manyase |
tarhyajñānī mahāgarvī vikārī sarvathā bhavān ||
meaning:
यन्नृसिंह महेशानं पुनर्भूतं तु मन्यसे |
तर्ह्यज्ञानी महागर्वी विकारी सर्वथा भवान् ||
text_mt: Since you, O Nṛsiṃha, consider Maheśāna to be born again, / you are utterly ignorant, highly arrogant, and subject to change.

sanskrit_iast:
na tvaṃ sraṣṭā na saṃhartā bhartāpi na nṛsiṃhaka |
paratantro vimūḍhātmā na svatantro hi kutracit ||
meaning:
न त्वं स्रष्टा न संहर्ता भर्तापि न नृसिंहक |
परतन्त्रो विमूढात्मा न स्वतन्त्रो हि कुत्रचित् ||
text_mt: You are neither creator, nor destroyer, nor sustainer, O little man-lion; / you are dependent, deluded at heart, and never independent anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
kulālacakravacchaktyā prerito'si pinākinā |
nānāvatārakartā tvaṃ tadadhīnaḥ sadā hare ||
meaning:
कुलालचक्रवच्छक्त्या प्रेरितोऽसि पिनाकिना |
नानावतारकर्ता त्वं तदधीनः सदा हरे ||
text_mt: Like a potter's wheel, you are set in motion by the power of the wielder of the Pināka; / you are the maker of diverse incarnations, always subject to him, O Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
adyāpi tava nikṣiptaṃ kapālaṃ kūrmarūpiṇaḥ |
harahāralatāmadhye dagdhaṃ kaścinna badhyate ||
meaning:
अद्यापि तव निक्षिप्तं कपालं कूर्मरूपिणः |
हरहारलतामध्ये दग्धं कश्चिन्न बध्यते ||
text_mt: Even today your skull in the form of the Tortoise is deposited / in the midst of the creeper-like garland of Hara; once burnt, no one is bound.

sanskrit_iast:
vismṛtiḥ kiṃ tadaṃśena daṃṣṭrotpātanapīḍitam |
vārāhavighnahaste'dya yākrośantārakāriṇā ||
meaning:
विस्मृतिः किं तदंशेन दंष्ट्रोत्पातनपीडितम् |
वाराहविघ्नहस्तेऽद्य याक्रोशन्तारकारिणा ||
text_mt: Is there forgetfulness of that portion, tormented by the extraction of the tusk, / which today, in the obstacle-hand of the Boar, is shouted down by the enemy of Tāraka?

sanskrit_iast:
dagdho'si paśya śūlāgnerviṣvaksenacchalādbhavān |
dakṣayajñe śiraśchinnaṃ mayā tejaḥsvarūpiṇā ||
meaning:
दग्धोऽसि पश्य शूलाग्नेर्विष्वक्सेनच्छलाद्भवान् |
दक्षयज्ञे शिरश्छिन्नं मया तेजःस्वरूपिणा ||
text_mt: Look, you were burnt by the fire of the trident under the pretext of Viṣvaksena; / at the sacrifice of Dakṣa your head was severed by me, who am of the nature of fiery energy.

sanskrit_iast:
adyāpi tava putrasya brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ |
chinnaṃ na sajjitaṃ bhūyo hare tadvismṛtaṃ tvayā ||
meaning:
अद्यापि तव पुत्रस्य ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः |
छिन्नं न सज्जितं भूयो हरे तद्विस्मृतं त्वया ||
text_mt: Even today the severed fifth head of your son, Brahmā, / has not been restored; have you forgotten that, O Hari?

sanskrit_iast:
nirjitastvaṃ dadhīcena saṅgrāme samarudgaṇaḥ |
kaṇḍūyamāne śirasi kathaṃ tadvismṛtaṃ tvayā ||
meaning:
निर्जितस्त्वं दधीचेन सङ्ग्रामे समरुद्गणः |
कण्डूयमाने शिरसि कथं तद्विस्मृतं त्वया ||
text_mt: You were defeated by Dadhīca in battle along with the host of Maruts / while his head was being scratched; how have you forgotten that?

sanskrit_iast:
cakraṃ vikramato yasya cakrapāṇe tava priyam |
kutaḥ prāptaṃ kṛtaṃ kena tvayā tadapi vismṛtam ||
meaning:
चक्रं विक्रमतो यस्य चक्रपाणे तव प्रियम् |
कुतः प्राप्तं कृतं केन त्वया तदपि विस्मृतम् ||
text_mt: That discus, beloved of you who stride forth, O discus-bearer— / whence was it obtained, and by whom was it made? Even that has been forgotten by you.

sanskrit_iast:
ye mayā sakalā lokā gṛhītāstvaṃ payonidhau |
nidrāparavaśaḥ śeṣe sa kathaṃ sāttviko bhavān ||
meaning:
ये मया सकला लोका गृहीतास्त्वं पयोनिधौ |
निद्रापरवशः शेषे स कथं सात्त्विको भवान् ||
text_mt: While all the worlds were taken by me, you lie in the ocean of milk / overpowered by sleep; how, then, are you virtuous?

sanskrit_iast:
tvadādistambaparyantaṃ rudraśaktivijṛmbhitam |
śaktimānabhitastvaṃ ca hyanalāttvaṃ vimohitaḥ ||
meaning:
त्वदादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं रुद्रशक्तिविजृम्भितम् |
शक्तिमानभितस्त्वं च ह्यनलात्त्वं विमोहितः ||
text_mt: Beginning with you and extending down to a blade of grass, it is the manifestation of Rudra's power; / you are surrounded by power, and you are deluded by fire.

sanskrit_iast:
tattejaso hi māhātmyaṃ pumāndraṣṭuṃ na hi kṣamaḥ |
asthūlā ye prapaśyanti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ||
meaning:
तत्तेजसो हि माहात्म्यं पुमान्द्रष्टुं न हि क्षमः |
अस्थूला ये प्रपश्यन्ति तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ||
text_mt: No mortal is able to behold the greatness of that fiery energy; / only those who are subtle behold that supreme step of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
dyāvāpṛthivyā indrāgneryamasya varuṇasya ca |
dhvāntodare śaśāṅke ca janitvā parameśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
द्यावापृथिव्या इन्द्राग्नेर्यमस्य वरुणस्य च |
ध्वान्तोदरे शशाङ्के च जनित्वा परमेश्वरः ||
text_mt: Having arisen in heaven and earth, in Indra and Agni, in Yama and Varuṇa, / within darkness, and in the moon, the Parameśvara [abides].

sanskrit_iast:
kālo'si tvaṃ mahākālaḥ kālakālo maheśvaraḥ |
atastvamugrakalayā mṛtyormṛtyurbhaviṣyasi ||
meaning:
कालोऽसि त्वं महाकालः कालकालो महेश्वरः |
अतस्त्वमुग्रकलया मृत्योर्मृत्युर्भविष्यसि ||
text_mt: You are Time, but he is Mahākāla, Maheśvara, the death of Time; / therefore, by his fierce portion, he shall become the death of your Death.

sanskrit_iast:
sthiro'dya tvakṣaro vīro vīro viśvāvakaḥ prabhuḥ |
upahantā jvaraṃ bhīmo mṛgaḥ pakṣī hiraṇmayaḥ ||
meaning:
स्थिरोऽद्य त्वक्षरो वीरो वीरो विश्वावकः प्रभुः |
उपहन्ता ज्वरं भीमो मृगः पक्षी हिरण्मयः ||
text_mt: Firm today, imperishable, a hero, a hero, the protector of the universe, the lord, / the remover of fever, fierce, a beast, a golden bird.

sanskrit_iast:
śāstā śeṣasya jagatastattvaṃ naiva caturmukhaḥ |
nānye ca kevalaṃ śambhuḥ sarvaśāstā na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
शास्ता शेषस्य जगतस्तत्त्वं नैव चतुर्मुखः |
नान्ये च केवलं शम्भुः सर्वशास्ता न संशयः ||
text_mt: You are not the ruler of the rest of the world, nor is the four-faced [Brahmā], / nor are others; Śambhu alone is the ruler of all, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ sarvaṃ samālokya saṃhārātmānamātmanā |
na vinaṣṭaṃ tvamātmānaṃ kuru he nṛhare'budha ||
meaning:
इत्थं सर्वं समालोक्य संहारात्मानमात्मना |
न विनष्टं त्वमात्मानं कुरु हे नृहरेऽबुध ||
text_mt: Seeing all this thus, restraining yourself by yourself, / do not destroy yourself, O foolish Nṛhari!

sanskrit_iast:
no cedidānīṃ krodhasya mahābhairavarūpiṇaḥ |
vajrāśaniriva sthāṇau tvayi mṛtyuḥ patiṣyati ||
meaning:
नो चेदिदानीं क्रोधस्य महाभैरवरूपिणः |
वज्राशनिरिव स्थाणौ त्वयि मृत्युः पतिष्यति ||
text_mt: Otherwise, death, resembling a thunderbolt upon a post, / will fall upon you right now from the wrath of him whose form is Mahābhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvā vīrabhadro'pi virarāmākutobhayaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā nṛsiṃhābhiprāyaṃ krodhamūrttiśśivasya saḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा वीरभद्रोऽपि विररामाकुतोभयः |
दृष्ट्वा नृसिंहाभिप्रायं क्रोधमूर्त्तिश्शिवस्य सः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, Vīrabhadra, free from all fear, ceased, / observing the intention of Nṛsiṃha, being the embodiment of the wrath of Śiva.

Thus ends the eleventh chapter, titled 'Description of the Incarnation of Śarabha', in the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, the third [book] of the auspicious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
nandīśvara mahāprājña vijñātaṃ tadanantaram |
mamopari kṛpāṃ kṛtvā prītyā tvaṃ tadvadādhunā ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
नन्दीश्वर महाप्राज्ञ विज्ञातं तदनन्तरम् |
ममोपरि कृपां कृत्वा प्रीत्या त्वं तद्वदाधुना ||
title: dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śarabhāvatāravarṇanam 2
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / O Nandīśvara, great in wisdom, I have understood what followed that. / Taking pity on me, please tell that out of affection now.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityukto vīrabhadreṇa nṛsiṃhaḥ krodhavihvalaḥ |
ninadannanuvegena taṃ grahītuṃ pracakrame ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्तो वीरभद्रेण नृसिंहः क्रोधविह्वलः |
निनदन्ननुवेगेन तं ग्रहीतुं प्रचक्रमे ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Thus addressed by Vīrabhadra, the man-lion, overwhelmed with anger, / roaring with intense speed, began to seize him.

sanskrit_iast:
atrāntare mahāghoraṃ pratyakṣabhayakāraṇam |
gaganavyāpi durdharṣaṃ śaivatejaḥ samudbhavam ||
meaning:
अत्रान्तरे महाघोरं प्रत्यक्षभयकारणम् |
गगनव्यापि दुर्धर्षं शैवतेजः समुद्भवम् ||
text_mt: In the meantime, a great and terrifying splendor of Śiva arose, / the visible cause of fear, pervading the sky and unconquerable.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhadrasya tadrūmadṛśyaṃ tu tataḥ kṣaṇāt |
tadvai hiraṇmayaṃ saumyaṃ na sauraṃ nāgnisambhavam ||
meaning:
वीरभद्रस्य तद्रूमदृश्यं तु ततः क्षणात् |
तद्वै हिरण्मयं सौम्यं न सौरं नाग्निसम्भवम् ||
text_mt: That form of Vīrabhadra became invisible in that very instant; / and that [light] was indeed golden and gentle, neither solar nor born of fire,

sanskrit_iast:
na taḍiccandrasadṛśamanaupamyaṃ maheśvaram |
tadā tejāṃsi sarvāṇi tasmiṃllīnāni śaṅkare ||
meaning:
न तडिच्चन्द्रसदृशमनौपम्यं महेश्वरम् |
तदा तेजांसि सर्वाणि तस्मिंल्लीनानि शङ्करे ||
text_mt: nor resembling lightning or the moon, incomparable, belonging to Maheśvara. / Then all splendors merged into that Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
na tadvyomaṃ mahattejo vyaktāntaścābhavattataḥ |
rudrasādhāraṇaṃ caiva cihnitaṃ vikṛtākṛti ||
meaning:
न तद्व्योमं महत्तेजो व्यक्तान्तश्चाभवत्ततः |
रुद्रसाधारणं चैव चिह्नितं विकृताकृति ||
text_mt: That great splendor was not [merely] the sky, and then its manifested form arose, / sharing the nature of Rudra, marked and monstrous in shape.

sanskrit_iast:
tatassaṃhārarūpeṇa suvyaktaṃ parameśvaraḥ |
paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ ||
meaning:
ततस्संहाररूपेण सुव्यक्तं परमेश्वरः |
पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः ||
text_mt: Then Parameśvara became clearly manifest in the form of destruction, / while all the gods looked on with auspicious shouts of victory and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrabāhurjaṭilaścandrārddhakṛtaśekharaḥ |
samṛddhograśarīreṇa pakṣābhyāṃ cañcunā dvijaḥ ||
meaning:
सहस्रबाहुर्जटिलश्चन्द्रार्द्धकृतशेखरः |
समृद्धोग्रशरीरेण पक्षाभ्यां चञ्चुना द्विजः ||
text_mt: Thousand-armed, matted-haired, with the half-moon adorning his crest, / with a swollen and fierce body, having two wings and a beak, a bird,

sanskrit_iast:
atitīkṣṇo mahādaṃṣṭro vajratulyanakhāyudhaḥ |
kaṇṭhe kālo mahābāhuścatuṣpādvahnisannibhaḥ ||
meaning:
अतितीक्ष्णो महादंष्ट्रो वज्रतुल्यनखायुधः |
कण्ठे कालो महाबाहुश्चतुष्पाद्वह्निसन्निभः ||
text_mt: exceedingly sharp, with huge fangs, his weapon-claws equal to the thunderbolt, / dark at the neck, large-armed, four-footed, resembling fire,

sanskrit_iast:
yugāntodyatajīmūtabhīmagambhīraniḥsvanaḥ |
mahākupitakṛtyāgnivyāvṛttanayanatrayaḥ ||
meaning:
युगान्तोद्यतजीमूतभीमगम्भीरनिःस्वनः |
महाकुपितकृत्याग्निव्यावृत्तनयनत्रयः ||
text_mt: with a terrible and deep roar like a cloud rising at the end of an aeon, / his three eyes rolling with the fire of a furiously enraged female fiend,

sanskrit_iast:
spaṣṭadaṃṣṭrādharoṣṭhaśca huṅkāraiḥ saṃyuto haraḥ |
īdṛgvidhasvarūpaśca hyugra āvirbabhūva ha ||
meaning:
स्पष्टदंष्ट्राधरोष्ठश्च हुङ्कारैः संयुतो हरः |
ईदृग्विधस्वरूपश्च ह्युग्र आविर्बभूव ह ||
text_mt: with distinct fangs and lower lip, accompanied by roars of 'huṃ'—Hara, / possessing such an appearance, fierce indeed, manifested himself.

sanskrit_iast:
haristaddarśanādeva vinaṣṭabalavikramaḥ |
bibhraddhāmasahasrāṃśoradhaḥ khadyotavibhramam ||
meaning:
हरिस्तद्दर्शनादेव विनष्टबलविक्रमः |
बिभ्रद्धामसहस्रांशोरधः खद्योतविभ्रमम् ||
text_mt: Just upon seeing him, Hari lost his strength and prowess, / bearing beneath the splendor of the thousand-rayed sun the semblance of a firefly.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vibhramya pakṣābhyāṃ nābhipādānvidārayan |
pādānbabandha pucchena bāhubhyāṃ bāhumaṇḍalam ||
meaning:
अथ विभ्रम्य पक्षाभ्यां नाभिपादान्विदारयन् |
पादान्बबन्ध पुच्छेन बाहुभ्यां बाहुमण्डलम् ||
text_mt: Then, wheeling around with his two wings, tearing open the navel and feet, / he bound the legs with his tail and the circle of arms with his two arms.

sanskrit_iast:
bhindannurasi bāhubhyāṃ nijagrāha haro harim |
tato jagāma gaganaṃ devaissaha maharṣibhiḥ ||
meaning:
भिन्दन्नुरसि बाहुभ्यां निजग्राह हरो हरिम् |
ततो जगाम गगनं देवैस्सह महर्षिभिः ||
text_mt: Splitting the chest with his two arms, Hara seized Hari. / Then he went into the sky along with the gods and the great seers.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasaivābhayādviṣṇuṃ sa hi śyena ivoragam |
utkṣipyotkṣipya saṅgṛhya nipātya ca nipātya ca ||
meaning:
सहसैवाभयाद्विष्णुं स हि श्येन इवोरगम् |
उत्क्षिप्योत्क्षिप्य सङ्गृह्य निपात्य च निपात्य च ||
text_mt: Suddenly taking Viṣṇu away from danger, just as a hawk [seizes] a snake, / repeatedly tossing him up, catching him, and throwing him down,

sanskrit_iast:
uḍḍīyoḍḍīya bhagavānpakṣaghātavimohitam |
harīṃ harastaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ viveśānanta īśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
उड्डीयोड्डीय भगवान्पक्षघातविमोहितम् |
हरीं हरस्तं वृषभं विवेशानन्त ईश्वरः ||
text_mt: flying up again and again, the Lord, stupefied by the beat of the wings, / Hara, the infinite Lord, entered Hari, that bull [among beings].

sanskrit_iast:
anuyāntaṃ surāḥ sarve namovākyena tuṣṭuvuḥ |
