praṇemuḥ sādaraṃ prītyā brahmādyāśca munīśvarāḥ ||
meaning:
अनुयान्तं सुराः सर्वे नमोवाक्येन तुष्टुवुः |
प्रणेमुः सादरं प्रीत्या ब्रह्माद्याश्च मुनीश्वराः ||
text_mt: All the gods, following along, praised him with words of salutation; / Brahmā and the foremost of sages bowed down with affection and respect.

sanskrit_iast:
nīyamānaḥ paravaśo dīnavaktraḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ |
tuṣṭāva parameśānaṃ haristaṃ lalitākṣaraiḥ ||
meaning:
नीयमानः परवशो दीनवक्त्रः कृताञ्जलिः |
तुष्टाव परमेशानं हरिस्तं ललिताक्षरैः ||
text_mt: Being led away, powerless, with a miserable face and folded hands, / Hari praised that Parameśāna with charming syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmnāmaṣṭaśatenaiva stutvā taṃ mṛḍameva ca |
punaśca prārthayāmāsa nṛsiṃhaḥ śarabheśvaram ||
meaning:
नाम्नामष्टशतेनैव स्तुत्वा तं मृडमेव च |
पुनश्च प्रार्थयामास नृसिंहः शरभेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Having praised Mṛḍa with one hundred and eight names, / the man-lion prayed once again to Śarabheśvara:

sanskrit_iast:
yadā yadā mamājñeyaṃ matiḥ syādgarvadūṣitā |
tadā tadā'panetavyā tvayaiva parameśvara ||
meaning:
यदा यदा ममाज्ञेयं मतिः स्याद्गर्वदूषिता |
तदा तदाऽपनेतव्या त्वयैव परमेश्वर ||
text_mt: 'Whenever my mind should become contaminated with pride due to ignorance, / at each of those times it must be dispelled by you alone, O Parameśvara.'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
evaṃ vijñāpayanprītyā śaṅkaraṃ narakesarī |
natvāśakto'bhavadviṣṇurjīvitāntaparājitaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
एवं विज्ञापयन्प्रीत्या शङ्करं नरकेसरी |
नत्वाशक्तोऽभवद्विष्णुर्जीवितान्तपराजितः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Making this request with love to Śaṅkara, the man-lion, / having bowed, Viṣṇu became powerless, overcome at the end of his life.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvaktraṃ śeṣagātrāntaṃ kṛtvā sarvasvavigraham |
śaktiyuktaṃ tadīyāṅgaṃ vīrabhadraḥ kṣaṇāttataḥ ||
meaning:
तद्वक्त्रं शेषगात्रान्तं कृत्वा सर्वस्वविग्रहम् |
शक्तियुक्तं तदीयाङ्गं वीरभद्रः क्षणात्ततः ||
text_mt: Making that face and the rest of the limbs an entire body, / Vīrabhadra then in an instant [took] that body endowed with power.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
atha brahmādayo devāḥ śārabhaṃ rūpamāsthitam |
tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṅkaraṃ devaṃ sarvalokaikaśaṅkaram ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
अथ ब्रह्मादयो देवाः शारभं रूपमास्थितम् |
तुष्टुवुः शङ्करं देवं सर्वलोकैकशङ्करम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Then Brahmā and the other gods praised Lord Śaṅkara, / who had assumed the form of a Śarabha, the sole benefactor of all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ |
brahmaviṣṇvindracandrādisurāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ |
ditijādyāḥ samprasūtāḥ tvattaḥ sarve maheśvara ||
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः |
ब्रह्मविष्ण्विन्द्रचन्द्रादिसुराः सर्वे महर्षयः |
दितिजाद्याः सम्प्रसूताः त्वत्तः सर्वे महेश्वर ||
text_mt: The gods said: / 'Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Indra, Candra, and all the gods, the great seers, / and the sons of Diti, etc., are all born from you, O Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇumahendrāṃśca sūryādyānasurānsurān |
tvaṃ vai sṛjasi pāsyatsi tvameva sakaleśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेन्द्रांश्च सूर्याद्यानसुरान्सुरान् |
त्वं वै सृजसि पास्यत्सि त्वमेव सकलेश्वरः ||
text_mt: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Mahendra, Sūrya and the others, the Asuras, and the Suras— / you alone create, protect, and consume; you alone are the Lord of all.

sanskrit_iast:
yato harasi saṃsāraṃ hara ityucyate budhaiḥ |
nigṛhīto hariryasmāddhara ityucyate budhaiḥ ||
meaning:
यतो हरसि संसारं हर इत्युच्यते बुधैः |
निगृहीतो हरिर्यस्माद्धर इत्युच्यते बुधैः ||
text_mt: Because you take away (harasi) worldly existence, you are called Hara by the wise; / because Hari was subdued (nigṛhītaḥ), he is called Hara by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
yato bibharṣi sakalaṃ vibhajya tanumaṣṭadhā |
ato'smānpāhi bhagavan surān dānairabhīpsitaiḥ ||
meaning:
यतो बिभर्षि सकलं विभज्य तनुमष्टधा |
अतोऽस्मान्पाहि भगवन् सुरान् दानैरभीप्सितैः ||
text_mt: Because you sustain everything, dividing your body into eight forms, / therefore protect us gods, O Lord, with desired boons.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ mahāpuruṣaḥ śambhuḥ sarveśaḥ suranāyakaḥ |
niḥsvātmā nirvikārātmā parabrahma satāṃ gatiḥ ||
meaning:
त्वं महापुरुषः शम्भुः सर्वेशः सुरनायकः |
निःस्वात्मा निर्विकारात्मा परब्रह्म सतां गतिः ||
text_mt: You are the Great Person, Śambhu, Lord of all, leader of the gods, / having no personal self, having an immutable self, the Supreme Brahman, the goal of the virtuous,

sanskrit_iast:
dīnabandhurdayāsindhuradbhutotiḥ parātmadṛk |
prājño virāṭ vibhuḥ satyaḥ saccidānandalakṣaṇaḥ ||
meaning:
दीनबन्धुर्दयासिन्धुरद्भुतोतिः परात्मदृक् |
प्राज्ञो विराट् विभुः सत्यः सच्चिदानन्दलक्षणः ||
text_mt: the friend of the distressed, an ocean of compassion, of wondrous deeds, beholding the supreme Self, / wise, cosmic, omnipresent, truth, characterized by existence, consciousness, and bliss.'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityākarṇya vacaḥ śambhurdevānāṃ parameśvaraḥ |
uvāca tān surāndevāmaharṣīṃśca purātanān ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचः शम्भुर्देवानां परमेश्वरः |
उवाच तान् सुरान्देवामहर्षींश्च पुरातनान् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing this speech of the gods, Śambhu, the Parameśvara, / spoke to those divine beings and ancient great seers:

sanskrit_iast:
yathā jalaṃ jale kṣiptaṃ kṣīre kṣīraṃ ghṛte ghṛtam |
eka eva tadā viṣṇuḥ śive līno na cānyathā ||
meaning:
यथा जलं जले क्षिप्तं क्षीरे क्षीरं घृते घृतम् |
एक एव तदा विष्णुः शिवे लीनो न चान्यथा ||
text_mt: 'Just as water poured into water, milk into milk, or clarified butter into clarified butter, / so the one Viṣṇu merged into Śiva, and not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
eko viṣṇurnṛsiṃhātmā sadarpaśca mahābalaḥ |
jagatsaṃhārakaraṇe pravṛtto narakesarī ||
meaning:
एको विष्णुर्नृसिंहात्मा सदर्पश्च महाबलः |
जगत्संहारकरणे प्रवृत्तो नरकेसरी ||
text_mt: The single Viṣṇu, taking the form of the man-lion, was full of pride and exceedingly powerful; / the man-lion had set out to cause the destruction of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
prārthanīyo namastasmai madbhaktaiḥ siddhikāribhiḥ |
madbhaktapravaraścaiva madbhaktavaradāyakaḥ ||
meaning:
प्रार्थनीयो नमस्तस्मै मद्भक्तैः सिद्धिकारिभिः |
मद्भक्तप्रवरश्चैव मद्भक्तवरदायकः ||
text_mt: He should be prayed to; salutations to him by my devotees who achieve accomplishments! / He is the foremost of my devotees and the granter of boons to my devotees.'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
etāvaduktvā bhagavān pakṣirājo mahābalaḥ |
paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् पक्षिराजो महाबलः |
पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, the Lord, the king of birds of great strength, / disappeared right there while all the gods looked on.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhadro'pi bhagavāngaṇādhyakṣo mahābalaḥ |
nṛsiṃhakṛttiṃ niṣkṛṣya samādāya yayau girim ||
meaning:
वीरभद्रोऽपि भगवान्गणाध्यक्षो महाबलः |
नृसिंहकृत्तिं निष्कृष्य समादाय ययौ गिरिम् ||
text_mt: Lord Vīrabhadra too, the commander of the attendants, of great might, / having flayed the hide of the man-lion and taken it, went to the mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhakṛttivasanastadāprabhṛti śaṅkaraḥ |
tadvaktraṃ muṇḍamālāyāṃ nāyakatvena kalpitam ||
meaning:
नृसिंहकृत्तिवसनस्तदाप्रभृति शङ्करः |
तद्वक्त्रं मुण्डमालायां नायकत्वेन कल्पितम् ||
text_mt: From then on, Śaṅkara has been clothed in the hide of the man-lion, / and that head was arranged as the central gem in his garland of skulls.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devā nirātaṅkāḥ kīrtayantaḥ kathāmimām |
vismayotphullanayanā jagmuḥ sarve yathāgatam ||
meaning:
ततो देवा निरातङ्काः कीर्तयन्तः कथामिमाम् |
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना जग्मुः सर्वे यथागतम् ||
text_mt: Then the gods, freed from anxiety, reciting this story / with eyes wide open in wonder, all went back as they had come.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ paramākhyānaṃ puṇyaṃ vedarasānvitam |
paṭhati śṛṇuyāccaiva sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||
meaning:
य इदं परमाख्यानं पुण्यं वेदरसान्वितम् |
पठति शृणुयाच्चैव सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: Whoever recites or listens to this supreme narrative, / meritorious and filled with the essence of the Veda, shall attain all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyamārogyampuṣṭivarddhanam |
sarvavighnapraśamanaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam ||
meaning:
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यमारोग्यम्पुष्टिवर्द्धनम् |
सर्वविघ्नप्रशमनं सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम् ||
text_mt: It brings fortune, fame, longevity, health, and increase of vitality; / it pacifies all obstacles and destroys all diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhapraśamanaṃ vāñchāsiddhidaṃ maṅgalālayam |
apamṛtyuharaṃ buddhipradaṃ śatruvināśanam ||
meaning:
दुःखप्रशमनं वाञ्छासिद्धिदं मङ्गलालयम् |
अपमृत्युहरं बुद्धिप्रदं शत्रुविनाशनम् ||
text_mt: It pacifies sorrow, grants the fulfillment of wishes, is the abode of auspiciousness, / removes untimely death, bestows intellect, and destroys enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ tu śarabhākāraṃ paraṃ rūpaṃ pinākinaḥ |
prakāśanīyaṃ bhakteṣu śaṅkarasya careṣu vai ||
meaning:
इदं तु शरभाकारं परं रूपं पिनाकिनः |
प्रकाशनीयं भक्तेषु शङ्करस्य चरेषु वै ||
text_mt: This supreme form of the wielder of the Pināka, having the appearance of a Śarabha, / should be revealed among devotees, the wandering mendicants of Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
taireva paṭhitavyaṃ ca śrotavyaṃ ca śivātmabhiḥ |
navadhābhaktidaṃ divyamantaḥkaraṇabuddhidam ||
meaning:
तैरेव पठितव्यं च श्रोतव्यं च शिवात्मभिः |
नवधाभक्तिदं दिव्यमन्तःकरणबुद्धिदम् ||
text_mt: It should be recited and heard only by those whose souls are devoted to Śiva; / it bestows ninefold devotion, is divine, and grants wisdom to the inner faculty.

sanskrit_iast:
śivotsaveṣu sarveṣu caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca |
paṭhetpratiṣṭhākāle tu śivasannidhikāraṇam ||
meaning:
शिवोत्सवेषु सर्वेषु चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च |
पठेत्प्रतिष्ठाकाले तु शिवसन्निधिकारणम् ||
text_mt: At all festivals of Śiva, and on the fourteenth and eighth lunar days, / and at the time of consecration, one should recite it; it causes the presence of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
cauravyāghranṛsiṃhātmakṛtarājabhayeṣu ca |
anyeṣūtpātabhūkampadasyvādipāṃsuvṛṣṭiṣu ||
meaning:
चौरव्याघ्रनृसिंहात्मकृतराजभयेषु च |
अन्येषूत्पातभूकम्पदस्य्वादिपांसुवृष्टिषु ||
text_mt: In fears arising from thieves, tigers, the man-lion, and kings, / and in other portents, earthquakes, bandits, and showers of dust,

sanskrit_iast:
ulkāpāte mahāvāte vināvṛṣṭyativṛṣṭiṣu |
paṭhedyaḥ prayato vidvān śivabhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ ||
meaning:
उल्कापाते महावाते विनावृष्ट्यतिवृष्टिषु |
पठेद्यः प्रयतो विद्वान् शिवभक्तो दृढव्रतः ||
text_mt: in the fall of meteors, severe gales, drought, and torrential rain, / whatever focused, learned devotee of Śiva of firm vows recites it—

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi niṣkāmo vratamaiśvaram |
rudralokaṃ samāsādya rudrasyānucaro bhavet ||
meaning:
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि निष्कामो व्रतमैश्वरम् |
रुद्रलोकं समासाद्य रुद्रस्यानुचरो भवेत् ||
text_mt: whoever, free from desire, recites or even listens to this observance of the Lord, / reaching the world of Rudra, shall become a follower of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
rudralokamanuprāpya rudreṇa saha modate |
tataḥ sāyujyamāpnoti śivasya kṛpayā mune ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
रुद्रलोकमनुप्राप्य रुद्रेण सह मोदते |
ततः सायुज्यमाप्नोति शिवस्य कृपया मुने ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Having attained the world of Rudra, he rejoices with Rudra; / then he attains communion through the grace of Śiva, O sage.

Thus ends the twelfth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Incarnation as Śarabha," in the third book, the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
śṛṇu brahmasuta prītyā caritaṃ śaśimaulinaḥ |
so'vatīrṇo yathā prītyā viśvānaragṛhe śivaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
शृणु ब्रह्मसुत प्रीत्या चरितं शशिमौलिनः |
सोऽवतीर्णो यथा प्रीत्या विश्वानरगृहे शिवः ||
title: trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | gṛhapatyavatāravarṇanam 1
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Listen with delight, O son of Brahmā, to the deeds of the moon-crested lord, / how Śiva, out of love, descended into the house of Viśvānara.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmnā gṛhapatiḥ so'bhūdagnilokapatirmune |
agnirūpastaijasaśca sarvātmā paramaḥ prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
नाम्ना गृहपतिः सोऽभूदग्निलोकपतिर्मुने |
अग्निरूपस्तैजसश्च सर्वात्मा परमः प्रभुः ||
text_mt: He became Gṛhapati by name, the lord of the world of fire, O sage, / having the form of fire, fiery, the Self of all, the supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
narmadāyāstaṭe ramye pure narmapure purā |
purāribhaktaḥ puṇyātmābhavadviśvānaro muniḥ ||
meaning:
नर्मदायास्तटे रम्ये पुरे नर्मपुरे पुरा |
पुरारिभक्तः पुण्यात्माभवद्विश्वानरो मुनिः ||
text_mt: Formerly, on the charming bank of the Narmadā, in the city of Narmapura, / there was a sage, Viśvānara, a pious soul and devotee of the enemy of Pura.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacaryāśrame niṣṭho brahmayajñarataḥ sadā |
śāṇḍilyagotraḥ śucimānbrahmatejonidhirvaśī ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमे निष्ठो ब्रह्मयज्ञरतः सदा |
शाण्डिल्यगोत्रः शुचिमान्ब्रह्मतेजोनिधिर्वशी ||
text_mt: Steadfast in the student stage of life, always devoted to the study of the Veda, / belonging to the Śāṇḍilya gotra, pure, a treasury of brahmanic splendor, self-controlled,

sanskrit_iast:
vijñātākhilaśāstrārthaḥ sadācārarataḥ sadā |
śaivācārapravīṇo'ti laukikācāravidvaraḥ ||
meaning:
विज्ञाताखिलशास्त्रार्थः सदाचाररतः सदा |
शैवाचारप्रवीणोऽति लौकिकाचारविद्वरः ||
text_mt: he understood the meaning of all the scriptures, was constantly devoted to proper conduct, / deeply skilled in the practice of Śaivism, and foremost among those who know worldly conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
citte vicārya gṛhiṇīguṇānviśvānaraḥ śubhān |
uduvāha vidhānena svocitāṃ kulakanyakām ||
meaning:
चित्ते विचार्य गृहिणीगुणान्विश्वानरः शुभान् |
उदुवाह विधानेन स्वोचितां कुलकन्यकाम् ||
text_mt: Reflecting in his mind on the auspicious virtues of a housewife, / Viśvānara duly wedded a maiden of good family who was suitable for him.

sanskrit_iast:
agniśuśrūṣaṇarataḥ pañcayajñaparāyaṇaḥ |
ṣaṭkarmanirato nityaṃ devapitratithipriyaḥ ||
meaning:
अग्निशुश्रूषणरतः पञ्चयज्ञपरायणः |
षट्कर्मनिरतो नित्यं देवपित्रतिथिप्रियः ||
text_mt: Devoted to serving the fire, intent on the five great sacrifices, / ever dedicated to the six duties, he held dear the gods, ancestors, and guests.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bahutithe kāle gate tasyāgrajanmanaḥ |
bhāryā śuciṣmatī nāma bhartāraṃ prāha suvratā ||
meaning:
एवं बहुतिथे काले गते तस्याग्रजन्मनः |
भार्या शुचिष्मती नाम भर्तारं प्राह सुव्रता ||
text_mt: When a long time had thus passed for that twice-born man, / his wife, named Śuciṣmatī, of virtuous observances, addressed her husband:

sanskrit_iast:
nātha bhogā mayā sarve bhuktā vai tvatprasādataḥ |
strīṇāṃ samucitā ye syuḥ tvāṃ sametya mudāvahāḥ ||
meaning:
नाथ भोगा मया सर्वे भुक्ता वै त्वत्प्रसादतः |
स्त्रीणां समुचिता ये स्युः त्वां समेत्य मुदावहाः ||
text_mt: “O master, through your favor I have enjoyed all pleasures / that are suitable for women, bringing joy upon uniting with you.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ me prārthitaṃ nātha cirāya hṛdi saṃsthitam |
gṛhasthānāṃ samucitaṃ tvametaddātumarhasi ||
meaning:
एवं मे प्रार्थितं नाथ चिराय हृदि संस्थितम् |
गृहस्थानां समुचितं त्वमेतद्दातुमर्हसि ||
text_mt: There is a desire long kept in my heart, O master, / suitable for householders; you ought to grant this to me.”

sanskrit_iast:
viśvānara uvāca |
kimadeyaṃ hi suśroṇi tava priyahitaiṣiṇī |
tatprārthaya mahābhāge prayacchāmyavilambitam ||
meaning:
विश्वानर उवाच |
किमदेयं हि सुश्रोणि तव प्रियहितैषिणी |
तत्प्रार्थय महाभागे प्रयच्छाम्यविलम्बितम् ||
text_mt: Viśvānara said: / “What could be withheld from you, O lady of fair hips, who desire my pleasure and benefit? / Ask for it, O fortunate one; I shall grant it without delay.

sanskrit_iast:
maheśituḥ prasādena mama kiñcinna durlabham |
ihāmutra ca kalyāṇi sarvakalyāṇakāriṇaḥ ||
meaning:
महेशितुः प्रसादेन मम किञ्चिन्न दुर्लभम् |
इहामुत्र च कल्याणि सर्वकल्याणकारिणः ||
text_mt: By the grace of the Great Lord, nothing is difficult for me to obtain / in this world or the next, O auspicious one, from him who brings about all blessings.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityākarṇya vacaḥ patyustasya sā patidevatā |
uvāca hṛṣṭavadanā karau baddhvā vinītikā ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचः पत्युस्तस्य सा पतिदेवता |
उवाच हृष्टवदना करौ बद्ध्वा विनीतिका ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing this speech of her husband, she to whom her husband was a deity / spoke with a cheerful face, joining her palms in humility:

sanskrit_iast:
śuciṣmatyuvāca |
varayogyāsmi cennātha yadi deyo varo mama |
maheśasadṛśaṃ putraṃ dehi nānyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇe ||
meaning:
शुचिष्मत्युवाच |
वरयोग्यास्मि चेन्नाथ यदि देयो वरो मम |
महेशसदृशं पुत्रं देहि नान्यं वरं वृणे ||
text_mt: Śuciṣmatī said: / “If I am worthy of a boon, O master, if a boon is to be given to me, / grant me a son equal to the Great Lord; I choose no other boon.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā brāhmaṇaḥ sa śucivrataḥ |
kṣaṇaṃ samādhimādhāya hṛdyetatsamacintayat ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा ब्राह्मणः स शुचिव्रतः |
क्षणं समाधिमाधाय हृद्येतत्समचिन्तयत् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing her words, that brahmin of pure observances / entered into deep meditation for a moment and reflected thus in his heart:

sanskrit_iast:
aho kiṃ me tayā tanvyā prārthitaṃ hyatidurlabham |
manorathapathāddūramastu vā sa hi sarvakṛt ||
meaning:
अहो किं मे तया तन्व्या प्रार्थितं ह्यतिदुर्लभम् |
मनोरथपथाद्दूरमस्तु वा स हि सर्वकृत् ||
text_mt: “Oh, what a very difficult thing this slender lady has asked of me! / It is far beyond the path of imagination—yet let it be so, for he is the maker of all!

sanskrit_iast:
tenaivāsyā mukhe sthitvā vāksvarūpeṇa śambhunā |
vyāhṛtaṃ ko'nyathā kartumutsaheta bhavedidam ||
meaning:
तेनैवास्या मुखे स्थित्वा वाक्स्वरूपेण शम्भुना |
व्याहृतं कोऽन्यथा कर्तुमुत्सहेत भवेदिदम् ||
text_mt: Śambhu himself, abiding in her mouth in the form of speech, / has spoken this. Who would venture to make it otherwise? It must come to pass.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti sañcintya sa munirviśvānara udāradhīḥ |
tataḥ provāca tāṃ patnīmekapatnīvrate sthitaḥ ||
meaning:
इति सञ्चिन्त्य स मुनिर्विश्वानर उदारधीः |
ततः प्रोवाच तां पत्नीमेकपत्नीव्रते स्थितः ||
text_mt: Having thus reflected, the noble-minded sage Viśvānara, / steadfast in the vow of having only one wife, then spoke to that wife.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
itthamāśvāsya tāṃ patnīṃ jagāma tapase muniḥ |
yatra viśveśvaraḥ sākṣātkāśīnātho'dhitiṣṭhati ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्थमाश्वास्य तां पत्नीं जगाम तपसे मुनिः |
यत्र विश्वेश्वरः साक्षात्काशीनाथोऽधितिष्ठति ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having thus comforted his wife, the sage departed to perform austerities / where Viśveśvara, the lord of Kāśī, resides in person.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpya vārāṇasīṃ tūrṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ maṇikarṇikām |
tatyāja tāpatritayamapi janmaśatārjitam ||
meaning:
प्राप्य वाराणसीं तूर्णं दृष्ट्वा तां मणिकर्णिकाम् |
तत्याज तापत्रितयमपि जन्मशतार्जितम् ||
text_mt: Quickly reaching Vārāṇasī and seeing that Maṇikarṇikā, / he abandoned the three kinds of suffering, even those earned across a hundred births.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā sarvāṇi liṅgāni viśveśapramukhāni ca |
snātvā sarveṣu kuṇḍeṣu vāpīkūpasarassu ca ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि लिङ्गानि विश्वेशप्रमुखानि च |
स्नात्वा सर्वेषु कुण्डेषु वापीकूपसरस्सु च ||
text_mt: Seeing all the liṅgas, headed by Viśveśa, / and bathing in all the pools, step-wells, wells, and lakes,

sanskrit_iast:
natvā vināyakānsarvāngaurīṃ śarvāṃ praṇamya ca |
sampūjya kālarājaṃ ca bhairavaṃ pāpabhakṣaṇam ||
meaning:
नत्वा विनायकान्सर्वान्गौरीं शर्वां प्रणम्य च |
सम्पूज्य कालराजं च भैरवं पापभक्षणम् ||
text_mt: bowing to all the Vināyakas, and paying homage to Gaurī and Śarvā, / and worshipping the lord of time, Bhairava, the devourer of sins,

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍanāyakamukhyāṃśca gaṇānstutvā prayatnataḥ |
ādikeśavamukhyāṃśca keśavaṃ paritoṣya ca ||
meaning:
दण्डनायकमुख्यांश्च गणान्स्तुत्वा प्रयत्नतः |
आदिकेशवमुख्यांश्च केशवं परितोष्य च ||
text_mt: carefully praising the attendants, headed by the Daṇḍanāyaka, / and propitiating Keśava, headed by Ādikeśava,

sanskrit_iast:
lolārkamukhasūryāṃśca praṇamya sa punaḥ punaḥ |
kṛtvā ca piṇḍadānāni sarvatīrtheṣvatandritaḥ ||
meaning:
लोलार्कमुखसूर्यांश्च प्रणम्य स पुनः पुनः |
कृत्वा च पिण्डदानानि सर्वतीर्थेष्वतन्द्रितः ||
text_mt: and bowing again and again to the suns, headed by Lolārka, / and unweariedly offering funeral cakes at all the sacred sites,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrabhojanādyaiśca munīnviprānpratarpya ca |
mahāpūjopacāraiśca liṅgānyabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ ||
meaning:
सहस्रभोजनाद्यैश्च मुनीन्विप्रान्प्रतर्प्य च |
महापूजोपचारैश्च लिङ्गान्यभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः ||
text_mt: satisfying the sages and brahmins with feasts of thousands and other rites, / and worshipping the liṅgas with devotion through the offerings of great worship,

sanskrit_iast:
asakṛccintayāmāsa kiṃ liṅgaṃ kṣiprasiddhidam |
yatra niścalatāmeti tapastanayakāmyayā ||
meaning:
असकृच्चिन्तयामास किं लिङ्गं क्षिप्रसिद्धिदम् |
यत्र निश्चलतामेति तपस्तनयकाम्यया ||
text_mt: he thought repeatedly: “Which liṅga swiftly bestows accomplishment, / where austerity, undertaken out of desire for a son, may attain steadfastness?”

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇaṃ vicārya sa muniriti viśvānaraḥ sudhīḥ |
kṣipraṃ putrapradaṃ liṅgaṃ vīreśaṃ praśaśaṃsa ha ||
meaning:
क्षणं विचार्य स मुनिरिति विश्वानरः सुधीः |
क्षिप्रं पुत्रप्रदं लिङ्गं वीरेशं प्रशशंस ह ||
text_mt: Reflecting for a moment, the wise sage Viśvānara / praised the liṅga Vīreśa, which swiftly grants a son:

sanskrit_iast:
asaṅkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi siddhāḥ siddhiṃ gatāstataḥ |
siddhaliṅgamiti khyātaṃ tasmādvīreśvaraṃ param ||
meaning:
असङ्ख्याताः सहस्राणि सिद्धाः सिद्धिं गतास्ततः |
सिद्धलिङ्गमिति ख्यातं तस्माद्वीरेश्वरं परम् ||
text_mt: “Countless thousands of perfected ones have attained perfection from it; / therefore the supreme Vīreśvara is celebrated as the Siddhaliṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
vīreśvaraṃ mahāliṅgamabdamabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ |
āyurmanorathaṃ sarvaṃ putrādikamanekaśaḥ ||
meaning:
वीरेश्वरं महालिङ्गमब्दमभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः |
आयुर्मनोरथं सर्वं पुत्रादिकमनेकशः ||
text_mt: Having worshipped the great liṅga Vīreśvara with devotion for a year, / [one obtains] life, all desired objects, children, and so forth in abundance.

sanskrit_iast:
ahamapyatra vīreśaṃ samārādhya trikālataḥ |
āśu putramavāpsyāmi yathābhilaṣitaṃ striyā ||
meaning:
अहमप्यत्र वीरेशं समाराध्य त्रिकालतः |
आशु पुत्रमवाप्स्यामि यथाभिलषितं स्त्रिया ||
text_mt: I too, having worshipped Vīreśa here at the three twilights, / shall quickly obtain a son as desired by my wife.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti kṛtvā matiṃ dhiro vipro viśvānaraḥ kṛtī |
candrakūpajale snātvā jagrāha niyamaṃ vratī ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति कृत्वा मतिं धिरो विप्रो विश्वानरः कृती |
चन्द्रकूपजले स्नात्वा जग्राह नियमं व्रती ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having thus resolved, the steadfast, skillful brahmin Viśvānara / bathed in the waters of the Candrakūpa and undertook his vow as an observer of austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhāro'bhavanmāsaṃ māsaṃ naktāśano'bhavat |
ayācitāśano māsaṃ māsaṃ tyaktāśanaḥ punaḥ ||
meaning:
एकाहारोऽभवन्मासं मासं नक्ताशनोऽभवत् |
अयाचिताशनो मासं मासं त्यक्ताशनः पुनः ||
text_mt: For a month he ate only once a day; for a month he ate only at night; / for a month he ate only unbegged food; and for a month he gave up food altogether.

sanskrit_iast:
payovrato'bhavanmāsaṃ māsaṃ śākaphalāśanaḥ |
māsaṃ muṣṭitilāhāro māsaṃ pānīyabhojanaḥ ||
meaning:
पयोव्रतोऽभवन्मासं मासं शाकफलाशनः |
मासं मुष्टितिलाहारो मासं पानीयभोजनः ||
text_mt: For a month he had a diet of milk; for a month he ate vegetables and fruit; / for a month his food was a handful of sesame seeds; for a month his nourishment was water.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyāśano māsaṃ māsaṃ cāndrāyaṇavratī |
māsaṃ kuśāgrajalabhugmāsaṃ śvasanabhakṣaṇaḥ ||
meaning:
पञ्चगव्याशनो मासं मासं चान्द्रायणव्रती |
मासं कुशाग्रजलभुग्मासं श्वसनभक्षणः ||
text_mt: For a month he ate the five products of the cow; for a month he observed the cāndrāyaṇa vow; / for a month he partook of water from the tips of kuśa grass; for a month he consumed only air.

sanskrit_iast:
evamabdamitaṃ kālaṃ tatāpa sa tapo'dbhutam |
trikālamarcayadbhaktyā vīreśaṃ liṅgamuttamam ||
meaning:
एवमब्दमितं कालं तताप स तपोऽद्भुतम् |
त्रिकालमर्चयद्भक्त्या वीरेशं लिङ्गमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: In this way, for the space of a year, he performed wondrous austerity; / with devotion he worshipped the excellent liṅga Vīreśa at the three twilights.

sanskrit_iast:
atha trayodaśe māsi snātvā tripathagāmbhasi |
pratyūṣa eva vīreśaṃ yāvadāyāti sa dvijaḥ ||
meaning:
अथ त्रयोदशे मासि स्नात्वा त्रिपथगाम्भसि |
प्रत्यूष एव वीरेशं यावदायाति स द्विजः ||
text_mt: Then, in the thirteenth month, having bathed in the waters of the triple-flowing river, / just at dawn, as that twice-born man approached Vīreśa,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadvilokayāñcakre madhye liṅgaṃ tapodhanaḥ |
vibhūtibhūṣaṇaṃ bālamaṣṭavarṣākṛtiṃ śiśum ||
meaning:
तावद्विलोकयाञ्चक्रे मध्ये लिङ्गं तपोधनः |
विभूतिभूषणं बालमष्टवर्षाकृतिं शिशुम् ||
text_mt: the ascetic saw in the middle of the liṅga / a boy adorned with ashes, a child having the appearance of an eight-year-old,

sanskrit_iast:
ākarṇāyatanetraṃ ca suraktadaśanacchadam |
cārupiṅgajaṭāmauliṃ nagna prahasitānanam ||
meaning:
आकर्णायतनेत्रं च सुरक्तदशनच्छदम् |
चारुपिङ्गजटामौलिं नग्न प्रहसिताननम् ||
text_mt: with eyes extending to his ears, bright red lips, / a charming crown of matted reddish hair, naked, with a smiling face,

sanskrit_iast:
śaiśavocitanepathyadhāriṇaṃ citidhāriṇam |
paṭhantaṃ śrutisūktāni hasantaṃ ca svalīlayā ||
meaning:
शैशवोचितनेपथ्यधारिणं चितिधारिणम् |
पठन्तं श्रुतिसूक्तानि हसन्तं च स्वलीलया ||
text_mt: wearing attire suited to childhood, holding an altar-fire, / reciting the Vedic hymns, and laughing in his divine play.

sanskrit_iast:
tamālokya mudaṃ prāpya romakañcukito muniḥ |
proccacāra hṛdālāpānnamo'stviti punaḥ punaḥ ||
meaning:
तमालोक्य मुदं प्राप्य रोमकञ्चुकितो मुनिः |
प्रोच्चचार हृदालापान्नमोऽस्त्विति पुनः पुनः ||
text_mt: Beholding him and filled with joy, his hair standing on end, the sage / uttered words from his heart, saying repeatedly: “Homage be to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
abhilāṣapradaiḥ padyairaṣṭabhirbālarūpiṇam |
tuṣṭāva paramānandaṃ śambhuṃ viśvānaraḥ kṛtī ||
meaning:
अभिलाषप्रदैः पद्यैरष्टभिर्बालरूपिणम् |
तुष्टाव परमानन्दं शम्भुं विश्वानरः कृती ||
text_mt: With eight verses that grant all desires, the skillful Viśvānara / praised Śambhu in the form of a child, the supreme bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvānara uvāca |
ekaṃ brahmaivādvitīyaṃ samastaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ neha nānāsti kiñcit |
eko rudro na dvitīyo'vatasthe tasmādekaṃ tvāṃ prapadye maheśam ||
meaning:
विश्वानर उवाच |
एकं ब्रह्मैवाद्वितीयं समस्तं सत्यं सत्यं नेह नानास्ति किञ्चित् |
एको रुद्रो न द्वितीयोऽवतस्थे तस्मादेकं त्वां प्रपद्ये महेशम् ||
text_mt: Viśvānara said: / “Brahman alone is one, without a second, all-encompassing; in truth, in truth, there is no diversity here whatsoever. / Rudra alone stood, without a second; therefore I take refuge in you alone, the Great Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
kartā harttā tvaṃ hi sarvasya śambho nānārūpeṣvekarūpo'pyarūpaḥ |
yadvatpratyagdharma eko'pyaneka-stasmānnānyaṃ tvāṃ vineśaṃ prapadye ||
meaning:
कर्ता हर्त्ता त्वं हि सर्वस्य शम्भो नानारूपेष्वेकरूपोऽप्यरूपः |
यद्वत्प्रत्यग्धर्म एकोऽप्यनेक-स्तस्मान्नान्यं त्वां विनेशं प्रपद्ये ||
text_mt: For you, O Śambhu, are the creator and destroyer of all, formless though possessing a single form among manifold forms; / just as the inner self is one though manifold in its attributes, therefore I take refuge in no other lord except you.

sanskrit_iast:
rajjau sarpaḥ śuktikāyāṃ ca raupyaṃ nairaḥ pūrastanmṛgākhye marīcau |
yadyatsadvadviṣvageva prapañco yasmin jñāte taṃ prapadye maheśam ||
meaning:
रज्जौ सर्पः शुक्तिकायां च रौप्यं नैरः पूरस्तन्मृगाख्ये मरीचौ |
यद्यत्सद्वद्विष्वगेव प्रपञ्चो यस्मिन् ज्ञाते तं प्रपद्ये महेशम् ||
text_mt: Just as a serpent appears in a rope, silver in mother-of-pearl, and a stream of water in the mirage named after a deer, / and whatever exists is this world manifest everywhere—on knowing whom [all this is dispelled], to that Great Lord I fly for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
toye śaityaṃ dāhakatvaṃ ca vahnau tāpo bhānau śītabhānau prasādaḥ |
puṣpe gandho dugdhamadhye'pi sarpi-ryattacchambho tvaṃ tatastvāṃ prapadye ||
meaning:
तोये शैत्यं दाहकत्वं च वह्नौ तापो भानौ शीतभानौ प्रसादः |
पुष्पे गन्धो दुग्धमध्येऽपि सर्पि-र्यत्तच्छम्भो त्वं ततस्त्वां प्रपद्ये ||
text_mt: Coldness in water, heat in fire, warmth in the sun, delight in the cool-rayed moon, / fragrance in a flower, and ghee in milk—whatever that is, O Śambhu, you are that; therefore to you I fly for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdaṃ gṛhṇāsyaśravāstvaṃ hi jighra-syaghrāṇastvaṃ vyaṅghrirāyāsi dūrāt |
vyakṣaḥ paśyestvaṃ rasajño'pyajihvaḥ kastvāṃ samyagvettyatastvāṃ prapadye ||
meaning:
शब्दं गृह्णास्यश्रवास्त्वं हि जिघ्र-स्यघ्राणस्त्वं व्यङ्घ्रिरायासि दूरात् |
व्यक्षः पश्येस्त्वं रसज्ञोऽप्यजिह्वः कस्त्वां सम्यग्वेत्त्यतस्त्वां प्रपद्ये ||
text_mt: Without ears you hear sound, without a nose you smell, without feet you arrive from afar, / without eyes you see, and without a tongue you taste flavors; who knows you properly? Therefore to you I fly for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
no veda tvāmīśa sākṣāddhi vedo no vā viṣṇurno vidhātākhilasya |
no yogīndrā nendramukhyāśca devā bhakto veda tvāmatastvāṃ prapadye ||
meaning:
नो वेद त्वामीश साक्षाद्धि वेदो नो वा विष्णुर्नो विधाताखिलस्य |
नो योगीन्द्रा नेन्द्रमुख्याश्च देवा भक्तो वेद त्वामतस्त्वां प्रपद्ये ||
text_mt: The Veda itself does not directly know you, O Īśa, nor does Viṣṇu, nor the creator of all; / neither do the best of yogins nor the gods headed by Indra know you; a devotee knows you; therefore to you I fly for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
no te gotraṃ neśa janmāpi nākhyā no vā rūpaṃ naiva śīlaṃ na deśaḥ |
itthambhūto'pīśvarastvaṃ trilokyāḥ sarvānkāmānpūrayestvaṃ bhaje tvām ||
meaning:
नो ते गोत्रं नेश जन्मापि नाख्या नो वा रूपं नैव शीलं न देशः |
इत्थम्भूतोऽपीश्वरस्त्वं त्रिलोक्याः सर्वान्कामान्पूरयेस्त्वं भजे त्वाम् ||
text_mt: You have no clan, O Īśa, nor birth, nor even a name, nor form, nor character, nor country; / though being such, you are the Lord of the three worlds and fulfill all desires; I revere you.

sanskrit_iast:
tvattaḥ sarvaṃ tvaṃ hi sarvaṃ smarāre tvaṃ gaurīśastvaṃ ca nagno'tiśāntaḥ |
tvaṃ vai vṛddhastvaṃ yuvā tvaṃ ca bāla-stattvaṃ yatkiṃ nānyatastvāṃ nato'ham ||
meaning:
त्वत्तः सर्वं त्वं हि सर्वं स्मरारे त्वं गौरीशस्त्वं च नग्नोऽतिशान्तः |
त्वं वै वृद्धस्त्वं युवा त्वं च बाल-स्तत्त्वं यत्किं नान्यतस्त्वां नतोऽहम् ||
text_mt: All is from you, for you are all, O enemy of Smara; you are the lord of Gaurī, and you are naked and supremely calm; / you indeed are an old man, you are a youth, and you are a child; whatever is the reality, you are not other than it; I bow to you.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
stutveti vipro nipapāta bhūmau sambaddhapāṇirbhavatīha yāvat |
tāvatsa bālo'khilavṛddhavṛddhaḥ provāca bhūdevamatīva hṛṣṭaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
स्तुत्वेति विप्रो निपपात भूमौ सम्बद्धपाणिर्भवतीह यावत् |
तावत्स बालोऽखिलवृद्धवृद्धः प्रोवाच भूदेवमतीव हृष्टः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / As soon as the brahmin, having thus praised [him], fell to the earth with joined palms, / that child, the oldest of all the old, spoke to the brahmin, exceedingly delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
bāla uvāca |
viśvānara muniśreṣṭha bhūdevāhaṃ tvayādya vai |
toṣitaḥ suprasannātmā vṛṇīṣva varamuttamam ||
meaning:
बाल उवाच |
विश्वानर मुनिश्रेष्ठ भूदेवाहं त्वयाद्य वै |
तोषितः सुप्रसन्नात्मा वृणीष्व वरमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: The child said: / O Viśvānara, best of sages, O brahmin, I am indeed / pleased by you today, my heart is exceedingly gracious; choose an excellent boon.

sanskrit_iast:
tata utthāya hṛṣṭātmā munirviśvānaraḥ kṛtī |
pratyabravīnmuniśreṣṭhaḥ śaṅkaraṃ bālarūpiṇam ||
meaning:
तत उत्थाय हृष्टात्मा मुनिर्विश्वानरः कृती |
प्रत्यब्रवीन्मुनिश्रेष्ठः शङ्करं बालरूपिणम् ||
text_mt: Then, rising with a delighted heart, the sage Viśvānara, accomplished and best of sages, / replied to Śaṅkara who was in the form of a child.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvānara uvāca |
maheśvara kimajñātaṃ sarvajñasya tava prabho |
sarvāntarātmā bhagavān śarvaḥ sarvaprado bhavān ||
meaning:
विश्वानर उवाच |
महेश्वर किमज्ञातं सर्वज्ञस्य तव प्रभो |
सर्वान्तरात्मा भगवान् शर्वः सर्वप्रदो भवान् ||
text_mt: Viśvānara said: / O Maheśvara, what is unknown to you, who are omniscient, O Lord? / You are the inner self of all, the blessed Lord, Śarva, bestower of everything.

sanskrit_iast:
yācñāṃ prati niyuktaṃ māṃ kiṃ brūṣe dainyakāriṇīm |
iti jñātvā maheśāna yathecchasi tathā kuru ||
meaning:
याच्ञां प्रति नियुक्तं मां किं ब्रूषे दैन्यकारिणीम् |
इति ज्ञात्वा महेशान यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ||
text_mt: Why do you tell me to make a petition that causes distress? / Knowing this, O Maheśāna, do as you wish.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti śrutvā vacastasya devo viśvānarasya hi |
śuciḥ śucivratasyātha śuciṃ smitvābravīcchiśuḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य देवो विश्वानरस्य हि |
शुचिः शुचिव्रतस्याथ शुचिं स्मित्वाब्रवीच्छिशुः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having heard these words of Viśvānara, the pure god, the child, / smiling, spoke to the pure one of pure vows:

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā śuce śuciṣmatyāṃ yo'bhilāṣaḥ kṛto hṛdi |
acireṇaiva kālena sa bhaviṣyatyasaṃśayam ||
meaning:
त्वया शुचे शुचिष्मत्यां योऽभिलाषः कृतो हृदि |
अचिरेणैव कालेन स भविष्यत्यसंशयम् ||
text_mt: "The desire that was conceived in your heart regarding Śuciṣmatī, O pure one, / will be fulfilled in no long time without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tava putratvameṣyāmi śuciṣmatyāṃ mahāmate |
khyāto gṛhapatirnāmnā śuciḥ sarvāmarapriyaḥ ||
meaning:
तव पुत्रत्वमेष्यामि शुचिष्मत्यां महामते |
ख्यातो गृहपतिर्नाम्ना शुचिः सर्वामरप्रियः ||
text_mt: I shall become your son in Śuciṣmatī, O highly intelligent one, / celebrated by the name Gṛhapati, pure, and beloved of all the immortals.

sanskrit_iast:
abhilāṣāṣṭakaṃ puṇyaṃ stotrametattvayeritam |
abdatrikālapaṭhanātkāmadaṃ śivasannidhau ||
meaning:
अभिलाषाष्टकं पुण्यं स्तोत्रमेतत्त्वयेरितम् |
अब्दत्रिकालपठनात्कामदं शिवसन्निधौ ||
text_mt: This holy hymn, the Abhilāṣāṣṭaka, has been spoken by you; / by reciting it at the three daily twilights for a year in the presence of Śiva, it grants all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
etatstotraprapaṭhanaṃ putrapautradhanapradam |
sarvaśāntikaraṃ cāpi sarvāpattivināśanam ||
meaning:
एतत्स्तोत्रप्रपठनं पुत्रपौत्रधनप्रदम् |
सर्वशान्तिकरं चापि सर्वापत्तिविनाशनम् ||
text_mt: The recitation of this hymn bestows sons, grandsons, and wealth; / it brings all peace and destroys all calamities.

sanskrit_iast:
svargāpavargasampattikārakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
sarvastotrasamaṃ hyetatsarvakāmapradaṃ sadā ||
meaning:
स्वर्गापवर्गसम्पत्तिकारकं नात्र संशयः |
सर्वस्तोत्रसमं ह्येतत्सर्वकामप्रदं सदा ||
text_mt: It brings about the wealth of heaven and liberation, there is no doubt in this; / it is equal to all hymns and ever bestows all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarutthāya susnāto liṅgamabhyarcya śāmbhavam |
varṣaṃ japannidaṃ stotramaputraḥ putravānbhavet ||
meaning:
प्रातरुत्थाय सुस्नातो लिङ्गमभ्यर्च्य शाम्भवम् |
वर्षं जपन्निदं स्तोत्रमपुत्रः पुत्रवान्भवेत् ||
text_mt: Having risen in the morning, bathed well, and worshipped the liṅga of Śambhu, / reciting this hymn for a year, a childless person becomes endowed with a son.

sanskrit_iast:
abhilāṣāṣṭakamidaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit |
gopanīyaṃ prayatnena mahāvandhyāprasūtikṛt ||
meaning:
अभिलाषाष्टकमिदं न देयं यस्य कस्यचित् |
गोपनीयं प्रयत्नेन महावन्ध्याप्रसूतिकृत् ||
text_mt: This Abhilāṣāṣṭaka should not be given to just anyone; / it should be guarded with effort; it brings about childbirth even in a woman who is completely barren.

sanskrit_iast:
striyā vā puruṣeṇāpi niyamālliṅgasannidhau |
abdaṃ japtamidaṃ stotraṃ putradaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
स्त्रिया वा पुरुषेणापि नियमाल्लिङ्गसन्निधौ |
अब्दं जप्तमिदं स्तोत्रं पुत्रदं नात्र संशयः ||
text_mt: Recited with regulation in the presence of the liṅga for a year / by a woman or by a man, this hymn bestows a son, there is no doubt in this."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvāntardadhe śambhurbālarūpaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ |
so'pi viśvānaro vipro hṛṣṭātmā svagṛhaṃ yayau ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे शम्भुर्बालरूपः सतां गतिः |
सोऽपि विश्वानरो विप्रो हृष्टात्मा स्वगृहं ययौ ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, Śambhu in the form of a child, the refuge of the virtuous, disappeared; / that brahmin Viśvānara too, with a delighted heart, went to his own home.

Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Incarnation of Gṛhapati,' in the Śatarudrasaṃhitā of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
sa vipro gṛhamāgatya mahāharṣasamanvitaḥ |
priyāyai kathayāmāsa tadvṛttāntamaśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
स विप्रो गृहमागत्य महाहर्षसमन्वितः |
प्रियायै कथयामास तद्वृत्तान्तमशेषतः ||
title: caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ | gṛhapatyavatāravarṇanam 2
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having returned home accompanied by great joy, that brahmin / related the entire incident to his beloved wife.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā viprapatnī sā mudaṃ prāpa śuciṣmatī |
atīva premasaṃyuktā praśaśaṃsa vidhiṃ nijam ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा विप्रपत्नी सा मुदं प्राप शुचिष्मती |
अतीव प्रेमसंयुक्ता प्रशशंस विधिं निजम् ||
text_mt: Having heard that, Śuciṣmatī, the brahmin’s wife, experienced joy; / filled with immense love, she praised her own fate.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kālena tadyoṣidantarvatnī babhūva ha |
vidhivad vihite tena garbhādhānākhyakarmaṇi ||
meaning:
अथ कालेन तद्योषिदन्तर्वत्नी बभूव ह |
विधिवद् विहिते तेन गर्भाधानाख्यकर्मणि ||
text_mt: Then, in time, his wife became pregnant, / after the rite called conception was duly performed by him according to the rules.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ puṃsavanaṃ tena spandanātprāgvipaścitā |
gṛhyoktavidhinā samyak kṛtaṃ puṃstvavivṛddhaye ||
meaning:
ततः पुंसवनं तेन स्पन्दनात्प्राग्विपश्चिता |
गृह्योक्तविधिना सम्यक् कृतं पुंस्त्वविवृद्धये ||
text_mt: Then, before quickening, the rite to produce a male child was properly performed by the wise man / according to the rules stated in the Gṛhyasūtras, for the increase of masculinity.

sanskrit_iast:
sīmanto'thāṣṭame māse garbharūpasamṛddhikṛt |
sukhaprasavasiddhau ca tenākari kriyāvidā ||
meaning:
सीमन्तोऽथाष्टमे मासे गर्भरूपसमृद्धिकृत् |
सुखप्रसवसिद्धौ च तेनाकरि क्रियाविदा ||
text_mt: Then, in the eighth month, the parting of the hair, which promotes the growth and beauty of the fetus / and ensures an easy delivery, was performed by him who knew the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
athātaḥ śubhatārāsu tārādhipavarānanaḥ |
kendre gurau śubhe lagne sugraheṣu yugeṣu ca ||
meaning:
अथातः शुभतारासु ताराधिपवराननः |
केन्द्रे गुरौ शुभे लग्ने सुग्रहेषु युगेषु च ||
text_mt: Then, under auspicious asterisms, with Jupiter in an angle, under a benign ascendant, / with the planets in auspicious positions and aspects, one whose excellent face was like the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
ariṣṭadīpanirvāṇaḥ sarvāriṣṭavināśakṛt |
tanayo nāma tasyāṃ tu śuciṣmatyāṃ babhūva ha ||
meaning:
अरिष्टदीपनिर्वाणः सर्वारिष्टविनाशकृत् |
तनयो नाम तस्यां तु शुचिष्मत्यां बभूव ह ||
text_mt: a son who was the extinguisher of the flame of misfortune and the destroyer of all evils, / was indeed born to her, Śuciṣmatī.

sanskrit_iast:
śarvaḥ samastasukhado bhūrbhuvaḥsvarnnivāsinām |
gandhavāhanavāhāśca digvadhūrmukhavāsasaḥ ||
meaning:
शर्वः समस्तसुखदो भूर्भुवःस्वर्न्निवासिनाम् |
गन्धवाहनवाहाश्च दिग्वधूर्मुखवाससः ||
text_mt: He was Śarva, bestower of all happiness upon the inhabitants of earth, intermediate space, and heaven; / the breezes wafted sweet fragrances, and the directions were like brides with perfumed mouths.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭagandhaprasūnaughairvavṛṣuste ghanāghanāḥ |
devadundubhayo neduḥ praseduḥ sarvato diśaḥ ||
meaning:
इष्टगन्धप्रसूनौघैर्ववृषुस्ते घनाघनाः |
देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः प्रसेदुः सर्वतो दिशः ||
text_mt: The thick clouds showered streams of delightfully fragrant blossoms; / the celestial drums sounded, and the quarters of the sky became clear everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
paritaḥ saritaḥ svacchā bhūtānāṃ mānasaiḥ saha |
tamo'tāmyattu nitarāṃ rajo'pi virajo'bhavat ||
meaning:
परितः सरितः स्वच्छा भूतानां मानसैः सह |
तमोऽताम्यत्तु नितरां रजोऽपि विरजोऽभवत् ||
text_mt: All around, the rivers became clear along with the minds of living beings; / darkness utterly languished, and passion became free of passion.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvāḥ sattvasamāyuktāḥ sudhāvṛṣṭirbabhūva vai |
kalyāṇī sarvathā vāṇī prāṇinaḥ priyavatyabhūt ||
meaning:
सत्त्वाः सत्त्वसमायुक्ताः सुधावृष्टिर्बभूव वै |
कल्याणी सर्वथा वाणी प्राणिनः प्रियवत्यभूत् ||
text_mt: Living beings became endowed with goodness; a shower of nectar indeed fell; / speech was in every way auspicious, and living beings spoke affectionate words.

sanskrit_iast:
rambhāmukhyā apsaraso maṅgaladravyapāṇayaḥ |
vidyādharyaśca kinnaryastathāmaryaḥ sahasraśaḥ ||
meaning:
रम्भामुख्या अप्सरसो मङ्गलद्रव्यपाणयः |
विद्याधर्यश्च किन्नर्यस्तथामर्यः सहस्रशः ||
text_mt: The apsarases headed by Rambhā, holding auspicious items in their hands, / and Vidyādharīs, Kinnarīs, and immortal women by the thousands,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvoragayakṣāṇāṃ sumāniyaḥ śubhasvarāḥ |
gāyantyo maṅgalaṃ gītaṃ tatrājagmuranekaśaḥ ||
meaning:
गन्धर्वोरगयक्षाणां सुमानियः शुभस्वराः |
गायन्त्यो मङ्गलं गीतं तत्राजग्मुरनेकशः ||
text_mt: and the esteemed women of Gandharvas, Uragas, and Yakṣas, possessing sweet voices, / singing an auspicious song, arrived there in great numbers.

sanskrit_iast:
marīciratriḥ pulahaḥ pulastyaḥ kraturaṅgirāḥ |
vasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapo'gastyo vibhāṇḍo māṇḍavīsutaḥ ||
meaning:
मरीचिरत्रिः पुलहः पुलस्त्यः क्रतुरङ्गिराः |
वसिष्ठः कश्यपोऽगस्त्यो विभाण्डो माण्डवीसुतः ||
text_mt: Marīci, Atri, Pulaha, Pulastya, Kratu, Aṅgiras, / Vasiṣṭha, Kaśyapa, Agastya, Vibhāṇḍa, the son of Māṇḍavī,

sanskrit_iast:
lomaśo romacaraṇo bharadvājo'tha gautamaḥ |
bhṛgustu gālavo gargo jātūkarṇyaḥ parāśaraḥ ||
meaning:
लोमशो रोमचरणो भरद्वाजोऽथ गौतमः |
भृगुस्तु गालवो गर्गो जातूकर्ण्यः पराशरः ||
text_mt: Lomaśa, Romacaraṇa, Bharadvāja, and Gautama, / Bhṛgu, Gālava, Garga, Jātūkarṇya, Parāśara,

sanskrit_iast:
āpastambo yājñavalkyo dakṣavālmīkimudgalāḥ |
śātātapaśca likhitaḥ śilādaḥ śaṅkha uñchabhuk ||
meaning:
आपस्तम्बो याज्ञवल्क्यो दक्षवाल्मीकिमुद्गलाः |
शातातपश्च लिखितः शिलादः शङ्ख उञ्छभुक् ||
text_mt: Āpastamba, Yājñavalkya, Dakṣa, Vālmīki, Mudgala, / Śātātapa, Likhita, Śilāda, Śaṅkha, Uñchabhuk,

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniśca saṃvarto mataṅgo bharatoṃ'śumān |
vyāsaḥ kātyāyanaḥ kutsaḥ śaunakaḥ suśrutaḥ śukaḥ ||
meaning:
जमदग्निश्च संवर्तो मतङ्गो भरतोंऽशुमान् |
व्यासः कात्यायनः कुत्सः शौनकः सुश्रुतः शुकः ||
text_mt: Jamadagni, Saṃvarta, Mataṅga, Bharata, Aṃśumān, / Vyāsa, Kātyāyana, Kutsa, Śaunaka, Suśruta, Śuka,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣyaśṛṅgo'tha durvāsāḥ śucirnāradatumburu |
uttaṅko vāmadevaśca pavano'sitadevalau ||
meaning:
ऋष्यशृङ्गोऽथ दुर्वासाः शुचिर्नारदतुम्बुरु |
उत्तङ्को वामदेवश्च पवनोऽसितदेवलौ ||
text_mt: Ṛṣyaśṛṅga, Durvāsas, Śuci, Nārada, Tumburu, / Uttaṅka, Vāmadeva, Pavana, Asita, Devala,

sanskrit_iast:
sālaṅkāyanahārītau viśvāmitro'tha bhārgavaḥ |
mṛkaṇḍaḥ saha putreṇa parvato dārukastathā ||
meaning:
सालङ्कायनहारीतौ विश्वामित्रोऽथ भार्गवः |
मृकण्डः सह पुत्रेण पर्वतो दारुकस्तथा ||
text_mt: Sālaṅkāyana, Hārīta, Viśvāmitra, and Bhārgava, / Mṛkaṇḍa together with his son, Parvata, and Dāruka,

sanskrit_iast:
dhaumyopamanyuvatsādyā munayo munikanyakāḥ |
tacchāntyarthaṃ samājagmurdhanyaṃ viśvānarāśramam ||
meaning:
धौम्योपमन्युवत्साद्या मुनयो मुनिकन्यकाः |
तच्छान्त्यर्थं समाजग्मुर्धन्यं विश्वानराश्रमम् ||
text_mt: Dhaumya, Upamanyu, Vatsa, and other sages, along with the daughters of sages, / came to the blessed hermitage of Viśvānara to invoke peace.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā bṛhaspatiyuto devo garuḍavāhanaḥ |
nandibhṛṅgisamāyukto gauryā saha vṛṣadhvajaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मा बृहस्पतियुतो देवो गरुडवाहनः |
नन्दिभृङ्गिसमायुक्तो गौर्या सह वृषध्वजः ||
text_mt: Brahmā accompanied by Bṛhaspati, the god whose mount is Garuḍa, / and Vṛṣadhvaja accompanied by Nandin and Bhṛṅgin along with Gaurī,

sanskrit_iast:
mahendramukhyā gīrvāṇā nāgāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ |
ratnānyādāya bahuśaḥ sasaritkā mahābdhayaḥ ||
meaning:
महेन्द्रमुख्या गीर्वाणा नागाः पातालवासिनः |
रत्नान्यादाय बहुशः ससरित्का महाब्धयः ||
text_mt: the gods headed by Mahendra, the serpents dwelling in Pātāla, / and the great oceans together with the rivers, carrying many jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāvarā jaṅgamaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvāyātāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
mahāmahotsave tasmin babhūvākālakaumudī ||
meaning:
स्थावरा जङ्गमं रूपं धृत्वायाताः सहस्रशः |
महामहोत्सवे तस्मिन् बभूवाकालकौमुदी ||
text_mt: [and] immovable beings, assuming moving forms, arrived by the thousands. / In that magnificent festival, an untimely moonlight arose.

sanskrit_iast:
jātakarma svayaṃ tasya kṛtavānvidhirānataḥ |
śrutiṃ vicārya tadrūpaṃ nāmnā gṛhapatistvayam ||
meaning:
जातकर्म स्वयं तस्य कृतवान्विधिरानतः |
श्रुतिं विचार्य तद्रूपं नाम्ना गृहपतिस्त्वयम् ||
text_mt: Brahmā himself reverently performed his birth rite; / having consulted the Vedic scripture, regarding that form: “He is Gṛhapati by name.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti nāma dadau tasmai deyamekādaśe'hani |
nāmakarmavidhānena tadarthaṃ śrutimuccaran ||
meaning:
इति नाम ददौ तस्मै देयमेकादशेऽहनि |
नामकर्मविधानेन तदर्थं श्रुतिमुच्चरन् ||
text_mt: Thus he gave him that name, which was to be given on the eleventh day, / reciting scripture for that purpose in accordance with the rule of the naming ceremony.

sanskrit_iast:
caturnigamamantroktairāśīrbhirabhinandya ca |
samayāddhaṃ samāruhya sarveṣāṃ ca pitāmahaḥ ||
meaning:
चतुर्निगममन्त्रोक्तैराशीर्भिरभिनन्द्य च |
समयाद्धं समारुह्य सर्वेषां च पितामहः ||
text_mt: And having blessed [him] with blessings spoken in mantras of the four Vedas, / the Grandfather of all, having mounted his swan according to custom,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā bālocitāṃ rakṣāṃ laukikīṃ gatimāśritaḥ |
āruhya yānaṃ svaṃ dhāma haro'pi hariṇā yayau ||
meaning:
कृत्वा बालोचितां रक्षां लौकिकीं गतिमाश्रितः |
आरुह्य यानं स्वं धाम हरोऽपि हरिणा ययौ ||
text_mt: having performed the protection appropriate for a child, following the worldly manner, / Hara too, having mounted his vehicle, went to his own abode along with Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
aho rūpamaho tejastvaho sarvāṅgalakṣaṇam |
aho śuciṣmatībhāgyamāvirāsītsvayaṃ haraḥ ||
meaning:
अहो रूपमहो तेजस्त्वहो सर्वाङ्गलक्षणम् |
अहो शुचिष्मतीभाग्यमाविरासीत्स्वयं हरः ||
text_mt: “Ah, what beauty! Ah, what splendour! Ah, auspicious marks on every limb! / Ah, the fortune of Śuciṣmatī! Hara himself has manifested!”

sanskrit_iast:
athavā kimidaṃ citraṃ śarvabhaktajaneṣvaho |
svayamāvirabhūd rudro yato rudrastadarcitaḥ ||
meaning:
अथवा किमिदं चित्रं शर्वभक्तजनेष्वहो |
स्वयमाविरभूद् रुद्रो यतो रुद्रस्तदर्चितः ||
text_mt: “Or rather, what wonder is this among the devotees of Śarva? Ah, / Rudra himself has manifested, since Rudra was worshipped by him.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti stuvantaste'nyo'nyaṃ samprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ |
viśvānaraṃ samāpṛcchya jagmuḥ sarve yathāgatam ||
meaning:
इति स्तुवन्तस्तेऽन्योऽन्यं सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः |
विश्वानरं समापृच्छ्य जग्मुः सर्वे यथागतम् ||
text_mt: Praising one another thus with their bodily hairs thrilled with joy, / they all took leave of Viśvānara and went away as they had come.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ putraṃ samīhante gṛhasthāśramavāsinaḥ |
putreṇa lokāñjayati śrutireṣā sanātanī ||
meaning:
अतः पुत्रं समीहन्ते गृहस्थाश्रमवासिनः |
पुत्रेण लोकाञ्जयति श्रुतिरेषा सनातनी ||
text_mt: Therefore, those dwelling in the householder stage of life desire a son: / “Through a son one conquers worlds”—this is eternal Vedic scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
aputrasya gṛhaṃ śūnyamaputrasyārjanaṃ vṛthā |
aputrasya tapaśchinnaṃ no pavitratyaputrataḥ ||
meaning:
अपुत्रस्य गृहं शून्यमपुत्रस्यार्जनं वृथा |
अपुत्रस्य तपश्छिन्नं नो पवित्रत्यपुत्रतः ||
text_mt: The house of a sonless man is empty; the earnings of a sonless man are in vain; / the austerity of a sonless man is broken; nothing becomes pure without a son.

sanskrit_iast:
na putrātparamo lābho na putrātparamaṃ sukham |
na putrātparamaṃ mitraṃ paratreha ca kutracit ||
meaning:
न पुत्रात्परमो लाभो न पुत्रात्परमं सुखम् |
न पुत्रात्परमं मित्रं परत्रेह च कुत्रचित् ||
text_mt: There is no gain higher than a son; there is no happiness higher than a son; / there is no friend higher than a son anywhere, in the hereafter or in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkramo'tha caturthe'sya māsi pitrā kṛto gṛhāt |
annaprāśanamabdārddhe cūḍābde cārthavatkṛtā ||
meaning:
निष्क्रमोऽथ चतुर्थेऽस्य मासि पित्रा कृतो गृहात् |
अन्नप्राशनमब्दार्द्धे चूडाब्दे चार्थवत्कृता ||
text_mt: Then, in his fourth month, his outgoing from the house was performed by the father; / the first feeding of solid food was performed at half a year, and the tonsure in the [first] year, according to proper meaning.

sanskrit_iast:
karṇavedhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śravaṇarkṣe sa karmavit |
brahmatejobhivṛddhyarthaṃ pañcame'bde vrataṃ dadau ||
meaning:
कर्णवेधं ततः कृत्वा श्रवणर्क्षे स कर्मवित् |
ब्रह्मतेजोभिवृद्ध्यर्थं पञ्चमेऽब्दे व्रतं ददौ ||
text_mt: Then, having performed the ear-piercing under the asterism Śravaṇa, he who knew rites / gave him the vow [of the sacred thread] in his fifth year for the increase of brahmanic lustre.

sanskrit_iast:
upākarma tataḥ kṛtvā vedānadhyāpayatsudhīḥ |
tryabdaṃ vedānsa vidhinādhyaiṣṭa sāṅgapadakramān ||
meaning:
उपाकर्म ततः कृत्वा वेदानध्यापयत्सुधीः |
त्र्यब्दं वेदान्स विधिनाध्यैष्ट साङ्गपदक्रमान् ||
text_mt: Then, having performed the commencement rite, the wise one taught him the Vedas; / for three years he studied the Vedas in accordance with rule, with their limbs, words, and sequential recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyājātaṃ samastaṃ ca sākṣimātraṃ gurormukhāt |
vinayādiguṇānāviṣkurvañjagrāha śaktimān ||
meaning:
विद्याजातं समस्तं च साक्षिमात्रं गुरोर्मुखात् |
विनयादिगुणानाविष्कुर्वञ्जग्राह शक्तिमान् ||
text_mt: And the capable boy grasped the entire collection of lore / as a mere witness from the mouth of his guru, displaying virtues such as modesty.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'tha navame varṣe pitroḥ śuśrūṣaṇe ratam |
vaiśvānaraṃ gṛhapatiṃ draṣṭumāyācca nāradaḥ ||
meaning:
ततोऽथ नवमे वर्षे पित्रोः शुश्रूषणे रतम् |
वैश्वानरं गृहपतिं द्रष्टुमायाच्च नारदः ||
text_mt: Then, in his ninth year, to see that son of Viśvānara, / Gṛhapati, devoted to serving his parents, Nārada came.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvānaroṭajaṃ prāpya devarṣistaṃ tu kautukī |
apṛcchatkuśalaṃ tatra gṛhītārghāsanaḥ kramāt ||
meaning:
विश्वानरोटजं प्राप्य देवर्षिस्तं तु कौतुकी |
अपृच्छत्कुशलं तत्र गृहीतार्घासनः क्रमात् ||
text_mt: Having reached the hut of Viśvānara, the divine sage, being inquisitive, / inquired about their welfare there, having received the seat and water of respect in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sarvaṃ ca tadbhāgyaṃ putradharmaṃ ca sammukhe |
viśvānaraṃ samavadatsmṛtvā śivapadāmbujam ||
meaning:
ततः सर्वं च तद्भाग्यं पुत्रधर्मं च सम्मुखे |
विश्वानरं समवदत्स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्बुजम् ||
text_mt: Then, remembering the lotus feet of Śiva, he spoke before Viśvānara / concerning all that good fortune and the duty of a son.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityukto muninā bālaḥ pitrorājñāmavāpya saḥ |
praṇamya nāradaṃ śrīmān bhaktyā prahva upāviśata ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्तो मुनिना बालः पित्रोराज्ञामवाप्य सः |
प्रणम्य नारदं श्रीमान् भक्त्या प्रह्व उपाविशत ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Thus addressed by the sage, that illustrious boy, having received permission from his parents / and bowed down to Nārada, sat down humbly with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca |
vaiśvānara samabhyehi mamotsaṅge niṣīda bhoḥ |
lakṣaṇāni parīkṣe'haṃ pāṇiṃ darśaya dakṣiṇam ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच |
वैश्वानर समभ्येहि ममोत्सङ्गे निषीद भोः |
लक्षणानि परीक्षेऽहं पाणिं दर्शय दक्षिणम् ||
text_mt: Nārada said: / “Come near, son of Viśvānara! Sit on my lap, O boy! / I shall examine the auspicious marks; show me your right hand.”

sanskrit_iast:
tato dṛṣṭvā tu sarvaṃ hi tālujihvādi nāradaḥ |
viśvānaraṃ samavadacchivapreraṇayā sudhīḥ ||
meaning:
ततो दृष्ट्वा तु सर्वं हि तालुजिह्वादि नारदः |
विश्वानरं समवदच्छिवप्रेरणया सुधीः ||
text_mt: Then, having examined everything—palate, tongue, and the rest—the wise Nārada / spoke to Viśvānara by the impulse of Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca |
viśvānara mune vacmi śṛṇu putrāṅkamādarāt |
sarvāṅgasvaṅkavānputro mahālakṣaṇavānayam ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच |
विश्वानर मुने वच्मि शृणु पुत्राङ्कमादरात् |
सर्वाङ्गस्वङ्कवान्पुत्रो महालक्षणवानयम् ||
text_mt: Nārada said: / “O sage Viśvānara, hear with attention; I speak of the marks on your son’s body. / This son possesses auspicious marks on all his limbs and has great auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
kintu sarvaguṇopetaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam |
sampūrṇanirmalakalaṃ pālayedvidhuvadvidhiḥ ||
meaning:
किन्तु सर्वगुणोपेतं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् |
सम्पूर्णनिर्मलकलं पालयेद्विधुवद्विधिः ||
text_mt: Yet, may the Creator protect him, endowed with all virtues and marked with all auspicious marks, / possessed of complete and spotless digits, like the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena rakṣaṇīyastvasau śiśuḥ |
guṇo'pi doṣatāṃ yāti vakrībhūte vidhātari ||
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन रक्षणीयस्त्वसौ शिशुः |
गुणोऽपि दोषतां याति वक्रीभूते विधातरि ||
text_mt: Therefore, this child must be protected by every effort; / even a virtue turns into a fault when the Creator becomes adverse.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅke'sya dvādaśe varṣe pratyūho vidyudagnitaḥ |
ityuktvā nārado'gacchaddevalokaṃ yathāgatam ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
शङ्केऽस्य द्वादशे वर्षे प्रत्यूहो विद्युदग्नितः |
इत्युक्त्वा नारदोऽगच्छद्देवलोकं यथागतम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
I suspect that in his twelfth year an obstacle will arise from the fire of lightning.” / Having said this, Nārada went to the realm of the gods as he had come.

Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, titled “Description of the Incarnation of Gṛhapati,” in the account of the incarnation of Gṛhapati, in the third [saṃhitā], the Śatarudrasaṃhitā of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
viśvānaraḥ sapatnīkaḥ tacchrutvā nāraderitam |
tadevaṃ manyamāno'bhūdvajrapātaṃ sudāruṇam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
विश्वानरः सपत्नीकः तच्छ्रुत्वा नारदेरितम् |
तदेवं मन्यमानोऽभूद्वज्रपातं सुदारुणम् ||
title: pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | gṛhapatyavatāravarṇanam 3
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having heard what was said by Nārada, Viśvānara along with his wife, / considering it to be thus, experienced a dreadful thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast:
hā hato'smīti vacasā hṛdayaṃ samatāḍayat |
mūrcchāmavāpa mahatīṃ putraśokasamākulaḥ ||
meaning:
हा हतोऽस्मीति वचसा हृदयं समताडयत् |
मूर्च्छामवाप महतीं पुत्रशोकसमाकुलः ||
text_mt: Crying, “Alas! I am undone!”, he struck his breast with his words; / bewildered by grief for his son, he fell into a deep swoon.

sanskrit_iast:
śuciṣmatyapi duḥkhārtā rurodātīva dussaham |
atisvareṇa hārāvairatyantaṃ vyākulendriyā ||
meaning:
शुचिष्मत्यपि दुःखार्ता रुरोदातीव दुस्सहम् |
अतिस्वरेण हारावैरत्यन्तं व्याकुलेन्द्रिया ||
text_mt: Śuciṣmatī too, afflicted with pain, wept bitterly, unbearable [grief], / with loud weeping and cries of woe, her senses utterly bewildered.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvārtanādamiti viśvanaro'pi mohaṃ hitvotthitaḥ kimiti kiṃ tviti kiṃ kimetat |
uccairvadan gṛhapatiḥ kva sa me bahisthaḥ prāṇo'ntarātmanilayassakalendriyeśaḥ ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वार्तनादमिति विश्वनरोऽपि मोहं हित्वोत्थितः किमिति किं त्विति किं किमेतत् |
उच्चैर्वदन् गृहपतिः क्व स मे बहिस्थः प्राणोऽन्तरात्मनिलयस्सकलेन्द्रियेशः ||
text_mt: Hearing that cry of distress, Viśvānara also discarded his stupor and arose, / crying out loudly: “What is this? What indeed? What, what is this? / Where is he, my Gṛhapati, my external life-breath, who resides in my inner self, the lord of all my senses?”

sanskrit_iast:
tato dṛṣṭvā sa pitarau bahuśokasamāvṛtau |
smitvovāca gṛhapatiḥ sabālaḥ śaṅkarāṃśajaḥ ||
meaning:
ततो दृष्ट्वा स पितरौ बहुशोकसमावृतौ |
स्मित्वोवाच गृहपतिः सबालः शङ्करांशजः ||
text_mt: Then, seeing his two parents enveloped in great grief, / that boy Gṛhapati, born of a portion of Śaṅkara, smiled and spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhapatiruvāca |
he mātastāta kiṃ jātaṃ kāraṇaṃ tadvadādhunā |
kimarthaṃ rudito'tyarthaṃ trāsastādṛk kuto hi vām ||
meaning:
गृहपतिरुवाच |
हे मातस्तात किं जातं कारणं तद्वदाधुना |
किमर्थं रुदितोऽत्यर्थं त्रासस्तादृक् कुतो हि वाम् ||
text_mt: Gṛhapati said: / “O mother! O father! What has happened? Tell that cause now. / Why this excessive weeping? Whence indeed has such fear come upon you two?

sanskrit_iast:
na māṃ kṛtavapustrāṇaṃ bhavaccaraṇareṇubhiḥ |
kālaḥ kalayituṃ śakto varākī cañcalālpikā ||
meaning:
न मां कृतवपुस्त्राणं भवच्चरणरेणुभिः |
कालः कलयितुं शक्तो वराकी चञ्चलाल्पिका ||
text_mt: When my body has been shielded by the dust of your feet, / Time cannot seize me, nor can that wretched, fickle, petty thing [lightning].

sanskrit_iast:
pratijñāṃ śṛṇutāṃ tātau yadi vāṃ tanayo hyaham |
kariṣye'haṃ tathā yena mṛtyustrasto bhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
प्रतिज्ञां शृणुतां तातौ यदि वां तनयो ह्यहम् |
करिष्येऽहं तथा येन मृत्युस्त्रस्तो भविष्यति ||
text_mt: O parents, listen to my vow, if indeed I am your son: / I shall act in such a way that Death itself will be terrified.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtyuñjayaṃ samārādhya sarvajñaṃ sarvadaṃ satām |
japiṣyāmi mahākālaṃ satyaṃ tātau vadāmyaham ||
meaning:
मृत्युञ्जयं समाराध्य सर्वज्ञं सर्वदं सताम् |
जपिष्यामि महाकालं सत्यं तातौ वदाम्यहम् ||
text_mt: Having propitiated Mṛtyuñjaya, the omniscient, the giver of everything to the virtuous, / I shall recite [the mantra of] Mahākāla; truly I say to you, O parents!”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti śrutvā vacastasya jāritau dvijadampatī |
akālāmṛtavarṣaughairgatatāpau tadocatuḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य जारितौ द्विजदम्पती |
अकालामृतवर्षौघैर्गततापौ तदोचतुः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing his words, the two twice-born spouses, brought to life / as if by untimely showers of nectar, their anguish gone, then said:

sanskrit_iast:
dvijadampatī ūcatuḥ |
punarbrūhi punarbrūhi kīdṛk kīdṛk punarvada |
kālaḥ kalayituṃ nālaṃ varākī cañcalāsti kā ||
meaning:
द्विजदम्पती ऊचतुः |
पुनर्ब्रूहि पुनर्ब्रूहि कीदृक् कीदृक् पुनर्वद |
कालः कलयितुं नालं वराकी चञ्चलास्ति का ||
text_mt: The two twice-born spouses said: / “Say it again! Say it again! How is it? How is it? Tell us again! / Time is not able to seize you? Who is that wretched, fickle thing?

sanskrit_iast:
āvayostāpanāśāya mahopāyastvayeritaḥ |
mṛtyuñjayākhyadevasya samārādhanalakṣaṇaḥ ||
meaning:
आवयोस्तापनाशाय महोपायस्त्वयेरितः |
मृत्युञ्जयाख्यदेवस्य समाराधनलक्षणः ||
text_mt: A great means for the destruction of our distress has been spoken by you, / consisting in the propitiation of the god known as Mṛtyuñjaya.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvacca śaraṇaṃ śambhornātaḥ parataraṃ hi tat |
manorathapathātītakāriṇaḥ pāpahāriṇaḥ ||
meaning:
तद्वच्च शरणं शम्भोर्नातः परतरं हि तत् |
मनोरथपथातीतकारिणः पापहारिणः ||
text_mt: Likewise, taking refuge in Śambhu—for nothing is higher than that— / who performs what is beyond the path of desire and takes away sins.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ na śrutaṃ tvayā tāta śvetaketuṃ yathā purā |
pāśitaṃ kālapāśena rarakṣa tripurāntakaḥ ||
meaning:
किं न श्रुतं त्वया तात श्वेतकेतुं यथा पुरा |
पाशितं कालपाशेन ररक्ष त्रिपुरान्तकः ||
text_mt: Did you not hear, O dear one, how formerly the destroyer of Tripura / protected Śvetaketu when he was bound by the noose of Time?

sanskrit_iast:
śilādatanayaṃ mṛtyugrastamaṣṭābdamātrakam |
śivo nijajanaṃ cakre nandinaṃ viśvanandinam ||
meaning:
शिलादतनयं मृत्युग्रस्तमष्टाब्दमात्रकम् |
शिवो निजजनं चक्रे नन्दिनं विश्वनन्दिनम् ||
text_mt: When the son of Śilāda was seized by death at only eight years old, / Śiva made Nandin his own attendant, delighting the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrodamathanodbhūtaṃ pralayānalasannibham |
pītvā hālāhalaṃ ghoramarakṣadbhuvanatrayam ||
meaning:
क्षीरोदमथनोद्भूतं प्रलयानलसन्निभम् |
पीत्वा हालाहलं घोरमरक्षद्भुवनत्रयम् ||
text_mt: Having drunk the terrible hālāhala poison, which arose from the churning of the milk ocean / and resembled the fire of cosmic dissolution, he protected the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
jalandharaṃ mahādarpaṃ hṛtatrailokyasampadam |
rucirāṅguṣṭharekhotthacakreṇa nijaghāna yaḥ ||
meaning:
जलन्धरं महादर्पं हृतत्रैलोक्यसम्पदम् |
रुचिराङ्गुष्ठरेखोत्थचक्रेण निजघान यः ||
text_mt: He who struck down Jalandhara, of great arrogance, / who had seized the wealth of the three worlds, with a discus that arose from the line of his charming big toe!”

sanskrit_iast:
ya ekeṣunipātotthajvalanaistripurampurā |
trailokyaiśvaryasammūḍhaṃ śoṣayāmāsa bhānunā ||
meaning:
य एकेषुनिपातोत्थज्वलनैस्त्रिपुरम्पुरा |
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यसम्मूढं शोषयामास भानुना ||
text_mt: He who formerly, with the fires arising from the fall of a single arrow, / dried up the city of Tripura, delusion-blinded by lordship over the three worlds, through the sun;

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaṃ dṛṣṭinipātena trailokyavijayorjitam |
nināyānaṅgapadavīṃ vīkṣyamāṇeṣvajādiṣu ||
meaning:
कामं दृष्टिनिपातेन त्रैलोक्यविजयोर्जितम् |
निनायानङ्गपदवीं वीक्ष्यमाणेष्वजादिषु ||
text_mt: who reduced Kāma, mighty with victory over the three worlds, / to the state of the bodiless one with a glance of his eye while Aja and the other [gods] were watching;

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ brahmādyaikakartāraṃ meghavāhanamacyutam |
prayāhi putra śaraṇaṃ viśvarakṣāmaṇiṃ śivam ||
meaning:
तं ब्रह्माद्यैककर्तारं मेघवाहनमच्युतम् |
प्रयाहि पुत्र शरणं विश्वरक्षामणिं शिवम् ||
text_mt: go, my son, for refuge to him, the sole maker of Brahmā and the others, whose mount is the cloud, the imperishable, / the crest-jewel protecting the universe, Śiva."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
pitroranujñāṃ prāpyeti praṇamya caraṇau tayoḥ |
prādakṣiṇyamupāvṛtya bahvāśvāsya viniryayau ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
पित्रोरनुज्ञां प्राप्येति प्रणम्य चरणौ तयोः |
प्रादक्षिण्यमुपावृत्य बह्वाश्वास्य विनिर्ययौ ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Having thus received the permission of his parents and bowed to their feet, / he circumambulated them, comforted them greatly, and set out.

sanskrit_iast:
samprāpya kāśīṃ duṣprāpāṃ brahmanārāyaṇādibhiḥ |
mahāsaṃvarttasantāpahantrīṃ viśveśapālitām ||
meaning:
सम्प्राप्य काशीं दुष्प्रापां ब्रह्मनारायणादिभिः |
महासंवर्त्तसन्तापहन्त्रीं विश्वेशपालिताम् ||
text_mt: Reaching Kāśī, hard to attain by Brahmā, Nārāyaṇa, and the others, / the destroyer of the torment of the great cosmic dissolution, protected by the lord of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
svardhunyā hārayaṣṭyeva rājitāṃ kaṇṭhabhūmiṣu |
vicitraguṇaśālinyā harapatnyā virājitām ||
meaning:
स्वर्धुन्या हारयष्ट्येव राजितां कण्ठभूमिषु |
विचित्रगुणशालिन्या हरपत्न्या विराजिताम् ||
text_mt: resplendent with the river of heaven as if with a necklace about its neck-regions, / adorned by Hara's wife endowed with wondrous virtues;

sanskrit_iast:
tatra prāpya sa vipreśaḥ prāgyayau maṇikarṇikām |
tatra snātvā vidhānena dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃ prabhum ||
meaning:
तत्र प्राप्य स विप्रेशः प्राग्ययौ मणिकर्णिकाम् |
तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन दृष्ट्वा विश्वेश्वरं प्रभुम् ||
text_mt: arriving there, that best of brahmins first went to Maṇikarṇikā; / bathing there according to rule and seeing the lord Viśveśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
sāñjalirnataśīrṣo'sau mahānandānvitaḥ sudhīḥ |
trailokyaprāṇasantrāṇakāriṇaṃ praṇanāma ha ||
meaning:
साञ्जलिर्नतशीर्षोऽसौ महानन्दान्वितः सुधीः |
त्रैलोक्यप्राणसन्त्राणकारिणं प्रणनाम ह ||
text_mt: with folded hands, bowed head, filled with great joy, the wise boy / bowed down to the savior of the breath of life of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
ālokyālokya talliṅgaṃ tutoṣa hṛdaye muhuḥ |
paramānandakandāḍhyaṃ sphuṭametanna saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
आलोक्यालोक्य तल्लिङ्गं तुतोष हृदये मुहुः |
परमानन्दकन्दाढ्यं स्फुटमेतन्न संशयः ||
text_mt: Gazing again and again upon that liṅga, he rejoiced repeatedly in his heart; / it was rich as the root of supreme bliss, evident beyond doubt:

sanskrit_iast:
aho na matto dhanyo'sti trailokye sacarācare |
yadadrākṣiṣamadyāhaṃ śrīmadviśveśvaraṃ vibhum ||
meaning:
अहो न मत्तो धन्योऽस्ति त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे |
यदद्राक्षिषमद्याहं श्रीमद्विश्वेश्वरं विभुम् ||
text_mt: "Ah, there is none more blessed than me in the three worlds with their moving and unmoving beings, / since today I have beheld the glorious lord Viśveśvara!

sanskrit_iast:
mama bhāgyodayāyaiva nāradena maharṣiṇā |
purāgatya tathoktaṃ yatkṛtakṛtyo'smyahaṃ tataḥ ||
meaning:
मम भाग्योदयायैव नारदेन महर्षिणा |
पुरागत्य तथोक्तं यत्कृतकृत्योऽस्म्यहं ततः ||
text_mt: It was indeed for the dawning of my good fortune that the great sage Nārada / formerly came and spoke in that way, through which I have accomplished my purpose!"

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityānandāmṛtarasairvidhāya sa hi pāraṇam |
tataḥ śubhe'hni saṃsthāpya liṅgaṃ sarvahitapradam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्यानन्दामृतरसैर्विधाय स हि पारणम् |
ततः शुभेऽह्नि संस्थाप्य लिङ्गं सर्वहितप्रदम् ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Having thus broken his fast with the nectar-rasas of joy, / he then, on an auspicious day, installed a liṅga conferring all welfare;

sanskrit_iast:
jagrāha niyamānghorān duṣkarānakṛtātmabhiḥ |
aṣṭottaraśataiḥ kumbhaiḥ pūrṇairgaṅgā'mbhasā śubhaiḥ ||
meaning:
जग्राह नियमान्घोरान् दुष्करानकृतात्मभिः |
अष्टोत्तरशतैः कुम्भैः पूर्णैर्गङ्गाऽम्भसा शुभैः ||
text_mt: he undertook severe observances, hard to perform by the undisciplined. / With one hundred and eight auspicious jars filled with Gaṅgā water,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsnāpya vāsasā pūtaiḥ pūtātmā pratyahaṃ śivam |
nīlotpalamayīṃ mālāṃ samarpayati so'nvaham ||
meaning:
संस्नाप्य वाससा पूतैः पूतात्मा प्रत्यहं शिवम् |
नीलोत्पलमयीं मालां समर्पयति सोऽन्वहम् ||
text_mt: having bathed Śiva daily with pure [waters filtered by] cloth, purified in soul, / he offered every day a garland made of blue lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādhikasahasraistu sumanobhirvinirmitām |
sa pakṣe vātha vā māse kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ ||
meaning:
अष्टाधिकसहस्रैस्तु सुमनोभिर्विनिर्मिताम् |
स पक्षे वाथ वा मासे कन्दमूलफलाशनः ||
text_mt: fashioned from one thousand and eight blossoms. / Eating bulbs, roots, and fruits once a fortnight or once a month,

sanskrit_iast:
śīrṇaparṇāśanairdhīraḥ ṣaṇmāsaṃ sambabhūva saḥ |
ṣaṇmāsaṃ vāyubhakṣo'bhūtṣaṇmāsaṃ jalabindubhuk ||
meaning:
शीर्णपर्णाशनैर्धीरः षण्मासं सम्बभूव सः |
षण्मासं वायुभक्षोऽभूत्षण्मासं जलबिन्दुभुक् ||
text_mt: that steadfast boy subsisted on fallen withered leaves for six months; / for six months he fed on air, and for six months he consumed [only] drops of water.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ varṣadvayaṃ tasya vyatikrāntaṃ mahātmanaḥ |
śivaikamanaso viprāstapyamānasya nārada ||
meaning:
एवं वर्षद्वयं तस्य व्यतिक्रान्तं महात्मनः |
शिवैकमनसो विप्रास्तप्यमानस्य नारद ||
text_mt: In this way, two years passed for that great-souled boy / practicing austerity, his mind fixed solely on Śiva, O Nārada, [foremost of] brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
janmato dvādaśe varṣe tadvaco nāraderitam |
satyaṃ kariṣyanniva tamabhyagātkuliśāyudhaḥ ||
meaning:
जन्मतो द्वादशे वर्षे तद्वचो नारदेरितम् |
सत्यं करिष्यन्निव तमभ्यगात्कुलिशायुधः ||
text_mt: In the twelfth year from his birth, as if to make true / the word spoken by Nārada, the thunderbolt-armed [Indra] approached him.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca ca varaṃ brūhi dadmi tvanmanasi sthitam |
ahaṃ śatakraturvipra prasanno'smi śubhavrataiḥ ||
meaning:
उवाच च वरं ब्रूहि दद्मि त्वन्मनसि स्थितम् |
अहं शतक्रतुर्विप्र प्रसन्नोऽस्मि शुभव्रतैः ||
text_mt: And he said: "Choose a boon! I give whatever is in your mind; / I am Śatakratu, O brahmin, pleased with your auspicious observances."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityākarṇya mahendrasya vākyaṃ munikumārakaḥ |
uvāca madhuraṃ dhīraḥ kīrtayanmadhurākṣaram ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य महेन्द्रस्य वाक्यं मुनिकुमारकः |
उवाच मधुरं धीरः कीर्तयन्मधुराक्षरम् ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Having heard this utterance of Mahendra, the young son of a sage, / steadfast, spoke sweetly, reciting sweet syllables:

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhapatiruvāca |
maghavan vṛtraśatro tvāṃ jāne kuliśapāṇinam |
nāhaṃ vṛṇe varaṃ tvattaḥ śaṅkaro varado'sti me ||
meaning:
गृहपतिरुवाच |
मघवन् वृत्रशत्रो त्वां जाने कुलिशपाणिनम् |
नाहं वृणे वरं त्वत्तः शङ्करो वरदोऽस्ति मे ||
text_mt:
Gṛhapati said:
"O Maghavan, foe of Vṛtra, I know you with the thunderbolt in hand; / I do not choose a boon from you; Śaṅkara is the giver of my boons."

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca |
na mattaḥ śaṅkarastvanyo devadevo'smyahaṃ śiśo |
vihāya bāliśatvaṃ tvaṃ varaṃ yācasva mā ciram ||
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच |
न मत्तः शङ्करस्त्वन्यो देवदेवोऽस्म्यहं शिशो |
विहाय बालिशत्वं त्वं वरं याचस्व मा चिरम् ||
text_mt:
Indra said:
"There is no Śaṅkara other than me; I am the god of gods, O child! / Giving up childishness, ask a boon without delay!"

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhapatiruvāca |
gacchāhalyāpate'sādho gotrāre pākaśāsana |
na prārthaye paśupateranyaṃ devāntaraṃ sphuṭam ||
meaning:
गृहपतिरुवाच |
गच्छाहल्यापतेऽसाधो गोत्रारे पाकशासन |
न प्रार्थये पशुपतेरन्यं देवान्तरं स्फुटम् ||
text_mt:
Gṛhapati said:
"Go, O husband of Ahalyā, unvirtuous one, foe of mountains, Pākaśāsana! / Clearly, I pray to no other deity apart from Paśupati."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ |
udyamya kuliśaṃ ghoraṃ bhīṣayāmāsa bālakam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः |
उद्यम्य कुलिशं घोरं भीषयामास बालकम् ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Having heard his word, with eyes reddened by anger, / raising his dreadful thunderbolt, [Indra] terrified the boy.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dṛṣṭvā bālako vajraṃ vidyujjvālāsamākulam |
smarannāradavākyaṃ ca mumūrccha bhayavihvalaḥ ||
meaning:
स दृष्ट्वा बालको वज्रं विद्युज्ज्वालासमाकुलम् |
स्मरन्नारदवाक्यं च मुमूर्च्छ भयविह्वलः ||
text_mt: Seeing the thunderbolt filled with flares of lightning, / and remembering Nārada's words, that boy fainted, overcome with fear.

sanskrit_iast:
atha gaurīpatiḥ śambhurāvirāsīttamonudaḥ |
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te sparśaiḥ sañjīvayanniva ||
meaning:
अथ गौरीपतिः शम्भुराविरासीत्तमोनुदः |
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भद्रं ते स्पर्शैः सञ्जीवयन्निव ||
text_mt: Then Śambhu, husband of Gaurī, the dispeller of darkness, appeared, / as if reviving him with his touch: "Arise, arise! May welfare be yours!"

sanskrit_iast:
unmīlya netrakamale supte iva dinakṣaye |
apaśyadagre cotthāya śambhumarkaśatādhikam ||
meaning:
उन्मील्य नेत्रकमले सुप्ते इव दिनक्षये |
अपश्यदग्रे चोत्थाय शम्भुमर्कशताधिकम् ||
text_mt: Opening the two lotuses of his eyes, as if asleep at the close of day, / and standing up, he saw before him Śambhu, brighter than a hundred suns,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāle locanamālokya kaṇṭhekālaṃ vṛṣadhvajam |
vāmāṅgasanniviṣṭādritanayaṃ candraśekharam ||
meaning:
भाले लोचनमालोक्य कण्ठेकालं वृषध्वजम् |
वामाङ्गसन्निविष्टाद्रितनयं चन्द्रशेखरम् ||
text_mt: seeing the eye on his forehead, the blue-throated, Vṛṣadhvaja, / with the daughter of the mountain seated on his left side, moon-crested,

sanskrit_iast:
kapardena virājantaṃ triśūlājagavāyudham |
sphuratkarpūragaurāṅgaṃ pariṇaddhagajājinam ||
meaning:
कपर्देन विराजन्तं त्रिशूलाजगवायुधम् |
स्फुरत्कर्पूरगौराङ्गं परिणद्धगजाजिनम् ||
text_mt: splendid with matted locks, weaponed with the trident and the Ajagava bow, / his limbs radiant and white like camphor, clad in an elephant hide.

sanskrit_iast:
parijñāya mahādevaṃ guruvākyata āgamāt |
harṣabāṣpākulāsannakaṇṭharomāñcakañcukaḥ ||
meaning:
परिज्ञाय महादेवं गुरुवाक्यत आगमात् |
हर्षबाष्पाकुलासन्नकण्ठरोमाञ्चकञ्चुकः ||
text_mt: Recognizing Mahādeva from the word of his guru and from tradition, / his throat choked with tears of joy, his body armored with horripilation,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇaṃ ca girivattasthau citrakṛtrimaputrakaḥ |
yathā tathā susampanno vismṛtyātmānameva ca ||
meaning:
क्षणं च गिरिवत्तस्थौ चित्रकृत्रिमपुत्रकः |
यथा तथा सुसम्पन्नो विस्मृत्यात्मानमेव च ||
text_mt: he stood for a moment like a mountain, like a painted puppet, / completely still, forgetting his very self.

sanskrit_iast:
na stotuṃ na namaskartuṃ kiñcidvijñaptumeva ca |
yadā sa na śaśākālaṃ tadā smitvāha śaṅkaraḥ ||
meaning:
न स्तोतुं न नमस्कर्तुं किञ्चिद्विज्ञप्तुमेव च |
यदा स न शशाकालं तदा स्मित्वाह शङ्करः ||
text_mt: When he was unable to praise, nor to bow down, / nor even to make any request, then Śaṅkara smiled and said:

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca |
śiśo gṛhapate śakrādvajrodyatakarādaho |
jñātaṃ bhīto'si mā bhaiṣīrjijñāsā te mayā kṛtā ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच |
शिशो गृहपते शक्राद्वज्रोद्यतकरादहो |
ज्ञातं भीतोऽसि मा भैषीर्जिज्ञासा ते मया कृता ||
text_mt:
The Lord said:
"O child, Gṛhapati! Ah, you were terrified / of Śakra whose hand raised the thunderbolt; I know, do not fear! A test was made by me.

sanskrit_iast:
mama bhaktasya no śakro na vajraṃ cāntako'pi ca |
prabhavedindrarūpeṇa mayaiva tvaṃ bibhīṣitaḥ ||
meaning:
मम भक्तस्य नो शक्रो न वज्रं चान्तकोऽपि च |
प्रभवेदिन्द्ररूपेण मयैव त्वं बिभीषितः ||
text_mt: Neither Śakra, nor the thunderbolt, nor even death can prevail / over my devotee; you were frightened by me alone in the form of Indra!

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ dadāmi te bhadra tvamagnipadabhāgbhava |
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ varadastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ||
meaning:
वरं ददामि ते भद्र त्वमग्निपदभाग्भव |
सर्वेषामेव देवानां वरदस्त्वं भविष्यसि ||
text_mt: I grant you a boon, O good one: become the recipient of the position of Agni! / You shall be the grantor of boons to all the gods!

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ tvamagne'ntaścaro bhava |
dharmarājendrayormadhye digīśo rājyamāpnuhi ||
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव भूतानां त्वमग्नेऽन्तश्चरो भव |
धर्मराजेन्द्रयोर्मध्ये दिगीशो राज्यमाप्नुहि ||
text_mt: O Agni, be the one who moves inside all living beings; / between Dharmarāja and Indra, obtain sovereignty as a guardian of the quarter!

sanskrit_iast:
tvayedaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati |
agnīśvara iti khyātaṃ sarvatejovibṛṃhaṇam ||
meaning:
त्वयेदं स्थापितं लिङ्गं तव नाम्ना भविष्यति |
अग्नीश्वर इति ख्यातं सर्वतेजोविबृंहणम् ||
text_mt: This liṅga installed by you shall be known by your name, / famed as Agnīśvara, augmenting all splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
agnīśvarasya bhaktānāṃ na bhayaṃ vidyudagnibhiḥ |
agnimāndyabhayaṃ naiva nākālamaraṇaṃ kvacit ||
meaning:
अग्नीश्वरस्य भक्तानां न भयं विद्युदग्निभिः |
अग्निमान्द्यभयं नैव नाकालमरणं क्वचित् ||
text_mt: For devotees of Agnīśvara, there is no fear from lightning and fires; / there is never fear of impaired digestion, nor untimely death anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
agnīśvaraṃ samabhyarcya kāśyāṃ sarvasamṛddhidam |
anyatrāpi mṛto daivādvahniloke mahīyate ||
meaning:
अग्नीश्वरं समभ्यर्च्य काश्यां सर्वसमृद्धिदम् |
अन्यत्रापि मृतो दैवाद्वह्निलोके महीयते ||
text_mt: Having worshipped Agnīśvara in Kāśī, the bestower of all prosperity, / even if one dies elsewhere by destiny, one is honored in the world of Agni."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvānīya tadbandhūnpitrośca paripaśyatoḥ |
dikpatitve'bhiṣicyāgniṃ tatra liṅge śivo'viśat ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वानीय तद्बन्धून्पित्रोश्च परिपश्यतोः |
दिक्पतित्वेऽभिषिच्याग्निं तत्र लिङ्गे शिवोऽविशत् ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Having spoken thus and brought his kinsmen, while his two parents looked on, / having consecrated Agni in the guardianship of the quarter, Śiva entered into that liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
itthamagnyavatāraste varṇito me janārdanaḥ |
nāmnā gṛhapatistāta śaṅkarasya parātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
इत्थमग्न्यवतारस्ते वर्णितो मे जनार्दनः |
नाम्ना गृहपतिस्तात शङ्करस्य परात्मनः ||
text_mt: Thus has this incarnation of Agni, [known] by the name Gṛhapati, / of Śaṅkara, the supreme soul, been described by me to you, O Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
citrahotrapurī ramyā sukhadārciṣmatī varā |
jātavedasi ye bhaktā te tatra nivasanti vai ||
meaning:
चित्रहोत्रपुरी रम्या सुखदार्चिष्मती वरा |
जातवेदसि ये भक्ता ते तत्र निवसन्ति वै ||
text_mt: The lovely city of Citrahotra, delight-giving, radiant, and excellent— / those who are devoted to Jātavedas indeed dwell there.

sanskrit_iast:
agnipraveśaṃ ye kuryurdṛḍhasattvā jitendriyāḥ |
striyo vā sattvasampannāste sarve'pyagnitejasaḥ ||
meaning:
अग्निप्रवेशं ये कुर्युर्दृढसत्त्वा जितेन्द्रियाः |
स्त्रियो वा सत्त्वसम्पन्नास्ते सर्वेऽप्यग्नितेजसः ||
text_mt: Those who enter the fire, firm in resolve and self-restrained, / or women endowed with goodness—all of them possess the splendor of Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotraratā viprāḥ sthāpitā brahmacāriṇaḥ |
paścāgnivarttino'pyevamagniloke'gnivarcasaḥ ||
meaning:
अग्निहोत्ररता विप्राः स्थापिता ब्रह्मचारिणः |
पश्चाग्निवर्त्तिनोऽप्येवमग्निलोकेऽग्निवर्चसः ||
text_mt: Brahmins devoted to the agnihotra, established celibate students, / and those who maintain the five sacred fires likewise possess the luster of Agni in the world of Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
śīte śītāpanuttyai yastvedhobhārānprayacchati |
kuryādagnīṣṭikāṃ vātha sa vasedagnisannidhau ||
meaning:
शीते शीतापनुत्त्यै यस्त्वेधोभारान्प्रयच्छति |
कुर्यादग्नीष्टिकां वाथ स वसेदग्निसन्निधौ ||
text_mt: He who gives loads of firewood in winter for the removal of cold, / or who provides a charcoal brazier, shall dwell in the presence of Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
anāthasyāgnisaṃskāraṃ yaḥ kuryācchraddhayānvitaḥ |
aśaktaḥ prerayedanyaṃ so'gniloke mahīyate ||
meaning:
अनाथस्याग्निसंस्कारं यः कुर्याच्छ्रद्धयान्वितः |
अशक्तः प्रेरयेदन्यं सोऽग्निलोके महीयते ||
text_mt: He who, filled with faith, performs the cremation rites for an orphan, / or if unable, prompts another [to do so], is honored in the world of Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
agnireko dvijātīnāṃ niḥśreyasakaraḥ paraḥ |
gururdevo vrataṃ tīrthaṃ sarvamagnirviniścitam ||
meaning:
अग्निरेको द्विजातीनां निःश्रेयसकरः परः |
गुरुर्देवो व्रतं तीर्थं सर्वमग्निर्विनिश्चितम् ||
text_mt: Fire alone is the supreme cause of the ultimate good for the twice-born. / Fire is definitely the guru, the deity, the vow, and the sacred site—fire is everything.

sanskrit_iast:
apāvanāni sarvāṇi vahnisaṃsargataḥ kṣaṇāt |
pāvanāni bhavantyeva tasmādyaḥ pāvakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
अपावनानि सर्वाणि वह्निसंसर्गतः क्षणात् |
पावनानि भवन्त्येव तस्माद्यः पावकः स्मृतः ||
text_mt: All unpurified things become purified instantly through contact with fire; / therefore it is known as Pāvaka, the purifier.

sanskrit_iast:
antarātmā hyayaṃ sākṣānniścayo hyāśuśukṣaṇiḥ |
māṃsagrāsānpacetkukṣau strīṇāṃ no māṃsapeśikām ||
meaning:
अन्तरात्मा ह्ययं साक्षान्निश्चयो ह्याशुशुक्षणिः |
मांसग्रासान्पचेत्कुक्षौ स्त्रीणां नो मांसपेशिकाम् ||
text_mt: For it is truly the inner Self manifested, the digestive fire, without a doubt; / it cooks morsels of food in the belly, but does not burn the embryo in the womb of women.

sanskrit_iast:
taijasī śāmbhavī mūrtiḥ pratyakṣā dahanātmikā |
kartrī hartrī pālayitrī vinaitāṃ kiṃ vilokyate ||
meaning:
तैजसी शाम्भवी मूर्तिः प्रत्यक्षा दहनात्मिका |
कर्त्री हर्त्री पालयित्री विनैतां किं विलोक्यते ||
text_mt: It is the fiery manifestation of Śambhu, perceptible, consisting of consumption; / it is the creator, the destroyer, the sustainer. What can be seen without it?

sanskrit_iast:
citrabhānurayaṃ sākṣānnetraṃ tribhuvaneśituḥ |
andhe tamomaye loke vinainaṃ kaḥ prakāśanaḥ ||
meaning:
चित्रभानुरयं साक्षान्नेत्रं त्रिभुवनेशितुः |
अन्धे तमोमये लोके विनैनं कः प्रकाशनः ||
text_mt: Fire is the direct eye of the Lord of the three worlds. / In a blind world made of darkness, what else would bring illumination without it?

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpapradīpanaivedyapayodadhighṛtaikṣavam |
etadbhuktaṃ niṣevante sarve divi divaukasaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
धूपप्रदीपनैवेद्यपयोदधिघृतैक्षवम् |
एतद्भुक्तं निषेवन्ते सर्वे दिवि दिवौकसः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Incense, lamps, food offerings, milk, curd, clarified butter, and sugarcane juice— / consumed by it, all the gods in heaven enjoy them.

Thus ends the fifteenth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Incarnation of Gṛhapati', in the third [section], the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
yakṣeśvarāvatāraṃ ca śṛṇu śambhormunīśvara |
