pratyaṣedhata viśveśaḥ prādurbhūto dvijeśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
तमथाग्निं पतिष्यन्तं स्वपदासक्तचेतसम् |
प्रत्यषेधत विश्वेशः प्रादुर्भूतो द्विजेश्वरः ||
text_mt: Then, as he was about to jump into the fire, his mind fixed on his own goal, / the Lord of the Universe, who had manifested as the foremost of the twice-born, restrained him.

sanskrit_iast:
tamīśvaraṃ pañcamukhaṃ trinetraṃ pinākinaṃ candrakalāvataṃsam |
pralambapiṅgāṃśujaṭākalāpaṃ madhyāhnasadbhāskarakoṭitejasam ||
meaning:
तमीश्वरं पञ्चमुखं त्रिनेत्रं पिनाकिनं चन्द्रकलावतंसम् |
प्रलम्बपिङ्गांशुजटाकलापं मध्याह्नसद्भास्करकोटितेजसम् ||
text_mt: That king saw Īśvara manifested before him, five-faced, three-eyed, holding the Pināka, adorned with the crescent moon, / with a mass of hanging, reddish-brown matted locks, radiant as ten million mid-day suns,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛṇālagauraṃ gajacarmavāsasaṃ gaṅgātaraṅgokṣitamaulideśakam |
nāgendrahārāvalikaṇṭhabhūṣaṇaṃ kirīṭakāñcyaṅgadakaṅkaṇojjvalam ||
meaning:
मृणालगौरं गजचर्मवाससं गङ्गातरङ्गोक्षितमौलिदेशकम् |
नागेन्द्रहारावलिकण्ठभूषणं किरीटकाञ्च्यङ्गदकङ्कणोज्ज्वलम् ||
text_mt: fair as a lotus stalk, clad in elephant hide, his crest sprinkled by the waves of the Gaṅgā, / his neck adorned with garlands of lordly serpents, radiant with crown, girdle, armlets, and bracelets,

sanskrit_iast:
śūlāsikhaṭvāṅgakuṭhāracarma-mṛgābhayāṣṭāṅgapinākahastam |
vṛṣoparisthaṃ śitikaṇṭhabhūṣaṇaṃ prodbhūtamagre sa nṛpo dadarśa ||
meaning:
शूलासिखट्वाङ्गकुठारचर्म-मृगाभयाष्टाङ्गपिनाकहस्तम् |
वृषोपरिस्थं शितिकण्ठभूषणं प्रोद्भूतमग्रे स नृपो ददर्श ||
text_mt: his eight arms holding trident, sword, skull-topped staff, axe, shield, deer, gesture of fearlessness, and the Pināka bow, / standing upon the bull, adorned with a dark neck.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'mbarād drutaṃ peturdivyāḥ kusumavṛṣṭayaḥ |
praṇedurdevatūryyāṇi devyaśca nanṛturjaguḥ ||
meaning:
ततोऽम्बराद् द्रुतं पेतुर्दिव्याः कुसुमवृष्टयः |
प्रणेदुर्देवतूर्य्याणि देव्यश्च ननृतुर्जगुः ||
text_mt: Then divine showers of flowers fell swiftly from the sky; / celestial drums sounded, and goddesses danced and sang.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrājagmuḥ stūyamānā harirbrahmā tathāsurāḥ |
indrādayo nāradādyā munayaścāpare'pi ca ||
meaning:
तत्राजग्मुः स्तूयमाना हरिर्ब्रह्मा तथासुराः |
इन्द्रादयो नारदाद्या मुनयश्चापरेऽपि च ||
text_mt: There arrived Hari, Brahmā, and also the gods, / Indra and the rest, Nārada and other sages, being praised, and others too.

sanskrit_iast:
tadotsavo mahānāsīttatra bhaktipravardhanaḥ |
sati paśyati bhūpāle bhaktinamrīkṛtāñjalau ||
meaning:
तदोत्सवो महानासीत्तत्र भक्तिप्रवर्धनः |
सति पश्यति भूपाले भक्तिनम्रीकृताञ्जलौ ||
text_mt: Then there was a great festival that increased devotion, / while the noble king looked on, his hands folded in devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
taddarśanānandavijṛmbhitāśayaḥ pravṛddhabāṣpāmbuviliptagātraḥ |
prahṛṣṭaromā sa hi gadgadākṣarastuṣṭāva gīrbhirmukulīkṛtāñjaliḥ ||
meaning:
तद्दर्शनानन्दविजृम्भिताशयः प्रवृद्धबाष्पाम्बुविलिप्तगात्रः |
प्रहृष्टरोमा स हि गद्गदाक्षरस्तुष्टाव गीर्भिर्मुकुलीकृताञ्जलिः ||
text_mt: His heart blossoming with the joy of seeing Him, his body drenched with overflowing tears, / his hair standing on end, he praised Him with choked words and prayers, his hands folded like a lotus bud.

sanskrit_iast:
tatassa bhagavān rājñā saṃstutaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
prasannaḥ saha pārvatyā tamuvāca dayānidhiḥ ||
meaning:
ततस्स भगवान् राज्ञा संस्तुतः परमेश्वरः |
प्रसन्नः सह पार्वत्या तमुवाच दयानिधिः ||
text_mt: Then the blessed Parameśvara, praised by the king, / pleased, accompanied by Pārvatī, that ocean of compassion, spoke to him:

sanskrit_iast:
rājaṃste parituṣṭo'haṃ bhaktyā tvaddharmato'dhikam |
varaṃ brūhi sapatnīkamprayacchāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
राजंस्ते परितुष्टोऽहं भक्त्या त्वद्धर्मतोऽधिकम् |
वरं ब्रूहि सपत्नीकम्प्रयच्छामि न संशयः ||
text_mt: "O king, I am well pleased with you, more by your devotion than by your duty. / Choose a boon along with your wife; I shall grant it, there is no doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
tava bhāvaparīkṣārthaṃ dvijo bhūtvāhamāgataḥ |
vyāghreṇa yā parigrastā sākṣāddevī śivā hi sā ||
meaning:
तव भावपरीक्षार्थं द्विजो भूत्वाहमागतः |
व्याघ्रेण या परिग्रस्ता साक्षाद्देवी शिवा हि सा ||
text_mt: I came having become a twice-born to test your disposition. / She who was seized by the tiger is indeed the goddess Śivā herself in visible form.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghro māyāmayo yaste śarairakṣata vigrahaḥ |
dhīratān draṣṭukāmaste patnīṃ yācitavānaham ||
meaning:
व्याघ्रो मायामयो यस्ते शरैरक्षत विग्रहः |
धीरतान् द्रष्टुकामस्ते पत्नीं याचितवानहम् ||
text_mt: The tiger was an illusion, whose body was uninjured by your arrows. / Desiring to see your steadfastness, I begged for your wife.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityākarṇya prabhorvākyaṃ sa bhadrāyurmahīpatiḥ |
punaḥ praṇamya saṃstūya svāminaṃ natako'bravīt ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य प्रभोर्वाक्यं स भद्रायुर्महीपतिः |
पुनः प्रणम्य संस्तूय स्वामिनं नतकोऽब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having heard these words of the Lord, King Bhadrāyus, / bowing down again and praising the master, spoke with bent head:

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrāyuruvāca |
eka eva varo nātha yadbhavānparameśvaraḥ |
bhavatāpaprataptasya mama pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ||
meaning:
भद्रायुरुवाच |
एक एव वरो नाथ यद्भवान्परमेश्वरः |
भवतापप्रतप्तस्य मम प्रत्यक्षतां गतः ||
text_mt: Bhadrāyus said: / There is only one boon, O Lord: that you, the Parameśvara, / have come into visible presence before me, who was burned by the distress of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
yaddadāsi punarnātha varaṃ svakṛpayā prabho |
vṛṇe'haṃ paramaṃ tvatto varaṃ hi varadarṣabhāt ||
meaning:
यद्ददासि पुनर्नाथ वरं स्वकृपया प्रभो |
वृणेऽहं परमं त्वत्तो वरं हि वरदर्षभात् ||
text_mt: Yet since you grant another boon by your grace, O Lord, / I choose a supreme boon from you, the bull among granters of boons.

sanskrit_iast:
vajrabāhuḥ pitā me hi sapatnīko maheśvara |
sapatnīkastvahaṃ nātha sadā tvatpādasevakaḥ ||
meaning:
वज्रबाहुः पिता मे हि सपत्नीको महेश्वर |
सपत्नीकस्त्वहं नाथ सदा त्वत्पादसेवकः ||
text_mt: Vajrabāhu is my father, along with his wife, O Maheśvara; / and I too, along with my wife, am always a servant of your feet, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyaḥ padmākaro nāma tatputraḥ sanayābhidhaḥ |
sarvānetānmaheśāna sadā tvaṃ pārśvagānkuru ||
meaning:
वैश्यः पद्माकरो नाम तत्पुत्रः सनयाभिधः |
सर्वानेतान्महेशान सदा त्वं पार्श्वगान्कुरु ||
text_mt: The vaiśya named Padmākara, and his son named Sanaya— / make all of these people attendants at your side forever, O Maheśāna!

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
atha rājñī ca tatpatnī pramattā kīrtimālinī |
bhaktyā prasādya giriśaṃ yayāce varamuttamam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
अथ राज्ञी च तत्पत्नी प्रमत्ता कीर्तिमालिनी |
भक्त्या प्रसाद्य गिरिशं ययाचे वरमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Then the queen, his ecstatic wife Kīrtimālinī, / having propitiated Giriśa with devotion, begged for an excellent boon.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñyuvāca |
candrāṅgado mama pitā mātā sīmantinī ca me |
tayoryāce mahādeva tvatpāśve sannidhiṃ mudā ||
meaning:
राज्ञ्युवाच |
चन्द्राङ्गदो मम पिता माता सीमन्तिनी च मे |
तयोर्याचे महादेव त्वत्पाश्वे सन्निधिं मुदा ||
text_mt: The queen said: / Candrāṅgada is my father, and Sīmantinī is my mother; / for both of them, O Mahādeva, I joyfully ask for proximity at your side.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
evamastviti gaurīśaḥ prasanno bhaktavatsalaḥ |
tayoḥ kāmavarāndattvā kṣaṇādantarhito'bhavat ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
एवमस्त्विति गौरीशः प्रसन्नो भक्तवत्सलः |
तयोः कामवरान्दत्त्वा क्षणादन्तर्हितोऽभवत् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Saying, "Let it be so," Gaurī's lord, pleased and affectionate toward devotees, / granted them the boons they desired and vanished in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrāyurapi suprītyā prasādaṃ prāpya śūlinaḥ |
sahitaḥ kīrtimālinyā bubhuje viṣayānbahūn ||
meaning:
भद्रायुरपि सुप्रीत्या प्रसादं प्राप्य शूलिनः |
सहितः कीर्तिमालिन्या बुभुजे विषयान्बहून् ||
text_mt: Bhadrāyus also, having obtained the grace of the wielder of the trident with great joy, / enjoyed many pleasures together with Kīrtimālinī.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā varṣāyutaṃ rājyamavyāhataparākramaḥ |
rājyaṃ vikṣipya tanaye jagāma śivasannidhim ||
meaning:
कृत्वा वर्षायुतं राज्यमव्याहतपराक्रमः |
राज्यं विक्षिप्य तनये जगाम शिवसन्निधिम् ||
text_mt: Having ruled the kingdom for ten thousand years with unimpeded prowess, / he transferred the kingdom to his son and went to the presence of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
candrāṅgado'pi rājendro rājñī sīmantinī ca sā |
bhaktyā sampūjya giriśaṃ jagmatuḥ śāmbhavaṃ padam ||
meaning:
चन्द्राङ्गदोऽपि राजेन्द्रो राज्ञी सीमन्तिनी च सा |
भक्त्या सम्पूज्य गिरिशं जग्मतुः शाम्भवं पदम् ||
text_mt: Candrāṅgada too, the foremost among kings, and that queen Sīmantinī, / having worshipped Giriśa with devotion, went to the abode of Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijeśvarāvatāraste varṇitaḥ paramo mayā |
maheśvarasya bhadrāyuparamānandadaḥ prabho ||
meaning:
द्विजेश्वरावतारस्ते वर्णितः परमो मया |
महेश्वरस्य भद्रायुपरमानन्ददः प्रभो ||
text_mt: This supreme incarnation of Maheśvara as the lord of the twice-born has been described to you by me, / which bestowed supreme bliss upon Bhadrāyus, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ caritraṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ śivāvatārasya pavitrakīrtteḥ |
dvijeśasaṃjñasya mahādbhutaṃ hi śṛṇvanpaṭhan śambhupadaṃ prayāti ||
meaning:
इदं चरित्रं परमं पवित्रं शिवावतारस्य पवित्रकीर्त्तेः |
द्विजेशसंज्ञस्य महाद्भुतं हि शृण्वन्पठन् शम्भुपदं प्रयाति ||
text_mt: Hearing or reading this supreme, holy, and exceedingly wondrous deed / of the incarnation of Śiva known as Dvijeśa, whose fame is pure, one goes to the abode of Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ |
na ścotati svadharmātsa paratra labhate gatim ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः |
न श्चोतति स्वधर्मात्स परत्र लभते गतिम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Whoever listens to this constantly or recites it with a collected mind / does not deviate from his own duty and attains the [supreme] state in the hereafter.

Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter, titled "The Description of the Incarnation of Śiva Known as Dvijeśa," in the third [book], the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
śṛṇu prājña pravakṣyāmi śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
avatāraṃ parānandaṃ yatināthāhvayaṃ mune ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
शृणु प्राज्ञ प्रवक्ष्यामि शिवस्य परमात्मनः |
अवतारं परानन्दं यतिनाथाह्वयं मुने ||
title: aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | yatināthabrahmahaṃsāhvayaśivāvatāracaritavarṇanam
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Listen, O wise one; I shall describe the supreme bliss, the incarnation / named Yatinātha of Śiva, the supreme Self, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
arbudācalasaṃjñe tu parvate bhillavaṃśajaḥ |
āhukaśca tadabhyāśe vasati sma munīśvara ||
meaning:
अर्बुदाचलसंज्ञे तु पर्वते भिल्लवंशजः |
आहुकश्च तदभ्याशे वसति स्म मुनीश्वर ||
text_mt: On the mountain named Arbudācala, born in the Bhilla lineage / and named Āhuka, [a man] lived near it, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpatnī hyāhukā nāma babhūva kila suvratā |
ubhāvapi mahāśaivāvāstāṃ tau śivapūjakau ||
meaning:
तत्पत्नी ह्याहुका नाम बभूव किल सुव्रता |
उभावपि महाशैवावास्तां तौ शिवपूजकौ ||
text_mt: His wife indeed was named Āhukā, of good vows; / both of them were great Śaivas, worshippers of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
kasmiṃścitsamaye bhillaḥ śivabhaktirataḥ sadā |
āhārārthaṃ svapatnyāśca sudūraṃ sa gato mune ||
meaning:
कस्मिंश्चित्समये भिल्लः शिवभक्तिरतः सदा |
आहारार्थं स्वपत्न्याश्च सुदूरं स गतो मुने ||
text_mt: At a certain time, that Bhilla, always intent on devotion to Śiva, / went far away for the sake of food for himself and his wife, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tatra gehe bhillasya śaṅkaraḥ |
bhūtvā yativapuḥ sāyaṃ parīkṣārthaṃ samāyayau ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र गेहे भिल्लस्य शङ्करः |
भूत्वा यतिवपुः सायं परीक्षार्थं समाययौ ||
text_mt: In the meantime, Śaṅkara, assuming the form of an ascetic, / came there in the evening to the house of the Bhilla in order to test [them].

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnavasare tatrājagāma sa gṛhādhipaḥ |
pūjanaṃ ca yatīśasya cakāra premataḥ sudhīḥ ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्नवसरे तत्राजगाम स गृहाधिपः |
पूजनं च यतीशस्य चकार प्रेमतः सुधीः ||
text_mt: At that moment, the master of the house arrived there / and the wise man worshiped the lord of ascetics with affection.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhāvasya parīkṣārthaṃ yatirūpaḥ sa śaṅkaraḥ |
mahālīlātaraḥ prītyā bhītaḥ provāca dīnagīḥ ||
meaning:
तद्भावस्य परीक्षार्थं यतिरूपः स शङ्करः |
महालीलातरः प्रीत्या भीतः प्रोवाच दीनगीः ||
text_mt: In order to test his disposition, that Śaṅkara in the form of an ascetic, / engaged in great play, affectionately spoke with a wretched voice as if afraid:

sanskrit_iast:
yatinātha uvāca |
adya sthalaṃ nivāsārthaṃ dehi me prātareva hi |
yāsyāmi sarvathā bhilla svasti syāttava sarvadā ||
meaning:
यतिनाथ उवाच |
अद्य स्थलं निवासार्थं देहि मे प्रातरेव हि |
यास्यामि सर्वथा भिल्ल स्वस्ति स्यात्तव सर्वदा ||
text_mt: Yatinātha said: / Today give me a place to stay; at dawn indeed / I will depart completely, O Bhilla. May there always be well-being for you!

sanskrit_iast:
bhilla uvāca |
satyaṃ proktaṃ tvayā svāmin śṛṇu madvacanaṃ ca te |
ati svalpaṃ sthalaṃ me hi syānnivāsaḥ kathaṃ tava ||
meaning:
भिल्ल उवाच |
सत्यं प्रोक्तं त्वया स्वामिन् शृणु मद्वचनं च ते |
अति स्वल्पं स्थलं मे हि स्यान्निवासः कथं तव ||
text_mt: The Bhilla said: / You have spoken the truth, O master; listen to my words also: / my place is extremely small; how could there be lodging for you?

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktaḥ sa yatistena gamanāya matiṃ dadhe |
tāvadbhillyā vacaḥ proktaṃ svāminaṃ saṃvicārya vai ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्तः स यतिस्तेन गमनाय मतिं दधे |
तावद्भिल्ल्या वचः प्रोक्तं स्वामिनं संविचार्य वै ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Thus addressed by him, that ascetic set his mind on leaving; / just then, a statement was made by the Bhilla woman after considering [it] with her master:

sanskrit_iast:
bhillyuvāca |
svāmindehi yateḥ sthānaṃ vimukhaṃ kuru mātithim |
gṛhadharmaṃ vicārya tvamanyathā dharmasaṅkṣayaḥ ||
meaning:
भिल्ल्युवाच |
स्वामिन्देहि यतेः स्थानं विमुखं कुरु मातिथिम् |
गृहधर्मं विचार्य त्वमन्यथा धर्मसङ्क्षयः ||
text_mt: The Bhilla woman said: / O master, give a place to the ascetic; do not turn the guest away. / Consider the duty of a householder; otherwise there will be destruction of righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
sthīyatāṃ te gṛhābhyantaḥ sukhena yatinā saha |
ahaṃ bahiḥ sthitiṃ kuryāmāyudhāni bṛhantyapi ||
meaning:
स्थीयतां ते गृहाभ्यन्तः सुखेन यतिना सह |
अहं बहिः स्थितिं कुर्यामायुधानि बृहन्त्यपि ||
text_mt: May you remain inside the house comfortably together with the ascetic; / I will stay outside, and [take] large weapons too.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhillyā dharmānvitaṃ śivam |
svapatnyā manasā tena bhillena ca vicāritam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भिल्ल्या धर्मान्वितं शिवम् |
स्वपत्न्या मनसा तेन भिल्लेन च विचारितम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having heard those auspicious words endowed with righteousness from her, the Bhilla woman, / that Bhilla reflected in his mind concerning his wife:

sanskrit_iast:
striyaṃ bahiśca niṣkāsya kathaṃ stheyaṃ mayā gṛhe |
yateranyatra gamanamadharmakaramātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
स्त्रियं बहिश्च निष्कास्य कथं स्थेयं मया गृहे |
यतेरन्यत्र गमनमधर्मकरमात्मनः ||
text_mt: "Sending the woman outside, how could I remain in the house? / Yet the ascetic's going elsewhere will cause unrighteousness to myself.

sanskrit_iast:
dvayamapyucitaṃ naiva sarvathā gṛhamedhinaḥ |
yadbhāvi tadbhavedeva mayā stheyaṃ gṛhād bahiḥ ||
meaning:
द्वयमप्युचितं नैव सर्वथा गृहमेधिनः |
यद्भावि तद्भवेदेव मया स्थेयं गृहाद् बहिः ||
text_mt: Both are completely improper for a householder. / Whatever is to happen, let it happen; I must remain outside the house."

sanskrit_iast:
ityāgrahaṃ tadā kṛtvā gṛhāntaḥ sthāpya tau mudā |
svāyudhāni ca saṃsthāpya bhillo'tiṣṭhad gṛhād bahiḥ ||
meaning:
इत्याग्रहं तदा कृत्वा गृहान्तः स्थाप्य तौ मुदा |
स्वायुधानि च संस्थाप्य भिल्लोऽतिष्ठद् गृहाद् बहिः ||
text_mt: Having thus made a resolve then, placing the two happily inside the house / and taking up his weapons, the Bhilla stayed outside the house.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau taṃ paśavaḥ krūrāḥ hiṃsakāḥ samapīḍayan |
tenāpi ca yathāśakti kṛto yatno mahāṃstadā ||
meaning:
रात्रौ तं पशवः क्रूराः हिंसकाः समपीडयन् |
तेनापि च यथाशक्ति कृतो यत्नो महांस्तदा ||
text_mt: In the night, cruel, violent beasts tormented him; / and he also made a great effort to the best of his ability at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yatnaṃ prakurvāṇaḥ sa bhillo balavānapi |
prārabdhātpreritairhiṃsrairbalādāsīcca bhakṣitaḥ ||
meaning:
एवं यत्नं प्रकुर्वाणः स भिल्लो बलवानपि |
प्रारब्धात्प्रेरितैर्हिंस्रैर्बलादासीच्च भक्षितः ||
text_mt: Making such an effort, that Bhilla, although strong, / was devoured by force by the violent beasts driven by past karma.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarutthāya sa yatirdṛṣṭvā hiṃsraiśca bhakṣitam |
bhillaṃ vanecaraṃ taṃ vai duḥkhito'bhūdatīva hi ||
meaning:
प्रातरुत्थाय स यतिर्दृष्ट्वा हिंस्रैश्च भक्षितम् |
भिल्लं वनेचरं तं वै दुःखितोऽभूदतीव हि ||
text_mt: Having arisen in the morning, seeing that Bhilla, the forest-dweller, / devoured by the violent beasts, that ascetic became exceedingly sorrowful.

sanskrit_iast:
dukhitaṃ taṃ yatiṃ dṛṣṭvā bhillī sā duḥkhitāpi hi |
dhairyātsvaduḥkhaṃ saṃhṛtya vacanaṃ cedamabravīt ||
meaning:
दुखितं तं यतिं दृष्ट्वा भिल्ली सा दुःखितापि हि |
धैर्यात्स्वदुःखं संहृत्य वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: Seeing that ascetic sorrowful, that Bhilla woman, though also sorrowful, / restrained her grief through fortitude and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
bhillyuvāca |
kimarthaṃ kriyate duḥkhaṃ bhadraṃ jātaṃ yate'dhunā |
dhanyo'yaṃ kṛtakṛtyaśca yajjāto mṛtyurīdṛśaḥ ||
meaning:
भिल्ल्युवाच |
किमर्थं क्रियते दुःखं भद्रं जातं यतेऽधुना |
धन्योऽयं कृतकृत्यश्च यज्जातो मृत्युरीदृशः ||
text_mt: The Bhilla woman said: / For what reason is sorrow felt? An auspicious thing has occurred now, O ascetic. / Blessed is he and fulfilled in his purpose, that such a death took place.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ cainaṃ gamiṣyāmi bhasma bhūtvānale yate |
citāṃ kāraya suprītyā strīṇāṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
meaning:
अहं चैनं गमिष्यामि भस्म भूत्वानले यते |
चितां कारय सुप्रीत्या स्त्रीणां धर्मः सनातनः ||
text_mt: And I shall go with him, becoming ashes in the fire, O ascetic; / please prepare a funeral pyre with great goodwill; this is the eternal duty of women.

sanskrit_iast:
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā hitaṃ matvā svayaṃ yatiḥ |
citāṃ vyaracayatsā hi praviveśa svadharmataḥ ||
meaning:
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हितं मत्वा स्वयं यतिः |
चितां व्यरचयत्सा हि प्रविवेश स्वधर्मतः ||
text_mt: Hearing those words of hers and thinking it beneficial, the ascetic himself / prepared the pyre; and she entered it in accordance with her own duty.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare sākṣātpuraḥ prādurabhūcchivaḥ |
dhanye dhanye iti prītyā praśaṃsastāṃ haro'bravīt ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे साक्षात्पुरः प्रादुरभूच्छिवः |
धन्ये धन्ये इति प्रीत्या प्रशंसस्तां हरोऽब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: In the meantime, Śiva visibly manifested before her; / praising her with affection, saying, "Blessed, blessed one!" Hara said:

sanskrit_iast:
hara uvāca |
varaṃ brūhi prasanno'smi tvadācaraṇato'naghe |
tavādeyaṃ na vai kiñcid vaśyo'haṃ te viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
हर उवाच |
वरं ब्रूहि प्रसन्नोऽस्मि त्वदाचरणतोऽनघे |
तवादेयं न वै किञ्चिद् वश्योऽहं ते विशेषतः ||
text_mt: Hara said: / Choose a boon; I am pleased by your conduct, O sinless one. / There is nothing that should not be given to you; I am especially under your control.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
tacchutvā śambhuvacanaṃ paramānandadāyakam |
sukhaṃ prāptaṃ viśeṣeṇa na kiñcitsmaraṇaṃ yayau ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
तच्छुत्वा शम्भुवचनं परमानन्ददायकम् |
सुखं प्राप्तं विशेषेण न किञ्चित्स्मरणं ययौ ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having heard those words of Śambhu which bestow supreme bliss, / she attained extraordinary joy, and no [other] remembrance remained.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstadgatimālakṣya suprasanno haro'bhavat |
uvāca ca punaḥ śambhurvaraṃ brūhīti tāṃ prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
तस्यास्तद्गतिमालक्ष्य सुप्रसन्नो हरोऽभवत् |
उवाच च पुनः शम्भुर्वरं ब्रूहीति तां प्रभुः ||
text_mt: Perceiving her state, Hara became exceedingly pleased, / and the Lord Śambhu spoke to her again: “Ask a boon.”

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca |
ayaṃ yatiśca madrūpo haṃsarūpo bhaviṣyati |
parajanmani vāṃ prītyā saṃyogaṃ kārayiṣyati ||
meaning:
शिव उवाच |
अयं यतिश्च मद्रूपो हंसरूपो भविष्यति |
परजन्मनि वां प्रीत्या संयोगं कारयिष्यति ||
text_mt: Śiva said: / “And this ascetic, who is my own form, shall take the form of a swan; / in your next birth he will lovingly bring about your union.

sanskrit_iast:
bhillaśca vīrasenasya naiṣadhe nagare vare |
mahānputro nalo nāma bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
भिल्लश्च वीरसेनस्य नैषधे नगरे वरे |
महान्पुत्रो नलो नाम भविष्यति न संशयः ||
text_mt: And the Bhilla will become the great son of Vīrasena / named Nala in the excellent city of Naiṣadha; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ sutā bhīmarājasya vaidarbhe nagare'naghe |
damayantī ca vikhyātā bhaviṣyasi guṇānvitā ||
meaning:
त्वं सुता भीमराजस्य वैदर्भे नगरेऽनघे |
दमयन्ती च विख्याता भविष्यसि गुणान्विता ||
text_mt: And you, faultless one, endowed with good qualities, will become / the daughter of King Bhīma, renowned as Damayantī in the city of Vidarbha.

sanskrit_iast:
yuvāṃ cobhau militvā ca rājabhogaṃ suvistaram |
bhuktvā muktiṃ ca yogīndrairlapsyethe durlabhāṃ dhruvam ||
meaning:
युवां चोभौ मिलित्वा च राजभोगं सुविस्तरम् |
भुक्त्वा मुक्तिं च योगीन्द्रैर्लप्स्येथे दुर्लभां ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: And both of you, having united and enjoyed vast royal pleasures, / will surely attain liberation, which is hard even for the foremost of yogins to obtain.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvā ca svayaṃ śambhurliṅgarūpo'bhavattadā |
tasmānna calito dharmādacaleśa iti smṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा च स्वयं शम्भुर्लिङ्गरूपोऽभवत्तदा |
तस्मान्न चलितो धर्मादचलेश इति स्मृतः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, Śambhu himself then assumed the form of a liṅga; / because he did not waver from righteousness, he is remembered as Acaleśa.

sanskrit_iast:
sa bhilla āhukaścāpi vīrasenasuto'bhavat |
naiṣadhe nagare tāta nalanāmā mahānṛpaḥ ||
meaning:
स भिल्ल आहुकश्चापि वीरसेनसुतोऽभवत् |
नैषधे नगरे तात नलनामा महानृपः ||
text_mt: That Bhilla named Āhuka became the son of Vīrasena, / O dear one, the great king named Nala in the city of Naiṣadha.

sanskrit_iast:
āhukā sā mahābhillī bhīmasya tanayābhavat |
vaidarbhe nagare rājño damayantīti viśrutā ||
meaning:
आहुका सा महाभिल्ली भीमस्य तनयाभवत् |
वैदर्भे नगरे राज्ञो दमयन्तीति विश्रुता ||
text_mt: That great Bhilla woman Āhukā became the daughter / of King Bhīma, renowned as Damayantī in the city of Vidarbha.

sanskrit_iast:
yatināthāhvayaḥ so'pi haṃsarūpo'bhavacchivaḥ |
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa damayantyā nalena vai ||
meaning:
यतिनाथाह्वयः सोऽपि हंसरूपोऽभवच्छिवः |
विवाहं कारयामास दमयन्त्या नलेन वै ||
text_mt: Śiva too, who bore the name Yatinātha, took the form of a swan; / he indeed brought about the marriage of Damayantī with Nala.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvasatkārarūpeṇa mahāpuṇyena śaṅkaraḥ |
haṃsarūpaṃ vidhāyaiva tābhyāṃ sukhamadātprabhuḥ ||
meaning:
पूर्वसत्काररूपेण महापुण्येन शङ्करः |
हंसरूपं विधायैव ताभ्यां सुखमदात्प्रभुः ||
text_mt: By virtue of that great merit taking the form of earlier hospitality, Śaṅkara, / the Lord, having assumed the form of a swan, bestowed happiness upon the two.

sanskrit_iast:
śivo haṃsāvatāro hi nānāvārtāvicakṣaṇaḥ |
damayantyā nalasyāpi paramānandadāyakaḥ ||
meaning:
शिवो हंसावतारो हि नानावार्ताविचक्षणः |
दमयन्त्या नलस्यापि परमानन्ददायकः ||
text_mt: Śiva as the swan incarnation, skilled in various matters, / was indeed the bestower of supreme bliss upon Damayantī and Nala.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ caritaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ śivāvatārasya pavitrakīrteḥ |
yatīśasaṃjñasya mahādbhutaṃ hi haṃsāhvayasyāpi vimuktidaṃ hi ||
meaning:
इदं चरितं परमं पवित्रं शिवावतारस्य पवित्रकीर्तेः |
यतीशसंज्ञस्य महाद्भुतं हि हंसाह्वयस्यापि विमुक्तिदं हि ||
text_mt: This supreme and holy narrative of the incarnation of Śiva of sacred fame, / known as Yatīśa and also named Haṃsa, is most wondrous and bestows liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yatīśabrahmahaṃsākhyāvatāracaritaṃ śubham |
śṛṇuyācchrāvayedyo hi sa labheta parāṃ gatim ||
meaning:
यतीशब्रह्महंसाख्यावतारचरितं शुभम् |
शृणुयाच्छ्रावयेद्यो हि स लभेत परां गतिम् ||
text_mt: Whoever hears or recites the auspicious account / of the incarnation named Yatīśa and Brahma-Haṃsa shall attain the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
idamākhyānamanaghaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam |
svargyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ bhaktivardhanamuttamam ||
meaning:
इदमाख्यानमनघं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् |
स्वर्ग्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं भक्तिवर्धनमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: This faultless narrative grants the fruits of all desires, / leads to heaven, brings fame and longevity, and supremely increases devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvaitaccaritaṃ śambhoryatihaṃsasvarūpayoḥ |
iha sarvasukhaṃ bhuktvā so'nte śivapuraṃ vrajet ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
श्रुत्वैतच्चरितं शम्भोर्यतिहंसस्वरूपयोः |
इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा सोऽन्ते शिवपुरं व्रजेत् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Having heard this story of Śambhu in the forms of the ascetic and the swan, / one enjoys all happiness in this world and at the end goes to the realm of Śiva.

Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, entitled ‘The Description of the Story of the Incarnations of Śiva Named Yatinātha and Brahma-Haṃsa,’ in the third book, the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
sanatkumāra śambhostvavatāraṃ paramaṃ śṛṇu |
nabhagajñānadaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanāhvayamuttamam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
सनत्कुमार शम्भोस्त्ववतारं परमं शृणु |
नभगज्ञानदं कृष्णदर्शनाह्वयमुत्तमम् ||
title: ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | kṛṣṇadarśanaśivāvatāravarṇanam
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / O Sanatkumāra, hear of the supreme, excellent incarnation of Śambhu / named Kṛṣṇadarśana, who bestowed knowledge upon Nabhaga.

sanskrit_iast:
ikṣvākupramukhā āsan śrāddhadevasutāśca ye |
nabhagastatra navamo nābhāgastatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
इक्ष्वाकुप्रमुखा आसन् श्राद्धदेवसुताश्च ये |
नभगस्तत्र नवमो नाभागस्तत्सुतः स्मृतः ||
text_mt: Those who were the sons of Śrāddhadeva, headed by Ikṣvāku— / among them Nabhaga was the ninth, and Nābhāga is remembered as his son.

sanskrit_iast:
ambarīṣaḥ sutastasya viṣṇubhakto babhūva saḥ |
yasyopari prasanno'bhūddurvāsā brahmabhaktitaḥ ||
meaning:
अम्बरीषः सुतस्तस्य विष्णुभक्तो बभूव सः |
यस्योपरि प्रसन्नोऽभूद्दुर्वासा ब्रह्मभक्तितः ||
text_mt: Ambarīṣa was his son; he became a devotee of Viṣṇu, / with whom Durvāsas was pleased on account of his devotion to the supreme reality.

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmaho'mbarīṣasya nabhago yaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
taccaritaṃ śṛṇu mune yasmai jñānamadācchivaḥ ||
meaning:
पितामहोऽम्बरीषस्य नभगो यः प्रकीर्तितः |
तच्चरितं शृणु मुने यस्मै ज्ञानमदाच्छिवः ||
text_mt: Hear the story, O sage, of Nabhaga, who is celebrated as Ambarīṣa’s grandfather, / to whom Śiva imparted knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
nabhago manuputrastu paṭhanārthaṃ subuddhimān |
cakre gurukule vāsaṃ bahukālaṃ jitendriyaḥ ||
meaning:
नभगो मनुपुत्रस्तु पठनार्थं सुबुद्धिमान् |
चक्रे गुरुकुले वासं बहुकालं जितेन्द्रियः ||
text_mt: Nabhaga, the very wise son of Manu, having conquered his senses, / lived for a long time in his teacher's household for the sake of study.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminsamaye te vai ikṣvākupramukhāḥ sutāḥ |
tasmai bhāgamakalpyaiva bhejurbhāgānnijānkramāt ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्समये ते वै इक्ष्वाकुप्रमुखाः सुताः |
तस्मै भागमकल्प्यैव भेजुर्भागान्निजान्क्रमात् ||
text_mt: At that time, those sons headed by Ikṣvāku, / without allotting a share to him, divided and took their own shares in order.

sanskrit_iast:
svaṃ svaṃ bhāgaṃ gṛhītvā te bubhujū rājyamuttamam |
aviṣādaṃ mahābhāgāḥ pitrādeśātsubuddhayaḥ ||
meaning:
स्वं स्वं भागं गृहीत्वा ते बुभुजू राज्यमुत्तमम् |
अविषादं महाभागाः पित्रादेशात्सुबुद्धयः ||
text_mt: Taking each his own share by their father's command, / those fortunate and wise princes enjoyed the excellent kingdom without grief.

sanskrit_iast:
sa paścādāgatastatra brahmacārī gurusthalāt |
nabhago'dhītya sarvāśca sāṅgopāṅgāḥ śrutīḥ kramāt ||
meaning:
स पश्चादागतस्तत्र ब्रह्मचारी गुरुस्थलात् |
नभगोऽधीत्य सर्वाश्च साङ्गोपाङ्गाः श्रुतीः क्रमात् ||
text_mt: Afterward, Nabhaga returned as a celibate student from the teacher's abode, / having studied in succession all the Vedas together with their auxiliary branches.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātṛnvilokya nabhago vibhaktānsakalānnijān |
dāyārthī prāha tānsnehādikṣvākupramukhānmune ||
meaning:
भ्रातृन्विलोक्य नभगो विभक्तान्सकलान्निजान् |
दायार्थी प्राह तान्स्नेहादिक्ष्वाकुप्रमुखान्मुने ||
text_mt: Seeing all his brothers divided, Nabhaga, / desiring his inheritance, spoke affectionately to them headed by Ikṣvāku, O sage:

sanskrit_iast:
nabhaga uvāca |
bhrātaro'bhaktakaṃ mahyaṃ dāyaṃ kṛtvā yathātatham |
sarve vibhaktāḥ suprītyā svadāyārthāgatāya ca ||
meaning:
नभग उवाच |
भ्रातरोऽभक्तकं मह्यं दायं कृत्वा यथातथम् |
सर्वे विभक्ताः सुप्रीत्या स्वदायार्थागताय च ||
text_mt: Nabhaga said: / “Brothers, leaving me without a portion, / you have all divided properly among yourselves, with great pleasure, while I have now come for my own inheritance.”

sanskrit_iast:
tadā vismṛtamasmābhiridānīṃ pitaraṃ tava |
vibhajāmo vayaṃ bhāgaṃ taṃ gṛhāṇa na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
तदा विस्मृतमस्माभिरिदानीं पितरं तव |
विभजामो वयं भागं तं गृहाण न संशयः ||
text_mt: [The brothers said:] / “At that time we forgot; now we allot to you / our father as your share; take him without doubt.”

sanskrit_iast:
tacchutvā bhrātṛvacanaṃ nabhagaḥ paravismṛtaḥ |
tadopakaṇṭhamāgatya pitaraṃ samabhāṣata ||
meaning:
तच्छुत्वा भ्रातृवचनं नभगः परविस्मृतः |
तदोपकण्ठमागत्य पितरं समभाषत ||
text_mt: Hearing those words of his brothers, Nabhaga was exceedingly astonished; / then, approaching his father, he addressed him:

sanskrit_iast:
nabhaga uvāca |
he tāta bhrātaraḥ sarve tyaktvā māṃ nyabhajaṃśca te |
paṭhanārthaṃ gataścāhaṃ brahmacārī guroḥ kule ||
meaning:
नभग उवाच |
हे तात भ्रातरः सर्वे त्यक्त्वा मां न्यभजंश्च ते |
पठनार्थं गतश्चाहं ब्रह्मचारी गुरोः कुले ||
text_mt: Nabhaga said: / “O father, all the brothers have divided, leaving me out, / for I had gone to the teacher’s family as a celibate student to study.

sanskrit_iast:
tata āgatya me pṛṣṭā dāyadānārthamādarāt |
te tvāmūcurvibhāgaṃ me tadarthamahamāgataḥ ||
meaning:
तत आगत्य मे पृष्टा दायदानार्थमादरात् |
ते त्वामूचुर्विभागं मे तदर्थमहमागतः ||
text_mt: Having returned from there, I respectfully asked them for my share of the inheritance; / they told me that you are my share; therefore I have come.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
tadākarṇya vacastasya pitā taṃ prāha vismitaḥ |
āśvāsya śrāddhadevaḥ sa satyadharmarataṃ mune ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
तदाकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य पिता तं प्राह विस्मितः |
आश्वास्य श्राद्धदेवः स सत्यधर्मरतं मुने ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing his words, his father, astonished, spoke to him; / having consoled him who was devoted to truth and righteousness, Śrāddhadeva [said], O sage:

sanskrit_iast:
manuruvāca |
taduktaṃ mādṛthāstāta pratāraṇakaraṃ hi tat |
na hyahaṃ paramaṃ dāyaṃ sarvathā bhogasādhanam ||
meaning:
मनुरुवाच |
तदुक्तं मादृथास्तात प्रतारणकरं हि तत् |
न ह्यहं परमं दायं सर्वथा भोगसाधनम् ||
text_mt: Manu said: / “Do not heed what was said by them, dear son; that is indeed deceitful; / for I am not a supreme inheritance that serves by any means as an instrument of enjoyment.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi dāyabhāvena datto'haṃ taiḥ pratāribhiḥ |
tava vai jīvanopāyaṃ vadāmi śṛṇu tattvataḥ ||
meaning:
तथापि दायभावेन दत्तोऽहं तैः प्रतारिभिः |
तव वै जीवनोपायं वदामि शृणु तत्त्वतः ||
text_mt: Nevertheless, since I have been given as an inheritance by those deceivers, / I shall tell you a means of livelihood; hear it truly.

sanskrit_iast:
satramāṅgirasā viprāḥ kurvantyadya sumedhasaḥ |
tatra karmaṇi muhyanti ṣaṣṭhaṃ ṣaṣṭhamahaḥ prati ||
meaning:
सत्रमाङ्गिरसा विप्राः कुर्वन्त्यद्य सुमेधसः |
तत्र कर्मणि मुह्यन्ति षष्ठं षष्ठमहः प्रति ||
text_mt: The wise brāhmaṇas descended from Aṅgiras are performing a sacrificial session today; / they become bewildered in that rite at every sixth day.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tvaṃ gaccha nabhaga tān suśaṃsa mahākave |
sūkte dve vaiśvadeve hi satraṃ śuddhaṃ hi tadbhavet ||
meaning:
तत्र त्वं गच्छ नभग तान् सुशंस महाकवे |
सूक्ते द्वे वैश्वदेवे हि सत्रं शुद्धं हि तद्भवेत् ||
text_mt: Go there, Nabhaga, and recite well for them, O great poet, / the two Vaiśvadeva hymns; then their sacrificial session will become flawless.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkarmaṇi samāpte hi svaryānto brāhmaṇāśca te |
dhanaṃ dāsyanti te tuṣṭāḥ svasatrapariśeṣitam ||
meaning:
तत्कर्मणि समाप्ते हि स्वर्यान्तो ब्राह्मणाश्च ते |
धनं दास्यन्ति ते तुष्टाः स्वसत्रपरिशेषितम् ||
text_mt: When that rite is completed, those brāhmaṇas, going to heaven, / will be pleased and give you the wealth that remains from their sacrificial session.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
tadākarṇya piturvākyaṃ nabhagaḥ satyasāravān |
jagāma tatra suprītyā yatra tatsatramuttamam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
तदाकर्ण्य पितुर्वाक्यं नभगः सत्यसारवान् |
जगाम तत्र सुप्रीत्या यत्र तत्सत्रमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing the words of his father, Nabhaga, whose essence was truth, / went with great joy to the place where that excellent sacrificial session was being held.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāhaḥ karmaṇi mune satre tasminsa mānavaḥ |
sūkte dve vaiśvadeve hi provāca spaṣṭataḥ sudhīḥ ||
meaning:
तदाहः कर्मणि मुने सत्रे तस्मिन्स मानवः |
सूक्ते द्वे वैश्वदेवे हि प्रोवाच स्पष्टतः सुधीः ||
text_mt: At that day's rite in that sacrificial session, O sage, that wise son of Manu / clearly recited the two Vaiśvadeva hymns.

sanskrit_iast:
samāpte karmaṇi tato viprā āṅgirasāśca te |
tasmai dattvā yayuḥ svargaṃ svaṃ svaṃ satrāvaśeṣitam ||
meaning:
समाप्ते कर्मणि ततो विप्रा आङ्गिरसाश्च ते |
तस्मै दत्त्वा ययुः स्वर्गं स्वं स्वं सत्रावशेषितम् ||
text_mt: When the rite was completed, those brāhmaṇas descended from Aṅgiras / gave him whatever remained from their sacrificial session and went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tattadā svīkariṣyantaṃ susatrapariśeṣitam |
vijñāya giriśaḥ sadya āvirbhūtaḥ sadūtikṛt ||
meaning:
तत्तदा स्वीकरिष्यन्तं सुसत्रपरिशेषितम् |
विज्ञाय गिरिशः सद्य आविर्भूतः सदूतिकृत् ||
text_mt: Knowing that he was then about to take that residue of the excellent sacrifice, / Giriśa immediately appeared, accompanied by a messenger.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṅgasundaraḥ śrīmānpuruṣaḥ kṛṣṇadarśanaḥ |
bhāvaṃ samīkṣituṃ bhāgaṃ dātuṃ jñānaṃ paraṃ ca tat ||
meaning:
सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरः श्रीमान्पुरुषः कृष्णदर्शनः |
भावं समीक्षितुं भागं दातुं ज्ञानं परं च तत् ||
text_mt: A glorious man of dark appearance, handsome in all his limbs, / [he appeared] to examine his disposition, to bestow his share, and that supreme knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
atho sa śaṅkaraḥ śambhuḥ parīkṣākara īśvaraḥ |
uvācottarato'bhyetya nabhagaṃ taṃ hi mānavam ||
meaning:
अथो स शङ्करः शम्भुः परीक्षाकर ईश्वरः |
उवाचोत्तरतोऽभ्येत्य नभगं तं हि मानवम् ||
text_mt: Then that Śaṅkara, Śambhu, the Lord who puts [one] to the test, / having approached from the north, said to that son of Manu, Nabhaga:

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca |
kastvaṃ gṛhṇāsi puruṣa mamedaṃ vāstukaṃ vasu |
preṣitaḥ kena tatsarvaṃ satyaṃ vada mamāgrataḥ ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच |
कस्त्वं गृह्णासि पुरुष ममेदं वास्तुकं वसु |
प्रेषितः केन तत्सर्वं सत्यं वद ममाग्रतः ||
text_mt: The Lord said: / “Who are you, O man, who take this wealth left on the sacrificial ground belonging to me? / By whom were you sent? Tell me all the truth before me.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
tacchrutvā tadvacastāta mānavo nabhagaḥ kaviḥ |
pratyuvāca vinītātmā puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
तच्छ्रुत्वा तद्वचस्तात मानवो नभगः कविः |
प्रत्युवाच विनीतात्मा पुरुषं कृष्णदर्शनम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing those words of his, dear one, the poet Nabhaga, son of Manu, / with a humble mind replied to the man of dark appearance.

sanskrit_iast:
nabhaga uvāca |
mamedamṛṣibhirdattaṃ vasu yajñagataṃ khalu |
kathaṃ vārayase māṃ tvaṃ gṛhṇataṃ kṛṣṇadarśana ||
meaning:
नभग उवाच |
ममेदमृषिभिर्दत्तं वसु यज्ञगतं खलु |
कथं वारयसे मां त्वं गृह्णतं कृष्णदर्शन ||
text_mt: Nabhaga said: / 'This wealth belonging to the sacrifice was indeed given to me by the sages. / Why do you stop me from taking it, O dark-complexioned one?'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ākarṇya nābhagaṃ vākyamidaṃ satyamudīritam |
pratyuvāca prasannātmā puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇadarśanaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
आकर्ण्य नाभगं वाक्यमिदं सत्यमुदीरितम् |
प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा पुरुषः कृष्णदर्शनः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing this spoken word of Nabhaga, which was truthful, / the dark-complexioned person, pleased in mind, replied:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇadarśana uvāca |
vivāde'sminhi nau tāta pramāṇaṃ janakastava |
yāhi taṃ pṛccha sa brūyāttatpramāṇaṃ tu satyataḥ ||
meaning:
कृष्णदर्शन उवाच |
विवादेऽस्मिन्हि नौ तात प्रमाणं जनकस्तव |
याहि तं पृच्छ स ब्रूयात्तत्प्रमाणं तु सत्यतः ||
text_mt: Kṛṣṇadarśana said: / 'In this dispute between the two of us, my dear, your father is the authority. / Go, ask him; whatever he states is truly the authority.'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
tadākarṇya vacastasya nabhago mānavaḥ kaviḥ |
āgacchatpitaraṃ prītyā taduktaṃ pṛṣṭavānmune ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
तदाकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य नभगो मानवः कविः |
आगच्छत्पितरं प्रीत्या तदुक्तं पृष्टवान्मुने ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing his word, the wise descendant of Manu, Nabhaga, / went gladly to his father, O sage, and asked him what had been said.

sanskrit_iast:
putroditaṃ samākarṇya śrāddhadevaḥ sa vai manuḥ |
smṛtvā śivapadāmbhojaṃ prāptasmṛtiruvāca tam ||
meaning:
पुत्रोदितं समाकर्ण्य श्राद्धदेवः स वै मनुः |
स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजं प्राप्तस्मृतिरुवाच तम् ||
text_mt: Hearing what was spoken by his son, that Manu, Śrāddhadeva, / remembered the lotus feet of Śiva and, regaining his mindfulness, said to him:

sanskrit_iast:
manuruvāca |
he tāta śṛṇu madvākyaṃ sa devaḥ puruṣaḥ śivaḥ |
tasyaiva sakalaṃ vastu yajñaprāptaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
मनुरुवाच |
हे तात शृणु मद्वाक्यं स देवः पुरुषः शिवः |
तस्यैव सकलं वस्तु यज्ञप्राप्तं विशेषतः ||
text_mt: Manu said: / 'O dear child, hear my word: that divine person is Śiva. / To him alone belongs every object, especially whatever is obtained from a sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
adhvarorvaritaṃ vastu rudrabhāgaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
ityapi prājñavādo hi kvacijjātastadicchayā ||
meaning:
अध्वरोर्वरितं वस्तु रुद्रभागः प्रकीर्तितः |
इत्यपि प्राज्ञवादो हि क्वचिज्जातस्तदिच्छया ||
text_mt: Whatever object is left over from a sacrifice is proclaimed to be Rudra’s share; / this saying of the wise has indeed arisen somewhere by his will.

sanskrit_iast:
sa deva īśvaraḥ sarvaṃ vastvarhati na saṃśayaḥ |
yajñāvaśiṣṭaṃ kimuta pare tasyecchayā vibhoḥ ||
meaning:
स देव ईश्वरः सर्वं वस्त्वर्हति न संशयः |
यज्ञावशिष्टं किमुत परे तस्येच्छया विभोः ||
text_mt: That divine lord deserves everything, there is no doubt; / how much more what remains of a sacrifice, while others exist by the will of that all-pervading lord?

sanskrit_iast:
anugrahārthamāyātastava tadrūpataḥ prabhuḥ |
tatra tvaṃ gaccha nabhaga prasannaṃ kuru satyataḥ ||
meaning:
अनुग्रहार्थमायातस्तव तद्रूपतः प्रभुः |
तत्र त्वं गच्छ नभग प्रसन्नं कुरु सत्यतः ||
text_mt: The Lord has come in that form in order to bestow grace upon you. / Go there, Nabhaga, and truly make him pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamāpaya svāparādhaṃ supraṇamya stutiṃ kuru |
sarvaprabhuḥ sa eveśo yajñādhīśo'khileśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
क्षमापय स्वापराधं सुप्रणम्य स्तुतिं कुरु |
सर्वप्रभुः स एवेशो यज्ञाधीशोऽखिलेश्वरः ||
text_mt: Beg forgiveness for your fault; prostrating well, offer praise. / He alone is the Lord of all, the master of the sacrifice, the sovereign of everything.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇubrahmādayo devāḥ siddhāḥ sarvarṣayo'pi hi |
tadanugrahatastāta samarthāḥ sarvakarmaṇi ||
meaning:
विष्णुब्रह्मादयो देवाः सिद्धाः सर्वर्षयोऽपि हि |
तदनुग्रहतस्तात समर्थाः सर्वकर्मणि ||
text_mt: The gods headed by Viṣṇu and Brahmā, the perfected ones, and even all the sages, / are indeed competent in every action only by his grace, my child.

sanskrit_iast:
kimbahūktyātmajaśreṣṭha gaccha tatrāśu māciram |
prasādaya mahādevaṃ sarvathā sakaleśvaram ||
meaning:
किम्बहूक्त्यात्मजश्रेष्ठ गच्छ तत्राशु माचिरम् |
प्रसादय महादेवं सर्वथा सकलेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: What is the use of saying much, best of sons? Go there quickly without delay. / Propitiate Mahādeva in every way, the sovereign of all.'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvā sa manuḥ śrāddhadevaśca tanayaṃ drutam |
preṣayāmāsa nikaṭaṃ śambhoḥ so'pi sametya tam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा स मनुः श्राद्धदेवश्च तनयं द्रुतम् |
प्रेषयामास निकटं शम्भोः सोऽपि समेत्य तम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, that Manu, Śrāddhadeva, quickly sent / his son to the presence of Śambhu. He too, approaching him,

sanskrit_iast:
nabhagaśca praṇamyāśu sāñjalirnatamastakaḥ |
provāca suprasannātmā vinayena mahāmatiḥ ||
meaning:
नभगश्च प्रणम्याशु साञ्जलिर्नतमस्तकः |
प्रोवाच सुप्रसन्नात्मा विनयेन महामतिः ||
text_mt: Nabhaga bowed quickly, with folded hands and bent head; / exceedingly pleased in mind, the great-minded one said with humility:

sanskrit_iast:
nabhaga uvāca |
idaṃ taveśa sarvaṃ hi vastu tribhuvane hi yat |
ityāha me pitā nūnaṃ kimutādhvaraśeṣitam ||
meaning:
नभग उवाच |
इदं तवेश सर्वं हि वस्तु त्रिभुवने हि यत् |
इत्याह मे पिता नूनं किमुताध्वरशेषितम् ||
text_mt: Nabhaga said: / 'O Lord, whatever object exists in the three worlds is indeed yours; / so my father has truly said—how much more what remains from a sacrifice?

sanskrit_iast:
ajānatā mayā nātha yaduktaṃ tadvaco bhramāt |
aparādhaṃ tvaṃ kṣamasva śirasā tvāṃ prasādaye ||
meaning:
अजानता मया नाथ यदुक्तं तद्वचो भ्रमात् |
अपराधं त्वं क्षमस्व शिरसा त्वां प्रसादये ||
text_mt: Whatever word was spoken by me in ignorance out of delusion, O protector, / forgive that offense; I propitiate you with my head [bowed].'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā nabhagaḥ so'tidīnadhīstu kṛtāñjaliḥ |
tuṣṭāva taṃ maheśānaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanamānataḥ ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा नभगः सोऽतिदीनधीस्तु कृताञ्जलिः |
तुष्टाव तं महेशानं कृष्णदर्शनमानतः ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Nabhaga, with a mind exceedingly humble and with folded hands, / praised that Maheśāna, Kṛṣṇadarśana, bowing down.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhadevo'pi śuddhātmā natakaḥ sāñjaliḥ sudhīḥ |
tuṣṭāva taṃ prabhuṃ natvā svāparādhaṃ kṣamāpayan ||
meaning:
श्राद्धदेवोऽपि शुद्धात्मा नतकः साञ्जलिः सुधीः |
तुष्टाव तं प्रभुं नत्वा स्वापराधं क्षमापयन् ||
text_mt: Śrāddhadeva too, pure in mind, bowing down with folded hands, wise, / praised that Lord, bowing and begging forgiveness for his own offense.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tatra viṣṇubrahmādayaḥ surāḥ |
vāsavādyāḥ samājagmuḥ siddhāśca munayo'pi hi ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र विष्णुब्रह्मादयः सुराः |
वासवाद्याः समाजग्मुः सिद्धाश्च मुनयोऽपि हि ||
text_mt: Meanwhile, the gods headed by Viṣṇu and Brahmā, / those headed by Indra, and the perfected ones and sages arrived there.

sanskrit_iast:
mahotsavaṃ prakurvantaḥ sukṛtāñjalayo'khilāḥ |
tuṣṭuvurnatakā bhaktyā supraṇamya pṛthakpṛthak ||
meaning:
महोत्सवं प्रकुर्वन्तः सुकृताञ्जलयोऽखिलाः |
तुष्टुवुर्नतका भक्त्या सुप्रणम्य पृथक्पृथक् ||
text_mt: Holding a great festival, all of them with well-folded hands, / bowing down, praised [him] individually with devotion, prostrating well.

sanskrit_iast:
atha rudraḥ prasannātmā kṛpādṛṣṭyā vilokya tān |
uvāca nabhagaṃ prītyā sasmitaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanaḥ ||
meaning:
अथ रुद्रः प्रसन्नात्मा कृपादृष्ट्या विलोक्य तान् |
उवाच नभगं प्रीत्या सस्मितं कृष्णदर्शनः ||
text_mt: Then Rudra, pleased in mind, looking upon them with a glance of compassion, / Kṛṣṇadarśana, spoke to Nabhaga with affection and a smile:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇadarśana uvāca |
yatte pitāvadaddharmyaṃ vākyaṃ tattu tathaiva hi |
tvayāpi satyamuktaṃ tat sādhustvaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
कृष्णदर्शन उवाच |
यत्ते पितावदद्धर्म्यं वाक्यं तत्तु तथैव हि |
त्वयापि सत्यमुक्तं तत् साधुस्त्वं नात्र संशयः ||
text_mt: Kṛṣṇadarśana said: / 'The righteous statement which your father uttered is indeed truly so; / and you too have spoken the truth; you are virtuous, of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
ato'haṃ suprasanno'smi sarvathā suvratena te |
dadāmi kṛpayā te hi jñānaṃ brahma sanātanam ||
meaning:
अतोऽहं सुप्रसन्नोऽस्मि सर्वथा सुव्रतेन ते |
ददामि कृपया ते हि ज्ञानं ब्रह्म सनातनम् ||
text_mt: Therefore, I am exceedingly pleased with your observance in every respect. / Out of compassion, I indeed give you knowledge, the eternal Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
mahājñānī bhava tvaṃ hi savipro nabhagaṃ drutam |
gṛhāṇa vastvidaṃ sarvaṃ maddattaṃ kṛpayādhunā ||
meaning:
महाज्ञानी भव त्वं हि सविप्रो नभगं द्रुतम् |
गृहाण वस्त्विदं सर्वं मद्दत्तं कृपयाधुना ||
text_mt: Quickly become one of great knowledge, O Nabhaga, along with the brahmins. / Take all this wealth now given by me out of compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
iha sarvasukhaṃ bhuṅkṣva nirvikāraṃ mahāmate |
sugatiṃ prāpsyasi tvaṃ hi savipraḥ kṛpayā mama ||
meaning:
इह सर्वसुखं भुङ्क्ष्व निर्विकारं महामते |
सुगतिं प्राप्स्यसि त्वं हि सविप्रः कृपया मम ||
text_mt: Enjoy all happiness here, free from alteration, O great-minded one; / along with the brahmins, you will attain a good state by my grace.'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvā tāta bhagavānsa rudraḥ satyavatsalaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ tatraivāntardadhe haraḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा तात भगवान्स रुद्रः सत्यवत्सलः |
सर्वेषां पश्यतां तेषां तत्रैवान्तर्दधे हरः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, my dear, the Lord, that Rudra who loves truth, / Hara, vanished right there while all of them were watching.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇurbrahmāpi devādyāḥ sarve te munisattama |
svaṃ svaṃ dhāma yayuḥ prītyā tasyai natvā diśe mudā ||
meaning:
विष्णुर्ब्रह्मापि देवाद्याः सर्वे ते मुनिसत्तम |
स्वं स्वं धाम ययुः प्रीत्या तस्यै नत्वा दिशे मुदा ||
text_mt: Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and all the gods, O best of sages, / bowed with joy toward that direction and departed gladly to their respective abodes.

sanskrit_iast:
saputraḥ śrāddhadevo'pi svasthānamagamanmudā |
bhuktvā bhogānsuvipulānso'nte śivapuraṃ yayau ||
meaning:
सपुत्रः श्राद्धदेवोऽपि स्वस्थानमगमन्मुदा |
भुक्त्वा भोगान्सुविपुलान्सोऽन्ते शिवपुरं ययौ ||
text_mt: Śrāddhadeva too, together with his son, went to his own place with joy; / having enjoyed vast pleasures, he went to Śiva’s abode at the end.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ te kīrtito brahmannavatāraḥ śivasya hi |
kṛṣṇadarśananāmā vai nabhagānandadāyakaḥ ||
meaning:
इत्थं ते कीर्तितो ब्रह्मन्नवतारः शिवस्य हि |
कृष्णदर्शननामा वै नभगानन्ददायकः ||
text_mt: Thus has been recounted to you, O brahmin, the incarnation of Śiva / named Kṛṣṇadarśana, who brought delight to Nabhaga.

sanskrit_iast:
idamākhyānamanaghaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ satām |
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ vāpi sarvakāmaphalapradam ||
meaning:
इदमाख्यानमनघं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं सताम् |
पठतां शृण्वतां वापि सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ||
text_mt: This faultless narrative grants enjoyment and liberation to the virtuous, / and to those who read or hear it, it bestows the fruit of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
ya etaccaritaṃ prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca smarate sudhīḥ |
kavirbhavati mantrajño gatimante labhetparām ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
य एतच्चरितं प्रातः सायं च स्मरते सुधीः |
कविर्भवति मन्त्रज्ञो गतिमन्ते लभेत्पराम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
The wise person who remembers this deed at morning and evening / becomes a poet, knower of mantras, and attains the supreme state at the end.

Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter, named 'Description of the Incarnation of Śiva as Kṛṣṇadarśana', in the third book, the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, in the dialogue between Nandīśvara and Sanatkumāra in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
śṛṇu tvaṃ brahmaputrādyāvatāraṃ parameśituḥ |
avadhūteśvarāhvaṃ vai śakragarvāpahārakam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
शृणु त्वं ब्रह्मपुत्राद्यावतारं परमेशितुः |
अवधूतेश्वराह्वं वै शक्रगर्वापहारकम् ||
title: triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | avadhūteśvaraśivāvatāracaritravarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
śakraḥ purā hi saguruḥ sarvadevasamanvitaḥ |
darśanaṃ kartumīśasya kailāsamagamanmune ||
meaning:
शक्रः पुरा हि सगुरुः सर्वदेवसमन्वितः |
दर्शनं कर्तुमीशस्य कैलासमगमन्मुने ||

sanskrit_iast:
atha gurvindrayorjñātvāgamanaṃ śaṅkarastayoḥ |
parīkṣituṃ ca tadbhāvaṃ svadarśanaratātmanoḥ ||
meaning:
अथ गुर्विन्द्रयोर्ज्ञात्वागमनं शङ्करस्तयोः |
परीक्षितुं च तद्भावं स्वदर्शनरतात्मनोः ||

sanskrit_iast:
avadhūtasvarūpo'bhūnnānālīlākaraḥ prabhuḥ |
digambaro mahābhīmo jvaladagnisamaprabhaḥ ||
meaning:
अवधूतस्वरूपोऽभून्नानालीलाकरः प्रभुः |
दिगम्बरो महाभीमो ज्वलदग्निसमप्रभः ||

sanskrit_iast:
so'vadhūtasvarūpo hi mārgamāruddhya sadgatiḥ |
lambamānapaṭaḥ śambhuratiṣṭhacchobhitākṛtiḥ ||
meaning:
सोऽवधूतस्वरूपो हि मार्गमारुद्ध्य सद्गतिः |
लम्बमानपटः शम्भुरतिष्ठच्छोभिताकृतिः ||

sanskrit_iast:
atha tau guruśakrau ca gacchantau śiva sannidhim |
adrāṣṭāṃ puruṣaṃ bhīmaṃ mārgamadhye'dbhutākṛtim ||
meaning:
अथ तौ गुरुशक्रौ च गच्छन्तौ शिव सन्निधिम् |
अद्राष्टां पुरुषं भीमं मार्गमध्येऽद्भुताकृतिम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
atha śakro mune'pṛcchatsvādhikāreṇa durmadaḥ |
puruṣaṃ taṃ svamārgāntaḥ sthitamajñāya śaṅkaram ||
meaning:
अथ शक्रो मुनेऽपृच्छत्स्वाधिकारेण दुर्मदः |
पुरुषं तं स्वमार्गान्तः स्थितमज्ञाय शङ्करम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
śakra uvāca |
kastvaṃ digambarākārāvadhūtaḥ kuta āgataḥ |
kinnāma tava vikhyātaṃ tattvato vada me'ciram ||
meaning:
शक्र उवाच |
कस्त्वं दिगम्बराकारावधूतः कुत आगतः |
किन्नाम तव विख्यातं तत्त्वतो वद मेऽचिरम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
svasthāne saṃsthitaḥ śambhuḥ kiṃ vānyatra gato'dhunā |
darśanārthaṃ hi tasyāhaṃ gacchāmi saguruḥ suraiḥ ||
meaning:
स्वस्थाने संस्थितः शम्भुः किं वान्यत्र गतोऽधुना |
दर्शनार्थं हि तस्याहं गच्छामि सगुरुः सुरैः ||

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
śakreṇetthaṃ sa pṛṣṭaśca kiñcinnovāca pūruṣaḥ |
līlāgṛhītadehaḥ sa śaṅkaro madahā prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
शक्रेणेत्थं स पृष्टश्च किञ्चिन्नोवाच पूरुषः |
लीलागृहीतदेहः स शङ्करो मदहा प्रभुः ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said: / 'Listen, O son of Brahmā, to another incarnation of the Supreme Lord, / named Avadhūteśvara, who removed the pride of Indra.

Nandīśvara said: / Questioned thus by Indra, that man said nothing at all— / that Lord Śaṅkara who had assumed a body in sport, the destroyer of pride.

sanskrit_iast:
śakraḥ punarapṛcchattaṃ novāca sa digambaraḥ |
avijñātagatiḥ śambhurmahākautukakārakaḥ ||
meaning:
शक्रः पुनरपृच्छत्तं नोवाच स दिगम्बरः |
अविज्ञातगतिः शम्भुर्महाकौतुककारकः ||
text_mt: Śakra asked him again; that naked one did not speak, / Śambhu of unfathomable course, creator of a great wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ purandaro'pṛccht trailokyādhipatiḥ svarāṭ |
tūṣṇīmāsa mahāyogī mahālīlākaraḥ sa vai ||
meaning:
पुनः पुरन्दरोऽपृच्छ्त् त्रैलोक्याधिपतिः स्वराट् |
तूष्णीमास महायोगी महालीलाकरः स वै ||
text_mt: Indra, the sovereign ruler and lord of the three worlds, asked again, / but that great yogin, the performer of great sport, remained silent.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ punaḥ punaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ śakreṇa sa digambaraḥ |
novāca kiñcidbhagavān śakradarpajighāṃsayā ||
meaning:
इत्थं पुनः पुनः पृष्टः शक्रेण स दिगम्बरः |
नोवाच किञ्चिद्भगवान् शक्रदर्पजिघांसया ||
text_mt: Though thus questioned again and again by Śakra, the naked ascetic, / the Lord, wishing to crush the pride of Śakra, said nothing at all.

sanskrit_iast:
atha cukrodha deveśastrailokyaiśvaryagarvitaḥ |
uvāca vacanaṃ krodhāttaṃ nirbhartsya jaṭādharam ||
meaning:
अथ चुक्रोध देवेशस्त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यगर्वितः |
उवाच वचनं क्रोधात्तं निर्भर्त्स्य जटाधरम् ||
text_mt: Then the lord of gods, proud of his sovereignty over the three worlds, became enraged; / he spoke these words in anger, rebuking that ascetic with matted hair:

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca |
pṛcchamāno'pi re mūḍha nottaraṃ dattavānasi |
atastvāṃ hanmi vajreṇa kaste trātāsti durmate ||
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच |
पृच्छमानोऽपि रे मूढ नोत्तरं दत्तवानसि |
अतस्त्वां हन्मि वज्रेण कस्ते त्रातास्ति दुर्मते ||
text_mt: Indra said: / 'O fool! Though questioned, you give no answer! / Therefore I shall strike you with my thunderbolt. Who will protect you, wicked-minded one?'

sanskrit_iast:
ityudīrya tato vajrī sannirīkṣya krudhā hi tam |
hantuṃ digambaraṃ vajramudyataṃ sa cakāra ha ||
meaning:
इत्युदीर्य ततो वज्री सन्निरीक्ष्य क्रुधा हि तम् |
हन्तुं दिगम्बरं वज्रमुद्यतं स चकार ह ||
text_mt: Having said this, the wielder of the thunderbolt looked at him with great fury / and raised his thunderbolt to slay the naked ascetic.

sanskrit_iast:
vajrahastaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ śīghraṃ sadāśivaḥ |
cakāra stambhanaṃ tasya vajrapātasya śaṅkaraḥ ||
meaning:
वज्रहस्तं च तं दृष्ट्वा शक्रं शीघ्रं सदाशिवः |
चकार स्तम्भनं तस्य वज्रपातस्य शङ्करः ||
text_mt: Seeing Śakra with the thunderbolt in his hand, Sadāśiva / quickly paralyzed that hurling of the thunderbolt, Śaṅkara did.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa puruṣaḥ kruddhaḥ karālākṣo bhayaṅkaraḥ |
drutameva prajajvāla tejasā pradahanniva ||
meaning:
ततः स पुरुषः क्रुद्धः करालाक्षो भयङ्करः |
द्रुतमेव प्रजज्वाल तेजसा प्रदहन्निव ||
text_mt: Then that person became wrathful, with fierce eyes, terrifying to behold; / he immediately blazed up with splendor as if to burn [everything].

sanskrit_iast:
bāhupratiṣṭambhabhuvā manyunāntaḥ śacīpatiḥ |
samadahyata bhogīva mantraruddhaparākramaḥ ||
meaning:
बाहुप्रतिष्टम्भभुवा मन्युनान्तः शचीपतिः |
समदह्यत भोगीव मन्त्ररुद्धपराक्रमः ||
text_mt: From the internal anger caused by the paralysis of his arm, the husband of Śacī / burned within like a serpent whose prowess is constrained by a spell.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā bṛhaspatistvenaṃ prajvalantaṃ svatejasā |
puruṣaṃ taṃ dhiyāmāsa praṇanāma haraṃ drutam ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा बृहस्पतिस्त्वेनं प्रज्वलन्तं स्वतेजसा |
पुरुषं तं धियामास प्रणनाम हरं द्रुतम् ||
text_mt: Seeing him blazing with his own brilliance, / Bṛhaspati recognized that person with his intellect and quickly bowed to Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā tato gururudāradhīḥ |
daṇḍavatkau punarnatvā prabhuṃ tuṣṭāva bhaktitaḥ ||
meaning:
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा ततो गुरुरुदारधीः |
दण्डवत्कौ पुनर्नत्वा प्रभुं तुष्टाव भक्तितः ||
text_mt: Then the guru, noble-minded, joining his palms in reverence, / bowed prostrate on the ground once more and praised the Lord with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
gururuvāca |
devadeva mahādeva śaraṇāgatavatsala |
prasanno bhava gaurīśa sarveśvara namo'stu te ||
meaning:
गुरुरुवाच |
देवदेव महादेव शरणागतवत्सल |
प्रसन्नो भव गौरीश सर्वेश्वर नमोऽस्तु ते ||
text_mt: The guru said: / 'O God of gods! O Mahādeva, affectionate toward those who seek refuge! / Be gracious, O lord of Gaurī, Lord of all! Homage be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
māyayā mohitāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇvādayo'pi te |
tvāṃ na jānanti tattvena jānanti tvadanugrahāt ||
meaning:
मायया मोहिताः सर्वे ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादयोऽपि ते |
त्वां न जानन्ति तत्त्वेन जानन्ति त्वदनुग्रहात् ||
text_mt: Deluded by your māyā, all beings, even Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and the others, / do not know you in truth; they know you [only] by your grace.'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
bṛhaspatiriti stutvā sa tadā śaṅkaraṃ prabhum |
pādayoḥ pātayāmāsa tasyeśasya purandaram ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
बृहस्पतिरिति स्तुत्वा स तदा शङ्करं प्रभुम् |
पादयोः पातयामास तस्येशस्य पुरन्दरम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having thus praised the Lord Śaṅkara, Bṛhaspati then / cast Purandara down at the feet of that Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastāta surācāryaḥ kṛtāñjalirudāradhīḥ |
bṛhaspatiruvācedaṃ praśrayāvanataḥ sudhīḥ ||
meaning:
ततस्तात सुराचार्यः कृताञ्जलिरुदारधीः |
बृहस्पतिरुवाचेदं प्रश्रयावनतः सुधीः ||
text_mt: Then, dear one, the preceptor of the gods, noble-minded and wise, / Bṛhaspati, with joined palms, bowed in humility and said this:

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca |
dīnānātha mahādeva praṇataṃ tava pādayoḥ |
samuddhara ca māṃ tattvaṃ krodhaṃ na praṇayaṃ kuru ||
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच |
दीनानाथ महादेव प्रणतं तव पादयोः |
समुद्धर च मां तत्त्वं क्रोधं न प्रणयं कुरु ||
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / 'O protector of the helpless! O Mahādeva! He is bowed at your feet; / rescue us truly; do not display anger, show your love!

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭo bhava mahādeva pāhīndraṃ śaraṇāgatam |
vahnireṣa samāyāti bhālanetrasamudbhavaḥ ||
meaning:
तुष्टो भव महादेव पाहीन्द्रं शरणागतम् |
वह्निरेष समायाति भालनेत्रसमुद्भवः ||
text_mt: Be pleased, O Mahādeva! Protect Indra who has come for refuge! / This fire is emerging, born from the eye on your forehead!'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityākarṇya gurorvākyamavadhūtākṛtiḥ prabhuḥ |
uvāca karuṇāsindhurvihasan sa sadūtikṛt ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य गुरोर्वाक्यमवधूताकृतिः प्रभुः |
उवाच करुणासिन्धुर्विहसन् स सदूतिकृत् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing this speech of the guru, the Lord in the form of an avadhūta, / that ocean of compassion, smiling, said:

sanskrit_iast:
avadhūta uvāca |
krodhācca nissṛtaṃ tejo dhārayāmi svanetrataḥ |
kathaṃ hi kañcukīṃ sarpaḥ sandhatte cojjhitāṃ punaḥ ||
meaning:
अवधूत उवाच |
क्रोधाच्च निस्सृतं तेजो धारयामि स्वनेत्रतः |
कथं हि कञ्चुकीं सर्पः सन्धत्ते चोज्झितां पुनः ||
text_mt: The Avadhūta said: / '[How can] I withhold the splendor that has issued from my eye through wrath? / How indeed does a serpent put back on a sloughed skin that has been cast off?'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti śrutvā vacastasya śaṅkarasya bṛhaspatiḥ |
uvāca sāñjalirbhūyo bhayavyākulamānasaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य शङ्करस्य बृहस्पतिः |
उवाच साञ्जलिर्भूयो भयव्याकुलमानसः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having heard these words of Śaṅkara, Bṛhaspati, / his mind agitated with fear, spoke once again with joined palms:

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca |
he deva bhagavanbhaktā anukampyāḥ sadaiva hi |
bhaktavatsalanāmeti svaṃ satyaṃ kuru śaṅkara ||
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच |
हे देव भगवन्भक्ता अनुकम्प्याः सदैव हि |
भक्तवत्सलनामेति स्वं सत्यं कुरु शङ्कर ||
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / 'O God! O Blessed One! Devotees must always be shown compassion; / make your name "affectionate toward devotees" true, O Śaṅkara!

sanskrit_iast:
kṣeptumanyatra deveśa svatejo'tyugramarhasi |
uddhartā sarvabhaktānāṃ samuddhara purandaram ||
meaning:
क्षेप्तुमन्यत्र देवेश स्वतेजोऽत्युग्रमर्हसि |
उद्धर्ता सर्वभक्तानां समुद्धर पुरन्दरम् ||
text_mt: O Lord of gods, you ought to cast your exceedingly fierce splendor elsewhere. / O deliverer of all devotees, deliver Purandara!'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityukto guruṇā rudro bhaktavatsalanāmabhāk |
pratyuvāca prasannātmā surejyaṃ praṇatārtihā ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्तो गुरुणा रुद्रो भक्तवत्सलनामभाक् |
प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा सुरेज्यं प्रणतार्तिहा ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Thus addressed by the guru, Rudra, who bears the name "affectionate toward devotees," / delighted in heart and remover of the distress of the bowed, answered the preceptor of the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
rudra uvāca |
prītaste'haṃ surācārya dadāmi varamuttamam |
indrasya jīvadānena jīveti tvaṃ prathāṃ vraja ||
meaning:
रुद्र उवाच |
प्रीतस्तेऽहं सुराचार्य ददामि वरमुत्तमम् |
इन्द्रस्य जीवदानेन जीवेति त्वं प्रथां व्रज ||
text_mt: Rudra said: / 'I am pleased with you, O preceptor of the gods; I grant you an excellent boon: / By granting life to Indra, you shall be renowned by the name Jīva.

sanskrit_iast:
samudbhūto'nalo yo'yaṃ bhālanetrātsurāsahaḥ |
enaṃ tyakṣyāmyahaṃ dūre yathendraṃ naiva pīḍayet ||
meaning:
समुद्भूतोऽनलो योऽयं भालनेत्रात्सुरासहः |
एनं त्यक्ष्याम्यहं दूरे यथेन्द्रं नैव पीडयेत् ||
text_mt: This fire that has arisen from my forehead-eye, intolerable even to the gods, / I shall cast far away, so that it will not torment Indra.'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvā sa kare dhṛtvā svatejo'nalamadbhutam |
bhālanetrasamudbhūtaṃ prākṣipallavaṇāmbhasi ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा स करे धृत्वा स्वतेजोऽनलमद्भुतम् |
भालनेत्रसमुद्भूतं प्राक्षिपल्लवणाम्भसि ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having said this, taking that wondrous fire of his splendor / produced from the eye on his forehead into his hand, he threw it into the salt sea.

sanskrit_iast:
atho śivasya tattejo bhālanetrasamudbhavam |
kṣiptaṃ ca lavaṇāmbhodhau sadyo bālo babhūva ha ||
meaning:
अथो शिवस्य तत्तेजो भालनेत्रसमुद्भवम् |
क्षिप्तं च लवणाम्भोधौ सद्यो बालो बभूव ह ||
text_mt: Then, that splendor of Śiva, produced from the eye on his forehead, / when thrown into the salt sea, instantly became an infant.

sanskrit_iast:
sa jalandharanāmābhūtsindhuputro'sureśvaraḥ |
taṃ jaghāna maheśāno devaprārthanayā prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
स जलन्धरनामाभूत्सिन्धुपुत्रोऽसुरेश्वरः |
तं जघान महेशानो देवप्रार्थनया प्रभुः ||
text_mt: He became the son of the ocean named Jalandhara, the lord of asuras; / at the prayer of the gods, the Lord Maheśāna later slew him.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ kṛtvā sucaritaṃ śaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ |
avadhūtasvarūpeṇa tataścāntarhito'bhavat ||
meaning:
इत्थं कृत्वा सुचरितं शङ्करो लोकशङ्करः |
अवधूतस्वरूपेण ततश्चान्तर्हितोऽभवत् ||
text_mt: Having thus performed this noble deed, Śaṅkara, the benefactor of the world, / then disappeared in that form of an avadhūta.

sanskrit_iast:
babhūvuḥ sakalā devāḥ sukhinaścātinirbhayāḥ |
guruśakrau bhayānmuktau jagmatuḥ sukhamuttamam ||
meaning:
बभूवुः सकला देवाः सुखिनश्चातिनिर्भयाः |
गुरुशक्रौ भयान्मुक्तौ जग्मतुः सुखमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: All the gods became happy and completely free from fear; / the guru and Śakra, freed from danger, attained the highest happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
yadarthe gamanodyuktau darśanaṃ prāpya tasya tau |
kṛtārthau guruśakrau hi svasthānaṃ jagmaturmudā ||
meaning:
यदर्थे गमनोद्युक्तौ दर्शनं प्राप्य तस्य तौ |
कृतार्थौ गुरुशक्रौ हि स्वस्थानं जग्मतुर्मुदा ||
text_mt: Having obtained the sight of him for which they had set out, / the guru and Śakra, their purpose fulfilled, went gladly to their own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
avadhūteśvarāhvo'vatāraste kathito mayā |
parameśasya paramānandadaḥ khaladaṇḍadaḥ ||
meaning:
अवधूतेश्वराह्वोऽवतारस्ते कथितो मया |
परमेशस्य परमानन्ददः खलदण्डदः ||
text_mt: This incarnation of Parameśa named Avadhūteśvara has been told to you by me; / it grants supreme bliss and inflicts punishment upon the wicked.

sanskrit_iast:
idamākhyānamanaghaṃ yaśasyaṃ svargyameva ca |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ||
meaning:
इदमाख्यानमनघं यशस्यं स्वर्ग्यमेव च |
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं दिव्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ||
text_mt: This sinless narrative brings renown and leads to heaven; / it bestows enjoyment and liberation, divine, granting the fruit of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ |
iha sarvasukhaṃ bhuktvā so'nte śivagatiṃ labhet ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः |
इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा सोऽन्ते शिवगतिं लभेत् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Whoever listens to this daily or recites it with a collected mind, / having enjoyed all pleasures in this world, shall attain the state of Śiva at the end.

Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, titled 'Description of the Avadhūteśvara Incarnation of Śiva,' in the dialogue between Nandīśvara and Sanatkumāra, in the third [saṃhitā], the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
atha vakṣye muniśreṣṭha śambhoḥ śṛṇvavatārakam |
svabhaktadayayā vipra nārīsandehabhañjakam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
अथ वक्ष्ये मुनिश्रेष्ठ शम्भोः शृण्ववतारकम् |
स्वभक्तदयया विप्र नारीसन्देहभञ्जकम् ||
title: ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | bhikṣuvaryāhvaśivāvatāra caritravarṇanam
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / 'Now, O foremost of sages, listen to an incarnation of Śambhu, / which dispelled a woman's doubt out of compassion for his devotee, O vipra.

sanskrit_iast:
āsītsatyaratho nāmnā vidarbhaviṣaye nṛpaḥ |
dharmātmā satyaśīlaśca mahāśaivajanapriyaḥ ||
meaning:
आसीत्सत्यरथो नाम्ना विदर्भविषये नृपः |
धर्मात्मा सत्यशीलश्च महाशैवजनप्रियः ||
text_mt: There was a king named Satyaratha in the region of Vidarbha, / righteous, truthful in conduct, and beloved by devotees of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya rājñaḥ sudharmeṇa mahīṃ pālayato mune |
mahānkālo vyatīyāya sukhena śivadharmataḥ ||
meaning:
तस्य राज्ञः सुधर्मेण महीं पालयतो मुने |
महान्कालो व्यतीयाय सुखेन शिवधर्मतः ||
text_mt: While that king was protecting the earth in accordance with true righteousness, O sage, / a long period of time passed in happiness through adherence to the duties sacred to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācittasya rājñastu śālvaiśca purarodhibhiḥ |
mahān raṇo babhūvātha bahusainyairbaloddhataiḥ ||
meaning:
कदाचित्तस्य राज्ञस्तु शाल्वैश्च पुररोधिभिः |
महान् रणो बभूवाथ बहुसैन्यैर्बलोद्धतैः ||
text_mt: Once, however, a great battle took place between that king and the Śālvas / who besieged the city with large armies arrogant with strength.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vidarbhanṛpaḥ kṛtvā sārdhaṃ tairdāruṇaṃ raṇam |
pranaṣṭorubalaḥ śālvairnihato daivayogataḥ ||
meaning:
स विदर्भनृपः कृत्वा सार्धं तैर्दारुणं रणम् |
प्रनष्टोरुबलः शाल्वैर्निहतो दैवयोगतः ||
text_mt: Having fought a fierce battle with them, that king of Vidarbha, / his great force destroyed, was slain by the Śālvas through the decree of destiny.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnṛpe hate yuddhe śālvaistu bhayavihvalāḥ |
sainikā hataśeṣāśca mantribhiḥ saha dudruvuḥ ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्नृपे हते युद्धे शाल्वैस्तु भयविह्वलाः |
सैनिका हतशेषाश्च मन्त्रिभिः सह दुद्रुवुः ||
text_mt: When that king was slain in battle by the Śālvas, / the remaining soldiers, overwhelmed with terror, fled together with the ministers.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tasya mahārājñī rātrau svapurato mune |
saṃruddhā ripubhiryatnādantarvatnī bahiryayau ||
meaning:
अथ तस्य महाराज्ञी रात्रौ स्वपुरतो मुने |
संरुद्धा रिपुभिर्यत्नादन्तर्वत्नी बहिर्ययौ ||
text_mt: Then, O sage, his chief queen, who was pregnant, / being besieged with effort by the enemies, slipped outside from her city at night.

sanskrit_iast:
nirgatā śokasantaptā sā rājamahiṣī śanaiḥ |
prācīṃ diśaṃ yayau dūraṃ smarantīśapadāmbujam ||
meaning:
निर्गता शोकसन्तप्ता सा राजमहिषी शनैः |
प्राचीं दिशं ययौ दूरं स्मरन्तीशपदाम्बुजम् ||
text_mt: Having set forth, afflicted with grief, that chief queen / went far toward the eastern quarter, remembering the lotus feet of Īśa.

sanskrit_iast:
atha prabhāte sā rājñī dadarśa vimalaṃ saraḥ |
atītā dūramadhvānaṃ dayayā śaṅkarasya hi ||
meaning:
अथ प्रभाते सा राज्ञी ददर्श विमलं सरः |
अतीता दूरमध्वानं दयया शङ्करस्य हि ||
text_mt: Then at daybreak, having traversed a great distance by the grace of Śaṅkara, / that queen saw a clear lake.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāgatya priyā rājñaḥ santaptā sukumāriṇī |
nivāsārthaṃ sarastīre chāyāvṛkṣamupāśrayat ||
meaning:
तत्रागत्य प्रिया राज्ञः सन्तप्ता सुकुमारिणी |
निवासार्थं सरस्तीरे छायावृक्षमुपाश्रयत् ||
text_mt: Having arrived there, that beloved wife of the king, afflicted and delicate, / took shelter under a shade-giving tree on the bank of the lake to rest.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra daivavaśādrājñī muhūrtte sadguṇānvite |
asūta tanayaṃ divyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam ||
meaning:
तत्र दैववशाद्राज्ञी मुहूर्त्ते सद्गुणान्विते |
असूत तनयं दिव्यं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् ||
text_mt: There, by the power of destiny, at an auspicious moment endowed with good qualities, / the queen gave birth to a divine son endowed with all auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tajjananī daivāttṛṣitāti nṛpāṅganā |
saro'vatīrṇā pānārthaṃ grastā grāheṇa pāthasi ||
meaning:
अथ तज्जननी दैवात्तृषिताति नृपाङ्गना |
सरोऽवतीर्णा पानार्थं ग्रस्ता ग्राहेण पाथसि ||
text_mt: Then his mother, that king's wife, being exceedingly thirsty by destiny, / went down into the lake to drink, and was seized by a crocodile in the water.

sanskrit_iast:
sa suto jātamātrastu kṣutpipāsārdito bhṛśam |
ruroda ca sarastīre vinaṣṭapitṛmātṛkaḥ ||
meaning:
स सुतो जातमात्रस्तु क्षुत्पिपासार्दितो भृशम् |
रुरोद च सरस्तीरे विनष्टपितृमातृकः ||
text_mt: The newborn son, deeply tormented by hunger and thirst, / wept on the shore of the lake, bereft of father and mother.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminvane krandamāne jātamātre sute mune |
kṛpānvito maheśo'bhūdantaryāmī sa rakṣakaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्वने क्रन्दमाने जातमात्रे सुते मुने |
कृपान्वितो महेशोऽभूदन्तर्यामी स रक्षकः ||
text_mt: As that newborn son was crying in the forest, O sage, / Maheśa, the inner controller and protector, was filled with compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
preritā manasā kācidīśena trāsahāriṇā |
akasmādāgatā tatra bhramantī bhaikṣyajīvinī ||
meaning:
प्रेरिता मनसा काचिदीशेन त्रासहारिणा |
अकस्मादागता तत्र भ्रमन्ती भैक्ष्यजीविनी ||
text_mt: Prompted in mind by the Lord who removes fear, / a certain wandering woman living on alms arrived there unexpectedly.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tvekahāyanaṃ bālaṃ vahantī vidhavā nijam |
anāthamekaṃ krandantaṃ śiśuṃ tatra dadarśa ha ||
meaning:
सा त्वेकहायनं बालं वहन्ती विधवा निजम् |
अनाथमेकं क्रन्दन्तं शिशुं तत्र ददर्श ह ||
text_mt: Carrying her own one-year-old boy, that widow / saw there a solitary, helpless infant weeping.

sanskrit_iast:
sā dṛṣṭvā tatra taṃ bālaṃ vane nirmanuje mune |
vismitāti dvijastrī sā cicinta hṛdaye bahu ||
meaning:
सा दृष्ट्वा तत्र तं बालं वने निर्मनुजे मुने |
विस्मिताति द्विजस्त्री सा चिचिन्त हृदये बहु ||
text_mt: Seeing that child there in the forest devoid of people, O sage, / that twice-born woman was exceedingly astonished and thought much in her heart:

sanskrit_iast:
aho sumahadāścaryamidaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mayādhunā |
asambhāvyamakathyaṃ ca sarvathā manasā girā ||
meaning:
अहो सुमहदाश्चर्यमिदं दृष्टं मयाधुना |
असम्भाव्यमकथ्यं च सर्वथा मनसा गिरा ||
text_mt: "Ah, a very great wonder have I seen now, / inconceivable and utterly unspeakable by mind or speech!

sanskrit_iast:
acchinnanābhinālo'yaṃ rasāyāṃ kevalaṃ śiśuḥ |
śete mātṛvihīnaśca krandaṃstejasvināṃ varaḥ ||
meaning:
अच्छिन्ननाभिनालोऽयं रसायां केवलं शिशुः |
शेते मातृविहीनश्च क्रन्दंस्तेजस्विनां वरः ||
text_mt: With his umbilical cord still uncut, lying alone on the bare earth, / bereft of his mother and weeping, this infant is the best of the radiant.

sanskrit_iast:
asya pitrādayaḥ ke'pi na santīha sahāyinaḥ |
kāraṇaṃ kiṃ babhūvātha hyaho daivabalaṃ mahat ||
meaning:
अस्य पित्रादयः केऽपि न सन्तीह सहायिनः |
कारणं किं बभूवाथ ह्यहो दैवबलं महत् ||
text_mt: He has no helpers here, such as a father and relatives. / What could have been the cause? Ah, great is the power of destiny!

sanskrit_iast:
na jāne kasya putro'yamasya jñātātra ko'pi na |
yataḥ pṛcchāmyasya janma jātā ca karuṇā mayi ||
meaning:
न जाने कस्य पुत्रोऽयमस्य ज्ञातात्र कोऽपि न |
यतः पृच्छाम्यस्य जन्म जाता च करुणा मयि ||
text_mt: I do not know whose son this is, and there is no one here who knows him / from whom I might ask of his birth; and compassion has arisen in me.

sanskrit_iast:
icchāmyenaṃ poṣituṃ hi bālamaurasaputravat |
saṃspraṣṭuṃ notsahe'jñātvā kulajanmādi cāsya vai ||
meaning:
इच्छाम्येनं पोषितुं हि बालमौरसपुत्रवत् |
संस्प्रष्टुं नोत्सहेऽज्ञात्वा कुलजन्मादि चास्य वै ||
text_mt: I wish indeed to nourish this boy like a son of my own body; / yet I dare not touch him without knowing his family, birth, and other particulars."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti sañcintyamānāyāṃ tasyāṃ vipravarastriyām |
kṛpāṃ cakāra mahatīṃ śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति सञ्चिन्त्यमानायां तस्यां विप्रवरस्त्रियाम् |
कृपां चकार महतीं शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / While that excellent twice-born woman was thus reflecting, / Śaṅkara, affectionate toward devotees, showed great mercy.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhre bhikṣusvarūpaṃ hi mahālīlo maheśvaraḥ |
sarvathā bhaktasukhado nirupādhiḥ svayaṃ sadā ||
meaning:
दध्रे भिक्षुस्वरूपं हि महालीलो महेश्वरः |
सर्वथा भक्तसुखदो निरुपाधिः स्वयं सदा ||
text_mt: Maheśvara, whose sport is great, took the form of a mendicant— / he who always bestows happiness on devotees in every way, himself ever free of limiting conditions.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrājagāma sahasā sa bhikṣuḥ parameśvaraḥ |
yatrāsti sandehavatī dvijastrī jñātumicchatī ||
meaning:
तत्राजगाम सहसा स भिक्षुः परमेश्वरः |
यत्रास्ति सन्देहवती द्विजस्त्री ज्ञातुमिच्छती ||
text_mt: That mendicant, Parameśvara, quickly went / to the place where the doubtful twice-born woman was wishing to know.

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣuvaryasvarūpo'sāvavijñātagatiḥ prabhuḥ |
tāmāha vipravanitāṃ vihasya karuṇānidhiḥ ||
meaning:
भिक्षुवर्यस्वरूपोऽसावविज्ञातगतिः प्रभुः |
तामाह विप्रवनितां विहस्य करुणानिधिः ||
text_mt: Assuming the form of an eminent mendicant, his ways unknown, that Lord, / a treasury of compassion, smiled and spoke to that twice-born woman.

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣuvarya uvāca |
sandehaṃ kuru no citte viprabhāmini mā khida |
rakṣainaṃ bālakaṃ prītyā supavitraṃ svaputrakam ||
meaning:
भिक्षुवर्य उवाच |
सन्देहं कुरु नो चित्ते विप्रभामिनि मा खिद |
रक्षैनं बालकं प्रीत्या सुपवित्रं स्वपुत्रकम् ||
text_mt: The eminent mendicant said: / "Do not harbor doubt in your heart, noble twice-born woman; do not grieve. / Protect this boy with love as your own very pure son.

sanskrit_iast:
anena śiśunā śreyaḥ prāpsyase na cirātparam |
puṣṇīhi sarvathā hyenaṃ mahātejasvinaṃ śiśum ||
meaning:
अनेन शिशुना श्रेयः प्राप्स्यसे न चिरात्परम् |
पुष्णीहि सर्वथा ह्येनं महातेजस्विनं शिशुम् ||
text_mt: Through this infant you shall before long attain supreme welfare. / Nurture this very radiant child in every way."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktavantaṃ taṃ bhikṣusvarūpaṃ karuṇānidhim |
sā vipravanitā śambhuṃ prītyā papraccha sādaram ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्तवन्तं तं भिक्षुस्वरूपं करुणानिधिम् |
सा विप्रवनिता शम्भुं प्रीत्या पप्रच्छ सादरम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / To Śambhu, that ocean of compassion who had spoken thus in the form of a mendicant, / the twice-born woman lovingly and respectfully inquired:

sanskrit_iast:
vipravanitovāca |
tvadājñayainaṃ bālaṃ hi rakṣiṣyāmi svaputravat |
pokṣyāmi nātra sandeho madbhāgyāttvamihāgataḥ ||
meaning:
विप्रवनितोवाच |
त्वदाज्ञयैनं बालं हि रक्षिष्यामि स्वपुत्रवत् |
पोक्ष्यामि नात्र सन्देहो मद्भाग्यात्त्वमिहागतः ||
text_mt: The twice-born woman said: / "By your command I will indeed protect this boy like my own son; / I will nourish him, there is no doubt of this; by my good fortune have you come here.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi jñātumicchāmi viśeṣeṇa tu tattvataḥ |
ko'yaṃ kasya sutaścāyaṃ kastvamatra samāgataḥ ||
meaning:
तथापि ज्ञातुमिच्छामि विशेषेण तु तत्त्वतः |
कोऽयं कस्य सुतश्चायं कस्त्वमत्र समागतः ||
text_mt: Even so, I wish to know especially and truly: / who is he, whose son is he, and who are you who have arrived here?

sanskrit_iast:
muhurmama samāyāti jñānaṃ bhikṣuvara prabho |
tvaṃ śivaḥ karuṇāsindhustvadbhakto'yaṃ śiśuḥ purā ||
meaning:
मुहुर्मम समायाति ज्ञानं भिक्षुवर प्रभो |
त्वं शिवः करुणासिन्धुस्त्वद्भक्तोऽयं शिशुः पुरा ||
text_mt: Repeatedly the realization comes to me, O eminent mendicant, O Lord, / that you are Śiva, an ocean of compassion, and this child was your devotee in a previous birth.

sanskrit_iast:
kenacitkarmadoṣeṇa samprāpto'yaṃ daśāmimām |
tadbhuktvā paramaṃ śreyaḥ prāpsyate tvadanugrahāt ||
meaning:
केनचित्कर्मदोषेण सम्प्राप्तोऽयं दशामिमाम् |
तद्भुक्त्वा परमं श्रेयः प्राप्स्यते त्वदनुग्रहात् ||
text_mt: By some fault of action he has reached this condition; / having experienced that, he will attain supreme welfare by your grace.

sanskrit_iast:
tvanmāyayaiva sāhaṃ vai mārgabhraṣṭā vimohitā |
āgatā preṣitā tvatto hyasya rakṣaṇahetutaḥ ||
meaning:
त्वन्माययैव साहं वै मार्गभ्रष्टा विमोहिता |
आगता प्रेषिता त्वत्तो ह्यस्य रक्षणहेतुतः ||
text_mt: It is by your delusion alone that I lost my way, was bewildered, / and arrived here, sent by you, for the purpose of protecting him."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti taddarśanaprāptavijñānāṃ viprakāminīm |
jñātukāmāṃ viśeṣeṇa proce bhikṣutanuḥ śivaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति तद्दर्शनप्राप्तविज्ञानां विप्रकामिनीम् |
ज्ञातुकामां विशेषेण प्रोचे भिक्षुतनुः शिवः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / To the twice-born woman, who had attained insight by the sight of him / and desired to know in detail, Śiva in the mendicant's body spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣuvarya uvāca |
śṛṇu prītyā viprapatni bālasyāsya purehitam |
sarvamanyasya suprītyā vakṣyate tattvato'naghe ||
meaning:
भिक्षुवर्य उवाच |
शृणु प्रीत्या विप्रपत्नि बालस्यास्य पुरेहितम् |
सर्वमन्यस्य सुप्रीत्या वक्ष्यते तत्त्वतोऽनघे ||
text_mt: The eminent mendicant said: / "Listen with love, O twice-born's wife, to the former conduct of this boy; / everything of the other shall be told with great love in truth, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
suto vidarbharājasya śivabhaktasya dhīmataḥ |
ayaṃ satyarathasyaiva svadharmaniratasya hi ||
meaning:
सुतो विदर्भराजस्य शिवभक्तस्य धीमतः |
अयं सत्यरथस्यैव स्वधर्मनिरतस्य हि ||
text_mt: He is the son of the king of Vidarbha, Satyaratha, / who was wise, devoted to Śiva, and dedicated to his own duty.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu satyaratho rājā hataḥ śālve raṇe paraiḥ |
tatpatnī niśi suvyagrā niryayau svagṛhād drutam ||
meaning:
शृणु सत्यरथो राजा हतः शाल्वे रणे परैः |
तत्पत्नी निशि सुव्यग्रा निर्ययौ स्वगृहाद् द्रुतम् ||
text_mt: Listen: King Satyaratha was slain in battle by enemies in Śālva; / his wife, deeply agitated at night, quickly departed from her home.

sanskrit_iast:
asūta tanayaṃ cainaṃ samāyātā prage'tra hi |
saro'vatīrṇā tṛṣayā grastā grāheṇa daivataḥ ||
meaning:
असूत तनयं चैनं समायाता प्रगेऽत्र हि |
सरोऽवतीर्णा तृषया ग्रस्ता ग्राहेण दैवतः ||
text_mt: Arriving here in the morning, she gave birth to this son; / having gone down to the lake out of thirst, she was seized by a crocodile through destiny."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti tasya samutpattiṃ tatpituḥ saṅgare mṛtim |
tanmātṛmaraṇaṃ grāhātsarvaṃ tasyai nyavedayat ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति तस्य समुत्पत्तिं तत्पितुः सङ्गरे मृतिम् |
तन्मातृमरणं ग्राहात्सर्वं तस्यै न्यवेदयत् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Thus he related to her everything—his birth, / his father's death in battle, and his mother's death by the crocodile.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sā brāhmaṇī caiva vismitāti munīśvara |
punaḥ papraccha taṃ bhikṣuṃ jñāninaṃ siddharūpakam ||
meaning:
अथ सा ब्राह्मणी चैव विस्मिताति मुनीश्वर |
पुनः पप्रच्छ तं भिक्षुं ज्ञानिनं सिद्धरूपकम् ||
text_mt: Then that brāhmaṇa woman, exceedingly astonished, O lord of sages, / again questioned that wise mendicant in the form of an adept.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇyuvāca |
sa rājo'sya pitā bhikṣo varabhogāntaraiva hi |
kasmācchālvaiḥ svaripubhiḥ svalpehaiśca vighātitaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मण्युवाच |
स राजोऽस्य पिता भिक्षो वरभोगान्तरैव हि |
कस्माच्छाल्वैः स्वरिपुभिः स्वल्पेहैश्च विघातितः ||
text_mt: The brāhmaṇa woman said: / "O mendicant, why was that king, his father, slain by his enemies, the Śālvas, / whose efforts were slight, right in the midst of his choice enjoyments?

sanskrit_iast:
kasmādasya śiśormātā grāheṇāśu subhakṣitā |
yasmādanātho'yaṃ jāto vibandhuścaiva janmataḥ ||
meaning:
कस्मादस्य शिशोर्माता ग्राहेणाशु सुभक्षिता |
यस्मादनाथोऽयं जातो विबन्धुश्चैव जन्मतः ||
text_mt: Why was the mother of this child swiftly devoured by a crocodile, / on account of which he has become helpless and bereft of kin from birth?

sanskrit_iast:
kasmātsuto mamāpīha sudaridro hi bhikṣukaḥ |
bhavetkathaṃ sukhaṃ bhikṣo putrayoranayorvada ||
meaning:
कस्मात्सुतो ममापीह सुदरिद्रो हि भिक्षुकः |
भवेत्कथं सुखं भिक्षो पुत्रयोरनयोर्वद ||
text_mt: Why is my own son here extremely poor and a beggar? / Tell me, O mendicant, how can there be happiness for these two sons?"

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā sa bhikṣuḥ parameśvaraḥ |
viprapatnyāḥ prasannātmā provāca vihasam̐śca tām ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा स भिक्षुः परमेश्वरः |
विप्रपत्न्याः प्रसन्नात्मा प्रोवाच विहसम्̐श्च ताम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing her words, that mendicant, Parameśvara, / gracious in mind, smiled and said to that twice-born's wife:

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣuvarya uvāca |
viprapatni viśeṣeṇa sarvapraśnānvadāmi te |
śṛṇu tvaṃ sāvadhānena caritramidamuttamam ||
