meaning:
भिक्षुवर्य उवाच |
विप्रपत्नि विशेषेण सर्वप्रश्नान्वदामि ते |
शृणु त्वं सावधानेन चरित्रमिदमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: The eminent mendicant said: / "O twice-born's wife, I shall answer all your questions in detail. / Listen with attention to this excellent account.

sanskrit_iast:
amuṣya bālasya pitā sa vidarbhamahīpatiḥ |
pūrvajanmani pāṇḍyo'sau babhūva nṛpasattamaḥ ||
meaning:
अमुष्य बालस्य पिता स विदर्भमहीपतिः |
पूर्वजन्मनि पाण्ड्योऽसौ बभूव नृपसत्तमः ||
text_mt: The father of this child, that lord of Vidarbha, / was in his previous birth the king of the Pāṇḍyas, best of rulers.

sanskrit_iast:
sa śaivanṛpatirdharmātpālayannikhilāṃ mahīm |
svaprajāṃ rañjayāmāsa sarvopadravanāśanaḥ ||
meaning:
स शैवनृपतिर्धर्मात्पालयन्निखिलां महीम् |
स्वप्रजां रञ्जयामास सर्वोपद्रवनाशनः ||
text_mt: That Śaiva king, ruling the entire earth righteously, / delighted his subjects, destroying all afflictions.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācitsa hi sarveśaṃ pradoṣe paryapūjayat |
trayodaśyāṃ nirāhāro divānaktavratī śivam ||
meaning:
कदाचित्स हि सर्वेशं प्रदोषे पर्यपूजयत् |
त्रयोदश्यां निराहारो दिवानक्तव्रती शिवम् ||
text_mt: Once at twilight on the thirteenth lunar day, fasting, / observing the daytime and nighttime vow, he was worshiping Śiva, the Lord of all.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya pūjayataḥ śambhuṃ pradoṣe giriśaṃ rate |
mahān śabdo babhūvātha vikaṭaḥ sarvathā pure ||
meaning:
तस्य पूजयतः शम्भुं प्रदोषे गिरिशं रते |
महान् शब्दो बभूवाथ विकटः सर्वथा पुरे ||
text_mt: While he was absorbed in worshiping Śambhu, Giriśa, at twilight, / a great, terrible noise arose throughout the city.

sanskrit_iast:
tamākarṇya ravaṃ so'tha rājā tyaktaśivārcanaḥ |
ripvāgamanaśaṅkāto niryayau bhavanād bahiḥ ||
meaning:
तमाकर्ण्य रवं सोऽथ राजा त्यक्तशिवार्चनः |
रिप्वागमनशङ्कातो निर्ययौ भवनाद् बहिः ||
text_mt: Hearing that roar, the king abandoned the worship of Śiva / and went out of the palace in fear of an enemy's arrival.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu tasyāmātyo mahābalī |
gṛhītaśatrusāmanto rājāntikamupāyayau ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु तस्यामात्यो महाबली |
गृहीतशत्रुसामन्तो राजान्तिकमुपाययौ ||
text_mt: At that very time, his mighty minister / came before the king, having captured an enemy feudatory.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā śatrusāmantaṃ mahākrodhena vihvalaḥ |
avicārya vṛṣantasya śiraśchedamakārayat ||
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा शत्रुसामन्तं महाक्रोधेन विह्वलः |
अविचार्य वृषन्तस्य शिरश्छेदमकारयत् ||
text_mt: Seeing that enemy feudatory, agitated with great wrath, / he had his head cut off immediately without deliberation.

sanskrit_iast:
asamāpyeśapūjāṃ tāmaśucirnaṣṭadhīrnṛpaḥ |
rātrau cakāra suprītyā bhojanaṃ naṣṭamaṅgalaḥ ||
meaning:
असमाप्येशपूजां तामशुचिर्नष्टधीर्नृपः |
रात्रौ चकार सुप्रीत्या भोजनं नष्टमङ्गलः ||
text_mt: Without completing that worship of the Lord, impure and deprived of judgment, / that king, having lost auspiciousness, ate his meal at night with great pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
vidarbhe so'bhavadrājā janmanīha śivavratī |
śivārcanāntarāyeṇa parairbhogāntare hataḥ ||
meaning:
विदर्भे सोऽभवद्राजा जन्मनीह शिवव्रती |
शिवार्चनान्तरायेण परैर्भोगान्तरे हतः ||
text_mt: He who was an observer of Śiva's vows became the king in Vidarbha in this birth; / because of the interruption of Śiva's worship, he was slain by enemies in the midst of his enjoyments.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpitā yaḥ pūrvabhave so'smiñjanmani tatsutaḥ |
ayameva hataiśvaryaḥ śivapūjāvyatikramāt ||
meaning:
तत्पिता यः पूर्वभवे सोऽस्मिञ्जन्मनि तत्सुतः |
अयमेव हतैश्वर्यः शिवपूजाव्यतिक्रमात् ||
text_mt: He who was his father in the former birth is his son in this birth; / this very one is deprived of his sovereignty because of the transgression against Śiva's worship.

sanskrit_iast:
asya mātā pūrvabhave sapatnīṃ chadmanāharat |
bhakṣitā tena pāpena grāheṇāsmin bhave hi sā ||
meaning:
अस्य माता पूर्वभवे सपत्नीं छद्मनाहरत् |
भक्षिता तेन पापेन ग्राहेणास्मिन् भवे हि सा ||
text_mt: His mother in a previous birth took away a co-wife through deceit; / by that sin she was indeed devoured by a crocodile in this birth."

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā pravṛttireteṣāṃ bhavatyai parikīrtitā |
anarcitaśivā bhaktyā prāpnuvanti daridratām ||
meaning:
एषा प्रवृत्तिरेतेषां भवत्यै परिकीर्तिता |
अनर्चितशिवा भक्त्या प्राप्नुवन्ति दरिद्रताम् ||
text_mt: This history of theirs has been related to you: / those who do not worship Śiva with devotion fall into poverty.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa te tanayaḥ pūrvajanmani brāhmaṇottamaḥ |
pratigrahairvayo ninye na yajñādyaiḥ sukarmabhiḥ ||
meaning:
एष ते तनयः पूर्वजन्मनि ब्राह्मणोत्तमः |
प्रतिग्रहैर्वयो निन्ये न यज्ञाद्यैः सुकर्मभिः ||
text_mt: In a previous birth, this son of yours was an excellent brāhmaṇa; / he spent his life [accepting] gifts, not performing sacrifices or other meritorious acts.

sanskrit_iast:
ato dāridryamāpannaḥ putraste dvijabhāmini |
taddoṣaparihārārthaṃ śaraṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ vraja ||
meaning:
अतो दारिद्र्यमापन्नः पुत्रस्ते द्विजभामिनि |
तद्दोषपरिहारार्थं शरणं शङ्करं व्रज ||
text_mt: Therefore, O noble brāhmaṇa lady, your son has fallen into poverty; / to dispel that fault, take refuge with Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
etābhyāṃ khalu bālābhyāṃ śivapūjā vidhīyatām |
upavītānantaraṃ hi śivaḥ śreyaḥ kariṣyati ||
meaning:
एताभ्यां खलु बालाभ्यां शिवपूजा विधीयताम् |
उपवीतानन्तरं हि शिवः श्रेयः करिष्यति ||
text_mt: Indeed, let the worship of Śiva be performed by these two boys; / after their sacred thread [investiture], Śiva will certainly bestow welfare."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti tāmupadiśyātha bhikṣuvaryatanuḥ śivaḥ |
svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa paramaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति तामुपदिश्याथ भिक्षुवर्यतनुः शिवः |
स्वरूपं दर्शयामास परमं भक्तवत्सलः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having thus instructed her, Śiva, who was in the form of an excellent mendicant / and who is affectionate toward devotees, revealed his supreme form.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sā vipravanitā jñātvā taṃ śaṅkaraṃ prabhum |
supraṇamya hi tuṣṭāva premṇā gadgadayā girā ||
meaning:
अथ सा विप्रवनिता ज्ञात्वा तं शङ्करं प्रभुम् |
सुप्रणम्य हि तुष्टाव प्रेम्णा गद्गदया गिरा ||
text_mt: Then that brāhmaṇa woman, recognizing him as the lord Śaṅkara, / bowed low and praised him with love in a stammering voice.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa bhagavān śambhurdhṛtabhikṣutanurdrutam |
paśyantyā viprapantyāstu tatraivāntaradhīyata ||
meaning:
ततः स भगवान् शम्भुर्धृतभिक्षुतनुर्द्रुतम् |
पश्यन्त्या विप्रपन्त्यास्तु तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ||
text_mt: Then the blessed Śambhu, who had assumed the form of a mendicant, / vanished right there while the brāhmaṇa woman was looking on.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tasmin gate bhikṣau viśrabdhā brāhmaṇī ca sā |
tamarbhakaṃ samādāya sasvaputrā gṛhaṃ yayau ||
meaning:
अथ तस्मिन् गते भिक्षौ विश्रब्धा ब्राह्मणी च सा |
तमर्भकं समादाय सस्वपुत्रा गृहं ययौ ||
text_mt: When the mendicant had departed, that brāhmaṇa woman, reassured, / took the boy and, accompanied by her own son, went home.

sanskrit_iast:
ekacakrāhvaye ramye grāmye kṛtaniketanā |
svaputraṃ rājaputraṃ ca varānnaiśca vyavardhayat ||
meaning:
एकचक्राह्वये रम्ये ग्राम्ये कृतनिकेतना |
स्वपुत्रं राजपुत्रं च वरान्नैश्च व्यवर्धयत् ||
text_mt: Having made her dwelling in the delightful village named Ekacakrā, / she raised her own son and the prince on excellent food.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṛtasaṃskārau kṛtopanayanau ca tau |
vavṛdhāte svagehe ca śivapūjanatatparau ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मणैः कृतसंस्कारौ कृतोपनयनौ च तौ |
ववृधाते स्वगेहे च शिवपूजनतत्परौ ||
text_mt: After their rites of passage and sacred thread investiture were performed by brāhmaṇas, / the two grew up in their home, devoted to the worship of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tau śāṇḍilyamunestāta nideśānniyamasthitau |
pradoṣe cakratuḥ śambhoḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ śubham ||
meaning:
तौ शाण्डिल्यमुनेस्तात निदेशान्नियमस्थितौ |
प्रदोषे चक्रतुः शम्भोः पूजां कृत्वा व्रतं शुभम् ||
text_mt: Remaining steadfast in their observance by the command of the sage Śāṇḍilya, O dear one, / they performed the worship of Śambhu at twilight, having undertaken the auspicious vow.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācid dvijaputreṇa vināsau rājanandanaḥ |
nadyāṃ snātuṃ gataḥ prāpa nidhānakalaśaṃ varam ||
meaning:
कदाचिद् द्विजपुत्रेण विनासौ राजनन्दनः |
नद्यां स्नातुं गतः प्राप निधानकलशं वरम् ||
text_mt: Once that prince, having gone to bathe in the river / without the brāhmaṇa boy, obtained an excellent jar filled with treasure.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pūjayatoḥ śambhuṃ rājadvijakumārayoḥ |
sukhenaiva vyatīyāya tayormāsacatuṣṭayam ||
meaning:
एवं पूजयतोः शम्भुं राजद्विजकुमारयोः |
सुखेनैव व्यतीयाय तयोर्मासचतुष्टयम् ||
text_mt: As the prince and the brāhmaṇa boy were thus worshiping Śambhu, / four months passed for them in sheer happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
evamarcayatoḥ śambhuṃ bhūyo'pi parayā mudā |
samvatsaro vyatīyāya tasminneva tayorgṛhe ||
meaning:
एवमर्चयतोः शम्भुं भूयोऽपि परया मुदा |
सम्वत्सरो व्यतीयाय तस्मिन्नेव तयोर्गृहे ||
text_mt: As they continued worshiping Śambhu with supreme joy, / a whole year passed for them in that very house.

sanskrit_iast:
samvatsare vyatikrānte sa rājatanayo mune |
gatvā vanānte vipreṇa śivasyānugrahādvibhoḥ ||
meaning:
सम्वत्सरे व्यतिक्रान्ते स राजतनयो मुने |
गत्वा वनान्ते विप्रेण शिवस्यानुग्रहाद्विभोः ||
text_mt: When a year had passed, O sage, the prince / went to the edge of the forest with the brāhmaṇa [boy], through the grace of the all-pervading Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
akasmādāgatāṃ tatra dattāṃ tajjanakena ha |
vivāhya gandharvasutāṃ cakre rājyamakaṇṭakam ||
meaning:
अकस्मादागतां तत्र दत्तां तज्जनकेन ह |
विवाह्य गन्धर्वसुतां चक्रे राज्यमकण्टकम् ||
text_mt: and marrying a Gandharva's daughter who had arrived there unexpectedly / and was given [to him] by her father, he ruled a kingdom free of adversaries.

sanskrit_iast:
yā vipravanitā pūrvaṃ tamapuṣṇātsvaputravat |
saiva mātābhavattasya sa bhrātā dvijanandanaḥ ||
itthamārādhya deveśaṃ dharmaguptāhvayaḥ sa vai |
vidarbhaviṣaye rājñyā tayā bhogaṃ cakāra ha ||
meaning:
या विप्रवनिता पूर्वं तमपुष्णात्स्वपुत्रवत् |
सैव माताभवत्तस्य स भ्राता द्विजनन्दनः ||
इत्थमाराध्य देवेशं धर्मगुप्ताह्वयः स वै |
विदर्भविषये राज्ञ्या तया भोगं चकार ह ||
text_mt:
The brāhmaṇa woman who had formerly nourished him like her own son / became his mother, and the brāhmaṇa boy became his brother.

Having thus worshiped the lord of gods, he, named Dharmagupta, / enjoyed pleasures in the Vidarbha country with that queen.

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣuvaryāvatāraste varṇitaśca mayādhunā |
śivasya dharmaguptāhvanṛpabālasukhapradaḥ ||
meaning:
भिक्षुवर्यावतारस्ते वर्णितश्च मयाधुना |
शिवस्य धर्मगुप्ताह्वनृपबालसुखप्रदः ||
text_mt: I have now described to you this incarnation of Śiva as an excellent mendicant, / which brought happiness to the royal boy named Dharmagupta.

sanskrit_iast:
etadākhyānamanaghaṃ pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ mahat |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ sarvakāmadam ||
meaning:
एतदाख्यानमनघं पवित्रं पावनं महत् |
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां साधनं सर्वकामदम् ||
text_mt: This spotless, pure, and great narrative / is a means to achieve virtue, wealth, pleasure, and liberation, and grants all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
ya etacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ |
sa bhuktvehākhilānkāmān so'nte śivapuraṃ vrajet ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
य एतच्छृणुयान्नित्यं श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः |
स भुक्त्वेहाखिलान्कामान् सोऽन्ते शिवपुरं व्रजेत् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Whoever listens to this daily or recites it with a concentrated mind / will enjoy all desires in this world and at the end go to the city of Śiva.

Thus ends the thirty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Incarnation of Śiva Known as the Foremost Mendicant,' in the third Śatarudrasaṃhitā of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu tāta pravakṣyāmi śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
sureśvarāvatāraste dhaumyāgrajahitāvaham ||
meaning:
शृणु तात प्रवक्ष्यामि शिवस्य परमात्मनः |
सुरेश्वरावतारस्ते धौम्याग्रजहितावहम् ||
title: dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | nandīśvara uvāca
text_mt: Listen, O dear one; I shall describe to you the Sureśvara incarnation / of Śiva, the supreme self, which brought welfare to the elder brother of Dhaumya.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghrapādasuto dhīmānupamanyuḥ satāṃ priyaḥ |
janmāntareṇa saṃsiddhaḥ prāpto munikumāratām ||
meaning:
व्याघ्रपादसुतो धीमानुपमन्युः सतां प्रियः |
जन्मान्तरेण संसिद्धः प्राप्तो मुनिकुमारताम् ||
text_mt: The wise Upamanyu, son of Vyāghrapāda, beloved of the virtuous, / perfected through a previous life, had attained the status of a sage's son.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāsa mātulagṛhe sa mātrā śiśureva hi |
upamanyurvyāghrapādiḥ syāddaridraśca daivataḥ ||
meaning:
उवास मातुलगृहे स मात्रा शिशुरेव हि |
उपमन्युर्व्याघ्रपादिः स्याद्दरिद्रश्च दैवतः ||
text_mt: While still a child, he lived in his maternal uncle's house with his mother; / Upamanyu, son of Vyāghrapāda, happened to be poor by fate.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācitkṣīramatyalpaṃ pītavānmātulāśrame |
yayāce mātaraṃ prītyā bahuśo dugdhalālasaḥ ||
meaning:
कदाचित्क्षीरमत्यल्पं पीतवान्मातुलाश्रमे |
ययाचे मातरं प्रीत्या बहुशो दुग्धलालसः ||
text_mt: Once he drank a very small amount of milk in the hermitage of his maternal uncle; / longing for milk, he repeatedly begged his mother with affection.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā putravacanaṃ tanmātā ca tapasvinī |
sāntaḥ praviśyātha tadā śubhopāyamarīracat ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा पुत्रवचनं तन्माता च तपस्विनी |
सान्तः प्रविश्याथ तदा शुभोपायमरीरचत् ||
text_mt: Hearing her son's words, his mother, an ascetic woman, / went inside and then devised an auspicious expedient.

sanskrit_iast:
uñchavṛttyarjitānbījānpiṣṭvāloḍya jalena tān |
upalālya sutaṃ tasmai sā dadau kṛtrimaṃ payaḥ ||
meaning:
उञ्छवृत्त्यर्जितान्बीजान्पिष्ट्वालोड्य जलेन तान् |
उपलाल्य सुतं तस्मै सा ददौ कृत्रिमं पयः ||
text_mt: Having ground seeds obtained by gleaning and mixed them with water, / she coaxed her son and gave him that artificial milk.

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā ca kṛtrimaṃ dugdhaṃ mātrā dattaṃ sa bālakaḥ |
naitatkṣīramiti prāha mātaraṃ cārudatpunaḥ ||
meaning:
पीत्वा च कृत्रिमं दुग्धं मात्रा दत्तं स बालकः |
नैतत्क्षीरमिति प्राह मातरं चारुदत्पुनः ||
text_mt: Having drunk the artificial milk given by his mother, the child, / possessing lovely teeth, spoke again to his mother, saying, 'This is not milk!'

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā sutasya ruditaṃ prāha sā duḥkhitā sutam |
sammārjya netre putrasya karābhyāṃ kamalākṛtiḥ ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वा सुतस्य रुदितं प्राह सा दुःखिता सुतम् |
सम्मार्ज्य नेत्रे पुत्रस्य कराभ्यां कमलाकृतिः ||
text_mt: Hearing her son weeping, she, distressed, / wiped her son's eyes with both hands, her face resembling a lotus, and said to him:

sanskrit_iast:
mātovāca |
kṣīramatra kuto'smākaṃ vane nivasatāṃ sadā |
prasādena vinā śambhoḥ payaḥ prāptirbhavenna hi ||
meaning:
मातोवाच |
क्षीरमत्र कुतोऽस्माकं वने निवसतां सदा |
प्रसादेन विना शम्भोः पयः प्राप्तिर्भवेन्न हि ||
text_mt: The mother said: / "Whence can we have milk here, living always in the forest? / Without the grace of Śambhu, milk cannot be obtained.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvajanmani yatkṛtyaṃ śivamuddiśya he suta |
tadeva labhyate nūnaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
meaning:
पूर्वजन्मनि यत्कृत्यं शिवमुद्दिश्य हे सुत |
तदेव लभ्यते नूनं नात्र कार्या विचारणा ||
text_mt: Whatever deed was performed dedicated to Śiva in a previous birth, O son, / only that is certainly obtained; no doubt should be entertained on this matter."

sanskrit_iast:
iti mātṛvacaḥ śrutvā vyāghrapādiḥ sa bālakaḥ |
pratyuvāca viśokātmā mātaraṃ mātṛvatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
इति मातृवचः श्रुत्वा व्याघ्रपादिः स बालकः |
प्रत्युवाच विशोकात्मा मातरं मातृवत्सलः ||
text_mt: Hearing his mother's words, that boy, the son of Vyāghrapāda, / his mind freed from sorrow and affectionate toward his mother, answered her:

sanskrit_iast:
śokenālamimaṃ mātaḥ śambhuryadyasti śaṅkaraḥ |
tyaja śokaṃ mahābhāge sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
शोकेनालमिमं मातः शम्भुर्यद्यस्ति शङ्करः |
त्यज शोकं महाभागे सर्वं भद्रं भविष्यति ||
text_mt: "Enough of this sorrow, Mother, if Śambhu is truly Śaṅkara! / Cast off sorrow, O blessed one; everything will be well.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu mātarvaco me'dya mahādevo'sti cetkvacit |
cirādvā hyacirādvāpi kṣīrodaṃ sādhayāmyaham ||
meaning:
शृणु मातर्वचो मेऽद्य महादेवोऽस्ति चेत्क्वचित् |
चिराद्वा ह्यचिराद्वापि क्षीरोदं साधयाम्यहम् ||
text_mt: Listen to my word today, Mother: if Mahādeva exists anywhere, / sooner or later I shall obtain the ocean of milk!"

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvā sa śiśuḥ prītyā śivaṃ me'stvityudīrya ca |
visṛjya tāṃ supraṇamya tapaḥ kartuṃ pracakrame ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा स शिशुः प्रीत्या शिवं मेऽस्त्वित्युदीर्य च |
विसृज्य तां सुप्रणम्य तपः कर्तुं प्रचक्रमे ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus with love, saying, 'May Śiva be mine,' / he bowed low to her, took his leave, and set out to perform austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
himavatparvatagataḥ vāyubhakṣaḥ samāhitaḥ |
aṣṭeṣṭakābhiḥ prāsādaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ ca mṛnmayam ||
meaning:
हिमवत्पर्वतगतः वायुभक्षः समाहितः |
अष्टेष्टकाभिः प्रासादं कृत्वा लिङ्गं च मृन्मयम् ||
text_mt: Having gone to the Himavat mountain, feeding only on air and concentrated in mind, / having built a shrine with eight bricks and fashioned an earthen liṅga,

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāvāhya śivaṃ sāmbaṃ bhaktyā pañcākṣareṇa ha |
patrapuṣpādibhirvanyaiḥ samānarca śiśuḥ sa vai ||
meaning:
तत्रावाह्य शिवं साम्बं भक्त्या पञ्चाक्षरेण ह |
पत्रपुष्पादिभिर्वन्यैः समानर्च शिशुः स वै ||
text_mt: and having invoked Śiva accompanied by Ambikā there with devotion through the five-syllable mantra, / the child worshiped him with wild leaves, flowers, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā śivaṃ ca taṃ sāmbaṃ japanpañcākṣaraṃ manum |
samabhyarcya ciraṃ kālaṃ cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ ||
meaning:
ध्यात्वा शिवं च तं साम्बं जपन्पञ्चाक्षरं मनुम् |
समभ्यर्च्य चिरं कालं चचार परमं तपः ||
text_mt: Meditating on Śiva accompanied by Ambikā, repeating the five-syllable mantra, / and worshiping him for a long time, he practiced supreme austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā tasya bālasya hyupamanyormahātmanaḥ |
carācaraṃ ca bhuvanaṃ pradīpitamabhūnmune ||
meaning:
तपसा तस्य बालस्य ह्युपमन्योर्महात्मनः |
चराचरं च भुवनं प्रदीपितमभून्मुने ||
text_mt: By the austerity of that child, the great-souled Upamanyu, / the world with its moving and unmoving beings was set ablaze, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare śambhurviṣṇvādyaiḥ prārthitaḥ prabhuḥ |
parīkṣituṃ ca tadbhaktiṃ śakrarūpo'bhavattadā ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शम्भुर्विष्ण्वाद्यैः प्रार्थितः प्रभुः |
परीक्षितुं च तद्भक्तिं शक्ररूपोऽभवत्तदा ||
text_mt: In the meantime, the lord Śambhu, besought by Viṣṇu and the others, / assumed the form of Śakra in order to test his devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
śivā śacīsvarūpābhūdgaṇāḥ sarve'bhavansurāḥ |
airāvatagajo nandī sarvameva ca tanmayam ||
meaning:
शिवा शचीस्वरूपाभूद्गणाः सर्वेऽभवन्सुराः |
ऐरावतगजो नन्दी सर्वमेव च तन्मयम् ||
text_mt: Śivā assumed the form of Śacī, all the attendants became the gods, / Nandin became the elephant Airāvata, and everything was transformed into that [heavenly host].

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sāmbaḥ śivaḥ śakrasvarūpaḥ sagaṇo drutam |
jagāmānugrahaṃ kartumupamanyostadāśramam ||
meaning:
ततः साम्बः शिवः शक्रस्वरूपः सगणो द्रुतम् |
जगामानुग्रहं कर्तुमुपमन्योस्तदाश्रमम् ||
text_mt: Then Śiva, accompanied by Ambikā, in the form of Śakra with his retinue, / went swiftly to the hermitage of Upamanyu to bestow his grace.

sanskrit_iast:
parīkṣituṃ ca tadbhaktiṃ śakrarūpadharo haraḥ |
prāha gambhīrayā vācā bālakaṃ taṃ munīśvara ||
meaning:
परीक्षितुं च तद्भक्तिं शक्ररूपधरो हरः |
प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा बालकं तं मुनीश्वर ||
text_mt: Bearing the form of Śakra in order to test his devotion, Hara / addressed that boy in a deep voice, O lord of sages:

sanskrit_iast:
sureśvara uvāca |
tuṣṭo'smi te varaṃ brūhi tapasānena suvrata |
dadāmi cecchitānkāmān sarvānnātrāsti saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
सुरेश्वर उवाच |
तुष्टोऽस्मि ते वरं ब्रूहि तपसानेन सुव्रत |
ददामि चेच्छितान्कामान् सर्वान्नात्रास्ति संशयः ||
text_mt: Sureśvara said: / "I am pleased with you; choose a boon, O one of noble vows, on account of this austerity! / I shall grant all desired wishes; of this there is no doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktaḥ sa vai tena śakrarūpeṇa śambhunā |
varayāmi śive bhaktimityuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
meaning:
एवमुक्तः स वै तेन शक्ररूपेण शम्भुना |
वरयामि शिवे भक्तिमित्युवाच कृताञ्जलिः ||
text_mt: Addressed thus by Śambhu in the form of Śakra, / he said with folded hands: "I choose devotion to Śiva."

sanskrit_iast:
tanniśamya hariḥ prāha māṃ na jānāsi lekhapam |
trailokyādhipatiṃ śakraṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam ||
meaning:
तन्निशम्य हरिः प्राह मां न जानासि लेखपम् |
त्रैलोक्याधिपतिं शक्रं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् ||
text_mt: Hearing that, Hari said: “Do you not know me, the ruler of the gods, / the sovereign of the three worlds, Śakra, bowed to by all the gods?

sanskrit_iast:
madbhakto bhava viprarṣe māmevārcaya sarvadā |
dadāmi sarvaṃ bhadraṃ te tyaja rudraṃ ca nirguṇam ||
meaning:
मद्भक्तो भव विप्रर्षे मामेवार्चय सर्वदा |
ददामि सर्वं भद्रं ते त्यज रुद्रं च निर्गुणम् ||
text_mt: Become devoted to me, O brahmin seer! Worship only me at all times! / I shall grant you every good. Abandon Rudra, who is devoid of attributes.

sanskrit_iast:
rudreṇa nirguṇenālaṃ kiṃ te kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati |
devajātibahirbhūto yaḥ piśācatvamāgataḥ ||
meaning:
रुद्रेण निर्गुणेनालं किं ते कार्यं भविष्यति |
देवजातिबहिर्भूतो यः पिशाचत्वमागतः ||
text_mt: Enough of Rudra, who has no attributes! What purpose will you achieve through him, / who has been cast out of the company of gods and has become a goblin?”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
tacchrutvā sa muneḥ putro japanpañcākṣaraṃ manum |
manyamāno dharmavighnaṃ prāha taṃ kartumāgatam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
तच्छ्रुत्वा स मुनेः पुत्रो जपन्पञ्चाक्षरं मनुम् |
मन्यमानो धर्मविघ्नं प्राह तं कर्तुमागतम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing that, the sage’s son, repeating the five-syllable mantra / and considering that one had come to cause an obstacle to his virtue, addressed him.

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
tvayaivaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bhavanindāratena vai |
prasaṅgāddevadevasya nirguṇatvaṃ piśācatā ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
त्वयैवं कथितं सर्वं भवनिन्दारतेन वै |
प्रसङ्गाद्देवदेवस्य निर्गुणत्वं पिशाचता ||
text_mt: Upamanyu said: / “All this has been spoken by you, who take delight in censuring Bhava; / you have spoken with reference to the God of gods, attributing to him the absence of qualities and the state of a goblin.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ na jānāsi vai rudraṃ sarvadeveśvareśvaram |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ janakaṃ prakṛteḥ param ||
meaning:
त्वं न जानासि वै रुद्रं सर्वदेवेश्वरेश्वरम् |
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां जनकं प्रकृतेः परम् ||
text_mt: Indeed, you do not know Rudra, the Lord over the lords of all the gods, / the generator of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśa, beyond primal matter.

sanskrit_iast:
sadasad vayaktamavyaktaṃ yamāhurbrahmavādinaḥ |
nityamekamanekaṃ ca varaṃ tasmād vṛṇomyaham ||
meaning:
सदसद् वयक्तमव्यक्तं यमाहुर्ब्रह्मवादिनः |
नित्यमेकमनेकं च वरं तस्माद् वृणोम्यहम् ||
text_mt: Him whom the knowers of the absolute call the real and the unreal, the manifest and the unmanifest, / eternal, one and manifold—from him I choose a boon.

sanskrit_iast:
hetuvādavinirmuktaṃ sāṅkhyayogārthadaṃ param |
yamuśanti hi tattvajñā varaṃ tasmād vṛṇomyaham ||
meaning:
हेतुवादविनिर्मुक्तं साङ्ख्ययोगार्थदं परम् |
यमुशन्ति हि तत्त्वज्ञा वरं तस्माद् वृणोम्यहम् ||
text_mt: Him whom the knowers of reality declare to be free from dialectical disputes, / supreme, the bestower of the purpose of Sāṅkhya and Yoga—from him I choose a boon.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti śambhoḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇat |
brahmaviṣṇvādidevānāṃ śreṣṭho guṇaparādvibhoḥ ||
meaning:
नास्ति शम्भोः परं तत्त्वं सर्वकारणकारणत् |
ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादिदेवानां श्रेष्ठो गुणपराद्विभोः ||
text_mt: There is no reality higher than Śambhu, because he is the cause of all causes; / he is greater than the gods such as Brahmā and Viṣṇu, the all-pervading Lord beyond the qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
nāhaṃ vṛṇe varaṃ tvatto na viṣṇorbrahmaṇo'pi vā |
nānyasmādamarādvāpi śaṅkaro varado'stu me ||
meaning:
नाहं वृणे वरं त्वत्तो न विष्णोर्ब्रह्मणोऽपि वा |
नान्यस्मादमराद्वापि शङ्करो वरदोऽस्तु मे ||
text_mt: I choose no boon from you, nor from Viṣṇu, nor even from Brahmā, / nor from any other immortal. Let Śaṅkara be my grantor of boons!

sanskrit_iast:
bahunātra kimuktena vacmi tattvaṃ mataṃ svakam |
na prārthaye paśupateranyaṃ devādikaṃ sphuṭam ||
meaning:
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन वच्मि तत्त्वं मतं स्वकम् |
न प्रार्थये पशुपतेरन्यं देवादिकं स्फुटम् ||
text_mt: What is the use of speaking much here? I declare my own firm conviction: / I plainly seek no other god or being than Paśupati.

sanskrit_iast:
madbhāvaṃ śṛṇu gotrāre mayādyānumitaṃ tvidam |
bhavāntare kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śrutā nindā bhavasya cet ||
meaning:
मद्भावं शृणु गोत्रारे मयाद्यानुमितं त्विदम् |
भवान्तरे कृतं पापं श्रुता निन्दा भवस्य चेत् ||
text_mt: Hear my feeling, O foe of Gotra! Today I have deduced this: / some sin was committed [by me] in another birth, since the censure of Bhava was heard [by me].

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā nindāṃ bhavasyātha tatkṣaṇādeva santyajet |
svadehaṃ tannihatyāśu śivalokaṃ sa gacchati ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वा निन्दां भवस्याथ तत्क्षणादेव सन्त्यजेत् |
स्वदेहं तन्निहत्याशु शिवलोकं स गच्छति ||
text_mt: Having heard censure of Bhava, one should immediately abandon / one's own body, having quickly slain that [reviler]; he goes to the world of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
āstāṃ tāvanmameccheyaṃ kṣīraṃ prati surādhama |
nihatya tvāṃ śivāstreṇa tyajāmyetatkalevaram ||
meaning:
आस्तां तावन्ममेच्छेयं क्षीरं प्रति सुराधम |
निहत्य त्वां शिवास्त्रेण त्यजाम्येतत्कलेवरम् ||
text_mt: Let this desire of mine for milk wait for now, O lowest of gods! / Having slain you with the weapon of Śiva, I shall cast off this body.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
evamuktvopamanyustaṃ martuṃ vyavasitaḥ svayam |
kṣīre vācchāmapi tyaktvā nihantuṃ śakramudyataḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
एवमुक्त्वोपमन्युस्तं मर्तुं व्यवसितः स्वयम् |
क्षीरे वाच्छामपि त्यक्त्वा निहन्तुं शक्रमुद्यतः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, Upamanyu resolved to die himself; / abandoning even his desire for milk, he prepared to slay Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmādāya tadādhārādaghostrābhimantritam |
visṛjya śakramuddiśya nanāda sa munistadā ||
meaning:
भस्मादाय तदाधारादघोस्त्राभिमन्त्रितम् |
विसृज्य शक्रमुद्दिश्य ननाद स मुनिस्तदा ||
text_mt: Taking ashes from its receptacle and consecrating it with the Aghora weapon, / releasing it aimed at Śakra, the sage then roared.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtvā sveṣṭapadadvandvaṃ svadehaṃ dagdhumudyataḥ |
āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ bibhradupamanyuravasthitaḥ ||
meaning:
स्मृत्वा स्वेष्टपदद्वन्द्वं स्वदेहं दग्धुमुद्यतः |
आग्नेयीं धारणां बिभ्रदुपमन्युरवस्थितः ||
text_mt: Remembering the pair of feet of his chosen deity, prepared to burn his own body, / holding the fiery concentration, Upamanyu stood firm.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vyavasite vipre bhagavān śakrarūpavān |
vārayāmāsa saumyena dhāraṇāṃ tasya yoginaḥ ||
meaning:
एवं व्यवसिते विप्रे भगवान् शक्ररूपवान् |
वारयामास सौम्येन धारणां तस्य योगिनः ||
text_mt: When the brahmin had thus resolved, the Lord, in the form of Śakra, / gently averted the concentration of that yogin.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvisṛṣṭamaghorāstraṃ nandīśvaraniyogataḥ |
jagṛhe madhyataḥ kṣiptaṃ nandī śaṅkaravallabham ||
meaning:
तद्विसृष्टमघोरास्त्रं नन्दीश्वरनियोगतः |
जगृहे मध्यतः क्षिप्तं नन्दी शङ्करवल्लभम् ||
text_mt: By command of Nandīśvara, Nandin caught midway the Aghora weapon, / hurled [by Upamanyu], which is dear to Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
svarūpameva bhagavānāsthāya parameśvaraḥ |
darśayāmāsa viprāya bālendukṛtaśekharam ||
meaning:
स्वरूपमेव भगवानास्थाय परमेश्वरः |
दर्शयामास विप्राय बालेन्दुकृतशेखरम् ||
text_mt: Assuming his own true form, the Lord, Parameśvara, / showed himself to the brahmin with the crescent moon adorning his crest.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrārṇavasahasraṃ ca dadhyāderarṇavaṃ tathā |
bhakṣyabhojyārṇavaṃ tasmai darśayāmāsa sa prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
क्षीरार्णवसहस्रं च दध्यादेरर्णवं तथा |
भक्ष्यभोज्यार्णवं तस्मै दर्शयामास स प्रभुः ||
text_mt: A thousand oceans of milk, and likewise an ocean of curds and the rest, / and an ocean of edible and drinkable foods the Lord revealed to him.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa dadṛśe śambhurdevyā sārdhaṃ vṛṣopari |
gaṇeśvaraistriśūlādyairdivyāstrairapi saṃvṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
एवं स ददृशे शम्भुर्देव्या सार्धं वृषोपरि |
गणेश्वरैस्त्रिशूलाद्यैर्दिव्यास्त्रैरपि संवृतः ||
text_mt: Thus Śambhu was seen together with the Goddess upon the bull, / surrounded by the lords of the attendants, and with divine weapons such as the trident.

sanskrit_iast:
divi dundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha |
viṣṇubrahmendrapramukhairdevaiśchannā diśo daśa ||
meaning:
दिवि दुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात ह |
विष्णुब्रह्मेन्द्रप्रमुखैर्देवैश्छन्ना दिशो दश ||
text_mt: In heaven kettledrums sounded, and a shower of flowers fell; / the ten directions were filled with gods headed by Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
athopamanyurānandasamudrormibhirāvṛtaḥ |
papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau bhaktinamreṇa cetasā ||
meaning:
अथोपमन्युरानन्दसमुद्रोर्मिभिरावृतः |
पपात दण्डवद्भूमौ भक्तिनम्रेण चेतसा ||
text_mt: Then Upamanyu, overwhelmed by the waves of an ocean of bliss, / fell like a staff upon the ground with a heart bowed in devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminsamaye tatra sasmito bhagavānbhavaḥ |
ehyehīti samāhūya mūrdhnyāghrāya dadau varān ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्समये तत्र सस्मितो भगवान्भवः |
एह्येहीति समाहूय मूर्ध्न्याघ्राय ददौ वरान् ||
text_mt: At that moment, the Lord Bhava, smiling there, / called out, “Come, come!” and, having smelled him on the head, granted boons.

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca |
vatsopamanyo tuṣṭo'smi tvadācaraṇato varāt |
dṛḍhabhakto'si viprarṣe mayā jijñāsito'dhunā ||
meaning:
शिव उवाच |
वत्सोपमन्यो तुष्टोऽस्मि त्वदाचरणतो वरात् |
दृढभक्तोऽसि विप्रर्षे मया जिज्ञासितोऽधुना ||
text_mt: Śiva said: / “Dear Upamanyu, I am pleased with your excellent conduct; / you are firm in your devotion, O brahmin seer, as tested now by me.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyabhogānyathākāmaṃ bāndhavairbhuṅkṣva sarvadā |
sukhī bhava sadā duḥkhanirmukto bhaktimānmama ||
meaning:
भक्ष्यभोगान्यथाकामं बान्धवैर्भुङ्क्ष्व सर्वदा |
सुखी भव सदा दुःखनिर्मुक्तो भक्तिमान्मम ||
text_mt: Enjoy edible delicacies as you desire, always with your kinsmen; / be ever happy, freed from sorrow, possessing devotion to me.

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyo mahābhāga tavāmbaiṣā hi pārvatī |
mayā putrīkṛto hyadya kumāratvaṃ sanātanam ||
meaning:
उपमन्यो महाभाग तवाम्बैषा हि पार्वती |
मया पुत्रीकृतो ह्यद्य कुमारत्वं सनातनम् ||
text_mt: O highly fortunate Upamanyu, this Pārvatī is indeed your mother; / you have been made my son today, [granted] eternal childhood.

sanskrit_iast:
dugdhadadhyājyamadhunāmarṇavāśca sahasraśaḥ |
bhakṣyabhojyādivastūnāmarṇavāścākhilāstathā ||
meaning:
दुग्धदध्याज्यमधुनामर्णवाश्च सहस्रशः |
भक्ष्यभोज्यादिवस्तूनामर्णवाश्चाखिलास्तथा ||
text_mt: Oceans of milk, curds, ghee, and honey by the thousands, / and all oceans of edible, drinkable, and other foods,

sanskrit_iast:
tubhyaṃ dattā mayā prītyā tvaṃ gṛhṇīṣva mahāmune |
amaratvaṃ tathā dattaṃ gāṇapatyaṃ ca śāśvatam ||
meaning:
तुभ्यं दत्ता मया प्रीत्या त्वं गृह्णीष्व महामुने |
अमरत्वं तथा दत्तं गाणपत्यं च शाश्वतम् ||
text_mt: have been given to you by me with affection; accept them, O great sage! / Immortality has likewise been given, and eternal leadership of the attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
pitāhaṃ te mahādevo mātā te jagadambikā |
varānvaraya suprītyā mano'bhilaṣitānparān ||
meaning:
पिताहं ते महादेवो माता ते जगदम्बिका |
वरान्वरय सुप्रीत्या मनोऽभिलषितान्परान् ||
text_mt: I, Mahādeva, am your father; your mother is the Mother of the Universe. / Choose with great joy supreme boons that are desired by your heart.

sanskrit_iast:
ajaraścāmaraścaiva bhava tvaṃ duḥkhavarjitaḥ |
yaśasvī varatejasvī divyajñānī mahāprabhuḥ ||
meaning:
अजरश्चामरश्चैव भव त्वं दुःखवर्जितः |
यशस्वी वरतेजस्वी दिव्यज्ञानी महाप्रभुः ||
text_mt: Be free from old age and free from death, devoid of sorrow, / renowned, of supreme splendor, endowed with divine knowledge, a great lord!”

sanskrit_iast:
atha śambhuḥ prasannātmā smṛtvā tasya tapo mahat |
punardaśa varāndivyānmunaye hyūpamanyave ||
meaning:
अथ शम्भुः प्रसन्नात्मा स्मृत्वा तस्य तपो महत् |
पुनर्दश वरान्दिव्यान्मुनये ह्यूपमन्यवे ||
text_mt: Then Śambhu, gracious in soul, remembering his great austerity, / [gave] ten more divine boons to the sage Upamanyu:

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ jñānaṃ vratayogaṃ ca tattvataḥ |
dadau tasmai pravaktṛtvaṃ pāṭavaṃ ca nijaṃ padamm ||
meaning:
व्रतं पाशुपतं ज्ञानं व्रतयोगं च तत्त्वतः |
ददौ तस्मै प्रवक्तृत्वं पाटवं च निजं पदम्म् ||
text_mt: He gave him the Pāśupata observance, knowledge, and the yoga of the observance in truth; / he gave him eloquence, skill, and his own realm.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dattvā mahādevaḥ karābhyāmupagṛhya tam |
mūrdhnyāghrāya sutaste'yamiti devyai nyavedayat ||
meaning:
एवं दत्त्वा महादेवः कराभ्यामुपगृह्य तम् |
मूर्ध्न्याघ्राय सुतस्तेऽयमिति देव्यै न्यवेदयत् ||
text_mt: Having thus granted them, Mahādeva lifted him up with both hands, / and, having smelled him on the head, presented him to the Goddess, saying, “This is your son.”

sanskrit_iast:
devī ca śṛṇvatī prītyā mūrdhni deśe karāmbujam |
vinyasya pradadau tasmai kumārapadamakṣayam ||
meaning:
देवी च शृण्वती प्रीत्या मूर्ध्नि देशे कराम्बुजम् |
विन्यस्य प्रददौ तस्मै कुमारपदमक्षयम् ||
text_mt: And the Goddess, hearing with affection, placed her lotus hand / on his head and granted him the imperishable status of a son.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrābdhimapi sākāraṃ kṣīrasvādukarodadhiḥ |
upāsthāya dadau tasmai piṇḍībhūtamanaśvaram ||
meaning:
क्षीराब्धिमपि साकारं क्षीरस्वादुकरोदधिः |
उपास्थाय ददौ तस्मै पिण्डीभूतमनश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Approaching him, the ocean, making the milk tasty, / brought the milk ocean in tangible form and gave it to him, solidified and imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
yogaiśvaryaṃ sadā tuṣṭaṃ brahmavidyāmanaśvarām |
samṛddhiṃ paramāṃ tasmai dadau santuṣṭamānasaḥ ||
meaning:
योगैश्वर्यं सदा तुष्टं ब्रह्मविद्यामनश्वराम् |
समृद्धिं परमां तस्मै ददौ सन्तुष्टमानसः ||
text_mt: The sovereign power of yoga, perpetual contentment, imperishable knowledge of the absolute, / and supreme prosperity she gave to him, her heart fully satisfied.

sanskrit_iast:
so'pi labdhvā varāndivyānkumāratvaṃ ca sarvadā |
tasmācchivācca tasyāśca śivāyā mudito'bhavat ||
meaning:
सोऽपि लब्ध्वा वरान्दिव्यान्कुमारत्वं च सर्वदा |
तस्माच्छिवाच्च तस्याश्च शिवाया मुदितोऽभवत् ||
text_mt: He too, having obtained divine boons and eternal status as a son / from that Śiva and that Śivā, rejoiced.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prasannacetaskaḥ supraṇamya kṛtāñjaliḥ |
yayāce sa varaṃ prītyā devadevānmaheśvarāt ||
meaning:
ततः प्रसन्नचेतस्कः सुप्रणम्य कृताञ्जलिः |
ययाचे स वरं प्रीत्या देवदेवान्महेश्वरात् ||
text_mt: Then, with a serene mind, bowing deeply with folded hands, / he affectionately requested a boon from the God of gods, Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
prasīda devadeveśa prasīda parameśvara |
svabhaktiṃ dehi paramāṃ divyāmavyabhicāriṇīm ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
प्रसीद देवदेवेश प्रसीद परमेश्वर |
स्वभक्तिं देहि परमां दिव्यामव्यभिचारिणीम् ||
text_mt: Upamanyu said: / “Be pleased, O Lord of the gods of gods! Be pleased, O Parameśvara! / Grant supreme, divine, unswerving devotion to yourself!

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhāṃ dehi mahādeva svasambandhiṣu me sadā |
svadāsyaṃ paramaṃ snehaṃ svasānnidhyaṃ ca sarvadā ||
meaning:
श्रद्धां देहि महादेव स्वसम्बन्धिषु मे सदा |
स्वदास्यं परमं स्नेहं स्वसान्निध्यं च सर्वदा ||
text_mt: Grant me constant faith in those related to you, O Mahādeva, / the highest servitude to you, affection, and proximity to you at all times!”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
evamuktvā prasannātmā harṣagadgadayā girā |
tuṣṭāva sa mahādevamupamanyurdvijottamaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
एवमुक्त्वा प्रसन्नात्मा हर्षगद्गदया गिरा |
तुष्टाव स महादेवमुपमन्युर्द्विजोत्तमः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, serene in mind, with a voice choked with joy, / that Upamanyu, the best of the twice-born, praised Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktaḥ śivastena sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ prabhuḥ |
pratyuvāca prasannātmopamanyuṃ sakaleśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
एवमुक्तः शिवस्तेन सर्वेषां शृण्वतां प्रभुः |
प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मोपमन्युं सकलेश्वरः ||
text_mt: Addressed thus by him, while everyone listened, the Lord Śiva, / the Lord of all, serene in mind, replied to Upamanyu.

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca |
vatsopamanyo dhanyastvaṃ mama bhakto viśeṣataḥ |
sarvaṃ dattaṃ mayā te hi yad vṛtaṃ bhavatānagha ||
meaning:
शिव उवाच |
वत्सोपमन्यो धन्यस्त्वं मम भक्तो विशेषतः |
सर्वं दत्तं मया ते हि यद् वृतं भवतानघ ||
text_mt: Śiva said: / “Dear Upamanyu, blessed are you, especially devoted to me; / everything has indeed been granted to you by me, whatever was chosen by you, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
ajaraścāmaraśca tvaṃ sarvadā duḥkhavarjitaḥ |
sarvapūjyo nirvikārī bhaktānāṃ pravaro bhava ||
meaning:
अजरश्चामरश्च त्वं सर्वदा दुःखवर्जितः |
सर्वपूज्यो निर्विकारी भक्तानां प्रवरो भव ||
text_mt: Free from old age and free from death, always free from sorrow, / worshipful by all, unperturbed, become the foremost among my devotees!”

sanskrit_iast:
akṣayā bāndhavāścaiva kulaṃ gotraṃ ca te sadā |
bhaviṣyati dvijaśreṣṭha mayi bhaktiśca śāśvatī ||
meaning:
अक्षया बान्धवाश्चैव कुलं गोत्रं च ते सदा |
भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ मयि भक्तिश्च शाश्वती ||
text_mt: Your kinsmen, family, and lineage shall be imperishable forever, / and you shall have eternal devotion to me, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
sānnidhyaṃ cāśraye nityaṃ kariṣyāmi mune tava |
tiṣṭha vatsa yathākāmaṃ notkaṇṭhāṃ ca kariṣyasi ||
meaning:
सान्निध्यं चाश्रये नित्यं करिष्यामि मुने तव |
तिष्ठ वत्स यथाकामं नोत्कण्ठां च करिष्यसि ||
text_mt: And I will always remain present in your hermitage, O sage. / Live as you please, dear child; you shall suffer no longing."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstasmai dattvā varānvarān |
sāmbaśca sagaṇaḥ sadyastatraivāntardadhe prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्तस्मै दत्त्वा वरान्वरान् |
साम्बश्च सगणः सद्यस्तत्रैवान्तर्दधे प्रभुः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus and granted him excellent boons, / the lord, accompanied by Ambā and his attendants, vanished right there instantly.

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuḥ prasannātmā prāpya śambhorvarānvarān |
jagāma jananīsthānaṃ mātre sarvamavarṇayat ||
meaning:
उपमन्युः प्रसन्नात्मा प्राप्य शम्भोर्वरान्वरान् |
जगाम जननीस्थानं मात्रे सर्वमवर्णयत् ||
text_mt: Upamanyu, delighted in soul upon receiving the excellent boons of Śambhu, / went to his mother's abode and related everything to his mother.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā tasya jananī mahāharṣamavāpa sā |
sarvapūjyo'bhavatso'pi sukhaṃ prāpādhikaṃ sadā ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा तस्य जननी महाहर्षमवाप सा |
सर्वपूज्योऽभवत्सोऽपि सुखं प्रापाधिकं सदा ||
text_mt: Hearing that, his mother experienced immense joy; / he too became revered by all and attained ever-greater happiness forever.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ te varṇitastāta śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
sureśvarāvatāro hi sarvadā sukhadaḥ satām ||
meaning:
इत्थं ते वर्णितस्तात शिवस्य परमात्मनः |
सुरेश्वरावतारो हि सर्वदा सुखदः सताम् ||
text_mt: Thus, dear one, has been described to you the incarnation of Śiva, the Supreme Self, / known as Sureśvara, which always brings happiness to the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
idamākhyānamanaghaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam |
svargyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ satām ||
meaning:
इदमाख्यानमनघं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् |
स्वर्ग्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं सताम् ||
text_mt: This faultless narrative bestows the fruit of all desires; / it leads to heaven, brings fame and long life, and gives enjoyment and liberation to the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
ya etacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ |
iha sarvasukhaṃ bhuktvā so'nte śivagatiṃ labhet ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
य एतच्छृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः |
इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा सोऽन्ते शिवगतिं लभेत् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Whoever hears this with devotion or recites it with a concentrated mind / shall enjoy every happiness in this world and at the end attain the state of Śiva.

Thus ends the thirty-second chapter, titled "Description of the Deeds of the Incarnation of Śiva Known as Sureśvara," in the Śatarudrasaṃhitā of the glorious Śivapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
sanatkumāra suprītyā śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
avatāraṃ śṛṇu vibhorjaṭilāhvaṃ supāvanam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
सनत्कुमार सुप्रीत्या शिवस्य परमात्मनः |
अवतारं शृणु विभोर्जटिलाह्वं सुपावनम् ||
title: trayotriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | brahmacāriśivāvatāravarṇanam
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / With great delight, Sanatkumāra, listen to the very purifying incarnation / of Śiva, the Supreme Self and omnipresent lord, named Jaṭila.

sanskrit_iast:
purā satī dakṣakanyā tyaktvā dehaṃ piturmakhe |
svapitrānādṛtā jajñe menāyāṃ himabhūdharāt ||
meaning:
पुरा सती दक्षकन्या त्यक्त्वा देहं पितुर्मखे |
स्वपित्रानादृता जज्ञे मेनायां हिमभूधरात् ||
text_mt: Formerly Satī, the daughter of Dakṣa, abandoned her body at her father's sacrifice; / disrespected by her father, she was born to Menā from the snow-mountain [Himavat].

sanskrit_iast:
sā gatvā gahane'raṇye tepe suvimalaṃ tapaḥ |
śaṅkaraṃ patimicchantī sakhībhyāṃ saṃyutā śivā ||
meaning:
सा गत्वा गहनेऽरण्ये तेपे सुविमलं तपः |
शङ्करं पतिमिच्छन्ती सखीभ्यां संयुता शिवा ||
text_mt: Entering a dense forest, she performed pristine austerity; / Śivā, desiring Śaṅkara as her husband, was accompanied by her two female friends.

sanskrit_iast:
tattapaḥ suparīkṣārthaṃ saptarṣīnpraiṣayacchivaḥ |
tapaḥsthānaṃ tu pārvatyā nānālīlāviśāradaḥ ||
meaning:
तत्तपः सुपरीक्षार्थं सप्तर्षीन्प्रैषयच्छिवः |
तपःस्थानं तु पार्वत्या नानालीलाविशारदः ||
text_mt: In order to thoroughly test that austerity, Śiva sent the seven seers / to the place of Pārvatī's austerity, for he is skilled in various divine sports.

sanskrit_iast:
te gatvā tatra munayaḥ parīkṣāṃ cakrurādarāt |
tasyāḥ suyatnato naiva samarthā hyabhavaṃśca te ||
meaning:
ते गत्वा तत्र मुनयः परीक्षां चक्रुरादरात् |
तस्याः सुयत्नतो नैव समर्था ह्यभवंश्च ते ||
text_mt: Going there, those sages respectfully conducted a test / of her with great effort, but they were by no means able [to shake her].

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāgatya śivaṃ natvā vṛttāntaṃ ca nivedya tat |
tadājñāṃ samanuprāpya svarlokaṃ jagmurādarāt ||
meaning:
तत्रागत्य शिवं नत्वा वृत्तान्तं च निवेद्य तत् |
तदाज्ञां समनुप्राप्य स्वर्लोकं जग्मुरादरात् ||
text_mt: Returning there, having bowed to Śiva and reported that incident, / they obtained his command and respectfully went to the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast:
gateṣu teṣu muniṣu svasthānaṃ śaṅkaraḥ svayam |
parīkṣituṃ śivāvṛttamaicchatsūtikaraḥ prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
गतेषु तेषु मुनिषु स्वस्थानं शङ्करः स्वयम् |
परीक्षितुं शिवावृत्तमैच्छत्सूतिकरः प्रभुः ||
text_mt: When those sages had gone to their own abode, Śaṅkara himself, / the lord who brings about prosperity, wished to test the conduct of Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
suprasannastapasvīcchāśamanādayamīśvaraḥ |
brahmacaryasvarūpo'bhūttadādbhutataraḥ prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
सुप्रसन्नस्तपस्वीच्छाशमनादयमीश्वरः |
ब्रह्मचर्यस्वरूपोऽभूत्तदाद्भुततरः प्रभुः ||
text_mt: Extremely pleased, in order to appease the desire of the female ascetic, / this lord, most wondrous, assumed the form of a student of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
atīva sthaviro vipradehadhārī svatejasā |
prajvalanmanasā hṛṣṭo daṇḍī chatrī mahojjalaḥ ||
meaning:
अतीव स्थविरो विप्रदेहधारी स्वतेजसा |
प्रज्वलन्मनसा हृष्टो दण्डी छत्री महोज्जलः ||
text_mt: Assuming the body of a very old brahmin, blazing with his own splendor, / cheerful in mind, holding a staff and an umbrella, exceedingly radiant,

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtvaivaṃ jāṭilaṃ rūpaṃ jagāma girijāvanam |
atiprītiyutaḥ śambhuḥ śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
धृत्वैवं जाटिलं रूपं जगाम गिरिजावनम् |
अतिप्रीतियुतः शम्भुः शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः ||
text_mt: having taken on such a form of an ascetic with matted hair, Śambhu went to the grove of Girijā, / filled with great affection—Śaṅkara, affectionate toward devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpaśyat sthitāṃ devīṃ sakhībhiḥ parivāritām |
vedikopari śuddhāntāṃ śivāmiva vidhoḥ kalām ||
meaning:
तत्रापश्यत् स्थितां देवीं सखीभिः परिवारिताम् |
वेदिकोपरि शुद्धान्तां शिवामिव विधोः कलाम् ||
text_mt: There he saw the goddess seated, surrounded by her female friends / upon an altar, pure within, like an auspicious crescent of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
śambhurnirīkṣya tāṃ devīṃ brahmacārisvarūpavān |
upakaṇṭhaṃ yayau prītyā cotsukī bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
शम्भुर्निरीक्ष्य तां देवीं ब्रह्मचारिस्वरूपवान् |
उपकण्ठं ययौ प्रीत्या चोत्सुकी भक्तवत्सलः ||
text_mt: Beholding that goddess, Śambhu in the form of a student of the Vedas / approached her with affection, eager, affectionate toward devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
āgataṃ sā tadā dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇaṃ tejasādbhutam |
aṅgeṣu lomaśaṃ śāntaṃ daṇḍacarmasamanvitam ||
meaning:
आगतं सा तदा दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणं तेजसाद्भुतम् |
अङ्गेषु लोमशं शान्तं दण्डचर्मसमन्वितम् ||
text_mt: Seeing the brahmin arrived then, wondrous with splendor, / hairy upon his limbs, tranquil, equipped with a staff and hide,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacaryadharaṃ vṛddhaṃ jaṭilaṃ sakamaṇḍalum |
apūjayatparaprītyā sarvapūjopahārakaiḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मचर्यधरं वृद्धं जटिलं सकमण्डलुम् |
अपूजयत्परप्रीत्या सर्वपूजोपहारकैः ||
text_mt: observing the vow of celibacy, old, with matted hair and a water-pot, / she worshipped him with supreme affection using all offerings of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā pārvatī devī pūjitaṃ parayā mudā |
kuśalaṃ paryapṛcchattaṃ brahmacāriṇamādarāt ||
meaning:
ततः सा पार्वती देवी पूजितं परया मुदा |
कुशलं पर्यपृच्छत्तं ब्रह्मचारिणमादरात् ||
text_mt: Then the goddess Pārvatī, having worshipped him with supreme joy, / respectfully asked that student of the Vedas about his well-being:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacārisvarūpeṇa kastvaṃ hi kuta āgataḥ |
idṃ vanaṃ bhāsayasi vada vedavidāṃ vara ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मचारिस्वरूपेण कस्त्वं हि कुत आगतः |
इद्ं वनं भासयसि वद वेदविदां वर ||
text_mt: "In the form of a student of the Vedas, who are you indeed, and whence have you come? / You illuminate this forest; speak, O best among the knowers of the Veda!"

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti pṛṣṭastu pārvatyā brahmacārī sa vai dvijaḥ |
pratyuvāca drutaṃ prītyā śivābhāvaparīkṣayā ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति पृष्टस्तु पार्वत्या ब्रह्मचारी स वै द्विजः |
प्रत्युवाच द्रुतं प्रीत्या शिवाभावपरीक्षया ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Thus questioned by Pārvatī, that twice-born student of the Vedas / immediately replied with affection, wishing to test the disposition of Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacāryuvāca |
ahamicchābhigāmī ca brahmacārī dvijo'smi vai |
tapasvī sukhado'nyeṣāmupakārī na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मचार्युवाच |
अहमिच्छाभिगामी च ब्रह्मचारी द्विजोऽस्मि वै |
तपस्वी सुखदोऽन्येषामुपकारी न संशयः ||
text_mt: The student of the Vedas said: / "I travel wherever I wish; I am indeed a twice-born student of the Vedas, / an ascetic, a bringer of happiness to others, and a benefactor without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvā brahmacārī sa śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ |
tasthivānupakaṇṭhaṃ sa gopāyan rūpamātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा ब्रह्मचारी स शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः |
तस्थिवानुपकण्ठं स गोपायन् रूपमात्मनः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, that student of the Vedas, Śaṅkara, affectionate toward devotees, / stood nearby, concealing his true form.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacāryuvāca |
kiṃ bravīmi mahādevi kathanīyaṃ na vidyate |
mahānarthakaraṃ vṛttaṃ dṛśyate vikṛtaṃ mahat ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मचार्युवाच |
किं ब्रवीमि महादेवि कथनीयं न विद्यते |
महानर्थकरं वृत्तं दृश्यते विकृतं महत् ||
text_mt: The student of the Vedas said: / "What shall I say, O great goddess? There is nothing worthy of being told; / a course of action bringing great calamity, exceedingly perverse, is seen.

sanskrit_iast:
nave vayasi sadbhogasādhane sukhakāraṇe |
mahopacārasadbhogairvṛthaiva tvaṃ tapasyasi ||
meaning:
नवे वयसि सद्भोगसाधने सुखकारणे |
महोपचारसद्भोगैर्वृथैव त्वं तपस्यसि ||
text_mt: In your young age, an instrument for true enjoyments and a source of happiness, / with great comforts and genuine pleasures [available], you vainly practice austerity!

sanskrit_iast:
kā tvaṃ kasyāsi tanayā kimarthaṃ vijane vane |
tapaścarasi durdharṣaṃ munibhiḥ prayatātmabhiḥ ||
meaning:
का त्वं कस्यासि तनया किमर्थं विजने वने |
तपश्चरसि दुर्धर्षं मुनिभिः प्रयतात्मभिः ||
text_mt: Who are you? Whose daughter are you? Why do you perform in an uninhabited forest / terrible austerity that can scarcely be endured even by self-controlled sages?"

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya parameśvarī |
uvāca vacanaṃ prītyā brahmacāriṇamuttamam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य परमेश्वरी |
उवाच वचनं प्रीत्या ब्रह्मचारिणमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing those words of his, the supreme sovereign goddess laughed / and spoke words with affection to the excellent student of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca |
śṛṇu vipra brahmacārin madvṛttamakhilaṃ mune |
janma me bhārate varṣe sāmprataṃ himavadgṛhe ||
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच |
शृणु विप्र ब्रह्मचारिन् मद्वृत्तमखिलं मुने |
जन्म मे भारते वर्षे साम्प्रतं हिमवद्गृहे ||
text_mt: Pārvatī said: / "Listen, O twice-born student of the Vedas, to my entire story, O sage: / My birth is presently in Bhāratavarṣa, in the house of Himavat.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ dakṣagṛhe janma satī śaṅkarakāminī |
yogena tyaktadehāhaṃ tātena patinindinā ||
meaning:
पूर्वं दक्षगृहे जन्म सती शङ्करकामिनी |
योगेन त्यक्तदेहाहं तातेन पतिनिन्दिना ||
text_mt: Previously my birth was in Dakṣa's house as Satī, the beloved of Śaṅkara; / I abandoned my body through yoga because of my father, who reviled my husband.

sanskrit_iast:
atra janmani samprāptaḥ supuṇyena śivo dvija |
māṃ tyaktvā bhasmasātkṛtvā manmathaṃ sa jagāma ha ||
meaning:
अत्र जन्मनि सम्प्राप्तः सुपुण्येन शिवो द्विज |
मां त्यक्त्वा भस्मसात्कृत्वा मन्मथं स जगाम ह ||
text_mt: In this birth, through great merit, Śiva was obtained, O twice-born one; / but having reduced Manmatha to ashes, he abandoned me and departed.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāte śaṅkare tāpād vrīḍitāhaṃ piturgṛhāt |
āgacchamatra tapase guruvākyena saṃyatā ||
meaning:
प्रयाते शङ्करे तापाद् व्रीडिताहं पितुर्गृहात् |
आगच्छमत्र तपसे गुरुवाक्येन संयता ||
text_mt: When Śaṅkara departed, distressed and ashamed, from my father's house / I came here for austerity, restrained in accordance with my preceptor's instruction.

sanskrit_iast:
manasā vacasā sākṣātkarmaṇā patibhāvataḥ |
satyaṃ bravīmi no'satyaṃ saṃvṛtaḥ śaṅkaro mayā ||
meaning:
मनसा वचसा साक्षात्कर्मणा पतिभावतः |
सत्यं ब्रवीमि नोऽसत्यं संवृतः शङ्करो मया ||
text_mt: In mind, in speech, and directly in action, regarding him as my husband— / I speak the truth, not a lie—Śaṅkara has been chosen by me.

sanskrit_iast:
jānāmi durlabhaṃ vastu kathaṃ prāpyaṃ mayā bhavet |
tathāpi manasautsukyāttapyate me tapo'dhunā ||
meaning:
जानामि दुर्लभं वस्तु कथं प्राप्यं मया भवेत् |
तथापि मनसौत्सुक्यात्तप्यते मे तपोऽधुना ||
text_mt: I know he is a rare object, and how could he be obtained by me? / Even so, out of mental longing, my austerity is now being performed.

sanskrit_iast:
hitvendrapramukhāndevānviṣṇuṃ brahmāṇamapyaham |
patiṃ pinākapāṇiṃ vai prāptumicchāmi satyataḥ ||
meaning:
हित्वेन्द्रप्रमुखान्देवान्विष्णुं ब्रह्माणमप्यहम् |
पतिं पिनाकपाणिं वै प्राप्तुमिच्छामि सत्यतः ||
text_mt: Setting aside the gods led by Indra, and even Viṣṇu and Brahmā, / I truly wish to obtain the wielder of the Pināka bow as my husband."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā pārvatyā hi suniścitam |
mune sa jaṭilo rudro vihasanvākyamabravīt ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा पार्वत्या हि सुनिश्चितम् |
मुने स जटिलो रुद्रो विहसन्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having heard these resolute words of Pārvatī, / that Rudra with matted hair laughed and spoke words, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭila uvāca |
himācalasute devi kā buddhiḥ svīkṛtā tvayā |
rudrārthaṃ vibudhānhitvā karoṣi vipulaṃ tapaḥ ||
meaning:
जटिल उवाच |
हिमाचलसुते देवि का बुद्धिः स्वीकृता त्वया |
रुद्रार्थं विबुधान्हित्वा करोषि विपुलं तपः ||
text_mt: The ascetic with matted hair said: / "O goddess, daughter of the Himālaya, what sort of idea have you embraced? / Forsaking the gods, you perform immense austerity for the sake of Rudra!

sanskrit_iast:
jānāmyahaṃ ca taṃ rudraṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ pravadāmi te |
vṛṣadhvajaḥ sa rudro hi vikṛtātmā jaṭādharaḥ ||
meaning:
जानाम्यहं च तं रुद्रं शृणु त्वं प्रवदामि ते |
वृषध्वजः स रुद्रो हि विकृतात्मा जटाधरः ||
text_mt: I know that Rudra; listen, I shall tell you: / that Rudra has a bull on his banner, a deformed nature, and wears matted hair.

sanskrit_iast:
ekākī ca sadā nityaṃ virāgī ca viśeṣataḥ |
tasmāttvaṃ tena rudreṇa mano yoktuṃ na cārhasi ||
meaning:
एकाकी च सदा नित्यं विरागी च विशेषतः |
तस्मात्त्वं तेन रुद्रेण मनो योक्तुं न चार्हसि ||
text_mt: He is always solitary and exceedingly detached; / therefore you ought not to set your heart upon that Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ viruddhaṃ rūpādi tava devi harasya ca |
mahyaṃ na rocate hyetadyadīcchasi tathā kuru ||
meaning:
सर्वं विरुद्धं रूपादि तव देवि हरस्य च |
मह्यं न रोचते ह्येतद्यदीच्छसि तथा कुरु ||
text_mt: Everything—beauty and the rest—is contrary between you, O goddess, and Hara. / This does not please me at all; if you still wish it, do as you please."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvā ca punā rudro brahmacārisvarūpavān |
nininda bahudhātmānaṃ tadagre tāṃ parīkṣitum ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा च पुना रुद्रो ब्रह्मचारिस्वरूपवान् |
निनिन्द बहुधात्मानं तदग्रे तां परीक्षितुम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, Rudra, in the form of a celibate student, / reviled himself in many ways before her in order to test her.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā pārvatī devī vipravākyaṃ durāsadam |
pratyuvāca mahākruddhā śivanindāparaṃ ca tam ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा पार्वती देवी विप्रवाक्यं दुरासदम् |
प्रत्युवाच महाक्रुद्धा शिवनिन्दापरं च तम् ||
text_mt: Hearing that harsh speech of the brahmin, the goddess Pārvatī / became exceedingly angry and replied to him who was intent on reviling Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaddhi mayā jñātaṃ kaścid dhanyo bhaviṣyati |
parantu sakalaṃ jñātamavadhyo dṛśyate'dhunā ||
meaning:
एतावद्धि मया ज्ञातं कश्चिद् धन्यो भविष्यति |
परन्तु सकलं ज्ञातमवध्यो दृश्यतेऽधुना ||
text_mt: “I thought this much: ‘He must be some blessed person.’ / But now everything is known; you appear [merely] someone not to be killed.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacārisvarūpeṇa kaścittvaṃ dhūrta āgataḥ |
śivanindā kṛtā mūḍha tvayā manyurabhūnmama ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मचारिस्वरूपेण कश्चित्त्वं धूर्त आगतः |
शिवनिन्दा कृता मूढ त्वया मन्युरभून्मम ||
text_mt: You are some rogue who has arrived in the form of a celibate student! / You have reviled Śiva, you fool, and caused me anger.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ tvaṃ ca na jānāsi śivāttvaṃ hi bahirmukhaḥ |
tvatpūjā ca kṛtā yanme tasmāttāpayutābhavam ||
meaning:
शिवं त्वं च न जानासि शिवात्त्वं हि बहिर्मुखः |
त्वत्पूजा च कृता यन्मे तस्मात्तापयुताभवम् ||
text_mt: You do not know Śiva, for you are turned away from Śiva. / Because worship was offered to you by me, I have come to feel torment.

sanskrit_iast:
śivanindāṃ karotīha tattvamajñāya yaḥ pumān |
ājanmasañcitaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya bhasmībhavatyuta ||
meaning:
शिवनिन्दां करोतीह तत्त्वमज्ञाय यः पुमान् |
आजन्मसञ्चितं पुण्यं तस्य भस्मीभवत्युत ||
text_mt: Whatever man in this world reviles Śiva without knowing reality, / even the merit accumulated since his birth turns to ashes.

sanskrit_iast: śivavidveṣiṇaṃ spṛṣṭvā prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ||
meaning: शिवविद्वेषिणं स्पृष्ट्वा प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत् ||
text_mt: Having touched one who hates Śiva, one should perform an expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
re re duṣṭa tvayā proktamahaṃ jānāmi śaṅkaram |
niścayena na vijñātaḥ śiva eva paraḥ prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
रे रे दुष्ट त्वया प्रोक्तमहं जानामि शङ्करम् |
निश्चयेन न विज्ञातः शिव एव परः प्रभुः ||
text_mt: Hey, wicked one, you said: ‘I know Śaṅkara.’ / But certainly you do not know that Śiva alone is the supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā tathā bhavedrudro māyayā bahurūpavān |
mamābhīṣṭaprado'tyantaṃ nirvikāraḥ satāṃ priyaḥ ||
meaning:
यथा तथा भवेद्रुद्रो मायया बहुरूपवान् |
ममाभीष्टप्रदोऽत्यन्तं निर्विकारः सतां प्रियः ||
text_mt: Be Rudra as he may, multi-formed by means of māyā, / he grants my deepest desire, is entirely changeless, and is dear to the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvā taṃ śivā devī śivatattvaṃ jagāda sā |
yatra brahmatayā rudraḥ kathyate nirguṇo'vyayaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा तं शिवा देवी शिवतत्त्वं जगाद सा |
यत्र ब्रह्मतया रुद्रः कथ्यते निर्गुणोऽव्ययः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus to him, the goddess Śivā declared the reality of Śiva, / wherein Rudra is declared to be Brahman, devoid of qualities and imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
tadākarṇya vaco devyā brahmacārī sa vai dvijaḥ |
punarvacanamādātuṃ yāvadeva pracakrame ||
meaning:
तदाकर्ण्य वचो देव्या ब्रह्मचारी स वै द्विजः |
पुनर्वचनमादातुं यावदेव प्रचक्रमे ||
text_mt: Hearing those words of the goddess, that twice-born celibate student, / just as he began to speak again,

sanskrit_iast:
provāca girijā tāvatsvasakhīṃ vijayāṃ drutam |
śivāsaktamanovṛttiḥ śivanindāparāṅmukhī ||
meaning:
प्रोवाच गिरिजा तावत्स्वसखीं विजयां द्रुतम् |
शिवासक्तमनोवृत्तिः शिवनिन्दापराङ्मुखी ||
text_mt: the mountain-born goddess quickly spoke to her friend Vijayā, / her mind's operation fixed on Śiva, averse to the reviling of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
girijovāca |
vāraṇīyaḥ prayatnena sakhyayaṃ hi dvijādhamaḥ |
punarvaktumanāścāyaṃ śivanindāṃ kariṣyati ||
meaning:
गिरिजोवाच |
वारणीयः प्रयत्नेन सख्ययं हि द्विजाधमः |
पुनर्वक्तुमनाश्चायं शिवनिन्दां करिष्यति ||
text_mt: The mountain-born goddess said: / “O friend, this lowest of the twice-born must be stopped with effort, / for he intends to speak again and will revile Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
na kevalaṃ bhavetpāpaṃ nindākartuḥ śivasya hi |
yo vai śṛṇoti tannindāṃ pāpabhāksa bhavediha ||
meaning:
न केवलं भवेत्पापं निन्दाकर्तुः शिवस्य हि |
यो वै शृणोति तन्निन्दां पापभाक्स भवेदिह ||
text_mt: Not only does sin accrue to the slanderer of Śiva, / but whoever hears his slander also partakes of sin in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
śivanindākaro vadhyaḥ sarvathā śivakiṅkaraiḥ |
brāhmaṇaścetsa vai tyājyo gantavyaṃ tatsthalāddrutam ||
meaning:
शिवनिन्दाकरो वध्यः सर्वथा शिवकिङ्करैः |
ब्राह्मणश्चेत्स वै त्याज्यो गन्तव्यं तत्स्थलाद्द्रुतम् ||
text_mt: The slanderer of Śiva is to be slain by all means by Śiva’s attendants; / but if he is a brahmin, he must be abandoned, and one must go quickly from that place.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ duṣṭaḥ punarnindāṃ kariṣyati śivasya hi |
brāhmaṇatvādavadhyaśca tyājyo'dṛśyaśca sarvathā ||
meaning:
अयं दुष्टः पुनर्निन्दां करिष्यति शिवस्य हि |
ब्राह्मणत्वादवध्यश्च त्याज्योऽदृश्यश्च सर्वथा ||
text_mt: This wicked one will revile Śiva again; / because he is a brahmin he must not be killed, but must be abandoned and never looked upon.

sanskrit_iast:
sthalametad drutaṃ hitvā yāsyāmo'nyatra mā ciram |
yathā sambhāṣaṇaṃ na syādanenāviduṣā punaḥ ||
meaning:
स्थलमेतद् द्रुतं हित्वा यास्यामोऽन्यत्र मा चिरम् |
यथा सम्भाषणं न स्यादनेनाविदुषा पुनः ||
text_mt: Leaving this place quickly, let us go elsewhere without delay, / so that there will be no further conversation with this ignorant fool.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvā comayā yāvatpadamutkṣipyate mune |
asau tāvacchivaḥ sākṣādālalambe paṭaṃ svayam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा चोमया यावत्पदमुत्क्षिप्यते मुने |
असौ तावच्छिवः साक्षादाललम्बे पटं स्वयम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, O sage, just as a step was being raised by Umā, / right then Śiva in person took hold of her garment himself.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā svarūpaṃ divyaṃ ca śivādhyānaṃ yathā tathā |
darśayitvā śivāyai tāmuvācāvāṅmukhīṃ śivaḥ ||
meaning:
कृत्वा स्वरूपं दिव्यं च शिवाध्यानं यथा तथा |
दर्शयित्वा शिवायै तामुवाचावाङ्मुखीं शिवः ||
text_mt: Assuming his divine form, exactly as in meditation upon Śiva, / and revealing it to Śivā, Śiva spoke to her as she stood with her face cast down.

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca |
kutra tvaṃ yāsi māṃ hitvā na tvaṃ tyājyā mayā śive |
mayā parīkṣitāsi tvaṃ dṛḍhabhaktāsi me'naghe ||
meaning:
शिव उवाच |
कुत्र त्वं यासि मां हित्वा न त्वं त्याज्या मया शिवे |
मया परीक्षितासि त्वं दृढभक्तासि मेऽनघे ||
text_mt: Śiva said: / “Where are you going, abandoning me? You are not to be abandoned by me, O Śivā! / You have been tested by me; you are firmly devoted to me, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacārisvarūpeṇa bhāvamicchustvadīyakam |
tavopakaṇṭhamāgatya prāvocaṃ vividhaṃ vacaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मचारिस्वरूपेण भावमिच्छुस्त्वदीयकम् |
तवोपकण्ठमागत्य प्रावोचं विविधं वचः ||
text_mt: Desiring to know your state of mind under the form of a celibate student, / I approached you and spoke various words.

sanskrit_iast:
prasanno'smi dṛḍhaṃ bhaktyā śive tava viśeṣataḥ |
cittepsitaṃ varaṃ brūhi nādeyaṃ vidyate tava ||
meaning:
प्रसन्नोऽस्मि दृढं भक्त्या शिवे तव विशेषतः |
चित्तेप्सितं वरं ब्रूहि नादेयं विद्यते तव ||
text_mt: I am deeply pleased with your devotion, O Śivā, especially so. / Name the boon desired in your heart; there is nothing not to be given to you.

sanskrit_iast:
adyaprabhṛti te dāsastapobhiḥ premanirbhare |
kṛto'smi tava saundaryātkṣaṇa eko yugāyate ||
meaning:
अद्यप्रभृति ते दासस्तपोभिः प्रेमनिर्भरे |
कृतोऽस्मि तव सौन्दर्यात्क्षण एको युगायते ||
text_mt: From this day forth I am your servant, bought by your austerities, O woman filled with love! / Because of your beauty, a single moment feels like an aeon.

sanskrit_iast:
tyajyatāṃ ca tvayā lajjā mama patnī sanātanī |
ehi priye tvayā sākaṃ drutaṃ yāmi svakaṃ girim ||
meaning:
त्यज्यतां च त्वया लज्जा मम पत्नी सनातनी |
एहि प्रिये त्वया साकं द्रुतं यामि स्वकं गिरिम् ||
text_mt: Cast away your shyness; you are my eternal wife. / Come, my beloved, together with you I will go quickly to my mountain.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavati deveśe śivātimudamāpa sā |
tapoduḥkhaṃ tu yatsarvaṃ tajjahau drutameva hi ||
meaning:
इत्युक्तवति देवेशे शिवातिमुदमाप सा |
तपोदुःखं तु यत्सर्वं तज्जहौ द्रुतमेव हि ||
text_mt: When the Lord of Gods had spoken thus, Śivā attained immense joy; / whatever distress had arisen from her austerity, she immediately abandoned it all.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭā sā dṛṣṭvā divyarūpaṃ śivasya tat |
pratyuvāca prabhuṃ prītyā lajjayādhomukhī śivā ||
meaning:
ततः प्रहृष्टा सा दृष्ट्वा दिव्यरूपं शिवस्य तत् |
प्रत्युवाच प्रभुं प्रीत्या लज्जयाधोमुखी शिवा ||
text_mt: Then, delighted upon seeing that divine form of Śiva, / the auspicious goddess, her face downcast with bashfulness, replied to the Lord with love.

sanskrit_iast:
śivovāca |
yadi prasanno deveśa karoṣi ca kṛpāṃ mayi |
patirme bhava deveśa ityuktaḥ śivayā śivaḥ ||
meaning:
शिवोवाच |
यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश करोषि च कृपां मयि |
पतिर्मे भव देवेश इत्युक्तः शिवया शिवः ||
text_mt: Śivā said: / “If you are pleased, O Lord of Gods, and show grace to me, / become my husband, O Lord of Gods.” Thus was Śiva addressed by Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca
gṛhītvā vidhivatpāṇiṃ kailāsaṃ sa tayā yayau |
patiṃ taṃ girijā prāpya devakāryaṃ cakāra sā ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच
गृहीत्वा विधिवत्पाणिं कैलासं स तया ययौ |
पतिं तं गिरिजा प्राप्य देवकार्यं चकार सा ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Taking her hand according to the prescribed rules, he went with her to Kailāsa. / Having obtained him as her husband, the mountain-born goddess accomplished the mission of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
iti proktastu te tāta brahmacārisvarūpakaḥ |
śivāvatāro hi mayā śivābhāvaparīkṣakaḥ ||
meaning:
इति प्रोक्तस्तु ते तात ब्रह्मचारिस्वरूपकः |
शिवावतारो हि मया शिवाभावपरीक्षकः ||
text_mt: Thus, dear one, has been told to you by me the incarnation of Śiva / in the form of a celibate student, which tested the devotion of Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
idamākhyānamanaghaṃ paramaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ mayā |
ya etacchṛṇuyātprītyā sa sukhī gatimāpnuyāt ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
इदमाख्यानमनघं परमं व्याहृतं मया |
य एतच्छृणुयात्प्रीत्या स सुखी गतिमाप्नुयात् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
This supreme, stainless narrative has been related by me; / whoever hears this with love will become happy and attain the supreme destination.

Thus ends the thirty-third chapter, named ‘Description of the Celibate Student Incarnation of Śiva,’ in the third book, the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
sanatkumāra sarvajña śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
avatāraṃ śṛṇu vibhoḥ sunartakanaṭāhvayam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ शिवस्य परमात्मनः |
अवतारं शृणु विभोः सुनर्तकनटाह्वयम् ||
title: catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | sunartakanaṭāhvaśivāvatāravarṇanam
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / O omniscient Sanatkumāra, hear of the incarnation of the all-pervading Śiva, / the Supreme Self, known by the name of the Good Dancer and Actor.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā hi kālikā devī pārvatī himavatsutā |
tepe tapaḥ suvimalaṃ vanaṃ gatvā śivāptaye ||
meaning:
यदा हि कालिका देवी पार्वती हिमवत्सुता |
तेपे तपः सुविमलं वनं गत्वा शिवाप्तये ||
text_mt: When the goddess Kālikā, Pārvatī, daughter of the Himavat, / went to the forest and performed flawless austerity in order to attain Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā śivaḥ prasanno'bhūttasyāḥ sutapaso mune |
tadvṛttasuparīkṣārthaṃ varaṃ dātuṃ mudā yayau ||
meaning:
तदा शिवः प्रसन्नोऽभूत्तस्याः सुतपसो मुने |
तद्वृत्तसुपरीक्षार्थं वरं दातुं मुदा ययौ ||
text_mt: then Śiva became pleased by her excellent austerity, O sage, / and went joyfully to grant a boon in order to thoroughly test her conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa tasyai suprītamānasaḥ |
varaṃ brūhīti covāca tāṃ śivāṃ śaṅkaro mune ||
meaning:
स्वरूपं दर्शयामास तस्यै सुप्रीतमानसः |
वरं ब्रूहीति चोवाच तां शिवां शङ्करो मुने ||
text_mt: With an exceedingly delighted mind, he displayed his form to her / and said to that auspicious goddess: “Choose a boon,” O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā śambhuvacanaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadrūpamuttamam |
sujaharṣa śivātīva prāha taṃ supraṇamya sā ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा शम्भुवचनं दृष्ट्वा तद्रूपमुत्तमम् |
सुजहर्ष शिवातीव प्राह तं सुप्रणम्य सा ||
text_mt: Hearing that speech of Śambhu and seeing that supreme form, / Śivā rejoiced exceedingly, and bowing respectfully to him, she said:

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca |
yadi prasanno deveśa mahyaṃ deyo varo yadi |
patirbhava mameśāna kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari ||
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच |
यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश मह्यं देयो वरो यदि |
पतिर्भव ममेशान कृपां कुरु ममोपरि ||
text_mt: Pārvatī said: / “If you are pleased, O Lord of Gods, if a boon is to be given to me, / become my husband, O Īśāna; bestow grace upon me.

sanskrit_iast:
piturgṛhe mayā samyaggamyate tvadanujñayā |
gantavyaṃ bhavatā nātha matpituḥ pārśvataḥ prabho ||
meaning:
पितुर्गृहे मया सम्यग्गम्यते त्वदनुज्ञया |
गन्तव्यं भवता नाथ मत्पितुः पार्श्वतः प्रभो ||
text_mt: With your permission I will proceed duly to my father’s house; / you must come, O Lord, to the presence of my father, O Master.

sanskrit_iast:
yācasva māṃ tato bhikṣuḥ khyāpayaṃśca yaśaḥ śubham |
piturme saphalaṃ sarvaṃ kuru prītyā gṛhāśramam ||
meaning:
याचस्व मां ततो भिक्षुः ख्यापयंश्च यशः शुभम् |
पितुर्मे सफलं सर्वं कुरु प्रीत्या गृहाश्रमम् ||
text_mt: Then, as a mendicant, ask for me, making known your auspicious fame; / joyfully make the householder life of my father entirely fruitful.

sanskrit_iast:
tato yathoktavidhinā kartumarhasi bho prabho |
vivāhaṃ tvaṃ maheśāna devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye ||
meaning:
ततो यथोक्तविधिना कर्तुमर्हसि भो प्रभो |
विवाहं त्वं महेशान देवानां कार्यसिद्धये ||
text_mt: Then, O Master, O Maheśāna, you should perform / the marriage in accordance with the prescribed injunctions for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaṃ me pūraya vibho nirvikāro bhavānsadā |
bhaktavatsalanāmā hi tava bhaktāsmyahaṃ sadā ||
meaning:
कामं मे पूरय विभो निर्विकारो भवान्सदा |
भक्तवत्सलनामा हि तव भक्तास्म्यहं सदा ||
text_mt: Fulfill my desire, O all-pervading Lord; you are ever free from transformation; / indeed, your name is affectionate toward devotees, and I am ever your devotee.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktaḥ sa tayā śambhurmaheśo bhaktavatsalaḥ |
tathāstviti vacaḥ procyāntarhitaḥ svagiriṃ yayau ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्तः स तया शम्भुर्महेशो भक्तवत्सलः |
तथास्त्विति वचः प्रोच्यान्तर्हितः स्वगिरिं ययौ ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Thus addressed by her, Śambhu, the great Lord affectionate toward devotees, / said, “So be it,” and vanishing, went to his own mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyapi tataḥ prītyā svasakhībhyāṃ samanvitā |
jagāma svapiturgehaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā tu sārthakam ||
meaning:
पार्वत्यपि ततः प्रीत्या स्वसखीभ्यां समन्विता |
जगाम स्वपितुर्गेहं रूपं कृत्वा तु सार्थकम् ||
text_mt: Pārvatī, too, accompanied by her two friends, then joyfully / went to her father’s home, having made her beauty purposeful.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyāgamanaṃ śrutvā menayā sa himācalaḥ |
parivārayuto draṣṭuṃ svasutāṃ tāṃ yayau mudā ||
meaning:
पार्वत्यागमनं श्रुत्वा मेनया स हिमाचलः |
परिवारयुतो द्रष्टुं स्वसुतां तां ययौ मुदा ||
text_mt: Hearing of Pārvatī’s arrival, the Himācala together with Menā / and accompanied by his retinue went joyfully to see his daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ suprasannāsyāmānayāmāsaturgṛham |
kārayāmāsatuḥ prītyā mahānandau mahotsavam ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तां सुप्रसन्नास्यामानयामासतुर्गृहम् |
कारयामासतुः प्रीत्या महानन्दौ महोत्सवम् ||
text_mt: Seeing her whose face was bright with joy, they both brought her home, / and, filled with great bliss, they lovingly held a great festival.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃ dadau dvijādibhyo menā girivarastathā |
maṅgalaṃ kārayāmāsa savedadhvanimādarāt ||
meaning:
धनं ददौ द्विजादिभ्यो मेना गिरिवरस्तथा |
मङ्गलं कारयामास सवेदध्वनिमादरात् ||
text_mt: Menā and the excellent mountain gave wealth to the twice-born and others, / and respectfully caused auspicious rites to be performed with the sound of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svakanyayā sārdhamuvāsa prāṅgaṇe mudā |
menā ca himavāñchailaḥ snātuṃ gaṅgāṃ jagāma saḥ ||
meaning:
ततः स्वकन्यया सार्धमुवास प्राङ्गणे मुदा |
मेना च हिमवाञ्छैलः स्नातुं गङ्गां जगाम सः ||
text_mt: Then Menā sat joyfully with her daughter in the courtyard, / and that mountain Himavat went to the Gaṅgā to bathe.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare śambhuḥ sulīlo bhaktavatsalaḥ |
sunartakanaṭo bhūtvā menakāsannidhiṃ yayau ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शम्भुः सुलीलो भक्तवत्सलः |
सुनर्तकनटो भूत्वा मेनकासन्निधिं ययौ ||
text_mt: In the meantime, Śambhu, fond of divine sport and affectionate toward devotees, / became an expert dancer and actor, and approached Menakā.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgaṃ vāme kare dhṛtvā dakṣiṇe ḍamaruṃ tathā |
pṛṣṭhe kanthāṃ raktavāsā nṛtyagānaviśāradaḥ ||
meaning:
शृङ्गं वामे करे धृत्वा दक्षिणे डमरुं तथा |
पृष्ठे कन्थां रक्तवासा नृत्यगानविशारदः ||
text_mt: Holding a horn in his left hand and a ḍamaru drum in his right, / wearing a patched cloth on his back and red garments, he was skilled in dancing and singing.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu naṭarūpo'sau menakāprāṅgaṇe mudā |
cakre sa nṛtyaṃ vividhaṃ gānaṃ cāti manoharam ||
meaning:
ततस्तु नटरूपोऽसौ मेनकाप्राङ्गणे मुदा |
चक्रे स नृत्यं विविधं गानं चाति मनोहरम् ||
text_mt: Then, in the form of a dancer, in Menakā’s courtyard, / he joyfully performed various dances and extremely charming singing.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgañca ḍamaruṃ tatra vādayāmāsa sudhvanim |
mahotiṃ vividhāṃ prītyā sa cakāra manoharām ||
meaning:
शृङ्गञ्च डमरुं तत्र वादयामास सुध्वनिम् |
महोतिं विविधां प्रीत्या स चकार मनोहराम् ||
text_mt: He played the horn and the ḍamaru drum there with a sweet sound; / with delight he performed various captivating sports.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ draṣṭuṃ nāgarāḥ sarve puruṣāśca striyastathā |
ājagmuḥ sahasā tatra bālā vṛddhā api dhruvam ||
meaning:
तं द्रष्टुं नागराः सर्वे पुरुषाश्च स्त्रियस्तथा |
आजग्मुः सहसा तत्र बाला वृद्धा अपि ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: To see him, all the townsfolk, both men and women, / suddenly came there, surely including children and old folk as well.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā sugītaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā sunṛtyaṃ ca manoharam |
sahasā mumuhuḥ sarve menāpi ca tadā mune ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वा सुगीतं तं दृष्ट्वा सुनृत्यं च मनोहरम् |
सहसा मुमुहुः सर्वे मेनापि च तदा मुने ||
text_mt: Hearing his melodious singing and beholding his charming, fine dance, / they all suddenly fell into wonder, and so did Menā at that time, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tato menāśu ratnāni svarṇapātrasthitāni ca |
tasmai dātuṃ yayau prītyā tadūtiprītamānasā ||
meaning:
ततो मेनाशु रत्नानि स्वर्णपात्रस्थितानि च |
तस्मै दातुं ययौ प्रीत्या तदूतिप्रीतमानसा ||
text_mt: Then Menā, her mind pleased by his sport, quickly went with joy / to give him jewels placed upon a golden plate.

sanskrit_iast:
tāni na svīcakārāsau bhikṣāṃ kāṅkṣe śivāṃ ca tām |
punaḥ sunṛtyaṃ gānaṃ ca kautukātkartumudyataḥ ||
meaning:
तानि न स्वीचकारासौ भिक्षां काङ्क्षे शिवां च ताम् |
पुनः सुनृत्यं गानं च कौतुकात्कर्तुमुद्यतः ||
text_mt: He did not accept them, [saying,] “I desire Śivā as alms,” / and again eagerly prepared to perform a fine dance and song out of sport.

sanskrit_iast:
menā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā cukopāti suvismitā |
bhikṣukaṃ bhartsayāmāsa bahiṣkartumiyeṣa sā ||
meaning:
मेना तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा चुकोपाति सुविस्मिता |
भिक्षुकं भर्त्सयामास बहिष्कर्तुमियेष सा ||
text_mt: Hearing his words, Menā became extremely angry and greatly astonished; / she scolded the beggar and wished to throw him out.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tatra gaṅgāto girirāḍ yayau |
dadarśa purato bhikṣuṃ prāṅgaṇasthaṃ narākṛtim ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र गङ्गातो गिरिराड् ययौ |
ददर्श पुरतो भिक्षुं प्राङ्गणस्थं नराकृतिम् ||
text_mt: In the meantime, the king of mountains came there from the Gaṅgā; / he saw before him in the courtyard the beggar in human form.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā menāmukhād vṛttaṃ tatsarvaṃ sucukopa saḥ |
ājñāṃ cakārānucarānbahiḥ kartuṃ ca bhikṣukam ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वा मेनामुखाद् वृत्तं तत्सर्वं सुचुकोप सः |
आज्ञां चकारानुचरान्बहिः कर्तुं च भिक्षुकम् ||
text_mt: Hearing that whole report from Menā’s mouth, he became very angry; / he commanded his servants to cast the beggar outside.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāgnimiva duḥsparśaṃ prajvalantaṃ sutejasam |
na śaśāka bahiḥ kartuṃ ko'pi taṃ munisattama ||
meaning:
महाग्निमिव दुःस्पर्शं प्रज्वलन्तं सुतेजसम् |
न शशाक बहिः कर्तुं कोऽपि तं मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: Like a great fire, unapproachable, blazing with immense splendor, / no one was able to cast him outside, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa bhikṣukastāta nānālīlāviśāradaḥ |
darśayāmāsa śailāya svaprabhāvamanantakam ||
meaning:
ततः स भिक्षुकस्तात नानालीलाविशारदः |
दर्शयामास शैलाय स्वप्रभावमनन्तकम् ||
text_mt: Then that beggar, O dear one, skilled in diverse sports, / revealed his endless power to the mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
śailo dadarśa taṃ tatra viṣṇurūpadharaṃ drutam |
tato brahmasvarūpaṃ ca sūryarūpaṃ tataḥ kṣaṇāt ||
meaning:
शैलो ददर्श तं तत्र विष्णुरूपधरं द्रुतम् |
ततो ब्रह्मस्वरूपं च सूर्यरूपं ततः क्षणात् ||
text_mt: The mountain beheld him there instantly assuming the form of Viṣṇu, / then the form of Brahmā, and in an instant the form of Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dadarśa taṃ tāta rudrarūpaṃ mahādbhutam |
pārvatīsahitaṃ ramyaṃ vihasantaṃ sutejasam ||
meaning:
ततो ददर्श तं तात रुद्ररूपं महाद्भुतम् |
पार्वतीसहितं रम्यं विहसन्तं सुतेजसम् ||
text_mt: Then, O dear one, he saw him in the exceedingly wondrous form of Rudra, / accompanied by Pārvatī, delightful, smiling, and endowed with great splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ subahurūpāṇi tasya tatra dadarśa saḥ |
suvismito babhūvāśu paramānandasamplutaḥ ||
meaning:
एवं सुबहुरूपाणि तस्य तत्र ददर्श सः |
सुविस्मितो बभूवाशु परमानन्दसम्प्लुतः ||
text_mt: Thus he beheld there his exceedingly numerous forms; / he was soon filled with wonder and flooded with supreme bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
athāsau bhikṣuvaryo hi tasmāttasyāśca sūtikṛt |
bhikṣāṃ yayāce durgāṃ tāṃ nānyajjagrāha kiñcana ||
meaning:
अथासौ भिक्षुवर्यो हि तस्मात्तस्याश्च सूतिकृत् |
भिक्षां ययाचे दुर्गां तां नान्यज्जग्राह किञ्चन ||
text_mt: Then that best of beggars, the creator of sport, / asked that Durgā as alms from him and from her; he accepted nothing else.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścāntardadhe bhikṣusvarūpaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
svālayaṃ sa jagāmāśu durgāvākyapraṇoditaḥ ||
meaning:
ततश्चान्तर्दधे भिक्षुस्वरूपः परमेश्वरः |
स्वालयं स जगामाशु दुर्गावाक्यप्रणोदितः ||
text_mt: Then Parameśvara in the form of the beggar vanished; / impelled by the words of Durgā, he quickly went to his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā babhūva sujñānaṃ menāśaileśayorapi |
āvāṃ śivo vañcayitvā gatavānsvālayaṃ vibhuḥ ||
meaning:
तदा बभूव सुज्ञानं मेनाशैलेशयोरपि |
आवां शिवो वञ्चयित्वा गतवान्स्वालयं विभुः ||
text_mt: Then true knowledge arose in Menā and the lord of mountains: / “The all-pervading Śiva has deceived us and gone to his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
asmai deyā svakanyeyaṃ pārvatī sutapasvinī |
evaṃ vicārya ca tayoḥ śive bhaktirabhūtparā ||
meaning:
अस्मै देया स्वकन्येयं पार्वती सुतपस्विनी |
एवं विचार्य च तयोः शिवे भक्तिरभूत्परा ||
text_mt: Our daughter Pārvatī, rich in austerity, is to be given to him.” / Having thus reflected, supreme devotion to Śiva arose in them both.

sanskrit_iast:
ato rudro mahotīśca kṛtvā bhaktamudāvaham |
vivāhaṃ kṛtavānprītyā pārvatyā sa vidhānataḥ ||
meaning:
अतो रुद्रो महोतीश्च कृत्वा भक्तमुदावहम् |
विवाहं कृतवान्प्रीत्या पार्वत्या स विधानतः ||
text_mt: Therefore Rudra, having performed sports that brought joy to his devotees, / lovingly and according to the rules married Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
iti proktastu te tāta sunartakanaṭāhvayaḥ |
śivāvatāro hi mayā śivāvākyaprapūrakaḥ ||
meaning:
इति प्रोक्तस्तु ते तात सुनर्तकनटाह्वयः |
शिवावतारो हि मया शिवावाक्यप्रपूरकः ||
text_mt: Thus, O dear one, I have told you of Śiva’s incarnation / named Sunartakanaṭa, which fulfilled the words of Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
idamākhyānamanaghaṃ paramaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ mayā |
ya etacchṛṇuyātprītyā sa sukhī gatimāpnuyāt ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
इदमाख्यानमनघं परमं व्याहृतं मया |
य एतच्छृणुयात्प्रीत्या स सुखी गतिमाप्नुयात् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
This supreme, faultless narrative has been recited by me; / whoever hears it with devotion shall become happy and attain the goal.

Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, titled “The Description of Śiva’s Incarnation as Sunartakanaṭa,” in the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, the third section of the Śrīśivamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
sanatkumāra sarvajña śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
avatāraṃ śṛṇu vibhoḥ sādhuveṣadvijāhvayam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ शिवस्य परमात्मनः |
अवतारं शृणु विभोः साधुवेषद्विजाह्वयम् ||
title: pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | sādhudvijaśivāvatāravarṇanam
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / O omniscient Sanatkumāra, hear of the incarnation of the all-pervading Śiva, / the Supreme Self, named the Twice-Born in the Garb of an Ascetic.

sanskrit_iast:
menāhimālayorbhaktiṃ śive jñātvā mahottamām |
cintāmāpuḥ surāḥ sarve mantrayāmāsurādarāt ||
meaning:
मेनाहिमालयोर्भक्तिं शिवे ज्ञात्वा महोत्तमाम् |
चिन्तामापुः सुराः सर्वे मन्त्रयामासुरादरात् ||
text_mt: Knowing the most excellent devotion to Śiva in Menā and Himālaya, / all the gods became worried and respectfully deliberated:

sanskrit_iast:
ekāntabhaktyā śailaścetkanyāṃ dāsyati śambhave |
dhruvaṃ nirvāṇatāṃ sadyaḥ samprāpsyati śivasya vai ||
meaning:
एकान्तभक्त्या शैलश्चेत्कन्यां दास्यति शम्भवे |
ध्रुवं निर्वाणतां सद्यः सम्प्राप्स्यति शिवस्य वै ||
text_mt: “If the mountain gives his daughter to Śambhu with exclusive devotion, / he will surely immediately attain the state of liberation of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
anantaratnādhāro'sau cetprayāsyati mokṣatām |
ratnagarbhābhidhā bhūmirmithyaiva bhavitā dhruvam ||
meaning:
अनन्तरत्नाधारोऽसौ चेत्प्रयास्यति मोक्षताम् |
रत्नगर्भाभिधा भूमिर्मिथ्यैव भविता ध्रुवम् ||
