text_mt: If he, the repository of endless jewels, attains liberation, / the name of the earth as ‘holding jewels in her womb’ will surely become false.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāvaratvaṃ parityajya divyarūpaṃ vidhāya saḥ |
kanyāṃ śūlabhṛte dattvā śivalokaṃ gamiṣyati ||
meaning:
स्थावरत्वं परित्यज्य दिव्यरूपं विधाय सः |
कन्यां शूलभृते दत्त्वा शिवलोकं गमिष्यति ||
text_mt: Abandoning immobility and assuming a divine form, / he will give his daughter to the trident-bearer and go to the world of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevasya sārūpyaṃ prāpya śambhoranugrahāt |
tatra bhuktvā mahābhogāṃstato mokṣamavāpsyati ||
meaning:
महादेवस्य सारूप्यं प्राप्य शम्भोरनुग्रहात् |
तत्र भुक्त्वा महाभोगांस्ततो मोक्षमवाप्स्यति ||
text_mt: Attaining similarity of form with Mahādeva by the grace of Śambhu, / he will enjoy great pleasures there and then attain liberation.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityālocya surāḥ sarve jagmurgurugṛhaṃ mune |
cakrurnivedanaṃ gatvā gurave svārthasādhakāḥ ||
meaning:
इत्यालोच्य सुराः सर्वे जग्मुर्गुरुगृहं मुने |
चक्रुर्निवेदनं गत्वा गुरवे स्वार्थसाधकाः ||
text_mt: Having thus reflected, all the gods went to their guru’s house, O sage; / having gone, those seekers of their own interest made a petition to the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ |
guro himālayagṛhaṃ gacchāsmatkāryasiddhaye |
kṛtvā nindāṃ maheśasya giribhaktiṃ nivāraya ||
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः |
गुरो हिमालयगृहं गच्छास्मत्कार्यसिद्धये |
कृत्वा निन्दां महेशस्य गिरिभक्तिं निवारय ||
text_mt: The gods said: / O guru, go to Himālaya’s house for the accomplishment of our purpose; / speaking ill of Maheśa, prevent the mountain’s devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
svaśraddhayā sutāṃ dattvā śivāya sa girirguro |
labheta muktimatraiva dharaṇyāṃ sa hi tiṣṭhatu ||
meaning:
स्वश्रद्धया सुतां दत्त्वा शिवाय स गिरिर्गुरो |
लभेत मुक्तिमत्रैव धरण्यां स हि तिष्ठतु ||
text_mt: If that mountain gives his daughter to Śiva with his faith, O guru, / he would attain liberation; let him rather remain right here on the earth.

sanskrit_iast: iti devavacaḥ śrutvā provāca ca vicārya tān ||
meaning: इति देववचः श्रुत्वा प्रोवाच च विचार्य तान् ||
text_mt: Having heard those words of the gods and reflected, he spoke to them:

sanskrit_iast:
gururuvāca |
kaścinmadhye ca yuṣmākaṃ gacchecchailāntikaṃ surāḥ |
sampādayetsvābhimatamahaṃ tatkartumakṣamaḥ ||
meaning:
गुरुरुवाच |
कश्चिन्मध्ये च युष्माकं गच्छेच्छैलान्तिकं सुराः |
सम्पादयेत्स्वाभिमतमहं तत्कर्तुमक्षमः ||
text_mt: The guru said: / Let someone among you go to the mountain, O gods, / and accomplish what is desired; I am unable to do that.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā gacchata surā brahmalokaṃ savāsavāḥ |
tasmai vṛttaṃ kathaya svaṃ sa vaḥ kāryaṃ kariṣyati ||
meaning:
अथवा गच्छत सुरा ब्रह्मलोकं सवासवाः |
तस्मै वृत्तं कथय स्वं स वः कार्यं करिष्यति ||
text_mt: Or else, O gods, go along with Indra to the world of Brahmā; / tell him your situation, and he will carry out your business.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
tacchrutvā te samālocya jagmurvidhisabhāṃ surāḥ |
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsustadvṛttaṃ purato vidheḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
तच्छ्रुत्वा ते समालोच्य जग्मुर्विधिसभां सुराः |
सर्वं निवेदयामासुस्तद्वृत्तं पुरतो विधेः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having heard that and deliberated, the gods went to the assembly of the Creator; / they reported that whole situation before the Creator.

sanskrit_iast:
avocattānvidhiḥ śrutvā tadvacaḥ suvicintya vai |
nāhaṃ kariṣye tannindāṃ duḥkhadāṃ kaharāṃ sadā ||
meaning:
अवोचत्तान्विधिः श्रुत्वा तद्वचः सुविचिन्त्य वै |
नाहं करिष्ये तन्निन्दां दुःखदां कहरां सदा ||
text_mt: Having heard their words and carefully considered them, the Creator spoke to them: / “I will not speak ill of him, which always brings sorrow and destroys happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
surā gacchata kailāsaṃ santoṣayata śaṅkaram |
prasthāpayata taṃ devaṃ himālayagṛhaṃ prati ||
meaning:
सुरा गच्छत कैलासं सन्तोषयत शङ्करम् |
प्रस्थापयत तं देवं हिमालयगृहं प्रति ||
text_mt: Go to Kailāsa, O gods, and please Śaṅkara; / send that god himself toward the house of Himālaya.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gacchedatha śaileśamātmanindāṃ karotu vai |
paranindā vināśāya svanindā yaśase matā ||
meaning:
स गच्छेदथ शैलेशमात्मनिन्दां करोतु वै |
परनिन्दा विनाशाय स्वनिन्दा यशसे मता ||
text_mt: Let him go to the lord of mountains and speak ill of himself; / speaking ill of others is considered to cause ruin, while speaking ill of oneself brings renown.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
tataste prayayuḥ śīghraṃ kailāsaṃ nikhilāḥ surāḥ |
supraṇamya śivaṃ bhaktyā tadvṛttaṃ nikhilā jaguḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
ततस्ते प्रययुः शीघ्रं कैलासं निखिलाः सुराः |
सुप्रणम्य शिवं भक्त्या तद्वृत्तं निखिला जगुः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Then all those gods went quickly to Kailāsa; / bowing low with devotion to Śiva, they related that entire situation.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā devavacanaṃ svīcakāra maheśvaraḥ |
devānsuyāpayāmāsa tānāśvāsya vihasya saḥ ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा देववचनं स्वीचकार महेश्वरः |
देवान्सुयापयामास तानाश्वास्य विहस्य सः ||
text_mt: Having heard the words of the gods, Maheśvara agreed; / having reassured them and laughed, he dismissed the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa bhagavāñchambhurmaheśo bhaktavatsalaḥ |
gantumaicchacchailamūlaṃ māyeśo na vikāravān ||
meaning:
ततः स भगवाञ्छम्भुर्महेशो भक्तवत्सलः |
गन्तुमैच्छच्छैलमूलं मायेशो न विकारवान् ||
text_mt: Then the blessed Śambhu, Maheśa, affectionate toward devotees, / the lord of māyā, free from modification, wished to go to the base of the mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍī chatrī divyavāsā bibhrattilakamujjvalam |
kare sphaṭikamālāṃ ca śālagrāmaṃ gale dadhat ||
meaning:
दण्डी छत्री दिव्यवासा बिभ्रत्तिलकमुज्ज्वलम् |
करे स्फटिकमालां च शालग्रामं गले दधत् ||
text_mt: Carrying a staff and an umbrella, clad in divine clothes, wearing a bright sectarian mark, / with a crystal rosary in his hand and bearing a śālagrāma on his neck,

sanskrit_iast:
japannāma harerbhaktyā sādhuveṣadharo dvijaḥ |
himācalaṃ jagāmāśu bandhuvargaiḥ sarmanvitam ||
meaning:
जपन्नाम हरेर्भक्त्या साधुवेषधरो द्विजः |
हिमाचलं जगामाशु बन्धुवर्गैः सर्मन्वितम् ||
text_mt: Reciting the name of Hari with devotion, the twice-born in the garb of an ascetic / went swiftly to Himācala, surrounded by his kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā samuttasthau sagaṇo'pi himālayaḥ |
nanāma daṇḍavadbhūmau sāṣṭāṅgaṃ vidhipūrvakam ||
meaning:
तं च दृष्ट्वा समुत्तस्थौ सगणोऽपि हिमालयः |
ननाम दण्डवद्भूमौ साष्टाङ्गं विधिपूर्वकम् ||
text_mt: Seeing him, the Himalaya stood up with his attendants / and bowed full-length on the ground according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ papraccha śaileśastaṃ dvijaṃ ko bhavāniti |
uvāca śīghraṃ viprendraḥ sa yogyadriṃ mahādarāt ||
meaning:
ततः पप्रच्छ शैलेशस्तं द्विजं को भवानिति |
उवाच शीघ्रं विप्रेन्द्रः स योग्यद्रिं महादरात् ||
text_mt: Then the lord of mountains asked that twice-born, “Who are you?” / That best of brahmins immediately replied to the suitable mountain with great respect:

sanskrit_iast:
sādhudvija uvāca |
sādhudvijāhvaḥ śailāhaṃ vaiṣṇavaḥ paramārthadṛk |
paropakārī sarvajñaḥ sarvagāmī gurorbalāt ||
meaning:
साधुद्विज उवाच |
साधुद्विजाह्वः शैलाहं वैष्णवः परमार्थदृक् |
परोपकारी सर्वज्ञः सर्वगामी गुरोर्बलात् ||
text_mt: The twice-born ascetic said: / “O mountain, I am called the twice-born ascetic, a Vaiṣṇava who sees the highest truth, / benevolent to others, omniscient, travelling everywhere by the power of my guru.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā jñātaṃ svavijñānātsvasthāne śailasattama |
tacchṛṇu prītito vacmi hitvā dambhaṃ tavāntikam ||
meaning:
मया ज्ञातं स्वविज्ञानात्स्वस्थाने शैलसत्तम |
तच्छृणु प्रीतितो वच्मि हित्वा दम्भं तवान्तिकम् ||
text_mt: O best of mountains, I learned [this] through my own insight in my own abode. / Listen to it; discarding deceit, I speak it to you out of affection.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkarāya sutāṃ dātuṃ tvamicchasi nijodbhavām |
imāṃ padmāsamāṃ ramyāmajñātakulaśīline ||
meaning:
शङ्कराय सुतां दातुं त्वमिच्छसि निजोद्भवाम् |
इमां पद्मासमां रम्यामज्ञातकुलशीलिने ||
text_mt: You wish to give your own-born daughter, / this lovely girl equal to Padmā, to Śaṅkara whose family and conduct are unknown.

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ matiste śailendra na yuktā maṅgalapradā |
nibodha jñānināṃ śreṣṭha nārāyaṇakulodbhava ||
meaning:
इयं मतिस्ते शैलेन्द्र न युक्ता मङ्गलप्रदा |
निबोध ज्ञानिनां श्रेष्ठ नारायणकुलोद्भव ||
text_mt: This notion of yours, O king of mountains, is not proper or auspicious. / Consider, O best of the wise, born in the lineage of Nārāyaṇa!

sanskrit_iast:
paśya śailādhipatvaṃ ca na tasyaiko'sti bāndhavaḥ |
bāndhavānsvānprayatnena pṛccha menāṃ ca svapriyām ||
meaning:
पश्य शैलाधिपत्वं च न तस्यैकोऽस्ति बान्धवः |
बान्धवान्स्वान्प्रयत्नेन पृच्छ मेनां च स्वप्रियाम् ||
text_mt: Look, O ruler of mountains! He does not have a single relative. / Ask your own kinsmen with care, and your beloved Menā.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānsampṛccha yatnena menādīnpārvatīṃ vinā |
rogiṇe nauṣadhaṃ śaila kupathyaṃ rocate sadā ||
meaning:
सर्वान्सम्पृच्छ यत्नेन मेनादीन्पार्वतीं विना |
रोगिणे नौषधं शैल कुपथ्यं रोचते सदा ||
text_mt: Ask everyone carefully, beginning with Menā, except for Pārvatī. / To a sick man, O mountain, unwholesome food always tastes pleasing, not medicine.

sanskrit_iast:
na te pātrānurūpaśca pārvatīdānakarmaṇi |
mahājanaḥ smeramukhaḥ śrutimātrādbhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
न ते पात्रानुरूपश्च पार्वतीदानकर्मणि |
महाजनः स्मेरमुखः श्रुतिमात्राद्भविष्यति ||
text_mt: And he is not a suitable recipient for the act of giving Pārvatī away. / Great people will smile [in ridicule] merely upon hearing of it.

sanskrit_iast:
nirāśrayaḥ sadāsaṅgo virūpo nirguṇo'vyayaḥ |
smaśānavāsī vikaṭo vyālagrāhī digambaraḥ ||
meaning:
निराश्रयः सदासङ्गो विरूपो निर्गुणोऽव्ययः |
स्मशानवासी विकटो व्यालग्राही दिगम्बरः ||
text_mt: He is without shelter, ever unattached, deformed, devoid of qualities, immutable, / a dweller in cremation grounds, monstrous, a snake-catcher, naked,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhūtibhūṣaṇo vyālavarāveṣṭitamastakaḥ |
sarvāśramaparibhraṣṭastvavijñātagatissadā ||
meaning:
विभूतिभूषणो व्यालवरावेष्टितमस्तकः |
सर्वाश्रमपरिभ्रष्टस्त्वविज्ञातगतिस्सदा ||
text_mt: adorned with ashes, his head wrapped by supreme serpents, / fallen from all stages of life, and his course ever unknown.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
ityādyuktvā vacastathyaṃ śivanindāparaṃ sa hi |
jagāma svālayaṃ śīghraṃ nānālīlākaraḥ śivaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
इत्याद्युक्त्वा वचस्तथ्यं शिवनिन्दापरं स हि |
जगाम स्वालयं शीघ्रं नानालीलाकरः शिवः ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having spoken such words intent on reviling Śiva, / Śiva, who performs various sports, swiftly departed to his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā vipravacanamabhūtāṃ ca tanū tayoḥ |
viparītānarthapare kiṃ kariṣyāvahe dhruvam ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा विप्रवचनमभूतां च तनू तयोः |
विपरीतानर्थपरे किं करिष्यावहे ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: Hearing that word of the brahmin, the bodies of both [parents] / were confounded by the reverse disaster: “What shall we surely do?”

sanskrit_iast:
tato rudro mahotiṃ ca kṛtvā bhaktamudāvahām |
vivāhayitvā girijāṃ devakāryaṃ cakāra saḥ ||
meaning:
ततो रुद्रो महोतिं च कृत्वा भक्तमुदावहाम् |
विवाहयित्वा गिरिजां देवकार्यं चकार सः ||
text_mt: Then Rudra, having arranged a great festival that brought joy to his devotees / and having married the mountain's daughter, accomplished the work of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
iti proktastu te tāta sādhuveṣo dvijāhvayaḥ |
śivāvatāro hi mayā devakāryakaraḥ prabho ||
meaning:
इति प्रोक्तस्तु ते तात साधुवेषो द्विजाह्वयः |
शिवावतारो हि मया देवकार्यकरः प्रभो ||
text_mt: Thus, O dear one, the incarnation of Śiva in the guise of an ascetic named a twice-born, / who accomplished the work of the gods, has been narrated to you by me, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
idamākhyānamanaghaṃ svargyamāyuṣyamuttamam |
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sa sukhī gatimāpnuyāt ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
इदमाख्यानमनघं स्वर्ग्यमायुष्यमुत्तमम् |
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि स सुखी गतिमाप्नुयात् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Whoever recites or even listens to this sinless narrative, / which grants heaven and prolongs life, being happy, will attain the supreme state.

Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Incarnation of Śiva as the Twice-born Ascetic,' in the third book, the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
sanatkumāra sarvajña śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
avatāraṃ śṛṇu vibhoraśvatthāmāhvayaṃ param ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ शिवस्य परमात्मनः |
अवतारं शृणु विभोरश्वत्थामाह्वयं परम् ||
title: ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | aśvatthāmaśivāvatāravarṇanam
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / “O omniscient Sanatkumāra, hear about the supreme incarnation of the all-pervading lord, / Śiva the Supreme Self, known by the name Aśvatthāman.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatermahābuddherdevarṣeraṃśato mune |
bharadvājātsamutpanno droṇo'yonija ātmavān ||
meaning:
बृहस्पतेर्महाबुद्धेर्देवर्षेरंशतो मुने |
भरद्वाजात्समुत्पन्नो द्रोणोऽयोनिज आत्मवान् ||
text_mt: Born from Bharadvāja through a portion of Bṛhaspati, the seer among gods of great intellect, / was self-restrained Droṇa, not born from a womb, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanurbhṛtāṃ varaḥ śūro viprarṣiḥ sarvaśāstravit |
bṛhatkīrtirmahātejā yaḥ sarvāstraviduttamaḥ ||
meaning:
धनुर्भृतां वरः शूरो विप्रर्षिः सर्वशास्त्रवित् |
बृहत्कीर्तिर्महातेजा यः सर्वास्त्रविदुत्तमः ||
text_mt: He was the foremost of archers, a hero, a brahmin seer who knew all scriptures, / possessing great fame and immense splendour, the best knower of all weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanurvede ca vede ca niṣṇātaṃ yaṃ vidurbudhāḥ |
variṣṭhaṃ citrakarmāṇaṃ droṇaṃ svakulavardhanam ||
meaning:
धनुर्वेदे च वेदे च निष्णातं यं विदुर्बुधाः |
वरिष्ठं चित्रकर्माणं द्रोणं स्वकुलवर्धनम् ||
text_mt: whom the wise knew to be skilled in both the science of archery and the Veda, / most eminent, performing wondrous deeds, Droṇa who increased his own lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
kauravāṇāṃ sa ācarya āsītsvabalato dvija |
mahārathiṣu vikhyātaḥ ṣaṭsu kauravamadhyataḥ ||
meaning:
कौरवाणां स आचर्य आसीत्स्वबलतो द्विज |
महारथिषु विख्यातः षट्सु कौरवमध्यतः ||
text_mt: He became the teacher of the Kauravas by his own power, O twice-born, / and was renowned among the six great chariot-warriors in the midst of the Kauravas.

sanskrit_iast:
sāhāyyārthaṃ kauravāṇāṃ sa tepe vipulaṃ tapaḥ |
śivamuddiśya putrārthaṃ droṇācāryo dvijottamaḥ ||
meaning:
साहाय्यार्थं कौरवाणां स तेपे विपुलं तपः |
शिवमुद्दिश्य पुत्रार्थं द्रोणाचार्यो द्विजोत्तमः ||
text_mt: For the sake of aiding the Kauravas, and for a son, / that best of the twice-born, Droṇācārya, performed vast austerity directed towards Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prasanno bhagavācchaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ |
āvirbabhūva purato droṇasya munisattama ||
meaning:
ततः प्रसन्नो भगवाच्छङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः |
आविर्बभूव पुरतो द्रोणस्य मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: Then, being pleased, the lord Śaṅkara, affectionate toward devotees, / appeared before Droṇa, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa dvijo droṇastuṣṭāvāśu praṇamya tam |
mahāprasannahṛdayo natakaḥ sukṛtāñjaliḥ ||
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा स द्विजो द्रोणस्तुष्टावाशु प्रणम्य तम् |
महाप्रसन्नहृदयो नतकः सुकृताञ्जलिः ||
text_mt: Seeing him, that twice-born Droṇa bowed down and praised him at once, / his heart exceedingly joyful, bowing low with hands respectfully folded.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya stutyā ca tapasā santuṣṭaḥ śaṅkaraḥ prabhuḥ |
varaṃ brūhīti covāca droṇaṃ taṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्य स्तुत्या च तपसा सन्तुष्टः शङ्करः प्रभुः |
वरं ब्रूहीति चोवाच द्रोणं तं भक्तवत्सलः ||
text_mt: Pleased by his hymn of praise and austerity, the lord Śaṅkara, / affectionate toward devotees, said to that Droṇa: 'Choose a boon.'

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā śambhuvacanaṃ droṇaḥ prāhātha sannataḥ |
svāṃśajaṃ tanayaṃ dehi sarvājeyaṃ mahābalam ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा शम्भुवचनं द्रोणः प्राहाथ सन्नतः |
स्वांशजं तनयं देहि सर्वाजेयं महाबलम् ||
text_mt: Hearing that word of Śambhu, Droṇa, bowed low, then said: / 'Grant me a son born of your own portion, invincible to all and of immense might.'

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā droṇavacanaṃ śambhuḥ proce tathāstviti |
abhūdantarhitastāta kautukī sukhakṛnmune ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा द्रोणवचनं शम्भुः प्रोचे तथास्त्विति |
अभूदन्तर्हितस्तात कौतुकी सुखकृन्मुने ||
text_mt: Hearing that speech of Droṇa, Śambhu said, 'So be it.' / The playful one who grants happiness vanished, O dear sage.

sanskrit_iast:
droṇo'pagacchatsvaṃ dhāma mahāhṛṣṭo gatabhramaḥ |
svapatnyai kathayāmāsa tadvṛtaṃ sakalaṃ mudā ||
meaning:
द्रोणोऽपगच्छत्स्वं धाम महाहृष्टो गतभ्रमः |
स्वपत्न्यै कथयामास तद्वृतं सकलं मुदा ||
text_mt: Droṇa returned to his own home, exceedingly delighted and free of perplexity, / and joyfully recounted that entire occurrence to his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
athāvasaramāsādya rudraḥ sarvāntakaḥ prabhuḥ |
svāṃśena tanayo jajñe droṇasya sa mahābalaḥ ||
meaning:
अथावसरमासाद्य रुद्रः सर्वान्तकः प्रभुः |
स्वांशेन तनयो जज्ञे द्रोणस्य स महाबलः ||
text_mt: Then, finding the opportune time, the lord Rudra, the ender of all, / was born by his own portion as the son of Droṇa, possessed of immense might.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthāmeti vikhyātaḥ sa babhūva kṣitau mune |
pravīraḥ kañjapatrākṣaḥ śatrupakṣakṣayaṅkaraḥ ||
meaning:
अश्वत्थामेति विख्यातः स बभूव क्षितौ मुने |
प्रवीरः कञ्जपत्राक्षः शत्रुपक्षक्षयङ्करः ||
text_mt: He became renowned on earth as Aśvatthāman, O sage, / a hero, with eyes like lotus petals, who brought ruin to the enemy's side.

sanskrit_iast:
yo bhārate raṇe khyātaḥ piturājñāmavāpya ca |
sahāyakṛd babhūvāta kauravāṇāṃ mahābalaḥ ||
meaning:
यो भारते रणे ख्यातः पितुराज्ञामवाप्य च |
सहायकृद् बभूवात कौरवाणां महाबलः ||
text_mt: He, of immense might, renowned in the Bhārata battle, / having received the command of his father, became a helper of the Kauravas.

sanskrit_iast:
yamāśritya mahāvīraṃ kauravāḥ sumahābalāḥ |
bhīṣmādayo babhūvuste'jeyā api divaukasām ||
meaning:
यमाश्रित्य महावीरं कौरवाः सुमहाबलाः |
भीष्मादयो बभूवुस्तेऽजेया अपि दिवौकसाम् ||
text_mt: Relying on him, that great hero, the Kauravas of immense might, / Bhīṣma and the others, became invincible even to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yadbhayātpāṇḍavāḥ sarve kauravāñjetumakṣamāḥ |
āsannaṣṭā mahāvīrā api sarve ca kovidāḥ ||
meaning:
यद्भयात्पाण्डवाः सर्वे कौरवाञ्जेतुमक्षमाः |
आसन्नष्टा महावीरा अपि सर्वे च कोविदाः ||
text_mt: Out of fear of him, all the Pāṇḍavas were unable to defeat the Kauravas; / though all were great heroes and skilled, they were rendered helpless.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇopadeśataḥ śambhostapaḥ kṛtvātidāruṇam |
prāpya cāstraṃ śambhuvarājjigye tānarjunastataḥ ||
meaning:
कृष्णोपदेशतः शम्भोस्तपः कृत्वातिदारुणम् |
प्राप्य चास्त्रं शम्भुवराज्जिग्ये तानर्जुनस्ततः ||
text_mt: Following Kṛṣṇa's instruction, having performed very fierce austerity toward Śambhu / and obtained a weapon by Śambhu's boon, Arjuna then defeated them.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthāmā mahāvīro mahādevāṃśajo mune |
tathāpi tadbhaktivaśaḥ svapratāpamadarśayat ||
meaning:
अश्वत्थामा महावीरो महादेवांशजो मुने |
तथापि तद्भक्तिवशः स्वप्रतापमदर्शयत् ||
text_mt: Aśvatthāman was a great hero born of a portion of Mahādeva, O sage; / nevertheless, subject to devotion to him, he displayed his own prowess,

sanskrit_iast:
vināśya pāṇḍavasutān śikṣitānapi yatnataḥ |
kṛṣṇādibhirmahāvīrairanivāryabalaḥ paraiḥ ||
meaning:
विनाश्य पाण्डवसुतान् शिक्षितानपि यत्नतः |
कृष्णादिभिर्महावीरैरनिवार्यबलः परैः ||
text_mt: having destroyed the sons of the Pāṇḍavas, even though carefully trained / by Kṛṣṇa and other great heroes, he possessing irresistible power against his enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
putraśokena vikalamāpatantaṃ tamarjunam |
rathenācyutavantaṃ hi dṛṣṭvā sa ca parādravat ||
meaning:
पुत्रशोकेन विकलमापतन्तं तमर्जुनम् |
रथेनाच्युतवन्तं हि दृष्ट्वा स च पराद्रवत् ||
text_mt: Seeing that Arjuna, distraught with grief for his sons, / rushing forward with Acyuta on his chariot, he fled.

sanskrit_iast:
astraṃ brahmaśiro nāma taduparyasṛjatsa hi |
tataḥ prādurabhūttejaḥ pracaṇḍaṃ sarvato diśam ||
meaning:
अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरो नाम तदुपर्यसृजत्स हि |
ततः प्रादुरभूत्तेजः प्रचण्डं सर्वतो दिशम् ||
text_mt: He released the weapon named Brahmaśiras against him; / then a fierce radiance burst forth in every direction.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāpadamabhiprekṣya so'rjunaḥ kleśasaṃyutaḥ |
uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ viklānto naṣṭatejā mahābhayaḥ ||
meaning:
प्राणापदमभिप्रेक्ष्य सोऽर्जुनः क्लेशसंयुतः |
उवाच कृष्णं विक्लान्तो नष्टतेजा महाभयः ||
text_mt: Seeing danger to his life and filled with distress, / that Arjuna, exhausted, his energy lost and in great fear, spoke to Kṛṣṇa:

sanskrit_iast:
arjuna uvāca |
kimidaṃ svitkuto veti kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa na vedmyaham |
sarvatomukhamāyāti tejaścedaṃ sudussaham ||
meaning:
अर्जुन उवाच |
किमिदं स्वित्कुतो वेति कृष्ण कृष्ण न वेद्म्यहम् |
सर्वतोमुखमायाति तेजश्चेदं सुदुस्सहम् ||
text_mt: Arjuna said: / 'What is this, or whence comes it, O Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa? I do not know. / And this unbearable brilliance is advancing in every direction.'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
śrutvārjunavacaścedaṃ sa kṛṣṇaḥ śaivasattamaḥ |
dadhyau śivaṃ sadāraṃ ca pratyāhārjunamādarāt ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
श्रुत्वार्जुनवचश्चेदं स कृष्णः शैवसत्तमः |
दध्यौ शिवं सदारं च प्रत्याहार्जुनमादरात् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing this word of Arjuna, Kṛṣṇa, that best of Śaivas, / meditated upon Śiva together with his consort and respectfully answered Arjuna:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
vetthedaṃ droṇaputrasya brāhmamastraṃ maholbaṇam |
na hyasyānyatamaṃ kiñcidastraṃ pratyavakarśanam ||
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच |
वेत्थेदं द्रोणपुत्रस्य ब्राह्ममस्त्रं महोल्बणम् |
न ह्यस्यान्यतमं किञ्चिदस्त्रं प्रत्यवकर्शनम् ||
text_mt: The glorious Kṛṣṇa said: / 'Know this to be the formidable Brahma-weapon of the son of Droṇa; / indeed, there is no other weapon whatsoever to counter it.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ smara drutaṃ śambhuṃ svaprabhuṃ bhaktarakṣakam |
yena dattaṃ hi te svāstraṃ sarvakāryakaraṃ param ||
meaning:
शिवं स्मर द्रुतं शम्भुं स्वप्रभुं भक्तरक्षकम् |
येन दत्तं हि ते स्वास्त्रं सर्वकार्यकरं परम् ||
text_mt: Remember quickly Śiva, Śambhu, your own lord, the protector of devotees, / by whom was given to you his supreme weapon that accomplishes all purposes.'”

sanskrit_iast:
jahyastrateja unnaddhaṃ tvaṃ tacchaivāstratejasā |
ityuktvā ca svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śivaṃ dadhyau tadarthakaḥ ||
meaning:
जह्यस्त्रतेज उन्नद्धं त्वं तच्छैवास्त्रतेजसा |
इत्युक्त्वा च स्वयं कृष्णः शिवं दध्यौ तदर्थकः ||
text_mt: "Destroy that raised power of the weapon through the power of Śiva's weapon." / Having spoken thus, Kṛṣṇa himself meditated on Śiva for that purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā kṛṣṇavacanaṃ pārthaḥ smṛtvā śivaṃ hṛdi |
spṛṣṭvāpastaṃ praṇamyāśu cikṣepāstraṃ tato mune ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा कृष्णवचनं पार्थः स्मृत्वा शिवं हृदि |
स्पृष्ट्वापस्तं प्रणम्याशु चिक्षेपास्त्रं ततो मुने ||
text_mt: Hearing that speech of Kṛṣṇa, Pārtha remembered Śiva in his heart, / touched water, quickly bowed to him, and then discharged his weapon, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyapyastraṃ brahmaśirastvamoghaṃ cāpratikriyam |
śaivāstratejasā sadyaḥ samaśāmyanmahāmune ||
meaning:
यद्यप्यस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरस्त्वमोघं चाप्रतिक्रियम् |
शैवास्त्रतेजसा सद्यः समशाम्यन्महामुने ||
text_mt: Even though that weapon, the Brahmaśiras, was unfailing and irresistible, / it was immediately pacified by the power of Śiva's weapon, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
mā maṃsthā hyetadāścaryaṃ sarvacitramaye śive |
yaḥ svaśaktyākhilaṃ viśvaṃ sṛjatyavati hantyajaḥ ||
meaning:
मा मंस्था ह्येतदाश्चर्यं सर्वचित्रमये शिवे |
यः स्वशक्त्याखिलं विश्वं सृजत्यवति हन्त्यजः ||
text_mt: Indeed, you should not consider this a wonder in Śiva, who consists of all wonders, / the unborn who by his own power creates, protects, and destroys the entire universe.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthāmā tato jñātvā vṛttametacchivāṃśajaḥ |
śaivaṃ na vivyathe kiñcicchivecchātuṣṭadhīrmune ||
meaning:
अश्वत्थामा ततो ज्ञात्वा वृत्तमेतच्छिवांशजः |
शैवं न विव्यथे किञ्चिच्छिवेच्छातुष्टधीर्मुने ||
text_mt: Then Aśvatthāman, born of a portion of Śiva, learning of this event / relating to Śiva, was not pained at all, his mind satisfied with Śiva's will, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
atha drauṇiridaṃ viśvaṃ kṛtsnaṃ kartumapāṇḍavam |
uttarāgarbhagaṃ bālaṃ nāśituṃ mana ādadhe ||
meaning:
अथ द्रौणिरिदं विश्वं कृत्स्नं कर्तुमपाण्डवम् |
उत्तरागर्भगं बालं नाशितुं मन आदधे ||
text_mt: Then the son of Droṇa set his mind to destroy the child residing in Uttarā's womb, / in order to make this entire world bereft of Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāstramanivāryaṃ tadanyairastrairmahāprabham |
uttarāgarbhamuddiśya cikṣepa sa mahāprabhuḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मास्त्रमनिवार्यं तदन्यैरस्त्रैर्महाप्रभम् |
उत्तरागर्भमुद्दिश्य चिक्षेप स महाप्रभुः ||
text_mt: He, the mighty lord, discharged the brahmāstra, irresistible / by other weapons and of great radiance, directing it toward Uttarā's womb.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca sottarā jiṣṇuvadhūrvikalamānasā |
kṛṣṇaṃ tuṣṭāva lakṣmīśaṃ dahyamānā tadastrataḥ ||
meaning:
ततश्च सोत्तरा जिष्णुवधूर्विकलमानसा |
कृष्णं तुष्टाव लक्ष्मीशं दह्यमाना तदस्त्रतः ||
text_mt: And then that Uttarā, the bride of Jiṣṇu, her mind agitated, / praised Kṛṣṇa, the lord of Lakṣmī, as she was being burned by that weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śivaṃ dhyātvā hṛdā nutvā praṇamya ca |
apāṇḍavamidaṃ kartuṃ drauṇerastramabudhyata ||
meaning:
ततः कृष्णः शिवं ध्यात्वा हृदा नुत्वा प्रणम्य च |
अपाण्डवमिदं कर्तुं द्रौणेरस्त्रमबुध्यत ||
text_mt: Then Kṛṣṇa, having meditated on Śiva, praised him in his heart, and bowed, / understood that the weapon of the son of Droṇa was meant to render this [world] bereft of Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit_iast:
svarakṣārthendradattena tadastreṇa suvarcasā |
sudarśanena tasyāśca vyadhādrakṣāṃ śivājñayā ||
meaning:
स्वरक्षार्थेन्द्रदत्तेन तदस्त्रेण सुवर्चसा |
सुदर्शनेन तस्याश्च व्यधाद्रक्षां शिवाज्ञया ||
text_mt: By command of Śiva, through that weapon of great brilliance given by Indra for his own protection, / the Sudarśana, he effected her protection.

sanskrit_iast:
svarūpaṃ śaṅkarādeśātkṛtaṃ śaivavareṇa ha |
kṛṣṇena caritaṃ jñātvā vimanaskaḥ śanairabhūt ||
meaning:
स्वरूपं शङ्करादेशात्कृतं शैववरेण ह |
कृष्णेन चरितं ज्ञात्वा विमनस्कः शनैरभूत् ||
text_mt: The manifestation had indeed been made by Kṛṣṇa, the best of Śaivas, by command of Śaṅkara; / learning of the deed, he gradually became downcast in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa kṛṣṇaḥ prītātmā pāṇḍavānsakalānapi |
apātayattadaṅghryostu tuṣṭaye tasya śaivarāṭ ||
meaning:
ततः स कृष्णः प्रीतात्मा पाण्डवान्सकलानपि |
अपातयत्तदङ्घ्र्योस्तु तुष्टये तस्य शैवराट् ||
text_mt: Then that Kṛṣṇa, his heart pleased, made all the Pāṇḍavas / fall at his feet, in order to propitiate him, the king of Śaivas.

sanskrit_iast:
atha drauṇiḥ prasannātmā pāṇḍavānkṛṣṇameva ca |
nānāvarāndadau prītyā so'śvatthāmānugṛhya ca ||
meaning:
अथ द्रौणिः प्रसन्नात्मा पाण्डवान्कृष्णमेव च |
नानावरान्ददौ प्रीत्या सोऽश्वत्थामानुगृह्य च ||
text_mt: Then the son of Droṇa, pleased at heart, showing grace to the Pāṇḍavas / and to Kṛṣṇa, that Aśvatthāman affectionately gave various boons.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ maheśvarastāta cakre līlāṃ parāṃ prabhuḥ |
avatīrya kṣitau drauṇirūpeṇa munisattama ||
meaning:
इत्थं महेश्वरस्तात चक्रे लीलां परां प्रभुः |
अवतीर्य क्षितौ द्रौणिरूपेण मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: Thus, O dear one, the Lord, Maheśvara, performed his supreme sport, / having descended upon the earth in the form of the son of Droṇa, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
śivāvatāro'śvatthāmā mahābalaparākramaḥ |
trailokyasukhado'dyāpi vartate jāhnavītaṭe ||
meaning:
शिवावतारोऽश्वत्थामा महाबलपराक्रमः |
त्रैलोक्यसुखदोऽद्यापि वर्तते जाह्नवीतटे ||
text_mt: The incarnation of Śiva, Aśvatthāman, of great strength and valor, / bestowing happiness upon the three worlds, resides even today on the bank of the Jāhnavī.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthāmāvatāraste varṇitaḥ śaṅkaraprabhoḥ |
sarvasiddhikaraścāpi bhaktābhīṣṭaphalapradaḥ ||
meaning:
अश्वत्थामावतारस्ते वर्णितः शङ्करप्रभोः |
सर्वसिद्धिकरश्चापि भक्ताभीष्टफलप्रदः ||
text_mt: The incarnation of Lord Śaṅkara as Aśvatthāman has been described to you; / it brings about all accomplishments and grants the fruit of the desires of devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā kīrtayedvā samāhitaḥ |
sa siddhiṃ prāpnuyādiṣṭāmante śivapuraṃ vrajet ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या कीर्तयेद्वा समाहितः |
स सिद्धिं प्राप्नुयादिष्टामन्ते शिवपुरं व्रजेत् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Whoever hears this with devotion or recites it with a collected mind / will attain the desired accomplishment, and at the end go to the city of Śiva.

Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter, named 'The Description of Śiva's Incarnation as Aśvatthāman,' in the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, the third [book] of the auspicious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
śṛṇu prājña kirātākhyamavatāraṃ pinākinaḥ |
mūkaṃ ca hatavānprīto yo'rjunāya varaṃ dadau ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
शृणु प्राज्ञ किराताख्यमवतारं पिनाकिनः |
मूकं च हतवान्प्रीतो योऽर्जुनाय वरं ददौ ||
title: saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | vyāsopadeśavarṇanam
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Listen, O wise one, to the incarnation called Kirāta of the wielder of the Pināka, / who, having killed Mūka, was pleased and granted a boon to Arjuna.

sanskrit_iast:
suyodhanajitāste vai pāṇḍavāḥ pravarāśca te |
draupadyā ca tayā sādhvyā dvaitākhyaṃ vanamāyayuḥ ||
meaning:
सुयोधनजितास्ते वै पाण्डवाः प्रवराश्च ते |
द्रौपद्या च तया साध्व्या द्वैताख्यं वनमाययुः ||
text_mt: Those preeminent Pāṇḍavas, conquered by Suyodhana, / went with that virtuous Draupadī to the forest named Dvaita.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva sūryadattāṃ vai sthālīṃ cāśritya te tadā |
kālaṃ ca vāhayāmāsuḥ sukhena kila pāṇḍavāḥ ||
meaning:
तत्रैव सूर्यदत्तां वै स्थालीं चाश्रित्य ते तदा |
कालं च वाहयामासुः सुखेन किल पाण्डवाः ||
text_mt: Relying there upon the cooking vessel given by the Sun, / the Pāṇḍavas indeed spent their time happily.

sanskrit_iast:
chalārthaṃ preritastena durvāsā munipuṅgavaḥ |
suyodhanena viprendra pāṇḍavāntikamādarāt ||
meaning:
छलार्थं प्रेरितस्तेन दुर्वासा मुनिपुङ्गवः |
सुयोधनेन विप्रेन्द्र पाण्डवान्तिकमादरात् ||
text_mt: The eminent sage Durvāsas was sent by that Suyodhana / with deceitful intent, O best of brahmins, into the presence of the Pāṇḍavas with [feigned] respect.

sanskrit_iast:
chātraiḥ svairvāyutaiḥ sārdhaṃ yayāce tatra tānmudā |
bhojyaṃ cittepsitaṃ vai sa tebhyaścaiva samāgataḥ ||
meaning:
छात्रैः स्वैर्वायुतैः सार्धं ययाचे तत्र तान्मुदा |
भोज्यं चित्तेप्सितं वै स तेभ्यश्चैव समागतः ||
text_mt: Together with ten thousand of his students, he arrived / and gladly requested food desired by his heart from them.

sanskrit_iast:
svīkṛtya pāṇḍavaistaistaiḥ snānārthaṃ preṣitāstadā |
durvāsaḥpramukhāścaiva munayaśca tapasvinaḥ ||
meaning:
स्वीकृत्य पाण्डवैस्तैस्तैः स्नानार्थं प्रेषितास्तदा |
दुर्वासःप्रमुखाश्चैव मुनयश्च तपस्विनः ||
text_mt: Having consented, those Pāṇḍavas then sent Durvāsas / and the other sages, the ascetics, to bathe.

sanskrit_iast:
atha te pāṇḍavāḥ sarve annābhāvānmunīśvara |
duḥkhitāśca tadā prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ citte samādadhuḥ ||
meaning:
अथ ते पाण्डवाः सर्वे अन्नाभावान्मुनीश्वर |
दुःखिताश्च तदा प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं चित्ते समादधुः ||
text_mt: Then all those Pāṇḍavas, O lord among sages, for lack of food, / were distressed and resolved in their minds to give up their lives.

sanskrit_iast:
draupadyā ca smṛtaḥ kṛṣṇa āgatastatkṣaṇādapi |
śākaṃ ca bhakṣayitvā tu teṣāṃ tṛptiṃ samādadhat ||
meaning:
द्रौपद्या च स्मृतः कृष्ण आगतस्तत्क्षणादपि |
शाकं च भक्षयित्वा तु तेषां तृप्तिं समादधत् ||
text_mt: Remembered by Draupadī, Kṛṣṇa arrived that very instant, / and having eaten a vegetable leaf, he brought them satisfaction.

sanskrit_iast:
durvāsāśca tadā śiṣyāṃstṛptān jñātvā yayau punaḥ |
pāṇḍavāḥ kṛcchranirmuktāḥ kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā tadā ||
meaning:
दुर्वासाश्च तदा शिष्यांस्तृप्तान् ज्ञात्वा ययौ पुनः |
पाण्डवाः कृच्छ्रनिर्मुक्ताः कृष्णस्य कृपया तदा ||
text_mt: Then Durvāsas, finding his disciples satisfied, went away again; / the Pāṇḍavas were freed from distress by the grace of Kṛṣṇa at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
atha te pāṇḍavāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ papracchuḥ kiṃ bhaviṣyati |
balavān śatrurutpannaḥ kiṃ kāryaṃ tadvada prabho ||
meaning:
अथ ते पाण्डवाः कृष्णं पप्रच्छुः किं भविष्यति |
बलवान् शत्रुरुत्पन्नः किं कार्यं तद्वद प्रभो ||
text_mt: Then those Pāṇḍavas asked Kṛṣṇa: "What will happen? / A powerful enemy has arisen; tell us what is to be done, O Lord."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti pṛṣṭhastadā taistu śrīkṛṣṇaḥ pāṇḍavairmune |
smṛtvā śivapadāmbhojau pāṇḍavānidamabravīt ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति पृष्ठस्तदा तैस्तु श्रीकृष्णः पाण्डवैर्मुने |
स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजौ पाण्डवानिदमब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Thus questioned at that time by those Pāṇḍavas, O sage, / Śrī Kṛṣṇa, remembering the lotus feet of Śiva, spoke this to the Pāṇḍavas:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
śrūyatāṃ pāṇḍavāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śrutvā kartavyameva hi |
madvṛttāntaṃ viśeṣeṇa śivasevāsamanvitam ||
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच |
श्रूयतां पाण्डवाः श्रेष्ठाः श्रुत्वा कर्तव्यमेव हि |
मद्वृत्तान्तं विशेषेण शिवसेवासमन्वितम् ||
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "Listen, O best of Pāṇḍavas; having heard, it should indeed be done: / my own account in particular, which is connected with the service of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārakāṃ ca mayā gatvā śatrūṇāṃ vijigīṣayā |
vicārya copadeśāṃśca hyupamanyormahātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
द्वारकां च मया गत्वा शत्रूणां विजिगीषया |
विचार्य चोपदेशांश्च ह्युपमन्योर्महात्मनः ||
text_mt: Having gone to Dvārakā with the desire to conquer enemies, / and having reflected upon the instructions of the great-souled Upamanyu,

sanskrit_iast:
mayā hyārādhitaḥ śambhuḥ prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
baṭuke parvataśreṣṭhe saptamāsaṃ susevitaḥ ||
meaning:
मया ह्याराधितः शम्भुः प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः |
बटुके पर्वतश्रेष्ठे सप्तमासं सुसेवितः ||
text_mt: Śambhu, Parameśvara, was propitiated by me and became pleased; / he was well served for seven months on the excellent mountain Baṭuka.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭānkāmānadānmahyaṃ viśveśaśca svayaṃ sthitaḥ |
tatprabhāvānmayā sarvasāmarthyaṃ labdhamuttamam ||
meaning:
इष्टान्कामानदान्मह्यं विश्वेशश्च स्वयं स्थितः |
तत्प्रभावान्मया सर्वसामर्थ्यं लब्धमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: The Lord of the Universe, standing in person, granted me my cherished desires; / through his power, all supreme capability was obtained by me.

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ sevyate devo bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ |
yūyaṃ sevata taṃ śambhumapi sarvasukhāvaham ||
meaning:
इदानीं सेव्यते देवो भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः |
यूयं सेवत तं शम्भुमपि सर्वसुखावहम् ||
text_mt: Now that God, who grants the fruits of enjoyment and liberation, is being served; / you too should serve that Śambhu, who brings all happiness."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvāntardadhe kṛṣṇa āśvāsyātha ca pāṇḍavān |
dvārakāmagamacchīghraṃ smaran śivapadāmbujam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे कृष्ण आश्वास्याथ च पाण्डवान् |
द्वारकामगमच्छीघ्रं स्मरन् शिवपदाम्बुजम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, Kṛṣṇa consoled the Pāṇḍavas and disappeared; / he went quickly to Dvārakā, remembering the lotus feet of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇḍavā atha bhillaṃ ca preṣayāmāsurojasā |
guṇānāṃ ca parīkṣārthaṃ tasya duryodhanasya ca ||
meaning:
पाण्डवा अथ भिल्लं च प्रेषयामासुरोजसा |
गुणानां च परीक्षार्थं तस्य दुर्योधनस्य च ||
text_mt: Then the Pāṇḍavas swiftly sent a mountaineer / in order to examine the merits of that Duryodhana.

sanskrit_iast:
so'pi sarvaṃ ca tatratyaṃ duryodhanaguṇodayam |
samīcīnaṃ ca tajjñātvā punaḥ prāpa prabhūnprati ||
meaning:
सोऽपि सर्वं च तत्रत्यं दुर्योधनगुणोदयम् |
समीचीनं च तज्ज्ञात्वा पुनः प्राप प्रभून्प्रति ||
text_mt: He, too, learning all about Duryodhana's rise in virtue there / to be proper, returned to his masters.

sanskrit_iast:
taduktaṃ te niśamyaivaṃ duḥkhaṃ prāpurmunīśvara |
parasparaṃ samūcuste pāṇḍavā atiduḥkhitāḥ ||
meaning:
तदुक्तं ते निशम्यैवं दुःखं प्रापुर्मुनीश्वर |
परस्परं समूचुस्ते पाण्डवा अतिदुःखिताः ||
text_mt: Having heard what he said, they were filled with grief, O lord among sages; / those Pāṇḍavas, exceedingly grieved, spoke to one another:

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyamasmābhiradhunā yudhi |
samarthā api vai sarve satyapāśena yantritāḥ ||
meaning:
किं कर्तव्यं क्व गन्तव्यमस्माभिरधुना युधि |
समर्था अपि वै सर्वे सत्यपाशेन यन्त्रिताः ||
text_mt: "What should be done? Where should we go now in battle? / Though all capable, we are restrained by the fetter of truth."

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
etasminsamaye vyāso bhasmabhūṣitamastakaḥ |
rudrākṣābharaṇaścāyājjaṭājūṭavibhūṣitaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
एतस्मिन्समये व्यासो भस्मभूषितमस्तकः |
रुद्राक्षाभरणश्चायाज्जटाजूटविभूषितः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / At this time Vyāsa arrived, his head adorned with ashes, / ornamented with rudrākṣa beads, and adorned with a matted coil of hair,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcākṣaraṃ japanmantraṃ śivapremasamākulaḥ |
tejasāṃ ca svayaṃrāśiḥ sākṣāddharma ivāparaḥ ||
meaning:
पञ्चाक्षरं जपन्मन्त्रं शिवप्रेमसमाकुलः |
तेजसां च स्वयंराशिः साक्षाद्धर्म इवापरः ||
text_mt: muttering the five-syllable mantra, overwhelmed with love for Śiva, / himself a mass of radiant energy, like Dharma incarnate.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā te tadā prītā utthāya purataḥ sthitāḥ |
dattvāsanaṃ tadā tasmai kuśājinasuśobhitam ||
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा ते तदा प्रीता उत्थाय पुरतः स्थिताः |
दत्त्वासनं तदा तस्मै कुशाजिनसुशोभितम् ||
text_mt: Seeing him then, delighted, they stood up before him; / having offered him a seat beautified with kuśa grass and an antelope skin,

sanskrit_iast:
tatropaviṣṭaṃ taṃ vyāsaṃ pūjayanti sma harṣitāḥ |
stutiṃ ca vividhāṃ kṛtvā dhanyāḥ sma iti vādinaḥ ||
meaning:
तत्रोपविष्टं तं व्यासं पूजयन्ति स्म हर्षिताः |
स्तुतिं च विविधां कृत्वा धन्याः स्म इति वादिनः ||
text_mt: joyfully they worshiped that Vyāsa who was seated there; / and having offered diverse praises, they said, 'We are blessed!'

sanskrit_iast:
tapaścaiva susantaptaṃ dānāni vividhāni ca |
tatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ jātaṃ tṛptāste darśanātprabho ||
meaning:
तपश्चैव सुसन्तप्तं दानानि विविधानि च |
तत्सर्वं सफलं जातं तृप्तास्ते दर्शनात्प्रभो ||
text_mt: "The austerities well performed and the diverse gifts given— / all that has borne fruit; they are satisfied by the sight of you, O Lord."

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhaṃ ca dūrato jātaṃ darśanātte pitāmaha |
duṣṭaiścaiva mahāduḥkhaṃ dattaṃ naḥ krūrakarmabhiḥ ||
meaning:
दुःखं च दूरतो जातं दर्शनात्ते पितामह |
दुष्टैश्चैव महादुःखं दत्तं नः क्रूरकर्मभिः ||
text_mt: And our suffering has been driven far away through seeing you, O grandfather. / Great suffering indeed was inflicted on us by the wicked perpetrators of cruel deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmatāṃ darśane jāte duḥkhaṃ caiva gamiṣyati |
kadācinna gataṃ tatra niścayo'yaṃ vicāritaḥ ||
meaning:
श्रीमतां दर्शने जाते दुःखं चैव गमिष्यति |
कदाचिन्न गतं तत्र निश्चयोऽयं विचारितः ||
text_mt: When the glorious are seen, suffering surely vanishes; / if it ever did not vanish, that matter has been carefully considered [by us].

sanskrit_iast:
mahatāmāśrame prāpte samarthe sarvakarmaṇi |
yadi duḥkhaṃ na gacchettu daivamevātra kāraṇam ||
meaning:
महतामाश्रमे प्राप्ते समर्थे सर्वकर्मणि |
यदि दुःखं न गच्छेत्तु दैवमेवात्र कारणम् ||
text_mt: When one reaches the hermitage of the great, who are capable in all actions, / if suffering still does not leave, then destiny alone is the cause here.

sanskrit_iast:
niścayenaiva gacchettu dāridyaṃ duḥkhakāraṇam |
mahatāṃ ca svabhāvo'yaṃ kalpavṛkṣasamo mataḥ ||
meaning:
निश्चयेनैव गच्छेत्तु दारिद्यं दुःखकारणम् |
महतां च स्वभावोऽयं कल्पवृक्षसमो मतः ||
text_mt: Certainly poverty, the cause of suffering, must depart; / for the nature of the great is regarded as equal to the wish-fulfilling tree.

sanskrit_iast:
tadguṇāneva gaṇayanmahato vastumātrataḥ |
āśrayasya vaśādeva puṃso vai jāyate prabho ||
meaning:
तद्गुणानेव गणयन्महतो वस्तुमात्रतः |
आश्रयस्य वशादेव पुंसो वै जायते प्रभो ||
text_mt: Reckoning those qualities from the mere reality of the great, / O Lord, [all things] arise for a person solely through the power of recourse [to them].

sanskrit_iast:
laghutvaṃ ca mahattvaṃ ca nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
uttamānāṃ svabhāvo'yaṃ yaddīnapratipālanam ||
meaning:
लघुत्वं च महत्त्वं च नात्र कार्या विचारणा |
उत्तमानां स्वभावोऽयं यद्दीनप्रतिपालनम् ||
text_mt: Lowness or greatness—no doubt should be harbored in this matter; / for the nature of the noble is to protect the wretched.

sanskrit_iast:
raṅkasya lakṣaṇaṃ loke hyatiśreyaskaraṃ matam |
puro'sya parayatno vai sujanānāṃ ca sevanam ||
meaning:
रङ्कस्य लक्षणं लोके ह्यतिश्रेयस्करं मतम् |
पुरोऽस्य परयत्नो वै सुजनानां च सेवनम् ||
text_mt: The characteristic of the beggar in this world is held to bring the highest good: / first, he makes an effort to serve virtuous people.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ ca bhāgyaṃ vai doṣaścaiva na dīyatām |
etasmātkāraṇātsvāmiṃstvayi dṛṣṭo śubhaṃ tadā ||
meaning:
अतः परं च भाग्यं वै दोषश्चैव न दीयताम् |
एतस्मात्कारणात्स्वामिंस्त्वयि दृष्टो शुभं तदा ||
text_mt: Beyond this lies good fortune; do not assign blame. / For this reason, O master, when you were seen, good fortune arose then.

sanskrit_iast:
tvadāgamanamātreṇa santuṣṭāni manāṃsi naḥ |
diśopadeśaṃ yenāśu duḥkhaṃ naṣṭaṃ bhavecca naḥ ||
meaning:
त्वदागमनमात्रेण सन्तुष्टानि मनांसि नः |
दिशोपदेशं येनाशु दुःखं नष्टं भवेच्च नः ||
text_mt: By your mere arrival, our minds have been gladdened. / Impart an instruction by which our suffering may quickly be destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā pāṇḍavānāṃ mahāmuniḥ |
prasannamānaso bhūtvā vyāsaścaivābravīdidam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्येतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पाण्डवानां महामुनिः |
प्रसन्नमानसो भूत्वा व्यासश्चैवाब्रवीदिदम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing this speech of the Pāṇḍavas, the great sage / Vyāsa, his mind pleased, spoke as follows:

sanskrit_iast:
he pāṇḍavāśca yūyaṃ vai na kaṣṭaṃ kartumarhatha |
dhanyāḥ stha kṛtakṛtyāḥ stha satyaṃ naiva vilopitam ||
meaning:
हे पाण्डवाश्च यूयं वै न कष्टं कर्तुमर्हथ |
धन्याः स्थ कृतकृत्याः स्थ सत्यं नैव विलोपितम् ||
text_mt: “O Pāṇḍavas, you ought not to give way to distress; / you are blessed, you have accomplished your duty, and truth has not been abandoned by you.

sanskrit_iast:
sujanānāṃ svabhāvo'yaṃ prāṇānte'pi suśobhanaḥ |
dharmaṃ tyajanti naivātra satyaṃ saphalabhājanam ||
meaning:
सुजनानां स्वभावोऽयं प्राणान्तेऽपि सुशोभनः |
धर्मं त्यजन्ति नैवात्र सत्यं सफलभाजनम् ||
text_mt: Such is the most radiant nature of good people, even at the end of life: / they do not abandon righteousness here, which is the vessel of fruitful truth.

sanskrit_iast:
asmākaṃ caiva yūyaṃ ca te cāpi samatāṃ gatāḥ |
tathāpi pakṣapāto vai dharmiṣṭhānāṃ mato budhaiḥ ||
meaning:
अस्माकं चैव यूयं च ते चापि समतां गताः |
तथापि पक्षपातो वै धर्मिष्ठानां मतो बुधैः ||
text_mt: To us, both you and they have achieved equality; / nevertheless, bias toward the righteous is approved by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtarāṣṭrena duṣṭena prathamaṃ ca hyacakṣuṣā |
dharmastyaktaḥ svayaṃ lobhādyuṣmākaṃ rājyamāhṛtam ||
meaning:
धृतराष्ट्रेन दुष्टेन प्रथमं च ह्यचक्षुषा |
धर्मस्त्यक्तः स्वयं लोभाद्युष्माकं राज्यमाहृतम् ||
text_mt: First, righteous duty was personally abandoned out of greed by the wicked and blind Dhṛtarāṣṭra, / and your kingdom was seized.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya yūyaṃ ca te cāpi putrā eva na saṃśayaḥ |
pitaryaparate bālā anukampyā mahātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्य यूयं च ते चापि पुत्रा एव न संशयः |
पितर्यपरते बाला अनुकम्प्या महात्मनः ||
text_mt: Both you and they are indeed his sons, without doubt; / when the father passes away, the children of a great soul are worthy of pity.

sanskrit_iast:
paścātputraśca tenaiva vārito na kadācana |
anartho naiva jāyeta yaccaivaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tadā ||
meaning:
पश्चात्पुत्रश्च तेनैव वारितो न कदाचन |
अनर्थो नैव जायेत यच्चैवं च कृतं तदा ||
text_mt: Afterwards, his son was never restrained by him. / No calamity would have arisen if he had acted thus back then.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ ca yajjātaṃ tajjātaṃ nānyathā bhavet |
ayaṃ duṣṭo bhavantaśca dharmiṣṭhāḥ satyavādinaḥ ||
meaning:
अतः परं च यज्जातं तज्जातं नान्यथा भवेत् |
अयं दुष्टो भवन्तश्च धर्मिष्ठाः सत्यवादिनः ||
text_mt: Beyond this, whatever has happened has happened; it cannot be otherwise. / That man is wicked, while you are righteous speakers of truth.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādante ca tasyaivāśubhaṃ hi bhavitā dhruvam |
yaccaiva vāpitaṃ bījaṃ tatpraroho bhavediha ||
meaning:
तस्मादन्ते च तस्यैवाशुभं हि भविता ध्रुवम् |
यच्चैव वापितं बीजं तत्प्ररोहो भवेदिह ||
text_mt: Therefore, in the end, misfortune will certainly befall him; / for whatever seed is sown, that very sprout arises here.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādduḥkhaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavadbhiḥ sarvathā dhruvam |
bhaviṣyati śubhaṃ vo hi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
meaning:
तस्माद्दुःखं न कर्तव्यं भवद्भिः सर्वथा ध्रुवम् |
भविष्यति शुभं वो हि नात्र कार्या विचारणा ||
text_mt: Therefore, no sorrow at all should be felt by you; / good fortune will certainly come to you; no doubt should be harbored in this matter.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvā pāṇḍavāḥ sarve tena vyāsena prīṇitāḥ |
yudhiṣṭhiramukhāste ca punarevābruvanvacaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा पाण्डवाः सर्वे तेन व्यासेन प्रीणिताः |
युधिष्ठिरमुखास्ते च पुनरेवाब्रुवन्वचः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, all the Pāṇḍavas, comforted by that Vyāsa / and headed by Yudhiṣṭhira, again spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇḍavā ūcuḥ |
satyamuktaṃ tvayā nātha duṣṭairduḥkhaṃ nirantaram |
duṣṭātmabhirvane cāpi dīyate hi muhurmuhuḥ ||
meaning:
पाण्डवा ऊचुः |
सत्यमुक्तं त्वया नाथ दुष्टैर्दुःखं निरन्तरम् |
दुष्टात्मभिर्वने चापि दीयते हि मुहुर्मुहुः ||
text_mt: The Pāṇḍavas said: / “O protector, you have spoken truly. Constant sorrow / is being inflicted again and again by the wicked-minded, even in the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
tannāśayāśubhaṃ meṃ'dya kiñciddeyaṃ śubhaṃ vibho |
kṛṣṇena kathitaṃ pūrvamārādhyaḥ śaṅkaraḥ sadā ||
meaning:
तन्नाशयाशुभं मेंऽद्य किञ्चिद्देयं शुभं विभो |
कृष्णेन कथितं पूर्वमाराध्यः शङ्करः सदा ||
text_mt: Therefore, destroy our misfortune today; grant us some good fortune, O powerful one. / Formerly, Kṛṣṇa told [us] that Śaṅkara is always to be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
pramādaśca kṛto'smābhistadvacaḥ śithilīkṛtam |
sa devamārgastu punaridānīmupadiśyatām ||
meaning:
प्रमादश्च कृतोऽस्माभिस्तद्वचः शिथिलीकृतम् |
स देवमार्गस्तु पुनरिदानीमुपदिश्यताम् ||
text_mt: Negligence was committed by us, and his word was neglected. / Let that divine path now be taught [to us] once again.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā vyāso harṣasamanvitaḥ |
uvāca pāṇḍavānprītyā smṛtvā śivapadāmbujam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्येतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा व्यासो हर्षसमन्वितः |
उवाच पाण्डवान्प्रीत्या स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्बुजम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Hearing this speech, Vyāsa, filled with joy, / lovingly addressed the Pāṇḍavas, remembering the lotus feet of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca |
śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ me'dya pāṇḍavā dharmabuddhayaḥ |
satyamuktaṃ tu kṛṣṇena mayā saṃsevyate śivaḥ ||
meaning:
व्यास उवाच |
श्रूयतां वचनं मेऽद्य पाण्डवा धर्मबुद्धयः |
सत्यमुक्तं तु कृष्णेन मया संसेव्यते शिवः ||
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / “Listen to my word today, O Pāṇḍavas, whose minds are fixed on righteousness: / what Kṛṣṇa said is true, and Śiva is worshipped by me.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavadbhiḥ sevyatāṃ prītyā sukhaṃ syādatulaṃ sadā |
sarvaduḥkhaṃ bhavatyeva śivāsevāta eva hi ||
meaning:
भवद्भिः सेव्यतां प्रीत्या सुखं स्यादतुलं सदा |
सर्वदुःखं भवत्येव शिवासेवात एव हि ||
text_mt: Let him be served lovingly by you; peerless happiness will always follow. / All suffering indeed arises only from not serving Śiva.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
atha pañcasu teṣveva vicārya śivapūjane |
arjunaṃ yogyamuccārya vyāso munivarastathā ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
अथ पञ्चसु तेष्वेव विचार्य शिवपूजने |
अर्जुनं योग्यमुच्चार्य व्यासो मुनिवरस्तथा ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Then, deliberating among those five regarding the worship of Śiva, / Vyāsa, the excellent sage, declared Arjuna to be worthy.

sanskrit_iast:
tapaḥsthānaṃ vicāryaivaṃ tataḥ sa munisattamaḥ |
pāṇḍavāndharmasanniṣṭhānpunarevābravīdidam ||
meaning:
तपःस्थानं विचार्यैवं ततः स मुनिसत्तमः |
पाण्डवान्धर्मसन्निष्ठान्पुनरेवाब्रवीदिदम् ||
text_mt: Having thus considered a place for austerity, that best of sages / spoke once again to the Pāṇḍavas, who were devoted to righteousness:

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca |
śrūyatāṃ pāṇḍavāḥ sarve kathayāmi hitaṃ sadā |
śivaṃ sarvaṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ brahma satāṃ gatim ||
meaning:
व्यास उवाच |
श्रूयतां पाण्डवाः सर्वे कथयामि हितं सदा |
शिवं सर्वं परं दृष्ट्वा परं ब्रह्म सतां गतिम् ||
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / “Listen, all Pāṇḍavas; I speak what is always beneficial, / seeing Śiva as all, supreme, the highest Brahman, the refuge of the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāditriparārddhāntaṃ yatkiñcid dṛśyate jagat |
tatsarvaṃ śivarūpaṃ ca pūjyaṃ dhyeyaṃ ca tatpunaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मादित्रिपरार्द्धान्तं यत्किञ्चिद् दृश्यते जगत् |
तत्सर्वं शिवरूपं च पूज्यं ध्येयं च तत्पुनः ||
text_mt: Whatever world is seen, from Brahmā up to three parārdha intervals, / all that is the form of Śiva, and it should be worshipped and meditated upon.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ caiva sevyo'sau śaṅkaraḥ sarvaduḥkhahā |
śivaḥ svalpena kālena samprasīdati bhaktitaḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वेषां चैव सेव्योऽसौ शङ्करः सर्वदुःखहा |
शिवः स्वल्पेन कालेन सम्प्रसीदति भक्तितः ||
text_mt: And that Śaṅkara, the destroyer of all sorrow, is to be served by all; / Śiva is well pleased in a short time through devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
suprasanno maheśo hi bhaktebhyaḥ sakalapradaḥ |
bhuktiṃ muktimihāmutra yacchatīti suniścitam ||
meaning:
सुप्रसन्नो महेशो हि भक्तेभ्यः सकलप्रदः |
भुक्तिं मुक्तिमिहामुत्र यच्छतीति सुनिश्चितम् ||
text_mt: For the great lord, highly pleased, gives everything to his devotees; / it is certain that he bestows enjoyment and liberation here and in the hereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsevyaḥ sadā śabhbhurbhuktimuktiphalepsubhiḥ |
puruṣaḥ śaṅkaraḥ sākṣād dṛṣṭahantā satāṃ gatiḥ ||
meaning:
तस्मात्सेव्यः सदा शभ्भुर्भुक्तिमुक्तिफलेप्सुभिः |
पुरुषः शङ्करः साक्षाद् दृष्टहन्ता सतां गतिः ||
text_mt: Therefore, Śambhu should always be served by those desiring the fruits of enjoyment and liberation: / the Primal Person Śaṅkara is visible, the destroyer [of sins], the refuge of the good.

sanskrit_iast:
parantu prathamaṃ śakravidyāṃ dṛḍhamanā japet |
kṣatriyasya parākhyasya cedameva samāhitam ||
meaning:
परन्तु प्रथमं शक्रविद्यां दृढमना जपेत् |
क्षत्रियस्य पराख्यस्य चेदमेव समाहितम् ||
text_mt: However, first one should recite with a firm mind the Indra-lore; / for a high-ranking kṣatriya, this alone is fitting.

sanskrit_iast:
ato'rjunaśca prathamaṃ śakravidyāṃ japed dṛḍhaḥ |
kariṣyati parīkṣāṃ prāk santuṣṭastadbhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
अतोऽर्जुनश्च प्रथमं शक्रविद्यां जपेद् दृढः |
करिष्यति परीक्षां प्राक् सन्तुष्टस्तद्भविष्यति ||
text_mt: Therefore, let Arjuna first recite the Indra-lore with firm resolve; / [Indra] will first test him, and then he will be satisfied.

sanskrit_iast:
suprasannaśca vighnāni saṃhariṣyati sarvadā |
punaścaivaṃ śivasyaiva varaṃ mantraṃ pradāsyati ||
meaning:
सुप्रसन्नश्च विघ्नानि संहरिष्यति सर्वदा |
पुनश्चैवं शिवस्यैव वरं मन्त्रं प्रदास्यति ||
text_mt: And when he is well pleased, he will always destroy obstacles, / and then he will impart the excellent mantra of Śiva.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvārjunamāhūyopendravidyāmupādiśat |
snātvā ca prāṅmukho bhūtvā jagrāhārjuna ugradhīḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वार्जुनमाहूयोपेन्द्रविद्यामुपादिशत् |
स्नात्वा च प्राङ्मुखो भूत्वा जग्राहार्जुन उग्रधीः ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, calling Arjuna, he imparted the Upendra-lore. / Having bathed and faced east, Arjuna of fierce intellect received it.

sanskrit_iast:
pārthivasya vidhānaṃ ca tasmai munivaro dadau |
pratyuvāca ca taṃ vyāso dhanañjayamudāradhīḥ ||
meaning:
पार्थिवस्य विधानं च तस्मै मुनिवरो ददौ |
प्रत्युवाच च तं व्यासो धनञ्जयमुदारधीः ||
text_mt: And the excellent sage gave him the procedure for the earthen emblem; / then Vyāsa, of noble intellect, said to Dhanañjaya:

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca |
ito gacchādhunā pārtha indrakīle suśobhane |
jāhnavyāśca samīpe vai sthitvā samyak tapaḥ kuru ||
meaning:
व्यास उवाच |
इतो गच्छाधुना पार्थ इन्द्रकीले सुशोभने |
जाह्नव्याश्च समीपे वै स्थित्वा सम्यक् तपः कुरु ||
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / “Depart from here now, O Pārtha, to the most lovely Indrakīla, / and staying near the Jāhnavī, perform austerity properly.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛśyā caiva vidyā syātsadā te hitakāriṇī |
ityāśiṣaṃ dadau tasmai tataḥ provāca tānmuniḥ ||
meaning:
अदृश्या चैव विद्या स्यात्सदा ते हितकारिणी |
इत्याशिषं ददौ तस्मै ततः प्रोवाच तान्मुनिः ||
text_mt: May this lore remain invisible [to others] and always beneficial to you!” / Having thus given him his blessing, the sage then said to them:

sanskrit_iast:
dharmamāsthāya sarve vai tiṣṭhantu nṛpasattamāḥ |
siddhiḥ syātsarvathā śreṣṭhā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
meaning:
धर्ममास्थाय सर्वे वै तिष्ठन्तु नृपसत्तमाः |
सिद्धिः स्यात्सर्वथा श्रेष्ठा नात्र कार्या विचारणा ||
text_mt: “Let all of you, best of kings, remain steadfast in righteousness; / the highest success will certainly come to pass; no doubt should be harbored in this matter.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti dattvāśiṣaṃ tebhyaḥ pāṇḍavebhyo munīśvaraḥ |
smṛtvā śivapadāmbhojaṃ vyāsaścāntardadhe kṣaṇāt ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति दत्त्वाशिषं तेभ्यः पाण्डवेभ्यो मुनीश्वरः |
स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजं व्यासश्चान्तर्दधे क्षणात् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said: / Having thus given his blessing to those Pāṇḍavas, the lord of sages, / Vyāsa, remembering the lotus feet of Śiva, vanished in an instant.

Thus ends the thirty-seventh chapter, entitled “Description of the Instruction of Vyāsa to Arjuna” in the context of the description of the Kirāta incarnation, in the third Śatarudrasaṃhitā of the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
arjuno'pi tadā tatra dīpyamāno vyadṛśyata |
mantreṇa śivarūpeṇa tejaścātulamāvahan ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
अर्जुनोऽपि तदा तत्र दीप्यमानो व्यदृश्यत |
मन्त्रेण शिवरूपेण तेजश्चातुलमावहन् ||
title: aṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | kirātāvatāravarṇanaprasaṅge'rjunatapovarṇanam
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Arjuna also appeared then and there, shining brightly, / bearing unequalled splendor through the mantra whose form is Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve cārjunaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavā niścayaṃ gatāḥ |
jayo'smākaṃ dhruvaṃ jātaṃ tejaśca vipulaṃ yataḥ ||
meaning:
ते सर्वे चार्जुनं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवा निश्चयं गताः |
जयोऽस्माकं ध्रुवं जातं तेजश्च विपुलं यतः ||
text_mt: All those Pāṇḍavas, seeing Arjuna, became resolved: / 'Our victory is certain, since such vast splendor has arisen.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ kāryaṃ tvayā sādhyaṃ nānyena ca kadācana |
vyāsasya vacanādbhāti saphalaṃ kuru jīvitam ||
meaning:
इदं कार्यं त्वया साध्यं नान्येन च कदाचन |
व्यासस्य वचनाद्भाति सफलं कुरु जीवितम् ||
text_mt: This task must be accomplished by you, and never by anyone else; / it appears so from Vyāsa's word. Make your life fruitful!'

sanskrit_iast:
iti procyārjunaṃ te vai virahautsukyakātarāḥ |
anicchanto'pi tatraiva preṣayāmāsurādarāt ||
meaning:
इति प्रोच्यार्जुनं ते वै विरहौत्सुक्यकातराः |
अनिच्छन्तोऽपि तत्रैव प्रेषयामासुरादरात् ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus to Arjuna, distressed by longing in separation, / though unwilling, they sent him forth from that very place with respect.

sanskrit_iast:
draupadī duḥkhasaṃyuktā netrāśrūṇi nirudhya ca |
preṣayantī śubhaṃ vākyaṃ tadovāca pativratā ||
meaning:
द्रौपदी दुःखसंयुक्ता नेत्राश्रूणि निरुध्य च |
प्रेषयन्ती शुभं वाक्यं तदोवाच पतिव्रता ||
text_mt: Draupadī, filled with sorrow, holding back her eye's tears, / sending him off, the devoted wife then spoke an auspicious word:

sanskrit_iast:
draupadyuvāca |
vyāsopadiṣṭaṃ yadrājaṃstvayā kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ |
śubhaprado'stu te panthāḥ śakaraḥ śaṃ karotu vai ||
meaning:
द्रौपद्युवाच |
व्यासोपदिष्टं यद्राजंस्त्वया कार्यं प्रयत्नतः |
शुभप्रदोऽस्तु ते पन्थाः शकरः शं करोतु वै ||
text_mt:
Draupadī said:
'O king, what was instructed by Vyāsa must be done by you with diligence. / May your path be auspicious; may Śaṅkara truly bring you good fortune!'

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve cāvasaṃstatra visṛjyārjunamādarāt |
atyantaduḥkhamāpannā militvā pañca eva ca ||
meaning:
ते सर्वे चावसंस्तत्र विसृज्यार्जुनमादरात् |
अत्यन्तदुःखमापन्ना मिलित्वा पञ्च एव च ||
text_mt: Having sent Arjuna off with respect, they all remained there, / having met together, only the five of them, fallen into extreme sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitāstatra vadanti sma śrūyatāmṛṣisattama |
duḥkhe'pi priyasaṅgo vai na duḥkhāya prajāyate ||
meaning:
स्थितास्तत्र वदन्ति स्म श्रूयतामृषिसत्तम |
दुःखेऽपि प्रियसङ्गो वै न दुःखाय प्रजायते ||
text_mt: Remaining there, they said—listen, O best of sages: / 'Even in sorrow, company with loved ones does not lead to sorrow;

sanskrit_iast:
viyoge dviguṇaṃ tasya duḥkhaṃ bhavati nityaśaḥ |
tatra dhairyadharasyāpi kathaṃ dhairyaṃ bhavediha ||
meaning:
वियोगे द्विगुणं तस्य दुःखं भवति नित्यशः |
तत्र धैर्यधरस्यापि कथं धैर्यं भवेदिह ||
text_mt: in separation, one's sorrow continually becomes twofold. / There, even for one who holds steadfastness, how could steadfastness remain here?'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
kurvatsveva tadā duḥkhampāṇḍaveṣu munīśvaraḥ |
kṛpāsindhuśca sa vyāsa ṛṣivaryaḥ samāgata ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
कुर्वत्स्वेव तदा दुःखम्पाण्डवेषु मुनीश्वरः |
कृपासिन्धुश्च स व्यास ऋषिवर्यः समागत ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Even as the Pāṇḍavas were lamenting, the lord of sages, / that ocean of compassion, Vyāsa, the excellent sage, arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tadā pāṇḍavāste vai natvā sampūjya cādarāt |
dattvāsanaṃ hi duḥkhāḍhyāḥ karau badhvā vaco'bruvan ||
meaning:
तं तदा पाण्डवास्ते वै नत्वा सम्पूज्य चादरात् |
दत्त्वासनं हि दुःखाढ्याः करौ बध्वा वचोऽब्रुवन् ||
text_mt: Then those Pāṇḍavas, bowing down to him and honoring him with respect, / having offered a seat, full of grief, joined their hands and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇḍavā ūcuḥ |
śrūyatāmṛṣabhaśreṣṭha duḥkhadagdhā vayaṃ prabho |
darśanaṃ te'dya samprāpya hyānandaṃ prāpnumo mune ||
meaning:
पाण्डवा ऊचुः |
श्रूयतामृषभश्रेष्ठ दुःखदग्धा वयं प्रभो |
दर्शनं तेऽद्य सम्प्राप्य ह्यानन्दं प्राप्नुमो मुने ||
text_mt:
The Pāṇḍavas said:
'Listen, O best among the eminent! We are burned by sorrow, O lord. / Having attained the sight of you today, O sage, we attain joy.

sanskrit_iast:
kiyatkālaṃ vasātraiva duḥkhanāśāya naḥ prabho |
darśanāttava viprarṣe sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ vilīyate ||
meaning:
कियत्कालं वसात्रैव दुःखनाशाय नः प्रभो |
दर्शनात्तव विप्रर्षे सर्वं दुःखं विलीयते ||
text_mt: Dwell right here for some time for the destruction of our sorrow, O lord. / From the sight of you, O brahmin sage, all sorrow dissolves.'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktaḥ sa ṛṣiśreṣṭho nyavasattatsukhāya vai |
kathābhirvividhābhiśca tadduḥkhaṃ nodayaṃstadā ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्तः स ऋषिश्रेष्ठो न्यवसत्तत्सुखाय वै |
कथाभिर्विविधाभिश्च तद्दुःखं नोदयंस्तदा ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Addressed thus, that best of sages dwelt there for their comfort, / dispelling their sorrow at that time with various narratives.

sanskrit_iast:
vārtāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ tena vyāsena sanmune |
supraṇamya vinītātmā dharmarājo'bravīdidam ||
meaning:
वार्तायां क्रियमाणायां तेन व्यासेन सन्मुने |
सुप्रणम्य विनीतात्मा धर्मराजोऽब्रवीदिदम् ||
text_mt: As conversation was being held by that Vyāsa, O virtuous sage, / having bowed well, humble in mind, Dharmarāja said this:

sanskrit_iast:
dharmarāja uvāca |
śṛṇu tvaṃ hi ṛṣiśreṣṭha duḥkhaśāntirmatā mama |
pṛcchāmi tvāṃ mahāprājña kathanīyaṃ tvayā prabho ||
meaning:
धर्मराज उवाच |
शृणु त्वं हि ऋषिश्रेष्ठ दुःखशान्तिर्मता मम |
पृच्छामि त्वां महाप्राज्ञ कथनीयं त्वया प्रभो ||
text_mt:
Dharmarāja said:
'Listen, O best of sages: in my view, peace from sorrow is needed. / I ask you, O highly wise one, it must be told by you, O lord:

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛśaṃ caiva duḥkhaṃ ca purā prāptaśca kaścana |
vayameva paraṃ duḥkhaṃ prāptā vai naiva kaścana ||
meaning:
ईदृशं चैव दुःखं च पुरा प्राप्तश्च कश्चन |
वयमेव परं दुःखं प्राप्ता वै नैव कश्चन ||
text_mt: Was such sorrow experienced by anyone in former times? / Or is it only we who have obtained supreme sorrow, and no one else?'

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca |
rājñastu nalanāmno vai niṣadhādhipateḥ purā |
bhavadduḥkhādhikaṃ duḥkhaṃ jātaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
व्यास उवाच |
राज्ञस्तु नलनाम्नो वै निषधाधिपतेः पुरा |
भवद्दुःखाधिकं दुःखं जातं तस्य महात्मनः ||
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
'For the king named Nala, ruler of the Niṣadhas, in former times, / there arose sorrow greater than your sorrow, for that noble-souled one.

sanskrit_iast:
hariścandrasya nṛpaterjātaṃ duḥkhaṃ mahattaram |
akathyaṃ tadviśeṣeṇa paraśokāvahaṃ tathā ||
meaning:
हरिश्चन्द्रस्य नृपतेर्जातं दुःखं महत्तरम् |
अकथ्यं तद्विशेषेण परशोकावहं तथा ||
text_mt: For King Hariścandra, a far greater sorrow arose, / especially indescribable, and likewise bringing immense grief.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhaṃ tathaiva vijñeyaṃ rāmasyāpyatha pāṇḍava |
yacchrutvā strīnarāṇāṃ ca bhavenmoho mahattaraḥ ||
meaning:
दुःखं तथैव विज्ञेयं रामस्याप्यथ पाण्डव |
यच्छ्रुत्वा स्त्रीनराणां च भवेन्मोहो महत्तरः ||
text_mt: Likewise, sorrow is to be known for Rāma too, O Pāṇḍava, / hearing which, greater delusion would arise for women and men.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvarṇayituṃ naiva śakyate hi mayā punaḥ |
śarīraṃ duḥkharāśiṃ ca matvā tyājyaṃ tvayādhunā ||
meaning:
तस्माद्वर्णयितुं नैव शक्यते हि मया पुनः |
शरीरं दुःखराशिं च मत्वा त्याज्यं त्वयाधुना ||
text_mt: Therefore, it is impossible for me to describe it all again. / Knowing the body to be a heap of sorrow, it should be renounced by you now.

sanskrit_iast:
yenedaṃ ca dhṛtaṃ tena vyāptameva na saṃśayaḥ |
prathamaṃ mātṛgarbhe vai janma duḥkhasya kāraṇam ||
meaning:
येनेदं च धृतं तेन व्याप्तमेव न संशयः |
प्रथमं मातृगर्भे वै जन्म दुःखस्य कारणम् ||
text_mt: By whoever this [body] is held, he is pervaded [by sorrow], there is no doubt. / First, birth in the mother's womb is a cause of sorrow;

sanskrit_iast:
kaumāre'pi mahāduḥkhaṃ bālalīlānusāri yat |
tato'pi yauvane kāmānbhuñjāno duḥkharūpiṇaḥ ||
meaning:
कौमारेऽपि महादुःखं बाललीलानुसारि यत् |
ततोऽपि यौवने कामान्भुञ्जानो दुःखरूपिणः ||
text_mt: in childhood too there is great sorrow, which follows child's play; / after that, in youth, enjoying desires that are of the nature of sorrow;

sanskrit_iast:
gatāgatairdinānāṃ hi kāryabhārairanekaśaḥ |
āyuśca kṣīyate nityaṃ na jānāti ha tatpunaḥ ||
meaning:
गतागतैर्दिनानां हि कार्यभारैरनेकशः |
आयुश्च क्षीयते नित्यं न जानाति ह तत्पुनः ||
text_mt: by the comings and goings of days and by many burdens of duty, / lifespan is continually diminished, and one does not know it.

sanskrit_iast:
ante ca maraṇaṃ caiva mahāduḥkhamataḥ param |
nānānarakapīḍāśca bhujyante'jñairnaraistadā ||
meaning:
अन्ते च मरणं चैव महादुःखमतः परम् |
नानानरकपीडाश्च भुज्यन्तेऽज्ञैर्नरैस्तदा ||
text_mt: And in the end, death is great sorrow beyond this; / and various torments of hell are then experienced by ignorant men.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādidamasatyaṃ ca tvantu satyaṃ samācara |
yenaiva tuṣyate śambhustathā kāryaṃ nareṇa ca ||
meaning:
तस्मादिदमसत्यं च त्वन्तु सत्यं समाचर |
येनैव तुष्यते शम्भुस्तथा कार्यं नरेण च ||
text_mt: Therefore, this is unreal; but you should practice truth. / That by which Śambhu is pleased should be done by a man.'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
evaṃ vividhavārtābhiḥ kālaniryāpaṇantadā |
cakruste bhrātaraḥ sarve manorathapathaiḥ punaḥ ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
एवं विविधवार्ताभिः कालनिर्यापणन्तदा |
चक्रुस्ते भ्रातरः सर्वे मनोरथपथैः पुनः ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Thus, passing the time through various conversations, / all those brothers then lived along the paths of hope.

sanskrit_iast:
arjuno'pi svayaṃ gacchandurgādriṣu dṛḍhavrataḥ |
yakṣaṃ labdhvā ca tenaiva dasyūnnighnannanekaśaḥ ||
meaning:
अर्जुनोऽपि स्वयं गच्छन्दुर्गाद्रिषु दृढव्रतः |
यक्षं लब्ध्वा च तेनैव दस्यून्निघ्नन्ननेकशः ||
text_mt: Arjuna too, going himself through rugged mountains, firm in his vows, / having obtained a Yakṣa, and repeatedly slaying robbers with him,

sanskrit_iast:
manasā harṣasaṃyukto jagāmācalamuttamam |
tatra gatvā ca gaṅgāyāḥ samīpaṃ sundaraṃ sthalam ||
meaning:
मनसा हर्षसंयुक्तो जगामाचलमुत्तमम् |
तत्र गत्वा च गङ्गायाः समीपं सुन्दरं स्थलम् ||
text_mt: full of joy in his mind, went to the excellent mountain. / Having gone there to a beautiful place near the Gaṅgā,

sanskrit_iast:
aśokakānanaṃ yatra tiṣṭhati svarga uttamaḥ |
tatra tasthau svayaṃ snātvā natvā ca gurumuttamam ||
meaning:
अशोककाननं यत्र तिष्ठति स्वर्ग उत्तमः |
तत्र तस्थौ स्वयं स्नात्वा नत्वा च गुरुमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: where there is an Aśoka grove, an excellent heaven, / there he stayed, having bathed himself and bowed to his excellent guru.

sanskrit_iast:
yathopadiṣṭaṃ veṣādi tathā caivākarotsvayam |
indriyāṇyapakṛṣyādau manasā saṃsthito'bhavat ||
meaning:
यथोपदिष्टं वेषादि तथा चैवाकरोत्स्वयम् |
इन्द्रियाण्यपकृष्यादौ मनसा संस्थितोऽभवत् ||
text_mt: He himself assumed the dress and other things just as instructed; / having first withdrawn the senses, he remained fixed in his mind.

sanskrit_iast:
punaśca pārthivaṃ kṛtvā sundaraṃ samasūtrakam |
tadagre praṇidadhyau sa tejorāśimanuttamam ||
meaning:
पुनश्च पार्थिवं कृत्वा सुन्दरं समसूत्रकम् |
तदग्रे प्रणिदध्यौ स तेजोराशिमनुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: And having made a beautiful, symmetrical earthen [liṅga], / before it he meditated upon the unsurpassed mass of splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
trikālaṃ caiva susnātaḥ pūjanaṃ vividhaṃ tadā |
cakāropāsanaṃ tatra harasya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
meaning:
त्रिकालं चैव सुस्नातः पूजनं विविधं तदा |
चकारोपासनं तत्र हरस्य च पुनः पुनः ||
text_mt: Well-bathed at the three daily twilights, he then performed / various worship and repeatedly practiced devotion to Hara there.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva śirasastejo nissṛtaṃ taccarāstadā |
dṛṣṭvā bhayaṃ samāpannāḥ praviṣṭaśca kadā hyayam ||
meaning:
तस्यैव शिरसस्तेजो निस्सृतं तच्चरास्तदा |
दृष्ट्वा भयं समापन्नाः प्रविष्टश्च कदा ह्ययम् ||
text_mt: The spies then saw the brilliance that issued from his head; / they became frightened, [wondering,] 'When did he enter [here]?'

sanskrit_iast:
punaste ca vicāryaivaṃ kathanīyaṃ viḍaujase |
ityuktvā tu gatāste vai śakrasyāntikamañjasā ||
meaning:
पुनस्ते च विचार्यैवं कथनीयं विडौजसे |
इत्युक्त्वा तु गतास्ते वै शक्रस्यान्तिकमञ्जसा ||
text_mt: Then, having deliberated thus: 'This must be told to Indra,' / having said this, they swiftly went to Indra's presence.

sanskrit_iast:
carā ūcuḥ |
devo vātha ṛṣiścaiva sūryo vātha vibhāvasuḥ |
tapaścarati deveśa na jānīmo vane ca tam ||
meaning:
चरा ऊचुः |
देवो वाथ ऋषिश्चैव सूर्यो वाथ विभावसुः |
तपश्चरति देवेश न जानीमो वने च तम् ||
text_mt:
The spies said:
'Whether a god, or a sage, or the sun, or fire, / he practices austerity in the forest, O lord of gods, and we do not know him.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva tejasā dagdhā āgatāstava sannidhau |
niveditañcaritraṃ tatkriyatāmucitaṃ tu yat ||
meaning:
तस्यैव तेजसा दग्धा आगतास्तव सन्निधौ |
निवेदितञ्चरित्रं तत्क्रियतामुचितं तु यत् ||
text_mt: Scorched by his brilliance, we have come to your presence. / That deed has been reported; let whatever is appropriate be done.'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktastaiścaraiḥ sarvaṃ jñātvā putracikīrṣitam |
sa gotrapānvisṛjyaiva tatra gantuṃ mano dadhe ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्तस्तैश्चरैः सर्वं ज्ञात्वा पुत्रचिकीर्षितम् |
स गोत्रपान्विसृज्यैव तत्र गन्तुं मनो दधे ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Addressed thus by those spies, understanding everything his son wished to do, / dismissing those protectors of the cows, he set his mind on going there.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vṛddhabrāhmaṇo bhūtvā brahmacārī śacīpatiḥ |
jagāma tatra viprendra parīkṣārthaṃ hi tasya vai ||
meaning:
स वृद्धब्राह्मणो भूत्वा ब्रह्मचारी शचीपतिः |
जगाम तत्र विप्रेन्द्र परीक्षार्थं हि तस्य वै ||
text_mt: Becoming an old brahmin, a celibate student, the husband of Śacī / went there, O best of brahmins, to test him.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāgataṃ tadā dṛṣṭvākārṣītpūjāṃ ca pāṇḍavaḥ |
sthito'gre ca stutiṃ kṛtvā kvāyāto'si vadādhunā ||
meaning:
तमागतं तदा दृष्ट्वाकार्षीत्पूजां च पाण्डवः |
स्थितोऽग्रे च स्तुतिं कृत्वा क्वायातोऽसि वदाधुना ||
text_mt: Seeing him arrive, the Pāṇḍava performed worship, / and standing before him, having praised him, [said:] 'Where have you come from? Tell me now.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktastena deveśo dhairyārthaṃ tasya prītitaḥ |
parīkṣāgarbhitaṃ vākyaṃ pāṇḍavantaṃ tato'bravīt ||
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्तेन देवेशो धैर्यार्थं तस्य प्रीतितः |
परीक्षागर्भितं वाक्यं पाण्डवन्तं ततोऽब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: Addressed thus by him, the lord of the gods, for the sake of his steadfastness, out of affection, / then spoke words pregnant with testing to that Pāṇḍava:

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇa uvāca |
nave vayasi vai tāta kintapasyasi sāmpratam |
muktyarthaṃ vā jayārthaṃ kiṃ sarvathaitattapastava ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मण उवाच |
नवे वयसि वै तात किन्तपस्यसि साम्प्रतम् |
मुक्त्यर्थं वा जयार्थं किं सर्वथैतत्तपस्तव ||
text_mt:
The brahmin said:
'In fresh youth, my child, why do you practice austerity now? / Is this austerity of yours for liberation or for victory by all means?'

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti pṛṣṭastadā tena sarvaṃ saṃveditaṃ punaḥ |
tacchrutvā sa punarvākyamuvāca brāhmaṇastadā ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति पृष्टस्तदा तेन सर्वं संवेदितं पुनः |
तच्छ्रुत्वा स पुनर्वाक्यमुवाच ब्राह्मणस्तदा ||
text_mt:
Nandīśvara said:
Questioned thus by him, [Arjuna] reported everything back. / Hearing that, the brahmin spoke these words again:

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇa uvāca |
yuktaṃ na kriyate vīra sukhaṃ prāptuṃ ca yattapaḥ |
kṣātradharmeṇa kriyate muktyarthaṃ kurusattama ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मण उवाच |
युक्तं न क्रियते वीर सुखं प्राप्तुं च यत्तपः |
क्षात्रधर्मेण क्रियते मुक्त्यर्थं कुरुसत्तम ||
text_mt:
The brahmin said:
'It is not fitting, O hero, that austerity is performed to obtain pleasure; / it is performed in accordance with warrior duty for the sake of liberation, O best of Kurus.'

sanskrit_iast:
indrastu sukhadātā vai muktidātā bhavenna hi |
tasmāttvaṃ sarvathā śreṣṭha kartumarhasi sattapaḥ |
nandīśvara uvāca |
idaṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā krodhaṃ cakre'rjunastadā |
pratyuvāca vinītātmā tadanādṛtya suvrataḥ ||
meaning:
इन्द्रस्तु सुखदाता वै मुक्तिदाता भवेन्न हि |
तस्मात्त्वं सर्वथा श्रेष्ठ कर्तुमर्हसि सत्तपः |
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इदं तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा क्रोधं चक्रेऽर्जुनस्तदा |
प्रत्युवाच विनीतात्मा तदनादृत्य सुव्रतः ||
text_mt: “Indra, indeed, gives happiness, but he certainly cannot give liberation. / Therefore, O best of men, you ought by all means to perform good austerity.” / Nandīśvara said: / Hearing those words of his, Arjuna then became angry, / but disregarding them, the humble, observant one replied:

sanskrit_iast:
arjuna uvāca |
rājyārthaṃ na ca muktyartha kimarthaṃ bhāṣase tvidam |
vyāsasya vacanenaiva kriyate tapa īdṛśam ||
meaning:
अर्जुन उवाच |
राज्यार्थं न च मुक्त्यर्थ किमर्थं भाषसे त्विदम् |
व्यासस्य वचनेनैव क्रियते तप ईदृशम् ||
text_mt: Arjuna said: / “It is for kingdom, not for liberation! Why do you speak this? / Only by the instruction of Vyāsa is such austerity being performed [by me].

sanskrit_iast:
ito gaccha brahmacārinmāṃ pātayitumicchasi |
prayojanaṃ kimatrāsti tava vai brahmacāriṇaḥ ||
meaning:
इतो गच्छ ब्रह्मचारिन्मां पातयितुमिच्छसि |
प्रयोजनं किमत्रास्ति तव वै ब्रह्मचारिणः ||
text_mt: Depart from here, O celibate student! You wish to bring about my downfall. / What purpose is there here for you, a celibate student?”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktaḥ sa prasanno'bhūtsundaraṃ rūpamadbhutam |
svopaskaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ darśayāmāsa vai nijam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्तः स प्रसन्नोऽभूत्सुन्दरं रूपमद्भुतम् |
स्वोपस्करणसंयुक्तं दर्शयामास वै निजम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Addressed thus, he was pleased, and revealed his own / beautiful, wondrous form, endowed with his distinctive paraphernalia.

sanskrit_iast:
śakrarūpaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā lajjitaścārjunastadā |
sa indrastaṃ samāśvāsya punareva vaco'bravīt ||
meaning:
शक्ररूपं तदा दृष्ट्वा लज्जितश्चार्जुनस्तदा |
स इन्द्रस्तं समाश्वास्य पुनरेव वचोऽब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: Seeing the form of Śakra, Arjuna was then embarrassed. / That Indra, comforting him, spoke words once more.

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca |
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva he tāta dhanañjaya mahāmate |
yadicchasi mano'bhīṣṭaṃ nādeyaṃ vidyate tava ||
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच |
वरं वृणीष्व हे तात धनञ्जय महामते |
यदिच्छसि मनोऽभीष्टं नादेयं विद्यते तव ||
text_mt: Indra said: / “Choose a boon, O dear Dhanañjaya of great intellect! / Whatever you desire in your heart, nothing is ungrantable to you.”

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā śakravacanaṃ pratyuvācārjunastadā |
vijayaṃ dehi me tāta śatrukliṣṭasya sarvathā ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा शक्रवचनं प्रत्युवाचार्जुनस्तदा |
विजयं देहि मे तात शत्रुक्लिष्टस्य सर्वथा ||
text_mt: Hearing Śakra's words, Arjuna then replied: / “Grant me victory by all means, O father, afflicted as I am by enemies!”

sanskrit_iast:
śakra uvāca |
baliṣṭhāḥ śatravaste ca duryodhanapuraḥsarāḥ |
droṇo bhīmaśca karṇaśca sarve te durjayā dhruvam ||
meaning:
शक्र उवाच |
बलिष्ठाः शत्रवस्ते च दुर्योधनपुरःसराः |
द्रोणो भीमश्च कर्णश्च सर्वे ते दुर्जया ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: Śakra said: / “Your enemies are very strong, headed by Duryodhana: / Droṇa, Bhīma, and Karṇa—they are all surely difficult to conquer.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthāmā droṇaputro raudroṃ'śo durjayo'ti saḥ |
mayāsādhyā bhaveyuste sarvathā svahitaṃ śṛṇu ||
meaning:
अश्वत्थामा द्रोणपुत्रो रौद्रोंऽशो दुर्जयोऽति सः |
मयासाध्या भवेयुस्ते सर्वथा स्वहितं शृणु ||
text_mt: Aśvatthāman, son of Droṇa, is an aggressive portion [of Rudra], exceedingly difficult to conquer. / They would be unmanageable for me. By all means, hear what is for your own welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
etadvīra jayaṃ kartuṃ na śaktaḥ kaścanādhunā |
vartate hi śivo varyastasmācchambhorjapo'dhunā ||
meaning:
एतद्वीर जयं कर्तुं न शक्तः कश्चनाधुना |
वर्तते हि शिवो वर्यस्तस्माच्छम्भोर्जपोऽधुना ||
text_mt: To gain this victory, O hero, no one is able at present. / For Śiva is supreme; therefore, recitation of Śambhu's [mantra] should be done now.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkaraḥ sarvalokeśaścarācarapatiḥ svarāṭ |
sarvaṃ kartuṃ samartho'sti bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ ||
meaning:
शङ्करः सर्वलोकेशश्चराचरपतिः स्वराट् |
सर्वं कर्तुं समर्थोऽस्ति भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः ||
text_mt: Śaṅkara is the lord of all the worlds, master of the moving and unmoving, sovereign ruler; / he is capable of doing everything, bestower of the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ahammanye ca brahmādyā viṣṇuḥ sarvavarapradaḥ |
anye jigīṣavo ye ca te sarve śivapūjakāḥ ||
meaning:
अहम्मन्ये च ब्रह्माद्या विष्णुः सर्ववरप्रदः |
अन्ये जिगीषवो ये च ते सर्वे शिवपूजकाः ||
text_mt: I consider, moreover, that Brahmā and others, and Viṣṇu who grants all boons, / and all others who desire victory—all of them worship Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
adyaprabhṛti tanmantraṃ hitvā bhaktyā śivaṃ bhaja |
pārthivena vidhānena dhyānenaiva śivasya ca ||
meaning:
अद्यप्रभृति तन्मन्त्रं हित्वा भक्त्या शिवं भज |
पार्थिवेन विधानेन ध्यानेनैव शिवस्य च ||
text_mt: From this day forth, set aside that [other] mantra and worship Śiva with devotion, / by means of the clay ritual and the contemplation of Śiva alone,

sanskrit_iast:
upacārairanekaiśca sarvabhāvena bhārata |
siddhiḥ syādacalā te'dya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
meaning:
उपचारैरनेकैश्च सर्वभावेन भारत |
सिद्धिः स्यादचला तेऽद्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा ||
text_mt: and with numerous offerings with all your being, O Bhārata. / Your success will become immovable today; no doubt should be entertained here.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvā ca carānsarvānsamāhūyābravīdidam |
sāvadhānena vai stheyametatsaṃrakṣaṇe sadā ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इत्युक्त्वा च चरान्सर्वान्समाहूयाब्रवीदिदम् |
सावधानेन वै स्थेयमेतत्संरक्षणे सदा ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus, he summoned all his spies and said this: / “You must remain attentive always for his protection.”

sanskrit_iast:
prabodhya svacarānindro'rjunasaṃrakṣaṇādikam |
vātsalyapūrṇahṛdayaḥ punarūce kapidhvajam ||
meaning:
प्रबोध्य स्वचरानिन्द्रोऽर्जुनसंरक्षणादिकम् |
वात्सल्यपूर्णहृदयः पुनरूचे कपिध्वजम् ||
text_mt: Having instructed his emissaries concerning the protection and care of Arjuna, / Indra, his heart filled with affectionate love, spoke again to the monkey-bannered hero:

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca |
rājyaṃ tvayā pramādādvai na kartavyaṃ kadācana |
śreyase bhadra vidyeyaṃ bhavettava parantapa ||
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच |
राज्यं त्वया प्रमादाद्वै न कर्तव्यं कदाचन |
श्रेयसे भद्र विद्येयं भवेत्तव परन्तप ||
text_mt: Indra said: / “Kingship should never be ruled by you heedlessly. / May this knowledge be for your highest welfare, O scorcher of foes!

sanskrit_iast:
dhairyaṃ dhāryaṃ sādhakena sarvathā rakṣakaḥ śivaḥ |
sampattīśca phalaṃ tubhyaṃ dāsyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
धैर्यं धार्यं साधकेन सर्वथा रक्षकः शिवः |
सम्पत्तीश्च फलं तुभ्यं दास्यते नात्र संशयः ||
text_mt: Firmness must be maintained by the practitioner; Śiva is the protector by all means. / He will give you prosperity and fruit; there is no doubt here.”

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
iti dattvā varaṃ tasya bhāratasya sureśvaraḥ |
smarañchivapadāmbhojaṃ jagāma bhavanaṃ svakam ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
इति दत्त्वा वरं तस्य भारतस्य सुरेश्वरः |
स्मरञ्छिवपदाम्भोजं जगाम भवनं स्वकम् ||
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having thus granted a boon to that descendant of Bharata, the lord of gods, / remembering the lotus feet of Śiva, went to his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
arjuno'pi mahāvīraḥ supraṇamya sureśvaram |
tapastepe saṃyatātmā śivamuddiśya tadvidham ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
meaning:
अर्जुनोऽपि महावीरः सुप्रणम्य सुरेश्वरम् |
तपस्तेपे संयतात्मा शिवमुद्दिश्य तद्विधम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
text_mt:
Arjuna too, the great hero, having bowed deeply to the lord of gods, / self-controlled, performed that kind of austerity directed toward Śiva.

Thus ends the thirty-eighth chapter, entitled ‘The Description of Arjuna’s Austerity,’ in the context of describing the Kirāta incarnation, in the third [section], the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, of the glorious Śiva Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandīśvara uvāca |
snānaṃ sa vidhivatkṛtvā nyāsādi vidhivattathā |
dhyānaṃ śivasya sadbhaktyā vyāsoktaṃ yattathākarot ||
meaning:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच |
स्नानं स विधिवत्कृत्वा न्यासादि विधिवत्तथा |
ध्यानं शिवस्य सद्भक्त्या व्यासोक्तं यत्तथाकरोत् ||
title: ekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | kirātāvatāravarṇane mūkadaityavadhaḥ
text_mt: Nandīśvara said: / Having performed his bath according to the rule, and likewise the placement [of mantras] according to the rule, / he performed the contemplation of Śiva with true devotion, as told by Vyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
ekapādatalenaiva tiṣṭhanmunivaro yathā |
sūrye dṛṣṭiṃ nibadhyaikāṃ mantramāvartayan sthitaḥ ||
meaning:
एकपादतलेनैव तिष्ठन्मुनिवरो यथा |
सूर्ये दृष्टिं निबध्यैकां मन्त्रमावर्तयन् स्थितः ||
text_mt: Standing upon the sole of a single foot like an eminent sage, / fixing his gaze solely upon the sun, he stood repeating the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
tapastepeti samprītyā saṃsmaranmanasā śivam |
pañcākṣaraṃ manuṃ śambhorjapansarvottamottamam ||
meaning:
तपस्तेपेति सम्प्रीत्या संस्मरन्मनसा शिवम् |
पञ्चाक्षरं मनुं शम्भोर्जपन्सर्वोत्तमोत्तमम् ||
text_mt: He performed austerity with great joy, meditating mentally on Śiva, / reciting the five-syllable mantra of Śambhu, highest of the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasasteja evāsīdyathā devā visismiyuḥ |
punaścaiva śivaṃ yātāḥ pratyūcuste samāhitāḥ ||
meaning:
तपसस्तेज एवासीद्यथा देवा विसिस्मियुः |
पुनश्चैव शिवं याताः प्रत्यूचुस्ते समाहिताः ||
text_mt: Such was the fiery power of his austerity that the gods were astonished; / and they went to Śiva once more and spoke with focused minds:

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ |
nareṇaikena sarveśa tvadarthe tapa āhitam |
yadicchati naraḥ so'yaṃ kinna yacchati tatprabho ||
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः |
नरेणैकेन सर्वेश त्वदर्थे तप आहितम् |
