yasyaiṣā sakalā pṛthvī kastadvīryaṃ vadiṣyati ||
meaning:
आस्ते कुसुममालेव फणामणिशिखारुणा |
यस्यैषा सकला पृथ्वी कस्तद्वीर्यं वदिष्यति ||
text_mt: Upon whom this entire earth rests like a garland of flowers / reddened by the radiance of the jewels on his hoods—who shall tell his might?

sanskrit_iast:
yadā vijṛmbhate'nanto madāghūrṇitalocanaḥ |
tadā calati bhūreṣā sādritoyādhikānanā ||
meaning:
यदा विजृम्भतेऽनन्तो मदाघूर्णितलोचनः |
तदा चलति भूरेषा साद्रितोयाधिकानना ||
text_mt: When Ananta yawns, his eyes rolling with intoxication, / then this earth shakes, together with its mountains, waters, and forests.

sanskrit_iast:
daśasāhasramekaikaṃ pātālaṃ munisattama |
atalaṃ vitalaṃ caiva sutalaṃ ca rasātalam ||
meaning:
दशसाहस्रमेकैकं पातालं मुनिसत्तम |
अतलं वितलं चैव सुतलं च रसातलम् ||
text_mt: Each netherworld measures ten thousand [yojanas], O best of sages: / Atala, Vitala, Sutala, and Rasātala,

sanskrit_iast:
talaṃ talātalaṃ cāgryaṃ pātālaṃ saptamaṃ matam |
bhūmeradhaḥ saptalokā ime jñeyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
meaning:
तलं तलातलं चाग्र्यं पातालं सप्तमं मतम् |
भूमेरधः सप्तलोका इमे ज्ञेया विचक्षणैः ||
text_mt: Tala, Talātala, and the foremost Pātāla, considered the seventh; / these seven worlds beneath the earth should be known by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
ucchrāyo dviguṇaścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ ratnabhūmayaḥ |
ratnavanto'tha prāsādā bhūmayo hemasambhavāḥ ||
meaning:
उच्छ्रायो द्विगुणश्चैषां सर्वेषां रत्नभूमयः |
रत्नवन्तोऽथ प्रासादा भूमयो हेमसम्भवाः ||
text_mt: The height of all of them is twice [that], their grounds made of jewels, / their palaces filled with gems, and their floors produced of gold.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu dānavadaiteyā nāgānāṃ jātayastathā |
nivasanti mahānāgā rākṣasā daityasambhavāḥ ||
meaning:
तेषु दानवदैतेया नागानां जातयस्तथा |
निवसन्ति महानागा राक्षसा दैत्यसम्भवाः ||
text_mt: In them dwell the Dānavas, the Daiteyas, the species of serpents, / great serpents, and rākṣasas born of Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
prāha svargasadomadhye pātālānīti nāradaḥ |
svarlokādati ramyāṇi tebhyo'sāvāgato divi ||
meaning:
प्राह स्वर्गसदोमध्ये पातालानीति नारदः |
स्वर्लोकादति रम्याणि तेभ्योऽसावागतो दिवि ||
text_mt: Nārada declared in the midst of the heaven-dwellers that the netherworlds / are far more delightful than heaven itself; from them he arrived in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣāśca maṇayo yatra suprabhāḥ |
āhlādakāriṇaḥ śubhrāḥ pātālaṃ kena tatsamam ||
meaning:
नानाभूषणभूषाश्च मणयो यत्र सुप्रभाः |
आह्लादकारिणः शुभ्राः पातालं केन तत्समम् ||
text_mt: Where radiant jewels, shining brightly and causing delight, / are ornaments on various adornments—what could be equal to that Pātāla?

sanskrit_iast:
pātāle kasya na prītiritaścetaśca śobhite |
detyadānavakanyābhirvimuktasyābhijāyate ||
meaning:
पाताले कस्य न प्रीतिरितश्चेतश्च शोभिते |
देत्यदानवकन्याभिर्विमुक्तस्याभिजायते ||
text_mt: In Pātāla, adorned on this side and that by the daughters of Daityas and Dānavas, / who would not feel delight, except one who is liberated?

sanskrit_iast:
divārkaraśmayo yatra na bhavanti vidhorniśi |
na śītamātapo yatra maṇitejo'tra kevalam ||
meaning:
दिवार्करश्मयो यत्र न भवन्ति विधोर्निशि |
न शीतमातपो यत्र मणितेजोऽत्र केवलम् ||
text_mt: Where there are no rays of the sun by day nor of the moon by night, / where there is neither cold nor heat, but only the brilliance of jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyabhojyānnapānāni bhujyante muditairbhṛśam |
yatra na jñāyate kālo gato'pi munisattama ||
meaning:
भक्ष्यभोज्यान्नपानानि भुज्यन्ते मुदितैर्भृशम् |
यत्र न ज्ञायते कालो गतोऽपि मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: Chewable and edible foods, dishes, and drinks are consumed by those who are exceedingly joyful, / where time is not perceived even as it passes, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃskokilarutaṃ yatra padmāni kamalākarāḥ |
nadyaḥ sarāṃsi ramyāṇi manojñānyambarāṇi ca ||
meaning:
पुंस्कोकिलरुतं यत्र पद्मानि कमलाकराः |
नद्यः सरांसि रम्याणि मनोज्ञान्यम्बराणि च ||
text_mt: Where there is the cry of male cuckoos, lotuses, lotus-ponds, / rivers, lovely lakes, and charming garments,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣaṇānyatiśubhrāṇi gandhāḍhyaṃ cānulepanam |
vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgānāṃ svanā geyāni ca dvija ||
meaning:
भूषणान्यतिशुभ्राणि गन्धाढ्यं चानुलेपनम् |
वीणावेणुमृदङ्गानां स्वना गेयानि च द्विज ||
text_mt: Exceedingly radiant ornaments, unguents rich in fragrance, / the sounds of lutes, flutes, and drums, and songs, O twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
daityoragaiśca bhujyante pātāle vai sukhāni ca |
tapasā samavāpnoti dānavaiḥ siddhamānavaiḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
दैत्योरगैश्च भुज्यन्ते पाताले वै सुखानि च |
तपसा समवाप्नोति दानवैः सिद्धमानवैः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Pleasures are indeed enjoyed in Pātāla by Daityas and serpents; / one attains it through austerity, as do Dānavas and perfected men.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
teṣāṃ mūrdhopariṣṭādvai narakāṃstān śruṇuṣva ca |
matto munivaraśreṣṭha pacyante yatra pāpinaḥ ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
तेषां मूर्धोपरिष्टाद्वै नरकांस्तान् श्रुणुष्व च |
मत्तो मुनिवरश्रेष्ठ पच्यन्ते यत्र पापिनः ||
title: ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ | narakoddhāravarṇanam
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Hear now from me about the hells situated above their heads, / O foremost of excellent sages, wherein sinners are cooked:

sanskrit_iast:
rauravaḥ śūkaro rodhastālo vivasanastathā |
mahājvālastaptakumbho lavaṇo'pi vilohitaḥ ||
meaning:
रौरवः शूकरो रोधस्तालो विवसनस्तथा |
महाज्वालस्तप्तकुम्भो लवणोऽपि विलोहितः ||
text_mt: Raurava, Śūkara, Rodha, Tāla, Vivasana, / Mahājvāla, Taptakumbha, Lavaṇa, and Vilohita,

sanskrit_iast:
vaitaraṇī pūyavahā kṛmiśaḥ kṛmibhojanaḥ |
asipatravanaṃ ghoraṃ lālābhakṣaśca dāruṇaḥ ||
meaning:
वैतरणी पूयवहा कृमिशः कृमिभोजनः |
असिपत्रवनं घोरं लालाभक्षश्च दारुणः ||
text_mt: Vaitaraṇī, Pūyavahā, Kṛmiśa, Kṛmibhojana, / the dreadful Asipatravana, and the terrifying Lālābhakṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā pūyavahaḥ prāyo vanhijvālo hyadhaḥśirāḥ |
sandaṃśaḥ kālasūtraśca tamaścāvīcirodhanaḥ ||
meaning:
तथा पूयवहः प्रायो वन्हिज्वालो ह्यधःशिराः |
सन्दंशः कालसूत्रश्च तमश्चावीचिरोधनः ||
text_mt: Likewise Pūyavaha, Vahnijvāla, Adhaḥśiras, / Sandaṃśa, Kālasūtra, Tamas, and Avīcirodhana,

sanskrit_iast:
śvabhojano'tha ruṣṭaśca mahārauravaśālmalī |
ityādyā bahavastatra narakā duḥkhadāyakāḥ ||
meaning:
श्वभोजनोऽथ रुष्टश्च महारौरवशाल्मली |
इत्याद्या बहवस्तत्र नरका दुःखदायकाः ||
text_mt: Śvabhojana, Ruṣṭa, Mahāraurava, Śālmalī, / and many other such hells that bestow torment.

sanskrit_iast:
pacyante teṣu puruṣāḥ pāpakarmaratāstu ye |
kramādvakṣye tu tān vyāsa sāvadhānatayā śṛṇu ||
meaning:
पच्यन्ते तेषु पुरुषाः पापकर्मरतास्तु ये |
क्रमाद्वक्ष्ये तु तान् व्यास सावधानतया शृणु ||
text_mt: In them men who are devoted to sinful deeds are cooked. / I will tell of them in order, Vyāsa; listen attentively.

sanskrit_iast:
kūṭasākṣyaṃ tu yo vakti vinā viprān surāṃśca gāḥ |
sadānṛtaṃ vadedyastu sa naro yāti rauravam ||
meaning:
कूटसाक्ष्यं तु यो वक्ति विना विप्रान् सुरांश्च गाः |
सदानृतं वदेद्यस्तु स नरो याति रौरवम् ||
text_mt: A man who gives false witness, except for the sake of brāhmaṇas, gods, and cows, / and one who always speaks untruth—that man goes to Raurava.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrūṇahā svarṇahartā ca gorodhī viśvaghātakaḥ |
surāpo brahmahantā ca paradravyāpahārakaḥ ||
meaning:
भ्रूणहा स्वर्णहर्ता च गोरोधी विश्वघातकः |
सुरापो ब्रह्महन्ता च परद्रव्यापहारकः ||
text_mt: One who slays an embryo, steals gold, obstructs a cow, betrays trust, / drinks liquor, slays a brāhmaṇa, or steals another's wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
yastatsaṅgī sa vai yāti mṛto vyāsa gurorvadhāt |
taptakumbhe svasurmāturgoścaiva duhitustathā ||
meaning:
यस्तत्सङ्गी स वै याति मृतो व्यास गुरोर्वधात् |
तप्तकुम्भे स्वसुर्मातुर्गोश्चैव दुहितुस्तथा ||
text_mt: And one who associates with them, O Vyāsa, goes upon death [to hell] for the murder of a teacher; / [and into] Taptakumbha goes one who sells his sister, mother, cow, daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
sādhvyā vikrayakṛccātha vārddhakī keśavikrayī |
taptaloheṣu pacyante yaśca bhaktaṃ parityajet ||
meaning:
साध्व्या विक्रयकृच्चाथ वार्द्धकी केशविक्रयी |
तप्तलोहेषु पच्यन्ते यश्च भक्तं परित्यजेत् ||
text_mt: Or a chaste wife, or a usurer, or one who sells hair; / and they who abandon a devotee are cooked in molten iron.

sanskrit_iast:
avamantā gurūṇāṃ yaḥ paścādbhoktā narādhamaḥ |
devadūṣayitā caiva devavikrayikaśca yaḥ ||
meaning:
अवमन्ता गुरूणां यः पश्चाद्भोक्ता नराधमः |
देवदूषयिता चैव देवविक्रयिकश्च यः ||
text_mt: One who disrespects teachers, a vile man who eats after [them without giving them food], / one who reviles deities, and one who sells deities,

sanskrit_iast:
agamyagāmī yaścānte yāti saptabalaṃ dvija |
cauro goghno hi patito maryādādūṣakastathā ||
meaning:
अगम्यगामी यश्चान्ते याति सप्तबलं द्विज |
चौरो गोघ्नो हि पतितो मर्यादादूषकस्तथा ||
text_mt: and one who consorts with forbidden women, at death he goes to Saptabala, O twice-born; / likewise a thief, a cow-killer, an outcaste, and one who violates established boundaries,

sanskrit_iast:
devadvijapitṛdveṣṭā ratnadūṣayitā ca yaḥ |
sa yāti kṛmibhakṣaṃ vai kṛmīnatti duriṣṭikṛt ||
meaning:
देवद्विजपितृद्वेष्टा रत्नदूषयिता च यः |
स याति कृमिभक्षं वै कृमीनत्ति दुरिष्टिकृत् ||
text_mt: one who hates deities, the twice-born, and the ancestors, and one who depreciates jewels, / he surely goes to Kṛmibhakṣa, and that doer of evil rites feeds on worms.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛdevasurān yastu paryaśnāti narādhamaḥ |
lālābhakṣaṃ sa yātyajño yaḥ śāstrakūṭakṛnnaraḥ ||
meaning:
पितृदेवसुरान् यस्तु पर्यश्नाति नराधमः |
लालाभक्षं स यात्यज्ञो यः शास्त्रकूटकृन्नरः ||
text_mt: A vile man who eats ahead of the ancestors, deities, and guests, / and an ignorant man who fabricates false scriptures, goes to Lālābhakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścāntyajena saṃsevyo hyasadgrāhī tu yo dvijaḥ |
ayājyayājakaścaiva tathaivābhakṣyabhakṣakaḥ ||
meaning:
यश्चान्त्यजेन संसेव्यो ह्यसद्ग्राही तु यो द्विजः |
अयाज्ययाजकश्चैव तथैवाभक्ष्यभक्षकः ||
text_mt: A twice-born who serves an outcaste, accepts gifts from the wicked, / officiates at sacrifices for those unfit to sacrifice, and eats forbidden food—

sanskrit_iast:
rudhiraughe patantyete somavikrayiṇaśca ye |
madhuhā grāmahā yāti krūrāṃ vaitaraṇīṃ nadīm ||
meaning:
रुधिरौघे पतन्त्येते सोमविक्रयिणश्च ये |
मधुहा ग्रामहा याति क्रूरां वैतरणीं नदीम् ||
text_mt: these fall into Rudhiraugha, as do sellers of soma; / a slayer of bees and a destroyer of villages goes to the cruel Vaitaraṇī river.

sanskrit_iast:
navayauvanamattāśca maryādābhedinaśca ye |
te kṛmyaṃ yāntyaśaucāśca kulaṭājīvinaśca ye ||
meaning:
नवयौवनमत्ताश्च मर्यादाभेदिनश्च ये |
ते कृम्यं यान्त्यशौचाश्च कुलटाजीविनश्च ये ||
text_mt: Those intoxicated with new youth, those who breach traditional bounds, / those who are impure, and those who live off unchaste women go to Kṛmya.

sanskrit_iast:
asipatravanaṃ yāti vṛkṣacchedī vṛthaiva yaḥ |
kṣurabhrakā mṛgavyādhā vahnijvāle patanti te ||
meaning:
असिपत्रवनं याति वृक्षच्छेदी वृथैव यः |
क्षुरभ्रका मृगव्याधा वह्निज्वाले पतन्ति ते ||
text_mt: One who fells trees in vain goes to Asipatravana; / barbers and hunters of deer fall into flames of fire.

sanskrit_iast:
bhraṣṭācāro hi yo vipraḥ kṣatriyo vaiśya eva ca |
yātyante dvija tatraiva yaḥ śvapākeṣu vahnidaḥ ||
vratasya lopakā ye ca svāśramādvicyutāśca ye |
sandaṃśayātanāmadhye patanti bhṛśadāruṇe ||
meaning:
भ्रष्टाचारो हि यो विप्रः क्षत्रियो वैश्य एव च |
यात्यन्ते द्विज तत्रैव यः श्वपाकेषु वह्निदः ||
व्रतस्य लोपका ये च स्वाश्रमाद्विच्युताश्च ये |
सन्दंशयातनामध्ये पतन्ति भृशदारुणे ||
text_mt:
A brahmin, a kṣatriya, or a vaiśya who has fallen from right conduct, / and one who sets fire among dog-cookers, goes right there at death, O twice-born.

Those who violate a vow and those who have fallen away from their own stage of life / fall into the exceedingly dreadful torment of Sandaṃśa.

sanskrit_iast:
vīryaṃ svapneṣu skandeyurye narā brahmacāriṇaḥ |
putrā nādhyāpitā yaiśca te patanti śvabhojane ||
meaning:
वीर्यं स्वप्नेषु स्कन्देयुर्ये नरा ब्रह्मचारिणः |
पुत्रा नाध्यापिता यैश्च ते पतन्ति श्वभोजने ||
text_mt: Those men living as students of the Veda who shed semen in dreams, / and those by whom sons were not instructed, fall into Śvabhojana.

sanskrit_iast:
ete cānye ca narakāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
yeṣu duṣkṛtakarmāṇaḥ pacyante yātanāgatāḥ ||
meaning:
एते चान्ये च नरकाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः |
येषु दुष्कृतकर्माणः पच्यन्ते यातनागताः ||
text_mt: These and other hells exist by the hundreds and thousands, / in which evil-doers cook, having met with torment.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva pāpānyetāni tathānyāni sahasraśaḥ |
bhujyante yāni puruṣairnarakāntaragocaraiḥ ||
meaning:
तथैव पापान्येतानि तथान्यानि सहस्रशः |
भुज्यन्ते यानि पुरुषैर्नरकान्तरगोचरैः ||
text_mt: Just so are these sins, and thousands of others, / which are experienced by men who have come within hells.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramaviruddhaṃ ca karma kurvanti ye narāḥ |
karmaṇā manasā vācā niraye tu patanti te ||
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमविरुद्धं च कर्म कुर्वन्ति ये नराः |
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा निरये तु पतन्ति ते ||
text_mt: Men who perform actions contrary to class and stage of life / fall into hell through deed, mind, or speech.

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥśirobhirdṛśyante nārakā divi daivataiḥ |
devānadhomukhān sarvānadhaḥ paśyanti nārakāḥ ||
meaning:
अधःशिरोभिर्दृश्यन्ते नारका दिवि दैवतैः |
देवानधोमुखान् सर्वानधः पश्यन्ति नारकाः ||
text_mt: The denizens of hell are seen head-downwards by the deities in heaven; / the denizens of hell look down upon all the deities as having their faces turned downwards.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāvarāḥ kṛmayo'bjāśca pakṣiṇaḥ paśavo narāḥ |
dhārmikāstridaśāstadvanmokṣiṇaśca yathākramam ||
meaning:
स्थावराः कृमयोऽब्जाश्च पक्षिणः पशवो नराः |
धार्मिकास्त्रिदशास्तद्वन्मोक्षिणश्च यथाक्रमम् ||
text_mt: Stationary creatures, worms, aquatic animals, birds, beasts, humans, / the righteous, the gods, and likewise those liberated, in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvanto jantavaḥ svarge tāvanto narakaukasaḥ |
pāpakṛdyāti narakaṃ prāyaścittaparāṅmukhaḥ ||
meaning:
यावन्तो जन्तवः स्वर्गे तावन्तो नरकौकसः |
पापकृद्याति नरकं प्रायश्चित्तपराङ्मुखः ||
text_mt: As many creatures as there are in heaven, so many are the dwellers in hell. / The sinner who turns his face away from expiation goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
gurūṇi gurubhiścaiva laghūni laghubhistathā |
prāyaścittāni kāleya manuḥ svāyambhuvo'bravīt ||
meaning:
गुरूणि गुरुभिश्चैव लघूनि लघुभिस्तथा |
प्रायश्चित्तानि कालेय मनुः स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: Heavy expiations for heavy sins, and light ones for light sins / in due time—so Svāyambhuva Manu has said.

sanskrit_iast:
yāni teṣāmaśeṣāṇāṃ karmāṇyuktāni teṣu vai |
prāyaścittamaśeṣeṇa harānusmaraṇaṃ param ||
meaning:
यानि तेषामशेषाणां कर्माण्युक्तानि तेषु वै |
प्रायश्चित्तमशेषेण हरानुस्मरणं परम् ||
text_mt: Whatever actions have been declared for all of them, / the supreme and complete expiation among them is indeed the remembrance of Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ tu tasyaikaṃ yasya puṃsaḥ prajāyate |
kṛte pāpe'nutāpo'pi śivasaṃsmaraṇaṃ param ||
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं तु तस्यैकं यस्य पुंसः प्रजायते |
कृते पापेऽनुतापोऽपि शिवसंस्मरणं परम् ||
text_mt: There is one expiation for that man in whom there arises / even repentance when a sin is committed: the supreme remembrance of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
māheśvaramavāpnoti madhyāhnādiṣu saṃsmaran |
prātarniśi ca sandhyāyāṃ kṣīṇapāpo bhavennaraḥ ||
meaning:
माहेश्वरमवाप्नोति मध्याह्नादिषु संस्मरन् |
प्रातर्निशि च सन्ध्यायां क्षीणपापो भवेन्नरः ||
text_mt: A man attains the state of Maheśvara by remembering [him] at noon and other [times]; / remembering at dawn, night, and twilight, he becomes one whose sins have vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
muktiṃ prayāti svargaṃ vā samastakleśasaṅkṣayam |
śivasya smaraṇādeva tasya śambhorumāpateḥ ||
meaning:
मुक्तिं प्रयाति स्वर्गं वा समस्तक्लेशसङ्क्षयम् |
शिवस्य स्मरणादेव तस्य शम्भोरुमापतेः ||
text_mt: He attains liberation, or heaven, and the cessation of all afflictions, / solely from the remembrance of Śiva, that Śambhu, lord of Umā.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpantarāyo viprendra japahomārcanādi ca |
bhavatyeva na kutrāpi trailokye munisattama ||
meaning:
पापन्तरायो विप्रेन्द्र जपहोमार्चनादि च |
भवत्येव न कुत्रापि त्रैलोक्ये मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: Nowhere in the three worlds, O best of sages, O foremost of the twice-born, / does an obstacle caused by sin arise to recitation, fire-offering, worship, and the like [for his devotee].

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvare matiryasya japahomārcanādiṣu |
yatpuṇyaṃ tatkṛtaṃ tena devendratvādikaṃ phalam ||
meaning:
महेश्वरे मतिर्यस्य जपहोमार्चनादिषु |
यत्पुण्यं तत्कृतं तेन देवेन्द्रत्वादिकं फलम् ||
text_mt: He whose mind is fixed on Maheśvara in recitation, fire-offerings, worship, and the like, / whatever merit he has performed yields lordship over the gods and other fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
pumānna narakaṃ yāti yaḥ smared bhaktito mune |
aharniśaṃ śivaṃ tasmāt sa kṣīṇāśeṣapātakaḥ ||
meaning:
पुमान्न नरकं याति यः स्मरेद् भक्तितो मुने |
अहर्निशं शिवं तस्मात् स क्षीणाशेषपातकः ||
text_mt: A man who remembers Śiva with devotion day and night, O sage, / does not go to hell; therefore all his sins are exhausted.

sanskrit_iast:
narakasvargasaṃjñe vai pāpapuṇye dvijottama |
yayostvekaṃ tu duḥkhāyānyatsukhāyodbhavāya ca ||
meaning:
नरकस्वर्गसंज्ञे वै पापपुण्ये द्विजोत्तम |
ययोस्त्वेकं तु दुःखायान्यत्सुखायोद्भवाय च ||
text_mt: Sin and merit are indeed called hell and heaven, O best of the twice-born; / one of the two leads to pain, the other to happiness and prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva prītaye bhūtvā punarduḥkhāya jāyate |
tatsmādduḥkhātmakaṃ nāsti na ca kiñcitsukhātmakam ||
meaning:
तदेव प्रीतये भूत्वा पुनर्दुःखाय जायते |
तत्स्माद्दुःखात्मकं नास्ति न च किञ्चित्सुखात्मकम् ||
text_mt: The very same thing, having caused pleasure, turns again to sorrow; / therefore nothing consists entirely of sorrow, and nothing consists entirely of happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
manasaḥ pariṇāmo'yaṃ sukhaduḥkhopalakṣaṇaḥ |
jñānameva paraṃ brahma jñānaṃ tattvāya kalpate ||
meaning:
मनसः परिणामोऽयं सुखदुःखोपलक्षणः |
ज्ञानमेव परं ब्रह्म ज्ञानं तत्त्वाय कल्पते ||
text_mt: This is a modification of the mind, characterized by pleasure and pain. / Knowledge alone is the supreme Brahman; knowledge leads to reality.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānātmakamidaṃ viśvaṃ sakalaṃ sacarācaram |
paravijñānataḥ kiñcit vidyate na paraṃ mune ||
meaning:
ज्ञानात्मकमिदं विश्वं सकलं सचराचरम् |
परविज्ञानतः किञ्चित् विद्यते न परं मुने ||
text_mt: This entire universe, with all that moves and is still, consists of knowledge; / apart from supreme consciousness, O sage, nothing else exists.

sanskrit_iast:
evametanmayākhyātaṃ sarvaṃ narakamaṇḍalam |
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sāmprataṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhuvaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
एवमेतन्मयाख्यातं सर्वं नरकमण्डलम् |
अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि साम्प्रतं मण्डलं भुवः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Thus has the entire sphere of hells been related by me; / henceforth I shall now proclaim the sphere of the earth.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
pārāśarya susaṅkṣepācchṛṇu tvaṃ vadato mama |
maṇḍalaṃ ca bhuvaḥ samyak saptadvīpādisaṃyutam ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
पाराशर्य सुसङ्क्षेपाच्छृणु त्वं वदतो मम |
मण्डलं च भुवः सम्यक् सप्तद्वीपादिसंयुतम् ||
title: saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | jambūdvīpavarṣavarṇanam
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / O son of Parāśara, hear from me as I speak in brief / of the sphere of the earth, well-provided with the seven continents and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
jambūḥ plakṣaḥ śālmaliśca kuśaḥ krauñcaśca śākakaḥ |
puṣkaraḥ saptamaḥ sarve samudraiḥ saptabhirvṛtāḥ ||
meaning:
जम्बूः प्लक्षः शाल्मलिश्च कुशः क्रौञ्चश्च शाककः |
पुष्करः सप्तमः सर्वे समुद्रैः सप्तभिर्वृताः ||
text_mt: Jambū, Plakṣa, Śālmali, Kuśa, Krauñca, Śāka, / and Puṣkara is the seventh; all are encircled by seven oceans:

sanskrit_iast:
lavaṇekṣurasau sarpirdadhidugdhajalāśayāḥ |
jambudvīpaḥ samastānāmeteṣāṃ madhyataḥ sthitaḥ ||
meaning:
लवणेक्षुरसौ सर्पिर्दधिदुग्धजलाशयाः |
जम्बुद्वीपः समस्तानामेतेषां मध्यतः स्थितः ||
text_mt: the reservoirs of salt water, sugarcane juice, wine, clarified butter, curds, milk, and fresh water. / Jambudvīpa is situated in the midst of all these.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpi meruḥ kāleya madhye kanakaparvataḥ |
praviṣṭaḥ ṣoḍaśādhastādyojanaistasya cocchrayaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्यापि मेरुः कालेय मध्ये कनकपर्वतः |
प्रविष्टः षोडशाधस्ताद्योजनैस्तस्य चोच्छ्रयः ||
text_mt: In its center also, O descendant of Kali, is Meru, the golden mountain; / its depth is sixteen [thousand] yojanas below, and its height

sanskrit_iast:
caturaśītimānaistairdvātriṃśanmūrdhni vistṛtaḥ |
bhūmipṛṣṭhasthaśailo'yaṃ vistarastasya sarvataḥ ||
meaning:
चतुरशीतिमानैस्तैर्द्वात्रिंशन्मूर्ध्नि विस्तृतः |
भूमिपृष्ठस्थशैलोऽयं विस्तरस्तस्य सर्वतः ||
text_mt: measures eighty-four [thousand yojanas]; at the summit it extends thirty-two [thousand]. / This mountain stands on the surface of the earth, and its extent on all sides

sanskrit_iast:
mūle ṣoḍaśasāhastra karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ |
himavān hemakūṭaśca niṣadhaścāsya dakṣiṇe ||
meaning:
मूले षोडशसाहस्त्र कर्णिकाकारसंस्थितः |
हिमवान् हेमकूटश्च निषधश्चास्य दक्षिणे ||
text_mt: is sixteen thousand at the base, shaped like a lotus pericarp. / Himavat, Hemakūṭa, and Niṣadha are to its south;

sanskrit_iast:
nīlaḥ śvetaśca śṛṅgī ca uttare varṣaparvatāḥ |
daśasāhasrikā hyete ratnavanto'ruṇaprabhāḥ ||
meaning:
नीलः श्वेतश्च शृङ्गी च उत्तरे वर्षपर्वताः |
दशसाहस्रिका ह्येते रत्नवन्तोऽरुणप्रभाः ||
text_mt: Nīla, Śveta, and Śṛṅgin are the boundary mountains to the north; / these are ten thousand [yojanas in extent], possessing gems and shining reddish.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrayojanotsedhāstāvadvistāriṇaśca te |
bhārataṃ prathamaṃ varṣaṃ tataḥ kimpuruṣaṃ smṛtam ||
meaning:
सहस्रयोजनोत्सेधास्तावद्विस्तारिणश्च ते |
भारतं प्रथमं वर्षं ततः किम्पुरुषं स्मृतम् ||
text_mt: They are a thousand yojanas in height and just as much in breadth. / The first continent-division is Bhārata, and after that Kimpuruṣa is remembered;

sanskrit_iast:
harivarṣaṃ tato'nyadvai merordakṣiṇato mune |
ramyakaṃ cottare pārśve tasyāṃśe tu hiraṇmayam ||
meaning:
हरिवर्षं ततोऽन्यद्वै मेरोर्दक्षिणतो मुने |
रम्यकं चोत्तरे पार्श्वे तस्यांशे तु हिरण्मयम् ||
text_mt: beyond that is another, Harivarṣa, south of Meru, O sage; / and Ramyaka is on the northern side, and adjoining it is Hiraṇmaya;

sanskrit_iast:
uttare kuravaścaiva yathā vai bhārataṃ tathā |
navasāhasramekaikameteṣāṃ munisattama ||
meaning:
उत्तरे कुरवश्चैव यथा वै भारतं तथा |
नवसाहस्रमेकैकमेतेषां मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: and in the north are the Kurus, just as Bhārata is [in the south]. / Each of these measures nine thousand [yojanas], O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
ilāvṛtaṃ tu tanmadhye tanmadhye merurucchritaḥ |
meroścaturdiśaṃ tatra navasāhasramucchritam ||
meaning:
इलावृतं तु तन्मध्ये तन्मध्ये मेरुरुच्छ्रितः |
मेरोश्चतुर्दिशं तत्र नवसाहस्रमुच्छ्रितम् ||
text_mt: Ilāvṛta is in their center, and in its center rises Meru; / on the four sides of Meru there, it rises nine thousand [yojanas].

sanskrit_iast:
ilāvṛtamṛṣiśreṣṭha catvāraścātra parvatāḥ |
viṣkambhā racitā meroryojitāḥ punarucchritāḥ ||
meaning:
इलावृतमृषिश्रेष्ठ चत्वारश्चात्र पर्वताः |
विष्कम्भा रचिता मेरोर्योजिताः पुनरुच्छ्रिताः ||
text_mt: Ilāvṛta, O best of ṛṣis, contains four mountains / constructed as buttresses of Meru, joined and soaring high:

sanskrit_iast:
pūrve hi mandaro nāma dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ |
vipulaḥ paścime bhāge supārśvaścottare sthitaḥ ||
meaning:
पूर्वे हि मन्दरो नाम दक्षिणे गन्धमादनः |
विपुलः पश्चिमे भागे सुपार्श्वश्चोत्तरे स्थितः ||
text_mt: Mandara in the east, Gandhamādana in the south, / Vipula in the western quarter, and Supārśva situated in the north.

sanskrit_iast:
kadambo jambuvṛkṣaśca pippalo vaṭa eva ca |
ekādaśaśatāyāmāḥ pādapā giriketavaḥ ||
meaning:
कदम्बो जम्बुवृक्षश्च पिप्पलो वट एव च |
एकादशशतायामाः पादपा गिरिकेतवः ||
text_mt: The kadamba, the jambu tree, the pippala, and the banyan, / eleven hundred [yojanas] in extent, are the trees that serve as the banners of the mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
jambūdvīpasya nāmno vai hetuṃ śṛṇu mahāmune |
virājante mahāvṛkṣāstatsvabhāvaṃ vadāmi te ||
meaning:
जम्बूद्वीपस्य नाम्नो वै हेतुं शृणु महामुने |
विराजन्ते महावृक्षास्तत्स्वभावं वदामि ते ||
text_mt: Hear the reason for the name of Jambūdvīpa, O great sage: / great trees shine there; I shall describe their nature to you.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāgajapramāṇāni jambvāstasyāḥ phalāni ca |
patanti bhūbhṛtaḥ pṛṣṭhe śīryamāṇāni sarvataḥ ||
meaning:
महागजप्रमाणानि जम्ब्वास्तस्याः फलानि च |
पतन्ति भूभृतः पृष्ठे शीर्यमाणानि सर्वतः ||
text_mt: The fruits of that jambu tree, having the size of great elephants, / fall upon the ridge of the mountain, bursting all around.

sanskrit_iast:
rasena teṣāṃ vikhyātā tatra jambūnadīti vai |
parito vartate tatra pīyate tannivāsibhiḥ ||
meaning:
रसेन तेषां विख्याता तत्र जम्बूनदीति वै |
परितो वर्तते तत्र पीयते तन्निवासिभिः ||
text_mt: From their juice, the famous river named Jambūnadī flows there, / flowing all around, and is drunk by its inhabitants.

sanskrit_iast:
na svedo na ca daurgandhyaṃ na jarā cendriyagrahaḥ |
tasyāstaṭe sthitānāṃ tu janānāṃ tanna jāyate ||
meaning:
न स्वेदो न च दौर्गन्ध्यं न जरा चेन्द्रियग्रहः |
तस्यास्तटे स्थितानां तु जनानां तन्न जायते ||
text_mt: Neither sweat nor bad odor, neither old age nor impairment of the senses / occurs in the people who dwell upon its banks.

sanskrit_iast:
tīramṛtsnāṃ ca samprāpya sukhavāyuviśoṣitām |
jāmbūnadākhyaṃ bhavati suvarṇaṃ siddhabhūṣaṇam ||
meaning:
तीरमृत्स्नां च सम्प्राप्य सुखवायुविशोषिताम् |
जाम्बूनदाख्यं भवति सुवर्णं सिद्धभूषणम् ||
text_mt: And when dried by the pleasant breeze on the shore's clay, / it becomes the gold called Jāmbūnada, an ornament for the Siddhas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrāśvaṃ pūrvato meroḥ ketumālaṃ ca paścime |
varṣe dve tu muniśreṣṭha tayormadhya ilāvṛtam ||
meaning:
भद्राश्वं पूर्वतो मेरोः केतुमालं च पश्चिमे |
वर्षे द्वे तु मुनिश्रेष्ठ तयोर्मध्य इलावृतम् ||
text_mt: Bhadrāśva is to the east of Meru, and Ketumāla is to the west; / these two are realms, O best of sages, and between them is Ilāvṛta.

sanskrit_iast:
vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ pūrve dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ |
vibhrājaṃ paścime tadvaduttare nandanaṃ smṛtam ||
meaning:
वनं चैत्ररथं पूर्वे दक्षिणे गन्धमादनः |
विभ्राजं पश्चिमे तद्वदुत्तरे नन्दनं स्मृतम् ||
text_mt: The Caitraratha forest is on the east, and Gandhamādana on the south; / similarly, Vibhrāja is on the west, and Nandana is traditionally taught on the north.

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇodaṃ mahābhadraṃ śītodaṃ mānasaṃ smṛtam |
sarāṃsyetāni catvāri devabhogyāni sarvaśaḥ ||
meaning:
अरुणोदं महाभद्रं शीतोदं मानसं स्मृतम् |
सरांस्येतानि चत्वारि देवभोग्यानि सर्वशः ||
text_mt: Aruṇoda, Mahābhadra, Śītoda, and Mānasa are recorded— / these four lakes are enjoyed on all sides by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
śītāñjanaḥ kuruṅgaśca kuraro mālyavāṃstathā |
ekaikapramukhā meroḥ pūrvataḥ kesarācalāḥ ||
meaning:
शीताञ्जनः कुरुङ्गश्च कुररो माल्यवांस्तथा |
एकैकप्रमुखा मेरोः पूर्वतः केसराचलाः ||
text_mt: Śītāñjana, Kuruṅga, Kurara, and Mālyavat, / each standing prominent, are the filament mountains to the east of Meru.

sanskrit_iast:
trikūṭaḥ śiśiraścaiva pataṅgo rucakastathā |
niṣadhaḥ kapilādyāśca dakṣiṇe kesarācalāḥ ||
meaning:
त्रिकूटः शिशिरश्चैव पतङ्गो रुचकस्तथा |
निषधः कपिलाद्याश्च दक्षिणे केसराचलाः ||
text_mt: Trikūṭa, Śiśira, Pataṅga, and Rucaka, / Niṣadha, Kapila, and the others are the filament mountains to the south.

sanskrit_iast:
sinīvāsaḥ kusumbhaśca kapilo nāradastathā |
nāgādayaśca girayaḥ paścime kesarācalāḥ ||
meaning:
सिनीवासः कुसुम्भश्च कपिलो नारदस्तथा |
नागादयश्च गिरयः पश्चिमे केसराचलाः ||
text_mt: Sinīvāsa, Kusumbha, Kapila, Nārada, / and mountains such as Nāga are the filament mountains to the west.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhacūḍo'tha ṛṣabho haṃso nāma mahīdharaḥ |
kālañjarādyāśca tathā uttare kesarācalāḥ ||
meaning:
शङ्खचूडोऽथ ऋषभो हंसो नाम महीधरः |
कालञ्जराद्याश्च तथा उत्तरे केसराचलाः ||
text_mt: Śaṅkhacūḍa, then Ṛṣabha, the mountain named Haṃsa, / and Kālañjara and others are the filament mountains to the north.

sanskrit_iast:
merorupari madhye hi śātakaumbhaṃ vidheḥ puram |
caturdaśasahasrāṇi yojanāni ca saṅkhyayā ||
meaning:
मेरोरुपरि मध्ये हि शातकौम्भं विधेः पुरम् |
चतुर्दशसहस्राणि योजनानि च सङ्ख्यया ||
text_mt: Upon the top and in the middle of Meru is the golden city of Brahmā, / measuring fourteen thousand yojanas in extent.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭānāṃ lokapālānāṃ paritastadanukramāt |
yathādiśaṃ yathārūpaṃ puro'ṣṭāvupakalpitāḥ ||
meaning:
अष्टानां लोकपालानां परितस्तदनुक्रमात् |
यथादिशं यथारूपं पुरोऽष्टावुपकल्पिताः ||
text_mt: All around it, in proper succession for the eight guardians of the world, / eight cities have been fashioned, according to direction and form.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ puryāṃ plāvayitvendumaṇḍalam |
viṣṇupādaviniṣkrāntā gaṅgā patati vai nadī ||
meaning:
तस्यां च ब्रह्मणः पुर्यां प्लावयित्वेन्दुमण्डलम् |
विष्णुपादविनिष्क्रान्ता गङ्गा पतति वै नदी ||
text_mt: And inundating the sphere of the moon, the river Gaṅgā, / issuing from the foot of Viṣṇu, falls into that city of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
sītā cālakanandā ca cakṣurbhadrā ca vai kramāt |
sā tatra patitā dikṣu caturdhā pratyapadyata ||
meaning:
सीता चालकनन्दा च चक्षुर्भद्रा च वै क्रमात् |
सा तत्र पतिता दिक्षु चतुर्धा प्रत्यपद्यत ||
text_mt: Falling there, it divided into four branches toward the directions, in order: / Sītā, Alakanandā, Cakṣu, and Bhadrā.

sanskrit_iast:
sītā pūrveṇa śailaṃ hi nandā caiva tu dakṣiṇe |
sā cakṣuḥ paścime caiva bhadrā cottarato vrajet ||
meaning:
सीता पूर्वेण शैलं हि नन्दा चैव तु दक्षिणे |
सा चक्षुः पश्चिमे चैव भद्रा चोत्तरतो व्रजेत् ||
text_mt: Sītā goes eastward past the mountain, and Nandā indeed to the south; / Cakṣu flows to the west, and Bhadrā to the north.

sanskrit_iast:
girīnatītya sakalāṃścaturdikṣu mahāmbudhim |
sā yayau prayatā bhūtā gaṅgā tripathagāminī ||
meaning:
गिरीनतीत्य सकलांश्चतुर्दिक्षु महाम्बुधिम् |
सा ययौ प्रयता भूता गङ्गा त्रिपथगामिनी ||
text_mt: Crossing all the mountains, reaching the great ocean in the four directions, / the holy Gaṅgā, traversing the three paths, proceeded.

sanskrit_iast:
sunīlaniṣadhau yau tau mālyavadgandhamādanau |
teṣāṃ madhyagato meruḥ karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ ||
meaning:
सुनीलनिषधौ यौ तौ माल्यवद्गन्धमादनौ |
तेषां मध्यगतो मेरुः कर्णिकाकारसंस्थितः ||
text_mt: Between the pair of mountains, the fair Nīla and Niṣadha, and Mālyavat and Gandhamādana, / situated in their midst stands Meru in the shape of a pericarp.

sanskrit_iast:
bhārataḥ ketumālaśca bhadrāśvaḥ kuravastathā |
patrāṇi lokapadmasya maryādālokaparvatāḥ ||
meaning:
भारतः केतुमालश्च भद्राश्वः कुरवस्तथा |
पत्राणि लोकपद्मस्य मर्यादालोकपर्वताः ||
text_mt: Bhārata, Ketumāla, Bhadrāśva, and the Kurus / are the petals of the world-lotus, with the boundary mountains forming their limits.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭharaṃ devakūṭaśca āyāme dakṣiṇottare |
gandhamādanakailāsau pūrvapaścimato gatau ||
meaning:
जठरं देवकूटश्च आयामे दक्षिणोत्तरे |
गन्धमादनकैलासौ पूर्वपश्चिमतो गतौ ||
text_mt: Jaṭhara and Devakūṭa extend north and south, / [while] Gandhamādana and Kailāsa run from east to west.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvapaścimato merorniṣadho nīlaparvataḥ |
dakṣiṇottaramāyātau karṇikāntarvyavasthitau ||
meaning:
पूर्वपश्चिमतो मेरोर्निषधो नीलपर्वतः |
दक्षिणोत्तरमायातौ कर्णिकान्तर्व्यवस्थितौ ||
text_mt: The Niṣadha and Nīla mountains extend east to west of Meru; / stretching north and south, they stand within the pericarp.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭharādyāḥ sthitā meroryeṣāṃ dvau dvau vyavasthitau |
kesarāḥ parvatā ete śvetādyāḥ sumanoramāḥ ||
meaning:
जठराद्याः स्थिता मेरोर्येषां द्वौ द्वौ व्यवस्थितौ |
केसराः पर्वता एते श्वेताद्याः सुमनोरमाः ||
text_mt: Jaṭhara and others are situated around Meru, standing two by two; / these delightful filament mountains are Śveta and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
śailānāmantare droṇyaḥ siddhacāraṇasevitāḥ |
suramyāṇi tathā tāsu kānanāni purāṇi ca ||
meaning:
शैलानामन्तरे द्रोण्यः सिद्धचारणसेविताः |
सुरम्याणि तथा तासु काननानि पुराणि च ||
text_mt: Between the mountains are valleys frequented by Siddhas and Cāraṇas; / and within them are exceedingly charming groves and cities.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ yakṣagandharvarakṣasām |
krīḍanti devadaiteyāḥ śailaprāyeṣvaharniśam ||
meaning:
सर्वेषां चैव देवानां यक्षगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् |
क्रीडन्ति देवदैतेयाः शैलप्रायेष्वहर्निशम् ||
text_mt: Of all the gods, Yakṣas, Gandharvas, and Rakṣasas; / gods and Daiteyas disport day and night throughout these mountainous regions.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmiṇāmālayā hyete bhaumāḥ svargāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
na teṣu pāpakartāro yānti paśyanti kutracit ||
meaning:
धर्मिणामालया ह्येते भौमाः स्वर्गाः प्रकीर्तिताः |
न तेषु पापकर्तारो यान्ति पश्यन्ति कुत्रचित् ||
text_mt: These abodes of the virtuous are indeed celebrated as earthly heavens; / evil-doers never go there, nor do they ever behold them.

sanskrit_iast:
yāni kimpuruṣādīni varṣāṇyaṣṭau mahāmune |
na teṣu śoko nāpattyo nodvegaḥ kṣudbhayādikam ||
meaning:
यानि किम्पुरुषादीनि वर्षाण्यष्टौ महामुने |
न तेषु शोको नापत्त्यो नोद्वेगः क्षुद्भयादिकम् ||
text_mt: In the eight realms beginning with Kimpuruṣa, O great sage, / there is no sorrow, no misfortunes, no distress, nor fear of hunger and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
svasthāḥ prajā nirātaṅkāḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitāḥ |
daśadvādaśavarṣāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi sthirāyuṣaḥ ||
meaning:
स्वस्थाः प्रजा निरातङ्काः सर्वदुःखविवर्जिताः |
दशद्वादशवर्षाणां सहस्राणि स्थिरायुषः ||
text_mt: The inhabitants are healthy, free from anxiety, and devoid of all suffering, / possessing a fixed lifespan of ten to twelve thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtatretādikāścaiva bhaumānyambhāṃsi sarvataḥ |
na teṣu varṣate devasteṣu sthāneṣu kalpanā ||
meaning:
कृतत्रेतादिकाश्चैव भौमान्यम्भांसि सर्वतः |
न तेषु वर्षते देवस्तेषु स्थानेषु कल्पना ||
text_mt: The ages beginning with Kṛta and Tretā [do not affect them], and waters are earthly everywhere; / the god of rain does not rain in them, nor is there such an arrangement in those places.

sanskrit_iast:
saptasveteṣu nadyaśca sujātāḥ svarṇavālukāḥ |
śataśaḥ santi kṣudrāśca tāsu krīḍecchubho janaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
सप्तस्वेतेषु नद्यश्च सुजाताः स्वर्णवालुकाः |
शतशः सन्ति क्षुद्राश्च तासु क्रीडेच्छुभो जनः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
In these seven realms there are well-formed rivers with golden sands, / and hundreds of minor streams, in which auspicious people disport.

Obeisance to the venerable Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
vakṣye'haṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ himādreścaiva dakṣiṇe |
uttare tu samudrasya bhāratī yatra saṃsṛtiḥ ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
वक्ष्येऽहं भारतं वर्षं हिमाद्रेश्चैव दक्षिणे |
उत्तरे तु समुद्रस्य भारती यत्र संसृतिः ||
title: aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | saptadvīpavarṇanam
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / I shall describe the realm of Bhārata, situated to the south of the snow mountain / and to the north of the ocean, where the Bhāratī lineage resides.

sanskrit_iast:
navayojanasāhasro vistāro'sya mahāmune |
svargāpavargayoḥ karmabhūmireṣā smṛtā budhaiḥ ||
meaning:
नवयोजनसाहस्रो विस्तारोऽस्य महामुने |
स्वर्गापवर्गयोः कर्मभूमिरेषा स्मृता बुधैः ||
text_mt: Its extent is nine thousand yojanas, O great sage; / it is known by the wise as the land of action for heaven and final liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ samprāpyate pumbhiḥ svargo naraka eva ca |
bhāratasyāpi varṣasya nava bhedān bravīmi te ||
meaning:
अतः सम्प्राप्यते पुम्भिः स्वर्गो नरक एव च |
भारतस्यापि वर्षस्य नव भेदान् ब्रवीमि ते ||
text_mt: From this land, heaven and hell are attained by men. / I shall also describe to you the nine divisions of the realm of Bhārata:

sanskrit_iast:
indradyumnaḥ kaseruśca tāmravarṇo gabhastimān |
nāgadvīpastathā saumyo gandharvastvatha vāruṇaḥ ||
meaning:
इन्द्रद्युम्नः कसेरुश्च ताम्रवर्णो गभस्तिमान् |
नागद्वीपस्तथा सौम्यो गन्धर्वस्त्वथ वारुणः ||
text_mt: Indradyumna, Kaseru, Tāmravarṇa, Gabhastimat, / Nāgadvīpa, Saumya, Gandharva, and Vāruṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ tu navamasteṣāṃ dvīpaḥ sāgarasambhṛtaḥ |
yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu dvīpo'yaṃ dakṣiṇottaraḥ ||
meaning:
अयं तु नवमस्तेषां द्वीपः सागरसम्भृतः |
योजनानां सहस्रं तु द्वीपोऽयं दक्षिणोत्तरः ||
text_mt: And this ninth among them is the dvīpa surrounded by the ocean; / stretching north to south, this dvīpa extends for a thousand yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrve kirātā yasya syurdakṣiṇe yavanāḥ sthitāḥ |
paścime ca tathā jñeyā uttare hi tapasvinaḥ ||
meaning:
पूर्वे किराता यस्य स्युर्दक्षिणे यवनाः स्थिताः |
पश्चिमे च तथा ज्ञेया उत्तरे हि तपस्विनः ||
text_mt: On its east dwell the Kirātas; on the south dwell the Yavanas; / they are known likewise in the west, and in the north are ascetics.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā madhye śūdrāśca bhūyaśaḥ |
ijyāyuddhapaṇāsevā vartayanto vyavasthitāḥ ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्या मध्ये शूद्राश्च भूयशः |
इज्यायुद्धपणासेवा वर्तयन्तो व्यवस्थिताः ||
text_mt: In the middle dwell Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas, and mostly Śūdras, / maintaining their livelihood through sacrifice, warfare, trade, and service.

sanskrit_iast:
mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ sudāmā carkṣaparvataḥ |
vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca saptātra kulaparvatāḥ ||
meaning:
महेन्द्रो मलयः सह्यः सुदामा चर्क्षपर्वतः |
विन्ध्यश्च पारियात्रश्च सप्तात्र कुलपर्वताः ||
text_mt: Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Sudāman, and the Ṛkṣa mountain, / Vindhya, and Pāriyātra: these seven are the principal mountain ranges here.

sanskrit_iast:
vedasmṛtipurāṇādyāḥ pāriyātrodbhavā mune |
sarvapāpaharā jñeyā darśanātsparśanādapi ||
meaning:
वेदस्मृतिपुराणाद्याः पारियात्रोद्भवा मुने |
सर्वपापहरा ज्ञेया दर्शनात्स्पर्शनादपि ||
text_mt: The rivers Vedasmṛti, Purāṇā, and others, originating from Pāriyātra, O sage, / are known to remove all sins merely through seeing or touching them.

sanskrit_iast:
narmadā surasādyāśca saptānyāśca sahasraśaḥ |
vindhyodbhavā mahānadyaḥ sarvapāpaharāḥ śubhāḥ ||
meaning:
नर्मदा सुरसाद्याश्च सप्तान्याश्च सहस्रशः |
विन्ध्योद्भवा महानद्यः सर्वपापहराः शुभाः ||
text_mt: The Narmadā, Surasā, and others, seven and thousands of others, / are the great auspicious rivers born of the Vindhya that remove all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
godāvarībhīmarathītāpīpramukhanimnagāḥ |
girervinirgatā ṛkṣātsadyaḥ pāpabhayāpahāḥ ||
meaning:
गोदावरीभीमरथीतापीप्रमुखनिम्नगाः |
गिरेर्विनिर्गता ऋक्षात्सद्यः पापभयापहाः ||
text_mt: The rivers headed by Godāvarī, Bhīmarathī, and Tāpī, / issuing from the Ṛkṣa mountain, immediately destroy the fear of sin.

sanskrit_iast:
sahyapādodbhavā nadyaḥ kṛṣṇāveṇyādikāstathā |
kṛtamālātāmraparṇīpramukhā malayodbhavāḥ ||
meaning:
सह्यपादोद्भवा नद्यः कृष्णावेण्यादिकास्तथा |
कृतमालाताम्रपर्णीप्रमुखा मलयोद्भवाः ||
text_mt: The rivers arising from the slopes of the Sahya are the Kṛṣṇā, Veṇī, and others; / those headed by Kṛtamālā and Tāmraparṇī originate from Malaya.

sanskrit_iast:
triyāmā carṣikulyādyā mahendraprabhavāḥ smṛtāḥ |
ṛṣikulyā kumāryādyāḥ śuktimatpādasambhavāḥ ||
meaning:
त्रियामा चर्षिकुल्याद्या महेन्द्रप्रभवाः स्मृताः |
ऋषिकुल्या कुमार्याद्याः शुक्तिमत्पादसम्भवाः ||
text_mt: Triyāmā, Ṛṣikulyā, and others are taught to be born of Mahendra; / Ṛṣikulyā, Kumārī, and others originate from the slopes of Śuktimat.

sanskrit_iast:
nānājanapadāsteṣu maṇḍaleṣu vasanti vai |
āsāṃ pibanti pānīyaṃ saraḥsu vividheṣu ca ||
meaning:
नानाजनपदास्तेषु मण्डलेषु वसन्ति वै |
आसां पिबन्ति पानीयं सरःसु विविधेषु च ||
text_mt: Various peoples live across these regions; / they drink the water of these rivers and from diverse lakes.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāri bhārate varṣe yugānyāsan mahāmune |
kṛtādīni na cānyeṣu dvīpeṣu prabhavanti hi ||
meaning:
चत्वारि भारते वर्षे युगान्यासन् महामुने |
कृतादीनि न चान्येषु द्वीपेषु प्रभवन्ति हि ||
text_mt: There are four cosmic ages in the realm of Bhārata, O great sage, / beginning with Kṛta; they do not prevail in the other continents.

sanskrit_iast:
dānāni cātra dīyante sukṛtaiścātra yājñikaiḥ |
tapastapanti yatayaḥ paralokārthamādarāt ||
meaning:
दानानि चात्र दीयन्ते सुकृतैश्चात्र याज्ञिकैः |
तपस्तपन्ति यतयः परलोकार्थमादरात् ||
text_mt: Gifts are given here by righteous sacrificers, / and ascetics zealously practice austerity for the sake of the next world.

sanskrit_iast:
yato hi karmabhūreṣā jambūdvīpe mahāmune |
atrāpi bhārataṃ śreṣṭhamato'nyā bhogabhūmayaḥ ||
meaning:
यतो हि कर्मभूरेषा जम्बूद्वीपे महामुने |
अत्रापि भारतं श्रेष्ठमतोऽन्या भोगभूमयः ||
text_mt: Because this is the land of action in Jambūdvīpa, O great sage, / even within it, Bhārata is the most supreme; the others are lands of enjoyment.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācillabhate martyaḥ sahasrairmunisattama |
atra janmasahasrāṇāṃ mānuṣyaṃ puṇyasañcayaiḥ ||
meaning:
कदाचिल्लभते मर्त्यः सहस्रैर्मुनिसत्तम |
अत्र जन्मसहस्राणां मानुष्यं पुण्यसञ्चयैः ||
text_mt: O best of sages, after thousands of births, through accumulations of merit, / a mortal may sometimes obtain human birth here.

sanskrit_iast:
svargāpavargāspadamārgabhūte dhanyāstu te bhāratabhūmibhāge |
gāyanti devāḥ kila gītakāni bhavanti bhūyaḥ puruṣāḥ surāste ||
meaning:
स्वर्गापवर्गास्पदमार्गभूते धन्यास्तु ते भारतभूमिभागे |
गायन्ति देवाः किल गीतकानि भवन्ति भूयः पुरुषाः सुरास्ते ||
text_mt: Blessed indeed are those on the soil of Bhārata, which is the path to heaven and final liberation! / Truly, the gods sing songs [saying]: 'May we gods become men there once more!'

sanskrit_iast:
vihṛtya śambhoḥ paramātmarūpe |
phalāni sarvāṇi tu karmajāni yāsyāmyahaṃ tattanutāṃ hi tasya ||
meaning:
विहृत्य शम्भोः परमात्मरूपे |
फलानि सर्वाणि तु कर्मजानि यास्याम्यहं तत्तनुतां हि तस्य ||
text_mt: Having sported in the supreme spiritual form of Śambhu, / [and having enjoyed] all fruits arising from actions, I shall certainly attain oneness with his body.

sanskrit_iast:
āpsyanti dhanyāḥ khalu te manuṣyāḥ sukhairyutāḥ karmaṇi sanniviṣṭāḥ |
janurhi yeṣāṃ khalu bhārate'sti te svargamokṣobhayalābhavantaḥ ||
meaning:
आप्स्यन्ति धन्याः खलु ते मनुष्याः सुखैर्युताः कर्मणि सन्निविष्टाः |
जनुर्हि येषां खलु भारतेऽस्ति ते स्वर्गमोक्षोभयलाभवन्तः ||
text_mt: Blessed indeed are those men who will attain [it], endowed with joys, devoted to action; / those who indeed have their birth in Bhārata possess the attainment of both heaven and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣayojanavistāraḥ samastaparimaṇḍalaḥ |
jambūdvīpo mayā khyātaḥ kṣārodadhisusaṃvṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
लक्षयोजनविस्तारः समस्तपरिमण्डलः |
जम्बूद्वीपो मया ख्यातः क्षारोदधिसुसंवृतः ||
text_mt: Extending for a hundred thousand yojanas, circular in its entirety, / Jambūdvīpa has been described by me, closely surrounded by the salt ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃveṣṭya kṣāramudadhiṃ śatasāhasrasammitam |
tato hi dviguṇo brahman plakṣadvīpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
meaning:
संवेष्ट्य क्षारमुदधिं शतसाहस्रसम्मितम् |
ततो हि द्विगुणो ब्रह्मन् प्लक्षद्वीपः प्रकीर्तितः ||
text_mt: Surrounding the salt ocean, which measures a hundred thousand [yojanas], / twice that size, O sage, Plakṣadvīpa is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
gomantaścaiva candraśca nārado dardurastathā |
somakaḥ sumanāḥ śailo vaibhrājaścaiva sattamaḥ ||
meaning:
गोमन्तश्चैव चन्द्रश्च नारदो दर्दुरस्तथा |
सोमकः सुमनाः शैलो वैभ्राजश्चैव सत्तमः ||
text_mt: Gomanta, Candra, Nārada, Dardura, / Somaka, the mountain Sumanas, and Vaibhrāja, the best—

sanskrit_iast:
varṣācaleṣu ramyeṣu sahitāḥ satataṃ prajāḥ |
vasanti devagandharvā varṣeṣveteṣu nityaśaḥ ||
meaning:
वर्षाचलेषु रम्येषु सहिताः सततं प्रजाः |
वसन्ति देवगन्धर्वा वर्षेष्वेतेषु नित्यशः ||
text_mt: on these charming boundary mountains the subjects constantly live together; / gods and Gandharvas dwell continually in these divisions.

sanskrit_iast:
nādhayo vyādhayo vāpi janānāṃ tatra kutracit |
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi tatra jīvanti mānavāḥ ||
meaning:
नाधयो व्याधयो वापि जनानां तत्र कुत्रचित् |
दश वर्षसहस्राणि तत्र जीवन्ति मानवाः ||
text_mt: There are neither mental anxieties nor bodily diseases anywhere for the people there; / men live there for ten thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
anutaptā śikhī caiva pāpaghnī tridivā kṛpā |
amṛtā sukṛtā caiva saptaivātra ca nimnagāḥ ||
meaning:
अनुतप्ता शिखी चैव पापघ्नी त्रिदिवा कृपा |
अमृता सुकृता चैव सप्तैवात्र च निम्नगाः ||
text_mt: Anutaptā, Śikhī, Pāpaghnī, Tridivā, Kṛpā, / Amṛtā, and Sukṛtā: these are the seven rivers here.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudranadyastathā śailāstatra santi sahasraśaḥ |
tāḥ pibanti susaṃhṛṣṭā nadīrjanapadāstu te ||
meaning:
क्षुद्रनद्यस्तथा शैलास्तत्र सन्ति सहस्रशः |
ताः पिबन्ति सुसंहृष्टा नदीर्जनपदास्तु ते ||
text_mt: There are minor rivers as well, and mountains there by the thousands; / those inhabitants of the land, greatly delighted, drink [from] these rivers.

sanskrit_iast:
na tatrāpi yugāvasthā yathā sthāneṣu saptasu |
tretāyugasamaḥ kālaḥ sarvadaiva mahāmune ||
meaning:
न तत्रापि युगावस्था यथा स्थानेषु सप्तसु |
त्रेतायुगसमः कालः सर्वदैव महामुने ||
text_mt: Nor is there any condition of the yugas there, as in the seven places; / the time is always equal to the Tretāyuga, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
viprakṣatriyavaiśyāste śūdrāśca munisattama |
kalpavṛkṣasamānastu tanmadhye sumahātaruḥ ||
meaning:
विप्रक्षत्रियवैश्यास्ते शूद्राश्च मुनिसत्तम |
कल्पवृक्षसमानस्तु तन्मध्ये सुमहातरुः ||
text_mt: There are Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras, O best of sages; / and resembling the wishing-tree, there is a very great tree in its center,

sanskrit_iast:
plakṣastannāmasaṃjño vai plakṣadvīpo dvijottama |
ijyate tatra bhagavān śaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ ||
meaning:
प्लक्षस्तन्नामसंज्ञो वै प्लक्षद्वीपो द्विजोत्तम |
इज्यते तत्र भगवान् शङ्करो लोकशङ्करः ||
text_mt: a plakṣa tree, after which it is called Plakṣadvīpa, O best of the twice-born. / There Lord Śaṅkara, the bringer of auspiciousness to the worlds, is worshipped,

sanskrit_iast:
hariśca bhagavān brahmā yantrairmantraiśca vaidikaiḥ |
saṅkṣepeṇa tathā bhūyaḥ śālmaliṃ tvaṃ niśāmaya ||
meaning:
हरिश्च भगवान् ब्रह्मा यन्त्रैर्मन्त्रैश्च वैदिकैः |
सङ्क्षेपेण तथा भूयः शाल्मलिं त्वं निशामय ||
text_mt: and Lord Hari and Brahmā, through Vedic yantras and mantras. / In brief, hear again from me about Śālmalidvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
saptavarṣāṇi tatraiva teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu |
śveto'tha haritaścaiva jīmūto rohitastathā ||
meaning:
सप्तवर्षाणि तत्रैव तेषां नामानि मे शृणु |
श्वेतोऽथ हरितश्चैव जीमूतो रोहितस्तथा ||
text_mt: There are seven divisions right there; hear their names from me: / Śveta, Harita, Jīmūta, Rohita,

sanskrit_iast:
vaikalo mānasaścaiva suprabhaḥ saptamo mune |
śālmalena tu vṛkṣeṇa dvīpaḥ śālmalisaṃjñakaḥ ||
meaning:
वैकलो मानसश्चैव सुप्रभः सप्तमो मुने |
शाल्मलेन तु वृक्षेण द्वीपः शाल्मलिसंज्ञकः ||
text_mt: Vaikala, Mānasa, and Suprabha as the seventh, O sage. / By virtue of the śālmali tree, the continent is named Śālmalidvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇena samudreṇa satataṃ saṃvṛtaḥ sthitaḥ |
varṣābhivyañjakā nadyastāsāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu ||
meaning:
द्विगुणेन समुद्रेण सततं संवृतः स्थितः |
वर्षाभिव्यञ्जका नद्यस्तासां नामानि मे शृणु ||
text_mt: It stands perpetually surrounded by an ocean twice its size; / hear from me the names of the rivers that delineate the divisions:

sanskrit_iast:
śuklā raktā hiraṇyā ca candrā śubhrā vimocanā |
nivṛttiḥ saptamī tāsāṃ puṇyatoyāḥ suśītalāḥ ||
meaning:
शुक्ला रक्ता हिरण्या च चन्द्रा शुभ्रा विमोचना |
निवृत्तिः सप्तमी तासां पुण्यतोयाः सुशीतलाः ||
text_mt: Śuklā, Raktā, Hiraṇyā, Candrā, Śubhrā, Vimocanā, / and Nivṛtti is the seventh of them, having holy waters, very cool.

sanskrit_iast:
saptaiva tāni varṣāṇi caturvarṇairyutāni ca |
bhagavantaṃ sadā śambhuṃ yajante vividhairmakhaiḥ ||
meaning:
सप्तैव तानि वर्षाणि चतुर्वर्णैर्युतानि च |
भगवन्तं सदा शम्भुं यजन्ते विविधैर्मखैः ||
text_mt: Those seven divisions, populated by the four social classes, / continually worship Lord Śambhu with diverse sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ tatra sānnidhyamatīva sumanorame |
eṣa dvīpaḥ samudreṇa surodena samāvṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
देवानां तत्र सान्निध्यमतीव सुमनोरमे |
एष द्वीपः समुद्रेण सुरोदेन समावृतः ||
text_mt: The presence of the gods is exceedingly delightful there. / This continent is surrounded by an ocean of wine,

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇena kuśadvīpaḥ samantād bāhyataḥ sthitaḥ |
vasanti tatra daiteyā manujaiḥ saha dānavāḥ ||
meaning:
द्विगुणेन कुशद्वीपः समन्ताद् बाह्यतः स्थितः |
वसन्ति तत्र दैतेया मनुजैः सह दानवाः ||
text_mt: twice its size, outside of which lies Kuśadvīpa all around. / There the Daiteyas live together with mortals and Dānavas,

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva devagandharvā yakṣāḥ kimpuruṣādayaḥ |
varṇāstatraiva catvāro nijānuṣṭhānatatparāḥ ||
meaning:
तथैव देवगन्धर्वा यक्षाः किम्पुरुषादयः |
वर्णास्तत्रैव चत्वारो निजानुष्ठानतत्पराः ||
text_mt: as do gods, Gandharvas, Yakṣas, Kimpuruṣas, and others. / The four social classes right there are dedicated to their own rituals.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva ca kuśadvīpe brahmāṇaṃ ca janārdanam |
yajanti ca tatheśānaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ||
meaning:
तत्रैव च कुशद्वीपे ब्रह्माणं च जनार्दनम् |
यजन्ति च तथेशानं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ||
text_mt: Right there in Kuśadvīpa, they worship Brahmā, Janārdana, / and likewise Īśāna, the bestower of the fruits of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśeśayo hariścaiva dyutimān puṣpavāṃstathā |
maṇidrumo hemaśailaḥ saptamo mandarācalaḥ ||
meaning:
कुशेशयो हरिश्चैव द्युतिमान् पुष्पवांस्तथा |
मणिद्रुमो हेमशैलः सप्तमो मन्दराचलः ||
text_mt: Kuśeśaya, Hari, Dyutimān, Puṣpavān, / Maṇidruma, Hemaśaila, and Mount Mandara is the seventh.

sanskrit_iast:
nadyaśca sapta tāsāṃ tu nāmāni śṛṇu tattvataḥ |
dhūtapāpā śivā caiva pavitrā sammitistathā ||
meaning:
नद्यश्च सप्त तासां तु नामानि शृणु तत्त्वतः |
धूतपापा शिवा चैव पवित्रा सम्मितिस्तथा ||
text_mt: And there are seven rivers; hear their names in truth: / Dhūtapāpā, Śivā, Pavitrā, Sammiti,

sanskrit_iast:
vidyā dambhā mahī cānyā sarvapāpaharāstvimāḥ |
anyāḥ sahasraśaḥ santi śubhāpo hemavālukāḥ ||
meaning:
विद्या दम्भा मही चान्या सर्वपापहरास्त्विमाः |
अन्याः सहस्रशः सन्ति शुभापो हेमवालुकाः ||
text_mt: Vidyā, Dambhā, and another, Mahī; these destroy all sins. / There are thousands of others, with auspicious waters and golden sands.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśadvīpe kuśastambo ghṛtodena samāvṛtaḥ |
krauñcadvīpo mahābhāga śrūyatāṃ cāparo mahān ||
meaning:
कुशद्वीपे कुशस्तम्बो घृतोदेन समावृतः |
क्रौञ्चद्वीपो महाभाग श्रूयतां चापरो महान् ||
text_mt: In Kuśadvīpa there is a clump of kuśa grass; it is surrounded by an ocean of clarified butter. / Hear now of another great one, Krauñcadvīpa, O noble one,

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇena samudreṇa dadhimaṇḍena cāvṛtaḥ |
varṣācalā mahābuddhe teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu ||
meaning:
द्विगुणेन समुद्रेण दधिमण्डेन चावृतः |
वर्षाचला महाबुद्धे तेषां नामानि मे शृणु ||
text_mt: surrounded by an ocean of curd-fluid twice its size. / Hear from me the names of the boundary mountains, O one of great intellect:

sanskrit_iast:
krauñcaśca vāmanaścaiva tṛtīyaścāndhakārakaḥ |
divāvṛtirmanaścaiva puṇḍarīkaśca dundubhiḥ ||
meaning:
क्रौञ्चश्च वामनश्चैव तृतीयश्चान्धकारकः |
दिवावृतिर्मनश्चैव पुण्डरीकश्च दुन्दुभिः ||
text_mt: Krauñca, Vāmana, Andhakāraka the third, / Divāvṛti, Manas, Puṇḍarīka, and Dundubhi.

sanskrit_iast:
nivasanti nirātaṅkā varṣaśaileṣu teṣu vai |
sarvasauvarṇaramyeṣu suhṛddevagaṇaiḥ prajāḥ ||
meaning:
निवसन्ति निरातङ्का वर्षशैलेषु तेषु वै |
सर्वसौवर्णरम्येषु सुहृद्देवगणैः प्रजाः ||
text_mt: Free from fear, on those boundary mountains / that are all golden and charming, the subjects live with groups of friendly gods.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścānukramoditāḥ |
santi tatra mahānadyaḥ saptānyāstu sahasraśaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्राश्चानुक्रमोदिताः |
सन्ति तत्र महानद्यः सप्तान्यास्तु सहस्रशः ||
text_mt: Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras are declared in succession. / There are seven great rivers there, and others by the thousands:

sanskrit_iast:
gaurī kumudvatī caiva sandhyā rātrirmanojavā |
śāntiśca puṇḍarīkā ca yāḥ pibanti payaḥ śubham ||
meaning:
गौरी कुमुद्वती चैव सन्ध्या रात्रिर्मनोजवा |
शान्तिश्च पुण्डरीका च याः पिबन्ति पयः शुभम् ||
text_mt: Gaurī, Kumudvatī, Sandhyā, Rātri, Manojavā, / Śānti, and Puṇḍarīkā, whose auspicious waters they drink.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavān pūjyate tatra yogarudrasvarūpavān |
dadhimaṇḍodakaścāpi śākadvīpena saṃvṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
भगवान् पूज्यते तत्र योगरुद्रस्वरूपवान् |
दधिमण्डोदकश्चापि शाकद्वीपेन संवृतः ||
text_mt: The Lord in the form of Yogarudra is worshipped there. / The ocean of curd-fluid is also surrounded by Śākadvīpa,

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇenādrayaḥ sapta teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu |
pūrve tatrodayagirirjaladhāraḥ pare yataḥ ||
meaning:
द्विगुणेनाद्रयः सप्त तेषां नामानि मे शृणु |
पूर्वे तत्रोदयगिरिर्जलधारः परे यतः ||
text_mt: twice its size. There are seven mountains; hear their names from me: / In the east there is the mountain of sunrise, Jaladhāra, beyond which—

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭhato'stagiriścaiva hyavikeśaśca kesarī |
śākastatra mahāvṛkṣaḥ siddhagandharvasevitaḥ ||
meaning:
पृष्ठतोऽस्तगिरिश्चैव ह्यविकेशश्च केसरी |
शाकस्तत्र महावृक्षः सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितः ||
text_mt: behind it is the mountain of sunset, as well as Avikeśa and Kesarī. / There stands the great śāka tree, attended by Siddhas and Gandharvas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra puṇyā janapadāścāturvarṇyasamanvitāḥ |
nadyaścātra mahāpuṇyāḥ sarvapāpabhayāpahāḥ ||
meaning:
तत्र पुण्या जनपदाश्चातुर्वर्ण्यसमन्विताः |
नद्यश्चात्र महापुण्याः सर्वपापभयापहाः ||
text_mt: There are holy territories endowed with the four social classes, / and there are most sacred rivers that take away fear of all sins:

sanskrit_iast:
sukumārī kumārī ca nalinī veṇukā tathā |
ikṣuśca reṇukā caiva gabhastiḥ saptamī tathā ||
meaning:
सुकुमारी कुमारी च नलिनी वेणुका तथा |
इक्षुश्च रेणुका चैव गभस्तिः सप्तमी तथा ||
text_mt: Sukumārī, Kumārī, Nalinī, Veṇukā, / Ikṣu, Reṇukā, and Gabhastī the seventh.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāḥ sahasraśastatra kṣudranadyo mahāmune |
mahīdharāstathā santi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ||
meaning:
अन्याः सहस्रशस्तत्र क्षुद्रनद्यो महामुने |
महीधरास्तथा सन्ति शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ||
text_mt: There are thousands of other minor rivers there, O great sage; / likewise there are mountains by the hundreds and thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmahānirna teṣvasti svargādāgatya mānavāḥ |
varṣeṣu teṣu pṛthivīṃ viharanti parasparam ||
meaning:
धर्महानिर्न तेष्वस्ति स्वर्गादागत्य मानवाः |
वर्षेषु तेषु पृथिवीं विहरन्ति परस्परम् ||
text_mt: There is no decline of dharma among them; having descended from heaven, / men sport with one another on the earth in those divisions.

sanskrit_iast:
śākadvīpe tu vai sūryaḥ prītyā janapadaiḥ sadā |
yathoktairijyate samyakkarmabhirniyatātmabhiḥ ||
meaning:
शाकद्वीपे तु वै सूर्यः प्रीत्या जनपदैः सदा |
यथोक्तैरिज्यते सम्यक्कर्मभिर्नियतात्मभिः ||
text_mt: In Śākadvīpa, the sun is always worshipped with love by the inhabitants of the land / properly through the prescribed rites, their minds self-controlled.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrodenāvṛtaḥ so'pi dviguṇena samantataḥ |
kṣīrābdhiḥ sarvato vyāsa puṣkarākhyena saṃvṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
क्षीरोदेनावृतः सोऽपि द्विगुणेन समन्ततः |
क्षीराब्धिः सर्वतो व्यास पुष्कराख्येन संवृतः ||
text_mt: That too is surrounded all around by the ocean of milk, twice its size. / The ocean of milk, O Vyāsa, is surrounded on all sides by that named Puṣkara,

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇena mahāvarṣastatra khyāto'tra mānasaḥ |
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi ūrdhvaṃ pañcāśaducchritaḥ ||
meaning:
द्विगुणेन महावर्षस्तत्र ख्यातोऽत्र मानसः |
योजनानां सहस्राणि ऊर्ध्वं पञ्चाशदुच्छ्रितः ||
text_mt: twice its size. Famous there is the great mountain range Mānasa, / rising fifty thousand yojanas high.

sanskrit_iast:
tāni caiva tu lakṣāṇi sarvato valayākṛtiḥ |
puṣkaradvīpavalayaṃ madhyena vibhajanniva ||
meaning:
तानि चैव तु लक्षाणि सर्वतो वलयाकृतिः |
पुष्करद्वीपवलयं मध्येन विभजन्निव ||
text_mt: It is circular on all sides for just as many hundred thousands [of yojanas], / as if dividing the ring of Puṣkaradvīpa through the middle.

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva valayākārā dvīpavarṣasamākṛtiḥ |
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tatra jīvanti mānavāḥ ||
meaning:
तेनैव वलयाकारा द्वीपवर्षसमाकृतिः |
दशवर्षसहस्राणि तत्र जीवन्ति मानवाः ||
text_mt: By that very mountain, the shape of the continent and division is made circular. / Men live there for ten thousand years,

sanskrit_iast:
nirāmayā vītaśokā rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ |
adharmo na matasteṣāṃ na bandhavadhakau mune ||
meaning:
निरामया वीतशोका रागद्वेषविवर्जिताः |
अधर्मो न मतस्तेषां न बन्धवधकौ मुने ||
text_mt: free from disease, rid of sorrow, devoid of passion and hatred. / Adharma is not acknowledged by them, nor is there imprisonment or slaughter, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
satyānṛte na tasyāstāṃ sadaiva vasatiḥ sadā |
tulyaveṣāstu manujā hemavarṇaikarūpiṇaḥ ||
meaning:
सत्यानृते न तस्यास्तां सदैव वसतिः सदा |
तुल्यवेषास्तु मनुजा हेमवर्णैकरूपिणः ||
text_mt: Truth and falsehood do not exist there; their dwelling is ever peaceful; / men wear identical garments, of a single golden hue.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣaścāyaṃ tu kāleya bhaumaḥ svargopamopamaḥ |
sarvasya sukhadaḥ kālo jarārogavivarjitaḥ ||
meaning:
वर्षश्चायं तु कालेय भौमः स्वर्गोपमोपमः |
सर्वस्य सुखदः कालो जरारोगविवर्जितः ||
text_mt: This division is indeed of the nature of time, an earthly counterpart of heaven; / the time bestows happiness on everyone, free from old age and disease.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkare dhātakīkhaṇḍe mahāvīte mahāmune |
nyagrodhaṃ puṣkaradvīpe brahmaṇaḥ sthānamuttamam ||
meaning:
पुष्करे धातकीखण्डे महावीते महामुने |
न्यग्रोधं पुष्करद्वीपे ब्रह्मणः स्थानमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: In Puṣkara, in Dhātakīkhaṇḍa, and in Mahāvīta, O great sage; / in Puṣkaradvīpa stands the banyan tree, the supreme abode of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnivasate brahmā pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ |
svādūdakenāmbudhinā puṣkaraḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्निवसते ब्रह्मा पूज्यमानः सुरासुरैः |
स्वादूदकेनाम्बुधिना पुष्करः परिवेष्टितः ||
text_mt: In it dwells Brahmā, worshipped by gods and demons. / Puṣkara is encircled by the ocean of sweet water.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dvīpāḥ samudraistu sapta saptabhirāvṛtāḥ |
dvīpāścaiva samudrāśca samānā dviguṇaiḥ paraiḥ ||
meaning:
एवं द्वीपाः समुद्रैस्तु सप्त सप्तभिरावृताः |
द्वीपाश्चैव समुद्राश्च समाना द्विगुणैः परैः ||
text_mt: In this way the seven continents are enclosed by the seven oceans; / the continents and oceans are equal [in width], each subsequent one being twice [the size of the preceding].

sanskrit_iast:
uktātiriktatā teṣāṃ samudreṣu samāni vai |
payāṃsi sarvadālpatvaṃ jāyante na kadācana ||
meaning:
उक्तातिरिक्तता तेषां समुद्रेषु समानि वै |
पयांसि सर्वदाल्पत्वं जायन्ते न कदाचन ||
text_mt: The waters in the oceans are indeed equal, despite what was said about their variation; / they never decrease in quantity at any time.

sanskrit_iast:
sthālīsthamagnisaṃyogādadhaḥsthaṃ munisattama |
tathenduvṛddhau salilamūrdhvagaṃ bhavati dhruvam ||
meaning:
स्थालीस्थमग्निसंयोगादधःस्थं मुनिसत्तम |
तथेन्दुवृद्धौ सलिलमूर्ध्वगं भवति ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: Just as the water at the bottom of a pot rises when in contact with fire, O best of sages, / so indeed does the water rise up with the waxing of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
udayāstamane tvindorvardhantyāpo hrasanti ca |
ato nyūnātiriktāśca pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ ||
meaning:
उदयास्तमने त्विन्दोर्वर्धन्त्यापो ह्रसन्ति च |
अतो न्यूनातिरिक्ताश्च पक्षयोः शुक्लकृष्णयोः ||
text_mt: At the rising and setting of the moon, the waters increase and diminish; / hence they vary in quantity during the bright and dark fortnights.

sanskrit_iast:
apāṃ vṛddhikṣayau dṛṣṭau śataśastu daśottaram |
samudrāṇāṃ muniśreṣṭha sarveṣāṃ kathitaṃ tava ||
meaning:
अपां वृद्धिक्षयौ दृष्टौ शतशस्तु दशोत्तरम् |
समुद्राणां मुनिश्रेष्ठ सर्वेषां कथितं तव ||
text_mt: The increase and decrease of the waters has been observed to be one hundred and ten [aṅgulas]; / this has been related to you, O best of sages, for all the oceans.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojanaṃ puṣkaradvīpe prajāḥ sarvāḥ sadaiva hi |
khaṇḍasya kurvate vipra tatra svayamupasthitam ||
meaning:
भोजनं पुष्करद्वीपे प्रजाः सर्वाः सदैव हि |
खण्डस्य कुर्वते विप्र तत्र स्वयमुपस्थितम् ||
text_mt: In Puṣkaradvīpa all the subjects always take food / of that region, O twice-born, which is readily present by itself.

sanskrit_iast:
svādūdakasya purato nāsti lokasya saṃsthitiḥ |
sauvarṇī dviguṇā bhūmiḥ sarvajantuvivarjitā ||
meaning:
स्वादूदकस्य पुरतो नास्ति लोकस्य संस्थितिः |
सौवर्णी द्विगुणा भूमिः सर्वजन्तुविवर्जिता ||
text_mt: Beyond the ocean of sweet water there is no habitation of living beings; / there lies the golden land, twice in extent, devoid of all creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
lokālokastataḥ śailaḥ sahasrāṇyacalo hi saḥ |
ucchrayeṇa hi tāvanti yojanāyutavistṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
लोकालोकस्ततः शैलः सहस्राण्यचलो हि सः |
उच्छ्रयेण हि तावन्ति योजनायुतविस्तृतः ||
text_mt: Beyond that is the Lokāloka mountain; that mountain extends for thousands [of yojanas], / being as many [thousands] in height, and ten thousand yojanas in breadth.

sanskrit_iast:
tamaścāṇḍakaṭāhena seyamurvī mahāmune |
pañcāśatkoṭivistārā sadvīpā samahīdharā ||
meaning:
तमश्चाण्डकटाहेन सेयमुर्वी महामुने |
पञ्चाशत्कोटिविस्तारा सद्वीपा समहीधरा ||
text_mt: Enclosed by the cosmic shell is darkness, and this earth, O great sage, / fifty crores [of yojanas] in extent, with its continents and mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhārabhūtā sarveṣāṃ sarvabhūtaguṇādhikā |
seyaṃ dhātrī ca kāleya sarveṣāṃ jagatāmilā ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
आधारभूता सर्वेषां सर्वभूतगुणाधिका |
सेयं धात्री च कालेय सर्वेषां जगतामिला ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
She is the support of all, possessing an abundance of the qualities of all elements; / this is the earth, O Kāleya, the nurse of all the worlds.

Homage to glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
ravicandramasoryāvanmayūkhā bhāsayanti hi |
tāvatpramāṇā pṛthivī bhūlokaḥ sa tu gīyate ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
रविचन्द्रमसोर्यावन्मयूखा भासयन्ति हि |
तावत्प्रमाणा पृथिवी भूलोकः स तु गीयते ||
title: ekonaviśo'dhyāyaḥ | lokavarṇanam
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / As far as the rays of the sun and the moon illuminate, / so great is the extent of the earth, and that is called Bhūloka.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmeryojanalakṣe tu saṃsthitaṃ ravimaṇḍalam |
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi sadaiva parisaṅkhyayā ||
meaning:
भूमेर्योजनलक्षे तु संस्थितं रविमण्डलम् |
योजनानां सहस्राणि सदैव परिसङ्ख्यया ||
text_mt: At a hundred thousand yojanas from the earth is situated the disc of the sun, / measuring always thousands of yojanas in circumference.

sanskrit_iast:
śaśinastu pramāṇāya jagataḥ paricakṣate |
raverūrdhvaṃ śaśī tasthau lakṣayojanasaṅkhyayā ||
meaning:
शशिनस्तु प्रमाणाय जगतः परिचक्षते |
रवेरूर्ध्वं शशी तस्थौ लक्षयोजनसङ्ख्यया ||
text_mt: The extent of the moon they declare to be twice that; / above the sun stands the moon at a distance of a hundred thousand yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
grahāṇāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vidhorupari saṃsthitam |
sanakṣatraṃ sahasrāṇi daśaiva paritopari ||
meaning:
ग्रहाणां मण्डलं कृत्स्नं विधोरुपरि संस्थितम् |
सनक्षत्रं सहस्राणि दशैव परितोपरि ||
text_mt: The entire orb of the planets is situated above the moon, / together with the constellations, ten thousand [yojanas] all around above it.

sanskrit_iast:
budhastasmādatho kāvyastasmādbhaumasya maṇḍalam |
bṛhaspatistadūrdhvaṃ tu tasyopari śanaiścaraḥ ||
meaning:
बुधस्तस्मादथो काव्यस्तस्माद्भौमस्य मण्डलम् |
बृहस्पतिस्तदूर्ध्वं तु तस्योपरि शनैश्चरः ||
text_mt: Beyond that is Mercury, then Venus; beyond that is the orb of Mars; / Jupiter is above that, and above him is Saturn.

sanskrit_iast:
saptarṣimaṇḍalaṃ tasmāllakṣeṇaikena saṃsthitam |
ṛṣibhyastu sahasrāṇāṃ śatādūrdhvaṃ dhruvaḥ sthitaḥ ||
meaning:
सप्तर्षिमण्डलं तस्माल्लक्षेणैकेन संस्थितम् |
ऋषिभ्यस्तु सहस्राणां शतादूर्ध्वं ध्रुवः स्थितः ||
text_mt: At one hundred thousand [yojanas] from that stands the constellation of the Seven Sages; / and a hundred thousand [yojanas] above the sages stands the pole star Dhruva.

sanskrit_iast:
meḍhībhūtaḥ sa yastasya jyotiścakrasya vai dhruvaḥ |
bhūrbhuvaḥ svariti jñeyaṃ bhuva ūrdhvaṃ dhruvādavāk ||
meaning:
मेढीभूतः स यस्तस्य ज्योतिश्चक्रस्य वै ध्रुवः |
भूर्भुवः स्वरिति ज्ञेयं भुव ऊर्ध्वं ध्रुवादवाक् ||
text_mt: He who serves as the pivot of the circle of luminaries is indeed Dhruva; / the realm from the earth up to below Dhruva is to be known as Bhūr, Bhuvas, and Svar.

sanskrit_iast:
ekayojanakoṭistu yatra te kalpavāsinaḥ |
dhruvādūrdhvaṃ maharlokaḥ saptaite brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ ||
meaning:
एकयोजनकोटिस्तु यत्र ते कल्पवासिनः |
ध्रुवादूर्ध्वं महर्लोकः सप्तैते ब्रह्मणः सुताः ||
text_mt: Where those who dwell for a kalpa reside is one crore of yojanas in extent; / above Dhruva is Maharloka, where reside these seven sons of Brahmā:

sanskrit_iast:
sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ |
kapilaścāsuriścaiva voḍhuḥ pañcaśikhastathā ||
meaning:
सनकश्च सनन्दश्च तृतीयश्च सनातनः |
कपिलश्चासुरिश्चैव वोढुः पञ्चशिखस्तथा ||
text_mt: Sanaka, Sananda, and the third, Sanātana; / and Kapila, Āsuri, Voḍhu, and Pañcaśikha.

sanskrit_iast:
upariṣṭāttataḥ śukro dvilakṣābhyantare sthitaḥ |
dvilakṣayojanaṃ tasmādadhaḥ somasutaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
उपरिष्टात्ततः शुक्रो द्विलक्षाभ्यन्तरे स्थितः |
द्विलक्षयोजनं तस्मादधः सोमसुतः स्मृतः ||
text_mt:
Then, higher up, Venus is situated within two hundred thousand [yojanas]; / two hundred thousand yojanas below him, the son of the Moon (Mercury) is taught to be.

Two hundred thousand yojanas above him stands Mars, O sage; / two hundred thousand yojanas above him stands Jupiter, the preceptor.

sanskrit_iast:
dvilakṣayojanaṃ tasmādūrdhvaṃ bhaumaḥ sthito mune |
dvilakṣayojanaṃ tasmādūrdhvaṃ jīvaḥ sthito guruḥ ||
meaning:
द्विलक्षयोजनं तस्मादूर्ध्वं भौमः स्थितो मुने |
द्विलक्षयोजनं तस्मादूर्ध्वं जीवः स्थितो गुरुः ||

sanskrit_iast:
dvilakṣayojanaṃ jīvādūrdhvaṃ saurirvyavasthitaḥ |
ete sapta grahāḥ proktāḥ sva sva rāśau vyavasthitā ||
meaning:
द्विलक्षयोजनं जीवादूर्ध्वं सौरिर्व्यवस्थितः |
एते सप्त ग्रहाः प्रोक्ताः स्व स्व राशौ व्यवस्थिता ||
text_mt: Two hundred thousand yojanas above Jupiter stands Saturn, the son of the Sun; / these are declared to be the seven planets, established in their respective zodiacal signs.

sanskrit_iast:
rudralakṣairyojanataḥ saptordhvamṛṣayaḥ sthitāḥ |
viśvalakṣairyojanato dhruvasthitirudāhṛtā ||
meaning:
रुद्रलक्षैर्योजनतः सप्तोर्ध्वमृषयः स्थिताः |
विश्वलक्षैर्योजनतो ध्रुवस्थितिरुदाहृता ||
text_mt: At eleven hundred thousand yojanas above stand the Seven Sages; / at thirteen hundred thousand yojanas the position of Dhruva is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
caturguṇottare cārdhe janalokāttapaḥ smṛtam |
vairājā yatra devā vai sthitā dāhavivarjitāḥ ||
meaning:
चतुर्गुणोत्तरे चार्धे जनलोकात्तपः स्मृतम् |
वैराजा यत्र देवा वै स्थिता दाहविवर्जिताः ||
text_mt: At four times the distance from Janaloka, Tapoloka is remembered, / where the Vairāja gods dwell, free from burning.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍguṇena tapolokātsatyaloko vyavasthitaḥ |
brahmalokaḥ sa vijñeyo vasantyamalacetasaḥ ||
meaning:
षड्गुणेन तपोलोकात्सत्यलोको व्यवस्थितः |
ब्रह्मलोकः स विज्ञेयो वसन्त्यमलचेतसः ||
text_mt: At six times [the distance] from Tapoloka is situated Satyaloka; / that is to be known as Brahmaloka, where dwell the pure-minded,

sanskrit_iast:
satyadharmaratāścaiva jñānino brahmacāriṇaḥ |
yadgāmino'tha bhūlokānnivasanti hi mānavāḥ ||
meaning:
सत्यधर्मरताश्चैव ज्ञानिनो ब्रह्मचारिणः |
यद्गामिनोऽथ भूलोकान्निवसन्ति हि मानवाः ||
text_mt: devoted to true righteousness, wise, observing celibacy; / men from the mortal world who go there dwell [with them].

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvarloke tu saṃsiddhā munayo devarūpiṇaḥ |
svargaloke surādityā maruto vasavo'śvinau ||
meaning:
भुवर्लोके तु संसिद्धा मुनयो देवरूपिणः |
स्वर्गलोके सुरादित्या मरुतो वसवोऽश्विनौ ||
text_mt: In Bhuvarloka dwell the perfected sages possessing godlike forms; / in Svargaloka dwell the gods, the Ādityas, the Maruts, the Vasus, the two Aśvins,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvedevāstathā rudrāḥ sādhyā nāgāḥ khagādayaḥ |
navagrahāstatastatra ṛṣayo vītakalmaṣāḥ ||
meaning:
विश्वेदेवास्तथा रुद्राः साध्या नागाः खगादयः |
नवग्रहास्ततस्तत्र ऋषयो वीतकल्मषाः ||
text_mt: the Viśvedevas, the Rudras, the Sādhyas, the Nāgas, the birds, and the rest; / then the nine planets, and there the sages free from sin.

sanskrit_iast:
ete sapta mahālokāḥ kāleya kathitāstava |
pātālāni ca saptaiva brahmāṇḍasya ca vistaraḥ ||
meaning:
एते सप्त महालोकाः कालेय कथितास्तव |
पातालानि च सप्तैव ब्रह्माण्डस्य च विस्तरः ||
text_mt: These seven great worlds have been described to you, O Kāleya, / as well as the seven netherworlds, and the extent of the cosmic egg.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhivṛkṣaphalaṃ yadvad vṛttiścordhvamadhastathā |
etadaṇḍakaṭāhena sarvato vai samāvṛtam ||
meaning:
दधिवृक्षफलं यद्वद् वृत्तिश्चोर्ध्वमधस्तथा |
एतदण्डकटाहेन सर्वतो वै समावृतम् ||
text_mt: Just like a wood-apple fruit, its circumference extends above and below; / this entire egg is enclosed all around by the cosmic shell.

sanskrit_iast:
daśaguṇena payasā sarvatastatsamāvṛtam |
vahninā vāyunā cāpi nabhasā tamasā tathā ||
meaning:
दशगुणेन पयसा सर्वतस्तत्समावृतम् |
वह्निना वायुना चापि नभसा तमसा तथा ||
text_mt: It is surrounded on all sides by water ten times [its size], / and by fire, wind, space, and darkness,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtādināpi mahatā digguṇottaraveṣṭitaḥ |
mahāntaṃ ca samāvṛtya pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ sthitaḥ ||
meaning:
भूतादिनापि महता दिग्गुणोत्तरवेष्टितः |
महान्तं च समावृत्य प्रधानं पुरुषः स्थितः ||
text_mt: as well as by the origin of the elements (ahaṃkāra) and by the cosmic intellect (mahat), each ten times greater than the last; / and encompassing the mahat, the unmanifest primal nature and the Puruṣa abide.

sanskrit_iast:
anantasya na tasyāsti saṅkhyāpi paramātmanaḥ |
tenānanta iti khyātaḥ pramāṇaṃ nāsti vai yataḥ ||
meaning:
अनन्तस्य न तस्यास्ति सङ्ख्यापि परमात्मनः |
तेनानन्त इति ख्यातः प्रमाणं नास्ति वै यतः ||
text_mt: There is no calculation even of that infinite Supreme Self; / therefore he is known as ‘Infinite’, because there is no measure for him.

sanskrit_iast:
hetubhūtaḥ samastasya prakṛtiḥ sā parā mune |
aṇḍānāṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇyayutāni ca ||
meaning:
हेतुभूतः समस्तस्य प्रकृतिः सा परा मुने |
अण्डानां तु सहस्राणां सहस्राण्ययुतानि च ||
text_mt: She is the cause of all, that supreme Prakṛti, O sage; / and thousands, tens of thousands, and hundreds of thousands of eggs

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛśānāṃ prabhūtāni tasmādavyaktajanmanaḥ |
dāruṇyagnistile tailaṃ payaḥsu ca yathā ghṛtam ||
meaning:
ईदृशानां प्रभूतानि तस्मादव्यक्तजन्मनः |
दारुण्यग्निस्तिले तैलं पयःसु च यथा घृतम् ||
text_mt: like this arise abundantly from that origin in the unmanifest. / Just as fire is in wood, oil in sesame seeds, and ghee in milks,

sanskrit_iast:
tathāsau paramātmā vai sarvaṃ vyāpyātmavedanaḥ |
ādibījātprasuvate tatastebhyaḥ pare'ṇḍajāḥ ||
meaning:
तथासौ परमात्मा वै सर्वं व्याप्यात्मवेदनः |
आदिबीजात्प्रसुवते ततस्तेभ्यः परेऽण्डजाः ||
text_mt: even so does the Supreme Self, knowing himself, pervade all. / From the primal seed they are generated; then from them further egg-born beings arise;

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyaḥ putrāstathānyeṣāṃ bījānyanyāni vai tataḥ |
mahadādiyoviśeṣāntāstadbhavanti surādayaḥ ||
meaning:
तेभ्यः पुत्रास्तथान्येषां बीजान्यन्यानि वै ततः |
महदादियोविशेषान्तास्तद्भवन्ति सुरादयः ||
text_mt: from them their sons, and likewise other seeds of others; / from the cosmic intellect down to the specific elements arise the gods and others.

sanskrit_iast:
bījād vṛkṣapraroheṇa yathā nāpacayastaroḥ |
sūryakāntamaṇeḥ sūryādyadvadvahniḥ prajāyate ||
meaning:
बीजाद् वृक्षप्ररोहेण यथा नापचयस्तरोः |
सूर्यकान्तमणेः सूर्याद्यद्वद्वह्निः प्रजायते ||
text_mt: Just as there is no diminishment of a tree by a shoot sprouting from a seed, / and just as fire is produced from the sunstone through the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvatsañjāyate sṛṣṭiḥ śivastatraḥ na kāmayet |
śivaśaktisamāyoge devādyāḥ prabhavanti hi ||
meaning:
तद्वत्सञ्जायते सृष्टिः शिवस्तत्रः न कामयेत् |
शिवशक्तिसमायोगे देवाद्याः प्रभवन्ति हि ||
text_mt: so the creation is brought forth; Śiva therein desires nothing. / From the union of Śiva and Śakti, the gods and others indeed come into being.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā svakarmaṇaikena prarohamupayānti vai |
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudrāśca sa śivaḥ parigīyate ||
meaning:
तथा स्वकर्मणैकेन प्ररोहमुपयान्ति वै |
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्राश्च स शिवः परिगीयते ||
text_mt: Likewise, through their own past action alone they undergo sprout-like growth; / Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and the Rudras—he is celebrated as Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāduddharate sarvaṃ yasmiṃśca layameṣyati |
kartā kriyāṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ sa śivaḥ parigīyate ||
meaning:
तस्मादुद्धरते सर्वं यस्मिंश्च लयमेष्यति |
कर्ता क्रियाणां सर्वासां स शिवः परिगीयते ||
text_mt: From him everything emerges, and into him it will dissolve; / he is the author of all acts, he is celebrated as Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca |
sanatkumāra sarvajña chindhi me saṃśayaṃ mahat |
santi lokā hi brahmāṇḍādupariṣṭānna vā mune ||
meaning:
व्यास उवाच |
सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ छिन्धि मे संशयं महत् |
सन्ति लोका हि ब्रह्माण्डादुपरिष्टान्न वा मुने ||
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / O omniscient Sanatkumāra, sever this great doubt of mine: / are there worlds above the cosmic egg, or not, O sage?

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
brahmāṇḍādupariṣṭācca santi lokā munīśvara |
tān śṛṇu tvaṃ viśeṣeṇa vacmi te'haṃ samāgataḥ ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
ब्रह्माण्डादुपरिष्टाच्च सन्ति लोका मुनीश्वर |
तान् शृणु त्वं विशेषेण वच्मि तेऽहं समागतः ||
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / There are indeed worlds above the cosmic egg, O lord among sages; / listen to them in detail, as I who have come will tell you.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhilokātparo loko vaikuṇṭha iti viśrutaḥ |
virājate mahādīptyā yatra viṣṇuḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
meaning:
विधिलोकात्परो लोको वैकुण्ठ इति विश्रुतः |
विराजते महादीप्त्या यत्र विष्णुः प्रतिष्ठितः ||
text_mt: Beyond the world of Brahmā is the world renowned as Vaikuṇṭha, / shining with great splendor, where Viṣṇu is established.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopariṣṭātkaumāro loko hi paramādbhutaḥ |
senānīḥ śambhutanayo rājate yatra suprabhaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्योपरिष्टात्कौमारो लोको हि परमाद्भुतः |
सेनानीः शम्भुतनयो राजते यत्र सुप्रभः ||
text_mt: Above that is the realm of Kumāra, most wondrous indeed, / where the brilliant commander of the army, Śambhu's son, shines forth.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ paramumāloko mahādivyo virājate |
yatra śaktirvibhātyekā tridevajananī śivā ||
meaning:
ततः परमुमालोको महादिव्यो विराजते |
यत्र शक्तिर्विभात्येका त्रिदेवजननी शिवा ||
text_mt: Beyond that shines the realm of Umā, exceedingly divine, / where the one Śakti, the mother of the three gods, Śivā, shines radiant.

sanskrit_iast:
parātparā hi prakṛtī rajaḥsattvatamomayī |
nirguṇā ca svayaṃ devī nirvikārā śivātmikā ||
meaning:
परात्परा हि प्रकृती रजःसत्त्वतमोमयी |
निर्गुणा च स्वयं देवी निर्विकारा शिवात्मिका ||
text_mt: She is Prakṛti, higher than the high, consisting of sattva, rajas, and tamas, / yet the goddess herself is devoid of qualities, changeless, and of the nature of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopariṣṭādvijñeyaḥ śivalokaḥ sanātanaḥ |
avināśī mahādivyo mahāśobhānvitaḥ sadā ||
meaning:
तस्योपरिष्टाद्विज्ञेयः शिवलोकः सनातनः |
अविनाशी महादिव्यो महाशोभान्वितः सदा ||
text_mt: Above that is to be known the eternal world of Śiva, / imperishable, exceedingly divine, and endowed forever with great splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
virājate paraṃ brahma yatra śambhurmaheśvaraḥ |
tridevajanakaḥ svāmī sarveṣāṃ triguṇātparaḥ ||
meaning:
विराजते परं ब्रह्म यत्र शम्भुर्महेश्वरः |
त्रिदेवजनकः स्वामी सर्वेषां त्रिगुणात्परः ||
text_mt: There shines the supreme Brahman, Śambhu, the great lord, / father of the three gods, master of all, beyond the three qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
tata ūrdhvaṃ na lokāśca golokastatsamīpataḥ |
gomātaraḥ suśīlākhyāstatra santi śivapriyā ||
meaning:
तत ऊर्ध्वं न लोकाश्च गोलोकस्तत्समीपतः |
गोमातरः सुशीलाख्यास्तत्र सन्ति शिवप्रिया ||
text_mt: Above that there are no worlds; Goloka is near to it, / where abide the beloved kine of Śiva named Suśīlās, mothers of cattle.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpālaḥ kṛṣṇanāmā hi rājate śaṅkarājñayā |
pratiṣṭhitaḥ śivenaiva śaktyā svacchandacāriṇā ||
meaning:
तत्पालः कृष्णनामा हि राजते शङ्कराज्ञया |
प्रतिष्ठितः शिवेनैव शक्त्या स्वच्छन्दचारिणा ||
text_mt: Its protector, named Kṛṣṇa, shines by the command of Śaṅkara, / established by Śiva himself, wandering at will through his power.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaloko'dbhuto vyāsa nirādhāro manoharaḥ |
tathānirvacanīyaśca nānāvastuvirājitaḥ ||
meaning:
शिवलोकोऽद्भुतो व्यास निराधारो मनोहरः |
तथानिर्वचनीयश्च नानावस्तुविराजितः ||
text_mt: The world of Śiva is wondrous, Vyāsa, supportless, captivating the mind, / likewise indescribable, and adorned with manifold objects.

sanskrit_iast:
śivastu tadadhiṣṭhātā sarvadevaśiromaṇiḥ |
viṣṇubrahmaharaiḥ sevyaḥ paramātmā nirañjanaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
शिवस्तु तदधिष्ठाता सर्वदेवशिरोमणिः |
विष्णुब्रह्महरैः सेव्यः परमात्मा निरञ्जनः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Śiva is its presiding lord, the crest-jewel of all the gods, / to be served by Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and Hara, the supreme Self, taintless.

Homage to the auspicious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca |
sanatkumāra sarvajña tatprāptiṃ vada sattama |
yad gatvā na nivartante śivabhaktiyutā narāḥ ||
meaning:
व्यास उवाच |
सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ तत्प्राप्तिं वद सत्तम |
यद् गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते शिवभक्तियुता नराः ||
title: viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | manuviśeṣakathanam
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / O omniscient Sanatkumāra, best of good men, tell me the means of attaining that [realm], / going to which men endowed with devotion to Śiva do not return.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
parāśarasuta vyāsa śṛṇu prītyā śubhāṃ gatim |
vrataṃ hi śuddhabhaktānāṃ tathā śuddhaṃ tapasvinām ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
पराशरसुत व्यास शृणु प्रीत्या शुभां गतिम् |
व्रतं हि शुद्धभक्तानां तथा शुद्धं तपस्विनाम् ||
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / O Vyāsa, son of Parāśara, listen with joy to the auspicious path, / the observance of pure devotees and of pure practitioners of austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
ye śivaṃ śuddhakarmāṇaḥ suśuddhatapasānvitāḥ |
samarcayanti taṃ nityaṃ vandyāste sarvathānvaham ||
meaning:
ये शिवं शुद्धकर्माणः सुशुद्धतपसान्विताः |
समर्चयन्ति तं नित्यं वन्द्यास्ते सर्वथान्वहम् ||
text_mt: Those of pure actions, endowed with exceedingly pure austerity, / who continually worship Śiva, are to be saluted in every way, day by day.

sanskrit_iast:
nātaptatapaso yānti śivalokamanāmayam |
śivānugrahasaddhetustapa eva mahāmune ||
meaning:
नातप्ततपसो यान्ति शिवलोकमनामयम् |
शिवानुग्रहसद्धेतुस्तप एव महामुने ||
text_mt: Those who have not performed austerity do not reach the world of Śiva, free from affliction; / austerity alone is the true cause of Śiva's grace, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā divi modante pratyakṣaṃ devatāgaṇāḥ |
ṛṣayo munayaścaiva satyaṃ jānīha madvacaḥ ||
meaning:
तपसा दिवि मोदन्ते प्रत्यक्षं देवतागणाः |
ऋषयो मुनयश्चैव सत्यं जानीह मद्वचः ||
text_mt: By austerity the hosts of deities visibly rejoice in heaven, / as do the ṛṣis and munis; know my words to be true.

sanskrit_iast:
sudurddharaṃ durārādhyaṃ sudūraṃ duratikramam |
tatsarvaṃ tapasā sādhyaṃ tapo hi duratikramam ||
meaning:
सुदुर्द्धरं दुराराध्यं सुदूरं दुरतिक्रमम् |
तत्सर्वं तपसा साध्यं तपो हि दुरतिक्रमम् ||
text_mt: What is extremely difficult to bear, hard to propitiate, very distant, and hard to surmount— / all that can be accomplished through austerity; for austerity is hard to surpass.

sanskrit_iast:
susthitastapasi brahmā nityaṃ viṣṇurharastathā |
devā devyo'khilāḥ prāptāstapasā durlabhaṃ phalam ||
meaning:
सुस्थितस्तपसि ब्रह्मा नित्यं विष्णुर्हरस्तथा |
देवा देव्योऽखिलाः प्राप्तास्तपसा दुर्लभं फलम् ||
text_mt: Firmly established in austerity are Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Hara always; / all the gods and goddesses attained their hard-to-obtain fruit by austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
yena yena hi bhāvena sthitvā yatkriyate tapaḥ |
tataḥ samprāpyate'sau tairiha loke na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
येन येन हि भावेन स्थित्वा यत्क्रियते तपः |
ततः सम्प्राप्यतेऽसौ तैरिह लोके न संशयः ||
text_mt: With whatever mental disposition one abides and performs austerity, / that [result] is obtained by them here in this world, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
sāttvikaṃ rājasaṃ caiva tāmasaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam |
vijñeyaṃ hi tapo vyāsa sarvasādhanasādhanam ||
meaning:
सात्त्विकं राजसं चैव तामसं त्रिविधं स्मृतम् |
विज्ञेयं हि तपो व्यास सर्वसाधनसाधनम् ||
