text_mt: It is taught to be threefold: sāttvika, rājasa, and tāmasa; / austerity is indeed to be known, Vyāsa, as the means of achieving all means.

sanskrit_iast:
sāttvikaṃ daivatānāṃ hi yatīnāmūrdhvaretasām |
rājasaṃ dānavānāṃ hi manuṣyāṇāṃ tathaiva ca |
tāmasaṃ rākṣasānāṃ hi narāṇāṃ krūrakarmaṇām ||
meaning:
सात्त्विकं दैवतानां हि यतीनामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् |
राजसं दानवानां हि मनुष्याणां तथैव च |
तामसं राक्षसानां हि नराणां क्रूरकर्मणाम् ||
text_mt: The sāttvika [austerity] belongs to the gods and to ascetics of upward-flowing seed, / the rājasa belongs to Dānavas and likewise to men, / and the tāmasa belongs to Rākṣasas and to men of cruel deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
trividhaṃ tatphalaṃ proktaṃ munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ |
japo dhyānaṃ tu devānāmarcanaṃ bhaktitaḥ śubham ||
meaning:
त्रिविधं तत्फलं प्रोक्तं मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः |
जपो ध्यानं तु देवानामर्चनं भक्तितः शुभम् ||
text_mt: Its fruit is declared to be of three kinds by the sages who see reality: / auspicious recitation, meditation, and the worship of the gods with devotion—

sanskrit_iast:
sāttvikaṃ taddhi nirdiṣṭamaśeṣaphalasādhakam |
iha loke pare caiva mano'bhipretasādhanam ||
meaning:
सात्त्विकं तद्धि निर्दिष्टमशेषफलसाधकम् |
इह लोके परे चैव मनोऽभिप्रेतसाधनम् ||
text_mt: that is designated as sāttvika, achieving boundless fruits, / fulfilling desires of the mind both in this world and the next.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmanāphalamuddiśya rājasaṃ tapa ucyate |
nijadehaṃ susampīḍya dehaśoṣakaduḥsahaiḥ ||
meaning:
कामनाफलमुद्दिश्य राजसं तप उच्यते |
निजदेहं सुसम्पीड्य देहशोषकदुःसहैः ||
text_mt: Austerity undertaken with a view to the fruit of desire is called rājasa; / and that which intensely afflicts one's own body through unbearable [penances] that dry up the body,

sanskrit_iast: tapastāmasamuddiṣṭaṃ mano'bhipretasādhanam ||
meaning: तपस्तामसमुद्दिष्टं मनोऽभिप्रेतसाधनम् ||
text_mt: fulfilling the mind's intent, is indicated as tāmasa austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamaṃ sāttvikaṃ vidyāddharmabuddhiśca niścalā |
snānaṃ pūjā japo homaḥ śuddhaśaucamahiṃsanam ||
meaning:
उत्तमं सात्त्विकं विद्याद्धर्मबुद्धिश्च निश्चला |
स्नानं पूजा जपो होमः शुद्धशौचमहिंसनम् ||
text_mt: One should know the sāttvika to be the highest, with an unswerving sense of duty: / bathing, worship, recitation, burnt offerings, pure cleanliness, non-violence,

sanskrit_iast:
vratopavāsacaryā ca maunamindriyanigrahaḥ |
dhīrvidyā satyamakrodho dānaṃ kṣāntirdamo dayā ||
meaning:
व्रतोपवासचर्या च मौनमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः |
धीर्विद्या सत्यमक्रोधो दानं क्षान्तिर्दमो दया ||
text_mt: observance of vows, fasts, silence, sense-restraint, / discernment, knowledge, truth, freedom from anger, giving, patience, self-control, compassion,

sanskrit_iast:
vāpīkūpataḍāgādeḥ prāsādasya ca kalpanā |
kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ yajñaḥ sutīrthānyāśramāḥ punaḥ ||
meaning:
वापीकूपतडागादेः प्रासादस्य च कल्पना |
कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं यज्ञः सुतीर्थान्याश्रमाः पुनः ||
text_mt: construction of stepped wells, wells, ponds, and temples, / the kṛcchra and cāndrāyaṇa penances, sacrifice, sacred pilgrimage sites, and hermitages.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmasthānāni caitāni sukhadāni manīṣiṇām |
sudharmaḥ paramo vyāsa śivabhakteśca kāraṇam ||
meaning:
धर्मस्थानानि चैतानि सुखदानि मनीषिणाम् |
सुधर्मः परमो व्यास शिवभक्तेश्च कारणम् ||
text_mt: These places of virtue bestow happiness upon the wise; / the highest righteousness, Vyāsa, is the cause of devotion to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
saṅkrāntiviṣuvadyogo nādamukte niyujyatām |
dhyānaṃ trikālikaṃ jyotirunmanībhāvadhāraṇā ||
meaning:
सङ्क्रान्तिविषुवद्योगो नादमुक्ते नियुज्यताम् |
ध्यानं त्रिकालिकं ज्योतिरुन्मनीभावधारणा ||
text_mt: Let there be application to the conjunction of the equinoxes and solstices, to liberation in sound, / threefold daily meditation, the light [within], and contemplation of the state beyond the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
recakaḥ pūrakaḥ kumbhaḥ prāṇāyāmastridhā smṛtaḥ |
nāḍīsañcāravijñānaṃ pratyāhāranirodhanam ||
meaning:
रेचकः पूरकः कुम्भः प्राणायामस्त्रिधा स्मृतः |
नाडीसञ्चारविज्ञानं प्रत्याहारनिरोधनम् ||
text_mt: Breath-control is remembered as threefold: exhalation, inhalation, and retention; / knowledge of the movement of the channels, withdrawal [of the senses], and suspension;

sanskrit_iast:
turīyaṃ tadadho buddhiraṇimādyaṣṭasaṃyutam |
pūrvottamaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ parajñānaprasādhanam ||
meaning:
तुरीयं तदधो बुद्धिरणिमाद्यष्टसंयुतम् |
पूर्वोत्तमं समुद्दिष्टं परज्ञानप्रसाधनम् ||
text_mt: the fourth state, and below it intellect accompanied by the eight supernatural powers such as minuteness; / the former is declared to be the best, the means to supreme knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣṭhāvasthā mṛtāvasthā haritā veti kīrtitāḥ |
nānopalabdhayo hyetāḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanāḥ ||
meaning:
काष्ठावस्था मृतावस्था हरिता वेति कीर्तिताः |
नानोपलब्धयो ह्येताः सर्वपापप्रणाशनाः ||
text_mt: The states called the fixed state, the dead state, and the green state— / these manifold attainments destroy all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
nārī śayyā tathā pānaṃ vastradhūpavilepanam |
tāmbūlabhakṣaṇaṃ pañca rājaiśvaryavibhūtayaḥ ||
meaning:
नारी शय्या तथा पानं वस्त्रधूपविलेपनम् |
ताम्बूलभक्षणं पञ्च राजैश्वर्यविभूतयः ||
text_mt: A woman, a bed, drinks, garments, incense, ointments, / and the chewing of betel: these are the five splendors of royal power.

sanskrit_iast:
hemabhārastathā tāmraṃ gṛhāśca ratnadhenavaḥ |
pāṇḍityaṃ vedaśāstrāṇāṃ gītanṛtyavibhūṣaṇam ||
meaning:
हेमभारस्तथा ताम्रं गृहाश्च रत्नधेनवः |
पाण्डित्यं वेदशास्त्राणां गीतनृत्यविभूषणम् ||
text_mt: Loads of gold, copper, houses, gems, cattle, / proficiency in the Vedas and treatises, singing, dancing, ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhavīṇāmṛdaṅgāśca gajendraḥ chtracāmare |
bhogarūpāṇi caitāni ebhiḥ sakto'nurajyate ||
meaning:
शङ्खवीणामृदङ्गाश्च गजेन्द्रः छ्त्रचामरे |
भोगरूपाणि चैतानि एभिः सक्तोऽनुरज्यते ||
text_mt: conches, lutes, and drums, noble elephants, parasols, and chowries— / these are the forms of enjoyment; attached to these, one is captivated.

sanskrit_iast:
ādarśavanmune snehaistilavatsa nipīḍyate |
araṃ gaccheti cāpyenaṃ kurute jñānamohitaḥ ||
meaning:
आदर्शवन्मुने स्नेहैस्तिलवत्स निपीड्यते |
अरं गच्छेति चाप्येनं कुरुते ज्ञानमोहितः ||
text_mt: Like a mirror, O sage, one is crushed with affections as sesame seeds [are for their oil]; / and deluded in knowledge, one makes oneself go swiftly [to ruin].

sanskrit_iast:
jānannapīha saṃsāre bhramate ghaṭiyantravat |
sarvayoniṣu duḥkhārtaḥ sthāvareṣu careṣu ca ||
meaning:
जानन्नपीह संसारे भ्रमते घटियन्त्रवत् |
सर्वयोनिषु दुःखार्तः स्थावरेषु चरेषु च ||
text_mt: Even while knowing, one wanders in this transmigratory existence like a waterwheel, / afflicted with sorrow through all wombs, among the immobile and mobile beings.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yoniṣu sarvāsu pratikramya bhrameṇa ta |
kālāntaravaśādyāti mānuṣyamatidurlabham ||
meaning:
एवं योनिषु सर्वासु प्रतिक्रम्य भ्रमेण त |
कालान्तरवशाद्याति मानुष्यमतिदुर्लभम् ||
text_mt: Having thus traversed all the wombs in succession through delusion, / one attains, under the influence of the lapse of time, the exceedingly rare human birth.

sanskrit_iast:
vyutkrameṇāpi mānuṣyaṃ prāpyate puṇyagauravāt |
vicitrā gatayaḥ proktāḥ karmaṇāṃ gurulāghavāt ||
meaning:
व्युत्क्रमेणापि मानुष्यं प्राप्यते पुण्यगौरवात् |
विचित्रा गतयः प्रोक्ताः कर्मणां गुरुलाघवात् ||
text_mt: Human birth is obtained even out of regular order by the weight of merit; / manifold are the courses declared [to arise] from the heaviness and lightness of actions.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣyaṃ ca samāsādya svargamokṣaprasādhanam |
nācaratyātmanaḥ śreyaḥ sa mṛtaḥ śocate ciram ||
meaning:
मानुष्यं च समासाद्य स्वर्गमोक्षप्रसाधनम् |
नाचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयः स मृतः शोचते चिरम् ||
text_mt: Having reached the human state, which accomplishes heaven and liberation, / if one does not practice what is beneficial to oneself, he grieves for a long time upon dying.

sanskrit_iast:
devāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ mānuṣyaṃ cātidurlabham |
tatsamprāpya tathā kuryānna gacchennarakaṃ yathā ||
meaning:
देवासुराणां सर्वेषां मानुष्यं चातिदुर्लभम् |
तत्सम्प्राप्य तथा कुर्यान्न गच्छेन्नरकं यथा ||
text_mt: The human state is exceedingly rare for all the gods and Asuras; / having attained it, one should act in such a way that one does not go to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
svargāpavargalābhāya yadi nāsti samudyamaḥ |
durlabhaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ vṛthā tajjanma kīrtitam ||
meaning:
स्वर्गापवर्गलाभाय यदि नास्ति समुद्यमः |
दुर्लभं प्राप्य मानुष्यं वृथा तज्जन्म कीर्तितम् ||
text_mt: If there is no exertion for the attainment of heaven and final release / after having obtained the rare human state, that birth is said to be in vain.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasya mūlaṃ mānuṣyaṃ caturvargasya kīrtitam |
samprāpya dharmato vyāsa tadyatnādanupālayet ||
meaning:
सर्वस्य मूलं मानुष्यं चतुर्वर्गस्य कीर्तितम् |
सम्प्राप्य धर्मतो व्यास तद्यत्नादनुपालयेत् ||
text_mt: Human birth is declared to be the root of all the four ends of life; / having attained it through righteousness, Vyāsa, one should preserve it with diligence.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmamūlaṃ hi mānuṣyaṃ labdhvā sarvārthasādhakam |
yadi lābhāya yatnaḥ syānmūlaṃ rakṣetsvayaṃ tataḥ ||
meaning:
धर्ममूलं हि मानुष्यं लब्ध्वा सर्वार्थसाधकम् |
यदि लाभाय यत्नः स्यान्मूलं रक्षेत्स्वयं ततः ||
text_mt: Having obtained human birth, the root of righteousness, which accomplishes all ends, / if one seeks gain, one should then guard the root oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣye'pi ca vipratvaṃ yaḥ prāpya khalu durlabham |
nācaratyātmanaḥ śreyaḥ ko'nyastasmādacetanaḥ ||
meaning:
मानुष्येऽपि च विप्रत्वं यः प्राप्य खलु दुर्लभम् |
नाचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयः कोऽन्यस्तस्मादचेतनः ||
text_mt: Even in human birth, who else is more senseless than he who, having obtained the state of a brahmin, / which is indeed rare, does not practice what is beneficial for himself?

sanskrit_iast:
dvīpānāmeva sarveṣāṃ karmabhūriyamucyate |
itaḥ svargaśca mokṣaśca prāpyate samupārjitaḥ ||
meaning:
द्वीपानामेव सर्वेषां कर्मभूरियमुच्यते |
इतः स्वर्गश्च मोक्षश्च प्राप्यते समुपार्जितः ||
text_mt: Among all the continents, this one is called the land of action; / from here heaven and liberation are attained through [merit] acquired.

sanskrit_iast:
deśe'smin bhārate varṣe prāpya mānuṣyamadhruvam |
na kuryādātmanaḥ śreyastenātmā khalu vañcitaḥ ||
meaning:
देशेऽस्मिन् भारते वर्षे प्राप्य मानुष्यमध्रुवम् |
न कुर्यादात्मनः श्रेयस्तेनात्मा खलु वञ्चितः ||
text_mt: Having obtained an unsteady human existence in this land, the realm of Bhārata, / if one does not bring about one's own welfare, he has truly cheated himself.

sanskrit_iast:
karmabhūmiriyaṃ vipra phalabhūmirasau smṛtā |
iha yatkriyate karma svarge tadanubhujyate ||
meaning:
कर्मभूमिरियं विप्र फलभूमिरसौ स्मृता |
इह यत्क्रियते कर्म स्वर्गे तदनुभुज्यते ||
text_mt: This is known as the land of action, O brahmin; that [other] is considered the land of fruitions. / The action which is performed here is experienced in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatsvāsthyaṃ śarīrasya tāvaddharmaṃ samācaret |
asvasthaścodito'pyanyairna kiñcitkartumutsahet ||
meaning:
यावत्स्वास्थ्यं शरीरस्य तावद्धर्मं समाचरेत् |
अस्वस्थश्चोदितोऽप्यन्यैर्न किञ्चित्कर्तुमुत्सहेत् ||
text_mt: As long as there is health in the body, so long should one practice dharma. / Once unwell, even if urged by others, one is unable to do anything.

sanskrit_iast:
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa dhruvaṃ yo na prasādhayet |
dhruvaṃ tasya paribhraṣṭamadhruvaṃ naṣṭameva ca ||
meaning:
अध्रुवेण शरीरेण ध्रुवं यो न प्रसाधयेत् |
ध्रुवं तस्य परिभ्रष्टमध्रुवं नष्टमेव च ||
text_mt: Whoever does not accomplish the permanent by means of the impermanent body, / his permanent is lost, and the impermanent is surely destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuṣaḥ khaṇḍakhaṇḍāni nipatanti tadagrataḥ |
ahorātropadeśena kimarthaṃ nāvabudhyate ||
meaning:
आयुषः खण्डखण्डानि निपतन्ति तदग्रतः |
अहोरात्रोपदेशेन किमर्थं नावबुध्यते ||
text_mt: Fragments of life-span are falling away before him; / by the indication of day and night, why does he not understand?

sanskrit_iast:
yadā na jñāyate mṛtyuḥ kadā kasya bhaviṣyati |
ākasmike hi maraṇe dhṛtiṃ vindati kastathā ||
meaning:
यदा न ज्ञायते मृत्युः कदा कस्य भविष्यति |
आकस्मिके हि मरणे धृतिं विन्दति कस्तथा ||
text_mt: When it is not known when whose death will occur, / who indeed finds steadfastness in sudden death?

sanskrit_iast:
parityajya yadā sarvamekākī yāsyati dhruvam |
na dadāti kadā kasmātpātheyārthamidaṃ dhanam ||
meaning:
परित्यज्य यदा सर्वमेकाकी यास्यति ध्रुवम् |
न ददाति कदा कस्मात्पाथेयार्थमिदं धनम् ||
text_mt: When, abandoning everything, one will surely depart alone, / why does one never give this wealth for the sake of provisions on the journey?

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītadānapātheyaḥ sukhaṃ yāti yamālayam |
anyathā kliśyate jantuḥ pātheyarahite pathi ||
meaning:
गृहीतदानपाथेयः सुखं याति यमालयम् |
अन्यथा क्लिश्यते जन्तुः पाथेयरहिते पथि ||
text_mt: One who has taken the provisions of charity goes happily to the abode of Yama; / otherwise, a creature suffers on a path devoid of provisions.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ kāleya puṇyāni paripūrṇāni sarvataḥ |
gacchatāṃ svargadeśaṃ hi teṣāṃ lābhaḥ pade pade ||
meaning:
येषां कालेय पुण्यानि परिपूर्णानि सर्वतः |
गच्छतां स्वर्गदेशं हि तेषां लाभः पदे पदे ||
text_mt: Those whose merits are complete on every side, O Kāleya, / for them who go to the realm of heaven there is gain at every step.

sanskrit_iast:
iti jñātvā naraḥ puṇyaṃ kuryātpāpaṃ vivarjayet |
puṇyena yāti devatvamapuṇyo narakaṃ vrajet ||
meaning:
इति ज्ञात्वा नरः पुण्यं कुर्यात्पापं विवर्जयेत् |
पुण्येन याति देवत्वमपुण्यो नरकं व्रजेत् ||
text_mt: Knowing this, a man should perform merit and avoid sin. / By merit one attains divinity; devoid of merit, one goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
ye manāgapi deveśaṃ prapannāḥ śaraṇaṃ śivam |
te'pi ghoraṃ na paśyanti yamaṃ na narakaṃ tathā ||
meaning:
ये मनागपि देवेशं प्रपन्नाः शरणं शिवम् |
तेऽपि घोरं न पश्यन्ति यमं न नरकं तथा ||
text_mt: Those who have surrendered for refuge to Śiva, the lord of gods, even slightly, / do not see dreadful Yama, nor hell.

sanskrit_iast:
kintu pāpairmahāmohaiḥ kiñcitkāle śivājñayā |
vasanti tatra mānuṣyāstato yānti śivāspadam ||
meaning:
किन्तु पापैर्महामोहैः किञ्चित्काले शिवाज्ञया |
वसन्ति तत्र मानुष्यास्ततो यान्ति शिवास्पदम् ||
text_mt: Yet, on account of sins born of great delusions, by Śiva's command humans dwell there / for a short time; after that, they go to the abode of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ye punaḥ sarvabhāvena pratipannā maheśvaram |
na te limpanti pāpena padmapatramivāmbhasā ||
meaning:
ये पुनः सर्वभावेन प्रतिपन्ना महेश्वरम् |
न ते लिम्पन्ति पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ||
text_mt: Those, on the other hand, who have turned to Maheśvara with their whole being / are not smeared with sin, just as a lotus leaf is not by water.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ śiveti yairnāma tathā hara hareti ca |
na teṣāṃ narakādbhītiryamāddhi munisattama ||
meaning:
उक्तं शिवेति यैर्नाम तथा हर हरेति च |
न तेषां नरकाद्भीतिर्यमाद्धि मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: Those by whom the name 'Śiva' is uttered, and likewise 'Hara, Hara,' / have no fear of hell, O best of sages, nor of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
paralokasya pātheyaṃ mokṣopāyamanāmayam |
puṇyasaṅghaikanilayaṃ śiva ityakṣaradvayam ||
meaning:
परलोकस्य पाथेयं मोक्षोपायमनामयम् |
पुण्यसङ्घैकनिलयं शिव इत्यक्षरद्वयम् ||
text_mt: The two syllables 'Śi-va' are the provision for the next world, / the wholesome means to liberation, the sole abode of an abundance of merit.

sanskrit_iast:
śivanāmaiva saṃsāramahārogaikaśāmakam |
nānyatsaṃsārarogasya śāmakaṃ dṛśyate mayā ||
meaning:
शिवनामैव संसारमहारोगैकशामकम् |
नान्यत्संसाररोगस्य शामकं दृश्यते मया ||
text_mt: The name of Śiva alone is the sole cure for the great disease of worldly existence; / no other curer of the disease of worldly existence is seen by me.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyāsahasrāṇi purā kṛtvā tu pulkasaḥ |
śiveti nāma vimalaṃ śrutvā mokṣaṃ gataḥ purā ||
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्यासहस्राणि पुरा कृत्वा तु पुल्कसः |
शिवेति नाम विमलं श्रुत्वा मोक्षं गतः पुरा ||
text_mt: An outcaste in the past, having committed thousands of brahminicides, / attained liberation formerly after hearing the pure name 'Śiva'.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvivardhayedbhaktimīśvare satataṃ budhaḥ |
śivabhaktyā mahāprājña bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca vindati ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
तस्माद्विवर्धयेद्भक्तिमीश्वरे सततं बुधः |
शिवभक्त्या महाप्राज्ञ भुक्तिं मुक्तिं च विन्दति ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Therefore, the wise person should constantly increase devotion to the Lord. / Through devotion to Śiva, O highly wise one, he attains enjoyment and liberation.

Obeisance to auspicious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca |
brāhmaṇatvaṃ hi duṣprāpyaṃ nisargād brāhmaṇo bhavet |
īśvarasya mukhātkṣatraṃ bāhubhyāmūruto viśaḥ ||
meaning:
व्यास उवाच |
ब्राह्मणत्वं हि दुष्प्राप्यं निसर्गाद् ब्राह्मणो भवेत् |
ईश्वरस्य मुखात्क्षत्रं बाहुभ्यामूरुतो विशः ||
title: ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | raṇaphalavarṇanam
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Brahminhood is indeed difficult to obtain; one becomes a brahmin by nature. / The kṣatriya came from the mouth of the Lord, from his arms, and the vaiśyas from his thighs;

sanskrit_iast:
padbhyāṃ śūdraḥ samutpanna iti tasya mukhāt śrutiḥ |
kimu sthitimadhaḥsthānādāpnuvanti hyato vada ||
meaning:
पद्भ्यां शूद्रः समुत्पन्न इति तस्य मुखात् श्रुतिः |
किमु स्थितिमधःस्थानादाप्नुवन्ति ह्यतो वद ||
text_mt: the śūdra arose from his feet: such is the Vedic teaching from his mouth. / Tell me, how do they attain a status below their station?

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
duṣkṛtena tu kāleya sthānād bhraśyanti mānavāḥ |
śreṣṭhaṃ sthānaṃ samāsādya tasmādrakṣeta paṇḍitaḥ ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
दुष्कृतेन तु कालेय स्थानाद् भ्रश्यन्ति मानवाः |
श्रेष्ठं स्थानं समासाद्य तस्माद्रक्षेत पण्डितः ||
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / By bad deeds, O Kāleya, men fall from their station; / having attained the best station, therefore, a wise person should protect it.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu vipratvamutsṛjya kṣatrayonyāṃ prasūyate |
brāhmaṇyātsa paribhraṣṭaḥ kṣatriyatvaṃ niṣevate ||
meaning:
यस्तु विप्रत्वमुत्सृज्य क्षत्रयोन्यां प्रसूयते |
ब्राह्मण्यात्स परिभ्रष्टः क्षत्रियत्वं निषेवते ||
text_mt: He who, casting off brahminhood, is born in a kṣatriya womb, / fallen from brahminhood, serves as a kṣatriya.

sanskrit_iast:
adharmasevanānmūḍhastathaiva parivartate |
janmāntarasahasrāṇi tamasyāviśate yataḥ ||
meaning:
अधर्मसेवनान्मूढस्तथैव परिवर्तते |
जन्मान्तरसहस्राणि तमस्याविशते यतः ||
text_mt: Through practicing unrighteousness, the deluded person turns around in that very way, / for he enters into darkness for thousands of subsequent births.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātprāpya paraṃ sthānaṃ pramādyenna tu nāśayet |
svasthānaṃ sarvadā rakṣetprāpyāpi vipado naraḥ ||
meaning:
तस्मात्प्राप्य परं स्थानं प्रमाद्येन्न तु नाशयेत् |
स्वस्थानं सर्वदा रक्षेत्प्राप्यापि विपदो नरः ||
text_mt: Therefore, having attained the highest station, one should not be heedless and destroy it. / A man should always protect his own station, even when facing misfortunes.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇatvaṃ śubhaṃ prāpya brāhmaṇyaṃ yo'vamanyate |
bhojyābhojyaṃ na jānāti sa pumān kṣatriyo bhavet ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मणत्वं शुभं प्राप्य ब्राह्मण्यं योऽवमन्यते |
भोज्याभोज्यं न जानाति स पुमान् क्षत्रियो भवेत् ||
text_mt: Having attained auspicious brahminhood, whoever disrespects the status of a brahmin / and does not know what is eatable and what is uneatable, that man becomes a kṣatriya.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā yena medhāvī śūdro vaiśyo hi jāyate |
tatte vakṣyāmi nikhilaṃ yena varṇottamo bhavet ||
meaning:
कर्मणा येन मेधावी शूद्रो वैश्यो हि जायते |
तत्ते वक्ष्यामि निखिलं येन वर्णोत्तमो भवेत् ||
text_mt: By what action an intelligent śūdra is born as a vaiśya, / that I shall tell you completely, by which one becomes the best of the social classes.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrakarma yathoddiṣṭaṃ śūdro bhūtvā samācaret |
yathāvatparicaryāṃ tu triṣu varṇeṣu nityadā ||
meaning:
शूद्रकर्म यथोद्दिष्टं शूद्रो भूत्वा समाचरेत् |
यथावत्परिचर्यां तु त्रिषु वर्णेषु नित्यदा ||
text_mt: Becoming a śūdra, one should perform the duty of a śūdra as prescribed, / namely, proper service toward the three social classes constantly.

sanskrit_iast:
kurute kāmayānastu śūdro'pi vaiśyatāṃ vrajet |
yo yojayeddhanairvaiśyo juhvānaśca yathāvidhi ||
meaning:
कुरुते कामयानस्तु शूद्रोऽपि वैश्यतां व्रजेत् |
यो योजयेद्धनैर्वैश्यो जुह्वानश्च यथाविधि ||
text_mt: Desiring [better rebirth], a śūdra who performs it attains the state of a vaiśya. / That vaiśya who provides with riches, offering oblations according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotramupādāya śeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ |
sa vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyakule jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रमुपादाय शेषान्नकृतभोजनः |
स वैश्यः क्षत्रियकुले जायते नात्र संशयः ||
text_mt: undertaking the agnihotra, eating the remnants of sacrificial food— / that vaiśya is born in a kṣatriya family; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyo jāyate yajñaiḥ saṃskṛtairāttadakṣiṇaiḥ |
adhīte svargamanvicchaṃstretāgniśaraṇaṃ sadā ||
meaning:
क्षत्रियो जायते यज्ञैः संस्कृतैरात्तदक्षिणैः |
अधीते स्वर्गमन्विच्छंस्त्रेताग्निशरणं सदा ||
text_mt: A kṣatriya is born [a brahmin] through sacrifices performed with distributed sacrificial fees; / seeking heaven, he studies [the Veda], always taking refuge in the three sacred fires.

sanskrit_iast:
ārdrahastapado nityaṃ kṣitiṃ dharmeṇa pālayet |
ṛtukālābhigāmī ca svabhāryāṃ dharmatatparaḥ ||
meaning:
आर्द्रहस्तपदो नित्यं क्षितिं धर्मेण पालयेत् |
ऋतुकालाभिगामी च स्वभार्यां धर्मतत्परः ||
text_mt: With wet hands and feet constantly, he protects the earth righteously; / and devoted to righteousness, he approaches his own wife at the proper season.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya bhūtebhyo dīyatāmiti |
gobrāhmaṇātmano'rthaṃ hi saṅgrāmābhihato bhavet ||
meaning:
सर्वातिथ्यं त्रिवर्गस्य भूतेभ्यो दीयतामिति |
गोब्राह्मणात्मनोऽर्थं हि सङ्ग्रामाभिहतो भवेत् ||
text_mt: Thinking, 'Let hospitality in all three ends of life be given to living beings,' / he is struck down in battle for the sake of cows, brahmins, and himself.

sanskrit_iast:
tenāgnimantrapūtātmā kṣatriyo brāhmaṇo bhavet |
vidhito brāhmaṇo bhūtvā yājakastu prajāyate ||
meaning:
तेनाग्निमन्त्रपूतात्मा क्षत्रियो ब्राह्मणो भवेत् |
विधितो ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा याजकस्तु प्रजायते ||
text_mt: Through that, the kṣatriya, his soul purified by fire and mantras, becomes a brahmin; / having become a brahmin according to rule, he is born as a sacrifice-performer.

sanskrit_iast:
svakarmanirato nityaṃ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ |
prāpyate vipulaḥ svargo devānāmapi vallabhaḥ ||
meaning:
स्वकर्मनिरतो नित्यं सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः |
प्राप्यते विपुलः स्वर्गो देवानामपि वल्लभः ||
text_mt: Constantly devoted to his own duties, truthful in speech, with senses subdued, / he attains the vast heaven, dear even to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇatvaṃ hi duṣprāpyaṃ kṛcchreṇa sādhyate naraiḥ |
brāhmaṇyātsakalaṃ prāpya mokṣaṃ cāpi munīśvara ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मणत्वं हि दुष्प्राप्यं कृच्छ्रेण साध्यते नरैः |
ब्राह्मण्यात्सकलं प्राप्य मोक्षं चापि मुनीश्वर ||
text_mt: Brahminhood is indeed difficult to attain; it is achieved by men with difficulty. / Having attained everything through brahminhood, one attains even liberation, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇo dharmatatparaḥ |
sādhanaṃ sarvavargasya rakṣed brāhmaṇyamuttamam ||
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणो धर्मतत्परः |
साधनं सर्ववर्गस्य रक्षेद् ब्राह्मण्यमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Therefore, with every effort, a brahmin devoted to righteousness / should protect the supreme brahminhood, the means of accomplishing all ends of life.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca |
saṅgrāmasyeha māhātmyaṃ tvayoktaṃ munisattama |
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ brūhi tvaṃ vadatāṃ vara ||
meaning:
व्यास उवाच |
सङ्ग्रामस्येह माहात्म्यं त्वयोक्तं मुनिसत्तम |
एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं ब्रूहि त्वं वदतां वर ||
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / The eulogy of battle has been spoken here by you, O best of sages; / I wish to hear this; speak, O best of speakers!

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
agniṣṭomādibhiryajñairiṣṭvā vipuladakṣiṇaiḥ |
na tatphalamavāpnoti saṅgrāme yadavāpnuyāt ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
अग्निष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा विपुलदक्षिणैः |
न तत्फलमवाप्नोति सङ्ग्रामे यदवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Having sacrificed with the Agniṣṭoma and other sacrifices with generous sacrificial fees, / one does not obtain that fruit which one obtains in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
iti tattvavidaḥ prāhuryajñakarmavidaḥ sadā |
tasmāttatte pravakṣyāmi yatphalaṃ śastrajīvinām ||
meaning:
इति तत्त्वविदः प्राहुर्यज्ञकर्मविदः सदा |
तस्मात्तत्ते प्रवक्ष्यामि यत्फलं शस्त्रजीविनाम् ||
text_mt: Thus the knowers of the truth, the knowers of sacrificial rites, always declare. / Therefore, I shall explain to you the fruit of those who live by weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmalābho'rthalābhaśca yaśolābhastathaiva ca |
yaḥ śūro vāñchate yuddhaṃ vimṛdan paravāhinīm ||
meaning:
धर्मलाभोऽर्थलाभश्च यशोलाभस्तथैव च |
यः शूरो वाञ्छते युद्धं विमृदन् परवाहिनीम् ||
text_mt: There is acquisition of righteousness, acquisition of wealth, and likewise acquisition of fame; / the hero who desires battle, crushing the enemy army,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya dharmārthakāmāśca yajñaścaiva sadakṣiṇaḥ |
paraṃ hyabhimukhaṃ dattvā tadyānaṃ yo'dhirohati ||
meaning:
तस्य धर्मार्थकामाश्च यज्ञश्चैव सदक्षिणः |
परं ह्यभिमुखं दत्त्वा तद्यानं योऽधिरोहति ||
text_mt: for him there is righteousness, wealth, desire, and sacrifice along with sacrificial fees; / confronting the enemy, he who mounts their vehicle,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuloke sa jāyeta yaśca yuddhe'parājitaḥ |
aśvamedhānavāpnoti caturo na mṛtaḥ sa cet ||
meaning:
विष्णुलोके स जायेत यश्च युद्धेऽपराजितः |
अश्वमेधानवाप्नोति चतुरो न मृतः स चेत् ||
text_mt: he is born in the realm of Viṣṇu; and he who is undefeated in battle, / if he is not killed, obtains four horse sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu śastramanutsṛjya mriyate vāhinīmukhe |
sammukho vartate śūraḥ sa svargānna nivartate ||
meaning:
यस्तु शस्त्रमनुत्सृज्य म्रियते वाहिनीमुखे |
सम्मुखो वर्तते शूरः स स्वर्गान्न निवर्तते ||
text_mt: He who, not abandoning his weapon, dies at the front of the army, / a hero standing facing forward, does not turn back from heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā vā rājaputro vā senāpatirathāpi vā |
hataḥ kṣātreṇa yaḥ śūrastasya loko'kṣayo bhavet ||
meaning:
राजा वा राजपुत्रो वा सेनापतिरथापि वा |
हतः क्षात्रेण यः शूरस्तस्य लोकोऽक्षयो भवेत् ||
text_mt: A king, or a prince, or indeed an army commander— / the hero who is killed by the warrior's code, his world becomes imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvanti tasya romāṇi bhidyante'strairmahāhave |
tāvato labhate lokān sarvakāmadughā'kṣayān ||
meaning:
यावन्ति तस्य रोमाणि भिद्यन्तेऽस्त्रैर्महाहवे |
तावतो लभते लोकान् सर्वकामदुघाऽक्षयान् ||
text_mt: As many body hairs of his as are pierced by weapons in great battle, / so many imperishable worlds yielding all desires does he obtain.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrāsanaṃ vīraśayyā vīrasthānasthitiḥ sthirā |
sarvadā bhavati vyāsa iha loke paratra ca ||
meaning:
वीरासनं वीरशय्या वीरस्थानस्थितिः स्थिरा |
सर्वदा भवति व्यास इह लोके परत्र च ||
text_mt: The posture of a hero, the bed of a hero, and a steadfast standing in the hero's abode / always belong to him, O Vyāsa, in this world and in the next.

sanskrit_iast:
gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe ca sthānasvāmyarthameva ca |
ye mṛtāste sukhaṃ yānti yathā sukṛtinastathā ||
meaning:
गवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे च स्थानस्वाम्यर्थमेव च |
ये मृतास्ते सुखं यान्ति यथा सुकृतिनस्तथा ||
text_mt: Those who die for the sake of cows, for the sake of brahmins, and for the sake of the master of their post / go to happiness, just as do the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kaścid brāhmaṇaṃ hatvā paścātprāṇān parityajet |
tatrāsau svapateryuddhe sa svargānna nivartate ||
meaning:
यः कश्चिद् ब्राह्मणं हत्वा पश्चात्प्राणान् परित्यजेत् |
तत्रासौ स्वपतेर्युद्धे स स्वर्गान्न निवर्तते ||
text_mt: If anyone who has killed a brahmin should later give up his life / in battle there for his master, he does not fall from heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
kravyādairdantibhiścaiva hatasya gatiruttamā |
dvijagosvāmināmarthe bhavedvipuladākṣayā ||
meaning:
क्रव्यादैर्दन्तिभिश्चैव हतस्य गतिरुत्तमा |
द्विजगोस्वामिनामर्थे भवेद्विपुलदाक्षया ||
text_mt: The highest state belongs to one killed by carnivores and elephants; / for the sake of the twice-born, cows, and masters, it becomes vast and inexhaustible.

sanskrit_iast:
śaknotviha samarthaśca yaṣṭuṃ kratuśatairapi |
ātmadehaparityāgaḥ kartuṃ yudhi suduṣkaraḥ ||
meaning:
शक्नोत्विह समर्थश्च यष्टुं क्रतुशतैरपि |
आत्मदेहपरित्यागः कर्तुं युधि सुदुष्करः ||
text_mt: Even if an able man here is capable of sacrificing with hundreds of rites, / the abandonment of one's own body in battle is exceedingly difficult to perform.

sanskrit_iast:
yuddhaṃ puṇyatamaṃ svargyaṃ rūpajñaṃ sarvatomukham |
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ kṣatriyasya viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
युद्धं पुण्यतमं स्वर्ग्यं रूपज्ञं सर्वतोमुखम् |
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां क्षत्रियस्य विशेषतः ||
text_mt: Battle is most sacred, leading to heaven, discerning of forms, and facing every direction, / for all social classes indeed, and especially for a kṣatriya.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛśaṃ caiva pravakṣyāmi yuddhadharmaṃ sanātanam |
yādṛśāya prahartavyaṃ yādṛśaṃ parivarjayet ||
meaning:
भृशं चैव प्रवक्ष्यामि युद्धधर्मं सनातनम् |
यादृशाय प्रहर्तव्यं यादृशं परिवर्जयेत् ||
text_mt: And I shall thoroughly proclaim the eternal duty of warfare: / what sort of person one may strike, and what sort one should spare.

sanskrit_iast:
ātatāyinamāyāntamapi vedāntaṅgaṃ dvijam |
jighāṃsantaṃ jighāṃsettu na tena brahmahā bhavet ||
meaning:
आततायिनमायान्तमपि वेदान्तङ्गं द्विजम् |
जिघांसन्तं जिघांसेत्तु न तेन ब्रह्महा भवेत् ||
text_mt: Even if an assassin approaching is a twice-born who has mastered the Vedānta, / if he wishes to kill, one should kill him; one does not thereby become a killer of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
hantavyo'pi na hantavyaḥ pānīyaṃ yaśca yācate |
raṇe hatvāturā vyāsa sa naro brahmahā bhavet ||
meaning:
हन्तव्योऽपि न हन्तव्यः पानीयं यश्च याचते |
रणे हत्वातुरा व्यास स नरो ब्रह्महा भवेत् ||
text_mt: Even an enemy deserving of death must not be slain if he begs for water; / killing afflicted men in battle, O Vyāsa, that man becomes a killer of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
vyādhitaṃ durbalaṃ bālaṃ stryanāthau kṛpaṇaṃ dhruvam |
dhanurbhagnaṃ chinnaguṇaṃ hatvā vai brahmahā bhavet ||
meaning:
व्याधितं दुर्बलं बालं स्त्र्यनाथौ कृपणं ध्रुवम् |
धनुर्भग्नं छिन्नगुणं हत्वा वै ब्रह्महा भवेत् ||
text_mt: By killing the diseased, the weak, a child, a woman, an unprotected person, the miserable, / or one whose bow is broken or bowstring snapped, one indeed becomes a killer of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vicārya saddhīmān bhavetprītyāḥ raṇapriyaḥ |
sa janmanaḥ phalaṃ prāpya paratreha pramodate ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
एवं विचार्य सद्धीमान् भवेत्प्रीत्याः रणप्रियः |
स जन्मनः फलं प्राप्य परत्रेह प्रमोदते ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Considering this, a truly wise man, with joy, should become a lover of battle; / obtaining the fruit of birth, he rejoices here and in the hereafter.

Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca |
vidhiṃ tāta vadedānīṃ jīvajanma vidhānataḥ |
garbhe sthitiṃ ca tasyāpi vairāgyārthaṃ munīśvara ||
meaning:
व्यास उवाच |
विधिं तात वदेदानीं जीवजन्म विधानतः |
गर्भे स्थितिं च तस्यापि वैराग्यार्थं मुनीश्वर ||
title: dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | dehotpattivarṇanam
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Speak now, dear father, properly of the rule of the soul's birth, / and also of its stay in the womb, for the sake of detachment, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
śṛṇu vyāsa samāsena śāstrasāramaśeṣataḥ |
vadiṣyāmi suvairāgyaṃ mumukṣorbhavabandhakṛt ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
शृणु व्यास समासेन शास्त्रसारमशेषतः |
वदिष्यामि सुवैराग्यं मुमुक्षोर्भवबन्धकृत् ||
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Listen, O Vyāsa, briefly to the entire essence of the scriptures; / I shall speak of true detachment, which breaks worldly bondage for the seeker of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
pākapātrasya madhye tu pṛthagannaṃ pṛthagjalam |
agnerūrdhvaṃ jalaṃ sthāpyaṃ tadannaṃ ca jalopari ||
meaning:
पाकपात्रस्य मध्ये तु पृथगन्नं पृथग्जलम् |
अग्नेरूर्ध्वं जलं स्थाप्यं तदन्नं च जलोपरि ||
text_mt: In the middle of the cooking pot, the food is separate and the water is separate; / the water must be placed above the fire, and that food above the water.

sanskrit_iast:
jalasyādhaḥ sa cāgnirhi sthito'gniṃ dhamate śanaiḥ |
vāyunā dhamyamāno'gniratyuṣṇaṃ kurute jalam ||
meaning:
जलस्याधः स चाग्निर्हि स्थितोऽग्निं धमते शनैः |
वायुना धम्यमानोऽग्निरत्युष्णं कुरुते जलम् ||
text_mt: And the fire situated beneath the water blows upon the fire slowly; / blown upon by wind, the fire makes the water extremely hot.

sanskrit_iast:
tadannamuṣṇatoyena samantātpacyate punaḥ |
dvidhā bhavati tatpakvaṃ pṛthakkiṭṭaṃ pṛthagrasaḥ ||
meaning:
तदन्नमुष्णतोयेन समन्तात्पच्यते पुनः |
द्विधा भवति तत्पक्वं पृथक्किट्टं पृथग्रसः ||
text_mt: That food is then cooked on all sides by the hot water; / once cooked, it becomes twofold: waste separately, and chyle separately.

sanskrit_iast:
malairdvādaśabhiḥ kiṭṭaṃ bhinnaṃ dehādbahirbhavet |
rasastu dehe sarati sa puṣṭastena jāyate ||
meaning:
मलैर्द्वादशभिः किट्टं भिन्नं देहाद्बहिर्भवेत् |
रसस्तु देहे सरति स पुष्टस्तेन जायते ||
text_mt: Separated through the twelve bodily impurities, the waste passes outside the body; / but the chyle circulates in the body, and by that it becomes nourished.

sanskrit_iast:
karṇākṣināsikā jihvā dantāḥ śiśno gudaṃ nakhāḥ |
malāśrayaḥ kaphaḥ svedo viṇmūtraṃ dvādaśa smṛtāḥ ||
meaning:
कर्णाक्षिनासिका जिह्वा दन्ताः शिश्नो गुदं नखाः |
मलाश्रयः कफः स्वेदो विण्मूत्रं द्वादश स्मृताः ||
text_mt: The ears, eyes, nostrils, tongue, teeth, penis, anus, nails, / the receptacles of phlegm, sweat, feces, and urine are remembered as the twelve.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtpadme pratibaddhāśca sarvanāḍyaḥ samantataḥ |
jñeyā rasapravāhinyastatprakāraṃ bruve mune ||
meaning:
हृत्पद्मे प्रतिबद्धाश्च सर्वनाड्यः समन्ततः |
ज्ञेया रसप्रवाहिन्यस्तत्प्रकारं ब्रुवे मुने ||
text_mt: Attached to the lotus of the heart on all sides are all the conduits; / they should be known as carrying the chyle; I will describe that process, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ mukheṣu taṃ sūkṣmaṃ prāṇaḥ sthāpayet rasam |
rasena tena nāḍīstāḥ prāṇaṃ pūrayate punaḥ ||
meaning:
तासां मुखेषु तं सूक्ष्मं प्राणः स्थापयेत् रसम् |
रसेन तेन नाडीस्ताः प्राणं पूरयते पुनः ||
text_mt: At their openings, the vital breath deposits that subtle chyle; / with that chyle resting in the conduits, it then fills the vital breath.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ prayānti sampūrṇāḥ tāśca dehaṃ samantataḥ |
tataḥ sa nāḍīmadhyasthaḥ śarīreṇātmanā rasaḥ ||
meaning:
पुनः प्रयान्ति सम्पूर्णाः ताश्च देहं समन्ततः |
ततः स नाडीमध्यस्थः शरीरेणात्मना रसः ||
text_mt: Filled again, they go everywhere throughout the body; / then that chyle residing within the conduits, together with the body itself,

sanskrit_iast:
pacyate pacyamānācca bhavetpākadvayaṃ punaḥ |
tvak tayā veṣṭyate pūrvaṃ rudhiraṃ ca prajāyate ||
meaning:
पच्यते पच्यमानाच्च भवेत्पाकद्वयं पुनः |
त्वक् तया वेष्ट्यते पूर्वं रुधिरं च प्रजायते ||
text_mt: is digested, and from that which is being digested, a twofold cooking takes place again: / first skin is wrapped by it, and blood is produced.

sanskrit_iast:
raktāllomāni māṃsaṃ ca keśāḥ snāyuśca māṃsataḥ |
snāyutaśca tathāsthīni nakhā majjāsthisambhavāḥ ||
meaning:
रक्ताल्लोमानि मांसं च केशाः स्नायुश्च मांसतः |
स्नायुतश्च तथास्थीनि नखा मज्जास्थिसम्भवाः ||
text_mt: From blood come body hair and flesh; from flesh come hair of the head and sinews; / from sinews likewise bones; nails and marrow arise from bone.

sanskrit_iast:
majjākāraṇavaikalyaṃ śukraṃ hi prasavātmakam |
iti dvādaśadhānnasya pariṇāmaḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
meaning:
मज्जाकारणवैकल्यं शुक्रं हि प्रसवात्मकम् |
इति द्वादशधान्नस्य परिणामः प्रकीर्तिताः ||
text_mt: Semen, which is generative, is the transformation caused by marrow. / Thus are declared the twelvefold transformations of food.

sanskrit_iast:
śukro'nnājjāyate śukrāddivyadehasya sambhavaḥ |
ṛtukāle yadā śukraṃ nirdoṣaṃ yonisaṃsthitam ||
meaning:
शुक्रोऽन्नाज्जायते शुक्राद्दिव्यदेहस्य सम्भवः |
ऋतुकाले यदा शुक्रं निर्दोषं योनिसंस्थितम् ||
text_mt: Semen is produced from food; from semen occurs the creation of the divine body. / When at the fertile season faultless semen enters the womb,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tad vāyusaṃspṛṣṭaṃ strīraktenaikatāṃ vrajet |
visargakāle śukrasya jīvaḥ kāraṇasaṃyutaḥ ||
meaning:
तदा तद् वायुसंस्पृष्टं स्त्रीरक्तेनैकतां व्रजेत् |
विसर्गकाले शुक्रस्य जीवः कारणसंयुतः ||
text_mt: then, touched by the wind, it attains unity with the woman's blood. / At the time of the emission of semen, the soul, accompanied by its causal body,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvṛtaḥ praviśedyoniṃ karmabhiḥ svairniyojitaḥ |
tacchukraraktamekasthamekāhātkalalaṃ bhavet ||
meaning:
संवृतः प्रविशेद्योनिं कर्मभिः स्वैर्नियोजितः |
तच्छुक्ररक्तमेकस्थमेकाहात्कललं भवेत् ||
text_mt: veiled and impelled by its own past actions, enters the womb. / That semen and blood united in one place become an embryonic mass in one day.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcarātreṇa kalalaṃ budbudākāratāṃ vrajet |
budbudaḥ saptarātreṇa māṃsapeśī bhavet punaḥ ||
meaning:
पञ्चरात्रेण कललं बुद्बुदाकारतां व्रजेत् |
बुद्बुदः सप्तरात्रेण मांसपेशी भवेत् पुनः ||
text_mt: In five nights the embryonic mass assumes the form of a bubble; / in seven nights the bubble becomes a lump of flesh again.

sanskrit_iast:
grīvā śiraśca skandhau ca pṛṣṭhavaṃśastathodaram |
pāṇipādaṃ tathā pārśve kaṭirgātraṃ tathaiva ca ||
meaning:
ग्रीवा शिरश्च स्कन्धौ च पृष्ठवंशस्तथोदरम् |
पाणिपादं तथा पार्श्वे कटिर्गात्रं तथैव च ||
text_mt: The neck, the head, the two shoulders, the backbone, the belly, / the hands and feet, both sides, the waist, and likewise the limbs

sanskrit_iast:
dvimāsābhyantareṇaiva kramaśaḥ śambhavediha |
tribhirmāsaiḥ prajāyante sarve hyaṅkurasandhayaḥ ||
māsaiścaturbhiraṅgulyaḥ prajāyante yathākramam |
mukhaṃ nāsā ca karṇau māsaiḥ pañcabhireva ca ||
meaning:
द्विमासाभ्यन्तरेणैव क्रमशः शम्भवेदिह |
त्रिभिर्मासैः प्रजायन्ते सर्वे ह्यङ्कुरसन्धयः ||
मासैश्चतुर्भिरङ्गुल्यः प्रजायन्ते यथाक्रमम् |
मुखं नासा च कर्णौ मासैः पञ्चभिरेव च ||
text_mt:
arise gradually here within two months; / in three months all the sprouted joints are formed.

In four months the fingers and toes are formed in due order; / the mouth, nose, and two ears form in five months.

sanskrit_iast:
dantapaṅktistathā guhyaṃ jāyante ca nakhāḥ punaḥ |
karṇayostu bhavecchidraṃ ṣaṇmāsābhyantareṇa tu ||
meaning:
दन्तपङ्क्तिस्तथा गुह्यं जायन्ते च नखाः पुनः |
कर्णयोस्तु भवेच्छिद्रं षण्मासाभ्यन्तरेण तु ||
text_mt: The row of teeth, the private parts, and nails also arise; / within six months the hole of the ears appears.

sanskrit_iast:
pāyurmehamupasthaṃ ca nābhiścābhyupajāyate |
sandhayo ye ca gātreṣu māsairjāyanti saptabhiḥ ||
meaning:
पायुर्मेहमुपस्थं च नाभिश्चाभ्युपजायते |
सन्धयो ये च गात्रेषु मासैर्जायन्ति सप्तभिः ||
text_mt: The anus, urethra, genitals, and navel are formed; / and the joints that are in the limbs arise in seven months.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgapratyaṅgasampūrṇaḥ paripakvaḥ sa tiṣṭhati |
udare māturācchanno jarāyau munisattama ||
meaning:
अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गसम्पूर्णः परिपक्वः स तिष्ठति |
उदरे मातुराच्छन्नो जरायौ मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: Complete with major and minor limbs, fully matured, it rests / in the belly of the mother, enveloped in the fetal membrane, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
māturāhāracauryeṇa ṣaḍvidhena rasena tu |
nābhinālanibaddhena varddhate sa dine dine ||
meaning:
मातुराहारचौर्येण षड्विधेन रसेन तु |
नाभिनालनिबद्धेन वर्द्धते स दिने दिने ||
text_mt: By stealing nourishment from the mother, through the sixfold flavored sap / connected through the umbilical cord, it grows day by day.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ smṛtiṃ labhejjīvaḥ sampūrṇe'smin śarīrake |
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vijānāti nidrāsvapnaṃ purākṛtam ||
meaning:
ततः स्मृतिं लभेज्जीवः सम्पूर्णेऽस्मिन् शरीरके |
सुखं दुःखं विजानाति निद्रास्वप्नं पुराकृतम् ||
text_mt: Then, when this little body is complete, the soul regains memory; / it recognizes pleasure, pain, sleep, dreams, and past deeds:

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtaścāhaṃ punarjāto jātaścāhaṃ punarmṛtaḥ |
nānāyonisahasrāṇi mayā dṛṣṭāni jāyatā ||
meaning:
मृतश्चाहं पुनर्जातो जातश्चाहं पुनर्मृतः |
नानायोनिसहस्राणि मया दृष्टानि जायता ||
text_mt: "I have died and been born again; I was born and died again; / thousands of various wombs have been seen by me as I was born.

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā jātamātro'haṃ prāptasaṃskāra eva ca |
śreyo'munā kariṣyāmi yena garbhe na sambhavaḥ ||
meaning:
अधुना जातमात्रोऽहं प्राप्तसंस्कार एव च |
श्रेयोऽमुना करिष्यामि येन गर्भे न सम्भवः ||
text_mt: Now, the moment I am born and receive the sacred rites, / I shall accomplish that good by which there is no further rebirth in a womb."

sanskrit_iast:
garbhasthaścintayannevamahaṃ garbhādviniḥsṛtaḥ |
anveṣyāmi śivajñānaṃ saṃsāravinivartakam ||
meaning:
गर्भस्थश्चिन्तयन्नेवमहं गर्भाद्विनिःसृतः |
अन्वेष्यामि शिवज्ञानं संसारविनिवर्तकम् ||
text_mt: Thinking thus while dwelling in the womb, [it resolves:] "Once emerged from the womb, / I shall seek the knowledge of Śiva which puts an end to worldly existence."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa garbhaduḥkhena mahatā paripīḍitaḥ |
jīvaḥ karmavaśādāste mokṣopāyaṃ vicintayan ||
meaning:
एवं स गर्भदुःखेन महता परिपीडितः |
जीवः कर्मवशादास्ते मोक्षोपायं विचिन्तयन् ||
text_mt: Tormented thus by the great suffering of the womb, / the soul sits under the sway of past action, reflecting on the means to liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā girivarākrāntaḥ kaścidduḥkhena tiṣṭhati |
tathā jarāyuṇā dehī duḥkhaṃ tiṣṭhati veṣṭitaḥ ||
meaning:
यथा गिरिवराक्रान्तः कश्चिद्दुःखेन तिष्ठति |
तथा जरायुणा देही दुःखं तिष्ठति वेष्टितः ||
text_mt: Just as someone remains in distress crushed under a great mountain, / so the embodied soul stays in distress, enveloped by the fetal membrane.

sanskrit_iast:
patitaḥ sāgare yadvadduḥkhamāste samākulaḥ |
garbhodakena siktāṅgaḥ sarvadākulitastadā ||
meaning:
पतितः सागरे यद्वद्दुःखमास्ते समाकुलः |
गर्भोदकेन सिक्ताङ्गः सर्वदाकुलितस्तदा ||
text_mt: Just as one fallen into the ocean remains in misery and agitation, / so, its limbs soaked in amniotic fluid, it remains constantly agitated.

sanskrit_iast:
lohakumbhe yathā nyastaḥ pacyate kaścidagninā |
garbhakumbhe tathā kṣiptaḥ pacyate jaṭharāgninā ||
meaning:
लोहकुम्भे यथा न्यस्तः पच्यते कश्चिदग्निना |
गर्भकुम्भे तथा क्षिप्तः पच्यते जठराग्निना ||
text_mt: Just as someone cast into an iron cauldron is cooked by fire, / so, thrown into the cauldron of the womb, it is cooked by the gastric fire.

sanskrit_iast:
sūcībhiragnivarṇābhirnirbhinnasya nirantaram |
yadduḥkhaṃ jāyate tasya tatra saṃsthasya cādhikam ||
meaning:
सूचीभिरग्निवर्णाभिर्निर्भिन्नस्य निरन्तरम् |
यद्दुःखं जायते तस्य तत्र संस्थस्य चाधिकम् ||
text_mt: Whatever pain arises for one pierced incessantly by fire-colored needles / is exceeded for the soul dwelling there.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhāvāsātparaṃ duḥkhaṃ kaṣṭaṃ naivāsti kutracit |
dehināṃ duḥkhabahulaṃ sughoramatisaṅkaṭam ||
meaning:
गर्भावासात्परं दुःखं कष्टं नैवास्ति कुत्रचित् |
देहिनां दुःखबहुलं सुघोरमतिसङ्कटम् ||
text_mt: There is no misery or hardship anywhere greater than dwelling in a womb; / for embodied souls, it is full of distress, exceedingly terrible, and an extreme torment.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetatsumahadduḥkhaṃ pāpināṃ parikīrtitam |
kevalaṃ dharmabudhdīnāṃ saptamāsairbhavaḥ sadā ||
meaning:
इत्येतत्सुमहद्दुःखं पापिनां परिकीर्तितम् |
केवलं धर्मबुध्दीनां सप्तमासैर्भवः सदा ||
text_mt: Thus has this immense suffering of sinners been described. / But for those of righteous mind, birth takes place always in seven months.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhātsudurlabhaṃ duḥkhaṃ yoniyantranipīḍanāt |
bhavetpāpātmanāṃ vyāsa na hi dharmayutātmanām ||
meaning:
गर्भात्सुदुर्लभं दुःखं योनियन्त्रनिपीडनात् |
भवेत्पापात्मनां व्यास न हि धर्मयुतात्मनाम् ||
text_mt: The suffering from the womb, through the tormenting press of the birth-canal, / falls upon sinners, O Vyāsa, never upon those endowed with righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
ikṣuvatpīḍyamānasya yantreṇaiva samantataḥ |
śirasā tāḍyamānasya pāpamudgarakeṇa ca ||
meaning:
इक्षुवत्पीड्यमानस्य यन्त्रेणैव समन्ततः |
शिरसा ताड्यमानस्य पापमुद्गरकेण च ||
text_mt: He is pressed on all sides like sugarcane in a press, / and struck on the head by the club of his sins.

sanskrit_iast:
yantreṇa pīḍitā yadvanniḥsārāḥ ssyustilāḥ kṣaṇāt |
tathā śarīraṃ nissāraṃ yoniyantranipīḍanāt ||
meaning:
यन्त्रेण पीडिता यद्वन्निःसाराः स्स्युस्तिलाः क्षणात् |
तथा शरीरं निस्सारं योनियन्त्रनिपीडनात् ||
text_mt: Just as sesame seeds pressed in an oil-mill become instantly devoid of essence, / even so the body becomes sapless from the tormenting press of the birth-canal.

sanskrit_iast:
asthipādatulāstambhaṃ snāyubandhena yantritam |
raktamāṃsamṛdāliptaṃ viṇmūtradravyabhājanam ||
meaning:
अस्थिपादतुलास्तम्भं स्नायुबन्धेन यन्त्रितम् |
रक्तमांसमृदालिप्तं विण्मूत्रद्रव्यभाजनम् ||
text_mt: It has pillars and beams of bones and feet, fastened with the binding of sinews; / it is plastered with the mud of blood and flesh, a vessel of feces and urine;

sanskrit_iast:
keśaromanakhacchannaṃ rogāyatanamāturam |
vadanaikamahādvāraṃ gavākṣāṣṭakabhūṣitam ||
meaning:
केशरोमनखच्छन्नं रोगायतनमातुरम् |
वदनैकमहाद्वारं गवाक्षाष्टकभूषितम् ||
text_mt: covered with hair on head and body and with nails; an afflicted abode of diseases; / possessing one great gateway, the mouth, and adorned with eight windows;

sanskrit_iast:
oṣṭhadvayakapāṭaṃ ca tathā jihvārgalānvitam |
bhogatṛṣṇāturaṃ mūḍhaṃ rāgadveṣavaśānugam ||
meaning:
ओष्ठद्वयकपाटं च तथा जिह्वार्गलान्वितम् |
भोगतृष्णातुरं मूढं रागद्वेषवशानुगम् ||
text_mt: having the two lips as doors and the tongue as a bolt; / tormented by thirst for pleasures, deluded, subject to attachment and aversion;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvartitāṅgapratyaṅgaṃ jarāyupariveṣṭitam |
saṅkaṭenāviviktena yonimārgeṇa nirgatam ||
meaning:
संवर्तिताङ्गप्रत्यङ्गं जरायुपरिवेष्टितम् |
सङ्कटेनाविविक्तेन योनिमार्गेण निर्गतम् ||
text_mt: its major and minor limbs folded up, wrapped in the chorion; / emerged through the narrow, unrefined passage of the birth-canal;

sanskrit_iast:
viṇmūtraraktasiktāṅgaṃ vikośikasamudbhavam |
asthipañjaravikhyātamasmin jñeyaṃ kalevaram ||
meaning:
विण्मूत्ररक्तसिक्ताङ्गं विकोशिकसमुद्भवम् |
अस्थिपञ्जरविख्यातमस्मिन् ज्ञेयं कलेवरम् ||
text_mt: its limbs smeared with feces, urine, and blood, emerging from the membrane— / this body is to be known as a celebrated cage of bones.

sanskrit_iast:
śatatrayaṃ ṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ pañca peśīśatāni ca |
sārdhābhistisṛbhiśchannaṃ samantādromakoṭibhiḥ ||
meaning:
शतत्रयं षष्ट्यधिकं पञ्च पेशीशतानि च |
सार्धाभिस्तिसृभिश्छन्नं समन्ताद्रोमकोटिभिः ||
text_mt: Three hundred and sixty [bones], five hundred muscles, / and covered all around with thirty-five million body hairs;

sanskrit_iast:
śarīraṃ sthūlasūkṣmābhirdṛśyādṛśyā hi tāḥ smṛtāḥ |
etāvatībhirnāḍībhiḥ koṭibhistatsamantataḥ ||
meaning:
शरीरं स्थूलसूक्ष्माभिर्दृश्यादृश्या हि ताः स्मृताः |
एतावतीभिर्नाडीभिः कोटिभिस्तत्समन्ततः ||
text_mt: the body [is covered] with gross and subtle channels—for they are said to be visible and invisible— / by so many millions [of vessels] all around it,

sanskrit_iast:
asvedamadhubhiryābhirantasthaḥ sravate bahiḥ |
dvātriṃśaddaśanāḥ proktā viṃśatiśca nakhāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
meaning:
अस्वेदमधुभिर्याभिरन्तस्थः स्रवते बहिः |
द्वात्रिंशद्दशनाः प्रोक्ता विंशतिश्च नखाः स्मृताः ||
text_mt: through which the internal fluid, sweatless and sweet, oozes outward. / Thirty-two teeth are declared, and twenty nails are recorded.

sanskrit_iast:
pittasya kuḍavaṃ jñeyaṃ kaphasyāthāḍhakaṃ smṛtam |
vasāyāśca palaṃ viṃśattadardhaṃ kapilasya ca ||
meaning:
पित्तस्य कुडवं ज्ञेयं कफस्याथाढकं स्मृतम् |
वसायाश्च पलं विंशत्तदर्धं कपिलस्य च ||
text_mt: A kuḍava of bile is to be known, and an āḍhaka of phlegm is recorded; / twenty palas of fat, and half of that of yellowish bile.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcārddhaṃ tu tulā jñeyā palāni daśa medasaḥ |
palatrayaṃ mahāraktaṃ majjāyāśca caturguṇam ||
meaning:
पञ्चार्द्धं तु तुला ज्ञेया पलानि दश मेदसः |
पलत्रयं महारक्तं मज्जायाश्च चतुर्गुणम् ||
text_mt: Half of five [palas] is a tulā, ten palas of adipose tissue are to be known; / three palas of primary blood, and four times that of marrow.

sanskrit_iast:
śukro'rddhaṃ kuḍavaṃ jñeyaṃ tadbījaṃ dehināṃ balam |
māṃsasya caikapiṇḍena palasāhasramucyate ||
meaning:
शुक्रोऽर्द्धं कुडवं ज्ञेयं तद्बीजं देहिनां बलम् |
मांसस्य चैकपिण्डेन पलसाहस्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: Semen is to be known as half a kuḍava; it is the seed, the strength of embodied beings. / And of flesh, in a single mass, a thousand palas are spoken of.

sanskrit_iast:
raktaṃ palaśataṃ jñeyaṃ viṇmūtraṃ yatpramāṇataḥ |
añjalayaśca catvāraścatvāro munisattama ||
meaning:
रक्तं पलशतं ज्ञेयं विण्मूत्रं यत्प्रमाणतः |
अञ्जलयश्च चत्वारश्चत्वारो मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: Blood is to be known as a hundred palas; and as for feces and urine, by measure, / they are each four añjalis, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
iti dehagṛhaṃ hyetannityasyānityamātmanaḥ |
aviśuddhaṃ viśuddhasya karmabandhādvinirmitam ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
इति देहगृहं ह्येतन्नित्यस्यानित्यमात्मनः |
अविशुद्धं विशुद्धस्य कर्मबन्धाद्विनिर्मितम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt: Thus this bodily house of the eternal soul is transient, / impure for the pure, fashioned by the bond of action.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
śṛṇu vyāsa mahābuddhe dehasyāśucitāṃ mune |
mahattvaṃ ca svabhāvasya samāsātkathayāmyaham ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
शृणु व्यास महाबुद्धे देहस्याशुचितां मुने |
महत्त्वं च स्वभावस्य समासात्कथयाम्यहम् ||
title: trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | dehāśucitvabālyādyavasthāduḥkhavarṇanam
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Listen, O Vyāsa of great intellect, O sage, to the impurity of the body / and the power of its nature; I shall speak in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
śukraśoṇitasaṃyogāddehaḥ sañjāyate yataḥ |
nityaṃ viṇmūtrasampūrṇastenāyamaśuciḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
शुक्रशोणितसंयोगाद्देहः सञ्जायते यतः |
नित्यं विण्मूत्रसम्पूर्णस्तेनायमशुचिः स्मृतः ||
text_mt: Because the body is produced from the union of semen and blood / and is always filled with feces and urine, it is therefore declared impure.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāntarviṣṭhayā pūrṇaḥ śucimānna bahirghaṭaḥ |
śodhyamāno hi deho'yaṃ tenāyamaśucistataḥ ||
meaning:
यथान्तर्विष्ठया पूर्णः शुचिमान्न बहिर्घटः |
शोध्यमानो हि देहोऽयं तेनायमशुचिस्ततः ||
text_mt: Just as a pot filled inside with feces does not become pure on the outside [though washed], / so this body, even while being cleansed, remains therefore impure.

sanskrit_iast:
samprāpyāti pavitrāṇi pañcagavyaṃ havīṃṣi ca |
aśucitvaṃ kṣaṇādyānti kimanyadaśucistataḥ ||
meaning:
सम्प्राप्याति पवित्राणि पञ्चगव्यं हवींषि च |
अशुचित्वं क्षणाद्यान्ति किमन्यदशुचिस्ततः ||
text_mt: Even exceedingly pure things like the five products of the cow and sacrificial offerings, / having reached [it], instantly become impure; what else is more impure than that?

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdyānyapyannapānāni yaṃ prāpya surabhīṇi ca |
aśucitvaṃ prayāntyāśu kimanyadaśucistataḥ ||
meaning:
हृद्यान्यप्यन्नपानानि यं प्राप्य सुरभीणि च |
अशुचित्वं प्रयान्त्याशु किमन्यदशुचिस्ततः ||
text_mt: Even foods and drinks that are delightful and fragrant, / having reached it, quickly turn into impurity; what else is more impure than that?

sanskrit_iast:
he janāḥ kinna paśyanti yanniryāti dine dine |
svadehātkaśmalaṃ pūtistadādhāraḥ kathaṃ śuciḥ ||
meaning:
हे जनाः किन्न पश्यन्ति यन्निर्याति दिने दिने |
स्वदेहात्कश्मलं पूतिस्तदाधारः कथं शुचिः ||
text_mt: O people, do they not see what leaves their own body / day after day as filth and foul rot? How can its receptacle be pure?

sanskrit_iast:
dehaḥ saśodhyamāno'pi pañcagavyakuśāmbubhiḥ |
ghṛṣyamāṇa ivāṅgāro nirmalatvaṃ na gacchati ||
meaning:
देहः सशोध्यमानोऽपि पञ्चगव्यकुशाम्बुभिः |
घृष्यमाण इवाङ्गारो निर्मलत्वं न गच्छति ||
text_mt: Even while being cleansed with the five products of the cow and kuśa-water, / the body does not attain spotless purity, like charcoal being scrubbed.

sanskrit_iast:
srotāṃsi yasya satataṃ prabhavanti gireriva |
kaphamūtrapurīṣādyaiḥ sa dehaḥ śudhyate katham ||
meaning:
स्रोतांसि यस्य सततं प्रभवन्ति गिरेरिव |
कफमूत्रपुरीषाद्यैः स देहः शुध्यते कथम् ||
text_mt: Whose streams constantly issue forth like [springs] from a mountain / with phlegm, urine, feces, and the like—how can that body be purified?

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāśucinidhānasya śarīrasya na vidyate |
śucirekaḥ pradeśo'pi viṇmūtrasya dṛteriva ||
meaning:
सर्वाशुचिनिधानस्य शरीरस्य न विद्यते |
शुचिरेकः प्रदेशोऽपि विण्मूत्रस्य दृतेरिव ||
text_mt: For the body, the repository of all impurities, / not even a single spot is pure, like a leather bag of feces and urine.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭvātmadehasrotāṃsi mṛttoyaiḥ śodhyate karaḥ |
tathāpyaśucibhāṇḍasya na vibhraśyati kiṃ karaḥ ||
meaning:
सृष्ट्वात्मदेहस्रोतांसि मृत्तोयैः शोध्यते करः |
तथाप्यशुचिभाण्डस्य न विभ्रश्यति किं करः ||
text_mt: Having touched the orifices of one's own body, the hand is purified with clay and water; / even so, does the hand of this vessel of impurity not fall [from purity]?

sanskrit_iast:
kāyaḥ sugandhadhūpādyairyatnenāpi susaṃskṛtaḥ |
na jahāti svabhāvaṃ sa śvapucchamiva nāmitam ||
meaning:
कायः सुगन्धधूपाद्यैर्यत्नेनापि सुसंस्कृतः |
न जहाति स्वभावं स श्वपुच्छमिव नामितम् ||
text_mt: Even when carefully treated with fragrant incenses and perfumes, / the body does not abandon its nature, like a dog's tail that has been bent.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā jātyaiva kṛṣṇorthaḥ śuklaḥ ssyānnahyupāyataḥ |
saṃśoddhyamānāpi tathā bhavenmūrtirna nirmalā ||
meaning:
यथा जात्यैव कृष्णोर्थः शुक्लः स्स्यान्नह्युपायतः |
संशोद्ध्यमानापि तथा भवेन्मूर्तिर्न निर्मला ||
text_mt: Just as an object that is black by its very nature cannot become white by any means, / even so this form, though thoroughly washed, cannot become spotless.

sanskrit_iast:
jighrannapi svadurgandhaṃ paśyannapi svakaṃ malam |
na virajyeta loko'yaṃ pīḍayannapi nāsikām ||
meaning:
जिघ्रन्नपि स्वदुर्गन्धं पश्यन्नपि स्वकं मलम् |
न विरज्येत लोकोऽयं पीडयन्नपि नासिकाम् ||
text_mt: Even while smelling its own foul odor, even while seeing its own filth, / this world does not become detached, even while holding its nose.

sanskrit_iast:
aho mohasya māhātmyaṃ yenedaṃ chāditaṃ jagat |
śīghraṃ paśyan svakaṃ doṣaṃ kāyasya na virajyate ||
meaning:
अहो मोहस्य माहात्म्यं येनेदं छादितं जगत् |
शीघ्रं पश्यन् स्वकं दोषं कायस्य न विरज्यते ||
text_mt: Ah, the power of delusion by which this world is shrouded! / Readily seeing the defect of his body, a person does not become detached.

sanskrit_iast:
svadehasya vigandhena na virajyeta yo naraḥ |
virāgakāraṇaṃ tasya kimetadupadiśyate ||
meaning:
स्वदेहस्य विगन्धेन न विरज्येत यो नरः |
विरागकारणं तस्य किमेतदुपदिश्यते ||
text_mt: A person who is not disgusted by the foul odor of his own body— / what can be taught to him as a cause of detachment?

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasyaiva jaganmadhye deha evāśucirbhavet |
tanmalāvayavasparśācchucirapyaśucirbhavet ||
meaning:
सर्वस्यैव जगन्मध्ये देह एवाशुचिर्भवेत् |
तन्मलावयवस्पर्शाच्छुचिरप्यशुचिर्भवेत् ||
text_mt: In the midst of the entire world, the body alone is impure; / by contact with the parts of its filth, even what is pure becomes impure.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhalepāpanodārtha śaucaṃ dehasya kīrtitam |
dvayasyāpagamācchuddhiḥ śuddhasparśādviśudhyati ||
meaning:
गन्धलेपापनोदार्थ शौचं देहस्य कीर्तितम् |
द्वयस्यापगमाच्छुद्धिः शुद्धस्पर्शाद्विशुध्यति ||
text_mt: Purification of the body is proclaimed for the removal of odor and smear; / from the removal of both comes purity; it is purified through contact with what is pure.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgātoyena sarveṇa mṛdbhāraiḥ parvatopamaiḥ |
āmṛtyorācarecchaucaṃ bhāvaduṣṭo na śudhyati ||
meaning:
गङ्गातोयेन सर्वेण मृद्भारैः पर्वतोपमैः |
आमृत्योराचरेच्छौचं भावदुष्टो न शुध्यति ||
text_mt: Even if one were to practice purification until death with all the water of the Gaṅgā / and mountain-like loads of earth, one of corrupt intention is not purified.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthasnānaistapobhirvā duṣṭātmā naiva śudhyati |
śvadṛtiḥ kṣālitā tīrthe kiṃ śuddhimadhigacchati ||
meaning:
तीर्थस्नानैस्तपोभिर्वा दुष्टात्मा नैव शुध्यति |
श्वदृतिः क्षालिता तीर्थे किं शुद्धिमधिगच्छति ||
text_mt: By baths at holy sites or by austerities, a wicked-minded person is never purified; / does a dog's leather bag washed at a holy ford attain purity?

sanskrit_iast:
antarbhāvapraduṣṭasya viśato'pi hutāśanam |
na svargo nāpavargaśca dehanirdahanaṃ param ||
meaning:
अन्तर्भावप्रदुष्टस्य विशतोऽपि हुताशनम् |
न स्वर्गो नापवर्गश्च देहनिर्दहनं परम् ||
text_mt: For one whose inner disposition is corrupted, even if he enters fire, / there is neither heaven nor liberation—only the burning of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṇa gāṅgena jalena samyaṅ mṛtparvatenāpyatha bhāvaduṣṭaḥ |
ājanmanaḥ snānaparo manuṣyo na śudhyatītyeva vayaṃ vadāmaḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वेण गाङ्गेन जलेन सम्यङ् मृत्पर्वतेनाप्यथ भावदुष्टः |
आजन्मनः स्नानपरो मनुष्यो न शुध्यतीत्येव वयं वदामः ||
text_mt: Even with all the water of the Gaṅgā and indeed a mountain of clay, / a corrupt-minded man devoted to bathing from birth is not purified; so we declare.

sanskrit_iast:
prajvālya vahniṃ ghṛtatailasiktaṃ pradakṣiṇāvartaśikhaṃ mahāntam |
praviśya dagdhastvapi bhāvaduṣṭo na dharmamāpnoti phalaṃ na cānyat ||
meaning:
प्रज्वाल्य वह्निं घृततैलसिक्तं प्रदक्षिणावर्तशिखं महान्तम् |
प्रविश्य दग्धस्त्वपि भावदुष्टो न धर्ममाप्नोति फलं न चान्यत् ||
text_mt: Kindling a great fire drenched in ghee and oil, with flames curling to the right, / even if one enters and is burned, one of corrupt intention attains neither merit nor any other fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāditīrtheṣu vasanti matsyā devālaye pakṣigaṇāśca nityam |
bhāvojjhitāste na phalaṃ labhante tīrthāvagāhācca tathaiva dānāt ||
meaning:
गङ्गादितीर्थेषु वसन्ति मत्स्या देवालये पक्षिगणाश्च नित्यम् |
भावोज्झितास्ते न फलं लभन्ते तीर्थावगाहाच्च तथैव दानात् ||
text_mt: Fish dwell permanently in holy waters such as the Gaṅgā, and flocks of birds in temples; / devoid of [proper] disposition, they gain no fruit from immersing in holy waters or from charity.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvaśuddhiḥ paraṃ śaucaṃ pramāṇe sarvakarmasu |
anyathāliṅgyate kāntā bhāvena duhitānyathā ||
meaning:
भावशुद्धिः परं शौचं प्रमाणे सर्वकर्मसु |
अन्यथालिङ्ग्यते कान्ता भावेन दुहितान्यथा ||
text_mt: Purity of intention is the supreme purity, the criterion in all actions; / a beloved wife is embraced with one intention, a daughter with another.

sanskrit_iast:
manaso bhidyate vṛttirabhinneṣvapi vastuṣu |
anyathaiva sutaṃ nārī cintayatyanyathā patim ||
meaning:
मनसो भिद्यते वृत्तिरभिन्नेष्वपि वस्तुषु |
अन्यथैव सुतं नारी चिन्तयत्यन्यथा पतिम् ||
text_mt: The function of the mind differs even toward identical objects; / a woman thinks of her son in one way, and of her husband in another.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyadhvamasya bhāvasya mahābhāgyamaśeṣataḥ |
pariṣvakto'pi yannāryā bhāvahīnaṃ na kāmayet ||
meaning:
पश्यध्वमस्य भावस्य महाभाग्यमशेषतः |
परिष्वक्तोऽपि यन्नार्या भावहीनं न कामयेत् ||
text_mt: Behold the immense power of this intention entirely: / even when embraced by a woman, one devoid of desire would not desire [her].

sanskrit_iast:
nādyādvividhamannādyaṃ bhakṣyāṇi surabhīṇi ca |
yadi cintāṃ samādhatte citte kāmādiṣu triṣu ||
meaning:
नाद्याद्विविधमन्नाद्यं भक्ष्याणि सुरभीणि च |
यदि चिन्तां समाधत्ते चित्ते कामादिषु त्रिषु ||
text_mt: One would not eat diverse foods and fragrant delicacies / if one fixes anxiety in one's mind upon the three [afflictions] beginning with desire.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhyate tena bhāvena naro bhāvādvimucyate |
bhāvataḥ śuci śuddhātmā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati ||
meaning:
गृह्यते तेन भावेन नरो भावाद्विमुच्यते |
भावतः शुचि शुद्धात्मा स्वर्गं मोक्षं च विन्दति ||
text_mt: By that mental disposition a man is bound; by mental disposition he is freed. / From mental disposition, pure and with purified soul, he attains heaven and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvenaikātmaśuddhātmā dahan juhvan stuvan mṛtaḥ |
jñānāvāpteravāpyāśu lokān subahuyājinām ||
meaning:
भावेनैकात्मशुद्धात्मा दहन् जुह्वन् स्तुवन् मृतः |
ज्ञानावाप्तेरवाप्याशु लोकान् सुबहुयाजिनाम् ||
text_mt: When a man of purified soul, single-minded through disposition, burns [oblations], offers sacrifices, or praises [God], on dying, / through gaining knowledge he swiftly reaches the worlds of those who perform very many sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānāmalāmbhasā puṃsāṃ sadvairāgyamṛdā punaḥ |
avidyārāgaviṇmūtralepagandhaviśodhanam ||
meaning:
ज्ञानामलाम्भसा पुंसां सद्वैराग्यमृदा पुनः |
अविद्यारागविण्मूत्रलेपगन्धविशोधनम् ||
text_mt: For men, with the pure water of knowledge and the earth of true dispassion, / there is cleansing of the scent and smear of ignorance, passion, feces, and urine.

sanskrit_iast:
evametaccharīraṃ hi nisargādaśuci smṛtam |
tvaṅmātrasāraṃ niḥsāraṃ kadalīsārasannibham ||
meaning:
एवमेतच्छरीरं हि निसर्गादशुचि स्मृतम् |
त्वङ्मात्रसारं निःसारं कदलीसारसन्निभम् ||
text_mt: Thus indeed this body is known to be impure by its very nature, / having substance only in skin, devoid of pith, like the trunk of a plantain tree.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvaivaṃ doṣavaddehaṃ yaḥ prājñaḥ śithilo bhavet |
dehabhogodbhavādbhāvācchamacittaḥ prasannadhīḥ ||
meaning:
ज्ञात्वैवं दोषवद्देहं यः प्राज्ञः शिथिलो भवेत् |
देहभोगोद्भवाद्भावाच्छमचित्तः प्रसन्नधीः ||
text_mt: The wise man who, having thus understood the body to be full of faults, becomes detached / from the disposition arising from bodily enjoyments, with a tranquil mind and clear intellect,

sanskrit_iast:
so'tikrāmati saṃsāraṃ jīvanmuktaḥ prajāyate |
saṃsāraṅkadalīsāradṛḍhagrāhyavatiṣṭhate ||
meaning:
सोऽतिक्रामति संसारं जीवन्मुक्तः प्रजायते |
संसारङ्कदलीसारदृढग्राह्यवतिष्ठते ||
text_mt: he transcends worldly existence and becomes liberated while living. / He who holds firmly to worldly existence remains grasped by plantain-trunk substance.

sanskrit_iast:
evametanmahākaṣṭaṃ janmaduḥkhaṃ prakīrtitam |
puṃsāmajñānadoṣeṇa nānākarmavaśena ca ||
meaning:
एवमेतन्महाकष्टं जन्मदुःखं प्रकीर्तितम् |
पुंसामज्ञानदोषेण नानाकर्मवशेन च ||
text_mt: Thus this greatly distressing suffering of birth has been proclaimed, / caused by men's fault of ignorance and governed by manifold karma.

sanskrit_iast:
ślokārdhena tu vakṣyāmi yaduktaṃ granthakoṭibhiḥ |
mameti paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ na mameti paraṃ sukham ||
meaning:
श्लोकार्धेन तु वक्ष्यामि यदुक्तं ग्रन्थकोटिभिः |
ममेति परमं दुःखं न ममेति परं सुखम् ||
text_mt: In half a verse, however, I shall state what has been proclaimed in ten million treatises: / 'Mine' is the supreme suffering; 'not mine' is supreme happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
bahavo'pīha rājānaḥ paraṃ lokamito gatāḥ |
nirmamatvasametāstu baddhāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ||
meaning:
बहवोऽपीह राजानः परं लोकमितो गताः |
निर्ममत्वसमेतास्तु बद्धाः शतसहस्रशः ||
text_mt: Many kings here have departed hence to the other world, / but those possessed of freedom from the sense of 'mine' [are freed, whereas] hundreds of thousands are bound.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhasthasya smṛtiryāsītsā ca tasya praṇaśyati |
sammūrchitena duḥkhena yoniyantranipīḍanāt ||
meaning:
गर्भस्थस्य स्मृतिर्यासीत्सा च तस्य प्रणश्यति |
सम्मूर्छितेन दुःखेन योनियन्त्रनिपीडनात् ||
text_mt: The memory that he had while in the womb is lost / due to his being stupefied with suffering from the pressure of the machine of the womb.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhyena vāyunā vāsya mohasaṅgena dehinaḥ |
spṛṣṭamātreṇa ghoreṇa jvaraḥ samupajāyate ||
meaning:
बाह्येन वायुना वास्य मोहसङ्गेन देहिनः |
स्पृष्टमात्रेण घोरेण ज्वरः समुपजायते ||
text_mt: Or by the external wind, by contact with delusion, / a dreadful fever is produced in the embodied being the moment he is touched.

sanskrit_iast:
tena jvareṇa mahatā sammohaśca prajāyate |
sammūḍhasya smṛtibhraṃśaḥ śīghraṃ sañjāyate punaḥ ||
meaning:
तेन ज्वरेण महता सम्मोहश्च प्रजायते |
सम्मूढस्य स्मृतिभ्रंशः शीघ्रं सञ्जायते पुनः ||
text_mt: From that great fever, delusion is produced; / and for one who is deluded, loss of memory swiftly occurs again.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtibhraṃśāttatastasya smṛtirnno pūrvakarmaṇaḥ |
ratiḥ sañjāyate tūrṇaṃ jantostatraiva janmani ||
meaning:
स्मृतिभ्रंशात्ततस्तस्य स्मृतिर्न्नो पूर्वकर्मणः |
रतिः सञ्जायते तूर्णं जन्तोस्तत्रैव जन्मनि ||
text_mt: Then, because of the loss of memory, he has no recollection of past karma; / immediately attachment is born in the living being right in that birth.

sanskrit_iast:
rakto mūḍhaśca loko'yaṃ na kārye sampravartate |
na cātmānaṃ vijānāti na paraṃ na ca daivatam ||
meaning:
रक्तो मूढश्च लोकोऽयं न कार्ये सम्प्रवर्तते |
न चात्मानं विजानाति न परं न च दैवतम् ||
text_mt: Attached and deluded, this world does not engage in what ought to be done; / nor does it know the self, nor the supreme, nor the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
na śṛṇoti paraṃ śreyaḥ sati karṇe'pi sanmune |
na paśyati paraṃ śreyaḥ sati cakṣuṣi tatkṣame ||
meaning:
न शृणोति परं श्रेयः सति कर्णेऽपि सन्मुने |
न पश्यति परं श्रेयः सति चक्षुषि तत्क्षमे ||
text_mt: It does not hear the supreme good, even though having ears, O virtuous sage; / it does not see the supreme good, even though having eyes capable of that.

sanskrit_iast:
same pathi śanairgacchan skhalatīva pade pade |
satyāṃ buddhau na jānāti bodhyamāno budhairapi ||
meaning:
समे पथि शनैर्गच्छन् स्खलतीव पदे पदे |
सत्यां बुद्धौ न जानाति बोध्यमानो बुधैरपि ||
text_mt: Walking slowly on an even path, it stumbles, as it were, at every step; / even though possessing intellect, it does not understand, though instructed even by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāre kliśyate tena garbhalobhavaśānugaḥ |
garbhasmṛtena pāpena samujjhitamatiḥ pumān ||
meaning:
संसारे क्लिश्यते तेन गर्भलोभवशानुगः |
गर्भस्मृतेन पापेन समुज्झितमतिः पुमान् ||
text_mt: Therefore the man is afflicted in worldly existence, subject to the greed of the womb, / his mind cast down by the sin remembered from the womb.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ mahatparaṃ divyaṃ śāstramuktaṃ śivena tu |
tapasaḥ kathanārthāya svargamokṣaprasādhanam ||
meaning:
इत्थं महत्परं दिव्यं शास्त्रमुक्तं शिवेन तु |
तपसः कथनार्थाय स्वर्गमोक्षप्रसाधनम् ||
text_mt: Thus Śiva spoke the great, supreme, divine scripture, / to teach about austerity, bringing about heaven and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ye satyasmin śive jñāne sarvakāmārthasādhane |
na kurvantyātmanaḥ śreyastadeva mahadadbhutam ||
meaning:
ये सत्यस्मिन् शिवे ज्ञाने सर्वकामार्थसाधने |
न कुर्वन्त्यात्मनः श्रेयस्तदेव महदद्भुतम् ||
text_mt: Since this knowledge of Śiva, which accomplishes all desires and aims, exists, / that people do not bring about their own good is indeed a great wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktendriyavṛttitvād bālye duḥkhaṃ mahatpunaḥ |
icchannapi na śaknoti vaktuṃ kartuṃ pratikriyām ||
meaning:
अव्यक्तेन्द्रियवृत्तित्वाद् बाल्ये दुःखं महत्पुनः |
इच्छन्नपि न शक्नोति वक्तुं कर्तुं प्रतिक्रियाम् ||
text_mt: Furthermore, in childhood there is great suffering because the sense organs' functions are unmanifest; / even though wishing, one cannot speak or apply a remedy.

sanskrit_iast:
dantotthāne mahadduḥkhamalpena vyādhinā tathā |
bālarogaiśca vividhaiḥ pīḍā bālagrahairapi ||
meaning:
दन्तोत्थाने महद्दुःखमल्पेन व्याधिना तथा |
बालरोगैश्च विविधैः पीडा बालग्रहैरपि ||
text_mt: At the eruption of teeth there is great suffering, and likewise from slight disease, / and affliction from diverse childhood ailments and childhood spirits.

sanskrit_iast:
kvacitkṣuttṛṭparītāṅgaḥ kvacittiṣṭhati saṃraṭan |
viṇmūtrabhakṣaṇādyaṃ ca mohād bālaḥ samācaret ||
meaning:
क्वचित्क्षुत्तृट्परीताङ्गः क्वचित्तिष्ठति संरटन् |
विण्मूत्रभक्षणाद्यं च मोहाद् बालः समाचरेत् ||
text_mt: At times his body is seized with hunger and thirst; at times he lies screaming; / and out of delusion a child engages in eating feces, urine, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
kaumāre karṇapīḍāyāṃ mātāpitrośca sādhanaiḥ |
akṣarādhyayanādyaiśca nānāduḥkhaṃ pravartate ||
meaning:
कौमारे कर्णपीडायां मातापित्रोश्च साधनैः |
अक्षराध्ययनाद्यैश्च नानादुःखं प्रवर्तते ||
text_mt: In boyhood, in the piercing of ears, by the discipline of mother and father, / and by studying letters and so forth, various sufferings arise.

sanskrit_iast:
bālye duḥkhamatītyaiva paśyannapi vimūḍhadhīḥ |
na kurvītātmanaḥ śreyastadatra mahadadbhutam ||
meaning:
बाल्ये दुःखमतीत्यैव पश्यन्नपि विमूढधीः |
न कुर्वीतात्मनः श्रेयस्तदत्र महदद्भुतम् ||
text_mt: Even having passed through suffering in childhood and seeing it, the one of deluded mind / does not work for his own good; that is indeed a great wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttendriyavṛttitvātkāmarogaprapīḍanāt |
tadaprāpte tu satataṃ kutaḥ saukhyaṃ tu yauvane ||
meaning:
प्रवृत्तेन्द्रियवृत्तित्वात्कामरोगप्रपीडनात् |
तदप्राप्ते तु सततं कुतः सौख्यं तु यौवने ||
text_mt: Because of the active functioning of the sense organs, and afflicted by the disease of lust, / and constantly failing to attain it, where is there happiness in youth?

sanskrit_iast:
īrṣyayā ca mahadduḥkhaṃ mohādraktasya tasya ca |
netrasya kupitasyeva tyāgī duḥkhāya kevalam ||
meaning:
ईर्ष्यया च महद्दुःखं मोहाद्रक्तस्य तस्य च |
नेत्रस्य कुपितस्येव त्यागी दुःखाय केवलम् ||
text_mt: And there is great suffering through jealousy, and for him who is attached out of delusion; / like a diseased eye, a castaway brings only suffering.

sanskrit_iast:
na rātrau vindate nidrāṃ kāmāgnipariveditaḥ |
divāpi ca kutaḥ saukhyamarthopārjanacintayā ||
meaning:
न रात्रौ विन्दते निद्रां कामाग्निपरिवेदितः |
दिवापि च कुतः सौख्यमर्थोपार्जनचिन्तया ||
text_mt: He does not find sleep at night, tormented by the fire of lust; / by day too, where is happiness, with the anxiety of acquiring wealth?

sanskrit_iast:
strīṣvadhyāsitacittasya ye puṃsaḥ śukrabindavaḥ |
te sukhāya na manyante svedajā iva te tathā ||
meaning:
स्त्रीष्वध्यासितचित्तस्य ये पुंसः शुक्रबिन्दवः |
ते सुखाय न मन्यन्ते स्वेदजा इव ते तथा ||
text_mt: For the man whose mind is fixed on women, those drops of semen / are not considered for happiness, just as those born of sweat are not.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛmibhistudyamānasya kuṣṭhino vānarasya ca |
kaṇḍūyanābhitāpena yadbhavet strīṣu tadvidaḥ ||
meaning:
कृमिभिस्तुद्यमानस्य कुष्ठिनो वानरस्य च |
कण्डूयनाभितापेन यद्भवेत् स्त्रीषु तद्विदः ||
text_mt: What comes to a leper or a monkey tormented by worms, / from the relief of scratching, know that to be the case with women.

sanskrit_iast:
yādṛśaṃ manyate saukhyaṃ gaṇḍe pūtivinirgamāt |
tādṛśaṃ strīṣu mantavyaṃ nādhikaṃ tāsu vidyate ||
meaning:
यादृशं मन्यते सौख्यं गण्डे पूतिविनिर्गमात् |
तादृशं स्त्रीषु मन्तव्यं नाधिकं तासु विद्यते ||
text_mt: Whatever happiness is thought to come from the discharge of foul matter from a boil, / such is to be understood in the case of women; there is nothing more in them.

sanskrit_iast:
viṇmūtrasya samutsargātsukhaṃ bhavati yādṛśam |
tādṛśaṃ strīṣu vijñeyaṃ mūḍhaiḥ kalpitamanyathā ||
meaning:
विण्मूत्रस्य समुत्सर्गात्सुखं भवति यादृशम् |
तादृशं स्त्रीषु विज्ञेयं मूढैः कल्पितमन्यथा ||
text_mt: Whatever pleasure comes from the discharge of feces and urine, / such is to be known in women; it is imagined otherwise by fools.

sanskrit_iast:
nārīṣvavastubhūtāsu sarvadoṣāśrayāsu ca |
nāṇumātraṃ sukhaṃ tāsu kathitaṃ pañcacūḍayā ||
meaning:
नारीष्ववस्तुभूतासु सर्वदोषाश्रयासु च |
नाणुमात्रं सुखं तासु कथितं पञ्चचूडया ||
text_mt: In women, who are unreal substances and the abode of all faults, / not an atom of pleasure exists in them, as spoken by Pañcacūḍā.

sanskrit_iast:
sammānanāvamānābhyāṃ viyogeneṣṭasaṅgamāt |
yauvanaṃ jarayā grastaṃ kva saukhyamanupadravam ||
meaning:
सम्माननावमानाभ्यां वियोगेनेष्टसङ्गमात् |
यौवनं जरया ग्रस्तं क्व सौख्यमनुपद्रवम् ||
text_mt: Through honor and dishonor, through separation from desired association, / and with youth seized by old age, where is unassailed happiness?

sanskrit_iast:
valīpalitakhālityaiḥ śithilikṛtavigraham |
sarvakriyāsvaśaktiṃ ca jarayā jarjarīkṛtam ||
meaning:
वलीपलितखालित्यैः शिथिलिकृतविग्रहम् |
सर्वक्रियास्वशक्तिं च जरया जर्जरीकृतम् ||
text_mt: With a body made slack by wrinkles, grey hair, and baldness, / and incapacity in all actions, shattered by old age,

sanskrit_iast:
strīpuṃsayauvanaṃ hṛdyamanyo'nyasya priyaṃ purā |
tadeva jarayā grastamanayorapi na priyam ||
meaning:
स्त्रीपुंसयौवनं हृद्यमन्योऽन्यस्य प्रियं पुरा |
तदेव जरया ग्रस्तमनयोरपि न प्रियम् ||
text_mt: the youth of woman and man, charming and dear to each other formerly, / that very youth, when seized by old age, is no longer dear even to the two of them.

sanskrit_iast:
apūrvavatsvamātmānaṃ jarayā parivartitam |
yaḥ paśyannapi rajyeta ko'nyastasmādacetanaḥ ||
meaning:
अपूर्ववत्स्वमात्मानं जरया परिवर्तितम् |
यः पश्यन्नपि रज्येत कोऽन्यस्तस्मादचेतनः ||
text_mt: Who, even seeing his own self transformed by old age as if into something unfamiliar, / would still be attached? Who could be more senseless than him?

sanskrit_iast:
jarābhibhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ putrīputrādibāndhavaiḥ |
asaktatvāddurādharṣairbhṛtyaiśca paribhūyate ||
meaning:
जराभिभूतः पुरुषः पुत्रीपुत्रादिबान्धवैः |
असक्तत्वाद्दुराधर्षैर्भृत्यैश्च परिभूयते ||
text_mt: A man overcome by old age is disrespected by daughters, sons, and other relatives, / and by servants who are difficult to discipline due to his incapacity.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ vā mokṣaṃ vātijarāturaḥ |
aśaktaḥ sādhituṃ tasmādyuvā dharmaṃ samācaret ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
धर्ममर्थं च कामं वा मोक्षं वातिजरातुरः |
अशक्तः साधितुं तस्माद्युवा धर्मं समाचरेत् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Afflicted with extreme old age, he is unable to accomplish / virtue, wealth, desire, or liberation; therefore, while young, one should practice virtue.

Salutation to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca |
kutsitaṃ yoṣidarthaṃ yatsamproktaṃ pañcacūḍayā |
tanme brūhi samāsena yadi tuṣṭo'si me mune ||
meaning:
व्यास उवाच |
कुत्सितं योषिदर्थं यत्सम्प्रोक्तं पञ्चचूडया |
तन्मे ब्रूहि समासेन यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे मुने ||
title: caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | strīsvabhāvavarṇanam
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / What was spoken by Pañcacūḍā concerning the vile matter of women, / tell me that in brief, O sage, if you are pleased with me.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
strīṇāṃ svabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu vipra yathātatham |
yasya śravaṇamātreṇa bhavedvairāgyamuttamam ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
स्त्रीणां स्वभावं वक्ष्यामि शृणु विप्र यथातथम् |
यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण भवेद्वैराग्यमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / I shall describe the nature of women; listen, O twice-born, as it truly is, / by the mere hearing of which supreme dispassion arises.

sanskrit_iast:
striyo mūlaṃ hi doṣāṇāṃ laghucittāḥ sadā mune |
tadāsaktirna kartavyā mokṣepsubhiratandritaiḥ ||
meaning:
स्त्रियो मूलं हि दोषाणां लघुचित्ताः सदा मुने |
तदासक्तिर्न कर्तव्या मोक्षेप्सुभिरतन्द्रितैः ||
text_mt: Women are indeed the root of faults, ever frivolous of mind, O sage; / attachment to them should not be made by those who desire liberation and are vigilant.

sanskrit_iast:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam |
nāradasya ca saṃvādaṃ puṃścalyā pañcacūḍayā ||
meaning:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् |
नारदस्य च संवादं पुंश्चल्या पञ्चचूडया ||
text_mt: In this connection also they cite this ancient legend: / the conversation of Nārada with the courtesan Pañcacūḍā.

sanskrit_iast:
lokān paricaran dhīmān devarṣirnāradaḥ purā |
dadarśāpsarasaṃ bālāṃ pañcacūḍāmanuttamām ||
meaning:
लोकान् परिचरन् धीमान् देवर्षिर्नारदः पुरा |
ददर्शाप्सरसं बालां पञ्चचूडामनुत्तमाम् ||
text_mt: Formerly, the wise divine sage Nārada, wandering through the worlds, / saw the youthful apsaras Pañcacūḍā, who was peerless.

sanskrit_iast:
papracchāpsarasaṃ subhrūṃ nārado munisattamaḥ |
saṃśayo hṛdi me kaścittanme brūhi sumadhyame ||
meaning:
पप्रच्छाप्सरसं सुभ्रूं नारदो मुनिसत्तमः |
संशयो हृदि मे कश्चित्तन्मे ब्रूहि सुमध्यमे ||
text_mt: Nārada, the best of sages, asked the fair-browed apsaras: / 'There is a certain doubt in my heart; tell it to me, O woman of slender waist.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktā tu sā vipraṃ pratyuvāca varāpsarā |
viṣaye sati vakṣyāmi samarthāṃ manyase'tha mām ||
meaning:
एवमुक्ता तु सा विप्रं प्रत्युवाच वराप्सरा |
विषये सति वक्ष्यामि समर्थां मन्यसेऽथ माम् ||
text_mt: Being addressed thus, the excellent apsaras answered the twice-born: / 'If it is within my sphere, I shall speak, should you consider me capable.'

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca |
na tvāmaviṣaye bhadre niyokṣyāmi kathañcana |
strīṇāṃ svabhāvamicchāmi tvattaḥ śrotuṃ sumadhyame ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच |
न त्वामविषये भद्रे नियोक्ष्यामि कथञ्चन |
स्त्रीणां स्वभावमिच्छामि त्वत्तः श्रोतुं सुमध्यमे ||
text_mt:
Nārada said:
I will by no means assign you to what is beyond your province, gentle lady. / I wish to hear from you the nature of women, O woman of slender waist.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
etacchrutvā vacastasya devarṣerapsarottamā |
pratyuvāca munīśaṃ taṃ devarṣiṃ munisattamam ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य देवर्षेरप्सरोत्तमा |
प्रत्युवाच मुनीशं तं देवर्षिं मुनिसत्तमम् ||
text_mt:
Sanatkumāra said:
Having heard this speech of the celestial sage, the best of apsarases / replied to the lord of munis, that celestial sage, best of munis.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcacūḍovāca |
mune śṛṇu na śakyā strī satī vai nindituṃ striyā |
viditāste striyo yāśca yādṛśyaśca svabhāvataḥ ||
meaning:
पञ्चचूडोवाच |
मुने शृणु न शक्या स्त्री सती वै निन्दितुं स्त्रिया |
विदितास्ते स्त्रियो याश्च यादृश्यश्च स्वभावतः ||
text_mt:
Pañcacūḍā said:
Listen, O muni: a virtuous woman cannot be disparaged by a woman. / You already know what women are and what they are like by nature.

sanskrit_iast:
na māmarhasi devarṣe niyoktuṃ praśnamīdṛśam |
ityuktvā sābhavattūṣṇīṃ pañcacūḍāpsarovarā ||
meaning:
न मामर्हसि देवर्षे नियोक्तुं प्रश्नमीदृशम् |
इत्युक्त्वा साभवत्तूष्णीं पञ्चचूडाप्सरोवरा ||
text_mt:
You ought not, O celestial sage, to engage me in such an inquiry.
Having spoken thus, she, Pañcacūḍā, best of apsarases, fell silent.

sanskrit_iast:
atha devarṣivaryo hi śrutvā tadvākyamuttamam |
pratyuvāca punastāṃ vai lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ||
meaning:
अथ देवर्षिवर्यो हि श्रुत्वा तद्वाक्यमुत्तमम् |
प्रत्युवाच पुनस्तां वै लोकानां हितकाम्यया ||
text_mt: Then the best of celestial sages, having heard that excellent speech of hers, / replied to her again out of a desire for the welfare of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca |
mṛṣāvāde bhaveddoṣaḥ satye doṣo na vidyate |
iti jānīhi satyaṃ tvaṃ vadātastatsumadhyame ||
meaning:
नारद उवाच |
मृषावादे भवेद्दोषः सत्ये दोषो न विद्यते |
इति जानीहि सत्यं त्वं वदातस्तत्सुमध्यमे ||
text_mt:
Nārada said:
Fault lies in speaking falsely; there is no fault in the truth. / Know this to be true, and therefore speak, O woman of slender waist.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca |
ityuktā sā kṛtamatī rabhasā cāruhāsinī |
strīdoṣān śāśvatānsatyān bhāṣituṃ sampracakrame ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच |
इत्युक्ता सा कृतमती रभसा चारुहासिनी |
स्त्रीदोषान् शाश्वतान्सत्यान् भाषितुं सम्प्रचक्रमे ||
text_mt:
Sanatkumāra said:
Thus addressed, having resolved her mind with zeal, the sweetly smiling woman / proceeded to describe the eternal, true faults of women.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcacūḍovāca |
kulīnā nāthavantyaśca rūpavantyaśca yoṣitaḥ |
maryādāṣu na tiṣṭhanti sa doṣaḥ strīṣu nārada ||
meaning:
पञ्चचूडोवाच |
कुलीना नाथवन्त्यश्च रूपवन्त्यश्च योषितः |
मर्यादाषु न तिष्ठन्ति स दोषः स्त्रीषु नारद ||
text_mt:
Pañcacūḍā said:
Women of noble birth, who have protectors and are endowed with beauty, / do not abide within bounds: that is the fault in women, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
na strībhyaḥ kiñcidanyadvai pāpīyastaramasti hi |
striyo mūlaṃ hi pāpānāṃ tathā tvamapi vettha ha ||
meaning:
न स्त्रीभ्यः किञ्चिदन्यद्वै पापीयस्तरमस्ति हि |
स्त्रियो मूलं हि पापानां तथा त्वमपि वेत्थ ह ||
text_mt: Indeed, there is nothing else more sinful than women; / women are the root of sins, and this you know as well.

sanskrit_iast:
samājñātānarthavataḥ pratirūpān yathepsitān |
patīnantaramāsādya nālaṃ nāryaḥ pratīkṣitum ||
meaning:
समाज्ञातानर्थवतः प्रतिरूपान् यथेप्सितान् |
पतीनन्तरमासाद्य नालं नार्यः प्रतीक्षितुम् ||
text_mt: Even having obtained renowned, wealthy, handsome, and desirable / husbands immediately at hand, women are incapable of waiting.

sanskrit_iast:
asaddharmastvayaṃ strīṇāmasmākaṃ bhavati prabho |
