text_mt: Then that foremost of sages, Vyāsa, son of Kālī, praised him, / Sanatkumāra, an ocean of divine wisdom, O sages.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca |
kṛtārtho'haṃ muniśreṣṭha brahmatvaṃ me tvayā kṛtam |
namaste'stu namaste'stu dhanyastvaṃ brahmavittamaḥ ||
meaning:
व्यास उवाच |
कृतार्थोऽहं मुनिश्रेष्ठ ब्रह्मत्वं मे त्वया कृतम् |
नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्तेऽस्तु धन्यस्त्वं ब्रह्मवित्तमः ||
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / "I have achieved my purpose, O best of sages; you have conferred upon me knowledge of Brahman. / Salutations unto you! Salutations unto you! Fortunate are you, the foremost knower of Brahman."

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
iti stutvā sa kāleyo brahmaputraṃ mahāmunim |
tūṣṇīṃ babhūva suprītaḥ paramānandanirbharaḥ ||
brahmaputrastamāmantrya pūjitastena śaunakaḥ |
yayau svadhāma suprīto vyāso'pi prītamānasaḥ ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
इति स्तुत्वा स कालेयो ब्रह्मपुत्रं महामुनिम् |
तूष्णीं बभूव सुप्रीतः परमानन्दनिर्भरः ||
ब्रह्मपुत्रस्तमामन्त्र्य पूजितस्तेन शौनकः |
ययौ स्वधाम सुप्रीतो व्यासोऽपि प्रीतमानसः ||
text_mt:
Sūta said: / Having thus praised the great sage, the son of Brahmā, that son of Kālī / became silent, well-pleased and filled with supreme bliss.

Taking leave of him and worshipped by him, the son of Brahmā / went to his own abode well-pleased, and Vyāsa too [departed] with a delighted mind, O Śaunaka.

sanskrit_iast:
iti me varṇito viprāḥ sukhadaḥ paramārthayuk |
sanatkumārakāleyasaṃvādo jñānavardhanaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
इति मे वर्णितो विप्राः सुखदः परमार्थयुक् |
सनत्कुमारकालेयसंवादो ज्ञानवर्धनः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt: Thus, O brahmins, have I described the dialogue between Sanatkumāra and the son of Kālī, / which brings happiness, is endowed with the supreme truth, and enhances knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
śaunaka uvāca |
śrutaṃ me mahadākhyānaṃ yattvayā parikīrtitam |
sanatkumārakāleyasaṃvādaṃ paramārthadam ||
meaning:
शौनक उवाच |
श्रुतं मे महदाख्यानं यत्त्वया परिकीर्तितम् |
सनत्कुमारकालेयसंवादं परमार्थदम् ||
title: ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | ādisargavarṇanam
text_mt: Śaunaka said: / "I have heard the great narrative which you have recounted, / the dialogue between Sanatkumāra and the son of Kālī, which bestows the supreme truth.

sanskrit_iast:
ato'haṃ śrotumicchāmi yathā sargastu brahmaṇaḥ |
samutpannaṃ tu me brūhi yathā vyāsācca te śrutam ||
meaning:
अतोऽहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि यथा सर्गस्तु ब्रह्मणः |
समुत्पन्नं तु मे ब्रूहि यथा व्यासाच्च ते श्रुतम् ||
text_mt: Therefore I wish to hear how the creation of Brahmā / arose; tell it to me as it was heard by you from Vyāsa."

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
mune śṛṇu kathāṃ divyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm |
kathyamānāṃ mayā citrāṃ bahvarthāṃ śrutavistarām ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
मुने शृणु कथां दिव्यां सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् |
कथ्यमानां मया चित्रां बह्वर्थां श्रुतविस्तराम् ||
text_mt: Sūta said: / "O sage, listen to the divine story that destroys all sins, / full of many meanings, an extensive scripture, wondrous as told by me.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścaināṃ pāṭhayettāṃ ca śṛṇuyādvāpyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ |
svavaṃśadhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā svargaloke mahīyate ||
meaning:
यश्चैनां पाठयेत्तां च शृणुयाद्वाप्यभीक्ष्णशः |
स्ववंशधारणं कृत्वा स्वर्गलोके महीयते ||
text_mt: And whoever causes this to be read or hears it repeatedly, / having sustained their lineage, is exalted in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānaṃ puruṣo yattannityaṃ sadasadātmakam |
pradhānapuruṣo bhūtvā nirmame lokabhāvanaḥ ||
meaning:
प्रधानं पुरुषो यत्तन्नित्यं सदसदात्मकम् |
प्रधानपुरुषो भूत्वा निर्ममे लोकभावनः ||
text_mt: That which is the eternal Pradhāna and Puruṣa, having the nature of being and non-being, / having become Pradhāna-Puruṣa, the creator of the worlds fashioned [creation].

sanskrit_iast:
sraṣṭāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇam |
taṃ vai viddhi muniśreṣṭha brahmāṇamamitaujasam ||
meaning:
स्रष्टारं सर्वभूतानां नारायणपरायणम् |
तं वै विद्धि मुनिश्रेष्ठ ब्रह्माणममितौजसम् ||
text_mt: Know him indeed, O best of sages, as Brahmā of immeasurable splendor, / the creator of all beings, entirely devoted to Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādakalpayatkalpāḥ samagrāḥ śucayo yataḥ |
bhavanti muniśārdūla namastasmai svayambhuve ||
meaning:
यस्मादकल्पयत्कल्पाः समग्राः शुचयो यतः |
भवन्ति मुनिशार्दूल नमस्तस्मै स्वयम्भुवे ||
text_mt: From whom he arranged the eons, and from whom all pure things / come to be, O tiger among sages, homage to that self-born one!

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai hiraṇyagarbhāya puruṣāyeśvarāya ca |
namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi bhūyaḥ sargamanuttamam ||
meaning:
तस्मै हिरण्यगर्भाय पुरुषायेश्वराय च |
नमस्कृत्य प्रवक्ष्यामि भूयः सर्गमनुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Having bowed to that Hiraṇyagarbha, the Puruṣa and Īśvara, / I shall proclaim once more the unsurpassed creation.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā sraṣṭā hariḥ pātā saṃhartā ca maheśvaraḥ |
tasya sargasya nānyo'sti kāle kāle tathā gate ||
so'pi svayambhūrbhagavān sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ |
apa eva sasarjādau tāsu vīryamavāsṛjat ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मा स्रष्टा हरिः पाता संहर्ता च महेश्वरः |
तस्य सर्गस्य नान्योऽस्ति काले काले तथा गते ||
सोऽपि स्वयम्भूर्भगवान् सिसृक्षुर्विविधाः प्रजाः |
अप एव ससर्जादौ तासु वीर्यमवासृजत् ||
text_mt:
Brahmā is the creator, Hari is the protector, and Maheśvara is the destroyer; / there is none other of that creation as time passes on and on.

He too, the self-born lord, desiring to create various offspring, / created the waters first and cast his seed into them.

sanskrit_iast:
āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ |
ayanaṃ tasya tāḥ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता आपो वै नरसूनवः |
अयनं तस्य ताः पूर्वं तेन नारायणः स्मृतः ||
text_mt: The waters are called 'nārāḥ', for the waters are indeed the offspring of Nara; / formerly they were his resting place, hence he is remembered as Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyavarṇamabhavattadaṇḍamudakeśayam |
tatra jajñe svayaṃ brahmā svayambhūriti viśrutaḥ ||
meaning:
हिरण्यवर्णमभवत्तदण्डमुदकेशयम् |
तत्र जज्ञे स्वयं ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूरिति विश्रुतः ||
text_mt: That egg resting upon the water became golden-hued; / in it Brahmā himself was born, renowned as the self-born.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavānuṣitvā parivatsaram |
tadaṇḍamakarod dvaidhaṃ divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca nirmame ||
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भो भगवानुषित्वा परिवत्सरम् |
तदण्डमकरोद् द्वैधं दिवं भूमिं च निर्ममे ||
text_mt: The lord Hiraṇyagarbha, having dwelt [there] for a year, / divided that egg in two and fashioned heaven and earth.

sanskrit_iast:
adho'dhordhvaṃ prayuktāni bhuvanāni caturddaśa |
tayoḥ śakalayormadhya ākāśamamṛjatprabhuḥ ||
meaning:
अधोऽधोर्ध्वं प्रयुक्तानि भुवनानि चतुर्द्दश |
तयोः शकलयोर्मध्य आकाशममृजत्प्रभुः ||
text_mt: The fourteen worlds were arranged below, lower down, and above; / between those two halves the lord fashioned space.

sanskrit_iast:
apsu pariplavāṃ pṛthvīṃ diśaśca daśadhā dadhe |
tatra kāle mano vācaṃ kāmakrodhāvatho ratim ||
meaning:
अप्सु परिप्लवां पृथ्वीं दिशश्च दशधा दधे |
तत्र काले मनो वाचं कामक्रोधावथो रतिम् ||
text_mt: He set the earth floating upon the waters and established the directions tenfold; / then, in that time, [he created] mind, speech, desire, anger, and pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
marīcimatryaṅgirasau pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum |
vasiṣṭhaṃ tu mahātejāḥ so'sṛjatsapta mānasān ||
meaning:
मरीचिमत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् |
वसिष्ठं तु महातेजाः सोऽसृजत्सप्त मानसान् ||
text_mt: The exceedingly lustrous one created the seven mind-born [sons]: / Marīci, Atri, Aṅgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, / and Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
sapta bahmāṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ |
tato'sṛjatpunarbrahmā rudrān krodhasamudbhavān ||
meaning:
सप्त बह्माण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः |
ततोऽसृजत्पुनर्ब्रह्मा रुद्रान् क्रोधसमुद्भवान् ||
text_mt: These are determined in the Purāṇa as the seven Brahmās. / Then Brahmā again created the Rudras, born of his anger,

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāraṃ ca ṛṣiṃ sarveṣāmapi pūrvajam |
sapta caite prajāyante paścādrudrāśca sarvataḥ ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमारं च ऋषिं सर्वेषामपि पूर्वजम् |
सप्त चैते प्रजायन्ते पश्चाद्रुद्राश्च सर्वतः ||
text_mt: and the sage Sanatkumāra, the eldest born of all; / and these seven are born, and afterwards the Rudras everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ sanatkumārastu tejaḥ saṅkṣipya tiṣṭhati |
teṣāṃ sapta mahāvaṃśā divyā devarṣipūjitāḥ ||
prajāyante kriyāvanto maharṣibhiralaṅkṛtāḥ |
vidyuto'śanimeghāṃśca rohitendradhanūṃṣi ca ||
meaning:
अतः सनत्कुमारस्तु तेजः सङ्क्षिप्य तिष्ठति |
तेषां सप्त महावंशा दिव्या देवर्षिपूजिताः ||
प्रजायन्ते क्रियावन्तो महर्षिभिरलङ्कृताः |
विद्युतोऽशनिमेघांश्च रोहितेन्द्रधनूंषि च ||
text_mt:
Hence Sanatkumāra remains, having withdrawn his splendor. / Their seven great lineages, divine and honored by divine sages,

are born active and adorned by great sages. / He created lightning, thunderbolts, clouds, and rainbow-hued bows;

sanskrit_iast:
payāṃsi ca sasarjādau parjanyaṃ ca sasarja ha |
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni nirmame yajñasiddhaye ||
meaning:
पयांसि च ससर्जादौ पर्जन्यं च ससर्ज ह |
ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि निर्ममे यज्ञसिद्धये ||
text_mt: he created waters at the beginning, and he indeed created the rain cloud; / he fashioned the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma verses for the accomplishment of sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyāṃstairayajandevānityevamanuśuśruma |
mukhāddevānajanayatpitṝṃścaivātha vakṣasaḥ |
prajanācca manuṣyānvai jaghanānnirmame'surān ||
meaning:
पूज्यांस्तैरयजन्देवानित्येवमनुशुश्रुम |
मुखाद्देवानजनयत्पितॄंश्चैवाथ वक्षसः |
प्रजनाच्च मनुष्यान्वै जघनान्निर्ममेऽसुरान् ||
text_mt: With these they worshipped the gods worthy of worship—thus have we heard. / From his mouth he brought forth the gods, from his chest the ancestors, / from his genitals human beings, and from his buttocks he fashioned the asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
uccāvacāni bhūtāni gātrebhyastasya jajñire |
āpavasya prajāsargaṃ sṛjato hi prajāpateḥ ||
meaning:
उच्चावचानि भूतानि गात्रेभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे |
आपवस्य प्रजासर्गं सृजतो हि प्रजापतेः ||
text_mt: Higher and lower beings were born from his limbs, / as Prajāpati, born of the waters, was bringing forth the creation of beings.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛjyamānāḥ prajāścaiva nāvardhanta yadā tadā |
dvidhā kṛtvātmano dehaṃ strī caiva puruṣo'bhavat ||
meaning:
सृज्यमानाः प्रजाश्चैव नावर्धन्त यदा तदा |
द्विधा कृत्वात्मनो देहं स्त्री चैव पुरुषोऽभवत् ||
text_mt: When the creatures being created did not multiply, / then, dividing his body in two, he became female and male.

sanskrit_iast:
sasṛje'tha prajāḥ sarvā mahimnā vyāpya viśvataḥ |
virājamasṛjadviṣṇuḥ sa sṛṣṭaḥ puruṣaṃ virāṭ ||
meaning:
ससृजेऽथ प्रजाः सर्वा महिम्ना व्याप्य विश्वतः |
विराजमसृजद्विष्णुः स सृष्टः पुरुषं विराट् ||
text_mt: Then he created all creatures, pervading everywhere with his greatness. / Viṣṇu created Virāj; that Virāj, having been created, [brought forth] Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaṃ taṃ manuṃ viddhi manorantarameva ca |
sa vairājaḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ sasarja puruṣaḥ prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
द्वितीयं तं मनुं विद्धि मनोरन्तरमेव च |
स वैराजः प्रजाः सर्वाः ससर्ज पुरुषः प्रभुः ||
text_mt: Know him as the second Manu, and also the period of Manu. / That powerful Puruṣa, born of Virāj, created all creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇavisargasya prajāstasyāpyayonijaḥ |
āyuṣmān kīrtimāndhanyaḥ prajāvāṃścābhavattataḥ ||
meaning:
नारायणविसर्गस्य प्रजास्तस्याप्ययोनिजः |
आयुष्मान् कीर्तिमान्धन्यः प्रजावांश्चाभवत्ततः ||
text_mt: The offspring of that creation of Nārāyaṇa was not born from a womb; / he then became long-lived, renowned, fortunate, and endowed with offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamādisargaste varṇito munisattama |
ādisargaṃ viditvaivaṃ yatheṣṭāṃ prāpnuyādgatim ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
इत्येवमादिसर्गस्ते वर्णितो मुनिसत्तम |
आदिसर्गं विदित्वैवं यथेष्टां प्राप्नुयाद्गतिम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Thus the primal creation has been described to you, O best of sages. / Knowing the primal creation in this manner, one attains the desired state."

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
saṃsṛṣṭāsu prajāsveva āpavo'tha prajāpatiḥ |
lebhe vai puruṣaḥ patnīṃ śatarūpāmayonijām ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
संसृष्टासु प्रजास्वेव आपवोऽथ प्रजापतिः |
लेभे वै पुरुषः पत्नीं शतरूपामयोनिजाम् ||
title: triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | sargavarṇanam 1
text_mt: Sūta said: / "When the creatures had thus been created, Prajāpati, born of the waters, / that Puruṣa, indeed obtained a wife, Śatarūpā, not born from a womb.

sanskrit_iast:
āpavasya mahimnā tu divamāvṛtya tiṣṭhataḥ |
dharmeṇaiva mahātmā sa śatarūpāpyajāyata ||
meaning:
आपवस्य महिम्ना तु दिवमावृत्य तिष्ठतः |
धर्मेणैव महात्मा स शतरूपाप्यजायत ||
text_mt: Through the greatness of the water-born one standing pervading heaven, / that great soul, through righteousness itself, Śatarūpā was born.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tu varṣaśataṃ taptvā tapaḥ paramaduścaram |
bhartāraṃ dīptatapasaṃ puruṣaṃ pratyapadyata ||
meaning:
सा तु वर्षशतं तप्त्वा तपः परमदुश्चरम् |
भर्तारं दीप्ततपसं पुरुषं प्रत्यपद्यत ||
text_mt: Having performed extremely arduous austerity for a hundred years, / she obtained as husband that Puruṣa of radiant austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vai svāyambhuvo jajñe puruṣo manurucyate |
tasyaikasaptatiyugaṃ manvantaramihocyate ||
meaning:
स वै स्वायम्भुवो जज्ञे पुरुषो मनुरुच्यते |
तस्यैकसप्ततियुगं मन्वन्तरमिहोच्यते ||
text_mt: That Puruṣa was born as Svāyambhuva and is called Manu; / his manvantara is said here to be seventy-one yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
vairājātpuruṣādvīrā śatarūpā vyajāyata |
priyavratottānapādau vīrakāyāmajāyatām ||
meaning:
वैराजात्पुरुषाद्वीरा शतरूपा व्यजायत |
प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ वीरकायामजायताम् ||
text_mt: From the Puruṣa born of Virāj, the heroic Śatarūpā gave birth; / Priyavrata and Uttānapāda were born to Vīrā."

sanskrit_iast:
kāmyā nāma mahābhāgā kardamasya prajāpateḥ |
kāmyāputrāstrayastvāsansaṃrāṭsākṣiraviṭprabhuḥ ||
meaning:
काम्या नाम महाभागा कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः |
काम्यापुत्रास्त्रयस्त्वासन्संराट्साक्षिरविट्प्रभुः ||
text_mt: The illustrious Kāmyā was the wife of the Prajāpati Kardama. / Kāmyā had three sons: the sovereign Saṃrāj, Sākṣin, and Raviṭ.

sanskrit_iast:
uttānapādo'janayatputrān śakrasamān prabhuḥ |
dhruvaṃ ca tanayaṃ divyamātmānandasuvarcasam ||
meaning:
उत्तानपादोऽजनयत्पुत्रान् शक्रसमान् प्रभुः |
ध्रुवं च तनयं दिव्यमात्मानन्दसुवर्चसम् ||
text_mt: The lord Uttānapāda fathered sons equal to Indra, / and a divine son, Dhruva, whose great radiance was his own delight.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmasya kanyā suśroṇī sunītirnāma viśrutā |
utpannā cāpi dharmeṇa dhruvasya jananī tathā ||
meaning:
धर्मस्य कन्या सुश्रोणी सुनीतिर्नाम विश्रुता |
उत्पन्ना चापि धर्मेण ध्रुवस्य जननी तथा ||
text_mt: A daughter of Dharma, fair-hipped, celebrated by the name Sunīti, / was also born in accordance with righteousness, and she was Dhruva's mother.

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvo varṣasahasrāṇi trīṇi divyāni kānane |
tapastepe sa bālastu prārthayansthānamavyayam ||
tasmai brahmā dadau prītaḥ sthānamātmasamaṃ prabhuḥ |
acalaṃ caiva purataḥ saptarṣīṇāṃ prajāpatiḥ ||
meaning:
ध्रुवो वर्षसहस्राणि त्रीणि दिव्यानि कानने |
तपस्तेपे स बालस्तु प्रार्थयन्स्थानमव्ययम् ||
तस्मै ब्रह्मा ददौ प्रीतः स्थानमात्मसमं प्रभुः |
अचलं चैव पुरतः सप्तर्षीणां प्रजापतिः ||
text_mt:
In the forest, for three thousand divine years, / Dhruva, while still a boy, performed austerity, praying for an imperishable abode.

Pleased, the lord Brahmā, the Prajāpati, granted him / a steadfast abode equal to his own, right before the seven sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt puṣṭiśca dhānyaśca dhruvātputrau vyajāyatām |
puṣṭirevaṃ samutthāyāḥ pañcaputrānakalmaṣān ||
meaning:
तस्मात् पुष्टिश्च धान्यश्च ध्रुवात्पुत्रौ व्यजायताम् |
पुष्टिरेवं समुत्थायाः पञ्चपुत्रानकल्मषान् ||
text_mt: From him, from Dhruva, two sons, Puṣṭi and Dhānya, were born. / From Puṣṭi, who thus arose, [came] five sinless sons.

sanskrit_iast:
ripuṃ ripuñjayaṃ vipraṃ vṛkalaṃ vṛṣatejasam |
riporevaṃ ca mahiṣī cākṣuṣaṃ sarvatodiśam ||
meaning:
रिपुं रिपुञ्जयं विप्रं वृकलं वृषतेजसम् |
रिपोरेवं च महिषी चाक्षुषं सर्वतोदिशम् ||
text_mt: Ripu, Ripuñjaya, Vipra, Vṛkala, and Vṛṣatejas. / And Ripu's queen bore Cākṣuṣa, who faced all directions.

sanskrit_iast:
ajījanatpuṣkariṇyāṃ varuṇaṃ cākṣuṣo manuḥ |
manorajāyanta daśa naḍvalāyāṃ mahaujasaḥ ||
meaning:
अजीजनत्पुष्करिण्यां वरुणं चाक्षुषो मनुः |
मनोरजायन्त दश नड्वलायां महौजसः ||
text_mt: Manu Cākṣuṣa begot Varuṇa through Puṣkariṇī; / and ten sons of great splendour were born to Manu through Naḍvalā,

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāyāṃ hi muniśreṣṭha vairājasya prajāpateḥ |
pururmāsaḥ śatadyumnastapasvī satyavitkaviḥ ||
meaning:
कन्यायां हि मुनिश्रेष्ठ वैराजस्य प्रजापतेः |
पुरुर्मासः शतद्युम्नस्तपस्वी सत्यवित्कविः ||
text_mt: the daughter, O best of sages, of the Prajāpati Vairāja: / Pūru, Māsa, Śatadyumna, Tapasvin, Satyavit, Kavi,

sanskrit_iast:
agniṣṭomo'tirātraścātimanyuḥ suyaśā daśa |
pūrorajanayatputrān ṣaḍāgneyī mahāprabhān ||
meaning:
अग्निष्टोमोऽतिरात्रश्चातिमन्युः सुयशा दश |
पूरोरजनयत्पुत्रान् षडाग्नेयी महाप्रभान् ||
text_mt: Agniṣṭoma, Atirātra, Atimanyu, Suyaśas, and Daśa— / Āgneyī bore to Pūru six sons of great splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgaṃ sumanasaṃ khyātiṃ sṛtimaṅgirasaṃ gayam |
aṅgātsunīthā bhāryā vai venamekamasūyata ||
meaning:
अङ्गं सुमनसं ख्यातिं सृतिमङ्गिरसं गयम् |
अङ्गात्सुनीथा भार्या वै वेनमेकमसूयत ||
text_mt: Aṅga, Sumanas, Khyāti, Sṛti, Aṅgiras, and Gaya. / And from Aṅga, his wife Sunīthā gave birth to Vena alone.

sanskrit_iast:
apacāreṇa venasya kopasteṣāṃ mahānabhūt |
huṅkāreṇaiva taṃ jaghnurmunayo dharmatatparāḥ ||
meaning:
अपचारेण वेनस्य कोपस्तेषां महानभूत् |
हुङ्कारेणैव तं जघ्नुर्मुनयो धर्मतत्पराः ||
text_mt: Because of Vena's misconduct, their anger became great; / the sages devoted to righteousness killed him with a mere hum sound.

sanskrit_iast:
atha prajārthamṛṣayaḥ prārthitāśca sunīthayā |
sārasvatāstadā tasya mamanthurdakṣiṇaṃ karam ||
meaning:
अथ प्रजार्थमृषयः प्रार्थिताश्च सुनीथया |
सारस्वतास्तदा तस्य ममन्थुर्दक्षिणं करम् ||
text_mt: Then, for the sake of progeny, when besought by Sunīthā, / the Sārasvata sages churned his right hand.

sanskrit_iast:
venasya pāṇau mathite sambabhūva tataḥ pṛthuḥ |
sa dhanvī kavacī jātastejasādityasannibhaḥ ||
avatāraḥ sa viṣṇorhi prajāpālanahetave |
dharmasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya duṣṭānāṃ daṇḍahetave ||
meaning:
वेनस्य पाणौ मथिते सम्बभूव ततः पृथुः |
स धन्वी कवची जातस्तेजसादित्यसन्निभः ||
अवतारः स विष्णोर्हि प्रजापालनहेतवे |
धर्मसंरक्षणार्थाय दुष्टानां दण्डहेतवे ||
text_mt:
When Vena's hand was churned, Pṛthu arose from it. / He was born bearing a bow and armor, resembling the sun in splendour.

He was indeed an incarnation of Viṣṇu for the sake of protecting the subjects, / for safeguarding righteousness, and for punishing the wicked.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthurvainyastadā pṛthvīmarakṣatkṣatrapūrvajaḥ |
rājasūyābhiṣiktānāmādyaḥ sa vasudhāpatiḥ ||
meaning:
पृथुर्वैन्यस्तदा पृथ्वीमरक्षत्क्षत्रपूर्वजः |
राजसूयाभिषिक्तानामाद्यः स वसुधापतिः ||
text_mt: Pṛthu, son of Vena, then protected the earth, being the ancestor of the Kṣatriyas. / He was the first lord of the earth among those consecrated in the royal consecration.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāccaiva samutpannau nipuṇau sūtamāgadhau |
teneyaṃ gaurmuniśreṣṭha dugdhā sarvahitāya vai ||
meaning:
तस्माच्चैव समुत्पन्नौ निपुणौ सूतमागधौ |
तेनेयं गौर्मुनिश्रेष्ठ दुग्धा सर्वहिताय वै ||
text_mt: From him were born the skillful bard and herald; / by him, O best of sages, this cow[-like earth] was milked for the benefit of all.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ vṛttidaścābhūddevarṣisurarakṣasām |
manuṣyāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa śatayajñakaro nṛpaḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वेषां वृत्तिदश्चाभूद्देवर्षिसुररक्षसाम् |
मनुष्याणां विशेषेण शतयज्ञकरो नृपः ||
text_mt: The king, performer of a hundred sacrifices, became the provider of livelihood / to all—the divine sages, gods, and demons, and especially to human beings.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthoḥ putrau tu jajñāte dharmajñau bhuvi pārthivau |
vijitāśvaśca haryakṣo mahāvīrau suviśrutau ||
meaning:
पृथोः पुत्रौ तु जज्ञाते धर्मज्ञौ भुवि पार्थिवौ |
विजिताश्वश्च हर्यक्षो महावीरौ सुविश्रुतौ ||
text_mt: Two sons, Vijitāśva and Haryakṣa, were born to Pṛthu, / rulers of the earth, knowers of righteousness, very heroic, and widely renowned.

sanskrit_iast:
śikhaṇḍinī cājanayatputraṃ prācīnabarhiṣam |
prācīnāgrāḥ kuśāstasya pṛthivītalacāriṇaḥ ||
meaning:
शिखण्डिनी चाजनयत्पुत्रं प्राचीनबर्हिषम् |
प्राचीनाग्राः कुशास्तस्य पृथिवीतलचारिणः ||
text_mt: Śikhaṇḍinī gave birth to a son, Prācīnabarhis; / moving upon the surface of the earth, his kuśa grass always had its tips pointed eastward.

sanskrit_iast:
samudratanayā tena dharmataḥ suvivāhitā |
reje'dhikataraṃ rājā kṛtadāro mahāprabhuḥ ||
meaning:
समुद्रतनया तेन धर्मतः सुविवाहिता |
रेजेऽधिकतरं राजा कृतदारो महाप्रभुः ||
text_mt: He duly married the daughter of the ocean according to righteousness; / married, that mighty lord, the king, shone all the more.

sanskrit_iast:
samudratanayāyāstu daśa prācīnabarhiṣaḥ |
babhūvustanayā divyā bahuyajñakarasya vai ||
meaning:
समुद्रतनयायास्तु दश प्राचीनबर्हिषः |
बभूवुस्तनया दिव्या बहुयज्ञकरस्य वै ||
text_mt: Ten divine sons were born to Prācīnabarhis, / that performer of many sacrifices, from the daughter of the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve prācetasā nāmnā dhanurvedasya pāragāḥ |
apṛthagdharmācaraṇāste'tapyanta mahattapaḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वे प्राचेतसा नाम्ना धनुर्वेदस्य पारगाः |
अपृथग्धर्माचरणास्तेऽतप्यन्त महत्तपः ||
text_mt: All named Prācetasa, masters of the science of archery, / practicing a single course of righteousness, they performed intense austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi samudrasalileśayāḥ |
rudragītaṃ japantaśca śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ ||
tapaścaratsu pṛthvyāmabhavaṃśca mahīruhāḥ |
arakṣyamāṇāyāṃ pṛthvyāṃ babhūvātha prajākṣayaḥ ||
meaning:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि समुद्रसलिलेशयाः |
रुद्रगीतं जपन्तश्च शिवध्यानपरायणाः ||
तपश्चरत्सु पृथ्व्यामभवंश्च महीरुहाः |
अरक्ष्यमाणायां पृथ्व्यां बभूवाथ प्रजाक्षयः ||
text_mt:
Lying in the waters of the ocean for ten thousand years, / they recited the Rudragītā, entirely devoted to meditation on Śiva.

While they practiced austerity, trees covered the earth; / and left unprotected, the earth suffered the destruction of its creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
tān dṛṣṭvā tu nivṛttāste tapaso labdhasadvarāḥ |
cukrudhurmuniśārdūla dagdhukāmāstapobalāḥ ||
meaning:
तान् दृष्ट्वा तु निवृत्तास्ते तपसो लब्धसद्वराः |
चुक्रुधुर्मुनिशार्दूल दग्धुकामास्तपोबलाः ||
text_mt: Returning from austerity after obtaining excellent boons, they saw them / and grew furious, O tiger among sages, wishing to burn them with the power of their austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
prācetasā mukhebhyaste prāsṛjannagnimārutau |
vṛkṣānunmūlya vāyustānadahaddhavyavāhanaḥ ||
meaning:
प्राचेतसा मुखेभ्यस्ते प्रासृजन्नग्निमारुतौ |
वृक्षानुन्मूल्य वायुस्तानदहद्धव्यवाहनः ||
text_mt: Those sons of Pracetas sent forth fire and wind from their mouths; / the wind uprooted the trees, and the fire burned them.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣakṣayaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā kiñciccheṣeṣu śākhiṣu |
upagamyābravīdetān rājā somaḥ pratāpavān ||
meaning:
वृक्षक्षयं ततो दृष्ट्वा किञ्चिच्छेषेषु शाखिषु |
उपगम्याब्रवीदेतान् राजा सोमः प्रतापवान् ||
text_mt: Then, seeing the destruction of the trees when only a few remained, / the majestic king Soma approached and spoke to them.

sanskrit_iast:
soma uvāca |
kopaṃ yacchata rājānaḥ sarve prācīnabarhiṣaḥ |
anubhūtānukanyeyaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ varavarṇinī ||
meaning:
सोम उवाच |
कोपं यच्छत राजानः सर्वे प्राचीनबर्हिषः |
अनुभूतानुकन्येयं वृक्षाणां वरवर्णिनी ||
text_mt: Soma said: / Restrain your wrath, all you royal sons of Prācīnabarhis! / This lovely maiden was produced from the trees.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyaṃ jānatā sā tu dhṛtā garbheṇa vai mayā |
bhāryā vo'stu mahābhāgāḥ somavaṃśavivardhinī ||
meaning:
भविष्यं जानता सा तु धृता गर्भेण वै मया |
भार्या वोऽस्तु महाभागाः सोमवंशविवर्धिनी ||
text_mt: Knowing the future, she was indeed held in the womb by me. / May this illustrious girl be your wife, increasing the lineage of Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāmutpatsyate vidvān dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ |
sṛṣṭikartā mahātejā brahmaputraḥ purātanaḥ ||
meaning:
अस्यामुत्पत्स्यते विद्वान् दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः |
सृष्टिकर्ता महातेजा ब्रह्मपुत्रः पुरातनः ||
text_mt: In her will be born the wise Prajāpati named Dakṣa, / the ancient son of Brahmā, possessed of great splendour, the author of creation.

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmākaṃ tejasārdhena mama cānena tejasā |
brahmatejomayo bhūpaḥ prajāḥ saṃvardhayiṣyati ||
meaning:
युष्माकं तेजसार्धेन मम चानेन तेजसा |
ब्रह्मतेजोमयो भूपः प्रजाः संवर्धयिष्यति ||
text_mt: With half of your splendor and this splendor of mine, / this king full of Brahmā's splendour will multiply the creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ somasya vacanājjagṛhuste pracetasaḥ |
bhāryāṃ dharmeṇa tāṃ prītyā vṛkṣajāṃ varavarṇinīm ||
meaning:
ततः सोमस्य वचनाज्जगृहुस्ते प्रचेतसः |
भार्यां धर्मेण तां प्रीत्या वृक्षजां वरवर्णिनीम् ||
text_mt: Then, at the word of Soma, those sons of Pracetas / joyfully took that lovely woman born of trees as their wife in accordance with righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyastasyāstu sañjajñe dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ |
so'pi jajñe mahātejāḥ somasyāṃśena vai mune ||
acarāṃśca carāṃścaiva dvipado'tha catuṣpadaḥ |
saṃsṛjya manasā dakṣo maithunīṃ sṛṣṭimārabhat ||
meaning:
तेभ्यस्तस्यास्तु सञ्जज्ञे दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः |
सोऽपि जज्ञे महातेजाः सोमस्यांशेन वै मुने ||
अचरांश्च चरांश्चैव द्विपदोऽथ चतुष्पदः |
संसृज्य मनसा दक्षो मैथुनीं सृष्टिमारभत् ||
text_mt:
From them, through her, was born the Prajāpati named Dakṣa; / he too was born, O sage, with great splendour from a portion of Soma.

Having created by mind the immobile and the mobile, the two-footed and the four-footed, / Dakṣa then began sexual creation.

sanskrit_iast:
vīraṇasya sutāṃ nāmnā vīraṇīṃ sa prajāpateḥ |
upayeme suvidhinā sudharmeṇa pativratām ||
meaning:
वीरणस्य सुतां नाम्ना वीरणीं स प्रजापतेः |
उपयेमे सुविधिना सुधर्मेण पतिव्रताम् ||
text_mt: He wedded the devoted wife named Vīraṇī, / the daughter of the Prajāpati Vīraṇa, with proper rites and excellent righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
haryaśvānayutaṃ tasyāṃ sutān puṇyānajījanat |
te viraktā babhūvuśca nāradasyopadeśataḥ ||
meaning:
हर्यश्वानयुतं तस्यां सुतान् पुण्यानजीजनत् |
ते विरक्ता बभूवुश्च नारदस्योपदेशतः ||
text_mt: He begot upon her ten thousand virtuous sons, the Haryaśvas; / but they became detached from worldly life through the teaching of Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchutvā sa punardakṣaḥ subalāśvānajījanat |
nāmatastanayāṃstasyāṃ sahasraparisaṅkhyayā ||
meaning:
तच्छुत्वा स पुनर्दक्षः सुबलाश्वानजीजनत् |
नामतस्तनयांस्तस्यां सहस्रपरिसङ्ख्यया ||
text_mt: Hearing that, Dakṣa again begot upon her / sons named Subalāśvas, numbering a thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
te'pi bhrātṛpathā yātāstanmunerupadeśataḥ |
nāgaman pitṛsānnidhyaṃ viraktā bhikṣumārgiṇaḥ ||
meaning:
तेऽपि भ्रातृपथा यातास्तन्मुनेरुपदेशतः |
नागमन् पितृसान्निध्यं विरक्ता भिक्षुमार्गिणः ||
text_mt: They too went the way of their brothers through the instruction of that sage; / detached and treading the path of mendicants, they did not return to their father's presence.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā śāpamākruddho munaye duḥsahaṃ dadau |
kutracinna labhasveti saṃsthitiṃ kalahapriya ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा शापमाक्रुद्धो मुनये दुःसहं ददौ |
कुत्रचिन्न लभस्वेति संस्थितिं कलहप्रिय ||
text_mt: Hearing that, enraged, he gave an unbearable curse to the sage: / "Find no dwelling anywhere, O lover of strife!"

sanskrit_iast:
sāntvito'tha vidhātrā hi sa paścādasṛjatstriyaḥ |
mahājvālāsvarūpeṇa guṇaiścāpi munīśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
सान्त्वितोऽथ विधात्रा हि स पश्चादसृजत्स्त्रियः |
महाज्वालास्वरूपेण गुणैश्चापि मुनीश्वरः ||
text_mt: Then, consoled by the Creator, that lord among sages / afterwards created women endowed with qualities, having the form of great flames.

sanskrit_iast:
dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa |
dve caivaṃ brahmaputrāya dve caivāṅgirase tadā ||
meaning:
ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश |
द्वे चैवं ब्रह्मपुत्राय द्वे चैवाङ्गिरसे तदा ||
text_mt: He gave ten to Dharma, thirteen to Kaśyapa, / two to the son of Brahmā, and two to Aṅgiras then,

sanskrit_iast:
dve kṛśāśvāya viduṣe munaye munisattama |
śiṣṭāḥ somāya dakṣo'pi nakṣatrākhyā dadau prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
द्वे कृशाश्वाय विदुषे मुनये मुनिसत्तम |
शिष्टाः सोमाय दक्षोऽपि नक्षत्राख्या ददौ प्रभुः ||
text_mt: two to the wise sage Kṛśāśva, O best of sages; / and the remaining ones, named after constellations, the lord Dakṣa gave to Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhyo dakṣasya putrībhyo jātā devāsurādayaḥ |
bahavastanayāḥ khyātāstaiḥ sarvaiḥ pūritaṃ jagat ||
tataḥ prabhṛti viprendra prajā maithunasambhavāḥ |
saṅkalpāddarśanātsparśātpūrveṣāṃ sṛṣṭirucyate ||
meaning:
ताभ्यो दक्षस्य पुत्रीभ्यो जाता देवासुरादयः |
बहवस्तनयाः ख्यातास्तैः सर्वैः पूरितं जगत् ||
ततः प्रभृति विप्रेन्द्र प्रजा मैथुनसम्भवाः |
सङ्कल्पाद्दर्शनात्स्पर्शात्पूर्वेषां सृष्टिरुच्यते ||
text_mt:
From those daughters of Dakṣa, the gods, asuras, and others were born; / many celebrated offspring were produced, by all of whom the world was filled.

From then on, O chief of brahmins, creatures are born of sexual union; / the creation of the earlier ones is said to have been through resolve, sight, and touch.

sanskrit_iast:
śaunaka uvāca |
aṅguṣṭhād brahmaṇo jajñe dakṣaścoktastvayā purā |
kathaṃ prācetasatvaṃ hi punarlebhe mahātapāḥ ||
meaning:
शौनक उवाच |
अङ्गुष्ठाद् ब्रह्मणो जज्ञे दक्षश्चोक्तस्त्वया पुरा |
कथं प्राचेतसत्वं हि पुनर्लेभे महातपाः ||
text_mt: Śaunaka said: / Dakṣa was born from Brahmā's thumb, as was told by you earlier; / how indeed did that [sage] of great austerity become the son of Pracetas once more?

sanskrit_iast:
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ sūta pratyākhyātuṃ tvamarhasi |
citrametatsa somasya kathaṃ śvaśuratāṃ gataḥ ||
meaning:
एतं मे संशयं सूत प्रत्याख्यातुं त्वमर्हसि |
चित्रमेतत्स सोमस्य कथं श्वशुरतां गतः ||
text_mt: You ought to resolve this doubt for me, Sūta; / it is wonderful how he became the father-in-law of Soma!

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
utpattiśca nirodhaśca nityaṃ bhūteṣu vartate |
kalpe kalpe bhavantyete sarve dakṣādayo mune ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
उत्पत्तिश्च निरोधश्च नित्यं भूतेषु वर्तते |
कल्पे कल्पे भवन्त्येते सर्वे दक्षादयो मुने ||
text_mt: Sūta said: / Origin and dissolution occur continually among living beings; / in every kalpa, all these figures such as Dakṣa come to be, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
imāṃ visṛṣṭiṃ dakṣasya yo vidyātsacarācarām |
prajāvānāyuṣā pūrṇaḥ svargaloke mahīyate ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
इमां विसृष्टिं दक्षस्य यो विद्यात्सचराचराम् |
प्रजावानायुषा पूर्णः स्वर्गलोके महीयते ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Whoever knows this creation of Dakṣa, consisting of the moving and unmoving, / becomes endowed with offspring, completes the full span of life, and is honored in heaven.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
śaunaka uvāca |
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām |
sṛṣṭiṃ tu vistareṇemāṃ sūtaputra vadāśu me ||
meaning:
शौनक उवाच |
देवानां दानवानां च गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् |
सृष्टिं तु विस्तरेणेमां सूतपुत्र वदाशु मे ||
title: ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | sargavarṇanam 2
text_mt: Śaunaka said: / Tell me quickly, O son of Sūta, in detail this creation / of the gods, the Dānavas, the Gandharvas, the serpents, and the Rakṣases.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
yadā na vavṛdhe sā tu vīraṇasya prajāpatiḥ |
sutāṃ sutapasā yuktāmāhvayatsargakāraṇāt ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
यदा न ववृधे सा तु वीरणस्य प्रजापतिः |
सुतां सुतपसा युक्तामाह्वयत्सर्गकारणात् ||
text_mt: Sūta said: / When it did not multiply, Prajāpati [Dakṣa] summoned / Vīraṇa's daughter, endowed with great austerity, for the sake of creation.

sanskrit_iast:
sa maithunena dharmeṇa sasarja vividhāḥ prajāḥ |
tāḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ mahāprājña kathayāmi samāsataḥ ||
meaning:
स मैथुनेन धर्मेण ससर्ज विविधाः प्रजाः |
ताः शृणु त्वं महाप्राज्ञ कथयामि समासतः ||
text_mt: By the law of sexual union, he produced manifold creatures. / Listen to [the account of] them, O very wise one; I tell it in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ putrasahasrāṇi vīriṇyāṃ pañca vīryavān |
āśritya janayāmāsa dakṣa eva prajāpatiḥ ||
meaning:
तस्यां पुत्रसहस्राणि वीरिण्यां पञ्च वीर्यवान् |
आश्रित्य जनयामास दक्ष एव प्रजापतिः ||
text_mt: Resorting to that Vīriṇī, the powerful Prajāpati Dakṣa / generated five thousand sons.

sanskrit_iast:
etān sṛṣṭāṃstu tāndṛṣṭvā nāradaḥ prāha vai muniḥ |
satre sa tu samutpanno nāradaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ ||
meaning:
एतान् सृष्टांस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा नारदः प्राह वै मुनिः |
सत्रे स तु समुत्पन्नो नारदः परमेष्ठिनः ||
text_mt: Seeing them created, the sage Nārada spoke [to them]; / indeed, that Nārada was born during the sacrificial session of Parameṣṭhin.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutavānvā kaśyapādvai puṃsāṃ sṛṣṭirbhaviṣyati |
dakṣasyaiva duhitṛṣu tasmāttānabravīttu saḥ ||
meaning:
श्रुतवान्वा कश्यपाद्वै पुंसां सृष्टिर्भविष्यति |
दक्षस्यैव दुहितृषु तस्मात्तानब्रवीत्तु सः ||
text_mt: He had heard that the creation of men would come from Kaśyapa / upon Dakṣa's daughters; therefore he spoke to them:

sanskrit_iast:
ajānantaḥ kathaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ bāliśā vai kariṣyatha |
diśaṃ kāñcidajānantastasmādvijñāya tāṃ bhuvam ||
meaning:
अजानन्तः कथं सृष्टिं बालिशा वै करिष्यथ |
दिशं काञ्चिदजानन्तस्तस्माद्विज्ञाय तां भुवम् ||
text_mt: "Not knowing, how will you foolish ones effect creation? / You do not know any direction; therefore understand the earth [first]!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktāḥ prayayuḥ sarve āśāṃ vijñātumojasā |
tadantaṃ na hi samprāpya na nivṛttāḥ piturgṛham ||
meaning:
इत्युक्ताः प्रययुः सर्वे आशां विज्ञातुमोजसा |
तदन्तं न हि सम्प्राप्य न निवृत्ताः पितुर्गृहम् ||
text_mt: Thus addressed, all of them went forth with might to discover the quarters. / Not reaching its end, they never returned to their father's house.

sanskrit_iast:
tajjñātvā janayāmāsa punaḥ pañcaśatān sutān |
tānuvāca punaḥ so'pi nāradaḥ sarvadarśanaḥ ||
nārada uvāca |
bhuvo mānamajānantaḥ kathaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ kariṣyatha |
sarve hi bāliśāḥ kiṃ hi sṛṣṭikartuṃ samudyatāḥ ||
meaning:
तज्ज्ञात्वा जनयामास पुनः पञ्चशतान् सुतान् |
तानुवाच पुनः सोऽपि नारदः सर्वदर्शनः ||
नारद उवाच |
भुवो मानमजानन्तः कथं सृष्टिं करिष्यथ |
सर्वे हि बालिशाः किं हि सृष्टिकर्तुं समुद्यताः ||
text_mt:
Knowing that, he generated five hundred sons again. / To them too spoke Nārada, who sees everything.

Nārada said: / "Not knowing the measure of the earth, how will you effect creation? / Are all of you fools indeed set upon undertaking creation?"

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
te'pi tadvacanaṃ śrutvā niryātāḥ sarvatodiśam |
subalāśvā dakṣasutā haryaśvā iva te purā ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
तेऽपि तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा निर्याताः सर्वतोदिशम् |
सुबलाश्वा दक्षसुता हर्यश्वा इव ते पुरा ||
text_mt: Sūta said: / They too, hearing his words, departed in every direction, / the Subalāśvas, sons of Dakṣa, just like the Haryaśvas earlier.

sanskrit_iast:
anantaṃ puṣkaraṃ prāpya gatāste'pi parābhavam |
adyāpi na nivartante samudrebhya ivāpagāḥ ||
meaning:
अनन्तं पुष्करं प्राप्य गतास्तेऽपि पराभवम् |
अद्यापि न निवर्तन्ते समुद्रेभ्य इवापगाः ||
text_mt: Reaching the endless expanse, they too met their end; / even today they do not return, like rivers [lost] in oceans.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāprabhṛti vai bhrātā bhrāturanveṣaṇe rataḥ |
prayāto naśyati mune tanna kāryaṃ vipaścitā ||
meaning:
तदाप्रभृति वै भ्राता भ्रातुरन्वेषणे रतः |
प्रयातो नश्यति मुने तन्न कार्यं विपश्चिता ||
text_mt: From that time forward, O sage, a brother devoted to seeking a brother, / once departed, is lost; therefore a wise man should not do that.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃścāpi naṣṭān vijñāya putrāndakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
sa ca krodhāddadau śāpaṃ nāradāya mahātmane ||
meaning:
तांश्चापि नष्टान् विज्ञाय पुत्रान्दक्षः प्रजापतिः |
स च क्रोधाद्ददौ शापं नारदाय महात्मने ||
text_mt: Knowing those sons also to be lost, Prajāpati Dakṣa / in anger gave a curse to the noble Nārada:

sanskrit_iast:
kutracinna labhasveti saṃsthitiṃ kalahapriya |
tava sānnidhyato loke bhavecca kalahaḥ sadā ||
meaning:
कुत्रचिन्न लभस्वेति संस्थितिं कलहप्रिय |
तव सान्निध्यतो लोके भवेच्च कलहः सदा ||
text_mt: "Find no dwelling anywhere, O lover of strife! / From your presence let there always be strife in the world!"

sanskrit_iast:
sāntvito'tha vidhātrā hi sa dakṣastu prajāpatiḥ |
kanyāḥ ṣaṣṭyasṛjatpaścādvīriṇyāmiti naḥ śrutam ||
meaning:
सान्त्वितोऽथ विधात्रा हि स दक्षस्तु प्रजापतिः |
कन्याः षष्ट्यसृजत्पश्चाद्वीरिण्यामिति नः श्रुतम् ||
text_mt: Then, consoled by the Creator, Prajāpati Dakṣa / afterwards generated sixty daughters upon Vīriṇī, so we have heard.

sanskrit_iast:
dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa |
saptaviṃśati somāya catasro'riṣṭanemine ||
meaning:
ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश |
सप्तविंशति सोमाय चतस्रोऽरिष्टनेमिने ||
text_mt: He gave ten to Dharma, thirteen to Kaśyapa, / twenty-seven to Soma, and four to Ariṣṭanemi;

sanskrit_iast:
dve caivaṃ brahmaputrāya dve caivāṅgirase tadā |
dve kṛśāśvāya viduṣe tāsāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu ||
meaning:
द्वे चैवं ब्रह्मपुत्राय द्वे चैवाङ्गिरसे तदा |
द्वे कृशाश्वाय विदुषे तासां नामानि मे शृणु ||
text_mt: two likewise to the son of Brahmā, two to Aṅgiras then, / and two to the wise Kṛśāśva. Listen to their names from me:

sanskrit_iast:
arundhatī vasuryāmirlambā bhānurmarutvatī |
saṅkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sandhyā viśvā ca vai mune ||
dharmapatnyo mune tvetāstāsvapatyāni me śṛṇu |
viśvedevāstu viśvāyāḥ sādhyānsādhyā vyajāyata ||
meaning:
अरुन्धती वसुर्यामिर्लम्बा भानुर्मरुत्वती |
सङ्कल्पा च मुहूर्ता च सन्ध्या विश्वा च वै मुने ||
धर्मपत्न्यो मुने त्वेतास्तास्वपत्यानि मे शृणु |
विश्वेदेवास्तु विश्वायाः साध्यान्साध्या व्यजायत ||
text_mt:
Arundhatī, Vasu, Yāmi, Lambā, Bhānu, Marutvatī, / Saṅkalpā, Muhūrtā, Sandhyā, and Viśvā, O sage.

These, O sage, were the wives of Dharma; hear from me their offspring: / from Viśvā [came] the Viśvedevas, and Sādhyā bore the Sādhyas;

sanskrit_iast:
marutvatyāṃ marutvanto vasostu vasavastathā |
bhānostu bhānavaḥ sarve muhūrtāyāṃ muhūrtajāḥ ||
meaning:
मरुत्वत्यां मरुत्वन्तो वसोस्तु वसवस्तथा |
भानोस्तु भानवः सर्वे मुहूर्तायां मुहूर्तजाः ||
text_mt: upon Marutvatī [came] the Marutvants, and from Vasu likewise the Vasus; / from Bhānu all the Bhānus, and upon Muhūrtā the Muhūrtajas;

sanskrit_iast:
lambāyāścaiva ghoṣo'tha nāgavīthī ca yāmijā |
pṛthivīviṣamastasyāmarundhatyāmajāyata ||
meaning:
लम्बायाश्चैव घोषोऽथ नागवीथी च यामिजा |
पृथिवीविषमस्तस्यामरुन्धत्यामजायत ||
text_mt: from Lambā came Ghoṣa, and Nāgavīthī was born of Yāmi; / the uneven places of the earth were born upon Arundhatī;

sanskrit_iast:
saṅkalpāyāstu satyātmā jajñe saṅkalpa eva hi |
ayādayo vasoḥ putrā aṣṭau tān śṛṇu śaunaka ||
meaning:
सङ्कल्पायास्तु सत्यात्मा जज्ञे सङ्कल्प एव हि |
अयादयो वसोः पुत्रा अष्टौ तान् शृणु शौनक ||
text_mt: and from Saṅkalpā was born Saṅkalpa himself, whose self is truth. / The sons of Vasu are eight, beginning with Aya; hear them, O Śaunaka:

sanskrit_iast:
ayo dhuvaśca somaśca dharaścaivānilo'nalaḥ |
pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavā'ṣṭau ca nāmataḥ ||
meaning:
अयो धुवश्च सोमश्च धरश्चैवानिलोऽनलः |
प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवाऽष्टौ च नामतः ||
text_mt: Aya, Dhruva, Soma, Dhara, Anila, Anala, / Pratyūṣa, and Prabhāsa—these are the eight Vasus by name.

sanskrit_iast:
ayasya putro vaitaṇḍaḥ śramaḥ śānto munistathā |
dhruvasya putro bhagavān kālo lokabhāvanaḥ ||
meaning:
अयस्य पुत्रो वैतण्डः श्रमः शान्तो मुनिस्तथा |
ध्रुवस्य पुत्रो भगवान् कालो लोकभावनः ||
text_mt: The son of Aya was Vaitaṇḍa, and Śrama, Śānta, and Muni; / Dhruva's son was the venerable Kāla, who brings forth the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
somasya bhagavān varcā varcasvī yena jāyate |
dharasya putro draviṇo hutahavyavahastathā ||
meaning:
सोमस्य भगवान् वर्चा वर्चस्वी येन जायते |
धरस्य पुत्रो द्रविणो हुतहव्यवहस्तथा ||
text_mt: Soma's [son was] the venerable Varcas, through whom the lustrous one is born; / Dhara's son was Draviṇa and Hutahavyavaha.

sanskrit_iast:
manoharāyāḥ śiśiraḥ prāṇo'tha ramaṇastathā |
anilasya śivā bhāryā yasyāḥ putrāḥ purojavaḥ ||
meaning:
मनोहरायाः शिशिरः प्राणोऽथ रमणस्तथा |
अनिलस्य शिवा भार्या यस्याः पुत्राः पुरोजवः ||
text_mt: From Manoharā [came] Śiśira, Prāṇa, and Ramaṇa; / Anila's wife was Śivā, whose sons were Purojava

sanskrit_iast:
avijñātagatiścaiva dvau putrāvanilasya tu |
agniputraḥ kumārastu śarastambe śriyāvṛte ||
meaning:
अविज्ञातगतिश्चैव द्वौ पुत्रावनिलस्य तु |
अग्निपुत्रः कुमारस्तु शरस्तम्बे श्रियावृते ||
text_mt: and Avijñātagati—the two sons of Anila. / Agni's son was Kumāra in the reed clump enveloped in splendor;

sanskrit_iast:
tasya śākho viśākhaśca naigameyaśca pṛṣṭhataḥ |
apatyaṃ kṛttikānāṃ tu kārtikeya iti smṛtaḥ ||
pratyūṣasya tvabhūtputra ṛṣirnāmnā tu devalaḥ |
dvau putrau devalasyāpi prajāvantau manīṣiṇau ||
meaning:
तस्य शाखो विशाखश्च नैगमेयश्च पृष्ठतः |
अपत्यं कृत्तिकानां तु कार्तिकेय इति स्मृतः ||
प्रत्यूषस्य त्वभूत्पुत्र ऋषिर्नाम्ना तु देवलः |
द्वौ पुत्रौ देवलस्यापि प्रजावन्तौ मनीषिणौ ||
text_mt:
his [brothers were] Śākha, Viśākha, and Naigameya behind him; / as the offspring of the Kṛttikās, he is remembered as Kārtikeya.

Pratyūṣa had a son, a sage named Devala; / Devala also had two wise sons with many offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatestu bhaginī varastrī brahmacāriṇī |
yogasiddhā jagatkṛtsnaṃ samantādvyacarattadā ||
meaning:
बृहस्पतेस्तु भगिनी वरस्त्री ब्रह्मचारिणी |
योगसिद्धा जगत्कृत्स्नं समन्ताद्व्यचरत्तदा ||
text_mt: The sister of Bṛhaspati was an excellent woman observing celibacy, / accomplished in yoga; she traversed the entire world in every direction at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāsasya tu sā bhāryā vasūnāmaṣṭamasya ca |
viśvakarmā mahābhāga tasya jajñe prajāpatiḥ ||
meaning:
प्रभासस्य तु सा भार्या वसूनामष्टमस्य च |
विश्वकर्मा महाभाग तस्य जज्ञे प्रजापतिः ||
text_mt: She was the wife of Prabhāsa, the eighth of the Vasus; / Viśvakarman, O noble one, the Prajāpati, was born to him.

sanskrit_iast:
kartā śilpasahasrāṇāṃ tridaśānāṃ ca vārdhakiḥ |
bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kartā śilpavatāṃ varaḥ ||
meaning:
कर्ता शिल्पसहस्राणां त्रिदशानां च वार्धकिः |
भूषणानां च सर्वेषां कर्ता शिल्पवतां वरः ||
text_mt: The maker of thousands of crafts and the architect of the gods, / the maker of all ornaments, the best among artisans,

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sarvāsāṃ vimānāni devatānāṃ cakāra ha |
manuṣyāścopajīvanti yasya śilpaṃ mahātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
यः सर्वासां विमानानि देवतानां चकार ह |
मनुष्याश्चोपजीवन्ति यस्य शिल्पं महात्मनः ||
text_mt: who fashioned the flying aerial chariots for all the deities, / and whose craft human beings live by, [the work of] that great soul.

sanskrit_iast:
raivato'jo bhavo bhīmo vāma ugro vṛṣākapiḥ |
ajaikapādahirbudhnyo bahurūpo mahāniti ||
meaning:
रैवतोऽजो भवो भीमो वाम उग्रो वृषाकपिः |
अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यो बहुरूपो महानिति ||
text_mt: Raivata, Aja, Bhava, Bhīma, Vāma, Ugra, Vṛṣākapi, / Ajaikapād, Ahirbudhnya, Bahurūpa, and Mahān—

sanskrit_iast:
sarūpāyāṃ prasūtasya striyāṃ rudraśca koṭiśaḥ |
tatraikādaśamukhyāstu tannāmāni mune śṛṇu ||
meaning:
सरूपायां प्रसूतस्य स्त्रियां रुद्रश्च कोटिशः |
तत्रैकादशमुख्यास्तु तन्नामानि मुने शृणु ||
text_mt: born upon the woman Sarūpā were Rudras by the crores; / among them eleven are chief: hear their names, O sage:

sanskrit_iast:
ajaikapādahirbudhnyastvaṣṭā rudraśca vīryavān |
haraśca bahurūpaśca tryambakaścāparājitaḥ ||
meaning:
अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यस्त्वष्टा रुद्रश्च वीर्यवान् |
हरश्च बहुरूपश्च त्र्यम्बकश्चापराजितः ||
text_mt: Ajaikapād, Ahirbudhnya, Tvaṣṭṛ, the powerful Rudra, / Hara, Bahurūpa, Tryambaka, Aparājita,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣākapiśca śambhuśca kapardī raivatastathā |
ekādaśaite kathitā rudrāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ ||
meaning:
वृषाकपिश्च शम्भुश्च कपर्दी रैवतस्तथा |
एकादशैते कथिता रुद्रास्त्रिभुवनेश्वराः ||
text_mt: Vṛṣākapi, Śambhu, Kapardin, and Raivata; / these are declared to be the eleven Rudras, lords of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ tvevaṃ samākhyātaṃ rudrāṇāmamitaujasām |
śṛṇu kaśyapapatnīnāṃ nāmāni munisattama ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
शतं त्वेवं समाख्यातं रुद्राणाममितौजसाम् |
शृणु कश्यपपत्नीनां नामानि मुनिसत्तम ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Thus a hundred Rudras of unmeasured vigor have been described; / hear the names of Kaśyapa's wives, O best of sages!

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
aditirditiśca surasāriṣṭelā danureva ca |
surabhirvinatā caiva tāmrā krodhavaśā khaśā ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
अदितिर्दितिश्च सुरसारिष्टेला दनुरेव च |
सुरभिर्विनता चैव ताम्रा क्रोधवशा खशा ||
title: dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | kaśyapavaṃśavarṇanam 1
text_mt: Sūta said: / Aditi, Diti, Surasā, Ariṣṭā, Ilā, and Danu, / Surabhi, Vinatā, Tāmrā, Krodhavaśā, and Khaśā,

sanskrit_iast:
kadrūrmuniśca viprendra tāsvapatyāni me śṛṇu |
pūrvamanvantare śreṣṭhe dvādaśāsansurottamāḥ ||
meaning:
कद्रूर्मुनिश्च विप्रेन्द्र तास्वपत्यानि मे शृणु |
पूर्वमन्वन्तरे श्रेष्ठे द्वादशासन्सुरोत्तमाः ||
text_mt: Kadrū and Muni, O best of brahmins—hear from me of the offspring born to them. / In an earlier, pre-eminent Manvantara, there were twelve supreme gods,

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣitā nāma te'nyonyamūcurvaivasvate'ntare |
upasthite suyaśasaścākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ ||
meaning:
तुषिता नाम तेऽन्योन्यमूचुर्वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे |
उपस्थिते सुयशसश्चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः ||
text_mt: named the Tuṣitas. In the Manvantara of Manu Cākṣuṣa, as the Vaivasvata interval approached, / they of great fame spoke to one another

sanskrit_iast:
hitāya sarvalokānāṃ samāgamya parasparam |
āgacchata drutaṃ devā aditiṃ ca praviśya vai ||
meaning:
हिताय सर्वलोकानां समागम्य परस्परम् |
आगच्छत द्रुतं देवा अदितिं च प्रविश्य वै ||
text_mt: for the welfare of all the worlds, having gathered together: / "Come quickly, O gods, and having entered Aditi,

sanskrit_iast:
manvantare prasūyāmaḥ satāṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati |
evamuktāstu te sarve cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ ||
meaning:
मन्वन्तरे प्रसूयामः सतां श्रेयो भविष्यति |
एवमुक्तास्तु ते सर्वे चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः ||
text_mt: let us be born in the [next] Manvantara; that will be for the good of the virtuous." / Being thus addressed, all of them, during the interval of Manu Cākṣuṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
mārīcātkaśyapājjātāste'dityāṃ dakṣakanyayā |
tatra viṣṇuśca śakraśca jajñāte punareva hi ||
meaning:
मारीचात्कश्यपाज्जातास्तेऽदित्यां दक्षकन्यया |
तत्र विष्णुश्च शक्रश्च जज्ञाते पुनरेव हि ||
text_mt: were born from Kaśyapa, son of Marīci, in Aditi, daughter of Dakṣa. / There Viṣṇu and Indra were indeed born once again,

sanskrit_iast:
aryamā caiva dhātā ca tvaṣṭā pūṣā tathaiva ca |
vivasvān savitā caiva mitrāvaruṇa eva ca ||
meaning:
अर्यमा चैव धाता च त्वष्टा पूषा तथैव च |
विवस्वान् सविता चैव मित्रावरुण एव च ||
text_mt: as well as Aryaman, Dhātṛ, Tvaṣṭṛ, and likewise Pūṣan, / Vivasvat, Savitṛ, and Mitra and Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśo bhagaścātitejā ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ |
cākṣuṣasyāntare pūrvamāsanye tuṣitāḥ surāḥ ||
meaning:
अंशो भगश्चातितेजा आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः |
चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे पूर्वमासन्ये तुषिताः सुराः ||
text_mt: Aṃśa, and Bhaga of immense splendor—these are known as the twelve Ādityas. / Those gods who were formerly the Tuṣitas in the interval of Cākṣuṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
puraiva tasyāntare tu ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ |
iti proktāni kramaśo'dityapatyāni śaunaka ||
saptaviṃśatiryāḥ proktāḥ somapatnyo'tha suvratāḥ |
tāsāmapatyānyabhavandīptayo'mitatejasaḥ ||
meaning:
पुरैव तस्यान्तरे तु आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः |
इति प्रोक्तानि क्रमशोऽदित्यपत्यानि शौनक ||
सप्तविंशतिर्याः प्रोक्ताः सोमपत्न्योऽथ सुव्रताः |
तासामपत्यान्यभवन्दीप्तयोऽमिततेजसः ||
text_mt:
in his interval previously were known as the twelve Ādityas. / Thus have the offspring of Aditi been recounted in order, O Śaunaka.

The twenty-seven wives of Soma who are described, of noble vows, / their children were the lights of boundless radiance.

sanskrit_iast:
ariṣṭanemipatnīnāmapatyānīha ṣoḍaśa |
bahuputrasya viduṣaścatasro vidyutaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
meaning:
अरिष्टनेमिपत्नीनामपत्यानीह षोडश |
बहुपुत्रस्य विदुषश्चतस्रो विद्युतः स्मृताः ||
text_mt: The offspring of the wives of Ariṣṭanemi are sixteen here; / of the wise Bahuputra, the four lightning flashes are recorded.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛśāśvasya tu devarṣe devapraharaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ |
bhārmyāyāmarciṣi mune dhūmrakeśastathaiva ca ||
meaning:
कृशाश्वस्य तु देवर्षे देवप्रहरणाः स्मृताः |
भार्म्यायामर्चिषि मुने धूम्रकेशस्तथैव च ||
text_mt: Of the divine seer Kṛśāśva, the divine weapons are recorded; / in Arcī, daughter of Bharmyāśva, O sage, Dhūmrakeśa likewise.

sanskrit_iast:
svadhā satī ca dve patnyau svadhā jyeṣṭhā satī parā |
svadhāsūta pitṝn vedamatharvāṅgirasaṃ satī ||
meaning:
स्वधा सती च द्वे पत्न्यौ स्वधा ज्येष्ठा सती परा |
स्वधासूत पितॄन् वेदमथर्वाङ्गिरसं सती ||
text_mt: Svadhā and Satī were his two wives—Svadhā the elder, Satī the other. / Svadhā bore the ancestors, and Satī the Atharvāṅgiras Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
ete yugasahasrānte jāyante punareva hi |
sarvadevanikāyāśca trayastriṃśattu kāmajāḥ ||
meaning:
एते युगसहस्रान्ते जायन्ते पुनरेव हि |
सर्वदेवनिकायाश्च त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तु कामजाः ||
text_mt: These are indeed born again at the end of a thousand yugas; / and all the classes of gods are thirty-three, born at will.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā sūryasya nityaṃ hi udayāstamayāviha |
evaṃ devānikāste ca sambhavanti yuge yuge ||
meaning:
यथा सूर्यस्य नित्यं हि उदयास्तमयाविह |
एवं देवानिकास्ते च सम्भवन्ति युगे युगे ||
text_mt: Just as the rising and setting of the sun are constant here, / even so these hosts of gods come into being yuga after yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
dityāṃ babhūvatuḥ putrau kaśyapāditi naḥ śrutam |
hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva hiraṇyākṣaśca vīryavān ||
meaning:
दित्यां बभूवतुः पुत्रौ कश्यपादिति नः श्रुतम् |
हिरण्यकशिपुश्चैव हिरण्याक्षश्च वीर्यवान् ||
text_mt: In Diti two sons were born from Kaśyapa, so we have heard: / Hiraṇyakaśipu, and the powerful Hiraṇyākṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhikā hyabhavatkanyā vipracitteḥ parigrahaḥ |
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putrāścatvāraḥ prathitaujasaḥ ||
meaning:
सिंहिका ह्यभवत्कन्या विप्रचित्तेः परिग्रहः |
हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्राश्चत्वारः प्रथितौजसः ||
text_mt: There was also a daughter, Siṃhikā, the wife of Vipracitti. / Four sons of celebrated might belonged to Hiraṇyakaśipu:

sanskrit_iast:
anuhrādaśca hrādaśca saṃhrādaścaiva vīryavān |
prahrādaścānujastatra viṣṇubhaktivicāradhīḥ ||
meaning:
अनुह्रादश्च ह्रादश्च संह्रादश्चैव वीर्यवान् |
प्रह्रादश्चानुजस्तत्र विष्णुभक्तिविचारधीः ||
text_mt: Anuhrāda, Hrāda, and the powerful Saṃhrāda, / and Prahrāda, their younger brother, whose mind was engaged in devotion to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
anuhrādasya sūryāyāṃ pulomā mahiṣastathā |
hrādasya dhamanirbhāryāsūta vātāpimilvalam ||
saṃhrādasya kṛtirbhāryāsūta pañcajanaṃ tataḥ |
virocanastu prāhrādirdevyāṃ tasyābhavad baliḥ ||
meaning:
अनुह्रादस्य सूर्यायां पुलोमा महिषस्तथा |
ह्रादस्य धमनिर्भार्यासूत वातापिमिल्वलम् ||
संह्रादस्य कृतिर्भार्यासूत पञ्चजनं ततः |
विरोचनस्तु प्राह्रादिर्देव्यां तस्याभवद् बलिः ||
text_mt:
To Anuhrāda, in Sūryā, were born Puloman and Mahiṣa; / Dhamani, wife of Hrāda, gave birth to Vātāpi and Ilvala.

Kṛti, wife of Saṃhrāda, then bore Pañcajana; / and Virocana was the son of Prahrāda, and in his queen was born Bali.

sanskrit_iast:
baleḥ putraśataṃ tvāsīdaśanāyāṃ munīśvara |
balirāsīnmahāśaivaḥ śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||
meaning:
बलेः पुत्रशतं त्वासीदशनायां मुनीश्वर |
बलिरासीन्महाशैवः शिवभक्तिपरायणः ||
text_mt: Bali had a hundred sons in Aśanā, O lord of sages. / Bali was a great devotee of Śiva, dedicated to devotion to Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
dānaśīla udāraśca puṇyakīrtitapāḥ smṛtaḥ |
tatputro bāṇanāmā yaḥ so'pi śaivavaraḥ sudhīḥ |
yaḥ santoṣya śivaṃ samyaggāṇapatyamavāpa ha ||
meaning:
दानशील उदारश्च पुण्यकीर्तितपाः स्मृतः |
तत्पुत्रो बाणनामा यः सोऽपि शैववरः सुधीः |
यः सन्तोष्य शिवं सम्यग्गाणपत्यमवाप ह ||
text_mt: charitable, noble, and known for his austerities of sacred renown. / His son named Bāṇa was also a wise and supreme devotee of Śiva, / who, having fully pleased Śiva, attained the status of lord of the attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
sā kathā śrutapūrvā te bāṇasya hi mahātmanaḥ |
kṛṣṇaṃ yaḥ samare vīraḥ suprasannaṃ cakāra ha ||
meaning:
सा कथा श्रुतपूर्वा ते बाणस्य हि महात्मनः |
कृष्णं यः समरे वीरः सुप्रसन्नं चकार ह ||
text_mt: That story of high-souled Bāṇa has been heard by you before— / the hero who made Kṛṣṇa exceptionally pleased in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyākṣasutāḥ pañca paṇḍitāḥ sumahābalāḥ |
kukuraḥ śakuniścaiva bhūtasantāpanastathā ||
meaning:
हिरण्याक्षसुताः पञ्च पण्डिताः सुमहाबलाः |
कुकुरः शकुनिश्चैव भूतसन्तापनस्तथा ||
text_mt: The sons of Hiraṇyākṣa were five, learned and of immense strength: / Kukura, Śakuni, and Bhūtasantāpana,

sanskrit_iast:
mahānādaśca vikrāntaḥ kālanābhastathaiva ca |
ityuktā ditiputrāśca danoḥ putrān mune śṛṇu ||
meaning:
महानादश्च विक्रान्तः कालनाभस्तथैव च |
इत्युक्ता दितिपुत्राश्च दनोः पुत्रान् मुने शृणु ||
text_mt: the valiant Mahānāda, and likewise Kālanābha. / Thus the sons of Diti have been spoken of; hear now, O sage, the sons of Danu.

sanskrit_iast:
abhavandanuputrāśca śataṃ tīvraparākramāḥ |
ayomukhaḥ śambaraśca kapolo vāmanastathā ||
meaning:
अभवन्दनुपुत्राश्च शतं तीव्रपराक्रमाः |
अयोमुखः शम्बरश्च कपोलो वामनस्तथा ||
text_mt: There were a hundred sons of Danu of fierce valor: / Ayomukha, Śambara, Kapola, and Vāmana,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvānaraḥ pulomā ca vidrāvaṇamahāśirau |
svarbhānurvṛṣaparvā ca vipracittiśca vīryavān ||
meaning:
वैश्वानरः पुलोमा च विद्रावणमहाशिरौ |
स्वर्भानुर्वृषपर्वा च विप्रचित्तिश्च वीर्यवान् ||
text_mt: Vaiśvānara, Puloman, Vidrāvaṇa and Mahāśiras, / Svarbhānu, Vṛṣaparvan, and the powerful Vipracitti.

sanskrit_iast:
ete sarve danoḥ putrāḥ kaśyapādanujajñire |
eṣāṃ putrīḥ śṛṇu mune prasaṅgādvacmi te'nagha ||
meaning:
एते सर्वे दनोः पुत्राः कश्यपादनुजज्ञिरे |
एषां पुत्रीः शृणु मुने प्रसङ्गाद्वच्मि तेऽनघ ||
text_mt: All these sons of Danu were born of Kaśyapa. / Hear their daughters, O sage; I tell you them in this context, O sinless one:

sanskrit_iast:
svabhārnostu prabhā kanyā pulomnastu śacī sutā |
upadānavī hayaśirā śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī ||
pulomikā pulomā ca vaiśvānarasute ubhe |
bahvapatye mahāvīrye mārīcestu parigrahā t ||
meaning:
स्वभार्नोस्तु प्रभा कन्या पुलोम्नस्तु शची सुता |
उपदानवी हयशिरा शर्मिष्ठा वार्षपर्वणी ||
पुलोमिका पुलोमा च वैश्वानरसुते उभे |
बह्वपत्ये महावीर्ये मारीचेस्तु परिग्रहा त् ||
text_mt:
Prabhā was the daughter of Svarbhānu; Śacī was the daughter of Puloman; / Upadānavī, Hayaśiras, and Śarmiṣṭhā, daughter of Vṛṣaparvan.

Pulomikā and Pulomā were both daughters of Vaiśvānara, / possessing many offspring and great vigor, wives of the son of Marīci.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoḥ putrasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭirdānavanandanāḥ |
marīcirjanayāmāsa mahatā tapasānvitāḥ ||
meaning:
तयोः पुत्रसहस्राणि षष्टिर्दानवनन्दनाः |
मरीचिर्जनयामास महता तपसान्विताः ||
text_mt: Through them the son of Marīci fathered sixty thousand sons, / sons of the Dānavas, endowed with great austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
paulomāḥ kālakhañjāśca dānavānāṃ mahābalāḥ |
avadhyā devatānāṃ ca hiraṇyapuravāsinaḥ ||
meaning:
पौलोमाः कालखञ्जाश्च दानवानां महाबलाः |
अवध्या देवतानां च हिरण्यपुरवासिनः ||
text_mt: The Paulomas and Kālakhañjas, of great strength among the Dānavas, / unslayable by the gods, dwelled in Hiraṇyapura.

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmahaprasādena ye hatāḥ savyasācinā |
siṃhikāyāmathotpannā vipracitteḥ sutāstathā ||
meaning:
पितामहप्रसादेन ये हताः सव्यसाचिना |
सिंहिकायामथोत्पन्ना विप्रचित्तेः सुतास्तथा ||
text_mt: By the grace of the Grandfather, they were slain by Savyasācin. / Then the sons born of Siṃhikā and Vipracitti,

sanskrit_iast:
daityadānavasaṃyogājjātāstīvraparākramāḥ |
saiṃhikeyā iti khyātāstrayodaśa mahābalāḥ ||
meaning:
दैत्यदानवसंयोगाज्जातास्तीव्रपराक्रमाः |
सैंहिकेया इति ख्यातास्त्रयोदश महाबलाः ||
text_mt: born of the union of Daitya and Dānava, of fierce valor, / were known as the Saiṃhikeyas, thirteen of great strength:

sanskrit_iast:
rāhuḥ śalyo subalino balaścaiva mahābalaḥ |
vātāpirnamuciścaivāthelvalaḥ svasṛpastathā ||
meaning:
राहुः शल्यो सुबलिनो बलश्चैव महाबलः |
वातापिर्नमुचिश्चैवाथेल्वलः स्वसृपस्तथा ||
text_mt: Rāhu, Śalya, two very powerful ones, and the mighty Bala, / Vātāpi, Namuci, Ilvala, and Svasṛpa,

sanskrit_iast:
ajiko narakaścaiva kālanābhastathaiva ca |
śaramāṇaḥ śaraḥ kalpa ete vaṃśavivardhanāḥ ||
meaning:
अजिको नरकश्चैव कालनाभस्तथैव च |
शरमाणः शरः कल्प एते वंशविवर्धनाः ||
text_mt: Ajika, Naraka, and likewise Kālanābha, / Śaramāṇa, Śara, and Kalpa: these caused the lineage to increase.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca danuvaṃśavivarddhanāḥ |
bahavaśca samudbhūtā vistaratvānna varṇitāḥ ||
meaning:
एषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च दनुवंशविवर्द्धनाः |
बहवश्च समुद्भूता विस्तरत्वान्न वर्णिताः ||
text_mt: The sons and grandsons of these, who increased the lineage of Danu, / were born in great numbers; they are not described on account of their vastness.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhrādasya tu daiteyā nivātakavacāḥ kule |
utpannā marutastasmiṃstapasā bhāvitātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
संह्रादस्य तु दैतेया निवातकवचाः कुले |
उत्पन्ना मरुतस्तस्मिंस्तपसा भावितात्मनः ||
text_mt: In the family of Saṃhrāda were the Daiteyas called Nivātakavacas; / in that [line] the Maruts were born from one who had purified his soul through austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmukhādyā mahāsattvāstāmrāyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
kākī śyenī ca bhāsī ca sugrīvī ca śukī tathā ||
gṛdhrikāśvī hyulūkī ca tāmrākanyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
kākī kākānajanayadulūkī pratyulūkakān ||
meaning:
षण्मुखाद्या महासत्त्वास्ताम्रायाः परिकीर्तिताः |
काकी श्येनी च भासी च सुग्रीवी च शुकी तथा ||
गृध्रिकाश्वी ह्युलूकी च ताम्राकन्याः प्रकीर्तिताः |
काकी काकानजनयदुलूकी प्रत्युलूककान् ||
text_mt:
Creatures of great strength, beginning with Ṣaṇmukha, are proclaimed of Tāmrā: / Kākī, Śyenī, Bhāsī, Sugrīvī, and Śukī,

Gṛdhrikā, Aśvī, and Ulūkī are proclaimed the daughters of Tāmrā. / Kākī gave birth to crows, and Ulūkī to owls;

sanskrit_iast:
śyenī śyenāṃstathā bhāsī bhāsāngṛddhī tu gṛdhrakān |
śukī śukānajanayatsugrīvī śubhapakṣiṇaḥ ||
meaning:
श्येनी श्येनांस्तथा भासी भासान्गृद्धी तु गृध्रकान् |
शुकी शुकानजनयत्सुग्रीवी शुभपक्षिणः ||
text_mt: Śyenī bore hawks, Bhāsī vultures, Gṛdhrī kites, / Śukī bore parrots, and Sugrīvī auspicious birds.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvānuṣṭrān gardabhāṃśca tāmrā ca kaśyapapriyā |
janayāmāsa cetyevaṃ tāmrāvaṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
meaning:
अश्वानुष्ट्रान् गर्दभांश्च ताम्रा च कश्यपप्रिया |
जनयामास चेत्येवं ताम्रावंशः प्रकीर्तितः ||
text_mt: Horses, camels, and donkeys Tāmrā, beloved of Kaśyapa, / brought forth; thus has the lineage of Tāmrā been proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
vinatāyāśca putrau dvāvaruṇo garuḍastathā |
suparṇaḥ patatāṃ śreṣṭho dāruṇaḥ svena karmaṇā ||
meaning:
विनतायाश्च पुत्रौ द्वावरुणो गरुडस्तथा |
सुपर्णः पततां श्रेष्ठो दारुणः स्वेन कर्मणा ||
text_mt: Vinatā had two sons: Aruṇa and Garuḍa; / Suparṇa was the foremost of flyers, fearsome through his own action.

sanskrit_iast:
surasāyāḥ sahasraṃ tu sarpāṇāmamitaujasām |
anekaśirasāṃ teṣāṃ khecarāṇāṃ mahātmanām ||
meaning:
सुरसायाः सहस्रं तु सर्पाणाममितौजसाम् |
अनेकशिरसां तेषां खेचराणां महात्मनाम् ||
text_mt: Of Surasā were a thousand serpents of boundless energy, / possessing many heads, moving through the sky, high-souled,

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ pradhānā rājānaḥ śeṣavāsukitakṣakāḥ |
airāvato mahāpadmaḥ kambalāśvatarāvubhau ||
meaning:
येषां प्रधाना राजानः शेषवासुकितक्षकाः |
ऐरावतो महापद्मः कम्बलाश्वतरावुभौ ||
text_mt: of whom the foremost kings were Śeṣa, Vāsuki, and Takṣaka, / Airāvata, Mahāpadma, both Kambala and Aśvatara,

sanskrit_iast:
ailāpatrastathā padmaḥ karkoṭakadhanañjayau |
mahānīlamahākarṇau dhṛtarāṣṭro balāhakaḥ ||
meaning:
ऐलापत्रस्तथा पद्मः कर्कोटकधनञ्जयौ |
महानीलमहाकर्णौ धृतराष्ट्रो बलाहकः ||
text_mt: Elāpatra, Padma, Karkoṭaka and Dhanañjaya, / Mahānīla and Mahākarṇa, Dhṛtarāṣṭra and Balāhaka,

sanskrit_iast:
kuharaḥ puṣpadantaśca durmukhaḥ sumukhastathā |
bahuśaḥ khararomā ca pāṇirityevamādayaḥ ||
meaning:
कुहरः पुष्पदन्तश्च दुर्मुखः सुमुखस्तथा |
बहुशः खररोमा च पाणिरित्येवमादयः ||
text_mt: Kuhara, Puṣpadanta, Durmukha and Sumukha, / Bahuśaḥ, Khararoman, Pāṇi, and others of that kind.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇāḥ krodhavaśāyāśca tasyāḥ sarve ca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ |
aṇḍajāḥ pakṣiṇo'bjāśca varāhyāḥ paśavo matāḥ ||
meaning:
गणाः क्रोधवशायाश्च तस्याः सर्वे च दंष्ट्रिणः |
अण्डजाः पक्षिणोऽब्जाश्च वराह्याः पशवो मताः ||
text_mt: The hosts of Krodhavaśā—all of them were fanged beasts; / the egg-born were birds, the water-born, and the animals born of Varāhī are considered.

sanskrit_iast:
anāyuṣāyāḥ putrāśca pañcāśacca mahābalāḥ |
abhavanbalavṛkṣau ca vikṣaro'tha bṛhaṃstathā ||
śaśāṃstu janayāmāsa surarabhirmahiṣāṃstathā |
ilā vṛkṣām̐llatā vallīstṛṇajātīstu sarvaśaḥ ||
meaning:
अनायुषायाः पुत्राश्च पञ्चाशच्च महाबलाः |
अभवन्बलवृक्षौ च विक्षरोऽथ बृहंस्तथा ||
शशांस्तु जनयामास सुररभिर्महिषांस्तथा |
इला वृक्षाम्̐ल्लता वल्लीस्तृणजातीस्तु सर्वशः ||
text_mt:
The sons of Anāyuṣā were fifty of great strength, / and Balavṛkṣa, Vikṣara, and Bṛhat came into being.

Surabhi gave birth to hares and to buffaloes; / Ilā to trees, creepers, climbing plants, and varieties of grass of every kind.

sanskrit_iast:
khaśā tu yakṣarakṣāṃsi munirapsarasastathā |
ariṣṭāsūta sarpāṃśca prabhā vai mānavottamān ||
meaning:
खशा तु यक्षरक्षांसि मुनिरप्सरसस्तथा |
अरिष्टासूत सर्पांश्च प्रभा वै मानवोत्तमान् ||
text_mt:
Khaśā [bore] the Yakṣas and Rākṣasas; Muni, the Apsarases;
Ariṣṭā gave birth to serpents; and Prabhā to the foremost of humans.

sanskrit_iast:
ete kaśyapadāyādāḥ kīrtitāste munīśvara |
yeṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
एते कश्यपदायादाः कीर्तितास्ते मुनीश्वर |
येषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
These descendants of Kaśyapa have been proclaimed to you, O lord of sages,
whose sons and grandsons [number] in the hundreds and thousands.

Obeisance to Śrī Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
eṣa manvantare tāta sargaḥ svārociṣe smṛtaḥ |
vaivasvate tu mahati vāruṇe vita te kratau ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
एष मन्वन्तरे तात सर्गः स्वारोचिषे स्मृतः |
वैवस्वते तु महति वारुणे वित ते क्रतौ ||
title: trayastriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ | kaśyapavaṃśavarṇanam 2
text_mt: Sūta said: / This creation is remembered, dear child, as having occurred in the Svārociṣa manvantara. / But in the Vaivasvata [manvantara], during the great sacrificial rite of Varuṇa that was spread out,

sanskrit_iast:
juhvānasya brahmaṇo vai prajāsarga ihocyate |
pūrvaṃ yānatha brahmarṣīnutpannān sapta mānasān ||
meaning:
जुह्वानस्य ब्रह्मणो वै प्रजासर्ग इहोच्यते |
पूर्वं यानथ ब्रह्मर्षीनुत्पन्नान् सप्त मानसान् ||
text_mt: the creation of offspring by Brahmā as he made oblations is described here. / Formerly, the seven mind-born [sons] who were produced as the brahmin sages,

sanskrit_iast:
putrānvai kalpayāmāsa svayameva pitāmahaḥ |
teṣāṃ virodho devānāṃ dānavānāṃ mahāṝṣe ||
meaning:
पुत्रान्वै कल्पयामास स्वयमेव पितामहः |
तेषां विरोधो देवानां दानवानां महाॠषे ||
text_mt: those sons the Grandfather himself conceived. / Between them, the gods and the Dānavas, an enmity arose, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
ditirvinaṣṭaputrā tu kaśyapaṃ samupasthitā |
sa kaśyapaḥ prasannātmā samgayagārādhitastayā ||
meaning:
दितिर्विनष्टपुत्रा तु कश्यपं समुपस्थिता |
स कश्यपः प्रसन्नात्मा सम्गयगाराधितस्तया ||
text_mt: Diti, having lost her sons, approached Kaśyapa. / Kaśyapa, pleased in spirit, was properly propitiated by her.

sanskrit_iast:
vareṇacchandayāmāsa sā ca vavre varaṃ tadā |
putramindravadhārthāya samarthamamitaujasam ||
meaning:
वरेणच्छन्दयामास सा च वव्रे वरं तदा |
पुत्रमिन्द्रवधार्थाय समर्थममितौजसम् ||
text_mt: He offered her a boon, and she then chose a boon: / a son capable of slaying Indra, possessed of boundless power.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasyai ca varaṃ prādātprārthitaṃ sumahātapāḥ |
brahmacaryyādiniyamaṃ prāha caiva śataṃ samāḥ ||
meaning:
स तस्यै च वरं प्रादात्प्रार्थितं सुमहातपाः |
ब्रह्मचर्य्यादिनियमं प्राह चैव शतं समाः ||
text_mt: He, of very great austerity, granted her the prayed-for boon, / and prescribed rules such as celibacy for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
dhārayāmāsa garbhaṃ tu śuciḥ sā varavarṇinī |
brahmacaryyādiniyamaṃ ditirdadhre tathaiva vai ||
meaning:
धारयामास गर्भं तु शुचिः सा वरवर्णिनी |
ब्रह्मचर्य्यादिनियमं दितिर्दध्रे तथैव वै ||
text_mt: Purified, the fair-complexioned lady bore the embryo; / Diti indeed maintained the observance of celibacy and the other rules in that very way.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastvādhāya so dityāṃ garbhaṃ taṃ śaṃsitavrataḥ |
jagāma kaśyapastaptuṃ tapaḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||
meaning:
ततस्त्वाधाय सो दित्यां गर्भं तं शंसितव्रतः |
जगाम कश्यपस्तप्तुं तपः संहृष्टमानसः ||
text_mt: Then, having deposited that embryo in Diti, with vows firmly observed, / Kaśyapa went away with a joyful mind to perform austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāścaivāntaraṃ prepsuḥ so'bhavatpākaśāsanaḥ |
ūnavarṣe śate cāsyā dadarśāntarameva saḥ ||
akṛtvā pādayoḥ śaucaṃ ditirarvākṣirāstadā |
nidrāmāhārayāmāsa bhāvino'rthasya gauravāt ||
meaning:
तस्याश्चैवान्तरं प्रेप्सुः सोऽभवत्पाकशासनः |
ऊनवर्षे शते चास्या ददर्शान्तरमेव सः ||
अकृत्वा पादयोः शौचं दितिरर्वाक्षिरास्तदा |
निद्रामाहारयामास भाविनोऽर्थस्य गौरवात् ||
text_mt:
Seeking an opportunity against her, Pākaśāsana [Indra] was [on the watch]; / and when one year was lacking from the hundred, he indeed found an opportunity.

Without washing her feet, Diti, with her head turned downward, / went to sleep because of the gravity of the destined event.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare śakrastasyāḥ kukṣiṃ praviśya saḥ |
vajrapāṇistu taṃ garbhaṃ saptadhā hi nyakṛntata ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शक्रस्तस्याः कुक्षिं प्रविश्य सः |
वज्रपाणिस्तु तं गर्भं सप्तधा हि न्यकृन्तत ||
text_mt: At that moment, Śakra entered her belly, / and, thunderbolt in hand, he cut that embryo into seven parts.

sanskrit_iast:
sa pāṭyamāno garbho'tha vajreṇa praruroda ha |
rudantaṃ saptadhaikaikaṃ mā rodīriti tānpunaḥ |
cakarta vajrapāṇistānneva mamrustathāpi te ||
meaning:
स पाट्यमानो गर्भोऽथ वज्रेण प्ररुरोद ह |
रुदन्तं सप्तधैकैकं मा रोदीरिति तान्पुनः |
चकर्त वज्रपाणिस्तान्नेव मम्रुस्तथापि ते ||
text_mt: Then that embryo, being cleaved by the thunderbolt, wept loudly. / While they were crying, the thunderbolt-handed one cut each one again into seven, saying, 'Do not cry!' / Even so, they did not die.

sanskrit_iast:
te tamūcuḥ pāṭyamānāḥ sarve prāñjalayo mune |
no jighāṃsasi kiṃ śakra bhrātaro marutastava ||
meaning:
ते तमूचुः पाट्यमानाः सर्वे प्राञ्जलयो मुने |
नो जिघांससि किं शक्र भ्रातरो मरुतस्तव ||
text_mt: While being cleaved, they all said to him with folded hands, O sage: / 'Why do you wish to kill us, Śakra? We are your brothers, the Maruts.'

sanskrit_iast:
indreṇa svīkṛtāste hi bhrātṛtve sarva eva ca |
tatyajurddaityabhāvaṃ te viprarṣe śaṅkarecchayā ||
meaning:
इन्द्रेण स्वीकृतास्ते हि भ्रातृत्वे सर्व एव च |
तत्यजुर्द्दैत्यभावं ते विप्रर्षे शङ्करेच्छया ||
text_mt: They were indeed accepted by Indra into brotherhood, all of them; / and by the will of Śaṅkara, they abandoned their demon nature, O sage among brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
maruto nāma te devā babhūvuḥ sumahābalāḥ |
khagā ekonapañcāśatsahāyā vajrapāṇinaḥ ||
meaning:
मरुतो नाम ते देवा बभूवुः सुमहाबलाः |
खगा एकोनपञ्चाशत्सहाया वज्रपाणिनः ||
text_mt: They became the gods named Maruts, exceedingly powerful, / moving through the sky, forty-nine in number, companions of the thunderbolt-handed one.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmeva pravṛddhānāṃ hariḥ prādātprajāpatiḥ |
kramaśastāni rājyāni pṛthupūrvaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat ||
meaning:
तेषामेव प्रवृद्धानां हरिः प्रादात्प्रजापतिः |
क्रमशस्तानि राज्यानि पृथुपूर्वं शृणुष्व तत् ||
text_mt: To them, when they were fully grown, Hari, the lord of creatures, / gave those kingdoms in succession, beginning with Pṛthu; hear that.

sanskrit_iast:
ariṣṭaḥ puruṣo vīraḥ kṛṣṇo jiṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥ |
parjanyastu dhanādhyakṣastasya sarvamidaṃ jagat ||
meaning:
अरिष्टः पुरुषो वीरः कृष्णो जिष्णुः प्रजापतिः |
पर्जन्यस्तु धनाध्यक्षस्तस्य सर्वमिदं जगत् ||
text_mt: Ariṣṭa, the heroic Puruṣa, Kṛṣṇa, the victorious lord of creatures, / and Parjanya the overseer of wealth—to him belongs all this world.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtasargamimaṃ samyagavocaṃ te mahāmune |
vibhāgaṃ śṛṇu rājyānāṃ kramaśastaṃ bruve'dhunā ||
meaning:
भूतसर्गमिमं सम्यगवोचं ते महामुने |
विभागं शृणु राज्यानां क्रमशस्तं ब्रुवेऽधुना ||
text_mt: I have duly recounted to you this creation of beings, O great sage. / Hear now the division of kingdoms; I will speak of it in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
abhiṣicyādhirājye tu pṛthuṃ vainyaṃ pitāmahaḥ |
tataḥ krameṇa rājyāni vyādeṣṭumupacakrame ||
dvijānāṃ vīrudhāṃ caiva nakṣatragrahayostathā |
yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva somaṃ rājye'bhyaṣecayat ||
meaning:
अभिषिच्याधिराज्ये तु पृथुं वैन्यं पितामहः |
ततः क्रमेण राज्यानि व्यादेष्टुमुपचक्रमे ||
द्विजानां वीरुधां चैव नक्षत्रग्रहयोस्तथा |
यज्ञानां तपसां चैव सोमं राज्येऽभ्यषेचयत् ||
text_mt:
Having consecrated Pṛthu, the son of Vena, to the supreme sovereignty, / the Grandfather then proceeded to assign the kingdoms in succession.

Over the twice-born, the creeping plants, the lunar mansions and planets, / and over sacrifices and austerities, he consecrated Soma to the kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
apāṃ tu varuṇaṃ rājye rājñāṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum |
ādityānāṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ vasūnāmatha pāvakam ||
meaning:
अपां तु वरुणं राज्ये राज्ञां वैश्रवणं प्रभुम् |
आदित्यानां तथा विष्णुं वसूनामथ पावकम् ||
text_mt: Varuṇa to the kingdom of the waters, the lord Vaiśravaṇa over kings, / likewise Viṣṇu over the Ādityas, and Pāvaka over the Vasus;

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣaṃ tu marutāmatha vāsavam |
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca prahlādamamitaujasam ||
meaning:
प्रजापतीनां दक्षं तु मरुतामथ वासवम् |
दैत्यानां दानवानां च प्रह्लादममितौजसम् ||
text_mt: Dakṣa over the lords of creatures, Vāsava over the Maruts, / and Prahlāda of boundless power over the Daityas and Dānavas;

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvataṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca yamaṃ rājye'bhyaṣecayat |
mātṝṇāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ ca tathā gavām ||
meaning:
वैवस्वतं पितॄणां च यमं राज्येऽभ्यषेचयत् |
मातॄणां च व्रतानां च मन्त्राणां च तथा गवाम् ||
text_mt: he consecrated Vaivasvata Yama to the kingdom over the ancestors, / and over mothers, observances, mantras, and cows;

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca pārthivānāṃ tathaiva ca |
sarvabhūtapiśācānāṃ giriśaṃ śūlapāṇinam ||
meaning:
यक्षाणां राक्षसानां च पार्थिवानां तथैव च |
सर्वभूतपिशाचानां गिरिशं शूलपाणिनम् ||
text_mt: and Giriśa, spear in hand, over the Yakṣas, Rākṣasas, / earthly kings, all spirits, and Piśācas;

sanskrit_iast:
śailānāṃ himavantaṃ ca nadīnāmatha sāgaram |
mṛgāṇāmatha śārdūlaṃ govṛṣaṃ tu gavāmapi ||
meaning:
शैलानां हिमवन्तं च नदीनामथ सागरम् |
मृगाणामथ शार्दूलं गोवृषं तु गवामपि ||
text_mt: Himavat over the mountains, the ocean over rivers, / the tiger over wild animals, and the bull over cattle;

sanskrit_iast:
vanaspatīnāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ vaṭaṃ rājye'bhyaṣecayat |
iti dattaṃ prajeśena rājyaṃ sarvatra vai kramāt ||
meaning:
वनस्पतीनां वृक्षाणां वटं राज्येऽभ्यषेचयत् |
इति दत्तं प्रजेशेन राज्यं सर्वत्र वै क्रमात् ||
text_mt: he consecrated the banyan tree to the kingdom over lords of the forest and trees. / Thus was kingship bestowed everywhere by the lord of creatures in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvasyāṃ diśi putraṃ tu vairājasya prajāpateḥ |
sthāpayāmāsa sarvātmā rājye viśvapatirvibhuḥ ||
meaning:
पूर्वस्यां दिशि पुत्रं तु वैराजस्य प्रजापतेः |
स्थापयामास सर्वात्मा राज्ये विश्वपतिर्विभुः ||
text_mt: In the eastern direction, the all-pervading sovereign of the universe, who is the self of all, / established the son of the lord of creatures Vairāja in kingship.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva muniśārdūla kardamasya prajāpateḥ |
dakṣiṇasyāṃ tathā putraṃ sudhanvānamacīklṛpat ||
meaning:
तथैव मुनिशार्दूल कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः |
दक्षिणस्यां तथा पुत्रं सुधन्वानमचीक्लृपत् ||
text_mt: Likewise, O tiger among sages, he placed Sudhanvan, / the son of the lord of creatures Kardama, in the southern [direction].

sanskrit_iast:
paścimāyāṃ diśi tathā rajasaḥ putramacyutam |
ketumantaṃ mahātmānaṃ rājānaṃ vyādiśatprabhuḥ ||
tathā hiraṇyaromāṇaṃ parjanyasya prajāpateḥ |
udīcyāṃ diśi rājānaṃ durdharṣaṃ so'bhyaṣecayat ||
meaning:
पश्चिमायां दिशि तथा रजसः पुत्रमच्युतम् |
केतुमन्तं महात्मानं राजानं व्यादिशत्प्रभुः ||
तथा हिरण्यरोमाणं पर्जन्यस्य प्रजापतेः |
उदीच्यां दिशि राजानं दुर्धर्षं सोऽभ्यषेचयत् ||
text_mt:
Likewise in the western direction, the lord designated the infallible / and magnanimous Ketumant, the son of Rajas, as king.

Likewise, he consecrated the unassailable Hiraṇyaroman, / the son of the lord of creatures Parjanya, as king in the northern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya vistāramākhyātaṃ pṛthorvainyasya śaunaka |
mahardhyai tadadhiṣṭhānaṃ purāṇaṃ parikīrtitam ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
तस्य विस्तारमाख्यातं पृथोर्वैन्यस्य शौनक |
महर्ध्यै तदधिष्ठानं पुराणं परिकीर्तितम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
The extent of that domain of Pṛthu, the son of Vena, has been recounted, O Śaunaka; / that ancient foundation has been proclaimed for great prosperity.

Obeisance to Śrī Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
śaunaka uvāca |
manvantarāṇi sarvāṇi vistareṇānukīrtaya |
yāvanto manavaścaiva śrotumicchāmi tānaham ||
meaning:
शौनक उवाच |
मन्वन्तराणि सर्वाणि विस्तरेणानुकीर्तय |
यावन्तो मनवश्चैव श्रोतुमिच्छामि तानहम् ||
title: catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | sarvamanvatarānurkārtanam
text_mt: Śaunaka said: / Recount in detail all the manvantaras, / and as many Manus as there are; I wish to hear them.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
svāyambhuvo manuścaiva tataḥ svārociṣastathā |
uttamastāmasaścaiva raivataścākṣuṣastathā ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
स्वायम्भुवो मनुश्चैव ततः स्वारोचिषस्तथा |
उत्तमस्तामसश्चैव रैवतश्चाक्षुषस्तथा ||
text_mt: Sūta said: / Svāyambhuva Manu, and then Svārociṣa, / Uttama, Tāmasa, Raivata, and Cākṣuṣa—

sanskrit_iast:
ete ca manavaḥ ṣaṭ te samproktā munipuṅgava |
vaivasvato muniśreṣṭha sāmprataṃ manurucyate ||
meaning:
एते च मनवः षट् ते सम्प्रोक्ता मुनिपुङ्गव |
वैवस्वतो मुनिश्रेष्ठ साम्प्रतं मनुरुच्यते ||
text_mt: these six Manus have been declared to you, O eminent sage; / Vaivasvata, O best of sages, is said to be the present Manu.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvarṇiśca manuścaiva tato raucyastathā paraḥ |
tathaiva brahmasāvarṇiścatvāro manavastathā ||
meaning:
सावर्णिश्च मनुश्चैव ततो रौच्यस्तथा परः |
तथैव ब्रह्मसावर्णिश्चत्वारो मनवस्तथा ||
text_mt: Then Sāvarṇi Manu, and next another, Raucya; / likewise Brahmasāvarṇi; thus four Manus [are spoken of];

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva dharmasāvarṇī rudrasāvarṇireva ca |
devasāvarṇirākhyāta indrasāvarṇireva ca ||
meaning:
तथैव धर्मसावर्णी रुद्रसावर्णिरेव च |
देवसावर्णिराख्यात इन्द्रसावर्णिरेव च ||
text_mt: likewise Dharmasāvarṇi and Rudrasāvarṇi, / Devasāvarṇi is declared, and Indrasāvarṇi.

sanskrit_iast:
atītā vartamānāśca tathaivānāgatāśca ye |
kīrtitā manavaścāpi mayaivaite yathā śrutāḥ ||
meaning:
अतीता वर्तमानाश्च तथैवानागताश्च ये |
कीर्तिता मनवश्चापि मयैवैते यथा श्रुताः ||
text_mt: Those that are past, those present, and those yet to come— / these Manus have thus been proclaimed by me just as they were heard.

sanskrit_iast:
mune caturdaśaitāni trikālānugatāni te |
proktāni nirmitaḥ kalpo yugasāhasraparyayaḥ ||
meaning:
मुने चतुर्दशैतानि त्रिकालानुगतानि ते |
प्रोक्तानि निर्मितः कल्पो युगसाहस्रपर्ययः ||
text_mt: These fourteen [periods], O sage, pertaining to the three divisions of time, have been declared to you; / a kalpa is formed of the revolution of a thousand yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣīṃsteṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi puttrān devagaṇāṃstathā |
śṛṇu śaunaka suprītyā kramaśastānyaśasvinaḥ ||
meaning:
ऋषींस्तेषां प्रवक्ष्यामि पुत्त्रान् देवगणांस्तथा |
शृणु शौनक सुप्रीत्या क्रमशस्तान्यशस्विनः ||
text_mt: I shall describe their sages, their sons, and their hosts of gods. / Hear of those renowned ones in due order, O Śaunaka, with great delight.

sanskrit_iast:
marīciratrirbhagavānaṅgirāḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ |
pulastyaśca vasiṣṭhaśca saptaite brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ ||
uttarasyāṃ diśi tathā mune saptarṣayastathā |
yāmā nāma tathā devā āsansvāyambhuve'ntare ||
meaning:
मरीचिरत्रिर्भगवानङ्गिराः पुलहः क्रतुः |
पुलस्त्यश्च वसिष्ठश्च सप्तैते ब्रह्मणः सुताः ||
उत्तरस्यां दिशि तथा मुने सप्तर्षयस्तथा |
यामा नाम तथा देवा आसन्स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे ||
text_mt:
Marīci, the venerable Atri, Aṅgiras, Pulaha, Kratu, / Pulastya, and Vasiṣṭha—these are the seven sons of Brahmā.

Likewise in the northern direction, O sage, are the Seven Sages; / and the gods named Yāmas existed in the Svāyambhuva manvantara.

sanskrit_iast:
āgnīdhraścāgnibāhuśca medhā medhātithirvasuḥ |
jyotiṣmāndhṛtimānhavyaḥ savanaḥ śubhra eva ca ||
meaning:
आग्नीध्रश्चाग्निबाहुश्च मेधा मेधातिथिर्वसुः |
ज्योतिष्मान्धृतिमान्हव्यः सवनः शुभ्र एव च ||
text_mt: Āgnīdhra, Agnibāhu, Medhā, Medhātithi, Vasu, / Jyotiṣmant, Dhṛtimant, Havya, Savana, and Śubhra—

sanskrit_iast:
svāyambhuvasya putrāste manordaśa mahātmanaḥ |
kīrtitā muniśārdūla tatrendro yajña ucyate ||
meaning:
स्वायम्भुवस्य पुत्रास्ते मनोर्दश महात्मनः |
कीर्तिता मुनिशार्दूल तत्रेन्द्रो यज्ञ उच्यते ||
text_mt: these are recorded as the ten sons of the magnanimous Manu Svāyambhuva, / O tiger among sages; there Indra is called Yajña.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ kathitaṃ tāta divyaṃ manvataraṃ tathā |
dvitīyaṃ te pravakṣyāmi tannibodha yathātatham ||
meaning:
प्रथमं कथितं तात दिव्यं मन्वतरं तथा |
द्वितीयं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्निबोध यथातथम् ||
text_mt: The first divine manvantara has thus been described, dear child; / I shall speak to you of the second; understand it properly.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrjastambhaḥ parastambha ṛṣabho vasumāṃstathā |
jyotiṣmān dyutimāṃścaiva rociṣmān saptamastathā ||
meaning:
ऊर्जस्तम्भः परस्तम्भ ऋषभो वसुमांस्तथा |
ज्योतिष्मान् द्युतिमांश्चैव रोचिष्मान् सप्तमस्तथा ||
text_mt: Ūrjastambha, Parastambha, Ṛṣabha, and Vasumat, / Jyotiṣmat, Dyutimat, and Rociṣmat as the seventh—

sanskrit_iast:
ete maharṣayo jñeyāstatrendro rocanastathā |
devāśca tuṣitā nāma smṛtāḥ svārociṣeṃ'tare ||
meaning:
एते महर्षयो ज्ञेयास्तत्रेन्द्रो रोचनस्तथा |
देवाश्च तुषिता नाम स्मृताः स्वारोचिषेंऽतरे ||
text_mt: these are to be known as the great sages. In that era, Indra was Rocana, / and the gods were known by the name Tuṣitas in the Svārociṣa manvantara.

sanskrit_iast:
harighnaḥ sukṛtirjyotirayomūrtirayasmayaḥ |
prathitaśca manasyuśca nabhaḥ sūryastathaiva ca ||
meaning:
हरिघ्नः सुकृतिर्ज्योतिरयोमूर्तिरयस्मयः |
प्रथितश्च मनस्युश्च नभः सूर्यस्तथैव च ||
text_mt: Harighna, Sukṛti, Jyotis, Ayomūrti, Ayasmaya, / Prathita, Manasyu, Nabhas, and Sūrya—

sanskrit_iast:
svārociṣasya putrāste manordaśa mahātmanaḥ |
kīrtitā muniśārdūla mahāvīryaparākramāḥ ||
meaning:
स्वारोचिषस्य पुत्रास्ते मनोर्दश महात्मनः |
कीर्तिता मुनिशार्दूल महावीर्यपराक्रमाः ||
text_mt: these ten sons of the great-souled Manu Svārociṣa, / endowed with great vigor and valor, have been proclaimed, O tiger among sages.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyametatkathitaṃ mune manvantaraṃ mayā |
tṛtīyaṃ tava vakṣyāmi tannibodha yathātatham ||
meaning:
द्वितीयमेतत्कथितं मुने मन्वन्तरं मया |
तृतीयं तव वक्ष्यामि तन्निबोध यथातथम् ||
text_mt: This second manvantara has been described by me, O sage; / I shall relate to you the third. Learn it accurately.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭhaputrāḥ saptāsanvāsiṣṭhā iti viśrutāḥ |
hiraṇyagarbhasya sutā ūrjā nāma mahaujasaḥ ||
ṛṣayo'tra samākhyātāḥ kīrtyamānānnibodha me |
auttameyā ṛṣiśreṣṭha daśa putrā manoḥ smṛtāḥ ||
meaning:
वसिष्ठपुत्राः सप्तासन्वासिष्ठा इति विश्रुताः |
हिरण्यगर्भस्य सुता ऊर्जा नाम महौजसः ||
ऋषयोऽत्र समाख्याताः कीर्त्यमानान्निबोध मे |
औत्तमेया ऋषिश्रेष्ठ दश पुत्रा मनोः स्मृताः ||
text_mt:
There were seven sons of Vasiṣṭha, renowned as the Vāsiṣṭhas, / sons of Hiraṇyagarbha, of great energy, known as Ūrjās.

The sages here are fully declared; listen to them being recounted by me. / Ten sons of Manu, born of Uttama, are recorded, O best of sages:

sanskrit_iast:
iṣa ūrjita ūrjaśca madhurmādhava eva ca |
śuciḥ śukravahaścaiva nabhaso nabha eva ca ||
meaning:
इष ऊर्जित ऊर्जश्च मधुर्माधव एव च |
शुचिः शुक्रवहश्चैव नभसो नभ एव च ||
text_mt: Iṣa, Ūrjita, Ūrja, Madhu, Mādhava, / Śuci, Śukravaha, Nabhasa, Nabha,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣabhastatra devāśca satyavedaśrutādayaḥ |
tatrendraḥ satyajinnāma trailokyādhipatirmune ||
meaning:
ऋषभस्तत्र देवाश्च सत्यवेदश्रुतादयः |
तत्रेन्द्रः सत्यजिन्नाम त्रैलोक्याधिपतिर्मुने ||
text_mt: and Ṛṣabha. There, the gods were Satyavedaśrutas and others. / There, the Indra was named Satyajit, lord of the three worlds, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyametatparamaṃ manvataramudāhṛtam |
manvataraṃ caturthaṃ te kathayāmi mune śṛṇu ||
meaning:
तृतीयमेतत्परमं मन्वतरमुदाहृतम् |
मन्वतरं चतुर्थं ते कथयामि मुने शृणु ||
