text_mt: All those twice-born once again spoke to their father: / "We shall make provision for you, by which you will sustain your livelihood.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ ślokaṃ mahārthaṃ tvaṃ rājānaṃ sahamantriṇam |
śrāvayethāḥ samāgamya brahmadattamakalmaṣam ||
meaning:
इमं श्लोकं महार्थं त्वं राजानं सहमन्त्रिणम् |
श्रावयेथाः समागम्य ब्रह्मदत्तमकल्मषम् ||
text_mt: Approaching the sinless king Brahmadatta along with his ministers, / you should recite this verse of profound meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
prītātmā dāsyati sa te grāmān bhogāṃśca puṣkalān |
etāvaduktvā te sarve pūjayitvā ca taṃ gurum |
yogadharmamanuprāpya parāṃ nirvṛtimāyayuḥ ||
meaning:
प्रीतात्मा दास्यति स ते ग्रामान् भोगांश्च पुष्कलान् |
एतावदुक्त्वा ते सर्वे पूजयित्वा च तं गुरुम् |
योगधर्ममनुप्राप्य परां निर्वृतिमाययुः ||
text_mt: 'With a pleased mind, he will give you villages and abundant enjoyments.' / Having spoken thus, all of them honored that guru, / attained the path of yoga, and reached the supreme tranquility.

sanskrit_iast:
caturṇāṃ tu pitā yo'sau brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām |
ślokaṃ so'dhītya putrebhyaḥ kṛtakṛtya ivābhavat ||
meaning:
चतुर्णां तु पिता योऽसौ ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम् |
श्लोकं सोऽधीत्य पुत्रेभ्यः कृतकृत्य इवाभवत् ||
text_mt: The father of those four high-souled brāhmaṇas, / having learned the verse from his sons, felt as if he had accomplished his purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvayāmāsa rājānaṃ slokaṃ taṃ sacivau ca tau |
saptavyādhā daśārṇeṣu mṛgāḥ kālañjare girau ||
meaning:
श्रावयामास राजानं स्लोकं तं सचिवौ च तौ |
सप्तव्याधा दशार्णेषु मृगाः कालञ्जरे गिरौ ||
text_mt: He recited that verse to the king and his two ministers: / 'Seven hunters in Daśārṇa, deer on Mount Kālañjara,

sanskrit_iast:
cakravākāḥ śaradvīpe haṃsāḥ sarasi mānase |
te'bhijātāḥ kurukṣetre brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ ||
meaning:
चक्रवाकाः शरद्वीपे हंसाः सरसि मानसे |
तेऽभिजाताः कुरुक्षेत्रे ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः ||
text_mt: ruddy geese in Śaradvīpa, swans in the Mānasa lake: / they were born in Kurukṣetra as brāhmaṇas who had mastered the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
prasthitā dirghamadhvānaṃ yuyaṃ kimavasīdatha |
tacchrutvā mohamagamadbrahmadatto narādhipaḥ ||
meaning:
प्रस्थिता दिर्घमध्वानं युयं किमवसीदथ |
तच्छ्रुत्वा मोहमगमद्ब्रह्मदत्तो नराधिपः ||
text_mt: Having set out on a long path, why do you now sink down?' / Hearing that, King Brahmadatta fell into confusion.

sanskrit_iast:
sacivaścāsya pāñcālaḥ puṇḍarīkaśca bhārata |
tataste tatsaraḥ smṛtvā yogaṃ tamupalabhya ca ||
meaning:
सचिवश्चास्य पाञ्चालः पुण्डरीकश्च भारत |
ततस्ते तत्सरः स्मृत्वा योगं तमुपलभ्य च ||
text_mt: And so did his ministers, Pāñcāla and Puṇḍarīka, O Bhārata. / Then, remembering that lake and regaining their yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ vipulairarthairbhogaiśca samayojayan |
abhiṣicya svarājye tu viṣvaksenamarindamam ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं विपुलैरर्थैर्भोगैश्च समयोजयन् |
अभिषिच्य स्वराज्ये तु विष्वक्सेनमरिन्दमम् ||
text_mt: they endowed the brāhmaṇa with vast riches and pleasures. / And having consecrated Viṣvaksena, suppressor of enemies, in his own kingdom,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma brahmadatto hi sadāro vanameva ha |
prāpya yogaṃ balādeva gatiṃ prāpa sudurlabhām ||
meaning:
जगाम ब्रह्मदत्तो हि सदारो वनमेव ह |
प्राप्य योगं बलादेव गतिं प्राप सुदुर्लभाम् ||
text_mt: Brahmadatta indeed went to the forest with his wife; / attaining yoga by sheer force, he reached that state so difficult to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇḍarīko'pi dharmātmā sāṅkhyayogamanuttamam |
prāpya yogagatiḥ siddho viśuddhastena karmaṇā ||
meaning:
पुण्डरीकोऽपि धर्मात्मा साङ्ख्ययोगमनुत्तमम् |
प्राप्य योगगतिः सिद्धो विशुद्धस्तेन कर्मणा ||
text_mt: The righteous Puṇḍarīka as well, having attained the unsurpassed Sāṅkhya-yoga, / reached the goal of yoga, perfected and purified by that action.

sanskrit_iast:
kramaṃ praṇīya pāñcālyaḥ śikṣāṃ cotpādya kevalām |
yogācāryagatiṃ prāpa yaśaścāgryaṃ mahātapāḥ ||
meaning:
क्रमं प्रणीय पाञ्चाल्यः शिक्षां चोत्पाद्य केवलाम् |
योगाचार्यगतिं प्राप यशश्चाग्र्यं महातपाः ||
text_mt: Pāñcālya, having composed the Pada-krama and produced flawless phonetic instruction, / attained the state of a master of yoga and foremost fame, rich in austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
śūrā ye samprapadyante apunarbhavakāṅkṣiṇaḥ |
pāpaṃ praṇāśayantvadya tacchambhoḥ paramaṃ padam ||
meaning:
शूरा ये सम्प्रपद्यन्ते अपुनर्भवकाङ्क्षिणः |
पापं प्रणाशयन्त्वद्य तच्छम्भोः परमं पदम् ||
text_mt: The heroes who surrender, desiring freedom from rebirth, / let them today destroy sin: that is the supreme abode of Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
śārīre mānase caiva pāpe vāgje mahāmune |
kṛte samyagidaṃ bhaktyā paṭhecchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
meaning:
शारीरे मानसे चैव पापे वाग्जे महामुने |
कृते सम्यगिदं भक्त्या पठेच्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ||
text_mt: When a bodily, mental, or vocal sin has been committed, O great sage, / one should properly read this with devotion and endowed with faith.

sanskrit_iast:
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ śivanāmānukīrtanāt |
uccāryamāṇa etasmindevadevasya tasya vai ||
meaning:
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः शिवनामानुकीर्तनात् |
उच्चार्यमाण एतस्मिन्देवदेवस्य तस्य वै ||
text_mt: One is freed from all sins by chanting the names of Śiva; / while this is being recited, indeed, of that God of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
vilayaṃ pāpamāyāti hyāmabhāṇḍamivāmbhasi |
tasmāttatsañcite pāpe samānāntarameva ca ||
meaning:
विलयं पापमायाति ह्यामभाण्डमिवाम्भसि |
तस्मात्तत्सञ्चिते पापे समानान्तरमेव च ||
text_mt: sin dissolves like an unbaked jar in water. / Therefore, immediately after sin has been accumulated,

sanskrit_iast:
japtavyametatpāpasya praśamāya mahāmune |
naraiḥ śraddhālubhibhūryaḥ sarvakāmaphalāptaye ||
meaning:
जप्तव्यमेतत्पापस्य प्रशमाय महामुने |
नरैः श्रद्धालुभिभूर्यः सर्वकामफलाप्तये ||
text_mt: this should be repeated to pacify sin, O great sage, / repeatedly by faithful men to obtain the fruit of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣṭyarthamimamadhyāyaṃ paṭhedenaṃ śṛṇoti vā |
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo mokṣaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
पुष्ट्यर्थमिममध्यायं पठेदेनं शृणोति वा |
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षं याति न संशयः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
One should read this chapter or listen to it for nourishment; / one is freed from all sins and goes to liberation, there is no doubt.

Obeisance to auspicious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
śaunaka uvāca |
ācāryapūjanaṃ brūhi sūta vyāsaguro'dhunā |
granthasya śravaṇānte hi kiṃ kartavyaṃ tadapyaho ||
meaning:
शौनक उवाच |
आचार्यपूजनं ब्रूहि सूत व्यासगुरोऽधुना |
ग्रन्थस्य श्रवणान्ते हि किं कर्तव्यं तदप्यहो ||
title: tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | vyāsapūjanaprakāraḥ
text_mt: Śaunaka said: / Speak now of the worship of the preceptor, O Sūta, teacher Vyāsa; / what indeed ought to be done at the conclusion of hearing the book? Ah!

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
pūjayedvidhivadbhaktyācāryaṃ śrutvā kathāṃ parām |
granthānte vidhivaddadyādācāryāya prasannadhīḥ ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
पूजयेद्विधिवद्भक्त्याचार्यं श्रुत्वा कथां पराम् |
ग्रन्थान्ते विधिवद्दद्यादाचार्याय प्रसन्नधीः ||
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard the supreme story, one should properly worship the preceptor with devotion; / at the end of the text, with a tranquil mind, one should properly make gifts to the preceptor.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vaktāramānamya sampūjya ca yathāvidhi |
bhūṣaṇairhastakarṇānāṃ vastraiḥ saumyādibhiḥ sudhīḥ ||
meaning:
ततो वक्तारमानम्य सम्पूज्य च यथाविधि |
भूषणैर्हस्तकर्णानां वस्त्रैः सौम्यादिभिः सुधीः ||
text_mt: Then, having bowed to the speaker and properly worshipped him / with ornaments for the hands and ears, and with pleasant garments and the like, the wise person,

sanskrit_iast:
śivapūjāsamāptau tu dadyāddhenuṃ savatsikām |
kṛtvāsanaṃ suvarṇasya palamānasya sāmbaram ||
meaning:
शिवपूजासमाप्तौ तु दद्याद्धेनुं सवत्सिकाम् |
कृत्वासनं सुवर्णस्य पलमानस्य साम्बरम् ||
text_mt: at the conclusion of the worship of Śiva, should give a cow along with her calf; / having made a seat of gold of a pala in weight, accompanied by cloth,

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāsthāpya śubhaṃ granthaṃ likhitaṃ lalitākṣaraiḥ |
ācāryāya sudhīrdadyānmuktaḥ syādbhavabandhanaiḥ ||
meaning:
तत्रास्थाप्य शुभं ग्रन्थं लिखितं ललिताक्षरैः |
आचार्याय सुधीर्दद्यान्मुक्तः स्याद्भवबन्धनैः ||
text_mt: and placing upon it the auspicious book written in beautiful letters, / the wise person should give it to the preceptor and become freed from the bonds of mundane existence.

sanskrit_iast:
grāmo gajo hayaścāpi yathāśaktyaparāṇi ca |
mune sarvāṇi deyāni vācakāya mahātmane ||
meaning:
ग्रामो गजो हयश्चापि यथाशक्त्यपराणि च |
मुने सर्वाणि देयानि वाचकाय महात्मने ||
text_mt: A village, an elephant, a horse, and others according to capacity— / all these should be given, O sage, to the high-souled reciter.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhānasahitaṃ samyak śrutaṃ hi saphalaṃ smṛtam |
purāṇaṃ śaunakamune satyamevoditaṃ mayā ||
meaning:
विधानसहितं सम्यक् श्रुतं हि सफलं स्मृतम् |
पुराणं शौनकमुने सत्यमेवोदितं मया ||
text_mt: Heard completely according to the proper ordinance, the Purāṇa is considered fruitful; / O sage Śaunaka, this has been spoken by me as absolute truth.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvidhānayuktaṃ tu śṛṇuyādbhaktito mune |
purāṇaṃ nigamārthāḍhyaṃ puṇyadaṃ hṛdayaṃ śruteḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
तस्माद्विधानयुक्तं तु शृणुयाद्भक्तितो मुने |
पुराणं निगमार्थाढ्यं पुण्यदं हृदयं श्रुतेः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Therefore, accompanied by the proper ordinance, one should listen with devotion, O sage, / to the Purāṇa, rich in the meaning of the Vedas, granting merit, the heart of the scripture.

Obeisance to auspicious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ |
vyāsotpattiṃ mahābuddhe brūhi sūta dayānidhe |
kṛpayā parayā svāmin kṛtārthānnaḥ kuru prabho ||
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः |
व्यासोत्पत्तिं महाबुद्धे ब्रूहि सूत दयानिधे |
कृपया परया स्वामिन् कृतार्थान्नः कुरु प्रभो ||
title: catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | vyāsotpattivarṇanam
text_mt: The sages said: / Speak of the birth of Vyāsa, O great intellect, Sūta, treasure-house of compassion; / out of supreme mercy, O master, fulfill our purpose, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsasya jananī proktā nāmnā satyavatī śubhā |
vivāhitā tu sā devī rājñā śantanunā kila ||
meaning:
व्यासस्य जननी प्रोक्ता नाम्ना सत्यवती शुभा |
विवाहिता तु सा देवी राज्ञा शन्तनुना किल ||
text_mt: The auspicious mother of Vyāsa is said to have been named Satyavatī; / indeed, that lady was married by King Śantanu.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ jāto mahāyogī kathaṃ vyāsaḥ parāśarāt |
sandeho'tra mahāñjātastaṃ bhavāñchettumarhati ||
meaning:
तस्यां जातो महायोगी कथं व्यासः पराशरात् |
सन्देहोऽत्र महाञ्जातस्तं भवाञ्छेत्तुमर्हति ||
text_mt: How was the great yogin Vyāsa born from her through Parāśara? / A great doubt has arisen here; you ought to resolve it.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
ekadā tīrthayātrāyāṃ vrajanyogī parāśaraḥ |
yadṛcchayāgato ramyaṃ yamunāyāstaṭaṃ śubham ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
एकदा तीर्थयात्रायां व्रजन्योगी पराशरः |
यदृच्छयागतो रम्यं यमुनायास्तटं शुभम् ||
text_mt: Sūta said: / Once, while wandering on a pilgrimage, the yogin Parāśara / came by chance to the charming, auspicious bank of the Yamunā.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣādamāha dharmātmā kurvantaṃ bhojanaṃ tadā |
nayasva yamunāpāraṃ jalayānena māmaram ||
meaning:
निषादमाह धर्मात्मा कुर्वन्तं भोजनं तदा |
नयस्व यमुनापारं जलयानेन मामरम् ||
text_mt: The righteous sage then spoke to a Niṣāda who was taking his meal: / 'Take me across the Yamunā swiftly in a boat.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto muninā tena niṣādaḥ svasutāṃ jagau |
matsyagandhāmamuṃ bāle pāraṃ nāvā naya drutam ||
meaning:
इत्युक्तो मुनिना तेन निषादः स्वसुतां जगौ |
मत्स्यगन्धाममुं बाले पारं नावा नय द्रुतम् ||
text_mt: Spoken to thus by that sage, the Niṣāda said to his daughter, / Matsyagandhā: 'O child, take him quickly across in the boat.

sanskrit_iast:
tāpaso'yaṃ mahābhāge dṛśyantīgarbhasambhavaḥ |
titīrṣurasti dharmābdhiścaturāmnāyapāragaḥ ||
meaning:
तापसोऽयं महाभागे दृश्यन्तीगर्भसम्भवः |
तितीर्षुरस्ति धर्माब्धिश्चतुराम्नायपारगः ||
text_mt: This ascetic, O fortunate girl, born from the womb of Dṛśyantī, / desires to cross over; he is an ocean of righteousness, one who has crossed to the far shore of the four Vedas.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti vijñāpitā pitrā matsyagandhā mahāmunim |
saṃvāhayati naukāyāmāsīnaṃ sūryarociṣam ||
meaning:
इति विज्ञापिता पित्रा मत्स्यगन्धा महामुनिम् |
संवाहयति नौकायामासीनं सूर्यरोचिषम् ||
text_mt: Instructed thus by her father, Matsyagandhā ferried / the great sage, who shone with the brilliance of the sun and sat in the boat.

sanskrit_iast:
kālayogānmahāyogī tasyāṃ kāmāturo'bhavat |
dṛṣṭvā yo'psarasāṃ rūpaṃ na kadāpi vimohitaḥ ||
meaning:
कालयोगान्महायोगी तस्यां कामातुरोऽभवत् |
दृष्ट्वा योऽप्सरसां रूपं न कदापि विमोहितः ||
text_mt: Through the course of time, the great yogin became afflicted with desire for her— / he who, upon seeing the beauty of apsarases, was never bewildered at any time.

sanskrit_iast:
grahītukāmaḥ sa munirdāśakanyāṃ manoharām |
dakṣiṇena kareṇaitāmaspṛśaddakṣiṇe kare ||
meaning:
ग्रहीतुकामः स मुनिर्दाशकन्यां मनोहराम् |
दक्षिणेन करेणैतामस्पृशद्दक्षिणे करे ||
text_mt: Desiring to grasp that lovely fisherman’s daughter, the sage / touched her right hand with his right hand.

sanskrit_iast:
tamuvāca viśālākṣī vacanaṃ smitapūrvakam |
kimidaṃ kriyate karma vācaṃyamavigarhitam ||
meaning:
तमुवाच विशालाक्षी वचनं स्मितपूर्वकम् |
किमिदं क्रियते कर्म वाचंयमविगर्हितम् ||
text_mt: The large-eyed girl said to him with a smile: / “What is this action being done, which is condemned by the restrained of speech?

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭhasya kule ramye tvaṃ jāto'si mahāmate |
niṣādajā tvahaṃ brahman kathaṃ saṅgo ghaṭeta nau ||
meaning:
वसिष्ठस्य कुले रम्ये त्वं जातोऽसि महामते |
निषादजा त्वहं ब्रह्मन् कथं सङ्गो घटेत नौ ||
text_mt: You are born in the delightful lineage of Vasiṣṭha, O wise one; / but I am born of a Niṣāda, O brahmin! How could a union occur between us?

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ janma brāhmaṇatvaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
tatrāpi tāpasatvaṃ ca durlabhaṃ munisattama ||
meaning:
दुर्लभं मानुषं जन्म ब्राह्मणत्वं विशेषतः |
तत्रापि तापसत्वं च दुर्लभं मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: Human birth is hard to attain, especially the status of a brahmin; / and even there, the status of an ascetic is hard to attain, O best of sages!

sanskrit_iast:
vidyayā vapuṣā vācā kulaśīlena cānvitaḥ |
kāmabāṇavaśaṃ yāto mahadāścaryamatra hi ||
meaning:
विद्यया वपुषा वाचा कुलशीलेन चान्वितः |
कामबाणवशं यातो महदाश्चर्यमत्र हि ||
text_mt: Endowed with learning, a fine form, speech, noble birth, and good conduct, / you have fallen under the sway of the arrows of desire! Great indeed is the wonder here.

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttamapyasatkarma kartumenaṃ na ko'pi ha |
bhuvi vārayituṃ śaktaḥ śāpabhītyāsya yoginaḥ ||
meaning:
प्रवृत्तमप्यसत्कर्म कर्तुमेनं न कोऽपि ह |
भुवि वारयितुं शक्तः शापभीत्यास्य योगिनः ||
text_mt: Even when he has set out to perform an unrighteous deed, no one on earth / is able to restrain this yogin out of fear of his curse.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti sañcintya hṛdaye nijagāda mahāmunim |
tāvaddhairyaṃ kuru svāminyāvattvāṃ pārayāmi na ||
meaning:
इति सञ्चिन्त्य हृदये निजगाद महामुनिम् |
तावद्धैर्यं कुरु स्वामिन्यावत्त्वां पारयामि न ||
text_mt: Reflecting thus in her heart, she said to the great sage: / “Master, maintain your composure for so long as I have not ferried you across.”

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
iti śrutvā vacastasyā yogirājaḥ parāśaraḥ |
tatyāja pāṇiṃ tarasā sindhoḥ pāraṃ gataḥ punaḥ ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्या योगिराजः पराशरः |
तत्याज पाणिं तरसा सिन्धोः पारं गतः पुनः ||
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hearing her words, Parāśara, the king of yogins, / quickly released her hand, and then reached the other shore of the river.

sanskrit_iast:
punarjagrāha tāṃ bālāṃ muniṃḥ kāmaprapīḍitaḥ |
kampamānā tu sā bālā tamuvāca dayānidhim ||
meaning:
पुनर्जग्राह तां बालां मुनिंः कामप्रपीडितः |
कम्पमाना तु सा बाला तमुवाच दयानिधिम् ||
text_mt: Afflicted by desire, the sage seized the maiden again. / But trembling, the girl said to that treasury of compassion:

sanskrit_iast:
durgandhāhaṃ muniśreṣṭha kṛṣṇavarṇā niṣādajā |
bhavāṃstu paramodāravicāro yogisattamaḥ ||
meaning:
दुर्गन्धाहं मुनिश्रेष्ठ कृष्णवर्णा निषादजा |
भवांस्तु परमोदारविचारो योगिसत्तमः ||
text_mt: “I am foul-smelling, dark-complexioned, and born of a Niṣāda, O best of sages! / You, however, are the best of yogins, whose thoughts are exceedingly noble.

sanskrit_iast:
nāvayorghaṭate saṅgo kācakāñcanayoriva |
tulyajātyākṛtikayoḥ saṅgaḥ saukhyaprado bhavet ||
meaning:
नावयोर्घटते सङ्गो काचकाञ्चनयोरिव |
तुल्यजात्याकृतिकयोः सङ्गः सौख्यप्रदो भवेत् ||
text_mt: Union between us is not fitting, like that of glass and gold. / A union between two of equal caste and form brings happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktena tayā tena kṣaṇamātreṇa kāminī |
kṛtā yojanagandhā tu ramyarūpā manoramā ||
meaning:
इत्युक्तेन तया तेन क्षणमात्रेण कामिनी |
कृता योजनगन्धा तु रम्यरूपा मनोरमा ||
text_mt: Addressed thus by her, in merely a moment that desirable woman / was made by him into one fragrant for a yojana, charming in form, and delightful.

sanskrit_iast:
punarjagrāha tāṃ bālāṃ sa muniḥ kāmapīḍitaḥ |
grahītukāmaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ provāca vāsavī ||
meaning:
पुनर्जग्राह तां बालां स मुनिः कामपीडितः |
ग्रहीतुकामं तं दृष्ट्वा पुनः प्रोवाच वासवी ||
text_mt: Afflicted by desire, the sage seized the girl again. / Seeing him desiring to take hold of her, Vāsavī spoke again:

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau vyavāyaḥ kartavyo na diveti śrutirjagau |
divāsaṅge mahāndoṣo nindā cāpi durāsadā ||
meaning:
रात्रौ व्यवायः कर्तव्यो न दिवेति श्रुतिर्जगौ |
दिवासङ्गे महान्दोषो निन्दा चापि दुरासदा ||
text_mt: “Sexual union is to be performed at night, not by day—so proclaims the sacred tradition; / there is great fault in union by day, and difficult-to-endure reproach as well.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttāvatpratīkṣasva yāvadbhavati yāminī |
paśyanti mānavāścātra pitā me ca taṭe sthitaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्मात्तावत्प्रतीक्षस्व यावद्भवति यामिनी |
पश्यन्ति मानवाश्चात्र पिता मे च तटे स्थितः ||
text_mt: Therefore, wait until night comes; / people are watching here, and my father stands on the bank.”

sanskrit_iast:
tayoktamidamākarṇya vacanaṃ munipuṅgavaḥ |
nīhāraṃ kalpayāmāsa sadyaḥ puṇyabalena vai ||
meaning:
तयोक्तमिदमाकर्ण्य वचनं मुनिपुङ्गवः |
नीहारं कल्पयामास सद्यः पुण्यबलेन वै ||
text_mt: Hearing these words spoken by her, the bull among sages / immediately created a mist by the power of his merit.

sanskrit_iast:
nīhāre ca samutpanne tamasā rātrisannibhe |
vyavāyacakitā bālā punaḥ provāca taṃ munim ||
meaning:
नीहारे च समुत्पन्ने तमसा रात्रिसन्निभे |
व्यवायचकिता बाला पुनः प्रोवाच तं मुनिम् ||
text_mt: When the mist arose, resembling the night with darkness, / the maiden, startled by sexual union, spoke again to the sage:

sanskrit_iast:
yoginnamoghavīryastvaṃ bhuktvā gantāsi māṃ yadi |
sagarbhā syāṃ tadā svāminkā gatirme bhavediti ||
meaning:
योगिन्नमोघवीर्यस्त्वं भुक्त्वा गन्तासि मां यदि |
सगर्भा स्यां तदा स्वामिन्का गतिर्मे भवेदिति ||
text_mt: “O yogin, your semen is unfailing; if you depart after enjoying me, / I may become pregnant; then, master, what will become of me?

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāvrataṃ mahābuddhe mama naṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati |
hasiṣyanti tadā lokāḥ pitaraṃ kiṃ bravīmyaham ||
meaning:
कन्याव्रतं महाबुद्धे मम नष्टं भविष्यति |
हसिष्यन्ति तदा लोकाः पितरं किं ब्रवीम्यहम् ||
text_mt: My maidenhood will be ruined, O one of great intellect; / then people will laugh, and what shall I say to my father?”

sanskrit_iast:
parāśara uvāca |
rama bāle mayā sārdhaṃ svacchandaṃ kāmajai rasaiḥ |
svīyābhilāṣamākhyāhi pūrayāmyadhunā priye ||
meaning:
पराशर उवाच |
रम बाले मया सार्धं स्वच्छन्दं कामजै रसैः |
स्वीयाभिलाषमाख्याहि पूरयाम्यधुना प्रिये ||
text_mt: Parāśara said: / “Sport with me freely, O girl, with the delights born of love! / Tell me your desire; I shall fulfill it now, my dear.

sanskrit_iast:
madājñāsatyakaraṇānnāmnā satyavatī bhava |
vandanīyā tathāśeṣairyogibhistridaśairapi ||
meaning:
मदाज्ञासत्यकरणान्नाम्ना सत्यवती भव |
वन्दनीया तथाशेषैर्योगिभिस्त्रिदशैरपि ||
text_mt: Because you have made my command come true, be named Satyavatī; / and you shall be revered by all yogins and even the gods.”

sanskrit_iast:
satyavatyuvāca |
jānate na pitā mātā na vānye bhuvi mānavāḥ |
kanyādharmo na me hanyādyadi svīkuru māṃ tadā ||
meaning:
सत्यवत्युवाच |
जानते न पिता माता न वान्ये भुवि मानवाः |
कन्याधर्मो न मे हन्याद्यदि स्वीकुरु मां तदा ||
text_mt: Satyavatī said: / “Neither father, mother, nor other mortals on earth must know of it, / nor should my status as a maiden be destroyed; if so, accept me then.

sanskrit_iast:
putraśca tvatsamo nātha bhavedadbhutaśaktimān |
saugandhyaṃ sarvadāṅge me tāruṇyaṃ ca navaṃ navam ||
meaning:
पुत्रश्च त्वत्समो नाथ भवेदद्भुतशक्तिमान् |
सौगन्ध्यं सर्वदाङ्गे मे तारुण्यं च नवं नवम् ||
text_mt: And may a son be born equal to you, O lord, possessing wondrous power; / may fragrance forever be on my body, and my youth ever fresh.”

sanskrit_iast:
parāśara uvāca |
śṛṇu priye tavābhīṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati |
viṣṇvaṃśasambhavaḥ putro bhavitā te mahāyaśāḥ ||
meaning:
पराशर उवाच |
शृणु प्रिये तवाभीष्टं सर्वं पूर्णं भविष्यति |
विष्ण्वंशसम्भवः पुत्रो भविता ते महायशाः ||
text_mt: Parāśara said: / “Listen, my dear: all that you desire shall be fulfilled; / your son, born of a portion of Viṣṇu, will possess great renown.

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcidvai kāraṇaṃ viddhi yato'haṃ kāmapīḍitaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā cāpsarasāṃ rūpaṃ nāmuhyanme manaḥ kvacit ||
meaning:
किञ्चिद्वै कारणं विद्धि यतोऽहं कामपीडितः |
दृष्ट्वा चाप्सरसां रूपं नामुह्यन्मे मनः क्वचित् ||
text_mt: Know that there is some cause whereby I am afflicted with desire; / even upon seeing the beauty of apsarases, my mind was never bewildered anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
mīnagandhāṃ samālakṣya tvāṃ mohavaśago'bhavam |
na bāle bhālapaṭṭastho brahmalekho'nyathā bhavet ||
meaning:
मीनगन्धां समालक्ष्य त्वां मोहवशगोऽभवम् |
न बाले भालपट्टस्थो ब्रह्मलेखोऽन्यथा भवेत् ||
text_mt: Perceiving you, smelling of fish, I fell under the sway of delusion; / O girl, the writing of Brahmā inscribed on the forehead cannot be otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇakartā putraste vedaśākhāvibhāgakṛt |
bhaviṣyati varārohe khyātakīrtirjagattraye ||
meaning:
पुराणकर्ता पुत्रस्ते वेदशाखाविभागकृत् |
भविष्यति वरारोहे ख्यातकीर्तिर्जगत्त्रये ||
text_mt: Your son will be the author of the Purāṇas and the divider of the branches of the Veda, / and he will be of renowned fame in the three worlds, O woman of lovely limbs!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā tāṃ suramyāṅgīṃ bhuktvā yogaviśāradaḥ |
vavrāja śīghraṃ yamunājale snātvā mahāmune ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तां सुरम्याङ्गीं भुक्त्वा योगविशारदः |
वव्राज शीघ्रं यमुनाजले स्नात्वा महामुने ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus and enjoyed that woman of lovely limbs, the expert in yoga / quickly departed after bathing in the waters of the Yamunā, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
sāpi garbhaṃ dadhārāśu dvādaśātmasamaprabham |
asūta sūryajādvīpe kāmadevamivātmajam ||
meaning:
सापि गर्भं दधाराशु द्वादशात्मसमप्रभम् |
असूत सूर्यजाद्वीपे कामदेवमिवात्मजम् ||
text_mt: She too quickly conceived an embryo with a splendor equal to the sun; / on the island in the Yamunā, she gave birth to a son who was like Kāmadeva,

sanskrit_iast:
vāme kamaṇḍaluṃ bibhraddakṣiṇe daṇḍamuttamam |
piśaṅgībhirjaṭābhiśca rājito mahasāṃ cayaḥ ||
meaning:
वामे कमण्डलुं बिभ्रद्दक्षिणे दण्डमुत्तमम् |
पिशङ्गीभिर्जटाभिश्च राजितो महसां चयः ||
text_mt: holding a water pot in his left hand and an excellent staff in his right, / resplendent with reddish-brown matted locks, a mass of splendors.

sanskrit_iast:
jātamātrastu tejasvī mātaraṃ pratyabhāṣata |
gaccha mātaryathākāmaṃ gacchāmyahamataḥ param ||
meaning:
जातमात्रस्तु तेजस्वी मातरं प्रत्यभाषत |
गच्छ मातर्यथाकामं गच्छाम्यहमतः परम् ||
text_mt: As soon as he was born, the radiant one addressed his mother: / “Go, mother, according to your pleasure; henceforth I shall go.

sanskrit_iast:
mātaryadā bhavetkāryaṃ tava kiñcid hṛdīpsitam |
saṃsmṛtaścāgamiṣyāmi tvadicchāpūrtihetave ||
meaning:
मातर्यदा भवेत्कार्यं तव किञ्चिद् हृदीप्सितम् |
संस्मृतश्चागमिष्यामि त्वदिच्छापूर्तिहेतवे ||
text_mt: O mother, whenever any purpose desired in your heart should arise, / I will come when remembered, in order to fulfill your wish.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā mātṛcaraṇāvabhivādya taponidhiḥ |
jagāma ca tapaḥ kartuṃ tīrthaṃ pāpaviśodhanam ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा मातृचरणावभिवाद्य तपोनिधिः |
जगाम च तपः कर्तुं तीर्थं पापविशोधनम् ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus and bowed to his mother’s feet, that treasure of austerity / went to a holy site that purifies sins, in order to perform austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
sāpi pitrantikaṃ yātā putrasnehākulā satī |
smarantī caritaṃ sūnorvarṇayantī svabhāgyakam ||
meaning:
सापि पित्रन्तिकं याता पुत्रस्नेहाकुला सती |
स्मरन्ती चरितं सूनोर्वर्णयन्ती स्वभाग्यकम् ||
text_mt: She too went to her father’s presence, the virtuous woman agitated with affection for her son, / remembering the conduct of her son and extolling her good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
dvīpe jāto yato bālastena dvaipāyano'bhavat |
vedaśākhāvibhajanādvedavyāsaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
meaning:
द्वीपे जातो यतो बालस्तेन द्वैपायनोऽभवत् |
वेदशाखाविभजनाद्वेदव्यासः प्रकीर्तितः ||
text_mt: Because the boy was born on an island, he became Dvaipāyana; / because he divided the branches of the Veda, he was celebrated as Vedavyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrtharājaṃ prathamato dharmakāmārthamokṣadam |
naimiṣaṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ gaṅgādvāramavantikām ||
meaning:
तीर्थराजं प्रथमतो धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदम् |
नैमिषं च कुरुक्षेत्रं गङ्गाद्वारमवन्तिकाम् ||
text_mt: First to Prayāga, which grants virtue, pleasure, wealth, and liberation; / to Naimiṣa, Kurukṣetra, Gaṅgādvāra, and Avantikā;

sanskrit_iast:
ayodhyāṃ mathurāṃ caiva dvārakāmamarāvatīm |
sarasvatīṃ sindhusaṅgaṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgamam ||
meaning:
अयोध्यां मथुरां चैव द्वारकाममरावतीम् |
सरस्वतीं सिन्धुसङ्गं गङ्गासागरसङ्गमम् ||
text_mt: to Ayodhyā, Mathurā, Dvārakā, and Amarāvatī; / to the Sarasvatī, the confluence of the Indus, and the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the ocean;

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcīṃ ca tryambakaṃ cāpi saptagodāvarītaṭam |
kālañjaraṃ prabhāsaṃ ca tathā badarikāśramam ||
meaning:
काञ्चीं च त्र्यम्बकं चापि सप्तगोदावरीतटम् |
कालञ्जरं प्रभासं च तथा बदरिकाश्रमम् ||
text_mt: to Kāñcī, Tryambaka, and the bank of the Saptagodāvarī; / to Kālañjara, Prabhāsa, and likewise Badarikāśrama;

sanskrit_iast:
mahālayaṃ tathoṅkārakṣetraṃ vai puruṣottamam |
gokarṇaṃ bhṛgukacchaṃ ca bhṛgutuṅgaṃ ca puṣkaram ||
meaning:
महालयं तथोङ्कारक्षेत्रं वै पुरुषोत्तमम् |
गोकर्णं भृगुकच्छं च भृगुतुङ्गं च पुष्करम् ||
text_mt: to Mahālaya, the field of Oṅkāra, Puruṣottama, / Gokarṇa, Bhṛgukaccha, Bhṛgutuṅga, and Puṣkara;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīparvatāditīrthāni dhārātīrthaṃ tathaiva ca |
gatvāvagāhya vidhinā cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ ||
meaning:
श्रीपर्वतादितीर्थानि धारातीर्थं तथैव च |
गत्वावगाह्य विधिना चचार परमं तपः ||
text_mt: having gone to holy places such as Śrīparvata and likewise Dhārātīrtha / and having bathed according to rule, he performed supreme austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tīrthānyanekāni nānādeśasthitāni ha |
paryaṭankālikāsūnuḥ prāpadvārāṇasīṃ purīm ||
meaning:
एवं तीर्थान्यनेकानि नानादेशस्थितानि ह |
पर्यटन्कालिकासूनुः प्रापद्वाराणसीं पुरीम् ||
text_mt: Thus, wandering through many holy places situated in various regions, / the son of Kālikā reached the city of Vārāṇasī,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra viśveśvaraḥ sākṣādannapūrṇā maheśvarī |
bhaktānāmamṛtaṃ dātuṃ virājete kṛpānidhī ||
meaning:
यत्र विश्वेश्वरः साक्षादन्नपूर्णा महेश्वरी |
भक्तानाममृतं दातुं विराजेते कृपानिधी ||
text_mt: where Viśveśvara in person and Maheśvarī Annapūrṇā, / those two treasuries of mercy, shine resplendent to grant nectar to devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpya vārāṇasītīrthaṃ dṛṣṭvātha maṇikarṇikām |
koṭijanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ tatyāja sa munīśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
प्राप्य वाराणसीतीर्थं दृष्ट्वाथ मणिकर्णिकाम् |
कोटिजन्मार्जितं पापं तत्याज स मुनीश्वरः ||
text_mt: Reaching the holy site of Vārāṇasī and then beholding Maṇikarṇikā, / that lord of sages abandoned the sins accumulated through ten million births.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā liṅgāni sarvāṇi viśveśapramukhāni ca |
snātvā sarveṣu kuṇḍeṣu vāpīkūpasaraḥsu ca ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा लिङ्गानि सर्वाणि विश्वेशप्रमुखानि च |
स्नात्वा सर्वेषु कुण्डेषु वापीकूपसरःसु च ||
text_mt: Having beheld all the liṅgas, headed by Viśveśa, / and having bathed in all the sacred pools, step-wells, wells, and lakes,

sanskrit_iast:
natvā vināyakānsarvāngaurīḥ sarvāḥ praṇamya ca |
sampūjya kālarājaṃ ca bhairavaṃ pāpabhakṣaṇam ||
meaning:
नत्वा विनायकान्सर्वान्गौरीः सर्वाः प्रणम्य च |
सम्पूज्य कालराजं च भैरवं पापभक्षणम् ||
text_mt: Having bowed to all the Vināyakas and having paid homage to all the Gaurīs, / and having fully worshipped Kālarāja, the Bhairava who devours sin,

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍanāyakamukhyāṃśca gaṇānstutvā prayatnataḥ |
ādikeśavamukhyāṃśca keśavānparitoṣya ca ||
meaning:
दण्डनायकमुख्यांश्च गणान्स्तुत्वा प्रयत्नतः |
आदिकेशवमुख्यांश्च केशवान्परितोष्य च ||
text_mt: and having diligently praised the attendants headed by Daṇḍanāyaka, / and having pleased the Keśavas headed by Ādikeśava,

sanskrit_iast:
lolārkamukhyasūryāṃśca praṇamya ca punaḥpunaḥ |
kṛtvā piṇḍapradānāni sarvatīrtheṣvatandritaḥ ||
meaning:
लोलार्कमुख्यसूर्यांश्च प्रणम्य च पुनःपुनः |
कृत्वा पिण्डप्रदानानि सर्वतीर्थेष्वतन्द्रितः ||
text_mt: and having repeatedly bowed to the suns headed by Lolārka, / and unweariedly offering ancestral balls of rice at all the holy sites,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayāmāsa puṇyātmā liṅgaṃ vyāseśvarābhidham |
yaddarśanādbhavedviprā naro vidyāsu vākpatiḥ ||
meaning:
स्थापयामास पुण्यात्मा लिङ्गं व्यासेश्वराभिधम् |
यद्दर्शनाद्भवेद्विप्रा नरो विद्यासु वाक्पतिः ||
text_mt: that holy-souled one established a liṅga named Vyāseśvara, / by seeing which, O Brahmins, a man becomes a master of speech in the sciences.

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgānyabhyarcya viśveśapramukhāni subhaktitaḥ |
asakṛccintayāmāsa kiṃ liṅgaṃ kṣiprasiddhidam ||
meaning:
लिङ्गान्यभ्यर्च्य विश्वेशप्रमुखानि सुभक्तितः |
असकृच्चिन्तयामास किं लिङ्गं क्षिप्रसिद्धिदम् ||
text_mt: Having worshipped the liṅgas headed by Viśveśa with great devotion, / he repeatedly reflected: 'Which liṅga is it that bestows quick success?

sanskrit_iast:
yamārādhya mahādevaṃ vidyāḥ sarvā labhemahi |
purāṇakartṛtāśaktirmamāstu yadanugrahāt ||
meaning:
यमाराध्य महादेवं विद्याः सर्वा लभेमहि |
पुराणकर्तृताशक्तिर्ममास्तु यदनुग्रहात् ||
text_mt: By worshipping which Mahādeva may we attain all the sciences? / By whose favor may the power of authorship of the Purāṇas be mine?

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmadoṅkāranāthaṃ vā kṛttivāseśvaraṃ kimu |
kedāreśaṃ tu kāmeśaṃ candreśaṃ vā trilocanam ||
meaning:
श्रीमदोङ्कारनाथं वा कृत्तिवासेश्वरं किमु |
केदारेशं तु कामेशं चन्द्रेशं वा त्रिलोचनम् ||
text_mt: Is it glorious Oṅkāranātha, or perhaps Kṛttivāseśvara, / Kedāreśa, or Kāmeśa, Candreśa, or Trilocana?

sanskrit_iast:
kāleśaṃ vṛddhakāleśaṃ kalaśeśvarameva vā |
jyeṣṭheśaṃ jambukeśaṃ vā jaigīṣavyeśvaraṃ tu vā ||
meaning:
कालेशं वृद्धकालेशं कलशेश्वरमेव वा |
ज्येष्ठेशं जम्बुकेशं वा जैगीषव्येश्वरं तु वा ||
text_mt: Kāleśa, Vṛddhakāleśa, or indeed Kalaśeśvara? / Jyeṣṭheśa, or Jambukeśa, or Jaigīṣavyeśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
daśāśvamedhamīśānaṃ drumacaṇḍeśameva vā |
dṛkkeśaṃ garuḍeśaṃ vā gokarṇeśaṃ gaṇeśvaram ||
meaning:
दशाश्वमेधमीशानं द्रुमचण्डेशमेव वा |
दृक्केशं गरुडेशं वा गोकर्णेशं गणेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Daśāśvamedha-Īśāna, or Drumacaṇḍeśa? / Dṛkkeśa, or Garuḍeśa, Gokarṇeśa, or Gaṇeśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
prasannavadaneśaṃ vā dharmeśaṃ tārakeśvaram |
nandikeśaṃ nivāseśaṃ patrīśaṃ prītikeśvaram ||
meaning:
प्रसन्नवदनेशं वा धर्मेशं तारकेश्वरम् |
नन्दिकेशं निवासेशं पत्रीशं प्रीतिकेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Prasannavadaneśa, Dharmeśa, or Tārakeśvara? / Nandikeśa, Nivāseśa, Patrīśa, or Prītikeśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
parvateśaṃ paśupatiṃ hāṭakeśvarameva vā |
bṛhaspatīśvaraṃ vātha tilabhāṇḍeśameva vā ||
meaning:
पर्वतेशं पशुपतिं हाटकेश्वरमेव वा |
बृहस्पतीश्वरं वाथ तिलभाण्डेशमेव वा ||
text_mt: Parvateśa, Paśupati, or Hāṭakeśvara? / Bṛhaspatīśvara, or indeed Tilabhāṇḍeśa?

sanskrit_iast:
bhārabhūteśvaraṃ kiṃ vā mahālakṣmīśvaraṃ tu vā |
maruteśaṃ tu mokṣeśaṃ gaṅgeśaṃ narmadeśvaram ||
meaning:
भारभूतेश्वरं किं वा महालक्ष्मीश्वरं तु वा |
मरुतेशं तु मोक्षेशं गङ्गेशं नर्मदेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Is it Bhārabhūteśvara, or Mahālakṣmīśvara? / Maruteśa, Mokṣeśa, Gaṅgeśa, or Narmadeśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇeśaṃ parameśānaṃ ratneśvaramathāpi vā |
yāmuneśaṃ lāṅgalīśaṃ śrīmadviśveśvaraṃ vibhum ||
meaning:
कृष्णेशं परमेशानं रत्नेश्वरमथापि वा |
यामुनेशं लाङ्गलीशं श्रीमद्विश्वेश्वरं विभुम् ||
text_mt: Kṛṣṇeśa, Parameśāna, or Ratneśvara? / Yāmuneśa, Lāṅgalīśa, or the all-pervading, glorious Viśveśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
avimukteśvaraṃ vātha viśālākṣīśameva vā |
vyāghreśvaraṃ varāheśaṃ vidyeśvaramathāpi vā ||
meaning:
अविमुक्तेश्वरं वाथ विशालाक्षीशमेव वा |
व्याघ्रेश्वरं वराहेशं विद्येश्वरमथापि वा ||
text_mt: Avimukteśvara, or Viśālākṣīśa? / Vyāghreśvara, Varāheśa, or Vidyeśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇeśaṃ vidhīśaṃ vā harikeśeśvaraṃ tu vā |
bhavānīśaṃ kapardīśaṃ kandukeśamajeśvaram ||
meaning:
वरुणेशं विधीशं वा हरिकेशेश्वरं तु वा |
भवानीशं कपर्दीशं कन्दुकेशमजेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Varuṇeśa, Vidhīśa, or Harikeśeśvara? / Bhavānīśa, Kapardīśa, Kandukeśa, or Ajeśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
viśvakarmeśvaraṃ vātha vīreśvaramathāpi vā |
nādeśaṃ kapileśaṃ ca bhuvaneśvarameva vā ||
meaning:
विश्वकर्मेश्वरं वाथ वीरेश्वरमथापि वा |
नादेशं कपिलेशं च भुवनेश्वरमेव वा ||
text_mt: Viśvakarmeśvara, or Vīreśvara? / Nādeśa, Kapileśa, or Bhuvaneśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
vāṣkulīśaṃ mahādevaṃ siddhīśvaramathāpi vā |
viśvedeveśvaraṃ vīrabhadreśaṃ bhairaveśvaram ||
meaning:
वाष्कुलीशं महादेवं सिद्धीश्वरमथापि वा |
विश्वेदेवेश्वरं वीरभद्रेशं भैरवेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Vāṣkulīśa, Mahādeva, or Siddhīśvara? / Viśvedeveśvara, Vīrabhadreśa, or Bhairaveśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
amṛteśaṃ satīśaṃ vā pārvatīśvarameva vā |
siddheśvaraṃ mataṅgeśaṃ bhūtīśvaramathāpi vā ||
meaning:
अमृतेशं सतीशं वा पार्वतीश्वरमेव वा |
सिद्धेश्वरं मतङ्गेशं भूतीश्वरमथापि वा ||
text_mt: Amṛteśa, Satīśa, or Pārvatīśvara? / Siddheśvara, Mataṅgeśa, or Bhūtīśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhīśaṃ prakāśeśaṃ koṭirudreśvaraṃ tathā |
madālaseśvaraṃ caiva tilaparṇeśvaraṃ kimu ||
meaning:
आषाढीशं प्रकाशेशं कोटिरुद्रेश्वरं तथा |
मदालसेश्वरं चैव तिलपर्णेश्वरं किमु ||
text_mt: Āṣāḍhīśa, Prakāśeśa, and Koṭirudreśvara? / Madālaseśvara, or Tilaparṇeśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ vā hiraṇyagarbheśaṃ kiṃ vā śrīmadhyameśvaram |
ityādi koṭiliṅgānāṃ madhye'haṃ kimupāśraye ||
meaning:
किं वा हिरण्यगर्भेशं किं वा श्रीमध्यमेश्वरम् |
इत्यादि कोटिलिङ्गानां मध्येऽहं किमुपाश्रये ||
text_mt: Is it Hiraṇyagarbheśa, or glorious Madhyameśvara? / Among these and other tens of millions of liṅgas, which one should I resort to?'

sanskrit_iast:
iti cintāturo vyāsaḥ śivabhaktiratātmavān |
kṣaṇaṃ vicārayāmāsa dhyānasusthiracetasā ||
meaning:
इति चिन्तातुरो व्यासः शिवभक्तिरतात्मवान् |
क्षणं विचारयामास ध्यानसुस्थिरचेतसा ||
text_mt: Anxious with this thought, Vyāsa, self-controlled and devoted to Śiva, / considered for a moment with a mind made steady in meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
āṃ jñātaṃ vismṛtaṃ tāvanniṣpanno me manorathaḥ |
siddhaiḥ sampūjitaṃ liṅgaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam ||
meaning:
आं ज्ञातं विस्मृतं तावन्निष्पन्नो मे मनोरथः |
सिद्धैः सम्पूजितं लिङ्गं धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदम् ||
text_mt: 'Ah, I know! It was forgotten till now, but my wish is fulfilled! / The liṅga worshipped by the Siddhas, which bestows duty, desire, wealth, and liberation;

sanskrit_iast:
darśanātsparśanādyasya ceto nirmalatāmiyāt |
udghāṭitaṃ sadaivāsti dvāraṃ svargasya yatra hi ||
meaning:
दर्शनात्स्पर्शनाद्यस्य चेतो निर्मलतामियात् |
उद्घाटितं सदैवास्ति द्वारं स्वर्गस्य यत्र हि ||
text_mt: by seeing and touching which the mind reaches purity; / where the door to heaven is truly open at all times;

sanskrit_iast:
avimukte mahākṣetre siddhakṣetre hi tatparam |
yatrāste paramaṃ liṅgaṃ madhyameśvarasaṃjñakam ||
meaning:
अविमुक्ते महाक्षेत्रे सिद्धक्षेत्रे हि तत्परम् |
यत्रास्ते परमं लिङ्गं मध्यमेश्वरसंज्ञकम् ||
text_mt: in the great field of Avimukta, the field of the accomplished, there is that supreme [site], / where the supreme liṅga named Madhyameśvara abides.

sanskrit_iast:
na madhyameśvarādanyālliṅgaṃ kāśyāṃ hi vidyate |
yaddarśanārthamāyānti devāḥ parvaṇi parvaṇi ||
meaning:
न मध्यमेश्वरादन्याल्लिङ्गं काश्यां हि विद्यते |
यद्दर्शनार्थमायान्ति देवाः पर्वणि पर्वणि ||
text_mt: Indeed, there is no liṅga in Kāśī other than Madhyameśvara / to see which the gods arrive at every festive occasion.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ sevyo mahādevo madhyameśvarasaṃjñakaḥ |
asyārādhanato viprā bahavaḥ siddhimāgatāḥ ||
meaning:
अतः सेव्यो महादेवो मध्यमेश्वरसंज्ञकः |
अस्याराधनतो विप्रा बहवः सिद्धिमागताः ||
text_mt: Therefore, Mahādeva named Madhyameśvara is to be served; / from worshipping him, O Brahmins, many have attained perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ pradhānatayā kāśyāṃ madhye tiṣṭhati śaṅkaraḥ |
svapurījana saukhyārthamato'sau madhyameśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
यः प्रधानतया काश्यां मध्ये तिष्ठति शङ्करः |
स्वपुरीजन सौख्यार्थमतोऽसौ मध्यमेश्वरः ||
text_mt: Because Śaṅkara stands prominently in the center of Kāśī / for the happiness of the people of his city, he is called Madhyameśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
tumbururnāma gandharvo devarṣirnāradastathā |
amumārādhya sampanno gānavidyāviśāradau ||
meaning:
तुम्बुरुर्नाम गन्धर्वो देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा |
अमुमाराध्य सम्पन्नो गानविद्याविशारदौ ||
text_mt: The Gandharva named Tumburu and the divine sage Nārada / became skilled in the art of music having worshipped this one.

sanskrit_iast:
amumeva samārādhya viṣṇurmokṣaprado'bhavat |
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca sṛṣṭipālakahārakāḥ ||
meaning:
अमुमेव समाराध्य विष्णुर्मोक्षप्रदोऽभवत् |
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च सृष्टिपालकहारकाः ||
text_mt: Having worshipped this very one, Viṣṇu became the bestower of liberation, / and Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra became the creator, preserver, and destroyer.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanādhīśaḥ kubero'pi vāmadevo hi śaivarāṭ |
khaṭvāṅgo nāma bhūpālo'napatyo'patyavānabhūt ||
meaning:
धनाधीशः कुबेरोऽपि वामदेवो हि शैवराट् |
खट्वाङ्गो नाम भूपालोऽनपत्योऽपत्यवानभूत् ||
text_mt: Kubera, the lord of wealth, and Vāmadeva, the king of Śaivas, [achieved their ends], / and the childless king named Khaṭvāṅga obtained offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
apsarāścandrabhāmākhyā nṛtyantī nijabhāvataḥ |
sadehā kokilālāpā liṅgamadhye layaṃ gatā ||
meaning:
अप्सराश्चन्द्रभामाख्या नृत्यन्ती निजभावतः |
सदेहा कोकिलालापा लिङ्गमध्ये लयं गता ||
text_mt: The celestial nymph named Candrabhāmā, dancing with innate emotion, / cuckoo-voiced, dissolved bodily into the center of the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkaro gopikāsūnuḥ sevitvā madhyameśvaram |
gāṇapatyaṃ samālebhe śivasya karuṇātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
श्रीकरो गोपिकासूनुः सेवित्वा मध्यमेश्वरम् |
गाणपत्यं समालेभे शिवस्य करुणात्मनः ||
text_mt: Śrīkara, the son of a cowherdess, having served Madhyameśvara, / obtained lordship of the attendants from compassionate Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
bhārgavo gīṣpatiścobhau devau daityasurārcitau |
vidyāpāraṅgatau jātau prasādānmadhyameśituḥ ||
meaning:
भार्गवो गीष्पतिश्चोभौ देवौ दैत्यसुरार्चितौ |
विद्यापारङ्गतौ जातौ प्रसादान्मध्यमेशितुः ||
text_mt: Bhārgava and Gīṣpati, the two gods worshipped by Daityas and deities, / became masters of the sciences by the grace of Madhyameśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
ahamapyatra sampūjya madhyameśvaramīśvaram |
purāṇakartṛtāśaktiṃ prāpsyāmi tarasā dhruvam ||
meaning:
अहमप्यत्र सम्पूज्य मध्यमेश्वरमीश्वरम् |
पुराणकर्तृताशक्तिं प्राप्स्यामि तरसा ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: I too, having worshipped Lord Madhyameśvara here, / shall surely and swiftly attain the power of Purāṇa authorship.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti kṛtvā matiṃ dhīro vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ |
bhāgīrathyambhasi snātvā jagrāha niyamaṃ vratī ||
meaning:
इति कृत्वा मतिं धीरो व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः |
भागीरथ्यम्भसि स्नात्वा जग्राह नियमं व्रती ||
text_mt: Having resolved thus, the steadfast Vyāsa, the son of Satyavatī, / bathed in the waters of the Bhāgīrathī and took up his vows as an ascetic.

sanskrit_iast:
kvacitparṇāśano bhūttvā phalaśākāśanaḥ kvacit |
vātabhugjalabhuk kvāpi kvacinniraśanavratī ||
meaning:
क्वचित्पर्णाशनो भूत्त्वा फलशाकाशनः क्वचित् |
वातभुग्जलभुक् क्वापि क्वचिन्निरशनव्रती ||
text_mt: Sometimes eating leaves, sometimes eating fruits and vegetables, / somewhere feeding on wind, drinking water somewhere, and at times fasting,

sanskrit_iast:
ityādiniyamairyogī trikālaṃ madhyameśvaram |
pūjayāmāsa dharmātmā nānāvṛkṣodbhavaiḥ phalaiḥ ||
meaning:
इत्यादिनियमैर्योगी त्रिकालं मध्यमेश्वरम् |
पूजयामास धर्मात्मा नानावृक्षोद्भवैः फलैः ||
text_mt: the righteous yogi worshipped Madhyameśvara at the three twilights / through such observances with fruits born of various trees.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ bahutithe kāle vyatīte kālikāsutaḥ |
snātvā tripathagātoye yāvadāyāti sa prage ||
meaning:
इत्थं बहुतिथे काले व्यतीते कालिकासुतः |
स्नात्वा त्रिपथगातोये यावदायाति स प्रगे ||
text_mt: When a long time had thus passed, the son of Kālikā, / having bathed in the water of the three-streamed river, as he arrived in the morning

sanskrit_iast:
madhyameśvaramīśānaṃ bhaktābhīṣṭavarapradam |
tāvaddadarśa puṇyātmā madhye liṅgaṃ maheśvaram ||
meaning:
मध्यमेश्वरमीशानं भक्ताभीष्टवरप्रदम् |
तावद्ददर्श पुण्यात्मा मध्ये लिङ्गं महेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: to Madhyameśvara, the Lord who grants the desired boons of his devotees, / the virtuous one saw Maheśvara within the liṅga:

sanskrit_iast:
umābhūṣitavāmāṅgaṃ vyāghracarmottarīyakam |
jaṭājūṭacaladgaṅgātaraṅgaiścāruvigraham ||
lasacchāradabālenducandrikācandritālakam |
bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅgaṃ karpūrārjunavigraham ||
meaning:
उमाभूषितवामाङ्गं व्याघ्रचर्मोत्तरीयकम् |
जटाजूटचलद्गङ्गातरङ्गैश्चारुविग्रहम् ||
लसच्छारदबालेन्दुचन्द्रिकाचन्द्रितालकम् |
भस्मोद्धूलितसर्वाङ्गं कर्पूरार्जुनविग्रहम् ||
text_mt:
his left side adorned by Umā, his upper garment a tiger skin, / his form lovely with the waves of the Gaṅgā rippling in his matted hair;

his locks brightened by the moonlight of the shining autumn crescent moon, / his entire body smeared with ashes, his form white as camphor;

sanskrit_iast:
karṇāntāyatanetraṃ ca vidrumāruṇadacchadam |
pañcavarṣākṛtiṃ bālaṃ bālakocitabhūṣaṇam ||
meaning:
कर्णान्तायतनेत्रं च विद्रुमारुणदच्छदम् |
पञ्चवर्षाकृतिं बालं बालकोचितभूषणम् ||
text_mt: his eyes elongated to the ends of his ears, his lips red like coral, / having the form of a five-year-old child, wearing ornaments fitting a boy;

sanskrit_iast:
dadhānaṃ koṭikandarpadarpahāniṃ tanudyutim |
nagraṃ prahasitāsyābjaṃ gāyantaṃ sāma līlayā ||
meaning:
दधानं कोटिकन्दर्पदर्पहानिं तनुद्युतिम् |
नग्रं प्रहसितास्याब्जं गायन्तं साम लीलया ||
text_mt: bearing bodily radiance that destroys the pride of ten million love-gods, / naked, his lotus face laughing gently, playfully singing the Sāma;

sanskrit_iast:
karuṇāpārapāthodhiṃ bhaktavatsalanāmakam |
āśutoṣamumākāntaṃ prasādasumukhaṃ haram ||
meaning:
करुणापारपाथोधिं भक्तवत्सलनामकम् |
आशुतोषमुमाकान्तं प्रसादसुमुखं हरम् ||
text_mt: a shoreless ocean of compassion, named Affectionate toward Devotees, / easily pleased, Umā's beloved, Hara with a gracious countenance.

sanskrit_iast:
samālokya stutiṃ cakre premagadgadayā girā |
yogināmapyagamyaṃ taṃ dīnabandhuṃ cidātmakam ||
meaning:
समालोक्य स्तुतिं चक्रे प्रेमगद्गदया गिरा |
योगिनामप्यगम्यं तं दीनबन्धुं चिदात्मकम् ||
text_mt: Having beheld him, who is inaccessible even to yogis, the friend of the humble, whose essence is consciousness, / he uttered praise with a voice faltering with love.

sanskrit_iast:
vedavyāsa uvāca |
devadeva mahābhāga śaraṇāgatavatsala |
vāṅmanaḥkarmaduṣprāpa yogināmapyagocara ||
meaning:
वेदव्यास उवाच |
देवदेव महाभाग शरणागतवत्सल |
वाङ्मनःकर्मदुष्प्राप योगिनामप्यगोचर ||
text_mt: Vedavyāsa said: / 'O God of gods, O exalted one, O affectionate to those who seek refuge, / hard to reach through speech, mind, and action, beyond the range even of yogis!

sanskrit_iast:
mahimānaṃ na te vedā vidāmāsurumāpate |
tvameva jagataḥ kartā dhartā hartā tathaiva ca ||
meaning:
महिमानं न ते वेदा विदामासुरुमापते |
त्वमेव जगतः कर्ता धर्ता हर्ता तथैव च ||
text_mt: The Vedas did not know your greatness, O Lord of Umā! / You alone are the creator, the sustainer, and likewise the destroyer of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tvamādyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ saccidānanda īśvaraḥ |
nāmagotre na vā te staḥ sarvajño'si sadāśiva ||
meaning:
त्वमाद्यः सर्वदेवानां सच्चिदानन्द ईश्वरः |
नामगोत्रे न वा ते स्तः सर्वज्ञोऽसि सदाशिव ||
text_mt: You are the primal God of all deities, existence-consciousness-bliss, the Lord; / you have neither name nor lineage; you are omniscient, O Sadāśiva!'

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva paramaṃ brahma māyāpāśanivartakaḥ |
guṇatrayairna liptastvaṃ padmapatramivāmbhasā ||
meaning:
त्वमेव परमं ब्रह्म मायापाशनिवर्तकः |
गुणत्रयैर्न लिप्तस्त्वं पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ||
text_mt: You alone are the supreme Brahman, the remover of the fetters of illusion. / You are untouched by the three qualities, as a lotus leaf by water.

sanskrit_iast:
na te janma na vā śīlaṃ na deśo na kulaṃ ca te |
itthambhūto'pīśvarastvaṃ trilokyāḥ kāmamāvaheḥ ||
meaning:
न ते जन्म न वा शीलं न देशो न कुलं च ते |
इत्थम्भूतोऽपीश्वरस्त्वं त्रिलोक्याः काममावहेः ||
text_mt: You have neither birth nor fixed conduct, neither native country nor family. / Even being such, you, the Lord, fulfill the desires of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
na brahmā na ca lakṣmīśo na ca sendrā divaukasaḥ |
na yogīndrā vidustattvaṃ yasya taṃ tvāmupāsmahe ||
meaning:
न ब्रह्मा न च लक्ष्मीशो न च सेन्द्रा दिवौकसः |
न योगीन्द्रा विदुस्तत्त्वं यस्य तं त्वामुपास्महे ||
text_mt: Neither Brahmā, nor the lord of Lakṣmī, nor the gods led by Indra, / nor the lords of yoga know your true nature; we worship you, who are that very one.

sanskrit_iast:
tvattaḥ sarvaṃ tvaṃ hi sarvaṃ gaurīśastvaṃ purāntakaḥ |
tvaṃ bālastvaṃ yuvā vṛddhastaṃ tvāṃ hṛdi yunajmyaham ||
meaning:
त्वत्तः सर्वं त्वं हि सर्वं गौरीशस्त्वं पुरान्तकः |
त्वं बालस्त्वं युवा वृद्धस्तं त्वां हृदि युनज्म्यहम् ||
text_mt: Everything comes from you; you indeed are everything, the lord of Gaurī, the destroyer of the [demon] cities. / You are the child, you are the youth, you are the old man; you I bind within my heart.

sanskrit_iast:
namastasmai maheśāya bhaktadhyeyāya śambhave |
purāṇapuruṣāyāddhā śaṅkarāya parātmane ||
meaning:
नमस्तस्मै महेशाय भक्तध्येयाय शम्भवे |
पुराणपुरुषायाद्धा शङ्कराय परात्मने ||
text_mt: Salutations to that Maheśa, Śambhu, who is to be meditated upon by devotees, / to the ancient Person indeed, Śaṅkara, the supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
iti stutvā kṣitau yāvaddaṇḍavannipapāta saḥ |
tāvatsa bālo hṛṣṭātmā vedavyāsamabhāṣata ||
meaning:
इति स्तुत्वा क्षितौ यावद्दण्डवन्निपपात सः |
तावत्स बालो हृष्टात्मा वेदव्यासमभाषत ||
text_mt: Having thus praised him, as soon as he fell prostrate like a staff upon the ground, / just then the child, glad at heart, spoke to Vedavyāsa:

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bho yoginyaste manasi vartate |
nādeyaṃ vidyate kiñcidbhaktādhīno yato'smyaham ||
meaning:
वरं वृणीष्व भो योगिन्यस्ते मनसि वर्तते |
नादेयं विद्यते किञ्चिद्भक्ताधीनो यतोऽस्म्यहम् ||
text_mt: "O yogin, choose the boon that lies in your mind. / There is nothing that cannot be granted, since I am subject to my devotees."

sanskrit_iast:
tata utthāya hṛṣṭātmā munirvyāso mahātapāḥ |
pratyabravītkimajñātaṃ sarvajñasya tava prabho ||
meaning:
तत उत्थाय हृष्टात्मा मुनिर्व्यासो महातपाः |
प्रत्यब्रवीत्किमज्ञातं सर्वज्ञस्य तव प्रभो ||
text_mt: Then, having risen, glad at heart, the sage Vyāsa of great austerities / replied: "What is unknown to you, the all-knowing Lord?

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāntarātmā bhagavān śarvaḥ sarvaprado bhavān |
yāñcāṃ pratiniyuṅkte māṃ kimīśo dainyakāriṇīm ||
meaning:
सर्वान्तरात्मा भगवान् शर्वः सर्वप्रदो भवान् |
याञ्चां प्रतिनियुङ्क्ते मां किमीशो दैन्यकारिणीम् ||
text_mt: You are the inner Self of all, the Blessed Lord, Śarva, the giver of everything. / Why does the Lord urge me to make a request, which causes humiliation?"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasya vyāsasyāmalacetasaḥ |
śuci smitvā mahādevo bālarūpadharo'bravīt ||
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य व्यासस्यामलचेतसः |
शुचि स्मित्वा महादेवो बालरूपधरोऽब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: Having heard those words of that pure-minded Vyāsa, / smiling gently, Mahādeva, who had assumed the form of a child, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
bāla uvāca |
tvayā brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭha yo'bhilāṣaḥ kṛto hṛdi |
acireṇaiva kālena sa bhaviṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
बाल उवाच |
त्वया ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठ योऽभिलाषः कृतो हृदि |
अचिरेणैव कालेन स भविष्यत्यसंशयः ||
text_mt: The child said: / "O best among knowers of Brahman, the desire you formed in your heart / shall be fulfilled without delay, beyond any doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhe sthitvā tava brahmannantaryāmyahamīśvaraḥ |
setihāsapurāṇāni samyaṅnirmāpayāmyaham ||
meaning:
कण्ठे स्थित्वा तव ब्रह्मन्नन्तर्याम्यहमीश्वरः |
सेतिहासपुराणानि सम्यङ्निर्मापयाम्यहम् ||
text_mt: Abiding in your throat, O brahmin, I, the inner controller, the Lord, / shall cause the Purāṇas along with the Itihāsas to be composed properly.

sanskrit_iast:
abhilāṣāṣṭakaṃ puṇyaṃ stotrametattvayeritam |
varṣaṃ trikālaṃ paṭhanātkāmadaṃ śambhusadmani ||
meaning:
अभिलाषाष्टकं पुण्यं स्तोत्रमेतत्त्वयेरितम् |
वर्षं त्रिकालं पठनात्कामदं शम्भुसद्मनि ||
text_mt: This holy hymn, the 'Octad of Desires,' was uttered by you. / Through reciting it at the three daily twilights for a year in the abode of Śambhu, it grants desires.

sanskrit_iast:
etatstotrasya paṭhanaṃ vidyābuddhivivardhanam |
sarvasampatkaraṃ proktaṃ dharmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ nṛṇām ||
meaning:
एतत्स्तोत्रस्य पठनं विद्याबुद्धिविवर्धनम् |
सर्वसम्पत्करं प्रोक्तं धर्मदं मोक्षदं नृणाम् ||
text_mt: The recitation of this hymn increases learning and intellect; / it is declared to bestow all prosperity, and to grant virtue and liberation to men.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarutthāya susnāto liṅgamabhyarcya śāṅkaram |
varṣaṃ paṭhannidaṃ stotraṃ mūrkho'pi syād bṛhaspatiḥ ||
meaning:
प्रातरुत्थाय सुस्नातो लिङ्गमभ्यर्च्य शाङ्करम् |
वर्षं पठन्निदं स्तोत्रं मूर्खोऽपि स्याद् बृहस्पतिः ||
text_mt: Having risen at dawn and bathed well, having worshipped the liṅga of Śaṅkara / and reciting this hymn for a year, even a fool would become a Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
striyā vā puruṣeṇāpi niyamālliṅgasannidhau |
varṣaṃ japtamidaṃ stotraṃ buddhiṃ vidyāṃ ca vardhayet ||
meaning:
स्त्रिया वा पुरुषेणापि नियमाल्लिङ्गसन्निधौ |
वर्षं जप्तमिदं स्तोत्रं बुद्धिं विद्यां च वर्धयेत् ||
text_mt: Repeated with self-restraint near a liṅga for a year / by a woman or by a man, this hymn increases intellect and learning."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa mahādevo bālo liṅge nyalīyata |
vyāso'pi muñcannaśrūṇi śivapremākulo'bhavat ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स महादेवो बालो लिङ्गे न्यलीयत |
व्यासोऽपि मुञ्चन्नश्रूणि शिवप्रेमाकुलोऽभवत् ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, that Mahādeva as a child vanished into the liṅga; / and Vyāsa, shedding tears, became overwhelmed with love for Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ labdhavaro vyāso maheśānmadhyameśvarāt |
aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni praṇināya svalīlayā ||
meaning:
एवं लब्धवरो व्यासो महेशान्मध्यमेश्वरात् |
अष्टादश पुराणानि प्रणिनाय स्वलीलया ||
text_mt: Having thus received the boon from Maheśa, Madhyameśvara, / Vyāsa composed the eighteen Purāṇas according to his spontaneous play:

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā |
bhaviṣyaṃ nāradīyaṃ ca mārkaṇḍeyamataḥ param ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मं पाद्मं वैष्णवं च शैवं भागवतं तथा |
भविष्यं नारदीयं च मार्कण्डेयमतः परम् ||
text_mt: The Brāhma, the Pādma, the Vaiṣṇava, the Śaiva, and the Bhāgavata; / the Bhaviṣya, the Nāradīya, and beyond that, the Mārkaṇḍeya;

sanskrit_iast:
āgneyaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ laiṅgaṃ vārāhameva ca |
vāmanākhyaṃ tataḥ kaurmaṃ mātsyaṃ gāruḍameva ca ||
meaning:
आग्नेयं ब्रह्मवैवर्तं लैङ्गं वाराहमेव च |
वामनाख्यं ततः कौर्मं मात्स्यं गारुडमेव च ||
text_mt: the Āgneya, the Brahmavaivarta, the Laiṅga, and the Vārāha; / then the one called Vāmana, the Kaurma, the Mātsya, and the Gāruḍa;

sanskrit_iast:
skāndaṃ tathaiva brahmāṇḍākhyaṃ purāṇaṃ ca kīrtitam |
yaśasyaṃ puṇyadaṃ nṝṇāṃ śrotṝṇāṃ śāṅkaraṃ yaśaḥ ||
meaning:
स्कान्दं तथैव ब्रह्माण्डाख्यं पुराणं च कीर्तितम् |
यशस्यं पुण्यदं नॄणां श्रोतॄणां शाङ्करं यशः ||
text_mt: the Skānda, and likewise the Purāṇa called Brahmāṇḍa are proclaimed. / The fame of Śaṅkara brings renown and yields merit to men who hear it.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāṃ pūrvaṃ nāmoditaṃ tvayā |
kuru nirvacanaṃ teṣāmidānīṃ vedavittama ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
अष्टादशपुराणानां पूर्वं नामोदितं त्वया |
कुरु निर्वचनं तेषामिदानीं वेदवित्तम ||
text_mt: Sūta said: / "Earlier the names of the eighteen Purāṇas were stated by you; / now, O best knower of the Veda, provide their etymological explanations."

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca |
ayameva kṛtaḥ praśnastaṇḍinā brahmayoninā |
nandikeśvaramuddiśya sa yadāha bravīmi tat ||
nandikeśvara uvāca |
yatra vaktā svayaṃ taṇḍin brahmā sākṣāccaturmukhaḥ ||
meaning:
व्यास उवाच |
अयमेव कृतः प्रश्नस्तण्डिना ब्रह्मयोनिना |
नन्दिकेश्वरमुद्दिश्य स यदाह ब्रवीमि तत् ||
नन्दिकेश्वर उवाच |
यत्र वक्ता स्वयं तण्डिन् ब्रह्मा साक्षाच्चतुर्मुखः ||
text_mt:
Vyāsa said: / "This very question was posed by Taṇḍin, born of Brahmā, / addressed to Nandikeśvara. What he said, that I shall declare:

Nandikeśvara said: / 'That in which the speaker is the four-faced Brahmā himself in visible form, O Taṇḍin,

sanskrit_iast: tasmād brāhmaṃ samākhyātaṃ purāṇaṃ prathamaṃ mune ||
meaning: तस्माद् ब्राह्मं समाख्यातं पुराणं प्रथमं मुने ||
text_mt: is therefore proclaimed, O sage, as the first Purāṇa, the Brāhma.

sanskrit_iast:
padmakalpasya māhātmyaṃ tatra yasyāmudāhṛtam |
tasmātpādmaṃ samākhyātaṃ purāṇaṃ ca dvitīyakam ||
meaning:
पद्मकल्पस्य माहात्म्यं तत्र यस्यामुदाहृतम् |
तस्मात्पाद्मं समाख्यातं पुराणं च द्वितीयकम् ||
text_mt: That in which the eulogy of the Lotus Kalpa is recounted / is on that account proclaimed as the second Purāṇa, the Pādma.

sanskrit_iast:
parāśarakṛtaṃ yattu purāṇaṃ viṣṇubodhakam |
tadeva vyāsakathitaṃ putrapitrorabhedataḥ ||
meaning:
पराशरकृतं यत्तु पुराणं विष्णुबोधकम् |
तदेव व्यासकथितं पुत्रपित्रोरभेदतः ||
text_mt: The Purāṇa composed by Parāśara, which makes Viṣṇu known, / that very one is recounted by Vyāsa, because father and son are non-different.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra pūrvottare khaṇḍe śivasya caritaṃ bahu |
śaivametatpurāṇaṃ hi purāṇajñā vadanti ca ||
meaning:
यत्र पूर्वोत्तरे खण्डे शिवस्य चरितं बहु |
शैवमेतत्पुराणं हि पुराणज्ञा वदन्ति च ||
text_mt: That in whose first and second parts there are many deeds of Śiva, / this Purāṇa the knowers of the Purāṇas call the Śaiva.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavatyāśca durgāyāścaritaṃ yatra vidyate |
tattu bhāgavataṃ proktaṃ nanu devīpurāṇakam ||
meaning:
भगवत्याश्च दुर्गायाश्चरितं यत्र विद्यते |
तत्तु भागवतं प्रोक्तं ननु देवीपुराणकम् ||
text_mt: And that in which the deed of the goddess Durgā is found, / that is declared to be the Bhāgavata, indeed the Devīpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nāradoktaṃ purāṇaṃ tu nāradīyaṃ pracakṣate |
yatra vaktābhavattaṇḍin mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ ||
meaning:
नारदोक्तं पुराणं तु नारदीयं प्रचक्षते |
यत्र वक्ताभवत्तण्डिन् मार्कण्डेयो महामुनिः ||
text_mt: The Purāṇa spoken by Nārada they declare to be the Nāradīya. / That in which the speaker was the great sage Mārkaṇḍeya, O Taṇḍin,

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇaṃ hi tadākhyātaṃ ca saptamam |
agniyogāttadāgneyaṃ bhaviṣyokterbhaviṣyakam ||
meaning:
मार्कण्डेयपुराणं हि तदाख्यातं च सप्तमम् |
अग्नियोगात्तदाग्नेयं भविष्योक्तेर्भविष्यकम् ||
text_mt: is indeed named the Mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇa, the seventh; / that is the Āgneya from connection with Agni; and the Bhaviṣyaka from the declaration of the future;

sanskrit_iast:
vivartanād brahmaṇastu brahmavaivartamucyate |
liṅgasya caritoktatvātpurāṇaṃ liṅgamucyate ||
meaning:
विवर्तनाद् ब्रह्मणस्तु ब्रह्मवैवर्तमुच्यते |
लिङ्गस्य चरितोक्तत्वात्पुराणं लिङ्गमुच्यते ||
text_mt: it is called the Brahmavaivarta because of the evolution of Brahman; / the Purāṇa is called the Laiṅga because the deeds of the liṅga are related;

sanskrit_iast:
varāhasya ca vārāhaṃ purāṇaṃ dvādaśaṃ mune |
yatra skandaḥ svayaṃ śrotā vaktā sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
वराहस्य च वाराहं पुराणं द्वादशं मुने |
यत्र स्कन्दः स्वयं श्रोता वक्ता साक्षान्महेश्वरः ||
text_mt: and the Vārāha is [the Purāṇa] of the Boar, the twelfth, O sage. / That in which Skanda himself is the hearer and Maheśvara in person is the speaker,

sanskrit_iast:
tattu skāndaṃ samākhyātaṃ vāmanasya tu vāmanam |
kaurmaṃ kūrmasya caritaṃ mātsyaṃ matsyena kīrtitam ||
meaning:
तत्तु स्कान्दं समाख्यातं वामनस्य तु वामनम् |
कौर्मं कूर्मस्य चरितं मात्स्यं मत्स्येन कीर्तितम् ||
text_mt: that is proclaimed as the Skānda; that of Vāmana is the Vāmana; / the Kaurma is the deed of the Tortoise; the Mātsya was proclaimed by the Fish;

sanskrit_iast:
garuḍastu svayaṃ vaktā yattad gāruḍasaṃjñakam |
brahmāṇḍacaritoktatvād brahmāṇḍaṃ parikīrtitam ||
meaning:
गरुडस्तु स्वयं वक्ता यत्तद् गारुडसंज्ञकम् |
ब्रह्माण्डचरितोक्तत्वाद् ब्रह्माण्डं परिकीर्तितम् ||
text_mt: that in which Garuḍa himself is the speaker is named the Gāruḍa; / it is proclaimed as the Brahmāṇḍa because the deeds of the cosmic egg are narrated.'

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
ayameva mayā'kāri praśno vyāsāya dhīmate |
tataḥ sarvapurāṇānāṃ mayā nirvacanaṃ śrutam ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
अयमेव मयाऽकारि प्रश्नो व्यासाय धीमते |
ततः सर्वपुराणानां मया निर्वचनं श्रुतम् ||
text_mt: Sūta said: / "This very question was put by me to the wise Vyāsa; / then the explanation of all the Purāṇas was heard by me.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vyāsaḥ samutpannaḥ satyavatyāṃ parāśarāt |
purāṇasaṃhitāścakre mahābhāratamuttamam ||
meaning:
एवं व्यासः समुत्पन्नः सत्यवत्यां पराशरात् |
पुराणसंहिताश्चक्रे महाभारतमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: In this way Vyāsa was born to Satyavatī from Parāśara; / he composed the Purāṇa saṃhitās and the excellent Mahābhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
parāśareṇa saṃyogaḥ punaḥ śantanunā yathā |
satyavatyā iva brahmannaḥ saṃśayitumarhasi ||
meaning:
पराशरेण संयोगः पुनः शन्तनुना यथा |
सत्यवत्या इव ब्रह्मन्नः संशयितुमर्हसि ||
text_mt: You ought not to doubt, O brahmin, regarding Satyavatī, / how there was union with Parāśara, and again with Śantanu.

sanskrit_iast:
sakāraṇeyamutpattiḥ kathitāścaryakāriṇī |
mahatāṃ carite caiva guṇā grāhyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
meaning:
सकारणेयमुत्पत्तिः कथिताश्चर्यकारिणी |
महतां चरिते चैव गुणा ग्राह्या विचक्षणैः ||
text_mt: This wondrous birth has been related with its cause; / and in the conduct of the great, the wise should take only the virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti paṭhatyapi |
sa sarvapāpanirmukta ṛṣiloke mahīyate ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
इदं रहस्यं परमं यः शृणोति पठत्यपि |
स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्त ऋषिलोके महीयते ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Whoever hears or even reads this supreme secret / is freed from all sins and honored in the world of the sages."

Salutation to holy Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ |
śrutā śambhoḥ kathā ramyā nānākhyānasamanvitā |
nānāvatārasaṃyuktā bhuktimuktipradā nṛṇām ||
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः |
श्रुता शम्भोः कथा रम्या नानाख्यानसमन्विता |
नानावतारसंयुक्ता भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा नृणाम् ||
title: pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | mahākālikāvatāravarṇanam
text_mt: The sages said: / "The charming narrative of Śambhu has been heard, accompanied by various stories, / endowed with his various incarnations, granting enjoyment and liberation to men.

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmastvatto brahmavidāṃvara |
caritraṃ jagadambāyā bhagavatyā manoharam ||
meaning:
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामस्त्वत्तो ब्रह्मविदांवर |
चरित्रं जगदम्बाया भगवत्या मनोहरम् ||
text_mt: Now we wish to hear from you, O best among the knowers of Brahman, / the captivating deeds of the goddess, the Mother of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
parabrahmamaheśasya śaktirādyā sanātanī |
umā yā samabhikhyātā trailokyajananī parā ||
meaning:
परब्रह्ममहेशस्य शक्तिराद्या सनातनी |
उमा या समभिख्याता त्रैलोक्यजननी परा ||
text_mt: the primordial, eternal Śakti of the supreme Brahman Maheśa, / who is celebrated as Umā, the supreme Mother of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
satī haimavatī tasyā avatāradvayaṃ śrutam |
aparānavatārāṃstvaṃ brūhi sūta mahāmate ||
meaning:
सती हैमवती तस्या अवतारद्वयं श्रुतम् |
अपरानवतारांस्त्वं ब्रूहि सूत महामते ||
text_mt: Her two incarnations as Satī and Haimavatī have been heard. / Tell of her other incarnations, O high-minded Sūta.

sanskrit_iast:
ko virajyeta matimān guṇaśravaṇakarmaṇi |
śrīmāturjñānino yāni na tyajanti kadācana ||
meaning:
को विरज्येत मतिमान् गुणश्रवणकर्मणि |
श्रीमातुर्ज्ञानिनो यानि न त्यजन्ति कदाचन ||
text_mt: What wise man would lose interest in the act of hearing the virtues / of the glorious Mother, which the wise never abandon?"

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
dhanyā yūyaṃ mahātmānaḥ kṛtakṛtyāḥ stha sarvadā |
yatpṛcchatha parāmbāyā umāyāścaritaṃ mahat ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
धन्या यूयं महात्मानः कृतकृत्याः स्थ सर्वदा |
यत्पृच्छथ पराम्बाया उमायाश्चरितं महत् ||
text_mt: Sūta said: / "Fortunate are you, great-souled ones; you are ever accomplished in your aims, / since you ask about the great deeds of the supreme Mother, Umā.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇvatāṃ pṛcchatāṃ caiva tathā vācayatāṃ ca tat |
pādāmbujarajāṃsyeva tīrthāni munayo viduḥ ||
meaning:
शृण्वतां पृच्छतां चैव तथा वाचयतां च तत् |
पादाम्बुजरजांस्येव तीर्थानि मुनयो विदुः ||
text_mt: Sages consider the very dust of the lotus feet of those who listen to it, ask about it, and recite it / to be sacred bathing places.

sanskrit_iast:
te dhanyā kṛtakṛtyāḥ syurdhanyā teṣāṃ prasūḥ kulam |
yeṣāṃ cittaṃ bhavellīnaṃ śrīdevyāṃ parasaṃvidi ||
meaning:
ते धन्या कृतकृत्याः स्युर्धन्या तेषां प्रसूः कुलम् |
येषां चित्तं भवेल्लीनं श्रीदेव्यां परसंविदि ||
text_mt: Fortunate are they, their purpose achieved, fortunate their mother and lineage, / whose minds are absorbed in the glorious Goddess, the Supreme Consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
ye na stuvanti deveśīṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇām |
māyāguṇairmohitāḥ syurhatabhāgyā na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
ये न स्तुवन्ति देवेशीं सर्वकारणकारणाम् |
मायागुणैर्मोहिताः स्युर्हतभाग्या न संशयः ||
text_mt: Those who do not praise the Ruler of Gods, the Cause of all causes, / are deluded by the strands of māyā and ill-fated, beyond doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
na bhajanti mahādevīṃ karuṇārasasāgarām |
andhakūpe patantyete ghore saṃsārarūpiṇi ||
meaning:
न भजन्ति महादेवीं करुणारससागराम् |
अन्धकूपे पतन्त्येते घोरे संसाररूपिणि ||
text_mt: Those who do not worship the Great Goddess, the ocean of the essence of compassion, / plunge into the blind well in the form of this terrible worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāṃ vihāya tṛptyarthaṃ maruvāri yathā vrajet |
vihāya devīṃ tadbhinnaṃ tathā devāntaraṃ vrajet ||
meaning:
गङ्गां विहाय तृप्त्यर्थं मरुवारि यथा व्रजेत् |
विहाय देवीं तद्भिन्नं तथा देवान्तरं व्रजेत् ||
text_mt: Just as one might leave the Gaṅgā and go to desert water to quench one's thirst, / so would one leave the Goddess and go to another deity distinct from Her.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam |
anāyāsena labhate kastyajettāṃ narottamaḥ ||
meaning:
यस्याः स्मरणमात्रेण पुरुषार्थचतुष्टयम् |
अनायासेन लभते कस्त्यजेत्तां नरोत्तमः ||
text_mt: By the mere remembrance of whom one effortlessly attains / the four aims of life—what best among men would abandon Her?

sanskrit_iast:
etatpṛṣṭaḥ purā medhāḥ surathena mahātmanā |
yaduktaṃ medhasā pūrvaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva vadāmi te ||
meaning:
एतत्पृष्टः पुरा मेधाः सुरथेन महात्मना |
यदुक्तं मेधसा पूर्वं तच्छृणुष्व वदामि ते ||
text_mt: Concerning this, the sage Medhas was asked in ancient times by the noble Suratha. / What was previously spoken by Medhas—listen to that, I shall tell you.

sanskrit_iast:
svārociṣe'ntare pūrvaṃ viratho nāma pārthivaḥ |
surathastasya putro'bhūnmahābalaparākramaḥ ||
meaning:
स्वारोचिषेऽन्तरे पूर्वं विरथो नाम पार्थिवः |
सुरथस्तस्य पुत्रोऽभून्महाबलपराक्रमः ||
text_mt: Formerly, in the Svārociṣa Manvantara, there was an earthly king named Viratha; / his son was Suratha, endowed with great strength and prowess.

sanskrit_iast:
dānaśauṇḍaḥ satyavādī svadharmakuśalaḥ kṛtī |
devībhakto dayāsindhuḥ prajānāṃ paripālakaḥ ||
meaning:
दानशौण्डः सत्यवादी स्वधर्मकुशलः कृती |
देवीभक्तो दयासिन्धुः प्रजानां परिपालकः ||
text_mt: Generous in giving, truthful in speech, skilled in his own duty, accomplished, / devoted to the Goddess, an ocean of compassion, a protector of his subjects.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivīṃ śāsatastasya pākaśāsanatejasaḥ |
babhūvurnava ye bhūpāḥ pṛthvīgrahaṇatatparāḥ ||
meaning:
पृथिवीं शासतस्तस्य पाकशासनतेजसः |
बभूवुर्नव ये भूपाः पृथ्वीग्रहणतत्पराः ||
text_mt: As he ruled the earth, possessing the splendour of Indra, / there arose nine kings bent upon seizing his land.

sanskrit_iast:
kolānāmnīṃ rājadhānīṃ rurudhustasya bhūpateḥ |
taiḥ samaṃ tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ samapadyata dāruṇam ||
meaning:
कोलानाम्नीं राजधानीं रुरुधुस्तस्य भूपतेः |
तैः समं तुमुलं युद्धं समपद्यत दारुणम् ||
text_mt: They besieged the capital of that king, named Kolā; / a fierce and terrible battle took place between them.

sanskrit_iast:
yuddhe sa nirjito bhūpaḥ prabalaistairdviṣadgaṇaiḥ |
ujjāsitaśca kolāyā hṛtvā rājyamaśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
युद्धे स निर्जितो भूपः प्रबलैस्तैर्द्विषद्गणैः |
उज्जासितश्च कोलाया हृत्वा राज्यमशेषतः ||
text_mt: Defeated in battle by those mighty hosts of enemies / and having his kingdom completely seized, he was driven out of Kolā.

sanskrit_iast:
sa rājā svapurīmetyākarodrājyaṃ svamantribhiḥ |
tatrāpi ca mahāpakṣairvipakṣaiḥ sa parājitaḥ ||
meaning:
स राजा स्वपुरीमेत्याकरोद्राज्यं स्वमन्त्रिभिः |
तत्रापि च महापक्षैर्विपक्षैः स पराजितः ||
text_mt: That king returned to his own city and ruled with his ministers; / even there, he was defeated by powerful adversaries.

sanskrit_iast:
daivācchatrutvamāpannairamātyapramukhairgaṇaiḥ |
kośasthitaṃ ca yadvittaṃ tatsarvaṃ cātmasātkṛtam ||
meaning:
दैवाच्छत्रुत्वमापन्नैरमात्यप्रमुखैर्गणैः |
कोशस्थितं च यद्वित्तं तत्सर्वं चात्मसात्कृतम् ||
text_mt: By the factions headed by ministers who had become enemies through fate, / all the treasure kept in the treasury was appropriated for themselves.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa nirgato rājā nagarānmṛgayāchalāt |
asahāyo'śvamāruhya jagāma gahanaṃ vanam ||
meaning:
ततः स निर्गतो राजा नगरान्मृगयाछलात् |
असहायोऽश्वमारुह्य जगाम गहनं वनम् ||
text_mt: Then that king departed from the city on the pretext of hunting; / alone, having mounted a horse, he went into the dense forest.

sanskrit_iast:
itastatastatra gacchanrājā munivarāśramam |
dadarśa kusumārāmabhrājitaṃ sarvatodiśam ||
meaning:
इतस्ततस्तत्र गच्छन्राजा मुनिवराश्रमम् |
ददर्श कुसुमारामभ्राजितं सर्वतोदिशम् ||
text_mt: Wandering here and there, the king saw the hermitage of an excellent sage, / radiant on every side with gardens of blossoms,

sanskrit_iast:
vedadhvanisamākīrṇaṃ śāntajantusamāśritam |
śiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyaistacchiṣyaiḥ samantātpariveṣṭitam ||
meaning:
वेदध्वनिसमाकीर्णं शान्तजन्तुसमाश्रितम् |
शिष्यैः प्रशिष्यैस्तच्छिष्यैः समन्तात्परिवेष्टितम् ||
text_mt: filled with the sound of the Vedas, resorted to by tranquil animals, / surrounded on all sides by disciples, disciples of disciples, and their students.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghrādayo mahāvīryā alpavīryānmahāmate |
tadāśrame na bādhante dvijavaryaprabhāvataḥ ||
meaning:
व्याघ्रादयो महावीर्या अल्पवीर्यान्महामते |
तदाश्रमे न बाधन्ते द्विजवर्यप्रभावतः ||
text_mt: Tigers and other animals of great prowess, O wise one, / did not harass weaker creatures in that hermitage, by the power of the foremost of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāsa tatra nṛpatirmahākāruṇiko budhaḥ |
satkṛto munināthena suvaco bhojanāsanaiḥ ||
meaning:
उवास तत्र नृपतिर्महाकारुणिको बुधः |
सत्कृतो मुनिनाथेन सुवचो भोजनासनैः ||
text_mt: The king, deeply compassionate and wise, dwelt there, / honoured by the lord of sages with kind words, food, and a seat.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā sa mahārājaścintāmāpa duratyayām |
aho me hīnabhāgyasya durbuddherhīnatejasaḥ ||
meaning:
एकदा स महाराजश्चिन्तामाप दुरत्ययाम् |
अहो मे हीनभाग्यस्य दुर्बुद्धेर्हीनतेजसः ||
text_mt: Once that great king was seized with insurmountable worry: / 'Alas for me, unfortunate, foolish, and bereft of splendour!

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtaṃ rājyamaśeṣeṇa śatruvargairmadoddhataiḥ |
matpūrvai rakṣitaṃ rājyaṃ śatrubhirbhujyate'dhunā ||
meaning:
हृतं राज्यमशेषेण शत्रुवर्गैर्मदोद्धतैः |
मत्पूर्वै रक्षितं राज्यं शत्रुभिर्भुज्यतेऽधुना ||
text_mt: My kingdom has been wholly seized by hordes of enemies insolent with pride; / the kingdom protected by my ancestors is now enjoyed by enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
mādṛśaścaitravaṃśe'sminna ko'pyāsīnmahīpatiḥ |
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ rājyaṃ labheya hi ||
meaning:
मादृशश्चैत्रवंशेऽस्मिन्न कोऽप्यासीन्महीपतिः |
किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि कथं राज्यं लभेय हि ||
text_mt: In this dynasty of Caitra there has never been any king like me. / What shall I do? Where shall I go? How indeed might I regain my kingdom?

sanskrit_iast:
amātyā mantriṇaścaiva māmakā ye sanātanāḥ |
na jāne kaṃ ca nṛpatiṃ samāsādyādhunāsate ||
meaning:
अमात्या मन्त्रिणश्चैव मामका ये सनातनाः |
न जाने कं च नृपतिं समासाद्याधुनासते ||
text_mt: My traditional ministers and counsellors— / I do not know which king they have now approached and serve.

sanskrit_iast:
vināśya rājyamadhunā na jāne kāṃ gatiṃ gatāḥ |
raṇabhūmimahotsāhā arivarganikartanāḥ ||
meaning:
विनाश्य राज्यमधुना न जाने कां गतिं गताः |
रणभूमिमहोत्साहा अरिवर्गनिकर्तनाः ||
text_mt: Now that the kingdom is destroyed, I do not know what state they have reached— / they who had great zeal on the battlefield, cutters-down of enemy hosts.

sanskrit_iast:
māmakā ye mahāśūrā nṛpamanyaṃ bhajanti te |
parvatābhā gajā aśvā vātavadvegagāminaḥ ||
meaning:
मामका ये महाशूरा नृपमन्यं भजन्ति ते |
पर्वताभा गजा अश्वा वातवद्वेगगामिनः ||
text_mt: My great heroes—are they serving another king? / And the mountain-like elephants, the horses swift as the wind—

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvapūrvārjitaḥ kośaḥ pālyate tairna vādhunā |
evaṃ mohavaśaṃ yāto rājā paramadhārmikaḥ ||
meaning:
पूर्वपूर्वार्जितः कोशः पाल्यते तैर्न वाधुना |
एवं मोहवशं यातो राजा परमधार्मिकः ||
text_mt: is the treasury accumulated by my predecessors being preserved by them now, or not?' / Thus fell into the sway of delusion that king of supreme righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tatra vaiśyaḥ kaścitsamāgataḥ |
rājā papraccha kastvaṃ bhoḥ kimarthamiha cāgataḥ ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र वैश्यः कश्चित्समागतः |
राजा पप्रच्छ कस्त्वं भोः किमर्थमिह चागतः ||
text_mt: At that moment, a certain merchant arrived there. / The king asked: 'Who are you, sir? And for what purpose have you come here?

sanskrit_iast:
durmanā lakṣyase kasmādetanme brūhi sāmpratam |
ityākarṇya vaco ramyaṃ narapālena bhāṣitam ||
meaning:
दुर्मना लक्ष्यसे कस्मादेतन्मे ब्रूहि साम्प्रतम् |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचो रम्यं नरपालेन भाषितम् ||
text_mt: Why do you appear dejected? Tell me this now.' / Hearing these pleasant words spoken by the protector of men,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛgbhyāṃ vimuñcannaśrūṇi samādhirvaiśyapuṅgavaḥ |
pratyuvāca mahīpālaṃ praṇayāvanatāṃ giram ||
meaning:
दृग्भ्यां विमुञ्चन्नश्रूणि समाधिर्वैश्यपुङ्गवः |
प्रत्युवाच महीपालं प्रणयावनतां गिरम् ||
text_mt: shedding tears from both eyes, Samādhi, the foremost of merchants, / replied to the earth-ruler in words lowered with affection.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśya uvāca |
samādhirnāma vaiśyo'haṃ dhanivaṃśasamudbhavaḥ |
putradārādibhistyakto dhanalobhānmahīpate ||
meaning:
वैश्य उवाच |
समाधिर्नाम वैश्योऽहं धनिवंशसमुद्भवः |
पुत्रदारादिभिस्त्यक्तो धनलोभान्महीपते ||
text_mt: The merchant said: / 'I am a merchant named Samādhi, born into a wealthy family; / I have been cast out by my sons, wife, and others through greed for wealth, O ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
vanamabhyāgato rājanduḥkhitaḥ svena karmaṇā |
so'haṃ putraprapautrāṇāṃ kalatrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ||
meaning:
वनमभ्यागतो राजन्दुःखितः स्वेन कर्मणा |
सोऽहं पुत्रप्रपौत्राणां कलत्राणां तथैव च ||
text_mt: I have come to the forest, O King, aggrieved by my own past action. / Even so, concerning my sons, great-grandsons, and wives,

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātṛṇāṃ bhrātṛputrāṇāṃ pareṣāṃ suhṛdāṃ tathā |
na vedmi kuśalaṃ samyak karuṇāsāgara prabho ||
meaning:
भ्रातृणां भ्रातृपुत्राणां परेषां सुहृदां तथा |
न वेद्मि कुशलं सम्यक् करुणासागर प्रभो ||
text_mt: and my brothers, nephews, others, and friends, / I do not know properly of their welfare, O lord, ocean of compassion.'

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca |
niṣkāsito yaiḥ putrādyairdurvṛttairdhanagardhibhiḥ |
teṣu kiṃ bhavatā prītiḥ kriyate mūrkhajantuvat ||
meaning:
राजोवाच |
निष्कासितो यैः पुत्राद्यैर्दुर्वृत्तैर्धनगर्धिभिः |
तेषु किं भवता प्रीतिः क्रियते मूर्खजन्तुवत् ||
text_mt: The king said: / 'By the sons and others, wicked and covetous of wealth, by whom you have been expelled— / why do you show affection toward them like a foolish creature?'

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśya uvāca |
samyaguktaṃ tvayā rājanvacaḥ sārārthabṛṃhitam |
tathāpi snehapāśena mohyate'tīva me manaḥ ||
meaning:
वैश्य उवाच |
सम्यगुक्तं त्वया राजन्वचः सारार्थबृंहितम् |
तथापि स्नेहपाशेन मोह्यतेऽतीव मे मनः ||
text_mt: The merchant said: / 'You have spoken well, O King, words fortified with meaningful truth; / even so, my mind is exceedingly deluded by the bond of affection.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ mohākulau vaiśyapārthivau munisattama |
jagmaturmunivaryasya medhasaḥ sannidhiṃ tadā ||
meaning:
एवं मोहाकुलौ वैश्यपार्थिवौ मुनिसत्तम |
जग्मतुर्मुनिवर्यस्य मेधसः सन्निधिं तदा ||
text_mt: Thus troubled by delusion, O best of sages, the merchant and the king / then went into the presence of the excellent sage Medhas.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vaiśyarājasahito nararājaḥ pratāpavān |
praṇanāma mahāvīraḥ śirasā yogināṃ varam ||
meaning:
स वैश्यराजसहितो नरराजः प्रतापवान् |
प्रणनाम महावीरः शिरसा योगिनां वरम् ||
text_mt: That mighty warrior, the glorious king of men, together with the merchant, / bowed his head before the best of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
baddhvāñjalimimāṃ vācamuvāca nṛpatirmunim |
bhagavannāvayormohaṃ chettumarhasi sāmpratam ||
meaning:
बद्ध्वाञ्जलिमिमां वाचमुवाच नृपतिर्मुनिम् |
भगवन्नावयोर्मोहं छेत्तुमर्हसि साम्प्रतम् ||
text_mt: Folding his hands in reverence, the king spoke this word to the sage: / 'O venerable one, you ought now to sever the delusion of us both.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ rājaśriyā tyakto gahanaṃ vanamāśritaḥ |
tathāpi hṛtarājyasya toṣo naivābhijāyate ||
meaning:
अहं राजश्रिया त्यक्तो गहनं वनमाश्रितः |
तथापि हृतराज्यस्य तोषो नैवाभिजायते ||
text_mt: Abandoned by royal fortune, I have resorted to the dense forest; / even so, bereft of my kingdom, contentment does not arise in me.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ ca vaiśyaḥ svajanairdārādyairniṣkṛto gṛhāt |
tathāpyetasya mamatā na nivṛttiṃ samaśnute ||
meaning:
अयं च वैश्यः स्वजनैर्दाराद्यैर्निष्कृतो गृहात् |
तथाप्येतस्य ममता न निवृत्तिं समश्नुते ||
text_mt: And this merchant has been expelled from home by his own kin, wife, and others; / yet his sense of possessiveness attains no cessation.

sanskrit_iast:
kimatra kāraṇaṃ brūhi jñāninorapi no manaḥ |
mohena vyākulaṃ jātaṃ mahatyeṣā hi mūrkhatā ||
meaning:
किमत्र कारणं ब्रूहि ज्ञानिनोरपि नो मनः |
मोहेन व्याकुलं जातं महत्येषा हि मूर्खता ||
text_mt: Tell me what the cause of this is: even though the two of us possess knowledge, our minds / have become confounded by delusion; this is indeed a great folly.'

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiruvāca |
mahāmāyā jagaddhātrī śaktirūpā sanātanī |
sā mohayati sarveṣāṃ samākṛṣya manāṃsi vai ||
meaning:
ऋषिरुवाच |
महामाया जगद्धात्री शक्तिरूपा सनातनी |
सा मोहयति सर्वेषां समाकृष्य मनांसि वै ||
text_mt: The sage said: / 'Mahāmāyā, the bearer of the universe, whose form is the eternal Śakti— / She indeed deludes the minds of all, having drawn them in.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādayaḥ surāḥ sarve yanmāyāmohitāḥ prabho |
na jānanti paraṃ tattvaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ca kā kathā ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मादयः सुराः सर्वे यन्मायामोहिताः प्रभो |
न जानन्ति परं तत्त्वं मनुष्याणां च का कथा ||
text_mt: All the gods, Brahmā and the rest, deluded by Her Māyā, O lord, / do not know the supreme reality; what then to say of human beings?

sanskrit_iast:
sā sṛjatyakhilaṃ viśvaṃ saiva pālayatīti ca |
saiva saṃharate kāle triguṇā parameśvarī ||
meaning:
सा सृजत्यखिलं विश्वं सैव पालयतीति च |
सैव संहरते काले त्रिगुणा परमेश्वरी ||
text_mt: She creates the entire universe, and She alone preserves it; / She alone dissolves it in time—the supreme Sovereign composed of the three guṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyopari prasannā sā varadā kāmarūpiṇī |
sa eva mohamatyeti nānyathā nṛpasattama ||
meaning:
यस्योपरि प्रसन्ना सा वरदा कामरूपिणी |
स एव मोहमत्येति नान्यथा नृपसत्तम ||
text_mt: He upon whom She, the granter of boons who can assume any form at will, is pleased / is the one who overcomes delusion, not otherwise, O best of kings.'

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca |
kā sā devī mahāmāyā yā ca mohayate'khilān |
kathaṃ jātā ca sā devī kṛpayā vada me mune ||
meaning:
राजोवाच |
का सा देवी महामाया या च मोहयतेऽखिलान् |
कथं जाता च सा देवी कृपया वद मे मुने ||
text_mt: The king said: / 'Who is that Goddess Mahāmāyā who deludes all? / And how was that Goddess born? Please tell me, O sage.'

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiruvāca |
jagatyekārṇave jāte śeṣamāstīrya yogarāṭ |
yoganidrāmupāśritya yadā suṣvāpa keśavaḥ ||
meaning:
ऋषिरुवाच |
जगत्येकार्णवे जाते शेषमास्तीर्य योगराट् |
योगनिद्रामुपाश्रित्य यदा सुष्वाप केशवः ||
text_mt: The sage said: / 'When the universe had become a single cosmic ocean, having spread out Śeṣa, the king of yogins, / Keśava, fell asleep, resorting to yogic sleep.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā dvāvasurau jātau viṣṇoḥ karṇamalena vai |
madhukaiṭabhanāmānau vikhyātau pṛthivītale ||
meaning:
तदा द्वावसुरौ जातौ विष्णोः कर्णमलेन वै |
मधुकैटभनामानौ विख्यातौ पृथिवीतले ||
text_mt: Then two asuras were born from the ear-wax of Viṣṇu, / famous throughout the earth by the names Madhu and Kaiṭabha,

sanskrit_iast:
pralayārkaprabhau ghorau mahākāyau mahāhanū |
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanau bhakṣayantau jaganti vā ||
meaning:
प्रलयार्कप्रभौ घोरौ महाकायौ महाहनू |
दंष्ट्राकरालवदनौ भक्षयन्तौ जगन्ति वा ||
text_mt: having the brilliance of the sun of cosmic dissolution, terrible, with huge bodies and huge jaws, / their faces frightful with fangs, as if devouring the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tau dṛṣṭvā bhagavannābhipaṅkaje kamalāsanam |
hananāyodyatāvāstāṃ kastvaṃ bhoriti vādinau ||
meaning:
तौ दृष्ट्वा भगवन्नाभिपङ्कजे कमलासनम् |
हननायोद्यतावास्तां कस्त्वं भोरिति वादिनौ ||
text_mt: Seeing the lotus-seated [Brahmā] on the lotus of the Lord’s navel, / those two prepared to kill him, saying: 'Who are you, sir?'

sanskrit_iast:
samālokya tu tau daityau surajyeṣṭho janārdanam |
śayānaṃ ca payombhodhau tuṣṭāva parameśvarīm ||
meaning:
समालोक्य तु तौ दैत्यौ सुरज्येष्ठो जनार्दनम् |
शयानं च पयोम्भोधौ तुष्टाव परमेश्वरीम् ||
text_mt: Beholding those two Daityas, the eldest of the gods, [seeing] Janārdana / asleep in the ocean of milk, praised the supreme Sovereign.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
rakṣa rakṣa mahāmāye śaraṇāgatavatsale |
etābhyāṃ ghorarūpābhyāṃ daityābhyāṃ jagadambike ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
रक्ष रक्ष महामाये शरणागतवत्सले |
एताभ्यां घोररूपाभ्यां दैत्याभ्यां जगदम्बिके ||
text_mt: Brahmā said: / 'Protect, protect [me], O Mahāmāyā, affectionate toward those who seek refuge! / From these two demons of terrible form, O Mother of the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamāmi mahāmāyāṃ yoganidrāmumāṃ satīm |
kālarātriṃ mahārātriṃ moharātriṃ parātparām ||
meaning:
प्रणमामि महामायां योगनिद्रामुमां सतीम् |
कालरात्रिं महारात्रिं मोहरात्रिं परात्पराम् ||
text_mt: I bow to Mahāmāyā, Yoganidrā, Umā, Satī, / Kālarātri, Mahārātri, Moharātri, higher than the highest,

sanskrit_iast:
tridevajananīṃ nityāṃ bhaktābhīṣṭaphalapradām |
pālinīṃ sarvadevānāṃ karuṇāvaruṇālayām ||
meaning:
त्रिदेवजननीं नित्यां भक्ताभीष्टफलप्रदाम् |
पालिनीं सर्वदेवानां करुणावरुणालयाम् ||
text_mt: the eternal Mother of the three gods, granter of the desired fruit to devotees, / protector of all the gods, ocean of compassion!

sanskrit_iast:
tvatprabhāvādahaṃ brahmā mādhavo girijāpatiḥ |
sṛjatyavati saṃsāraṃ kāle saṃharatīti ca ||
meaning:
त्वत्प्रभावादहं ब्रह्मा माधवो गिरिजापतिः |
सृजत्यवति संसारं काले संहरतीति च ||
text_mt: By your power I, Brahmā, create, Mādhava preserves the world, / and the husband of Girijā destroys it at the end of time.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ svadhā tvaṃ hrīstvaṃ buddhirvimalā matā |
tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭistvamevāmba śāntiḥ kṣāntiḥ kṣudhā dayā ||
meaning:
त्वं स्वाहा त्वं स्वधा त्वं ह्रीस्त्वं बुद्धिर्विमला मता |
तुष्टिः पुष्टिस्त्वमेवाम्ब शान्तिः क्षान्तिः क्षुधा दया ||
