लोकत्रयपदस्यान्ते व्यापिने परमात्मने |
शिवायेदं न मम च पदं ब्रूयादतः परम् ||
text_mt:
From the word 'viśvarūpāya' of the mantra beginning with 'uttiṣṭhasva', / one should say the word 'puruṣāya', and recite 'om svāhā' to it.

After the word 'lokatrayavyāpine', / one should speak the words 'paramātmane śivāyedaṃ na mama' after this.

sanskrit_iast:
svaśākhoktaprakāreṇa purastāttantrakarma ca |
nirvartya sarpiṣā miśraṃ caruṃ prāśya purodhase ||
meaning:
स्वशाखोक्तप्रकारेण पुरस्तात्तन्त्रकर्म च |
निर्वर्त्य सर्पिषा मिश्रं चरुं प्राश्य पुरोधसे ||
text_mt: Having first performed the ritual action according to the method stated in one's own Vedic branch, / and having consumed the caru offering mixed with clarified butter, to the domestic priest

sanskrit_iast:
pradadyād dakṣiṇāṃ tasmai hemādiparibṛṃhitām |
brahmāṇamudvāsya tataḥ prātaraupāsanaṃ hunet ||
meaning:
प्रदद्याद् दक्षिणां तस्मै हेमादिपरिबृंहिताम् |
ब्रह्माणमुद्वास्य ततः प्रातरौपासनं हुनेत् ||
text_mt: he should present a sacrificial fee enriched with gold and the like; / having then dismissed Brahmā, he should offer the morning domestic fire-offering.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃ mā siñcantu maruta iti mantraṃ japennaraḥ |
yāte agna ityanena mantreṇāgnau pratāpya ca ||
meaning:
सं मा सिञ्चन्तु मरुत इति मन्त्रं जपेन्नरः |
याते अग्न इत्यनेन मन्त्रेणाग्नौ प्रताप्य च ||
text_mt: A man should recite the mantra, "May the Maruts sprinkle me"; / and having warmed his hand at the fire with the mantra, "That [form] of yours, O Agni",

sanskrit_iast:
hastamagnau samāropya svātmanyadvaitadhāmani |
prābhātikīṃ tataḥ sandhyāmupāsyādityamapyatha ||
meaning:
हस्तमग्नौ समारोप्य स्वात्मन्यद्वैतधामनि |
प्राभातिकीं ततः सन्ध्यामुपास्यादित्यमप्यथ ||
text_mt: and consigning the fire into his own self, the non-dual abode, / having then attended the morning twilight, and also the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
upasthāya praviśyāpsu nābhidaghnaṃ praveśayan |
tanmantrāṃ perajapetprītyā niścalātmā samutsukaḥ ||
meaning:
उपस्थाय प्रविश्याप्सु नाभिदघ्नं प्रवेशयन् |
तन्मन्त्रां पेरजपेत्प्रीत्या निश्चलात्मा समुत्सुकः ||
text_mt: having approached and stepped into water up to his navel, / an earnest man with a steady mind should attentively recite those mantras with love.

sanskrit_iast:
āhitāgnistu yaḥ kuryātprājāpatyeṣṭimāhite |
śraute vaiśvānare samyak sarvavedasadakṣiṇām ||
meaning:
आहिताग्निस्तु यः कुर्यात्प्राजापत्येष्टिमाहिते |
श्रौते वैश्वानरे सम्यक् सर्ववेदसदक्षिणाम् ||
text_mt: The keeper of the sacred fires, however, should properly perform the Prājāpatya sacrifice / in the consecrated Vedic Vaiśvānara fire, giving all his possessions as fee.

sanskrit_iast:
athāgnimātmanyāropya brāhmaṇaḥ pravrajed guhāt |
sāvitrīprathamaṃ pādaṃ sāvitrīmityudīrya ca ||
meaning:
अथाग्निमात्मन्यारोप्य ब्राह्मणः प्रव्रजेद् गुहात् |
सावित्रीप्रथमं पादं सावित्रीमित्युदीर्य च ||
text_mt: Then, consigning the fire into his self, the brāhmaṇa should renounce from his house; / having recited the first quarter of the Sāvitrī, and saying "sāvitrīm",

sanskrit_iast:
praveśayāmi śabdānte bhūromiti ca saṃvadet |
dvitīyaṃ pādamuccārya sāvitrīmiti pūrvavat ||
meaning:
प्रवेशयामि शब्दान्ते भूरोमिति च संवदेत् |
द्वितीयं पादमुच्चार्य सावित्रीमिति पूर्ववत् ||
text_mt: after the word 'praveśayāmi' he should utter "bhūr om"; / reciting the second quarter, saying "sāvitrīm" as before,

sanskrit_iast:
praveśayāmi śabdānte bhūromiti ca saṃvadet |
tṛtīyaṃ pādamuccārya sāvitrīmityataḥ param ||
praveśayāmi śabdānte suvaromityudīrayet |
tripādamuccaretpūrvaṃ sāvitrīmityataḥ param ||
meaning:
प्रवेशयामि शब्दान्ते भूरोमिति च संवदेत् |
तृतीयं पादमुच्चार्य सावित्रीमित्यतः परम् ||
प्रवेशयामि शब्दान्ते सुवरोमित्युदीरयेत् |
त्रिपादमुच्चरेत्पूर्वं सावित्रीमित्यतः परम् ||
text_mt:
after the word 'praveśayāmi' he should utter "bhur om"; / reciting the third quarter, after this, saying "sāvitrīm",

after the word 'praveśayāmi' he should utter "suvar om"; / he should first recite the three quarters, and after this, saying "sāvitrīm",

sanskrit_iast:
praveśayāmi śabdānte bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaromiti |
udīrayetparaṃ prītyā niścalātmā munīśvara ||
meaning:
प्रवेशयामि शब्दान्ते भूर्भुवः सुवरोमिति |
उदीरयेत्परं प्रीत्या निश्चलात्मा मुनीश्वर ||
text_mt: after the word 'praveśayāmi' he should utter "bhūrbhuvaḥ suvar om" / with supreme devotion, steady in self, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ bhagavatī sākṣācchaṅkarārddhaśarīriṇī |
pañcavaktrā daśabhujā tripañcanayanojjvalā ||
meaning:
इयं भगवती साक्षाच्छङ्करार्द्धशरीरिणी |
पञ्चवक्त्रा दशभुजा त्रिपञ्चनयनोज्ज्वला ||
text_mt: This goddess is visibly half the body of Śaṅkara; / she has five faces, ten arms, and is radiant with fifteen eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
navaratnakirīṭodyaccandralekhāvataṃsinī |
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśā daśāyudhadharā śubhā ||
meaning:
नवरत्नकिरीटोद्यच्चन्द्रलेखावतंसिनी |
शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशा दशायुधधरा शुभा ||
text_mt: She is adorned with a crescent moon rising on a crown of nine jewels; / she resembles pure crystal, holds ten weapons, and is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
hārakeyūrakaṭakakiṅkiṇīnūpurādibhiḥ |
bhūṣitāvayavā divyavasanā ratnabhūṣaṇā ||
meaning:
हारकेयूरकटककिङ्किणीनूपुरादिभिः |
भूषितावयवा दिव्यवसना रत्नभूषणा ||
text_mt: Her limbs are adorned with necklaces, armlets, bracelets, tinkling bells, and anklets; / she wears divine garments and jeweled ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇunā vidhinā devaṛṣigandharvadānavaiḥ |
mānavaiśca sadā sevyā sarvātmavyāpinī śivā ||
meaning:
विष्णुना विधिना देवऋषिगन्धर्वदानवैः |
मानवैश्च सदा सेव्या सर्वात्मव्यापिनी शिवा ||
text_mt: She is ever to be served by Viṣṇu, Brahmā, the gods, sages, gandharvas, dānavas, / and humans—the auspicious goddess pervading the inner self of all.

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivasya devasya dharmapatnī manoharā |
jagadambā trijananī triguṇā nirguṇāpyajā ||
meaning:
सदाशिवस्य देवस्य धर्मपत्नी मनोहरा |
जगदम्बा त्रिजननी त्रिगुणा निर्गुणाप्यजा ||
text_mt: She is the delightful lawful wife of the god Sadāśiva, / the mother of the universe, mother of the triad, composed of the three qualities, yet devoid of qualities, unborn.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ saṃvicāryātha gāyatrīṃ prajapetsudhīḥ |
ādidevīṃ ca tripadāṃ brāhmaṇatvādidāmajām ||
meaning:
इत्येवं संविचार्याथ गायत्रीं प्रजपेत्सुधीः |
आदिदेवीं च त्रिपदां ब्राह्मणत्वादिदामजाम् ||
text_mt: Reflecting thus, the wise person should then recite the Gāyatrī, / the primordial goddess consisting of three feet, the giver of brāhmaṇahood and the like, unborn.

sanskrit_iast:
yo hyanyathā japetpāpo gāyatrīṃ śivarūpiṇīm |
sa pacyate mahāghore narake kalpasaṅkhyayā ||
meaning:
यो ह्यन्यथा जपेत्पापो गायत्रीं शिवरूपिणीम् |
स पच्यते महाघोरे नरके कल्पसङ्ख्यया ||
text_mt: A wicked person who recites the Gāyatrī, whose form is Śiva, in any other manner / is cooked in a most dreadful hell for a multitude of kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
sā vyāhṛtibhyaḥ sañjātā tāsveva vilayaṃ gatā |
tāśca praṇavasambhūtā praṇave vilayaṃ gatāḥ ||
praṇavaḥ sarvavedādiḥ praṇavaḥ śivavācakaḥ |
mantrādhirājarājaśca mahābījaṃ manuḥ paraḥ ||
meaning:
सा व्याहृतिभ्यः सञ्जाता तास्वेव विलयं गता |
ताश्च प्रणवसम्भूता प्रणवे विलयं गताः ||
प्रणवः सर्ववेदादिः प्रणवः शिववाचकः |
मन्त्राधिराजराजश्च महाबीजं मनुः परः ||
text_mt:
She arose from the sacred utterances, and into them she dissolves; / and they arose from the Praṇava, and into the Praṇava they dissolve.

The Praṇava is the beginning of all the Vedas; the Praṇava is expressive of Śiva; / it is the sovereign king among mantras, the supreme seed, the supreme mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
śivo vā praṇavo hyeṣa praṇavo vā śivaḥ smṛtaḥ |
vācyavācakayorbhedo nātyantaṃ vidyate yataḥ ||
meaning:
शिवो वा प्रणवो ह्येष प्रणवो वा शिवः स्मृतः |
वाच्यवाचकयोर्भेदो नात्यन्तं विद्यते यतः ||
text_mt: Either Śiva is the Praṇava, or the Praṇava is traditionally declared as Śiva; / for no absolute distinction is found between the expressed meaning and the expressive word.

sanskrit_iast:
enameva mahāmantraṃ jīvānāṃ ca tanutyajām |
kāśyāṃ saṃśrāvya maraṇe datte muktiṃ parāṃ śivaḥ ||
meaning:
एनमेव महामन्त्रं जीवानां च तनुत्यजाम् |
काश्यां संश्राव्य मरणे दत्ते मुक्तिं परां शिवः ||
text_mt: Śiva, making living beings who give up their bodies in Kāśī / hear this very great mantra at the time of death, bestows supreme liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādekākṣaraṃ devaṃ śivaṃ paramakāraṇam |
upāsate yatiśreṣṭhā hṛdayāmbhojamadhyagam ||
meaning:
तस्मादेकाक्षरं देवं शिवं परमकारणम् |
उपासते यतिश्रेष्ठा हृदयाम्भोजमध्यगम् ||
text_mt: Therefore, the best of ascetics worship the single-syllabled god Śiva, / the supreme cause, residing in the middle of the lotus of the heart.

sanskrit_iast:
mumukṣavo'pare dhīrā viraktā laukikā narāḥ |
viṣayānmanasā jñātvopāsate paramaṃ śivam ||
meaning:
मुमुक्षवोऽपरे धीरा विरक्ता लौकिका नराः |
विषयान्मनसा ज्ञात्वोपासते परमं शिवम् ||
text_mt: Other wise seekers of liberation, dispassionate worldly men, / having known sensory objects through the mind, worship supreme Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vilāpya gāyatrīṃ praṇave śivavācake |
ahaṃ vṛkṣasya rerivetyanuvākaṃ japetpunaḥ ||
meaning:
एवं विलाप्य गायत्रीं प्रणवे शिववाचके |
अहं वृक्षस्य रेरिवेत्यनुवाकं जपेत्पुनः ||
text_mt: Having thus dissolved the Gāyatrī into the Praṇava that expresses Śiva, / one should again recite the Vedic section beginning with "ahaṃ vṛkṣasya rerivā".

sanskrit_iast:
yaśchandasāmāmṛṣabha ityanuvākamupakramāt |
gopāyāntaṃ japanpaścādutthitohamitīrayet ||
meaning:
यश्छन्दसामामृषभ इत्यनुवाकमुपक्रमात् |
गोपायान्तं जपन्पश्चादुत्थितोहमितीरयेत् ||
text_mt: Reciting the Vedic section beginning with "yaśchandasāmṛṣabho" from the beginning / down to the end of "gopāya", he should then say, "I have arisen."

sanskrit_iast:
vadejjapet tridhā mandamadhyocchrāyakramānmune |
praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhatya sṛṣṭisthitilayakramāt ||
meaning:
वदेज्जपेत् त्रिधा मन्दमध्योच्छ्रायक्रमान्मुने |
प्रणवं पूर्वमुद्धत्य सृष्टिस्थितिलयक्रमात् ||
text_mt: One should speak and recite three times, in the order of low, medium, and high tone, O sage, / first pronouncing the Praṇava, in the order of creation, maintenance, and dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmatha kramādbhūyādbhūḥ saṃnyastambhuvastathā |
saṃnyastaṃ suvarityuktvā sannyastaṃ padamuccaram ||
meaning:
तेषामथ क्रमाद्भूयाद्भूः संन्यस्तम्भुवस्तथा |
संन्यस्तं सुवरित्युक्त्वा सन्न्यस्तं पदमुच्चरम् ||
text_mt: Then, in their respective order, it should be: "Earth is renounced," and likewise, "Atmosphere / is renounced," and saying "Heaven is renounced," uttering the word 'renounced'.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamantrānta pradeśe mayeti ca padaṃ vadet |
praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya samaṣṭivyāhṛtīrvadet ||
samastamityato brūyānmayeti ca samabravīt |
sadāśivaṃ hṛdi dhyātvā mandādīti tato mune ||
meaning:
सर्वमन्त्रान्त प्रदेशे मयेति च पदं वदेत् |
प्रणवं पूर्वमुद्धृत्य समष्टिव्याहृतीर्वदेत् ||
समस्तमित्यतो ब्रूयान्मयेति च समब्रवीत् |
सदाशिवं हृदि ध्यात्वा मन्दादीति ततो मुने ||
text_mt:
At the conclusion of every mantra, one should utter the word "mayā"; / first uttering the Praṇava, one should utter the collective sacred utterances.

After this, one should say "samastam", and he said "mayā"; / having meditated on Sadāśiva in his heart, in a low tone and so forth, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
praiṣamantrāṃstu japtvaivaṃ sāvadhānena cetasā |
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo mattaḥ svāheti sañjapan ||
meaning:
प्रैषमन्त्रांस्तु जप्त्वैवं सावधानेन चेतसा |
अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो मत्तः स्वाहेति सञ्जपन् ||
text_mt: having thus recited the renunciation mantras with an attentive mind, / reciting: "Freedom from fear to all beings from me, svāhā,"

sanskrit_iast:
prācyāṃ diśyapa uddhṛtya prakṣipedajaliṃ tataḥ |
śikhāṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca yatrotpāṭya ca pāṇinā ||
meaning:
प्राच्यां दिश्यप उद्धृत्य प्रक्षिपेदजलिं ततः |
शिखां यज्ञोपवीतं च यत्रोत्पाट्य च पाणिना ||
text_mt: and raising water toward the eastern direction, he should then throw the handful; / plucking out with his hand the tuft of hair and the sacred thread where [it is],

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā praṇavaṃ bhūśca samudraṃ gaccha saṃvadet |
vahnijāyāṃ samuccāryya sodakāñjalinā tataḥ ||
meaning:
गृहीत्वा प्रणवं भूश्च समुद्रं गच्छ संवदेत् |
वह्निजायां समुच्चार्य्य सोदकाञ्जलिना ततः ||
text_mt: taking it with the Praṇava, he should say, "O earth, go to the ocean!"; / then, uttering the wife of fire (svāhā), with a handful of water,

sanskrit_iast:
apsu hūyādatha preṣairabhimantrya tridhā tvapaḥ |
prāśya tīre samāgatya bhūmau vastrādikaṃ tyajet ||
meaning:
अप्सु हूयादथ प्रेषैरभिमन्त्र्य त्रिधा त्वपः |
प्राश्य तीरे समागत्य भूमौ वस्त्रादिकं त्यजेत् ||
text_mt: he should offer it into the water; then, having consecrated the water three times with the praiṣa formulas, / sipping it, coming to the bank, he should abandon his clothes and the like on the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā gacchessaptapadādhikam |
kiñciddūramathācāryastiṣṭha tiṣṭheti saṃvadet ||
meaning:
उदङ्मुखः प्राङ्मुखो वा गच्छेस्सप्तपदाधिकम् |
किञ्चिद्दूरमथाचार्यस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति संवदेत् ||
text_mt: Facing north or facing east, he should walk more than seven steps; / then, when he is a little distance away, the preceptor should say, "Stop! Stop!"

sanskrit_iast:
lokasya vyavahārārthaṃ kaupīnaṃ daṇḍameva ca |
bhagavansvīkuruṣveti dadyātsvenaiva pāṇinā ||
meaning:
लोकस्य व्यवहारार्थं कौपीनं दण्डमेव च |
भगवन्स्वीकुरुष्वेति दद्यात्स्वेनैव पाणिना ||
text_mt: "For the sake of worldly propriety, accept a loincloth and a staff, / O venerable one," saying this, he should present them with his own hand.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā sudoraṃ kaupīnaṃ kāṣāyavasanaṃ tataḥ |
ācchādyācamya ca dvedhā ta śiṣyamiti saṃvadet ||
meaning:
दत्त्वा सुदोरं कौपीनं काषायवसनं ततः |
आच्छाद्याचम्य च द्वेधा त शिष्यमिति संवदेत् ||
text_mt: Having given the loincloth with a good cord, and then the ochre robe, / covering him and having sipped water twice, he should address that disciple thus.

sanskrit_iast:
indrasya vajro'si tata iti mantramudāharet |
samprārthya daṇḍaṃ gṛhṇīyātsakhāya iti sañjapan ||
meaning:
इन्द्रस्य वज्रोऽसि तत इति मन्त्रमुदाहरेत् |
सम्प्रार्थ्य दण्डं गृह्णीयात्सखाय इति सञ्जपन् ||
text_mt: Then he should utter the mantra, 'You are Indra's thunderbolt.' / Having prayed, he should take up the staff while chanting, 'Friends...'

sanskrit_iast:
atha gatvā guroḥ pārśvaṃ śivapādāmbujaṃ smaran |
praṇameddaṇḍavadbhūmau trivāraṃ saṃyatātmavān ||
punarutthāya ca śanaiḥ premṇā paśyanguruṃ nijam |
kṛtāñjalipuṭastiṣṭhedgurupāda samīpataḥ ||
meaning:
अथ गत्वा गुरोः पार्श्वं शिवपादाम्बुजं स्मरन् |
प्रणमेद्दण्डवद्भूमौ त्रिवारं संयतात्मवान् ||
पुनरुत्थाय च शनैः प्रेम्णा पश्यन्गुरुं निजम् |
कृताञ्जलिपुटस्तिष्ठेद्गुरुपाद समीपतः ||
text_mt:
Then, having approached the guru while meditating on Śiva's lotus feet, / self-controlled, he should prostrate like a staff on the ground three times.

Rising slowly once again and looking upon his guru with love, / he should stand near the guru's feet with palms joined in reverence.

sanskrit_iast:
karmmārambhātpūrvameva gṛhītvā gomayaṃ śubham |
sthūlāmalakamātreṇa kṛtvā piṇḍānviśoṣayeta ||
meaning:
कर्म्मारम्भात्पूर्वमेव गृहीत्वा गोमयं शुभम् |
स्थूलामलकमात्रेण कृत्वा पिण्डान्विशोषयेत ||
text_mt: Even before commencing the rite, having gathered auspicious cow dung / and formed lumps the size of a large myrobalan fruit, he should dry them.

sanskrit_iast:
sauraistu kiraṇaireva homārambhāgnimadhyagān |
nikṣipya homasampūrttau bhasma saṅgṛhya gopayet ||
meaning:
सौरैस्तु किरणैरेव होमारम्भाग्निमध्यगान् |
निक्षिप्य होमसम्पूर्त्तौ भस्म सङ्गृह्य गोपयेत् ||
text_mt: Only by the sun's rays [having dried them], casting them into the middle of the fire at the start of the oblation, / he should collect and preserve the ash when the oblation is complete.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gurussamādāya virajānalajaṃ sitam |
bhasma tenaiva taṃ śiṣyamagnirityādibhiḥ kramāt ||
meaning:
ततो गुरुस्समादाय विरजानलजं सितम् |
भस्म तेनैव तं शिष्यमग्निरित्यादिभिः क्रमात् ||
text_mt: Then the guru, taking the white ash / born from the Virajā fire, should touch the limbs of that disciple in sequence with that very [ash], / using the mantras beginning with 'Fire...'

sanskrit_iast:
mantrairaṅgāni saṃspṛśya mūrddhādicaraṇāntataḥ |
īśānādyaiḥ pañcamantrai śira ārabhya sarvataḥ ||
meaning:
मन्त्रैरङ्गानि संस्पृश्य मूर्द्धादिचरणान्ततः |
ईशानाद्यैः पञ्चमन्त्रै शिर आरभ्य सर्वतः ||
text_mt: touching the limbs from head to feet. / Beginning from the head and all over with the five mantras starting with Īśāna,

sanskrit_iast:
samuddhṛtya vidhānena tripuṇḍraṃ dhārayettataḥ |
triyāyuṣaistryambakaiśca mūrdhna ārabhya ca kramāt ||
meaning:
समुद्धृत्य विधानेन त्रिपुण्ड्रं धारयेत्ततः |
त्रियायुषैस्त्र्यम्बकैश्च मूर्ध्न आरभ्य च क्रमात् ||
text_mt: having lifted it according to the rule, he should then apply the tripuṇḍra / in sequence starting from the head, with the [mantras] 'Triyāyuṣa' and 'Tryambaka'.

sanskrit_iast:
tatassadbhaktiyuktena cetasā śiṣyasattamaḥ |
hṛtpaṅkaje samāsīnaṃ dhyāyecchivamumāsakham ||
meaning:
ततस्सद्भक्तियुक्तेन चेतसा शिष्यसत्तमः |
हृत्पङ्कजे समासीनं ध्यायेच्छिवमुमासखम् ||
text_mt: Then, with a mind endowed with true devotion, the excellent disciple / should meditate on Śiva, Umā's companion, seated in the heart-lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
hastaṃ nidhāya śirasi śiṣyasya sa gururvadet |
trivāraṃ praṇavaṃ dakṣakarṇe ṛṣyādisaṃyutam ||
meaning:
हस्तं निधाय शिरसि शिष्यस्य स गुरुर्वदेत् |
त्रिवारं प्रणवं दक्षकर्णे ऋष्यादिसंयुतम् ||
text_mt: Placing his hand on the disciple's head, that guru should speak / the Praṇava into the right ear three times, along with its seer and other details.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṛtvā ca karuṇāṃ praṇavasyārtha mādiśet |
ṣaḍvidhārtthapari jñānasahitaṃ gurusattamaḥ ||
meaning:
ततः कृत्वा च करुणां प्रणवस्यार्थ मादिशेत् |
षड्विधार्त्थपरि ज्ञानसहितं गुरुसत्तमः ||
text_mt: Then, having shown compassion, the excellent guru should impart the meaning of the Praṇava, / together with the thorough knowledge of its sixfold meaning.

sanskrit_iast:
dviṣaṭprakāraṃ sa guruṃ praṇamedbhuvi daṇḍavat |
tadadhīno bhavennityaṃ nānyatkarmma samācaret ||
tadājñayā tataḥ śiṣyo vedāntārthānusārataḥ |
śivajñānaparo bhūyātsaguṇāguṇabhedataḥ ||
meaning:
द्विषट्प्रकारं स गुरुं प्रणमेद्भुवि दण्डवत् |
तदधीनो भवेन्नित्यं नान्यत्कर्म्म समाचरेत् ||
तदाज्ञया ततः शिष्यो वेदान्तार्थानुसारतः |
शिवज्ञानपरो भूयात्सगुणागुणभेदतः ||
text_mt:
He should prostrate like a staff on the ground to the guru in twelve ways; / he should remain continually subject to him and perform no other action.

Then, by his command, according to the import of the Vedānta, the disciple / should be devoted to the knowledge of Śiva, differentiated as with qualities and without qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastenaiva śiṣyeṇa śravaṇādyaṅgapūrvvakam |
prabhātikādyanuṣṭhānaṃ japānte kārayedguruḥ ||
meaning:
ततस्तेनैव शिष्येण श्रवणाद्यङ्गपूर्व्वकम् |
प्रभातिकाद्यनुष्ठानं जपान्ते कारयेद्गुरुः ||
text_mt: Then, through that very disciple, preceded by the limbs such as hearing, / the guru should have him perform the morning and other observances at the end of recitation,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāṃ ca maṇḍale tasminkailāsaprastarāhvaye |
śivoditena mārgeṇa śiṣyastatraiva pūjayet ||
meaning:
पूजां च मण्डले तस्मिन्कैलासप्रस्तराह्वये |
शिवोदितेन मार्गेण शिष्यस्तत्रैव पूजयेत् ||
text_mt: and worship in that maṇḍala called Kailāsaprastara; / according to the path declared by Śiva, the disciple should perform worship right there.

sanskrit_iast:
devannityamaśaktaścetpūjituṃ guruṇā śubham |
sphāṭikaṃ pīṭhikopetaṃ gṛhṇīyālliṅgamaiśvaram ||
meaning:
देवन्नित्यमशक्तश्चेत्पूजितुं गुरुणा शुभम् |
स्फाटिकं पीठिकोपेतं गृह्णीयाल्लिङ्गमैश्वरम् ||
text_mt: If he is unable to worship the god daily, he should take from the guru / an auspicious crystal liṅga of Īśvara, endowed with a pedestal.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ prāṇaparityāgaśchedanaṃ śiraso'pi me |
na tvanabhyarcya bhuñjīyāṃ bhagavantaṃ trilocanam ||
meaning:
वरं प्राणपरित्यागश्छेदनं शिरसोऽपि मे |
न त्वनभ्यर्च्य भुञ्जीयां भगवन्तं त्रिलोचनम् ||
text_mt: 'Better the giving up of my life, or even the severing of my head, / than that I should eat without having worshiped the three-eyed Lord!'

sanskrit_iast:
evantrivāramuccāryya śapathaṃ gurusannidhau |
kuryyāddṛḍhamanāśśiṣyaḥ śivabhaktisamudvahan ||
meaning:
एवन्त्रिवारमुच्चार्य्य शपथं गुरुसन्निधौ |
कुर्य्याद्दृढमनाश्शिष्यः शिवभक्तिसमुद्वहन् ||
text_mt: Having spoken this oath three times in the presence of the guru, / carrying firm devotion to Śiva, the disciple should make his resolve steady.

sanskrit_iast:
tata eva mahādevaṃ nityamudyuktamānasaḥ |
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā pañcāvaraṇamārgataḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
तत एव महादेवं नित्यमुद्युक्तमानसः |
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या पञ्चावरणमार्गतः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
From then on, with a mind ever eager, / he should worship Mahādeva with supreme devotion, according to the path of the five coverings.

Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmadeva uvāca |
bhagavanṣaṇmukhāśeṣavijñānāmṛtavāridhe |
viśvāmareśvarasuta praṇatārttiprabhañjana ||
meaning:
वामदेव उवाच |
भगवन्षण्मुखाशेषविज्ञानामृतवारिधे |
विश्वामरेश्वरसुत प्रणतार्त्तिप्रभञ्जन ||
title: caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivarūpapraṇavavarṇanam
text_mt: Vāmadeva said: / 'O Lord, six-faced one, ocean of the nectar of complete knowledge, / son of the lord of all the immortals, dispeller of the distress of those bowed in homage!

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍvidhārtthaparijñānamiṣṭadaṃ kimudāhṛtam |
ke tatra ṣaḍvidhā arthāḥ parijñānaṃ ca kiṃ prabho ||
meaning:
षड्विधार्त्थपरिज्ञानमिष्टदं किमुदाहृतम् |
के तत्र षड्विधा अर्थाः परिज्ञानं च किं प्रभो ||
text_mt: What is declared to be the thorough knowledge of the sixfold meaning that grants desires? / What are the sixfold meanings in that regard, and what is the thorough knowledge, O Lord?

sanskrit_iast:
pratipādyaśca kastasya parijñāne ca kiṃ phalam |
etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva yadyatpṛṣṭaṃ mayā guha ||
meaning:
प्रतिपाद्यश्च कस्तस्य परिज्ञाने च किं फलम् |
एतत्सर्वं समाचक्ष्व यद्यत्पृष्टं मया गुह ||
text_mt: And what is to be demonstrated by it, and what is the fruit of its thorough knowledge? / Explain all this to me, whatever I have asked, O Guha!

sanskrit_iast:
etamartthamavijñāya paśuśāstravimohitaḥ |
adyāpyahaṃ mahāsena bhrāntaśca śivamāyayā ||
meaning:
एतमर्त्थमविज्ञाय पशुशास्त्रविमोहितः |
अद्याप्यहं महासेन भ्रान्तश्च शिवमायया ||
text_mt: Not knowing this meaning and deluded by scriptures for bound souls, / even today I wander deluded by Śiva's illusion, O Mahāsena!

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ śivapadadvandvajñānāmṛtarasāyanam |
pīttvā vigatasammoho bhaviṣyāmi yathā tathā ||
meaning:
अहं शिवपदद्वन्द्वज्ञानामृतरसायनम् |
पीत्त्वा विगतसम्मोहो भविष्यामि यथा तथा ||
text_mt: Having drunk the elixir of the nectar of knowledge of Śiva's two feet, / in whatever manner I shall become free from delusion,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpāmṛtārdrayā dṛṣṭyā vilokya suciraṃ mayi |
karttavyo'nugrahaḥ śrīmatpādābjaśaraṇāgate ||
meaning:
कृपामृतार्द्रया दृष्ट्या विलोक्य सुचिरं मयि |
कर्त्तव्योऽनुग्रहः श्रीमत्पादाब्जशरणागते ||
text_mt: looking upon me for a long time with a gaze wet with the nectar of compassion, / favor must be shown to me who have sought refuge at your glorious lotus feet.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā munīndroktaṃ jñānaśaktidharo vibhuḥ |
prāhānyadarśanamahāsantrāsajanakaṃ vacaḥ ||
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा मुनीन्द्रोक्तं ज्ञानशक्तिधरो विभुः |
प्राहान्यदर्शनमहासन्त्रासजनकं वचः ||
text_mt: Having heard what was said by the lord of sages, the omnipresent wielder of the power of knowledge / spoke words that cause great terror to other philosophical systems.

sanskrit_iast:
subrahmaṇya uvāca |
śrūyatāṃ muniśārdūla tvayā yatpṛṣṭamādarāt |
samaṣṭivyaṣṭibhāvena parijñānammaheśituḥ ||
meaning:
सुब्रह्मण्य उवाच |
श्रूयतां मुनिशार्दूल त्वया यत्पृष्टमादरात् |
समष्टिव्यष्टिभावेन परिज्ञानम्महेशितुः ||
text_mt: Subrahmaṇya said: / 'Listen, O tiger among sages, to what has been asked by you with respect / regarding the thorough knowledge of the Great Lord in terms of the collective and the distributive.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavārtthaparijñānarūpaṃ tadvistarādaham |
vadāmi ṣaḍvidhārthaikyaparijñānena suvrata ||
prathamo mantrarūpaḥ syād dvitīyo mantrabhāvitaḥ |
devatārtthastṛtīyo'rthaḥ prapañcārthastataḥ param ||
meaning:
प्रणवार्त्थपरिज्ञानरूपं तद्विस्तरादहम् |
वदामि षड्विधार्थैक्यपरिज्ञानेन सुव्रत ||
प्रथमो मन्त्ररूपः स्याद् द्वितीयो मन्त्रभावितः |
देवतार्त्थस्तृतीयोऽर्थः प्रपञ्चार्थस्ततः परम् ||
text_mt:
I shall explain that in detail in the form of thorough knowledge of the Praṇava's meaning, / by means of the thorough knowledge of the oneness of the sixfold meaning, O you of noble vows!

The first is in the form of the mantra; the second is meditated upon through the mantra; / the deity is the third meaning; after that is the meaning of the cosmic manifestation;

sanskrit_iast:
caturthaḥ pañcamārthaḥ syād gururūpapradarśakaḥ |
ṣaṣṭhaḥ śiṣyātmarūpo'rthaḥ ṣaḍvidhārthāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
meaning:
चतुर्थः पञ्चमार्थः स्याद् गुरुरूपप्रदर्शकः |
षष्ठः शिष्यात्मरूपोऽर्थः षड्विधार्थाः प्रकीर्तिताः ||
text_mt: the fourth [being that], the fifth meaning displays the form of the guru; / the sixth is the meaning having the form of the disciple's self: [thus] the sixfold meanings are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra mantrasvarūpaṃ te vadāmi munisattama |
yena vijñātamātreṇa mahājñānī bhavennaraḥ ||
meaning:
तत्र मन्त्रस्वरूपं ते वदामि मुनिसत्तम |
येन विज्ञातमात्रेण महाज्ञानी भवेन्नरः ||
text_mt: Among these, I shall tell you the true nature of the mantra, O best of sages, / merely by knowing which a man becomes a possessor of great knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyaḥ svaraḥ pañcamaśca pañcamāntastataḥ paraḥ |
bindunādau ca pañcārṇāḥ proktā vedairna cānyathā ||
meaning:
आद्यः स्वरः पञ्चमश्च पञ्चमान्तस्ततः परः |
बिन्दुनादौ च पञ्चार्णाः प्रोक्ता वेदैर्न चान्यथा ||
text_mt: The first vowel, and the fifth, and then beyond that the last of the fifth class [of consonants], / and the bindu and nāda: these five syllables are taught by the Vedas and not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsamaṣṭirūpo hi vedādiḥ samudāhṛtaḥ |
nādaḥ sarvasamaṣṭiḥ syād bindvāḍhyaṃ yaccatuṣṭayam ||
meaning:
एतत्समष्टिरूपो हि वेदादिः समुदाहृतः |
नादः सर्वसमष्टिः स्याद् बिन्द्वाढ्यं यच्चतुष्टयम् ||
text_mt: The beginning of the Veda is indeed declared to consist of the totality of these. / Nāda is the collective of all, while the group of four endowed with bindu

sanskrit_iast:
vyaṣṭirūpeṇa saṃsiddhaṃ praṇave śivavācake |
yantrarūpaṃ śṛṇu prājña śivaliṅgaṃ tadeva hi ||
meaning:
व्यष्टिरूपेण संसिद्धं प्रणवे शिववाचके |
यन्त्ररूपं शृणु प्राज्ञ शिवलिङ्गं तदेव हि ||
text_mt: is established in a distributive manner in the Praṇava which denotes Śiva. / Hear the form of the yantra, O wise one; that very thing is indeed the Śivaliṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvādhastāllikhetpīṭhaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ prathamaṃ svaram |
uvarṇaṃ ca tadūrdhvasthaṃ pavargāntaṃ tadūrdhvagam ||
meaning:
सर्वाधस्ताल्लिखेत्पीठं तदूर्ध्वं प्रथमं स्वरम् |
उवर्णं च तदूर्ध्वस्थं पवर्गान्तं तदूर्ध्वगम् ||
text_mt: At the very bottom he should draw the pedestal; above that, the first vowel; / and the letter "u" above that; the last of the "pa"-class above that;

sanskrit_iast:
tanmastakasthaṃ binduṃ ca tadūrdhvaṃ nādamālikhet |
yantre sampūrṇatāṃ yāte sarvakāmaḥ prasidhyati ||
meaning:
तन्मस्तकस्थं बिन्दुं च तदूर्ध्वं नादमालिखेत् |
यन्त्रे सम्पूर्णतां याते सर्वकामः प्रसिध्यति ||
text_mt: and the bindu situated at its crest, and above that he should draw the nāda. / When the yantra has reached completeness, every desire is accomplished.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ yantraṃ samālikhya praṇave nava veṣṭayet | ta-va tadutthenaiva nādena vidyannādāvasānakam ||
meaning: एवं यन्त्रं समालिख्य प्रणवे नव वेष्टयेत् | त-व तदुत्थेनैव नादेन विद्यन्नादावसानकम् ||
text_mt: Having drawn the yantra in this manner, one should encompass it nine times in the Praṇava, / knowing it to end in nāda, with that very nāda arising from it.

sanskrit_iast:
devatārtthaṃ pravakṣyāmi gūḍhaṃ sarvatra yanmune |
tava snehād vāmadeva yathā śaṅkarabhāṣitam ||
sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmītyupakramya sadāśivom |
iti prāha śrutistāraṃ brahmapañcakavācakam ||
meaning:
देवतार्त्थं प्रवक्ष्यामि गूढं सर्वत्र यन्मुने |
तव स्नेहाद् वामदेव यथा शङ्करभाषितम् ||
सद्योजातं प्रपद्यामीत्युपक्रम्य सदाशिवोम् |
इति प्राह श्रुतिस्तारं ब्रह्मपञ्चकवाचकम् ||
text_mt:
I shall explain the meaning of the deity, which is hidden everywhere, O sage, / out of affection for you, O Vāmadeva, as it was spoken by Śaṅkara.

Beginning with 'I resort to Sadyojāta', / the scripture speaks the Om of Sadāśiva, the Praṇava signifying the pentad of Brahmans.

sanskrit_iast:
vijñeyā brahmarūpiṇyaḥ sūkṣmāḥ pañcaiva devatāḥ |
etā eva śivasyāpi mūrtitvenopabṛṃhitāḥ ||
meaning:
विज्ञेया ब्रह्मरूपिण्यः सूक्ष्माः पञ्चैव देवताः |
एता एव शिवस्यापि मूर्तित्वेनोपबृंहिताः ||
text_mt: The subtle deities are to be known as five, having the nature of Brahman; / these very five are magnified as forms of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
śivasya vācako mantraḥ śivamūrtteśca vācakaḥ |
mūrttimūrtimatorbhedo nātyantaṃ vidyate yataḥ ||
meaning:
शिवस्य वाचको मन्त्रः शिवमूर्त्तेश्च वाचकः |
मूर्त्तिमूर्तिमतोर्भेदो नात्यन्तं विद्यते यतः ||
text_mt: The mantra denotes Śiva, and it denotes the form of Śiva, / since there is no absolute difference between the form and that which possesses the form.

sanskrit_iast:
īśānamukuṭopeta ityārabhya puroditaḥ |
śivasya vigrahaḥ pañcavaktrāṇi śṛṇu sāmpratam ||
meaning:
ईशानमुकुटोपेत इत्यारभ्य पुरोदितः |
शिवस्य विग्रहः पञ्चवक्त्राणि शृणु साम्प्रतम् ||
text_mt: Śiva's body was spoken of earlier, beginning with 'Endowed with the crown of Īśāna.' / Now hear about the five faces:

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamādi samārabhya sadyojātādyanukramāt |
ūrdhvāntamīśānāntaṃ ca mukhapañcakamīritam ||
meaning:
पञ्चमादि समारभ्य सद्योजाताद्यनुक्रमात् |
ऊर्ध्वान्तमीशानान्तं च मुखपञ्चकमीरितम् ||
text_mt: Beginning with the fifth, in the regular order from Sadyojāta / up to the upper one, ending with Īśāna, the five faces are declared.

sanskrit_iast:
īśānasyaiva devasya caturvyūhapade sthitam |
puruṣādyaṃ ca sadyāntaṃ brahmarūpaṃ catuṣṭayam ||
meaning:
ईशानस्यैव देवस्य चतुर्व्यूहपदे स्थितम् |
पुरुषाद्यं च सद्यान्तं ब्रह्मरूपं चतुष्टयम् ||
text_mt: Situated in the status of the fourfold manifestation of that very god Īśāna / is the quartet having the nature of Brahman, beginning with Puruṣa and ending with Sadyojāta.

sanskrit_iast:
pañca brahmasamaṣṭiḥ syādīśānaṃ brahma viśrutam |
puruṣādyaṃ tu tadvyaṣṭiḥ sadyojātāntikaṃ mune ||
meaning:
पञ्च ब्रह्मसमष्टिः स्यादीशानं ब्रह्म विश्रुतम् |
पुरुषाद्यं तु तद्व्यष्टिः सद्योजातान्तिकं मुने ||
text_mt: The collective of the five Brahmans is the celebrated Brahman Īśāna; / but its distributive aspect, O sage, begins with Puruṣa and ends with Sadyojāta.

sanskrit_iast:
anugrahamayaṃ cakramidaṃ pañcārthakāraṇam |
parabrahmātmakaṃ sūkṣmaṃ nirvikāramanāmayam ||
meaning:
अनुग्रहमयं चक्रमिदं पञ्चार्थकारणम् |
परब्रह्मात्मकं सूक्ष्मं निर्विकारमनामयम् ||
text_mt: Consisting of grace, this wheel is the cause of the five objects, / subtle, having the nature of the Supreme Brahman, free from alteration, and free from affliction.

sanskrit_iast:
anugraho'pi dvividhastirobhāvādigocaraḥ |
prabhuścānyastu jīvānāṃ parāvaravimuktidaḥ ||
meaning:
अनुग्रहोऽपि द्विविधस्तिरोभावादिगोचरः |
प्रभुश्चान्यस्तु जीवानां परावरविमुक्तिदः ||
text_mt: Grace too is twofold: concerned with concealment and the like, / and the Lord's other [grace] which grants liberation, higher and lower, to embodied souls.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsadāśivasyaiva kṛtyadvayamudāhṛtam |
anugrahe'pi sṛṣṭyādikṛtyānāṃ pañcakaṃ vibhoḥ ||
mune tatrāpi sadyādyā devatāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
parabrahmasvarūpāstāḥ pañca kalyāṇadāḥ sadā ||
meaning:
एतत्सदाशिवस्यैव कृत्यद्वयमुदाहृतम् |
अनुग्रहेऽपि सृष्ट्यादिकृत्यानां पञ्चकं विभोः ||
मुने तत्रापि सद्याद्या देवताः परिकीर्तिताः |
परब्रह्मस्वरूपास्ताः पञ्च कल्याणदाः सदा ||
text_mt:
This is declared to be the twofold activity of Sadāśiva alone. / Even within grace, the all-pervading Lord has a group of five activities, beginning with creation.

O sage, even there the deities beginning with Sadyojāta are proclaimed; / having the nature of supreme Brahman, those five always bestow auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
anugrahamayaṃ cakraṃ śāntyatītakalāmayam |
sadāśivādhiṣṭhitaṃ ca paramaṃ padamucyate ||
meaning:
अनुग्रहमयं चक्रं शान्त्यतीतकलामयम् |
सदाशिवाधिष्ठितं च परमं पदमुच्यते ||
text_mt: The wheel of grace consists of the Śāntyatīta energy; / presided over by Sadāśiva, it is called the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
etadeva padaṃ prāpya yatīnāṃ bhavitātmanām |
sadāśivopāsakānāṃ praṇavāsaktacetasām ||
meaning:
एतदेव पदं प्राप्य यतीनां भवितात्मनाम् |
सदाशिवोपासकानां प्रणवासक्तचेतसाम् ||
text_mt: Having attained this very abode, for ascetics with cultivated minds, / worshippers of Sadāśiva whose minds are intent on the Praṇava,

sanskrit_iast:
etadeva padaṃ prāpya tena sākaṃ munīśvarāḥ |
bhuktvā suvipulānbhogāndevena brahmarūpiṇā ||
meaning:
एतदेव पदं प्राप्य तेन साकं मुनीश्वराः |
भुक्त्वा सुविपुलान्भोगान्देवेन ब्रह्मरूपिणा ||
text_mt: having attained this very abode, O lords of sages, together with Him, / having enjoyed extensive pleasures with the god who has the nature of Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpralayasambhūtau śivasāmyaṃ bhajanti hi |
na patanti punaḥ kvāpi saṃsārābdhau janāśca te ||
meaning:
महाप्रलयसम्भूतौ शिवसाम्यं भजन्ति हि |
न पतन्ति पुनः क्वापि संसाराब्धौ जनाश्च ते ||
text_mt: when the great dissolution occurs, they certainly attain equality with Śiva; / and those people never fall again anywhere into the ocean of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
te brahmaloka iti ca śrutirāha sanātanī |
aiśvaryaṃ tu śivasyāpi samaṣṭiridameva hi ||
meaning:
ते ब्रह्मलोक इति च श्रुतिराह सनातनी |
ऐश्वर्यं तु शिवस्यापि समष्टिरिदमेव हि ||
text_mt: And the eternal Śruti says: “They [abide] in the world of Brahmā.” / For this totality is indeed the sovereign power of Śiva as well.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaiśvaryeṇa sampanna ityāhātharvaṇī śikhā |
sarvaiśvaryapradātṛtvamasyaiva pravadanti hi ||
meaning:
सर्वैश्वर्येण सम्पन्न इत्याहाथर्वणी शिखा |
सर्वैश्वर्यप्रदातृत्वमस्यैव प्रवदन्ति हि ||
text_mt: “Endowed with all sovereignty,” says the Atharvaśikhā [Upaniṣad]; / for they declare Him alone to be the bestower of all sovereignty.

sanskrit_iast:
camakasya padānnānyadadhikaṃ vidyate padam |
brahmapañcakavistāraprapañcaḥ khalu dṛśyate ||
meaning:
चमकस्य पदान्नान्यदधिकं विद्यते पदम् |
ब्रह्मपञ्चकविस्तारप्रपञ्चः खलु दृश्यते ||
text_mt: There is no other state higher than the word of the Camaka. / Indeed, the expanded universe of the five Brahmans is visible.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmabhya evaṃ sañjātā nivṛttyādyāḥ kalā matāḥ |
sūkṣmabhūtasvarūpiṇyaḥ kāraṇatvena viśrutāḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मभ्य एवं सञ्जाता निवृत्त्याद्याः कला मताः |
सूक्ष्मभूतस्वरूपिण्यः कारणत्वेन विश्रुताः ||
text_mt: Thus the energies beginning with Nivṛtti are understood to have arisen from the Brahmans; / having the form of subtle elements, they are renowned as the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlarūpasvarūpasya prapañcasyāsya suvrata |
pañcadhāvasthitaṃ yattad brahmapañcakamiṣyate ||
puruṣaḥ śrotravāṇyau ca śabdakāśau ca pañcakam |
vyāptamīśānarūpeṇa brahmaṇā munisattama ||
meaning:
स्थूलरूपस्वरूपस्य प्रपञ्चस्यास्य सुव्रत |
पञ्चधावस्थितं यत्तद् ब्रह्मपञ्चकमिष्यते ||
पुरुषः श्रोत्रवाण्यौ च शब्दकाशौ च पञ्चकम् |
व्याप्तमीशानरूपेण ब्रह्मणा मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt:
O you of noble vows, of this manifest world which has the form of gross matter, / that which is fivefold is recognized as the group of five Brahmans.

Puruṣa, the ears, speech, sound, and space: this group of five / is pervaded by Brahman in the form of Īśāna, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtistvakca pāṇiśca sparśo vāyuśca pañcakam |
vyāptaṃ puruṣarūpeṇa brahmaṇaiva munīśvara ||
meaning:
प्रकृतिस्त्वक्च पाणिश्च स्पर्शो वायुश्च पञ्चकम् |
व्याप्तं पुरुषरूपेण ब्रह्मणैव मुनीश्वर ||
text_mt: Prakṛti, skin, the hand, touch, and wind: this group of five / is pervaded by Brahman in the form of Puruṣa alone, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṅkārastathā cakṣuḥ pādo rūpaṃ ca pāvakaḥ |
aghorabrahmaṇā vyāptametatpañcakamañcitam ||
meaning:
अहङ्कारस्तथा चक्षुः पादो रूपं च पावकः |
अघोरब्रह्मणा व्याप्तमेतत्पञ्चकमञ्चितम् ||
text_mt: Ego, eye, foot, form, and fire: / this distinguished group of five is pervaded by the Aghora Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
buddhiśca rasanā pāyū rasa āpaśca pañcakam |
brahmaṇā vāmadevena vyāptaṃ bhavati nityaśaḥ ||
meaning:
बुद्धिश्च रसना पायू रस आपश्च पञ्चकम् |
ब्रह्मणा वामदेवेन व्याप्तं भवति नित्यशः ||
text_mt: Intellect, tongue, anus, taste, and water: this group of five / is eternally pervaded by the Brahman Vāmadeva.

sanskrit_iast:
mano nāsā tathopastho gandho bhūmiśca pañcakam |
sadyena brahmaṇā vyāptaṃ pañcabrahmamayaṃ jagat ||
meaning:
मनो नासा तथोपस्थो गन्धो भूमिश्च पञ्चकम् |
सद्येन ब्रह्मणा व्याप्तं पञ्चब्रह्ममयं जगत् ||
text_mt: Mind, nose, genitals, smell, and earth: this group of five / is pervaded by the Sadyojāta Brahman; the universe consists of the five Brahmans.

sanskrit_iast:
yantrarūpeṇopadiṣṭaḥ praṇavaḥ śivavācakaḥ |
samaṣṭiḥ pañcavarṇānāṃ bindvādyaṃ yaccatuṣṭayam ||
meaning:
यन्त्ररूपेणोपदिष्टः प्रणवः शिववाचकः |
समष्टिः पञ्चवर्णानां बिन्द्वाद्यं यच्चतुष्टयम् ||
text_mt: The Praṇava, expressive of Śiva, is taught in the form of a yantra, / as the aggregate of the five syllables and the group of four beginning with the point (bindu).

sanskrit_iast:
śivopadiṣṭamārgeṇa yantrarūpaṃ vibhāvayet |
praṇavaṃ paramaṃ mantrādhirājaṃ śivarūpiṇam ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
शिवोपदिष्टमार्गेण यन्त्ररूपं विभावयेत् |
प्रणवं परमं मन्त्राधिराजं शिवरूपिणम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
According to the path taught by Śiva, one should contemplate the form of the yantra, / the supreme Praṇava, the sovereign ruler of mantras, having the nature of Śiva.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca |
tataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi sṛṣṭipaddhatimuttamām |
sadāśivānmaheśādicatuṣkasya varānane ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच |
ततः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि सृष्टिपद्धतिमुत्तमाम् |
सदाशिवान्महेशादिचतुष्कस्य वरानने ||
title: pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | upāsanāmūrttivarṇanam
text_mt: The Lord said: / Beyond that I shall declare the excellent procedure of creation / from Sadāśiva of the group of four beginning with Maheśa, O fair-faced lady.

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivaḥ samaṣṭiḥ syādākāśadhipatiḥ prabhuḥ |
asyaiva vyaṣṭitāpannaṃ maheśādicatuṣṭayam ||
meaning:
सदाशिवः समष्टिः स्यादाकाशधिपतिः प्रभुः |
अस्यैव व्यष्टितापन्नं महेशादिचतुष्टयम् ||
text_mt: Sadāśiva is the totality, the ruler, the sovereign of space; / the group of four beginning with Maheśa has assumed the state of his particulars.

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivasahasrāṃśānmaheśasya samudbhavaḥ |
puruṣānantarūpatvādvāyoradhipatiśca saḥ ||
meaning:
सदाशिवसहस्रांशान्महेशस्य समुद्भवः |
पुरुषानन्तरूपत्वाद्वायोरधिपतिश्च सः ||
text_mt: From a thousandth part of Sadāśiva arose Maheśa; / having the infinite form of Puruṣa, he is also the ruler of wind.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāśaktiyuto vāme sakalaśca kriyādhikaḥ |
asyaiva vyaṣṭirūpaṃ syādīśvarādicatuṣṭayam ||
meaning:
मायाशक्तियुतो वामे सकलश्च क्रियाधिकः |
अस्यैव व्यष्टिरूपं स्यादीश्वरादिचतुष्टयम् ||
text_mt: Endowed with the energy of Māyā on his left, he is possessing form and has activity in excess. / The group of four beginning with Īśvara is the particularised form of him alone:

sanskrit_iast:
īśo viśveśvaraḥ paścātparameśastataḥ param |
sarveśvara itīdaṃ tu tirodhācakramuttamam ||
meaning:
ईशो विश्वेश्वरः पश्चात्परमेशस्ततः परम् |
सर्वेश्वर इतीदं तु तिरोधाचक्रमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Īśa, then Viśveśvara, then Parameśa, / and Sarveśvara: this is the excellent wheel of concealment.

sanskrit_iast:
tirobhāvo dvidhā bhinna eko rudrādigocaraḥ |
anyaśca dehabhāvena paśuvargasya santateḥ ||
meaning:
तिरोभावो द्विधा भिन्न एको रुद्रादिगोचरः |
अन्यश्च देहभावेन पशुवर्गस्य सन्ततेः ||
text_mt: Concealment is divided into two: one pertains to Rudra and others, / and the other, through bodily existence, to the continuous succession of the class of bound souls.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogānurañjanaparaḥ karmasāmyakṣaṇāvadhi |
karmasāmye sa ekaḥ syādanugrahamayo vibhuḥ ||
meaning:
भोगानुरञ्जनपरः कर्मसाम्यक्षणावधि |
कर्मसाम्ये स एकः स्यादनुग्रहमयो विभुः ||
text_mt: Intent upon delight in enjoyments until the moment of the equilibration of karma; / at the equilibration of karma, that single, all-pervading Lord becomes full of grace.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sarveśvarā yāste devatāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
parabrahmātmakāḥ sākṣānnirvikalpā nirāmayāḥ ||
meaning:
तत्र सर्वेश्वरा यास्ते देवताः परिकीर्तिताः |
परब्रह्मात्मकाः साक्षान्निर्विकल्पा निरामयाः ||
text_mt: The deities who are proclaimed there, the Sarveśvaras, / directly embody the supreme Brahman, free of conceptual differentiation and free of affliction.

sanskrit_iast:
tirobhāvātmakaṃ cakraṃ bhavecchāntikalāmayam |
maheśvarādhiṣṭhitaṃ ca padametadanuttamam ||
etadeva padaṃ prāpyaṃ maheśapadasevinām |
māheśvarāṇāṃ sālokyakramādeva vimuktidam ||
meaning:
तिरोभावात्मकं चक्रं भवेच्छान्तिकलामयम् |
महेश्वराधिष्ठितं च पदमेतदनुत्तमम् ||
एतदेव पदं प्राप्यं महेशपदसेविनाम् |
माहेश्वराणां सालोक्यक्रमादेव विमुक्तिदम् ||
text_mt:
The wheel of concealment consists of the Śānti energy; / presided over by Maheśvara, this abode is unsurpassed.

This very abode is to be attained by those who attend upon the station of Maheśa; / for Māheśvaras, it grants liberation precisely through the sequence of co-presence.

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvarasahasrāṃśād rudramūrtirajāyata |
aghoravadanākārastejastattvādhipaśca saḥ ||
meaning:
महेश्वरसहस्रांशाद् रुद्रमूर्तिरजायत |
अघोरवदनाकारस्तेजस्तत्त्वाधिपश्च सः ||
text_mt: From a thousandth part of Maheśvara arose the form of Rudra; / he has the appearance of the face of Aghora and is the ruler of the fire element.

sanskrit_iast:
gaurīśaktiyuto vāme sarvasaṃhārakṛtprabhuḥ |
asyaiva vyaṣṭirūpaṃ syācchivādyatha catuṣṭayam ||
meaning:
गौरीशक्तियुतो वामे सर्वसंहारकृत्प्रभुः |
अस्यैव व्यष्टिरूपं स्याच्छिवाद्यथ चतुष्टयम् ||
text_mt: Endowed with the Gaurī energy on his left, he is the Lord, the destroyer of all; / the group of four beginning with Śiva is the particularised form of him alone:

sanskrit_iast:
śivo haro mṛḍabhavau viditaṃ cakramadbhutam |
saṃhārākhyaṃ mahādivyaṃ paramaṃ hi munīśvara ||
meaning:
शिवो हरो मृडभवौ विदितं चक्रमद्भुतम् |
संहाराख्यं महादिव्यं परमं हि मुनीश्वर ||
text_mt: Śiva, Hara, Mṛḍa, and Bhava; known as the wondrous wheel, / this supreme, greatly divine [wheel] is called dissolution, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
sa saṃhārastridhā prokto budhairnityādibhedataḥ |
nityo jīvasuṣuptyākhyo vidhernaimittikaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
स संहारस्त्रिधा प्रोक्तो बुधैर्नित्यादिभेदतः |
नित्यो जीवसुषुप्त्याख्यो विधेर्नैमित्तिकः स्मृतः ||
text_mt: That dissolution is declared by the wise to be threefold, through the division into eternal and the like: / the eternal is named the deep sleep of the soul; that of the Creator is traditionally considered occasional;

sanskrit_iast:
vilayastasya tu mahāniti vedanidarśitaḥ |
jīvānāṃ janmaduḥkhādiśāntānāmuṣitātmanām ||
meaning:
विलयस्तस्य तु महानिति वेदनिदर्शितः |
जीवानां जन्मदुःखादिशान्तानामुषितात्मनाम् ||
text_mt: his dissolution, however, is the great [dissolution]: so it is indicated by the Veda. / For the sake of rest of the souls, who are weary of the sufferings of birth and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
viśrāntyarthaṃ muniśreṣṭha karmaṇāṃ pākahetave |
saṃhāraḥ kalpitastredhā rudreṇāmitatejasā ||
meaning:
विश्रान्त्यर्थं मुनिश्रेष्ठ कर्मणां पाकहेतवे |
संहारः कल्पितस्त्रेधा रुद्रेणामिततेजसा ||
text_mt: and for the ripening of their karmas, O best of sages, / dissolution has been conceived as threefold by Rudra of boundless splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
rudrasyaiva tu kṛtyānāṃ trayametadudāhṛtam |
saṃhṛtavapi sṛṣṭyādikṛtyānāṃ pañcakaṃ vibhoḥ ||
meaning:
रुद्रस्यैव तु कृत्यानां त्रयमेतदुदाहृतम् |
संहृतवपि सृष्ट्यादिकृत्यानां पञ्चकं विभोः ||
text_mt: This triad of actions is cited as belonging to Rudra alone; / even in dissolution, the all-pervading Lord possesses the group of five actions, beginning with creation.

sanskrit_iast:
mune tatra bhavādyāste devatāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
parabrahmasvarūpāśca lokānugrahakārakāḥ ||
meaning:
मुने तत्र भवाद्यास्ते देवताः परिकीर्तिताः |
परब्रह्मस्वरूपाश्च लोकानुग्रहकारकाः ||
text_mt: O sage, those deities beginning with Bhava are proclaimed there; / embodying the supreme Brahman, they bestow grace upon the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhārākhyamidaṃ cakraṃ vidyārūpakalāmayam |
adhiṣṭhitaṃ ca rudreṇa padametannirāmayam ||
etadeva padaṃ prāpyaṃ rudrārādhanakāṅkṣiṇām |
rudrāṇāṃ taddhi sālokyakramātsāyujyadaṃ mune ||
meaning:
संहाराख्यमिदं चक्रं विद्यारूपकलामयम् |
अधिष्ठितं च रुद्रेण पदमेतन्निरामयम् ||
एतदेव पदं प्राप्यं रुद्राराधनकाङ्क्षिणाम् |
रुद्राणां तद्धि सालोक्यक्रमात्सायुज्यदं मुने ||
text_mt:
This wheel called dissolution consists of the energy of knowledge; / and this disease-free abode is presided over by Rudra.

This very abode is to be attained by those who desire the worship of Rudra; / for Rudras, through the sequence of co-presence, it grants communion, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
rudramūrteḥ sahasrāṃśādviṣṇoścaivābhavajjaniḥ |
sa vāmadevacakrātmā vāritattvaikanāyakaḥ ||
meaning:
रुद्रमूर्तेः सहस्रांशाद्विष्णोश्चैवाभवज्जनिः |
स वामदेवचक्रात्मा वारितत्त्वैकनायकः ||
text_mt: From a thousandth part of the form of Rudra occurred the birth of Viṣṇu; / embodying the wheel of Vāmadeva, he is the sole ruler of the water element.

sanskrit_iast:
ramāśaktiyuto vāme sarvvarakṣākaro mahān |
caturbhujo'ravindākṣaḥ śyāmaḥ śaṅkhādicihnabhṛt ||
meaning:
रमाशक्तियुतो वामे सर्व्वरक्षाकरो महान् |
चतुर्भुजोऽरविन्दाक्षः श्यामः शङ्खादिचिह्नभृत् ||
text_mt: Endowed with the Ramā energy on his left, he is the great protector of all, / four-armed, lotus-eyed, dark, bearing the conch and other emblems.

sanskrit_iast:
asyaiva vāsudevādicatuṣkaṃ vyaṣṭitāṃ gatam |
upāsanaratānāṃ vai vaiṣṇavānāṃ vimuktidam ||
meaning:
अस्यैव वासुदेवादिचतुष्कं व्यष्टितां गतम् |
उपासनरतानां वै वैष्णवानां विमुक्तिदम् ||
text_mt: The group of four beginning with Vāsudeva has become his particulars, / granting liberation indeed to Vaiṣṇavas devoted to worship:

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevo'niruddhaśca tataḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ paraḥ |
pradyumnaśceti vikhyātaṃ sthiticakramanuttamam ||
meaning:
वासुदेवोऽनिरुद्धश्च ततः सङ्कर्षणः परः |
प्रद्युम्नश्चेति विख्यातं स्थितिचक्रमनुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: Vāsudeva and Aniruddha, then the supreme Saṅkarṣaṇa, / and Pradyumna: this is renowned as the unsurpassed wheel of maintenance.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitiḥ sṛṣṭasya jagatastatkartrā saha pālanam |
ārabdhakarmabhogāntaṃ jīvānāṃ phalabhoginām ||
meaning:
स्थितिः सृष्टस्य जगतस्तत्कर्त्रा सह पालनम् |
आरब्धकर्मभोगान्तं जीवानां फलभोगिनाम् ||
text_mt: Maintenance is the preservation of the created world along with its creator, / until the end of the enjoyment of commenced karmas for souls experiencing results.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇorevedamākhyātaṃ kṛtyaṃ rakṣāvidhāyinaḥ |
sthitāvapi tu sṛṣṭyādikṛtyānāṃ pañcakaṃ vibhoḥ ||
meaning:
विष्णोरेवेदमाख्यातं कृत्यं रक्षाविधायिनः |
स्थितावपि तु सृष्ट्यादिकृत्यानां पञ्चकं विभोः ||
text_mt: This action is declared to belong to Viṣṇu alone, the author of protection; / but even in maintenance, the all-pervading Lord has a group of five actions, beginning with creation.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra pradyumnamukhyāste devatāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
nirvikalpā nirātaṅkā muktānandakarāḥ sadā ||
meaning:
तत्र प्रद्युम्नमुख्यास्ते देवताः परिकीर्तिताः |
निर्विकल्पा निरातङ्का मुक्तानन्दकराः सदा ||
text_mt: Those deities there, headed by Pradyumna, are proclaimed / to be free from conceptual differentiation, free of fear, and always bestowers of the bliss of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sthiticakramidaṃ brahman pratiṣṭhārūpamuttamam |
janārdanādhiṣṭhitaṃ ca paramaṃ padamucyate ||
meaning:
स्थितिचक्रमिदं ब्रह्मन् प्रतिष्ठारूपमुत्तमम् |
जनार्दनाधिष्ठितं च परमं पदमुच्यते ||
text_mt: This wheel of maintenance, O brahmin, is the excellent form of Pratiṣṭhā; / and presided over by Janārdana, it is called the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
evadeva padaṃ prāpyaṃ viṣṇupādābjasevinām |
vaiṣṇavānāṃ cakramidaṃ sālokyādipadapradam ||
viṣṇoreva sahasrāṃśātsambabhūva pitāmahaḥ |
sadyojātamukhātmā yaḥ pṛthivītattvanāyakaḥ ||
meaning:
एवदेव पदं प्राप्यं विष्णुपादाब्जसेविनाम् |
वैष्णवानां चक्रमिदं सालोक्यादिपदप्रदम् ||
विष्णोरेव सहस्रांशात्सम्बभूव पितामहः |
सद्योजातमुखात्मा यः पृथिवीतत्त्वनायकः ||
text_mt:
This very state is to be attained by those who serve the lotus feet of Viṣṇu; / this wheel bestows the state of dwelling in the same world and the rest upon Vaiṣṇavas.

From a thousandth fraction of Viṣṇu himself was born the Grandfather, / whose self is the face of Sadyojāta, who is the ruler of the element earth,

sanskrit_iast:
vāgdevīsahito vāme sṛṣṭikarttā jagatprabhuḥ |
caturmukho raktavarṇo rajorūpasvarūpavān ||
meaning:
वाग्देवीसहितो वामे सृष्टिकर्त्ता जगत्प्रभुः |
चतुर्मुखो रक्तवर्णो रजोरूपस्वरूपवान् ||
text_mt: accompanied by the goddess of speech on his left, the creator of creation, the lord of the world, / four-faced, red in complexion, whose essential nature consists of the quality of passion.

sanskrit_iast:
hiṇyagarbhādyasyaiva vyaṣṭirūpaṃ catuṣṭayam |
hiraṇyagarbho'tha virāṭ puruṣaḥ kāla eva ca ||
meaning:
हिण्यगर्भाद्यस्यैव व्यष्टिरूपं चतुष्टयम् |
हिरण्यगर्भोऽथ विराट् पुरुषः काल एव च ||
text_mt: His individualized manifestation is indeed a fourfold set beginning with Hiraṇyagarbha: / Hiraṇyagarbha, then Virāṭ, Puruṣa, and Kāla itself.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭicakramidaṃ brahma putrādiṛṣisevitam |
sarvakāmārthadaṃ brahmanparivārasukhapradam ||
meaning:
सृष्टिचक्रमिदं ब्रह्म पुत्रादिऋषिसेवितम् |
सर्वकामार्थदं ब्रह्मन्परिवारसुखप्रदम् ||
text_mt: This is the wheel of Brahmā, the wheel of creation, served by his sons and other sages, / granting all desired ends, O sage, and bestowing the happiness of family.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭistu saṃhṛtasyāsya jīvasya prakṛtau bahiḥ |
ānīya karmabhogārthaṃ sādhanāṅgaphalaissaha ||
meaning:
सृष्टिस्तु संहृतस्यास्य जीवस्य प्रकृतौ बहिः |
आनीय कर्मभोगार्थं साधनाङ्गफलैस्सह ||
text_mt: Creation, however, consists in bringing out into nature the individual soul that was withdrawn, / for the experience of its deeds along with the means, auxiliaries, and fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyojanamitīdaṃ tu kṛtyaṃ paitāmahaṃ viduḥ |
jagatsṛṣṭikriyāvijñā yāvad vyūhaṃ sukhāvaham ||
meaning:
संयोजनमितीदं तु कृत्यं पैतामहं विदुः |
जगत्सृष्टिक्रियाविज्ञा यावद् व्यूहं सुखावहम् ||
text_mt: and conjoining it [with them]—this the knowers of the act of world-creation / recognize as the task belonging to the Grandfather, as far as the array that brings happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
jagatsṛṣṭāvapi mune kṛtyānāṃ ca pañcakaṃ vibhoḥ |
asti kālodayastatra devatāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
meaning:
जगत्सृष्टावपि मुने कृत्यानां च पञ्चकं विभोः |
अस्ति कालोदयस्तत्र देवताः परिकीर्तिताः ||
text_mt: Even in the creation of the world, O sage, the fivefold task belongs to the omnipresent Lord; / the rise of time is there, and the deities are celebrated.

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttirūpamākhyātaṃ sṛṣṭicakramidaṃ budhaiḥ |
pitāmahādhiṣṭhitaṃ ca padametaddhi śobhanam ||
meaning:
निवृत्तिरूपमाख्यातं सृष्टिचक्रमिदं बुधैः |
पितामहाधिष्ठितं च पदमेतद्धि शोभनम् ||
text_mt: This wheel of creation is declared by the wise to consist of cessation; / presided over by the Grandfather, this station is indeed splendid.

sanskrit_iast:
etadeva pradaṃ prāpyaṃ brahmārpitadhiyāṃ nṛṇām |
paitāmahānāmetaddhi sālokyādivimuktidam ||
meaning:
एतदेव प्रदं प्राप्यं ब्रह्मार्पितधियां नृणाम् |
पैतामहानामेतद्धि सालोक्यादिविमुक्तिदम् ||
text_mt: This very station is to be attained by men whose intellect is surrendered to Brahmā; / for devotees of the Grandfather, it indeed bestows liberation such as dwelling in the same world.

sanskrit_iast:
asminnapi catuṣke tu cakrāṇāṃ praṇavo bhavet |
maheśādikramādeva gauṇyā vṛttyā sa vācakaḥ ||
idaṃ khalu jagaccakraṃ śrutiviśrutavaibhavam |
pañcāraṃ cakramiti ha stauti śrutiridaṃ mune ||
meaning:
अस्मिन्नपि चतुष्के तु चक्राणां प्रणवो भवेत् |
महेशादिक्रमादेव गौण्या वृत्त्या स वाचकः ||
इदं खलु जगच्चक्रं श्रुतिविश्रुतवैभवम् |
पञ्चारं चक्रमिति ह स्तौति श्रुतिरिदं मुने ||
text_mt:
Even in this tetrad of wheels, the praṇava is present; / in the order beginning with Maheśa, it is their expressive word by secondary signification.

This indeed is the world-wheel whose majesty is celebrated in the Vedas; / the Veda praises this, O sage, as the five-spoked wheel.

sanskrit_iast:
ekameva jagaccakraṃ śambhoḥ śaktivijṛmbhitam |
sṛṣṭyādipañcāvayavaṃ pañcāramiti kathyate ||
meaning:
एकमेव जगच्चक्रं शम्भोः शक्तिविजृम्भितम् |
सृष्ट्यादिपञ्चावयवं पञ्चारमिति कथ्यते ||
text_mt: The world-wheel is only one, the manifestation of the power of Śambhu; / having five parts beginning with creation, it is called five-spoked.

sanskrit_iast:
alātacakrabhramivadavicchinnalayodayam |
parito vartate yasmāttasmāccakramitīritam ||
meaning:
अलातचक्रभ्रमिवदविच्छिन्नलयोदयम् |
परितो वर्तते यस्मात्तस्माच्चक्रमितीरितम् ||
text_mt: Because it revolves all around like the circling of a firebrand, / with uninterrupted dissolution and rising, it is spoken of as a wheel.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭyādipṛthusṛṣṭitvātpṛthutvenopadṛśyate |
hiraṇmayasya devasya śambhoramitatejasaḥ ||
meaning:
सृष्ट्यादिपृथुसृष्टित्वात्पृथुत्वेनोपदृश्यते |
हिरण्मयस्य देवस्य शम्भोरमिततेजसः ||
text_mt: Because it creates broadly through creation and the rest, it is seen as vast. / Of the golden god, of Śambhu of unmeasured splendor,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktikāryamidaṃ cakraṃ hiraṇyajyotirāśritam |
salilenāvṛtamidaṃ salilaṃ vahnināvṛtam ||
meaning:
शक्तिकार्यमिदं चक्रं हिरण्यज्योतिराश्रितम् |
सलिलेनावृतमिदं सलिलं वह्निनावृतम् ||
text_mt: this wheel is the effect of his power, resorting to golden light. / It is enveloped by water, and the water is enveloped by fire;

sanskrit_iast:
āvṛto vāyunā vahnirākāśenāvṛtaṃ mahat |
bhūtādinā tathākāśo bhūtādirmahatāvṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
आवृतो वायुना वह्निराकाशेनावृतं महत् |
भूतादिना तथाकाशो भूतादिर्महतावृतः ||
text_mt: fire is enveloped by wind; the great [principle] is enveloped by space; / space likewise by the origin of elements, and the origin of elements is enveloped by the great [principle];

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktenāvṛtastadvanmahānityevamāstikaiḥ |
brahmāṇḍamiti samproktamācāryairmunisattama ||
meaning:
अव्यक्तेनावृतस्तद्वन्महानित्येवमास्तिकैः |
ब्रह्माण्डमिति सम्प्रोक्तमाचार्यैर्मुनिसत्तम ||
text_mt: similarly the great [principle] is enveloped by the unmanifest—thus by the faithful, / by the teachers, it is declared to be the cosmic egg, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
uktāni saptāvaraṇānyasya viśvasya guptaye |
cakrāddaśaguṇādhikyaṃ salilasya vidhīyate ||
meaning:
उक्तानि सप्तावरणान्यस्य विश्वस्य गुप्तये |
चक्राद्दशगुणाधिक्यं सलिलस्य विधीयते ||
text_mt: Seven coverings are spoken of for the protection of this universe; / a tenfold increase beyond the wheel is prescribed for water.

sanskrit_iast:
uparyupari cānyo'nyamevaṃ daśaguṇādhikam |
brahmāṇḍamiti vijñeyaṃ tad vijairmunināyaka ||
meaning:
उपर्युपरि चान्योऽन्यमेवं दशगुणाधिकम् |
ब्रह्माण्डमिति विज्ञेयं तद् विजैर्मुनिनायक ||
text_mt: Above and beyond, each is thus ten times greater than the other; / this should be known as the cosmic egg by those who know it, O leader of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
imamarthamurīkṛtya cakrasāmīpyavarttanāt |
salilasya ca tanmadhye iti prāha śrutiḥ svayam ||
anugrahatirobhāvasaṃhṛtisthitisṛṣṭibhiḥ |
karotyavirataṃ līlāmekaḥ śaktiyutaḥ śivaḥ ||
meaning:
इममर्थमुरीकृत्य चक्रसामीप्यवर्त्तनात् |
सलिलस्य च तन्मध्ये इति प्राह श्रुतिः स्वयम् ||
अनुग्रहतिरोभावसंहृतिस्थितिसृष्टिभिः |
करोत्यविरतं लीलामेकः शक्तियुतः शिवः ||
text_mt:
Accepting this meaning, on account of its existence near the wheel / and water in the middle of it, the Veda itself spoke thus.

Through grace, concealment, destruction, preservation, and creation, / the one Śiva, endowed with power, ceaselessly performs his sport.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuneha kimuktena mune sāraṃ vadāmi te |
śiva evedamakhilaṃ śaktimāniti niścitam ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
oṃ namaḥ śivāya ||
ṣaṣṭhī kailāsasaṃhitā
meaning:
बहुनेह किमुक्तेन मुने सारं वदामि ते |
शिव एवेदमखिलं शक्तिमानिति निश्चितम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
ओं नमः शिवाय ||
षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता
text_mt:
What is the use of much said here, O sage? I tell you the essence: / all this is indeed Śiva, the possessor of power; this is certain.

Obeisance to the auspicious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

The Sixth, the Kailāsasaṃhitā.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
śrutvopadiṣṭaṃ guruṇā vedārthaṃ munipuṅgavaḥ |
paramātmani sandigdhaṃ paripapraccha sādaram ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
श्रुत्वोपदिष्टं गुरुणा वेदार्थं मुनिपुङ्गवः |
परमात्मनि सन्दिग्धं परिपप्रच्छ सादरम् ||
title: ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivatattvavarṇanam
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard the meaning of the Veda taught by his guru, the eminent sage, / having doubts concerning the supreme Self, respectfully inquired.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmadeva uvāca |
jñānaśaktidhara svāminparamānandavigraha |
praṇavārthāmṛtaṃ pītaṃ śrīmukhābjātparisrutam ||
meaning:
वामदेव उवाच |
ज्ञानशक्तिधर स्वामिन्परमानन्दविग्रह |
प्रणवार्थामृतं पीतं श्रीमुखाब्जात्परिस्रुतम् ||
text_mt: Vāmadeva said: / O wielder of the power of knowledge, O master, O embodiment of supreme bliss, / the nectar of the meaning of the praṇava that flowed from your auspicious lotus face has been drunk.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛḍhaprajñaśca jāto'smi sandeho vigato mama |
kiñcidanyanmahāsena pṛcchāmi tvāṃ śṛṇu prabho ||
meaning:
दृढप्रज्ञश्च जातोऽस्मि सन्देहो विगतो मम |
किञ्चिदन्यन्महासेन पृच्छामि त्वां शृणु प्रभो ||
text_mt: My intellect has become firm, and my doubt has departed. / I ask you something else, O Mahāsena; listen, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivādikīṭāntarūpasya jagataḥ sthitiḥ |
strīpuṃrūpeṇa sarvatra dṛśyate na hi saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
सदाशिवादिकीटान्तरूपस्य जगतः स्थितिः |
स्त्रीपुंरूपेण सर्वत्र दृश्यते न हि संशयः ||
text_mt: The maintenance of the universe, whose forms range from Sadāśiva to a worm, / is everywhere seen in male and female form; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ rūpasya jagataḥ kāraṇaṃ yatsanātanam |
strīrūpaṃ tatkimāhosvitpuruṣo vā napuṃsakam ||
meaning:
एवं रूपस्य जगतः कारणं यत्सनातनम् |
स्त्रीरूपं तत्किमाहोस्वित्पुरुषो वा नपुंसकम् ||
text_mt: What is the eternal cause of a universe of such a form? / Is it female in form, or indeed male, or neuter,

sanskrit_iast:
uta miśraṃ kimanyadvā na jātastatra nirṇayaḥ |
bahudhā vivadantīha vidvāṃsaḥ śāstramohitāḥ ||
meaning:
उत मिश्रं किमन्यद्वा न जातस्तत्र निर्णयः |
बहुधा विवदन्तीह विद्वांसः शास्त्रमोहिताः ||
text_mt: or mixed, or what else? No conclusion has been reached there; / the learned here dispute in many ways, deluded by the treatises.

sanskrit_iast:
jagatsṛṣṭividhāyinyaḥ śrutayo jagatā saha |
viṣṇubrahmādayo devāḥ siddhāśca na vidanti hi ||
meaning:
जगत्सृष्टिविधायिन्यः श्रुतयो जगता सह |
विष्णुब्रह्मादयो देवाः सिद्धाश्च न विदन्ति हि ||
text_mt: The Vedas that prescribe the creation of the world, along with the world, / the gods beginning with Viṣṇu and Brahmā, and the perfected ones do not know [it].

sanskrit_iast:
yathaikyabhāvaṃ gaccheyuretadanyacca vedaya |
jānāmīti karomīti vyavahāraḥ pradṛśyate ||
meaning:
यथैक्यभावं गच्छेयुरेतदन्यच्च वेदय |
जानामीति करोमीति व्यवहारः प्रदृश्यते ||
text_mt: Make known how they might attain unity, and explain this other matter as well: / the worldly convention 'I know,' 'I act' is observed;

sanskrit_iast:
sa hi sarvātmasaṃsiddho vivādo nātra kasyacit |
sarvadehendriyamanobuddhyahaṅkārasambhavaḥ ||
āhosvidātmano rūpaṃ mahānatrāpi saṃśayaḥ |
dvayametaddhi sarveṣāṃ vivādāspadamadbhutam ||
meaning:
स हि सर्वात्मसंसिद्धो विवादो नात्र कस्यचित् |
सर्वदेहेन्द्रियमनोबुद्ध्यहङ्कारसम्भवः ||
आहोस्विदात्मनो रूपं महानत्रापि संशयः |
द्वयमेतद्धि सर्वेषां विवादास्पदमद्भुतम् ||
text_mt:
for it is established in all selves, and there is no dispute about this among anyone. / Does it arise from all the bodies, sense organs, mind, intellect, and egoism,

or is it the nature of the Self? Here too there is a great doubt; / for these two are a wondrous ground of dispute for everyone.

sanskrit_iast:
utpāṭyājñānasambhūtaṃ saṃśayākhyaṃ viṣadrumam |
śivādvaitamahākalpavṛkṣabhūmiryathā bhavet ||
meaning:
उत्पाट्याज्ञानसम्भूतं संशयाख्यं विषद्रुमम् |
शिवाद्वैतमहाकल्पवृक्षभूमिर्यथा भवेत् ||
text_mt: Having uprooted the poisonous tree called doubt, born of ignorance, / so that my mind may become the ground for the great wish-fulfilling tree of Śiva's non-duality,

sanskrit_iast:
cittaṃ mama yathā deva bodhyo'smi kṛpayā tava |
kṛpātastava deveśa dṛḍhajñānī bhavāmyaham ||
meaning:
चित्तं मम यथा देव बोध्योऽस्मि कृपया तव |
कृपातस्तव देवेश दृढज्ञानी भवाम्यहम् ||
text_mt: I must be enlightened by your grace, O god; / by your grace, O Lord of gods, may I become firm in knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
śrutvaivaṃ muninā pṛṣṭaṃ vaco vedāntanirvṛtam |
rahasyaṃ prabhurāhedaṃ kiñcitprahasitānanaḥ ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
श्रुत्वैवं मुनिना पृष्टं वचो वेदान्तनिर्वृतम् |
रहस्यं प्रभुराहेदं किञ्चित्प्रहसिताननः ||
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard these words inquiring into the Vedanta, uttered by the sage, / the Lord, his face slightly smiling, spoke this secret.

sanskrit_iast:
subrahmaṇya uvāca |
etadeva mune guhyaṃ śivena paribhāṣitam |
ambāyāḥ śṛṇvato devyā vāmadeva mamāpi hi ||
meaning:
सुब्रह्मण्य उवाच |
एतदेव मुने गुह्यं शिवेन परिभाषितम् |
अम्बायाः शृण्वतो देव्या वामदेव ममापि हि ||
text_mt: Subrahmaṇya said: / This very secret, O sage, was expounded by Śiva / as the goddess Mother was listening, and I too, O Vāmadeva.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ stanyaṃ tadā pītvā santṛpto'smi muhurmuhuḥ |
śrutavānniścalaṃ tadvai niścitaṃ me vicāritam ||
meaning:
तस्याः स्तन्यं तदा पीत्वा सन्तृप्तोऽस्मि मुहुर्मुहुः |
श्रुतवान्निश्चलं तद्वै निश्चितं मे विचारितम् ||
text_mt: Having drunk her breast milk then, I was satisfied again and again; / I heard it attentively, and indeed considered it firmly in my mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tatte vadāmi dayayā vāmadeva mahāmune |
mahadguhyaṃ ca paramaṃ suta tvaṃ śṛṇu sāmpratam ||
meaning:
तत्ते वदामि दयया वामदेव महामुने |
महद्गुह्यं च परमं सुत त्वं शृणु साम्प्रतम् ||
text_mt: Out of compassion, O great sage Vāmadeva, I tell you that / which is a great and supreme secret; listen now, O son.

sanskrit_iast:
karmāsti tattvādārabhya śāstravādaḥ suvistaraḥ |
yathāvivekaṃ śrotavyo jñāninā jñānado mune ||
meaning:
कर्मास्ति तत्त्वादारभ्य शास्त्रवादः सुविस्तरः |
यथाविवेकं श्रोतव्यो ज्ञानिना ज्ञानदो मुने ||
text_mt: Beginning from the principle 'action exists,' the discourse of the treatises is very extensive; / it should be heard with discrimination by the wise one, as it gives knowledge, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayopadiṣṭā ye śiṣyāstatra ko vā bhavatsamaḥ |
kapilādiṣu śāstreṣu bhramantyadyāpi te'dhamāḥ ||
meaning:
त्वयोपदिष्टा ये शिष्यास्तत्र को वा भवत्समः |
कपिलादिषु शास्त्रेषु भ्रमन्त्यद्यापि तेऽधमाः ||
text_mt: Among those disciples instructed by you, who indeed is equal to you? / Those vile ones still wander about in the doctrines of Kapila and others.

sanskrit_iast:
te śaptā munibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ śivanindāparāḥ purā |
na śrotavyā hi tadvārttā te'nyathāvādino yataḥ ||
anumānaprayogasyāpyavakāśo'trana vidyate |
pañcāvayavayuktasya sa tu dhūmasya darśanāt ||
meaning:
ते शप्ता मुनिभिः षड्भिः शिवनिन्दापराः पुरा |
न श्रोतव्या हि तद्वार्त्ता तेऽन्यथावादिनो यतः ||
अनुमानप्रयोगस्याप्यवकाशोऽत्रन विद्यते |
पञ्चावयवयुक्तस्य स तु धूमस्य दर्शनात् ||
text_mt:
They were cursed of old by the six sages, being intent on reviling Śiva; / news of them should not even be heard, because they teach otherwise.

Nor is there scope here for the application of inference / endowed with five members; for that, from the sight of smoke,

sanskrit_iast:
parvatasyāgnimadbhāvaṃ vadantyatrāpi suvrata |
pratyakṣasya prapañcasya darśanālambanaṃ tvataḥ ||
meaning:
पर्वतस्याग्निमद्भावं वदन्त्यत्रापि सुव्रत |
प्रत्यक्षस्य प्रपञ्चस्य दर्शनालम्बनं त्वतः ||
text_mt: states the mountain's possession of fire. Even here, O you of good vows, / by taking the sight of the perceptible manifest universe as a support,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātavyaḥ parameśānaḥ paramātmā na saṃśayaḥ |
strīpuṃrūpamayaṃ viśvaṃ pratyakṣeṇaiva dṛśyate ||
meaning:
ज्ञातव्यः परमेशानः परमात्मा न संशयः |
स्त्रीपुंरूपमयं विश्वं प्रत्यक्षेणैव दृश्यते ||
text_mt: Parameśāna, the supreme Self, is to be known without doubt; / the universe consisting of male and female forms is seen directly through perception alone.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkośarūpaḥ piṇḍo hi tatra cādyatrayaṃ bhavet |
mātraṃśajaṃ punaścānyatpitraṃśajamiti śrutiḥ ||
meaning:
षट्कोशरूपः पिण्डो हि तत्र चाद्यत्रयं भवेत् |
मात्रंशजं पुनश्चान्यत्पित्रंशजमिति श्रुतिः ||
text_mt: The body indeed consists of six sheaths, and among them the first triad / is born from the mother's share, and the other from the father's share—so says the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sarvaśarīreṣu strīpumbhāvavido janāḥ |
paramātmanyapi mune strīpumbhāvaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ||
meaning:
एवं सर्वशरीरेषु स्त्रीपुम्भावविदो जनाः |
परमात्मन्यपि मुने स्त्रीपुम्भावं विदुर्बुधाः ||
text_mt: Thus people recognize the nature of female and male in all bodies; / in the Supreme Self also, O sage, the wise recognize the nature of female and male.

sanskrit_iast:
saccidānadarūpatvaṃ vadati brahmaṇaḥ śrutiḥ |
asannivartakaḥ śabdaḥ sadātmeti nigadyate ||
meaning:
सच्चिदानदरूपत्वं वदति ब्रह्मणः श्रुतिः |
असन्निवर्तकः शब्दः सदात्मेति निगद्यते ||
text_mt: Scripture declares that Brahman has the nature of being, consciousness, and bliss. / The word that negates non-being is declared to be 'the Self that is being'.

sanskrit_iast:
nivartanaṃ jaḍatvasya cicchabdena vidhīyate |
triliṅgavartī sacchabdaḥ puruṣo'tra vidhīyatām ||
meaning:
निवर्तनं जडत्वस्य चिच्छब्देन विधीयते |
त्रिलिङ्गवर्ती सच्छब्दः पुरुषोऽत्र विधीयताम् ||
text_mt: The negation of insentience is effected by the word 'consciousness'. / The word 'being' operates in all three genders; here let it be designated masculine.

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśavācī sa bhavetsatprakāśa iti sphuṭam |
jñānaśabdasya paryāyaścicchabdaḥ strītvamāgataḥ ||
meaning:
प्रकाशवाची स भवेत्सत्प्रकाश इति स्फुटम् |
ज्ञानशब्दस्य पर्यायश्चिच्छब्दः स्त्रीत्वमागतः ||
text_mt: It expresses light: 'being is light'—this is clear. / The word 'consciousness', a synonym of the word 'knowledge', assumes the feminine gender.

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśaścicca mithunaṃ jagatkāraṇatāṃ gatam |
saccidātmanyapi tathā jagatkāraṇatāṃ gate ||
meaning:
प्रकाशश्चिच्च मिथुनं जगत्कारणतां गतम् |
सच्चिदात्मन्यपि तथा जगत्कारणतां गते ||
text_mt: Light and consciousness are a couple that have become the cause of the world; / so too in the Self of being and consciousness that has become the cause of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
ekatraiva śivaḥ śaktiriti bhāvo vidhīyate |
tailavarttyādimālinyātprakāśasyāpi vartate ||
mālinyamaśivatvaṃ ca citāgnyādiṣu dṛśyate |
evaṃ nivartakatvena śivatvaṃ śruticoditam ||
meaning:
एकत्रैव शिवः शक्तिरिति भावो विधीयते |
तैलवर्त्त्यादिमालिन्यात्प्रकाशस्यापि वर्तते ||
मालिन्यमशिवत्वं च चिताग्न्यादिषु दृश्यते |
एवं निवर्तकत्वेन शिवत्वं श्रुतिचोदितम् ||
text_mt:
in one single [principle] the condition of Śiva and Śakti is established. / Just as through the impurity of oil, wick, and the like, light also undergoes [obscuration],

and impurity and inauspiciousness are seen in funeral pyre fires and the like, / thus, by being their negator, Śivahood is enjoined by scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvāśritāyāścicchakterdaurbalyaṃ vidyate sadā |
tannivṛttyarthamevātra śaktitvaṃ sārvakālikam ||
meaning:
जीवाश्रितायाश्चिच्छक्तेर्दौर्बल्यं विद्यते सदा |
तन्निवृत्त्यर्थमेवात्र शक्तित्वं सार्वकालिकम् ||
text_mt: Weakness is always found in the power of consciousness dependent on the bound soul; / precisely for its removal, Śaktihood is ever-present here.

sanskrit_iast:
balavān śaktimāṃśceti vyavahāraḥ pradṛśyate |
loke vede ca satataṃ vāmadeva mahāmune ||
meaning:
बलवान् शक्तिमांश्चेति व्यवहारः प्रदृश्यते |
लोके वेदे च सततं वामदेव महामुने ||
text_mt: 'He is strong and possessed of power'—such common usage is seen / always in the world and in the Veda, O great sage Vāmadeva.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ śivatvaṃ śaktitvaṃ paramātmani darśitam |
śivaśaktyostu saṃyogādānandaḥ satatoditaḥ ||
meaning:
एवं शिवत्वं शक्तित्वं परमात्मनि दर्शितम् |
शिवशक्त्योस्तु संयोगादानन्दः सततोदितः ||
text_mt: Thus the state of Śiva and the state of Śakti are demonstrated in the Supreme Self; / and from the union of Śiva and Śakti, bliss is ever arisen.

sanskrit_iast:
ato mune tamuddiśya munayaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ |
śive manaḥ samādhāya prāptāḥ śivamanāmayam ||
meaning:
अतो मुने तमुद्दिश्य मुनयः क्षीणकल्मषाः |
शिवे मनः समाधाय प्राप्ताः शिवमनामयम् ||
text_mt: Therefore, O sage, with reference to him, sages whose sins are destroyed, / fixing their minds on Śiva, have attained the stainless Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātmatvaṃ tayorevaṃ brahmetyupaniṣatsu ca |
gīyate brahmaśabdena bṛṃhidhātvarthagocaram ||
meaning:
सर्वात्मत्वं तयोरेवं ब्रह्मेत्युपनिषत्सु च |
गीयते ब्रह्मशब्देन बृंहिधात्वर्थगोचरम् ||
text_mt: Their being the Self of all is thus sung as 'Brahman' in the Upaniṣads, / through the word 'Brahman' which falls within the meaning of the root bṛṃh-.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛṃhaṇatvaṃ bṛhatvaṃ ca śambhvākhyavigrahe |
pañcabrahmamaye viśvapratītirbrahmaśabditā ||
meaning:
बृंहणत्वं बृहत्वं च शम्भ्वाख्यविग्रहे |
पञ्चब्रह्ममये विश्वप्रतीतिर्ब्रह्मशब्दिता ||
text_mt: Expansion and greatness reside in the embodiment called Śambhu; / in him who consists of the five Brahmans, perception of the universe is designated by the word 'Brahman'.

sanskrit_iast:
pratilomātmakaṃ haṃse vakṣyāmi praṇavodbhavam |
tava snehādvāmadeva sāvadhānatayā śṛṇu ||
meaning:
प्रतिलोमात्मकं हंसे वक्ष्यामि प्रणवोद्भवम् |
तव स्नेहाद्वामदेव सावधानतया शृणु ||
text_mt: I shall explain the inverted nature of the praṇava that arises from haṃsa. / Out of affection for you, Vāmadeva, listen attentively.

sanskrit_iast:
vyañjanasya sakārasya hakārasya ca varjanāt |
omityeva bhavetsthūlo vācakaḥ paramātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
व्यञ्जनस्य सकारस्य हकारस्य च वर्जनात् |
ओमित्येव भवेत्स्थूलो वाचकः परमात्मनः ||
text_mt: By dropping the consonants s and h, / OM alone becomes the gross expressor of the Supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmantraḥ sa vijñeyo munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ |
tatra sūkṣmo mahāmantrastaduddhāraṃ vadāmi te ||
ādye tripañcarūpe ca svare ṣoḍaśake triṣu |
mahāmantro bhavedādau sasakāro bhavedyadā ||
meaning:
महामन्त्रः स विज्ञेयो मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः |
तत्र सूक्ष्मो महामन्त्रस्तदुद्धारं वदामि ते ||
आद्ये त्रिपञ्चरूपे च स्वरे षोडशके त्रिषु |
महामन्त्रो भवेदादौ ससकारो भवेद्यदा ||
text_mt:
That great mantra is to be known by sages who see reality. / I shall tell you the extraction of that subtle great mantra therein:

Among the first fifteen vowels, and among the three of the sixteen, / it becomes the great mantra at first, when it is accompanied by the sound s.

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsasya pratilomaḥ syātsakārārthaḥ śivaḥ smṛtaḥ |
śaktyātmako mahāmantravācyaḥ syāditi nirṇayaḥ ||
meaning:
हंसस्य प्रतिलोमः स्यात्सकारार्थः शिवः स्मृतः |
शक्त्यात्मको महामन्त्रवाच्यः स्यादिति निर्णयः ||
text_mt: It would be the reverse of haṃsa; the meaning of the sound s is remembered as Śiva. / It is determined that what is expressed by the great mantra consists of Śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
gurūpadeśakāle tu so'haṃśaktyātmakaḥ śivaḥ |
iti jīvaparo bhūyānmahāmantrastadā paśuḥ ||
meaning:
गुरूपदेशकाले तु सोऽहंशक्त्यात्मकः शिवः |
इति जीवपरो भूयान्महामन्त्रस्तदा पशुः ||
text_mt: At the time of the guru's instruction, however, Śiva consists of the Śakti of 'so 'ham' ('I am he'); / thus the great mantra is oriented toward the soul; then [it is] the bound soul.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktyātmakaḥ śivāṃśaśca śivaikyācchivasāmyabhāk |
prajñānaṃ brahmavākye tu prajñānārthaḥ pradṛśyate ||
meaning:
शक्त्यात्मकः शिवांशश्च शिवैक्याच्छिवसाम्यभाक् |
प्रज्ञानं ब्रह्मवाक्ये तु प्रज्ञानार्थः प्रदृश्यते ||
text_mt: Composed of Śakti and a portion of Śiva, through oneness with Śiva he shares equality with Śiva. / And in the statement 'consciousness is Brahman', the meaning of consciousness is perceived.

sanskrit_iast:
prajñānaśabdaścaitanyaparyāyaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ |
caitanyamātmeti mune śivasūtraṃ pravartitam ||
meaning:
प्रज्ञानशब्दश्चैतन्यपर्यायः स्यान्न संशयः |
चैतन्यमात्मेति मुने शिवसूत्रं प्रवर्तितम् ||
text_mt: The word prajñāna is a synonym for caitanya, without doubt. / 'The Self is consciousness', O sage, was taught as a Śivasūtra.

sanskrit_iast:
caitanyamiti viśvasya sarvajñānakriyātmakam |
svātantryaṃ tatsvabhāvo yaḥ sa ātmā parikīrtitaḥ ||
meaning:
चैतन्यमिति विश्वस्य सर्वज्ञानक्रियात्मकम् |
स्वातन्त्र्यं तत्स्वभावो यः स आत्मा परिकीर्तितः ||
text_mt: Consciousness means the freedom consisting of all knowledge and action belonging to the universe; / that which is its inherent nature is proclaimed to be the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
ityādiśivasūtrāṇāṃ vārtikaṃ kathitaṃ mayā |
jñānaṃ bandha itīdaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ sūtramīśituḥ ||
meaning:
इत्यादिशिवसूत्राणां वार्तिकं कथितं मया |
ज्ञानं बन्ध इतीदं तु द्वितीयं सूत्रमीशितुः ||
text_mt: Thus I have spoken the commentary on such Śivasūtras. / 'Knowledge is bondage' is the Lord's second sūtra.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānamityātmanastasya kiñcijjñānakriyātmakam |
ityāhādyapadeneśaḥ paśuvargasya lakṣaṇam ||
meaning:
ज्ञानमित्यात्मनस्तस्य किञ्चिज्ज्ञानक्रियात्मकम् |
इत्याहाद्यपदेनेशः पशुवर्गस्य लक्षणम् ||
text_mt: By the word 'knowledge', the Lord, with the initial word, stated the definition of the class of bound souls / as having limited knowledge and action belonging to that self.

sanskrit_iast:
etad dvayaṃ parāśakteḥ prathamaṃ spandatāṃ gatam |
etāmeva parāṃ śaktiṃ śvetāśvataraśākhinaḥ ||
meaning:
एतद् द्वयं पराशक्तेः प्रथमं स्पन्दतां गतम् |
एतामेव परां शक्तिं श्वेताश्वतरशाखिनः ||
text_mt: This pair first became the vibration of the Supreme Śakti; / this very Supreme Śakti the followers of the Śvetāśvatara school

sanskrit_iast:
svābhāvikī jñānabalakriyā cetyastuvanmudā |
jñānakriyecchārūpaṃ hi śambhordṛṣṭitrayaṃ viduḥ ||
etanmanomadhyagaṃ sadindriyajñānagocaram |
anupraviśya jānāti karoti ca paśuḥ sadā ||
meaning:
स्वाभाविकी ज्ञानबलक्रिया चेत्यस्तुवन्मुदा |
ज्ञानक्रियेच्छारूपं हि शम्भोर्दृष्टित्रयं विदुः ||
एतन्मनोमध्यगं सदिन्द्रियज्ञानगोचरम् |
अनुप्रविश्य जानाति करोति च पशुः सदा ||
text_mt:
gladly praised as 'inherent, consisting of knowledge, power, and action.' / Indeed, they know the threefold vision of Śambhu to consist of knowledge, action, and desire.

Being situated within this mind and falling within the scope of sensory cognition, / entering [it], the bound soul always knows and acts.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādātmana evedaṃ rūpamityeva niścitam |
prapañcārthaṃ pravakṣyāmi praṇavaikyapradarśanam ||
meaning:
तस्मादात्मन एवेदं रूपमित्येव निश्चितम् |
प्रपञ्चार्थं प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रणवैक्यप्रदर्शनम् ||
text_mt: Therefore it is determined that this is the very nature of the Self. / For the purpose of expansion, I shall declare the demonstration of oneness with the praṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
omitīdaṃ sarvamiti śrutirāha sanātanī |
tasmādvetītyupakramya jagatsṛṣṭiḥ prakīrtitā ||
meaning:
ओमितीदं सर्वमिति श्रुतिराह सनातनी |
तस्माद्वेतीत्युपक्रम्य जगत्सृष्टिः प्रकीर्तिता ||
text_mt: 'All this is OM', says the eternal scripture; / beginning with 'from that [Brahman]', the creation of the universe is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ śrutestu tātparyaṃ vakṣyāmi śrūyatāmidam |
tava snehādvāmadeva vivekārthavijṛmbhitam ||
meaning:
तस्याः श्रुतेस्तु तात्पर्यं वक्ष्यामि श्रूयतामिदम् |
तव स्नेहाद्वामदेव विवेकार्थविजृम्भितम् ||
text_mt: I shall explain the import of that scripture, let this be heard; / out of affection for you, Vāmadeva, unfolded for the sake of discernment:

sanskrit_iast:
śivaśaktisamāyogaḥ paramātmeti niścitam |
parāśaktestu sañjātā cicchaktistu tadudbhavā ||
meaning:
शिवशक्तिसमायोगः परमात्मेति निश्चितम् |
पराशक्तेस्तु सञ्जाता चिच्छक्तिस्तु तदुद्भवा ||
text_mt: It is determined that the union of Śiva and Śakti is the Supreme Self. / From the Supreme Śakti, however, arose the power of consciousness;

sanskrit_iast:
ānandaśaktistajjā syādicchāśaktistadudbhavā |
jñānaśaktistato jātā kriyāśaktistu pañcamī |
etābhya eva sañjātā nivṛttyādyāḥ kalā mune ||
meaning:
आनन्दशक्तिस्तज्जा स्यादिच्छाशक्तिस्तदुद्भवा |
ज्ञानशक्तिस्ततो जाता क्रियाशक्तिस्तु पञ्चमी |
एताभ्य एव सञ्जाता निवृत्त्याद्याः कला मुने ||
text_mt: from that was born the power of bliss; from that arose the power of desire; / from that the power of knowledge was born, and the power of action is the fifth; / from these very ones, O sage, arose the kalās beginning with Nivṛtti.

sanskrit_iast:
cidānandasamutpannau nādabindū prakīrtitau |
icchāśaktermakārastu jñānaśaktestu pañcamaḥ ||
meaning:
चिदानन्दसमुत्पन्नौ नादबिन्दू प्रकीर्तितौ |
इच्छाशक्तेर्मकारस्तु ज्ञानशक्तेस्तु पञ्चमः ||
text_mt: Nāda and bindu are proclaimed to be born of consciousness and bliss; / the sound m is from the power of desire, and from the power of knowledge is the fifth

sanskrit_iast:
svaraḥ kriyāśaktijāto hyakārastu munīśvara |
ityuktā praṇavotpattiḥ pañcabrahmodbhavaṃ śṛṇu ||
meaning:
स्वरः क्रियाशक्तिजातो ह्यकारस्तु मुनीश्वर |
इत्युक्ता प्रणवोत्पत्तिः पञ्चब्रह्मोद्भवं शृणु ||
text_mt: vowel; the sound a is indeed born of the power of action, O lord of sages. / Thus the origin of the praṇava is declared; hear the origin of the five Brahmans:

sanskrit_iast:
śivādīśāna utpannastatastatpuruṣodbhavaḥ |
tato'ghorastato vāmaḥ sadyojātodbhavastataḥ ||
meaning:
शिवादीशान उत्पन्नस्ततस्तत्पुरुषोद्भवः |
ततोऽघोरस्ततो वामः सद्योजातोद्भवस्ततः ||
text_mt: From Śiva arose Īśāna; from that, the origin of Tatpuruṣa; / from that Aghora; from that Vāmadeva; from that the origin of Sadyojāta.

sanskrit_iast:
etasmānmātṛkādaṣṭatriṃśanmātṛsamudbhavaḥ |
īśānācchāntyatītākhyā kalā jātātha pūruṣāt |
utpadyate śāntikalā vidyāghorasamudbhavā ||
pratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttiśca vāmasadyodbhave mate |
īśāccicchaktimukhato vibhormithunapañcakam ||
meaning:
एतस्मान्मातृकादष्टत्रिंशन्मातृसमुद्भवः |
ईशानाच्छान्त्यतीताख्या कला जाताथ पूरुषात् |
उत्पद्यते शान्तिकला विद्याघोरसमुद्भवा ||
प्रतिष्ठा च निवृत्तिश्च वामसद्योद्भवे मते |
ईशाच्चिच्छक्तिमुखतो विभोर्मिथुनपञ्चकम् ||
text_mt:
From this mātṛkā arose the thirty-eight mothers. / From Īśāna was born the kalā named Śāntyatītā; then from Tatpuruṣa / the Śānti-kalā is produced; Vidyā originates from Aghora;

Pratiṣṭhā and Nivṛtti are considered to originate from Vāma and Sadyojāta. / From the Lord, through the mouth of the power of consciousness, the all-pervading one produced the five couples.

sanskrit_iast:
anugrahādikṛtyānāṃ hetuḥ pañcakamiṣyate |
tadvidbhirmunibhiḥ prājñairvaratattvapradarśibhiḥ ||
meaning:
अनुग्रहादिकृत्यानां हेतुः पञ्चकमिष्यते |
तद्विद्भिर्मुनिभिः प्राज्ञैर्वरतत्त्वप्रदर्शिभिः ||
text_mt: The pentad is regarded as the cause of the activities beginning with grace / by wise sages who know that and perceive the supreme reality.

sanskrit_iast:
vācyavācakasambandhānmithunatvamupeyuṣi |
kalāvarṇasvarūpe'sminpañcake bhūtapañcakam ||
meaning:
वाच्यवाचकसम्बन्धान्मिथुनत्वमुपेयुषि |
कलावर्णस्वरूपेऽस्मिन्पञ्चके भूतपञ्चकम् ||
text_mt: In this pentad having the nature of kalās and phonemes, which has attained pairing / through the relation of expressed and expressor, the five gross elements

sanskrit_iast:
viyadādikramādāsīdutpannaṃ munipuṅgava |
ādyaṃ mithunamārabhya pañcamaṃ yanmayaṃ viduḥ ||
meaning:
वियदादिक्रमादासीदुत्पन्नं मुनिपुङ्गव |
आद्यं मिथुनमारभ्य पञ्चमं यन्मयं विदुः ||
text_mt: arose in the order beginning with ether, O best of sages, / beginning with the first pair, which they know as made up of the fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdaikaguṇa ākāśaḥ śabdasparśaguṇo marut |
śabdasparśarūpaguṇapradhāno vahnirucyate ||
meaning:
शब्दैकगुण आकाशः शब्दस्पर्शगुणो मरुत् |
शब्दस्पर्शरूपगुणप्रधानो वह्निरुच्यते ||
text_mt: Ether has sound as its sole quality; wind has sound and touch as qualities; / fire is said to have sound, touch, and form as its primary qualities;

sanskrit_iast:
śabdasparśarūparasaguṇakaṃ salilaṃ smṛtam |
śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḍhyā pṛthivī smṛtā ||
meaning:
शब्दस्पर्शरूपरसगुणकं सलिलं स्मृतम् |
शब्दस्पर्शरूपरसगन्धाढ्या पृथिवी स्मृता ||
text_mt: water is remembered as having sound, touch, form, and taste as qualities; / earth is remembered as rich in sound, touch, form, taste, and smell.
