gaurīṃ gaṅgāṃ ca suṣuve bhavāṅgāśleṣapāvanīm ||
meaning:
मेना हिमवतः पत्नी मैनाकं क्रौञ्चमेव च |
गौरीं गङ्गां च सुषुवे भवाङ्गाश्लेषपावनीम् ||
text_mt: Menā, the wife of Himavat, gave birth to Maināka and Krauñca, / and to Gaurī and Gaṅgā, who purifies by the embrace of Bhava's body.

sanskrit_iast:
merostu dharaṇī patnī divyauṣadhisamanvitam |
mandaraṃ suṣuve putraṃ citrisundarakandharam ||
meaning:
मेरोस्तु धरणी पत्नी दिव्यौषधिसमन्वितम् |
मन्दरं सुषुवे पुत्रं चित्रिसुन्दरकन्धरम् ||
text_mt: And Dharaṇī, the wife of Meru, endowed with divine herbs, / gave birth to a son, Mandara, whose ridges were charmingly variegated.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva mandaraḥ śrīmānmeruputrastapobalāt |
sākṣācchrīkaṇṭhanāthasya śivasyāvasathaṃ gataḥ ||
meaning:
स एव मन्दरः श्रीमान्मेरुपुत्रस्तपोबलात् |
साक्षाच्छ्रीकण्ठनाथस्य शिवस्यावसथं गतः ||
text_mt: That very Mandara, the glorious son of Meru, through the power of austerity / went to the abode of Śiva, the manifest lord Śrīkaṇṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
sā'sūtā dharaṇī bhūyastisraḥ kanyāśca viśrutāḥ |
velāṃ ca niyatiṃ caiva tṛtīyāmapi cāyatim ||
meaning:
साऽसूता धरणी भूयस्तिस्रः कन्याश्च विश्रुताः |
वेलां च नियतिं चैव तृतीयामपि चायतिम् ||
text_mt: Dharaṇī further gave birth to three renowned daughters: / Velā, Niyati, and also a third, Āyati.

sanskrit_iast:
āyatirniyatiścaiva patnyau dve bhṛguputrayoḥ |
svāyambhuve'ntare pūrvaṃ kathitaste tadanvayaḥ ||
meaning:
आयतिर्नियतिश्चैव पत्न्यौ द्वे भृगुपुत्रयोः |
स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे पूर्वं कथितस्ते तदन्वयः ||
text_mt: Āyati and Niyati were the two wives of the two sons of Bhṛgu. / Their lineage was recounted to you previously in the Svāyambhuva period.

sanskrit_iast:
suṣuve sāgarādvelā kanyāmekāmaninditām |
savarṇāṃ nāma sāmudrīṃ patnīṃ prācīnabarhiṣaḥ ||
meaning:
सुषुवे सागराद्वेला कन्यामेकामनिन्दिताम् |
सवर्णां नाम सामुद्रीं पत्नीं प्राचीनबर्हिषः ||
text_mt: From the ocean, Velā gave birth to an unblemished daughter / named Savarṇā, a daughter of the sea, the wife of Prācīnabarhis.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmudrī suṣuve putrāndaśa prācīnabarhiṣaḥ |
sarve prācetasā nāma dhanurvedasya pāragāḥ ||
meaning:
सामुद्री सुषुवे पुत्रान्दश प्राचीनबर्हिषः |
सर्वे प्राचेतसा नाम धनुर्वेदस्य पारगाः ||
text_mt: The daughter of the sea bore ten sons to Prācīnabarhis; / they were all called the Pracetasas, masters of the science of archery,

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ svāyambhuve dakṣaḥ putratvamagamatpurā |
triyambakasya śāpena cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ ||
meaning:
येषां स्वायम्भुवे दक्षः पुत्रत्वमगमत्पुरा |
त्रियम्बकस्य शापेन चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः ||
text_mt: of whom Dakṣa, formerly in the Svāyambhuva [manvantara], became the son / in the period of the Manu Cākṣuṣa because of the curse of Triyambaka.

sanskrit_iast:
ityete brahmaputrāṇāṃ dharmādīnāṃ mahātmanām |
nātisaṅkṣepato viprā nātivistarataḥ kramāt ||
meaning:
इत्येते ब्रह्मपुत्राणां धर्मादीनां महात्मनाम् |
नातिसङ्क्षेपतो विप्रा नातिविस्तरतः क्रमात् ||
text_mt: Thus the divine lineages of the great-souled sons of Brahmā, Dharma and the rest, / accompanied by the hosts of gods, have been described in order by me, O brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
varṇitā vai mayā vaṃśā divyā devagaṇānvitāḥ |
kriyāvantaḥ prajāvanto maharddhibhiralaṅkṛtāḥ ||
meaning:
वर्णिता वै मया वंशा दिव्या देवगणान्विताः |
क्रियावन्तः प्रजावन्तो महर्द्धिभिरलङ्कृताः ||
text_mt: neither too briefly nor in too much detail— / rites-performing, possessed of offspring, adorned with great prosperities.

sanskrit_iast:
prajānāṃ sanniveśo'yaṃ prajāpatisamudbhavaḥ |
na hi śakyaḥ prasaṅkhyātuṃ varṣakoṭiśatairapi ||
meaning:
प्रजानां सन्निवेशोऽयं प्रजापतिसमुद्भवः |
न हि शक्यः प्रसङ्ख्यातुं वर्षकोटिशतैरपि ||
text_mt: This arrangement of creatures born from the Prajāpatis / cannot be enumerated even in hundreds of millions of years.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñāmapi ca yo vaṃśo dvidhā so'pi pravartate |
sūryavaṃśaḥ somavaṃśa iti puṇyatamaḥ kṣitau ||
meaning:
राज्ञामपि च यो वंशो द्विधा सोऽपि प्रवर्तते |
सूर्यवंशः सोमवंश इति पुण्यतमः क्षितौ ||
text_mt: And the lineage of kings also proceeds in two lines: / the Solar dynasty and the Lunar dynasty, most sacred on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
ikṣvākurambarīṣaśca yayātirnāhuṣādayaḥ |
puṇyaślokāḥ śrutā ye'tra te'pi tadvaṃśasambhavāḥ ||
meaning:
इक्ष्वाकुरम्बरीषश्च ययातिर्नाहुषादयः |
पुण्यश्लोकाः श्रुता येऽत्र तेऽपि तद्वंशसम्भवाः ||
text_mt: Ikṣvāku, Ambarīṣa, Yayāti, Nahuṣa, and the rest— / those of holy renown who are heard of here were also born in those lineages.

sanskrit_iast:
anye ca rājaṛṣayo nānāvīryasamanvitāḥ |
kiṃ taiḥ phalamanutkrāntairuktapūrvaiḥ purātanaiḥ ||
meaning:
अन्ये च राजऋषयो नानावीर्यसमन्विताः |
किं तैः फलमनुत्क्रान्तैरुक्तपूर्वैः पुरातनैः ||
text_mt: And there were other royal sages endowed with various heroic deeds. / What is the use of repeating those ancients that have already been told?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ ceśvarakathāvṛttau yatra tatrānyakīrtanam |
na sadbhiḥ sammataṃ matvā notsahe bahubhāṣitum ||
meaning:
किं चेश्वरकथावृत्तौ यत्र तत्रान्यकीर्तनम् |
न सद्भिः सम्मतं मत्वा नोत्सहे बहुभाषितुम् ||
text_mt: Moreover, in an account of Īśvara's deeds, narrating other matters here and there / is not approved by the virtuous; considering this, I do not wish to speak at length.

sanskrit_iast:
prasaṅgādīśvarasyaiva prabhāvadyotanādapi |
sargādayo'pi kathitā ityatra tatpravistaraiḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
प्रसङ्गादीश्वरस्यैव प्रभावद्योतनादपि |
सर्गादयोऽपि कथिता इत्यत्र तत्प्रविस्तरैः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
In connection [with that] and to illuminate the majesty of Īśvara, / creation and the rest have also been recounted with extensive details.

Homage to the holy Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
devī dakṣasya tanayā tyaktvā dākṣāyaṇīṃ tanum |
kathaṃ himavataḥ putrī menāyāmabhavatpurā ||
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः |
देवी दक्षस्य तनया त्यक्त्वा दाक्षायणीं तनुम् |
कथं हिमवतः पुत्री मेनायामभवत्पुरा ||
title: aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | satīdehatyāgaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ ca nindito rudro dakṣeṇa ca mahātmanā |
nimittamapi kiṃ tatra yena syānnindito bhavaḥ ||
meaning:
कथं च निन्दितो रुद्रो दक्षेण च महात्मना |
निमित्तमपि किं तत्र येन स्यान्निन्दितो भवः ||

sanskrit_iast:
utpannaśca kathaṃ dakṣo hyabhiśāpādbhavasya tu |
cākṣuṣasyāntare pūrvaṃ manoḥ prabrūhi māruta ||
meaning:
उत्पन्नश्च कथं दक्षो ह्यभिशापाद्भवस्य तु |
चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे पूर्वं मनोः प्रब्रूहि मारुत ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāva śṛṇvantu kathayiṣyāmi dakṣasya laghucetasaḥ |
vṛttaṃ pāpāt pramādācca viśvāmaravidūṣaṇam ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाव शृण्वन्तु कथयिष्यामि दक्षस्य लघुचेतसः |
वृत्तं पापात् प्रमादाच्च विश्वामरविदूषणम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
purā surāsurāḥ sarve siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ |
kadācid draṣṭumīśānaṃ himavacchikharaṃ yayuḥ ||
meaning:
पुरा सुरासुराः सर्वे सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः |
कदाचिद् द्रष्टुमीशानं हिमवच्छिखरं ययुः ||
text_mt: went once to the peak of the Himavat to behold Īśāna. / Then both the god and the goddess, seated on a celestial throne,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā devaśca devī ca divyāsanagatāvubhau |
darśanaṃ dadatusteṣāṃ devādīnāṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
meaning:
तदा देवश्च देवी च दिव्यासनगतावुभौ |
दर्शनं ददतुस्तेषां देवादीनां द्विजोत्तमाः ||
text_mt: granted an audience to those beings headed by the gods, O best of the twice-born. / Just then, Dakṣa too went there along with the immortals

sanskrit_iast:
tadānīmeva dakṣo'pi gatastatra sahāmaraiḥ |
jāmātaraṃ haraṃ draṣṭuṃ devīṃ cātmasutāṃ satīm ||
meaning:
तदानीमेव दक्षोऽपि गतस्तत्र सहामरैः |
जामातरं हरं द्रष्टुं देवीं चात्मसुतां सतीम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tadātmagauravāddevo devyā dakṣe samāgate |
devādibhyo viśeṣeṇa na kadācidabhūtsmṛtiḥ ||
meaning:
तदात्मगौरवाद्देवो देव्या दक्षे समागते |
देवादिभ्यो विशेषेण न कदाचिदभूत्स्मृतिः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tasyāḥ paraṃ bhāvamajñātuścāpi kevalam |
putrītyevaṃ vimūḍhasya tasyāṃ vairamajāyata ||
meaning:
तस्य तस्याः परं भावमज्ञातुश्चापि केवलम् |
पुत्रीत्येवं विमूढस्य तस्यां वैरमजायत ||
text_mt:
did not pay special regard to him above the gods and others. / Dakṣa, ignorant of his and her transcendent nature,
deluded into thinking 'She is merely my daughter,' conceived hostility toward her. / Then, impelled by that very hostility and by destiny,

sanskrit_iast:
tatastenaiva vaireṇa vidhinā ca pracoditaḥ |
nājuvāha bhavaṃ dakṣo dīkṣitastāmapi dviṣan ||
meaning:
ततस्तेनैव वैरेण विधिना च प्रचोदितः |
नाजुवाह भवं दक्षो दीक्षितस्तामपि द्विषन् ||

sanskrit_iast:
anyāñjāmātaraḥ sarvānāhūya sa yathākramam |
śataśaḥ puṣkalāmarcāñcakāra ca pṛthak pṛthak ||
meaning:
अन्याञ्जामातरः सर्वानाहूय स यथाक्रमम् |
शतशः पुष्कलामर्चाञ्चकार च पृथक् पृथक् ||
text_mt: he performed extensive worship for them individually by the hundreds. / Then, having heard from the mouth of Nārada that they had assembled,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā tānsaṅgatān śrutvā nāradasya mukhāttadā |
yayau rudrāya rudrāṇī vijñāpya bhavanaṃ pituḥ ||
meaning:
तथा तान्सङ्गतान् श्रुत्वा नारदस्य मुखात्तदा |
ययौ रुद्राय रुद्राणी विज्ञाप्य भवनं पितुः ||
text_mt: Rudrāṇī, having informed Rudra, departed for her father's abode. / Then an attendant celestial aerial chariot, facing all directions,

sanskrit_iast:
atha sannihitaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ viśvatomukham |
lakṣaṇāḍhyaṃ sukhārohamatimātraṃ manoharam ||
meaning:
अथ सन्निहितं दिव्यं विमानं विश्वतोमुखम् |
लक्षणाढ्यं सुखारोहमतिमात्रं मनोहरम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
taptajāmbūnadaprakhyaṃ citraratnapariṣkṛtam |
muktāmayavitānāgnyaṃ sragdāmasamalaṅkṛtam ||
meaning:
तप्तजाम्बूनदप्रख्यं चित्ररत्नपरिष्कृतम् |
मुक्तामयवितानाग्न्यं स्रग्दामसमलङ्कृतम् ||
text_mt: rich in auspicious marks, easy to mount, exceedingly delightful, / resembling molten Jāmbūnada gold, embellished with varied gems,

sanskrit_iast:
taptakañcananirvyūhaṃ ratnastambhaśatāvṛtam |
vajrakalpitasopānaṃ vidrumastambhatoraṇam ||
meaning:
तप्तकञ्चननिर्व्यूहं रत्नस्तम्भशतावृतम् |
वज्रकल्पितसोपानं विद्रुमस्तम्भतोरणम् ||
text_mt: with stairways fashioned of diamond, and archways on coral pillars,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpapaṭṭaparistīrṇaṃ citraratnamahāsanam |
vajrajālakiracchidramacchidramaṇikuṭṭimam ||
meaning:
पुष्पपट्टपरिस्तीर्णं चित्ररत्नमहासनम् |
वज्रजालकिरच्छिद्रमच्छिद्रमणिकुट्टिमम् ||
text_mt: spread with flower cloths, having a great seat of varied jewels, / with perforations cast by diamond lattice-windows and an unbroken inlaid floor of gems,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇidaṇḍamanojñena mahāvṛṣabhalakṣmaṇā |
alaṅkṛtapurobhāgamabhraśubhreṇa ketunā ||
meaning:
मणिदण्डमनोज्ञेन महावृषभलक्ष्मणा |
अलङ्कृतपुरोभागमभ्रशुभ्रेण केतुना ||
text_mt: its front portion decorated with an emblem white as a cloud, / bearing the sign of the great bull, pleasing with its jeweled staff,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnakañcukaguptāṅgaiścitravetraikapāṇibhiḥ |
adhiṣṭhitamahādvāramapradhṛṣyairgaṇeśvaraiḥ ||
meaning:
रत्नकञ्चुकगुप्ताङ्गैश्चित्रवेत्रैकपाणिभिः |
अधिष्ठितमहाद्वारमप्रधृष्यैर्गणेश्वरैः ||
text_mt: its main gateway guarded by unassailable lords of the attendants, / their bodies protected by jeweled coats of mail, holding varied canes in one hand,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdaṅgatālagītādiveṇuvīṇāviśāradaiḥ |
vidagdhaveṣabhūṣaiśca bahubhiḥ strījanairvṛtam ||
meaning:
मृदङ्गतालगीतादिवेणुवीणाविशारदैः |
विदग्धवेषभूषैश्च बहुभिः स्त्रीजनैर्वृतम् ||
text_mt: surrounded by many women adept in mṛdaṅga, cymbals, singing, and the like, / as well as the flute and lute, and adorned in skillful attire and ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
āruroha mahādevī saha priyasakhījanaiḥ |
cāmāravyajane tasyā vajradaṇḍamanohare ||
meaning:
आरुरोह महादेवी सह प्रियसखीजनैः |
चामारव्यजने तस्या वज्रदण्डमनोहरे ||
text_mt: The great goddess mounted it together with her dear female companions. / Two charming fly-whisks with diamond handles

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā rudrakanye dve vivījaturubhe śubhe |
tadā cāmarayormadhye devyā vadanamābabhau ||
meaning:
गृहीत्वा रुद्रकन्ये द्वे विवीजतुरुभे शुभे |
तदा चामरयोर्मध्ये देव्या वदनमाबभौ ||
text_mt: were taken by two auspicious maidens of Rudra, who fanned her. / Then, between the two fly-whisks, the face of the goddess shone

sanskrit_iast:
anyo'nyaṃ yudhyatormadhye haṃsayoriva paṅkajam |
chatraṃ śaśinibhaṃ tasyāścūḍopari sumālinī ||
meaning:
अन्योऽन्यं युध्यतोर्मध्ये हंसयोरिव पङ्कजम् |
छत्रं शशिनिभं तस्याश्चूडोपरि सुमालिनी ||
text_mt: like a lotus between two swans fighting with one another. / Above her crest, Sumālinī, filled with deep love,

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtamuktāparikṣiptaṃ babhāra premanirbharā |
tacchatramujjvalaṃ devyā ruruce vadanopari ||
meaning:
धृतमुक्तापरिक्षिप्तं बभार प्रेमनिर्भरा |
तच्छत्रमुज्ज्वलं देव्या रुरुचे वदनोपरि ||
text_mt: held a moon-like parasol surrounded by suspended pearls. / That bright parasol shone above the face of the goddess

sanskrit_iast:
uparyamṛtabhāṇḍasya maṇḍalaṃ śaśino yathā |
atha cāgre samāsīnā susmitāsyā śubhāvatī ||
meaning:
उपर्यमृतभाण्डस्य मण्डलं शशिनो यथा |
अथ चाग्रे समासीना सुस्मितास्या शुभावती ||
text_mt: like the disc of the moon above a vessel of nectar. / Then, seated in front with a smiling face, Śubhāvatī

sanskrit_iast:
akṣadyūtavinodena ramayāmāsa vai satīm |
suyaśāḥ pāduke devyāḥ śubhe ratnapariṣkṛte ||
meaning:
अक्षद्यूतविनोदेन रमयामास वै सतीम् |
सुयशाः पादुके देव्याः शुभे रत्नपरिष्कृते ||
text_mt: delighted Satī with the amusement of a dice game. / Placing the auspicious, jewel-adorned sandals of the goddess

sanskrit_iast:
stanayorantare kṛtvā tadā devīmasevata |
anyā kāñcanacārvaṅgī dīptaṃ jagrāha darpaṇam ||
meaning:
स्तनयोरन्तरे कृत्वा तदा देवीमसेवत |
अन्या काञ्चनचार्वङ्गी दीप्तं जग्राह दर्पणम् ||
text_mt: between her breasts, Suyaśā then served the goddess. / Another maiden, her limbs beautiful as gold, held a blazing mirror.

sanskrit_iast:
aparā tālavṛntaṃ ca parā tāmbūlapeṭikām |
kācitkrīḍāśukaṃ cāru kare'kuruta bhāminī ||
meaning:
अपरा तालवृन्तं च परा ताम्बूलपेटिकाम् |
काचित्क्रीडाशुकं चारु करेऽकुरुत भामिनी ||
text_mt: Another lady took a palmyra-fan, another a betel-box, / And a certain lovely lady held a pet parrot in her hand.

sanskrit_iast:
kācittu sumanojñāni puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca |
kācidābharaṇādhāraṃ babhāra kamalekṣaṇā ||
meaning:
काचित्तु सुमनोज्ञानि पुष्पाणि सुरभीणि च |
काचिदाभरणाधारं बभार कमलेक्षणा ||
text_mt: One woman [carried] very charming and fragrant flowers, / and another lotus-eyed maiden held a casket of ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
kācicca punarālepaṃ suprasūnaṃ śubhāñjanam |
anyāśca sadṛśāstāstā yathāsvamucitakriyāḥ ||
meaning:
काचिच्च पुनरालेपं सुप्रसूनं शुभाञ्जनम् |
अन्याश्च सदृशास्तास्ता यथास्वमुचितक्रियाः ||
text_mt: Another again held unguent, fine flowers, and auspicious collyrium; / and other women like them performed their respective, fitting tasks.

sanskrit_iast:
āvṛtya tāṃ mahādevīmasevanta samantataḥ |
atīva śuśubhe tāsāmantare parameśvarī ||
meaning:
आवृत्य तां महादेवीमसेवन्त समन्ततः |
अतीव शुशुभे तासामन्तरे परमेश्वरी ||
text_mt: Surrounding the great goddess on all sides, they waited upon her. / In their midst the supreme goddess shone exceedingly,

sanskrit_iast:
tārāpariṣado madhye candralekheva śāradī |
tataḥ śaṅkhasamutthasya nādasya samanantaram ||
meaning:
तारापरिषदो मध्ये चन्द्रलेखेव शारदी |
ततः शङ्खसमुत्थस्य नादस्य समनन्तरम् ||
text_mt: like the autumnal crescent moon amidst an assembly of stars. / Then, immediately after the blare of a conch sounded,

sanskrit_iast:
prāsthāniko mahānādaḥ paṭahaḥ samatāḍyata |
tato madhuravādyāni saha tālodyataiḥ svanaiḥ ||
meaning:
प्रास्थानिको महानादः पटहः समताड्यत |
ततो मधुरवाद्यानि सह तालोद्यतैः स्वनैः ||
text_mt: a great-sounding drum for the departure was struck. / Then melodious instruments resounded together with notes raised by cymbals,

sanskrit_iast:
anāhatāni sanneduḥ kāhalānāṃ śatāni ca |
sāyudhānāṃ gaṇeśānāṃ maheśasamatejasām ||
meaning:
अनाहतानि सन्नेदुः काहलानां शतानि च |
सायुधानां गणेशानां महेशसमतेजसाम् ||
text_mt: and hundreds of trumpets sounded, unstruck. / Then eight hundred thousand lords of the attendants, armed with weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāṇi śatānyaṣṭau tadānīṃ purato yayuḥ |
teṣāṃ madhye vṛṣārūḍho gajārūḍho yathā guruḥ ||
meaning:
सहस्राणि शतान्यष्टौ तदानीं पुरतो ययुः |
तेषां मध्ये वृषारूढो गजारूढो यथा गुरुः ||
text_mt: and equal in splendor to Maheśa, marched ahead. / In their midst, mounted on a bull like the Preceptor mounted on an elephant,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma gaṇapaḥ śrīmān somanandīśvarārcitaḥ |
devadundubhayo nedurdivi divyasukhā ghanāḥ ||
meaning:
जगाम गणपः श्रीमान् सोमनन्दीश्वरार्चितः |
देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुर्दिवि दिव्यसुखा घनाः ||
text_mt: rode the glorious lord of the attendants, worshipped by Soma and Nandīśvara. / Divine kettledrums resounded densely in heaven, bringing divine joy.

sanskrit_iast:
nanṛturmunayaḥ sarve mumuduḥ siddhayoginaḥ |
sasṛjuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca vitānopari vāridāḥ ||
meaning:
ननृतुर्मुनयः सर्वे मुमुदुः सिद्धयोगिनः |
ससृजुः पुष्पवृष्टिं च वितानोपरि वारिदाः ||
text_mt: All the sages danced, the Siddha yogins rejoiced, / and the clouds poured forth a rain of flowers upon the canopy.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā devagaṇaiścānyaiḥ pathi sarvatra saṅgatāḥ |
kṣaṇādiva piturgehaṃ praviveśa maheśvarī ||
meaning:
तदा देवगणैश्चान्यैः पथि सर्वत्र सङ्गताः |
क्षणादिव पितुर्गेहं प्रविवेश महेश्वरी ||
text_mt: Then, met everywhere along the road by other hosts of gods, / the great goddess entered her father’s house in what seemed like a moment.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kupito dakṣaścātmanaḥ kṣayakāraṇāt |
tasyā yavīyasībhyo'pi cakre pūjāmasatkṛtām ||
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वा कुपितो दक्षश्चात्मनः क्षयकारणात् |
तस्या यवीयसीभ्योऽपि चक्रे पूजामसत्कृताम् ||
text_mt: Seeing her, Dakṣa, angered toward the cause of his own ruin, / offered her a contemptuous greeting, [inferior] even to [that given to] her younger sisters.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā śaśimukhī devī pitaraṃ sadasi sthitam |
ambikā yuktamavyagramuvācākṛpaṇaṃ vacaḥ ||
meaning:
तदा शशिमुखी देवी पितरं सदसि स्थितम् |
अम्बिका युक्तमव्यग्रमुवाचाकृपणं वचः ||
text_mt: Then the moon-faced goddess, Ambikā, / spoke fitting, composed, and unyielding words to her father seated in the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca |
brahmādayaḥ piśācāntā yasyājñāvaśavartinaḥ |
sa devaḥ sāmprataṃ tāta vidhinā nārcitaḥ kila ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच |
ब्रह्मादयः पिशाचान्ता यस्याज्ञावशवर्तिनः |
स देवः साम्प्रतं तात विधिना नार्चितः किल ||

sanskrit_iast:
tadāstāṃ mama jyāyasyāḥ putryāḥ pūjāṃ kimīdṛśīm |
asatkṛtāmavajñāya kṛtavānasi garhitam ||
meaning:
तदास्तां मम ज्यायस्याः पुत्र्याः पूजां किमीदृशीम् |
असत्कृतामवज्ञाय कृतवानसि गर्हितम् ||
text_mt:
that god, O father, has truly not been worshipped according to the sacred rule at present!
Let that be; why have you offered such a dishonourable worship,

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto'bravīdenāṃ dakṣaḥ krodhādamarṣitaḥ |
tvattaḥ śreṣṭhā viśiṣṭāśca pūjyā bālāḥ sutā mama ||
meaning:
एवमुक्तोऽब्रवीदेनां दक्षः क्रोधादमर्षितः |
त्वत्तः श्रेष्ठा विशिष्टाश्च पूज्या बालाः सुता मम ||
text_mt:
disregarding me, your eldest daughter? You have committed a censurable act!”
Being addressed in this manner, Dakṣa, intolerant through anger, said to her:
“Better and superior to you, worthy of honour, are my young daughters.
And their husbands are held by me in high regard with joy;

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ tu ye ca bharttāraste me bahumatā mudā |
guṇaiścāpyadhikāḥ sarve bhartuste tryambakādapi ||
meaning:
तासां तु ये च भर्त्तारस्ते मे बहुमता मुदा |
गुणैश्चाप्यधिकाः सर्वे भर्तुस्ते त्र्यम्बकादपि ||

sanskrit_iast:
stabdhātmā tāmasaḥ śarvaḥ tvamimaṃ samupāśritā |
tena tvāmavamanye'haṃ pratikūlo hi me bhavaḥ ||
meaning:
स्तब्धात्मा तामसः शर्वः त्वमिमं समुपाश्रिता |
तेन त्वामवमन्येऽहं प्रतिकूलो हि मे भवः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tathoktā pitaraṃ dakṣaṃ kruddhā devī tamabravīt |
śṛṇvatāmeva sarveṣāṃ ye yajñasadasi sthitāḥ ||
meaning:
तथोक्ता पितरं दक्षं क्रुद्धा देवी तमब्रवीत् |
शृण्वतामेव सर्वेषां ये यज्ञसदसि स्थिताः ||
text_mt:
therefore I show disregard to you, for Bhava is hostile to me!”
Having been spoken to thus, the angry goddess said to her father Dakṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
akasmānmama bhartāramajātāśeṣadūṣaṇam |
vācā dūṣayase dakṣa sākṣāllokamaheśvaram ||
meaning:
अकस्मान्मम भर्तारमजाताशेषदूषणम् |
वाचा दूषयसे दक्ष साक्षाल्लोकमहेश्वरम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
vidyācauro gurudrohī vedeśvaravidūṣakaḥ |
ta ete bahupāpmānaḥ sarve daṇḍyā iti śrutiḥ ||
meaning:
विद्याचौरो गुरुद्रोही वेदेश्वरविदूषकः |
त एते बहुपाप्मानः सर्वे दण्ड्या इति श्रुतिः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādatyutkaṭasyāsya pāpasya sadṛśo bhṛśam |
sahasā dāruṇo daṇḍastava daivādbhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
तस्मादत्युत्कटस्यास्य पापस्य सदृशो भृशम् |
सहसा दारुणो दण्डस्तव दैवाद्भविष्यति ||
text_mt:
all these are great sinners; all are to be punished: so states the sacred scripture.
Therefore, a punishment precisely equal to this excessively heinous sin,

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā na pūjito yasmāddevadevastriyambakaḥ |
tasmāttava kulaṃ duṣṭaṃ naṣṭamityavadhāraya ||
meaning:
त्वया न पूजितो यस्माद्देवदेवस्त्रियम्बकः |
तस्मात्तव कुलं दुष्टं नष्टमित्यवधारय ||
text_mt:
know for certain that your wicked clan is destroyed!”
Having spoken thus to her father, enraged Satī, having cast aside all fear,

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā pitaraṃ ruṣṭā satī santyaktasādhvasā |
tadīyāṃ ca tanuṃ tyaktvā himavantaṃ yayau girim ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा पितरं रुष्टा सती सन्त्यक्तसाध्वसा |
तदीयां च तनुं त्यक्त्वा हिमवन्तं ययौ गिरिम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
sa parvataparaḥ śrīmām̐llabdhapuṇyaphalodayaḥ |
tadarthameva kṛtavān suciraṃ duścaraṃ tapaḥ ||
meaning:
स पर्वतपरः श्रीमाम्̐ल्लब्धपुण्यफलोदयः |
तदर्थमेव कृतवान् सुचिरं दुश्चरं तपः ||
text_mt:
abandoned the body received from him and went to Mount Himavat.
That foremost of mountains, glorious, having attained the ripening of his merit,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttamanugṛhṇāti bhūdhareśvaramīśvarī |
svecchayā pitaraṃ cakre svātmano yogamāyayā ||
meaning:
तस्मात्तमनुगृह्णाति भूधरेश्वरमीश्वरी |
स्वेच्छया पितरं चक्रे स्वात्मनो योगमायया ||

sanskrit_iast:
yadā gatā satī dakṣaṃ vinindya bhayavihvalam |
tadā tirohitā mantrā vihataśca tato'dhvaraḥ ||
meaning:
यदा गता सती दक्षं विनिन्द्य भयविह्वलम् |
तदा तिरोहिता मन्त्रा विहतश्च ततोऽध्वरः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tadupaśrutya gamanaṃ devyāstripurumardanaḥ |
dakṣāya ca ṛṣibhyaśca cukopa ca śaśāpa tān ||
meaning:
तदुपश्रुत्य गमनं देव्यास्त्रिपुरुमर्दनः |
दक्षाय च ऋषिभ्यश्च चुकोप च शशाप तान् ||
text_mt:
then the mantras vanished and the sacrifice was consequently ruined.
Hearing of that departure of the goddess, the crusher of the three cities

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādavamatā dakṣamatkṛte'nāgasā satī |
pūjitāścetarāḥ sarvāḥ svasutā bhartṛbhiḥ saha ||
meaning:
यस्मादवमता दक्षमत्कृतेऽनागसा सती |
पूजिताश्चेतराः सर्वाः स्वसुता भर्तृभिः सह ||
text_mt:
while all your other daughters were worshipped along with their husbands,
therefore, in the Vaivasvata interval, these sons-in-law of yours

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvate'ntare tasmāttava jāmātarastvamī |
utpatsyante samaṃ sarve brahmayajñeṣvayonijāḥ ||
meaning:

पर्वताश्च व्यशीर्यन्त चकम्पे च वसुन्धरा |
मरुतश्च व्यघूर्णन्त चुक्षुभे मकरालयः ||

sanskrit_iast:
agnayo naiva dīpyante na ca dīpyati bhāskaraḥ |
grahāśca na prakāśante nakṣatrāṇi ca tārakāḥ ||
meaning:
अग्नयो नैव दीप्यन्ते न च दीप्यति भास्करः |
ग्रहाश्च न प्रकाशन्ते नक्षत्राणि च तारकाः ||

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu yajñavāṭaṃ tadujjvalam |
samprāpa bhagavānbhadro bhadraiśca saha bhadrayā ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु यज्ञवाटं तदुज्ज्वलम् |
सम्प्राप भगवान्भद्रो भद्रैश्च सह भद्रया ||
text_mt: the blessed Bhadra reached, accompanied by the auspicious ones and the auspicious goddess. / Seeing him, Dakṣa, though thoroughly terrified, stood firm as if resolute;

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītabhīto'pi dakṣo dṛḍha iva sthitaḥ |
kruddhavad vacanaṃ prāha ko bhavān kimihecchasi ||
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा भीतभीतोऽपि दक्षो दृढ इव स्थितः |
क्रुद्धवद् वचनं प्राह को भवान् किमिहेच्छसि ||
text_mt: as if angry, he spoke these words: "Who are you? What do you want here?" / Hearing those words of the wicked-souled Dakṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣasya ca durātmanaḥ |
vīrabhadro mahātejā meghagambhīraniḥsvanaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दक्षस्य च दुरात्मनः |
वीरभद्रो महातेजा मेघगम्भीरनिःस्वनः ||

sanskrit_iast:
smayanniva tamālokya dakṣaṃ devāṃśca ṛtvijaḥ |
arthagarbhamasambhrāntamavocaducitaṃ vacaḥ ||
meaning:
स्मयन्निव तमालोक्य दक्षं देवांश्च ऋत्विजः |
अर्थगर्भमसम्भ्रान्तमवोचदुचितं वचः ||
text_mt: smiling, as it were, looking at Dakṣa, the gods, and the sacrificial priests, / spoke meaningful, unconfused, and fitting words.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhadra uvāca |
vayaṃ hyanucarāḥ sarve śarvasyāmitatejasaḥ |
bhāgābhilipsayā prāptā bhāgo naḥ sampradīyatām ||
meaning:
वीरभद्र उवाच |
वयं ह्यनुचराः सर्वे शर्वस्यामिततेजसः |
भागाभिलिप्सया प्राप्ता भागो नः सम्प्रदीयताम् ||
text_mt:
Vīrabhadra said:
"We are indeed all followers of Śarva of boundless majesty.

sanskrit_iast:
atha cedadhvare'smākaṃ na bhāgaḥ parikalpitaḥ |
kathyatāṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra yudhyatāṃ vā mayāmaraiḥ ||
meaning:
अथ चेदध्वरेऽस्माकं न भागः परिकल्पितः |
कथ्यतां कारणं तत्र युध्यतां वा मयामरैः ||
text_mt:
We have arrived desiring our share; let our share be given to us. / But if no share has been allotted to us in this sacrifice,
let the reason for it be told, or let the immortals fight with me!" / Addressed thus by the lord of the gaṇas, the gods headed by Dakṣa

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktāste gaṇendreṇa devā dakṣapurogamāḥ |
ūcurmantrāḥ pramāṇaṃ no na vayaṃ prabhavastviti ||
meaning:
इत्युक्तास्ते गणेन्द्रेण देवा दक्षपुरोगमाः |
ऊचुर्मन्त्राः प्रमाणं नो न वयं प्रभवस्त्विति ||
text_mt: said, "The mantras are our authority; we have no power." / The mantras said: "O gods, your minds are ruined by delusion,

sanskrit_iast:
mantrā ūcussurā yūyaṃ mohopahatacetasaḥ |
yena prathamabhāgārhaṃ na yajadhvaṃ maheśvaram ||
meaning:
मन्त्रा ऊचुस्सुरा यूयं मोहोपहतचेतसः |
येन प्रथमभागार्हं न यजध्वं महेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: since you do not worship Maheśvara, who is worthy of the first share!" / Even though addressed by the mantras, all those gods, their minds utterly deluded,

sanskrit_iast:
mantroktā api te devāḥ sarve sammūḍhacetasaḥ |
bhadrāya na dadurbhāgaṃ tatprahāṇamabhīpsavaḥ ||
meaning:
मन्त्रोक्ता अपि ते देवाः सर्वे सम्मूढचेतसः |
भद्राय न ददुर्भागं तत्प्रहाणमभीप्सवः ||
text_mt: did not give a share to Bhadra, wishing for his departure. / When their true and wholesome speech proved useless,

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tathyaṃ ca pathyaṃ ca svavākyaṃ tadvṛthā'bhavat |
tadā tato yayurmantrā brahmalokaṃ sanātanam ||
meaning:
यदा तथ्यं च पथ्यं च स्ववाक्यं तद्वृथाऽभवत् |
तदा ततो ययुर्मन्त्रा ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
athovāca gaṇādhyakṣo devān viṣṇupurogamān |
mantrāḥ pramāṇaṃ na kṛtā yuṣmābhirbalagarvitaiḥ ||
meaning:
अथोवाच गणाध्यक्षो देवान् विष्णुपुरोगमान् |
मन्त्राः प्रमाणं न कृता युष्माभिर्बलगर्वितैः ||
text_mt: "You, arrogant with strength, did not accept the mantras as authority! / Since we have been thus dishonored by the gods in this sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādasmin makhe devairitthaṃ vayamasatkṛtāḥ |
tasmādvo jīvitaissārddhamapaneṣyāmi garvitam ||
meaning:
यस्मादस्मिन् मखे देवैरित्थं वयमसत्कृताः |
तस्माद्वो जीवितैस्सार्द्धमपनेष्यामि गर्वितम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhagavān kruddho vyadahannetravahninā |
yajñavāṭaṃ mahākūṭaṃ yathā tisraḥ puro haraḥ ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् क्रुद्धो व्यदहन्नेत्रवह्निना |
यज्ञवाटं महाकूटं यथा तिस्रः पुरो हरः ||
text_mt: therefore I shall take away your pride along with your lives!" / Having spoken thus, the blessed lord, infuriated, burned with the fire of his eye

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaṇeśvarāḥ sarve parvatodagravigrahāḥ |
yūpānutpāṭya hotṝṇāṃ kaṇṭheṣvābadhya rajjubhiḥ ||
meaning:
ततो गणेश्वराः सर्वे पर्वतोदग्रविग्रहाः |
यूपानुत्पाट्य होतॄणां कण्ठेष्वाबध्य रज्जुभिः ||

sanskrit_iast:
yajñapātrāṇi citrāṇi bhittvā sañcūrṇya vāriṇi |
gṛhītvā caiva yajñāṅgaṃ gaṅgāsrotasi cikṣipuḥ ||
meaning:
यज्ञपात्राणि चित्राणि भित्त्वा सञ्चूर्ण्य वारिणि |
गृहीत्वा चैव यज्ञाङ्गं गङ्गास्रोतसि चिक्षिपुः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tatra divyānnapānānāṃ rāśayaḥ parvatopamāḥ |
kṣīranadyo'mṛtasrāvāḥ susnigdhadadhikardamāḥ ||
meaning:
तत्र दिव्यान्नपानानां राशयः पर्वतोपमाः |
क्षीरनद्योऽमृतस्रावाः सुस्निग्धदधिकर्दमाः ||
text_mt: rivers of milk flowing with nectar, mud of smooth curd, / various kinds of meats, and fragrant edibles [were destroyed].

sanskrit_iast:
uccāvacāni māṃsāni bhakṣyāṇi surabhīṇi ca |
rasavanti ca pānāni lehyacoṣyāṇi tāni vai ||
meaning:
उच्चावचानि मांसानि भक्ष्याणि सुरभीणि च |
रसवन्ति च पानानि लेह्यचोष्याणि तानि वै ||

sanskrit_iast:
vīrāstadbhuñjate vaktrairvilumpanti kṣipanti ca |
vajraiścakrairmahāśūlaiḥ śaktibhiḥ pāśapaṭṭiśaiḥ ||
meaning:
वीरास्तद्भुञ्जते वक्त्रैर्विलुम्पन्ति क्षिपन्ति च |
वज्रैश्चक्रैर्महाशूलैः शक्तिभिः पाशपट्टिशैः ||

sanskrit_iast:
musalairasibhiṣṭaṅkairbhindipālaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ |
uddhatāṃstridaśānsarvāṃllokapālapurassarān ||
meaning:
मुसलैरसिभिष्टङ्कैर्भिन्दिपालैः परश्वधैः |
उद्धतांस्त्रिदशान्सर्वांल्लोकपालपुरस्सरान् ||
text_mt: the mighty heroes born from the limbs of Vīrabhadra / pierced all the arrogant gods, headed by the world-guardians.

sanskrit_iast:
bibhidurbalino vīrā vīrabhadrāṅgasambhavāḥ |
chindhi bhindhi kṣipa kṣipraṃ māryatāṃ dāryatāmiti ||
meaning:
बिभिदुर्बलिनो वीरा वीरभद्राङ्गसम्भवाः |
छिन्धि भिन्धि क्षिप क्षिप्रं मार्यतां दार्यतामिति ||

sanskrit_iast:
harasva praharasveti pāṭayotpāṭayeti ca |
saṃrambhaprabhavāḥ krūrāḥ śabdāḥ śravaṇaśaṅkavaḥ ||
meaning:
हरस्व प्रहरस्वेति पाटयोत्पाटयेति च |
संरम्भप्रभवाः क्रूराः शब्दाः श्रवणशङ्कवः ||

sanskrit_iast:
yatra tatra gaṇeśānāṃ jajñire samarocitāḥ |
vivṛttanayanāḥ kecid daṣṭadaṃṣṭroṣṭhatālavaḥ ||
meaning:
यत्र तत्र गणेशानां जज्ञिरे समरोचिताः |
विवृत्तनयनाः केचिद् दष्टदंष्ट्रोष्ठतालवः ||
text_mt: Some, with rolling eyes, their fangs biting their lips and palates, / dragged those who dwelt in the hermitage, rich in penance, and slew them.

sanskrit_iast:
āśramasthān samākṛṣya mārayanti tapodhanān |
sruvānapaharantaśca kṣipanto'gniṃ jaleṣu ca ||
meaning:
आश्रमस्थान् समाकृष्य मारयन्ति तपोधनान् |
स्रुवानपहरन्तश्च क्षिपन्तोऽग्निं जलेषु च ||

sanskrit_iast:
kalaśānapi bhindantaśchindanto maṇivedikāḥ |
gāyantaśca nadantaśca hasantaśca muhurmuhuḥ |
raktāsavaṃ pibantaśca nanṛturgaṇapuṅgavāḥ ||
meaning:
कलशानपि भिन्दन्तश्छिन्दन्तो मणिवेदिकाः |
गायन्तश्च नदन्तश्च हसन्तश्च मुहुर्मुहुः |
रक्तासवं पिबन्तश्च ननृतुर्गणपुङ्गवाः ||

sanskrit_iast:
nirmathya sendrānamarān gaṇendrā vṛṣendranāgendramṛgendrasārāḥ |
cakrurbahūnyapratimabhāvāḥ saharṣaromāṇi viceṣṭitāni ||
meaning:
निर्मथ्य सेन्द्रानमरान् गणेन्द्रा वृषेन्द्रनागेन्द्रमृगेन्द्रसाराः |
चक्रुर्बहून्यप्रतिमभावाः सहर्षरोमाणि विचेष्टितानि ||
text_mt: of incomparable majesty, performed many actions that made their hair stand on end with joy.

sanskrit_iast: nandanti kecitpraharanti kecit dhāvanti kecitpralapanti kecit ||
meaning: नन्दन्ति केचित्प्रहरन्ति केचित् धावन्ति केचित्प्रलपन्ति केचित् ||
text_mt: Some rejoiced; some struck; / some ran; some babbled;

sanskrit_iast: nṛtyanti kecidvihasanti kecit valganti kecitpramathā balena ||
meaning: नृत्यन्ति केचिद्विहसन्ति केचित् वल्गन्ति केचित्प्रमथा बलेन ||
text_mt: some danced; some laughed aloud; / some Pramathas leaped about with might.

sanskrit_iast:
kecijjighṛkṣanti ghanānsa toyān kecidgrahītuṃ ravimutpatanti |
kecitprasartuṃ pavanena sārddha-micchanti bhīmāḥ pramathā viyatsthāḥ ||
meaning:
केचिज्जिघृक्षन्ति घनान्स तोयान् केचिद्ग्रहीतुं रविमुत्पतन्ति |
केचित्प्रसर्तुं पवनेन सार्द्ध-मिच्छन्ति भीमाः प्रमथा वियत्स्थाः ||
text_mt: Some wished to seize the water-bearing clouds; some sprang up to grasp the sun; / some terrible Pramathas standing in the sky wished to race alongside the wind.

sanskrit_iast:
ākṣipya kecicca varāyudhāni mahābhujaṅgāniva vainateyāḥ |
bhramanti devānapi vidravantaḥ khamaṇḍale parvatakūṭakalpāḥ ||
meaning:
आक्षिप्य केचिच्च वरायुधानि महाभुजङ्गानिव वैनतेयाः |
भ्रमन्ति देवानपि विद्रवन्तः खमण्डले पर्वतकूटकल्पाः ||
text_mt: Tossing their excellent weapons about like the sons of Vinatā [tossing] great serpents, / they roamed the vault of the sky like mountain peaks, putting even the gods to flight.

sanskrit_iast:
utpāṭya cotpāṭya gṛhāṇi kecit sajālavātāyanavedikāni |
vikṣipya vikṣipya jalasya madhye kālāmbudābhāḥ pramathā nineduḥ ||
meaning:
उत्पाट्य चोत्पाट्य गृहाणि केचित् सजालवातायनवेदिकानि |
विक्षिप्य विक्षिप्य जलस्य मध्ये कालाम्बुदाभाः प्रमथा निनेदुः ||
text_mt: Tearing up house after house, with their latticed windows and balconies, / and hurling them repeatedly into the midst of the water, the Pramathas roared like the dark clouds of doomsday.

sanskrit_iast:
udvartitadvārakapāṭakuḍyaṃ vidhvastaśālāvalabhīgavākṣam |
aho batābhajyata yajñavāṭa-manāptavadvākyamivāyathārtham ||
meaning:
उद्वर्तितद्वारकपाटकुड्यं विध्वस्तशालावलभीगवाक्षम् |
अहो बताभज्यत यज्ञवाट-मनाप्तवद्वाक्यमिवायथार्थम् ||
text_mt: With the walls and leaves of its gateways overturned, with its halls, roofs, and lattice-windows destroyed, / alas, the sacrificial enclosure was demolished like the false utterance of an untrustworthy person.

sanskrit_iast:
hā nātha tāteti pituḥ suteti bhrātarmamāmbeti ca mātuleti |
utpāṭyamāneṣu gṛheṣu nāryo hyanāthaśabdānbahuśaḥ pracakruḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
हा नाथ तातेति पितुः सुतेति भ्रातर्ममाम्बेति च मातुलेति |
उत्पाट्यमानेषु गृहेषु नार्यो ह्यनाथशब्दान्बहुशः प्रचक्रुः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
"Ah, lord!", "Father!", "Child of my father!", / "Brother!", "My mother!", and "Uncle!"— / as the houses were being torn up, the women repeatedly uttered cries of helplessness.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
tatastridaśamukhyāste viṣṇuśakrapurogamāḥ |
sarve bhayaparitrastā dudruvurbhayavihvalāḥ ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
ततस्त्रिदशमुख्यास्ते विष्णुशक्रपुरोगमाः |
सर्वे भयपरित्रस्ता दुद्रुवुर्भयविह्वलाः ||
title: ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | devadaṇḍavarṇanam
text_mt:
Chapter 21
Vāyu said:
Then those chief gods, headed by Viṣṇu and Śakra,
all fled, terrified with fear, agitated by dread. / Seeing the gods routed, their own limbs unharmed,

sanskrit_iast:
nijairadūṣitairaṅgairdṛṣṭvā devānupadrutān |
daṇḍyānadaṇḍitān matvā cukopa gaṇapuṅgavaḥ ||
meaning:
निजैरदूषितैरङ्गैर्दृष्ट्वा देवानुपद्रुतान् |
दण्ड्यानदण्डितान् मत्वा चुकोप गणपुङ्गवः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tatastriśūlamādāya śarvaśaktinibarhaṇam |
ūrdhvadṛṣṭirmahābāhurmukhājjvālāḥ samutsṛjan ||
meaning:
ततस्त्रिशूलमादाय शर्वशक्तिनिबर्हणम् |
ऊर्ध्वदृष्टिर्महाबाहुर्मुखाज्ज्वालाः समुत्सृजन् ||
text_mt: gazing upward, mighty-armed, emitting flames from his mouth, / he rushed against the gods as a lion against elephants.

sanskrit_iast:
amarānapi dudrāva dviradāniva kesarī |
tānabhidravatastasya gamanaṃ sumanoharam ||
meaning:
अमरानपि दुद्राव द्विरदानिव केसरी |
तानभिद्रवतस्तस्य गमनं सुमनोहरम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāraṇasyeva mattasya jagāma prekṣaṇīyatām |
tatastatkṣobhayāmāsa mahatsurabalaṃ balī ||
meaning:
वारणस्येव मत्तस्य जगाम प्रेक्षणीयताम् |
ततस्तत्क्षोभयामास महत्सुरबलं बली ||

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsarovaraṃ yadvanmatto vāraṇayūthapaḥ |
vikurvanbahudhā varṇānnīlapāṇḍuralohitān ||
meaning:
महासरोवरं यद्वन्मत्तो वारणयूथपः |
विकुर्वन्बहुधा वर्णान्नीलपाण्डुरलोहितान् ||

sanskrit_iast:
bibhrad vyāghrājinaṃ vāso hemapravaratārakam |
chindan bhindannudan klindandārayanpramathannapi ||
meaning:
बिभ्रद् व्याघ्राजिनं वासो हेमप्रवरतारकम् |
छिन्दन् भिन्दन्नुदन् क्लिन्दन्दारयन्प्रमथन्नपि ||
text_mt: Displaying diverse hues—dark blue, pale white, and blood-red— / wearing a garment of tiger-skin adorned with stars of excellent gold,

sanskrit_iast:
vyacaraddevasaṅgheṣu bhadro'gniriva kakṣagaḥ |
yatra tatra mahāvegāccarantaṃ śūladhāriṇam ||
meaning:
व्यचरद्देवसङ्घेषु भद्रोऽग्निरिव कक्षगः |
यत्र तत्र महावेगाच्चरन्तं शूलधारिणम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tamekaṃ tridaśāḥ sarve sahasramiva menire |
bhadrakālī ca saṅkruddhā yuddhavṛddhamadoddhatā ||
meaning:
तमेकं त्रिदशाः सर्वे सहस्रमिव मेनिरे |
भद्रकाली च सङ्क्रुद्धा युद्धवृद्धमदोद्धता ||

sanskrit_iast:
muktajvālena śūlena nirbibheda raṇe surān |
sa tayā ruruce bhadro rudrakopasamudbhavaḥ ||
meaning:
मुक्तज्वालेन शूलेन निर्बिभेद रणे सुरान् |
स तया रुरुचे भद्रो रुद्रकोपसमुद्भवः ||

sanskrit_iast:
prabhayeva yugāntāgniścalayā dhūmadhūmrayā |
bhadrakālī tadā yuddhe vidrutatridaśā babhau ||
meaning:
प्रभयेव युगान्ताग्निश्चलया धूमधूम्रया |
भद्रकाली तदा युद्धे विद्रुतत्रिदशा बभौ ||
text_mt: Bhadrakālī then shone in the battle, while the gods were put to flight,

sanskrit_iast:
kalpe śeṣānalajvālā dagdhāviśvajagadyathā |
tadā savājinaṃ sūryaṃ rudrān rudragaṇāgraṇīḥ ||
meaning:
कल्पे शेषानलज्वाला दग्धाविश्वजगद्यथा |
तदा सवाजिनं सूर्यं रुद्रान् रुद्रगणाग्रणीः ||
text_mt: like the flame of the fire of Śeṣa at the dissolution of an aeon, which has consumed the entire universe. / Then Bhadra, the leader of the hosts of Rudras, swiftly and effortlessly

sanskrit_iast:
bhadro mūrdhni jaghānāśu vāmapādena līlayā |
asibhiḥ pāvakaṃ bhadraḥ paṭṭiśaistu yamaṃ yamīm ||
meaning:
भद्रो मूर्ध्नि जघानाशु वामपादेन लीलया |
असिभिः पावकं भद्रः पट्टिशैस्तु यमं यमीम् ||
text_mt: struck with his left foot the head of Sūrya with his horses, and the Rudras. / Bhadra [struck] Agni with swords, and Yama and Yamī with spears;

sanskrit_iast:
rudrān dṛḍhena śūlena mudgarairvaruṇaṃ dṛḍhaiḥ |
parighairnirṛtiṃ vāyuṃ ṭaṅkaiṣṭaṅkadharaḥ svayam ||
meaning:
रुद्रान् दृढेन शूलेन मुद्गरैर्वरुणं दृढैः |
परिघैर्निरृतिं वायुं टङ्कैष्टङ्कधरः स्वयम् ||
text_mt: he, bearing a stone-cutter's chisel, struck the Rudras with a stout trident, Varuṇa with stout clubs, / Nirṛti with iron bludgeons, and Vāyu with stone chisels.

sanskrit_iast:
nirbibheda raṇe vīro līlayaiva gaṇeśvaraḥ |
sarvāndevagaṇānsadyo munīn śambhorvirodhinaḥ ||
meaning:
निर्बिभेद रणे वीरो लीलयैव गणेश्वरः |
सर्वान्देवगणान्सद्यो मुनीन् शम्भोर्विरोधिनः ||
text_mt: The heroic lord of attendants in battle effortlessly pierced / all the hosts of gods and the sages who opposed Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devaḥ sarasvatyā nāsikāgraṃ suśobhanam |
ciccheda karajāgreṇa devamātustathaiva ca ||
meaning:
ततो देवः सरस्वत्या नासिकाग्रं सुशोभनम् |
चिच्छेद करजाग्रेण देवमातुस्तथैव च ||
text_mt: Then the lord sliced off the beautiful tip of Sarasvatī's nose with the tip of his claw, / and likewise that of the mother of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
ciccheda ca kuṭhāreṇa bāhudaṇḍaṃ vibhāvasoḥ |
agrato dvyaṅgulāṃ jihvāmāttahavyāṃ lulāva ca ||
meaning:
चिच्छेद च कुठारेण बाहुदण्डं विभावसोः |
अग्रतो द्व्यङ्गुलां जिह्वामात्तहव्यां लुलाव च ||
text_mt: With an axe, he severed the forearm of Vibhāvasu, / and cut off his forward two-finger tongue that receives the sacrificial offering.

sanskrit_iast:
svāhādevyāstathā devo dakṣiṇaṃ nāsikāpuṭam |
cakarta karajāgreṇa vāmaṃ ca stanacūcukam ||
meaning:
स्वाहादेव्यास्तथा देवो दक्षिणं नासिकापुटम् |
चकर्त करजाग्रेण वामं च स्तनचूचुकम् ||
text_mt: Likewise, the lord sliced off the right nostril of goddess Svāhā with the tip of his claw, / and her left nipple.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagasya vipule netre śatapatrasamaprabhe |
prasahyotpāṭayāmāsa bhadraḥ paramavegavān ||
meaning:
भगस्य विपुले नेत्रे शतपत्रसमप्रभे |
प्रसह्योत्पाटयामास भद्रः परमवेगवान् ||
text_mt: The two wide eyes of Bhaga, which shone like lotuses, / Bhadra violently gouged out with extreme speed.

sanskrit_iast:
pūṣṇo daśanarekhāṃ ca dīptāṃ muktāvalīmiva |
jaghāna dhanuṣaḥ koṭyā sa tenāspaṣṭavāgabhūt ||
meaning:
पूष्णो दशनरेखां च दीप्तां मुक्तावलीमिव |
जघान धनुषः कोट्या स तेनास्पष्टवागभूत् ||
text_mt: And the row of teeth of Pūṣan, shining like a string of pearls, / he struck with the tip of his bow; by that he became incoherent in speech.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścandramasaṃ devaḥ pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā |
kṣaṇaṃ kṛmivadākramya gharṣayāmāsa bhūtale ||
meaning:
ततश्चन्द्रमसं देवः पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया |
क्षणं कृमिवदाक्रम्य घर्षयामास भूतले ||
text_mt: Then, effortlessly treading upon the Moon with the big toe of his foot, / the lord ground him for a moment upon the surface of the earth like a worm.

sanskrit_iast:
śiraściccheda dakṣasya bhadraḥ paramakopataḥ |
krośantyāmeva vairiṇyāṃ bhadrakālyai dadau ca tat ||
meaning:
शिरश्चिच्छेद दक्षस्य भद्रः परमकोपतः |
क्रोशन्त्यामेव वैरिण्यां भद्रकाल्यै ददौ च तत् ||
text_mt: In extreme anger, Bhadra cut off the head of Dakṣa; / and while the enemy's [wife] was screaming, he gave it to Bhadrakālī.

sanskrit_iast:
tatprahṛṣṭā samādāya śirastālaphalopamam |
sā devī kandukakrīḍāṃ cakāra samarāṅgaṇe ||
meaning:
तत्प्रहृष्टा समादाय शिरस्तालफलोपमम् |
सा देवी कन्दुकक्रीडां चकार समराङ्गणे ||
text_mt: Joyfully taking that head, which resembled a palmyra fruit, / that goddess played a game of ball upon the field of battle.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dakṣasya yajñastrī kuśīlā bhartṛbhiryathā |
pādābhyāṃ caiva hastābhyāṃ hanyate sma gaṇeśvaraiḥ ||
meaning:
ततो दक्षस्य यज्ञस्त्री कुशीला भर्तृभिर्यथा |
पादाभ्यां चैव हस्ताभ्यां हन्यते स्म गणेश्वरैः ||
text_mt: Then Dakṣa's sacrificial queen, like a misbehaving woman by her husbands, / was beaten with feet and hands by the lords of attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
ariṣṭaneminaṃ somaṃ dharmaṃ caiva prajāpatim |
bahuputraṃ cāṅgirasaṃ kṛśāśvaṃ kāśyapaṃ tathā ||
meaning:
अरिष्टनेमिनं सोमं धर्मं चैव प्रजापतिम् |
बहुपुत्रं चाङ्गिरसं कृशाश्वं काश्यपं तथा ||
text_mt: Ariṣṭanemi, Soma, and the Prajāpati Dharma, / Bahuputra, Aṅgiras, Kṛśāśva, and Kāśyapa—

sanskrit_iast:
gale pragṛhya balino gaṇapāḥ siṃhavikramāḥ |
bhartsayanto bhṛśaṃ vāgbhirnijaghnurmūrdhni muṣṭibhiḥ ||
meaning:
गले प्रगृह्य बलिनो गणपाः सिंहविक्रमाः |
भर्त्सयन्तो भृशं वाग्भिर्निजघ्नुर्मूर्ध्नि मुष्टिभिः ||
text_mt: the mighty lords of attendants, possessing the valor of lions, seized them by the throat, / rebuked them fiercely with words, and struck them on the head with their fists.

sanskrit_iast:
dharṣitā bhūtavetālairdārāḥ sutaparigrahāḥ |
yathā kaliyuge jārairbalena kulayoṣitaḥ ||
meaning:
धर्षिता भूतवेतालैर्दाराः सुतपरिग्रहाः |
यथा कलियुगे जारैर्बलेन कुलयोषितः ||
text_mt: Wives, daughters, and retinues were violated by the Bhūtas and Vetālas, / just as noble women in the Kaliyuga [are violated] by paramours by force.

sanskrit_iast:
tacca vidhvastakalaśaṃ bhagnayūpaṃ gatotsavam |
pradīpitamahāśālaṃ prabhinnadvāratoraṇam ||
meaning:
तच्च विध्वस्तकलशं भग्नयूपं गतोत्सवम् |
प्रदीपितमहाशालं प्रभिन्नद्वारतोरणम् ||
text_mt: And with its pitchers smashed, its sacrificial post broken, its festive joy gone, / its great hall set ablaze, its gateway arches shattered,

sanskrit_iast:
utpāṭitasurānīkaṃ hanyamānatapodhanam |
praśāntabrahmanirghoṣaṃ prakṣīṇajanasañcayam ||
meaning:
उत्पाटितसुरानीकं हन्यमानतपोधनम् |
प्रशान्तब्रह्मनिर्घोषं प्रक्षीणजनसञ्चयम् ||
text_mt: the armies of the gods routed, the ascetics being slain, / the sound of the Vedas silenced, and the crowd of people decimated,

sanskrit_iast:
krandamānāturastrīkaṃ hatāśeṣaparicchadam |
śūnyāraṇyanibhaṃ jajñe yajñavāṭaṃ tadārditam ||
meaning:
क्रन्दमानातुरस्त्रीकं हताशेषपरिच्छदम् |
शून्यारण्यनिभं जज्ञे यज्ञवाटं तदार्दितम् ||
text_mt: its women wailing and distressed, all its utensils destroyed, / the sacrificial enclosure, thus afflicted, resembled a deserted wilderness.

sanskrit_iast:
śūlavegaprarugṇāśca bhinnabāhūruvakṣasaḥ |
vinikṛttottamāṅgāśca petururvyāṃ surottamāḥ ||
meaning:
शूलवेगप्ररुग्णाश्च भिन्नबाहूरुवक्षसः |
विनिकृत्तोत्तमाङ्गाश्च पेतुरुर्व्यां सुरोत्तमाः ||
text_mt: Shattered by the force of tridents, their arms, thighs, and chests broken, / their heads severed, the foremost gods fell to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
hateṣu teṣu deveṣu patiteṣu sahasraśaḥ |
praviveśa gaṇeśānaḥ kṣaṇādāhavanīyakam ||
meaning:
हतेषु तेषु देवेषु पतितेषु सहस्रशः |
प्रविवेश गणेशानः क्षणादाहवनीयकम् ||
text_mt: When those gods were slain and had fallen by the thousands, / the lord of the attendants entered the Āhavanīya fire within an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
praviṣṭamatha taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhadraṃ kālāgnisannibham |
dudrāva maraṇādbhīto yajño mṛgavapurdharaḥ ||
meaning:
प्रविष्टमथ तं दृष्ट्वा भद्रं कालाग्निसन्निभम् |
दुद्राव मरणाद्भीतो यज्ञो मृगवपुर्धरः ||
text_mt: Seeing Bhadra, who resembled the fire of doomsday, entered [there], / the Sacrifice, having assumed the form of a deer, fled in fear of death.

sanskrit_iast:
sa visphārya mahaccāpaṃ dṛḍhajyāghoṣaṇabhīṣaṇam |
bhadrastamabhidudrāva vikṣipanneva sāyakān ||
meaning:
स विस्फार्य महच्चापं दृढज्याघोषणभीषणम् |
भद्रस्तमभिदुद्राव विक्षिपन्नेव सायकान् ||
text_mt: Stringing his great bow, dreadful with the sound of its tight bowstring, / Bhadra rushed after him, discharging arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
ākarṇapūrṇamākṛṣṭaṃ dhanurambudasannibham |
nādayāmāsa ca jyāṃ dyāṃ khaṃ ca bhūmiṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ||
meaning:
आकर्णपूर्णमाकृष्टं धनुरम्बुदसन्निभम् |
नादयामास च ज्यां द्यां खं च भूमिं च सर्वशः ||
text_mt: The bow, drawn full to the ear and resembling a cloud, / caused its string to resonate through heaven, the sky, and the earth on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
tamupaśrutya sannādaṃ hato'smītyeva vihvalam |
śareṇārdhena vakreṇa sa vīro'dhvarapūruṣam ||
meaning:
तमुपश्रुत्य सन्नादं हतोऽस्मीत्येव विह्वलम् |
शरेणार्धेन वक्रेण स वीरोऽध्वरपूरुषम् ||
text_mt: Hearing that loud twang, thinking "I am slain!", frantic, / that hero, with a curved crescent-tipped arrow, [struck] the personified Sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhayaskhalatpādaṃ vepantaṃ vigatatviṣam |
mṛgarūpeṇa dhāvantaṃ viśiraskaṃ tadākarot ||
meaning:
महाभयस्खलत्पादं वेपन्तं विगतत्विषम् |
मृगरूपेण धावन्तं विशिरस्कं तदाकरोत् ||
text_mt: whose feet were stumbling in great fear, trembling, devoid of luster, / fleeing in the form of a deer—he then made him headless.

sanskrit_iast:
tamīdṛśamavajñātaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai sūryasambhavam |
viṣṇuḥ paramasaṅkruddho yuddhāyābhavadudyataḥ ||
meaning:
तमीदृशमवज्ञातं दृष्ट्वा वै सूर्यसम्भवम् |
विष्णुः परमसङ्क्रुद्धो युद्धायाभवदुद्यतः ||
text_mt:
Seeing him thus insulted, that son born of Sūrya,
Viṣṇu, extremely enraged, prepared for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
tamuvāha mahāvegātskandhena natasandhinā |
sarveṣāṃ vayasāṃ rājā garuḍaḥ pannagāśanaḥ ||
meaning:
तमुवाह महावेगात्स्कन्धेन नतसन्धिना |
सर्वेषां वयसां राजा गरुडः पन्नगाशनः ||
text_mt:
With great speed, upon his shoulder with bent joints,
Garuḍa, the king of all birds, the devourer of snakes, carried him.

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca hataśiṣṭā ye devarājapurogamāḥ |
pracakrustasya sāhāyyaṃ prāṇāṃstyaktumivodyatāḥ ||
meaning:
देवाश्च हतशिष्टा ये देवराजपुरोगमाः |
प्रचक्रुस्तस्य साहाय्यं प्राणांस्त्यक्तुमिवोद्यताः ||
text_mt:
And the gods who remained unslain, led by the king of the gods,
came to his aid, as if prepared to abandon their lives.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇunā sahitān devān mṛgendraḥ kroṣṭukāniva |
dṛṣṭvā jahāsa bhūtendro mṛgendra iva vivyathaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
विष्णुना सहितान् देवान् मृगेन्द्रः क्रोष्टुकानिव |
दृष्ट्वा जहास भूतेन्द्रो मृगेन्द्र इव विव्यथः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Seeing the gods accompanied by Viṣṇu, as a lion sees jackals,
the lord of spirits laughed without distress, like a lion.

Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca
tasminnavasare vyomni samāvirabhavadrathaḥ |
sahasrasūryasaṅkāśaścārucīravṛṣadhvajaḥ ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच
तस्मिन्नवसरे व्योम्नि समाविरभवद्रथः |
सहस्रसूर्यसङ्काशश्चारुचीरवृषध्वजः ||
title: dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | dakṣayajñavidhvaṃsavarṇanam
text_mt:
Chapter 22
At that moment, a chariot appeared in the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvaratnadvayodāro rathacakracatuṣṭayaḥ |
sañcitānekadivyāstraśastraratnapariṣkṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
अश्वरत्नद्वयोदारो रथचक्रचतुष्टयः |
सञ्चितानेकदिव्यास्त्रशस्त्ररत्नपरिष्कृतः ||
text_mt: adorned with numerous collected divine weapons and jewels of arms. / And indeed, the very same driver who had been the charioteer of that foremost chariot

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpi rathavaryasyāsītsa eva hi sārathiḥ |
yaścaiva traipure yuddhe pūrvaṃ śārvarathe sthitaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्यापि रथवर्यस्यासीत्स एव हि सारथिः |
यश्चैव त्रैपुरे युद्धे पूर्वं शार्वरथे स्थितः ||

sanskrit_iast:
sa taṃ rathavaraṃ brahmā śāsanādeva śūlinaḥ |
hareḥ samīpamānīya kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata ||
meaning:
स तं रथवरं ब्रह्मा शासनादेव शूलिनः |
हरेः समीपमानीय कृताञ्जलिरभाषत ||

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavan bhadra bhadrāṅga bhagavānindubhūṣaṇaḥ |
ājñāpayati vīrastvāṃ rathamāroḍhumavyayaḥ ||
meaning:
भगवन् भद्र भद्राङ्ग भगवानिन्दुभूषणः |
आज्ञापयति वीरस्त्वां रथमारोढुमव्ययः ||

sanskrit_iast:
raibhyāśramasamīpasthastryambako'mbikayā saha |
sampaśyate mahābāho dussahaṃ te parākramam ||
meaning:
रैभ्याश्रमसमीपस्थस्त्र्यम्बकोऽम्बिकया सह |
सम्पश्यते महाबाहो दुस्सहं ते पराक्रमम् ||
text_mt: the heroic and imperishable one, commands you to mount the chariot. / Tryambaka, stationed near the hermitage of Rebha along with Ambikā,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa vīro gaṇakuñjaraḥ |
āruroha rathaṃ divyamanugṛhya pitāmaham ||
meaning:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स वीरो गणकुञ्जरः |
आरुरोह रथं दिव्यमनुगृह्य पितामहम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tathā rathavare tasmin sthite brahmaṇi sārathau |
bhadrasya vavṛdhe lakṣmī rudrasyeva puradviṣaḥ ||
meaning:
तथा रथवरे तस्मिन् स्थिते ब्रह्मणि सारथौ |
भद्रस्य ववृधे लक्ष्मी रुद्रस्येव पुरद्विषः ||
text_mt:
favouring the Grandfather, mounted the divine chariot. / And when Brahmā stood as the charioteer on that foremost chariot,
the splendour of Bhadra increased like that of Rudra, the enemy of the three cities. / Then, placing a radiant, excellent conch resembling the full moon to his mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śaṅkhavaraṃ dīptaṃ pūrṇacandrasamaprabham |
pradadhmau vadane kṛtvā bhānukampo mahābalaḥ ||
meaning:
ततः शङ्खवरं दीप्तं पूर्णचन्द्रसमप्रभम् |
प्रदध्मौ वदने कृत्वा भानुकम्पो महाबलः ||
text_mt: the mighty Bhānukampa blew it. / Hearing that sound of his conch, which was like the call of a divided crane,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya śaṅkhasya taṃ nādaṃ bhinnasāgarasannibham |
śrutvā bhayena devānāṃ jajvāla jaṭharānalaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्य शङ्खस्य तं नादं भिन्नसागरसन्निभम् |
श्रुत्वा भयेन देवानां जज्वाल जठरानलः ||

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣavidyādharāhīndraiḥ siddhairyuddhadidṛkṣubhiḥ |
kṣaṇena nibiḍībhūtāḥ sākāśavivarā diśaḥ ||
meaning:
यक्षविद्याधराहीन्द्रैः सिद्धैर्युद्धदिदृक्षुभिः |
क्षणेन निबिडीभूताः साकाशविवरा दिशः ||
text_mt: the gastric fire of the gods blazed up with fear. / By the yakṣas, vidyādharas, lords of snakes, and siddhas wishing to watch the battle,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śārṅgeṇa cāpāṅkātsa nārāyaṇanīradaḥ |
mahatā bāṇavarṣeṇa tutoda gaṇagovṛṣam ||
meaning:
ततः शार्ङ्गेण चापाङ्कात्स नारायणनीरदः |
महता बाणवर्षेण तुतोद गणगोवृषम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇumāyāntaṃ śatadhā bāṇavarṣiṇam |
sa cādade dhanurjaitraṃ bhadro bāṇasahasramuk ||
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा विष्णुमायान्तं शतधा बाणवर्षिणम् |
स चाददे धनुर्जैत्रं भद्रो बाणसहस्रमुक् ||
text_mt: Bhadra, shooting thousands of arrows, took up his victorious bow. / And taking up that divine bow, terrible in battle,

sanskrit_iast:
samādāya ca taddivyaṃ dhanuḥ samarabhairavam |
śanairvisphārayāmāsa meruṃ dhanuriveśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
समादाय च तद्दिव्यं धनुः समरभैरवम् |
शनैर्विस्फारयामास मेरुं धनुरिवेश्वरः ||
text_mt: he slowly bent it, as the Lord bent Mount Meru as a bow. / As that bow was being strung, there was a mighty sound;

sanskrit_iast:
tasya visphāryyamāṇasya dhanuṣo'bhūnmahāsvanaḥ |
tena svanena mahatā pṛthivīṃ samakampayat ||
meaning:
तस्य विस्फार्य्यमाणस्य धनुषोऽभून्महास्वनः |
तेन स्वनेन महता पृथिवीं समकम्पयत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śaravaraṃ ghoraṃ dīptamāśīviṣopamam |
jagrāha gaṇapaḥ śrīmānsvayamugraparākramaḥ ||
meaning:
ततः शरवरं घोरं दीप्तमाशीविषोपमम् |
जग्राह गणपः श्रीमान्स्वयमुग्रपराक्रमः ||
text_mt: himself grasped an excellent, terrible arrow, blazing like a venomous serpent. / As he drew the arrow, his arm, reaching into the mouth of the quiver,

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇoddhāre bhujo hyasya tūṇīvadanasaṅgataḥ |
pratyadṛśyata valmīkaṃ vivekṣuriva pannagaḥ ||
meaning:
बाणोद्धारे भुजो ह्यस्य तूणीवदनसङ्गतः |
प्रत्यदृश्यत वल्मीकं विवेक्षुरिव पन्नगः ||
text_mt: appeared like a serpent wishing to enter an ant-hill. / Drawn forth in his hand, the arrow shone at that moment

sanskrit_iast:
samuddhṛtaḥ kare tasya tatkṣaṇaṃ ruruce śaraḥ |
mahābhujaṅgasandaṣṭo yathā bālabhujaṅgamaḥ ||
meaning:
समुद्धृतः करे तस्य तत्क्षणं रुरुचे शरः |
महाभुजङ्गसन्दष्टो यथा बालभुजङ्गमः ||

sanskrit_iast:
śareṇa ghanatīvreṇa bhadro rudraparākramaḥ |
vivyādha kupito gāḍhaṃ lalāṭe viṣṇumavyayam ||
meaning:
शरेण घनतीव्रेण भद्रो रुद्रपराक्रमः |
विव्याध कुपितो गाढं ललाटे विष्णुमव्ययम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭe'bhihato viṣṇuḥ pūrvamevāvamānitaḥ |
cukopa gaṇapendrāya mṛgendrāyeva govṛṣaḥ ||
meaning:
ललाटेऽभिहतो विष्णुः पूर्वमेवावमानितः |
चुकोप गणपेन्द्राय मृगेन्द्रायेव गोवृषः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tatastvaśanikalpena krūrāsyena maheṣuṇā |
vivyādha gaṇarājasya bhuje bhujagasannibhe ||
meaning:
ततस्त्वशनिकल्पेन क्रूरास्येन महेषुणा |
विव्याध गणराजस्य भुजे भुजगसन्निभे ||

sanskrit_iast:
so'pi tasya bhuje bhūyaḥ sūryāyutasamaprabham |
visasarja śaraṃ vegādvīrabhadro mahābalaḥ ||
meaning:
सोऽपि तस्य भुजे भूयः सूर्यायुतसमप्रभम् |
विससर्ज शरं वेगाद्वीरभद्रो महाबलः ||
text_mt: he struck the arm of the king of the gaṇas, which was like a serpent. / And he too, upon his arm, with an arrow equal in splendour to ten thousand suns,

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca viṣṇuḥ punarbhadraṃ bhadro viṣṇuṃ tathā punaḥ |
sa ca taṃ ca sa taṃ viprāḥ śaraistāvanujaghnatuḥ ||
meaning:
स च विष्णुः पुनर्भद्रं भद्रो विष्णुं तथा पुनः |
स च तं च स तं विप्राः शरैस्तावनुजघ्नतुः ||
text_mt: Vīrabhadra of great might swiftly shot forth [another]. / And that Viṣṇu again struck Bhadra, and Bhadra struck Viṣṇu again;

sanskrit_iast:
tayoḥ parasparaṃ vegāccharānāśu vimuñcatoḥ |
dvayoḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam ||
meaning:
तयोः परस्परं वेगाच्छरानाशु विमुञ्चतोः |
द्वयोः समभवद्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
taddṛṣṭvā tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ tayoreva parasparam |
hāhākāro mahānāsīdākāśe khecareritaḥ ||
meaning:
तद्दृष्ट्वा तुमुलं युद्धं तयोरेव परस्परम् |
हाहाकारो महानासीदाकाशे खेचरेरितः ||
text_mt: a tumultuous, hair-raising battle arose between them. / Seeing that tumultuous battle between the two of them,

sanskrit_iast:
tatastvanalatuṇḍena śareṇādityavarcasā |
vivyādha sudṛḍhaṃ bhadraṃ viṣṇormahati vakṣasi ||
meaning:
ततस्त्वनलतुण्डेन शरेणादित्यवर्चसा |
विव्याध सुदृढं भद्रं विष्णोर्महति वक्षसि ||

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu tīvraprapātena śareṇa dṛḍhamāhataḥ |
mahatīṃ rujamāsādya nipapāta vimohitaḥ ||
meaning:
स तु तीव्रप्रपातेन शरेण दृढमाहतः |
महतीं रुजमासाद्य निपपात विमोहितः ||

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ kṣaṇādivotthāya labdhasaṃjñastadā hariḥ |
sarvāṇyapi ca divyāstrāṇyathainaṃ pratyavāsṛjat ||
meaning:
पुनः क्षणादिवोत्थाय लब्धसंज्ञस्तदा हरिः |
सर्वाण्यपि च दिव्यास्त्राण्यथैनं प्रत्यवासृजत् ||
text_mt:
fell down, stunned, having incurred great pain. / Rising up again as if after a moment, Hari then regained consciousness,
and discharged all divine weapons against him. / And all the arrows shot from Viṣṇu's bow, the general of Sarva's army,

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca viṣṇurdhanurmuktānsarvān śarvacamūpatiḥ |
sahasā vārayāmāsa ghoraiḥ pratiśaraiḥ śarān ||
meaning:
स च विष्णुर्धनुर्मुक्तान्सर्वान् शर्वचमूपतिः |
सहसा वारयामास घोरैः प्रतिशरैः शरान् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tato viṣṇuḥ svanāmāṅkaṃ bāṇamavyāhataṃ kvacit |
sasarja krodharaktākṣaḥ tamuddiśya gaṇeśvaram |
taṃ bāṇaṃ bāṇavaryeṇa bhadro bhadrāhvayeṇa tu ||
meaning:
ततो विष्णुः स्वनामाङ्कं बाणमव्याहतं क्वचित् |
ससर्ज क्रोधरक्ताक्षः तमुद्दिश्य गणेश्वरम् |
तं बाणं बाणवर्येण भद्रो भद्राह्वयेण तु ||

sanskrit_iast:
aprāptameva bhagavān ciccheda śatadhā pathi |
athaikeneṣuṇā śārṅgaṃ dvābhyāṃ pakṣau garutmataḥ ||
meaning:
अप्राप्तमेव भगवान् चिच्छेद शतधा पथि |
अथैकेनेषुणा शार्ङ्गं द्वाभ्यां पक्षौ गरुत्मतः ||
text_mt: Then with one arrow he shattered the Śārṅga [bow], and with two, the wings of Garuḍa / in the twinkling of an eye; that was like a miracle.

sanskrit_iast:
nimeṣādeva ciccheda tadadbhutamivābhavat |
tato yogabalādviṣṇurdehāddevān sudāruṇān ||
meaning:
निमेषादेव चिच्छेद तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् |
ततो योगबलाद्विष्णुर्देहाद्देवान् सुदारुणान् ||

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhacakragadāhastān visasarja sahasraśaḥ |
sarvāṃstānkṣaṇamātreṇa traipurāniva śaṅkaraḥ ||
meaning:
शङ्खचक्रगदाहस्तान् विससर्ज सहस्रशः |
सर्वांस्तान्क्षणमात्रेण त्रैपुरानिव शङ्करः ||

sanskrit_iast:
nirdadāha mahābāhurnetrasṛṣṭena vahninā |
tataḥ kruddhataro viṣṇuścakramudyamya satvaraḥ ||
meaning:
निर्ददाह महाबाहुर्नेत्रसृष्टेन वह्निना |
ततः क्रुद्धतरो विष्णुश्चक्रमुद्यम्य सत्वरः ||
text_mt: Then the hero Viṣṇu, still more enraged, quickly raised his discus / and prepared at that moment to hurl it upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminvīre samutsraṣṭuṃ tadānīmudyato'bhavat |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā cakramudyamya purataḥ samupasthitam ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्वीरे समुत्स्रष्टुं तदानीमुद्यतोऽभवत् |
तं दृष्ट्वा चक्रमुद्यम्य पुरतः समुपस्थितम् ||
text_mt: Seeing him standing in front with raised discus, / the lord of the gaṇas, as if smiling, effortlessly paralysed him.

sanskrit_iast:
smayanniva gaṇeśāno vyaṣṭambhayadayatnataḥ |
stambhitāṅgastu taccakraṃ ghoramapratimaṃ kvacit ||
meaning:
स्मयन्निव गणेशानो व्यष्टम्भयदयत्नतः |
स्तम्भिताङ्गस्तु तच्चक्रं घोरमप्रतिमं क्वचित् ||

sanskrit_iast:
icchannapi samutsraṣṭuṃ na viṣṇurabhavatkṣamaḥ |
śvasannivaikamuddhṛtya bāhuṃ cakrasamanvitam ||
meaning:
इच्छन्नपि समुत्स्रष्टुं न विष्णुरभवत्क्षमः |
श्वसन्निवैकमुद्धृत्य बाहुं चक्रसमन्वितम् ||
text_mt:
With his limbs paralysed, Viṣṇu was unable to release that terrible discus, / peerless anywhere, even though he wished to.
Holding up one arm accompanied by the discus, as if gasping for breath, / he stood motionless, having become inactive like a stone.

sanskrit_iast:
atiṣṭhadalaso bhūtvā pāṣāṇāmiva niścalaḥ |
viśarīro yathā jīvo viśṛṅgo vā yathā vṛṣaḥ ||
meaning:
अतिष्ठदलसो भूत्वा पाषाणामिव निश्चलः |
विशरीरो यथा जीवो विशृङ्गो वा यथा वृषः ||

sanskrit_iast:
vidaṃṣṭraśca yathā siṃhastathā viṣṇuravasthitaḥ |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā durdaśāpannaṃ viṣṇumindrādayaḥ surāḥ |
samunnaddhā gaṇendreṇa mṛgendreṇeva govṛṣāḥ ||
meaning:
विदंष्ट्रश्च यथा सिंहस्तथा विष्णुरवस्थितः |
तं दृष्ट्वा दुर्दशापन्नं विष्णुमिन्द्रादयः सुराः |
समुन्नद्धा गणेन्द्रेण मृगेन्द्रेणेव गोवृषाः ||
text_mt: Just like a living being without a body, or a bull without horns, / or a lion without fangs, so Viṣṇu stood.

sanskrit_iast:
pragṛhītāyudhā yauddhuṃ kruddhāḥ samupatasthire |
tāndṛṣṭvā samare bhadraḥ kṣudrāniva harirmṛgān ||
meaning:
प्रगृहीतायुधा यौद्धुं क्रुद्धाः समुपतस्थिरे |
तान्दृष्ट्वा समरे भद्रः क्षुद्रानिव हरिर्मृगान् ||
text_mt:
Seeing Viṣṇu fallen into such a wretched state, the gods headed by Indra, / like bulls aroused against a lion by the lord of the gaṇas, / stood ready, enraged, taking up their weapons to fight.
Seeing them in battle like a lion seeing petty deer, Bhadra, / the hero whose form was Rudra himself, surrounded by a host of choice heroes,

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣād rudratanurvīro varavīragaṇāvṛtaḥ |
aṭṭahāsena ghoreṇa vyaṣṭambhayadaninditaḥ ||
meaning:
साक्षाद् रुद्रतनुर्वीरो वरवीरगणावृतः |
अट्टहासेन घोरेण व्यष्टम्भयदनिन्दितः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tathā śatamakhasyāpi savajro dakṣiṇaḥ karaḥ |
sisṛkṣoreva udvajraścitrīkṛta ivābhavat ||
meaning:
तथा शतमखस्यापि सवज्रो दक्षिणः करः |
सिसृक्षोरेव उद्वज्रश्चित्रीकृत इवाभवत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
anyeṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ saraktā api bāhavaḥ |
alasānāmivārambhāstādṛśāḥ pratiyāntyuta ||
meaning:
अन्येषामपि सर्वेषां सरक्ता अपि बाहवः |
अलसानामिवारम्भास्तादृशाः प्रतियान्त्युत ||

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bhagavatā tena vyāhatāśeṣavaibhavāt |
amarāḥ samare tasya purataḥ sthātumakṣamāḥ ||
meaning:
एवं भगवता तेन व्याहताशेषवैभवात् |
अमराः समरे तस्य पुरतः स्थातुमक्षमाः ||

sanskrit_iast:
stabdhairavayavaireva dudruvurbhayavihvalāḥ |
sthitiṃ ca cakrire yuddhe vīratejo'bhayākulāḥ ||
meaning:
स्तब्धैरवयवैरेव दुद्रुवुर्भयविह्वलाः |
स्थितिं च चक्रिरे युद्धे वीरतेजोऽभयाकुलाः ||
text_mt:
the immortals, unable to stand before him in battle, / fled, overwhelmed with fear, with their limbs indeed stiffened;
overcome with fear at the hero's splendour, they could make no stand in battle. / As the heroic thirty [gods] fled, the mighty-armed Vīrabhadra

sanskrit_iast:
vidrutāṃstridaśānvīrānvīrabhadro mahābhujaḥ |
vivyādha niśitairbāṇaiermegho varṣairivācalān ||
meaning:
विद्रुतांस्त्रिदशान्वीरान्वीरभद्रो महाभुजः |
विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैएर्मेघो वर्षैरिवाचलान् ||

sanskrit_iast:
bahavastasya vīrasya bāhavaḥ parighopamāḥ |
śastraiścakāśire dīptaiḥ sāgnijvālā ivoragāḥ ||
meaning:
बहवस्तस्य वीरस्य बाहवः परिघोपमाः |
शस्त्रैश्चकाशिरे दीप्तैः साग्निज्वाला इवोरगाः ||
text_mt: shone with radiant weapons like serpents accompanied by flames of fire. / Discharging numerous weapons and missiles, that hero shone

sanskrit_iast:
astraśastrāṇyanekāni sa vīro visṛjanbabhau |
visṛjansarvabhūtāni yathādau viśvasambhavaḥ ||
meaning:
अस्त्रशस्त्राण्यनेकानि स वीरो विसृजन्बभौ |
विसृजन्सर्वभूतानि यथादौ विश्वसम्भवः ||
text_mt: like the Creator of the universe in the beginning, emitting all beings. / Just as the sun covers the earth with its rays,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā raśmibhirādityaḥ pracchādayati medinīm |
tathā vīraḥ kṣaṇādeva śaraiḥ prācchādayaddiśaḥ ||
meaning:
यथा रश्मिभिरादित्यः प्रच्छादयति मेदिनीम् |
तथा वीरः क्षणादेव शरैः प्राच्छादयद्दिशः ||

ब्रह्मोवाच |

Wondrous indeed is your conduct, determined by your grace;

शिव उवाच |

इति सुरानभिधाय सुरेश्वरो निकृतदक्षकृतक्रतुरक्रतुः |

text_mt:
Having spoken thus to the gods, the Lord of the gods, who had ruined the sacrifice performed by Dakṣa, himself free from sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:

sapadi khena sukhena yathāsukhaṃ yayuranekamukhāḥ maghavanmukhāḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
अथ सुरा अपि ते विगतव्यथाः कथितभद्रसुभद्रपराक्रमाः |
सपदि खेन सुखेन यथासुखं ययुरनेकमुखाः मघवन्मुखाः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Hara, together with the daughter of the Mountain, with his followers and his retinue, vanished, as if remaining in the sky. / Then those gods too, free from pain, having their valiant and auspicious prowess described,
went at once through the sky at their ease, happily, in many directions, led by Maghavat.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
antardhānagato devyā saha sānucaro haraḥ |
kva yātaḥ kutra vā vāsaḥ kiṃ kṛtvā virarāma ha ||
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः |
अन्तर्धानगतो देव्या सह सानुचरो हरः |
क्व यातः कुत्र वा वासः किं कृत्वा विरराम ह ||
title: caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivamandaragirinivāsakrīḍoktivarṇanam
text_mt: Chapter 24 / The sages said: / Hara having vanished together with the Goddess and his followers,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
mahīdharavaraḥ śrīmān mandaraścitrakandaraḥ |
dayito devadevasya nivāsastapaso'bhavat ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
महीधरवरः श्रीमान् मन्दरश्चित्रकन्दरः |
दयितो देवदेवस्य निवासस्तपसोऽभवत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tapo mahatkṛtaṃ tena voḍhuṃ svaśirasā śivau |
cireṇa labdhaṃ tatpādapaṅkajasparśajaṃ sukham ||
meaning:
तपो महत्कृतं तेन वोढुं स्वशिरसा शिवौ |
चिरेण लब्धं तत्पादपङ्कजस्पर्शजं सुखम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tasya śailasya saundaryaṃ sahasravadanairapi |
na śakyaṃ vistarādvaktuṃ varṣakoṭiśatairapi ||
meaning:
तस्य शैलस्य सौन्दर्यं सहस्रवदनैरपि |
न शक्यं विस्तराद्वक्तुं वर्षकोटिशतैरपि ||
text_mt:
after a long time it attained the bliss born of the touch of their lotus feet. / The beauty of that mountain cannot be described in detail even with a thousand mouths,
even in hundreds of millions of years. / Even if it were possible, I do not venture to describe its beauty,

sanskrit_iast:
śakyamapyasya saundaryaṃ na varṇayitumutsahe |
parvatāntarasaundaryaṃ sādhāraṇavidhāraṇāt ||
meaning:
शक्यमप्यस्य सौन्दर्यं न वर्णयितुमुत्सहे |
पर्वतान्तरसौन्दर्यं साधारणविधारणात् ||
text_mt: because it shares the common condition of the beauty of other mountains. / But this can be said about this handsome mountain:

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ tu śakyate vaktumasminparvatasundare |
ṛddhyā kayāpi saundaryamīśvarāvāsayogyatā ||
meaning:
इदं तु शक्यते वक्तुमस्मिन्पर्वतसुन्दरे |
ऋद्ध्या कयापि सौन्दर्यमीश्वरावासयोग्यता ||

sanskrit_iast:
ata eva hi devena devyāḥ priyacikīrṣayā |
atīva ramaṇīyo'yaṃ girirantaḥpurīkṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
अत एव हि देवेन देव्याः प्रियचिकीर्षया |
अतीव रमणीयोऽयं गिरिरन्तःपुरीकृतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
mekhalābhūmayastasya vimalopalapādapāḥ |
śivayornityasānnidhyānnyakkurvantyakhilaṃ jagat ||
meaning:
मेखलाभूमयस्तस्य विमलोपलपादपाः |
शिवयोर्नित्यसान्निध्यान्न्यक्कुर्वन्त्यखिलं जगत् ||
text_mt: The slopes of its ridges, with pure stones and trees, / surpass the entire world because of the constant presence of the two auspicious ones.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛbhyāṃ jagato nityaṃ snānapānopayogataḥ |
avāptapuṇyasaṃskāraḥ prasaradbhiritastataḥ ||
meaning:
पितृभ्यां जगतो नित्यं स्नानपानोपयोगतः |
अवाप्तपुण्यसंस्कारः प्रसरद्भिरितस्ततः ||
text_mt: From constantly serving for the bathing and drinking of the parents of the universe, / it attained holy purification from the waters flowing here and there,

sanskrit_iast:
laghuśītalasaṃsparśairacchācchairnirjharāmbubhiḥ |
adhirājyena cādrīṇāmadrīreṣo'bhiṣicyate ||
meaning:
लघुशीतलसंस्पर्शैरच्छाच्छैर्निर्झराम्बुभिः |
अधिराज्येन चाद्रीणामद्रीरेषोऽभिषिच्यते ||
text_mt: with crystal-clear torrent waters, light and cool to the touch; / and this mountain is consecrated into the sovereignty over mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
niśāsu śikharaprāntarvartinā sa śiloccayaḥ |
candreṇācalasāmrājyacchatreṇeva virājate ||
meaning:
निशासु शिखरप्रान्तर्वर्तिना स शिलोच्चयः |
चन्द्रेणाचलसाम्राज्यच्छत्रेणेव विराजते ||
text_mt: At night, by the moon resting on the edge of its peaks, / that mass of rocks shines as if with the parasol of imperial rule over mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
sa śailaścañcalībhūtairbālaiścāmarayoṣitām |
sarvaparvatasāmrājyacāmarairiva vījyate ||
meaning:
स शैलश्चञ्चलीभूतैर्बालैश्चामरयोषिताम् |
सर्वपर्वतसाम्राज्यचामरैरिव वीज्यते ||
text_mt: And that mountain is fanned, as if by the fly-whisks of sovereignty over all mountains, / by the waving hairs of the yak-tailed deer.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarabhyudite bhānau bhūdharo ratnabhūṣitaḥ |
darpaṇe dehasaubhāgyaṃ draṣṭukāma iva sthitaḥ ||
meaning:
प्रातरभ्युदिते भानौ भूधरो रत्नभूषितः |
दर्पणे देहसौभाग्यं द्रष्टुकाम इव स्थितः ||
text_mt: When the sun has risen in the morning, the mountain, adorned with jewels, / stands as if desiring to behold the beauty of its body in a mirror.

sanskrit_iast:
kūjadvihaṅgavācālairvātoddhṛtalatābhujaiḥ |
vimuktapuṣpaiḥ satataṃ vyālambimṛdupallavaiḥ ||
meaning:
कूजद्विहङ्गवाचालैर्वातोद्धृतलताभुजैः |
विमुक्तपुष्पैः सततं व्यालम्बिमृदुपल्लवैः ||
text_mt: With trees noisy with chirping birds, their vine-arms raised by the wind, / shedding blossoms continuously, their tender sprouts drooping down,

sanskrit_iast:
latāpratānajaṭilaistarubhistāpasairiva |
jayāśiṣā sahābhyarcya niṣevyata ivādrirāṭ ||
meaning:
लताप्रतानजटिलैस्तरुभिस्तापसैरिव |
जयाशिषा सहाभ्यर्च्य निषेव्यत इवाद्रिराट् ||
text_mt: matted with creepers like ascetics with matted hair, / the king of mountains is attended as if worshipped with blessings of victory.

sanskrit_iast:
adhomukhairūrdhvamukhaiḥ śṛṅgaistiryaṅmukhaistathā |
prapatanniva pātāle bhūpṛṣṭhādutpatanniva ||
meaning:
अधोमुखैरूर्ध्वमुखैः शृङ्गैस्तिर्यङ्मुखैस्तथा |
प्रपतन्निव पाताले भूपृष्ठादुत्पतन्निव ||
text_mt: With peaks pointing downwards, pointing upwards, and pointing sideways, / it is as if plunging into the netherworld, as if flying up from the earth's surface,

sanskrit_iast:
parītaḥ sarvato dikṣu bhramanniva vihāyasi |
paśyanniva jagatsarvaṃ nṛtyanniva nirantaram ||
meaning:
परीतः सर्वतो दिक्षु भ्रमन्निव विहायसि |
पश्यन्निव जगत्सर्वं नृत्यन्निव निरन्तरम् ||
text_mt: surrounded in all directions, as if wandering in the sky, / as if beholding the entire universe, as if perpetually dancing.

sanskrit_iast:
guhāmukhaiḥ pratidinaṃ vyāttāsyo vipulodaraiḥ |
ajīrṇalāvaṇyatayā jṛmbhamāṇa ivācalaḥ ||
meaning:
गुहामुखैः प्रतिदिनं व्यात्तास्यो विपुलोदरैः |
अजीर्णलावण्यतया जृम्भमाण इवाचलः ||
text_mt: With its mouth opened wide every day by the cave-mouths of its vast interior, / the mountain is as if yawning on account of its undigested beauty,

sanskrit_iast:
grasanniva jagatsarvaṃ pibanniva payonidhim |
vamanniva tamo'ntasthaṃ mādyanniva khamambudaiḥ ||
meaning:
ग्रसन्निव जगत्सर्वं पिबन्निव पयोनिधिम् |
वमन्निव तमोऽन्तस्थं माद्यन्निव खमम्बुदैः ||
text_mt: as if swallowing the entire world, as if drinking the ocean, / as if vomiting the darkness within, as if intoxicating the sky with clouds.

sanskrit_iast:
nivāsabhūmayastāstā darpaṇapratimodarāḥ |
tiraskṛtātapāḥ snigdhāśramacchāyāmahīruhāḥ ||
meaning:
निवासभूमयस्तास्ता दर्पणप्रतिमोदराः |
तिरस्कृतातपाः स्निग्धाश्रमच्छायामहीरुहाः ||
text_mt: Those various dwelling grounds, with interiors like mirrors, / their heat dispelled, having glossy trees with restful shade,

sanskrit_iast:
saritsarastaḍāgādisamparkaśiśirānilāḥ |
tatra tatra niṣaṇṇābhyāṃ śivābhyāṃ saphalīkṛtāḥ ||
meaning:
सरित्सरस्तडागादिसम्पर्कशिशिरानिलाः |
तत्र तत्र निषण्णाभ्यां शिवाभ्यां सफलीकृताः ||
text_mt: with breezes cool from contact with rivers, lakes, and ponds, / were made fruitful by the two auspicious ones seated here and there.

sanskrit_iast:
tamimaṃ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ smṛtvā sāmbastriyambakaḥ |
raibhyāśramasamīpasthaścāntardhānaṃ gato yayau ||
meaning:
तमिमं सर्वतः श्रेष्ठं स्मृत्वा साम्बस्त्रियम्बकः |
रैभ्याश्रमसमीपस्थश्चान्तर्धानं गतो ययौ ||
text_mt: Remembering that mountain which is best in every respect, the three-eyed Lord with Ambā, / who was near the hermitage of Raibhya, vanished and went there.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrodyānamanuprāpya devyā saha maheśvaraḥ |
rarāma ramaṇīyāsu devyāntaḥpurabhūmiṣu ||
meaning:
तत्रोद्यानमनुप्राप्य देव्या सह महेश्वरः |
रराम रमणीयासु देव्यान्तःपुरभूमिषु ||
text_mt: Having reached the garden there together with the goddess, the Great Lord / took his delight in the delightful inner apartments of the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā gateṣu kāleṣu pravṛddhāsu prajāsu ca |
daityau śumbhaniśumbhākhyau bhrātarau sambabhūvatuḥ ||
meaning:
तथा गतेषु कालेषु प्रवृद्धासु प्रजासु च |
दैत्यौ शुम्भनिशुम्भाख्यौ भ्रातरौ सम्बभूवतुः ||
text_mt: As time thus passed and living beings multiplied, / two Daitya brothers named Śumbha and Niśumbha were born.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhyāṃ tapobalāddattaṃ brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā |
avadhyatvaṃ jagatyasminpuruṣairakhilairapi ||
meaning:
ताभ्यां तपोबलाद्दत्तं ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना |
अवध्यत्वं जगत्यस्मिन्पुरुषैरखिलैरपि ||
text_mt: By virtue of their austerity, Brahmā, the supreme lord, granted them / invulnerability to all men in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
ayonijā tu yā kanyā hyambikāṃśasamudbhavā |
ajātapuṃsparśaratiravilaṅghyaparākramā ||
meaning:
अयोनिजा तु या कन्या ह्यम्बिकांशसमुद्भवा |
अजातपुंस्पर्शरतिरविलङ्घ्यपराक्रमा ||
text_mt: "Let there be a maiden not born of a womb, born from a portion of Ambikā, / taking no pleasure in the touch of a man, of insurmountable prowess;

sanskrit_iast:
tayā tu nau vadhaḥ saṅkhye tasyāṃ kāmābhibhūtayoḥ |
iti cābhyarthito brahmā tābhyāṃ prāha tathāstviti ||
meaning:
तया तु नौ वधः सङ्ख्ये तस्यां कामाभिभूतयोः |
इति चाभ्यर्थितो ब्रह्मा ताभ्यां प्राह तथास्त्विति ||
text_mt: by her alone let there be the death of us two in battle, when we are overcome by desire for her." / Besought thus by the two, Brahmā said to them, "So be it."

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛti śakrādīnvijitya samare surān |
niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṃ jagaccakraturakramāt ||
meaning:
ततः प्रभृति शक्रादीन्विजित्य समरे सुरान् |
निःस्वाध्यायवषट्कारं जगच्चक्रतुरक्रमात् ||
text_mt: From that time forward, having conquered the gods headed by Śakra in battle, / they unlawfully made the world devoid of Vedic recitation and sacrificial cries.

sanskrit_iast:
tayorvadhāya deveśaṃ brahmābhyarthitavānpunaḥ |
vinindyāpi rahasyambāṃ krodhayitvā yathā tathā ||
meaning:
तयोर्वधाय देवेशं ब्रह्माभ्यर्थितवान्पुनः |
विनिन्द्यापि रहस्यम्बां क्रोधयित्वा यथा तथा ||
text_mt: For their slaughter, Brahmā once again besought the Lord of gods: / "Even by reproaching Ambā in secret, having provoked her to anger by whatever means,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvarṇakośajāṃ śaktimakāmāṃ kanyakātmikām |
niśumbhaśumbhayorhantrīṃ surebhyo dātumarhasi ||
meaning:
तद्वर्णकोशजां शक्तिमकामां कन्यकात्मिकाम् |
निशुम्भशुम्भयोर्हन्त्रीं सुरेभ्यो दातुमर्हसि ||
text_mt: you ought to grant to the gods the power born of the sheath of her complexion, free of desire, in the form of a maiden, / the slayer of Niśumbha and Śumbha."

sanskrit_iast:
evamabhyarthito dhātrā bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ |
kālītyāha rahasyaṃ vāṃ nindayanniva sasmitaḥ ||
meaning:
एवमभ्यर्थितो धात्रा भगवान्नीललोहितः |
कालीत्याह रहस्यं वां निन्दयन्निव सस्मितः ||
text_mt: Entreated thus by the Creator, the blessed Nīlalohita, / as if reproaching her in secret, smiled and said, "Kālī!"

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kruddhā tadā devī suvarṇā varṇakāraṇāt |
smayantī cāha bhartāramasamādheyayā girā ||
meaning:
ततः क्रुद्धा तदा देवी सुवर्णा वर्णकारणात् |
स्मयन्ती चाह भर्तारमसमाधेयया गिरा ||
text_mt: Then the golden-complexioned goddess became angry on account of her complexion, / and smilingly addressed her husband with speech that admitted of no reconciliation:

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca |
īdṛśe mama varṇe'sminna ratirbhavato'sti cet |
evāvantaṃ ciraṃ kālaṃ kathameṣā niyamyate ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच |
ईदृशे मम वर्णेऽस्मिन्न रतिर्भवतोऽस्ति चेत् |
एवावन्तं चिरं कालं कथमेषा नियम्यते ||

sanskrit_iast:
aratyā vartamāno'pi kathaṃ ca ramase mayā |
na hyaśakyaṃ jagatyasminnīśvarasya jagatprabhoḥ ||
meaning:
अरत्या वर्तमानोऽपि कथं च रमसे मया |
न ह्यशक्यं जगत्यस्मिन्नीश्वरस्य जगत्प्रभोः ||
text_mt:
Indeed, nothing is impossible in this world for the Sovereign, the Lord of the world.
For you, rejoicing in your own Self, pleasure is not the means of happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
svātmārāmasya bhavato ratirna sukhasādhanam |
iti hetoḥ smaro yasmātprasabhaṃ bhasmasātkṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
स्वात्मारामस्य भवतो रतिर्न सुखसाधनम् |
इति हेतोः स्मरो यस्मात्प्रसभं भस्मसात्कृतः ||
text_mt:
For this reason, Smara was forcibly reduced to ashes.
And she who is not pleasing to her husband, even if beautiful in every limb,

sanskrit_iast:
yā ca nābhiratā bharturapi sarvāṅgasundarī |
sā vṛthaiva hi jāyeta sarvairapi guṇāntaraiḥ ||
meaning:
या च नाभिरता भर्तुरपि सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी |
सा वृथैव हि जायेत सर्वैरपि गुणान्तरैः ||

sanskrit_iast:
bharturbhogaikaśeṣo hi sarga evaiṣa yoṣitām |
tathāsatyanyathā bhūtā nārī kutropayujyate ||
meaning:
भर्तुर्भोगैकशेषो हि सर्ग एवैष योषिताम् |
तथासत्यन्यथा भूता नारी कुत्रोपयुज्यते ||

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvarṇamimaṃ tyaktvā tvayā rahasi ninditam |
varṇāntaraṃ bhajiṣye vā na bhajiṣyāmi vā svayam ||
meaning:
तस्माद्वर्णमिमं त्यक्त्वा त्वया रहसि निन्दितम् |
वर्णान्तरं भजिष्ये वा न भजिष्यामि वा स्वयम् ||
text_mt:
That being so, of what use is a woman who has become otherwise?
Therefore, having abandoned this complexion blamed by you in secret,
I shall take another complexion, or I shall not take one at all.”
Having spoken thus and risen from the bed, the Goddess spoke falteringly;

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvotthāya śayanāddevī sācaṣṭa gadgadam |
yayāce'numatiṃ bhartustapase kṛtaniścayā ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वोत्थाय शयनाद्देवी साचष्ट गद्गदम् |
ययाचेऽनुमतिं भर्तुस्तपसे कृतनिश्चया ||

sanskrit_iast:
tathā praṇayabhaṅgena bhīto bhūtapatiḥ svayam |
pādayoḥ praṇamanneva bhavānīṃ pratyabhāṣata ||
meaning:
तथा प्रणयभङ्गेन भीतो भूतपतिः स्वयम् |
पादयोः प्रणमन्नेव भवानीं प्रत्यभाषत ||
text_mt:
bowing down at her feet, spoke in reply to Bhavānī.
Īśvara said:
“O dear one, not understanding a playful remark, why are you angry with me?

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca |
ajānatī ca krīḍoktiṃ priye kiṃ kupitāsi me |
ratiḥ kuto vā jāyeta tvattaścedaratirmama ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच |
अजानती च क्रीडोक्तिं प्रिये किं कुपितासि मे |
रतिः कुतो वा जायेत त्वत्तश्चेदरतिर्मम ||

sanskrit_iast:
mātā tvamasya jagataḥ pitāhamadhipastathā |
kathaṃ tadupapadyeta tvatto nābhiratirmama ||
meaning:
माता त्वमस्य जगतः पिताहमधिपस्तथा |
कथं तदुपपद्येत त्वत्तो नाभिरतिर्मम ||

sanskrit_iast:
āvayorabhikāmo'pi kimasau kāmakāritaḥ |
yataḥ kāmasamutteḥ prāgeva jagadudbhavaḥ ||
meaning:
आवयोरभिकामोऽपि किमसौ कामकारितः |
यतः कामसमुत्तेः प्रागेव जगदुद्भवः ||

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthagjanānāṃ rataye kāmātmā kalpito mayā |
tataḥ kathamupālabdhaḥ kāmadāhādahaṃ tvayā ||
meaning:
पृथग्जनानां रतये कामात्मा कल्पितो मया |
ततः कथमुपालब्धः कामदाहादहं त्वया ||

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ vai tridaśasāmānyaṃ manyamāno manobhavaḥ |
manākparibhavaṃ kurvanmayā vai bhasmasātkṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
मां वै त्रिदशसामान्यं मन्यमानो मनोभवः |
मनाक्परिभवं कुर्वन्मया वै भस्मसात्कृतः ||
text_mt:
how, then, am I reproached by you on account of the burning of Kāma?
Indeed, the Mind-born one, considering me to be an ordinary god,
caused a slight disrespect and was burned to ashes by me.
Even this sport of ours is for the sake of protecting the world.

sanskrit_iast:
vihāro'pyāvayorasya jagatastrāṇakāraṇāt |
tatastadarthaṃ tvayyadya krīḍoktiṃ kṛtavānaham ||
meaning:
विहारोऽप्यावयोरस्य जगतस्त्राणकारणात् |
ततस्तदर्थं त्वय्यद्य क्रीडोक्तिं कृतवानहम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāyamacirādarthastavaivāviṣkariṣyate |
krodhasya janakaṃ vākyaṃ hṛdi kṛtvedamabravīt ||
meaning:
स चायमचिरादर्थस्तवैवाविष्करिष्यते |
क्रोधस्य जनकं वाक्यं हृदि कृत्वेदमब्रवीत् ||
text_mt:
Keeping in her heart the words that gave rise to anger, she said this.
The Goddess said:
“O Lord, your flattering speech has indeed been heard by me before,

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca |
śrutapūrvaṃ hi bhagavaṃstava cāṭuvaco mayā |
yenaivamatidhīrāhamapi prāgabhivañcitā ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच |
श्रुतपूर्वं हि भगवंस्तव चाटुवचो मया |
येनैवमतिधीराहमपि प्रागभिवञ्चिता ||

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇānapyapriyā bharturnārī yā na parityajet |
kulāṅganā śubhā sadbhiḥ kutsitaiva hi gamyate ||
meaning:
प्राणानप्यप्रिया भर्तुर्नारी या न परित्यजेत् |
कुलाङ्गना शुभा सद्भिः कुत्सितैव हि गम्यते ||
text_mt:
by which even I, although very steadfast, was previously deceived.
A woman who is not pleasing to her husband and does not abandon even her life,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyasī ca tavāprītiragauramiti me vapuḥ |
krīḍoktirapi kālīti ghaṭate kathamanyathā ||
meaning:
भूयसी च तवाप्रीतिरगौरमिति मे वपुः |
क्रीडोक्तिरपि कालीति घटते कथमन्यथा ||

sanskrit_iast:
sadbhirvigarhitaṃ tasmāttava kārṣṇyamasammatam |
anutsṛjya tapoyogātsthātumeveha notsahe ||
meaning:
सद्भिर्विगर्हितं तस्मात्तव कार्ष्ण्यमसम्मतम् |
अनुत्सृज्य तपोयोगात्स्थातुमेवेह नोत्सहे ||
text_mt:
How else does even a playful remark, ‘O Kālī!’, fit?
Therefore, having not discarded this blackness censured by the virtuous and disliked by you,
through the practice of asceticism, I do not wish to remain here at all.”

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca |
yadyevaṃvidhatāpaste tapasā kiṃ prayojanam |
mamecchayā svecchayā vā varṇāntaravatī bhava ||
meaning:
शिव उवाच |
यद्येवंविधतापस्ते तपसा किं प्रयोजनम् |
ममेच्छया स्वेच्छया वा वर्णान्तरवती भव ||
text_mt:
Śiva said:
“If your heat [of resolution] is of such a kind, what is the use of asceticism?
By my will or by your own will, possess another complexion.”
The Goddess said:
“I do not wish to change my complexion by your [will] or on my own.

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca |
necchāmi bhavato varṇaṃ svayaṃ vā kartumanyathā |
brahmāṇaṃ tapasārādhya kṣipraṃ gaurī bhavāmyaham ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच |
नेच्छामि भवतो वर्णं स्वयं वा कर्तुमन्यथा |
ब्रह्माणं तपसाराध्य क्षिप्रं गौरी भवाम्यहम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca |
matprasādātpurā brahmā brahmatvaṃ prāptavānpurā |
tamāhūya mahādevi tapasā kiṃ kariṣyasi ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच |
मत्प्रसादात्पुरा ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मत्वं प्राप्तवान्पुरा |
तमाहूय महादेवि तपसा किं करिष्यसि ||

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca |
tvatto labdhapadā eva sarve brahmādayaḥ surāḥ |
tathāpyārādhya tapasā brahmāṇaṃ tvanniyogataḥ ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच |
त्वत्तो लब्धपदा एव सर्वे ब्रह्मादयः सुराः |
तथाप्याराध्य तपसा ब्रह्माणं त्वन्नियोगतः ||
text_mt:
having summoned him, O great Goddess, what will you accomplish with asceticism?”
The Goddess said:
“All the gods, beginning with Brahmā, have indeed obtained their positions from you.
Nevertheless, having propitiated Brahmā through asceticism at your command,
formerly I was indeed born as the daughter of Dakṣa named Satī;

sanskrit_iast:
purā kila satī nāmnā dakṣasya duhitā'bhavam |
jagatāṃ patimeva tvāṃ patiṃ prāptavatī tathā ||
meaning:
पुरा किल सती नाम्ना दक्षस्य दुहिताऽभवम् |
जगतां पतिमेव त्वां पतिं प्राप्तवती तथा ||

sanskrit_iast:
evamadyāpi tapasā toṣayitvā dvijaṃ vidhim |
gaurī bhavitumicchāmi ko doṣaḥ kathyatāmiha ||
meaning:
एवमद्यापि तपसा तोषयित्वा द्विजं विधिम् |
गौरी भवितुमिच्छामि को दोषः कथ्यतामिह ||

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto mahādevyā vāmadevaḥ smayanniva |
na tāṃ nirbandhayāmāsa devakāryacikīrṣayā ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
एवमुक्तो महादेव्या वामदेवः स्मयन्निव |
न तां निर्बन्धयामास देवकार्यचिकीर्षया ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt: Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya patimambā pativratā |
