niyamya ca viyogārtiṃ jagāma himavadgirim ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य पतिमम्बा पतिव्रता |
नियम्य च वियोगार्तिं जगाम हिमवद्गिरिम् ||
title: pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | devīgauratvaprāptiḥ
text_mt:
Chapter 25
Vāyu said:
Then, having circumambulated her husband, the mother, devoted to her husband,

sanskrit_iast:
tapaḥ kṛtavatī pūrvaṃ deśe yasminsakhījanaiḥ |
tameva deśamavṛṇottapase praṇayātpunaḥ ||
meaning:
तपः कृतवती पूर्वं देशे यस्मिन्सखीजनैः |
तमेव देशमवृणोत्तपसे प्रणयात्पुनः ||
text_mt:
and restraining the pain of separation, went to the Himavat mountain,
to the region where she had previously performed asceticism together with her female companions.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svapitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā mātaraṃ ca tayorgṛhe |
praṇamya vṛttaṃ vijñāpya tābhyāṃ cānumatā satī ||
meaning:
ततः स्वपितरं दृष्ट्वा मातरं च तयोर्गृहे |
प्रणम्य वृत्तं विज्ञाप्य ताभ्यां चानुमता सती ||
text_mt: bowing down and informing [them] of what had occurred, and permitted by both, Satī / went again to the penance grove, discarded her ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
punastapovanaṃ gatvā bhūṣaṇāni visṛjya ca |
snātvā tapasvino veṣaṃ kṛtvā paramapāvanam ||
meaning:
पुनस्तपोवनं गत्वा भूषणानि विसृज्य च |
स्नात्वा तपस्विनो वेषं कृत्वा परमपावनम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
saṅkalpya ca mahātīvraṃ tapaḥ paramaduścaram |
sadā manasi sandhāya bhartuścaraṇapaṅkajam ||
meaning:
सङ्कल्प्य च महातीव्रं तपः परमदुश्चरम् |
सदा मनसि सन्धाय भर्तुश्चरणपङ्कजम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tameva kṣaṇike liṅge dhyātvā bāhyavidhānataḥ |
trisandhyamabhyarcayantī vanyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalādibhiḥ ||
meaning:
तमेव क्षणिके लिङ्गे ध्यात्वा बाह्यविधानतः |
त्रिसन्ध्यमभ्यर्चयन्ती वन्यैः पुष्पैः फलादिभिः ||
text_mt: worshiping at the three twilights with wild flowers, fruits, and the like, [she thought:] / 'He alone, assuming the form of Brahmā, the fruit of my asceticism

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva brahmaṇo mūrtimāsthāya tapasaḥ phalam |
pradāsyati mametyevaṃ nityaṃ kṛtvā'karottapaḥ ||
meaning:
स एव ब्रह्मणो मूर्तिमास्थाय तपसः फलम् |
प्रदास्यति ममेत्येवं नित्यं कृत्वाऽकरोत्तपः ||
text_mt: will grant to me.' Thinking thus constantly, she performed asceticism. / While she was thus performing asceticism, when a long time had passed,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā tapaścarantīṃ tāṃ kāle bahutithe gate |
dṛṣṭaḥ kaścinmahāvyāghro duṣṭabhāvādupāgamat ||
meaning:
तथा तपश्चरन्तीं तां काले बहुतिथे गते |
दृष्टः कश्चिन्महाव्याघ्रो दुष्टभावादुपागमत् ||
text_mt: a certain great tiger was seen, which approached with wicked intent. / Even as he thus approached, that exceedingly wicked-minded one's

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivopagatasyāpi tasyātīva durātmanaḥ |
gātraṃ citrārpitamiva stabdhaṃ tasyāḥ sakāśataḥ ||
meaning:
तथैवोपगतस्यापि तस्यातीव दुरात्मनः |
गात्रं चित्रार्पितमिव स्तब्धं तस्याः सकाशतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvāpi tathā vyāghraṃ duṣṭabhāvādupāgatam |
na pṛthagjanavaddevī svabhāvena vivicyate ||
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वापि तथा व्याघ्रं दुष्टभावादुपागतम् |
न पृथग्जनवद्देवी स्वभावेन विविच्यते ||
text_mt: body became rigid in her presence, like [a figure] painted in a picture. / Even having seen that tiger approaching with wicked intent,

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu viṣṭabdhasarvāṅgo bubhukṣāparipīḍitaḥ |
mamāmiṣaṃ tato nānyaditi matvā nirantaram ||
meaning:
स तु विष्टब्धसर्वाङ्गो बुभुक्षापरिपीडितः |
ममामिषं ततो नान्यदिति मत्वा निरन्तरम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
nirīkṣyamāṇaḥ satataṃ devīmeva tadā'niśam |
atiṣṭhadagratastasyā upāsanamivācarat ||
meaning:
निरीक्ष्यमाणः सततं देवीमेव तदाऽनिशम् |
अतिष्ठदग्रतस्तस्या उपासनमिवाचरत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
devyāśca hṛdaye nityaṃ mamaivāyamupāsakaḥ |
trātā ca duṣṭasattvebhya iti pravavṛte kṛpā ||
meaning:
देव्याश्च हृदये नित्यं ममैवायमुपासकः |
त्राता च दुष्टसत्त्वेभ्य इति प्रववृते कृपा ||
text_mt: And in the heart of the goddess compassion constantly arose: / ‘This is my devotee, and a protector from wicked creatures.’

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā eva kṛpāyogātsadyo naṣṭamalatrayaḥ |
babhūva sahasā vyāghro devīṃ ca bubudhe tadā ||
meaning:
तस्या एव कृपायोगात्सद्यो नष्टमलत्रयः |
बभूव सहसा व्याघ्रो देवीं च बुबुधे तदा ||
text_mt: Through association with her compassion, his three impurities immediately destroyed, / the tiger suddenly became enlightened and recognized the goddess then.

sanskrit_iast:
nyavartata bubhukṣā ca tasyāṅgastambhanaṃ tathā |
daurātmyaṃ janmasiddhaṃ ca tṛptiśca samajāyata ||
meaning:
न्यवर्तत बुभुक्षा च तस्याङ्गस्तम्भनं तथा |
दौरात्म्यं जन्मसिद्धं च तृप्तिश्च समजायत ||
text_mt: Both his hunger and the stiffening of his limbs ceased, / as did his wickedness born of birth, and satisfaction arose [within him].

sanskrit_iast:
tadā paramabhāvena jñātvā kārtārthyamātmanaḥ |
sadyopāsaka evaiṣa siṣeve parameśvarīm ||
meaning:
तदा परमभावेन ज्ञात्वा कार्तार्थ्यमात्मनः |
सद्योपासक एवैष सिषेवे परमेश्वरीम् ||
text_mt: Then, knowing his own fulfillment with supreme devotion, / having immediately become an attendant, he served the supreme goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
duṣṭānāmapi sattvānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ durātmanām |
sa eva drāvako bhūtvā vicacāra tapovane ||
meaning:
दुष्टानामपि सत्त्वानां तथान्येषां दुरात्मनाम् |
स एव द्रावको भूत्वा विचचार तपोवने ||
text_mt: Becoming the router of evil creatures / and of other wicked beings, he roamed in the penance grove.

sanskrit_iast:
tapaśca vavṛdhe devyāstīvraṃ tīvratarātmakam |
devāśca daityanirbandhād brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||
meaning:
तपश्च ववृधे देव्यास्तीव्रं तीव्रतरात्मकम् |
देवाश्च दैत्यनिर्बन्धाद् ब्रह्माणं शरणं गताः ||
text_mt: And the austerity of the goddess increased, intense and increasingly severe; / and the gods, distressed by the Daityas, went to Brahmā for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrurnivedanaṃ devāḥ svaduḥkhasyāripīḍanāt |
yathā ca dadatuḥ śumbhaniśumbhau varasammadāt ||
meaning:
चक्रुर्निवेदनं देवाः स्वदुःखस्यारिपीडनात् |
यथा च ददतुः शुम्भनिशुम्भौ वरसम्मदात् ||
text_mt: The gods made a petition concerning their own sorrow caused by the affliction from enemies, / and how Śumbha and Niśumbha struck because of the arrogance of a boon.

sanskrit_iast:
so'pi śrutvā vidhirduḥkhaṃ surāṇāṃ kṛpayānvitaḥ |
āsīddaityavadhāyaiva smṛtvā hetvāśrayāṃ kathām ||
meaning:
सोऽपि श्रुत्वा विधिर्दुःखं सुराणां कृपयान्वितः |
आसीद्दैत्यवधायैव स्मृत्वा हेत्वाश्रयां कथाम् ||
text_mt: Vidhi, having heard the distress of the gods, was filled with compassion, / and remembered the narrative concerning the cause for the slaughter of the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmaraḥ prārthito brahmā yayau devyāstapovanam |
saṃsmaranmanasā devaduḥkhamokṣaṃ svayatnataḥ ||
meaning:
सामरः प्रार्थितो ब्रह्मा ययौ देव्यास्तपोवनम् |
संस्मरन्मनसा देवदुःखमोक्षं स्वयत्नतः ||
text_mt: Brahmā, implored along with the immortals, went to the goddess's penance grove, / remembering in his mind the liberation of the gods from sorrow by his own effort.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa ca suraśreṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhe tapasi niṣṭhitām |
pratiṣṭhāmiva viśvasya bhavānīṃ parameśvarīm ||
meaning:
ददर्श च सुरश्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठे तपसि निष्ठिताम् |
प्रतिष्ठामिव विश्वस्य भवानीं परमेश्वरीम् ||
text_mt: And the best of the gods saw the supreme goddess Bhavānī, / established in excellent austerity, like the foundation of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
nanāma cāsya jagato mātaraṃ svasya vai hareḥ |
rudrasya ca piturbhāryāmāryāmadrīśvarātmajām ||
meaning:
ननाम चास्य जगतो मातरं स्वस्य वै हरेः |
रुद्रस्य च पितुर्भार्यामार्यामद्रीश्वरात्मजाम् ||
text_mt: And he bowed to the mother of this universe, of himself, and indeed of Hari / and of Rudra, the wife of his father, the noble daughter of the lord of the mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā devī devagaṇaiḥ sahaḥ |
arghyaṃ tadarhaṃ dattvā'smai svāgatādyairupācarat ||
meaning:
ब्रह्माणमागतं दृष्ट्वा देवी देवगणैः सहः |
अर्घ्यं तदर्हं दत्त्वाऽस्मै स्वागताद्यैरुपाचरत् ||
text_mt: Seeing Brahmā arrived along with the hosts of gods, / having offered him the guest water worthy of him, the goddess welcomed him with greeting and other courtesies.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ ca pratyupacāroktiṃ puraskṛtyābhinandya ca |
papraccha tapaso hetumajānanniva padmajaḥ ||
meaning:
तां च प्रत्युपचारोक्तिं पुरस्कृत्याभिनन्द्य च |
पप्रच्छ तपसो हेतुमजानन्निव पद्मजः ||
text_mt: Having reciprocated with words of courtesy and having commended her, / the lotus-born [Brahmā] asked the cause of her austerity, as if not knowing.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
tīvreṇa tapasānena devyā kimiha sādhyate |
tapaḥphalānāṃ sarveṣāṃ tvadadhīnā hi siddhayaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
तीव्रेण तपसानेन देव्या किमिह साध्यते |
तपःफलानां सर्वेषां त्वदधीना हि सिद्धयः ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said: / What is being accomplished here by the goddess with this fierce asceticism?
For the attainments of all the fruits of asceticism are dependent on you. / And having obtained as your husband the very Supreme Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
yaścaiva jagatāṃ bhartā tameva parameśvaram |
bhartāramātmanā prāpya prāptaṃ ca tapasaḥ phalam ||
meaning:
यश्चैव जगतां भर्ता तमेव परमेश्वरम् |
भर्तारमात्मना प्राप्य प्राप्तं च तपसः फलम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
athavā sarvamevaitatkrīḍāvilasitaṃ tava |
idaṃ tu citraṃ devasya virahaṃ sahase katham ||
meaning:
अथवा सर्वमेवैतत्क्रीडाविलसितं तव |
इदं तु चित्रं देवस्य विरहं सहसे कथम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca |
sargādau bhavato devādutpattiḥ śrūyate yadā |
tadā prajānāṃ prathamastvaṃ me prathamajaḥ sutaḥ ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच |
सर्गादौ भवतो देवादुत्पत्तिः श्रूयते यदा |
तदा प्रजानां प्रथमस्त्वं मे प्रथमजः सुतः ||
text_mt:
Yet this is wondrous: how do you endure separation from the god? / The goddess said: / When, in the beginning of creation, your birth from the god is heard,
then you, the first of creatures, are my firstborn son. / When again, for the increase of creatures, Bhava from your forehead

sanskrit_iast:
yadā punaḥ prajāvṛddhyai lalāṭādbhavato bhavaḥ |
utpanno'bhūttadā tvaṃ me guruḥ śvaśurabhāvataḥ ||
meaning:
यदा पुनः प्रजावृद्ध्यै ललाटाद्भवतो भवः |
उत्पन्नोऽभूत्तदा त्वं मे गुरुः श्वशुरभावतः ||
text_mt: was born, then you were my elder in the role of a father-in-law. / When the Lord of Mountains, who was your son, became my father himself,

sanskrit_iast:
yadābhavadgirīndraste putro mama pitā svayam |
tadā pitāmahastvaṃ me jāto lokapitāmaha ||
meaning:
यदाभवद्गिरीन्द्रस्ते पुत्रो मम पिता स्वयम् |
तदा पितामहस्त्वं मे जातो लोकपितामह ||

sanskrit_iast:
tadīdṛśasya bhavato lokayātrāvidhāyinaḥ |
vṛttamantaḥpure bhartrā kathayiṣye kathaṃ punaḥ ||
meaning:
तदीदृशस्य भवतो लोकयात्राविधायिनः |
वृत्तमन्तःपुरे भर्त्रा कथयिष्ये कथं पुनः ||

sanskrit_iast:
kimatra bahunā dehe yaścāyaṃ mama kālimā |
tyaktvā sattvavidhānena gaurī bhavitumutsahe ||
meaning:
किमत्र बहुना देहे यश्चायं मम कालिमा |
त्यक्त्वा सत्त्वविधानेन गौरी भवितुमुत्सहे ||
text_mt: casting it off by the method of pure goodness, I strive to become Gaurī. / 530b

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
etāvatā kimarthena tīvraṃ devi tapaḥ kṛtam |
svecchaiva kimaparyāptā krīḍeyaṃ hi tavedṛśī ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
एतावता किमर्थेन तीव्रं देवि तपः कृतम् |
स्वेच्छैव किमपर्याप्ता क्रीडेयं हि तवेदृशी ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said: / For such a purpose, O goddess, why was fierce asceticism undertaken?
Was your own will not sufficient? For such is your play. / And even your play, O Mother of the Universe, is indeed for the welfare of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍā'pi ca jaganmātastava lokahitāya vai |
ato mameṣṭamanayā phalaṃ kimapi sādhyatām ||
meaning:
क्रीडाऽपि च जगन्मातस्तव लोकहिताय वै |
अतो ममेष्टमनया फलं किमपि साध्यताम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
niśumbhaśumbhanāmānau daityau dattavarau mayā |
dṛptau devānprabādhete tvatto labdhastayorvadhaḥ ||
meaning:
निशुम्भशुम्भनामानौ दैत्यौ दत्तवरौ मया |
दृप्तौ देवान्प्रबाधेते त्वत्तो लब्धस्तयोर्वधः ||
text_mt:
Therefore, let a certain desired fruit of mine be accomplished by this [penance]. / Two Daityas named Niśumbha and Śumbha, granted boons by me,
arrogant, oppress the gods; their slaying can be obtained from you. / Enough of delay here; be steady in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃ vilambanenātra tvaṃ kṣaṇena sthirā bhava |
śaktirvisṛjyamānādya tayormṛtyurbhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
अलं विलम्बनेनात्र त्वं क्षणेन स्थिरा भव |
शक्तिर्विसृज्यमानाद्य तयोर्मृत्युर्भविष्यति ||
text_mt: The śakti released today will be the death of the two. / And requested thus by Brahmā, the goddess, daughter of the best of mountains,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇā'bhyarthitā caiva devī girivarātmajā |
tvakkośaṃ sahasotsṛjya gaurī sā samajāyata ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाऽभ्यर्थिता चैव देवी गिरिवरात्मजा |
त्वक्कोशं सहसोत्सृज्य गौरी सा समजायत ||

sanskrit_iast:
sā tvakkośātmanotsṛṣṭā kauśikī nāma nāmataḥ |
kālī kālāmbudaprakhyā kanyakā samapadyata ||
meaning:
सा त्वक्कोशात्मनोत्सृष्टा कौशिकी नाम नामतः |
काली कालाम्बुदप्रख्या कन्यका समपद्यत ||

sanskrit_iast:
sā tu māyātmikā śaktiryoganidrā ca vaiṣṇavī |
śaṅkhacakratriśūlādisāyudhāṣṭamahābhujā ||
meaning:
सा तु मायात्मिका शक्तिर्योगनिद्रा च वैष्णवी |
शङ्खचक्रत्रिशूलादिसायुधाष्टमहाभुजा ||

sanskrit_iast:
saumyā ghorā ca miśrā ca trinetrā candraśekharā |
ajātapuṃsparśaratiradhṛṣyā cātisundarī ||
meaning:
सौम्या घोरा च मिश्रा च त्रिनेत्रा चन्द्रशेखरा |
अजातपुंस्पर्शरतिरधृष्या चातिसुन्दरी ||
text_mt: with eight mighty arms bearing weapons—conch, discus, trident, and others— / gentle, fierce, and mixed, three-eyed, crescent-crested,

sanskrit_iast:
dattā ca brahmaṇe devyā śaktireṣā sanātanī |
niśumbhasya ca śumbhasya nihantrī daityasiṃhayoḥ ||
meaning:
दत्ता च ब्रह्मणे देव्या शक्तिरेषा सनातनी |
निशुम्भस्य च शुम्भस्य निहन्त्री दैत्यसिंहयोः ||

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇā'pi prahṛṣṭena tasyai paramaśaktaye |
prabalaḥ kesarī datto vāhanatve samāgataḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मणाऽपि प्रहृष्टेन तस्यै परमशक्तये |
प्रबलः केसरी दत्तो वाहनत्वे समागतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
vindhye ca vasatiṃ tasyāḥ pūjāmāsavapūrvakaiḥ |
māṃsairmatsyairapūpaiśca nirvartyāsau samādiśat ||
meaning:
विन्ध्ये च वसतिं तस्याः पूजामासवपूर्वकैः |
मांसैर्मत्स्यैरपूपैश्च निर्वर्त्यासौ समादिशत् ||
text_mt:
a mighty lion was given, which arrived to serve as her mount. / And establishing her residence in the Vindhya, and her worship with liquor and the like,
with meats, fish, and cakes, he gave instructions. / And that śakti, highly honored by Brahmā, the maker of everything,

sanskrit_iast:
sā caiva sammatā śaktirbrahmaṇo viśvakarmaṇaḥ |
praṇamya mātaraṃ gaurīṃ brahmāṇaṃ cānupūrvaśaḥ ||
meaning:
सा चैव सम्मता शक्तिर्ब्रह्मणो विश्वकर्मणः |
प्रणम्य मातरं गौरीं ब्रह्माणं चानुपूर्वशः ||
text_mt: having bowed to mother Gaurī and to Brahmā in due order, / and surrounded by many equal śaktis born of herself,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktibhiścāpi tulyābhiḥ svātmajābhiranekaśaḥ |
parītā prayayau vindhyaṃ daityendrau hantumudyatā ||
meaning:
शक्तिभिश्चापि तुल्याभिः स्वात्मजाभिरनेकशः |
परीता प्रययौ विन्ध्यं दैत्येन्द्रौ हन्तुमुद्यता ||
text_mt: set forth to the Vindhya, prepared to slay the two lords of Daityas. / And there in battle the two best of Daityas were slain by her.

sanskrit_iast:
nihatau ca tayā tatra samare daityapuṅgavau |
tadbāṇaiḥ kāmabāṇaiśca cchinnabhinnāṅgamānasau ||
meaning:
निहतौ च तया तत्र समरे दैत्यपुङ्गवौ |
तद्बाणैः कामबाणैश्च च्छिन्नभिन्नाङ्गमानसौ ||

sanskrit_iast:
tadyuddhavistaraścātra na kṛto'nyatra varṇanāt |
ūhanīyaṃ parasmācca prastutaṃ varṇayāmi vaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
तद्युद्धविस्तरश्चात्र न कृतोऽन्यत्र वर्णनात् |
ऊहनीयं परस्माच्च प्रस्तुतं वर्णयामि वः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
their limbs and minds severed and pierced by her arrows and by the arrows of Kāma. / And the detailed account of that battle is not given here, because it has been described elsewhere.
It should be inferred from other [texts]; I shall recount to you the matter at hand.

Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
utpādya kauśikīṃ gaurī brahmaṇe pratipādya tām |
tasya pratyupakārāya pitāmahamathābravīt ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
उत्पाद्य कौशिकीं गौरी ब्रह्मणे प्रतिपाद्य ताम् |
तस्य प्रत्युपकाराय पितामहमथाब्रवीत् ||
title: ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | vyāghragativarṇanam
text_mt:
Chapter 26
Vāyu said:
Having brought forth Kauśikī and given her to Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca |
dṛṣṭaḥ kimeṣa bhavatā śārdūlo madupāśrayaḥ |
anena duṣṭasattvebhyo rakṣitaṃ mattapovanam ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच |
दृष्टः किमेष भवता शार्दूलो मदुपाश्रयः |
अनेन दुष्टसत्त्वेभ्यो रक्षितं मत्तपोवनम् ||
text_mt:
Gaurī then spoke to the Grandfather to repay his favor. / The Goddess said:
Have you seen this tiger who has taken refuge with me?
By him my penance grove has been protected from wicked creatures. / With his mind dedicated to me, he worships me with undivided thought.

sanskrit_iast:
mayyarpitamanā eṣa bhajate māmananyadhīḥ |
asya saṃrakṣaṇādanyatpriyaṃ mama na vidyate ||
meaning:
मय्यर्पितमना एष भजते मामनन्यधीः |
अस्य संरक्षणादन्यत्प्रियं मम न विद्यते ||

sanskrit_iast:
bhavitavyamanenāto mamāntaḥpuracāriṇā |
gaṇeśvarapadaṃ cāsmai prītyā dāsyati śaṅkaraḥ ||
meaning:
भवितव्यमनेनातो ममान्तःपुरचारिणा |
गणेश्वरपदं चास्मै प्रीत्या दास्यति शङ्करः ||

sanskrit_iast:
enamagresaraṃ kṛtvā sakhībhirgantumutsahe |
pradīyatāmanujñā me prajānāṃ patinā tvayā ||
meaning:
एनमग्रेसरं कृत्वा सखीभिर्गन्तुमुत्सहे |
प्रदीयतामनुज्ञा मे प्रजानां पतिना त्वया ||
text_mt: Let permission be granted to me by you, the lord of creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ prahasanbrahmā devīṃ mugdhāmiva smayan |
tasya tīvraiḥ purāvṛttairdaurātmyaṃ samavarṇayat ||
meaning:
इत्युक्तः प्रहसन्ब्रह्मा देवीं मुग्धामिव स्मयन् |
तस्य तीव्रैः पुरावृत्तैर्दौरात्म्यं समवर्णयत् ||
text_mt:
Addressed thus, Brahmā, laughing, smiling as if at an innocent woman,
described his wickedness through his harsh past deeds. 1

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
paśau devi mṛgāḥ krūrāḥ kva ca te'nugrahaḥ śubhaḥ |
āśīviṣamukhe sākṣādamṛtaṃ kiṃ niṣicyate ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
पशौ देवि मृगाः क्रूराः क्व च तेऽनुग्रहः शुभः |
आशीविषमुखे साक्षादमृतं किं निषिच्यते ||
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
O goddess, where is a cruel wild animal of a beast, and where is your auspicious grace?

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghramātreṇa sanneṣa duṣṭaḥ ko'pi niśācaraḥ |
anena bhakṣitā gāvo brāhmaṇāśca tapodhanāḥ ||
meaning:
व्याघ्रमात्रेण सन्नेष दुष्टः कोऽपि निशाचरः |
अनेन भक्षिता गावो ब्राह्मणाश्च तपोधनाः ||
text_mt: Is nectar directly poured into the mouth of a venomous serpent? / Being merely a tiger [in appearance], he is some wicked night-wanderer.

sanskrit_iast:
tarpayaṃstān yathākāmaṃ kāmarūpī caratyasau |
avaśyaṃ khalu bhoktavyaṃ phalaṃ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ ||
meaning:
तर्पयंस्तान् यथाकामं कामरूपी चरत्यसौ |
अवश्यं खलु भोक्तव्यं फलं पापस्य कर्मणः ||
text_mt:
By him cows and Brahmins rich in penance were devoured. / Sating himself with them at will, this shape-shifter roams about.
The fruit of sinful action must indeed be experienced; / therefore, what is the use of mercy toward such wicked souls?

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ kiṃ kṛpayā kṛtyamīdṛśeṣu durātmasu |
anena devyāḥ kiṃ kṛtyaṃ prakṛtyā kaluṣātmanā ||
meaning:
अतः किं कृपया कृत्यमीदृशेषु दुरात्मसु |
अनेन देव्याः किं कृत्यं प्रकृत्या कलुषात्मना ||

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca |
yaduktaṃ bhavatā sarvaṃ tathyamastvayamīdṛśaḥ |
tathāpi māṃ prapanno'bhūnna tyājyo māmupāśritaḥ ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच |
यदुक्तं भवता सर्वं तथ्यमस्त्वयमीदृशः |
तथापि मां प्रपन्नोऽभून्न त्याज्यो मामुपाश्रितः ||
text_mt:
What business has the Goddess with this one who is wicked-minded by nature? / The Goddess said:
All that you have said is true; let him be such.
Even so, he has surrendered to me; one who has taken refuge in me must not be abandoned. / Brahmā said:
Not knowing his devotion, his past deeds were reported to you by me.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca |
asya bhaktimavijñāya prāgvṛttaṃ te niveditam |
bhaktiścedasya kiṃ pāpairna te bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच |
अस्य भक्तिमविज्ञाय प्राग्वृत्तं ते निवेदितम् |
भक्तिश्चेदस्य किं पापैर्न ते भक्तः प्रणश्यति ||
text_mt: If he has devotion, what do sins matter? Your devotee does not perish. / What could even a doer of meritorious deeds accomplish without regard for your command?

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyakarmāpi kiṃ kuryyāttvadīyājñānapekṣayā |
ajā prajñā purāṇī ca tvameva parameśvarī ||
meaning:
पुण्यकर्मापि किं कुर्य्यात्त्वदीयाज्ञानपेक्षया |
अजा प्रज्ञा पुराणी च त्वमेव परमेश्वरी ||

sanskrit_iast:
tvadadhīnā hi sarveṣāṃ bandhamokṣavyavasthitiḥ |
tvadṛte paramā śaktiḥ saṃsiddhiḥ kasya karmaṇā ||
meaning:
त्वदधीना हि सर्वेषां बन्धमोक्षव्यवस्थितिः |
त्वदृते परमा शक्तिः संसिद्धिः कस्य कर्मणा ||
text_mt: Without you, the supreme śakti, whose accomplishment could arise through action? / You yourself are the manifold power of all existences, or [existence] itself.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva vividhā śaktiḥ bhavānāmatha vā svayam |
aśaktaḥ karmakaraṇe kartā vā kiṃ kariṣyati ||
meaning:
त्वमेव विविधा शक्तिः भवानामथ वा स्वयम् |
अशक्तः कर्मकरणे कर्ता वा किं करिष्यति ||

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇośca mama cānyeṣāṃ devadānavarakṣasām |
tattadaiśvaryasamprāptyai tavaivājñā hi kāraṇam ||
meaning:
विष्णोश्च मम चान्येषां देवदानवरक्षसाम् |
तत्तदैश्वर्यसम्प्राप्त्यै तवैवाज्ञा हि कारणम् ||
text_mt: your command alone is the cause for obtaining their respective sovereign powers. / Indeed, countless Brahmās, Haris, and Bhavas have passed away,

sanskrit_iast:
atītāḥ khalvasaṅkhyātā brahmāṇo harayo bhavāḥ |
anāgatāstvasaṅkhyātāstvadājñānuvidhāyinaḥ ||
meaning:
अतीताः खल्वसङ्ख्याता ब्रह्माणो हरयो भवाः |
अनागतास्त्वसङ्ख्यातास्त्वदाज्ञानुविधायिनः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmanārādhya deveśi puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam |
labdhuṃ na śakyamasmābhirapi sarvaiḥ surottamaiḥ ||
meaning:
त्वामनाराध्य देवेशि पुरुषार्थचतुष्टयम् |
लब्धुं न शक्यमस्माभिरपि सर्वैः सुरोत्तमैः ||
text_mt: cannot be obtained even by all of us, the foremost of gods. / Even an immediate reversal could occur between the state of Brahmā and that of an immobile being,

sanskrit_iast:
vyatyāso'pi bhavetsadyo brahmatvasthāvaratvayoḥ |
sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ cāpi tvayaiva sthāpitaṃ yataḥ ||
meaning:
व्यत्यासोऽपि भवेत्सद्यो ब्रह्मत्वस्थावरत्वयोः |
सुकृतं दुष्कृतं चापि त्वयैव स्थापितं यतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hi sarvajagadbhartuḥ śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
anādimadhyanidhanā śaktirādyā sanātanī ||
meaning:
त्वं हि सर्वजगद्भर्तुः शिवस्य परमात्मनः |
अनादिमध्यनिधना शक्तिराद्या सनातनी ||

sanskrit_iast:
samastalokayātrārthaṃ mūrtimāviśya kāmapi |
krīḍase vividhairbhāvaiḥ kastvāṃ jānāti tattvataḥ ||
meaning:
समस्तलोकयात्रार्थं मूर्तिमाविश्य कामपि |
क्रीडसे विविधैर्भावैः कस्त्वां जानाति तत्त्वतः ||
text_mt: you sport with manifold states; who knows you in truth? 2 / Therefore, even if this tiger is an evil-doer, through your grace

sanskrit_iast:
ato duṣkṛtakarmāpi vyāghro'yaṃ tvadanugrahāt |
prāpnotu paramāṃ siddhimatra kaḥ pratibandhakaḥ ||
meaning:
अतो दुष्कृतकर्मापि व्याघ्रोऽयं त्वदनुग्रहात् |
प्राप्नोतु परमां सिद्धिमत्र कः प्रतिबन्धकः ||
text_mt: let him attain supreme perfection; what obstacle is there here? / Having thus appropriately reminded her of her supreme state,

sanskrit_iast:
ityātmanaḥ paraṃ bhāvaṃ smārayitvānurūpataḥ |
brahmaṇābhyarthitā gaurī tapaso'pi nyavartata ||
meaning:
इत्यात्मनः परं भावं स्मारयित्वानुरूपतः |
ब्रह्मणाभ्यर्थिता गौरी तपसोऽपि न्यवर्तत ||
text_mt: Gaurī, entreated by Brahmā, ceased from her penance. / Then, having taken leave of the Goddess, when Brahmā had disappeared,

sanskrit_iast:
tato devīmanujñāpya brahmaṇyantarhite sati |
devīṃ ca mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā menāṃ himavatā saha ||
meaning:
ततो देवीमनुज्ञाप्य ब्रह्मण्यन्तर्हिते सति |
देवीं च मातरं दृष्ट्वा मेनां हिमवता सह ||

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamyāśvāsya bahudhā pitarau virahāsahau |
tapaḥ praṇayino devī tapovanamahīruhān ||
meaning:
प्रणम्याश्वास्य बहुधा पितरौ विरहासहौ |
तपः प्रणयिनो देवी तपोवनमहीरुहान् ||
text_mt: bowing to her parents who could not endure separation and comforting them repeatedly, / the goddess [looked upon] the trees of the penance grove that loved her penance,

sanskrit_iast:
viprayogaśucevāgre puṣpabāṣpaṃ vimuñcataḥ |
tattacchākhāsamārūḍhavihagodīritai rutaiḥ ||
meaning:
विप्रयोगशुचेवाग्रे पुष्पबाष्पं विमुञ्चतः |
तत्तच्छाखासमारूढविहगोदीरितै रुतैः ||
text_mt: which, as if in sorrow over parting, shed tears of flowers before her, / and through the cries uttered by birds perched on various branches,

sanskrit_iast:
vyākulaṃ bahudhā dīnaṃ vilāpamiva kurvataḥ |
sakhībhyaḥ kathayantvevaṃ sattvarā bhartṛdarśane ||
meaning:
व्याकुलं बहुधा दीनं विलापमिव कुर्वतः |
सखीभ्यः कथयन्त्वेवं सत्त्वरा भर्तृदर्शने ||
text_mt: were as if uttering confused, manifold, and plaintive lamentations. / Speaking thus to her companions, eager to see her husband,

sanskrit_iast:
puraskṛtya ca taṃ vyāghraṃ snehātputramivaurasam |
dehasya prabhayā caiva dīpayantī diśo daśa ||
meaning:
पुरस्कृत्य च तं व्याघ्रं स्नेहात्पुत्रमिवौरसम् |
देहस्य प्रभया चैव दीपयन्ती दिशो दश ||
text_mt: and placing that tiger at the head like an own son out of affection, / illuminating the ten directions with the radiance of her body,

sanskrit_iast:
prayayau mandaraṃ gaurī yatra bhartā maheśvaraḥ |
sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ dhātā kartā pātā vināśakṛt ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
प्रययौ मन्दरं गौरी यत्र भर्ता महेश्वरः |
सर्वेषां जगतां धाता कर्ता पाता विनाशकृत् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Gaurī went to Mount Mandara, where her husband Maheśvara was— / the creator, preserver, protector, and destroyer of all the worlds.

Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
kṛtvā gauraṃ vapurdivyaṃ devī girivarātmajā |
kathaṃ dadarśa bhartāraṃ praviṣṭā mandiraṃ satī ||
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः |
कृत्वा गौरं वपुर्दिव्यं देवी गिरिवरात्मजा |
कथं ददर्श भर्तारं प्रविष्टा मन्दिरं सती ||
title: saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | devīśivamilanavarṇanam
text_mt:
Chapter 27
The sages said:
Having made her divine body fair, how did the goddess, the daughter of the best of mountains,

sanskrit_iast:
praveśasamaye tasyā bhavanadvāragocaraiḥ |
gaṇeśaiḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ devastāṃ dṛṣṭvā kiṃ tadākarot ||
meaning:
प्रवेशसमये तस्या भवनद्वारगोचरैः |
गणेशैः किं कृतं देवस्तां दृष्ट्वा किं तदाकरोत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
pravaktumañjasāśakyaḥ tādṛśaḥ paramo rasaḥ |
yena praṇayagarbheṇa bhāvo bhāvavatāṃ hṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
प्रवक्तुमञ्जसाशक्यः तादृशः परमो रसः |
येन प्रणयगर्भेण भावो भाववतां हृतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
dvāḥsthaiḥ sasambhramaireva devo devyāgamotsukaḥ |
śaṅkamānā praviṣṭāntastaṃ ca sā samapaśyata ||
meaning:
द्वाःस्थैः ससम्भ्रमैरेव देवो देव्यागमोत्सुकः |
शङ्कमाना प्रविष्टान्तस्तं च सा समपश्यत ||

sanskrit_iast:
taistaiḥ praṇayabhāvaiśca bhavanāntaravartibhiḥ |
gaṇendrairvanditā vācā praṇanāma triyambakam ||
meaning:
तैस्तैः प्रणयभावैश्च भवनान्तरवर्तिभिः |
गणेन्द्रैर्वन्दिता वाचा प्रणनाम त्रियम्बकम् ||
text_mt:
Apprehensive, she entered within and saw him. / Praised with words expressing their various sentiments of love
by the lords of the gaṇas present inside the palace, she bowed to Triyambaka. / Before she could even rise after bowing, the Supreme Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya notthitā yāvattāvattāṃ parameśvaraḥ |
pragṛhya dorbhyāmāśliṣya paritaḥ parayā mudā ||
meaning:
प्रणम्य नोत्थिता यावत्तावत्तां परमेश्वरः |
प्रगृह्य दोर्भ्यामाश्लिष्य परितः परया मुदा ||
text_mt: clasping her with his arms, embracing her all around with supreme joy, / though he began to take her onto his lap, she sat down on the couch.

sanskrit_iast:
svāṅke dhartuṃ pravṛtto'pi sā paryaṅke nyaṣīdata |
paryaṅkato balāddevīṃ so'ṅkamāropya susmitām ||
meaning:
स्वाङ्के धर्तुं प्रवृत्तोऽपि सा पर्यङ्के न्यषीदत |
पर्यङ्कतो बलाद्देवीं सोऽङ्कमारोप्य सुस्मिताम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
sasmito vivṛtairnetraistadvaktraṃ prapibanniva |
tayā sambhāṣaṇāyeśaḥ pūrvabhāṣitamabravīt ||
meaning:
सस्मितो विवृतैर्नेत्रैस्तद्वक्त्रं प्रपिबन्निव |
तया सम्भाषणायेशः पूर्वभाषितमब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: Drawing the sweetly smiling goddess by force from the couch onto his lap, / smiling himself, as if drinking in her face with wide-open eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
devadeva uvāca |
sā daśā ca vyatītā kiṃ tava sarvāṅgasundari |
yasyāmanunayopāyaḥ ko'pi kopānna labhyate ||
meaning:
देवदेव उवाच |
सा दशा च व्यतीता किं तव सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरि |
यस्यामनुनयोपायः कोऽपि कोपान्न लभ्यते ||

sanskrit_iast:
svecchayāpi na kālīti nānyavarṇavatīti ca |
tvatsvabhāvahṛtaṃ cittaṃ subhru cintāvahaṃ mama ||
meaning:
स्वेच्छयापि न कालीति नान्यवर्णवतीति च |
त्वत्स्वभावहृतं चित्तं सुभ्रु चिन्तावहं मम ||

sanskrit_iast:
vismṛtaḥ paramo bhāvaḥ kathaṃ svecchāṅgayogataḥ |
na sambhavanti ye tatra cittakāluṣyahetavaḥ ||
meaning:
विस्मृतः परमो भावः कथं स्वेच्छाङ्गयोगतः |
न सम्भवन्ति ये तत्र चित्तकालुष्यहेतवः ||

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthagjanavadanyo'nyaṃ vipriyasyāpi kāraṇam |
āvayorapi yadyasti nāstyevaitaccarācaram ||
meaning:
पृथग्जनवदन्योऽन्यं विप्रियस्यापि कारणम् |
आवयोरपि यद्यस्ति नास्त्येवैतच्चराचरम् ||
text_mt: Those causes of mental defilement do not exist there, / which, as in ordinary people, are the cause of mutual displeasure.

sanskrit_iast:
ahamagniśironiṣṭhastvaṃ somaśirasi sthitā |
agnīṣomātmakaṃ viśvamāvābhyāṃ samadhiṣṭhitam ||
meaning:
अहमग्निशिरोनिष्ठस्त्वं सोमशिरसि स्थिता |
अग्नीषोमात्मकं विश्वमावाभ्यां समधिष्ठितम् ||
text_mt: The universe consisting of Agni and Soma is presided over by the two of us, / who roam about for the welfare of the world, having assumed bodies of our own will.

sanskrit_iast:
jagaddhitāya caratoḥ svecchādhṛtaśarīrayoḥ |
āvayorviprayoge hi syānnirālambanaṃ jagat ||
meaning:
जगद्धिताय चरतोः स्वेच्छाधृतशरीरयोः |
आवयोर्विप्रयोगे हि स्यान्निरालम्बनं जगत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
asti hetvantaraṃ cātra śāstrayuktiviniścitam |
vāgarthamiva caivaitajjagatsthāvarajaṅgamam ||
meaning:
अस्ति हेत्वन्तरं चात्र शास्त्रयुक्तिविनिश्चितम् |
वागर्थमिव चैवैतज्जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् ||
text_mt: For in our separation, the world would be without support. / There is another reason here, established by scripture and reasoning.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hi vāgamṛtaṃ sākṣādahamarthāmṛtaṃ param |
dvayamapyamṛtaṃ kasmādviyuktamupapadyate ||
meaning:
त्वं हि वागमृतं साक्षादहमर्थामृतं परम् |
द्वयमप्यमृतं कस्माद्वियुक्तमुपपद्यते ||
text_mt: This world of immobile and mobile beings is mine like word and meaning. / For you are the nectar of speech incarnate, and I am the supreme nectar of meaning.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāpratyāyikā tvaṃ me vedyo'haṃ pratyayāttava |
vidyāvedyātmanoreva viśleṣaḥ kathamāvayoḥ ||
meaning:
विद्याप्रत्यायिका त्वं मे वेद्योऽहं प्रत्ययात्तव |
विद्यावेद्यात्मनोरेव विश्लेषः कथमावयोः ||
text_mt: You are the revealer of my knowledge, and I am to be known through your cognition; / how can there be separation between the two of us, whose very nature is knowledge and the knowable?

sanskrit_iast:
na karmaṇā sṛjāmīdaṃ jagatpratisṛjāmi ca |
sarvasyājñaikalabhyatvādājñātvaṃ hi garīyasī ||
meaning:
न कर्मणा सृजामीदं जगत्प्रतिसृजामि च |
सर्वस्याज्ञैकलभ्यत्वादाज्ञात्वं हि गरीयसी ||
text_mt: I do not create this world through action, nor do I dissolve it; / because everything is obtained solely by command, and the state of being the command is supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
ājñaikasāramaiśvaryaṃ yasmātsvātantryalakṣaṇam |
ājñayā viprayuktasya caiśvaryaṃ mama kīdṛśam ||
meaning:
आज्ञैकसारमैश्वर्यं यस्मात्स्वातन्त्र्यलक्षणम् |
आज्ञया विप्रयुक्तस्य चैश्वर्यं मम कीदृशम् ||
text_mt: Sovereignty has the command as its sole essence, because its characteristic is independence; / and what sort of sovereignty would mine be, if separated from the command?

sanskrit_iast:
na kadācidavasthānamāvayorviprayuktayoḥ |
devānāṃ kāryamuddiśya līloktiṃ kṛtavānaham ||
meaning:
न कदाचिदवस्थानमावयोर्विप्रयुक्तयोः |
देवानां कार्यमुद्दिश्य लीलोक्तिं कृतवानहम् ||
text_mt: There is never any staying apart for the two of us; / for the sake of the gods' purpose, I merely spoke in jest.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayāpyaviditaṃ nāsti kathaṃ kupitavatyasi |
tatastrilokarakṣārthe kopo mayyapi te kṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
त्वयाप्यविदितं नास्ति कथं कुपितवत्यसि |
ततस्त्रिलोकरक्षार्थे कोपो मय्यपि ते कृतः ||
text_mt: Nothing is unknown even to you; why did you become angry? / Therefore, your anger, even toward me, was shown for the protection of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
yadanarthāya bhūtānāṃ na tadasti khalu tvayi |
iti priyaṃvade sākṣādīśvare parameśvare ||
meaning:
यदनर्थाय भूतानां न तदस्ति खलु त्वयि |
इति प्रियंवदे साक्षादीश्वरे परमेश्वरे ||
text_mt: Whatever would cause harm to living beings certainly does not exist in you. / While Īśvara, Parameśvara in visible form, was thus speaking pleasant words,

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgārabhāvasārāṇāṃ janmabhūmirakṛtrimā |
svabhartrā lalitaṃ tathyamuktaṃ matvā smitottaram ||
meaning:
शृङ्गारभावसाराणां जन्मभूमिरकृत्रिमा |
स्वभर्त्रा ललितं तथ्यमुक्तं मत्वा स्मितोत्तरम् ||
text_mt: she, the natural birthplace of the essences of erotic sentiment, / considering what had been charmingly and truly spoken by her husband, followed by a smile,

sanskrit_iast:
lajjayā na kimapyūce kauśikī varṇanātparam |
tadeva varṇayāmyadya śṛṇu devyāśca varṇanam ||
meaning:
लज्जया न किमप्यूचे कौशिकी वर्णनात्परम् |
तदेव वर्णयाम्यद्य शृणु देव्याश्च वर्णनम् ||
text_mt: spoke nothing out of modesty, other than the description of Kauśikī. / I shall describe that very thing today; hear the goddess's description:

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca |
kiṃ devena na sā dṛṣṭā yā sṛṣṭā kauśikī mayā |
tādṛśī kanyakā loke na bhūtā na bhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
देव्युवाच |
किं देवेन न सा दृष्टा या सृष्टा कौशिकी मया |
तादृशी कन्यका लोके न भूता न भविष्यति ||
text_mt: The Goddess said: / Did the Lord not see her, the Kauśikī whom I created?

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā vīryaṃ balaṃ vindhyanilayaṃ vijayaṃ tathā |
śumbhasya ca niśumbhasya māraṇe ca raṇe tayoḥ ||
meaning:
तस्या वीर्यं बलं विन्ध्यनिलयं विजयं तथा |
शुम्भस्य च निशुम्भस्य मारणे च रणे तयोः ||
text_mt: No maiden like her has ever existed in the world, nor will there be. / Her valour, strength, abode in the Vindhya, and her victory,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyakṣaphaladānaṃ ca lokāya bhajate sadā |
lokānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ śaśvad brahmā vijñāpayiṣyati ||
meaning:
प्रत्यक्षफलदानं च लोकाय भजते सदा |
लोकानां रक्षणं शश्वद् ब्रह्मा विज्ञापयिष्यति ||
text_mt: Brahmā will forever report the protection of the worlds. / By order of the Goddess as she spoke thus,

sanskrit_iast:
iti sambhāṣamāṇāyā devyā evājñayā tadā |
vyāghraḥ sakhyā samānīya puro'vasthāpitastadā ||
meaning:
इति सम्भाषमाणाया देव्या एवाज्ञया तदा |
व्याघ्रः सख्या समानीय पुरोऽवस्थापितस्तदा ||
text_mt: While the goddess was speaking thus, by her very command then, / the tiger was brought by her female companion and placed before them.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ prekṣyāha punardevī devānītamupāyatam |
vyāghraṃ paśya na cānena sadṛśo madupāsakaḥ ||
meaning:
तं प्रेक्ष्याह पुनर्देवी देवानीतमुपायतम् |
व्याघ्रं पश्य न चानेन सदृशो मदुपासकः ||

sanskrit_iast:
anena duṣṭasaṅghebhyo rakṣitaṃ mattapovanam |
atīva mama bhaktaśca viśrabdhaśca svarakṣaṇāt ||
meaning:
अनेन दुष्टसङ्घेभ्यो रक्षितं मत्तपोवनम् |
अतीव मम भक्तश्च विश्रब्धश्च स्वरक्षणात् ||
text_mt: He is exceedingly devoted to me and confident through my protection. / Abandoning his own land, he has come here for my grace.

sanskrit_iast:
svadeśaṃ ca parityajya prasādārthaṃ samāgataḥ |
yadi prītirabhūnmattaḥ parāṃ prītiṃ karoṣi me ||
meaning:
स्वदेशं च परित्यज्य प्रसादार्थं समागतः |
यदि प्रीतिरभून्मत्तः परां प्रीतिं करोषि मे ||
text_mt: If you have affection for me, show great kindness to me: / let him dwell constantly at the gate of the inner apartments by Nandī's appointment,

sanskrit_iast:
nityamantaḥpuradvāri niyogānnandinaḥ svayam |
rakṣibhiḥ saha taccihnairvartatāmayamīśvara ||
meaning:
नित्यमन्तःपुरद्वारि नियोगान्नन्दिनः स्वयम् |
रक्षिभिः सह तच्चिह्नैर्वर्ततामयमीश्वर ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
madhuraṃ praṇayodarkaṃ śrutvā devyāḥ śubhaṃ vacaḥ |
prīto'smītyāha taṃ devaḥ sa cādṛśyata tatkṣaṇāt ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
मधुरं प्रणयोदर्कं श्रुत्वा देव्याः शुभं वचः |
प्रीतोऽस्मीत्याह तं देवः स चादृश्यत तत्क्षणात् ||
text_mt:
along with the guards, bearing their insignia, O Lord."
/ Vāyu said:
Having heard the sweet, affectionate, and auspicious words of the Goddess,

sanskrit_iast:
bibhradvetralatāṃ haimīṃ ratnacitraṃ ca kañcukam |
churikāmuragaprakhyāṃ gaṇeśo rakṣaveṣadhṛk ||
meaning:
बिभ्रद्वेत्रलतां हैमीं रत्नचित्रं च कञ्चुकम् |
छुरिकामुरगप्रख्यां गणेशो रक्षवेषधृक् ||
text_mt: holding a dagger resembling a serpent, as a leader of the gaṇas wearing the attire of a guard. / Because Mahādeva Soma and Nandī were gladdened by him,

sanskrit_iast:
yasmātsomo mahādevo nandī cānena nanditaḥ |
somanandīti vikhyātastasmādeṣa samākhyayā ||
meaning:
यस्मात्सोमो महादेवो नन्दी चानेन नन्दितः |
सोमनन्दीति विख्यातस्तस्मादेष समाख्यया ||

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ devyāḥ priyaṃ kṛtvā devaścārddhendubhūṣaṇaḥ |
bhūṣayāmāsa taṃ divyairbhūṣaṇai ratnabhūṣitaiḥ ||
meaning:
इत्थं देव्याः प्रियं कृत्वा देवश्चार्द्धेन्दुभूषणः |
भूषयामास तं दिव्यैर्भूषणै रत्नभूषितैः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa gaurīṃ giriśo girīndrajāṃ sagauravāṃ sarvamanoharāṃ haraḥ |
paryaṅkamāropya varāṅgabhūṣaṇai-rvibhūṣayāmāsa śaśāṅkabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
ततः स गौरीं गिरिशो गिरीन्द्रजां सगौरवां सर्वमनोहरां हरः |
पर्यङ्कमारोप्य वराङ्गभूषणै-र्विभूषयामास शशाङ्कभूषणः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
adorned him with divine ornaments set with jewels. / Then Giriśa, Hara, having seated Gaurī, the dignified daughter of the King of Mountains who enchants all,

Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
devīṃ samādadhānena devenedaṃ kimīritam |
agniṣomātmakaṃ viśvaṃ vāgarthātmakamityapi ||
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः |
देवीं समादधानेन देवेनेदं किमीरितम् |
अग्निषोमात्मकं विश्वं वागर्थात्मकमित्यपि ||
title: aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | bhasmatattvavarṇanam
text_mt:
Chapter 28
The sages said:
What was this that was said by the God consoling the Goddess,
namely, that the universe consists of Agni and Soma, and also consists of word and meaning, / and that sovereignty has command as its sole essence, and that you are the command?

sanskrit_iast:
ājñaikasāramaiśvaryamājñātvamiti coditam |
tadidaṃ śrotumicchāmo yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ||
meaning:
आज्ञैकसारमैश्वर्यमाज्ञात्वमिति चोदितम् |
तदिदं श्रोतुमिच्छामो यथावदनुपूर्वशः ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
agnirityucyate raudrī ghorā yā taijasī tanuḥ |
somaḥ śākto'mṛtamayaḥ śakteḥ śāntikarī tanuḥ ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
अग्निरित्युच्यते रौद्री घोरा या तैजसी तनुः |
सोमः शाक्तोऽमृतमयः शक्तेः शान्तिकरी तनुः ||
text_mt:
We wish to hear all this properly in due order.
/ Vāyu said:
That terrible, fiery body of Rudra is called Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtaṃ yatpratiṣṭhā sā tejo vidyā kalā svayam |
bhūtasūkṣmeṣu sarveṣu ta eva rasatejasī ||
meaning:
अमृतं यत्प्रतिष्ठा सा तेजो विद्या कला स्वयम् |
भूतसूक्ष्मेषु सर्वेषु त एव रसतेजसी ||

sanskrit_iast:
dvividhā tejaso vṛttiḥ sūryātmā cānalātmikā |
tathaiva rasavṛttiśca somātmā ca jalātmikā ||
meaning:
द्विविधा तेजसो वृत्तिः सूर्यात्मा चानलात्मिका |
तथैव रसवृत्तिश्च सोमात्मा च जलात्मिका ||

sanskrit_iast:
vidyudādimayaṃ tejo madhurādimayo rasaḥ |
tejorasavibhedaistu dhṛtametaccarācaram ||
meaning:
विद्युदादिमयं तेजो मधुरादिमयो रसः |
तेजोरसविभेदैस्तु धृतमेतच्चराचरम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
agneramṛtaniṣpattiramṛtenāgniredhate |
ata eva hi vikrāntamagnīṣomaṃ jagaddhitam ||
meaning:
अग्नेरमृतनिष्पत्तिरमृतेनाग्निरेधते |
अत एव हि विक्रान्तमग्नीषोमं जगद्धितम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
haviṣe sasyasampattirvṛṣṭiḥ sasyābhivṛddhaye |
vṛṣṭereva havistasmādagnīṣomadhṛtaṃ jagat ||
meaning:
हविषे सस्यसम्पत्तिर्वृष्टिः सस्याभिवृद्धये |
वृष्टेरेव हविस्तस्मादग्नीषोमधृतं जगत् ||
text_mt: Therefore indeed, the universe consisting of Agni and Soma is pervasive for the welfare of the world. / The prosperity of crops is for the oblation, and rain is for the growth of crops.

sanskrit_iast:
agnirūrdhvaṃ jvalatyeṣa yāvatsaumyaṃ parāmṛtam |
yāvadagnyāspadaṃ saumyamamṛtaṃ ca sravatyadhaḥ ||
meaning:
अग्निरूर्ध्वं ज्वलत्येष यावत्सौम्यं परामृतम् |
यावदग्न्यास्पदं सौम्यममृतं च स्रवत्यधः ||
text_mt:
From rain alone comes the oblation; therefore, the world is sustained by Agni and Soma. / This fire blazes upward as far as the supreme, lunar nectar,
and as far as the realm of fire, the lunar nectar flows downward. / Therefore, Kālāgni is below and Śakti is above,

sanskrit_iast:
ata eva hi kālāgniradhastācchaktirūrdhvataḥ |
yāvadādahanaṃ cordhvamadhaścāplāvanaṃ bhavet ||
meaning:
अत एव हि कालाग्निरधस्ताच्छक्तिरूर्ध्वतः |
यावदादहनं चोर्ध्वमधश्चाप्लावनं भवेत् ||
text_mt: so that there may be burning above and inundation below. / Held by the foundational śakti alone, this Kālāgni moves upward,

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraśaktyaiva dhṛtaḥ kālāgnirayamūrdhvagaḥ |
tathaiva nimnagaḥ somaḥ śivaśaktipadāspadaḥ ||
meaning:
आधारशक्त्यैव धृतः कालाग्निरयमूर्ध्वगः |
तथैव निम्नगः सोमः शिवशक्तिपदास्पदः ||

sanskrit_iast:
śivaścordhvamadhaḥ śaktirūrdhvaṃ śaktiradhaḥ śivaḥ |
taditthaṃ śivaśaktibhyāṃ nāvyāptamiha kiñcana ||
meaning:
शिवश्चोर्ध्वमधः शक्तिरूर्ध्वं शक्तिरधः शिवः |
तदित्थं शिवशक्तिभ्यां नाव्याप्तमिह किञ्चन ||

sanskrit_iast:
asakṛccāgninā dagdhaṃ jagadyadbhasmasātkṛtam |
agnervīryamidaṃ cāhustadvīryaṃ bhasma yattataḥ ||
meaning:
असकृच्चाग्निना दग्धं जगद्यद्भस्मसात्कृतम् |
अग्नेर्वीर्यमिदं चाहुस्तद्वीर्यं भस्म यत्ततः ||
text_mt:
Thus, nothing here is unpervaded by Śiva and Śakti. / Because the world, repeatedly burned by fire, has been reduced to ashes,
they say this ash is the virility of fire, because it is that virility. / Whoever, knowing the true nature of ash thus, bathes with ash

sanskrit_iast:
yaścetthaṃ bhasmasadbhāvaṃ jñātvā snāti ca bhasmanā |
agnirityādibhirmantrairbaddhaḥ pāśātpramucyate ||
meaning:
यश्चेत्थं भस्मसद्भावं ज्ञात्वा स्नाति च भस्मना |
अग्निरित्यादिभिर्मन्त्रैर्बद्धः पाशात्प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: reciting mantras such as "Agni is [ash]", is freed from the bond though bound. / But that ash which is the virility of fire, inundated again by Soma,

sanskrit_iast:
agnervīryaṃ tu yadbhasma somenāplāvitaṃ punaḥ |
ayogayuktyā prakṛteradhikārāya kalpate ||
meaning:
अग्नेर्वीर्यं तु यद्भस्म सोमेनाप्लावितं पुनः |
अयोगयुक्त्या प्रकृतेरधिकाराय कल्पते ||

sanskrit_iast:
yogayuktyā tu tadbhasma plāvyamānaṃ samantataḥ |
śāktenāmṛtavarṣeṇa cādhikārānnivartayet ||
meaning:
योगयुक्त्या तु तद्भस्म प्लाव्यमानं समन्ततः |
शाक्तेनामृतवर्षेण चाधिकारान्निवर्तयेत् ||
text_mt: serves for the cosmic governance of Prakṛti when applied through ayoga. / But when that ash is inundated on all sides through yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
ato mṛtyuñjayāyetthamamṛtaplāvanaṃ sadā |
śivaśaktyamṛtasparśe labdhaṃ yena kuto mṛtiḥ ||
meaning:
अतो मृत्युञ्जयायेत्थममृतप्लावनं सदा |
शिवशक्त्यमृतस्पर्शे लब्धं येन कुतो मृतिः ||
text_mt: Whence can there be death for one by whom the touch of the nectar of Śiva and Śakti has been obtained? / He who knows the secret burning and inundation as described,

sanskrit_iast:
yo veda dahanaṃ guhyaṃ plāvanaṃ ca yathoditam |
agnīṣomapadaṃ hitvā na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate ||
meaning:
यो वेद दहनं गुह्यं प्लावनं च यथोदितम् |
अग्नीषोमपदं हित्वा न स भूयोऽभिजायते ||

sanskrit_iast:
śivāgninā tanuṃ dagdhvā śaktisaumyāmṛtena yaḥ |
plāvayedyogamārgeṇa so'mṛtatvāya kalpate ||
meaning:
शिवाग्निना तनुं दग्ध्वा शक्तिसौम्यामृतेन यः |
प्लावयेद्योगमार्गेण सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते ||
text_mt: leaving behind the state of Agni and Soma, he is not born again. / Having burnt the body with the fire of Śiva, he who with the nectar of Śakti, pleasant as Soma,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdi kṛtvemamarthaṃ vai devena samudāhṛtam |
agnīṣomātmakaṃ viśvaṃ jagadityanurūpataḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
हृदि कृत्वेममर्थं वै देवेन समुदाहृतम् |
अग्नीषोमात्मकं विश्वं जगदित्यनुरूपतः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt: Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
nivedayāmi jagato vāgarthātmyaṃ kṛtaṃ yathā |
ṣaḍadhvavedanaṃ samyak samāsānna tu vistarāt ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
निवेदयामि जगतो वागर्थात्म्यं कृतं यथा |
षडध्ववेदनं सम्यक् समासान्न तु विस्तरात् ||
title: ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | vāgarthātmakatattvavarṇanam
text_mt:
Chapter 29
Vāyu said:
I shall explain how the world is made of word and meaning,
the full knowledge of the six paths in brief and not in detail. / There is no meaning without a word, nor is any word meaningless;

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti kaścidaśabdārtho nāpi śabdo nirarthakaḥ |
tato hi samaye śabdaḥ sarvaḥ sarvārthabodhakaḥ ||
meaning:
नास्ति कश्चिदशब्दार्थो नापि शब्दो निरर्थकः |
ततो हि समये शब्दः सर्वः सर्वार्थबोधकः ||

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛteḥ pariṇāmo'yaṃ dvidhā śabdārthabhāvanā |
tāmāhuḥ prākṛtīṃ mūrtiṃ śivayoḥ paramātmanoḥ ||
meaning:
प्रकृतेः परिणामोऽयं द्विधा शब्दार्थभावना |
तामाहुः प्राकृतीं मूर्तिं शिवयोः परमात्मनोः ||
text_mt:
therefore, by convention, every word conveys every meaning. / This modification of Prakṛti is twofold, conceived as word and meaning;
they call that the material form of the two Śivas, the Supreme Selves. / That manifestation consisting of sound is declared by the wise to be threefold:

sanskrit_iast:
śabdātmikā vibhūtiryā sā tridhā kathyate budhaiḥ |
sthūlā sūkṣmā parā ceti sthūlā yā śrutigocarā ||
meaning:
शब्दात्मिका विभूतिर्या सा त्रिधा कथ्यते बुधैः |
स्थूला सूक्ष्मा परा चेति स्थूला या श्रुतिगोचरा ||

sanskrit_iast:
sūkṣmā cintāmayī proktā cintayā rahitā parā |
yā śaktiḥ sā parā śaktiḥ śivatattvasamāśrayā ||
meaning:
सूक्ष्मा चिन्तामयी प्रोक्ता चिन्तया रहिता परा |
या शक्तिः सा परा शक्तिः शिवतत्त्वसमाश्रया ||

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaśaktisamāyogādicchopodbalikā tathā |
sarvaśaktisamaṣṭyātmā śaktitattvasamākhyayā ||
meaning:
ज्ञानशक्तिसमायोगादिच्छोपोद्बलिका तथा |
सर्वशक्तिसमष्ट्यात्मा शक्तितत्त्वसमाख्यया ||
text_mt: Consisting of the totality of all powers, under the name of the śakti-principle, / she has become the primordial matter of the whole aggregate of effects.

sanskrit_iast:
samastakāryajātasya mūlaprakṛtitāṃ gatā |
saiva kuṇḍalinī māyā śuddhādhvaparamā satī ||
meaning:
समस्तकार्यजातस्य मूलप्रकृतितां गता |
सैव कुण्डलिनी माया शुद्धाध्वपरमा सती ||

sanskrit_iast:
sā vibhāgasvarūpaiva ṣaḍadhvātmā vijṛmbhate |
tatra śabdāstrayo'dhvānastrayaścārthāḥ samīritāḥ ||
meaning:
सा विभागस्वरूपैव षडध्वात्मा विजृम्भते |
तत्र शब्दास्त्रयोऽध्वानस्त्रयश्चार्थाः समीरिताः ||
text_mt:
She alone is Kuṇḍalinī, Māyā, supreme in the pure path, virtuous; / having the very nature of division, she manifests as the six paths.
There, three paths are declared to be words and three are meanings. / For all souls according to their own purity,

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmapi vai puṃsāṃ naijaśuddhyanurūpataḥ |
layabhogādhikārāḥ syuḥ sarvatattvavibhāgataḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वेषामपि वै पुंसां नैजशुद्ध्यनुरूपतः |
लयभोगाधिकाराः स्युः सर्वतत्त्वविभागतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
kalābhistāni tattvāni vyāptānyeva yathātatham |
parasyāḥ prakṛterādau pañcadhā pariṇāmataḥ ||
meaning:
कलाभिस्तानि तत्त्वानि व्याप्तान्येव यथातथम् |
परस्याः प्रकृतेरादौ पञ्चधा परिणामतः ||
text_mt: Those principles are pervaded by the kalās just as they are, / from the beginning, through the fivefold modification of the supreme Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
kalāśca tā nivṛttyādyāḥ paryyāptā iti niścayaḥ |
mantrādhvā ca padādhvā ca varṇādhvā ceti śabdataḥ ||
meaning:
कलाश्च ता निवृत्त्याद्याः पर्य्याप्ता इति निश्चयः |
मन्त्राध्वा च पदाध्वा च वर्णाध्वा चेति शब्दतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvanādhvā ca tattvādhvā kalādhvā cārthataḥ kramāt |
atrānyo'nyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vyāpyavyāpakatocyate ||
meaning:
भुवनाध्वा च तत्त्वाध्वा कलाध्वा चार्थतः क्रमात् |
अत्रान्योऽन्यं च सर्वेषां व्याप्यव्यापकतोच्यते ||
text_mt:
The path of mantras, the path of words, and the path of phonemes—according to sound; / and the path of worlds, the path of principles, and the path of kalās—according to meaning, in order.
Here their mutual relation of pervaded and pervader is declared: / mantras are pervaded by all words because they are sentences, and words

sanskrit_iast:
mantrāḥ sarve padairvyāptā vākyabhāvātpadāni ca |
varṇairvarṇasamūhaṃ hi padamāhurvipaścitaḥ ||
meaning:
मन्त्राः सर्वे पदैर्व्याप्ता वाक्यभावात्पदानि च |
वर्णैर्वर्णसमूहं हि पदमाहुर्विपश्चितः ||
text_mt: by phonemes, for the wise call a collection of phonemes a word; / but phonemes are pervaded by worlds, since they are observed within them;

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāstu bhuvanairvyāptāsteṣāṃ teṣūpalambhanāt |
bhuvanānyapi tattvaughairutpattyāntarbahiṣkramāt ||
meaning:
वर्णास्तु भुवनैर्व्याप्तास्तेषां तेषूपलम्भनात् |
भुवनान्यपि तत्त्वौघैरुत्पत्त्यान्तर्बहिष्क्रमात् ||

sanskrit_iast:
vyāptāni kāraṇaistattvairārabdhatvādanekaśaḥ |
antarādutthitānīha bhuvanāni tu kānicit ||
meaning:
व्याप्तानि कारणैस्तत्त्वैरारब्धत्वादनेकशः |
अन्तरादुत्थितानीह भुवनानि तु कानिचित् ||
text_mt: the worlds too are pervaded by the multitude of principles through the sequence of arising inside and outside, / because they are originated manifoldly by the causal principles.

sanskrit_iast:
paurāṇikāni cānyāni vijñeyāni śivāgame |
sāṅkhyayogaprasiddhāni tattvānyapi ca kānicit ||
meaning:
पौराणिकानि चान्यानि विज्ञेयानि शिवागमे |
साङ्ख्ययोगप्रसिद्धानि तत्त्वान्यपि च कानिचित् ||

sanskrit_iast:
śivaśāstraprasiddhāni tato'nyānyapi kṛtsnaśaḥ |
kalābhistāni tattvāni vyāptānyeva yathātatham ||
meaning:
शिवशास्त्रप्रसिद्धानि ततोऽन्यान्यपि कृत्स्नशः |
कलाभिस्तानि तत्त्वानि व्याप्तान्येव यथातथम् ||
text_mt:
there are absorption, enjoyment, and cosmic governance through the division of all principles. / Those principles are pervaded by the kalās just as they are,
Some principles are well known in Sāṅkhya and Yoga, / and all others beyond them are well known in the Śiva scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
parasyāḥ prakṛterādau pañcadhā pariṇāmataḥ |
kalāśca tā nivṛttyādyā vyāptāḥ pañca yathottaram ||
meaning:
परस्याः प्रकृतेरादौ पञ्चधा परिणामतः |
कलाश्च ता निवृत्त्याद्या व्याप्ताः पञ्च यथोत्तरम् ||
text_mt:
from the beginning, through the fivefold modification of the supreme Prakṛti. / And those kalās, beginning with Nivṛtti, are ascertained to be adequate.
And those five kalās, beginning with Nivṛtti, are pervaded each by the succeeding one. / Hence the supreme śakti is the undivided pervader of the six paths.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpikātaḥ parāśaktiravibhaktā ṣaḍadhvanām |
paraprakṛtibhāvasya tatsattvācchivatattvataḥ ||
meaning:
व्यापिकातः पराशक्तिरविभक्ता षडध्वनाम् |
परप्रकृतिभावस्य तत्सत्त्वाच्छिवतत्त्वतः ||
text_mt: Because the supreme Prakṛti exists from the principle of Śiva, / everything from Śakti to earth arises from the principle of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktyādi ca pṛthivyantaṃ śivatattvasamudbhavam |
vyāptamekena tenaiva mṛdā kumbhādikaṃ yathā ||
meaning:
शक्त्यादि च पृथिव्यन्तं शिवतत्त्वसमुद्भवम् |
व्याप्तमेकेन तेनैव मृदा कुम्भादिकं यथा ||

sanskrit_iast:
śaivaṃ tatparamaṃ dhāma yatprāpyaṃ ṣaḍbhiradhvabhiḥ |
vyāpikā'vyāpikā śaktiḥ pañcatattvaviśodhanāt ||
meaning:
शैवं तत्परमं धाम यत्प्राप्यं षड्भिरध्वभिः |
व्यापिकाऽव्यापिका शक्तिः पञ्चतत्त्वविशोधनात् ||
text_mt:
It is pervaded by that single one, just as a pot and the like [are pervaded] by clay. / That supreme abode is Śaiva, which is to be attained by the six paths.
The pervading, non-pervading śakti [purifies] through the purification of the five principles.

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttyā rudraparyantaṃ sthitiraṇḍasya śodhyate |
pratiṣṭhayā tadūrdhvaṃ tu yāvadavyaktagocaram ||
meaning:
निवृत्त्या रुद्रपर्यन्तं स्थितिरण्डस्य शोध्यते |
प्रतिष्ठया तदूर्ध्वं तु यावदव्यक्तगोचरम् ||
text_mt: By Nivṛtti, the state of the cosmic egg up to Rudra is purified; / by Pratiṣṭhā, that which is above it, up to the domain of the Unmanifest;

sanskrit_iast:
tadūrdhvaṃ vidyayā madhye yāvadviśveśvarāvadhi |
śāntyā tadūrdhvammadhvānte viśuddhiḥ śāntyatītayā ||
meaning:
तदूर्ध्वं विद्यया मध्ये यावद्विश्वेश्वरावधि |
शान्त्या तदूर्ध्वम्मध्वान्ते विशुद्धिः शान्त्यतीतया ||
text_mt: above that, in the middle, by Vidyā, up to the limit of Viśveśvara; / above that, by Śānti; at the end of the path, purification is through Śāntyatītā,

sanskrit_iast:
yāmāhuḥ paramaṃ vyoma paraprakṛtiyogataḥ |
etāni pañcatattvāni yairvyāptamakhilaṃ jagat ||
meaning:
यामाहुः परमं व्योम परप्रकृतियोगतः |
एतानि पञ्चतत्त्वानि यैर्व्याप्तमखिलं जगत् ||
text_mt: which they call the supreme ether, through connection with the supreme Prakṛti. / These are the five principles by which the entire world is pervaded.

sanskrit_iast:
atraiva sarvamevedaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ khalu sādhakaiḥ |
adhvavyāptimavijñāya śuddhiṃ yaḥ kartumicchati ||
meaning:
अत्रैव सर्वमेवेदं द्रष्टव्यं खलु साधकैः |
अध्वव्याप्तिमविज्ञाय शुद्धिं यः कर्तुमिच्छति ||
text_mt: Indeed, all this is to be seen right here by practitioners. / He who desires to perform purification without knowing the pervasion of the paths,

sanskrit_iast:
sa vipralambhakaḥ śuddhernālaṃ prāpayituṃ phalam |
vṛthā pariśramastasya nirayāyaiva kevalam ||
meaning:
स विप्रलम्भकः शुद्धेर्नालं प्रापयितुं फलम् |
वृथा परिश्रमस्तस्य निरयायैव केवलम् ||
text_mt: he is a deceiver of purification, incapable of producing the fruit; / his exertion is in vain, leading solely to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktipātasamāyogādṛte tattvāni tattvataḥ |
tadvyāptistadvivṛddhiśca jñātumevaṃ na śakyate ||
meaning:
शक्तिपातसमायोगादृते तत्त्वानि तत्त्वतः |
तद्व्याप्तिस्तद्विवृद्धिश्च ज्ञातुमेवं न शक्यते ||
text_mt: Without the descent of power, the principles in truth, / their pervasion, and their expansion cannot be known in this way.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktirājñā parā śaivī cidrūpā parameśvarī |
śivo'dhitiṣṭhatyakhilaṃ yayā kāraṇabhūtayā ||
meaning:
शक्तिराज्ञा परा शैवी चिद्रूपा परमेश्वरी |
शिवोऽधितिष्ठत्यखिलं यया कारणभूतया ||
text_mt: The sovereign power is the supreme Śaiva command, consisting of consciousness, the supreme Mistress, / through whom as the cause Śiva presides over everything.

sanskrit_iast:
nātmano naiva māyaiṣā na vikāro vicārataḥ |
na bandho nāpi muktiśca bandhamuktividhāyinī ||
meaning:
नात्मनो नैव मायैषा न विकारो विचारतः |
न बन्धो नापि मुक्तिश्च बन्धमुक्तिविधायिनी ||
text_mt: Upon deliberation, she is neither the self nor Māyā, nor a modification; / she is neither bondage nor liberation, but the dispenser of bondage and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaiśvaryaparākāṣṭhā śivasyāvyabhicāriṇī |
samānadharmiṇī tasya taistairbhāvairviśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वैश्वर्यपराकाष्ठा शिवस्याव्यभिचारिणी |
समानधर्मिणी तस्य तैस्तैर्भावैर्विशेषतः ||
text_mt: She is the culmination of all sovereignty, unfailing toward Śiva, / possessing the same attributes as his, particularly through those various states.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tayaiva gṛhī sāpi tenaiva gṛhiṇī sadā |
tayorapatyaṃ yatkāryaṃ paraprakṛtijaṃ jagat ||
meaning:
स तयैव गृही सापि तेनैव गृहिणी सदा |
तयोरपत्यं यत्कार्यं परप्रकृतिजं जगत् ||
text_mt: He is a householder solely with her, and she is ever the housewife solely with him; / their offspring is the effect, the universe born from the supreme Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kartā kāraṇaṃ seti tayorbhedo vyavasthitaḥ |
eka eva śivaḥ sākṣād dvidhā'sau samavasthitaḥ ||
meaning:
स कर्ता कारणं सेति तयोर्भेदो व्यवस्थितः |
एक एव शिवः साक्षाद् द्विधाऽसौ समवस्थितः ||
text_mt: He is the agent and she is the cause: thus their distinction is established. / Śiva directly is only one, though he stands twofold.

sanskrit_iast:
strīpuṃsabhāvena tayorbheda ityapi kecana |
apare tu parā śaktiḥ śivasya samavāyinī ||
meaning:
स्त्रीपुंसभावेन तयोर्भेद इत्यपि केचन |
अपरे तु परा शक्तिः शिवस्य समवायिनी ||
text_mt: Some say their distinction is by way of the condition of female and male; / but others say the supreme Śakti is inherent in Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
prabheva bhānościdrūpā bhinnaiveti vyavasthitaḥ |
tasmācchivaḥ paro hetustasyājñā parameśvarī ||
meaning:
प्रभेव भानोश्चिद्रूपा भिन्नैवेति व्यवस्थितः |
तस्माच्छिवः परो हेतुस्तस्याज्ञा परमेश्वरी ||
text_mt: like the radiance of the sun, consisting of consciousness, [and not] separate: thus it is established. / Therefore Śiva is the supreme cause, and his command is the supreme Mistress.

sanskrit_iast:
tayaiva preritā śaivī mūlaprakṛtiravyayā |
mahāmāyā ca māyā ca prakṛtistriguṇeti ca ||
meaning:
तयैव प्रेरिता शैवी मूलप्रकृतिरव्यया |
महामाया च माया च प्रकृतिस्त्रिगुणेति च ||
text_mt: Impelled by her alone, the imperishable Śaiva primordial nature— / Mahāmāyā, Māyā, and the nature consisting of three guṇas—

sanskrit_iast:
trividhā kāryabhedena sā prasūte ṣaḍadhvanaḥ |
sa vāgarthamayaścādhvā ṣaḍvidho nikhilaṃ jagat ||
meaning:
त्रिविधा कार्यभेदेन सा प्रसूते षडध्वनः |
स वागर्थमयश्चाध्वा षड्विधो निखिलं जगत् ||
text_mt: Threefold through divisions of effect, brings forth the six paths. / That sixfold path consisting of word and meaning is the entire universe.

sanskrit_iast:
asyaiva vistaraṃ prāhuḥ śāstrajātamaśeṣataḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
अस्यैव विस्तरं प्राहुः शास्त्रजातमशेषतः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
they declare that the whole body of scriptures is its amplification.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
caritāni vicitrāṇi gṛhyāṇi gahanāni ca |
durvijñeyāni devaiśca mohayanti manāṃsi naḥ ||
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः |
चरितानि विचित्राणि गृह्याणि गहनानि च |
दुर्विज्ञेयानि देवैश्च मोहयन्ति मनांसि नः ||
title: triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivatattvapraśnaḥ
text_mt:
Chapter 30
The sages said:
Varied, inward, and profound are the deeds

sanskrit_iast:
śivayostattvasambandhe na doṣa upalabhyate |
caritaiḥ prākṛto bhāvastayorapi vibhāvyate ||
meaning:
शिवयोस्तत्त्वसम्बन्धे न दोष उपलभ्यते |
चरितैः प्राकृतो भावस्तयोरपि विभाव्यते ||

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādayo'pi lokānāṃ sṛṣṭisthityantahetavaḥ |
nigrahānugrahau prāpya śivasya vaśavartinaḥ ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मादयोऽपि लोकानां सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तहेतवः |
निग्रहानुग्रहौ प्राप्य शिवस्य वशवर्तिनः ||
text_mt:
yet by their deeds, an ordinary human nature also appears in them both.
Even Brahmā and the others, who are causes of the creation, preservation, and end of the worlds,
having received constraint and grace, remain obedient to Śiva.
Śiva, on the other hand, is not the object of constraint and grace by anyone.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaḥ punarna kasyāpi nigrahānugrahāspadam |
ato'nāyattamaiśvaryaṃ tasyaiveti viniścitam ||
meaning:
शिवः पुनर्न कस्यापि निग्रहानुग्रहास्पदम् |
अतोऽनायत्तमैश्वर्यं तस्यैवेति विनिश्चितम् ||
text_mt:
Therefore, sovereign power belongs to him alone unassisted; so it is resolved.
534a

sanskrit_iast:
yadyevamīdṛśaiśvaryaṃ tattu svātantryalakṣaṇam |
svabhāvasiddhaṃ caitasya mūrtimattāspadaṃ bhavet ||
meaning:
यद्येवमीदृशैश्वर्यं तत्तु स्वातन्त्र्यलक्षणम् |
स्वभावसिद्धं चैतस्य मूर्तिमत्तास्पदं भवेत् ||
text_mt: If such sovereignty, characterized by absolute freedom, is his, / and if it is inherent to his nature, it would become the locus of embodiment.

sanskrit_iast:
na mūrtiśca svatantrasya ghaṭate mūlahetunā |
mūrterapi ca kāryatvāttatsiddhiḥ syādahaitukī ||
meaning:
न मूर्तिश्च स्वतन्त्रस्य घटते मूलहेतुना |
मूर्तेरपि च कार्यत्वात्तत्सिद्धिः स्यादहैतुकी ||
text_mt: Yet embodiment does not suit an independent being through a primary cause; / and since a body is an effect, its establishment [in him] would be uncaused.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra paramo bhāvo'paramaścānya ucyate |
paramāparamau bhāvau kathamekatra saṅgatau ||
meaning:
सर्वत्र परमो भावोऽपरमश्चान्य उच्यते |
परमापरमौ भावौ कथमेकत्र सङ्गतौ ||
text_mt: Everywhere the highest state is proclaimed, and another is the un-highest; / how can the highest and un-highest states be combined in one [entity]?

sanskrit_iast:
niṣphalo hi svabhāvo'sya paramaḥ paramātmanaḥ |
sa eva sakalaḥ kasmātsvabhāvo hyaviparyayaḥ ||
meaning:
निष्फलो हि स्वभावोऽस्य परमः परमात्मनः |
स एव सकलः कस्मात्स्वभावो ह्यविपर्ययः ||
text_mt: For the highest nature of this Supreme Self is without parts; / why then is he possessed of parts, since nature admits of no reversal?

sanskrit_iast:
svabhāvo viparītaścetsvatantraḥ svecchayā yadi |
na karoti kimīśāno nityānityaviparyayam ||
meaning:
स्वभावो विपरीतश्चेत्स्वतन्त्रः स्वेच्छया यदि |
न करोति किमीशानो नित्यानित्यविपर्ययम् ||
text_mt: If his nature were reversed by his own will because he is independent, / why would Īśāna not make a reversal of the eternal and non-eternal?

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtātmā sakalaḥ kaścitsa cānyo niṣphalaḥ śivaḥ |
śivenādhiṣṭhitaśceti sarvatra laghu kathyate ||
meaning:
मूर्तात्मा सकलः कश्चित्स चान्यो निष्फलः शिवः |
शिवेनाधिष्ठितश्चेति सर्वत्र लघु कथ्यते ||
text_mt: The embodied soul is possessed of parts, and that other Śiva is partless; / and that he is presided over by Śiva is commonly stated everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtyātmaiva tadā mūrtiḥ śivasyāsya bhavediti |
tasyāṃ mūrtau mūrtimatoḥ pāratantryaṃ hi niścitam ||
meaning:
मूर्त्यात्मैव तदा मूर्तिः शिवस्यास्य भवेदिति |
तस्यां मूर्तौ मूर्तिमतोः पारतन्त्र्यं हि निश्चितम् ||
text_mt: Then the body itself would be the body of this Śiva; / in that body, dependence is indeed established for the one possessed of a body.

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā nirapekṣeṇa mūrtiḥ svīkriyate katham |
mūrtisvīkaraṇaṃ tasmānmūrtau sādhyaphalepsayā ||
meaning:
अन्यथा निरपेक्षेण मूर्तिः स्वीक्रियते कथम् |
मूर्तिस्वीकरणं तस्मान्मूर्तौ साध्यफलेप्सया ||
text_mt: Otherwise, how could a body be assumed by one who is without need? / Therefore, the assumption of a body must be through a desire for a fruit to be achieved in the body.

sanskrit_iast:
na hi svecchāśarīratvaṃ svātantryāyopapadyate |
svecchaiva tādṛśī puṃsāṃ yasmātkarmānusāriṇī ||
meaning:
न हि स्वेच्छाशरीरत्वं स्वातन्त्र्यायोपपद्यते |
स्वेच्छैव तादृशी पुंसां यस्मात्कर्मानुसारिणी ||
text_mt: Possessing a body by one's own will does not establish independence, / because that very will of beings follows karma.

sanskrit_iast:
svīkartuṃ svecchayā dehaṃ hātuṃ ca prabhavantyuta |
brahmādayaḥ piśācāntāḥ kiṃ te karmātivartinaḥ ||
meaning:
स्वीकर्तुं स्वेच्छया देहं हातुं च प्रभवन्त्युत |
ब्रह्मादयः पिशाचान्ताः किं ते कर्मातिवर्तिनः ||
text_mt: Beings from Brahmā down to ghosts are able / to assume a body by their will and to abandon it; do they transcend karma?

sanskrit_iast:
icchayā dehanirmāṇamindrajālopamaṃ viduḥ |
aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryavaśīkārānatikramāt ||
meaning:
इच्छया देहनिर्माणमिन्द्रजालोपमं विदुः |
अणिमादिगुणैश्वर्यवशीकारानतिक्रमात् ||
text_mt: They consider the creation of a body by will to be like an illusion, / because it does not transcend the mastery of powers of qualities such as minuteness.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvarūpaṃ dadhadviṣṇurdadhīcena maharṣiṇā |
yudhyatā samupālabdhastadrūpaṃ dadhatā svayam ||
meaning:
विश्वरूपं दधद्विष्णुर्दधीचेन महर्षिणा |
युध्यता समुपालब्धस्तद्रूपं दधता स्वयम् ||
text_mt: Viṣṇu assuming the cosmic form was censured / by the great sage Dadhīca as he fought, himself assuming that form.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasmādadhikasyāpi śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
śarīravattayānyātmasādharmyaṃ pratibhāti naḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वस्मादधिकस्यापि शिवस्य परमात्मनः |
शरीरवत्तयान्यात्मसाधर्म्यं प्रतिभाति नः ||
text_mt: Even of Śiva, the Supreme Self who is greater than all, / by his having a body, a common nature with other souls appears to us.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānugrāhakaṃ prāhuḥ śivaṃ paramakāraṇam |
sa nirgṛhṇāti devānāṃ sarvānugrāhakaḥ katham ||
meaning:
सर्वानुग्राहकं प्राहुः शिवं परमकारणम् |
स निर्गृह्णाति देवानां सर्वानुग्राहकः कथम् ||
text_mt: They declare Śiva, the supreme cause, to be the benefactor of all; / how does he who favors all punish the gods?

sanskrit_iast:
ciccheda bahuśo devo brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ |
śivanindāṃ prakurvantaṃ putreti kumaterhaṭhāt ||
meaning:
चिच्छेद बहुशो देवो ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः |
शिवनिन्दां प्रकुर्वन्तं पुत्रेति कुमतेर्हठात् ||
text_mt: Many times the god violently severed Brahmā's fifth head, / because that foolish one, calling him "son," was reviling Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇorapi nṛsiṃhasya rabhasā śarabhākṛtiḥ |
bibheda padbhyāmākramya hṛdayaṃ nakharaiḥ kharaiḥ ||
meaning:
विष्णोरपि नृसिंहस्य रभसा शरभाकृतिः |
बिभेद पद्भ्यामाक्रम्य हृदयं नखरैः खरैः ||
text_mt: Even of Viṣṇu as the Man-Lion, [Śiva] violently assuming the form of a Śarabha / split the chest with sharp claws, trampling him with his feet.

sanskrit_iast:
devastrīṣu ca deveṣu dakṣasyādhvarakāraṇāt |
vīreṇa vīrabhadreṇa na hi kaścidadaṇḍitaḥ ||
meaning:
देवस्त्रीषु च देवेषु दक्षस्याध्वरकारणात् |
वीरेण वीरभद्रेण न हि कश्चिददण्डितः ||
text_mt: Among the women of the gods and among the gods, on account of Dakṣa's sacrifice, / no one at all was left unpunished by the hero Vīrabhadra.

sanskrit_iast:
puratrayaṃ ca sastrīkaṃ sadaityaṃ saha bālakaiḥ |
kṣaṇenaikena devena netrāgnerindhanīkṛtam ||
meaning:
पुरत्रयं च सस्त्रीकं सदैत्यं सह बालकैः |
क्षणेनैकेन देवेन नेत्राग्नेरिन्धनीकृतम् ||
text_mt: And the three cities, together with their women, Daityas, and children, / were made fuel for the fire of his eye by the god in a single moment.

sanskrit_iast:
prajānāṃ ratihetuśca kāmo ratipatiḥ svayam |
krośatāmeva devānāṃ huto netrahutāśane ||
meaning:
प्रजानां रतिहेतुश्च कामो रतिपतिः स्वयम् |
क्रोशतामेव देवानां हुतो नेत्रहुताशने ||
text_mt: And Kāma, the lord of Rati, the cause of pleasure for creatures, / was offered into the fire of his eye, even as the gods were crying out.

sanskrit_iast:
gāvaśca kaściddugdhaughaṃ sravantyo mūrdhni khecarāḥ |
saruṣā prekṣya devena tatkṣaṇe bhasmasātkṛtāḥ ||
meaning:
गावश्च कश्चिद्दुग्धौघं स्रवन्त्यो मूर्ध्नि खेचराः |
सरुषा प्रेक्ष्य देवेन तत्क्षणे भस्मसात्कृताः ||
text_mt: And certain cows moving in the sky, shedding a flood of milk upon his head, / were reduced to ashes that very moment when looked upon angrily by the god.

sanskrit_iast:
jalandharāsuro dīrṇaścakrīkṛtya jalaṃ padā |
baddhvānantena yo viṣṇuṃ cikṣepa śatayojanam ||
meaning:
जलन्धरासुरो दीर्णश्चक्रीकृत्य जलं पदा |
बद्ध्वानन्तेन यो विष्णुं चिक्षेप शतयोजनम् ||
text_mt: The Asura Jalandhara was torn apart [by Śiva] after forming a disc in the water with his foot— / [the Asura] who, having bound Viṣṇu with Ananta, hurled him a hundred yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
tameva jalasandhāyī śūlenaiva jaghāna saḥ |
taccakraṃ tapasā labdhvā labdhavīryo hariḥ sadā ||
meaning:
तमेव जलसन्धायी शूलेनैव जघान सः |
तच्चक्रं तपसा लब्ध्वा लब्धवीर्यो हरिः सदा ||
text_mt: Him indeed the one who placed [the disc] in the water slew with his trident; / Hari, having obtained that discus through austerity, is always endowed with power.

sanskrit_iast:
jighāṃsatāṃ surārīṇāṃ kulaṃ nirghṛṇacetasām |
triśūlenāndhakasyoraḥ śikhinaivopatāpitam ||
meaning:
जिघांसतां सुरारीणां कुलं निर्घृणचेतसाम् |
त्रिशूलेनान्धकस्योरः शिखिनैवोपतापितम् ||
text_mt: When the race of merciless enemies of the gods wished to kill, / the chest of Andhaka was tormented by the three-pronged trident as if by fire.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhātkālāṅganāṃ sṛṣṭvā dārako'pi nipātitaḥ |
kauśikīṃ janayitvā tu gauryyāstvakkośagocarām ||
meaning:
कण्ठात्कालाङ्गनां सृष्ट्वा दारकोऽपि निपातितः |
कौशिकीं जनयित्वा तु गौर्य्यास्त्वक्कोशगोचराम् ||
text_mt: Creating the dark woman from his throat, Dāraka too was struck down; / and having generated Kauśikī, who was within the sheath of Gaurī's skin,

sanskrit_iast:
śumbhaḥ saha niśumbhena prāpito maraṇaṃ raṇe |
śrutaṃ ca mahadākhyānaṃ skānde skandasamāśrayam ||
meaning:
शुम्भः सह निशुम्भेन प्रापितो मरणं रणे |
श्रुतं च महदाख्यानं स्कान्दे स्कन्दसमाश्रयम् ||
text_mt: Śumbha along with Niśumbha was brought to death in battle. / And the great narrative pertaining to Skanda has been heard in the Skanda [Purāṇa]:

sanskrit_iast:
vadhārthe tārakākhyasya daityendrasyendravidviṣaḥ |
brahmaṇābhyarthito devo mandarāntaḥpuraṃ gataḥ ||
meaning:
वधार्थे तारकाख्यस्य दैत्येन्द्रस्येन्द्रविद्विषः |
ब्रह्मणाभ्यर्थितो देवो मन्दरान्तःपुरं गतः ||
text_mt: For the sake of slaying the Daitya king named Tāraka, the enemy of Indra, / the god, implored by Brahmā, went to the inner apartments on Mandara.

sanskrit_iast:
vihṛtya suciraṃ devyā vihārātiprasaṅgataḥ |
rasāṃ rasātalaṃ nītāmiva kṛtvābhidhāṃ tataḥ ||
meaning:
विहृत्य सुचिरं देव्या विहारातिप्रसङ्गतः |
रसां रसातलं नीतामिव कृत्वाभिधां ततः ||
text_mt: Having sported for a very long time with Devī, through excessive indulgence in amorous play, / making the earth as if driven down to the netherworld, making it true to its name,

sanskrit_iast:
devīṃ ca vañcayaṃstasyāṃ svavīryamatidurvaham |
avisṛjya visṛjyāgnau haviḥ pūtamivāmṛtam ||
meaning:
देवीं च वञ्चयंस्तस्यां स्ववीर्यमतिदुर्वहम् |
अविसृज्य विसृज्याग्नौ हविः पूतमिवामृतम् ||
text_mt: And deceiving the goddess, not releasing his exceedingly unbearable semen into her, / but casting it into the fire like purified nectar-like oblation,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgādiṣvapi nikṣipya vahnidvārā tadaṃśataḥ |
tatsamāhṛtya śanakaistokaṃ stokamitastataḥ ||
meaning:
गङ्गादिष्वपि निक्षिप्य वह्निद्वारा तदंशतः |
तत्समाहृत्य शनकैस्तोकं स्तोकमितस्ततः ||
text_mt: And through Fire casting portions of it into the Gaṅgā and other [places], / gradually gathering it bit by bit from here and there,

sanskrit_iast:
svāhayā kṛttikārūpātsvabhartrā ramamāṇayā |
suvarṇībhūtayā nyastaṃ merau śaravaṇe kvacit ||
meaning:
स्वाहया कृत्तिकारूपात्स्वभर्त्रा रममाणया |
सुवर्णीभूतया न्यस्तं मेरौ शरवणे क्वचित् ||
text_mt: It was deposited in a reed bed somewhere on Meru by Svāhā, / turned golden, as she sported with her husband in the form of the Kṛttikās.

sanskrit_iast:
sandīpayitvā kālena tasya bhāsā diśo daśa |
rañjayitvā girīnsarvān kāñcanīkṛtya meruṇā ||
meaning:
सन्दीपयित्वा कालेन तस्य भासा दिशो दश |
रञ्जयित्वा गिरीन्सर्वान् काञ्चनीकृत्य मेरुणा ||
text_mt: Having illuminated the ten directions with its radiance in course of time, / having tinted all mountains and made them golden along with Meru,

sanskrit_iast:
tataścireṇa kālena sañjāte tatra tejasi |
kumāre sukumārāṅge kumārāṇāṃ nidarśane ||
meaning:
ततश्चिरेण कालेन सञ्जाते तत्र तेजसि |
कुमारे सुकुमाराङ्गे कुमाराणां निदर्शने ||
text_mt: Then, after a long time, when that splendor was born there / as Kumāra, delicate of limb, the exemplar of boys,

sanskrit_iast:
tacchaiśavaṃ svarūpaṃ ca tasya dṛṣṭvā manoharam |
saha devāsurairlokairvismite ca vimohite ||
meaning:
तच्छैशवं स्वरूपं च तस्य दृष्ट्वा मनोहरम् |
सह देवासुरैर्लोकैर्विस्मिते च विमोहिते ||
text_mt: Seeing that childhood and his captivating form, / the worlds together with the gods and Asuras were astonished and fascinated.

sanskrit_iast:
devo'pi svayamāyātaḥ putradarśanalālasaḥ |
saha devyāṅkamāropya tato'sya smeramānanam ||
meaning:
देवोऽपि स्वयमायातः पुत्रदर्शनलालसः |
सह देव्याङ्कमारोप्य ततोऽस्य स्मेरमाननम् ||
text_mt: The god himself also arrived, longing to see his son; / placing him along with the goddess on his lap, and then his smiling face,

sanskrit_iast:
pītāmṛtamiva snehavivaśenāntarātmanā |
deveṣvapi ca paśyatsu vītarāgaistapasvibhiḥ ||
meaning:
पीतामृतमिव स्नेहविवशेनान्तरात्मना |
देवेष्वपि च पश्यत्सु वीतरागैस्तपस्विभिः ||
text_mt: [Gazing upon it] as if drinking nectar, with an inner soul helpless with affection, / while the gods and ascetics free from passion looked on,

sanskrit_iast:
svasya vakṣaḥsthale svairaṃ nartayitvā kumārakam |
anubhūya ca tatkrīḍāṃ sambhāvya ca parasparam ||
meaning:
स्वस्य वक्षःस्थले स्वैरं नर्तयित्वा कुमारकम् |
अनुभूय च तत्क्रीडां सम्भाव्य च परस्परम् ||
text_mt: Freely making the little boy dance upon his own chest, / and enjoying his play and honoring each other,

sanskrit_iast:
stanyamājñāpayandevyāḥ pāyayitvāmṛtopamam |
tavāvatāro jagatāṃ hitāyetyanuśāsya ca ||
meaning:
स्तन्यमाज्ञापयन्देव्याः पाययित्वामृतोपमम् |
तवावतारो जगतां हितायेत्यनुशास्य च ||
text_mt: Commanding [her] to give the goddess's breast-milk, making him drink that nectar-like milk, / and instructing him, "Your incarnation is for the welfare of the worlds,"

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ devaśca devī ca na tṛptimupajagmatuḥ |
tataḥ śakreṇa sandhāya bibhyatā tārakāsurāt ||
meaning:
स्वयं देवश्च देवी च न तृप्तिमुपजग्मतुः |
ततः शक्रेण सन्धाय बिभ्यता तारकासुरात् ||
text_mt: The god and the goddess themselves could not attain satiety. / Then, having made an alliance through Śakra who feared the Asura Tāraka,

sanskrit_iast:
kārayitvā'bhiṣekaṃ ca senāpatye divaukasām |
putramantarataḥ kṛtvā devena tripuradviṣaḥ ||
meaning:
कारयित्वाऽभिषेकं च सेनापत्ये दिवौकसाम् |
पुत्रमन्तरतः कृत्वा देवेन त्रिपुरद्विषः ||
text_mt: And having had the son of the enemy of Tripura consecrated / to the generalship of the gods, placing him within,

sanskrit_iast:
svayamantarhitenaiva skandamindrādirakṣitam |
tacchaktyā krauñcabhedinyā yudhi kālāgnikalpayā ||
meaning:
स्वयमन्तर्हितेनैव स्कन्दमिन्द्रादिरक्षितम् |
तच्छक्त्या क्रौञ्चभेदिन्या युधि कालाग्निकल्पया ||
text_mt: [Śiva] having vanished himself, Skanda was protected by Indra and the others; / with his spear that cleaves the Krauñca mountain, resembling the fire of cosmic dissolution in battle,

sanskrit_iast:
cheditaṃ tārakasyāpi śiraḥ śakrabhiyā saha |
stutiṃ cakrurviśeṣeṇa haridhātṛmukhāḥ surāḥ ||
meaning:
छेदितं तारकस्यापि शिरः शक्रभिया सह |
स्तुतिं चक्रुर्विशेषेण हरिधातृमुखाः सुराः ||
text_mt: Tāraka's head was cut off, along with Indra's fear; / the gods, headed by Hari and the creator, offered special praise.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā rakṣo'dhipaḥ sākṣādrāvaṇo balagarvitaḥ |
uddharansvabhujairdīrghaiḥ kailāsaṃ girimātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
तथा रक्षोऽधिपः साक्षाद्रावणो बलगर्वितः |
उद्धरन्स्वभुजैर्दीर्घैः कैलासं गिरिमात्मनः ||
text_mt: Likewise the lord of the rākṣasas, Rāvaṇa himself, proud of his strength, / lifting his own Mount Kailāsa with his long arms,

sanskrit_iast:
tadāgo'sahamānasya devadevasya śūlinaḥ |
padāṅguṣṭhaparispandānmamajja mṛdito bhuvi ||
meaning:
तदागोऽसहमानस्य देवदेवस्य शूलिनः |
पदाङ्गुष्ठपरिस्पन्दान्ममज्ज मृदितो भुवि ||
text_mt: by the twitch of the big toe of the trident-bearing god of gods, / who could not endure his offense, sank down, crushed into the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
baṭoḥ kenacidarthena svāśritasya gatāyuṣaḥ |
tvarayāgatya devena pādāntaṃ gamito'ntakaḥ ||
meaning:
बटोः केनचिदर्थेन स्वाश्रितस्य गतायुषः |
त्वरयागत्य देवेन पादान्तं गमितोऽन्तकः ||
text_mt: For the sake of a young boy, his refugee, whose lifespan had run out, / the god arrived in haste and drove the Ender to his feet.

sanskrit_iast:
svavāhanamavijñāya vṛṣendraṃ vaḍavānalaḥ |
sagalagrahamānītastato'styekodakaṃ jagat ||
meaning:
स्ववाहनमविज्ञाय वृषेन्द्रं वडवानलः |
सगलग्रहमानीतस्ततोऽस्त्येकोदकं जगत् ||
text_mt: Failing to recognize his own mount, the great bull, the submarine fire / was seized by the neck; from that the world became a single ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
alokaviditaistaistairvṛttairānandasundaraiḥ |
aṅgahārakrameṇedamasakṛccālitaṃ jagat ||
meaning:
अलोकविदितैस्तैस्तैर्वृत्तैरानन्दसुन्दरैः |
अङ्गहारक्रमेणेदमसकृच्चालितं जगत् ||
text_mt: By those various delightful and beautiful dances unknown to the world, / this world was repeatedly agitated through the sequence of movements.

sanskrit_iast:
śānta eva sadā sarvamanugṛhṇāti cecchivaḥ |
sarvāṇi pūrayedeva kathaṃ śaktena mocayet ||
meaning:
शान्त एव सदा सर्वमनुगृह्णाति चेच्छिवः |
सर्वाणि पूरयेदेव कथं शक्तेन मोचयेत् ||
text_mt: If Śiva, being ever peaceful, shows grace to everything, / he should fulfill all things; how could he liberate by force?

sanskrit_iast:
anādikarmavaicitryamapi nātra niyāmakam |
kāraṇaṃ khalu karmāpi bhavedīśvarakāritam ||
meaning:
अनादिकर्मवैचित्र्यमपि नात्र नियामकम् |
कारणं खलु कर्मापि भवेदीश्वरकारितम् ||
text_mt: Even the variety of beginningless action is not the regulator here; / for action itself must indeed be a cause prompted by the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
kimatra bahunoktena nāstikyaṃ hetukārakam |
yathā hyāśu nivarteta tathā kathaya māruta ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन नास्तिक्यं हेतुकारकम् |
यथा ह्याशु निवर्तेत तथा कथय मारुत ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
What is the use of speaking much here? Nihilism is the cause of doubt; / tell us, O Vāyu, how it may be quickly dispelled.

Homage to the venerable Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
sthane saṃśayitaṃ viprā bhavadbhirhetucoditaiḥ |
jijñāsā hi na nāstikyaṃ sādhayetsādhubuddhiṣu ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
स्थने संशयितं विप्रा भवद्भिर्हेतुचोदितैः |
जिज्ञासा हि न नास्तिक्यं साधयेत्साधुबुद्धिषु ||
title: ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | jñānopadeśaḥ
text_mt:
Chapter 31
Vāyu said:
It is proper that doubt has been raised by you, O brahmins, prompted by reasoning.
For inquiry does not establish godlessness in those with good intellects.
Here I shall explain the authority that dispels the delusion of the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
pramaṇamatra vakṣyāmi satāṃ mohanivartakam |
asatāṃ tvanyathābhāvaḥ prasādena vinā prabhoḥ ||
meaning:
प्रमणमत्र वक्ष्यामि सतां मोहनिवर्तकम् |
असतां त्वन्यथाभावः प्रसादेन विना प्रभोः ||
text_mt:
The contrary state belongs to the wicked without the Lord's favor.
For Śiva, who is completely full, apart from bestowing grace on others,

sanskrit_iast:
śivasya paripūrṇasya parānugrahamantarā |
na kiñcidapi kartavyamiti sādhu viniścitam ||
meaning:
शिवस्य परिपूर्णस्य परानुग्रहमन्तरा |
न किञ्चिदपि कर्तव्यमिति साधु विनिश्चितम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
svabhāva eva paryāptaḥ parānugrahakarmaṇi |
anyathā niḥsvabhāvena na kimapyanugṛhyate ||
meaning:
स्वभाव एव पर्याप्तः परानुग्रहकर्मणि |
अन्यथा निःस्वभावेन न किमप्यनुगृह्यते ||

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ sarvamanugrāhyaṃ paśupāśātmakaṃ jagat |
parasyānugrahārthaṃ tu patyurājñāsamanvayaḥ ||
meaning:
परं सर्वमनुग्राह्यं पशुपाशात्मकं जगत् |
परस्यानुग्रहार्थं तु पत्युराज्ञासमन्वयः ||
text_mt:
Otherwise, by one devoid of inherent nature, nothing whatsoever is graced.
All else, the world consisting of bound souls and bonds, is the object to be graced.
For the sake of gracing others, the command of the Master is connected.
The Master who gives commands graces all at all times.

sanskrit_iast:
patirājñāpakaḥ sarvamanugṛhṇāti sarvadā |
tadarthamarthasvīkāre paratantraḥ kathaṃ śivaḥ ||
meaning:
पतिराज्ञापकः सर्वमनुगृह्णाति सर्वदा |
तदर्थमर्थस्वीकारे परतन्त्रः कथं शिवः ||

sanskrit_iast:
anugrāhyānapekṣo'sti na hi kaścidanugrahaḥ |
ataḥ svātantryaśabdārthānanapekṣatvalakṣaṇaḥ ||
meaning:
अनुग्राह्यानपेक्षोऽस्ति न हि कश्चिदनुग्रहः |
अतः स्वातन्त्र्यशब्दार्थाननपेक्षत्वलक्षणः ||
text_mt:
Therefore the meaning of the word 'independence' is characterized by not being dependent [on a master].
On the other hand, this object of grace is considered dependent on another,

sanskrit_iast:
etatpunaranugrāhyaṃ paratantraṃ tadiṣyate |
anugrahād ṛte tasya bhuktimuktyorananvayāt ||
meaning:
एतत्पुनरनुग्राह्यं परतन्त्रं तदिष्यते |
अनुग्रहाद् ऋते तस्य भुक्तिमुक्त्योरनन्वयात् ||

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtātmano'pyanugrāhyā śivājñānanivartanāt |
ajñānādhiṣṭhitaṃ śambhorna kiñcidiha vidyate ||
meaning:
मूर्तात्मनोऽप्यनुग्राह्या शिवाज्ञाननिवर्तनात् |
अज्ञानाधिष्ठितं शम्भोर्न किञ्चिदिह विद्यते ||
text_mt:
since without grace there is no connection to enjoyment or liberation.
Even embodied souls are to be graced, because of the cessation of ignorance regarding Śiva's command.

sanskrit_iast:
yenopalabhyate'smābhiḥ sakalenāpi niṣkalaḥ |
sa mūrtyātmā śivaḥ śaivamūrtirityupacaryate ||
meaning:
येनोपलभ्यतेऽस्माभिः सकलेनापि निष्कलः |
स मूर्त्यात्मा शिवः शैवमूर्तिरित्युपचर्यते ||
text_mt:
That embodied self is Śiva, metaphorically called the form of Śiva.
For that partless, directly manifest Śiva is not the ultimate cause

sanskrit_iast:
na hyasau niṣkalaḥ sākṣācchivaḥ paramakāraṇam |
sākāreṇānubhāvena kenāpyanupalakṣitaḥ ||
meaning:
न ह्यसौ निष्कलः साक्षाच्छिवः परमकारणम् |
साकारेणानुभावेन केनाप्यनुपलक्षितः ||

sanskrit_iast:
pramāṇagamyatāmātraṃ tatsvabhāvopapādakam |
na tāvatātropekṣādhīrupalakṣaṇamantarā ||
meaning:
प्रमाणगम्यतामात्रं तत्स्वभावोपपादकम् |
न तावतात्रोपेक्षाधीरुपलक्षणमन्तरा ||
text_mt:
unindicated by any embodied manifestation.
Only being accessible through means of knowledge establishes his inherent nature.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmopamolbaṇaṃ sākṣānmūrtireva hi kācana |
śivasya mūrtirmūrtyātmā parastasyopalakṣaṇam ||
meaning:
आत्मोपमोल्बणं साक्षान्मूर्तिरेव हि काचन |
शिवस्य मूर्तिर्मूर्त्यात्मा परस्तस्योपलक्षणम् ||
text_mt:
The form of Śiva is the embodied self, and the higher is its indirect indication,
just as fire not residing in logs of wood is not perceived.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā kāṣṭheṣvanārūḍho na vahnirupalabhyate |
evaṃ śivo'pi mūrtyātmanyanārūḍha iti sthitiḥ ||
meaning:
यथा काष्ठेष्वनारूढो न वह्निरुपलभ्यते |
एवं शिवोऽपि मूर्त्यात्मन्यनारूढ इति स्थितिः ||

sanskrit_iast:
yathāgnimānayetyukte jvalatkāṣṭhādṛte svayam |
nāgnirānīyate tadvatpūjyo mūrtyātmanā śivaḥ ||
meaning:
यथाग्निमानयेत्युक्ते ज्वलत्काष्ठादृते स्वयम् |
नाग्निरानीयते तद्वत्पूज्यो मूर्त्यात्मना शिवः ||
text_mt:
Thus also Śiva does not reside in the embodied self; such is the state.
Just as when it is said 'Bring fire,' without the burning wood itself
fire is not brought, just so is Śiva to be worshipped through the embodied self. / Therefore indeed, in worship and other rites, the conception of the embodied self is made,

sanskrit_iast:
ata eva hi pūjādau mūrtyātmaparikalpanam |
