text_mt: He who observes this vow every day or for twelve days / also becomes equal to a lifelong ascetic, because of his devotion to the severe vow.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtākto yaścaredetad vrataṃ vrataparāyaṇaḥ |
dvitraikadivasaṃ vāpi sa ca kaścana naiṣṭhikaḥ ||
meaning:
घृताक्तो यश्चरेदेतद् व्रतं व्रतपरायणः |
द्वित्रैकदिवसं वापि स च कश्चन नैष्ठिकः ||
text_mt: And he who, smeared with clarified butter, devoted to the vow, practices this / for two, three, or one day, he too is a lifelong ascetic of a kind.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtyamityeva niṣkāmo yaścared vratamuttamam |
śivārpitātmā satataṃ na tena sadṛśaḥ kvacit ||
meaning:
कृत्यमित्येव निष्कामो यश्चरेद् व्रतमुत्तमम् |
शिवार्पितात्मा सततं न तेन सदृशः क्वचित् ||
text_mt: He who, free from desire, performs this excellent vow simply as a duty, / his self constantly surrendered to Śiva—there is never anyone equal to him.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmacchanno dvijo vidvānmahāpātakasambhavaiḥ |
pāpaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ sadyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
भस्मच्छन्नो द्विजो विद्वान्महापातकसम्भवैः |
पापैः सुदारुणैः सद्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ||
text_mt: A learned twice-born covered with ashes is instantly freed / from terrible sins born of the great sins; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāgniryatparaṃ vīryaṃ tadbhasma parikīrtitam |
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu vīryavānbhasmasaṃyutaḥ ||
meaning:
रुद्राग्निर्यत्परं वीर्यं तद्भस्म परिकीर्तितम् |
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु वीर्यवान्भस्मसंयुतः ||
text_mt: The ash is proclaimed to be the supreme seed-power of Rudra’s fire; / therefore, at all times, one united with ash is full of power.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmaniṣṭhasya naśyanti deṣā bhasmāgnisaṅgamāt |
bhasmasnānaviśuddhātmā bhasmaniṣṭha iti smṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
भस्मनिष्ठस्य नश्यन्ति देषा भस्माग्निसङ्गमात् |
भस्मस्नानविशुद्धात्मा भस्मनिष्ठ इति स्मृतः ||
text_mt: The faults of one devoted to ash are destroyed by contact with the fire of ash. / He whose self is purified by bathing in ashes is considered devoted to ash.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmanā digdhasarvāṅgo bhasmadīptatripuṇḍrakaḥ |
bhasmasnāyī ca puruṣo bhasmaniṣṭha iti smṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
भस्मना दिग्धसर्वाङ्गो भस्मदीप्तत्रिपुण्ड्रकः |
भस्मस्नायी च पुरुषो भस्मनिष्ठ इति स्मृतः ||
text_mt: The man whose limbs are all smeared with ashes, who shines with the triple mark of ashes, / and who bathes in ashes, is considered devoted to ash.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtapretapiśāsāśca rogāścātīva dussahāḥ |
bhasmaniṣṭhasya sānnidhyād vidravanti na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
भूतप्रेतपिशासाश्च रोगाश्चातीव दुस्सहाः |
भस्मनिष्ठस्य सान्निध्याद् विद्रवन्ति न संशयः ||
text_mt: Ghosts, spirits, flesh-eaters, and very unbearable diseases / scatter in the presence of one devoted to ash, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāsanādbhasitaṃ proktaṃ bhasma kalmaṣabhakṣaṇāt |
bhūtiḥ bhūtikarī caiva rakṣā rakṣākarī param ||
meaning:
भासनाद्भसितं प्रोक्तं भस्म कल्मषभक्षणात् |
भूतिः भूतिकरी चैव रक्षा रक्षाकरी परम् ||
text_mt: It is called *bhasita* because of illuminating; *bhasma* because of consuming sins; / *bhūti* because it causes prosperity; and supreme *rakṣā* because it brings protection.

sanskrit_iast:
kimanyadiha vaktavyaṃ bhasmamāhātmyakāraṇam |
vratī ca bhasmanā snātaḥ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
किमन्यदिह वक्तव्यं भस्ममाहात्म्यकारणम् |
व्रती च भस्मना स्नातः स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः ||
text_mt: What else needs to be said here about the cause of the eulogy of ashes? / The Lord Maheśvara himself is an observer of vows who has bathed in ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
paramāstraṃ ca śaivānāṃ bhasmaitatpārameśvaram |
dhaumyāgrajasya tapasi vyāpado yannivāritāḥ ||
meaning:
परमास्त्रं च शैवानां भस्मैतत्पारमेश्वरम् |
धौम्याग्रजस्य तपसि व्यापदो यन्निवारिताः ||
text_mt: This ash belonging to the Supreme Lord is the ultimate weapon of the Śaivas, / by which misfortunes were averted during the austerity of Dhaumya's elder brother.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kṛtvā pāśupatavratam |
dhanavadbhasma saṅgṛhya bhasmasnānarato bhavet ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कृत्वा पाशुपतव्रतम् |
धनवद्भस्म सङ्गृह्य भस्मस्नानरतो भवेत् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Therefore, having performed the Pāśupata observance with all effort, / gathering ash like wealth, one should take delight in bathing in ashes.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
dhaumyāgrajena śiśunā kṣīrārthaṃ hi tapaḥ kṛtam |
tasmāt kṣīrārṇavo dattastasmai devena śūlinā ||
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः |
धौम्याग्रजेन शिशुना क्षीरार्थं हि तपः कृतम् |
तस्मात् क्षीरार्णवो दत्तस्तस्मै देवेन शूलिना ||
title: catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | upamanyutapovarṇanam
text_mt: / therefore, the ocean of milk was given to him by the trident-bearing Lord. / How did that little child obtain the status of an expositor of the scripture of Śiva?

sanskrit_iast:
sa kathaṃ śiśuko lebhe śivaśāstrapravaktṛtām |
kathaṃ vā śivasadbhāvaṃ jñātvā tapasi niṣṭhitaḥ ||
meaning:
स कथं शिशुको लेभे शिवशास्त्रप्रवक्तृताम् |
कथं वा शिवसद्भावं ज्ञात्वा तपसि निष्ठितः ||
text_mt: / Or how, having known the true reality of Śiva, was he established in asceticism? / And how did he obtain knowledge at the juncture of performing asceticism?

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ ca labdhavijñānastapaścaraṇaparvaṇi |
rudrāgneryatparaṃ vīryaṃ labhe bhasma svarakṣakam ||
meaning:
कथं च लब्धविज्ञानस्तपश्चरणपर्वणि |
रुद्राग्नेर्यत्परं वीर्यं लभे भस्म स्वरक्षकम् ||
text_mt: / [How did he] obtain ash, his protector, which is the supreme virility of Rudra's fire? / Vāyu said: / He who performed asceticism was indeed no ordinary child;

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
na hyeṣa śiśukaḥ kaścitprākṛtaḥ kṛtavāṃstapaḥ |
munivaryasya tanayo vyāghrapādasya dhīmataḥ ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
न ह्येष शिशुकः कश्चित्प्राकृतः कृतवांस्तपः |
मुनिवर्यस्य तनयो व्याघ्रपादस्य धीमतः ||
text_mt: / [he was] the son of the excellent sage, the wise Vyāghrapāda, / who had attained perfection in another birth, but for a certain reason

sanskrit_iast:
janmāntareṇa saṃsiddhaḥ kenāpi khalu hetunā |
svapadapracyuto diṣṭyā prāpto munikumāratām ||
meaning:
जन्मान्तरेण संसिद्धः केनापि खलु हेतुना |
स्वपदप्रच्युतो दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो मुनिकुमारताम् ||
text_mt: / fell from his state and by destiny attained the condition of a sage's son, / having attained the fortune of the future favor of Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevaprasādasya bhāgyāpannasya bhāvinaḥ |
dugdhābhilāṣaprabhavadvāratāmagamattapaḥ ||
meaning:
महादेवप्रसादस्य भाग्यापन्नस्य भाविनः |
दुग्धाभिलाषप्रभवद्वारतामगमत्तपः ||
text_mt: asceticism became the means that arose from his desire for milk. / Hence [he gained] lordship over all gaṇas and eternal youth;

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ sarvagaṇeśatvaṃ kumāratvaṃ ca śāśvatam |
saha dugdhābdhinā tasmai pradadau śaṅkaraḥ svayam ||
meaning:
अतः सर्वगणेशत्वं कुमारत्वं च शाश्वतम् |
सह दुग्धाब्धिना तस्मै प्रददौ शङ्करः स्वयम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tasya jñānāgamo'pyasya prasādādeva śāṅkarāt |
kaumāraṃ hi paraṃ sākṣājjñānaṃ śaktimayaṃ viduḥ ||
meaning:
तस्य ज्ञानागमोऽप्यस्य प्रसादादेव शाङ्करात् |
कौमारं हि परं साक्षाज्ज्ञानं शक्तिमयं विदुः ||
text_mt: For they know the state of Kumāra to be supreme, direct knowledge consisting of śakti; / and his role as an expounder of the scriptures of Śiva was also brought about by that.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaśāstrapravaktṛtvamapi tasya hi tatkṛtam |
kumāromukhato labdhajñānābdheriva nandinaḥ ||
meaning:
शिवशास्त्रप्रवक्तृत्वमपि तस्य हि तत्कृतम् |
कुमारोमुखतो लब्धज्ञानाब्धेरिव नन्दिनः ||

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ tasya śivajñānasamanvaye |
svamātṛvacanaṃ sākṣācchokajaṃ kṣīrakāraṇāt ||
meaning:
दृष्टं तु कारणं तस्य शिवज्ञानसमन्वये |
स्वमातृवचनं साक्षाच्छोकजं क्षीरकारणात् ||
text_mt: was directly his mother's word, born of sorrow on account of milk. / Once, in his maternal uncle's hermitage, he drank a very little milk.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācitkṣīramatyalpaṃ pītavānmātulāśrame |
īrṣyayā mātulasutaṃ santṛptakṣīramuttamam ||
meaning:
कदाचित्क्षीरमत्यल्पं पीतवान्मातुलाश्रमे |
ईर्ष्यया मातुलसुतं सन्तृप्तक्षीरमुत्तमम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā sthitaṃ yathākāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai mātulātmajam |
upamanyurvyāghrapādiḥ prītyā provāca mātaram ||
meaning:
पीत्वा स्थितं यथाकामं दृष्ट्वा वै मातुलात्मजम् |
उपमन्युर्व्याघ्रपादिः प्रीत्या प्रोवाच मातरम् ||
text_mt:
Seeing his maternal uncle's son, with jealousy, having drunk excellent milk to his satisfaction, / standing at his pleasure—the son of his maternal uncle—
Upamanyu, the son of Vyāghrapāda, spoke affectionately to his mother. / Upamanyu said: / Mother! Mother, highly fortunate one! Ascetic woman, give me

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
mātarmātarmahābhāge mama dehi tapasvini |
gavyaṃ kṣīramatisvādu nālpamuṣṇaṃ pibāmyaham ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
मातर्मातर्महाभागे मम देहि तपस्विनि |
गव्यं क्षीरमतिस्वादु नाल्पमुष्णं पिबाम्यहम् ||
text_mt: very delicious cow's milk! Not a little; I will drink it warm.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
tacchrutvā putravacanaṃ tanmātā ca tapasvinī |
vyāghrapādasya mahiṣī duḥkhamāpattadā ca sā ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
तच्छ्रुत्वा पुत्रवचनं तन्माता च तपस्विनी |
व्याघ्रपादस्य महिषी दुःखमापत्तदा च सा ||
text_mt: Vāyu said: / Hearing that speech of her son, his mother, that ascetic woman,

sanskrit_iast:
upalālyātha suprītyā putramāliṅgya sādaram |
duḥkhitā vilalāpātha smṛtvā nairdhanyamātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
उपलाल्याथ सुप्रीत्या पुत्रमालिङ्ग्य सादरम् |
दुःखिता विललापाथ स्मृत्वा नैर्धन्यमात्मनः ||
text_mt: she lamented in sorrow, remembering her own poverty. / But remembering milk again and again, that boy Upamanyu,

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtvā smṛtvā punaḥ kṣīramupamanyuḥ sa bālakaḥ |
dehi dehīti tāmāha rudranbhūyo mahādyutiḥ ||
meaning:
स्मृत्वा स्मृत्वा पुनः क्षीरमुपमन्युः स बालकः |
देहि देहीति तामाह रुद्रन्भूयो महाद्युतिः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tad haṭhaṃ sā parijñāya dvijapatnī tapasvinī |
śāntaye tad haṭhasyātha śubhopāyamarīracat ||
meaning:
तद् हठं सा परिज्ञाय द्विजपत्नी तपस्विनी |
शान्तये तद् हठस्याथ शुभोपायमरीरचत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
uñchavṛttyārjitānbījānsvayaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca sā tadā |
bījapiṣṭamathāloḍya toyena kalabhāṣiṇī ||
meaning:
उञ्छवृत्त्यार्जितान्बीजान्स्वयं दृष्ट्वा च सा तदा |
बीजपिष्टमथालोड्य तोयेन कलभाषिणी ||
text_mt: and devised an auspicious means to pacify his obstinacy. / Seeing herself the grains collected by gleaning,

sanskrit_iast:
ehyehi mama putreti sāmapūrvaṃ tataḥ sutam |
āliṅgyādāya duḥkhārtā pradadau kṛtrimaṃ payaḥ ||
meaning:
एह्येहि मम पुत्रेति सामपूर्वं ततः सुतम् |
आलिङ्ग्यादाय दुःखार्ता प्रददौ कृत्रिमं पयः ||

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā ca kṛtrimaṃ kṣīraṃ mātrāṃ dattaṃ sa bālakaḥ |
naitatkṣīramiti prāha mātaraṃ cātivihvalaḥ ||
meaning:
पीत्वा च कृत्रिमं क्षीरं मात्रां दत्तं स बालकः |
नैतत्क्षीरमिति प्राह मातरं चातिविह्वलः ||
text_mt: afflicted with sorrow, she embraced him, took him up, and gave him the artificial milk. / Having drunk the artificial milk given by his mother, that boy,

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhitā sā tadā prāha samprekṣyāghrāya mūrddhani |
sammārjya netra putrasya karābhyāṃ kamalāyate ||
meaning:
दुःखिता सा तदा प्राह सम्प्रेक्ष्याघ्राय मूर्द्धनि |
सम्मार्ज्य नेत्र पुत्रस्य कराभ्यां कमलायते ||

sanskrit_iast:
jananyuvāca |
taṭinī ratnapūrṇāstāḥ svargapātālagocarāḥ |
bhāgyahīnā na paśyanti bhaktihīnāśca ye śive ||
meaning:
जनन्युवाच |
तटिनी रत्नपूर्णास्ताः स्वर्गपातालगोचराः |
भाग्यहीना न पश्यन्ति भक्तिहीनाश्च ये शिवे ||

sanskrit_iast:
rājyaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca bhojanaṃ kṣīrasambhavam |
na labhante priyāṇyeṣāṃ na tuṣyati yadā śivaḥ ||
meaning:
राज्यं स्वर्गं च मोक्षं च भोजनं क्षीरसम्भवम् |
न लभन्ते प्रियाण्येषां न तुष्यति यदा शिवः ||
text_mt: those devoid of good fortune and devoid of devotion to Śiva do not see. / Sovereignty, heaven, liberation, and food produced from milk—

sanskrit_iast:
bhavaprasādajaṃ sarvaṃ nānyaddevaprasādajam |
anyadeveṣu niratā duḥkhārtā vibhramanti ca ||
meaning:
भवप्रसादजं सर्वं नान्यद्देवप्रसादजम् |
अन्यदेवेषु निरता दुःखार्ता विभ्रमन्ति च ||
text_mt: these pleasant things they do not obtain when Śiva is not pleased. / Everything is born of the grace of Bhava; nothing is born of the grace of other gods.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīraṃ tatra kuto'smākaṃ vane nivasatāṃ sadā |
kva dugdhasādhanaṃ vatsa kva vayaṃ vanavāsinaḥ ||
meaning:
क्षीरं तत्र कुतोऽस्माकं वने निवसतां सदा |
क्व दुग्धसाधनं वत्स क्व वयं वनवासिनः ||
text_mt: Where are the means for milk, my child, and where are we, forest dwellers? / Due to complete lack, out of poverty, by me, unfortunate as I am,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtsnābhāvena dāridryānmayā te bhāgyahīnayā |
mithyādugdhamidaṃ dattaṃ piṣṭamāloḍya vāriṇā ||
meaning:
कृत्स्नाभावेन दारिद्र्यान्मया ते भाग्यहीनया |
मिथ्यादुग्धमिदं दत्तं पिष्टमालोड्य वारिणा ||
text_mt: this false milk was given, flour stirred with water. / Having drunk a little warm, delicious milk in your maternal uncle's house,

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ mātulagṛhe svalpaṃ pītvā svādu payaḥ śrutam |
jñātvā svādu tvayā pītaṃ tajjātīyamanusmaran ||
meaning:
त्वं मातुलगृहे स्वल्पं पीत्वा स्वादु पयः श्रुतम् |
ज्ञात्वा स्वादु त्वया पीतं तज्जातीयमनुस्मरन् ||
text_mt: knowing it to be delicious, and remembering that kind which you drank, / saying, "Milk was not given," you make me sorrowful as you weep.

sanskrit_iast:
dattaṃ na paya ityuktvā rudan duḥkhīkaroṣi mām |
prasādena vinā śambhoḥ payastava na vidyate ||
meaning:
दत्तं न पय इत्युक्त्वा रुदन् दुःखीकरोषि माम् |
प्रसादेन विना शम्भोः पयस्तव न विद्यते ||

sanskrit_iast:
pādapaṅkajayostasya sāmbasya sagaṇasya ca |
bhaktyā samarpitaṃ yattatkāraṇaṃ sarvasampadām ||
meaning:
पादपङ्कजयोस्तस्य साम्बस्य सगणस्य च |
भक्त्या समर्पितं यत्तत्कारणं सर्वसम्पदाम् ||
text_mt: and with his gaṇas is the cause of all prosperity. / Mahādeva, the bestower of wealth, was not worshipped by us before now;

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā vasudo'smābhirmahādevo na pūjitaḥ |
sakāmānāṃ yathākāmaṃ yathoktaphaladāyakaḥ ||
meaning:
अधुना वसुदोऽस्माभिर्महादेवो न पूजितः |
सकामानां यथाकामं यथोक्तफलदायकः ||

sanskrit_iast:
dhanānyuddiśya nāsmābhiritaḥ prāgarcitaḥ śivaḥ |
ato daridrāḥ sañjātā vayaṃ tasmānna te payaḥ ||
meaning:
धनान्युद्दिश्य नास्माभिरितः प्रागर्चितः शिवः |
अतो दरिद्राः सञ्जाता वयं तस्मान्न ते पयः ||
text_mt: he gives according to the desire of those who have desires, conferring the fruit as stated. / Śiva was not worshipped by us prior to this with wealth in view.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvajanmani yaddattaṃ śivamuddiśya vai sutaḥ |
tadeva labhyate nānyad viṣṇumuddiśya vā prabhum ||
meaning:
पूर्वजन्मनि यद्दत्तं शिवमुद्दिश्य वै सुतः |
तदेव लभ्यते नान्यद् विष्णुमुद्दिश्य वा प्रभुम् ||
text_mt:
Therefore we have become poor; consequently, there is no milk for you. / What was given in a previous birth with Śiva in view, O son,
that alone is obtained, nothing else—or with Lord Viṣṇu in view. / Vāyu said: / Hearing this speech of his mother, truthful and indicative of sorrow,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
iti mātṛvacaḥ śrutvā tathyaṃ śokādisūcakam |
bālo'pyanutapannantaḥ pragalbhamidamabravīt ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
इति मातृवचः श्रुत्वा तथ्यं शोकादिसूचकम् |
बालोऽप्यनुतपन्नन्तः प्रगल्भमिदमब्रवीत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
śokenālamito mataḥ sāmbo yadyasti śaṅkaraḥ |
tyaja śokaṃ mahābhāge sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
शोकेनालमितो मतः साम्बो यद्यस्ति शङ्करः |
त्यज शोकं महाभागे सर्वं भद्रं भविष्यति ||
text_mt: Upamanyu said: / Away with sorrow, mother, if Śaṃkara with Ambā exists!

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu mātarvaco me'dya mahādevo'sti cet kvacit |
cirādvā hyacirādvāpi kṣīrodaṃ sādhayāmyaham ||
meaning:
शृणु मातर्वचो मेऽद्य महादेवोऽस्ति चेत् क्वचित् |
चिराद्वा ह्यचिराद्वापि क्षीरोदं साधयाम्यहम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
iti śrutvā vacastasya bālakasya mahāmateḥ |
pratyuvāca tadā mātā suprasannā manasvinī ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य बालकस्य महामतेः |
प्रत्युवाच तदा माता सुप्रसन्ना मनस्विनी ||
text_mt: either after a long time or soon, I will win the ocean of milk. / Vāyu said: / Hearing that speech of the highly intelligent boy,

sanskrit_iast:
mātovāca |
śubhaṃ vicāritaṃ tāta tvayā matprītivarddhanam |
vilambaṃ mā kathāstvaṃ hi bhaja sāmbaṃ sadāśivam ||
meaning:
मातोवाच |
शुभं विचारितं तात त्वया मत्प्रीतिवर्द्धनम् |
विलम्बं मा कथास्त्वं हि भज साम्बं सदाशिवम् ||
text_mt: Make no delay; worship Sadāśiva with Ambā. / Śiva is indeed greater than all, the supreme cause.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasmādadhiko'styeva śivaḥ paramakāraṇam |
tatkṛtaṃ hi jagatsarvaṃ brahmādyāstasya kiṅkarāḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वस्मादधिकोऽस्त्येव शिवः परमकारणम् |
तत्कृतं हि जगत्सर्वं ब्रह्माद्यास्तस्य किङ्कराः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tatprasādakṛtaiśvaryā dāsāstasya vayaṃ prabhoḥ |
taṃ vinānyaṃ na jānīmaḥ śaṅkaraṃ lokaśaṅkaram ||
meaning:
तत्प्रसादकृतैश्वर्या दासास्तस्य वयं प्रभोः |
तं विनान्यं न जानीमः शङ्करं लोकशङ्करम् ||
text_mt: The entire universe is made by him; Brahmā and the others are his servants. / With our sovereignty created by his grace, we are servants of that Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
anyān devānn parityajya karmaṇā manasā girā |
tameva sāmbaṃ sagaṇaṃ bhaja bhāvapurassaram ||
meaning:
अन्यान् देवान्न् परित्यज्य कर्मणा मनसा गिरा |
तमेव साम्बं सगणं भज भावपुरस्सरम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tasya devādhidevasya śivasya varadāyinaḥ |
sākṣānnamaḥ śivāyeti mantro'yaṃ vācakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्य देवाधिदेवस्य शिवस्य वरदायिनः |
साक्षान्नमः शिवायेति मन्त्रोऽयं वाचकः स्मृतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
saptakoṭimahāmantrāḥ sarve sapraṇavāḥ pare |
tasminneva vilīyante punastasmādvinirgatāḥ ||
meaning:
सप्तकोटिमहामन्त्राः सर्वे सप्रणवाः परे |
तस्मिन्नेव विलीयन्ते पुनस्तस्माद्विनिर्गताः ||

sanskrit_iast:
saprasādāśca te mantrāḥ svādhikārādyapekṣayā |
sarvādhikārastveko'yaṃ mantra eveśvarājñayā ||
meaning:
सप्रसादाश्च ते मन्त्राः स्वाधिकाराद्यपेक्षया |
सर्वाधिकारस्त्वेकोऽयं मन्त्र एवेश्वराज्ञया ||

sanskrit_iast:
yathā nikṛṣṭānutkṛṣṭānsarvānapyātmanaḥ śivaḥ |
kṣamate rakṣituṃ tadvanmantro'yamapi sarvadā ||
meaning:
यथा निकृष्टानुत्कृष्टान्सर्वानप्यात्मनः शिवः |
क्षमते रक्षितुं तद्वन्मन्त्रोऽयमपि सर्वदा ||
text_mt: This single mantra alone has universal authority by the command of the Lord. / Just as Śiva is able to protect all beings,

sanskrit_iast:
prabalaśca tathā hyeṣa mantro mantrāntarādapi |
sarvarakṣākṣamo'pyeṣa nāparaḥ kaścidiṣyate ||
meaning:
प्रबलश्च तथा ह्येष मन्त्रो मन्त्रान्तरादपि |
सर्वरक्षाक्षमोऽप्येष नापरः कश्चिदिष्यते ||

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmantrāntarāṃstyaktvā pañcākṣaraparo bhava |
tasmin jihvāntaragate na kiñcidiha durlabham ||
meaning:
तस्मान्मन्त्रान्तरांस्त्यक्त्वा पञ्चाक्षरपरो भव |
तस्मिन् जिह्वान्तरगते न किञ्चिदिह दुर्लभम् ||
text_mt: it is capable of all protection, and no other is acknowledged [like it]. / Therefore, abandoning other mantras, be devoted to the five-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
aghorāstraṃ ca śaivānāṃ rakṣāheturanuttamam |
tacca tatprabhavaṃ matvā tatparo bhava nānyathā ||
meaning:
अघोरास्त्रं च शैवानां रक्षाहेतुरनुत्तमम् |
तच्च तत्प्रभवं मत्वा तत्परो भव नान्यथा ||
text_mt: knowing that it originates from him, be intent on it, not otherwise. / This excellent ash was obtained by me from your father;

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmedaṃ tu mayā labdhaṃ pitureva tavottamam |
virajānalasaṃsiddhaṃ mahāvyāpannivāraṇam ||
meaning:
भस्मेदं तु मया लब्धं पितुरेव तवोत्तमम् |
विरजानलसंसिद्धं महाव्यापन्निवारणम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ ca te mayā dattaṃ gṛhāṇa madanujñayā |
anenaivāśu japtena rakṣā tava bhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
मन्त्रं च ते मया दत्तं गृहाण मदनुज्ञया |
अनेनैवाशु जप्तेन रक्षा तव भविष्यति ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
evaṃ mātrā samādiśya śivamastvityudīrya ca |
visṛṣṭastadvaco mūrdhni kurvanneva tadā muniḥ ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
एवं मात्रा समादिश्य शिवमस्त्वित्युदीर्य च |
विसृष्टस्तद्वचो मूर्ध्नि कुर्वन्नेव तदा मुनिः ||
text_mt:
By reciting this alone swiftly, your protection will come about. / Vāyu said: / Having thus instructed him and saying, "May it be auspicious!"
Dismissed, placing her word upon his head,
the sage then bowed to her, spoke thus, and set about performing austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ praṇamyaivamuktvā ca tapaḥ kartuṃ pracakrame |
tamāha ca tadā mātā śubhaṃ kurvantu te surāḥ ||
meaning:
तां प्रणम्यैवमुक्त्वा च तपः कर्तुं प्रचक्रमे |
तमाह च तदा माता शुभं कुर्वन्तु ते सुराः ||

sanskrit_iast:
anujñātastayā tatra tapastepe sa duścaram |
himavatparvataṃ prāpya vāyubhakṣaḥ samāhitaḥ ||
meaning:
अनुज्ञातस्तया तत्र तपस्तेपे स दुश्चरम् |
हिमवत्पर्वतं प्राप्य वायुभक्षः समाहितः ||
text_mt:
Having reached Mount Himavat, feeding on air, composed in mind,
making an altar with eight bricks and an earthen liṅga,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭeṣṭakābhiḥ prāsādaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ ca mṛṇmayam |
tatrāvāhya mahādevaṃ sāmbaṃ sagaṇamavyayam ||
meaning:
अष्टेष्टकाभिः प्रासादं कृत्वा लिङ्गं च मृण्मयम् |
तत्रावाह्य महादेवं साम्बं सगणमव्ययम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā pañcākṣareṇaiva putraiḥ puṣpairvanodbhavaiḥ |
samabhyarcya ciraṃ kālaṃ cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ ||
meaning:
भक्त्या पञ्चाक्षरेणैव पुत्रैः पुष्पैर्वनोद्भवैः |
समभ्यर्च्य चिरं कालं चचार परमं तपः ||
text_mt: having worshipped with devotion by means of the five-syllable [mantra] alone, with leaves and flowers born of the forest, / he practiced supreme austerity for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastapaścarattaṃ taṃ bālamekākinaṃ kṛśam |
upamanyuṃ dvijavaraṃ śivasaṃsaktamānasam ||
meaning:
ततस्तपश्चरत्तं तं बालमेकाकिनं कृशम् |
उपमन्युं द्विजवरं शिवसंसक्तमानसम् ||
text_mt: Then, as he was practicing austerity, that solitary, emaciated boy, / Upamanyu, best of the twice-born, whose mind was attached to Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
purā marīcinā śaptāḥ kecinmunipiśācakāḥ |
sampīḍya rākṣasairbhāvaistapaso vighnamācaran ||
meaning:
पुरा मरीचिना शप्ताः केचिन्मुनिपिशाचकाः |
सम्पीड्य राक्षसैर्भावैस्तपसो विघ्नमाचरन् ||
text_mt: certain sage-piśācas, cursed in the past by Marīci, / tormenting [him] with demonic dispositions, caused obstacles to his austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca taiḥ pīḍyamāno'pi tapaḥ kurvankathañcana |
sadā namaḥ śivāyeti krośati smārtanādavat ||
meaning:
स च तैः पीड्यमानोऽपि तपः कुर्वन्कथञ्चन |
सदा नमः शिवायेति क्रोशति स्मार्तनादवत् ||
text_mt: And though afflicted by them, performing austerity somehow, / he constantly cried out “Namaḥ Śivāya!” like a cry of distress.

sanskrit_iast:
tannādaśravaṇādeva tapaso vighnakāriṇaḥ |
te taṃ bālaṃ samutsṛjya munayaḥ samupācaran ||
meaning:
तन्नादश्रवणादेव तपसो विघ्नकारिणः |
ते तं बालं समुत्सृज्य मुनयः समुपाचरन् ||
text_mt: Merely upon hearing that sound, those causers of obstacle to the austerity, / those sages, having released that boy, attended upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā tasya viprasya copamanyormahātmanaḥ |
carācaraṃ ca munayaḥ pradīpitamabhūjjagat ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
तपसा तस्य विप्रस्य चोपमन्योर्महात्मनः |
चराचरं च मुनयः प्रदीपितमभूज्जगत् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
O sages, by the austerity of that twice-born, the high-souled Upamanyu, / the world, moving and unmoving, was illuminated.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
atha sarve pradīptāṅgā vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayurdrutam |
praṇamyāhuśca tatsarvaṃ haraye devasattamāḥ ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
अथ सर्वे प्रदीप्ताङ्गा वैकुण्ठं प्रययुर्द्रुतम् |
प्रणम्याहुश्च तत्सर्वं हरये देवसत्तमाः ||
title: pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | upamanyucaritavarṇanam
text_mt:
Bowing down, the best of the gods reported all that to Hari.
Hearing their words then, the blessed Puruṣottama,

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā teṣāṃ tadā vākyaṃ bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ |
kimidaṃ tviti sañcintya jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ ca saḥ ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तेषां तदा वाक्यं भगवान्पुरुषोत्तमः |
किमिदं त्विति सञ्चिन्त्य ज्ञात्वा तत्कारणं च सः ||

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma mandaraṃ tūrṇaṃ maheśvaradidṛkṣayā |
dṛṣṭvā devaṃ praṇamyaivaṃ provāca sukṛtāñjaliḥ ||
meaning:
जगाम मन्दरं तूर्णं महेश्वरदिदृक्षया |
दृष्ट्वा देवं प्रणम्यैवं प्रोवाच सुकृताञ्जलिः ||

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca |
bhagavanbrāhmaṇaḥ kaścidupamanyuriti śrutaḥ |
kṣīrārthamadahatsarvaṃ tapasā tannivāraya ||
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच |
भगवन्ब्राह्मणः कश्चिदुपमन्युरिति श्रुतः |
क्षीरार्थमदहत्सर्वं तपसा तन्निवारय ||
text_mt:
Having seen the god and bowed down, he spoke thus with folded hands.
Viṣṇu said:
"O Lord, a certain brāhmaṇa named Upamanyu is heard of.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
iti śrutvā vaco viṣṇoḥ prāha devo maheśvaraḥ |
śiśuṃ nivārayiṣyāmi tattvaṃ gaccha svamāśramam ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
इति श्रुत्वा वचो विष्णोः प्राह देवो महेश्वरः |
शिशुं निवारयिष्यामि तत्त्वं गच्छ स्वमाश्रमम् ||
text_mt:
For the sake of milk, he is burning everything through his austerity; stop him!"
Vāyu said:
Hearing this word of Viṣṇu, the god Maheśvara said:
"I will restrain the child; go back to your own hermitage."
Hearing that word of Śambhu, Viṣṇu, dear to the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā śambhuvacanaṃ sa viṣṇurdevavallabhaḥ |
jagāmāśvāsya tānsarvān svalokamamarādikān ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा शम्भुवचनं स विष्णुर्देववल्लभः |
जगामाश्वास्य तान्सर्वान् स्वलोकममरादिकान् ||

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare devaḥ pinākī parameśvaraḥ |
śakrasya rūpamāsthāya gantuṃ cakre matiṃ tataḥ ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवः पिनाकी परमेश्वरः |
शक्रस्य रूपमास्थाय गन्तुं चक्रे मतिं ततः ||
text_mt:
assuming the form of Śakra, set his mind then on going.
Then Sadāśiva went to the sage's penance grove upon an excellent white elephant,

sanskrit_iast:
atha jagāma munestu tapovanaṃ gajavareṇa sitena sadāśivaḥ |
saha surāsurasiddhamahoragai-ramararājatanuṃ svayamāsthitaḥ ||
meaning:
अथ जगाम मुनेस्तु तपोवनं गजवरेण सितेन सदाशिवः |
सह सुरासुरसिद्धमहोरगै-रमरराजतनुं स्वयमास्थितः ||
text_mt:
accompanied by gods, asuras, siddhas, and great serpents, having himself assumed the body of the king of immortals.
That elephant, fanning that all-pervading divine lord nicely with a tail-whisk,

sanskrit_iast:
sa vāraṇaścāru tadā vibhuṃ taṃ nivījya vālavyajanena divyam |
dadhāra śacyā sahitaṃ surendraṃ kareṇa vāmena sitātapatram ||
meaning:
स वारणश्चारु तदा विभुं तं निवीज्य वालव्यजनेन दिव्यम् |
दधार शच्या सहितं सुरेन्द्रं करेण वामेन सितातपत्रम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
rarāja bhagavānsomaḥ śakrarūpī sadāśivaḥ |
tenātapatreṇa yathā candrabimbena mandaraḥ ||
meaning:
रराज भगवान्सोमः शक्ररूपी सदाशिवः |
तेनातपत्रेण यथा चन्द्रबिम्बेन मन्दरः ||

sanskrit_iast:
āsthāyaivaṃ hi śakrasya svarūpaṃ parameśvaraḥ |
jagāmānugrahaṃ kartumupamanyostadāśramam ||
meaning:
आस्थायैवं हि शक्रस्य स्वरूपं परमेश्वरः |
जगामानुग्रहं कर्तुमुपमन्योस्तदाश्रमम् ||
text_mt:
with that parasol just as Mount Mandara shines with the orb of the moon.
Having thus assumed the form of Śakra, the Supreme Lord

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā parameśānaṃ śakrarūpadharaṃ śivam |
praṇamya śirasā prāha mahāmunivaraḥ svayam ||
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा परमेशानं शक्ररूपधरं शिवम् |
प्रणम्य शिरसा प्राह महामुनिवरः स्वयम् ||
text_mt:
went to Upamanyu's hermitage to bestow his grace.
Seeing that Supreme Lord, Śiva, wearing the form of Śakra,

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
pāvitaścāśramaḥ so'yaṃ mama deveśvara svayam |
prāpto yattvaṃ jagannātha bhagavandevasattama ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
पावितश्चाश्रमः सोऽयं मम देवेश्वर स्वयम् |
प्राप्तो यत्त्वं जगन्नाथ भगवन्देवसत्तम ||
text_mt:
since you have arrived, O Lord of the Universe, blessed one, best of the gods!"
Vāyu said:
Seeing the twice-born standing thus having spoken, with folded hands,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
evamuktvā sthitaṃ prekṣya kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ dvijam |
prāha gambhīrayā vācā śakrarūpadharo haraḥ ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
एवमुक्त्वा स्थितं प्रेक्ष्य कृताञ्जलिपुटं द्विजम् |
प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा शक्ररूपधरो हरः ||
text_mt: Hara, bearing the form of Śakra, spoke in a deep voice.

sanskrit_iast:
śakra uvāca |
tuṣṭo'smi te varaṃ brūhi tapasā'nena suvrata |
dadāmi cepsitānsarvān dhaumyāgraja mahāmune ||
meaning:
शक्र उवाच |
तुष्टोऽस्मि ते वरं ब्रूहि तपसाऽनेन सुव्रत |
ददामि चेप्सितान्सर्वान् धौम्याग्रज महामुने ||
text_mt:
Śakra said:
"I am pleased with you; choose a boon on account of this austerity, O you of good vows!
I grant all desired things, O Dhaumya's elder brother, great sage!"
Vāyu said:
Being addressed thus then by that Śakra, the best of sages

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
evamuktastadā tena śakreṇa munipuṅgavaḥ |
varayāmi śive bhaktimityuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन शक्रेण मुनिपुङ्गवः |
वरयामि शिवे भक्तिमित्युवाच कृताञ्जलिः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tanniśamya hariḥ prāha māṃ na jānāsi lekhapam |
trailokyādhipatiṃ śakraṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam ||
meaning:
तन्निशम्य हरिः प्राह मां न जानासि लेखपम् |
त्रैलोक्याधिपतिं शक्रं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
madbhakto bhava viprarṣe māmevārcaya sarvadā |
dadāmi sarvaṃ bhadraṃ te tyaja rudraṃ ca nirguṇam ||
meaning:
मद्भक्तो भव विप्रर्षे मामेवार्चय सर्वदा |
ददामि सर्वं भद्रं ते त्यज रुद्रं च निर्गुणम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
rudreṇa nirguṇenāpi kiṃ te kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati |
devapaṅktibahirbhūto yaḥ piśācatvamāgataḥ ||
meaning:
रुद्रेण निर्गुणेनापि किं ते कार्यं भविष्यति |
देवपङ्क्तिबहिर्भूतो यः पिशाचत्वमागतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
tacchrutvā prāha sa munirjapanpañcākṣaraṃ manum |
manyamāno dharmavighnaṃ prāha taṃ kartumāgatam ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
तच्छ्रुत्वा प्राह स मुनिर्जपन्पञ्चाक्षरं मनुम् |
मन्यमानो धर्मविघ्नं प्राह तं कर्तुमागतम् ||
text_mt:
He who is excluded from the row of the gods, who has attained the status of a piśāca?"
Vāyu said:
Hearing that, the sage, repeating the five-syllable mantra, spoke,

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
tvayaivaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bhavanindāratena vai |
prasaṅgādeva devasya nirguṇatvaṃ mahātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
त्वयैवं कथितं सर्वं भवनिन्दारतेन वै |
प्रसङ्गादेव देवस्य निर्गुणत्वं महात्मनः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ na jānāmi vai rudraṃ sarvadeveśvareśvaram |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ janakaṃ prakṛteḥ param ||
meaning:
त्वं न जानामि वै रुद्रं सर्वदेवेश्वरेश्वरम् |
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां जनकं प्रकृतेः परम् ||
text_mt:
Only incidentally is the attributelessness of the great-souled god [mentioned].
Indeed, you do not know Rudra, the lord of the lords of all the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
sadasadvyaktamavyaktaṃ yamāhurbrahmavādinaḥ |
nityamekamanekaṃ ca varaṃ tasmād vṛṇomyaham ||
meaning:
सदसद्व्यक्तमव्यक्तं यमाहुर्ब्रह्मवादिनः |
नित्यमेकमनेकं च वरं तस्माद् वृणोम्यहम् ||
text_mt:
the progenitor of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśāna, beyond material nature,
whom the proclaimers of Brahman call being, non-being, manifest, and unmanifest,

sanskrit_iast:
hetuvādavinirmuktaṃ sāṅkhyayogārthadaṃ param |
upāsate yaṃ tattvajñā varaṃ tasmād vṛṇomyaham ||
meaning:
हेतुवादविनिर्मुक्तं साङ्ख्ययोगार्थदं परम् |
उपासते यं तत्त्वज्ञा वरं तस्माद् वृणोम्यहम् ||
text_mt:
whom the knowers of reality worship; from him I choose a boon!
There is no reality higher than Śambhu, who is the cause of all causes,

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti śambhoḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇāt |
brahmaviṣṇvādidevānāṃ sraṣṭurguṇaparādvibhoḥ ||
meaning:
नास्ति शम्भोः परं तत्त्वं सर्वकारणकारणात् |
ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादिदेवानां स्रष्टुर्गुणपराद्विभोः ||
text_mt:
the creator of the gods beginning with Brahmā and Viṣṇu, the all-pervading lord beyond the guṇas.
What is the use of saying much here? A great thing has been inferred by me today:

sanskrit_iast:
bahunātra kimuktena mayādyānumitaṃ mahat |
bhavāntare kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śrutā nindā bhavasya cet ||
meaning:
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन मयाद्यानुमितं महत् |
भवान्तरे कृतं पापं श्रुता निन्दा भवस्य चेत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā nindāṃ bhavasyātha tatkṣaṇādeva santyajet |
svadehaṃ tannihatyāśu śivalokaṃ sa gacchati ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वा निन्दां भवस्याथ तत्क्षणादेव सन्त्यजेत् |
स्वदेहं तन्निहत्याशु शिवलोकं स गच्छति ||

sanskrit_iast:
āstāṃ tāvanmameccheyaṃ kṣīraṃ prati surādhama |
nihatya tvāṃ śivāstreṇa tyajāmyetaṃ kalevaram ||
meaning:
आस्तां तावन्ममेच्छेयं क्षीरं प्रति सुराधम |
निहत्य त्वां शिवास्त्रेण त्यजाम्येतं कलेवरम् ||
text_mt:
Having slain you with the missile of Śiva, I will cast off this body."
Vāyu said:
Having spoken thus, Upamanyu, resolved himself to die,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
evamuktvopamanyustaṃ martuṃ vyavasitaḥ svayam |
kṣīre vāñchāmapi tyaktvā nihantuṃ śakramudyataḥ ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
एवमुक्त्वोपमन्युस्तं मर्तुं व्यवसितः स्वयम् |
क्षीरे वाञ्छामपि त्यक्त्वा निहन्तुं शक्रमुद्यतः ||
text_mt:
giving up even the longing for milk, undertook to slay Śakra.
Taking ash then, consecrated with the Aghorāstra,

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmādāya tadā ghoramaghorāstrābhimantritam |
visṛjya śakramuddiśya nanāda sa munistadā ||
meaning:
भस्मादाय तदा घोरमघोरास्त्राभिमन्त्रितम् |
विसृज्य शक्रमुद्दिश्य ननाद स मुनिस्तदा ||

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtvā śambhupadadvandvaṃ svadehaṃ dugdhumudyataḥ |
āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ bibhradupamanyuravasthitaḥ ||
meaning:
स्मृत्वा शम्भुपदद्वन्द्वं स्वदेहं दुग्धुमुद्यतः |
आग्नेयीं धारणां बिभ्रदुपमन्युरवस्थितः ||

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vyavasite vipre bhagavān bhaganetrahā |
vārayāmāsa saumyena dhāraṇāṃ tasya yoginaḥ ||
meaning:
एवं व्यवसिते विप्रे भगवान् भगनेत्रहा |
वारयामास सौम्येन धारणां तस्य योगिनः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tadvisṛṣṭamaghorāstraṃ nandīśvaraniyogataḥ |
jagṛhe madhyataḥ kṣiptaṃ nandī śaṅkaravallabhaḥ ||
meaning:
तद्विसृष्टमघोरास्त्रं नन्दीश्वरनियोगतः |
जगृहे मध्यतः क्षिप्तं नन्दी शङ्करवल्लभः ||

sanskrit_iast:
svaṃ rūpameva bhagavānāsthāya parameśvaraḥ |
darśayāmāsa śiprāya bālendukṛtaśekharam ||
meaning:
स्वं रूपमेव भगवानास्थाय परमेश्वरः |
दर्शयामास शिप्राय बालेन्दुकृतशेखरम् ||
text_mt: Assuming his own form, the blessed Parameśvara / showed himself to the child with the crescent moon adorning his crest,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrārṇavasahasraṃ ca pīyūṣārṇavameva vā |
dadhyāderarṇavāṃścaiva ghṛtodārṇavameva ca ||
meaning:
क्षीरार्णवसहस्रं च पीयूषार्णवमेव वा |
दध्यादेरर्णवांश्चैव घृतोदार्णवमेव च ||
text_mt: and [showed] a thousand oceans of milk, or rather an ocean of nectar, / oceans of curd and the like, and an ocean of clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
phalārṇavaṃ ca bālasya bhakṣyabhojyārṇavaṃ tathā |
apūpānāṃ giriṃ caiva darśayāmāsa sa prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
फलार्णवं च बालस्य भक्ष्यभोज्यार्णवं तथा |
अपूपानां गिरिं चैव दर्शयामास स प्रभुः ||
text_mt: and an ocean of fruits, and likewise an ocean of eatables and foods, / and a mountain of cakes—the Lord showed [all this] to the boy.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa dadṛśe devo devyā sārddhaṃ vṛṣopari |
gaṇeśvaraistriśūlādyairdivyāstrairapi saṃvṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
एवं स ददृशे देवो देव्या सार्द्धं वृषोपरि |
गणेश्वरैस्त्रिशूलाद्यैर्दिव्यास्त्रैरपि संवृतः ||
text_mt: Thus the god was seen together with the goddess upon the bull, / surrounded by the lords of the attendants, and by divine missiles such as the trident.

sanskrit_iast:
divi dundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca |
viṣṇubrahmendrapramukhairdevaiśchannā diśo daśa ||
meaning:
दिवि दुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात च |
विष्णुब्रह्मेन्द्रप्रमुखैर्देवैश्छन्ना दिशो दश ||
text_mt: In heaven kettledrums sounded, and a shower of flowers fell; / the ten directions were filled with gods headed by Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
athopamanyurānandasamudrormibhirāvṛtaḥ |
papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau bhaktinamreṇa cetasā ||
meaning:
अथोपमन्युरानन्दसमुद्रोर्मिभिरावृतः |
पपात दण्डवद्भूमौ भक्तिनम्रेण चेतसा ||
text_mt: Then Upamanyu, overwhelmed by waves of the ocean of bliss, / fell like a staff upon the earth with a mind bowed in devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminsamaye tatra sasmito bhagavānbhavaḥ |
ehyehīti tamāhūya mūrdhnyāghrāya dadau varān ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्समये तत्र सस्मितो भगवान्भवः |
एह्येहीति तमाहूय मूर्ध्न्याघ्राय ददौ वरान् ||
text_mt: At that moment, the blessed Bhava, smiling, / called him, saying 'Come, come!', smelled him on the head, and granted boons:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca |
bhakṣyabhojyānyathākāmaṃ bāndhavairbhuṅkṣva sarvadā |
sukhī bhava sadā duḥkhānnirmukto bhaktimānmama ||
meaning:
शिव उवाच |
भक्ष्यभोज्यान्यथाकामं बान्धवैर्भुङ्क्ष्व सर्वदा |
सुखी भव सदा दुःखान्निर्मुक्तो भक्तिमान्मम ||
text_mt:
Śiva said:
“Eat always at your pleasure eatables and foods with your kinsmen!

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyo mahābhāga tavāmbaiṣā hi pārvatī |
mayā putrīkṛto hyadya dattaḥ kṣīrodakārṇavaḥ ||
meaning:
उपमन्यो महाभाग तवाम्बैषा हि पार्वती |
मया पुत्रीकृतो ह्यद्य दत्तः क्षीरोदकार्णवः ||
text_mt:
Today indeed you have been made my son; the ocean of milk has been granted to you,
as well as an ocean of honey, and an ocean of curd-rice,

sanskrit_iast:
madhunaścārṇavaścaiva dadhyannārṇava eva ca |
ājyaudanārṇavaścaiva phalādyarṇava eva ca ||
meaning:
मधुनश्चार्णवश्चैव दध्यन्नार्णव एव च |
आज्यौदनार्णवश्चैव फलाद्यर्णव एव च ||

sanskrit_iast:
apūpagirayaścaiva bhakṣyabhojyārṇavastathā |
ete dattā mayā te hi tvaṃ gṛhṇīṣva mahāmune ||
meaning:
अपूपगिरयश्चैव भक्ष्यभोज्यार्णवस्तथा |
एते दत्ता मया ते हि त्वं गृह्णीष्व महामुने ||
text_mt:
an ocean of ghee-rice, and an ocean of fruits and other things,
and mountains of cakes, and an ocean of eatables and foods.

sanskrit_iast:
pitā tava mahādevo mātā vai jagadambikā |
amaratvaṃ mayā dattaṃ gāṇapatyaṃ ca śāśvatam ||
meaning:
पिता तव महादेवो माता वै जगदम्बिका |
अमरत्वं मया दत्तं गाणपत्यं च शाश्वतम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
varānvaraya suprītyā mano'bhilaṣitānparān |
prasanno'haṃ pradāsyāmi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
meaning:
वरान्वरय सुप्रीत्या मनोऽभिलषितान्परान् |
प्रसन्नोऽहं प्रदास्यामि नात्र कार्या विचारणा ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
evamuktvā mahādevaḥ karābhyāmupagṛhya tam |
mūrdhnyāghrāya sutaste'yamiti devyai nyavedayat ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
एवमुक्त्वा महादेवः कराभ्यामुपगृह्य तम् |
मूर्ध्न्याघ्राय सुतस्तेऽयमिति देव्यै न्यवेदयत् ||
text_mt:
Being pleased, I shall grant them; there need be no hesitation here.”
Vāyu said:
Having spoken thus, Mahādeva, raising him up with both hands,

sanskrit_iast:
devī ca guhavatprītyā mūrdhni tasya karāmbujam |
vinyasya pradadau tasmai kumārapadamavyayam ||
meaning:
देवी च गुहवत्प्रीत्या मूर्ध्नि तस्य कराम्बुजम् |
विन्यस्य प्रददौ तस्मै कुमारपदमव्ययम् ||
text_mt:
and smelling his head, presented him to the goddess, saying, “This is your son.”
And the goddess, with affection as toward Guha, placing her lotus-hand upon his head,
bestowed upon him the imperishable station of Kumāra.
The ocean of milk also, taking embodied form and holding delicious milk in its hand,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrābdhirapi sākāraḥ kṣīraṃ svādu kare dadhat |
upasthāya dadau piṇḍībhūtaṃ kṣīramanaśvaram ||
meaning:
क्षीराब्धिरपि साकारः क्षीरं स्वादु करे दधत् |
उपस्थाय ददौ पिण्डीभूतं क्षीरमनश्वरम् ||
text_mt:
approached and gave him imperishable, congealed milk.
The mastery of yoga, perpetual contentment, the imperishable knowledge of brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
yogaiśvaryaṃ sadā tuṣṭiṃ brahmavidyāmanaśvarām |
samṛddhiṃ paramāṃ tasmai dadau santuṣṭamānasaḥ ||
meaning:
योगैश्वर्यं सदा तुष्टिं ब्रह्मविद्यामनश्वराम् |
समृद्धिं परमां तस्मै ददौ सन्तुष्टमानसः ||

sanskrit_iast:
atha śambhuḥ prasannātmā dṛṣṭvā tasya tapo mahaḥ |
punardadau varaṃ divyaṃ munaye hyupamanyave ||
meaning:
अथ शम्भुः प्रसन्नात्मा दृष्ट्वा तस्य तपो महः |
पुनर्ददौ वरं दिव्यं मुनये ह्युपमन्यवे ||
text_mt:
and supreme prosperity, she gave to him, her heart fully satisfied.
Then Śambhu, pleased in spirit, beholding the glory of his austerity,

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ jñānaṃ vratayogaṃ ca tattvataḥ |
dadau tasmai pravaktṛtvapāṭavaṃ suciraṃ param ||
meaning:
व्रतं पाशुपतं ज्ञानं व्रतयोगं च तत्त्वतः |
ददौ तस्मै प्रवक्तृत्वपाटवं सुचिरं परम् ||
text_mt:
and he gave him supreme eloquence for a very long time.
He too, having obtained divine boons and perpetual status as Kumāra

sanskrit_iast:
so'pi labdhvā varāndivyān kumāratvaṃ ca sarvadā |
tasmācchivācca tasyāśca śivāyā mudito'bhavat ||
meaning:
सोऽपि लब्ध्वा वरान्दिव्यान् कुमारत्वं च सर्वदा |
तस्माच्छिवाच्च तस्याश्च शिवाया मुदितोऽभवत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prasannacetaskaḥ supraṇamya kṛtāñjaliḥ |
yayāce sa varaṃ vipro devadevānmaheśvarāt ||
meaning:
ततः प्रसन्नचेतस्कः सुप्रणम्य कृताञ्जलिः |
ययाचे स वरं विप्रो देवदेवान्महेश्वरात् ||

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
prasīda devadeveśa prasīda parameśvara |
svabhaktiṃ dehi paramāṃ divyāmavyabhicāriṇīm ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
प्रसीद देवदेवेश प्रसीद परमेश्वर |
स्वभक्तिं देहि परमां दिव्यामव्यभिचारिणीम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhāṃ dehi mahādeva svasambandhiṣu me sadā |
svadāsyaṃ paramaṃ snehaṃ sānnidhyaṃ caiva sarvadā ||
meaning:
श्रद्धां देहि महादेव स्वसम्बन्धिषु मे सदा |
स्वदास्यं परमं स्नेहं सान्निध्यं चैव सर्वदा ||
text_mt:
Grant me, O Mahādeva, constant faith toward those related to you,
supreme servitude to you, affection, and your perpetual presence."

sanskrit_iast:
muktvā prasannātmā harṣagadgadayā girā |
sa tuṣṭāva mahādevamupamanyurdvijottamaḥ ||
meaning:
मुक्त्वा प्रसन्नात्मा हर्षगद्गदया गिरा |
स तुष्टाव महादेवमुपमन्युर्द्विजोत्तमः ||
text_mt:
Having spoken with a serene heart in a voice choked with joy,
that Upamanyu, best of the twice-born, praised Mahādeva:

sanskrit_iast:
devadeva mahādeva śaraṇāgatavatsala |
prasīda karuṇāsindho sāmba śaṅkara sarvadā ||
meaning:
देवदेव महादेव शरणागतवत्सल |
प्रसीद करुणासिन्धो साम्ब शङ्कर सर्वदा ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
evamukto mahādevaḥ sarveṣāṃ ca varapradaḥ |
pratyuvāca prasannātmopamanyuṃ munisattamam ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
एवमुक्तो महादेवः सर्वेषां च वरप्रदः |
प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मोपमन्युं मुनिसत्तमम् ||
text_mt:
Be gracious, O ocean of compassion, O Śaṅkara with Ambā, always!”
Vāyu said:
Addressed thus, Mahādeva, the bestower of boons to all,
pleased in spirit, replied to Upamanyu, the best of sages.
Śiva said:
“Child Upamanyu, I am pleased; everything has indeed been granted to you by me.

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca |
vatsopamanyo tuṣṭo'smi sarvaṃ dattaṃ mayā hi te |
dṛḍhabhakto'si viprarṣe mayā vijñāsito hyasi ||
meaning:
शिव उवाच |
वत्सोपमन्यो तुष्टोऽस्मि सर्वं दत्तं मया हि ते |
दृढभक्तोऽसि विप्रर्षे मया विज्ञासितो ह्यसि ||

sanskrit_iast:
ajaraścāmaraścaiva bhava tvaṃ duḥkhavarjitaḥ |
yaśasvī tejasā yukto divyajñānasamanvitaḥ ||
meaning:
अजरश्चामरश्चैव भव त्वं दुःखवर्जितः |
यशस्वी तेजसा युक्तो दिव्यज्ञानसमन्वितः ||

sanskrit_iast:
akṣayā bāndhavāścaiva kulaṃ gotraṃ ca te sadā |
bhaviṣyati dvijaśreṣṭha mayi bhaktiśca śāśvatī ||
meaning:
अक्षया बान्धवाश्चैव कुलं गोत्रं च ते सदा |
भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ मयि भक्तिश्च शाश्वती ||

sanskrit_iast:
sānnidhyaṃ cāśrame nityaṃ kariṣyāmi dvijottama |
upakaṇṭhaṃ mama tvaṃ vai sānandaṃ vihariṣyasi ||
meaning:
सान्निध्यं चाश्रमे नित्यं करिष्यामि द्विजोत्तम |
उपकण्ठं मम त्वं वै सानन्दं विहरिष्यसि ||
text_mt:
O best of the twice-born, and your devotion to me shall be eternal.
And I shall constantly maintain my presence in your hermitage, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā sa bhagavān sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ |
īśānaḥ sa varāndattvā tatraivāntardadhe haraḥ ||
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः |
ईशानः स वरान्दत्त्वा तत्रैवान्तर्दधे हरः ||

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuḥ prasannātmā prāpya tasmādvarādvarān |
jagāma jananīsthānaṃ sukhaṃ prāpādhikaṃ ca saḥ ||
samāpto'yaṃ saptamyā vāyavīyasaṃhitāyāḥ pūrvakhaṇḍaḥ ||
śrīḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
atha saptamyāṃ vāyavīyasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍaḥ prārabhyate |
meaning:
उपमन्युः प्रसन्नात्मा प्राप्य तस्माद्वराद्वरान् |
जगाम जननीस्थानं सुखं प्रापाधिकं च सः ||
समाप्तोऽयं सप्तम्या वायवीयसंहितायाः पूर्वखण्डः ||
श्रीः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
अथ सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डः प्रारभ्यते |
text_mt:
Īśāna, Hara, having granted those boons, vanished right there.
Upamanyu, pleased in spirit, having obtained the finest of boons from him,
went to his mother's abode and attained abundant happiness.

Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter, named 'The Description of Upamanyu's Deeds', in the first section of the Vāyavīyasaṃhitā, the seventh [saṃhitā] within the venerable Śivamahāpurāṇa composed by Vyāsa, consisting of twenty-four thousand verses.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namaḥ samasta saṃsāracakrabhramaṇahetave |
gaurīkucataṭadvandvakuṅkumāṅkitavakṣase ||
meaning:
ओं नमः समस्त संसारचक्रभ्रमणहेतवे |
गौरीकुचतटद्वन्द्वकुङ्कुमाङ्कितवक्षसे ||
title: prathamo'dhyāyaḥ | kṛṣṇaputraprāptivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
uktvā bhagavato labdhaṃ prasādādupamanyunā |
niyamādutthito vāyurmadhye prāpte divākare ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
उक्त्वा भगवतो लब्धं प्रसादादुपमन्युना |
नियमादुत्थितो वायुर्मध्ये प्राप्ते दिवाकरे ||

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayaścāpi te sarve naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ |
athāyamarthaḥ praṣṭavya iti kṛtvā viniścayam ||
meaning:
ऋषयश्चापि ते सर्वे नैमिषारण्यवासिनः |
अथायमर्थः प्रष्टव्य इति कृत्वा विनिश्चयम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā yathā svakaṃ kṛtyaṃ pratyahaṃ te yathā purā |
bhagavantamupāyāntaṃ samīkṣya samupāviśan ||
meaning:
कृत्वा यथा स्वकं कृत्यं प्रत्यहं ते यथा पुरा |
भगवन्तमुपायान्तं समीक्ष्य समुपाविशन् ||

sanskrit_iast:
athāsau niyamasyānte bhagavānambarodbhavaḥ |
madhye munisabhāyāstu bheje kḷptaṃ varāsanam ||
meaning:
अथासौ नियमस्यान्ते भगवानम्बरोद्भवः |
मध्ये मुनिसभायास्तु भेजे कॢप्तं वरासनम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
sukhāsanopaviṣṭaśca vāyurlokanamaskṛtaḥ |
śrīmadvibhūtimīśasya hṛdi kṛtvedamabravīt ||
meaning:
सुखासनोपविष्टश्च वायुर्लोकनमस्कृतः |
श्रीमद्विभूतिमीशस्य हृदि कृत्वेदमब्रवीत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ prapadye mahādevaṃ sarvajñamaparājitam |
vibhūtiḥ sakalaṃ yasya carācaramidaṃ jagat ||
meaning:
तं प्रपद्ये महादेवं सर्वज्ञमपराजितम् |
विभूतिः सकलं यस्य चराचरमिदं जगत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
ityākarṇya śubhāṃ vāṇīṃ ṛṣayaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ |
vibhūtivistaraṃ śrotumūcuste paramaṃ vacaḥ ||
meaning:
इत्याकर्ण्य शुभां वाणीं ऋषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः |
विभूतिविस्तरं श्रोतुमूचुस्ते परमं वचः ||

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
uktaṃ bhagavatā vṛttamupamanyormahātmanaḥ |
kṣīrārthenāpi tapasā yatprāptaṃ parameśvarāt ||
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः |
उक्तं भगवता वृत्तमुपमन्योर्महात्मनः |
क्षीरार्थेनापि तपसा यत्प्राप्तं परमेश्वरात् ||

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭo'sau vāsudevena kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā |
dhaumyāgrajastatastena kṛtvā pāśupataṃ vratam ||
meaning:
दृष्टोऽसौ वासुदेवेन कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा |
धौम्याग्रजस्ततस्तेन कृत्वा पाशुपतं व्रतम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
prāptaṃ ca paramaṃ jñānamiti prāgeva śuśruma |
kathaṃ sa labdhavān kṛṣṇo jñānaṃ pāśupataṃ param ||
meaning:
प्राप्तं च परमं ज्ञानमिति प्रागेव शुश्रुम |
कथं स लब्धवान् कृष्णो ज्ञानं पाशुपतं परम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
svecchayā hyavatīrṇo'pi vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ |
nindayanniva mānuṣyaṃ dehaśuddhiṃ cakāra saḥ ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
स्वेच्छया ह्यवतीर्णोऽपि वासुदेवः सनातनः |
निन्दयन्निव मानुष्यं देहशुद्धिं चकार सः ||

sanskrit_iast:
putrārthaṃ hi tapastaptuṃ gatastasya mahāmuneḥ |
āśramaṃ munibhirdṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭavāṃstatra vai munim ||
meaning:
पुत्रार्थं हि तपस्तप्तुं गतस्तस्य महामुनेः |
आश्रमं मुनिभिर्दृष्टं दृष्टवांस्तत्र वै मुनिम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmāvadātaṃ sarvāṅgaṃ tripuṇḍrāṅkitamastakam |
rudrākṣamālābharaṇaṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam ||
meaning:
भस्मावदातं सर्वाङ्गं त्रिपुण्ड्राङ्कितमस्तकम् |
रुद्राक्षमालाभरणं जटामण्डलमण्डितम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tacchiṣyabhūtairmunibhiḥ śāstrairvedamivāvṛtam |
śivadhyānarataṃ śāntamupamanyuṃ mahādyutim ||
meaning:
तच्छिष्यभूतैर्मुनिभिः शास्त्रैर्वेदमिवावृतम् |
शिवध्यानरतं शान्तमुपमन्युं महाद्युतिम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
namaścakāra taṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭasarvatanūruhaḥ |
bahumānena kṛṣṇo'sau triḥ kṛtvā tu pradakṣiṇām |
stutiṃ cakāra suprītyā nataskandhaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
meaning:
नमश्चकार तं दृष्ट्वा हृष्टसर्वतनूरुहः |
बहुमानेन कृष्णोऽसौ त्रिः कृत्वा तु प्रदक्षिणाम् |
स्तुतिं चकार सुप्रीत्या नतस्कन्धः कृताञ्जलिः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāvalokanādeva muneḥ kṛṣṇasya dhīmataḥ |
naṣṭamāsīnmalaṃ sarvaṃ māyājaṃ kārmameva ca ||
meaning:
तस्यावलोकनादेव मुनेः कृष्णस्य धीमतः |
नष्टमासीन्मलं सर्वं मायाजं कार्ममेव च ||

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṣīṇamalaṃ kṛṣṇamupamanyuryathāvidhi |
bhasmanoddhūlya taṃ mantrairagnirityādibhiḥ kramāt ||
meaning:
ततः क्षीणमलं कृष्णमुपमन्युर्यथाविधि |
भस्मनोद्धूल्य तं मन्त्रैरग्निरित्यादिभिः क्रमात् ||

sanskrit_iast:
atha pāśupataṃ sākṣād vrataṃ dvādaśamāsikam |
kārayitvā munistasmai pradadau jñānamuttamam ||
meaning:
अथ पाशुपतं साक्षाद् व्रतं द्वादशमासिकम् |
कारयित्वा मुनिस्तस्मै प्रददौ ज्ञानमुत्तमम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tadāprabhṛti taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ munayaśśaṃsitavratāḥ |
divyāḥ pāśupatāḥ sarve parivṛtyopatasthire ||
meaning:
तदाप्रभृति तं कृष्णं मुनयश्शंसितव्रताः |
दिव्याः पाशुपताः सर्वे परिवृत्योपतस्थिरे ||

sanskrit_iast:
tato guruniyogād vai kṛṣṇaḥ paramaśaktimān |
tapaścakāra putrārthaṃ sāmbamuddiśya śaṅkaram ||
meaning:
ततो गुरुनियोगाद् वै कृष्णः परमशक्तिमान् |
तपश्चकार पुत्रार्थं साम्बमुद्दिश्य शङ्करम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tapaso tena varṣānte dṛṣṭo'sau parameśvaraḥ |
śriyā paramayā yuktaḥ sāmbaśca sagaṇaḥ śivaḥ ||
meaning:
तपसो तेन वर्षान्ते दृष्टोऽसौ परमेश्वरः |
श्रिया परमया युक्तः साम्बश्च सगणः शिवः ||

sanskrit_iast:
varārthamāvirbhūtasya harasya subhagākṛteḥ |
stutiṃ cakāra natvā'sau kṛṣṇaḥ samyak kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
meaning:
वरार्थमाविर्भूतस्य हरस्य सुभगाकृतेः |
स्तुतिं चकार नत्वाऽसौ कृष्णः सम्यक् कृताञ्जलिः ||

sanskrit_iast:
sāmbena sagaṇenāpi labdhavān yutramātmanaḥ |
tapasā tuṣṭacittena dattaṃ viṣṇoḥ śivena vai ||
meaning:
साम्बेन सगणेनापि लब्धवान् युत्रमात्मनः |
तपसा तुष्टचित्तेन दत्तं विष्णोः शिवेन वै ||

sanskrit_iast:
yasmātsāmbo mahādevaḥ pradadau putramātmanaḥ |
tasmājjāmbavatīsūnuṃ sāmbaṃ cakre sa nāmataḥ ||
meaning:
यस्मात्साम्बो महादेवः प्रददौ पुत्रमात्मनः |
तस्माज्जाम्बवतीसूनुं साम्बं चक्रे स नामतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tadetatkathitaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇasyāmitakarmaṇaḥ |
maharṣerjñānalābhaśca putralābhaśca śaṅkarāt ||
meaning:
तदेतत्कथितं सर्वं कृष्णस्यामितकर्मणः |
महर्षेर्ज्ञानलाभश्च पुत्रलाभश्च शङ्करात् ||

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ kīrtayennityaṃ śṛṇuyācchrāvayettathā |
sa viṣṇorjñānamāsādya tenaiva saha modate ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
meaning:
य इदं कीर्तयेन्नित्यं शृणुयाच्छ्रावयेत्तथा |
स विष्णोर्ज्ञानमासाद्य तेनैव सह मोदते ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
text_mt: Obeisance to venerable Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
kiṃ tatpāśupataṃ jñānaṃ kathaṃ paśupatiḥ śivaḥ |
kathaṃ dhaumyāgrajaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā ||
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः |
किं तत्पाशुपतं ज्ञानं कथं पशुपतिः शिवः |
कथं धौम्याग्रजः पृष्टः कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ||
title: dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ | śivamāhātmyavarṇanam
text_mt: and then Dhaumya's elder brother, having performed the Pāśupata observance through him, / obtained supreme knowledge—thus we have heard before.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva vāyo śaṅkaravigraha |
tvatsamo na hi vaktāsti trailokyeṣvaparaḥ prabhuḥ ||
meaning:
एतत्सर्वं समाचक्ष्व वायो शङ्करविग्रह |
त्वत्समो न हि वक्तास्ति त्रैलोक्येष्वपरः प्रभुः ||

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca |
ityākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ prabhañjanaḥ |
saṃsmṛtya śivamīśānaṃ pravaktumupacakrame ||
meaning:
सूत उवाच |
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तेषां महर्षीणां प्रभञ्जनः |
संस्मृत्य शिवमीशानं प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमे ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca |
purā sākṣāt maheśena śrīkaṇṭhākhyena mandare |
devyai devena kathitaṃ jñānaṃ pāśupataṃ param ||
meaning:
वायुरुवाच |
पुरा साक्षात् महेशेन श्रीकण्ठाख्येन मन्दरे |
देव्यै देवेन कथितं ज्ञानं पाशुपतं परम् ||
text_mt: the supreme Pāśupata knowledge was related by the god to the goddess. / That very knowledge was asked about by Kṛṣṇa Viṣṇu, the source of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva pṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇena viṣṇunā viśvayoninā |
paśutvaṃ ca surādīnāṃ patitvaṃ ca śivasya ca ||
meaning:
तदेव पृष्टं कृष्णेन विष्णुना विश्वयोनिना |
पशुत्वं च सुरादीनां पतित्वं च शिवस्य च ||

sanskrit_iast:
yathopadiṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇāya muninā hyupamanyunā |
tathā samāsato vakṣye tacchṛṇudhvamatandritāḥ ||
meaning:
यथोपदिष्टं कृष्णाय मुनिना ह्युपमन्युना |
तथा समासतो वक्ष्ये तच्छृणुध्वमतन्द्रिताः ||

sanskrit_iast:
puropamanyumāsīnaṃ viṣṇuḥkṛṣṇavapurdharaḥ |
praṇipatya yathānyāyamidaṃ vacanamabravīt ||
meaning:
पुरोपमन्युमासीनं विष्णुःकृष्णवपुर्धरः |
प्रणिपत्य यथान्यायमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: so I shall speak in brief; listen to it without sloth! / Formerly, when Upamanyu was seated, Viṣṇu, bearing the form of Kṛṣṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
bhagavañchrotumicchāmi devyai devena bhāṣitam |
divyaṃ pāśupataṃ jñānaṃ vibhūtiṃ vāsya kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच |
भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि देव्यै देवेन भाषितम् |
दिव्यं पाशुपतं ज्ञानं विभूतिं वास्य कृत्स्नशः ||
text_mt:
bowed down according to proper manner and spoke this word.” / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “O blessed lord, I desire to hear what was spoken by the god to the goddess:
the divine Pāśupata knowledge, and his cosmic manifestation in its entirety. / How is the god the Lord of Bound Creatures? Who are declared to be the bound creatures?

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ paśupatirdevaḥ paśavaḥ ke prakīrtitāḥ |
kaiḥ pāśaiste nibadhyante vimucyante ca te katham ||
meaning:
कथं पशुपतिर्देवः पशवः के प्रकीर्तिताः |
कैः पाशैस्ते निबध्यन्ते विमुच्यन्ते च ते कथम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
iti sañcoditaḥ śrīmānupamanyurmahātmanā |
praṇamya devaṃ devīṃ ca prāha puṣṭo yathā tathā ||
meaning:
इति सञ्चोदितः श्रीमानुपमन्युर्महात्मना |
प्रणम्य देवं देवीं च प्राह पुष्टो यथा तथा ||
text_mt:
Thus urged by the great soul, the glorious Upamanyu,
having bowed to the God and the Goddess, spoke as he was asked, in this manner:

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
brahmādyāḥ sthāvarāntāśca devadevasya śūlinaḥ |
paśavaḥ parikīrtyante saṃsāravaśavartinaḥ ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
ब्रह्माद्याः स्थावरान्ताश्च देवदेवस्य शूलिनः |
पशवः परिकीर्त्यन्ते संसारवशवर्तिनः ||

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ patitvāddeveśaḥ śivaḥ paśupatiḥ smṛtaḥ |
malamāyādibhiḥ pāśaiḥ sa badhnāti paśūn patiḥ ||
meaning:
तेषां पतित्वाद्देवेशः शिवः पशुपतिः स्मृतः |
मलमायादिभिः पाशैः स बध्नाति पशून् पतिः ||
text_mt:
they are proclaimed as bound creatures subject to transmigration. / Because of his lordship over them, Śiva, the Lord of Gods, is commemorated as the Lord of Bound Creatures.
The Lord binds the creatures with the bonds of defilement, māyā, and the rest; / he alone is their liberator when properly worshipped with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva mocakasteṣāṃ bhaktyā samyagupāsitaḥ |
caturviṃśatitattvāni māyākarmaguṇā amī ||
meaning:
स एव मोचकस्तेषां भक्त्या सम्यगुपासितः |
चतुर्विंशतितत्त्वानि मायाकर्मगुणा अमी ||

sanskrit_iast:
viṣayā iti kathyante pāśā jīvanibandhanāḥ |
brahmādistambaparyantān paśūn baddhvā maheśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
विषया इति कथ्यन्ते पाशा जीवनिबन्धनाः |
ब्रह्मादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तान् पशून् बद्ध्वा महेश्वरः ||

sanskrit_iast:
pāśairetaiḥ patirdevaḥ kāryaṃ kārayati svakam |
tasyājñayā maheśasya prakṛtiḥ puruṣocitām ||
meaning:
पाशैरेतैः पतिर्देवः कार्यं कारयति स्वकम् |
तस्याज्ञया महेशस्य प्रकृतिः पुरुषोचिताम् ||
text_mt:
the God, the Lord, effects his own work through these fetters.
By the command of that Maheśa, primordial matter,

sanskrit_iast:
buddhiṃ prasūte sā buddhirahaṅkāramahaṅkṛtiḥ |
indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca tanmātrāpañcakaṃ tathā ||
meaning:
बुद्धिं प्रसूते सा बुद्धिरहङ्कारमहङ्कृतिः |
इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च तन्मात्रापञ्चकं तथा ||
text_mt:
suited to the conscious subject, brings forth intellect; that intellect brings forth ego; ego [brings forth]
the eleven faculties and the five subtle elements.

sanskrit_iast:
śāsanāddevadevasya śivasya śivadāyinaḥ |
tanmātrāṇyapi tasyaiva śāsanena mahīyasā ||
meaning:
शासनाद्देवदेवस्य शिवस्य शिवदायिनः |
तन्मात्राण्यपि तस्यैव शासनेन महीयसा ||
text_mt:
By the command of the God of gods, Śiva, the giver of auspiciousness,
the subtle elements, also by his supreme command,

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhūtānyaśeṣāṇi bhāvayantyanupūrvaśaḥ |
brahmādīnāṃ tṛṇāntānāṃ dehināṃ dehasaṅgatim ||
meaning:
महाभूतान्यशेषाणि भावयन्त्यनुपूर्वशः |
ब्रह्मादीनां तृणान्तानां देहिनां देहसङ्गतिम् ||
text_mt:
bring forth all the gross elements in succession.
For the embodied beings from Brahmā down to a blade of grass,

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhūtānyaśeṣāṇi janayanti śivājñayā |
adhyavasyati vai buddhirahaṅkārobhimanyate ||
meaning:
महाभूतान्यशेषाणि जनयन्ति शिवाज्ञया |
अध्यवस्यति वै बुद्धिरहङ्कारोभिमन्यते ||
text_mt:
all the gross elements produce the association with a body by Śiva's command.
The intellect determines; the ego identifies;

sanskrit_iast:
cittaṃ cetayate cāpi manaḥ saṅkalpayatyapi |
śrotrādīni ca gṛhṇanti śabdādīnviṣayān pṛthak ||
meaning:
चित्तं चेतयते चापि मनः सङ्कल्पयत्यपि |
श्रोत्रादीनि च गृह्णन्ति शब्दादीन्विषयान् पृथक् ||
text_mt:
thought conceives, and mind deliberates;
and hearing and the others apprehend sound and the other distinct sense objects,

sanskrit_iast:
svāneva nānyān devasya divyenājñābalena vai |
vāgādīnyapi yānyāsaṃstāni karmendriyāṇi ca ||
meaning:
स्वानेव नान्यान् देवस्य दिव्येनाज्ञाबलेन वै |
वागादीन्यपि यान्यासंस्तानि कर्मेन्द्रियाणि च ||
text_mt:
their own and not others, indeed by the divine power of the God's command.
Those which are the faculties of action, speech and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
yathāsvaṃ karma kurvanti nānyatkiñcid śivājñayā |
śabdādayo'pi gṛhyante kriyante vacanādayaḥ ||
meaning:
यथास्वं कर्म कुर्वन्ति नान्यत्किञ्चिद् शिवाज्ञया |
शब्दादयोऽपि गृह्यन्ते क्रियन्ते वचनादयः ||
text_mt:
perform their respective actions and nothing else, by Śiva's command.
Sound and the rest are apprehended, and speech and the rest are performed.

sanskrit_iast:
avilaṅghyā hi sarveṣāmājñā śambhorgarīyasī |
avakāśamaśeṣāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ samprayacchati ||
meaning:
अविलङ्घ्या हि सर्वेषामाज्ञा शम्भोर्गरीयसी |
अवकाशमशेषाणां भूतानां सम्प्रयच्छति ||
text_mt:
For the momentous command of Śambhu is unalterable for all;
space provides accommodation for all beings,

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśaḥ parameśasya śāsanādeva sarvagaḥ |
prāṇādyaiśca tathā nāmabhedairantarbahirjagat ||
meaning:
आकाशः परमेशस्य शासनादेव सर्वगः |
प्राणाद्यैश्च तथा नामभेदैरन्तर्बहिर्जगत् ||
text_mt:
all-pervading space [does so] solely by the command of the supreme Lord.
And through distinctions of names such as the vital breath, inside and outside,

sanskrit_iast:
bibharti sarvaṃ śarvasya śāsanena prabhañjanaḥ |
havyaṃ vahati devānāṃ kavyaṃ kavyāśināmapi ||
meaning:
बिभर्ति सर्वं शर्वस्य शासनेन प्रभञ्जनः |
हव्यं वहति देवानां कव्यं कव्याशिनामपि ||
text_mt:
the Wind-god sustains the entire universe by the command of Śarva.
Fire carries the sacrificial offering for the gods and the ancestral offering for the pitṛs;

sanskrit_iast:
pākādyaṃ ca karotyagniḥ parameśvaraśāsanāt |
sañjīvanādyaṃ sarvasya kurvatyāpastadājñayā ||
meaning:
पाकाद्यं च करोत्यग्निः परमेश्वरशासनात् |
सञ्जीवनाद्यं सर्वस्य कुर्वत्यापस्तदाज्ञया ||
text_mt:
and it performs cooking and other tasks by the command of Parameśvara.
The waters perform reviving and other tasks for everything by his command.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvambharā jagannityaṃ dhatte viśveśvarājñayā |
devān yātyasurān hanti trilokamabhirakṣati ||
meaning:
विश्वम्भरा जगन्नित्यं धत्ते विश्वेश्वराज्ञया |
देवान् यात्यसुरान् हन्ति त्रिलोकमभिरक्षति ||
text_mt:
The earth constantly sustains the world by the command of the Lord of the Universe.
By his command, which is inviolable by all gods,

sanskrit_iast:
ājñayā tasya devendraḥ sarvairdevairalaṅghyayā |
ādhipatyamapāṃ nityaṃ kurute varuṇaḥ sadā ||
meaning:
आज्ञया तस्य देवेन्द्रः सर्वैर्देवैरलङ्घ्यया |
आधिपत्यमपां नित्यं कुरुते वरुणः सदा ||
text_mt:
the King of the Gods approaches the gods, slays the asuras, and protects the three worlds.
Varuṇa always exercises dominion over the waters,

sanskrit_iast:
pāśairbadhnāti ca yathā daṇḍyāṃstasyaiva śāsanāt |
dadāti nityaṃ yakṣendro draviṇaṃ draviṇeśvaraḥ ||
meaning:
पाशैर्बध्नाति च यथा दण्ड्यांस्तस्यैव शासनात् |
ददाति नित्यं यक्षेन्द्रो द्रविणं द्रविणेश्वरः ||
text_mt:
and binds those deserving punishment with nooses, by his command alone.
The Lord of the Yakṣas, the lord of wealth, constantly gives wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyānurūpaṃ bhūtebhyaḥ puruṣasyānuśāsanāt |
karoti sampadaḥ śaśvat jñānaṃ cāpi sumedhasām ||
meaning:
पुण्यानुरूपं भूतेभ्यः पुरुषस्यानुशासनात् |
करोति सम्पदः शश्वत् ज्ञानं चापि सुमेधसाम् ||
text_mt:
in accordance with merit to living beings, by the decree of the Supreme Person.
Śiva constantly creates prosperity, and wisdom for the intelligent,

sanskrit_iast:
nigrahaṃ cāpyasādhūnāmīśānaḥ śivaśāsanāt |
dhatte tu dharaṇīṃ mūrdhnā śeṣaḥ śivaniyogataḥ ||
meaning:
निग्रहं चाप्यसाधूनामीशानः शिवशासनात् |
धत्ते तु धरणीं मूर्ध्ना शेषः शिवनियोगतः ||
text_mt:
and restraint of the wicked, by his command.
Śeṣa supports the earth with his head by Śiva's appointment;

sanskrit_iast:
yāmāhustāmasīṃ raudrīṃ mūrtimantakarīṃ hareḥ |
sṛjatyaśeṣamīśasya śāsanāccaturānanaḥ ||
meaning:
यामाहुस्तामसीं रौद्रीं मूर्तिमन्तकरीं हरेः |
सृजत्यशेषमीशस्य शासनाच्चतुराननः ||
text_mt:
that which they call the dark, fierce, destroy-causing form of Hari,
by the command of the Lord the four-faced Brahmā creates the whole universe;

sanskrit_iast:
anyābhirmūrtibhiḥ svābhiḥ pāti cānte nihanti ca |
viṣṇuḥ pālayate viśvaṃ kālakālasya śāsanāt ||
meaning:
अन्याभिर्मूर्तिभिः स्वाभिः पाति चान्ते निहन्ति च |
विष्णुः पालयते विश्वं कालकालस्य शासनात् ||
text_mt:
by other forms of his own he protects it, and at the end destroys it.
Viṣṇu protects the universe by the command of the Death of Death;

sanskrit_iast:
sṛjate trasate cāpi svakābhistanubhistribhiḥ |
haratyante jagatsarvaṃ harastasyaiva śāsanāt ||
meaning:
सृजते त्रसते चापि स्वकाभिस्तनुभिस्त्रिभिः |
हरत्यन्ते जगत्सर्वं हरस्तस्यैव शासनात् ||
text_mt:
he also creates and destroys through his own three forms.
Hara at the end dissolves the whole universe by his command alone;

sanskrit_iast:
sṛjatyapi ca viśvātmā tridhā bhinnastu rakṣati |
kālaḥ karoti sakalaṃ kālassaṃharati prajāḥ ||
meaning:
सृजत्यपि च विश्वात्मा त्रिधा भिन्नस्तु रक्षति |
कालः करोति सकलं कालस्संहरति प्रजाः ||
text_mt:
and the Self of all creates, yet divided threefold, he protects.
Time makes everything; Time withdraws all creatures;

sanskrit_iast:
kālaḥ pālayate viśvaṃ kālakālasya śāsanāt |
tribhiraṃśairjagadbibhrattejobhirvṛṣṭimādiśan ||
meaning:
कालः पालयते विश्वं कालकालस्य शासनात् |
त्रिभिरंशैर्जगद्बिभ्रत्तेजोभिर्वृष्टिमादिशन् ||
text_mt:
Time protects the universe by the command of the Death of Death.
Sustaining the world by three portions of light, distributing rain,

sanskrit_iast:
divi varṣatyasau bhānurdevadevasya śāsanāt |
puṣṇātyoṣadhijātāni bhūtānyāhlādayatyapi ||
meaning:
दिवि वर्षत्यसौ भानुर्देवदेवस्य शासनात् |
पुष्णात्योषधिजातानि भूतान्याह्लादयत्यपि ||
text_mt:
the sun yonder shines in the sky by the command of the God of gods.
It nourishes the plants, brings forth creatures, and gives them joy;

sanskrit_iast:
devaiśca pīyate candraścandrabhūṣaṇaśāsanāt |
ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau marutastathā ||
meaning:
देवैश्च पीयते चन्द्रश्चन्द्रभूषणशासनात् |
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा अश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा ||
text_mt:
and the moon is drunk by the gods by the command of the Moon-adorned Lord.
The Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, the two Aśvins, and the Maruts,

sanskrit_iast:
khecarā ṛṣayassiddhā bhogino manujā mṛgāḥ |
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścaiva kīṭādyāḥ sthāvarāṇi ca ||
meaning:
खेचरा ऋषयस्सिद्धा भोगिनो मनुजा मृगाः |
पशवः पक्षिणश्चैव कीटाद्याः स्थावराणि च ||
text_mt:
the sky-dwellers, sages, siddhas, serpents, humans, wild beasts,
bound animals, birds, insects and immobile things,

sanskrit_iast:
nadyassamudrā girayaḥ kānanāni sarāṃsi ca |
vedāḥ sāṅgāśca śāstrāṇi mantrastomamakhādayaḥ ||
meaning:
नद्यस्समुद्रा गिरयः काननानि सरांसि च |
वेदाः साङ्गाश्च शास्त्राणि मन्त्रस्तोममखादयः ||
text_mt:
rivers, oceans, mountains, forests, and lakes,
the Vedas with their auxiliary limbs, scriptures, host of mantras, sacrifices, and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
kālāgnyādiśivāntāni bhuvanāni sahādhipaiḥ |
brahmāṇḍānyapyasaṅkhyāni teṣāmāvaraṇāni ca ||
meaning:
कालाग्न्यादिशिवान्तानि भुवनानि सहाधिपैः |
ब्रह्माण्डान्यप्यसङ्ख्यानि तेषामावरणानि च ||
text_mt:
the worlds extending from the Fire of Time up to Śiva, together with their regents,
and the innumerable cosmic eggs and their coverings,

sanskrit_iast:
vartamānānyatītāni bhaviṣyantyapi kṛtsnaśaḥ |
diśaśca vidiśaścaiva kālabhedāḥ kalādayaḥ ||
meaning:
वर्तमानान्यतीतानि भविष्यन्त्यपि कृत्स्नशः |
दिशश्च विदिशश्चैव कालभेदाः कलादयः ||
text_mt:
present, past, and all that are yet to come,
the cardinal and intermediate directions, divisions of time such as kalās and the rest—

sanskrit_iast:
yacca kiñcijjagatyasmin dṛśyate śrūyate'pi vā |
tatsarvaṃ śaṅkarasyājñābalena samadhiṣṭhitam ||
meaning:
यच्च किञ्चिज्जगत्यस्मिन् दृश्यते श्रूयतेऽपि वा |
तत्सर्वं शङ्करस्याज्ञाबलेन समधिष्ठितम् ||
text_mt: And whatever is seen or even heard in this world, / all that is presided over by the power of Śaṅkara's command.

sanskrit_iast:
ājñābalāttasya dharā sthiteha dharādharā vāridharāḥ samudrāḥ |
jyotirgaṇāḥ śakramukhāśca devāḥ sthiraṃ ciraṃ vā cidacidyadasti ||
meaning:
आज्ञाबलात्तस्य धरा स्थितेह धराधरा वारिधराः समुद्राः |
ज्योतिर्गणाः शक्रमुखाश्च देवाः स्थिरं चिरं वा चिदचिद्यदस्ति ||
text_mt: By the power of his command the earth stands here, the mountains, clouds, and oceans, / the hosts of luminaries, and the gods headed by Śakra, and whatever exists, whether stable or enduring, conscious or unconscious.

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
atyāścaryamidaṃ kṛṣṇa śambhoramitakarmaṇaḥ |
ājñākṛtaṃ śṛṇuṣvaitacchrutaṃ śrutimukhe mayā ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
अत्याश्चर्यमिदं कृष्ण शम्भोरमितकर्मणः |
आज्ञाकृतं शृणुष्वैतच्छ्रुतं श्रुतिमुखे मया ||
text_mt:
Upamanyu said:
Hear, O Kṛṣṇa, this most wondrous deed performed through the command
of Śambhu of unmeasured actions, heard by me from the mouth of the Veda.
Formerly, indeed, the gods along with Indra, disputing with one another

sanskrit_iast:
purā kila surāḥ sendrā vivadantaḥ parasparam |
asurānsamare jitvā jetāhamahamityuta ||
meaning:
पुरा किल सुराः सेन्द्रा विवदन्तः परस्परम् |
असुरान्समरे जित्वा जेताहमहमित्युत ||

sanskrit_iast:
tadā maheśvarasteṣāṃ madhyato varaveṣadhṛk |
svalakṣaṇairvihīnāṅgaḥ svayaṃ yakṣa ivābhavat ||
meaning:
तदा महेश्वरस्तेषां मध्यतो वरवेषधृक् |
स्वलक्षणैर्विहीनाङ्गः स्वयं यक्ष इवाभवत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
sa tānāha surānekaṃ tṛṇamādāya bhūtale |
ya etadvikṛtaṃ kartuṃ kṣamate sa tu daityajit ||
meaning:
स तानाह सुरानेकं तृणमादाय भूतले |
य एतद्विकृतं कर्तुं क्षमते स तु दैत्यजित् ||

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vajrapāṇiḥ śacīpatiḥ |
kiñcit kruddho vihasyainaṃ tṛṇamādātumudyataḥ ||
meaning:
यक्षस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा वज्रपाणिः शचीपतिः |
किञ्चित् क्रुद्धो विहस्यैनं तृणमादातुमुद्यतः ||
text_mt:
“Whoever is able to alter this is truly the conqueror of the daityas.”
Hearing the yakṣa's word, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the lord of Śacī,

sanskrit_iast:
na tattṛṇamupadātuṃ manasāpi ca śakyate |
yathā tathāpi tacchettuṃ vajraṃ vajradharo'sṛjat ||
meaning:
न तत्तृणमुपदातुं मनसापि च शक्यते |
यथा तथापि तच्छेत्तुं वज्रं वज्रधरोऽसृजत् ||
text_mt:
Then, to split it by any means, the thunderbolt-bearer hurled his thunderbolt.
That thunderbolt, as though collided with everywhere by another thunderbolt,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvajraṃ nijavajreṇa saṃsṛṣṭamiva sarvataḥ |
tṛṇenābhihataṃ tena tiryagagraṃ papāta ha ||
meaning:
तद्वज्रं निजवज्रेण संसृष्टमिव सर्वतः |
तृणेनाभिहतं तेन तिर्यगग्रं पपात ह ||

sanskrit_iast:
tataścānye susaṃrabdhā lokapālā mahābalāḥ |
sasṛjustṛṇamuddiśya svāyudhāni sahasraśaḥ ||
meaning:
ततश्चान्ये सुसंरब्धा लोकपाला महाबलाः |
ससृजुस्तृणमुद्दिश्य स्वायुधानि सहस्रशः ||

sanskrit_iast:
prajajjvāla mahāvahniḥ pracaṇḍaḥ pavano vavau |
pravṛddho'pāmpatiryadvatpralaye samupasthite ||
meaning:
प्रजज्ज्वाल महावह्निः प्रचण्डः पवनो ववौ |
प्रवृद्धोऽपाम्पतिर्यद्वत्प्रलये समुपस्थिते ||
text_mt:
and the lord of waters swelled as when the cosmic dissolution is at hand.
Thus whatever was undertaken with exertion by the gods against that blade of grass,

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ devaiḥ samārabdhaṃ tṛṇamuddiśya yatnataḥ |
vyarthamāsīdaho kṛṣṇa yakṣasyātmabalena vai ||
meaning:
एवं देवैः समारब्धं तृणमुद्दिश्य यत्नतः |
व्यर्थमासीदहो कृष्ण यक्षस्यात्मबलेन वै ||
text_mt:
alas, O Kṛṣṇa, proved futile through the yakṣa's own power.
Then the lord of gods, indignant, said to the yakṣa: “Who are you?”

sanskrit_iast:
tadāha yakṣaṃ devendraḥ ko bhavānityamarṣitaḥ |
tataḥ sa paśyatāmeva teṣāmantaradhādatha ||
meaning:
तदाह यक्षं देवेन्द्रः को भवानित्यमर्षितः |
ततः स पश्यतामेव तेषामन्तरधादथ ||

sanskrit_iast:
tadantare haimavatī devī divyavibhūṣaṇā |
āvirāsīnnabhoraṅge śobhamānā śucismitā ||
meaning:
तदन्तरे हैमवती देवी दिव्यविभूषणा |
आविरासीन्नभोरङ्गे शोभमाना शुचिस्मिता ||

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ |
praṇamya yakṣaṃ papracchuḥ ko'sau yakṣo vilakṣaṇaḥ ||
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वा विस्मयाविष्टा देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः |
प्रणम्य यक्षं पप्रच्छुः कोऽसौ यक्षो विलक्षणः ||
text_mt:
appeared in the arena of the sky, shining and with a bright smile.
Seeing her, the gods headed by Śakra were filled with wonder,
bowed down, and asked about the yakṣa: “Who is that extraordinary yakṣa?”

sanskrit_iast:
sā'bravītsasmitaṃ devī sa yuṣmākamagocaraḥ |
tenedaṃ bhramyate cakraṃ saṃsārākhyaṃ carācaram ||
meaning:
साऽब्रवीत्सस्मितं देवी स युष्माकमगोचरः |
तेनेदं भ्रम्यते चक्रं संसाराख्यं चराचरम् ||
text_mt: Smiling, the goddess said: “He is beyond your realm of perception. / By him this moving and unmoving wheel named saṃsāra is set in motion.

sanskrit_iast:
tenādau kriyate viśvaṃ tena saṃhriyate punaḥ |
na tanniyantā kaścit syāttena sarvaṃ niyamyate ||
meaning:
तेनादौ क्रियते विश्वं तेन संह्रियते पुनः |
न तन्नियन्ता कश्चित् स्यात्तेन सर्वं नियम्यते ||
text_mt: By him the universe is created in the beginning; by him it is withdrawn again. / No one can be his controller; everything is controlled by him.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sā mahādevī tatraivāntaradhatta vai |
devāśca vismitāḥ sarve tāṃ praṇamya divaṃ yayuḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा सा महादेवी तत्रैवान्तरधत्त वै |
देवाश्च विस्मिताः सर्वे तां प्रणम्य दिवं ययुः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
Having said this, that Great Goddess vanished right there, / and all the gods, astonished, bowed to her and went to heaven.

Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
śṛṇu kṛṣṇa maheśasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
mūrtyātmabhistataṃ kṛtsnaṃ jagadetaccarācaram ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
शृणु कृष्ण महेशस्य शिवस्य परमात्मनः |
मूर्त्यात्मभिस्ततं कृत्स्नं जगदेतच्चराचरम् ||
title: tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ | ṛṣṇāyopamanyorupadeśavarṇanam
text_mt:
Chapter 3
Upamanyu said:
Listen, Kṛṣṇa, to [how] the entire world, moving and unmoving,
is pervaded by the embodied forms of the great Lord, Śiva, the Supreme Self.
Śiva is indeed this entire [universe], and with his own forms,

sanskrit_iast:
sa śivaḥ sarvamevedaṃ svakīyābhiśca mūrtibhiḥ |
adhitiṣṭhatyameyātmā hyetatsarvamanusmṛtam ||
meaning:
स शिवः सर्वमेवेदं स्वकीयाभिश्च मूर्तिभिः |
अधितिष्ठत्यमेयात्मा ह्येतत्सर्वमनुस्मृतम् ||
text_mt:
he of immeasurable self presides over all this, as is remembered.
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, Maheśāna, and Sadāśiva—

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā viṣṇustathā rudro maheśānaḥ sadāśivaḥ |
mūrtayastasya vijñeyā yābhirviśvamidaṃ tatam ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा रुद्रो महेशानः सदाशिवः |
मूर्तयस्तस्य विज्ञेया याभिर्विश्वमिदं ततम् ||
text_mt:
these are to be known as his forms, by which this universe is pervaded.
Now, there are also five other forms named after the Brahmans.

sanskrit_iast:
athānyāścāpi tanavaḥ pañca brahmasamāhvayāḥ |
tanūbhistābhirāvyāptamiha kiñcinna vidyate ||
meaning:
अथान्याश्चापि तनवः पञ्च ब्रह्मसमाह्वयाः |
तनूभिस्ताभिराव्याप्तमिह किञ्चिन्न विद्यते ||

sanskrit_iast:
īśānaḥ puruṣo'ghoro vāmaḥ sadyastathaiva ca |
brahmāṇyetāni devasya mūrtayaḥ pañca viśrutāḥ ||
meaning:
ईशानः पुरुषोऽघोरो वामः सद्यस्तथैव च |
ब्रह्माण्येतानि देवस्य मूर्तयः पञ्च विश्रुताः ||
text_mt:
these are the five renowned forms of the god, the Brahmans.
His first and most exalted form, named Īśāna,

sanskrit_iast:
īśānākhyā tu yā tasya mūrtirādyā garīyasī |
bhoktāraṃ prakṛteḥ sākṣāt kṣetrajñamadhitiṣṭhati ||
meaning:
ईशानाख्या तु या तस्य मूर्तिराद्या गरीयसी |
भोक्तारं प्रकृतेः साक्षात् क्षेत्रज्ञमधितिष्ठति ||

sanskrit_iast:
sthāṇostatpuruṣākhyā yā mūrtirmūrtimataḥ prabhoḥ |
guṇāśrayātmakaṃ bhogyamavyaktamadhitiṣṭhati ||
meaning:
स्थाणोस्तत्पुरुषाख्या या मूर्तिर्मूर्तिमतः प्रभोः |
गुणाश्रयात्मकं भोग्यमव्यक्तमधितिष्ठति ||
text_mt:
directly presides over the experiencer of nature, the knower of the field.
That form of Sthāṇu, the embodied lord, which is named Tatpuruṣa,
presides over the unmanifest [prakṛti], the object of experience, which is the substrate of the guṇas.
The principle of intellect (buddhi), possessed of the eight limbs beginning with dharma, of the wielder of Pināka,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādyaṣṭāṅgasaṃyuktaṃ buddhitattvaṃ pinākinaḥ |
adhitiṣṭhatyaghorākhyā mūrtiratyantapūjitā ||
meaning:
धर्माद्यष्टाङ्गसंयुक्तं बुद्धितत्त्वं पिनाकिनः |
अधितिष्ठत्यघोराख्या मूर्तिरत्यन्तपूजिता ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāmadevāhvayāṃ mūrtiṃ mahādevasya vedhasaḥ |
ahaṅkṛteradhiṣṭhātrīmāhurāgamavedinaḥ ||
meaning:
वामदेवाह्वयां मूर्तिं महादेवस्य वेधसः |
अहङ्कृतेरधिष्ठात्रीमाहुरागमवेदिनः ||

sanskrit_iast:
sadyo jātāhvayāṃ mūrtiṃ śambhoramitavarcasaḥ |
mānasaḥ samadhiṣṭhātrīṃ matimantaḥ pracakṣate ||
meaning:
सद्यो जाताह्वयां मूर्तिं शम्भोरमितवर्चसः |
मानसः समधिष्ठात्रीं मतिमन्तः प्रचक्षते ||
text_mt:
the knowers of the Āgamas declare to be the presiding deity of egoity (ahaṃkāra).
The form named Sadyojāta of Śambhu of unmeasured radiance

sanskrit_iast:
śrotrasya vācaḥ śabdasya vibhorvyomnastathaiva ca |
īśvarīmīśvarasyemāmīśākhyāṃ hi vidurbudhāḥ ||
meaning:
श्रोत्रस्य वाचः शब्दस्य विभोर्व्योम्नस्तथैव च |
ईश्वरीमीश्वरस्येमामीशाख्यां हि विदुर्बुधाः ||
text_mt:
the wise proclaim to be the presiding deity of the mind.
Over the ear, speech, sound, and the all-pervading space,
the wise know this form of the Lord, named Īśā, to be the ruler.
The sovereign form named Puruṣa, over skin, hand, touch, and wind,

sanskrit_iast:
tvakpāṇisparśavāyūnāmīśvarīṃ mūrtimaiśvarīm |
puruṣākhyaṃ viduḥ sarve purāṇārthaviśāradāḥ ||
meaning:
त्वक्पाणिस्पर्शवायूनामीश्वरीं मूर्तिमैश्वरीम् |
पुरुषाख्यं विदुः सर्वे पुराणार्थविशारदाः ||

sanskrit_iast:
cakṣuṣaścaraṇasyāpi rūpasyāgnestathaiva ca |
aghorākhyāmadhiṣṭhātrīṃ mūrtimāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ||
meaning:
चक्षुषश्चरणस्यापि रूपस्याग्नेस्तथैव च |
अघोराख्यामधिष्ठात्रीं मूर्तिमाहुर्मनीषिणः ||
text_mt:
all who are skilled in the meaning of the Purāṇas know.
Over the eye, foot, form, and fire,
the wise call the presiding form that named Aghora.
Over the tongue, anus, taste, and water,

sanskrit_iast:
ramanāyāśca pāyośca rasasyāpāṃ tathaiva ca |
īśvarīṃ vāmadevākhyāṃ mūrtiṃ tanniratāṃ viduḥ ||
meaning:
रमनायाश्च पायोश्च रसस्यापां तथैव च |
ईश्वरीं वामदेवाख्यां मूर्तिं तन्निरतां विदुः ||
text_mt:
they know the sovereign form named Vāmadeva to be intent upon them.
Over the nose, genitals, smell, and earth,

sanskrit_iast:
ghrāṇasya caivopasthasya gandhasya ca bhuvastathā |
sadyojñātāhvayāṃ mūrtimīśvarīṃ sampracakṣate ||
meaning:
घ्राणस्य चैवोपस्थस्य गन्धस्य च भुवस्तथा |
सद्योज्ञाताह्वयां मूर्तिमीश्वरीं सम्प्रचक्षते ||

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtayaḥ pañca devasya vandanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ |
śreyo'rthibhirnarairnityaṃ śreyasāmekahetavaḥ ||
meaning:
मूर्तयः पञ्च देवस्य वन्दनीयाः प्रयत्नतः |
श्रेयोऽर्थिभिर्नरैर्नित्यं श्रेयसामेकहेतवः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tasya devādidevasya mūrtyaṣṭakamayaṃ jagat |
tasmin vyāpya sthitaṃ viśvaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva ||
meaning:
तस्य देवादिदेवस्य मूर्त्यष्टकमयं जगत् |
तस्मिन् व्याप्य स्थितं विश्वं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ||

sanskrit_iast:
śarvo bhavastathā rudra ugro bhīmaḥ paśoḥ patiḥ |
īśānaśca mahādevo mūrtayaścāṣṭa viśrutāḥ ||
meaning:
शर्वो भवस्तथा रुद्र उग्रो भीमः पशोः पतिः |
ईशानश्च महादेवो मूर्तयश्चाष्ट विश्रुताः ||
text_mt: Śarva, Bhava, Rudra, Ugra, Bhīma, Paśupati, / Īśāna, and Mahādeva are celebrated as his eight embodiments.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmyambho'gnimarudvyomakṣetrajñārkaniśākarāḥ |
adhiṣṭhitā maheśasya śarvādyairaṣṭamūrtibhiḥ ||
meaning:
भूम्यम्भोऽग्निमरुद्व्योमक्षेत्रज्ञार्कनिशाकराः |
अधिष्ठिता महेशस्य शर्वाद्यैरष्टमूर्तिभिः ||
text_mt: Earth, water, fire, wind, space, the knower of the field, the sun, and the moon / are presided over by the eight embodiments of the Great Lord, beginning with Śarva.

sanskrit_iast:
carācarātmakaṃ viśvaṃ dhatte viśvambharātmikā |
śārvī rśivāhvayā mūrtiriti śāstrasya niścayaḥ ||
meaning:
चराचरात्मकं विश्वं धत्ते विश्वम्भरात्मिका |
शार्वी र्शिवाह्वया मूर्तिरिति शास्त्रस्य निश्चयः ||
text_mt: Consisting of the all-bearing [earth], the embodiment of Śarva named Śivā / upholds the world composed of the moving and unmoving; such is the conclusion of the scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
sañjīvanaṃ samastasya jagataḥ salilātmikāj |
bhāvīti gīyate mūrtibhavasya paramātmanaḥ ||
meaning:
सञ्जीवनं समस्तस्य जगतः सलिलात्मिकाज् |
भावीति गीयते मूर्तिभवस्य परमात्मनः ||
text_mt: Consisting of water, the life-giving force of the entire world, / the embodiment of Bhava, the Supreme Self, is sung of as Bhāvī.

sanskrit_iast:
bahirantargatā viśvaṃ vyāpya tejomayī śubhā |
raudrī rudrāvyayā mūrtirāsthitā ghorarūpiṇī ||
meaning:
बहिरन्तर्गता विश्वं व्याप्य तेजोमयी शुभा |
रौद्री रुद्राव्यया मूर्तिरास्थिता घोररूपिणी ||
text_mt: Going within and without, pervading the universe, auspicious and fiery, / the immutable, terrible embodiment of Rudra stands as Raudrī.

sanskrit_iast:
spandayatyanilātmedaṃ bibharti spandate svayam |
augrīti kathyate sadbhirmūrtirugrasya vedhasaḥ ||
meaning:
स्पन्दयत्यनिलात्मेदं बिभर्ति स्पन्दते स्वयम् |
औग्रीति कथ्यते सद्भिर्मूर्तिरुग्रस्य वेधसः ||
text_mt: Having the nature of wind, it causes this [universe] to vibrate, sustains it, and vibrates itself; / it is called Augrī by the good, the embodiment of Ugra, the creator.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāvakāśadā sarvavyāpikā gaganātmikā |
mūrtirbhīmasya bhīmākhyā bhūtavṛndasya bhedikā ||
meaning:
सर्वावकाशदा सर्वव्यापिका गगनात्मिका |
मूर्तिर्भीमस्य भीमाख्या भूतवृन्दस्य भेदिका ||
text_mt: Granting space to all, all-pervading, consisting of the sky, / the embodiment of Bhīma, named Bhīmā, divides the collection of beings.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātmanāmadhiṣṭhātrī sarvakṣetranivāsinī |
mūrtiḥ paśupaterjñeyā paśupāśanikṛntanī ||
meaning:
सर्वात्मनामधिष्ठात्री सर्वक्षेत्रनिवासिनी |
मूर्तिः पशुपतेर्ज्ञेया पशुपाशनिकृन्तनी ||
text_mt: Presiding over all souls, dwelling in all bodies, / the embodiment of Paśupati is to be known as severing the fetters of the bound soul.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpayantī jagatsarvaṃ divākarasamāhvayā |
īśānākhyā maheśasya mūrtirdivi visarpati ||
meaning:
दीपयन्ती जगत्सर्वं दिवाकरसमाह्वया |
ईशानाख्या महेशस्य मूर्तिर्दिवि विसर्पति ||
text_mt: Illuminating the entire world, bearing the name of the sun, / the embodiment of the Great Lord named Īśāna moves through the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
āpyāyayati yo viśvamamṛtāṃśurniśākaraḥ |
mahādevasya sā mūrtirmahādevasamāhvayā ||
meaning:
आप्याययति यो विश्वममृतांशुर्निशाकरः |
महादेवस्य सा मूर्तिर्महादेवसमाह्वया ||
text_mt: The moon, whose rays are nectar, who nourishes the universe, / is that embodiment of Mahādeva which bears the name of Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmā tasyāṣṭamī mūrtiḥ śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
vyāpiketaramūrtīnāṃ viśvaṃ tasmāt śivātmakam ||
meaning:
आत्मा तस्याष्टमी मूर्तिः शिवस्य परमात्मनः |
व्यापिकेतरमूर्तीनां विश्वं तस्मात् शिवात्मकम् ||
text_mt: The soul is the eighth form of Śiva, the Supreme Self; / it pervades the other forms, and therefore the universe consists of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣasya mūlasekena śākhāḥ puṣyanti vai yathā |
śivasya pūjayā tadvatpuṣyatyasya vapurjagat ||
meaning:
वृक्षस्य मूलसेकेन शाखाः पुष्यन्ति वै यथा |
शिवस्य पूजया तद्वत्पुष्यत्यस्य वपुर्जगत् ||
text_mt: Just as branches flourish by watering the root of a tree, / likewise, by worshiping Śiva, this universe, his body, flourishes.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābhayapradānaṃ ca sarvānugrahaṇaṃ tathā |
sarvopakārakaraṇaṃ śivasyārādhanaṃ viduḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वाभयप्रदानं च सर्वानुग्रहणं तथा |
सर्वोपकारकरणं शिवस्याराधनं विदुः ||
text_mt: Bestowing fearlessness upon all, granting grace to all, / and rendering service to all: this they know to be the worship of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
yatheha putrapautrādeḥ prītyā prīto bhavetpitā |
tathā sarvasya samprītyā prīto bhavati śaṅkaraḥ ||
meaning:
यथेह पुत्रपौत्रादेः प्रीत्या प्रीतो भवेत्पिता |
तथा सर्वस्य सम्प्रीत्या प्रीतो भवति शङ्करः ||
text_mt: Just as a father here is delighted by the joy of his sons and grandsons, / so Śaṅkara is delighted by the delight of everyone.

sanskrit_iast:
dehino yasya kasyāpi kriyate yadi nigrahaḥ |
aniṣṭamaṣṭamūrtestatkṛtameva na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning:
देहिनो यस्य कस्यापि क्रियते यदि निग्रहः |
अनिष्टमष्टमूर्तेस्तत्कृतमेव न संशयः ||
text_mt: If injury is done to any embodied being whatsoever, / that is an offense done to the Eight-Formed Lord without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamūrtyātmanā viśvamadhiṣṭhāya sthitaṃ śivam |
bhajasva sarvabhāvena rudraṃ paramakāraṇam ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
meaning:
अष्टमूर्त्यात्मना विश्वमधिष्ठाय स्थितं शिवम् |
भजस्व सर्वभावेन रुद्रं परमकारणम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
text_mt:
Worship with all your heart Śiva, who abides presiding over the universe / in the form of the eight bodies—Rudra, the ultimate cause.

Obeisance to glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
bhagavan parameśasya śarvasyāmitatejasaḥ |
mūrtibhirviśvamevedaṃ yathā vyāptaṃ tathā śrutam ||
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच |
भगवन् परमेशस्य शर्वस्यामिततेजसः |
