tadā nārāyaṇaḥ śete devo māyāmayīṃ tanum ||
meaning:
गुणमूर्त्यात्मनां चैव ततोऽवान्तरसंहृतिः |
तदा नारायणः शेते देवो मायामयीं तनुम् ||
text_mt: and through the forms of the qualities; then came the intermediate dissolution. / At that time the god Nārāyaṇa sleeps, having assumed a body made of illusion,

sanskrit_iast:
āsthāya bhogiparyaṅkaśayane toyamadhyagaḥ |
tannābhipaṅkajājjātaḥ pañcavaktraḥ pitāmahaḥ ||
meaning:
आस्थाय भोगिपर्यङ्कशयने तोयमध्यगः |
तन्नाभिपङ्कजाज्जातः पञ्चवक्त्रः पितामहः ||
text_mt: resting on the couch of the serpent's coils, situated in the midst of the waters. / From the lotus of his navel was born the five-faced Grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
sisṛkṣamāṇo lokāṃstrīnna sakto hyasahāyavān |
munīndaśa sasarjādau mānasānamitaujasaḥ ||
meaning:
सिसृक्षमाणो लोकांस्त्रीन्न सक्तो ह्यसहायवान् |
मुनीन्दश ससर्जादौ मानसानमितौजसः ||
text_mt: Desiring to create the three worlds, being without assistance he was unable. / First he created ten mind-born sages of boundless radiance.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ siddhivivṛddhyarthaṃ māṃ provāca pitāmahaḥ |
matputrāṇāṃ mahādeva śaktiṃ dehi maheśvara ||
meaning:
तेषां सिद्धिविवृद्ध्यर्थं मां प्रोवाच पितामहः |
मत्पुत्राणां महादेव शक्तिं देहि महेश्वर ||
text_mt: For the increase of their perfection, the Grandfather spoke to me: / 'Grant power to my sons, O Mahādeva, O Maheśvara!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ prārthitastena pañcavaktradharo hyaham |
pañcākṣarāṇi kramaśaḥ proktavān padmayonaye ||
meaning:
इत्येवं प्रार्थितस्तेन पञ्चवक्त्रधरो ह्यहम् |
पञ्चाक्षराणि क्रमशः प्रोक्तवान् पद्मयोनये ||
text_mt: Thus petitioned by him, I, bearing five faces, / declared the five syllables in order to the lotus-born [Brahmā].

sanskrit_iast:
sa pañcavadanaistāni gṛhṇam̐llokapitāmahaḥ |
vācyavācakabhāvena jñātavānmāṃ maheśvaram ||
meaning:
स पञ्चवदनैस्तानि गृह्णम्̐ल्लोकपितामहः |
वाच्यवाचकभावेन ज्ञातवान्मां महेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Receiving them with his five mouths, the Grandfather of the worlds / understood me, Maheśvara, through the relation of the signified and the signifier.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā prayogaṃ vidhivat siddhamantraḥ prajāpatiḥ |
putrebhyaḥ pradadau mantraṃ mantrārthaṃ ca yathātatham ||
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा प्रयोगं विधिवत् सिद्धमन्त्रः प्रजापतिः |
पुत्रेभ्यः प्रददौ मन्त्रं मन्त्रार्थं च यथातथम् ||
text_mt: Having understood the application according to rule, the lord of creatures, his mantra perfected, / imparted the mantra to his sons, and the meaning of the mantra accurately.

sanskrit_iast:
te ca labdhvā mantraratnaṃ sākṣāt lokapitāmahāt |
tadājñaptena mārgeṇa madārādhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ||
meaning:
ते च लब्ध्वा मन्त्ररत्नं साक्षात् लोकपितामहात् |
तदाज्ञप्तेन मार्गेण मदाराधनकाङ्क्षिणः ||
text_mt: And having obtained that jewel of a mantra directly from the Grandfather of the worlds, / desirous of worshiping me by the path enjoined by him,

sanskrit_iast:
merostu śikhare ramye muñjavānnāma parvataḥ |
matpriyaḥ satataṃ śrīmānmadbhaktai rakṣitaḥ sadā ||
meaning:
मेरोस्तु शिखरे रम्ये मुञ्जवान्नाम पर्वतः |
मत्प्रियः सततं श्रीमान्मद्भक्तै रक्षितः सदा ||
text_mt: on a delightful peak of Meru there is a mountain named Muñjavat, / ever dear to me, splendid, always protected by my devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyābhyāśe tapastīvraṃ lokaṃ sraṣṭuṃ samutsukāḥ |
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu vāyubhakṣāḥ samācaran ||
meaning:
तस्याभ्याशे तपस्तीव्रं लोकं स्रष्टुं समुत्सुकाः |
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु वायुभक्षाः समाचरन् ||
text_mt: Near it, eager to create the world, living on air, / they performed severe austerity for a divine thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ bhaktimahaṃ dṛṣṭvā sadyaḥ pratyakṣatāmiyām |
ṛṣiṃ chandaśca kīlaṃ ca bījaśaktiṃ ca daivatam ||
meaning:
तेषां भक्तिमहं दृष्ट्वा सद्यः प्रत्यक्षतामियाम् |
ऋषिं छन्दश्च कीलं च बीजशक्तिं च दैवतम् ||
text_mt: Seeing their devotion, I became immediately visible to them. / The sage, the meter, the peg, the seed, the power, and the deity,

sanskrit_iast:
nyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ digbandhaṃ viniyogamaśeṣataḥ |
proktavānahamāryāṇāṃ jagatsṛṣṭivivṛddhaye ||
meaning:
न्यासं षडङ्गं दिग्बन्धं विनियोगमशेषतः |
प्रोक्तवानहमार्याणां जगत्सृष्टिविवृद्धये ||
text_mt: the placement, the six limbs, the binding of the directions, and the application in full / I declared to the noble ones for the increase of the creation of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste mantramāhātmyād ṛṣayastapasaudhitāḥ |
sṛṣṭiṃ vitanvate samyak sadevāsuramānuṣīm ||
meaning:
ततस्ते मन्त्रमाहात्म्याद् ऋषयस्तपसौधिताः |
सृष्टिं वितन्वते सम्यक् सदेवासुरमानुषीम् ||
text_mt: Then, from the majesty of the mantra, those sages, magnified by austerity, / thoroughly spread forth creation along with gods, asuras, and humans.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāḥ paramavidyāyāḥ svarūpamadhunocyate |
ādau namaḥ prayoktavyaṃ śivāya tu tataḥ param ||
meaning:
अस्याः परमविद्यायाः स्वरूपमधुनोच्यते |
आदौ नमः प्रयोक्तव्यं शिवाय तु ततः परम् ||
text_mt: Now the essential form of this supreme lore is declared: / First 'namaḥ' is to be uttered, and 'śivāya' after that.

sanskrit_iast:
saiṣā pañcākṣarī vidyā sarvaśrutiśirogatā |
sarvajātasya sarvasya bījabhūtā sanātanī ||
meaning:
सैषा पञ्चाक्षरी विद्या सर्वश्रुतिशिरोगता |
सर्वजातस्य सर्वस्य बीजभूता सनातनी ||
text_mt: This is the five-syllabled lore, situated at the head of all revelation, / the eternal seed of everything that has come to be.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ manmukhodgīrṇā sā mamaivāsti vācikā |
taptacāmīkaraprakhyā pīnonnatapayodharā ||
meaning:
प्रथमं मन्मुखोद्गीर्णा सा ममैवास्ति वाचिका |
तप्तचामीकरप्रख्या पीनोन्नतपयोधरा ||
text_mt: First uttered from my mouth, it is expressive of me alone. / Resembling molten gold, with full, elevated breasts,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujā trinayanā bālendukṛtaśekharā |
padmotpalakarā saumyā varadābhayapāṇikā ||
meaning:
चतुर्भुजा त्रिनयना बालेन्दुकृतशेखरा |
पद्मोत्पलकरा सौम्या वरदाभयपाणिका ||
text_mt: four-armed, three-eyed, having the crescent moon as her crest, / holding a day-lotus and a night-lotus in her hands, gentle, with hands granting boons and fearlessness,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇasampannā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā |
sitapadmāsanāsīnā nīlakuñcitīmūrddhajā ||
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्ना सर्वाभरणभूषिता |
सितपद्मासनासीना नीलकुञ्चितीमूर्द्धजा ||
text_mt: endowed with all auspicious marks, adorned with all ornaments, / seated on a white lotus seat, with dark curly hair.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāḥ pañcavidhā varṇāḥ prasphurad raśmimaṇḍalāḥ |
pītaḥ kṛṣṇastathā dhūmraḥ svarṇābho rakta eva ca ||
meaning:
अस्याः पञ्चविधा वर्णाः प्रस्फुरद् रश्मिमण्डलाः |
पीतः कृष्णस्तथा धूम्रः स्वर्णाभो रक्त एव च ||
text_mt: yellow, black, smoky, gold-colored, and red; / when these are employed separately, adorned with bindu and nāda,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthak prayojyā yadyete bindunādavibhūṣitāḥ |
arddhacandranibho bindurnādo dīpaśikhākṛtiḥ ||
meaning:
पृथक् प्रयोज्या यद्येते बिन्दुनादविभूषिताः |
अर्द्धचन्द्रनिभो बिन्दुर्नादो दीपशिखाकृतिः ||

sanskrit_iast:
bījaṃ dvitīyaṃ bījeṣu mantrasyāsya varānane |
dīrghapūrvaṃ turīyasya pañcamaṃ śaktimādiśet ||
meaning:
बीजं द्वितीयं बीजेषु मन्त्रस्यास्य वरानने |
दीर्घपूर्वं तुरीयस्य पञ्चमं शक्तिमादिशेत् ||
text_mt: preceded by a long [vowel], one should indicate as the fifth, the śakti of the fourth. / The ṛṣi is named Vāmadeva; the metre is declared to be Paṅkti;

sanskrit_iast:
vāmadevo nāma ṛṣiḥ paṅktiśchanda udāhṛtam |
devatā śiva evāhaṃ mantrasyāsya varānane ||
meaning:
वामदेवो नाम ऋषिः पङ्क्तिश्छन्द उदाहृतम् |
देवता शिव एवाहं मन्त्रस्यास्य वरानने ||

sanskrit_iast:
gautamo'trirvarārohe viśvāmitrastathāṅgirāḥ |
bharadvājaśca varṇānāṃ kramaśaścarṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
meaning:
गौतमोऽत्रिर्वरारोहे विश्वामित्रस्तथाङ्गिराः |
भरद्वाजश्च वर्णानां क्रमशश्चर्षयः स्मृताः ||
text_mt: and Bharadvāja are traditionally remembered as the ṛṣis of the syllables in order. / The metres are Gāyatrī, Anuṣṭubh, Triṣṭubh, Bṛhatī, and Virāj;

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryanuṣṭup triṣṭup ca chandāṃsi bṛhatī virāṭ |
indro rudro harirbrahmā skandasteṣāṃ ca devatāḥ ||
meaning:
गायत्र्यनुष्टुप् त्रिष्टुप् च छन्दांसि बृहती विराट् |
इन्द्रो रुद्रो हरिर्ब्रह्मा स्कन्दस्तेषां च देवताः ||

sanskrit_iast:
mama pañcamukhānyāhuḥ sthāne teṣāṃ varānane |
pūrvādeścordhvaparyantaṃ nakārādi yathākramam ||
meaning:
मम पञ्चमुखान्याहुः स्थाने तेषां वरानने |
पूर्वादेश्चोर्ध्वपर्यन्तं नकारादि यथाक्रमम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
udāttaḥ prathamo varṇaścaturthaśca dvitīyakaḥ |
pañcamaḥ svaritaścaiva tṛtīyo nihitaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
उदात्तः प्रथमो वर्णश्चतुर्थश्च द्वितीयकः |
पञ्चमः स्वरितश्चैव तृतीयो निहितः स्मृतः ||
text_mt: beginning from the east and extending to the upward, corresponding to the syllable na and the rest in order. / The first syllable is udātta, and the second is the fourth [tone],

sanskrit_iast:
mūlavidyā śivaṃ śaivaṃ sūtraṃ pañcākṣaraṃ tathā |
nāmānyasya vijānīyācchaivaṃ me hṛdayaṃ mahat ||
meaning:
मूलविद्या शिवं शैवं सूत्रं पञ्चाक्षरं तथा |
नामान्यस्य विजानीयाच्छैवं मे हृदयं महत् ||
text_mt:
and the fifth is svarita; the third is remembered as nihata. / The basic vidyā, Śiva, the Śaiva sūtra, and the five-syllable [mantra]—
one should know these as its names; it is my great Śaiva heart. / The syllable na is called the head, while the syllable ma is called the crest;

sanskrit_iast:
nakāraḥ śira ucyeta makārastu śikhocyate |
śikāraḥ kavacaṃ tadvadvakāro netramucyate ||
meaning:
नकारः शिर उच्येत मकारस्तु शिखोच्यते |
शिकारः कवचं तद्वद्वकारो नेत्रमुच्यते ||

sanskrit_iast:
yakāro'straṃ namaḥ svāhā vaṣaṭ huṃ vauṣaḍityapi |
phaḍityapi ca varṇānāmante'ṅgatvaṃ yadā tadā ||
meaning:
यकारोऽस्त्रं नमः स्वाहा वषट् हुं वौषडित्यपि |
फडित्यपि च वर्णानामन्तेऽङ्गत्वं यदा तदा ||

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi mūlamantro'yaṃ kiñcidbhedasamanvayāt |
tatrāpi pañcamo varṇo dvādaśasvarabhūṣitaḥ ||
meaning:
तत्रापि मूलमन्त्रोऽयं किञ्चिद्भेदसमन्वयात् |
तत्रापि पञ्चमो वर्णो द्वादशस्वरभूषितः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādanena mantreṇa manovākkāyabhedataḥ |
āvayorarcanaṃ kuryyājjapahomādikaṃ tathā ||
meaning:
तस्मादनेन मन्त्रेण मनोवाक्कायभेदतः |
आवयोरर्चनं कुर्य्याज्जपहोमादिकं तथा ||

sanskrit_iast:
yathāprajñaṃ yathākālaṃ yathāśāstraṃ yathāmati |
yathāśakti yathāsampadyathāyogaṃ yathārati ||
meaning:
यथाप्रज्ञं यथाकालं यथाशास्त्रं यथामति |
यथाशक्ति यथासम्पद्यथायोगं यथारति ||
text_mt:
one should perform worship of both of us, as well as recitation, fire offerings, and so forth, / according to one's understanding, according to time, according to scripture, according to intellect,
according to one's ability, according to one's wealth, according to yoga, according to desire. / Whenever, or wherever, performed with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
yadā kadāpi vā bhaktyā yatra kutrāpi vā kṛtā |
yena kenāpi vā devi pūjā muktiṃ nayiṣyati ||
meaning:
यदा कदापि वा भक्त्या यत्र कुत्रापि वा कृता |
येन केनापि वा देवि पूजा मुक्तिं नयिष्यति ||

sanskrit_iast:
mayyāsaktena manasā yatkṛtaṃ mama sundari |
matpriyaṃ ca śivaṃ caiva krameṇāpyakrameṇa vā ||
meaning:
मय्यासक्तेन मनसा यत्कृतं मम सुन्दरि |
मत्प्रियं च शिवं चैव क्रमेणाप्यक्रमेण वा ||
text_mt: is pleasing to me and auspicious, whether in regular order or without order. / Nevertheless, for those devotees of mine who are not utterly helpless,

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi mama bhaktā ye nātyantavivaśāḥ punaḥ |
teṣāṃ sarveṣu śāstreṣu mayaiva niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
तथापि मम भक्ता ये नात्यन्तविवशाः पुनः |
तेषां सर्वेषु शास्त्रेषु मयैव नियमः कृतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
tatrādau sampravakṣyāmi mantrasaṅgrahaṇaṃ śubham |
yaṃ vinā niṣphalaṃ jāpyaṃ yena vā saphalaṃ bhavet ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
तत्रादौ सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि मन्त्रसङ्ग्रहणं शुभम् |
यं विना निष्फलं जाप्यं येन वा सफलं भवेत् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
without which recitation is fruitless, or by which it becomes fruitful. / Om. Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, entitled “Description of the Greatness of the Five-Syllable [Mantra],” in the Uttarakhaṇḍa of the Vāyavīyasaṃhitā in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

Homage to glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca |
ājñāhīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ śraddhāhīnaṃ varānane |
ājñārthaṃ dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ sadā japtaṃ ca niṣphalam ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच |
आज्ञाहीनं क्रियाहीनं श्रद्धाहीनं वरानने |
आज्ञार्थं दक्षिणाहीनं सदा जप्तं च निष्फलम् ||
title: caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ | pañcākṣaramahimavarṇanam
text_mt:
Chapter 14
Īśvara said:
Bereft of permission, bereft of ritual action, bereft of faith, O fair-faced one,
and bereft of the dakṣiṇā meant for permission, what is recited constantly is fruitless. / Accomplished through permission, accomplished through ritual action, accomplished through faith, having my nature,

sanskrit_iast:
ājñāsiddhaṃ kriyāsiddhaṃ śraddhāsiddhaṃ mamātmakam |
evaṃ ceddakṣiṇāyuktaṃ mantrasiddhirmahatphalam ||
meaning:
आज्ञासिद्धं क्रियासिद्धं श्रद्धासिद्धं ममात्मकम् |
एवं चेद्दक्षिणायुक्तं मन्त्रसिद्धिर्महत्फलम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
upagamya guruṃ vipramācāryaṃ tattvavedinam |
jāpinaṃ sadguṇopetaṃ dhyānayogaparāyaṇam ||
meaning:
उपगम्य गुरुं विप्रमाचार्यं तत्त्ववेदिनम् |
जापिनं सद्गुणोपेतं ध्यानयोगपरायणम् ||
text_mt:
Having approached a guru who is a Brahmin, an ācārya, a knower of truth,
one who practices recitation, is endowed with good qualities, and is devoted to meditation and yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
toṣayettaṃ prayatnena bhāvaśuddhisamanvitaḥ |
vācā ca manasā caiva kāyena draviṇena ca ||
meaning:
तोषयेत्तं प्रयत्नेन भावशुद्धिसमन्वितः |
वाचा च मनसा चैव कायेन द्रविणेन च ||
text_mt:
endowed with purity of thought, one should diligently please him
with speech, mind, body, and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryaṃ pūjayedvipraḥ sarvadātiprayatnataḥ |
hastyaśvaratharatnāni kṣetrāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca ||
meaning:
आचार्यं पूजयेद्विप्रः सर्वदातिप्रयत्नतः |
हस्त्यश्वरथरत्नानि क्षेत्राणि च गृहाणि च ||
text_mt:
A Brahmin should worship the ācārya always with great effort:
elephants, horses, chariots, and jewels, lands and houses,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣaṇāni ca vāsāṃsi dhānyāni ca dhanāni ca |
etāni gurave dadyādbhaktyā ca vibhave sati ||
meaning:
भूषणानि च वासांसि धान्यानि च धनानि च |
एतानि गुरवे दद्याद्भक्त्या च विभवे सति ||
text_mt:
ornaments, clothes, grain, and wealth—
these one should give to the guru with devotion, if one possesses the means.

sanskrit_iast:
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchetsiddhimātmanaḥ |
paścānnivedya svātmānaṃ gurave saparicchadam ||
meaning:
वित्तशाठ्यं न कुर्वीत यदीच्छेत्सिद्धिमात्मनः |
पश्चान्निवेद्य स्वात्मानं गुरवे सपरिच्छदम् ||
text_mt:
One must not practice deceit regarding wealth if one desires one's own success.
Afterward, offering oneself to the guru along with all one's belongings,

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sampūjya vidhivadyathāśakti tvavañcayan |
ādadīta gurormantraṃ jñānaṃ caiva krameṇa tu ||
meaning:
एवं सम्पूज्य विधिवद्यथाशक्ति त्ववञ्चयन् |
आददीत गुरोर्मन्त्रं ज्ञानं चैव क्रमेण तु ||
text_mt:
having thus worshipped him according to rule, to the best of one's ability, without deception,
one should receive the mantra from the guru, and knowledge in due succession.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tuṣṭo guruḥ śiṣyaṃ pūjakaṃ vatsaroṣitam |
śuśrūṣumanahaṅkāraṃ snātaṃ śucimupoṣitam ||
meaning:
एवं तुष्टो गुरुः शिष्यं पूजकं वत्सरोषितम् |
शुश्रूषुमनहङ्कारं स्नातं शुचिमुपोषितम् ||
text_mt:
Thus pleased, the guru, to the worshipping disciple who has lived [with him] for a year,
who is eager to serve, free from pride, bathed, pure, and has fasted,

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayitvā viśuddhyarthaṃ pūrṇakumbhaghṛtena vai |
jalena mantraśuddhena puṇyadravyayutena ca ||
meaning:
स्नापयित्वा विशुद्ध्यर्थं पूर्णकुम्भघृतेन वै |
जलेन मन्त्रशुद्धेन पुण्यद्रव्ययुतेन च ||
text_mt:
having bathed him for complete purification with ghee from a full jar,
and with water purified by mantras and accompanied by auspicious substances,

sanskrit_iast:
alaṅkṛtya suveṣaṃ ca gandhasragvastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā ca brāhmaṇānabhipūjya ca ||
meaning:
अलङ्कृत्य सुवेषं च गन्धस्रग्वस्त्रभूषणैः |
पुण्याहं वाचयित्वा च ब्राह्मणानभिपूज्य च ||
text_mt:
and having adorned him, well attired, with perfumes, garlands, garments, and ornaments,
having had auspicious blessings recited, and having honoured the Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
samudratīre nadyāṃ ca goṣṭhe devālaye'pi vā |
śucau deśe gṛhe vāpi kāle siddhikare tithau ||
meaning:
समुद्रतीरे नद्यां च गोष्ठे देवालयेऽपि वा |
शुचौ देशे गृहे वापि काले सिद्धिकरे तिथौ ||
text_mt:
on the seashore, by a river, in a cowshed, or in a temple,
in a clean place, or in a house, at an auspicious time, on a lunar day that grants success,

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatre śubhayoge ca sarvadoṣavivarjite |
anugṛhya tato dadyājjñānaṃ mama yathāvidhi ||
meaning:
नक्षत्रे शुभयोगे च सर्वदोषविवर्जिते |
अनुगृह्य ततो दद्याज्ज्ञानं मम यथाविधि ||
text_mt:
under a lunar mansion and in an auspicious conjunction free from all defects,
having bestowed grace, he should then impart my knowledge according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
svareṇoccārayetsamyagekānte'tiprasannadhīḥ |
uccāryoccārayitvā tamāvayormantramuttamam ||
meaning:
स्वरेणोच्चारयेत्सम्यगेकान्तेऽतिप्रसन्नधीः |
उच्चार्योच्चारयित्वा तमावयोर्मन्त्रमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt:
With a very serene mind, in solitude, he should pronounce it correctly with proper tone;
having uttered and made him utter that supreme mantra of both of us,

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ cāstu śubhaṃ cāstu śobhano'stu priyo'stviti |
evaṃ dadyād gururmantramājñāṃ caiva tataḥ param ||
meaning:
शिवं चास्तु शुभं चास्तु शोभनोऽस्तु प्रियोऽस्त्विति |
एवं दद्याद् गुरुर्मन्त्रमाज्ञां चैव ततः परम् ||
text_mt:
saying, ‘May it be auspicious, may it be beneficial, may it be splendid, may it be dear!’—
thus the guru should give the mantra, and thereafter the command.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ labdhvā gurormantramājñāṃ caiva samāhitaḥ |
saṅkalpya ca japennityaṃ puraścaraṇapūrvakam ||
meaning:
एवं लब्ध्वा गुरोर्मन्त्रमाज्ञां चैव समाहितः |
सङ्कल्प्य च जपेन्नित्यं पुरश्चरणपूर्वकम् ||
text_mt:
Having thus received the mantra and the command from the guru, composed in mind
and having formed a resolution, he should recite it daily, preceded by the preliminary rite.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvajjīvaṃ japennityamaṣṭottarasahasrakam |
ananyastatparo bhūtvā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
meaning:
यावज्जीवं जपेन्नित्यमष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् |
अनन्यस्तत्परो भूत्वा स याति परमां गतिम् ||
text_mt:
He who recites one thousand and eight times daily throughout his life,
becoming single-minded and intent upon it, goes to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
japedakṣaralakṣaṃ vai caturguṇitamādarāt |
naktāśī saṃyamī yaḥ sa pauraścaraṇikaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
जपेदक्षरलक्षं वै चतुर्गुणितमादरात् |
नक्ताशी संयमी यः स पौरश्चरणिकः स्मृतः ||
text_mt:
He who recites one hundred thousand times per syllable, quadrupled with devotion,
eating only at night and self-restrained, is deemed a practitioner of the preliminary rite.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ puraścaraṇaṃ kṛtvā nityajāpī bhavetpunaḥ |
tasya nāsti samo loke sa siddhaḥ siddhido bhavet ||
meaning:
यः पुरश्चरणं कृत्वा नित्यजापी भवेत्पुनः |
तस्य नास्ति समो लोके स सिद्धः सिद्धिदो भवेत् ||
text_mt:
He who, having performed the preliminary rite, becomes a regular reciter again—
there is no one equal to him in the world; he is an adept and grants success.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ kṛtvā śucau deśe baddhvā ruciramāsanam |
tvayā māṃ hṛdi sañcintya sañcintya svaguruṃ tataḥ ||
meaning:
स्नानं कृत्वा शुचौ देशे बद्ध्वा रुचिरमासनम् |
त्वया मां हृदि सञ्चिन्त्य सञ्चिन्त्य स्वगुरुं ततः ||
text_mt:
Having bathed in a clean place, having assumed a pleasing seat,
having meditated in the heart upon me together with you, and then upon his own guru,

sanskrit_iast:
udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā maunī caikāgramānasaḥ |
viśodhya pañcatattvāni dahanaplāvanādibhiḥ ||
meaning:
उदङ्मुखः प्राङ्मुखो वा मौनी चैकाग्रमानसः |
विशोध्य पञ्चतत्त्वानि दहनप्लावनादिभिः ||
text_mt:
facing north or facing east, silent, with one-pointed mind,
having purified the five elements through burning, flooding, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
mantranyāsādikaṃ kṛtvā saphalīkṛtavigrahaḥ |
āvayorvigrahau dhyāyanprāṇāpānau niyamya ca ||
meaning:
मन्त्रन्यासादिकं कृत्वा सफलीकृतविग्रहः |
आवयोर्विग्रहौ ध्यायन्प्राणापानौ नियम्य च ||
text_mt:
having performed the imposition of mantras and the rest, making his body fruitful,
meditating upon the forms of both of us, and restraining the inward and outward breaths,

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāsthānaṃ svakaṃ rūpaṃ ṛṣiṃ chando'dhidaivatam |
bījaṃ śaktiṃ tathā vākyaṃ smṛtvā pañcākṣarīṃ japet ||
meaning:
विद्यास्थानं स्वकं रूपं ऋषिं छन्दोऽधिदैवतम् |
बीजं शक्तिं तथा वाक्यं स्मृत्वा पञ्चाक्षरीं जपेत् ||
text_mt:
recalling the seat of the vidyā, its own form, the seer, the metre, the presiding deity,
the seed-syllable, the power, and the formula, one should recite the five-syllabled [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
uttamaṃ mānasaṃ jāpyamupāṃśuṃ caiva madhyamam |
adhamaṃ vācikaṃ prāhurāgamārthaviśāradāḥ ||
meaning:
उत्तमं मानसं जाप्यमुपांशुं चैव मध्यमम् |
अधमं वाचिकं प्राहुरागमार्थविशारदाः ||
text_mt:
Mental recitation is the highest, muttered recitation is middling,
and voiced recitation is the lowest: so say those skilled in the meaning of the Āgamas.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamaṃ rudradaivatyaṃ madhyamaṃ viṣṇudaivatam |
adhamaṃ brahmadaivatyamityāhuranupūrvaśaḥ ||
meaning:
उत्तमं रुद्रदैवत्यं मध्यमं विष्णुदैवतम् |
अधमं ब्रह्मदैवत्यमित्याहुरनुपूर्वशः ||
text_mt:
The highest has Rudra as its deity, the middling has Viṣṇu as its deity,
and the lowest has Brahmā as its deity: thus they declare in order.

sanskrit_iast:
yaduccanīcasvaritaiḥ spaṣṭāspaṣṭapadākṣaraiḥ |
mantramuccārayedvācā vāciko'yaṃ japaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
यदुच्चनीचस्वरितैः स्पष्टास्पष्टपदाक्षरैः |
मन्त्रमुच्चारयेद्वाचा वाचिकोऽयं जपः स्मृतः ||
text_mt:
When one pronounces the mantra with the voice, with high, low, and circumflex tones,
with distinct or indistinct words and syllables, this is considered voiced recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
jihvāmātraparispandādīṣaduccārito'pi vā |
aparairaśrutaḥ kiñcicchruto vopāṃśurucyate ||
meaning:
जिह्वामात्रपरिस्पन्दादीषदुच्चारितोऽपि वा |
अपरैरश्रुतः किञ्चिच्छ्रुतो वोपांशुरुच्यते ||
text_mt:
Uttered slightly with mere movement of the tongue,
unheard by others or just barely heard, it is called muttered [recitation].

sanskrit_iast:
dhiyā yadakṣaraśreṇyā varṇādvarṇaṃ padātpadam |
śabdārthacintanaṃ bhūyaḥ kathyate mānaso japaḥ ||
meaning:
धिया यदक्षरश्रेण्या वर्णाद्वर्णं पदात्पदम् |
शब्दार्थचिन्तनं भूयः कथ्यते मानसो जपः ||
text_mt:
When, by the intellect, along the series of syllables, from letter to letter, from word to word,
there is repeated contemplation of the sound and its meaning, it is called mental recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
vācikastveka eva syādupāṃśuḥ śatamucyate |
sāhasraṃ mānasaḥ proktaḥ sagarbhastu śatādhikaḥ ||
meaning:
वाचिकस्त्वेक एव स्यादुपांशुः शतमुच्यते |
साहस्रं मानसः प्रोक्तः सगर्भस्तु शताधिकः ||
text_mt:
The voiced is just single, the muttered is declared to be a hundredfold,
the mental is declared a thousandfold, while that with breath-retention is more than a hundred times [that].

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmasamāyuktaḥ sagarbho japa ucyate |
ādyantayoragarbho'pi prāṇāyāmaḥ praśasyate ||
meaning:
प्राणायामसमायुक्तः सगर्भो जप उच्यते |
आद्यन्तयोरगर्भोऽपि प्राणायामः प्रशस्यते ||
text_mt:
Recitation accompanied by breath-control is called pregnant;
even non-pregnant, breath-control at the beginning and the end is praised.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśatsamāvṛttīḥ prāṇānāyamya saṃsmaret |
mantraṃ mantrārthaviddhīmānaśaktaḥ śaktito japet ||
meaning:
चत्वारिंशत्समावृत्तीः प्राणानायम्य संस्मरेत् |
मन्त्रं मन्त्रार्थविद्धीमानशक्तः शक्तितो जपेत् ||
text_mt:
Restraining the breaths for forty repetitions, the wise man,
knowing the meaning of the mantra, should contemplate the mantra; if unable, he should recite according to his ability.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcakaṃ trikamekaṃ vā prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret |
agarbhaṃ vā sagarbhaṃ vā sagarbhastatra śasyate ||
meaning:
पञ्चकं त्रिकमेकं वा प्राणायामं समाचरेत् |
अगर्भं वा सगर्भं वा सगर्भस्तत्र शस्यते ||
text_mt:
One should perform five, three, or one breath-control,
either non-pregnant or pregnant; among them, the pregnant is commended.

sanskrit_iast:
sagarbhādapi sāhasraṃ sadhyāno japa ucyate |
eṣu pañcavidheṣvekaḥ karttavyaḥ śaktito japaḥ ||
meaning:
सगर्भादपि साहस्रं सध्यानो जप उच्यते |
एषु पञ्चविधेष्वेकः कर्त्तव्यः शक्तितो जपः ||
text_mt:
Recitation accompanied by meditation is declared a thousandfold even compared to the pregnant;
among these five kinds, one should perform recitation according to one’s capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgulyā japasaṅkhyānamekamevamudāhṛtam |
rekhayāṣṭaguṇaṃ vidyātputrajīvairdaśādhikam ||
meaning:
अङ्गुल्या जपसङ्ख्यानमेकमेवमुदाहृतम् |
रेखयाष्टगुणं विद्यात्पुत्रजीवैर्दशाधिकम् ||
text_mt:
Counting recitation with the fingers is thus said to be single;
one should know it as eightfold with the lines [of the hand], and ten times more with putrajīva seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ syācchaṅkhamaṇibhiḥ pravālaistu sahasrakam |
sphaṭikairdaśasāhasraṃ mauktikairlakṣamucyate ||
meaning:
शतं स्याच्छङ्खमणिभिः प्रवालैस्तु सहस्रकम् |
स्फटिकैर्दशसाहस्रं मौक्तिकैर्लक्षमुच्यते ||
text_mt:
With conch beads it is a hundredfold, with corals a thousandfold,
with crystal ten thousandfold, and with pearls it is declared a hundred thousandfold.

sanskrit_iast:
padmākṣairdaśalakṣaṃ tu sauvarṇaiḥ koṭirucyate |
kuśagranthyā ca rudrākṣairanantaguṇitaṃ bhavet ||
meaning:
पद्माक्षैर्दशलक्षं तु सौवर्णैः कोटिरुच्यते |
कुशग्रन्थ्या च रुद्राक्षैरनन्तगुणितं भवेत् ||
text_mt: [Recitation] with lotus seeds [yields] a millionfold [benefit], but with golden [beads] ten million is declared; / with knots of kuśa grass and with rudrākṣa beads it becomes multiplied infinitely.

sanskrit_iast:
triṃśadakṣaiḥ kṛtā mālā dhanadā japakarmaṇi |
saptaviṃśatisaṅkhyātairakṣaiḥ puṣṭipradā bhavet ||
meaning:
त्रिंशदक्षैः कृता माला धनदा जपकर्मणि |
सप्तविंशतिसङ्ख्यातैरक्षैः पुष्टिप्रदा भवेत् ||
text_mt: A rosary made of thirty beads grants wealth in the rite of recitation; / made of twenty-seven beads, it bestows nourishment.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyātaiḥ kṛtā muktiṃ prayacchati |
akṣaistu pañcadaśabhirabhicāraphalapradā ||
meaning:
पञ्चविंशतिसङ्ख्यातैः कृता मुक्तिं प्रयच्छति |
अक्षैस्तु पञ्चदशभिरभिचारफलप्रदा ||
text_mt: Made of twenty-five beads, it grants liberation; / but with fifteen beads, it yields the fruits of sorcery.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhaṃ mokṣadaṃ vidyāttarjjanīṃ śatrunāśinīm |
madhyamāṃ dhanadāṃ śāntiṃ karotyeṣā hyanāmikā ||
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठं मोक्षदं विद्यात्तर्ज्जनीं शत्रुनाशिनीम् |
मध्यमां धनदां शान्तिं करोत्येषा ह्यनामिका ||
text_mt: One should know the thumb brings liberation, the forefinger destroys enemies, / the middle finger grants wealth, and the ring finger brings peace.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ mālā tatra syāduttamottamā |
śatasaṅkhyottamā mālā pañcāśadbhistu madhyamā ||
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशतं माला तत्र स्यादुत्तमोत्तमा |
शतसङ्ख्योत्तमा माला पञ्चाशद्भिस्तु मध्यमा ||
text_mt: A rosary of one hundred and eight beads is the best of the best; / a rosary of one hundred is the best, but one of fifty is middling.

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥpañcāśadakṣaistu hṛcchreṣṭhā hi prakīrtitā |
ityevaṃ mālayā kuryājjapaṃ kasmai na darśayet ||
meaning:
चतुःपञ्चाशदक्षैस्तु हृच्छ्रेष्ठा हि प्रकीर्तिता |
इत्येवं मालया कुर्याज्जपं कस्मै न दर्शयेत् ||
text_mt: With fifty-four beads it is celebrated as dear to the heart. / In this way one should perform recitation with a rosary; one should not show it to anyone.

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhā kṣariṇī proktā japakarmaṇi śobhanā |
aṅguṣṭhena japejjapyamanyairaṅgulibhiḥ saha ||
meaning:
कनिष्ठा क्षरिणी प्रोक्ता जपकर्मणि शोभना |
अङ्गुष्ठेन जपेज्जप्यमन्यैरङ्गुलिभिः सह ||
text_mt: The little finger is called fleeting, [yet] auspicious in the rite of recitation. / One should perform recitation with the thumb together with the other fingers,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhena vinā japyaṃ kṛtaṃ tadaphalaṃ yataḥ |
gṛhe japaṃ samaṃ vidyād goṣṭhe śataguṇaṃ viduḥ ||
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठेन विना जप्यं कृतं तदफलं यतः |
गृहे जपं समं विद्याद् गोष्ठे शतगुणं विदुः ||
text_mt: for recitation done without the thumb is fruitless. / Recitation in a house is considered ordinary; in a cowshed they know it to be a hundredfold [more fruitful].

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyāraṇye tathārāme sahasraguṇamucyate |
ayutaṃ parvate puṇye nadyāṃ lakṣamudāhṛtam ||
meaning:
पुण्यारण्ये तथारामे सहस्रगुणमुच्यते |
अयुतं पर्वते पुण्ये नद्यां लक्षमुदाहृतम् ||
text_mt: In a sacred forest and likewise in a grove it is said to be a thousandfold; / on a sacred mountain ten-thousandfold, and by a river it is declared a hundred-thousandfold.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭiṃ devālaye prāhuranantaṃ mama sannidhau |
sūryasyāgnergurorindordīpasya ca jalasya ca ||
meaning:
कोटिं देवालये प्राहुरनन्तं मम सन्निधौ |
सूर्यस्याग्नेर्गुरोरिन्दोर्दीपस्य च जलस्य च ||
text_mt: In a temple of the gods they say it is ten-millionfold; in my presence, infinite. / In the presence of the sun, of fire, of the guru, of the moon, of a lamp, and of water,

sanskrit_iast:
viprāṇāṃ ca gavāṃ caiva sannidhau śasyate japaḥ |
tatpūrvābhimukhaṃ vaśyaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cābhicārikam ||
meaning:
विप्राणां च गवां चैव सन्निधौ शस्यते जपः |
तत्पूर्वाभिमुखं वश्यं दक्षिणं चाभिचारिकम् ||
text_mt: and in the presence of Brahmins and cows, recitation is praised. / Facing east it brings subjugation; facing south, rites of sorcery.

sanskrit_iast:
paścimaṃ dhanadaṃ vidyādauttaraṃ śāntidaṃ bhavet |
sūryyāgnivipradevānāṃ gurūṇāmapi sannidhau ||
meaning:
पश्चिमं धनदं विद्यादौत्तरं शान्तिदं भवेत् |
सूर्य्याग्निविप्रदेवानां गुरूणामपि सन्निधौ ||
text_mt: Facing west should be known as granting wealth; facing north brings peace. / In the presence of the sun, fire, Brahmins, gods, and gurus,

sanskrit_iast:
anyeṣāṃ ca prasaktānāṃ mantraṃ na vimukho japet |
uṣṇīṣī kañcukī nagno muktakeśo galāvṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
अन्येषां च प्रसक्तानां मन्त्रं न विमुखो जपेत् |
उष्णीषी कञ्चुकी नग्नो मुक्तकेशो गलावृतः ||
text_mt: and of other [honoured ones] attached [there], one should not recite the mantra with one's back turned. / Wearing a turban, wearing a tunic, naked, with dishevelled hair, with the neck covered,

sanskrit_iast:
apavitrakaro'śuddho vilapanna japet kvacit |
krodhaṃ madaṃ kṣutaṃ trīṇi niṣṭhīvanavijṛmbhaṇe ||
meaning:
अपवित्रकरोऽशुद्धो विलपन्न जपेत् क्वचित् |
क्रोधं मदं क्षुतं त्रीणि निष्ठीवनविजृम्भणे ||
text_mt: with impure hands, unclean, or lamenting, one should never recite. / Anger, intoxication, and sneezing—these three—and spitting and yawning,

sanskrit_iast:
darśanaṃ ca śvanīcānāṃ varjayejjapakarmaṇi |
ācametsambhave teṣāṃ smaredvā māṃ tvayā saha ||
meaning:
दर्शनं च श्वनीचानां वर्जयेज्जपकर्मणि |
आचमेत्सम्भवे तेषां स्मरेद्वा मां त्वया सह ||
text_mt: and the sight of dogs and low-born people should be avoided during the rite of recitation. / If these occur, one should sip water, or remember me together with you,

sanskrit_iast:
jyotīṃṣi ca prapaśyedvā kuryād vā prāṇasaṃyamam |
anāsanaḥ śayāno vā gacchannutthita eva vā ||
meaning:
ज्योतींषि च प्रपश्येद्वा कुर्याद् वा प्राणसंयमम् |
अनासनः शयानो वा गच्छन्नुत्थित एव वा ||
text_mt: or gaze at the heavenly lights, or perform breath control. / Without a seat, lying down, walking, or standing upright,

sanskrit_iast:
rathyāyāmaśive sthāne na japettimirāntare |
prasāryya na japetpādau kukkuṭāsana eva vā ||
meaning:
रथ्यायामशिवे स्थाने न जपेत्तिमिरान्तरे |
प्रसार्य्य न जपेत्पादौ कुक्कुटासन एव वा ||
text_mt: on a public road, in an unhallowed place, or within darkness, one should not recite. / One should not recite with legs outstretched or in the cock posture,

sanskrit_iast:
yānaśayyādhirūḍho vā cintāvyākulito'thavā |
śaktaścetsarvamevaitadaśaktaḥ śaktito japet ||
meaning:
यानशय्याधिरूढो वा चिन्ताव्याकुलितोऽथवा |
शक्तश्चेत्सर्वमेवैतदशक्तः शक्तितो जपेत् ||
text_mt: or mounted upon a vehicle or bed, or agitated by worry. / If capable, [one should avoid] all of this; if incapable, one may recite according to one's capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
kimatra bahunoktena samāsena vacaḥ śṛṇu |
sadācāro japan śuddhaṃ dhyāyanbhadraṃ samaśnute ||
meaning:
किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन समासेन वचः शृणु |
सदाचारो जपन् शुद्धं ध्यायन्भद्रं समश्नुते ||
text_mt: What is the use of speaking much on this? Hear the word in brief: / Practising good conduct, pure while reciting and meditating, one attains good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāraḥ paramo dharma ācāraḥ paramaṃ dhanam |
ācāraḥ paramā vidyā ācāraḥ paramā gatiḥ ||
meaning:
आचारः परमो धर्म आचारः परमं धनम् |
आचारः परमा विद्या आचारः परमा गतिः ||
text_mt: Conduct is the highest virtue; conduct is the highest wealth; / conduct is the highest knowledge; conduct is the highest goal.

sanskrit_iast:
ācārahīnaḥ puruṣo loke bhavati ninditaḥ |
paratra ca sukhī na syāttasmādācāravānbhavet ||
meaning:
आचारहीनः पुरुषो लोके भवति निन्दितः |
परत्र च सुखी न स्यात्तस्मादाचारवान्भवेत् ||
text_mt: A person devoid of conduct is condemned in the world / and will not be happy in the hereafter; therefore, one should be virtuous in conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya yadvihitaṃ karma vede śāstre ca vaidikaiḥ |
tasya tena samācāraḥ sadācāro na cetaraḥ ||
meaning:
यस्य यद्विहितं कर्म वेदे शास्त्रे च वैदिकैः |
तस्य तेन समाचारः सदाचारो न चेतरः ||
text_mt: Whatever rite is prescribed for anyone in the Veda and the treatise by Vedic [authorities], / adhering to that is good conduct for him, not anything else.

sanskrit_iast:
sadbhirācaritatvācca sadācāraḥ sa ucyate |
sadācārasya tasyāhurāstikyaṃ mūlakāraṇam ||
meaning:
सद्भिराचरितत्वाच्च सदाचारः स उच्यते |
सदाचारस्य तस्याहुरास्तिक्यं मूलकारणम् ||
text_mt: And because it is practised by the good, it is called good conduct. / They say faith is the root cause of that good conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
āstikaścetpramādādyaiḥ sadācārādavicyutaḥ |
na duṣyati naro nityaṃ tasmādāstikatāṃ vrajet ||
meaning:
आस्तिकश्चेत्प्रमादाद्यैः सदाचारादविच्युतः |
न दुष्यति नरो नित्यं तस्मादास्तिकतां व्रजेत् ||
text_mt: If one has faith, though deviated from good conduct through negligence and the like, / a man is never ruined; therefore, one should attain faith.

sanskrit_iast:
yathehāsti sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukṛtairduṣkṛtairapi |
tathā paratra cāstīti matirāstikyamucyate ||
meaning:
यथेहास्ति सुखं दुःखं सुकृतैर्दुष्कृतैरपि |
तथा परत्र चास्तीति मतिरास्तिक्यमुच्यते ||
text_mt: Just as there is pleasure and pain here through good and bad deeds, / so too there is in the hereafter—such a conviction is called faith.

sanskrit_iast:
rahasyamanyadvakṣyāmi gopanīyamidaṃ priye |
na vācyaṃ yasya kasyāpi nāstikasyātha vā paśoḥ ||
meaning:
रहस्यमन्यद्वक्ष्यामि गोपनीयमिदं प्रिये |
न वाच्यं यस्य कस्यापि नास्तिकस्याथ वा पशोः ||
text_mt: I shall tell another secret that must be concealed, my dear; / it should not be told to just anyone, nor to a nihilist or a bound soul.

sanskrit_iast:
sadācāravihīnasya patitasyāntyajasya ca |
pañcākṣarātparaṃ nāsti paritrāṇaṃ kalau yuge ||
meaning:
सदाचारविहीनस्य पतितस्यान्त्यजस्य च |
पञ्चाक्षरात्परं नास्ति परित्राणं कलौ युगे ||
text_mt: For one devoid of good conduct, an outcaste, and a low-born man, / there is no protection higher than the five-syllable [mantra] in the Kaliyuga.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchatastiṣṭhato vāpi svecchayā karma kurvataḥ |
aśucervā śucervāpi mantro'yaṃ na ca niṣphalaḥ ||
meaning:
गच्छतस्तिष्ठतो वापि स्वेच्छया कर्म कुर्वतः |
अशुचेर्वा शुचेर्वापि मन्त्रोऽयं न च निष्फलः ||
text_mt: Whether walking or standing, or performing actions according to his wish, / whether impure or pure, this mantra is not fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
anācāravatāṃ puṃsāmaviśuddhaṣaḍadhvanām |
anādiṣṭo'pi guruṇā mantro'yaṃ na ca niṣphalaḥ ||
meaning:
अनाचारवतां पुंसामविशुद्धषडध्वनाम् |
अनादिष्टोऽपि गुरुणा मन्त्रोऽयं न च निष्फलः ||
text_mt: For men of improper conduct whose six pathways are unpurified, / even if not instructed by a guru, this mantra is not fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
antyajasyāpi mūrkhasya mūḍhasya patitasya ca |
nirmaryādasya nīcasya mantro'yaṃ na ca niṣphalaḥ ||
meaning:
अन्त्यजस्यापि मूर्खस्य मूढस्य पतितस्य च |
निर्मर्यादस्य नीचस्य मन्त्रोऽयं न च निष्फलः ||
text_mt: Even for a low-born man, a fool, an idiot, and an outcaste, / an unrestrained man, or a base man, this mantra is not fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāvasthāṃ gatasyāpi mayi bhaktimataḥ param |
sidhyatyeva na sandeho nāparasya tu kasyacit ||
meaning:
सर्वावस्थां गतस्यापि मयि भक्तिमतः परम् |
सिध्यत्येव न सन्देहो नापरस्य तु कस्यचित् ||
text_mt: Even when fallen into any condition, for one who is exceedingly devoted to me, / it is indeed successful, there is no doubt—but not for any other.

sanskrit_iast:
na lagnatithinakṣatravārayogādayaḥ priye |
asyātyantamavekṣyāḥ syurnaiṣa saptaḥ sadoditaḥ ||
meaning:
न लग्नतिथिनक्षत्रवारयोगादयः प्रिये |
अस्यात्यन्तमवेक्ष्याः स्युर्नैष सप्तः सदोदितः ||
text_mt: The ascendant, lunar day, asterism, weekday, and astrological conjunctions, my dear, / need not be strictly considered for this [mantra]; it is not dormant, [but] eternally awakened.

sanskrit_iast:
na kadācinna kasyāpi ripureṣa mahāmanuḥ |
susiddho vāpi siddho vā sādhyo vāpi bhaviṣyati ||
meaning:
न कदाचिन्न कस्यापि रिपुरेष महामनुः |
सुसिद्धो वापि सिद्धो वा साध्यो वापि भविष्यति ||
text_mt: Never is this great mantra an enemy to anyone; / it is either fully perfected, perfected, or to be mastered.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhena guruṇādiṣṭaḥ susiddha iti kathyate |
asiddhenāpi vā dattaḥ siddhasādhyastu kevalaḥ ||
meaning:
सिद्धेन गुरुणादिष्टः सुसिद्ध इति कथ्यते |
असिद्धेनापि वा दत्तः सिद्धसाध्यस्तु केवलः ||
text_mt: Instructed by a perfected guru, it is said to be 'fully perfected'; / given even by one not perfected, it is merely 'perfected' or 'to be mastered'.

sanskrit_iast:
asādhitaḥ sādhito vā sidhyatvena na saṃśayaḥ |
śraddhātiśayayuktasya mayi mantre tathā gurau ||
meaning:
असाधितः साधितो वा सिध्यत्वेन न संशयः |
श्रद्धातिशययुक्तस्य मयि मन्त्रे तथा गुरौ ||
text_mt: Whether unmastered or mastered, it certainly attains perfection, without doubt, / for one endowed with abundant faith in me, in the mantra, and likewise in the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmantrāntarāṃstyaktvā sāpāyānadhikārataḥ |
āśrayetparamāṃ vidyāṃ sākṣātpañcākṣarīṃ budhaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्मान्मन्त्रान्तरांस्त्यक्त्वा सापायानधिकारतः |
आश्रयेत्परमां विद्यां साक्षात्पञ्चाक्षरीं बुधः ||

sanskrit_iast:
mantrāntareṣu siddheṣu mantra eṣa na sidhyati |
siddhe tvasminmahāmantre te ca siddhā bhavantyuta ||
meaning:
मन्त्रान्तरेषु सिद्धेषु मन्त्र एष न सिध्यति |
सिद्धे त्वस्मिन्महामन्त्रे ते च सिद्धा भवन्त्युत ||

sanskrit_iast:
yathā deveṣvalabdho'smi labdheṣvapi maheśvari |
mayi labdhe tu te labdhā mantreṣveṣu samo vidhiḥ ||
meaning:
यथा देवेष्वलब्धोऽस्मि लब्धेष्वपि महेश्वरि |
मयि लब्धे तु ते लब्धा मन्त्रेष्वेषु समो विधिः ||
text_mt:
but when this great mantra is mastered, they too certainly become mastered.
Just as I am not gained among the gods, even when they are gained, great Mistress,

sanskrit_iast:
ye doṣāḥ sarvamantrāṇāṃ na te'smin sambhavantyapi |
asya mantrasya jātyādīnanapekṣya pravartanāt ||
meaning:
ये दोषाः सर्वमन्त्राणां न तेऽस्मिन् सम्भवन्त्यपि |
अस्य मन्त्रस्य जात्यादीननपेक्ष्य प्रवर्तनात् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi naiva kṣudreṣu phaleṣu pratiyogiṣu |
sahasā viniyuñjīta tasmādeṣa mahābalaḥ ||
meaning:
तथापि नैव क्षुद्रेषु फलेषु प्रतियोगिषु |
सहसा विनियुञ्जीत तस्मादेष महाबलः ||

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
evaṃ sākṣānmahādevyai mahādevena śūlinā |
hitāya jagatāmuktaḥ pañcākṣaravidhiryathā ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
एवं साक्षान्महादेव्यै महादेवेन शूलिना |
हिताय जगतामुक्तः पञ्चाक्षरविधिर्यथा ||
text_mt:
for trifling fruits against yogins.
Upamanyu said:
In this way, directly to the great Goddess by the great God, the Trident-bearer,

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ kīrtayedbhaktyā śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prayāti paramāṃ gatim ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
य इदं कीर्तयेद्भक्त्या शृणुयाद्वा समाहितः |
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः प्रयाति परमां गतिम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt: freed from all sins, goes to the supreme goal.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
bhagavanmantramāhātmyaṃ bhavatā kathitaṃ prabho |
tatprayogavidhānaṃ ca sākṣācchrutisamaṃ yathā ||
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच |
भगवन्मन्त्रमाहात्म्यं भवता कथितं प्रभो |
तत्प्रयोगविधानं च साक्षाच्छ्रुतिसमं यथा ||
title: pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | dīkṣāvidhāne gurumāhātmyavarṇanam
text_mt:
as well as the procedure for its application, which is truly equal to the Vedic revelation.
Now I wish to hear the highest Śaiva rite of consecration.

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi śivasaṃskāramuttamam |
mantrasaṅgrahaṇe kiñcitsūcitaṃ na tu vismṛtam ||
meaning:
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामि शिवसंस्कारमुत्तमम् |
मन्त्रसङ्ग्रहणे किञ्चित्सूचितं न तु विस्मृतम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi sarvapāpaviśodhanam |
saṃskāraṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ śivena patibhāṣitam ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि सर्वपापविशोधनम् |
संस्कारं परमं पुण्यं शिवेन पतिभाषितम् ||
text_mt:
It was hinted at a little during the receipt of the mantra, but has not been forgotten.
Upamanyu said:
Well, I shall tell you that which purifies all sins,
the supreme holy rite of consecration proclaimed by Śiva,
by which a man becomes fully qualified for worship and other rites.

sanskrit_iast:
samyak kṛtādhikāraḥ syātpūjādiṣu naro yataḥ |
saṃskāraḥ kathyate tena ṣaḍadhvapariśodhanam ||
meaning:
सम्यक् कृताधिकारः स्यात्पूजादिषु नरो यतः |
संस्कारः कथ्यते तेन षडध्वपरिशोधनम् ||
text_mt:
Therefore it is called a rite of consecration, which thoroughly purifies the six pathways.
Because by it special knowledge is given (dīyate) and the bondage of bonds is destroyed (kṣīyate),

sanskrit_iast:
dīyate yena vijñānaṃ kṣīyate pāśabandhanam |
tasmātsaṃskāra evāyaṃ dīkṣetyapi ca kathyate ||
meaning:
दीयते येन विज्ञानं क्षीयते पाशबन्धनम् |
तस्मात्संस्कार एवायं दीक्षेत्यपि च कथ्यते ||
text_mt:
for that reason this very rite of consecration is also called initiation (dīkṣā).
In the Śaiva scripture, Śāmbhavī, Śāktī, and Māntrī—

sanskrit_iast:
śāmbhavī caiva śāktī ca māntrī caiva śivāgame |
dīkṣopadiśyate tredhā śivena paramātmanā ||
meaning:
शाम्भवी चैव शाक्ती च मान्त्री चैव शिवागमे |
दीक्षोपदिश्यते त्रेधा शिवेन परमात्मना ||

sanskrit_iast:
gurorālokamātreṇa sparśātsambhāṣaṇādapi |
sadyaḥ saṃjñā bhavejjantoḥ pāśopakṣayakāriṇī ||
meaning:
गुरोरालोकमात्रेण स्पर्शात्सम्भाषणादपि |
सद्यः संज्ञा भवेज्जन्तोः पाशोपक्षयकारिणी ||

sanskrit_iast:
sā dīkṣā śāmbhavī proktā sā punarbhidyate dvidhā |
tīvrā tīvratarā ceti pāśopakṣayabhedataḥ ||
meaning:
सा दीक्षा शाम्भवी प्रोक्ता सा पुनर्भिद्यते द्विधा |
तीव्रा तीव्रतरा चेति पाशोपक्षयभेदतः ||
text_mt:
there would instantly be realization for a creature, destroying the bonds.
That initiation is called Śāmbhavī; it is again divided into two types,

sanskrit_iast:
yayā syānnirvṛtiḥ sadyaḥ saiva tīvratarā matā |
tīvrā tu jīvato'tyantaṃ puṃsaḥ pāpaviśodhikā ||
meaning:
यया स्यान्निर्वृतिः सद्यः सैव तीव्रतरा मता |
तीव्रा तु जीवतोऽत्यन्तं पुंसः पापविशोधिका ||

sanskrit_iast:
śāktī jñānavatī dīkṣā śiṣyadehaṃ praviśya tu |
guruṇā yogamārgeṇa kriyate jñānacakṣuṣā ||
meaning:
शाक्ती ज्ञानवती दीक्षा शिष्यदेहं प्रविश्य तु |
गुरुणा योगमार्गेण क्रियते ज्ञानचक्षुषा ||
text_mt: The Śāktī initiation is endowed with knowledge: having entered the disciple's body / by the path of yoga, it is performed by the guru with the eye of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
māntrī kriyāvatī dīkṣā kuṇḍamaṇḍalapūrvikā |
mandamandataroddeśātkartavyā guruṇā bahiḥ ||
meaning:
मान्त्री क्रियावती दीक्षा कुण्डमण्डलपूर्विका |
मन्दमन्दतरोद्देशात्कर्तव्या गुरुणा बहिः ||
text_mt: The Māntrī initiation is accompanied by ritual action, preceded by the fire pit and the mandala; / it should be performed externally by the guru with a view to the slow and slower [aspirants].

sanskrit_iast:
śaktipātānusāreṇa śiṣyo'nugrahamarhati |
śaivadharmānusārasya tanmūlatvātsamāsataḥ ||
meaning:
शक्तिपातानुसारेण शिष्योऽनुग्रहमर्हति |
शैवधर्मानुसारस्य तन्मूलत्वात्समासतः ||
text_mt: In accordance with the descent of power (śaktipāta), the disciple is worthy of grace, / for conformity to the Śaiva dharma is rooted in that, in short.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra śaktirna patitā tatra śuddhirna jāyate |
na vidyā na śivācāro na muktirna ca siddhayaḥ ||
meaning:
यत्र शक्तिर्न पतिता तत्र शुद्धिर्न जायते |
न विद्या न शिवाचारो न मुक्तिर्न च सिद्धयः ||
text_mt: Where power has not descended, purity does not arise there, / nor knowledge, nor Śaiva practice, nor liberation, nor supernatural powers.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt liṅgāni saṃvīkṣya śaktipātasya bhūyasaḥ |
jñānena kriyayā vātha guruḥ śiṣyaṃ viśodhayet ||
meaning:
तस्मात् लिङ्गानि संवीक्ष्य शक्तिपातस्य भूयसः |
ज्ञानेन क्रियया वाथ गुरुः शिष्यं विशोधयेत् ||
text_mt: Therefore, observing the signs of the abundant descent of power, / the guru should purify the disciple either through knowledge or through ritual action.

sanskrit_iast:
yo'nyathā kurute mohāt sa vinaśyati durmatiḥ |
tasmātsarvaprakāreṇa guruḥ śiṣyaṃ parīkṣayet ||
meaning:
योऽन्यथा कुरुते मोहात् स विनश्यति दुर्मतिः |
तस्मात्सर्वप्रकारेण गुरुः शिष्यं परीक्षयेत् ||
text_mt: He who does otherwise out of delusion, that fool perishes; / therefore the guru should test the disciple in every way.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇaṃ śaktipātasya prabodhānandasambhavaḥ |
sā yasmātparamā śaktiḥ prabodhānandarūpiṇī ||
meaning:
लक्षणं शक्तिपातस्य प्रबोधानन्दसम्भवः |
सा यस्मात्परमा शक्तिः प्रबोधानन्दरूपिणी ||
text_mt: The mark of the descent of power is the arising of awakening and bliss, / since that supreme power has the form of awakening and bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
ānandabodhayorliṅgamantaḥkaraṇavikriyāḥ |
yathā syātkamparomāñcasvaranetrāṅgavikriyāḥ ||
meaning:
आनन्दबोधयोर्लिङ्गमन्तःकरणविक्रियाः |
यथा स्यात्कम्परोमाञ्चस्वरनेत्राङ्गविक्रियाः ||
text_mt: The sign of bliss and awakening consists in transformations of the internal organ, / such as trembling, horripilation, and transformations of voice, eyes, and limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyo'pi lakṣaṇairebhiḥ kuryādguruparīkṣaṇam |
tatsamparkaiḥ śivārcādau saṅgatairvātha tadgataiḥ ||
meaning:
शिष्योऽपि लक्षणैरेभिः कुर्याद्गुरुपरीक्षणम् |
तत्सम्पर्कैः शिवार्चादौ सङ्गतैर्वाथ तद्गतैः ||
text_mt: The disciple too should test the guru by these marks, / by contact with him, or in the worship of Śiva and the like, through those who associate with him or are devoted to him.

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyastu śikṣaṇīyatvādgurorgauravakāraṇāt |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena gurorgauravamācaret ||
meaning:
शिष्यस्तु शिक्षणीयत्वाद्गुरोर्गौरवकारणात् |
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन गुरोर्गौरवमाचरेत् ||
text_mt: The disciple, however, being one to be instructed, because of the guru's venerability, / must therefore treat the guru with veneration by every effort.

sanskrit_iast:
yo guruḥ sa śivaḥ prokto yaḥ śivaḥ sa guruḥ smṛtaḥ |
gururvā śiva evātha vidyākāreṇa saṃsthitaḥ ||
meaning:
यो गुरुः स शिवः प्रोक्तो यः शिवः स गुरुः स्मृतः |
गुरुर्वा शिव एवाथ विद्याकारेण संस्थितः ||
text_mt: He who is the guru is declared to be Śiva; he who is Śiva is remembered as the guru; / or the guru is Śiva himself established in the form of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā śivastathā vidyā yathā vidyā tathā guruḥ |
śivavidyā gurūṇāṃ ca pūjayā sadṛśaṃ phalam ||
meaning:
यथा शिवस्तथा विद्या यथा विद्या तथा गुरुः |
शिवविद्या गुरूणां च पूजया सदृशं फलम् ||
text_mt: As Śiva is, so is knowledge; as knowledge is, so is the guru; / and through the worship of Śiva, knowledge, and gurus, the fruit is equal.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevātmakaścāsau sarvamantramayo guruḥ |
tasmātsarvaprayatnena yasyājñāṃ śirasā vahet ||
meaning:
सर्वदेवात्मकश्चासौ सर्वमन्त्रमयो गुरुः |
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन यस्याज्ञां शिरसा वहेत् ||
text_mt: And this guru embodies all the gods and consists of all mantras; / therefore one should bear his command on one's head with every effort.

sanskrit_iast:
śreyo'rthī yadi gurvājñāṃ manasāpi na laṅghayet |
gurvājñāpālako yasmāt jñānasampattimaśnute ||
meaning:
श्रेयोऽर्थी यदि गुर्वाज्ञां मनसापि न लङ्घयेत् |
गुर्वाज्ञापालको यस्मात् ज्ञानसम्पत्तिमश्नुते ||
text_mt: If one desires the good, one should not transgress the guru's command even in thought, / because one who obeys the guru's command attains the wealth of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchaṃstiṣṭhan svapan bhuñjannānyatkarma samācaret |
samakṣaṃ yadi kurvīta sarvaṃ cānujñayā guroḥ ||
meaning:
गच्छंस्तिष्ठन् स्वपन् भुञ्जन्नान्यत्कर्म समाचरेत् |
समक्षं यदि कुर्वीत सर्वं चानुज्ञया गुरोः ||
text_mt: Walking, standing, sleeping, or eating, one should perform no other deed [without him]; / if doing something in his presence, all should be done with the guru's permission.

sanskrit_iast:
gurorgṛhe samakṣaṃ vā na yatheṣṭāsano bhavet |
gururdevo yataḥ sākṣāttadgṛhaṃ devamandiram ||
meaning:
गुरोर्गृहे समक्षं वा न यथेष्टासनो भवेत् |
गुरुर्देवो यतः साक्षात्तद्गृहं देवमन्दिरम् ||
text_mt: In the guru's house or in his presence, one should not sit as one pleases, / for the guru is God manifest, and his house is the temple of God.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpināṃ ca yathā saṅgāttatpāpātpatito bhavet |
yatheha vahnisamparkāt malaṃ tyajati kāñcanam |
tathaiva gurusamparkāt pāpaṃ tyajati mānavaḥ ||
meaning:
पापिनां च यथा सङ्गात्तत्पापात्पतितो भवेत् |
यथेह वह्निसम्पर्कात् मलं त्यजति काञ्चनम् |
तथैव गुरुसम्पर्कात् पापं त्यजति मानवः ||
text_mt: And just as from the association with sinners one would fall because of their sin, / just as here gold sheds its impurity through contact with fire, / so too a human being sheds sin through contact with the guru.

sanskrit_iast: yathā vahnisamīpastho ghṛtakumbho vilīyate tathā pāpaṃ vilīyeta hyācāryasya samīpataḥ ||
meaning: यथा वह्निसमीपस्थो घृतकुम्भो विलीयते तथा पापं विलीयेत ह्याचार्यस्य समीपतः ||
text_mt: Just as a pot of ghee placed near fire melts away, / so indeed sin melts away in the vicinity of the preceptor.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā prajvalito vahniḥ śuṣkamārdraṃ ca nirdahet |
tathāyamapi santuṣṭo guruḥ pāpaṃ kṣaṇāddahet ||
meaning:
यथा प्रज्वलितो वह्निः शुष्कमार्द्रं च निर्दहेत् |
तथायमपि सन्तुष्टो गुरुः पापं क्षणाद्दहेत् ||
text_mt: Just as a blazing fire burns dry and moist alike, / so this guru, when pleased, burns away sin in an instant.

sanskrit_iast: manasā karmaṇā vācā guroḥ krodhaṃ na kārayet ||
meaning: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा गुरोः क्रोधं न कारयेत् ||
text_mt: One should not cause anger in the guru in mind, deed, or speech;

sanskrit_iast:
tasya krodhena dahyante hyāyuḥ śrījñānasatkriyāḥ |
tatkrodhakāriṇo ye syusteṣāṃ yajñāśca niṣphalāḥ ||
meaning:
तस्य क्रोधेन दह्यन्ते ह्यायुः श्रीज्ञानसत्क्रियाः |
तत्क्रोधकारिणो ये स्युस्तेषां यज्ञाश्च निष्फलाः ||
text_mt: By his anger, longevity, prosperity, knowledge, and virtuous deeds are burned away; / and those who cause his anger have their sacrifices rendered fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
yamaśca niyamāścaiva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
gurorviruddhaṃ yadvākyaṃ na vadejjātucinnaraḥ ||
meaning:
यमश्च नियमाश्चैव नात्र कार्या विचारणा |
गुरोर्विरुद्धं यद्वाक्यं न वदेज्जातुचिन्नरः ||
text_mt: Restraints and observances [also become fruitless]; there should be no doubt about this. / A man should never speak any word contrary to the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
vadedyadi mahāmohādrauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet |
manasā karmaṇā vācā gurumuddiśya yatnataḥ ||
meaning:
वदेद्यदि महामोहाद्रौरवं नरकं व्रजेत् |
मनसा कर्मणा वाचा गुरुमुद्दिश्य यत्नतः ||
text_mt: If he should speak out of great delusion, he would go to the Raurava hell. / In mind, deed, and speech, with effort toward the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
śreyo'rthī cennaro dhīmānna mithyācāramācaret |
gurorhitaṃ priyaṃ kuryādādiṣṭo vā na vā sadā ||
meaning:
श्रेयोऽर्थी चेन्नरो धीमान्न मिथ्याचारमाचरेत् |
गुरोर्हितं प्रियं कुर्यादादिष्टो वा न वा सदा ||
text_mt: if a wise man desires the good, he must not practice hypocrisy. / He should do what is beneficial and pleasing to the guru, always, whether commanded or not.

sanskrit_iast:
asamakṣaṃ samakṣaṃ vā tasya kāryaṃ samācaret |
itthamācāravānbhakto nityamudyuktamānasaḥ ||
meaning:
असमक्षं समक्षं वा तस्य कार्यं समाचरेत् |
इत्थमाचारवान्भक्तो नित्यमुद्युक्तमानसः ||
text_mt: In his absence or in his presence, he should carry out his work. / A devotee who conducts himself thus, whose mind is ever diligent,

sanskrit_iast:
gurupriyakaraḥ śiṣyaḥ śaivadharmāṃstato'rhati |
guruścedguṇavān prājñaḥ paramānandabhāsakaḥ ||
meaning:
गुरुप्रियकरः शिष्यः शैवधर्मांस्ततोऽर्हति |
गुरुश्चेद्गुणवान् प्राज्ञः परमानन्दभासकः ||
text_mt: a disciple who does what pleases the guru, is then worthy of the Śaiva virtues. / If the guru is virtuous, wise, illuminating supreme bliss,

sanskrit_iast:
tattvavicchivasaṃsakto muktido na tu cāparaḥ |
saṃvitsañjananaṃ tattvaṃ paramānandasambhavam ||
meaning:
तत्त्वविच्छिवसंसक्तो मुक्तिदो न तु चापरः |
संवित्सञ्जननं तत्त्वं परमानन्दसम्भवम् ||
text_mt: knower of reality, attached to Śiva, he gives liberation, and no other; / the reality that generates consciousness arises from supreme bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
tattattvaṃ viditaṃ yena sa evānandadarśakaḥ |
na punarnāmamātreṇa saṃvidārahitastu yaḥ ||
meaning:
तत्तत्त्वं विदितं येन स एवानन्ददर्शकः |
न पुनर्नाममात्रेण संविदारहितस्तु यः ||
text_mt: He by whom that reality is known is indeed the shower of bliss; / but not one who has it in name alone, who is devoid of consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
anyo'nyaṃ tārayennaukā kiṃ śilā tārayecchilām |
etasya nāmamātreṇa muktirvai nāmamātrikā ||
meaning:
अन्योऽन्यं तारयेन्नौका किं शिला तारयेच्छिलाम् |
एतस्य नाममात्रेण मुक्तिर्वै नाममात्रिका ||
text_mt: A boat may carry another across; can a stone carry a stone across? / For one [who is a guru] in name alone, liberation is indeed only nominal.

sanskrit_iast:
yaiḥ punarviditaṃ tattvaṃ te muktā mocayantyapi |
tattvahīne kuto bodhaḥ kuto hyātmaparigrahaḥ ||
meaning:
यैः पुनर्विदितं तत्त्वं ते मुक्ता मोचयन्त्यपि |
तत्त्वहीने कुतो बोधः कुतो ह्यात्मपरिग्रहः ||
text_mt: Those by whom reality is known, however, are liberated and liberate others as well; / for one lacking reality, whence could come awakening, whence the acceptance of the self?

sanskrit_iast:
parigrahavinirmuktaḥ paśurityabhidhīyate |
paśubhiḥ preritaścāpi paśutvaṃ nātivartate ||
meaning:
परिग्रहविनिर्मुक्तः पशुरित्यभिधीयते |
पशुभिः प्रेरितश्चापि पशुत्वं नातिवर्तते ||
text_mt: One devoid of acceptance is called a bound soul; / and even when impelled by bound souls, he does not transcend soulhood.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttattvavideveha mukto mocaka iṣyate |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaḥ sarvaśāstravidapyayam ||
meaning:
तस्मात्तत्त्वविदेवेह मुक्तो मोचक इष्यते |
सर्वलक्षणसंयुक्तः सर्वशास्त्रविदप्ययम् ||
text_mt: Therefore, only the knower of reality here is accepted as liberated and a liberator. / Even though possessed of all marks and knowing all scriptures,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvopāyavidhijño'pi tattvahīnastu niṣphalaḥ |
yasyānubhavaparyantā buddhistattve pravartate ||
meaning:
सर्वोपायविधिज्ञोऽपि तत्त्वहीनस्तु निष्फलः |
यस्यानुभवपर्यन्ता बुद्धिस्तत्त्वे प्रवर्तते ||
text_mt: even though knowing the rules of all means, one who lacks reality is fruitless. / He whose intellect extends to reality culminating in direct experience—

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāvalokanādyaiśca parānando'bhijāyate |
tasmādyasyaiva samparkātprabodhānandasambhavaḥ ||
meaning:
तस्यावलोकनाद्यैश्च परानन्दोऽभिजायते |
तस्माद्यस्यैव सम्पर्कात्प्रबोधानन्दसम्भवः ||
text_mt: from the mere sight of him supreme bliss is born. / Therefore, him alone through whose contact awakening and bliss arise,

sanskrit_iast:
guruṃ tameva vṛṇuyānnāparaṃ matimānnaraḥ |
sa śiṣyairvinayācāracaturairucito guruḥ ||
meaning:
गुरुं तमेव वृणुयान्नापरं मतिमान्नरः |
स शिष्यैर्विनयाचारचतुरैरुचितो गुरुः ||
text_mt: him alone should a wise man choose as guru, and no other. / He is the guru suitable for disciples skilled in humility and proper conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadvijñāyate tāvatsevanīyo mumukṣubhiḥ |
jñāte tasminsthirā bhaktiryāvattattvaṃ samāśrayet ||
meaning:
यावद्विज्ञायते तावत्सेवनीयो मुमुक्षुभिः |
ज्ञाते तस्मिन्स्थिरा भक्तिर्यावत्तत्त्वं समाश्रयेत् ||
text_mt: He should be served by seekers of liberation as long as [reality] is being understood; / when it is known, steady devotion should resort to reality as long as [life lasts].

sanskrit_iast:
na tu tattvaṃ tyajejjātu nopekṣeta kathañcana |
yatrānandaḥ prabodho vā nālpamapyupalabhyate ||
meaning:
न तु तत्त्वं त्यजेज्जातु नोपेक्षेत कथञ्चन |
यत्रानन्दः प्रबोधो वा नाल्पमप्युपलभ्यते ||
text_mt: Yet one must never abandon reality, nor ever neglect it. / Where bliss or awakening is not obtained even in the least,

sanskrit_iast:
vatsarādapi śiṣyeṇa so'nyaṃ gurumupāśrayet |
gurumanyaṃ prapanne'pi nāvamanyeta paurvikam |
gurorbhrātṝṃstathā putrān bodhakān prerakānapi ||
meaning:
वत्सरादपि शिष्येण सोऽन्यं गुरुमुपाश्रयेत् |
गुरुमन्यं प्रपन्नेऽपि नावमन्येत पौर्विकम् |
गुरोर्भ्रातॄंस्तथा पुत्रान् बोधकान् प्रेरकानपि ||
text_mt: even after a year, the disciple should take refuge in another guru. / Even when resorting to another guru, he should not disrespect the former one, / nor the guru's brothers, nor his sons, who are awakeners and instigators.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrādāvupasaṅgamya brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam |
gurumārādhayetprājñaṃ śubhagaṃ priyadarśanam ||
meaning:
तत्रादावुपसङ्गम्य ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम् |
गुरुमाराधयेत्प्राज्ञं शुभगं प्रियदर्शनम् ||
text_mt: There, having first approached a Brahmin who has crossed to the other shore of the Veda, / he should worship the guru, who is wise, fortunate, and of pleasing appearance,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābhayapradātāraṃ karuṇākrāntamānasam |
toṣayettaṃ prayatnena manasā karmaṇā girā ||
meaning:
सर्वाभयप्रदातारं करुणाक्रान्तमानसम् |
तोषयेत्तं प्रयत्नेन मनसा कर्मणा गिरा ||
text_mt: the bestower of all fearlessness, whose mind is overcome with compassion; / he should please him with effort, in mind, deed, and speech.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadārādhayecchiṣyaḥ prasanno'sau bhavedyathā |
tasmin prasanne śiṣyasya sadyaḥ pāpakṣayo bhavet ||
meaning:
तावदाराधयेच्छिष्यः प्रसन्नोऽसौ भवेद्यथा |
तस्मिन् प्रसन्ने शिष्यस्य सद्यः पापक्षयो भवेत् ||
text_mt: The disciple should worship him as long as needed so that he becomes pleased; / when he is pleased, the disciple's sins are destroyed immediately.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddhanāni ratnāni kṣetrāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca |
bhūṣaṇāni ca vāsāṃsi yānaśayyāsanāni ca ||
meaning:
तस्माद्धनानि रत्नानि क्षेत्राणि च गृहाणि च |
भूषणानि च वासांसि यानशय्यासनानि च ||
text_mt: Therefore, wealth, gems, fields, and houses, / ornaments, clothes, vehicles, beds, and seats [should be offered to him]—

sanskrit_iast:
etāni gurave dadyādbhaktyā vittānusārataḥ |
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchetparamāṃ gatim ||
meaning:
एतानि गुरवे दद्याद्भक्त्या वित्तानुसारतः |
वित्तशाठ्यं न कुर्वीत यदीच्छेत्परमां गतिम् ||
text_mt: One should give these to the guru with devotion, according to one's wealth; / one should not practice deceit regarding wealth, if one desires the supreme goal.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva janako mātā bhartā bandhurdhanaṃ sukham |
sakhā mitraṃ ca yattasmātsarvaṃ tasmai nivedayet ||
meaning:
स एव जनको माता भर्ता बन्धुर्धनं सुखम् |
सखा मित्रं च यत्तस्मात्सर्वं तस्मै निवेदयेत् ||
text_mt: He alone is father, mother, husband, relative, wealth, happiness, / comrade, and friend; therefore, one should offer everything to him.

sanskrit_iast:
nivedya paścātsvātmānaṃ sānvayaṃ saparigraham |
samarpya sodakaṃ tasmai nityaṃ tadvaśago bhavet ||
meaning:
निवेद्य पश्चात्स्वात्मानं सान्वयं सपरिग्रहम् |
समर्प्य सोदकं तस्मै नित्यं तद्वशगो भवेत् ||
text_mt: Having offered [all], one should then surrender oneself along with one's family and possessions, / together with water, unto him, and remain always obedient to his will.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā śivāya svātmānaṃ dattavān deśikātmane |
tadā śaivo bhaveddehī na tato'sti punarbhavaḥ ||
meaning:
यदा शिवाय स्वात्मानं दत्तवान् देशिकात्मने |
तदा शैवो भवेद्देही न ततोऽस्ति पुनर्भवः ||
text_mt: When an embodied soul gives himself to Śiva in the person of the guru, / he then becomes a Śaiva; from then on there is no rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
guruśca svāśritaṃ śiṣyaṃ varṣamekaṃ parīkṣayet |
brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ dvivarṣaṃ ca trivarṣakam ||
meaning:
गुरुश्च स्वाश्रितं शिष्यं वर्षमेकं परीक्षयेत् |
ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियं वैश्यं द्विवर्षं च त्रिवर्षकम् ||
text_mt: And the guru should test a pupil who has sought refuge with him for one year, / a brāhmaṇa for one year, a kṣatriya for two years, and a vaiśya for three years,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇadravyapradānādyairādeśaiśca samāsamaiḥ |
uttamāṃścādhame kṛtvā nīcānuttamakarmaṇi ||
meaning:
प्राणद्रव्यप्रदानाद्यैरादेशैश्च समासमैः |
उत्तमांश्चाधमे कृत्वा नीचानुत्तमकर्मणि ||
text_mt: by demanding life, wealth, and the like, and through equal and unequal commands, / assigning the high-born to base work and the low-born to noble work.

sanskrit_iast:
ākruṣṭāstāḍitā vāpi ye viṣādaṃ na yāntyapi |
te yogyāḥ saṃyatāḥ śuddhāḥ śivasaṃskārakarmaṇi ||
meaning:
आक्रुष्टास्ताडिता वापि ये विषादं न यान्त्यपि |
ते योग्याः संयताः शुद्धाः शिवसंस्कारकर्मणि ||
text_mt: Those who do not despond even when reviled or beaten, / they are fit, self-controlled, and purified for the consecration rites of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsakā dayāvanto nityamudyuktacetasaḥ |
amānino buddhimantaḥ tyaktasparddhāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ ||
meaning:
अहिंसका दयावन्तो नित्यमुद्युक्तचेतसः |
अमानिनो बुद्धिमन्तः त्यक्तस्पर्द्धाः प्रियंवदाः ||
text_mt: Non-violent, compassionate, constantly energetic in mind, / humble, intelligent, free from rivalry, speaking pleasantly,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛjavo mṛdavaḥ svacchā vinītāḥ sthiracetasaḥ |
śaucācārasamāyuktāḥ śivabhaktā dvijātayaḥ ||
meaning:
ऋजवो मृदवः स्वच्छा विनीताः स्थिरचेतसः |
शौचाचारसमायुक्ताः शिवभक्ता द्विजातयः ||
text_mt: upright, gentle, pure, well-behaved, firm in mind, / endowed with clean conduct, devoted to Śiva—such are the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vṛttasamopetā vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ |
śodhyā bodhyā yathānyāyamiti śāstreṣu niścayaḥ ||
meaning:
एवं वृत्तसमोपेता वाङ्मनःकायकर्मभिः |
शोध्या बोध्या यथान्यायमिति शास्त्रेषु निश्चयः ||
text_mt: Endowed with such conduct in actions of speech, mind, and body, / they are to be purified and instructed according to rule: this is the decision in the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
nādhikāraḥ svato nāryāḥ śivasaṃskārakarmaṇi |
niyogādbharturastyeva bhaktiyuktā yadīśvare ||
meaning:
नाधिकारः स्वतो नार्याः शिवसंस्कारकर्मणि |
नियोगाद्भर्तुरस्त्येव भक्तियुक्ता यदीश्वरे ||
text_mt: A woman has no independent eligibility for the consecration rites of Śiva; / she has it indeed by her husband’s direction, if she is endowed with devotion to the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva bhartṛhīnāyā putrāderabhyanujñayā |
adhikāro bhavatyeva kanyāyāḥ piturājñayā |
śūdrāṇāṃ martyajātīnāṃ patitānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
तथैव भर्तृहीनाया पुत्रादेरभ्यनुज्ञया |
अधिकारो भवत्येव कन्यायाः पितुराज्ञया |
शूद्राणां मर्त्यजातीनां पतितानां विशेषतः ||
text_mt: Likewise, a woman without a husband [has eligibility] by the permission of her son and others; / an unmarried girl has eligibility indeed by her father's order. / For śūdras, mortal castes, and especially fallen persons,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā saṅkarajātīnāṃ nādhvaśuddhirvidhīyate |
tai'pyakṛtrimabhāvāścecchive paramakāraṇe ||
meaning:
तथा सङ्करजातीनां नाध्वशुद्धिर्विधीयते |
तैऽप्यकृत्रिमभावाश्चेच्छिवे परमकारणे ||
text_mt: as well as mixed castes, purification of the paths is not prescribed. / Yet if they possess genuine devotion to Śiva, the supreme cause,

sanskrit_iast:
pādodakapradānādyaiḥ kuryuḥ pāpaviśodhanam |
atrānulomajātā ye yuktā eva dvijātiṣu ||
meaning:
पादोदकप्रदानाद्यैः कुर्युः पापविशोधनम् |
अत्रानुलोमजाता ये युक्ता एव द्विजातिषु ||
text_mt: they may effect the purification of sin by offering water for his feet and the like. / In this regard, those born in the natural order who are associated with the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmadhvaviśuddhyādi kuryānmātṛkulocitam |
yā tu kanyā svapitrādyaiḥ śivadharme niyojitā ||
meaning:
तेषामध्वविशुद्ध्यादि कुर्यान्मातृकुलोचितम् |
या तु कन्या स्वपित्राद्यैः शिवधर्मे नियोजिता ||
text_mt: for them one should perform the purification of the paths and the like appropriate to the maternal family. / But a girl who is dedicated to the Śaiva path by her parents and others,

sanskrit_iast:
sā bhaktāya pradātavyā nāparāya virodhine |
dattā cetpratikūlāya pramādādbodhayetpatim ||
meaning:
सा भक्ताय प्रदातव्या नापराय विरोधिने |
दत्ता चेत्प्रतिकूलाय प्रमादाद्बोधयेत्पतिम् ||
text_mt: she should be given to a devotee, not to another who is opposed. / If by error she is given to an adversary, she should awaken her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
aśaktā taṃ parityajya manasā dharmamācaret |
yathā munivaraṃ tyaktvā patimatriṃ pativratā ||
meaning:
अशक्ता तं परित्यज्य मनसा धर्ममाचरेत् |
यथा मुनिवरं त्यक्त्वा पतिमत्रिं पतिव्रता ||
text_mt: If unable, she should abandon him and practice dharma in her mind, / just as in the past, having abandoned the excellent sage, her husband Atri, a devoted wife

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtakṛtyābhavatpūrvaṃ tapasārādhya śaṅkaram |
yathā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tapasārādhya pāṇḍavāḥ ||
meaning:
कृतकृत्याभवत्पूर्वं तपसाराध्य शङ्करम् |
यथा नारायणं देवं तपसाराध्य पाण्डवाः ||
text_mt: became one who achieved her goal by worshipping Śaṅkara through austerity; / just as the Pāṇḍavas [obtained their end] by worshipping Lord Nārāyaṇa through austerity;

sanskrit_iast:
patatīm̐llabdhavatī dharme gurubhirna niyojitā |
asvātantryakṛto doṣo nehāsti paramārthataḥ ||
meaning:
पततीम्̐ल्लब्धवती धर्मे गुरुभिर्न नियोजिता |
अस्वातन्त्र्यकृतो दोषो नेहास्ति परमार्थतः ||
text_mt: she who obtained husbands was not directed in dharma by her elders. / In truth, there is no fault here born of lack of independence

sanskrit_iast:
śivadharme niyuktāyāḥ śivaśāsanagauravāt |
bahunātra kimuktena yo'pi ko'pi śivāśrayaḥ ||
meaning:
शिवधर्मे नियुक्तायाः शिवशासनगौरवात् |
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन योऽपि कोऽपि शिवाश्रयः ||
text_mt: for a woman engaged in the Śaiva path, due to the gravity of Śiva’s command. / What is the use of speaking much on this matter? Whoever has taken refuge in Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskāryo gurvadhīnaścetsaṃskriyā na prabhidyate |
gurorālokanādeva sparśātsambhāṣaṇādapi ||
meaning:
संस्कार्यो गुर्वधीनश्चेत्संस्क्रिया न प्रभिद्यते |
गुरोरालोकनादेव स्पर्शात्सम्भाषणादपि ||
text_mt: is fit to be consecrated; if he is subordinate to the guru, the consecration does not fail. / From the mere glance of the guru, from his touch, or even from his conversation,

sanskrit_iast:
yasya sañjāyate prajñā tasya nāsti parājayaḥ |
manasā yastu saṃskāraḥ kriyate yogavartmanā ||
meaning:
यस्य सञ्जायते प्रज्ञा तस्य नास्ति पराजयः |
मनसा यस्तु संस्कारः क्रियते योगवर्त्मना ||
text_mt: one in whom wisdom arises suffers no defeat. / But the consecration which is performed mentally by the path of yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
sa neha kathito guhyo guruvaktraikagocaraḥ |
kriyāvān yastu saṃskāraḥ kuṇḍamaṇḍapapūrvakaḥ |
sa vakṣyate samāsena tasya śakyo na vistaraḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
स नेह कथितो गुह्यो गुरुवक्त्रैकगोचरः |
क्रियावान् यस्तु संस्कारः कुण्डमण्डपपूर्वकः |
स वक्ष्यते समासेन तस्य शक्यो न विस्तरः ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
that is not spoken of here; it is secret, accessible only through the guru's mouth. / But the consecration involving rituals, preceded by fire-pit and pavilion, / that will be described in brief; its detailed account is impossible [to give fully].

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
puṇye'hani śucau deśe bahudoṣavivarjite |
deśikaḥ prathamaṃ kuryātsaṃskāraṃ samayāhvayam ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
पुण्येऽहनि शुचौ देशे बहुदोषविवर्जिते |
देशिकः प्रथमं कुर्यात्संस्कारं समयाह्वयम् ||
title: ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śiṣyasaṃskāravarṇanam
text_mt:
Chapter 16
Upamanyu said:
On an auspicious day, in a pure place, free from many defects,
the spiritual guide should first perform the sacrament called Samaya,
having properly examined the ground by its smell, colour, taste, and other qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
parīkṣya bhūmiṃ vidhivad gandhavarṇarasādibhiḥ |
śilpiśāstroktamārgeṇa maṇḍapaṃ tatra kalpayet ||
meaning:
परीक्ष्य भूमिं विधिवद् गन्धवर्णरसादिभिः |
शिल्पिशास्त्रोक्तमार्गेण मण्डपं तत्र कल्पयेत् ||
text_mt:
There he should construct a pavilion in accordance with the method stated in the architectural treatises,
and having made an altar in its centre, he should prepare fire-pits

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā vediṃ ca tanmadhye kuṇḍāni parikalpayet |
aṣṭadikṣu tathā dikṣu tatraiśānyāṃ punaḥ kramāt ||
meaning:
कृत्वा वेदिं च तन्मध्ये कुण्डानि परिकल्पयेत् |
अष्टदिक्षु तथा दिक्षु तत्रैशान्यां पुनः क्रमात् ||
text_mt:
in the eight directions; then, in due order, in the north-east
he should make the principal fire-pit, or alternatively in the western portion.

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānakuṇḍaṃ kurvīta yadvā paścimabhāgataḥ |
pradhānamekamevātha kṛtvā śobhāṃ prakalpayet ||
meaning:
प्रधानकुण्डं कुर्वीत यद्वा पश्चिमभागतः |
प्रधानमेकमेवाथ कृत्वा शोभां प्रकल्पयेत् ||
text_mt:
Or having made only one principal pit, he should arrange the decoration
with various and numerous canopies, banners, and garlands.

sanskrit_iast:
vitānadhvajamālābhirvividhābhiranekaśaḥ |
vedimadhye tataḥ kuryānmaṇḍalaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam ||
meaning:
वितानध्वजमालाभिर्विविधाभिरनेकशः |
वेदिमध्ये ततः कुर्यान्मण्डलं शुभलक्षणम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
raktahemādibhiścūrṇairīśvarāvāhanocitam |
sindūraśālinīvāracūrṇairevātha nirdhanaḥ ||
meaning:
रक्तहेमादिभिश्चूर्णैरीश्वरावाहनोचितम् |
सिन्दूरशालिनीवारचूर्णैरेवाथ निर्धनः ||

sanskrit_iast:
ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā sitaṃ vā raktameva vā |
ekahastasya padmasya karṇikāṣṭāṅgulā matā ||
meaning:
एकहस्तं द्विहस्तं वा सितं वा रक्तमेव वा |
एकहस्तस्य पद्मस्य कर्णिकाष्टाङ्गुला मता ||

sanskrit_iast:
kesarāṇi tadardhāni śeṣaṃ cāṣṭadalādikam |
dvihastasya tu padmasya dviguṇaṃ karṇikādikam ||
meaning:
केसराणि तदर्धानि शेषं चाष्टदलादिकम् |
द्विहस्तस्य तु पद्मस्य द्विगुणं कर्णिकादिकम् ||
text_mt:
For a lotus of two cubits, the pericarp and other parts are doubled.
Having made it rich in beauty and embellishment, he should prepare in the north-east

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā śobhopaśobhāḍhya maiśānyāṃ tasya kalpayet |
ekahastaṃ tadarddhaṃ vā punarvedyāṃ tu maṇḍalam ||
meaning:
कृत्वा शोभोपशोभाढ्य मैशान्यां तस्य कल्पयेत् |
एकहस्तं तदर्द्धं वा पुनर्वेद्यां तु मण्डलम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
vrīhitandulasiddhārthatilapuṣpakuśāstṛte |
tatra lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ śivakumbhaṃ prasādhayet ||
meaning:
व्रीहितन्दुलसिद्धार्थतिलपुष्पकुशास्तृते |
तत्र लक्षणसंयुक्तं शिवकुम्भं प्रसाधयेत् ||
text_mt:
There he should arrange Śiva's pot, endowed with the proper characteristics,
made of gold, silver, copper, or clay,

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi tāmrajaṃ mṛnmayaṃ tu vā |
gandhapuṣpākṣatākīrṇaṃ kuśadūrvāṅkurācitam ||
meaning:
सौवर्णं राजतं वापि ताम्रजं मृन्मयं तु वा |
गन्धपुष्पाक्षताकीर्णं कुशदूर्वाङ्कुराचितम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
sitasūtrāvṛtaṃ kaṇṭhe navavastrayugāvṛtam |
śuddhāmbupūrṇamutkūrcaṃ sadravyaṃ sapidhānakam ||
meaning:
सितसूत्रावृतं कण्ठे नववस्त्रयुगावृतम् |
शुद्धाम्बुपूर्णमुत्कूर्चं सद्रव्यं सपिधानकम् ||
text_mt:
filled with pure water, furnished with a kūrca, containing ritual substances, provided with a lid,
as well as a spouted pitcher and a vardhanī vessel, a conch, or a discus,

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛṅgāraṃ vardhanīṃ cāpi śaṅkhaṃ ca cakrameva vā |
vinā sūtrādikaṃ sarvaṃ padmapatramathāpi vā ||
meaning:
भृङ्गारं वर्धनीं चापि शङ्खं च चक्रमेव वा |
विना सूत्रादिकं सर्वं पद्मपत्रमथापि वा ||

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāsanāravindasya kalpayeduttare dale |
agrataścandanāmbhobhirastrarājasya vardhanīm ||
meaning:
तस्यासनारविन्दस्य कल्पयेदुत्तरे दले |
अग्रतश्चन्दनाम्भोभिरस्त्रराजस्य वर्धनीम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalasya tataḥ prācyāṃ mantrakumbhe ca pūrvavat |
kṛtvā vidhivadīśasya mahāpūjāṃ samācaret ||
meaning:
मण्डलस्य ततः प्राच्यां मन्त्रकुम्भे च पूर्ववत् |
कृत्वा विधिवदीशस्य महापूजां समाचरेत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
athārṇavasya tīre vā nadyāṃ goṣṭhe'pi vā girau |
devāgare gṛhe vāpi deśe'nyasminmanohare ||
meaning:
अथार्णवस्य तीरे वा नद्यां गोष्ठेऽपि वा गिरौ |
देवागरे गृहे वापि देशेऽन्यस्मिन्मनोहरे ||

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā pūrvoditaṃ sarvaṃ vinā vā maṇḍapādikam |
maṇḍalaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ ca vibhāvasoḥ ||
meaning:
कृत्वा पूर्वोदितं सर्वं विना वा मण्डपादिकम् |
मण्डलं पूर्ववत्कृत्वा स्थण्डिलं च विभावसोः ||

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya pūjābhavanaṃ prahṛṣṭavadano guruḥ |
sarvamaṅgalasaṃyuktaḥ samācaritanaityakaḥ ||
meaning:
प्रविश्य पूजाभवनं प्रहृष्टवदनो गुरुः |
सर्वमङ्गलसंयुक्तः समाचरितनैत्यकः ||

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpūjāṃ maheśasya kṛtvā maṇḍalamadhyataḥ |
śivakumbhe tathā bhūyaḥ śivamāvāhya pūjayet ||
meaning:
महापूजां महेशस्य कृत्वा मण्डलमध्यतः |
शिवकुम्भे तथा भूयः शिवमावाह्य पूजयेत् ||
text_mt: having performed the great worship of Maheśa in the middle of the diagram, / and having invoked Śiva in the Śiva-pitcher, should worship him again.

sanskrit_iast:
paścimābhimukhaṃ dhyātvā yajñarakṣakamīśvaram |
arcayedastravarddhanyāmastramīśasya dakṣiṇe ||
meaning:
पश्चिमाभिमुखं ध्यात्वा यज्ञरक्षकमीश्वरम् |
अर्चयेदस्त्रवर्द्धन्यामस्त्रमीशस्य दक्षिणे ||
text_mt: Having meditated on the Lord facing west as the protector of the sacrifice, / he should worship the weapon of the Lord to his right, in the weapon-pitcher.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrakumbhe ca vinyasya mantraṃ mantraviśāradaḥ |
kṛtvā mudrādikaṃ sarvaṃ mantrayāgaṃ samācaret ||
meaning:
मन्त्रकुम्भे च विन्यस्य मन्त्रं मन्त्रविशारदः |
कृत्वा मुद्रादिकं सर्वं मन्त्रयागं समाचरेत् ||
text_mt: And having placed the mantra in the mantra-pitcher, skilled in mantras, / having made all the mudrās and the like, he should perform the sacrifice of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śivānale homaṃ kuryāddeśikasattamaḥ |
pradhānakuṇḍe parito juhuyuścāpare dvijāḥ ||
meaning:
ततः शिवानले होमं कुर्याद्देशिकसत्तमः |
प्रधानकुण्डे परितो जुहुयुश्चापरे द्विजाः ||
text_mt: Then the best of teachers should offer oblations into the fire of Śiva; / around the principal fire-pit other twice-born men should make offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryātpādamarddhaṃ vā homasteṣāṃ vidhīyate |
pradhānakuṇḍa evātha juhuyāddeśikottamaḥ ||
meaning:
आचार्यात्पादमर्द्धं वा होमस्तेषां विधीयते |
प्रधानकुण्ड एवाथ जुहुयाद्देशिकोत्तमः ||
text_mt: Their offering of oblations is prescribed as a fourth or half of that of the preceptor; / or the best of teachers alone may make offerings in the principal fire-pit.

sanskrit_iast:
svādhyāyamapare kuryuḥ stotraṃ maṅgalavācanam |
japaṃ ca vidhivaccānye śivabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||
meaning:
स्वाध्यायमपरे कुर्युः स्तोत्रं मङ्गलवाचनम् |
जपं च विधिवच्चान्ये शिवभक्तिपरायणाः ||
text_mt: Others should perform sacred study, hymn-singing, and the recitation of auspicious verses; / and others devoted to Śiva's devotion [should perform] recitation according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca maṅgalānyaparāṇi ca |
pūjanaṃ ca sadasyānāṃ kṛtvā samyagvidhānataḥ ||
meaning:
नृत्यं गीतं च वाद्यं च मङ्गलान्यपराणि च |
पूजनं च सदस्यानां कृत्वा सम्यग्विधानतः ||
text_mt: Having duly performed dancing, singing, instrumental music, / other auspicious rites, and the honoring of the assembly according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyāhaṃ kārayitvātha punaḥ sampūjya śaṅkaram |
prārthayeddeśiko devaṃ śiṣyānugrahakāmyayā ||
meaning:
पुण्याहं कारयित्वाथ पुनः सम्पूज्य शङ्करम् |
प्रार्थयेद्देशिको देवं शिष्यानुग्रहकाम्यया ||
text_mt: having then had the auspicious day ceremony performed and worshipped Śaṅkara again, / the guru should pray to the God with a desire to bestow grace upon the disciple:

sanskrit_iast:
prasīda devadeveśa dehamāviśya māmakam |
vimocayainaṃ viśveśa ghṛṇayā ca ghṛṇānidhe ||
meaning:
प्रसीद देवदेवेश देहमाविश्य मामकम् |
विमोचयैनं विश्वेश घृणया च घृणानिधे ||
text_mt: "Be pleased, O Lord of the gods of gods! Having entered into my body, / release this [disciple], O Lord of the universe, out of compassion, O treasure of compassion!"

sanskrit_iast:
atha caivaṃ karomīti labdhānujñastu deśikaḥ |
ānīyopoṣitaṃ śiṣyaṃ haviṣyāśinameva vā ||
meaning:
अथ चैवं करोमीति लब्धानुज्ञस्तु देशिकः |
आनीयोपोषितं शिष्यं हविष्याशिनमेव वा ||
text_mt: Then, having obtained the permission—"I will do so"—the guru, / having brought the disciple who has fasted or eaten only sacrificial food,

sanskrit_iast:
ekāśanaṃ vā virataṃ snātaṃ prātaḥkṛtakriyam |
japantaṃ praṇavaṃ devaṃ dhyāyantaṃ kṛtamaṅgalam ||
meaning:
एकाशनं वा विरतं स्नातं प्रातःकृतक्रियम् |
जपन्तं प्रणवं देवं ध्यायन्तं कृतमङ्गलम् ||
text_mt: or eaten once a day, abstinent, bathed, having performed the morning rites, / reciting the praṇava, meditating on the God, and having auspicious marks applied,

sanskrit_iast:
dvārasya paścimasyāgramaṇḍale dakṣiṇasya vā |
darbhāsane samāsīnaṃ vidhāyodaṅmukhaṃ śiśum ||
meaning:
द्वारस्य पश्चिमस्याग्रमण्डले दक्षिणस्य वा |
दर्भासने समासीनं विधायोदङ्मुखं शिशुम् ||
text_mt: having made the child sit facing north on a darbha-grass seat / in the front of the western or southern door of the maṇḍala,

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ prāgvadanastiṣṭhannūrdhvakāyaṃ kṛtāñjalim |
samprokṣya prokṣaṇītoyairmūrddhanyastreṇa mudrayā ||
meaning:
स्वयं प्राग्वदनस्तिष्ठन्नूर्ध्वकायं कृताञ्जलिम् |
सम्प्रोक्ष्य प्रोक्षणीतोयैर्मूर्द्धन्यस्त्रेण मुद्रया ||
text_mt: himself standing facing east, with body erect and hands folded, / sprinkling [him] on the head with sprinkling waters using the Astra-mantra and mudrā,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpakṣepeṇa santāḍya badhnīyāllocanaṃ guruḥ |
dukūlārddhena vastreṇa mantritena navena ca ||
meaning:
पुष्पक्षेपेण सन्ताड्य बध्नीयाल्लोचनं गुरुः |
दुकूलार्द्धेन वस्त्रेण मन्त्रितेन नवेन च ||
text_mt: striking [him] with the casting of flowers, the guru should bind his eyes / with half a silken cloth that is fresh and consecrated with mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ praveśayecchiṣyaṃ gururdvāreṇa maṇḍalam |
so'pi teneritaḥ śambhorācaret triḥpradakṣiṇam ||
meaning:
ततः प्रवेशयेच्छिष्यं गुरुर्द्वारेण मण्डलम् |
सोऽपि तेनेरितः शम्भोराचरेत् त्रिःप्रदक्षिणम् ||
text_mt: Then the guru should lead the disciple through the entrance into the maṇḍala; / he, directed by him, should circumambulate Śambhu three times.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ suvarṇasammiśraṃ dattvā puṣpāñjaliṃ prabhoḥ |
prāṅmukhaścodaṅmukho vā praṇameddaṇḍavatkṣitau ||
meaning:
ततः सुवर्णसम्मिश्रं दत्त्वा पुष्पाञ्जलिं प्रभोः |
प्राङ्मुखश्चोदङ्मुखो वा प्रणमेद्दण्डवत्क्षितौ ||
text_mt: Then, having offered an añjali of flowers mixed with gold to the Lord, / facing east or facing north, he should bow prostrate like a staff upon the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samprokṣya mūlena śirasyastreṇa pūrvavat |
santāḍya deśikastasya mocayennetrabandhanam ||
meaning:
ततः सम्प्रोक्ष्य मूलेन शिरस्यस्त्रेण पूर्ववत् |
सन्ताड्य देशिकस्तस्य मोचयेन्नेत्रबन्धनम् ||
text_mt: Then, having sprinkled [him] with the root mantra on the head and struck [him] with the Astra-mantra as before, / the guru should release his eye-binding.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dṛṣṭvā maṇḍalaṃ bhūyaḥ praṇametsāñjaliḥ prabhum |
athāsīnaṃ śivācāryo maṇḍalasya tu dakṣiṇe ||
meaning:
स दृष्ट्वा मण्डलं भूयः प्रणमेत्साञ्जलिः प्रभुम् |
अथासीनं शिवाचार्यो मण्डलस्य तु दक्षिणे ||
text_mt: Seeing the maṇḍala, he should bow again with folded hands to the Lord. / Then the Śaiva master, seated to the south of the maṇḍala,

sanskrit_iast:
upaveśyātmanaḥ savye śiṣyaṃ darbhāsane guruḥ |
ārādhya ca mahādevaṃ śivahastaṃ pravinyaset ||
meaning:
उपवेश्यात्मनः सव्ये शिष्यं दर्भासने गुरुः |
आराध्य च महादेवं शिवहस्तं प्रविन्यसेत् ||
text_mt: having seated the disciple on a darbha-grass seat to his own left, / and having worshipped Mahādeva, the guru should place the Śiva-hand [upon him].

sanskrit_iast:
śivatejomayaṃ pāṇiṃ śivamantramudīrayet |
śivābhimānasampanno nyasecchiṣyasya mastake ||
meaning:
शिवतेजोमयं पाणिं शिवमन्त्रमुदीरयेत् |
शिवाभिमानसम्पन्नो न्यसेच्छिष्यस्य मस्तके ||
text_mt: He should utter the Śiva-mantra over his hand, which consists of Śiva's splendor, / and, possessed of identification with Śiva, place it upon the disciple's head.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṅgālambanaṃ caiva kuryāttenaiva deśikaḥ |
śiṣyo'pi praṇamedbhūmau deśikākṛtimīśvaram ||
meaning:
सर्वाङ्गालम्बनं चैव कुर्यात्तेनैव देशिकः |
शिष्योऽपि प्रणमेद्भूमौ देशिकाकृतिमीश्वरम् ||
text_mt: With that very [hand] the guru should also touch all his limbs; / and the disciple should prostrate on the ground to the Lord who has assumed the form of the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śivānale devaṃ samabhyarcya yathāvidhi |
hutāhutitrayaṃ śiṣyamupaveśya yathā purā ||
meaning:
ततः शिवानले देवं समभ्यर्च्य यथाविधि |
हुताहुतित्रयं शिष्यमुपवेश्य यथा पुरा ||
text_mt: Then, having worshipped the God properly in the fire of Śiva, / having offered three oblations, and having seated the disciple as before,

sanskrit_iast:
darbhāgraiḥ saṃspṛśaṃstaṃ ca vidyayātmānamāviśet |
namaskṛtya mahādevaṃ nāḍīsandhānamācaret ||
meaning:
दर्भाग्रैः संस्पृशंस्तं च विद्ययात्मानमाविशेत् |
नमस्कृत्य महादेवं नाडीसन्धानमाचरेत् ||
