meaning:
आपोहिष्ठादिभिर्मन्त्रैः शेषमाघ्राय वै जलम् |
वामनासापुटेनैव देवं सम्भावयेत्सितम् ||
text_mt: with the mantras beginning with "āpo hi ṣṭhā," having inhaled the remaining water / through the left nostril, he should visualize the white deity.

sanskrit_iast:
arghamādāya dehasthaṃ savyanāsāpuṭena ca |
kṛṣṇavarṇena bāhyasthaṃ bhāvayecca śilāgatam ||
meaning:
अर्घमादाय देहस्थं सव्यनासापुटेन च |
कृष्णवर्णेन बाह्यस्थं भावयेच्च शिलागतम् ||
text_mt: Taking the water-offering present in the body, and through the right nostril / [expelling it] as black-colored, he should visualize it situated outside upon a stone.

sanskrit_iast:
tarpayedatha devebhya ṛṣibhyaśca viśeṣataḥ |
bhūtebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca dadyādarghyaṃ yathāvidhi ||
meaning:
तर्पयेदथ देवेभ्य ऋषिभ्यश्च विशेषतः |
भूतेभ्यश्च पितृभ्यश्च दद्यादर्घ्यं यथाविधि ||
text_mt: He should then offer libation to the deities and especially to the sages; / and he should offer water-offering according to rule to the beings and to the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
raktacandanatoyena hastamātreṇa maṇḍalam |
suvṛttaṃ kalpayedbhūmau raktacūrṇādyalaṅkṛtam ||
meaning:
रक्तचन्दनतोयेन हस्तमात्रेण मण्डलम् |
सुवृत्तं कल्पयेद्भूमौ रक्तचूर्णाद्यलङ्कृतम् ||
text_mt: With red-sandalwood water, one cubit in measure, / he should fashion a well-rounded circle on the ground, adorned with red powder and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sampūjayedbhānuṃ svakīyāvaraṇaiḥ saha |
khakholkāyeti mantreṇa sāṅgataḥ sukhasiddhaye ||
meaning:
तत्र सम्पूजयेद्भानुं स्वकीयावरणैः सह |
खखोल्कायेति मन्त्रेण साङ्गतः सुखसिद्धये ||
text_mt: There he should worship the sun together with his surrounding attendants / with the mantra "khakholkāya," complete with its limbs, for the attainment of happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
punaśca maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tadaṅgaiḥ paripūjya ca |
tatra sthāpya hemapātraṃ māgadhaprasthasammitam ||
meaning:
पुनश्च मण्डलं कृत्वा तदङ्गैः परिपूज्य च |
तत्र स्थाप्य हेमपात्रं मागधप्रस्थसम्मितम् ||
text_mt: And having made the circle again and worshipped him with his limbs, / placing there a gold vessel measuring a Māgadha prastha,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrayet gandhatoyena raktacandanayoginā |
raktapuṣpaistilaiścaiva kuśākṣatasamanvitaiḥ ||
meaning:
पूरयेत् गन्धतोयेन रक्तचन्दनयोगिना |
रक्तपुष्पैस्तिलैश्चैव कुशाक्षतसमन्वितैः ||
text_mt: he should fill it with perfumed water mixed with red sandalwood, / with red flowers and sesame seeds, combined with kuśa grass and unhusked barley,

sanskrit_iast:
dūrvāpāmārgagavyaiśca kevalena jalena vā |
jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gatvā natvā devaṃ ca maṇḍale ||
meaning:
दूर्वापामार्गगव्यैश्च केवलेन जलेन वा |
जानुभ्यां धरणीं गत्वा नत्वा देवं च मण्डले ||
text_mt: with dūrvā grass, apāmārga, and cow-products, or with plain water; / touching the ground with his knees and bowing to the deity in the circle,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā śirasi tatpātraṃ dadyādarghyaṃ śivāya tat |
athavāñjalinā toyaṃ sadarbhaṃ mūlavidyayā ||
meaning:
कृत्वा शिरसि तत्पात्रं दद्यादर्घ्यं शिवाय तत् |
अथवाञ्जलिना तोयं सदर्भं मूलविद्यया ||
text_mt: placing that vessel on his head, he should offer that water-offering to Śiva; / or with cupped hands [offer] water with darbha grass through the root vidyā,

sanskrit_iast:
utkṣipedambarasthāya śivāyādityamūrtaye |
kṛtvā punaḥ karanyāsaṃ karaśodhanapūrvakam ||
meaning:
उत्क्षिपेदम्बरस्थाय शिवायादित्यमूर्तये |
कृत्वा पुनः करन्यासं करशोधनपूर्वकम् ||
text_mt: throwing it upward to Śiva situated in the sky in the form of the sun. / Having performed ritual assignment on the hands again, preceded by the purification of the hands,

sanskrit_iast:
buddhveśānādi sadyāntaṃ pañcabrahmamayaṃ śivam |
gṛhītvā bhasitaṃ mantrairvimṛjyāṅgāni saṃspṛśet ||
meaning:
बुद्ध्वेशानादि सद्यान्तं पञ्चब्रह्ममयं शिवम् |
गृहीत्वा भसितं मन्त्रैर्विमृज्याङ्गानि संस्पृशेत् ||
text_mt: knowing Śiva as consisting of the five Brahmas beginning with Īśāna and ending with Sadyojāta, / taking ash with the mantras and rubbing it, he should touch the limbs:

sanskrit_iast:
āpādāntaiḥ śirovaktrahṛdguhyacaraṇān kramāt |
tato mūlena sarvāṅgamālabhya vasanāntaram ||
meaning:
आपादान्तैः शिरोवक्त्रहृद्गुह्यचरणान् क्रमात् |
ततो मूलेन सर्वाङ्गमालभ्य वसनान्तरम् ||
text_mt: the head, face, heart, private parts, and feet in order, ending at the feet; / then rubbing all the limbs with the root mantra, putting on another garment,

sanskrit_iast:
paridhāya dvirācamya prokṣyaikādaśamantritaiḥ |
jalairācchādya vāso'yad dvirācamya śivaṃ smaret ||
meaning:
परिधाय द्विराचम्य प्रोक्ष्यैकादशमन्त्रितैः |
जलैराच्छाद्य वासोऽयद् द्विराचम्य शिवं स्मरेत् ||
text_mt: donning it, sipping water twice, sprinkling with waters consecrated / eleven times, covering with the garment, sipping water twice, he should remember Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
punarnyastakaro mantrī tripuṇḍraṃ bhasmanā likhet |
avakramāya taṃ vyaktaṃ lalāṭe gandhavāriṇā ||
meaning:
पुनर्न्यस्तकरो मन्त्री त्रिपुण्ड्रं भस्मना लिखेत् |
अवक्रमाय तं व्यक्तं ललाटे गन्धवारिणा ||
text_mt: Again having assigned the hands, the practitioner of mantras should draw the tripuṇḍra with ash, / straight, distinct, on the forehead with perfumed water,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttaṃ vā caturasraṃ vā bindumarddhendumeva vā |
lalāṭe yādṛśaṃ puṇḍraṃ likhitaṃ bhasmanā punaḥ ||
meaning:
वृत्तं वा चतुरस्रं वा बिन्दुमर्द्धेन्दुमेव वा |
ललाटे यादृशं पुण्ड्रं लिखितं भस्मना पुनः ||
text_mt: or round, or four-cornered, or a dot, or a crescent moon; / whatever sort of mark is drawn on the forehead with ash,

sanskrit_iast:
tādṛśaṃ bhujayormūrdhni stanayorantare likhet |
sarvāṅgoddhūlanaṃ caiva na samānaṃ tripuṇḍrakaiḥ ||
meaning:
तादृशं भुजयोर्मूर्ध्नि स्तनयोरन्तरे लिखेत् |
सर्वाङ्गोद्धूलनं चैव न समानं त्रिपुण्ड्रकैः ||
text_mt: a similar one he should draw on both arms, the head, and between the breasts. / Smearing all the limbs is not equal to the tripuṇḍras;

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt tripuṇḍramevaikaṃ likheduddhūlanaṃ vinā |
rudrākṣāndhārayenmūrdhni kaṇṭhe śrote kare tathā ||
meaning:
तस्मात् त्रिपुण्ड्रमेवैकं लिखेदुद्धूलनं विना |
रुद्राक्षान्धारयेन्मूर्ध्नि कण्ठे श्रोते करे तथा ||
text_mt: therefore, he should draw the tripuṇḍra alone, without smearing [the whole body]. / He should wear rudrākṣa beads on the head, neck, ears, and hands.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇavarṇamacchinnaṃ śubhaṃ nānyairdhṛtaṃ śubham |
viprādīnāṃ kramāt śreṣṭhaṃ pītaṃ raktamathāsitam ||
meaning:
सुवर्णवर्णमच्छिन्नं शुभं नान्यैर्धृतं शुभम् |
विप्रादीनां क्रमात् श्रेष्ठं पीतं रक्तमथासितम् ||
text_mt: One of golden hue, unbroken, is auspicious; one worn by no others is auspicious. / For brahmins and the other classes in order, yellow, red, and then black are best.

sanskrit_iast:
tadalābhe yathālābhaṃ dhāraṇīyamadūṣitam |
tatrāpi nottaraṃ nīcairdhāryaṃ nīcamathottaraiḥ ||
meaning:
तदलाभे यथालाभं धारणीयमदूषितम् |
तत्रापि नोत्तरं नीचैर्धार्यं नीचमथोत्तरैः ||
text_mt: If that is not obtained, one should wear whatever is obtained, unblemished; / even there, a superior one must not be worn by low persons, nor an inferior one by the superior.

sanskrit_iast:
nāśucirddhārayedakṣaṃ sadā kāleṣu dhārayet |
itthaṃ trisandhyamathavā dvisandhyaṃ sakṛdeva vā ||
meaning:
नाशुचिर्द्धारयेदक्षं सदा कालेषु धारयेत् |
इत्थं त्रिसन्ध्यमथवा द्विसन्ध्यं सकृदेव वा ||
text_mt: When impure, he must not wear the rudrākṣa; at all times [otherwise] he should wear it. / Thus at the three daily twilights, or at two daily twilights, or only once,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā snānādikaṃ śaktyā pūjayetparameśvaram |
pūjāsthānaṃ samāsādya baddhvā ruciramāsanam ||
meaning:
कृत्वा स्नानादिकं शक्त्या पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् |
पूजास्थानं समासाद्य बद्ध्वा रुचिरमासनम् ||
text_mt: having performed bathing and the rest according to capacity, he should worship Parameśvara. / Approaching the place of worship, having assumed an agreeable seat,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyeddevaṃ ca devīṃ ca prāṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥ |
śvetādīnnakulīśāntāṃstacchiṣyānpraṇamedgurum ||
meaning:
ध्यायेद्देवं च देवीं च प्राङ्मुखो वाप्युदङ्मुखः |
श्वेतादीन्नकुलीशान्तांस्तच्छिष्यान्प्रणमेद्गुरुम् ||
text_mt: facing east or facing north, he should meditate on the God and the Goddess; / he should bow to the teachers from Śveta to Nakulīśa, their disciples, and his own guru.

sanskrit_iast:
punardevaṃ śivaṃ natvā tato nāmāṣṭakaṃ japet |
śivo maheśvaraścaiva rudro viṣṇuḥ pitāmahaḥ ||
meaning:
पुनर्देवं शिवं नत्वा ततो नामाष्टकं जपेत् |
शिवो महेश्वरश्चैव रुद्रो विष्णुः पितामहः ||
text_mt: Bowing again to the divine Śiva, he should then recite the eight names: / Śiva, Maheśvara, Rudra, Viṣṇu, Pitāmaha,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāravaidyaḥ sarvajñaḥ paramātmeti cāṣṭakam |
athavā śivamevaikaṃ japitvaikādaśādhikam ||
meaning:
संसारवैद्यः सर्वज्ञः परमात्मेति चाष्टकम् |
अथवा शिवमेवैकं जपित्वैकादशाधिकम् ||
text_mt: Physician of Transmigratory Existence, All-Knowing, and Supreme Self—the eight names. / Or having recited only Śiva eleven times [more],

sanskrit_iast:
jihvāgre tejaso rāśiṃ dhyātvā vyādhyādiśāntaye |
prakṣālya caraṇau kṛtvā karau candanacarcitau |
prakurvīta karanyāsaṃ karaśodhanapūrvakam ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
जिह्वाग्रे तेजसो राशिं ध्यात्वा व्याध्यादिशान्तये |
प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ कृत्वा करौ चन्दनचर्चितौ |
प्रकुर्वीत करन्यासं करशोधनपूर्वकम् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
meditating on a mass of splendour at the tip of the tongue for the pacification of disease and the like, / washing the feet, making the hands smeared with sandalwood paste, / he should perform the ritual assignment on the hands, preceded by the purification of the hands.

Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
nyāsastu trividhaḥ proktaḥ sthityutpattilayakramāt |
sthitirnyāso gṛhasthānāmutpattirbrahmacāriṇām ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
न्यासस्तु त्रिविधः प्रोक्तः स्थित्युत्पत्तिलयक्रमात् |
स्थितिर्न्यासो गृहस्थानामुत्पत्तिर्ब्रह्मचारिणाम् ||
title: dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivaśāstroktanityanaimittikakarmavarṇanam
text_mt:
Chapter 22 / Upamanyu said: / Placement of mantras is declared to be threefold according to the order of maintenance, origination, and dissolution.
/ The placement of maintenance is for householders, origination for celibate students, / / 570a

sanskrit_iast:
yatīnāṃ saṃhṛtinyāso vanasthānāṃ tathaiva ca |
sa eva bhartṛhīnāyāḥ kuṭumbinyāḥ sthitirbhavet ||
meaning:
यतीनां संहृतिन्यासो वनस्थानां तथैव च |
स एव भर्तृहीनायाः कुटुम्बिन्याः स्थितिर्भवेत् ||
text_mt: the assignment of withdrawal is for ascetics, and likewise for forest-dwellers; / that very one is for a woman without a husband; for a female householder it should be maintenance.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāyāḥ punarutpattiṃ vakṣye nyāsasya lakṣaṇam |
aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ sthitinyāsa udāhṛtaḥ ||
meaning:
कन्यायाः पुनरुत्पत्तिं वक्ष्ये न्यासस्य लक्षणम् |
अङ्गुष्ठादिकनिष्ठान्तं स्थितिन्यास उदाहृतः ||
text_mt: For an unmarried girl, it is origination. I shall explain the characteristics of ritual assignment: / ending at the little finger, beginning with the thumb, is declared the assignment of maintenance;

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhamārabhya vāmāṅguṣṭhāntameva ca |
utpattinyāsa ākhyāto viparītastu saṃhṛtiḥ ||
meaning:
दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठमारभ्य वामाङ्गुष्ठान्तमेव च |
उत्पत्तिन्यास आख्यातो विपरीतस्तु संहृतिः ||
text_mt: beginning with the right thumb and ending at the left thumb / is called the assignment of origination; the reverse is withdrawal.

sanskrit_iast:
sabindukānnakārādīn varṇān nyasyedanukramāt |
aṅgulīṣu śivaṃ nyasyet talayorapyanāmayoḥ ||
meaning:
सबिन्दुकान्नकारादीन् वर्णान् न्यस्येदनुक्रमात् |
अङ्गुलीषु शिवं न्यस्येत् तलयोरप्यनामयोः ||
text_mt: He should assign in sequence the syllables beginning with na and accompanied by the bindu; / he should assign Śiva to the fingers and to both palms and back of the hands.

sanskrit_iast:
astranyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā daśadikṣvastramantrataḥ |
nivṛttyādikalāḥ pañca pañcabhūtasvarūpiṇīḥ ||
meaning:
अस्त्रन्यासं ततः कृत्वा दशदिक्ष्वस्त्रमन्त्रतः |
निवृत्त्यादिकलाः पञ्च पञ्चभूतस्वरूपिणीः ||
text_mt: Then, having performed the assignment of the weapon in the ten directions with the weapon mantra, / [and having assigned] the five kalās beginning with Nivṛtti, whose nature is the five elements,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcabhūtādhipaiḥ sārddhaṃ tattaccihnasamanvitāḥ |
hṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyabrahmarandhrasamāśrayāḥ ||
meaning:
पञ्चभूताधिपैः सार्द्धं तत्तच्चिह्नसमन्विताः |
हृत्कण्ठतालुभ्रूमध्यब्रह्मरन्ध्रसमाश्रयाः ||
text_mt: Together with the presiding deities of the five elements, endowed with their respective characteristics, / stationed in the heart, throat, palate, space between the eyebrows, and the brahmarandhra;

sanskrit_iast:
tattadbījena saṅgranthīṃstattadbījeṣu bhāvayet |
tāsāṃ viśodhanārthāya vidyāṃ pañcākṣarīṃ japet ||
meaning:
तत्तद्बीजेन सङ्ग्रन्थींस्तत्तद्बीजेषु भावयेत् |
तासां विशोधनार्थाय विद्यां पञ्चाक्षरीं जपेत् ||
text_mt: One should visualize the knots tied with their respective seed syllables in those respective seed syllables; / in order to purify them, one should recite the five-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
niruddhvā prāṇavāyuṃ ca guṇasaṅkhyānusārataḥ |
bhūtagranthiṃ tataḥ chindyādastreṇaivāstramudrayā ||
meaning:
निरुद्ध्वा प्राणवायुं च गुणसङ्ख्यानुसारतः |
भूतग्रन्थिं ततः छिन्द्यादस्त्रेणैवास्त्रमुद्रया ||
text_mt: And restraining the vital breath according to the number of virtues, / one should then cut the elemental knot with the weapon-mantra using the weapon-mudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
nāḍyāḥ suṣumṇayātmānaṃ preritaṃ prāṇavāyunā |
nirgataṃ brahmarandhreṇa yojayet śivatejasā ||
meaning:
नाड्याः सुषुम्णयात्मानं प्रेरितं प्राणवायुना |
निर्गतं ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण योजयेत् शिवतेजसा ||
text_mt: The self, impelled by the vital breath through the suṣumṇā channel / and departed through the brahmarandhra, one should unite with the radiance of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
viśoṣya vāyunā paścāddehaṃ kālāgninā dahet |
tataścoparibhāvena kalāḥ saṃhṛtya vāyunā ||
meaning:
विशोष्य वायुना पश्चाद्देहं कालाग्निना दहेत् |
ततश्चोपरिभावेन कलाः संहृत्य वायुना ||
text_mt: Having first dried up the body with wind, one should burn it with the fire of time; / and then, by means of an upward motion, having withdrawn the kalās with wind,

sanskrit_iast:
dehaṃ saṃhṛtya vai dagdhaṃ kalāḥ spṛṣṭvā sahādhipam |
plāvayitvāmṛtairdehaṃ yathāsthānaṃ niveśayet ||
meaning:
देहं संहृत्य वै दग्धं कलाः स्पृष्ट्वा सहाधिपम् |
प्लावयित्वामृतैर्देहं यथास्थानं निवेशयेत् ||
text_mt: Having destroyed the burned body, touching the kalās together with their lord, / and flooding the body with nectar, one should place it in its proper position.

sanskrit_iast:
atha saṃhṛtya vai dagdhaḥ kalāsargaṃ vinaiva tu |
amṛtaplāvanaṃ kuryād bhasmībhūtasya vai tataḥ ||
meaning:
अथ संहृत्य वै दग्धः कलासर्गं विनैव तु |
अमृतप्लावनं कुर्याद् भस्मीभूतस्य वै ततः ||
text_mt: Then, having indeed dissolved the burned [body] without creating the kalās, / one should then bathe in nectar that which has been reduced to ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vidyāmaye tasmin dehe dīpaśikhākṛtim |
śivānnirgatamātmānaṃ brahmarandhreṇa yojayet ||
meaning:
ततो विद्यामये तस्मिन् देहे दीपशिखाकृतिम् |
शिवान्निर्गतमात्मानं ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण योजयेत् ||
text_mt: Then, in that body made of knowledge, one should unite through the brahmarandhra / the self that has emerged from Śiva, having the shape of a lamp flame.

sanskrit_iast:
dehasyāntaḥ praviṣṭaṃ taṃ dhyātvā hṛdayapaṅkaje |
punaścāmṛtavarṣeṇa siñced vidyāmayaṃ vapuḥ ||
meaning:
देहस्यान्तः प्रविष्टं तं ध्यात्वा हृदयपङ्कजे |
पुनश्चामृतवर्षेण सिञ्चेद् विद्यामयं वपुः ||
text_mt: Having meditated upon it entered inside the body within the heart lotus, / one should again sprinkle the body made of knowledge with a shower of nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kuryāt karanyāsaṃ karaśodhanapūrvakam |
dehanyāsaṃ tataḥ paścānmahatyā mudrayā caret ||
meaning:
ततः कुर्यात् करन्यासं करशोधनपूर्वकम् |
देहन्यासं ततः पश्चान्महत्या मुद्रया चरेत् ||
text_mt: Then one should perform the imposition on the hands preceded by the purification of the hands; / then afterwards, one should perform the imposition on the body with the great mudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅganyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śivoktena tu vartmanā |
varṇanyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāddhastapādādisandhiṣu ||
meaning:
अङ्गन्यासं ततः कृत्वा शिवोक्तेन तु वर्त्मना |
वर्णन्यासं ततः कुर्याद्धस्तपादादिसन्धिषु ||
text_mt: Then, having performed the imposition on the limbs according to the method spoken by Śiva, / one should then perform the imposition of the phonemes on the joints of the hands, feet, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṅgāni tato nyasya jātiṣaṭkayutāni ca |
digbandhamācaretpaścādāgneyādi yathākramam ||
meaning:
षडङ्गानि ततो न्यस्य जातिषट्कयुतानि च |
दिग्बन्धमाचरेत्पश्चादाग्नेयादि यथाक्रमम् ||
text_mt: Then, having placed the six limbs endowed with the six endings, / one should afterwards perform the locking of the directions in proper order, beginning with the southeast.

sanskrit_iast:
yadvā mūrddhādipañcāṅgaṃ nyāsameva samācaret |
tathā ṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ ca bhūtaśuddhyādikaṃ vinā ||
meaning:
यद्वा मूर्द्धादिपञ्चाङ्गं न्यासमेव समाचरेत् |
तथा षडङ्गन्यासं च भूतशुद्ध्यादिकं विना ||
text_mt: Or else, one should perform just the five-limb imposition starting with the head, / and likewise the six-limb imposition, without the purification of the elements and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ samāsarūpeṇa kṛtvā dehātmaśodhanam |
śivabhāvamupāgamya pūjayetparameśvaram ||
meaning:
एवं समासरूपेण कृत्वा देहात्मशोधनम् |
शिवभावमुपागम्य पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् ||
text_mt: Having thus performed the purification of the body and self in concise form, / attaining the state of Śiva, one should worship Parameśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
atha yasyāstyavasaro nāsti vā mativibhramaḥ |
sa vistīrṇena kalpena nyāsakarma samācaret ||
meaning:
अथ यस्यास्त्यवसरो नास्ति वा मतिविभ्रमः |
स विस्तीर्णेन कल्पेन न्यासकर्म समाचरेत् ||
text_mt: Now, he who has the leisure or whose mind is free from confusion, / should perform the rite of imposition according to the detailed procedure.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrādyo mātṛkānyāso brahmanyāsastataḥ paraḥ |
tṛtīyaḥ praṇavanyāso haṃsanyāsastaduttaraḥ ||
meaning:
तत्राद्यो मातृकान्यासो ब्रह्मन्यासस्ततः परः |
तृतीयः प्रणवन्यासो हंसन्यासस्तदुत्तरः ||
text_mt: Therein, the first is the mātṛkānyāsa, and next to it is the brahmanyāsa; / the third is the praṇavanyāsa, and higher than that is the haṃsanyāsa;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamaḥ kathyate sadbhirnyāsaḥ pañcākṣarātmakaḥ |
eteṣvekamanekaṃ vā kuryāt pūjādikarmasu ||
meaning:
पञ्चमः कथ्यते सद्भिर्न्यासः पञ्चाक्षरात्मकः |
एतेष्वेकमनेकं वा कुर्यात् पूजादिकर्मसु ||
text_mt: The fifth imposition, consisting of the five syllables, is declared by the virtuous; / one should perform one or many among these in rites such as worship.

sanskrit_iast:
akāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya ākāraṃ ca lalāṭake |
iṃ īṃ ca netrayostadvat uṃ ūṃ śravaṇayostathā ||
meaning:
अकारं मूर्ध्नि विन्यस्य आकारं च ललाटके |
इं ईं च नेत्रयोस्तद्वत् उं ऊं श्रवणयोस्तथा ||
text_mt: Placing “a” on the crown of the head and “ā” on the forehead, / “i” and “ī” likewise on the two eyes, “u” and “ū” similarly on the two ears,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṃ ṝṃ kapolayoścaiva ḷṃ ḹṃ nāsāpuṭadvaye |
emaimmoṣṭhadvayoromauṃ dantapaṅktidvayoḥ kramāt ||
meaning:
ऋं ॠं कपोलयोश्चैव ऌं ॡं नासापुटद्वये |
एमैम्मोष्ठद्वयोरोमौं दन्तपङ्क्तिद्वयोः क्रमात् ||
text_mt: “ṛ” and “ṝ” on the two cheeks, “ḷ” and “ḹ” on the two nostrils, / “e” and “ai” on the two lips, “o” and “au” on the two rows of teeth in order,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃ jihvāyāmatho tālunyaḥ prayojyo yathākramam |
kavargaṃ dakṣiṇe haste nyasetpañcasu sandhiṣu ||
meaning:
अं जिह्वायामथो तालुन्यः प्रयोज्यो यथाक्रमम् |
कवर्गं दक्षिणे हस्ते न्यसेत्पञ्चसु सन्धिषु ||
text_mt: “aṃ” on the tongue, and “aḥ” should be applied to the palate in proper order; / one should place the k-group on the five joints of the right hand,

sanskrit_iast:
cavargaṃ ca tathā vāmahastasandhiṣu vinyaset |
ṭavargaṃ ca tavargaṃ ca pādayorubhayorapi ||
meaning:
चवर्गं च तथा वामहस्तसन्धिषु विन्यसेत् |
टवर्गं च तवर्गं च पादयोरुभयोरपि ||
text_mt: And likewise one should place the c-group on the joints of the left hand, / and the ṭ-group and t-group on both feet,

sanskrit_iast:
paphau tu pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe nābhau cāpi babhau tataḥ |
nyasenmakāraṃ hṛdaye tvagādiṣu yathākramam ||
meaning:
पफौ तु पार्श्वयोः पृष्ठे नाभौ चापि बभौ ततः |
न्यसेन्मकारं हृदये त्वगादिषु यथाक्रमम् ||
text_mt: “pa” and “pha” on the two flanks, “ba” and “bha” on the back and also on the navel; / then one should place “ma” on the heart, upon the skin and the other [constituents] in order.

sanskrit_iast:
yakārādisakārāntān nyasetsaptasu dhātuṣu |
haṅkāraṃ hṛdayasyāntaḥ kṣakāraṃ bhrūyugāntare ||
meaning:
यकारादिसकारान्तान् न्यसेत्सप्तसु धातुषु |
हङ्कारं हृदयस्यान्तः क्षकारं भ्रूयुगान्तरे ||
text_mt: One should place the letters from “ya” to “sa” on the seven bodily elements, / “ha” within the heart, and “kṣa” between the two eyebrows.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ varṇān pravinyasya pañcāśat rudravartmanā |
aṅgavaktrakalābhedāt pañca brahmāṇi vinyaset ||
meaning:
एवं वर्णान् प्रविन्यस्य पञ्चाशत् रुद्रवर्त्मना |
अङ्गवक्त्रकलाभेदात् पञ्च ब्रह्माणि विन्यसेत् ||
text_mt: Having thus properly imposed the fifty phonemes according to the method of Rudra, / one should place the five Brahmans according to the division of limbs, faces, and kalās.

sanskrit_iast:
karanyāsādyamapi taiḥ kṛtvā vātha na vā kramāt |
śirovadanahṛdguhyapādeṣvetāni kalpayet ||
meaning:
करन्यासाद्यमपि तैः कृत्वा वाथ न वा क्रमात् |
शिरोवदनहृद्गुह्यपादेष्वेतानि कल्पयेत् ||
text_mt: Having performed the imposition on the hands and so forth with them, or not, in order, / one should assign these to the head, face, heart, private parts, and feet.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścordhvādivaktrāṇi paścimāntāni kalpayet |
īśānasya kalāḥ pañca pañcasveteṣu ca kramāt ||
meaning:
ततश्चोर्ध्वादिवक्त्राणि पश्चिमान्तानि कल्पयेत् |
ईशानस्य कलाः पञ्च पञ्चस्वेतेषु च क्रमात् ||
text_mt: And then one should assign the faces beginning with the upper and ending with the western; / and the five kalās of Īśāna upon these five in order.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścaturṣu vaktreṣu puruṣasya kalā api |
catasraḥ praṇidhātavyāḥ pūrvādikramayogataḥ ||
meaning:
ततश्चतुर्षु वक्त्रेषु पुरुषस्य कला अपि |
चतस्रः प्रणिधातव्याः पूर्वादिक्रमयोगतः ||
text_mt: Then upon the four faces, the four kalās of Puruṣa / are also to be applied, following the sequence beginning with the east.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtkaṇṭhāṃseṣu nābhau ca kukṣau pṛṣṭhe ca vakṣasi |
aghorasya kalāścāṣṭau pādayorapi hastayoḥ ||
meaning:
हृत्कण्ठांसेषु नाभौ च कुक्षौ पृष्ठे च वक्षसि |
अघोरस्य कलाश्चाष्टौ पादयोरपि हस्तयोः ||
text_mt: On the heart, throat, shoulders, navel, belly, back, chest, / and also on the feet and hands, are the eight kalās of Aghora.

sanskrit_iast:
paścāt trayodaśakalāḥ pāyumeḍhrorujānuṣu |
jaṅghāsphikkaṭipārśveṣu vāmadevasya bhāvayet ||
meaning:
पश्चात् त्रयोदशकलाः पायुमेढ्रोरुजानुषु |
जङ्घास्फिक्कटिपार्श्वेषु वामदेवस्य भावयेत् ||
text_mt: Afterwards, one should contemplate the thirteen kalās of Vāmadeva / on the anus, penis, thighs, knees, shanks, buttocks, waist, and flanks.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyasyā'pi kalāścāṣṭau pādayorapi hastayoḥ |
ghrāṇe śirasi bāhvośca kalpayetkalpavittamaḥ |
aṣṭatriṃśatkalānyāsamevaṃ kṛtvānupūrvaśaḥ ||
meaning:
सद्यस्याऽपि कलाश्चाष्टौ पादयोरपि हस्तयोः |
घ्राणे शिरसि बाह्वोश्च कल्पयेत्कल्पवित्तमः |
अष्टत्रिंशत्कलान्यासमेवं कृत्वानुपूर्वशः ||
text_mt: One most skilled in ritual should also assign the eight kalās of Sadyojāta / to the feet, hands, nose, head, and two arms; / having thus performed the imposition of the thirty-eight kalās in sequence,

sanskrit_iast:
paścāt praṇavaviddhīmān praṇavanyāsamācaret |
bāhudvaye kūrparayostathā ca maṇibandhayoḥ ||
meaning:
पश्चात् प्रणवविद्धीमान् प्रणवन्यासमाचरेत् |
बाहुद्वये कूर्परयोस्तथा च मणिबन्धयोः ||
text_mt: Afterwards, the wise person knowing the praṇava should perform the praṇavanyāsa: / on both arms, both elbows, and likewise both wrists,

sanskrit_iast:
pārśvodarorujaṅgheṣu pādayoḥ pṛṣṭhatastathā |
itthaṃ praṇavavinyāsaṃ kṛtvā nyāsavicakṣaṇaḥ ||
meaning:
पार्श्वोदरोरुजङ्घेषु पादयोः पृष्ठतस्तथा |
इत्थं प्रणवविन्यासं कृत्वा न्यासविचक्षणः ||
text_mt: On the flanks, belly, thighs, shanks, feet, and also on the back; / having thus performed the imposition of the praṇava, one skilled in nyāsa,

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsanyāsaṃ prakurvīta śivaśāstre yathoditam |
bījaṃ vibhajya haṃsasya netrayorghrāṇayorapi ||
meaning:
हंसन्यासं प्रकुर्वीत शिवशास्त्रे यथोदितम् |
बीजं विभज्य हंसस्य नेत्रयोर्घ्राणयोरपि ||
text_mt: Should perform the haṃsanyāsa as declared in the Śiva scriptures; / dividing the seed syllable of haṃsa on the eyes and nostrils,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhajya bāhunetrāsyalalāṭe karṇayorapi |
kakṣayoḥ skandhayoścaiva pārśvayoḥ stanayostathā ||
meaning:
विभज्य बाहुनेत्रास्यललाटे कर्णयोरपि |
कक्षयोः स्कन्धयोश्चैव पार्श्वयोः स्तनयोस्तथा ||
text_mt: Dividing it on the arms, eyes, face, forehead, and ears, / on the armpits and shoulders, on the flanks and breasts,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṭyāṃ pāṇyorgulphayośca yadvā pañcāṅgavartmanā |
haṃsanyāsamimaṃ kṛtvā nyaset pañcākṣarīṃ tataḥ ||
meaning:
कट्यां पाण्योर्गुल्फयोश्च यद्वा पञ्चाङ्गवर्त्मना |
हंसन्यासमिमं कृत्वा न्यसेत् पञ्चाक्षरीं ततः ||
text_mt: On the waist, hands, and ankles; or else by the path of the five limbs; / having performed this haṃsanyāsa, one should then impose the five syllables,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā pūrvoktamārgeṇa śivatvaṃ yena jāyate |
nāśivaḥ śivamabhyasyennāśivaḥ śivamarcayet |
nāśivastu śivaṃ dhyāyennāśivaḥ prāpnuyāt śivam ||
meaning:
यथा पूर्वोक्तमार्गेण शिवत्वं येन जायते |
नाशिवः शिवमभ्यस्येन्नाशिवः शिवमर्चयेत् |
नाशिवस्तु शिवं ध्यायेन्नाशिवः प्राप्नुयात् शिवम् ||
text_mt: In the manner previously stated, by which the state of Śiva is produced; / one who is not Śiva should not study Śiva, one who is not Śiva should not worship Śiva, / one who is not Śiva should not meditate on Śiva, one who is not Śiva cannot attain Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt śaivīṃ tanuṃ kṛtvā tyaktvā ca paśubhāvanām |
śivo'hamiti sañcintya śaivaṃ karma samācaret ||
meaning:
तस्मात् शैवीं तनुं कृत्वा त्यक्त्वा च पशुभावनाम् |
शिवोऽहमिति सञ्चिन्त्य शैवं कर्म समाचरेत् ||
text_mt: Therefore, having made a Śaiva body and having abandoned the notion of the bound soul, / thinking “I am Śiva,” one should perform Śaiva rites.

sanskrit_iast:
karmayajñastapoyajño japayajñastaduttaraḥ |
dhyānayajño jñānayajñaḥ pañca yajñāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
meaning:
कर्मयज्ञस्तपोयज्ञो जपयज्ञस्तदुत्तरः |
ध्यानयज्ञो ज्ञानयज्ञः पञ्च यज्ञाः प्रकीर्तिताः ||
text_mt: Action-sacrifice, austerity-sacrifice, recitation-sacrifice higher than that, / meditation-sacrifice, and knowledge-sacrifice: five sacrifices are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
karmayajñaratāḥ kecittapoyajñaratāḥ pare |
japayajñaratāścānye dhyānayajñaratāstathā ||
meaning:
कर्मयज्ञरताः केचित्तपोयज्ञरताः परे |
जपयज्ञरताश्चान्ये ध्यानयज्ञरतास्तथा ||
text_mt: Some are devoted to action-sacrifice, others to austerity-sacrifice; / still others are devoted to recitation-sacrifice, and likewise to meditation-sacrifice;

sanskrit_iast:
jñānayajñaratāścānye viśiṣṭāścottarottaram |
karmayajño dvidhā proktaḥ kāmākāmavibhedataḥ ||
meaning:
ज्ञानयज्ञरताश्चान्ये विशिष्टाश्चोत्तरोत्तरम् |
कर्मयज्ञो द्विधा प्रोक्तः कामाकामविभेदतः ||
text_mt: And others are devoted to knowledge-sacrifice, each superior to the preceding; / action-sacrifice is said to be of two kinds according to the distinction of desire and desirelessness.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmān kāmī tato bhuktvā kāmāsaktaḥ punarbhavet |
akāmo rudrabhavane bhogān bhuktvā tataścyutaḥ ||
meaning:
कामान् कामी ततो भुक्त्वा कामासक्तः पुनर्भवेत् |
अकामो रुद्रभवने भोगान् भुक्त्वा ततश्च्युतः ||
text_mt: The person with desire, having enjoyed desires, becomes attached to desires again; / the desireless person, having enjoyed pleasures in the abode of Rudra and then descended from there,

sanskrit_iast:
tapoyajñarato bhūtvā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
tapasvī ca punastasmin bhogān bhuktvā tataścyutaḥ ||
meaning:
तपोयज्ञरतो भूत्वा जायते नात्र संशयः |
तपस्वी च पुनस्तस्मिन् भोगान् भुक्त्वा ततश्च्युतः ||
text_mt: Is born devoted to austerity-sacrifice—of this there is no doubt; / and the ascetic, having again enjoyed pleasures there and then descended from there,

sanskrit_iast:
japadhyānarato bhūtvā jāyate bhuvi mānavaḥ |
japadhyānarato martyastadvaiśiṣṭyavaśādiha ||
meaning:
जपध्यानरतो भूत्वा जायते भुवि मानवः |
जपध्यानरतो मर्त्यस्तद्वैशिष्ट्यवशादिह ||
text_mt: Is born on earth as a human devoted to recitation and meditation; / the mortal devoted to recitation and meditation, in this world, by virtue of that excellence,

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaṃ labdhvācirādeva śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt |
tasmānmukto śivājñaptaḥ karmayajño'pi dehinām ||
meaning:
ज्ञानं लब्ध्वाचिरादेव शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात् |
तस्मान्मुक्तो शिवाज्ञप्तः कर्मयज्ञोऽपि देहिनाम् ||
text_mt: Having attained knowledge, quickly achieves communion with Śiva; / therefore, action-sacrifice commanded by Śiva is also for the liberation of embodied beings.

sanskrit_iast:
akāmaḥ kāmasaṃyukto bandhāyaiva bhaviṣyati |
tasmātpañcasu yajñeṣu dhyānajñānaparo bhavet ||
meaning:
अकामः कामसंयुक्तो बन्धायैव भविष्यति |
तस्मात्पञ्चसु यज्ञेषु ध्यानज्ञानपरो भवेत् ||
text_mt: When free from desire, [it liberates; but] when joined with desire, it leads only to bondage; / therefore, among the five sacrifices, one should be dedicated to meditation and knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaṃ jñānaṃ ca yasyāsti tīrṇastena bhavārṇavaḥ |
hiṃsādidoṣanirmukto viśuddhaścittasādhanaḥ ||
meaning:
ध्यानं ज्ञानं च यस्यास्ति तीर्णस्तेन भवार्णवः |
हिंसादिदोषनिर्मुक्तो विशुद्धश्चित्तसाधनः ||
text_mt: He who possesses meditation and knowledge has crossed the ocean of worldly existence; / free from faults such as violence, pure, having the mind as its instrument,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānayajñaḥ parastasmādapavargaphalapradaḥ |
bahiḥ karmikarā yadvannātīva phalabhāginaḥ ||
meaning:
ध्यानयज्ञः परस्तस्मादपवर्गफलप्रदः |
बहिः कर्मिकरा यद्वन्नातीव फलभागिनः ||
text_mt: The meditation-sacrifice is supreme, bestowing the fruit of liberation; / just as external laborers do not receive the greatest reward.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā narendrabhavane tadvadatrāpi karmiṇaḥ |
dhyānināṃ hi vapuḥ sūkṣmaṃ bhavetpratyakṣamaiśvaram ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा नरेन्द्रभवने तद्वदत्रापि कर्मिणः |
ध्यानिनां हि वपुः सूक्ष्मं भवेत्प्रत्यक्षमैश्वरम् ||
text_mt: just as in a king's palace, so here too the ritualists are seen [to gain little]. / For meditators, indeed, the subtle, divine body becomes directly manifest;

sanskrit_iast:
yatheha karmiṇāṃ sthūlaṃ mṛtkāṣṭhādyaiḥ prakalpitam |
dhyānayajñaratāstasmāddevānpāṣāṇamṛṇmayān ||
meaning:
यथेह कर्मिणां स्थूलं मृत्काष्ठाद्यैः प्रकल्पितम् |
ध्यानयज्ञरतास्तस्माद्देवान्पाषाणमृण्मयान् ||
text_mt: just as here for the ritualists [the divine body] is gross, fashioned out of clay, wood, and the like. / Therefore, those devoted to the sacrifice of meditation do not excessively accept

sanskrit_iast:
nātyantaṃ pratipadyante śivayāthātmyavedanāt |
ātmasthaṃ yaḥ śivaṃ tyaktvā bahirabhyarcayennaraḥ ||
meaning:
नात्यन्तं प्रतिपद्यन्ते शिवयाथात्म्यवेदनात् |
आत्मस्थं यः शिवं त्यक्त्वा बहिरभ्यर्चयेन्नरः ||
text_mt: gods made of stone and clay, because of their knowledge of Śiva's true nature. / A person who, abandoning Śiva abiding within himself, worships him outside,

sanskrit_iast:
hastasthaṃ phalamutsṛjya lihetkūrparamātmanaḥ |
jñānāddhyānaṃ bhaveddhyānājjñānaṃ bhūyaḥ pravartate ||
meaning:
हस्तस्थं फलमुत्सृज्य लिहेत्कूर्परमात्मनः |
ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं भवेद्ध्यानाज्ज्ञानं भूयः प्रवर्तते ||
text_mt: is like one who casts away fruit in his hand and licks his own elbow. / From knowledge meditation arises; from meditation, knowledge proceeds again.

sanskrit_iast:
tadubhābhyāṃ bhavenmuktistasmāddhyānarato bhavet |
dvādaśānte tathā mūrdhni lalāṭe bhrūyugāntare ||
meaning:
तदुभाभ्यां भवेन्मुक्तिस्तस्माद्ध्यानरतो भवेत् |
द्वादशान्ते तथा मूर्ध्नि ललाटे भ्रूयुगान्तरे ||
text_mt: Liberation comes from both; therefore, one should be devoted to meditation. / At the [aperture] twelve digits above, or on the crown of the head, on the forehead, between the two eyebrows,

sanskrit_iast:
nāsāgre vā tathāsye vā kandhare hṛdaye tathā |
nābhau vā śāśvatasthāne śraddhāviddhena cetasā ||
meaning:
नासाग्रे वा तथास्ये वा कन्धरे हृदये तथा |
नाभौ वा शाश्वतस्थाने श्रद्धाविद्धेन चेतसा ||
text_mt: or at the tip of the nose, or in the mouth, in the neck, and in the heart, / or at the navel—in an eternal place—with a mind filled with faith,

sanskrit_iast:
bahiryāgopacāreṇa devaṃ devīṃ ca pūjayet |
athavā pūjayennityaṃ liṅge vā kṛtake'pi vā ||
meaning:
बहिर्यागोपचारेण देवं देवीं च पूजयेत् |
अथवा पूजयेन्नित्यं लिङ्गे वा कृतकेऽपि वा ||
text_mt: one should worship the God and the Goddess with external offerings of worship. / Or, one should continually worship in a liṅga, even an artificial one,

sanskrit_iast:
vahnau vā sthaṇḍile vātha bhaktyā vittānusārataḥ |
athavāntarbahiścaiva pūjayetparameśvaram |
antaryāgarataḥ pūjāṃ bahiḥ kurvīta vā na vā ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
वह्नौ वा स्थण्डिले वाथ भक्त्या वित्तानुसारतः |
अथवान्तर्बहिश्चैव पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् |
अन्तर्यागरतः पूजां बहिः कुर्वीत वा न वा ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
or in fire, or on an altar, with devotion according to one's wealth. / Or else, one should worship Parameśvara internally and externally. / Devoted to internal sacrifice, one may perform external worship, or may not.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
vyākhyāṃ pūjāvidhānasya pravadāmi samāsataḥ |
śivaśāstre śivenaiva śivāyai kathitasya tu ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
व्याख्यां पूजाविधानस्य प्रवदामि समासतः |
शिवशास्त्रे शिवेनैव शिवायै कथितस्य तु ||
title: trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | pūjāvidhāna vyākhyānavarṇanam
text_mt:
Chapter 23
Upamanyu said:
I shall explain concisely the exposition of the rule of worship

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgamabhyantaraṃ yāgamagnikāryāvasānakam |
vidhāya vā na vā paścād bahiryāgaṃ samācaret ||
meaning:
अङ्गमभ्यन्तरं यागमग्निकार्यावसानकम् |
विधाय वा न वा पश्चाद् बहिर्यागं समाचरेत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
tatra dravyāṇi manasā kalpayitvā viśodhya ca |
dhyātvā vināyakaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
meaning:
तत्र द्रव्याणि मनसा कल्पयित्वा विशोध्य च |
ध्यात्वा विनायकं देवं पूजयित्वा विधानतः ||
text_mt: having meditated upon Lord Vināyaka and worshipped [him] according to the rule,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe cottare caiva nandīśaṃ suyaśāṃ tathā |
ārādhya manasā samyagāsanaṃ kalpayedbudhaḥ ||
meaning:
दक्षिणे चोत्तरे चैव नन्दीशं सुयशां तथा |
आराध्य मनसा सम्यगासनं कल्पयेद्बुधः ||
text_mt: and on the right and on the left having properly revered with the mind / the lord of Nandin and Suyaśā, the wise man should envision a seat.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhanādikairyuktaḥ siṃhayogāsanādikam |
padmāsanaṃ vā vimalaṃ tattvatrayasamanvitam ||
meaning:
आराधनादिकैर्युक्तः सिंहयोगासनादिकम् |
पद्मासनं वा विमलं तत्त्वत्रयसमन्वितम् ||
text_mt: Accompanied by acts of adoration and the like, [he should envision] a lion-seat, yogic seat, or the like, / or a spotless lotus-seat endowed with the three principles.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopari śivaṃ dhyāyet sāmbaṃ sarvamanoharam |
sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ sarvāvayavaśobhanam ||
meaning:
तस्योपरि शिवं ध्यायेत् साम्बं सर्वमनोहरम् |
सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नं सर्वावयवशोभनम् ||
text_mt: Upon it he should meditate upon Śiva, accompanied by Ambā, captivating all, / endowed with all auspicious marks, handsome in all limbs,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātiśayasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam |
raktāsyapāṇicaraṇaṃ kundacandrasmitānanam ||
meaning:
सर्वातिशयसंयुक्तं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् |
रक्तास्यपाणिचरणं कुन्दचन्द्रस्मिताननम् ||
text_mt: endowed with all excellences, adorned with all ornaments, / with reddish mouth, hands, and feet, with a face smiling like a jasmine and the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ phullapadmatrilocanam |
caturbhujamudārāṅgaṃ cārucandrakalādharam ||
meaning:
शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं फुल्लपद्मत्रिलोचनम् |
चतुर्भुजमुदाराङ्गं चारुचन्द्रकलाधरम् ||
text_mt: resembling pure crystal, with three eyes like blossoming lotuses, / four-armed, of noble frame, bearing the lovely crescent moon,

sanskrit_iast:
varadābhayahastaṃ ca mṛgaṭaṅkadharaṃ haram |
bhujaṅgahāravalayaṃ cārunīlagalāntaram ||
meaning:
वरदाभयहस्तं च मृगटङ्कधरं हरम् |
भुजङ्गहारवलयं चारुनीलगलान्तरम् ||
text_mt: Hara, his hands granting boons and fearlessness, holding a deer and a chisel, / with serpents for necklace and bracelet, and a lovely dark throat,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvopamānarahitaṃ sānugaṃ saparicchadam |
tataḥ sañcintayettasya vāmabhāge maheśvarīm ||
meaning:
सर्वोपमानरहितं सानुगं सपरिच्छदम् |
ततः सञ्चिन्तयेत्तस्य वामभागे महेश्वरीम् ||
text_mt: beyond all comparison, accompanied by followers and retinue. / Then he should contemplate on his left side Maheśvarī,

sanskrit_iast:
praphullotpalapatrābhāṃ vistīrṇāyatalocanām |
pūrṇacandrābhavadanāṃ nīlakuñcitamūrdhajām ||
meaning:
प्रफुल्लोत्पलपत्राभां विस्तीर्णायतलोचनाम् |
पूर्णचन्द्राभवदनां नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजाम् ||
text_mt: resembling the petal of a blossoming blue lotus, with wide and elongated eyes, / with a face like the full moon, and dark curled hair,

sanskrit_iast:
nīlotpaladalaprakhyāṃ candrārddhakṛtaśekharām |
ativṛttaghanottuṅgasnigdhapīnapayodharām ||
meaning:
नीलोत्पलदलप्रख्यां चन्द्रार्द्धकृतशेखराम् |
अतिवृत्तघनोत्तुङ्गस्निग्धपीनपयोधराम् ||
text_mt: splendid like a blue-lotus petal, with the half-moon as her crest, / with very round, firm, high, glossy, and plump breasts,

sanskrit_iast:
tanumadhyāṃ pṛthuśroṇīṃ pītasūkṣmavarāmbarām |
sarvābharaṇasampannāṃ lalāṭatilakojjvalām ||
meaning:
तनुमध्यां पृथुश्रोणीं पीतसूक्ष्मवराम्बराम् |
सर्वाभरणसम्पन्नां ललाटतिलकोज्ज्वलाम् ||
text_mt: slender-waisted, with broad hips, clad in an exquisite thin yellow garment, / endowed with all ornaments, radiant with a tilaka on her forehead,

sanskrit_iast:
vicitrapuṣpasaṅkīrṇakeśapāśopaśobhitām |
sarvato'nuguṇākārāṃ kiñcillajjānatānanām ||
meaning:
विचित्रपुष्पसङ्कीर्णकेशपाशोपशोभिताम् |
सर्वतोऽनुगुणाकारां किञ्चिल्लज्जानताननाम् ||
text_mt: adorned with a mass of hair interwoven with various flowers, / well-proportioned in every way, her face slightly bowed with modesty,

sanskrit_iast:
hemāravindaṃ vilasaddadhānāṃ dakṣiṇe kare |
daṇḍavaccāparaṃ hastaṃ nyasyāsīnāṃ mahāsane ||
meaning:
हेमारविन्दं विलसद्दधानां दक्षिणे करे |
दण्डवच्चापरं हस्तं न्यस्यासीनां महासने ||
text_mt: holding a radiant golden lotus in her right hand, / and resting her other hand like a staff, seated upon the great seat,

sanskrit_iast:
pāśavicchedikāṃ sākṣātsaccidānandarūpiṇīm |
evaṃ devaṃ ca devīṃ ca dhyātvāsanavare śubhe ||
meaning:
पाशविच्छेदिकां साक्षात्सच्चिदानन्दरूपिणीम् |
एवं देवं च देवीं च ध्यात्वासनवरे शुभे ||
text_mt: the severer of fetters, whose form is direct existence, consciousness, and bliss. / Having thus meditated on the God and the Goddess on the auspicious, supreme seat,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvopacāravad bhaktyā bhāvapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet |
athavā parikalpyaivaṃ mūrtimanyatamāṃ vibhoḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वोपचारवद् भक्त्या भावपुष्पैः समर्चयेत् |
अथवा परिकल्प्यैवं मूर्तिमन्यतमां विभोः ||
text_mt: he should worship them with devotion with all offerings, using the flowers of contemplation. / Or, having thus imagined any one form of the Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
śaivīṃ sadāśivākhyāṃ vā tathā māheśvarīṃ parām |
ṣaḍviṃśakābhidhānāṃ vā śrīkaṇṭhākhyāmathāpi vā ||
meaning:
शैवीं सदाशिवाख्यां वा तथा माहेश्वरीं पराम् |
षड्विंशकाभिधानां वा श्रीकण्ठाख्यामथापि वा ||
text_mt: pertaining to Śiva, named Sadāśiva, or the supreme form of Maheśvara, / or designated as the Twenty-Sixth, or called Śrīkaṇṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
mantranyāsādikāṃścāpi kṛtvā svasyāṃ tanau yathā |
asyāṃ mūrtau mūrtimantaṃ śivaṃ sadasataḥ param ||
meaning:
मन्त्रन्यासादिकांश्चापि कृत्वा स्वस्यां तनौ यथा |
अस्यां मूर्तौ मूर्तिमन्तं शिवं सदसतः परम् ||
text_mt: and having performed the imposition of mantras and other rites upon his own body as prescribed, / he should meditate upon Śiva, endowed with form, beyond being and non-being, in this form;

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā bāhyakrameṇaiva pūjāṃ nirvarttayeddhiyā |
samidājyādibhiḥ paścānnābhau homaṃ ca bhāvayet ||
meaning:
ध्यात्वा बाह्यक्रमेणैव पूजां निर्वर्त्तयेद्धिया |
समिदाज्यादिभिः पश्चान्नाभौ होमं च भावयेत् ||
text_mt: and by means of intellect he should perform the worship following the external procedure itself. / Thereafter, he should contemplate an oblation at the navel with firewood, clarified butter, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrūmadhye ca śivaṃ dhyāyecchuddhadīpaśikhākṛtim |
itthamaṅge svatantre vā yoge dhyānamaye śubhe ||
meaning:
भ्रूमध्ये च शिवं ध्यायेच्छुद्धदीपशिखाकृतिम् |
इत्थमङ्गे स्वतन्त्रे वा योगे ध्यानमये शुभे ||
text_mt: And between the eyebrows he should meditate upon Śiva in the form of a pure lamp-flame. / Thus, whether in an auxiliary [ritual] or in an independent, auspicious meditation-based yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
agnikāryāvasānaṃ ca sarvatraiva samo vidhiḥ |
atha cintāmayaṃ sarvaṃ samāpyārādhanakramam ||
meaning:
अग्निकार्यावसानं च सर्वत्रैव समो विधिः |
अथ चिन्तामयं सर्वं समाप्याराधनक्रमम् ||
text_mt: the rule ending with the fire-ritual is identical everywhere. / Then, having completed the entire contemplative sequence of adoration,

sanskrit_iast:
liṅge ca pūjayeddevaṃ sthaṇḍile vānale'pi vā ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
लिङ्गे च पूजयेद्देवं स्थण्डिले वानलेऽपि वा ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
one should worship the God in a liṅga, on an altar, or in fire.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
prokṣayenmūlamantreṇa pūjāsthānaṃ viśuddhaye |
gandhacandanatoyena puṣpaṃ tatra vinikṣipet ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
प्रोक्षयेन्मूलमन्त्रेण पूजास्थानं विशुद्धये |
गन्धचन्दनतोयेन पुष्पं तत्र विनिक्षिपेत् ||
title: caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | śāstroktaśivapūjanavarṇanam
text_mt:
one should cast a flower there with water of fragrant sandalwood paste.
Having driven away obstacles with the weapon-mantra and veiled [the area] with the armor-mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
astreṇotsārya vai vighnānavaguṇṭhya ca varmaṇā |
astraṃ dikṣu pravinyasya kalpayedarcanābhuvam ||
meaning:
अस्त्रेणोत्सार्य वै विघ्नानवगुण्ठ्य च वर्मणा |
अस्त्रं दिक्षु प्रविन्यस्य कल्पयेदर्चनाभुवम् ||
text_mt:
and placed the weapon-mantra in the directions, one should arrange the ground of worship.
Having strewn darbha grass there, one should cleanse [the vessels] by sprinkling and other means;

sanskrit_iast:
tatra darbhānparistīrya kṣālayetprokṣaṇādibhiḥ |
saṃśodhya sarvapātrāṇi dravyaśuddhiṃ samācaret ||
meaning:
तत्र दर्भान्परिस्तीर्य क्षालयेत्प्रोक्षणादिभिः |
संशोध्य सर्वपात्राणि द्रव्यशुद्धिं समाचरेत् ||
text_mt:
having purified all the vessels, one should perform the purification of substances.
The sprinkling vessel and the arghya vessel, and after that the foot-washing vessel,

sanskrit_iast:
prokṣaṇīmarghyapātraṃ ca pādyapātramataḥ param |
tathaivācamanīyasya pātraṃ ceti catuṣṭayam ||
meaning:
प्रोक्षणीमर्घ्यपात्रं च पाद्यपात्रमतः परम् |
तथैवाचमनीयस्य पात्रं चेति चतुष्टयम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣālya prokṣya vīkṣyātha kṣipetteṣu jalaṃ śivam |
puṇyadravyāṇi sarvāṇi yathālābhaṃ vinikṣipet ||
meaning:
प्रक्षाल्य प्रोक्ष्य वीक्ष्याथ क्षिपेत्तेषु जलं शिवम् |
पुण्यद्रव्याणि सर्वाणि यथालाभं विनिक्षिपेत् ||
text_mt:
and likewise the vessel for sipping water: having washed, sprinkled, and inspected this tetrad, one should cast auspicious water into them.
One should cast into them all sacred substances as available: / jewels, silver, gold, fragrant flowers, unbroken grain, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnāni rajataṃ hema gandhapuṣpākṣatādayaḥ |
phalapallavadarbhāṃśca puṇyadravyāṇyanekadhā ||
meaning:
रत्नानि रजतं हेम गन्धपुष्पाक्षतादयः |
फलपल्लवदर्भांश्च पुण्यद्रव्याण्यनेकधा ||
text_mt:
fruits, tender shoots, and darbha grass—sacred substances of various kinds.
In the bath-water [one should put] fragrant substances and the like, and especially in drinking water

sanskrit_iast:
snānodake sugandhādi pānīye ca viśeṣataḥ |
śītalāni manojñānī kusumādīni nikṣipet ||
meaning:
स्नानोदके सुगन्धादि पानीये च विशेषतः |
शीतलानि मनोज्ञानी कुसुमादीनि निक्षिपेत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
uśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva pādye tu parikalpayet |
jātikaṅkolakarpūrabahumūlatamālakān ||
meaning:
उशीरं चन्दनं चैव पाद्ये तु परिकल्पयेत् |
जातिकङ्कोलकर्पूरबहुमूलतमालकान् ||

sanskrit_iast:
kṣipedācamanīye ca cūrṇayitvā viśeṣataḥ |
elāṃ pātreṣu sarveṣu karpūraṃ candanaṃ tathā ||
meaning:
क्षिपेदाचमनीये च चूर्णयित्वा विशेषतः |
एलां पात्रेषु सर्वेषु कर्पूरं चन्दनं तथा ||

sanskrit_iast:
kuśāgrāṇyakṣatāṃścaiva yavavrīhitilānapi |
ājyasiddhārthapuṣpāṇi bhasitaṃ cārghyapātrake ||
meaning:
कुशाग्राण्यक्षतांश्चैव यवव्रीहितिलानपि |
आज्यसिद्धार्थपुष्पाणि भसितं चार्घ्यपात्रके ||

sanskrit_iast:
kuśapuṣpayavavrīhibahumūlatamālakān |
prakṣipet prokṣaṇīpātre bhasitaṃ ca yathākramam ||
meaning:
कुशपुष्पयवव्रीहिबहुमूलतमालकान् |
प्रक्षिपेत् प्रोक्षणीपात्रे भसितं च यथाक्रमम् ||
text_mt: one should throw into the sprinkling vessel, and ash, in due order. / Having placed the mantra everywhere, having enveloped [it] externally with the armour [mantra],

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra mantraṃ vinyasya varmaṇāveṣṭya bāhyataḥ |
paścādastreṇa saṃrakṣya dhenumudrāṃ pradarśayet ||
meaning:
सर्वत्र मन्त्रं विन्यस्य वर्मणावेष्ट्य बाह्यतः |
पश्चादस्त्रेण संरक्ष्य धेनुमुद्रां प्रदर्शयेत् ||
text_mt: afterwards having protected [it] with the weapon [mantra], one should display the dhenumudrā. / All the articles of worship, with the water of the sprinkling vessel,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjādravyāṇi sarvāṇi prokṣaṇīpātravāriṇā |
samprokṣya mūlamantreṇa śodhayedvidhivattataḥ ||
meaning:
पूजाद्रव्याणि सर्वाणि प्रोक्षणीपात्रवारिणा |
सम्प्रोक्ष्य मूलमन्त्रेण शोधयेद्विधिवत्ततः ||

sanskrit_iast:
pātrāṇāṃ prokṣaṇīmekāmalābhe sarvakarmasu |
sādhayedarghyamadbhistatsāmānyaṃ sādhakottamaḥ ||
meaning:
पात्राणां प्रोक्षणीमेकामलाभे सर्वकर्मसु |
साधयेदर्घ्यमद्भिस्तत्सामान्यं साधकोत्तमः ||
text_mt: the excellent practitioner should prepare that general arghya with water. / Then, having worshipped the god Vināyaka in order with foods to be chewed and eaten,

sanskrit_iast:
tato vināyakaṃ devaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādibhiḥ kramāt |
pūjayitvā vidhānena dvārapārśve'tha dakṣiṇe ||
meaning:
ततो विनायकं देवं भक्ष्यभोज्यादिभिः क्रमात् |
पूजयित्वा विधानेन द्वारपार्श्वेऽथ दक्षिणे ||

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥpurādhipaṃ sākṣānnandinaṃ samyagarcayet |
cāmīkarācalaprakhyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ||
meaning:
अन्तःपुराधिपं साक्षान्नन्दिनं सम्यगर्चयेत् |
चामीकराचलप्रख्यं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
bālendumukuṭaṃ saumyaṃ trinetraṃ ca caturbhujam |
dīptaśūlamṛgīṭaṅkatigmavetradharaṃ prabhum ||
meaning:
बालेन्दुमुकुटं सौम्यं त्रिनेत्रं च चतुर्भुजम् |
दीप्तशूलमृगीटङ्कतिग्मवेत्रधरं प्रभुम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
candrabimbābhavadanaṃ harivaktramathāpi vā |
uttare dvārapārśvasya bhāryāṃ ca marutāṃ sutām ||
meaning:
चन्द्रबिम्बाभवदनं हरिवक्त्रमथापि वा |
उत्तरे द्वारपार्श्वस्य भार्यां च मरुतां सुताम् ||
text_mt: and on the northern side of the door, his wife, the daughter of the Maruts, / of good renown, of noble vows, the mother, devoted to adorning his feet.

sanskrit_iast:
suyaśāṃ suvratāmambāṃ pādamaṇḍanatatparām |
pūjayitvā praviśyāntarbhavanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ ||
meaning:
सुयशां सुव्रतामम्बां पादमण्डनतत्पराम् |
पूजयित्वा प्रविश्यान्तर्भवनं परमेष्ठिनः ||
text_mt: Having worshipped [them], having entered inside the residence of the Supreme Lord, / having worshipped the liṅga with those substances, one should remove the nirmālya.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjya liṅgaṃ tairdravyairnirmālyamapanodayet |
prakṣālya puṣpaṃ śirasi nyasettasya viśuddhaye ||
meaning:
सम्पूज्य लिङ्गं तैर्द्रव्यैर्निर्माल्यमपनोदयेत् |
प्रक्षाल्य पुष्पं शिरसि न्यसेत्तस्य विशुद्धये ||
text_mt: Having washed [it], one should place a flower upon its head for its purification. / With flower in hand, one should recite the mantra according to one's capacity for the purification of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpahasto japet śaktyā mantraṃ mantraviśuddhaye |
aiśānyāṃ caṇdamārādhya nirmālyaṃ tasya dāpayet ||
meaning:
पुष्पहस्तो जपेत् शक्त्या मन्त्रं मन्त्रविशुद्धये |
ऐशान्यां चण्दमाराध्य निर्माल्यं तस्य दापयेत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
kalpayedāsanaṃ paścādādhārādi yathākramam |
ādhāraśaktiṃ kalyāṇīṃ śyāmāṃ dhyāyedatho bhuvi ||
meaning:
कल्पयेदासनं पश्चादाधारादि यथाक्रमम् |
आधारशक्तिं कल्याणीं श्यामां ध्यायेदथो भुवि ||

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ purastādutkaṇṭhamanantaṃ kuṇḍalākṛtim |
dhavalaṃ pañcaphaṇinaṃ lelihānamivāmbaram ||
meaning:
तस्याः पुरस्तादुत्कण्ठमनन्तं कुण्डलाकृतिम् |
धवलं पञ्चफणिनं लेलिहानमिवाम्बरम् ||
text_mt:
In front of her, [he should meditate on] Ananta with his neck raised, coiled in shape,
white, five-hooded, as if licking the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyoparyāsanaṃ bhadraṃ kaṇṭhīravacatuṣpadam |
dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca padāni vai ||
meaning:
तस्योपर्यासनं भद्रं कण्ठीरवचतुष्पदम् |
धर्मो ज्ञानं च वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं च पदानि वै ||
text_mt:
Upon that is an auspicious seat with four lion legs:
Dharma, Jñāna, Vairāgya, and Aiśvarya are indeed its legs,

sanskrit_iast:
āgneyādiśvetaraktapītaśyāmāni varṇataḥ |
adharmādīni pūrvādīnyuttarāntānyanukramāt ||
meaning:
आग्नेयादिश्वेतरक्तपीतश्यामानि वर्णतः |
अधर्मादीनि पूर्वादीन्युत्तरान्तान्यनुक्रमात् ||
text_mt:
in order from the southeast: white, red, yellow, and dark in colour;
and Adharma and the rest [form the planks], beginning from the east and ending in the north in sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
rājāvartamaṇiprakhyānnyasya gātrāṇi bhāvayet |
asyordhvacchādanaṃ padmamāsanaṃ vimalaṃ sitam ||
meaning:
राजावर्तमणिप्रख्यान्न्यस्य गात्राणि भावयेत् |
अस्योर्ध्वच्छादनं पद्ममासनं विमलं सितम् ||
text_mt:
Having placed them resembling lapis lazuli gems, he should contemplate the frame;
its upper covering is a lotus seat, pure and white.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭapatrāṇi tasyāhuraṇimādiguṇāṣṭakam |
kesarāṇi ca vāmādyā rudrā vāmādiśaktibhiḥ ||
meaning:
अष्टपत्राणि तस्याहुरणिमादिगुणाष्टकम् |
केसराणि च वामाद्या रुद्रा वामादिशक्तिभिः ||
text_mt:
Its eight petals, they say, are the eight powers such as Aṇimā;
and the filaments are Vāmā and the others, the Rudras along with the powers Vāmā and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
bījānyapi ca tā eva śaktayontarmanonmanīḥ |
karṇikāparavairāgyaṃ nālaṃ jñānaṃ śivātmakam ||
meaning:
बीजान्यपि च ता एव शक्तयोन्तर्मनोन्मनीः |
कर्णिकापरवैराग्यं नालं ज्ञानं शिवात्मकम् ||
text_mt:
The seeds too are those very powers, and within is Manonmanī;
the pericarp is supreme dispassion, and the stalk is knowledge of the nature of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
kandaśca śivadharmātmā karṇikānte trimaṇḍale |
trimaṇḍaloparyātmāditattvatritayamāsanam ||
meaning:
कन्दश्च शिवधर्मात्मा कर्णिकान्ते त्रिमण्डले |
त्रिमण्डलोपर्यात्मादितत्त्वत्रितयमासनम् ||
text_mt:
The bulb is composed of Śiva's dharma; at the edge of the pericarp are the three discs;
above the three discs is the seat consisting of the triad of principles: the Self and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāsanopari sukhaṃ vicitrāstaraṇāstṛtam |
āsanaṃ kalpayeddivyaṃ śuddhavidyāsamujjvalam ||
meaning:
सर्वासनोपरि सुखं विचित्रास्तरणास्तृतम् |
आसनं कल्पयेद्दिव्यं शुद्धविद्यासमुज्ज्वलम् ||
text_mt:
Above every seat, he should arrange a celestial, comfortable seat
spread with a variegated cover, shining with pure wisdom.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhanaṃ sthāpanaṃ ca sannirodhaṃ nirīkṣaṇam |
namaskāraṃ ca kurvīta badhvā mudrāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ||
meaning:
आवाहनं स्थापनं च सन्निरोधं निरीक्षणम् |
नमस्कारं च कुर्वीत बध्वा मुद्राः पृथक्पृथक् ||
text_mt:
He should perform invocation, installation, containment, contemplation,
and salutation, forming the hand-gestures individually.

sanskrit_iast:
pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ tataḥ param |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dattvātha snāpayet śivau ||
meaning:
पाद्यमाचमनं चार्घ्यं गन्धं पुष्पं ततः परम् |
धूपं दीपं च ताम्बूलं दत्त्वाथ स्नापयेत् शिवौ ||
text_mt:
Having offered water for the feet, water for sipping, offering-water, perfume, flowers,
and after that, incense, a lamp, and betel, he should then bathe the two Śivas.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā parikalpyaivamāsanaṃ mūrtimeva ca |
sakalīkṛtya mūlena brahmabhiścāparaistathā ||
meaning:
अथवा परिकल्प्यैवमासनं मूर्तिमेव च |
सकलीकृत्य मूलेन ब्रह्मभिश्चापरैस्तथा ||
text_mt:
Or else, having thus arranged the seat and the form,
and having made them endowed with parts by means of the root mantra and the other Brahma mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayettato devyā śivaṃ paramakāraṇam |
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ devaṃ niścalamakṣaram ||
meaning:
आवाहयेत्ततो देव्या शिवं परमकारणम् |
शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं देवं निश्चलमक्षरम् ||
text_mt:
he should then invoke Śiva along with the Goddess, the ultimate cause,
the god resembling pure crystal, unmoving and imperishable,

sanskrit_iast:
kāraṇaṃ sarvalokānāṃ sarvalokamayaṃ param |
antarbahiḥsthitaṃ vyāpya hyaṇoraṇu mahattaram ||
meaning:
कारणं सर्वलोकानां सर्वलोकमयं परम् |
अन्तर्बहिःस्थितं व्याप्य ह्यणोरणु महत्तरम् ||
text_mt: standing within and without, having pervaded [everything], subtler than the subtle, greater [than the great],

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktānāmaprayatnena dṛśyamīśvaramavyayam |
brahmendraviṣṇurudrādyairapi devairagocaram ||
meaning:
भक्तानामप्रयत्नेन दृश्यमीश्वरमव्ययम् |
ब्रह्मेन्द्रविष्णुरुद्राद्यैरपि देवैरगोचरम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
devasāraṃ ca vidvadbhiragocaramiti śrutam |
ādimadhyāntarahitaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavarogiṇām ||
meaning:
देवसारं च विद्वद्भिरगोचरमिति श्रुतम् |
आदिमध्यान्तरहितं भेषजं भवरोगिणाम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
śivatattvamiti khyātaṃ śivārthaṃ jagati sthiram |
pañcopacāravadbhaktyā pūjayelliṅgamuttamam ||
meaning:
शिवतत्त्वमिति ख्यातं शिवार्थं जगति स्थिरम् |
पञ्चोपचारवद्भक्त्या पूजयेल्लिङ्गमुत्तमम् ||
text_mt: devoid of beginning, middle, and end, the medicine for those afflicted with the disease of worldly existence, / known as the Śiva-principle, established in the world for the sake of auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgamūrttirmaheśasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
snānakāle prakurvīta jayaśabdādimaṅgalam ||
meaning:
लिङ्गमूर्त्तिर्महेशस्य शिवस्य परमात्मनः |
स्नानकाले प्रकुर्वीत जयशब्दादिमङ्गलम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyaghṛtakṣīradadhimadhvādipūrvakaiḥ |
mūlaiḥ phalānāṃ sāraiśca tilasarṣapasaktubhiḥ ||
meaning:
पञ्चगव्यघृतक्षीरदधिमध्वादिपूर्वकैः |
मूलैः फलानां सारैश्च तिलसर्षपसक्तुभिः ||
text_mt:
At the time of bathing, one should perform auspicious acts such as shouts of victory, / with the five products of the cow, clarified butter, milk, curds, honey, and so forth foremost,
with roots, essences of fruits, sesamum, mustard, barley-meal, / with excellent seeds such as barley, and with flours produced from black gram and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
bījairyavādibhiśśastaiścūrṇairmāṣādisambhavaiḥ |
saṃsnāpyālipya piṣṭādyaiḥ snāpayeduṣṇavāribhiḥ ||
meaning:
बीजैर्यवादिभिश्शस्तैश्चूर्णैर्माषादिसम्भवैः |
संस्नाप्यालिप्य पिष्टाद्यैः स्नापयेदुष्णवारिभिः ||
text_mt: Having bathed [it], having anointed [it] with paste and the like, one should bathe [it] with hot water; / one should rub [it] with bilva leaves and the like to remove the smeared paste and odor.

sanskrit_iast:
gharṣayedbilvapatrādyairlepagandhāpanuttaye |
punaḥ saṃsnāpya salilaiścakravarttyupacārataḥ ||
meaning:
घर्षयेद्बिल्वपत्राद्यैर्लेपगन्धापनुत्तये |
पुनः संस्नाप्य सलिलैश्चक्रवर्त्त्युपचारतः ||

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhāmalakaṃ dadyād haridrāṃ ca yathākramam |
tataḥ saṃśodhya salilairliṅgaṃ beramathāpi vā ||
meaning:
सुगन्धामलकं दद्याद् हरिद्रां च यथाक्रमम् |
ततः संशोध्य सलिलैर्लिङ्गं बेरमथापि वा ||
text_mt:
he should offer fragrant myrobalan and turmeric in due order;
then, having cleansed the liṅga or the sculpted image with waters,

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayedgandhatoyena kuśapuṣpodakena ca |
hiraṇyaratnatoyaiśca mantrasiddhairyathākramam ||
meaning:
स्नापयेद्गन्धतोयेन कुशपुष्पोदकेन च |
हिरण्यरत्नतोयैश्च मन्त्रसिद्धैर्यथाक्रमम् ||
text_mt:
he should bathe it with fragrant water, with water of kuśa grass and flowers,
and with gold- and gem-water consecrated by mantras in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
asambhave tu dravyāṇāṃ yathāsambhavasambhṛtaiḥ |
kevalairmantratoyairvā snāpayecchraddhayā śivam ||
meaning:
असम्भवे तु द्रव्याणां यथासम्भवसम्भृतैः |
केवलैर्मन्त्रतोयैर्वा स्नापयेच्छ्रद्धया शिवम् ||
text_mt:
In the absence of the materials, however, with whatever is available,
or with mantra-consecrated water alone, he should bathe Śiva with faith.

sanskrit_iast:
kalaśenātha śaṅkhena varddhanyā pāṇinā tathā |
sakuśena sapuṣpeṇa snāpayenmantrapūrvakam ||
meaning:
कलशेनाथ शङ्खेन वर्द्धन्या पाणिना तथा |
सकुशेन सपुष्पेण स्नापयेन्मन्त्रपूर्वकम् ||
text_mt:
With a water-pot, a conch, a ritual vessel, or with the hand
holding kuśa grass and holding a flower, he should bathe [him] accompanied by mantras:

sanskrit_iast:
pavamānena rudreṇa nīlena tvaritena ca |
liṅgasūktādisūktaiśca śirasātharvaṇena ca ||
meaning:
पवमानेन रुद्रेण नीलेन त्वरितेन च |
लिङ्गसूक्तादिसूक्तैश्च शिरसाथर्वणेन च ||
text_mt:
with the Pavamāna hymn, the Rudra hymn, the Nīlarudra hymn, the Tvaritā hymn,
with hymns such as the Liṅgasūkta, and with the Atharvaśiras Upanishad,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgbhiśca sāmabhiḥ śaivairbrahmabhiścāpi pañcabhiḥ |
snāpayeddevadeveśaṃ śivena praṇavena ca ||
meaning:
ऋग्भिश्च सामभिः शैवैर्ब्रह्मभिश्चापि पञ्चभिः |
स्नापयेद्देवदेवेशं शिवेन प्रणवेन च ||
text_mt:
with Ṛgvedic verses, with Śaiva Sāman chants, and with the five Brahma mantras,
with the Śiva mantra, and with the syllable Oṃ, he should bathe the Lord of the gods of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā devasya devyāśca kuryātsnānādikaṃ tathā |
na tu kaścidviśeṣo'sti tatra tau sadṛśau yataḥ ||
meaning:
यथा देवस्य देव्याश्च कुर्यात्स्नानादिकं तथा |
न तु कश्चिद्विशेषोऽस्ति तत्र तौ सदृशौ यतः ||
text_mt:
As he would perform the bathing and other rites for the God, so he should perform them for the Goddess;
there is no difference between them, because they are equal.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ devamuddiśya kṛtvā snānādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
devyai praścātprakurvīta devadevasya śāsanāt ||
meaning:
प्रथमं देवमुद्दिश्य कृत्वा स्नानादिकाः क्रियाः |
देव्यै प्रश्चात्प्रकुर्वीत देवदेवस्य शासनात् ||
text_mt:
Having first performed the bath and other rites intended for the God,
he should perform them afterward for the Goddess, by order of the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
arddhanārīśvare pūjye paurvāparyaṃ na vidyate |
tatra tatropacārāṇāṃ liṅge vānyatra vā kvacit ||
meaning:
अर्द्धनारीश्वरे पूज्ये पौर्वापर्यं न विद्यते |
तत्र तत्रोपचाराणां लिङ्गे वान्यत्र वा क्वचित् ||
text_mt:
When worshipping Ardhanārīśvara, there is no sequence of before and after
with regard to the various offerings, whether in the liṅga or anywhere else.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā'bhiṣekaṃ liṅgasya śucinā ca sugandhinā |
sammṛjya vāsasā dadyādambaraṃ copavītakam ||
meaning:
कृत्वाऽभिषेकं लिङ्गस्य शुचिना च सुगन्धिना |
सम्मृज्य वाससा दद्यादम्बरं चोपवीतकम् ||
text_mt:
Having performed the ceremonial bath of the liṅga, and having wiped it
with a clean, fragrant cloth, he should offer garments and a sacred thread,

sanskrit_iast:
pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca bhūṣaṇam |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ pānīyaṃ mukhaśodhanam ||
meaning:
पाद्यमाचमनं चार्घ्यं गन्धं पुष्पं च भूषणम् |
धूपं दीपं च नैवेद्यं पानीयं मुखशोधनम् ||
text_mt:
water for the feet, water for sipping, offering-water, perfume, flowers, ornaments,
incense, a lamp, food offering, drinking water, and mouth-rinse,

sanskrit_iast:
punaścācamanīyaṃ ca mukhavāsaṃ tataḥ param |
mukuṭaṃ ca śubhaṃ bhadraṃ sarvaratnairalaṅkṛtam ||
meaning:
पुनश्चाचमनीयं च मुखवासं ततः परम् |
मुकुटं च शुभं भद्रं सर्वरत्नैरलङ्कृतम् ||
text_mt:
water for sipping once again, and after that, mouth perfume,
and an auspicious, splendid crown adorned with all kinds of jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣaṇāni pavitrāṇi mālyāni vividhāni ca |
vyajane cāmare chatraṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca darpaṇam ||
meaning:
भूषणानि पवित्राणि माल्यानि विविधानि च |
व्यजने चामरे छत्रं तालवृन्तं च दर्पणम् ||
text_mt:
pure ornaments, various garlands,
a fan, two fly-whisks, an umbrella, a palm-leaf fan, and a mirror.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā nīrājanaṃ kuryātsarvamaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ |
gītanṛtyādibhiścaiva jayaśabdasamanvitaḥ ||
meaning:
दत्त्वा नीराजनं कुर्यात्सर्वमङ्गलनिःस्वनैः |
गीतनृत्यादिभिश्चैव जयशब्दसमन्वितः ||
text_mt:
Having offered these, he should perform the waving of lights amid all kinds of auspicious sounds,
with singing and dancing, accompanied by shouts of victory.

sanskrit_iast:
haime ca rājate tāmre pātre vā mṛṇmaye śubhe |
padmakaiḥ śobhitaiḥ puṣpairbījairdadhyakṣatādibhiḥ ||
meaning:
हैमे च राजते ताम्रे पात्रे वा मृण्मये शुभे |
पद्मकैः शोभितैः पुष्पैर्बीजैर्दध्यक्षतादिभिः ||
text_mt:
On an auspicious vessel of gold, silver, copper, or earthenware,
beautified with lotus designs, flowers, seeds, curd, and unbroken rice grains,

sanskrit_iast:
triśūlaśaṅkhayugmābjanandyāvartaiḥ karīṣajaiḥ |
śrīvatsasvastikādarśavajrairvahnyādicihnitaiḥ ||
meaning:
त्रिशूलशङ्खयुग्माब्जनन्द्यावर्तैः करीषजैः |
श्रीवत्सस्वस्तिकादर्शवज्रैर्वह्न्यादिचिह्नितैः ||
text_mt:
marked with tridents, pairs of conches, lotuses, and nandyāvarta designs made of cow dung,
and with śrīvatsas, svastikas, mirrors, thunderbolts, and symbols of fire and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭau pradīpānparito vidhāyaikaṃ tu madhyame |
teṣu vāmādikāścintyāḥ pūjyāśca nava śaktayaḥ ||
meaning:
अष्टौ प्रदीपान्परितो विधायैकं तु मध्यमे |
तेषु वामादिकाश्चिन्त्याः पूज्याश्च नव शक्तयः ||
text_mt:
having placed eight lamps all around and one in the center,
in these the nine powers, Vāmā and the others, should be meditated upon and worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
kavacena samācchādya saṃrakṣyāstreṇa sarvataḥ |
dhenumudrāṃ ca sandarśya pāṇibhyāṃ pātramuddharet ||
meaning:
कवचेन समाच्छाद्य संरक्ष्यास्त्रेण सर्वतः |
धेनुमुद्रां च सन्दर्श्य पाणिभ्यां पात्रमुद्धरेत् ||
text_mt:
Having covered it with the Armour mantra, protected it on all sides with the Weapon mantra,
and displayed the Cow gesture, he should lift the vessel with both hands.

sanskrit_iast:
athavāropayetpātre pañcadīpānyathākramam |
vidikṣvapi ca madhye ca dīpamekamathāpi vā ||
meaning:
अथवारोपयेत्पात्रे पञ्चदीपान्यथाक्रमम् |
विदिक्ष्वपि च मध्ये च दीपमेकमथापि वा ||
text_mt:
Or else, he may place five lamps on the vessel in due order,
in the intermediate directions and in the center, or even a single lamp.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastatpātramuddhṛtya liṅgāderupari kramāt |
triḥpradakṣiṇayogena bhrāmayenmūlavidyayā ||
meaning:
ततस्तत्पात्रमुद्धृत्य लिङ्गादेरुपरि क्रमात् |
त्रिःप्रदक्षिणयोगेन भ्रामयेन्मूलविद्यया ||
text_mt: Then, lifting that vessel, in proper order above the liṅga and other [forms], / one should wave it three times clockwise with the root mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādarghyaṃ tato mūrdhni bhasitaṃ ca sugandhitam |
kṛtvā puṣpāñjaliṃ paścādupahārānnivedayet ||
meaning:
दद्यादर्घ्यं ततो मूर्ध्नि भसितं च सुगन्धितम् |
कृत्वा पुष्पाञ्जलिं पश्चादुपहारान्निवेदयेत् ||
text_mt: Then one should offer water for honouring upon the head, and fragrant ash; / having made an offering of flowers with folded hands, one should then present the offerings of food.

sanskrit_iast:
pānīyaṃ ca tato dadyāddattvā vācamanaṃ punaḥ |
pañca saugandhikopetaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayet ||
meaning:
पानीयं च ततो दद्याद्दत्त्वा वाचमनं पुनः |
पञ्च सौगन्धिकोपेतं ताम्बूलं च निवेदयेत् ||
text_mt: And one should then give drinking water, and having given water for sipping again, / one should present betel accompanied by the five aromatics.

sanskrit_iast:
prokṣayetprokṣaṇīyāni gānanāṭyāni kārayet |
liṅgādau śivayościntāṃ kṛtvā śaktyā japet śivam ||
meaning:
प्रोक्षयेत्प्रोक्षणीयानि गाननाट्यानि कारयेत् |
लिङ्गादौ शिवयोश्चिन्तां कृत्वा शक्त्या जपेत् शिवम् ||
text_mt: One should sprinkle the things to be sprinkled, and arrange songs and dances; / contemplating the two Śivas in the liṅga and other forms, one should recite the mantra of Śiva according to one's capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇaṃ praṇāmaṃ ca stavaṃ cātmasamarpaṇam |
vijñāpanaṃ ca kāryāṇāṃ kuryādvinayapūrvakam ||
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणं प्रणामं च स्तवं चात्मसमर्पणम् |
विज्ञापनं च कार्याणां कुर्याद्विनयपूर्वकम् ||
text_mt: One should perform circumambulation, prostration, praise, self-surrender, / and announcement of one's tasks, preceded by humility.

sanskrit_iast:
arghyaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā baddhvā mudrāṃ yathāvidhi |
paścātkṣamāpayeddevamudvāsyātmani cintayet ||
meaning:
अर्घ्यं पुष्पाञ्जलिं दत्त्वा बद्ध्वा मुद्रां यथाविधि |
पश्चात्क्षमापयेद्देवमुद्वास्यात्मनि चिन्तयेत् ||
text_mt: Having offered water for honouring and an offering of flowers with folded hands, and having formed the mudrā according to rule, / one should then ask the god's forgiveness, dismiss him, and meditate on him within oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
pādyādimukhavāsāntamarghyādyaṃ cātisaṅkaṭe |
puṣpavikṣepamātraṃ vā kuryādbhāvapuraḥsaram ||
meaning:
पाद्यादिमुखवासान्तमर्घ्याद्यं चातिसङ्कटे |
पुष्पविक्षेपमात्रं वा कुर्याद्भावपुरःसरम् ||
text_mt: In extreme difficulty, one may perform [the worship] from water for washing the feet up to mouth perfume, or starting with water for honouring, / or merely throwing flowers, accompanied by devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvataiva paro dharmo bhāvane sukṛto bhavet |
asampūjya na bhuñjīta śivamāprāṇasañcarāt ||
meaning:
तावतैव परो धर्मो भावने सुकृतो भवेत् |
असम्पूज्य न भुञ्जीत शिवमाप्राणसञ्चरात् ||
text_mt: By just that much, the highest duty is well accomplished in one's feeling. / As long as life-breath moves, one should not eat without having worshipped Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi pāpastu bhuñjīta svairaṃ tasya na niṣkṛtiḥ |
pramādena tu bhuṅkte cettadudgīrya prayatnataḥ ||
meaning:
यदि पापस्तु भुञ्जीत स्वैरं तस्य न निष्कृतिः |
प्रमादेन तु भुङ्क्ते चेत्तदुद्गीर्य प्रयत्नतः ||
text_mt: If a sinner should eat at his own will, there is no expiation for him; / but if he eats through heedlessness, having vomited it up with effort,

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā dviguṇamabhyarcya devaṃ devīmupoṣya ca |
śivasyāyutamabhyasyed brahmacaryapuraḥsaram ||
meaning:
स्नात्वा द्विगुणमभ्यर्च्य देवं देवीमुपोष्य च |
शिवस्यायुतमभ्यस्येद् ब्रह्मचर्यपुरःसरम् ||
text_mt: having bathed, worshipped the god and goddess twice over, and fasted, / he should repeat the mantra of Śiva ten thousand times, preceded by celibacy.

sanskrit_iast:
paredyuḥ śaktito dattvā suvarṇādyaṃ śivāya ca |
śivabhaktāya vā kṛtvā mahāpūjāṃ śucirbhavet ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
meaning:
परेद्युः शक्तितो दत्त्वा सुवर्णाद्यं शिवाय च |
शिवभक्ताय वा कृत्वा महापूजां शुचिर्भवेत् ||
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ||
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ||
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ||
text_mt:
On the next day, having given gold and the like to Śiva or to a devotee of Śiva according to his ability, / and having performed a great worship, he becomes pure.

Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyuruvāca |
anuktaṃ cātra pūjāyāḥ kramalopabhayādiva |
yattadanyatpravakṣyāmi samāsānna tu vistarāt ||
meaning:
उपमन्युरुवाच |
अनुक्तं चात्र पूजायाः क्रमलोपभयादिव |
यत्तदन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि समासान्न तु विस्तरात् ||
title: pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivaśāstroktapūjanavarṇanam
text_mt:
that other [matter] I shall declare concisely and not at length.
Prior to the offering of oblation, and immediately after the offering of lamps,

sanskrit_iast:
havirnivedanātpūrvaṃ dīpadānādanantaram |
kuryādāvaraṇābhyarcāṃ prāpte nīrājane'thavā ||
meaning:
हविर्निवेदनात्पूर्वं दीपदानादनन्तरम् |
कुर्यादावरणाभ्यर्चां प्राप्ते नीराजनेऽथवा ||
text_mt:
one should worship the surrounding deities, or else when the waving of lamps has arrived.
There, [the mantras] ending with Sadyojāta, beginning with Īśāna, and ending with Astra, beginning with Rudra,

sanskrit_iast:
tatreśānādisadyāntaṃ rudrādyastrāntameva ca |
śivasya vā śivāyāśca prathamāvaraṇe yajet ||
meaning:
तत्रेशानादिसद्यान्तं रुद्राद्यस्त्रान्तमेव च |
शिवस्य वा शिवायाश्च प्रथमावरणे यजेत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyāṃ pūrvabhāge ca dakṣiṇe cottare tathā |
paścime ca tathāgneyyāmaiśānyāṃ nairṛte tathā ||
meaning:
ऐशान्यां पूर्वभागे च दक्षिणे चोत्तरे तथा |
पश्चिमे च तथाग्नेय्यामैशान्यां नैरृते तथा ||
text_mt:
and in the west, and likewise in the southeast, in the northeast, likewise in the southwest,
in the northwest, and again in the northeast, and after that in the four cardinal directions.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavyāṃ punaraiśānyāṃ caturdikṣu tataḥ param |
garbhāvaraṇamākhyātaṃ mantrasaṅghātameva vā ||
meaning:
वायव्यां पुनरैशान्यां चतुर्दिक्षु ततः परम् |
गर्भावरणमाख्यातं मन्त्रसङ्घातमेव वा ||

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayādyastraparyantamathavāpi samarcayet |
tadbahiḥ pūrvataḥ śakraṃ yamaṃ dakṣiṇato yajet ||
meaning:
हृदयाद्यस्त्रपर्यन्तमथवापि समर्चयेत् |
तद्बहिः पूर्वतः शक्रं यमं दक्षिणतो यजेत् ||
text_mt:
Outside of that, the wise one should worship Śakra in the east, Yama in the south,
Varuṇa in the western quarter, and the Giver of Wealth in the north;

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇaṃ vāruṇe bhāge dhanadaṃ cottare budhaḥ |
īśamaiśe'nalaṃ svīye nairṛte nirṛtiṃ yajet ||
meaning:
वरुणं वारुणे भागे धनदं चोत्तरे बुधः |
ईशमैशेऽनलं स्वीये नैरृते निरृतिं यजेत् ||

sanskrit_iast:
mārute mārutaṃ viṣṇuṃ nairṛte vidhimaiśvare |
bahiḥpadmasya vajrādyānyābjāntānyāyudhānyapi ||
meaning:
मारुते मारुतं विष्णुं नैरृते विधिमैश्वरे |
बहिःपद्मस्य वज्राद्यान्याब्जान्तान्यायुधान्यपि ||

sanskrit_iast:
prasiddharūpāṇyāśāsu lokeśānāṃ kramādyajet |
devaṃ devīṃ ca samprekṣya sarvāvaraṇadevatāḥ ||
meaning:
प्रसिद्धरूपाण्याशासु लोकेशानां क्रमाद्यजेत् |
देवं देवीं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य सर्वावरणदेवताः ||
text_mt:
Outside the lotus, the weapons beginning with the thunderbolt and ending with the lotus,
possessing their well-known forms, one should worship in the quarters of the guardians of the worlds in order.
Gazing upon the God and the Goddess, all the deities of the enclosures
should be meditated upon with hands joined in supplication, seated comfortably.

sanskrit_iast:
baddhāñjalipuṭā dhyeyāḥ samāsīnā yathāsukham |
sarvāvaraṇadevānāṃ svābhidhānairnamoyutaiḥ ||
meaning:
बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा ध्येयाः समासीना यथासुखम् |
सर्वावरणदेवानां स्वाभिधानैर्नमोयुतैः ||
text_mt:
One should perform the worship of all the deities of the enclosures with flowers,
using their own names joined with 'namaḥ', having bowed down to all of them in proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaiḥ sampūjanaṃ kuryānnatvā sarvānyathākramam |
garbhāvaraṇamevāpi yajetsvāvaraṇena vā ||
meaning:
पुष्पैः सम्पूजनं कुर्यान्नत्वा सर्वान्यथाक्रमम् |
गर्भावरणमेवापि यजेत्स्वावरणेन वा ||

sanskrit_iast:
yoge dhyāne jape home bāhye vābhyantare'pi vā |
haviśca ṣaḍvidhaṃ deyaṃ śuddhaṃ mudgānnameva ca ||
meaning:
योगे ध्याने जपे होमे बाह्ये वाभ्यन्तरेऽपि वा |
हविश्च षड्विधं देयं शुद्धं मुद्गान्नमेव च ||
text_mt:
And food oblation of six kinds should be offered: pure rice, rice with mung beans,
milk-rice, mixed with yogurt, sweetened with molasses, and bathed in honey.

sanskrit_iast:
pāyasaṃ dadhisammiśraṃ gauḍaṃ ca madhunāplutam |
eteṣvekamanekaṃ vā nānāvyañjanasaṃyutam ||
meaning:
पायसं दधिसम्मिश्रं गौडं च मधुनाप्लुतम् |
एतेष्वेकमनेकं वा नानाव्यञ्जनसंयुतम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
guḍakhaṇḍānvitaṃ dadyānmathitaṃ dadhi cottamam |
bhakṣyāṇyapūpamukhyāni svādumanti phalāni ca ||
meaning:
गुडखण्डान्वितं दद्यान्मथितं दधि चोत्तमम् |
भक्ष्याण्यपूपमुख्यानि स्वादुमन्ति फलानि च ||
text_mt: One should give excellent churned curd accompanied by pieces of jaggery, / sweetmeats chief of which are cakes, and sweet fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
raktacandanapuṣpāḍhyaṃ pānīyaṃ cātiśītalam |
mṛdu elārasāktaṃ ca khaṇḍaṃ pūgaphalasya ca ||
meaning:
रक्तचन्दनपुष्पाढ्यं पानीयं चातिशीतलम् |
मृदु एलारसाक्तं च खण्डं पूगफलस्य च ||
text_mt: and very cool drinking water rich with red sandalwood and flowers, / soft pieces of betel nut mixed with cardamom juice,

sanskrit_iast:
dalāni nāgavallyāśca yuktāni khadirādibhiḥ |
gaurāṇi svarṇavarṇāni vihitāni śivāni ca |
śailameva sitaṃ cūrṇaṃ nātirūkṣaṃ na dūṣitam ||
meaning:
दलानि नागवल्ल्याश्च युक्तानि खदिरादिभिः |
गौराणि स्वर्णवर्णानि विहितानि शिवानि च |
शैलमेव सितं चूर्णं नातिरूक्षं न दूषितम् ||
text_mt: and betel leaves combined with catechu and the like, / pale, gold-coloured, prescribed and auspicious, / and white mineral powder, not too dry and not tainted.

sanskrit_iast:
karpūraṃ cātha kaṅkolaṃ jātyādi ca navaṃ śubham |
ālepanaṃ candanaṃ syānmūlakāṣṭhaṃ rajomayam ||
meaning:
कर्पूरं चाथ कङ्कोलं जात्यादि च नवं शुभम् |
आलेपनं चन्दनं स्यान्मूलकाष्ठं रजोमयम् ||
text_mt: And camphor, cubeb, and fresh, auspicious nutmeg and others; / the ointment should be sandalwood [paste] powdered from root wood,

sanskrit_iast:
kastūrikā kuṅkumaṃ ca raso mṛgamadātmakaḥ |
puṣpāṇi surabhīṇyeva pavitrāṇi śubhāni ca ||
meaning:
कस्तूरिका कुङ्कुमं च रसो मृगमदात्मकः |
पुष्पाणि सुरभीण्येव पवित्राणि शुभानि च ||
text_mt: musk, saffron, and deer-musk liquid; / flowers should be fragrant, pure, and auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
nirgandhānyugragandhāni dūṣitānyuṣitāni ca |
svayameva viśīrṇāni na deyāni śivārcane ||
meaning:
निर्गन्धान्युग्रगन्धानि दूषितान्युषितानि च |
स्वयमेव विशीर्णानि न देयानि शिवार्चने ||
text_mt: Scentless, harshly-scented, defiled, stale, / or withered on their own must not be given in the worship of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsāṃsi ca mṛdūnyeva tapanīyamayāni ca |
vidyudvalayakalpāni bhūṣaṇāni viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning:
वासांसि च मृदून्येव तपनीयमयानि च |
विद्युद्वलयकल्पानि भूषणानि विशेषतः ||
text_mt: And garments should be soft and made of gold, / ornaments especially resembling circles of lightning.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṇyetāni karpūraniryāsāgurucandanaiḥ |
ādhūpitāni puṣpaughairvāsitāni samantataḥ ||
meaning:
सर्वाण्येतानि कर्पूरनिर्यासागुरुचन्दनैः |
आधूपितानि पुष्पौघैर्वासितानि समन्ततः ||
text_mt: All these should be fumigated with camphor, resin, aloe, and sandalwood, / and perfumed on all sides with heaps of flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
candanāgurukarpūrakāṣṭhaguggulucūrṇakaiḥ |
ghṛtena madhunā caiva siddho dhūpaḥ praśasyate ||
meaning:
चन्दनागुरुकर्पूरकाष्ठगुग्गुलुचूर्णकैः |
घृतेन मधुना चैव सिद्धो धूपः प्रशस्यते ||
text_mt: Incense prepared with powders of sandalwood, aloe, camphor wood, and bdellium, / along with clarified butter and honey, is commended.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāsambhavenaiva ghṛtenātisugandhinā |
nityaṃ pradīpitā dīpāḥ śastāḥ karpūrasaṃyutāḥ ||
meaning:
कपिलासम्भवेनैव घृतेनातिसुगन्धिना |
नित्यं प्रदीपिता दीपाः शस्ताः कर्पूरसंयुताः ||
text_mt: Lamps constantly lit with clarified butter from a tawny cow, / exceedingly fragrant and combined with camphor, are recommended.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyaṃ ca madhuraṃ payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā |
kapilāsambhavaṃ śambhoriṣṭaṃ snāne ca pānake ||
meaning:
पञ्चगव्यं च मधुरं पयो दधि घृतं तथा |
कपिलासम्भवं शम्भोरिष्टं स्नाने च पानके ||
text_mt: Sweet fivefold cow products, as well as milk, curd, and clarified butter / coming from a tawny cow, are desired by Śambhu for bathing and drinking.

sanskrit_iast:
āsanāni ca bhadrāṇi gajadantamayāni ca |
suvarṇaratnayuktāni citrāṇyāstaraṇāni ca ||
meaning:
आसनानि च भद्राणि गजदन्तमयानि च |
सुवर्णरत्नयुक्तानि चित्राण्यास्तरणानि च ||
text_mt: And seats should be splendid, made of ivory, / endowed with gold and jewels, and with variegated coverings,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdūpadhānayuktāni sūkṣmatūlamayāni ca |
uccāvacāni ramyāṇi śayanāni sukhāni ca ||
meaning:
मृदूपधानयुक्तानि सूक्ष्मतूलमयानि च |
उच्चावचानि रम्याणि शयनानि सुखानि च ||
text_mt: provided with soft cushions and made of fine cotton, / beds of varied heights, delightful and comfortable.

sanskrit_iast:
nadyaḥ samudragāminyā nadādvāmbhaḥ samāhṛtam |
śītañca vastrapūtaṃ tadviśiṣṭaṃ snānapānayoḥ ||
meaning:
नद्यः समुद्रगामिन्या नदाद्वाम्भः समाहृतम् |
शीतञ्च वस्त्रपूतं तद्विशिष्टं स्नानपानयोः ||
text_mt: Water fetched from a river flowing to the ocean or from a stream, / cold and purified by cloth, is superior for bathing and drinking.

sanskrit_iast:
chatraṃ śaśinibhaṃ cāru muktādāmavirājitam |
navaratnacitaṃ divyaṃ hemadaṇḍamanoharam ||
meaning:
छत्रं शशिनिभं चारु मुक्तादामविराजितम् |
नवरत्नचितं दिव्यं हेमदण्डमनोहरम् ||
text_mt: An umbrella radiant like the moon, beautiful, adorned with strings of pearls, / inlaid with the nine gems, divine, with an enchanting golden shaft;

sanskrit_iast:
cāmare ca site sūkṣme cāmīkarapariṣkṛte |
rājahaṃsadvayākāre ratnadaṇḍopaśobhite ||
meaning:
चामरे च सिते सूक्ष्मे चामीकरपरिष्कृते |
राजहंसद्वयाकारे रत्नदण्डोपशोभिते ||
text_mt: and two white, fine chowries, ornamented with gold, / having the appearance of a pair of royal swans, beautified by jewelled handles;

sanskrit_iast:
darpaṇaṃ cāpi susnigdhaṃ divyagandhānulepanam |
samantādratnasañchannaṃ sragvaraiścāpi bhūṣitam ||
meaning:
दर्पणं चापि सुस्निग्धं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् |
समन्ताद्रत्नसञ्छन्नं स्रग्वरैश्चापि भूषितम् ||
text_mt: and a mirror that is very smooth, anointed with divine perfume, / covered all around with jewels, and decorated with excellent garlands;

sanskrit_iast:
gambhīraninadaḥ śaṅkho haṃsakundendusannibhaḥ |
āsyapṛṣṭhādideśeṣu ratnacāmīkarācitaḥ ||
meaning:
गम्भीरनिनदः शङ्खो हंसकुन्देन्दुसन्निभः |
आस्यपृष्ठादिदेशेषु रत्नचामीकराचितः ||
text_mt: a conch of deep sound, resembling a swan, jasmine, and the moon, / inlaid with jewels and gold at its mouth, back, and other parts;

sanskrit_iast:
kāhalāni ca ramyāṇi nānānādakarāṇi ca |
suvarṇanirmitānyeva mauktikālaṅkṛtāni ca ||
meaning:
काहलानि च रम्याणि नानानादकराणि च |
सुवर्णनिर्मितान्येव मौक्तिकालङ्कृतानि च ||
text_mt: and charming large horns producing varied sounds, / made of gold and adorned with pearls;

sanskrit_iast:
bherīmṛdaṅgamurajatimicchapaṭahādayaḥ |
samudrakalpasannādāḥ kalpanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ ||
meaning:
भेरीमृदङ्गमुरजतिमिच्छपटहादयः |
समुद्रकल्पसन्नादाः कल्पनीयाः प्रयत्नतः ||
text_mt: kettledrums, mṛdaṅgas, murajas, timicchas, paṭahas, and others, / with a resounding roar resembling the ocean, should be prepared with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāṇḍānyapi ca ramyāṇi pātrāṇyapi ca kṛtsnaśaḥ |
tadādhārāṇi sarvāṇi sauvarṇānyeva sādhayet ||
meaning:
भाण्डान्यपि च रम्याणि पात्राण्यपि च कृत्स्नशः |
तदाधाराणि सर्वाणि सौवर्णान्येव साधयेत् ||
text_mt: and one should provide all their bases made entirely of gold.

sanskrit_iast:
ālayaṃ ca maheśasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
rājāvasathavatkalpyaṃ śilpaśāstroktalakṣaṇam ||
meaning:
आलयं च महेशस्य शिवस्य परमात्मनः |
राजावसथवत्कल्प्यं शिल्पशास्त्रोक्तलक्षणम् ||
text_mt:
And the temple of the Great Lord, Śiva, the Supreme Self,
should be constructed like a royal palace, possessing the characteristics taught in architectural treatises,
with a high surrounding wall, and a gateway resembling a mountain,

sanskrit_iast:
uccaprākārasambhinnaṃ bhūdharākāragopuram |
anekaratnasañcchannaṃ hemadvārakapāṭakam ||
meaning:
उच्चप्राकारसम्भिन्नं भूधराकारगोपुरम् |
अनेकरत्नसञ्च्छन्नं हेमद्वारकपाटकम् ||

sanskrit_iast:
taptajāmbūnadamayaṃ ratnastambhaśatāvṛtam |
muktādāmavitānāḍhyaṃ vidrumadvāratoraṇam ||
meaning:
तप्तजाम्बूनदमयं रत्नस्तम्भशतावृतम् |
मुक्तादामवितानाढ्यं विद्रुमद्वारतोरणम् ||
text_mt:
covered with numerous gems, with door-panels of gold,
made of refined gold, enclosed by hundreds of jewel-pillars,

sanskrit_iast:
cāmīkaramayairdivyairmukuṭaiḥ kumbhalakṣaṇaiḥ |
alaṅkṛtaśirobhāgamastrarājena cihnitam ||
meaning:
चामीकरमयैर्दिव्यैर्मुकुटैः कुम्भलक्षणैः |
अलङ्कृतशिरोभागमस्त्रराजेन चिह्नितम् ||
text_mt:
rich with canopies of pearl strands, with coral archways over the doors,
with divine golden spires marked like water jars,

sanskrit_iast:
rājanyārhanivāsaiśca rājavīthyādiśobhitaiḥ |
procchritaprāṃśuśikharaiḥ prāsādaiśca samantataḥ ||
meaning:
राजन्यार्हनिवासैश्च राजवीथ्यादिशोभितैः |
प्रोच्छ्रितप्रांशुशिखरैः प्रासादैश्च समन्ततः ||
text_mt:
its pinnacle adorned, marked by the King of Weapons,
with residences fit for royalty and beautified with royal avenues and the like,
with mansions all around possessing towering high pinnacles,
and with choice council chambers situated in the cardinal and intermediate directions,

sanskrit_iast:
āsthānasthānavaryaiśca sthitairdikṣu vidikṣu ca |
atyantālaṅkṛtaprāntamantarāvaraṇairiva ||
meaning:
आस्थानस्थानवर्यैश्च स्थितैर्दिक्षु विदिक्षु च |
अत्यन्तालङ्कृतप्रान्तमन्तरावरणैरिव ||

sanskrit_iast:
uttamastrīsahasraiśca nṛtyageyaviśāradaiḥ |
veṇuvīṇāvidagdhaiśca puruṣairbahubhiryutam ||
meaning:
उत्तमस्त्रीसहस्रैश्च नृत्यगेयविशारदैः |
वेणुवीणाविदग्धैश्च पुरुषैर्बहुभिर्युतम् ||
text_mt:
with inner precincts highly decorated as if by inner enclosures,
with thousands of noble women skilled in dancing and singing,
and filled with many men proficient with the flute and vīṇā,
guarded by heroic guards accompanied by elephants, horses, and chariots,

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣitaṃ rakṣibhirvīrairgajavājirathānvitaiḥ |
anekapuṣpavāṭībhiranekaiśca sarovaraiḥ ||
meaning:
रक्षितं रक्षिभिर्वीरैर्गजवाजिरथान्वितैः |
